entries.translated_prompt: Generate an 11-second cinematic live-action short video in 9:16 vertical format. The character's features, hairstyle, body proportions, and costume before the transformation must strictly refer to @BeforeTransformationCharacterImage. The character's features, hairstyle, body proportions, and costume after the transformation must strictly refer to @AfterTransformationCharacterImage. The person before and after must clearly be the same individual in two different styling states. Maintain consistency in facial features, face shape, age, and identity. The sword, hilt, scabbard, blade length, material, and patterns after transformation must strictly refer to @SwordReferenceImage. The sword must remain consistent in the second half, with no changes in length, hilt, or scabbard appearance. No background music; all ambient, action, and weapon sounds must be synchronized with movements. Overall direction: The video follows a continuous structure: everyday movement -> broom swinging -> movement stabilization -> pose matching -> instant transformation -> unsheathing sword -> heroic character display. The first half has a casual mobile video feel, while the second half is a cinematic martial arts display. The climax is driven by a Match Cut transformation and the sound of unsheathing the sword. No body melting, particle growth, lightning, or slow morphing effects during transformation. 0.0–0.7s: Low-angle start showing the ground, legs, shoes, and a long broom in the foreground. The character grips the broom handle. The camera tilts up and slightly pulls back with realistic handheld shake. Ambient sounds include wind, birds, and the broom dragging on gravel. 0.7–1.4s: The character steps forward, swinging the broom like a staff. The camera retreats slightly, stabilizing at a waist-level view. Sound: broom slicing air (whoosh) and footstep sounds. 1.4–2.1s: The character rotates the broom around their body. The camera adjusts slightly to keep the action centered. Sound: intensified air-cutting sounds (whoosh, fwoosh). 2.1–2.9s: High broom rotation passing over the head with realistic human inertia. No broom clipping through the body. Horizontal camera follow. Sound: spatialized air-cutting sounds. 2.9–3.7s: Movement slows. The character brings the broom to their side and lifts a knee to balance. Sound: fabric friction and hand-sliding sounds. 3.7–4.7s: The lifted leg extends sideways in a playful posture. The broom is held nearly vertically. Reduced camera movement. Sound: handle creaks and clothing rustles. 4.7–5.6s: Stabilizing in a 3/4 profile posture, establishing a clear silhouette for the Match Cut. Near-fixed shot with handheld breathing. 5.6–6.30s: Further stabilization. The character remains in the @BeforeTransformation pose. Ambient sounds fade into a brief silence before the climax. 6.30–6.45s: Transformation via Hard Match Cut to the @AfterTransformation styling. Environment changes to a cinematic forest/mountain path. Position and posture remain consistent between frames. Sound: short low-frequency thump (THUMP/BOOM), air shock (WHOOMP), and fabric snap (FLAP). 6.45–6.65s: Transformation complete. The character adjusts their center of gravity and drops their leg into a powerful stance. One hand approaches the sword hilt. 6.65–7.35s: The core action of unsheathing the sword. Hand grips the hilt, blade slides out of the scabbard realistically along its axis. No magic appearances or clipping. Sound: creak -> shrrrk -> SHHHHK -> SHING! The unsheathing sound is perfectly synchronized with the movement. 7.35–7.60s: Brief silence after the blade is out, retaining the metallic resonance (SHING—). 7.6–8.3s: The character moves the sword into a final display position with a crisp arc. The character looks toward the camera. Sound: sharp sword wind (SWISH—) and clothing rustles. 8.3–9.3s: Heroic display phase. The camera begins a very slow push-in. Gaze turns cold. Natural forest sounds resume. 9.3–10.2s: Final hero posture with calm, imposing gaze. Gaze direct or distant. Continual slow camera push-in with handheld breathing. 10.2–10.93s: Final frozen pose with realistic breathing and slight wind effects on clothes/hair. Frame ends directly. Final sound: faint wind and metallic after-vibes. Camera plan: 0-1.4s low-angle tilt/retreat; 1.4-3s full-body tracking; 3-6.3s stabilization for Match Cut; 6.3s Hard Cut; 6.4-7.4s stabilized unsheathing; 7.5-10.93s slow push-in to hero shot. Continuity constraints: Strictly separate pre- and post-transform styling with one clear cut point. Broom and sword must maintain physical logic and reference images throughout. Sound must be synchronized and realistic, avoiding BGM or anime effects.

entries.title: Woman Riding Ice Dragon
entries.description: A fantasy video prompt of a woman riding a white ice dragon over snowy mountains and frozen rivers.
entries.prompt: Use the uploaded reference image as the exact character reference. Keep the same face, hair, outfit and appearance throughout. entries.description: An incredibly detailed documentary-style prompt for Seedance 2.5 to recreate a nostalgic 1985 Japanese summer day through a home video lens.
entries.prompt:
【概要】1985年、田舎の祖父母の家で夏休みを過ごす10歳の男の子の1日。帰省中の若い叔父が家庭用ビデオカメラで、声をかけずに離れた場所から記録している。480p、16:9、15秒。7ショット（各約2秒）のハードカットで、7か所すべて別の場所。トランジションやフェードは使わない。被写体はカメラに向かって何もしない：目線を送らない、物を見せない、手を振らない、ポーズを取らない。遊びに没頭している。演技ではなく、日常の途中を切り取った断片。会話・セリフ・ナレーションは一切なし。

【被写体】美貌の定義：将来ハンサムになると誰もが言う、子役級の日本人の美少年。水に入った瞬間の子どもの顔が一番いい。顔：短い黒髪に寝癖、太い眉、切れ長できりっとした二重の目、日焼けで鼻の頭の皮がむけている（現実的な肌の質感）、白い歯、あごに小さなかさぶた。服（普段着）：白いランニングシャツ（洗いざらしで少し黄ばんでいる）、緑の半ズボン、麦わら帽子（つばがほつれている）、首に白いタオル、素足にゴム草履。仕草の癖：帽子を後ろにずらす、弟をちらっと見る。全ショットで顔・髪・服装が完全に同一。

【登場人物】弟（6歳）：まん丸の顔、坊主頭、白いランニングと赤い半ズボン。兄のやることを全部真似する。怖がり。誰もカメラを見ない。

【時代・場所・光】1985年8月の田舎。①古い日本家屋の縁側（朝の光、緑色の渦巻き型の蚊取り線香から細い煙、卵かけご飯）②田んぼのあぜ道（真夏の白い光、自転車）③川の浅瀬（きらめく水面）④川の岩場（小さな岩から浅瀬へ）⑤川原の石の上（スイカ、強い日差し）⑥神社の境内の木（木漏れ日、セミ）⑦夕方の縁側（線香花火：細いこよりの先で小さな火の玉がぱちぱちと火花を散らす手持ち花火。青い夕闇）。看板・文字は画面に入れない。

【カメラ】1985年の家庭用ビデオカメラの質感：色がにじみ、解像度が低く、水面の反射が白飛びし、輪郭が甘い。日付表示は出さない。手持ち、自然な揺れ、不完全な構図、ズームの迷い、露出のゆらぎ。被写体から3〜6mの距離。被写体はカメラを気にしない。スタビライズ、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画的照明、商業カラーグレーディングはなし。カメラは常に撮影者が手に持っている位置（立つ・座る・しゃがむ・歩きながら・隣の席から）から撮る。人がいられない場所（空中・水中・天井・真上・車の外から走る車内・被写体の目の前数センチ等）からのアングルは使わない。撮影者は同じ空間に確かにいる一人の人として、被写体が動けば少し遅れて追い、ときどき構図が甘くなる。

【ショット】（各約2秒。各行＝場所・光／没頭していること／内側の感情と、それが漏れる小さなしぐさ／カメラ位置）
1. 縁側・朝。卵かけご飯を急いでかきこんでいる。目はもう庭の先を見ている。感情：早く川に行きたい。蚊取り線香の煙が横に流れる。カメラ：縁側の外から。
2. あぜ道・自転車。弟を荷台に乗せて立ちこぎ。口を真一文字に結んで前を見る。感情：兄貴風の頼もしさ。風で帽子が後ろにずれる。カメラ：後ろから追う、揺れる。
3. 川の浅瀬。腰まで浸かって網を構え、息を止めて魚を見つめる。感情：集中。弟が後ろでじっとしている。カメラ：岸から、水面の反射が白飛び。
4. 岩場。小さな岩から浅瀬へ飛び込み、水しぶきの中から顔を上げて大笑い。感情：解放感、爽快。カメラ：岸から少し離れて、しぶきが画面にかかる。
5. 川原の石の上・スイカ。かぶりついて、種を遠くへ飛ばし、弟をちらっと見てにやりとする。感情：競争心。カメラ：横から、強い日差し。
6. 神社の木・木漏れ日。虫取り網で捕まえたセミを弟の目の前に突き出し、仰け反る弟を見て大笑い。感情：いたずら心。カメラ：弟の後ろから。
7. 縁側・夕方。線香花火の火の玉を真剣な目で見つめ、落ちた瞬間、消えた先をしばらく見つめている。感情：一日が終わる小さな寂しさ。カメラ：縁側の端に座って横から。その途中、およそ00:14で録画は突然ブラックアウトに切り替わる。フェードアウトなし。

【小物・道具のディテール】網は竹の柄に緑の網。自転車は黒い実用車で荷台つき。麦わら帽子はつばがほつれている。スイカは縞で、皮の近くまで食べる。蚊取り線香は緑の渦巻きで陶器の豚の入れ物に入っている。線香花火はこよりの先に赤い紙。

【文字の禁止】画面内に読める文字・ロゴ・看板・ラベル・数字を一切出さない。

【物理・一貫性】現実世界の物理。余分な指、融合した手、歪んだ解剖学、浮遊物、消える物体、突然の変形はなし。水しぶき、濡れた髪と服、火花は現実的に。足は地面に接地。麦わら帽子、タオル、弟の服装は全ショットで同じ。

【音】自然な環境音のみ（ショットごとに切り替わる）：茶碗の音、自転車のチェーンと風、川の流れ、飛び込みの水音、スイカをかじる音、セミの大合唱、線香花火のぱちぱち。言葉は一切なし。撮影者のときどきの小さな笑い声・息づかいと、被写体の笑い声・息づかいのみ可。音楽なし。ナレーションなし。人工的な音響効果なし。

【雰囲気】大人が見て「こういう夏休みがあった」と思う、昭和の田舎の少年のなんでもない1日の記録。演技ではなく、遊びの途中の断片。懐かしく、まぶしく、深く人間的. カメラがたまたまそこにあったような感じを優先。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Overview] A day in the life of a 10-year-old boy spending his summer vacation at his grandparents' rural home in 1985. A young uncle visiting home records with a handheld video camera from a distance without speaking. 480p, 16:9, 15 seconds. 7 shots (approx. 2s each) with hard cuts; all 7 locations are different. No transitions or fades. The subject does nothing for the camera: no eye contact, no showing objects, no waving, no posing. Immersed in play. Fragments cut from the middle of daily life, not acting. No dialogue, lines, or narration.

[Subject] Definition of beauty: A Japanese boy of child-actor caliber whom everyone says will be handsome in the future. A child's face the moment they enter water is best. Face: short black hair with bedhead, thick eyebrows, sharp double-lidded eyes, peeling skin on the bridge of the nose from sunburn (realistic skin texture), white teeth, a small scab on the chin. Clothing (everyday wear): white tank top (slightly yellowed from washing), green shorts, straw hat (frayed brim), white towel around the neck, bare feet in rubber sandals. Habits: pushing the hat back, glancing at the younger brother. Face, hair, and clothing are identical in all shots.

[Characters] Younger brother (6 years old): round face, buzzed head, white tank top and red shorts. Mimics everything the older brother does. Easily scared. No one looks at the camera.

[Era, Place, Light] Rural countryside in August 1985. 1) Veranda of an old Japanese house (morning light, thin smoke from a green coil mosquito repellent, rice with raw egg) 2) Rice field path (midsummer white light, bicycle) 3) Shallow river (sparkling water surface) 4) River rocks (jumping from a small rock to the shallows) 5) On a riverbank stone (watermelon, strong sunlight) 6) Tree in a shrine precinct (dappled sunlight, cicadas) 7) Veranda in the evening (sparkler firework: a small ball of fire sparking at the end of a thin paper twist. Blue twilight). No signs or text in the frame.

[Camera] 1985 home video camera texture: bleeding colors, low resolution, blown-out highlights on water reflections, soft outlines. No date display. Handheld, natural shake, imperfect composition, hunting zoom, exposure fluctuations. 3-6m distance from subject. Subject ignores the camera. No stabilization, gimbals, drones, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading. The camera is always at the height of a person holding it (standing, sitting, crouching, walking, next seat). No angles from places a person couldn't be. The filmer is a person clearly in the same space, following slightly late when the subject moves, occasionally with soft framing.

[Shots] (Approx. 2s each. Each line = Location & Light / Activity / Inner emotion and small leaked gestures / Camera position)
1. Veranda/Morning. Hurriedly eating rice with egg. Eyes already on the garden ahead. Emotion: Wanting to get to the river fast. Mosquito coil smoke drifts sideways. Camera: From outside the veranda.
2. Path/Bicycle. Standing to pedal with the brother on the back. Mouth set in a firm line looking ahead. Emotion: Reliable older brother vibe. Hat slips back in the wind. Camera: Following from behind, shaking.
3. Shallows. Submerged to the waist with a net, holding breath staring at fish. Emotion: Concentration. Brother still behind. Camera: From the bank, water reflections blown out.
4. Rocks. Diving from a small rock into the shallows, laughing loudly with face rising from splashing water. Emotion: Sense of liberation, refreshment. Camera: Slightly away from the bank, spray hits the screen.
5. Bank stone/Watermelon. Biting in, spitting seeds far, glancing at the brother with a smirk. Emotion: Competitiveness. Camera: From the side, strong sunlight.
6. Shrine tree/Dappled light. Thrusting a cicada caught in a net in front of the brother, laughing at him recoil. Emotion: Mischievousness. Camera: From behind the brother.
7. Veranda/Evening. Staring seriously at the fire ball of a sparkler, watching the spot it vanished after falling. Emotion: Small loneliness at the end of the day. Camera: Sitting at the edge of the veranda from the side. During this, at approx 00:14, the recording suddenly blacks out. No fade out.

[Prop Details] Net has a bamboo handle with green mesh. Bicycle is a black utility bike with a carrier. Straw hat brim is frayed. Watermelon is striped, eaten close to the rind. Mosquito coil is a green spiral in a ceramic pig holder. Sparkler has red paper at the tip of the twist.

[Prohibition of Text] No readable text, logos, signs, labels, or numbers on screen.

[Physics & Consistency] Real-world physics. No extra fingers, fused hands, distorted anatomy, floating objects, vanishing items, or sudden deformations. Splashes, wet hair/clothes, and sparks should be realistic. Feet grounded. Hat, towel, and brother's clothes same in all shots.

[Sound] Only natural ambient sounds (switches per shot): clinking of a rice bowl, bicycle chain and wind, river flow, splash of diving, biting watermelon, cicada chorus, crackling of sparklers. No words. Occasional small laughter/breaths from the filmer and subject allowed. No music, no narration, no artificial sound effects.

[Atmosphere] A record of a nondescript day of a boy in Showa-era countryside that makes adults feel 'I had a summer like this.' Fragments of play, not acting. Nostalgic, bright, deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that a camera just happened to be there.

entries.title: UGC Skincare Selfie Vlog
entries.description: A realistic user-generated content prompt for a skincare routine, focusing on product interaction and an intimate bedroom setting.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps ultra-photorealistic skincare UGC selfie video. REFERENCE PRIORITY Image 1 = exact character identity. Image 2 = exact product appearance. Additional storyboard images = composition, timing and motion only. Keep the woman’s exact face, freckles, skin tone, blue-green eyes, long light-brown caramel hair, blue hoop earrings, pearl necklace, white linen shirt, body proportions and identity consistent throughout. Use Image 2 as the exact Crème de la Mer Moisturizing Cream reference. Preserve the same creamy-white jar, lid, shape, proportions, material, label layout and packaging colors throughout. Never turn it blue, translucent, gel-like, or replace it with another product. STYLE Authentic end-of-day skincare vlog filmed by the woman herself on a smartphone. Relaxed, intimate, slightly tired, low-energy and unperformed. Not a polished beauty ad. No presenter behavior, exaggerated reactions, product-selling gestures or glossy TVC lighting. LOCATION Mediterranean-style villa bedroom at golden hour. White stucco walls, rumpled white bedding, open doorway, soft bougainvillea and olive leaves in the background. Warm natural sunlight enters from frame-left, creating soft golden highlights on her hair, cheek and jaw. No ring light or studio lighting. CAMERA Horizontal 16:9 selfie composition. Keep her face visually dominant, usually 40–60% of frame width. Use asymmetric framing with the product, applying hand or environment on the opposite side. Mostly head-and-shoulders or tight upper-chest framing. Authentic smartphone footage: arm’s-length handheld camera, small tremor, subtle horizontal drift, minor framing corrections, occasional autofocus shifts, mild wide-angle distortion, natural motion blur, slight rolling shutter, subtle sensor noise. Never feel gimbal-stabilized or professionally operated. SHOT 1 — 0:00–0:04 Horizontal selfie close-up. Her face is slightly right-of-center. She pushes loose hair away with the back of her wrist and briefly checks herself on the phone screen. The OPEN white La Mer jar casually enters the lower-left beside her cheek. Natural autofocus shift between face and jar. She exhales softly. Dialogue: “Okay. Last thing, then bed.” SHOT 2 — 0:04–0:07 Horizontal detail shot. Jar on the left, softly blurred part of her face on the right. She gently presses one fingertip into the thick white cream. Show realistic deformation: dense, silky, opaque cream folds under the finger and forms a soft peak when lifted. Briefly show the front label clearly: “CRÈME DE LA MER™” “LA MER” “moisturizing cream” Then she rubs a small amount between two fingertips. Natural rack focus: label → cream → fingertips. Dialogue: “It’s so rich.” SHOT 3 — 0:07–0:11 Return to horizontal face close-up. Her face slightly left-of-center, applying hand on the right. She warms the cream and gently presses small amounts onto both cheeks, forehead and chin. Do not create a thick white mask. The cream appears briefly, then gradually absorbs. Freckles, pores, under-eye shadows and fine skin texture remain visible. Only a subtle hydrated sheen develops. Dialogue: “I just warm it up and press it in.” SHOT 4 — 0:11–0:15 Closest three-quarter selfie framing. She presses two fingertips into her cheek, lifts them, then slowly turns into the warm sunlight. A subtle hydrated sheen catches the cheekbone while freckles and pores remain visible. She looks mostly at her phone screen, gives a tiny delayed half-smile and small nod. The white La Mer jar appears naturally in soft focus near the lower frame. She reaches toward the phone to stop recording, causing a slight natural sideways tilt. Dialogue: “Morning me is gonna be so happy.” PERFORMANCE End-of-day energy: relaxed, slightly tired, casual and natural. Include subtle micro-behaviors: slow blinking, small exhale, natural swallowing, tiny head tilt, eyes checking the screen, loose hairs falling across her cheek, small posture shifts, delayed half-smile. VOICE Soft female voice, slightly tired and flat. Close smartphone microphone sound. Natural breathing. No studio-clean voice-over. SKIN REALISM Pore-level realism. Visible freckles, pores, fine forehead texture, faint under-eye shadows, tiny imperfections, vellus facial hair, moist eyes, natural catchlights, real lip texture. The moisturizer must behave like a real thick cream before absorbing. No plastic skin, beauty-filter smoothing, artificial glow or waxy face. STRICT NEGATIVE No face drift. No character replacement. No hairstyle or outfit change. No packaging change. No blue jar, blue lid, blue cream or translucent gel. No Laneige or other skincare product. No product duplication. No fake label. No commercial presenter pose. No ring light. No glossy ad lighting. No extreme beauty retouching. No plastic skin. No watermark, subtitles, UI or random text.

entries.title: Alien Planet Found-Footage Vlog
entries.description: A found-footage style prompt of a woman exploring an alien coast, featuring on-camera lines and raw, atmospheric visuals.
entries.prompt: [STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE] Real found-footage phone vlog on an alien planet. She is filming as she walks, the way someone records a trip for a friend: uneven clips, hard cuts, the phone too close, then swung out at whatever just moved. Slight shake, bad exposure, soft focus, lens dirt, wind slamming the mic, then creatures and plants filling the frame. When she speaks to the lens, she says the exact short lines written below, clear and plain, in a normal speaking voice. Wind can sit under the words. It does not replace them. No transitions, no slow-mo, no grade, no text, no stickers. It feels raw because the planet is doing too much for a phone. A giant moon hangs in the sky the whole day, pale and huge, even with the suns up. [SUBJECT] A woman about 27 in alien years, off-world traveler filming her own vlog. Cool lilac-grey complexion, faint mint freckles, a short glassy hair-crest messy from wind, gold eyes. Simple field clothes the whole take: dusty linen wrap, travel shirt, boots, a small pack. Fully clothed in every clip. She talks to the lens only at the beats marked below, then forgets the camera and points it at the planet. Same face in every cut. Calm, curious, a little worn. Not performing. [PLACE] An alien wild coast, lived-in and too big for the phone. Chalk shelves, forests of tall ribbed plants that lean and creak, ground-cover that pulls back when a boot lands, a gel-river the color of bottle glass, herds crossing open amber flats, a cliff path under the giant moon. Two small suns. Wind, grit, insect-choir, distant animal calls. No postcard town. The extraordinary stuff is just outside the lane. [ON-CAMERA LINES] She only speaks these lines, in this order, in a clear everyday voice: 1. “Day two. That moon still hasn’t moved.” 2. “It’s fine. It’s just eating.” 3. “They cross here every day. Look at the legs.” 4. “Yeah. I’m not going in.” 5. “Two suns. Moon’s still up.” 6. “Stopping here. I’ll send this later.” [TIMELINE — PHONE VLOG, HARD CUTS] 0-4s: HOOK — she is already walking a chalk shelf, phone in her hand, giant moon filling the upper frame behind her. She turns the lens on herself and says, clear: “Day two. That moon still hasn’t moved.” Then she flips the phone out: a stand of ribbed plants as tall as towers, swaying, seed-pods knocking. Raw, immediate. 4-9s: She pushes through a lane of vegetation. Leaves the size of doors fold aside and settle behind her. Cut to the phone dropped low: ground-cover peeling back from her boots, pale roots clicking. Cut to her stopping, holding the phone steady, filming a slow six-legged grazer the size of a cart chewing a pod. It looks at the lens. She does not get closer. She says, clear, off the side of the frame: “It’s fine. It’s just eating.” Wind under the line, words intact. 9-15s: She crests a rise. The giant moon sits on the horizon, enormous, craters readable. She films it, then the phone dips and catches a herd of long-necked grazers crossing the amber flat, legs too many, moving like a slow traffic jam. Cut to a close of a plant opening as the herd passes, then shutting. Cut to her face for a second, squinting. She says, clear: “They cross here every day. Look at the legs.” Then the phone goes back to the animals. Overexposed, dusty, real. 15-21s: Gel-river. She stands on the bank and films the surface beading and rolling upstream. Something large moves under it, a dark shape, then a fin of shell breaks and sinks. She steps back, laughs once, and says, clear: “Yeah. I’m not going in.” Cut to her crouched, filming a cluster of cube-bodied river birds pecking the mud. One hops onto a rock and stares. She stays quiet. Cut to the moon reflected, broken, in the gel. Phone almost slips. She catches it. 21-26s: Afternoon wind. She follows a dirt track between breathing shell-boulders. A door-sized beetle crosses ahead and she waits, filming its legs, then its eye, then the plants it brushes. She stays quiet. Cut to her wiping the lens with her sleeve. Cut to a high shelf: two suns, the giant moon still up, a valley of moving forest below. She turns the lens on herself and says, clear: “Two suns. Moon’s still up.” Then she holds the wide shot. The audio is wind, the far call, and that line. 26-30s: The light drops. The moon brightens until it is the main light. She films a night-opening grove, pods glowing faint mint, small flyers stitching between them. Cut to her face, tired, hair-crest flat from the wind, the moon over her shoulder. She says, clear: “Stopping here. I’ll send this later.” Last shot: phone pointed out from the shelf at the giant moon and the dark gel-river, a herd still moving as small shapes, her breathing on the mic, then the recording ends mid-step, like a real vlog file. [REALISM LOCK] Found footage alien vlog only. Handheld phone, hard cuts, dirty lens, wind, bad exposure. Same woman, fully clothed, same face. She speaks only the six written lines, in order, intelligible, everyday English. Giant moon in the sky all day. Creatures and vegetation carry the clips: ribbed forest, ground-cover that pulls back, a six-legged grazer, a many-legged herd, cube-bodied river birds, a shape under the gel, a door-sized beetle. Raw, specific, extraordinary, and ordinary to her.

entries.title: Dark Gothic Psychological Horror Mirror Scene
entries.description: A detailed narrative prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a psychological horror encounter between a jester and her reflection, with precise choreography and atmospheric details.
entries.prompt: HALF A BEAT LATE — 15 seconds. Dark gothic psychological horror. 16:9. Real-time action, controlled cuts, continuous spatial and emotional progression. REFERENCES Image 1 defines adult female jester Sin and her identical evil mirror double: exact face, white makeup, red nose, dark eye makeup, painted tear marks, red twin-horn hair, gold crown with bells, ivory ruff, red-and-blue court costume, pointed shoes. Image 2 defines the room and opening frame: burgundy curtain and warm wall sconce on the left, charcoal walls, wooden floor, large antique gold mirror on the right. Preserve the room, mirror frame, and light direction. IDENTITY AND STAGING SIN starts outside the mirror: increasingly frightened, resisting capture. DOUBLE starts inside the mirror: amused, disobedient, smiling, physically assertive. After the exchange, DOUBLE is outside in the room and SIN is trapped behind intact glass. Begin on Image 2’s empty-room composition. Sin enters from lower-left, walks diagonally to the mirror, and stops about 55 cm from the glass, torso facing it, back and partial profile toward camera. Keep her slightly off the mirror center so both real and reflected faces stay visible. Camera remains on the mirror’s left-front side; the glass stays broadly visible, not edge-on. Natural perspective, readable facial detail, enough depth of field for both faces. During the exchange, Sin passes inward through the screen-left half of the mirror while Double steps outward through the screen-right half. Their paths stay separate. Afterward Double takes one short settling step toward screen-left, ending in the left foreground while trapped Sin remains visible inside the mirror on the right. PERFORMANCE LOCK Sin stops smiling once she notices the anomaly and never smiles again. Double keeps smiling and never copies Sin’s fear. Sin shakes her head, retreats, gasps, loses balance, resists. Double refuses to follow, advances, grips, pulls, plants its feet. After the exchange, Sin panics inside the mirror while Double turns toward camera, smiles wickedly, then whispers. Both faces stay alive and natural, never frozen or deformed. 0-3 SECONDS — THE SMILE REMAINS A heel clicks offscreen. Sin enters immediately, takes two or three short grounded steps to the mirror, relaxed posture, chin slightly raised, small habitual smile. Weight transfers naturally through each foot; skirt and crown bells follow with soft motion and sound. Her reflection appears normal at first. Sin briefly adjusts the side of her crown with her right hand, lowers it, exhales, and her mouth turns neutral. The reflected hand lowers about half a second late. Double keeps smiling and slowly shows its teeth. A restrained push-in keeps both faces readable: Sin neutral and unsmiling, Double still smiling. 3-5.5 SECONDS — OPEN DISOBEDIENCE Sin looks from Double’s mouth to its eyes, brow tightening, then slowly shakes her head once. Double does not shake. It tilts its head slightly and widens its amused smile. Sin catches her breath, draws her chin back, retreats about 20 cm, and raises her right hand at chest height, palm toward the mirror. Double leans closer to the glass as Sin increases her real distance. Keep both opposing movements visible in the same oblique frame. 5.5-8 SECONDS — GRIP, THEN PULL Hard cut to a same-side medium shot holding both faces, Sin’s raised right wrist, and the mirror’s left edge. A localized patch of glass turns into a dark elastic membrane. Double’s left hand reaches through into the room and grips Sin’s right wrist firmly. Double pulls inward. Sin’s eyes snap to the captured wrist; her lips part in a sharp inhale. Her left hand grabs the mirror’s left frame, rear foot braces on the wooden floor, knees bend as she pulls backward. Double keeps its cold smile and retracts with steady force. Sin loses her hold on the frame. Her right shoulder is pulled forward first, then her torso; her rear shoe begins to slide. She resists the whole time and never walks voluntarily into the mirror. 8-11.5 SECONDS — ONE IN, ONE OUT The camera withdraws slightly to reveal the mirror boundary and landing foot. Double steps outward through the screen-right half of the mirror and plants one pointed shoe firmly on the wooden floor before taking weight. Sin is pulled inward through the screen-left half. Double keeps hold until Sin crosses the surface, then releases her wrist. Their identical faces pass on separate paths: Sin terrified, trembling, ragged breath; Double composed with a small victorious smile. Red hair and moving fabric briefly occlude the crossing point. Use one concealed continuity cut inside that occlusion only. When the occlusion clears, the exchange is complete: inside the mirror Sin stumbles one step away, then turns and lunges back toward the glass; outside, Double completes its settling step toward screen-left. The membrane seals back into intact reflective glass before Sin reaches it. Her palms hit the inner surface and stop. The gold frame stays rigid. No shattering. 11.5-13 SECONDS — TURN FIRST Hard cut to a same-side medium close shot that clearly contains both faces. Double starts facing the mirror, then shoulders and torso turn toward the camera until its face is fully visible. Show the full body turn before any frontal smile. Behind it, trapped Sin faces outward from inside the mirror. She looks down at her blocked palms, urgently scans the frame edges, then looks at Double. She strikes the glass once and opens her mouth to call out, unheard. entries.prompt: A cinematic 30-second alpine winter vlog montage featuring the same young woman exploring a snow-covered mountain village during a cozy winter getaway. Format: 4K cinematic video, 24fps, 35mm film grain, realistic handheld camera, soft focus, cool-warm contrast palette, travel documentary style. Scene 1 (0-4s) — Arrival at the Chalet Village: A crisp winter morning, light snow falling. She steps out of a wooden chalet doorway wearing a cream cable-knit sweater, faux-fur-trimmed parka, and a knit beanie, breath visible in the cold air. Camera trails her from behind down a snowy cobblestone lane lined with timber cottages, then swings into a close-up as she turns and smiles, saying softly, "Okay, this already feels like a movie." Scene 2 (4-8s) — First Ski Run: She glides down a gentle beginner slope, snow spraying softly at her skis, pine trees blurred past on either side. Low chase shots from behind, then a front-facing GoPro-style angle catching her laughing as she wobbles slightly and steadies herself. Scene 3 (8-12s) — Snow-Covered Pine Forest Walk: A worm's-eye view looking up through frosted pine branches, pale sunlight filtering through with soft lens flares on ice crystals. Cut to a close-up of her walking through untouched snow, mittened hand trailing along a low branch, murmuring, "It's so quiet here it feels unreal." Scene 4 (12-16s) — Cozy Café Break: She sits by a frosted window inside a small timber café, wrapped hands around a steaming mug of hot chocolate topped with whipped cream. Warm interior light contrasts the blue-white world outside. Close-up on the marshmallows melting, her contented half-smile as she watches snow drift past the glass. Scene 5 (16-20s) — Sledding Adventure: She sits on a wooden sled at the top of a gentle hill, pushes off, and speeds down laughing, hair flying loose from under her beanie. Camera tracks alongside at sled height. She tumbles softly into a snowbank at the bottom, laughing, and calls toward the camera, "Don't film this part — okay, keep filming it." Scene 6 (20-24s) — Christmas Market Exploration: A glowing evening market strung with warm fairy lights, snow settling on wooden stalls, the smell of roasted chestnuts implied through steam rising from vendor carts. She weaves through the crowd sampling mulled cider and gingerbread, face lit by string lights and lantern glow. Cinematic close-ups of her eyes widening at the taste, lights blurred into soft bokeh behind her. Scene 7 (24-27s) — Golden Sunset Over the Peaks: A wide silhouette shot of her standing on a snowy overlook as the sun dips behind the mountain range, sky shifting from pale gold to soft violet, her scarf drifting in the wind. She sits curled up on a wool blanket, mug in hand, firelight flickering across her face. The zombies suddenly start chasing them. The three characters run through the forest in panic. The male friend clears obstacles from their path while running. The girl struggles to keep up, breathing heavily, looking terrified. Use handheld shaky camera style like a real survival horror movie.
Scene 5 (17–22s): Hide Inside Old Cabin
They reach an abandoned wooden cabin and rush inside. They push a heavy wooden door and try to block it while zombies hit from outside. Show their fear, exhaustion, and struggle. Flashlight lighting, dark interior, realistic shadows.
Scene 6 (22–27s): Window Attack
Suddenly a zombie crashes through the side window. Glass breaks and falls. The three characters step back in fear. They desperately search for another escape route. Show realistic panic, fast movements, and intense horror atmosphere.
Scene 7 (27–30s): Final Escape
The three run out of the cabin toward an old dark tunnel in the forest. The zombie horde follows closely behind. The camera follows from behind with cinematic tracking movement. They enter the tunnel as zombies approach. End with a dark suspenseful cliffhanger.
Visual Style:
Ultra realistic live-action horror movie, natural human faces, realistic body movement, cinematic lighting, dark blue-green color grading, foggy forest, realistic physics, handheld camera

entries.title: Korean Folk Horror Shamanic Ritual
entries.description: A chilling prompt for a Korean folk horror scene involving a shamanic exorcism ritual in a traditional house.
entries.prompt:
30-sec cinematic Korean folk-horror ritual. Keep the Word character’s face and outfit consistent throughout.

1. 0–4s: Word character kneels pale and weak in a dim traditional Korean house; worried family, candles, incense, shaman preparing the ritual.
2. 4–8s: Salt circle and talismans surround her; candlelight flickers as her eyes twitch and fingers convulse.
3. 8–12s: Her head snaps unnaturally; guttural inhuman voice, dark veins spreading, body twisting as the ritual intensifies.
4. 12–16s: Eyes turn black; shaman chants frantically and throws rice/salt; her body convulses violently.
5. 16–20s: She rises unnaturally; shaman presses a burning talisman to her forehead as wind tears through the closed room.
6. 20–24s: Talisman burns, flames surge, she collapses and becomes completely still.
7. 24–27s: Her eyes reopen human; family rushes to her in relief while the exhausted shaman watches.
8. 27–30s: Wide aftermath: scattered salt, burnt talismans, melted candles. One intact talisman emits faint dark smoke, leaving an unsettling unresolved ending.

Style: cinematic Korean folk horror, dark wooden interior, warm candlelight, deep shadows, tense atmosphere, realistic, unsettling, dramatic camera movement.

entries.title: Korean Neighborhood Action-Comedy Scene
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a comedy scene set in a Korean residential area, focusing on character consistency and a handheld camcorder aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic Korean neighborhood action-comedy scene using the uploaded images as exact visual references. Keep the same characters, faces, hair, outfits and environment consistent throughout.
CHARACTERS:
Young Korean woman, early 20s, long straight black hair, green cropped long-sleeve top, loose blue jeans and silver jewelry; confident, expressive and fearless.
Young Korean man, early 20s, short black hair, gray button-up shirt, dark trousers and white sneakers; cocky at first, then increasingly nervous.
SHOT 1
The woman walks down a quiet residential street carrying a small grocery bag. She notices the man riding a tiny electric scooter toward her way too fast.
SHOT 2
He suddenly rings the bell repeatedly and gestures for her to move. She calmly steps aside, watching him pass with an annoyed expression.
SHOT 3
A few seconds later, the scooter rolls back into frame by itself. The man runs after it, desperately trying to catch it.
SHOT 4
The woman watches him sprint past her. She casually sticks out one foot and stops the scooter before it rolls into the street.
SHOT 5
He finally reaches her, out of breath, and says, “Wait… you stopped it?” She simply looks at him and says, “You’re welcome.”
SHOT 6
He grabs the scooter and tries to ride away again, but the woman notices his grocery bag has fallen open and vegetables are rolling down the sidewalk.
SHOT 7
She quickly catches several vegetables before they reach the road. The man stands there embarrassed while an elderly neighbor watches and quietly laughs.
SHOT 8
The woman hands everything back to him, gives him a playful “seriously?” look and walks away.
SHOT 9 — ENDING
The man starts riding away, then realizes his helmet is still in her hand. She raises it above her head with a tiny satisfied smile. He stops, turns around and walks back toward her as she laughs.
VISUAL STYLE:
Ultra-realistic Korean residential neighborhood, early-2000s MiniDV/camcorder aesthetic, handheld camera, imperfect framing, slight autofocus hunting, natural exposure shifts, subtle motion blur, soft digital detail, warm afternoon sunlight, realistic Korean houses, parked scooters, utility poles, narrow streets and authentic everyday atmosphere. Fast comedic timing, natural body language and hard cuts between shots.
AUDIO:
Only natural diegetic sound — footsteps, scooter motor, bell, distant traffic, birds, neighborhood ambience, vegetables hitting the pavement, natural dialogue and laughter. Absolutely no music or score.
NEGATIVE PROMPT:
No gore, blood, serious injuries, identity drift, outfit changes, duplicated people, extra limbs, distorted hands, teleportation, impossible physics, cartoon reactions, CGI look, subtitles, captions, text, logos or watermark.

entries.title: 1986 Japanese Housing Complex Girl Video Prompt
entries.description: A meticulous, long-form multi-sequence historical recreation prompt mapping a young girl's day in a 1986 Japanese suburban housing district.
entries.prompt:
【概要】1986年、団地に住む8歳の女の子の1日。母が父のビデオカメラを借りて、声をかけずに離れた場所から記録している。480p、16:9、15秒。7ショット（各約2秒）のハードカットで、7か所すべて別の場所。トランジションやフェードは使わない。被写体はカメラに向かって何もしない：目線を送らない、物を見せない、手を振らない、ポーズを取らない。遊びや用事に没頭している。演技ではなく、日常の途中を切り取った断片。会話・セリフ・ナレーションは一切なし。

【被写体】美貌の定義：クラスで一番かわいいと言われる、子役級の日本人の女の子。真剣な顔と、できたときに自分でにこっとする顔が一番かわいい。顔：まっすぐ切りそろえたおかっぱ（前髪も一直線）、丸い顔、黒目がちの大きな目、上を向いた小さな鼻、赤い頬（現実的な肌の質感）、前歯が1本抜けている。服（普段着）：白い丸襟のブラウス（襟が少しよれている）、赤いジャンパースカート、白いハイソックス（片方がずり落ちる）、白いズック靴、髪の左側に赤いピン。仕草の癖：できたものを自分の目の前で眺める、ソックスを引き上げる。全ショットで顔・髪・服装が完全に同一。

【登場人物】友達2人：ポニーテールで黄色いTシャツの子（そばかす）、三つ編みで水色のワンピースの子（眼鏡）。誰もカメラを見ない。

【時代・場所・光】1986年夏の団地。①ベランダ（洗濯物の間、朝の光）②団地の中庭のゴム跳び（2人が長い平たいゴムひもを足首の高さで両側から張り、その間で跳ぶ遊び。午前の光）③給水塔の下の日陰④集会所前の縁石（あやとり：輪にした1本のひもを両手の指にかけて形を作る遊び。木漏れ日）⑤公園の砂場（泥だんご：泥を丸めて乾いた砂をまぶし、手で磨いてつやつやにした球。白い光）⑥団地の郵便受けの前（夕方の橙）⑦団地の階段（夕方）。看板・文字は画面に入れない。手紙の宛名面は映さない。

【カメラ】1986年の家庭用ビデオカメラの質感：色がにじみ、解像度が低く、明るい空が白飛びし、輪郭が甘い。日付表示は出さない。手持ち、自然な揺れ、不完全な構図、ズームの迷い、露出のゆらぎ。被写体から2〜5mの距離。被写体はカメラを気にしない。スタビライズ、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画的照明、商業カラーグレーディングはなし。カメラは常に撮影者が手に持っている位置（立つ・座る・しゃがむ・歩きながら・隣の席から）から撮る。人がいられない場所（空中・水中・天井・真上・車の外から走る車内・被写体の目の前数センチ等）からのアングルは使わない。撮影者は同じ空間に確かにいる一人の人として、被写体が動けば少し遅れて追い、ときどき構図が甘くなる。

【ショット】（各約2秒。各行＝場所・光／没頭していること／内側の感情と、それが漏れる小さなしぐさ／カメラ位置）
1. ベランダ・朝。干した洗濯物の間を縫って歩きながら、赤いピンを付け直している。感情：はりきっている。口を結んでピンを押し込む。カメラ：室内側から、逆光でシーツが白く光る。
2. 中庭・ゴム跳び。張られたゴムひもを跳び、足を引っかけて転びかけ、自分でおかしくて笑う。感情：夢中で楽しい。カメラ：正面、腰の高さ、少し離れて。
3. 給水塔の日陰。3人で並んで座り、水筒のコップの麦茶を飲む。コップの縁に口をつけたまま遠くの空を見て、それから次の子に渡す。感情：暑くてほっとする。カメラ：横から。
4. 集会所前の縁石・木漏れ日。あやとりで「はしご」ができて、自分の手を目の前で眺め、にこっとする。感情：できた満足。カメラ：斜め前から、手にピント。
5. 砂場。磨いた泥だんごを両手で包んで、光にかざして角度を変えている。感情：誇らしい。目がきらきらしている。カメラ：しゃがんで泥だんごに寄る。
6. 郵便受けの前・夕方。背伸びして郵便受けを覗き、封筒（無地、宛名面は映さない）を取り出して胸に抱く。感情：わくわく。カメラ：横から。
7. 団地の階段・夕方。封筒を抱えて駆け上がる後ろ姿。踊り場を曲がって見えなくなる。感情：早く伝えたい。カメラ：階段の下から見上げたまま。その途中、およそ00:14で録画は突然ブラックアウトに切り替わる。フェードアウトなし。

【小物・道具のディテール】ゴムひもは白くて平たい幅広のゴム。水筒は赤いプラスチックでふたがコップになる。泥だんごはつやつやの黒褐色。あやとりのひもは赤い毛糸の輪。封筒は白い無地。赤いピンは丸い頭のプラスチック。

【文字の禁止】画面内に読める文字・ロゴ・看板・ラベル・数字を一切出さない。封筒は無地。

【物理・一貫性】現実世界の物理。余分な指、融合した手、歪んだ解剖学、浮遊物、消える物体、突然の変形はなし。足は地面に接地。赤いピン、ジャンパースカート、友達の服装は全ショットで同じ。

【音】自然な環境音のみ（ショットごとに切り替わる）：洗濯物のはためき、ゴム跳びの足音と笑い声、水筒の音、木漏れ日の鳥、砂の音、郵便受けの金属音、階段の足音。言葉は一切なし。撮影者のときどきの小さな笑い声・息づかいと、被写体の笑い声・息づかいのみ可。音楽なし。ナレーションなし。人工的な音響効果なし。

【雰囲気】大人が見て「私もやった」と思う、昭和の団地の女の子のなんでもない1日の記録。演技ではなく、遊びと用事の途中の断片。懐かしく、いとおしく、深く人間的。カメラがたまたまそこにあったような感じを優先。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Overview] In 1986, the day of an 8-year-old girl living in a public housing complex. Recorded by her mother from a distance using her father's video camera without speaking to her. 480p, 16:9, 15 seconds. 7 shots (approx. 2 seconds each) with hard cuts across 7 completely different locations. No transitions or fades. The subject does nothing facing the camera: no looks, no showing objects, no waving, no posing. Absorbed in play and tasks. Fragments cutting into raw daily life, not acting. No dialogue, speech, or narration at all.

[Subject] Standard of appearance: A Japanese girl cute enough to be a child actor, known as the prettiest in class. A focused face and a face that naturally smiles when successful are best. Face: cleanly cut bob hair (straight bangs), round face, large eyes with prominent black irises, a small upturned nose, red cheeks (realistic skin texture), one missing front tooth. Clothes (everyday wear): a white blouse with a round collar (slightly loose collar), a red jumper skirt, white high socks (one slipping down), white canvas shoes, a red pin on the left side of her hair. Behavioral habits: gazing at things she completed right in front of her face, pulling up her socks. Face, hair, and clothing are entirely consistent in all shots.

[Characters] 2 friends: a girl with a ponytail in a yellow T-shirt (freckles), a girl with braids in a light blue one-piece dress (glasses). None look at the camera.

[Era/Location/Light] A housing complex in the summer of 1986. (1) Balcony (among drying laundry, morning light) (2) Elastics jump game in the courtyard (two people stretching long flat elastic bands around ankle height from both sides, hopping in between; morning light) (3) Shade beneath the water tower (4) Curb in front of the community center (cat's cradle game using a looped string around hands; sunbeams) (5) Park sandbox (mud dumplings: spheres made of mud covered in dry sand and polished shiny by hand; white light) (6) In front of mailboxes (evening orange light) (7) Complex stairs (evening). No signs or lettering on screen. Do not display address details on envelopes.

[Camera] Aesthetics of a 1986 home video camera: bleeding colors, low resolution, blown-out bright skies, soft outlines. No date stamps. Handheld with realistic shaking, imperfect framework, hesitant zooming, shifting exposure. Distance of 2 to 5 meters from the subject. The subject disregards the camera. No stabilization, gimbals, drones, slow motion, cinematic setup, or commercial color grading. The camera is always recorded from the physical position held by the operator (standing, sitting, crouching, walking, next seat). Avoid perspectives from impossible locations (mid-air, underwater, ceiling, directly above, outside running vehicles, centimeters from the face). The operator acts as an actual person sharing the environment, tracking with a short delay when the subject moves, sometimes losing ideal framing.

[Shots] (approx. 2 seconds each. Each line = location/light / focus / internal emotion expressed via subtle motions / camera position)
1. Balcony, morning. Weaving through drying laundry while adjusting her red hair clip. Emotion: motivated. Clamping mouth shut while pushing the pin in. Camera: from the inside looking out, sheets glowing white in backlight.
2. Courtyard, elastics game. Jumping the elastics, catching her foot and nearly falling, laughing spontaneously. Emotion: fully immersed and happy. Camera: front view, waist height, slightly back.
3. Shadow of the water tower. Three girls sitting together, drinking barley tea from a thermos cup. Looking at the far sky with the cup pressed to her mouth before passing it to the next child. Emotion: hot but relieved. Camera: side view.
4. Curb in front of the community center, sunbeams. Completing the "ladder" pattern in cat's cradle, staring at her hands and smiling. Emotion: satisfied with success. Camera: oblique front angle, focusing on hands.
5. Sandbox. Enfolding a polished mud dumpling in both hands, tilting it against the light to look at angles. Emotion: proud. Sparkling eyes. Camera: crouching close to the mud dumpling.
6. In front of mailboxes, evening. Standing on tiptoes to peer inside, pulling out an envelope (plain, hiding addresses) and cradling it against her chest. Emotion: excited anticipation. Camera: side view.
7. Complex stairs, evening. Back view of her running up holding the envelope. Turning past the landing out of sight. Emotion: eager to share. Camera: looking up from the base of the stairs. Around 00:14, the video cuts abruptly to a black screen. No fade-out.

[Item/Prop Details] The elastic string is a white, flat, wide band. The thermos is red plastic with a lid that acts as a cup. Mud dumplings are shiny dark brown. Cat's cradle string is a loop of red yarn. The envelope is plain white. The red pin is plastic with a round top.

[Text Prohibition] No legible text, logos, signs, labels, or numbers on screen. The envelope is blank.

[Physics/Consistency] Real-world physics. No excess digits, fused limbs, warped anatomy, floating items, vanishing objects, or sudden transformations. Feet touch the ground properly. Red pin, jumper skirt, and friends' apparel stay uniform across all scenes.

[Audio] Natural environmental sounds only (cutting with each shot): flapping laundry, foot thuds and laughter from elastics play, thermos noises, birds in sunbeams, sand shuffling, metallic mailbox clicks, steps on stairs. No spoken dialogue. Only occasional low giggles/breathing from the camerawork operator or subject allowed. No music. No narration. No synthetic sound production effects.

[Atmosphere] Replicating a simple day for a Showa-era girl that makes adults think "I used to do that." Fragments of standard play and tasks over simulated acting. Nostalgic, endearing, deeply human. Prioritize a random, organic camera presence.

entries.description: A detailed一镜到底 (one-shot) script instruction involving a woman teaching a clumsy humanoid robot thief a lesson after it fails to steal her bag.
entries.prompt:
一段15秒、9:16竖屏的智能手机视频，极其逼真的实拍质感。白天，从临街公寓楼上窗口向下斜拍，一位冷艳的成年女子在人行道上遭到人形机器人抢包，机器人逃跑时自己摔倒，女子从容取回包，并用一种出人意料的方式教训它。 【拍摄视角】 摄影者站在公寓窗口，手机镜头朝下斜俯拍楼下近处的人行道与相邻的沥青道路。画面左边缘露出很窄的一条深色窗框，浅灰色混凝土人行道位于左侧，深灰色道路位于右侧，路缘在画面中呈斜线延伸。没有天空、远处天际线或大范围城市全景。 俯拍角度能同时看见人物头顶、肩部、身体正面的一部分和完整脚步。人物足够大，能够辨认抢包、跌倒、捡包及手臂动作，避免高空航拍般的人物过小。 手机基本保持原来的方向，仅有轻微自然手持晃动，突发动作时有幅度很小、稍慢半拍的构图修正。始终在同一个窗口拍摄，连续一镜到底，没有电影式运镜、切镜、特写插入或场景过渡。 【角色与道具】 女主使用成年预设女主角#1
，保持预设脸部、发型、身材与身份，完整穿着预设服装#2
，鞋履和配饰沿用预设，不自行改款。 她左手提着一个中等大小的印花手提包，包口闭合，提带没有缠绕手腕。全片只有一个包，不使用拐杖。 她以自然克制的海妖风步态行走：肩部放松下沉，颈部舒展，下巴略抬，身体随着重心转移形成柔和流动的S形线条；步幅适中，双脚沿较窄的步行轨迹自然交替，双腿前后错位但不刻意交叉。神态冷淡，有距离感，不夸张扭腰，不像舞台走秀。转身、弯腰和用力时保持真实的人体平衡。 一个黑白相间的未来主义人形机器人

跟在她身后几步远。机器人拥有流畅、可信的机械身躯，白色装甲板、黑色关节、深色无特征面罩，接近成年人的身高。关节活动有机械重量感，面罩不显示表情、文字或图案。 【0—3秒】 女主沿着人行道缓缓朝画面下方走近，左手的印花包轻轻摆动。机器人在她身后正常行走，随后加快两步，从她靠道路的一侧接近。 接近段不提前搞怪，让机器人看起来确实正在寻找抢包机会。女主没有察觉，也不回头看它。 【3—6秒】 机器人伸出右手，抓住印花包的提带，突然将包从女主左手中夺走，随即跨下路缘，转向道路逃跑。 女主左臂被带动一下，立即松手站稳，转头看向机器人，没有跌倒或被拖行。 机器人刚跑出两步便回头看她，转身与落脚没有协调好，一只脚尖碰到自己的另一只脚踝。它连续小碎步试图找回平衡，身体却越晃越大，最终侧髋撞地，翻成仰躺，两条腿短暂抬起后落回沥青路面。 摔倒突然、笨拙而沉重，有明确的脚部失误和补救过程，不做后空翻，不悬空旋转。右手在撞击时松开，包落在人行道边、机器人右肩旁。包口保持闭合。 【6—9秒】 女主停顿半秒，低头看着四脚摊开的机器人，然后从容走到它身边。 她双脚站稳，微屈膝俯身，用左手捡回自己的包。机器人仰躺着，右肘弯曲，刚才抢包的右手缓慢抬起，手掌半张。 女主拿回包后，视线落到那只机械手上。她没有立即离开，而是停住片刻，伸出空着的右手抓住它的右腕。 【9—12秒：核心喜剧动作】 女主左手提包，右手握着机器人的右腕，带动它松弛的前臂，让它用自己的手掌朝自己的额部装甲拍一下。 “啪。” 她把它的手掌拉开十几厘米，短暂停顿，再拍一下。 “啪。” 两下分明、干脆，接触过程完整可见：机器人刚才用这只手抢包，现在女主直接拿这只手教训它自己。 机器人右肘保持自然弯曲，肩关节没有反折。女主只移动它的一条松弛前臂，不抬起整台机器人。每次拍到额部时，机器人头部仅轻轻晃动，不飞起、不碎裂、不爆火花。 女主神态始终冷淡，动作利落，没有大喊大叫，也没有夸张挥臂。拍完后松开它的手腕，那条机械前臂顺着重力落回胸甲，发出短短一下碰撞声。 【12—15秒】 女主直起身，整理一下左手的包带，转身回到原来的行进方向，自然恢复冷艳从容的海妖风步态。 她平静地继续走，像刚处理完一件小麻烦。机器人仍仰躺在道路上，右手搭在自己胸前，双腿狼狈地摊开。 结尾保留女主离开的全身和地上的机器人，让从容的人与失败的机械小偷同时出现在画面里。不增加新的反转动作。 【视觉真实性】 自然日光和真实建筑阴影，混凝土接缝、路缘磨损、沥青颗粒与细小污渍清晰可信。服装褶皱随身体动作变化，包随惯性摆动，机器人装甲反射周围真实环境，人物与机器人共享一致的光线和接触阴影。 整体具有电影级的材质与光影可信度，但仍像手机偶然拍下的街头事件。保留轻微手抖、适量手机压缩、自然运动模糊和细微自动曝光变化。不使用美颜、过度锐化、夸张景深虚化、广告式布光或重度电影滤镜。 【声音】 公寓窗口距离下的自然街道收音：轻微风声、远处城市底噪、较远的脚步声、机器人撞地的沉闷机械声，以及两次短促的手掌碰撞装甲声。声音保留空间距离，不像贴近人物录制。 无对白、无旁白、无配乐、无罐头笑声、无卡通音效。 【连续性要求】 女主外貌与服装、机器人外形、手提包、街道结构、光线方向全程一致。 手提包严格遵循：女主左手携带—机器人右手抢走—随机器人落地—女主左手捡回—女主带走。 打击动作严格保持女主右手握住机器人右腕，机器人用自己的右手掌拍自己的额部。手腕、手肘和肩膀结构连续，不增加肢体、不左右互换、不穿模。 无剪辑、无场景过渡、无慢动作、无文字、无字幕、无水印、无过度CGI特效。
entries.translated_prompt: A 15-second, 9:16 vertical smartphone video with extremely realistic live-action quality. In the daytime, shot from a window of a street-facing apartment building looking diagonally downward, a cold and elegant adult woman is robbed of her bag on the sidewalk by a humanoid robot. The robot trips and falls while running away, the woman calmly retrieves her bag, and punishes it in an unexpected way. [Shooting Perspective] The photographer stands at the apartment window, with the phone lens pointing diagonally downward at the nearby sidewalk below and the adjacent asphalt road. A very narrow dark window frame is visible on the left edge of the screen, the light gray concrete sidewalk is on the left, and the dark gray road is on the right, with the curb extending as a diagonal line in the frame. No sky, distant skyline, or large-scale city panoramas. The high-angle shot allows simultaneous viewing of the top of the characters' heads, shoulders, part of the front body, and complete steps. The characters are large enough to identify bag snatching, falling, picking up bags, and arm movements, avoiding characters being too small as in high-altitude aerial photography. The phone basically maintains its original direction, with only slight natural handheld shake, and a very small, slightly delayed half-beat framing correction during sudden actions. Always shot from the same window, continuous one-shot to the end, without cinematic camera movements, cuts, close-up insertions, or scene transitions. [Characters & Props] The female lead uses Adult Preset Heroine #1, maintaining the preset face, hairstyle, figure, and identity, completely wearing Preset Clothing #2, shoes and accessories follow the preset, without modifying styles on her own. She carries a medium-sized printed handbag in her left hand, with the bag mouth closed, and the strap is not wrapped around her wrist. There is only one bag in the entire video, and no crutches are used. She walks with a naturally restrained siren-style gait: shoulders relaxed and dropped, neck extended, chin slightly raised, body forming a soft, flowing S-curve with the shift of gravity; stride length is moderate, feet naturally alternate along a narrower walking path, legs are staggered front and back but not intentionally crossed. Her expression is cold and distant, without exaggerated waist-twisting, unlike a runway show. Maintains realistic human balance when turning, bending, and exerting force. A black-and-white futuristic humanoid robot ceYCnpdUfKl6 follows a few paces behind her. The robot possesses a smooth, believable mechanical body, white armor plates, black joints, a dark featureless face shield, close to adult human height. Joint movement has mechanical weight, and the face shield does not display expressions, text, or patterns. [0—3 seconds] The female lead walks slowly along the sidewalk towards the bottom of the screen, the printed bag in her left hand swinging gently. The robot walks normally behind her, then quickens by two steps, approaching from her side closer to the road. The approach segment does not act funny in advance, making the robot look like it is genuinely seeking an opportunity to snatch the bag. The female lead does not notice, nor does she turn back to look at it. [3—6 seconds] The robot extends its right hand, grabs the strap of the printed bag, suddenly snatches the bag away from the female lead's left hand, then steps off the curb, turning into the road to escape. The female lead's left arm is pulled slightly, she immediately lets go to stand firm, turning her head to look at the robot, without falling or being dragged. The robot looks back at her after running just two steps, failing to coordinate its turn and foot placement, with one toe hitting its other ankle. It takes continuous small steps trying to regain balance, but its body sways larger and larger, finally landing sideways on its hip, flipping onto its back, with its two legs lifting briefly before falling back onto the asphalt surface. The fall is sudden, clumsy, and heavy, with a clear foot mistake and recovery process, no backflips, no suspended rotation. The right hand releases upon impact, the bag lands by the sidewalk, next to the robot's right shoulder. The bag mouth remains closed. [6—9 seconds] The female lead pauses for half a second, looks down at the sprawled robot, then calmly walks over to its side. She stands firm with both feet, slightly bends her knees, and picks up her bag with her left hand. The robot lies on its back, right elbow bent, the right hand that just snatched the bag slowly rises, palm half open. After taking back the bag, the female lead's gaze lands on that mechanical hand. Instead of leaving immediately, she pauses for a moment, extending her free right hand to grab its right wrist. [9—12 seconds: Core Comedic Action] The female lead holds the bag in her left hand, grabs the robot's right wrist with her right hand, moving its relaxed forearm, letting it slap its own forehead armor with its own palm. "Slap." She pulls its palm away by a dozen centimeters, pauses briefly, and slaps it again. "Slap." Two distinct, crisp slaps, the contact process completely visible: the robot used this hand to snatch the bag just now, now the female lead directly uses this hand to teach it a lesson itself. The robot's right elbow maintains a natural bend, the shoulder joint is not inverted. The female lead only moves one of its relaxed forearms, not lifting the entire robot. Each time it hits the forehead, the robot's head only shakes gently, not flying off, fracturing, or exploding sparks. The female lead's demeanor remains cold throughout, her movements sharp, without shouting or exaggerated arm-waving. After slapping, she releases its wrist, and that mechanical forearm drops back onto the chest armor under gravity, making a short clatter. [12—15 seconds] The female lead straightens up, adjusts the bag strap in her left hand, turns back to her original direction of travel, naturally resuming her cold and elegant siren-style gait. She continues to walk calmly, as if she had just handled a small trouble. The robot still lies on its back on the road, right hand resting on its chest, legs clumsily spread out. The ending retains the full body of the female lead leaving and the robot on the ground, allowing the calm human and the failed mechanical thief to appear simultaneously in the frame. No new twist actions are added. [Visual Realism] Natural daylight and realistic architectural shadows, concrete joints, curb wear, asphalt particles, and minor stains are clear and believable. Clothing wrinkles change with body movements, the bag swings with inertia, the robot armor reflects the surrounding real environment, and the characters and robot share consistent light and contact shadows. The overall project possesses cinematic-level material and lighting credibility, yet still looks like a street incident accidentally captured by a phone. Retains slight hand shake, appropriate phone compression, natural motion blur, and subtle auto-exposure variations. Does not use beauty filters, over-sharpening, exaggerated depth of field blur, commercial lighting, or heavy movie filters. [Sound] Natural street recording under apartment window distance: slight wind sound, distant city ambient noise, distant footsteps, the dull mechanical sound of the robot hitting the ground, and two brief palm-on-armor collision sounds. Sound retains spatial distance, not like recorded close to the characters. No dialogue, no voiceover, no background music, no canned laughter, no cartoon sound effects. [Continuity Requirements] Female lead's appearance and clothing, robot appearance, handbag, street structure, light direction consistent throughout. Handbag strictly follows: carried by female lead's left hand—snatched by robot's right hand—falls with robot—picked up by female lead's left hand—taken away by female lead. Striking action strictly maintains female lead's right hand holding robot's right wrist, robot using its own right palm to slap its own forehead. Wrist, elbow, and shoulder structures continuous, no added limbs, no left-right swaps, no clipping. No editing, no scene transitions, no slow motion, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks, no excessive CGI special effects.

entries.title: Mobile Controlled POV Outfit Transition
entries.description: A detailed script for a Seedance 2.5 video featuring a first-person perspective where a character's outfit changes instantly via a mobile app interface. It includes specific timing, sound effects, and motion constraints.
entries.prompt:
Duration: 20秒
Aspect ratio: 9:16
Overall style: POV男友第一人称短剧，真实手机手持轻微呼吸晃动，室内自然光通透，手机滑动+点击瞬间换装，节奏轻快甜宠，竖屏

【场景】明亮客厅/卧室，落地窗自然光，背景简洁温馨，地面干净无杂物
【角色】女主（@图片1，开场穿角色原本服装）；男主为POV视角，全程不露脸，仅画面下方出现持手机的男性手
【道具】一部现代全面屏手机，竖持。屏幕是简洁时尚穿搭App：上方大预览图，下方横向可滑动的服装卡片。每次滑动有跟手惯性，点击卡片时屏幕轻微缩放+短震反馈

SHOT 1（00:00-00:03.5）开场展示
画面：POV，女主站画面中央，开心地原地转半圈展示穿搭，双手轻提衣摆，眼睛亮亮看镜头。
台词：女主:"老公，看我今天穿得怎么样？"
音效：室内底噪，衣料轻响。
Constraints: 女主全身入画，开场服装=角色原本服装。

SHOT 2（00:03.5-00:06.5）掏出手机+第一次滑动
画面：画面下方男主手举起手机入镜，屏幕亮起，显示穿搭App。拇指从右向左滑过卡片，停在@衣服1的卡片上，预览图放大。
台词：男主（画外音，慵懒）:"还行。换这套看看。"
音效：屏幕滑动轻摩擦声。
Constraints: 手机屏幕清晰可读，卡片上能看出是@衣服1；男主只出手，不露脸。

SHOT 3（00:06.5-00:09.5）第一次点击瞬变
画面：拇指点在@衣服1卡片上，屏幕短震。点击落下的同一帧，女主服装瞬间变成@衣服1，站位、姿势、发型完全连续；她低头看衣服，瞪大眼张嘴，再抬头看镜头。
台词：女主（惊讶）:"诶？！"
音效：清脆"滴"+换装"叮"，衣料展开微响。
Constraints: 换装发生在点击同一帧，单帧瞬变；可加一道从上到下扫过身体的柔和微光；禁止叠化、黑闪、人物跳位。

SHOT 4（00:09.5-00:13）第二次滑动+点击瞬变
画面：拇指再次左滑，卡片停在@衣服2，点一下。同一帧女主换成@衣服2；这次她反应过来，脸颊微红，手指绞在身前，害羞小幅扭身，眼神躲闪又忍不住看镜头。
台词：男主（画外音）:"这套也行。"
女主（小声）:"你……乱点。"
音效：滑动声+"滴"+"叮"，轻快音乐渐起。
Constraints: 滑动必须完整看见从@衣服1卡片滑到@衣服2；换装仍是点击同一帧硬切。

SHOT 5（00:13-00:16.5）第三次滑动+点击瞬变
画面：再滑到@衣服3，点一下。同一帧换成@衣服3；女主已经习惯，咬一下下唇，抬手整理新衣服领口/裙摆，眼神带点得意看镜头。
台词：女主:"这套……还挺好看的嘛。"
音效："滴"+"叮"，音乐节奏加快半拍。
Constraints: 三次反应递进：惊讶→害羞→得意；每次都有小动作，禁止呆立。

SHOT 6（00:16.5-00:20）第四次滑动+点击+收尾
画面：最后一滑停在@衣服4，拇指点下。同一帧女主瞬变为@衣服4；她直接笑出来，上前一步凑近镜头，狡黠眯眼。手机仍举在画面下方，屏幕停在@衣服4预览。
台词：男主（画外音，满意）:"这套定了。"
女主（笑着凑近，嗔怪）:"你好坏啊——我好喜欢！"
音效："滴"+"叮"，音乐在女主台词落点收在甜甜重拍。
Constraints: 结尾女主凑近但不过分贴脸；手机始终在画面下方可见；服装顺序锁定：开场=原本 → @衣服1 → @衣服2 → @衣服3 → @衣服4，不可乱。

【导演铁律】
1. 换装铁律：每次换装发生在“点击”同一帧，单帧瞬变。女主站位、姿势、发型、脸型跨越换装帧完全连续，只有服装改变。
2. POV铁律：镜头=男主眼睛，全程轻微手持呼吸晃动；男主只出手+画外音，禁止露脸。
3. 手机铁律：每次必须先滑动再点击，滑动跟手、卡片切换清楚；禁止凭空换装、禁止不看屏幕直接变。
4. 服装引用：开场=@图片1原本衣服；第1次=@衣服1；第2次=@衣服2；第3次=@衣服3；第4次=@衣服4。
5. 台词口型清晰，与点击节拍对齐。

Negative: 叠化换装，黑闪，白闪，烟雾，旋转遮挡，人物瞬移，姿势断裂，脸型变化，发型变化，鞋子乱变（除非衣服图自带），露男主脸，横屏，字幕，水印，Logo，背景突然更换，多人入画，宽松居家服除非衣服图就是，镜头剧烈抖动，手机屏幕模糊不可读。
entries.translated_prompt:
Duration: 20 seconds
Aspect ratio: 9:16
Overall style: POV boyfriend first-person short drama, realistic handheld mobile phone with slight breathing shake, transparent indoor natural light, instant outfit change upon sliding and clicking on the phone, fast-paced and sweet, vertical screen.

[Scene] Bright living room/bedroom, natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows, simple and warm background, clean floor without clutter.
[Character] Female lead (@Image 1, wearing original character clothing at start); male lead is POV perspective, no face shown throughout, only male hands holding a phone appearing at the bottom of the screen.
[Props] A modern full-screen mobile phone, held vertically. The screen displays a simple and stylish outfit app: a large preview image at the top and horizontally scrollable clothing cards at the bottom. Each slide has follow-through inertia, and there's a slight UI scale and short vibration feedback when clicking a card.

SHOT 1 (00:00-00:03.5) Opening Display
Visual: POV, female lead standing in center of screen, happily turning half a circle to show her outfit, lightly lifting the hem, eyes bright looking at camera.
Dialogue: Female lead: "Hubby, what do you think of my outfit today?"
Audio: Indoor ambient noise, light fabric sounds.
Constraints: Female lead full body in shot, starting outfit = original character clothing.

SHOT 2 (00:03.5-00:06.5) Pulling out phone + First slide
Visual: Male lead's hand holding phone enters screen at bottom, screen lights up showing outfit app. Thumb slides cards from right to left, stopping on the card for @Outfit 1, preview enlarges.
Dialogue: Male lead (Voiceover, lazy): "It's okay. Try this set."
Audio: Screen sliding friction sound.
Constraints: Phone screen clearly readable, card shows @Outfit 1; male lead only shows hands, no face.

SHOT 3 (00:06.5-00:09.5) First click instant change
Visual: Thumb clicks @Outfit 1 card, screen vibrates. At the same frame as the click, the clothing instantly changes to @Outfit 1, with position, posture, and hairstyle completely continuous; she looks down at the clothes, eyes wide, mouth open, then looks back at the camera.
Dialogue: Female lead (Surprised): "Eh?!"
Audio: Sharp "beep" + change "ding", fabric unfolding sound.
Constraints: Outfit change happens on the exact frame of the click, single-frame transition; a soft light sweep from top to bottom can be added; no dissolves, black frames, or character jumping.

SHOT 4 (00:09.5-00:13) Second slide + Click instant change
Visual: Thumb slides left again, card stops at @Outfit 2, click. Instantly changes to @Outfit 2; this time she reacts, cheeks slightly red, fingers twisting in front, shyly turning slightly, avoiding eye contact but unable to resist looking at the camera.
Dialogue: Male lead (Voiceover): "This set works too."
Female lead (Whispering): "You... clicking randomly."
Audio: Sliding sound + "beep" + "ding", light music begins to rise.
Constraints: Slide must completely show the movement from @Outfit 1 card to @Outfit 2; change remains an instant cut on click.

SHOT 5 (00:13-00:16.5) Third slide + Click instant change
Visual: Slide to @Outfit 3, click. Instantly changes to @Outfit 3; she's used to it now, bites her lower lip, adjusts the new collar/skirt hem, looks at the camera with a bit of pride.
Dialogue: Female lead: "This set... actually looks quite good."
Audio: "Beep" + "ding", music tempo speeds up by half a beat.
Constraints: Three reactions progress: surprise → shyness → pride; each has small movements, no standing still.

SHOT 6 (00:16.5-00:20) Fourth slide + Click + Closing
Visual: One last slide to @Outfit 4, thumb clicks. Instantly changes to @Outfit 4; she laughs, steps closer to the camera, squints playfully. Phone remains at bottom of screen, showing @Outfit 4 preview.
Dialogue: Male lead (Voiceover, satisfied): "This one is it."
Female lead (Laughing and leaning in, mock-blaming): "You're so bad—but I love it!"
Audio: "Beep" + "ding", music hits a sweet heavy beat on the dialogue finish.
Constraints: Ending lead leans in but not excessively close to lens; phone always visible at bottom; outfit sequence fixed: Start = Original → @Outfit 1 → @Outfit 2 → @Outfit 3 → @Outfit 4, no deviation.

[Director Rules]
1. Transition Rule: Each change must occur on the same frame as the 'click', instant single-frame change. Character position, pose, hairstyle, and face shape must be perfectly continuous across the transition frame.
2. POV Rule: Camera = male lead's eyes, slight handheld breathing shake throughout; male lead only shows hands + voiceover, no face.
3. Phone Rule: Must slide then click every time, card switching must be clear; no floating changes without interaction.
4. Asset Reference: Start = @Image 1 original clothes; 1st = @Outfit 1; 2nd = @Outfit 2; 3rd = @Outfit 3; 4th = @Outfit 4.
5. Dialogue lip-sync clear and aligned with clicking rhythm.

Negative: Dissolve changes, black frames, white flashes, smoke, spinning transitions, character teleporting, posture breakage, facial changes, hairstyle changes, shoe changes (unless in outfit image), male lead face reveal, horizontal screen, subtitles, watermarks, logos, sudden background change, extra people, baggy home clothes unless in the asset, heavy camera shake, unreadable screen.

Location: Small old Seoul apartment balcony on a sunny summer morning—concrete walls, metal railing, clothesline, colorful laundry, plastic basket, potted plants, neighboring buildings and distant rooftops. Bright, slightly hazy sunlight.

Photorealistic live-action Hollywood disaster film, ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic cinematic lens, realistic Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, practical stunt realism, believable destruction physics, handheld tracking, cinematic lighting, motion blur, dust, shattered glass, sparks and realistic debris.

entries.prompt:
【风格】 真人实拍质感的拟人猫咪搞笑短视频。猫咪保持真实的毛发、猫脸、胡须、耳朵和肉垫，身体能够拟人坐立、抱臂和操作麻将，但不能变成人脸、人手或卡通身体。室内柔和顶光，清晰自然的毛发细节、皮革纹理和麻将塑料反光。笑点依靠动作、停顿和两只猫的反应形成，不依靠夸张卡通特效。
【时长】 10秒，9:16竖屏。全程单一连续镜头，正常速度，不切特写、不慢放。
【场景】 现代居家麻将房，米白色墙面、简洁装饰画、右后方浅灰色落地窗帘，天花板有方形灯槽和嵌入式照明。前景是一张绿色绒面自动麻将桌，深色桌框，左下方露出一部分圆形控制盘。 麻将为蓝色牌背、白色牌面，牌面有红绿黑色图案。桌面中间散放少量打出的牌，近处与左右两侧排列着其他玩家的牌墙。西部牛仔猫面前有一排横向整齐排列的麻将，牌的蓝色背面朝向摄影机，看不见里面的花纹。画面下方和右侧偶尔出现其他玩家的真人手与前臂，完成摸牌、放牌和整理牌墙的小动作，不露出其他人的脸。
【角色一：坐着打麻将的西部牛仔猫】 使用参考图一中的灰褐色猫形象。 它坐在麻将桌对面的深色椅子上，位于画面中央偏右，面对摄影机。桌面高度约在它腹部，两只前爪能自然伸到桌面。帽檐略微上翘，始终能看清眼睛。气质像自以为牌技高超的冷面高手，动作越花哨，表情越淡定。嘴里还夹着一根烟，非常酷拽的表情。 只借用参考图的猫咪外貌和牛仔服装，手中只操作麻将；不加入参考图中的枪械、滑板、设定卡文字或其他装备展示。 【
角色二：站着围观的工牌猫】 使用参考图二中的银灰色虎斑猫：颈部佩戴挂绳，胸前悬挂透明卡套，卡套内有猫咪证件照，工牌大小适中且始终可辨认。 工牌猫直立站在牛仔猫身后偏左的位置，头部高于坐着的牛仔猫，身体露出上半身。前半段两只前爪交叉抱在胸前，工牌从交叠前臂下方露出。它始终面无表情地盯着牛仔猫的动作，眼神带审视和嫌弃，身体基本不动，形成和牛仔猫花式动作的反差。 【镜头与构图】 摄影机位于麻将桌另一侧，接近坐着的玩家视线高度，略微向下拍摄桌面。绿色麻将桌占画面下半部，两只猫占中上部。牛仔猫位于前方中央偏右，工牌猫位于后方偏左，始终保持这组前后关系。 轻微手机广角，固定位置手持微晃。两只猫的脸、牛仔猫的双爪、面前整排麻将和工牌猫的工牌都尽量留在画面内。镜头不绕行、不突然推近，结尾依靠动作制造冲击。
[00:00–00:01.40] 动作段1：
开场牛仔猫已经坐在桌前，挺着胸，微微抬起下巴，眼睛半眯，摆出胸有成竹的神态。 它先用右前爪沿桌面向画面左侧轻快伸出，拨动一张麻将，再把爪子收回。随后两只前爪分别按住面前全是背面的横排麻将的左右两端，向中间轻轻归拢，将牌列理齐。动作干净利落，肩膀几乎不动，像对桌上的局面完全有把握。 工牌猫在身后抱臂站立，只用眼睛跟随它的爪子移动，没有笑容，也不帮忙。右侧一只真人手把一张麻将放入桌面中间，随即收回。
音效：清脆的麻将碰撞声，轻微室内环境声。
[00:01.40–00:03.20] 动作段2：
牛仔猫从面前牌列中拿起一张蓝背麻将，左前爪在胸腹前摊开，肉垫朝上，形成承接姿态；右前爪将麻将压在左爪上 亲亲抚摸，摆出一副不用看牌就知道的表情。 工牌猫抱臂不动，目光向下，盯着它搓牌的双爪。

[00:03.20–00:05.80] 动作段3：

[00:05.80–00:07.70] 动作段4：
牛仔猫上身向前探，右前爪从自己面前伸向画面左下方的蓝背牌墙，爪垫压住最外侧一张麻将，把它从牌墙端部拖出，再沿桌面带回自己面前。 右爪收回时，它的身体重新坐直，头部却故意向上抬，目光看向上方偏右，仿佛不用看牌也知道下一步。左爪搭在自己的牌列旁，右爪把新摸的牌放在牌列附近。 。 音效：摸牌“咔”的一声，随后是一小段尴尬的安静。
[00:07.70–00:08.65] 动作段5：
牛仔猫胸有成竹的表情，做出一副要麻将胡了的动作：转两只前爪分别伸到自己面前整排麻将的两端，向内夹住牌列，试图把整排麻将同时提起并向上翻动。 它双肘弯曲，双爪快速上抬，但中间的麻将没有得到支撑，牌列立刻从中间断开。靠近双爪的几张牌先被带起，中间多张麻将接连滑落；蓝色牌背和白色牌面在空中交替翻转，落回绿色桌面。 失手只发生在桌面上方很短的高度，麻将以不同角度撞击、弹跳、翻倒，向桌面中央和左右散开，碰乱附近打出的牌。整排麻将从有序直线变成一桌凌乱，桌子本身不翻倒。 牛仔猫双爪仍停在半空，短暂保持原本准备展示的姿势，随后发现爪中已经空了。牛仔猫冷面高手的气势瞬间消失，表情略显尴尬。
音效：从一声失手的“咔”迅速变成密集的“哗啦啦、噼里啪啦”，最后几张麻将零星弹跳收尾。
[00:08.65–00:09.25] 动作段6：
牛仔猫双爪尴尬地悬在胸前，先低头看散乱的麻将，再慢慢转头望向身后的工牌猫。耳朵略向两侧压低，眼睛睁圆，表情从自信变成心虚。 工牌猫低头看一眼桌面，再看牛仔猫，眼睛略微眯起。它终于松开交叉的前爪，其中一只爪子从胸前抬起，肘部弯曲，爪垫朝向牛仔猫帽顶。胸前工牌随着解除抱臂的动作轻轻摆动。 保留短暂的对视停顿，让观众先看到牛仔猫意识到自己闯祸。
音效：最后一张麻将落稳的轻响。
[00:09.25–00:10.00] 动作段7
工牌猫抬起的前爪从上方向前下方快速挥出，用柔软爪垫在牛仔猫的帽顶和后脑方向狠狠拍了一下，动作短促明确，像对炫技失败的嫌弃提醒。 牛仔帽受到触碰后直接被扇飞。牛仔猫立即缩脖子、低头，身体向画面右侧躲开，双爪本能抬到脸和帽檐旁挡住，肩膀耸起。它仍坐在椅子上，不摔倒、不离开画面。 工牌猫的前爪跟随动作伸直，再开始收回，脸上始终保持无语的严肃表情；胸前工牌因挥爪轻轻晃动。桌面上留着刚才散落的麻将，其他玩家的真人手短暂停在桌边。
音效：一下轻巧的“啪”，。
【动作与一致性要求】 坐着打麻将的始终是西部牛仔猫，站在身后围观并在结尾抬爪的始终是工牌猫，不交换位置、服装或身份。牛仔帽、围巾、皮衣、虎斑花纹和工牌保持连续一致。 前半段突出“冷脸、稳坐、花式搓牌、抬头装高手”，后半段突出“整排提牌失手、麻将散落、空爪僵住、心虚回头、被轻拍帽顶”。必须先失手撒牌，再有工牌猫的反应和拍帽动作。 麻将是有厚度的硬质长方体，蓝背白面，接触双爪时有明确支撑，掉落时有重力、碰撞与反弹。麻将不凭空复制、不变成纸片、不长时间悬空。工牌

Its elbows bend and paws raise quickly, but the middle tiles lack support, causing the row to break instantly from the center. A few tiles near the paws lift first, while multiple middle tiles slip and fall sequentially; blue backs and white faces alternate flipping in the air, landing back onto the green tabletop. The blunder happens at a very short height above the table; tiles crash, bounce, and tip over at different angles, scattering toward the center and sides, disrupting nearby discarded tiles. The orderly row turns into complete chaos, though the table itself does not flip. Cowboy Cat's paws freeze mid-air, briefly holding the intended showoff pose before realizing its paws are empty. Cowboy Cat's stone-faced master aura vanishes instantly, replaced by a slightly awkward expression.
Audio: Shifts rapidly from a single failing 'crack' into a dense 'clatter, crash, pitter-patter', ending with a few scattered bouncing tiles.
[00:08.65–00:09.25] Action Section 6:
Cowboy Cat suspends its paws awkwardly in front of its chest, first looking down at the messy tiles, then slowly turning its head to look at ID Card Cat behind it. Its ears flatten slightly to the sides, eyes widen, and its expression changes from confident to guilty. ID Card Cat looks down at the table, then at Cowboy Cat, eyes narrowing slightly. It finally uncrosses its front paws, raising one from its chest, elbow bending, with the paw pad facing the top of Cowboy Cat's hat. The ID card on its chest sways gently with the arm movement. A brief standoff pause is maintained, letting the audience see Cowboy Cat realizing it caused trouble first.
Audio: Faint sound of the last tile settling down.
[00:09.25–00:10.00] Action Section 7:
ID Card Cat's raised front paw strikes down quickly from above, slapping Cowboy Cat firmly on the top of its hat and back of its head with its soft paw pad. The action is short and precise, like a disgusted reminder for the failed trick. The cowboy hat flies off upon impact. Cowboy Cat instantly tucks its neck, ducks its head, and dodges toward the right side of the screen, instinctively raising both paws to block its face and hat brim while shrugging shoulders. It remains seated on the chair, not falling or leaving the frame. ID Card Cat's front paw extends straight following the motion, then begins to retract, its face maintaining a wordless, serious expression throughout; the ID card on its chest sways gently from the swipe. The scattered mahjong tiles remain on the table, and real human hands of other players pause briefly by the edge.
Audio: A crisp 'smack'.
[Movement & Consistency Requirements] The one playing mahjong is always the Western Cowboy Cat, and the one standing behind observing and slapping at the end is always the ID Card Cat; no swapping of positions, clothing, or identities. The cowboy hat, scarf, leather jacket, tabby stripes, and ID card remain continuous and consistent. The first half highlights 'cold face, steady sitting, fancy tile-rubbing, and looking up like a master', while the second half highlights 'failing to lift the tile row, scattered mahjong tiles, freezing with empty paws, looking back guiltily, and getting tapped on the hat brim'. The tile blunder must happen before ID Card Cat's reaction and slap. Mahjong tiles are thick, rigid rectangular blocks with blue backs and white faces, showing clear support when touching paws and demonstrating gravity, collision, and bounce when dropping. entries.title: Seoul Morning Vlog Commute
entries.description: A 30-second vlog-style video prompt simulating a sleepy morning commute in Seoul, captured with handheld smartphone realism.
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home video in 16:9 landscape, showing an ordinary early morning in the life of one adult Korean woman commuting through Seoul. Use an entirely original fictional character created from the written description below. No reference image is supplied or required. The finished video should resemble genuine footage casually recorded by a close friend accompanying her during a sleepy morning commute. MAIN CHARACTER: One 23-year-old Korean woman with a petite oval face, naturally fair skin with visible texture, soft brown eyes, straight eyebrows, a small natural nose, and muted coral lips. Her under-eyes look slightly puffy from waking early. She wears bare-minimal makeup with no artificial skin smoothing. Her long black hair is arranged in a loose, messy half-up bun with several strands falling naturally around her face and neck. She wears the same oversized medium-blue denim jacket over a cream knitted sweater, charcoal wide-leg trousers, black leather loafers, and small silver stud earrings throughout. A slim dark-green canvas tote remains on her left shoulder, and she carries the same black smartphone in her right hand. Preserve her exact face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, tote, phone, and sleepy personality across every scene. CAMERA APPROACH: The camera is operated horizontally by an unseen friend walking and commuting beside her. She never records herself and never takes the camera. Use authentic handheld smartphone footage with gentle hand tremor, subtle walking bounce, occasional imperfect framing, mild low-light grain, small exposure changes, realistic motion blur, and autofocus that briefly searches in the dim subway lighting. The friend usually records from chest or eye height at a natural conversational distance. Avoid polished compositions and repeated direct eye contact with the lens. Make the footage feel personal, spontaneous, and slightly unplanned. OPENING — QUIET PLATFORM WAIT Begin immediately on a mostly empty underground Seoul subway platform before sunrise. Pale fluorescent ceiling lights reflect softly across the clean floor. Light condensation covers sections of the platform-screen doors, and vague red and white signal lights glow along the distant tracks. A few pigeons can be seen safely on an unused exterior section beyond the platform barriers. The first commuters of the morning wait quietly at widely separated positions. The camera approaches the woman from slightly behind and to her left. She stands near a marked waiting area with her tote on her left shoulder and her phone in her right hand. She reads something on the phone, blinks slowly, and gives a small involuntary yawn that she covers with the back of her left hand. She places that hand back on her tote strap and gently shifts her weight from one loafer to the other. The friend filming steps closer, causing the phone camera to briefly lose focus before finding her face. She notices the camera for a moment but is still too sleepy to react. A loose strand of black hair rests across her cheek while the remaining commuters continue behaving naturally in the background. TRAIN ARRIVAL — MORNING AIR AND MOVEMENT A distant train rumble grows louder. She locks her phone and lowers it beside her right thigh while keeping a secure grip on it. The camera turns briefly toward the tunnel as the approaching headlights brighten behind the glass barriers. The train enters the station with a strong rush of air. Her loose hair strands and oversized denim jacket move naturally in the draft. She narrows her eyes, turns her face away from the wind, and holds the tote strap more securely with her left hand. Reflections of passing train windows rapidly travel over her face and clothing. When the platform and train doors align and open, she waits for two adult passengers to exit before stepping aboard. The friend follows directly behind her, and the frame is briefly obstructed by the shoulder of another commuter. The camera corrects its position naturally rather than producing a perfect transition. Show one quick interior moment as she stands beside the train door, holding a metal support pole with her left hand while the tote stays trapped securely between her arm and body. She briefly closes her eyes as if she could fall asleep while standing. Keep the train interior ordinary, moderately lit, and only lightly occupied. STREET EXIT — FIRST DAYLIGHT Transition with a simple natural cut to the woman climbing the final stairs out of a subway exit. The unseen friend follows two steps behind. The outside light is pale blue and slightly brighter than the station, causing the smartphone exposure to adjust gradually. She reaches the quiet street, squints at the dawn light, and takes a deeper breath of cold air. She transfers her phone briefly into her left hand, stretches her right arm above her head, and rolls one shoulder beneath the oversized jacket. After stretching, she returns the phone to her right hand and settles the tote back into its original position on her left shoulder. The Seoul neighborhood is only beginning to wake. Show closed storefront shutters, a delivery bicycle leaning against a wall, traffic signals changing over an almost empty intersection, a city bus passing in the distance, and the first office workers walking toward the station. Keep signs and branding soft, distant, and unreadable. ODENG CART — A WARM MORNING STOP As she continues walking, she notices a small street-food cart preparing to open near the subway exit. Steam rises from a metal broth container into the cold blue morning air. An adult vendor arranges fish-cake skewers while warm light from the cart contrasts naturally with the cool street. She walks over, politely nods to the vendor, and stops beside the cart. The friend films from her right side as she chooses one folded fish-cake skewer. The vendor places the skewer in a small paper cup containing a little hot broth and hands it to her. She accepts the cup carefully with her left hand while continuing to hold her phone in her right. She lifts the cup close to her lips, blows gently over the broth, and attempts a cautious sip. The broth is hotter than expected. She immediately pulls it away, raises her eyebrows, presses her lips together, and releases a quiet amused breath through her nose. Keep the reaction small, natural, and spontaneous. She then takes a modest bite from the fish cake, chews naturally, and begins walking again while carrying the cup securely. Steam should continue rising from the broth, the skewer must remain inside the same cup, and its size must reduce naturally after the bite. FINAL MOMENT — SLEEPY COMMENT The friend walks backward a few steps while recording her from the front. She glances toward the camera with tired eyes and notices that her ordinary breakfast is still being filmed. Without stopping, she says naturally in English, “You’re always filming the boring parts.” Her voice is soft, sleepy, and playfully annoyed. After speaking, she gives the friend a small genuine smile, looks back toward the sidewalk, and continues walking. The camera allows her to move slightly farther ahead before following from behind. End with her oversized denim jacket, messy half-up bun, dark-green tote, and steaming breakfast cup visible as she walks into the pale morning street. Finish with a simple natural fade to black. AUDIO: Use synchronized original location sound only: distant train rumble, soft platform announcement murmurs, train-door chimes, compressed air, footsteps on station tiles, jacket fabric movement, quiet early-morning traffic, the vendor arranging metal containers, broth being poured, light street wind, and her natural dialogue. Background conversations remain indistinct. No music and no narration. REALISM AND CONTINUITY:

SCENE BREAKDOWN (2-SECOND BEATS)
00:00–00:02 (Beat 1 — The Kitchen) She turns from the counter holding a glass of iced tea, spots the lens, and flashes an amused half-smile as the friend quickly taps zoom in and out.

00:02–00:04 (Beat 2 — Stepping Outside) She shoulders her canvas tote and pushes open the heavy wooden alley door, holding it open for the camera while a bicycle rattles past on cobblestones.

00:04–00:06 (Beat 3 — The Fruit Stand) Pausing at a corner wooden crate, she picks up a ripe peach, exchanges a quick laugh and coins with the vendor, and drops it into a small paper sleeve.
