entries.prompt:
A 15-second cinematic sci-fi adventure sequence in one continuous flowing scene. Deep beneath a remote desert archaeological site, an experienced archaeologist in dusty expedition clothing, leather satchel, gloves, and a headlamp carefully explores a vast underground chamber that has remained sealed for thousands of years. Massive stone pillars covered in mysterious glowing symbols surround an enormous circular structure partially buried beneath the sand and rock, unlike any ancient technology ever discovered. The archaeologist brushes away centuries of dust from a smooth metallic surface and unknowingly presses a strange glowing symbol. 

Instantly, ancient mechanisms awaken throughout the chamber. Giant stone rings begin rotating with a deep mechanical rumble as hidden blue energy races through intricate channels carved into the walls. Dust falls from the ceiling while the entire underground complex trembles. The archaeologist steps back in awe as the enormous machine slowly rises from beneath the ground, revealing impossible engineering far beyond human civilization. Ancient holographic symbols materialize in the air, rotating around the machine while thousands of tiny lights illuminate the chamber for the first time in millennia. Suddenly the machine projects a massive three-dimensional star map above itself, displaying countless galaxies before focusing on Earth. One glowing point begins flashing directly beneath the archaeologist's feet. The chamber falls silent. The machine slowly turns toward the archaeologist as if it has become aware of their presence. 

A metallic iris opens at its center, revealing a brilliant white eye that blinks once and calmly speaks in an ancient synthetic voice: "Welcome back... Commander." The archaeologist freezes in disbelief, realizing the machine was not waiting for someone to find it-it was waiting for them. End on an extreme close-up of the archaeologist's stunned face reflected in the glowing mechanical eye before cutting instantly to black. Photorealistic cinematic realism, ancient-meets-futuristic design, monumental underground architecture, ultra-detailed stone textures and advanced metallic machinery, blue and gold energy illumination, volumetric dust, dramatic light rays, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, fluid cinematic camera movement, epic scale, mysterious atmosphere, grounded visual effects, consistent character appearance throughout, no text overlays, no subtitles, no title card.

entries.title: Japanese Schoolgirl Brass Band Vlog
entries.description: A comprehensive video generation prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a realistic, nostalgic Vlog-style sequence of a Japanese middle school girl practicing the trumpet, focusing on character consistency and natural physical interactions.
entries.prompt:
田舎の中学校の吹奏楽部の女の子の放課後を、同じパートの友達が撮った15秒間のVlog風ホームビデオとして作成せよ。15秒は7個の短いショット（各約2秒）のハードカット of モンタージュで構成する。各ショットはすべて別の瞬間で、1ショット＝1つの小さな出来事。トランジションやフェードは使わない。撮っているのは仲のいい友達なので、彼女はリラックスしていて素の表情を見せる。

メイン被写体
全ショットを通じて同じ日本人の女子中学生。透明感のある美少女。やや垂れ目がちの大きな二重の目、伏し目のときに影を落とすほど長いまつげ、細い自然な眉、透けるように白い現実的な肌の質感、ノーメイク、小さくすっとした鼻筋、薄い桜色の唇、きれいな卵型の輪郭。まっすぐな黒髪を低い位置でひとつに結んでいる。普段は控えめでおっとりした雰囲気。白い半袖のセーラー服、紺の襟、膝丈の紺のプリーツスカート、上履き。楽器は使い込まれた銀のトランペット。顔、体型、髪型、制服、楽器を最初から最後まで完全に一貫させる。

ロケーション
夏の放課後の、田舎の中学校の音楽室。譜面台、並んだ椅子、開いた窓、窓の外のグラウンドと山。夕方の光が少しずつ濃くなる。広告、認識できるブランドはなし。

カメラ / ビジュアルスタイル
全ショット共通：手持ちの古い家庭用デジタルカメラ。自然な揺れ、不完全なフレーミング、時折のピントの迷い、露出のゆらぎ、軽いモーションブラー、微妙なノイズ、少し抑えた色。スタビライズ、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画的照明はなし。

ショットリスト（順番通り、各約2秒、すべてハードカット）
1. 楽器ケースを抱えて音楽室に入ってきて、カメラに気づき、恥ずかしそうに小さく手を振る。
2. ケースを開け、トランペットを柔らかい布でていねいに磨く手元。
3. 譜面台の楽譜に鉛筆で小さく書き込みながら、口の中でメロディーを歌う。
4. 友達と椅子を並べて何か喋って、口元を隠して笑う（言葉は聞こえない）。
5. トランペットを構えた瞬間、表情が変わる。夕日の差す音楽室で、凛とした真剣な横顔。
6. ロングトーン。まっすぐ前を見つめる目。窓の外から遠くの部活の声。
7. 吹き終えてふっと息を抜き、カメラに向かって照れたように笑う。その途中、およそ00:14で録画は突然ブラックアウトに切り替わる。フェードアウトなし。

物理的リアリズム
信ぴょう性のある現実世界の物理を維持。手、指、髪、制服、トランペット、譜面台は自然に振る舞う。余分な指、融合した手、歪んだ体、浮遊物、消える物体、突然の変形はなし。楽器の構え方と指の位置は現実的なまま。全ショットで被写体を一貫させる。

オーディオ
自然な環境音のみ。トランペットの澄んだロングトーン、布の擦れる音、鉛筆の音、遠くの部活の掛け声、セミの声。音楽（BGM）なし。ナレーションなし。人工的な音響効果なし。

最終的な雰囲気
控えめな子が楽器を構えた瞬間だけ別人みたいに凛とする、その両方が見える放課後の記録。商業作品ではない。ミュージックビデオではない。静かで、ひたむきで、懐かしく、温かく、即興的で、深く人間的。カメラがたまたまそこにあったような感じを優先。

entries.title: Futuristic Space Station Transformation Video
entries.description: A cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 depicting a futuristic space station that morphs into a giant mechanical creature while people inside continue their lives.

entries.title: 7-Year-Old Girl Summer Vlog
entries.description: A nostalgic, home-video style prompt for a 7-year-old Japanese girl helping her mother in a rural setting, featuring a montage of 7 realistic short shots.
entries.prompt: 田舎で夏休みを過ごす7歳の日本人の女の子が、お母さんのお手伝いについて回る様子を、お父さんが撮った15秒間のVlog風ホームビデオとして作成せよ。480p。15秒は7個の短いショット（各約2秒）のハードカットのモンタージュで構成する。各ショットはすべて別の瞬間で、1ショット＝1つの小さな出来事。トランジションやフェードは使わない。家族のカメラなので、彼女は完全にリラックスしていて素の表情を見せる。メイン被写体：全ショットを通じて同じ7歳の日本人の女の子。田舎町にいるとは思えないほどかわいい美少女だが、表情はあどけない。黒目がちの大きな澄んだ瞳とくっきりした二重、長い自然なまつげ、ふっくらした丸い頬、小さく丸い鼻、桜色の小さな唇。笑うと目じりが下がり、抜けた前歯が1本見える。日に焼けた健康的な肌、現実的な肌の質感、頬にほんのり赤み、汗で額に少し張りつく前髪。黒髪のおかっぱ。ノースリーブの白いワンピースに子ども用の小さなエプロン、裸足に近いサンダル。顔、体型、髪型、服装を最初から最後まで完全に一貫させる。ロケーション：夏の田舎の古い日本家屋。台所、縁側、庭の物干し。セミの声。生活感のある本物の家。広告、認識できるブランドはなし。カメラ / ビジュアルスタイル：全ショット共通：手持ちの古い家庭用デジタルカメラ。自然な揺れ、不完全なフレーミング、時折のピントの迷い、露出のゆらぎ、軽いモーションブラー、微妙なノイズ、少し抑えた色。スタビライズ、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画的照明はなし。ショットリスト（順番通り、各約2秒、すべてハードカット）：1. 台所の踏み台の上でお母さんの隣に立ち、トマトを洗う。水を跳ねさせてしまい、母と顔を見合わせて笑う。2. 洗い終わったシーツを抱えて庭へ運ぶ。顔が半分埋まって、よろよろ歩く。3. 物干しで母に洗濯ばさみを1個ずつ渡す。得意げな顔。1個落として「あっ」という顔をする。4. 縁側で豆のすじ取り。1本ぽきっと折りすぎて、こっそり背中の後ろに隠す。5. 麦茶のコップを両手で持ち、こぼさないように一歩ずつ、世界一真剣な顔で運ぶ。6. 母に渡せた瞬間、ぱあっと満面の得意顔。頭を撫でられて目を細める。7. 縁側で母と並んでスイカ。カメラに気づいて、種を飛ばすまねをして笑う。その途中、およそ00:14で録画は突然ブラックアウトに切り替わる。フェードアウトなし。物理的リアリズム：信ぴょう性のある現実世界の物理を維持。手、指、足、髪、水、シーツ、コップ、スイカは自然に振る舞う。余分な指、融合した手、歪んだ体、浮遊物、消える物体、突然の変形はなし。全ショットで被写体を一貫させる。オーディオ：自然な環境音のみ。セミの声、水の音、風鈴、洗濯物のはためき、母のやさしい声（言葉は聞き取れない）。音楽なし。ナレーションなし。人工的な音響効果なし。最終的な雰囲気：ちょっとずつ失敗するけど憎めない、7歳の夏の午後の記録。商業作品ではない。CMではない。失敗して隠す顔と、できた瞬間の得意顔の両方がいとおしい。あどけなく、懐かしく、温かく、即興的で、深く人間的。カメラがたまたまそこにあったような感じを優先。
entries.translated_prompt: Create a 15-second vlog-style home video of a 7-year-old Japanese girl spending her summer vacation in the countryside, following her mother around to help. 480p. The 15 seconds should consist of a hard-cut montage of 7 short shots (approx. 2 seconds each). Each shot is a different moment, 1 shot = 1 small event. No transitions or fades. Since it's a family camera, she is completely relaxed and shows her natural expressions. Main Subject: The same 7-year-old Japanese girl throughout all shots. A beautiful girl, incredibly cute for a rural town, but with an innocent expression. Large clear dark eyes with distinct double eyelids, long natural lashes, plump round cheeks, a small round nose, and small cherry-pink lips. When she laughs, the corners of her eyes drop, and one missing front tooth is visible. Sun-tanned healthy skin with realistic texture, a hint of redness on her cheeks, and bangs slightly stuck to her forehead with sweat. Black bob hair. Sleeveless white dress with a small child's apron, and sandals close to barefoot. Maintain complete consistency in face, body type, hairstyle, and clothing from start to finish. Location: An old Japanese house in the summer countryside. Kitchen, veranda, and garden clothesline. Sound of cicadas. A real home with a lived-in feel. No advertisements or recognizable brands. Camera / Visual Style: For all shots: handheld old household digital camera. Natural shaking, imperfect framing, occasional focus hunting, exposure fluctuations, light motion blur, subtle noise, and slightly suppressed colors. No stabilization, gimbals, drones, slow motion, or cinematic lighting. Shot List (in order, approx. 2 seconds each, all hard cuts): 1. Standing next to mother on a kitchen stool, washing tomatoes. Splashes water and laughs while looking at mother. 2. Carrying washed sheets to the garden. Her face is half-buried, walking unsteadily. 3. Handing clothespins one by one to mother at the clothesline. A proud face. Drops one and makes an 'oops' face. 4. Removing strings from beans on the veranda. Snaps one too much and secretly hides it behind her back. 5. Holding a cup of barley tea with both hands, carrying it step by step with the world's most serious face to avoid spilling. 6. The moment she hands it to mother, her face lights up with full pride. She narrows her eyes as her head is patted. 7. Eating watermelon side-by-side with mother on the veranda. Notices the camera and laughs while pretending to spit a seed. During this, at approx. 00:14, the recording suddenly cuts to black. No fade-out. Physical Realism: Maintain credible real-world physics. Hands, fingers, feet, hair, water, sheets, cups, and watermelon behave naturally. No extra fingers, fused hands, distorted bodies, floating objects, disappearing objects, or sudden deformations. Maintain subject consistency across all shots. Audio: Only natural ambient sounds. Cicadas, water, wind chimes, flapping laundry, mother's gentle voice (words unintelligible). No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects. Final Atmosphere: A record of a 7-year-old's summer afternoon, failing a little but being lovable. Not a commercial work. Not a CM. Both the face of hiding a failure and the proud face of a success are precious. Innocent, nostalgic, warm, improvisational, and deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that the camera just happened to be there.

entries.title: Realistic 2000s Home Video Snack Fail
entries.description: An ultra-realistic prompt for Seedance 2.0 designed to replicate the look and feel of a spontaneous early-2000s handheld home video.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic personal home-video featuring the woman from the reference image. Keep her exact appearance, facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, and identity consistent throughout the entire video.

Setting: A quiet roadside neighborhood at night during summer. Warm streetlights illuminate the pavement, with dark trees, small roadside shops, parked vehicles, and occasional distant headlights. The environment feels ordinary and slightly imperfect.

Wardrobe: She wears a simple white casual dress, natural and slightly loose, with realistic fabric movement.

Action: She stands or sits casually by the roadside, holding a small everyday snack in her hand. As she eats, a little piece unexpectedly falls onto her hand. She notices it, tries to catch it with her fingers, then looks toward the camera and laughs naturally. She wipes her hand with a napkin, shakes her head and quietly mutters, “This is going terribly.” A moment later, another small piece falls onto her hand. She looks directly into the camera with a defeated little smile and says, “I'm still eating it.”

Visual style: Shot like a random early-2000s family video. Handheld DV camcorder, imperfect framing, tiny focus mistakes, soft digital noise, mild motion blur, slight lens imperfections, uneven exposure from streetlights, realistic low-light grain. No cinematic composition or polished commercial look.

Audio: Natural nighttime roadside ambience—distant traffic, passing motorcycles, insects, soft wind, occasional footsteps, snack-wrapper crinkles, and quiet spontaneous laughter. No music, subtitles, or cinematic sound effects.

Keep the acting understated, awkward, spontaneous, and genuinely human. The whole clip should feel like an accidentally recorded silly nighttime moment rather than a scripted performance.

entries.title: Cyberpunk Anime Street Fight
entries.description: An extremely detailed 15-second combat prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a high-energy fight between two stylized characters in a dense urban setting.
entries.prompt: 保持首帧中两名少年角色的脸、发型、服装、体型、配色、气质和站位关系一致，不要换脸，不要换衣服，不要交换角色。 左侧角色：黑发少年，红色格纹外套、白色T恤、深色长裤，动作风格偏力量型、压迫型、近身硬打型。 右侧角色：银蓝色短发少年，黑白科技感外套、深色长裤、红白运动鞋，动作风格偏高速突进型、敏捷型、蓝色能量强化型。 场景是现代高楼密集都市街道，港风中文招牌、红色出租车、密集建筑立面、强烈透视街景。 整体风格为 高完成度热血国漫 / 动漫电影感 / 超高能战斗PV感。 整段视频是 15秒纯享高燃打斗，第一秒立即开打，没有对白，没有字幕，没有Logo，没有UI，没有搞笑桥段。 核心要求 - 15秒 - 16:9 - 第一秒立刻爆发 - 动作极快 - 镜头高速跟随 - 特效夸张 - 速度感极强 - 环境破坏明显 - 尽量压缩所有时间在打斗上 - 不做冗长铺垫 - 动作必须清楚可读 - 特效不能把动作完全遮住 15秒动作设计 0—3秒 从首帧动作直接爆开。 银蓝发角色一拳缠绕巨大蓝色电流与高亮能量拳风，正面轰向黑发角色。 黑发角色不闪，沉肩硬挡，左臂格住冲击，右拳同时反轰。 双拳接触瞬间爆出巨大的蓝白冲击波，地面积水、碎石、白色气浪和碎片同时炸开。 街边红色出租车车身剧烈震动，中文招牌狂晃，玻璃反光被瞬间点亮。 镜头贴近拳头开始，然后像穿越机一样高速绕两人半圈，第一秒就拉满冲击感。 3—6秒 黑发角色展开近身重压，连续前冲： - 直拳 - 肘击 - 膝撞 - 肩撞 每一击都带白色爆裂拳风和短促音爆感。 银蓝发角色高速格挡、偏闪、滑步侧移，脚下不断炸出蓝色残影和电弧。 黑发角色一拳将银蓝发角色轰向红色出租车，车门凹陷。 银蓝发角色借车身反蹬翻起，从黑发角色头顶掠过，留下长长蓝色能量尾迹，落地瞬间回身一记回旋踢，踢出巨大蓝色弧光。 6—9秒 银蓝发角色开始高速反压。 他进入爆发状态，以极高速度围绕黑发角色连续突进打击： - 超快直拳连打 - 贴身肘击 - 膝击 - 能量重拳 蓝色能量轨迹像流体闪电一样缠绕全身。 黑发角色连续防守，被打得后退，鞋底在地面拖出痕迹。 一记重击把黑发角色打进街边设施，碎石、广告牌碎片和尘土一起爆散。 镜头贴地高速滑行，再猛然抬升穿过飞散碎片 and 能量残影。 9—12秒 黑发角色强行顶回去，不再后退。 他硬抗一波攻击后抓住银蓝发角色手腕，强行打断对方高速节奏。 地面在拽停瞬间爆裂，周围空气像被猛地撕开。 黑发角色立刻接上重型近战连段： - 一记腹部重拳 - 一记上勾拳 - 一记肘击 - 一记将对手轰飞出去的正面重击 银蓝发角色被轰飞，撞在街边招牌或车体上，金属扭曲，玻璃震裂，火花、蓝色粒子和碎片一起炸开。 整条街都有明显破坏反馈。 12—15秒 最后高潮。 银蓝发角色借墙面或车顶反弹回来，蓝色能量全面爆发。 黑发角色也全力爆发。 两人在街道中央展开最后一轮超高速对轰： - 连续直拳对撞 - 交叉格挡 - 回旋踢 - 膝撞 - 正面重拳互轰 每次碰撞都爆出巨大蓝白闪光、能量冲击波和破风流线。 地面裂开，积水炸起，出租车震动，招牌狂晃，整条街被冲击波横扫。 最后黑发角色抓到空档，一记极重正面冲拳将银蓝发角色轰飞出去，拖着长长蓝色能量尾迹滑出很远。 但银蓝发角色最终单膝落地，手撑地面，没有彻底败北。 镜头快速从两人中间穿过，带出满街狼藉、残留电弧、漂浮能量粒子和晃动招牌，在双方遥遥对峙的高张力画面中结束。 特效要求 重点强化： - 蓝色高能拳风 - 蓝白电弧 - 巨大冲击波 - 能量拖尾 - 残影 - 粒子爆散 - 空气撕裂流线 - 地面裂纹 - 水花和碎石飞溅 - 车辆震动变形 - 玻璃震裂 - 招牌晃动 - 街道级破坏反馈 镜头要求 - 高速跟拍 - 环绕 - 贴身推进 - 穿越式掠过 - 低机位仰拍 - 突然拉远再猛冲近 - 尽量像一镜到底 - 始终跟着打斗重心 - 不要乱切，不要看不清动作

entries.title: Nostalgic High School Girl Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for creating a nostalgic, vlog-style video of a Japanese high school girl's day, focusing on natural interactions and authentic school settings.
entries.prompt: かわいい日本人の女子高校生の、なんでもない学校の1日を、同級生の親友が撮ったVlog風個人ホームビデオとして作成せよ。超現実的。約10個の短いショット（各2〜3秒）のハードカットのモンタージュで構成する。各ショットはすべて別の場所・別の瞬間で、1ショット＝1つの小さな出来事。トランジション効果やフェードは使わない。撮っているのはいちばん仲のいい親友なので、彼女は完全にリラックスしていて、カメラに笑いかけ、物を見せ、話しかける（言葉は聞き取れない）。ポーズや演技ではなく、親友にだけ見せる素の表情。 メイン被写体 全ショットを通じて同じ日本人の女子高校生。目を引く完璧な美人ではなく、笑った瞬間がいちばんかわいい、話しかけやすい親しみのある顔立ち。 現実的な肌の質感、ノーメイク、頬にほんの少し赤み。笑うと目が三日月になり、八重歯が少しのぞく。 黒髪のゆるいボブで、右の耳の上を小さな銀のヘアピンで留めている。 白い半袖の開襟シャツ、えんじ色のリボン、グレーの膝丈プリーツスカート、白いソックス、上履き（校外では白いスニーカー）、肩掛けのスクールバッグ。 顔、体型、髪型、制服、持ち物を最初から最後まで完全に一貫させる。 ロケーション 夏の朝から夕方の、ごく普通の公立高校。昇降口、窓際の席のある教室、廊下、購買、中庭、放課後の夕日が差す教室、校門。生活感のある本物の学校。他の生徒は背景に自然な程度。広告、認識できるブランドはなし。 カメラ / ビジュアルスタイル 全ショット共通：親友が構える手持ちの古い民生用デジタルカメラ。自然な揺れ、不完全なフレーミング、時折のオートフォーカス変更、露出のゆらぎ、柔らかい画像ディテール、軽いモーションブラー、微妙なデジタルノイズ、少し抑えた色、不完全なホワイトバランス。スタビライズ、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画的照明、商業カラーグレーディングはなし。 ショットリスト（順番通り、各2〜3秒、すべてハードカット） 1. 休み時間。前の席の椅子に後ろ向きに座り、身振りをつけて何か喋る（聞こえない）。 2. 購買でパンを2つ買い、1つをレンズに差し出す。 3. 昼休みの中庭のベンチ。パンをかじりながら、木漏れ日に目を細める。 4. 廊下で笑いすぎて壁にもたれ、目じりを指で拭う。 5. 掃除の時間。ほうきを持ったままふざけたポーズをして、廊下の先の気配に気づき、慌ててまじめに掃きだす。 6. 水道で手を洗い、濡れた指先でカメラに水滴を飛ばすまねをして笑う。 7. 放課後、夕日の教室。机に伏せてうたた寝しているところを撮られ、起きて照れ笑い。 8. 黒板の隅に小さな落書きを描いて振り返り、八重歯を見せてにっと笑い、すぐ消す。 9. 昇降口でスニーカーに履き替えながら、何か喋って笑う。 10. 夕焼けの校門で振り返り、両手で大きく手を振る。その途中、録画は突然ブラックアウトに切り替わる。フェードアウトなし。 物理的リアリズム 全ショットで信ぴょう性のある現実世界の物理を維持。手、指、足、制服、髪、パン、ほうき、ノート、スクールバッグは自然に振る舞う。余分な指、融合した手、重複した手足、歪んだ解剖学、浮遊物、消える物体、突然の変形はなし。足は床と地面に適切に繋がったまま。ショット間で被写体を一貫させ、光は朝→昼→夕焼けへ自然に進む。 オーディオ 自然な環境音のみ。ショットごとに環境音も切り替わる。遠くのチャイム、上履きの音、教室のざわめき、購買の喧騒、セミの声、ほうきの音、遠くの部活の掛け声、言葉として聞き取れない話し声と笑い声。音楽なし。ナレーションなし。人工的な音響効果なし。 最終的な雰囲気 12個の何気ない瞬間を並べただけなのに、あとで見返すとエモいと感じる映像。商業作品ではない。ファッション映画ではない。ミュージックビデオではない。同じクラスの親友のカメラにだけ残っている、なんでもないのに二度と戻らない学校の1日の記録。屈託がなく、青春の途中で、懐かしく、温かく、即興的で、深く人間的。カメラがたまたまそこにあったような感じを優先。
entries.translated_prompt:
Create a 30-second 1080p ultra-realistic personal home video depicting a typical day in the life of a cute Japanese high school girl, filmed by her best friend. The style should be hyper-realistic, composed of a montage of about 10 short shots (2-3 seconds each) with hard cuts. No transition effects or fades. Since it is her best friend filming, she is completely relaxed, smiling at the camera, showing things, and talking (words are inaudible). The expressions should be natural ones shown only to a close friend, not posed or acted.

Main Subject: The same Japanese high school girl throughout all shots. Not a striking perfect beauty, but someone with a friendly, approachable face who is cutest when she smiles. Realistic skin texture, no makeup, a slight flush on the cheeks. Her eyes turn into crescents when she laughs, and her snaggletooth slightly shows. She has a loose black bob hair pinned above her right ear with a small silver hairpin. She wears a white short-sleeved open-collar shirt, a dark red ribbon, a gray knee-length pleated skirt, white socks, indoor shoes (white sneakers outside), and a shoulder school bag. Maintain complete consistency of face, body, hairstyle, uniform, and belongings.

Location: A typical public high school from summer morning to evening. Entrance, classroom with window seats, hallway, school store, courtyard, classroom in evening sun, school gate. A real school with a sense of daily life. Other students in the background at a natural level. No advertisements or recognizable brands.

Camera / Visual Style: A handheld old consumer digital camera held by a best friend. Natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus changes, exposure fluctuations, soft image detail, light motion blur, subtle digital noise, slightly desaturated colors, imperfect white balance. No stabilization, gimbal, drone, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading.

Shot List: (10 shots including classroom breaks, buying bread at the store, lunch in the courtyard, cleaning time, nap in the classroom, and waving goodbye at sunset.)

Atmosphere: A recording of a mundane but irreplaceable day at school that feels nostalgic and emotional when looked back upon later. Not a commercial, fashion film, or music video. Prioritize the feeling that the camera just happened to be there.

entries.title: The Last of the Mohicans Waterfall Scene
entries.description: A structured cinematic scene prompt depicting characters from The Last of the Mohicans hiding behind a waterfall while warriors search nearby.
entries.prompt:
Characters:
* Hawkeye — rugged frontiersman with shoulder-length dark hair, buckskin clothing, long rifle.
* Cora Munro — young woman in a pale colonial dress.
* Uncas — athletic Native American warrior with braided hair.
* Huron warriors — several hunters carrying spears.

Scene: Late afternoon beside a roaring waterfall deep in the forest. Hawkeye, Cora, and Uncas crouch silently behind rocks inside a shallow cave hidden by the falling water. Outside, several Huron warriors carefully search the riverbank but fail to notice the concealed entrance. Water sprays across the rocks as everyone remains perfectly still, waiting until the search party slowly disappears downstream. No music. Pay attention to maintain spatial consistency and respect 180 degree rule in cinematography.

preview_videos.caption: The Last of the Mohicans Waterfall Scene

entries.title: French Comic Octopus Detective Mystery
entries.description: An animated mystery comedy prompt in a French ligne claire comic-book style, featuring an octopus detective in an underwater office.
entries.prompt:
montage, multi-shot animated mystery comedy, Don't use one camera angle or single cut, French ligne claire comic-book animation, clean precise outlines, flat elegant colors, minimal shading, charming European graphic storytelling, crisp architectural backgrounds, expressive restrained faces, sparkling underwater caustics, turquoise coral red cream and navy palette

Inside a glass-domed detective office on the floor of a colorful tropical sea, an elegant octopus detective wearing a tiny trench coat sits behind a desk, a nervous pufferfish client floats opposite him, and a bored seahorse assistant holds a notepad. Outside the giant windows, schools of fish glide between coral towers. A suspicious crab hides beneath the desk.

Shot 1: Medium shot with a smooth sideways dolly, the octopus detective steeples four pairs of tentacles confidently. He says: "No mystery is too complicated for Monsieur Octave."

Shot 2: Close-up, the nervous pufferfish inflates slightly with distress and says: "Someone stole my priceless pearl!"

Shot 3: Wide shot, the octopus rises dramatically and uses six tentacles simultaneously to examine the room with magnifying glasses while the seahorse assistant scribbles notes.

Shot 4: Medium tracking shot, the detective follows a trail of tiny scratches across the floor directly toward the crab hiding beneath his own desk. He whispers: "The culprit is near."

Shot 5: Close-up insert, the crab opens one claw — the missing pearl sits inside it — then quickly hides it behind his back.

Shot 6: Wide shot, everyone stares silently at the crab. The crab points one claw toward a passing fish outside the window. The detective sighs: "An ambitious defense."

entries.title: Woman and Cat Interaction Punch Video
entries.description: A realistic video prompt for Seedance 2.5 depicting a playful interaction between a woman and a cat that turns into a high-impact 'cat punch' caught on camera.
entries.prompt: 日本人女性。ネコが急に暴れ出して手に負えず一緒に後ろに倒れ込む。カメラは猫と女性の顔に急接近する。今度はネコに女性が顔をすりつける。女性はカメラ目線でネコの顔の横にキスをする。ちょっとネコが嫌がる。こちらに気づいたネコが怒り出してこちらにむかってネコパンチをはなつ。ネコパンチは完全に振り抜く。迫力の映像と素人が撮影したような手ブレ映像。BGMなし。
entries.translated_prompt: Japanese woman. The cat suddenly starts acting wildly, and she can't handle it, falling backward together. The camera zooms in quickly on the cat's and the woman's faces. This time, the woman rubs her face against the cat. The woman looks at the camera and kisses the side of the cat's face. The cat is a little annoyed. The cat notices the camera, gets angry, and throws a 'cat punch' toward the lens. The cat punch is a complete follow-through. A high-impact video with handheld camera shake as if filmed by an amateur. No BGM.

preview_videos.caption: Woman and Cat Interaction Punch Video

entries.title: Chinese Deadpan Comedy Short Drama
entries.description: A creative prompt designed for a Chinese-style deadpan comedy sketch, featuring multiple characters and detailed instructions for physical interactions and realistic reactions to unexpected events in everyday settings.
entries.prompt: 【风格】中国本土黑色冷幽默短剧（Chinese Deadpan Comedy），真实人物实拍（Photorealistic Live Action），生活化网络短片质感，轻微手持摄影，真实物理运动，4K高清【时长】30秒，单次直出【画幅】16:9横屏【语言】全程中文现场对白，精准中文口型同步；无旁白、无字幕【场景】中国北方县城老院子 → 中国小城复古甜品店 → 中国县城老式招待所走廊【角色】@图片1 命名“墨宁”，负责对镜讲解；@图片2 命名“阿蓝”，甜品店同桌顾客；@图片3 命名“王姨”，阿蓝的陪同者【参考图执行规则】三名角色的脸部、身形、发型、妆容、服装和配饰全部严格继承各自参考图，不在视频中自行增加、删除或修改任何人物外观元素。角色第一次出现时即完全匹配对应参考图，后续场景切换不得换脸、换装或改变体型。【核心内容】墨宁面对镜头讲解：判断一条视频是否由AI生成，不要只看清晰度，而要观察动物动作、物理效果、人物反应和空间关系。她一边讲解，一边用越来越荒唐的现场行为进行“示范”，但始终认为出现问题的是AI视频，而不是她自己。【人物表演逻辑】墨宁始终把自己当成认真教学的专业人士。越是发生荒唐事件，她越冷静、越理直气壮。她不是故意逗观众笑，笑点来自她一本正经的错误判断。阿蓝在事件发生前完全没有防备；必须等液体真正接触身体后，才出现缩颈、闭眼、抬手和躲闪反应。王姨必须先确认阿蓝的情况，再转头看向墨宁；禁止提前瞪人或提前预知事件。[00:00-00:05.30] 镜头1：不用看画质，先看细节（Static Medium Shot）中国北方县城老院子，灰砖墙、红色木门、白色塑料椅、墙根杂草、晾晒的玉米和生活杂物。午后自然光从侧面照进院子，树叶影子轻微晃动。固定正面中景：墨宁坐在白色塑料椅上，身体自然前倾，双手靠近膝盖，直视镜头。[00:00-00:02.30]墨宁像分享一个简单实用的小技巧，语速清楚、自然：【对白口型指导】“怎么判断一条视频是不是AI做的？”说完保持目光不动，停顿约0.2秒，确认观众注意力已经集中。[00:02.30-00:05.30]墨宁轻轻抬起一只手，像开始列举重点：【对白口型指导】“不用盯着画质，先看动物。AI一碰猫猫狗狗，最容易露馅。”“先看动物”略微加重；“最容易露馅”说得很笃定，像这是一条已经被反复验证的规律。说到“猫猫狗狗”时，院子外传来逐渐靠近的狗喘气声。墨宁听见声音，但暂时不回头。[00:05.30-00:10.20] 镜头2：动物动作最容易露馅（Handheld Reframing）[00:05.30-00:06.50]一只大型黑狗从画面左下方快速进入，直接把脑袋挤到墨宁两腿之间。狗进入时身体具有真实前冲惯性，先是头部靠近，随后肩膀和身体跟上，禁止整只狗突然出现在画面里。墨宁的双手被狗顶得自然抬起，身体向后回弹几厘米。摄影机因为狗突然进入而本能向下偏移，焦点短暂落在狗头上。墨宁低头看着狗说：【对白口型指导】“就拿这只来说。”她的语气不是逗狗，而是像终于找到了现成的教学案例。[00:06.50-00:07.70]黑狗继续向前挤，身体横在墨宁腿前，尾巴扫过塑料椅腿。墨宁用手把狗头轻轻往旁边推，随后抬眼看向镜头：【对白口型指导】“看出来了吗？”她问完后保持半秒停顿，给观众观察狗的时间。[00:07.70-00:09.60]黑狗从墨宁面前横向经过，又突然把鼻子凑近摄影机，导致画面前景明显虚焦。墨宁的视线跟着狗移动，眉头逐渐收紧：【对白口型指导】“动作一卡一卡的，眼神也不对。”“动作一卡一卡的”说得像在进行技术分析。狗的动作本身必须连续自然，笑点来自墨宁强行把正常动作说成AI破绽。[00:09.60-00:10.20]狗鼻尖几乎贴住镜头，发出一声短促狗叫。墨宁在后方看着它，干脆地下结论：【对白口型指导】“一看就假。”说完不笑。狗叫声结束的瞬间硬切下一场景。[00:10.20-00:14.60] 镜头3：物理效果测试（Extreme Close-up → Medium Shot）硬切到中国小城复古甜品店。木桌、玻璃食品柜、白瓷茶杯、暖水瓶、纸巾盒和中文价目牌构成生活化环境。背景顾客自然吃饭聊天。墨宁、阿蓝和王姨坐在同一张桌旁。桌上摆着一大杯粉红色草莓酸奶饮品和另一杯浅色饮品。[00:10.20-00:10.70]墨宁突然向摄影机靠近，脸部进入极近景。由于距离快速缩短，画面先轻微失焦，随后自动对焦准确落在墨宁的双眼和嘴唇上。[00:10.70-00:13.70]墨宁睁大眼睛，像准备讲第二个重点：【对白口型指导】“第二，看物理效果。画面里的液体一多，最容易穿帮。”“物理效果”四个字说得清楚、稍慢。说到“液体一多”时，她的视线短暂移向桌上的粉红色饮品；说到“最容易穿帮”时，再把目光转回镜头。阿蓝和王姨继续自然坐着，不得提前观察墨宁的手，也不得表现出警惕。[00:13.70-00:14.60]切换双人中景。墨宁退回座位，顺手拿起阿蓝面前的粉红色饮品，双手将杯子举到阿蓝头顶。她没有蓄力或夸张准备，直接把杯口翻转。浓稠粉红液体在重力作用下形成连续流柱，先落到阿蓝头顶，再沿头部、脸侧、肩膀和衣料向下流淌，最后飞溅到木桌上。杯内液面必须随着倾倒逐渐降低；液体具有真实重量、黏度和飞溅惯性，禁止凭空出现、悬浮、逆流或穿透容器。【音效】玻璃杯轻响、浓稠液体落下声、液体拍击桌面的飞溅声。[00:14.60-00:18.20] 镜头4：真实反应不能提前（Delayed Reaction）[00:14.60-00:15.20]液体第一次接触阿蓝后，保留约0.2秒的神经反应延迟。随后阿蓝突然缩起脖子、闭紧双眼，肩膀快速抬高，双手本能地挡在头部附近。她张嘴发出一声短促尖叫，身体带着真实惯性向侧后方躲闪，椅子被动作带动，在地面摩擦出声音。禁止阿蓝在液体落下前闭眼、尖叫、抬手或闪躲。[00:15.20-00:16.30]阿蓝继续向旁边躲，手臂扫过桌面，带动桌面上的液体发生第二次小范围飞溅。墨宁保持杯口向下，直到饮品基本流空才把杯子收回。杯子不能突然变空，手掌不能与杯子融合。墨宁低头看一眼空杯，确认“实验完成”，整个过程没有道歉，也没有慌乱。[00:16.30-00:17.50]王姨先愣住半拍，随后立刻靠近阿蓝。她一只手扶住阿蓝，另一只手帮她擦掉脸部附近的液体。她的注意力必须先集中在阿蓝身上，确认情况后才抬头。[00:17.50-00:18.20]近景：王姨缓慢转头看向墨宁，眉头压低，嘴唇紧闭。阿蓝靠着王姨喘气，残留液体继续自然向下滴落。两人没有清晰对白，只保留尖叫尾音、急促呼吸和衣料摩擦声。[00:18.20-00:21.30] 镜头5：人物反应也会露馅（Reverse Medium Close-up）正反打切到墨宁。她独自坐在桌子另一侧，面前的桌面被粉红液体和水果碎块弄得一片狼藉，空杯落在桌角。[00:18.20-00:19.00]墨宁看向阿蓝和王姨，轻轻抬起眉峰：【对白口型指导】“再看人物反应。”她的口吻依然是讲解知识点，没有任何内疚。[00:19.00-00:21.30]墨宁先观察阿蓝，再看一眼正盯着自己的王姨，最后重新看向镜头：【对白口型指导】“刚才那一下，反应太整齐，明显演过了。”“反应太整齐”说得像在进行技术分析；“演过了”短促收尾。直到整句话说完，她一侧嘴角才出现非常轻微的讥讽笑意。禁止提前微笑或从头到尾保持笑容。[00:21.30-00:25.20] 镜头6：空间关系最难处理（Backward Tracking Shot）硬切到中国县城老式招待所走廊。狭长走廊两侧分布多扇房门，墙面安装暖黄色吸顶灯。墙上只有一块清晰规范的绿色中文“安全出口”标识，禁止出现英文或乱码。[00:21.30-00:22.40]墨宁从走廊远端径直走向摄影机。摄影机以相同速度向后移动，始终保持墨宁位于画面中央。她先不说话，走廊中只保留脚步声和轻微环境声。[00:22.40-00:25.20]墨宁继续行走，对镜头讲出最后一个判断方法：【对白口型指导】“最后看门。空间关系一复杂，AI就特别容易出错。”“最后看门”稍微停顿；“空间关系”清晰咬字；“特别容易出错”语气笃定。经过“安全出口”标识时，标识必须固定在墙面，不能跟随人物移动、扭曲或变成其他文字。[00:25.20-00:28.50] 镜头7：门认错了（Door Physics Punchline）[00:25.20-00:25.80]墨宁停在走廊左侧的一扇房门前，侧身面对房门。手部特写：她准确握住这扇门的金属把手，将把手向下压。手指数量正确，手掌与门把手保持明确接触，禁止粘连、穿透或错位。[00:25.80-00:26.30]切换中景。墨宁握住的这扇门没有打开，旁边另一扇完全无人触碰的门反而同步打开一条缝。两扇门保持独立完整，门板和门框不能融合。错误动作只发生一次，因果关系必须清楚：墨宁压下左侧门把手，右侧房门却打开。[00:26.30-00:27.00]墨宁先低头确认自己手里的门把手，再缓慢转头看向旁边自行打开的门。她眉头轻轻收紧，停顿半秒后看向镜头：【对白口型指导】“看吧，门都认错了。”不是惊讶尖叫，而是“果然被我说中了”的平静语气。[00:27.00-00:27.80]旁边的门缓慢自行关闭。墨宁明显翻一次白眼，松开手中的门把手：【对白口型指导】“算了，走了。”语气疲惫、干脆，最后一个字自然落下。[00:27.80-00:28.50]墨宁再次推动原来的房门，这一次房门正常打开。她侧身进入房间。摄影机停留在走廊，不跟进房间。墨宁完全出画后，房门迅速关上，发出一声沉闷的“砰”。[00:28.50-00:30.00] 镜头8：黑屏收尾（Hard Cut to Black）关门声响起的瞬间硬切纯黑画面，黑屏保持到30秒结束。黑屏中保留关门声余韵和房间内逐渐远去的两三步脚步声。最后0.5秒完全安静。黑屏不出现字幕、标题、Logo或结束卡。【完整对白汇总】墨宁：“怎么判断一条视频是不是AI做的？”墨宁：“不用盯着画质，先看动物。AI一碰猫猫狗狗，最容易露馅。”墨宁：“就拿这只来说。”墨宁：“看出来了吗？”墨宁：“动作一卡一卡的，眼神也不对。”墨宁：“一看就假。”墨宁：“第二，看物理效果。画面里的液体一多，最容易穿帮。”墨宁：“再看人物反应。”墨宁：“刚才那一下，反应太整齐，明显演过了。”墨宁：“最后看门。空间关系一复杂，AI就特别容易出错。”墨宁：“看吧，门都认错了。”墨宁：“算了，走了。”【声音要求】墨宁所有对白使用同一中文声线，语速自然、清晰，像面对手机镜头分享经验，不使用翻译腔、播音腔或机械朗读。每句对白必须由墨宁本人开口，中文口型与声音准确同步。院子保留风声、鸟叫、狗喘气和狗叫；甜品店保留顾客交谈、餐具声、液体飞溅和尖叫；招待所保留脚步、门轴和关门声。不添加持续背景音乐，不使用罐头笑声。【全局连续性】三名人物始终严格继承各自参考图，不对外貌、发型、身形、妆容、服装和配饰进行任何二次设计。墨宁在三个场景中保持同一外观和同一声线。阿蓝与王姨只出现在甜品店；黑狗只出现在院子；角色离开画面后不得在同一镜头突然返回。甜品店正反打保持人物座位和视线方向一致。所有场景切换使用明确硬切，禁止人物或背景在画面中途融化变形。
entries.translated_prompt: [Style] Chinese local black humor short drama (Chinese Deadpan Comedy), Photorealistic Live Action, everyday online short film texture, slight handheld photography, real physical movement, 4K HD [Duration] 30 seconds, single direct output [Frame] 16:9 widescreen [Language] Full Chinese on-site dialogue, precise Chinese lip-sync; no narration, no subtitles [Scenes] Old courtyard in a northern Chinese county town → Retro dessert shop in a small Chinese town → Old-fashioned guesthouse corridor in a Chinese county town [Characters] @Image1 named 'Mo Ning', responsible for on-camera explanation; @Image2 named 'A Lan', a fellow customer at the dessert shop; @Image3 named 'Auntie Wang', A Lan's companion [Reference Image Execution Rules] All three characters' faces, body shapes, hairstyles, makeup, clothing, and accessories must strictly inherit from their respective reference images, with no additions, deletions, or modifications to any appearance elements. Characters must fully match the reference images upon their first appearance, and no face-swapping, outfit-changing, or body-type changes are allowed during subsequent scene transitions. [Core Content] Mo Ning explains to the camera: To judge if a video is AI-generated, don't just look at the resolution, but observe animal movements, physical effects, character reactions, and spatial relationships. As she explains, she 'demonstrates' with increasingly absurd on-site actions, but consistently believes the issue lies with the AI video, not herself. [Character Performance Logic] Mo Ning always regards herself as a serious professional educator. The more absurd the event, the calmer and more self-righteous she becomes. She is not trying to be funny; the humor comes from her deadpan, erroneous judgments. A Lan is completely off-guard before the incident; she must wait until the liquid actually touches her body before showing signs of cringing, closing her eyes, raising her hands, and dodging. Auntie Wang must first check on A Lan before turning to look at Mo Ning; no premature staring or predicting the event. [00:00-00:05.30] Scene 1: Don't look at image quality, look at details (Static Medium Shot). An old courtyard in a northern Chinese county town with gray brick walls, a red wooden door, white plastic chairs, weeds by the wall, drying corn, and daily sundries. Afternoon natural light enters from the side, with tree shadows swaying slightly. Fixed front medium shot: Mo Ning sits on a white plastic chair, leaning forward naturally, hands near her knees, looking directly at the camera. [00:00-00:02.30] Mo Ning speaks as if sharing a simple, practical tip, her speech clear and natural: [Lip-sync Guide] 'How do you tell if a video is made by AI?' She finishes and keeps her gaze fixed, pausing for about 0.2 seconds to ensure the audience's attention is focused. [00:02.30-00:05.30] Mo Ning lightly raises one hand as if listing key points: [Lip-sync Guide] 'Don't just stare at the resolution; look at the animals first. When AI handles cats and dogs, it’s most likely to slip up.' She emphasizes 'look at the animals' slightly; 'most likely to slip up' is said with certainty. As she says 'cats and dogs', the sound of a dog panting approaches from outside the courtyard. Mo Ning hears it but doesn't look back yet. [00:05.30-00:10.20] Scene 2: Animal movements are most likely to slip up (Handheld Reframing). [00:05.30-00:06.50] A large black dog enters quickly from the lower left of the frame, squeezing its head between Mo Ning's legs. The dog has real momentum upon entry; its head appears first, followed by its shoulders and body. Mo Ning's hands are naturally lifted by the dog, and her body bounces back a few centimeters. The camera instinctively tilts down due to the dog's entry, briefly focusing on the dog's head. Mo Ning looks down at the dog: [Lip-sync Guide] 'Take this one, for example.' Her tone isn't playful; it's as if she found a ready-made teaching case. [00:06.50-00:07.70] The black dog continues to squeeze through, its body crossing in front of Mo Ning's legs, its tail brushing against the plastic chair leg. Mo Ning gently pushes the dog's head aside with her hand, then looks up at the camera: [Lip-sync Guide] 'Can you tell?' She pauses for half a second to give the audience time to observe. [00:07.70-00:09.60] The dog passes horizontally in front of Mo Ning and suddenly puts its nose close to the camera, causing the foreground to blur. Mo Ning's gaze follows the dog, her brow tightening: [Lip-sync Guide] 'The movement is glitchy, and the eyes aren't right.' She says 'glitchy' as if performing a technical analysis. The dog's actual movement must be continuous and natural; the humor comes from Mo Ning forcing a normal action into an 'AI flaw'. [00:09.60-00:10.20] The dog's nose almost touches the lens, emitting a short bark. Mo Ning watches it from behind and concludes flatly: [Lip-sync Guide] 'It looks fake at a glance.' She doesn't smile. A hard cut to the next scene occurs immediately after the bark. [00:10.20-00:14.60] Scene 3: Physical Effect Test (Extreme Close-up → Medium Shot). Hard cut to a retro dessert shop in a small Chinese town. Wooden tables, glass food cabinets, white porcelain cups, thermoses, tissue boxes, and Chinese price tags create an everyday environment. Background customers chat naturally. Mo Ning, A Lan, and Auntie Wang sit at the same table. A large cup of pink strawberry yogurt drink and another light-colored drink are on the table. [00:10.20-00:10.70] Mo Ning suddenly moves closer to the camera into an extreme close-up. Due to the rapid distance change, the frame briefly blurs before auto-focusing accurately on Mo Ning's eyes and lips. [00:10.70-00:13.70] Mo Ning opens her eyes wide: [Lip-sync Guide] 'Second, look at physical effects. When there's a lot of liquid in the frame, it’s most likely to be a giveaway.' She says 'physical effects' clearly and slowly. When she says 'a lot of liquid', her gaze briefly shifts to the pink drink; when she says 'giveaway', she looks back at the camera. A Lan and Auntie Wang continue to sit naturally, not watching Mo Ning's hand or showing alarm. [00:13.70-00:14.60] Switch to a two-person medium shot. Mo Ning returns to her seat, picks up the pink drink in front of A Lan, and holds it over A Lan's head with both hands. Without warning, she flips the cup. The thick pink liquid forms a continuous stream, landing on A Lan's head and flowing down her face, shoulders, and clothes, finally splashing onto the wooden table. The liquid level in the cup must drop as it pours; the liquid must have real weight, viscosity, and splash inertia. [Sound Effects] Cup clinking, thick liquid pouring, liquid splashing on the table. [00:14.60-00:18.20] Scene 4: Real reactions cannot be premature (Delayed Reaction). [00:14.60-00:15.20] After the liquid first hits A Lan, there is a 0.2-second neural delay. Then A Lan suddenly winces, closes her eyes tightly, shrugs her shoulders, and instinctively blocks her head. She lets out a short scream, dodging backward with real inertia, the chair scraping against the floor. A Lan is prohibited from closing her eyes or dodging before the liquid hits. [00:15.20-00:16.30] A Lan continues to dodge, her arm sweeping across the table and causing a second small splash of liquid. Mo Ning keeps the cup inverted until it is empty before pulling it back. The cup cannot suddenly become empty. Mo Ning looks at the empty cup, confirming the 'experiment is complete', with no apology or panic. [00:16.30-00:17.50] Auntie Wang is stunned for half a beat, then immediately moves toward A Lan to help wipe the liquid. Her attention must be on A Lan first. [00:17.50-00:18.20] Close-up: Auntie Wang slowly turns to look at Mo Ning, brow furrowed. A Lan pants against Auntie Wang. No clear dialogue, only lingering screams, heavy breathing, and clothing rustling. [00:18.20-00:21.30] Scene 5: Character reactions also give it away (Reverse Medium Close-up). Shot/reverse shot to Mo Ning. She sits alone at the other side of the table, which is a mess of pink liquid and fruit bits. [00:18.20-00:19.00] Mo Ning looks at A Lan and Auntie Wang, slightly raising her eyebrows: [Lip-sync Guide] 'Then look at character reactions.' Her tone is still that of a teacher, with no guilt. [00:19.00-00:21.30] Mo Ning observes A Lan, then Auntie Wang, then looks back at the camera: [Lip-sync Guide] 'That reaction just now was too coordinated; obviously overacted.' She says 'too coordinated' like an acting critic. Only after the sentence is finished does a very slight mocking smile appear on one side of her mouth. [00:21.30-00:25.20] Scene 6: Spatial relationships are the hardest to handle (Backward Tracking Shot). Hard cut to an old guesthouse corridor. Dim lights, several doors. A clear green Chinese 'Emergency Exit' sign on the wall; no gibberish. [00:21.30-00:22.40] Mo Ning walks from the far end of the corridor toward the camera. The camera moves back at the same speed. Only footsteps are heard. [00:22.40-00:25.20] Mo Ning continues walking: [Lip-sync Guide] 'Finally, look at doors. When spatial relationships get complex, AI is prone to making mistakes.' The 'Emergency Exit' sign must remain fixed on the wall and not distort. [00:25.20-00:28.50] Scene 7: The wrong door (Door Physics Punchline). [00:25.20-00:25.80] Mo Ning stops in front of a door on the left and turns toward it. Hand Close-up: She accurately grasps the metal handle and presses down. Correct number of fingers; hand-handle contact is clear. [00:25.80-00:26.30] Switch to Medium Shot. The door she is holding doesn't open, but the door next to it—untouched by anyone—opens slightly. The doors remain distinct; no merging. Mo Ning presses the left handle, but the right door opens. [00:26.30-00:27.00] Mo Ning looks at her handle, then slowly turns her head to the door that opened on its own. She frowns slightly, then looks at the camera: [Lip-sync Guide] 'See? Even the doors are confused.' Her tone is calm, 'I told you so'. [00:27.00-00:27.80] The adjacent door slowly closes on its own. Mo Ning rolls her eyes and lets go of her handle: [Lip-sync Guide] 'Forget it, I'm leaving.' Her tone is tired and decisive. [00:27.80-00:28.50] Mo Ning pushes the original door again, and this time it opens normally. She enters the room. The camera stays in the corridor. Once she is out of frame, the door shuts quickly with a heavy 'thud'. [00:28.50-00:30.00] Scene 8: Ending (Hard Cut to Black). The moment the door thuds, it cuts to black until the end. Footsteps fading away inside the room are heard. The final 0.5 seconds are silent. No text or logos. [Dialogue Summary] Mo Ning: 'How do you tell if a video is made by AI?', 'Don't just stare at the resolution; look at the animals first...', 'Take this one, for example.', 'Can you tell?', 'The movement is glitchy, and the eyes aren't right.', 'It looks fake at a glance.', 'Second, look at physical effects...', 'Then look at character reactions.', 'That reaction just now was too coordinated; obviously overacted.', 'Finally, look at doors...', 'See? Even the doors are confused.', 'Forget it, I'm leaving.' [Audio Requirements] One consistent Chinese voice for Mo Ning, natural and clear. No mechanical or robotic tones. Ambient sounds: wind, birds, dog panting, barks in the courtyard; chatter, clinking, splashes, and screams in the shop; footsteps and doors in the guesthouse. No background music or canned laughter. [Global Continuity] Characters strictly match reference images throughout. Mo Ning maintains the same appearance and voice. A Lan and Auntie Wang only in the shop; black dog only in the courtyard. entries.title: Vintage Japanese MiniDV Travel Memory
entries.description: A nostalgic video prompt designed for a 2000s-style MiniDV look, featuring a first-person POV trip to Japan with atmospheric grainy textures and intimate camera movements.
entries.prompt:
参考的同一位成年女性角色，保持浅金色长直发、轻薄刘海、深蓝色花朵发夹、脸部五官和身材比例一致。全片始终穿 Image1 中同一套浅奶油色细肩带刺绣长裙，带柔和缎面质感、浅金花卉刺绣与蕾丝细节。

Location： 日本郊外铁路站台、草地、旧书店/漫画店、日本小巷、拉面店、公园与鹿、黄昏草地、繁华夜街。整体像和女友一起度过的一天，被快速剪成旅行记忆碎片。

Visual Style： 真人实拍，日本青春旅行记忆，Dreamy、自然、亲密、随手记录感。全片统一呈现 2000 年代老式 MiniDV 家庭录像质感：柔焦、低反差、高光轻微泛白、自然颗粒、柔和光晕、轻微自动曝光变化和明显运动拖影。

Camera Style： 第一人称男友 POV，近距离手持 DV 摄像机，广角，不稳定构图，自然晃动与快速自动对焦。摄影机像故事中的第二个角色，女孩会不断看向、靠近、回头寻找摄影者。不同场景之间使用快速硬切。

Timeline（20 sec）：

00:00–00:04.5 → 日本郊外站台。第一帧危险已经存在：女孩站在靠近轨道的位置，身体微微前倾，一只手遮在额头前看向前方；一列红白色日本通勤列车已经从她背后的轨道高速驶来。第一人称男友立即伸手抓住她的上臂，抓住的同一瞬间手臂持续向自己方向快速回收，一次连续把女孩从站台边缘拉到摄影机近前。女孩产生明显位移，只仓促调整 1–2 步；男友身体自然后撤半步。女孩刚离开原位置，列车立即从她身后高速掠过。她被拉到镜头前，浅金色长发与长裙被风压吹起，双眼睁大、嘴唇微张，惊魂未定。

00:04.5–00:06.2 → 晴天草地，第一人称牵着女孩向前移动，她看向摄影者开心地笑，长发和长裙随风飘动。

00:06.2–00:07.5 → 日本旧书店，从两排书架缝隙拍摄，女孩突然俯身探头看向镜头，露出俏皮轻笑。

00:07.5–00:08.5 → 低角度记录女孩穿着浅奶油色长裙走过日本街道斑马线，裙摆随着脚步自然摆动。

00:08.5–00:09.7 → 日本狭窄小巷，女孩走在前方，眼睛先向后看，随后回头看向摄影者并轻轻一笑。

00:09.7–00:10.8 → 日本拉面店，热气腾腾的拉面近景，焦点自然从面条切换到坐在对面的女孩。

00:10.8–00:12.0 → 漫画店，女孩从书架抽出一本漫画，低头翻开阅读。

00:12.0–00:13.1 → 第一人称在日本公园给鹿喂鹿饼，女孩模糊地出现在后方草地。

00:13.1–00:14.1 → 女孩安静坐着翻漫画，近距离记录双手、书页与浅奶油色刺绣长裙细节。

00:14.1–00:15.6 → 黄昏草地，暖金色逆光，女孩站在鹿群附近轻轻转身看向摄影者，头发与长裙被晚风吹动。

00:15.6–00:17.5 → 日本繁华夜街，女孩突然轻快向前跑，回头看摄影者，手持摄影机追随，霓虹灯形成强烈老 DV 运动拖影。

00:17.5–00:18.4 → 快速闪过浅奶油色刺绣长裙、蕾丝和自然垂落裙摆的生活细节镜头。

00:18.4–00:20.0 → 一台 2000 年代消费级数码摄像机进入画面，翻转 LCD 中同步显示正在被拍摄的同一位女孩。她发现摄影者还在拍自己，轻轻露出俏皮表情后自然笑出来，最后高光快速泛白结束。

Audio： 只保留真实同期声：火车与铁轨声、强烈风压、脚步、风声、翻书声、店内环境声、鹿与公园环境声、夜街人群与车辆声、人物自然惊呼和轻笑。无背景音乐，无字幕。

Goal： 像多年以后重新翻出的一盘日本旅行 MiniDV 录像——开场用“差一点被火车撞到、男友瞬间拉回”的危险钩子抓住观众，随后快速进入轻松、亲密、朦胧的青春旅行记忆。
entries.translated_prompt:
Reference the same adult female character, maintaining light blonde long straight hair, light bangs, a dark blue flower hairpin, facial features, and body proportions. Throughout the film, she wears the same light cream-colored thin-strap embroidered long dress from Image1, featuring a soft satin texture, light gold floral embroidery, and lace details.

Location: Japanese suburban railway platform, meadow, old bookstore/manga shop, Japanese alley, ramen shop, park with deer, sunset meadow, bustling night street. The overall feel is like a day spent with a girlfriend, quickly edited into travel memory fragments.

Visual Style: Live-action filming, Japanese youth travel memory, dreamy, natural, intimate, snapshot feel. The entire film presents a 2000s vintage MiniDV home video quality: soft focus, low contrast, highlights slightly washed out, natural grain, soft halation, slight auto-exposure changes, and obvious motion blur.

Camera Style: First-person boyfriend POV, close-range handheld DV camera, wide-angle, unstable composition, natural shaking, and fast auto-focus. The camera acts as a second character in the story; the girl will constantly look at, approach, and turn back to find the cameraman. Fast hard cuts are used between different scenes.

Timeline (20 sec):

00:00–00:04.5 → Japanese suburban platform. Danger exists from the first frame: the girl stands near the tracks, body slightly leaning forward, one hand shading her forehead. A red and white Japanese commuter train is already speeding toward her. The boyfriend POV immediately reaches out to grab her upper arm, pulling her back toward the camera in one continuous motion. The girl shifts significantly, adjusting 1–2 steps; the boyfriend naturally steps back. Just as she leaves the spot, the train speeds past. She is pulled close to the lens, hair and dress blown by wind pressure, eyes wide, lips parted in shock.

00:04.5–00:06.2 → Sunny meadow, first-person holding the girl's hand moving forward; she looks at the cameraman and laughs happily, hair and dress flowing in the wind.

00:06.2–00:07.5 → Japanese old bookstore, filmed through bookshelves; the girl suddenly leans her head out to look at the camera with a playful smile.

00:07.5–00:08.5 → Low-angle recording of the girl in the cream dress walking across a Japanese pedestrian crossing, the skirt swaying naturally with her steps.

00:08.5–00:09.7 → Narrow Japanese alley, the girl walks ahead, looking back then turning to the cameraman with a soft smile.

00:09.7–00:10.8 → Ramen shop, close-up of steaming ramen, focus naturally shifts to the girl sitting opposite.

00:10.8–00:12.0 → Manga shop, the girl pulls a manga from the shelf and reads.

00:12.0–00:13.1 → First-person feeding deer crackers in a Japanese park, the girl appearing blurred in the background meadow.

00:13.1–00:14.1 → The girl sits quietly flipping through manga, close-up of hands, pages, and dress details.

00:14.1–00:15.6 → Sunset meadow, warm golden backlighting, the girl stands near the deer turning back to the cameraman.

00:15.6–00:17.5 → Night street, the girl runs forward, looking back; handheld camera follows with strong motion blur.

00:17.5–00:18.4 → Quick cuts of lifestyle details like the embroidered dress and lace.

00:18.4–00:20.0 → A 2000s digital camcorder enters the frame, showing the same girl on the flip-out LCD. She notices she's still being filmed, smiles playfully, and the screen fades to white.

Audio: Only real ambient sounds: train on tracks, wind pressure, footsteps, page-turning, park environment, people/vehicles at night, natural gasps and laughs. No background music, no subtitles.

Goal: Like finding an old MiniDV tape of a Japan trip years later—starting with a 'near-train-collision' hook then moving into intimate youth travel memories.

entries.prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5｜水上人形墙挑战

【风格】真人水上综艺闯关节目（Live-Action Water Game Show），明快饱和色彩，盛夏正午自然光，真实广播级摄影，快速剪辑，轻喜剧节奏，真实重力与水体物理，4K高清
【时长】15秒
【画幅】16:9横屏
【语言】中文男声画外解说，主角没有正式台词，仅保留呼吸、用力声和落水前的短促惊叫；无字幕
【场景】大型户外水上综艺竞技场，碧蓝泳池中央架设橙色狭长挑战平台，平台尽头是一块沿隐藏轨道匀速前进的浅蓝色厚实人形墙板；墙板中央开着“头部居中、双肘横向打开、双手抱头、双腿大幅分开下蹲”的螃蟹深蹲人形孔洞。泳池对面是坐满观众的半圆形看台，上方覆盖大型白色遮阳棚。

【人物角色卡】
@图片1 命名“夏妍”，水上综艺闯关者。人物脸部、身形、发型、妆容、服装及配饰完全继承参考图，不增加或修改任何外观元素。
角色目标：在移动人形墙到达前，快速看懂孔洞姿势并让身体穿过。
表演轨迹：自信亮相 → 看清题目后短暂震惊 → 急忙调整姿势 → 以为已经成功 → 察觉尺寸不合 → 被墙体推落水 → 浮出水面后不服气地瞪向镜头。
表演方式：偏真实综艺反应，不故意卖萌，不从第一秒就夸张；所有表情变化必须由墙体移动、身体接触和落水结果依次触发。

[00:00-00:02.00] 镜头1：第二关开始（Close-up Hook）
正面近景：夏妍站在橙色平台中央，泳池和浅蓝色人形墙板位于她身后。镜头使用中长焦压缩背景，观众席轻微虚化。

[00:00-00:00.80]
夏妍直视镜头，保持自信从容的笑容，肩膀自然放松。背景传来机械装置启动的“咔嗒”声和低沉电机声。

【中文男声画外解说】“第二关，开始！”

解说声音明亮有力，像现场综艺主持人，不能使用新闻播音腔。

[00:00-00:00.80-00:02.00]
机械运转声逐渐接近。夏妍的笑容停住，眼睛突然睁大，嘴唇自然张成小圆形；她先看镜头，再迅速转动眼睛观察身后的挑战墙。

反应不能提前出现，必须在机械声响起之后才从自信变为意外。

【中文男声画外解说】“这次是——超级螃蟹蹲！”

“超级螃蟹蹲”提高音量并拉长尾音，配短促综艺铜管音效。

[00:02.00-00:05.00] 镜头2：看懂姿势，马上就位（Wide Shot → Rear Three-quarter）
硬切全景：完整展示橙色平台、泳池、浅蓝色人形墙板和观众席。人形墙从平台远端沿直线轨道缓慢向夏妍移动，全程保持垂直，速度稳定。

[00:02.00-00:03.00]
夏妍迅速转身面向人形孔洞，先上下扫视孔洞轮廓，确认头、双肘、躯干和双腿的位置。

她小跑两步靠近墙板前方的定位区域，脚底与平台接触真实，不打滑、不瞬移。

[00:03.00-00:05.00]
后侧三分之二机位：夏妍双手抬到脑后，手指交叠，双肘向左右打开；双脚快速向两侧分开，膝盖向外，身体重心逐渐下沉。

【中文男声画外解说】“双腿打开，重心压低，双手抱头！”

解说节奏与动作同步：

“双腿打开”对应双脚向两侧移动；
“重心压低”对应身体进入深蹲；
“双手抱头”对应双手在脑后交叠。

身体动作必须依次完成，禁止三种动作同一帧突然出现。

[00:05.00-00:09.00] 镜头3：姿势对了，尺寸不对（Symmetrical Front Shot）
切到墙板正面的对称全景。摄影机隔着人形孔洞拍摄夏妍，她的头、手臂、躯干和双腿分别对准对应开口。

[00:05.00-00:06.20]
夏妍保持双手抱头和宽距深蹲，左右调整脚步，再把身体向孔洞中心移动几厘米。

她先低头检查双脚位置，再抬眼看向正在接近的墙板。嘴唇轻轻抿住，呼吸加快。

[00:06.20-00:07.50]
墙板继续沿轨道匀速前进。夏妍把重心压得更低，让双肘和双腿尽量贴合孔洞边缘。

她短暂闭眼用力，肩膀轻微抬高；重新睁眼时，瞳孔扩大，嘴唇张开，发现孔洞比预想中更紧。

【中文男声画外解说】“姿势很标准——”

前半句语气兴奋，像在宣布她即将成功。

[00:07.50-00:09.00]
墙板距离她越来越近。她保持姿势不敢乱动，只能轻微转动眼睛观察两侧孔洞边缘。

孔洞边缘逐渐靠近她的双肘 and 腿部，但尚未发生接触。她脸上的自信一点点消失，嘴巴微张，呼吸停顿半拍。

【中文男声画外解说】“可这个洞……好像小了点！”

“可这个洞”后停顿约0.3秒；“小了点”降低音量，带明显不妙的预感。

背景音乐在此处暂停一个重拍，只留下墙体机械声和观众吸气声。

[00:09.00-00:10.50] 镜头4：没穿过去（Side Shot / Physical Comedy）
切到平台侧面中全景，同时看见人形墙、夏妍和她身后的泳池边缘。

[00:09.00-00:09.50]
墙板到达夏妍的位置。孔洞边缘先轻轻接触她身体外侧，她立即意识到无法完全穿过，双眼睁大，手从脑后松开，掌心向前寻找支撑。

反应必须由接触触发，禁止提前站起或提前后仰。

【中文男声画外解说】“糟了，没卡进去！”

[00:09.50-00:10.50]
墙板继续保持原有速度向前，无法通过孔洞的夏妍被平稳推向平台边缘。

她的重心逐渐越过脚后跟，脚掌先在平台上向后滑动小段距离；随后膝盖伸展、身体向后倾斜、双臂在身体两侧快速摆动维持平衡。

到达平台边缘时，她先半坐到边缘，双腿因惯性向上抬起，然后整个身体向后落入泳池。

禁止墙板突然加速，禁止夏妍主动起跳；落水必须来自墙板持续推动和身体重心后移。

夏妍在离开平台瞬间发出短促自然的“啊！”声。

[00:10.50-00:12.50] 镜头5：巨大落水水花（Water Impact / Real Fluid Physics）
[00:10.50-00:11.20]
侧面宽景：夏妍背部和身体后侧首先接触水面，双腿随后落水。

入水点瞬间炸开大片白色水花，水柱向上和向两侧扩散；细小水滴形成真实抛物线，较重水团迅速回落。

【中文男声画外解说】“还是被推下水了！”

“下水了”与最大水花同时出现。

【音效】低沉落水声、大片水花声、观众惊呼。

[00:11.20-00:12.50]
镜头继续停留在落水区域。夏妍完全没入水中，只剩白色泡沫、扩散涟漪和逐渐回落的水滴。

泡沫由密到疏，水面波纹向泳池四周传播。人形墙停在平台边缘，不能倒下、弯曲或落入水中。

背景音乐短暂停顿，随后以轻快鼓点重新进入。

[00:12.50-00:15.00] 镜头6：不服气的回马枪（Water-level Push-in）
切到接近水面的正面中景。

[00:12.50-00:13.20]
夏妍从水下浮出，先露出头部，再露出肩膀。她闭着眼睛呼出一口气，水从脸部和下巴连续滴落。

她张开双臂划水保持身体稳定。湿水只能改变表面状态，不得改变人物脸部、发型结构、服装结构或身份特征。

[00:13.20-00:14.00]
夏妍睁开眼睛，确认
entries.translated_prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 | Water Humanoid Wall Challenge

[Style] Live-action water game show, bright saturated colors, natural mid-summer noon light, professional broadcast-quality photography, fast-paced editing, light comedy rhythm, realistic gravity and water physics, 4K HD.
[Duration] 15 seconds
[Format] 16:9 widescreen
[Language] Chinese male voiceover, protagonist has no formal dialogue, only breathing, effort sounds, and short screams before falling into the water; no subtitles.
[Scene] Large outdoor water variety arena, a long orange challenge platform set up in the middle of a clear blue swimming pool. At the end of the platform is a thick light blue humanoid wall moving at a constant speed along a hidden track; in the center of the wall is a 'crab squat' humanoid hole with the head centered, elbows opened horizontally, hands holding the head, and legs wide apart. Opposite the pool is a semi-circular grandstand filled with spectators, covered by a large white sunshade.

[Character Card]
@Image1 named 'Xia Yan', a contestant in the water variety show. The character's face, body shape, hairstyle, makeup, clothing, and accessories completely inherit the reference image without adding or modifying any appearance elements.
Character Goal: Quickly understand the pose of the hole and get the body through before the moving humanoid wall arrives.
Performance Trajectory: Confident appearance → Brief shock after seeing the puzzle → Hurriedly adjusting pose → Thinking she succeeded → Realizing the size is wrong → Pushed into the water by the wall → Looking at the camera unconvinced after surfacing.
Performance Style: Realistic variety show reaction, not intentionally cute, not exaggerated from the first second; all facial expression changes must be triggered by the wall movement, physical contact, and the result of falling into the water.

[00:00-00:02.00] Shot 1: Level 2 Start (Close-up Hook)
Front close-up: Xia Yan stands in the center of the orange platform, with the pool and light blue humanoid wall behind her. The lens uses a medium-telephoto focal length to compress the background, with the audience seats slightly blurred.

[00:00-00:00.80]
Xia Yan looks directly at the camera, maintaining a confident and calm smile, shoulders naturally relaxed. The sound of a mechanical device starting and a low motor sound come from the background.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'Level 2, Start!'
Voiceover is bright and energetic, like a live variety show host, not a news anchor tone.

[00:00-00:00.80-00:02.00]
The mechanical operation sound gradually approaches. Xia Yan's smile stops, her eyes suddenly widen, and her lips naturally form a small circle; she looks at the camera first, then quickly turns her eyes to observe the challenge wall behind her.
Reactions cannot appear in advance; they must transition from confidence to surprise after the mechanical sound starts.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'This time it's—the Super Crab Squat!'
'Super Crab Squat' increases in volume and elongates the ending, accompanied by a short variety show brass sound effect.

[00:02.00-00:05.00] Shot 2: Understanding the pose, getting in position (Wide Shot → Rear Three-quarter)
Hard cut to wide shot: Fully displays the orange platform, pool, light blue humanoid wall, and audience seats. The humanoid wall moves at a constant speed from the far end of the platform toward Xia Yan. It stays vertical throughout, with stable speed.

[00:02.00-00:03.00]
Xia Yan quickly turns around to face the humanoid hole, first scanning the outline from top to bottom to confirm the positions of the head, elbows, torso, and legs.
She jogs a few steps toward the positioning area in front of the wall panel, feet making realistic contact with the platform without sliding or teleporting.

[00:03.00-00:05.00]
Rear three-quarter angle: Xia Yan raises her hands behind her head, fingers interlaced, elbows open to the left and right; feet quickly spread to both sides, knees out, center of gravity gradually sinking.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'Legs open, lower the center of gravity, hands behind the head!'
Voiceover rhythm is synchronized with the action: 'Legs open' corresponds to feet moving to both sides; 'lower the center of gravity' corresponds to the body entering a deep squat; 'hands behind the head' corresponds to the hands interlacing behind the head. Actions must be completed sequentially; all three actions appearing in the same frame is prohibited.

[00:05.00-00:09.00] Shot 3: Right pose, wrong size (Symmetrical Front Shot)
Cut to a symmetrical wide shot from the front of the wall panel. The camera films Xia Yan through the humanoid hole, with her head, arms, torso, and legs aligned with the corresponding openings.

[00:05.00-00:06.20]
Xia Yan maintains her hands behind her head and a wide deep squat, adjusting her steps left and right, then moving her body a few centimeters toward the center of the hole. She first looks down to check her foot position, then looks up at the approaching wall. Her lips are slightly pressed together, breathing quickens.

[00:06.20-00:07.50]
The wall panel continues to move forward at a constant speed. Xia Yan presses her center of gravity even lower, making her elbows and legs fit the edges of the hole as closely as possible. She briefly closes her eyes with effort, shoulders slightly raised; when she reopens her eyes, her pupils are dilated, lips open, realizing the hole is tighter than expected.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'The pose is very standard—'
The first half of the sentence sounds excited, as if announcing her imminent success.

[00:07.50-00:09.00]
The wall panel gets closer and closer. She maintains her pose, not daring to move, only slightly rolling her eyes to observe the edges of the hole on both sides. The edges of the hole gradually approach her elbows and legs but have not yet made contact. The confidence on her face slowly disappears, her mouth slightly ajar, breathing pauses for a half-beat.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'But this hole... seems a bit small!'
A pause of about 0.3 seconds after 'But this hole'; 'a bit small' lowers in volume, with a clear sense of looming trouble. The background music pauses for a heavy beat here, leaving only the wall's mechanical sound and the audience's gasps.

[00:09.00-00:10.50] Shot 4: Failed to pass through (Side Shot / Physical Comedy)
Cut to a mid-wide shot from the side of the platform, showing the humanoid wall, Xia Yan, and the pool edge behind her.

[00:09.00-00:09.50]
The wall panel reaches Xia Yan's position. The edge of the hole first lightly contacts the outside of her body; she immediately realizes she cannot pass through completely, eyes widen, hands release from behind her head, palms facing forward looking for support. Reactions must be triggered by contact; standing up or leaning back in advance is prohibited.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'Oh no, she didn't fit!'

[00:09.50-00:10.50]
The wall panel continues forward at its original speed, and Xia Yan, unable to pass through the hole, is steadily pushed toward the edge of the platform. Her center of gravity gradually passes her heels, feet sliding a short distance on the platform first; then knees extend, body tilts backward, and arms swing quickly on both sides to maintain balance. Reaching the edge, she first half-sits on the edge, legs lifting up due to inertia, then her whole body falls backward into the pool. Sudden acceleration of the wall and Xia Yan jumping voluntarily are prohibited; falling into the water must come from the continuous push of the wall and the shift of the body's center of gravity. Xia Yan emits a short, natural 'Ah!' at the moment she leaves the platform.

[00:10.50-00:12.50] Shot 5: Huge water splash (Water Impact / Real Fluid Physics)
[00:10.50-00:11.20]
Side wide shot: Xia Yan's back and rear of her body contact the water surface first, followed by her legs. A large white splash explodes at the entry point, water columns spreading upward and to both sides; fine droplets form realistic parabolas, heavier water masses quickly fall back.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'Still pushed into the water!'
'Into the water' appears with the largest splash. [Sound Effects] Low-pitched water entry, large splash sound, audience gasps.

[00:11.20-00:12.50]
The camera continues to stay on the entry area. Xia Yan is completely submerged, leaving only white foam, spreading ripples, and gradually falling droplets. Foam goes from dense to sparse, ripples spread to the sides of the pool. The humanoid wall stops at the edge of the platform, must not fall, bend, or fall into the water. Background music pauses briefly, then restarts with a light drum beat.

[00:12.50-00:15.00] Shot 6: Unconvinced Comeback (Water-level Push-in)
Cut to a front mid-shot close to the water surface.

[00:12.50-00:13.20]
Xia Yan surfaces from underwater, head first, then shoulders. She closes her eyes and exhales a breath, water continuously dripping from her face and chin. She spreads her arms to tread water and keep her body stable. Wet water can only change surface state, not character face, hairstyle structure, clothing structure, or identity characteristics.

[00:13.20-00:14.00]
Xia Yan opens her eyes, confirms

entries.title: Istanbul Photographer Lifestyle Vlog
entries.description: A multi-shot Seedance 2.5 prompt using reference images to create a photorealistic vlog of a photographer in historic Istanbul.
entries.prompt: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic professional photographer lifestyle vlog. STORY: A female professional photographer prepares her camera equipment at home, travels to historic Istanbul, photographs a female model in the historic streets, reviews the photos on her camera, and finishes by walking through the beautiful historic district. REFERENCE PRIORITY: @IMG1 = MAIN FEMALE PHOTOGRAPHER @IMG2 = ISTANBUL HISTORIC LOCATION @IMG3 = PROFESSIONAL CAMERA GEAR @IMG4 = PHOTOGRAPHER + MODEL PHOTOSHOOT @IMG5 = PHOTO REVIEW @IMG6 = FINAL ISTANBUL WALK CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: The EXACT SAME woman from @IMG1 must appear throughout the video. Preserve her exact: face, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, age appearance and overall identity. She remains the photographer throughout. Keep her outfit, camera bag and professional appearance consistent. -------------------------------------------------- 0–4 SECONDS — PREPARING AT HOME Use @IMG1 + @IMG3. Early morning. The photographer is at home preparing for the photoshoot. She opens her camera bag. She checks the professional camera. She checks the battery and memory card. She carefully attaches the same 24–70mm lens shown in @IMG3. She places the camera into her shoulder bag. She picks up the bag and prepares to leave. CAMERA: Quick cinematic close-ups of the camera, lens and accessories. Then a medium shot of her leaving home. Keep the sequence natural and efficient. -------------------------------------------------- 4–8 SECONDS — ARRIVING IN ISTANBUL Use @IMG1 + @IMG2. Transition naturally to historic Istanbul. The photographer arrives at the Sultanahmet historic area. She walks along the cobblestone street carrying her camera bag. She looks around at the architecture. She chooses a beautiful location for the photoshoot. She takes the camera out of her bag. CAMERA: Wide establishing shot revealing the historic Istanbul architecture. Then a medium tracking shot following the photographer. -------------------------------------------------- 8–13 SECONDS — PREPARING THE PHOTOSHOOT Use @IMG1 + @IMG2 + @IMG3 + @IMG4. The female model arrives. The photographer positions the model against the historic Istanbul architecture. She checks the camera settings. She adjusts the lens. She raises the camera to her eye. She gives the model a subtle hand gesture indicating where to stand and how to pose. The model responds naturally. CAMERA: Medium shot showing photographer and model. Brief close-up of the camera and lens. -------------------------------------------------- 13–20 SECONDS — PROFESSIONAL PHOTOSHOOT Use @IMG4. The photographer begins taking professional photographs. The model poses naturally. The photographer moves slightly to one side to change the composition. She takes a portrait shot. Then she changes position and takes a wider environmental shot. Then she briefly crouches to capture a dramatic low-angle photograph. The model remains natural and confident. The photographer presses the shutter naturally. CAMERA: Alternate between: photographer POV, side angle, over-the-shoulder camera shot, low-angle photography position, wide shot showing the historic architecture. Keep the photography process realistic. -------------------------------------------------- 20–25 SECONDS — REVIEWING THE PHOTOS Use @IMG5. The photoshoot is complete. The photographer lowers the camera. She turns the camera screen toward herself. She scrolls through the photographs. Show a beautiful portrait of the same model on the camera display. She stops on one particularly strong image. She looks pleased with the result. A subtle satisfied smile appears. CAMERA: Medium shot → close-up of camera screen → close-up of photographer's satisfied expression. Make the camera screen look realistic. -------------------------------------------------- 25–30 SECONDS — FINAL WALK AWAY Use @IMG6. The photographer puts the camera on her shoulder. She adjusts the camera strap. She picks up her camera bag. She begins walking calmly through the historic Istanbul street. Warm golden-hour sunlight illuminates the buildings. She walks away from the camera. The camera slowly pulls back into a wide cinematic shot. Reveal the historic street, architecture, domes and distant minarets. End with the photographer becoming smaller in the beautiful Istanbul environment. CUT TO BLACK. -------------------------------------------------- CAMERA STYLE: Premium cinematic travel-fashion photography vlog. Smooth tracking shots. Natural handheld movement. Professional documentary-style camera work. Wide establishing shots. Medium lifestyle shots. Close-ups for camera equipment. Over-the-shoulder photography shots. Gentle cinematic pull-back at the ending. Do not use excessive camera shake. Do not use unrealistic camera movements. -------------------------------------------------- REALISM: Realistic camera handling. Realistic lens interaction. Realistic shutter operation. Realistic walking. Realistic model posing. Natural human anatomy. Realistic hands and fingers. Natural facial expressions. Realistic clothing movement. Realistic camera screen. Natural Istanbul environment. -------------------------------------------------- CONTINUITY: Same female photographer throughout. Same face. Same hairstyle. Same outfit. Same camera. Same lens. Same camera bag. Same Istanbul location. Same model during all photoshoot scenes. No identity swapping. No different photographer. No different model. No camera change. No lens suddenly changing. No face morphing. No distorted hands. No extra fingers. No cartoon. No anime. No CGI-looking people. No text. No logos. No watermark. FINAL FEELING: A polished professional photography lifestyle vlog. The viewer should feel they followed the photographer through a real working day: PREPARE CAMERA → LEAVE HOME → ARRIVE IN ISTANBUL → SET UP SHOOT → PHOTOGRAPH MODEL → REVIEW PHOTOS → WALK AWAY.

entries.title: Realistic Japanese High School Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed, long-form prompt for generating a realistic 30-second vlog-style video of a Japanese high school student's after-school activities with a nostalgic, home-movie aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
日本人の女子高校生の何気ない放課後を、一緒に下校する同級生の友達が撮った30秒間のVlog風個人ホームビデオとして作成せよ。超現実的。30秒は約12個の短いショット（各2〜3秒）のハードカットのモンタージュで構成する。各ショットはすべて別の場所・別の瞬間で、1ショット＝1つの小さな出来事。トランジション効果やフェードは使わない。撮っているのは仲のいい同級生なので、彼女は完全にリラックスしていて、カメラに笑いかけ、物を見せ、話しかける（言葉は聞き取れない）。ポーズや演技ではなく、友達にだけ見せる素の表情。

メイン被写体
全ショットを通じて同じ日本人の女子高校生。自然で健康的、現実的な肌の質感、ノーメイク、部活帰りの少し疲れたが晴れやかな目。黒髪を高めのポニーテールにし、後れ毛が数本頬にかかる。白い半袖のセーラー服（紺の襟とスカーフ）、膝丈の紺のプリーツスカート、白いソックス、白いスニーカー、肩掛けのスクールバッグ。顔、体型、髪型、制服、持ち物を最初から最後まで完全に一貫させる。

ロケーション
夏の放課後から日暮れの、学校とそこから続く坂の通学路。放課後の教室、廊下、昇降口、校門、自販機、土手の道、駄菓子屋、夕焼けの横断歩道。生活感のある本物の通学路。群衆、広告、認識できるブランドはなし。

カメラ / ビジュアルスタイル
全ショット共通：同級生が構える手持ちの古い民生用デジタルカメラ。自然な揺れ、不完全なフレーミング、時折のオートフォーカス変更、露出のゆらぎ、柔らかい画像ディテール、軽いモーションブラー、微妙なデジタルノイズ、少し抑えた色、不完全なホワイトバランス。スタビライズ、ジンバル、ドローン、スローモーション、映画的照明、商業カラーグレーディングはなし。

ショットリスト（順番通り、各2〜3秒、すべてハードカット）
1. 放課後の教室で帰り支度。カメラに気づき、笑って軽く手のひらでレンズを遮る。
2. 誰もいない放課後の廊下を並んで歩く。上履きの音が響く。
3. 昇降口でスニーカーに履き替えながら、何か喋って笑う（聞こえない）。
4. 校門を出て、振り返って夕方の校舎を一度見上げる。
5. 自販機で飲み物を2本買い、1本をレンズに差し出す。
6. 土手の道を歩く。風になびくポニーテールを押さえて笑う。
7. 塀の上の猫にしゃがんで手を伸ばし、するりとかわされてふたりで笑う。
8. 駄菓子屋の棒アイスをパキッと半分に割り、片方をカメラに差し出す。
9. 突然のにわか雨。スクールバッグを頭にかざして笑いながら走り、途中でかざすのをやめる。
10. 軒下で濡れた前髪のまま、わざと変な顔をして撮影者を笑わせる。
11. 夕焼けの横断歩道を渡りながら、振り返る。
12. 別れ道の角で、両手で大きく手を振る。その途中、およそ00:29で録画は突然ブラックアウトに切り替わる。フェードアウトなし。

物理的リアリズム
全ショットで信ぴょう性のある現実世界の物理を維持。手、指、足、制服、髪、雨、スクールバッグ、棒アイスは自然に振る舞う。余分な指、融合した手、重複した手足、歪んだ解剖学、浮遊物、消える物体、突然の変形はなし。足は地面に適切に繋がったまま。ショット間で被写体を一貫させ、光は放課後→夕焼けへ自然に進む。

オーディオ
自然な環境音のみ。ショットごとに環境音も切り替わる。遠くの部活の掛け声、上履きの音、セミの声、自販機の音、アイスを割る音、雨音、横断歩道の音、言葉として聞き取れない話し声と笑い声。音楽なし。ナレーションなし。人工的な音響効果なし。

最終的な雰囲気
12個の何気ない瞬間を並べただけなのに、あとで見返すとエモいと感じる映像。商業作品ではない。ファッション映画ではない。ミュージックビデオではない。同級生のカメラに残っている、なんでもないのに二度と戻らない放課後の記録。屈託がなく、青春の途中で、懐かしく、温かく、即興的で、深く人間的。カメラがたまたまそこにあったような感じを優先。
entries.translated_prompt:
Create a 30-second personal home video in the style of a vlog, filmed by a high school classmate walking home with a Japanese high school girl. Hyper-realistic. The 30 seconds should consist of a montage of hard cuts comprising about 12 short shots (2-3 seconds each). Each shot should be in a different place and at a different moment, where 1 shot = 1 small event. Do not use transition effects or fades. Since the person filming is a close classmate, she is completely relaxed, smiling at the camera, showing things, and talking (words are inaudible). Not poses or acting, but the natural expressions she only shows to friends.

Main Subject:
The same Japanese high school girl throughout all shots. Natural, healthy, realistic skin texture, no makeup, slightly tired but bright eyes after club activities. Black hair tied in a high ponytail with a few stray hairs on her cheeks. White short-sleeved sailor uniform (navy collar and scarf), knee-length navy pleated skirt, white socks, white sneakers, and a shoulder school bag. Keep face, body shape, hairstyle, uniform, and belongings completely consistent from start to finish.

Locations:
A school road and its slopes from after school in summer until sunset. After-school classrooms, hallways, entrance halls, school gates, vending machines, riverbank paths, candy stores, and crosswalks at sunset. Authentic school roads full of everyday life. No crowds, advertisements, or recognizable brands.

Camera / Visual Style:
Common to all shots: a handheld old consumer digital camera held by a classmate. Natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus changes, exposure fluctuations, soft image detail, light motion blur, subtle digital noise, slightly suppressed colors, and imperfect white balance. No stabilization, gimbals, drones, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading.

Shot List (in order, 2-3 seconds each, all hard cuts):
1. Getting ready to go home in the after-school classroom. Noticing the camera, smiling, and lightly covering the lens with her palm.
2. Walking together down an empty hallway after school. The sound of indoor shoes echoes.
3. Changing into sneakers at the entrance while talking and laughing about something (inaudible).
4. Leaving the school gate, turning back once to look up at the school building in the evening.
5. Buying two drinks at a vending machine and offering one to the lens.
6. Walking along a riverbank path. Laughing while holding her ponytail fluttering in the wind.
7. Squatting down to reach for a cat on a wall, laughing with her friend as the cat deftly dodges.
8. Splitting a popsicle from a candy store in half and offering one side to the camera.
9. A sudden summer shower. Running while laughing with her school bag over her head, then stopping to hold it up halfway.
10. Under a roof with wet bangs, intentionally making a funny face to make the photographer laugh.
11. Turning back while crossing a crosswalk at sunset.
12. Waving both hands widely at a fork in the road. In the middle of this, around 00:29, the recording suddenly cuts to black. No fade-out.

Physical Realism:
Maintain plausible real-world physics in all shots. Hands, fingers, feet, uniform, hair, rain, school bags, and popsicles behave naturally. No extra fingers, fused hands, duplicated limbs, distorted anatomy, floating objects, disappearing items, or sudden deformations. Feet remain properly connected to the ground. Maintain subject consistency between shots, with lighting naturally progressing from after-school to sunset.

Audio:
Natural environmental sounds only. Environmental sounds also cut with each shot. Distant club activity shouts, indoor shoe sounds, cicada chirps, vending machine sounds, popsicle splitting sounds, rain sounds, crosswalk sounds, and inaudible voices and laughter. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

Final Atmosphere:
A video that feels emotional when looked back on, even though it's just 12 ordinary moments lined up. Not a commercial work. Not a fashion film. Not a music video. A record of an ordinary but irreplaceable after-school moment left on a classmate's camera. Carefree, in the middle of youth, nostalgic, warm, spontaneous, and deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that the camera just happened to be there.

entries.title: Scarlet Priestess Time Freeze Fantasy
entries.description: A breathtaking cinematic fantasy sequence where a mage stops time during a storm to reconstruct a shattered tree.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second multi-shot 16:9 ultra-photorealistic live-action cinematic fantasy sequence. The sequence must look like a real high-end live-action film scene shot on location with a real performer and practical wardrobe. Absolute photographic realism. No 3D look, no CGI feel, no game-engine rendering, no plastic vegetation, no synthetic surfaces, no fantasy illustration aesthetic. Natural skin texture, visible textile fibers, heavy cloth behavior, wet moss, irregular bark, realistic droplets, physically believable wind, real gravity, true inertia, cinematic lens behavior, subtle film grain, restrained cinematic color grading. Core concept: a violent supernatural storm tears through the forest. The mage raises her staff high into the air to stop time. At the exact moment the staff reaches upward, time freezes instantly all around her: rain, leaves, broken branches, bark, wood splinters, moss, droplets and debris are suspended motionless in midair. Important: the mage herself is not frozen. She alone remains alive and moving outside stopped time. Her hair continues to flow in the wind, her immense red garment continues to ripple and breathe with natural weight, and she can move her hand through the frozen world. The camera glides through the suspended storm in macro detail, then reveals her gently touching a frozen droplet with her fingertips. She closes her fingers, and the whole forest rewinds violently in reverse. Final shot: a gigantic shattered tree reconstructs itself around her in a breathtaking live-action spectacle. SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.0 s. Wide kinetic establishing shot in the forest, 28mm lens feeling, camera moving through the trees as a violent supernatural storm tears across the landscape. Branches whip, leaves spiral, rain and spray burst through frame, loose bark and splinters fly through the air, ferns bend under sudden force. The mage stands ahead in the distance as a vivid red silhouette against the dark green forest. The storm is chaotic, heavy and physically believable. SHOT 2 — 2.0–4.0 s. Dramatic low-angle medium-wide shot. The mage powerfully raises her tall moss-covered staff high above her head toward the sky. Her stance is rooted and sovereign. Her expression is calm, focused, and absolute. Strong wind pushes through her long red hair and the heavy fibrous strands of her cloak, making them stream and flutter with real weight and texture. She is alive, powerful, and dynamic. The storm continues raging violently around her as she completes the upward gesture. SHOT 3 — 4.0–5.0 s. Extreme close shot on the staff lifted in the air and on her hand gripping it. At the exact peak of the gesture, time stops instantly. Hard supernatural freeze. Rain droplets, leaves, bark fragments, twigs, mud particles and torn moss become perfectly suspended in the air. The environment freezes absolutely. Important: only the world freezes. The mage remains unfrozen, breathing subtly, with hair and garment still moving in a mysterious residual wind. SHOT 4 — 5.0–7.0 s. Macro traversal shot through the frozen storm. The camera moves slowly and elegantly through suspended droplets, torn leaves, wood splinters, clumps of wet moss and airborne soil particles, all perfectly still. Shallow depth of field and delicate rack focus. Hyper-detailed water, bark fibers and plant textures. In the background, the mage remains the only moving element in the frame, her red hair drifting softly and her cloak breathing in the wind while everything else is frozen solid in time. SHOT 5 — 7.0–9.5 s. Intimate close shot transitioning from macro to portrait. The camera passes in front of the mage’s face as she slowly extends one hand into the frozen air. She gently touches a single suspended water droplet with her fingertips. The droplet remains perfectly suspended in space while her hand moves freely around it. Her face is alive, calm and controlled, not frozen. Her eyes study the droplet with quiet mastery. Strands of red hair move across the hood and cheeks, and the edges of her garment subtly ripple. Around her, the storm debris hangs motionless like a halo of suspended destruction. SHOT 6 — 9.5–12.0 s. Close dynamic shot with a slightly orbiting camera angle. After touching the droplet, the mage slowly closes her fingers. At that exact moment, the entire world reverses direction violently. All suspended elements accelerate backward through their original paths: droplets fly back into rain streams, splinters return into branches, bark fragments reattach, leaves reverse through the air, mud and moss snap back into place. The reverse motion must feel like true time rewinding, not simply objects moving backward. The mage remains centered and controlled while the forest heals around her. SHOT 7 — 12.0–15.0 s. Grand final shot, dramatic low-angle to medium-wide composition centered on the mage. Around and behind her stands a gigantic tree that had been violently shattered by the storm. In reverse motion, colossal trunk fragments, bark slabs, inner wood fibers, branches, moss and debris reassemble around her at monumental scale. The ancient tree reconstructs itself completely, sealing and becoming whole again while she stands beneath it with her staff still raised or just beginning to lower, hair and garment still moved by the lingering wind. End on a majestic completed composition: the restored towering tree enclosing her presence, the storm gone, the forest returned to impossible stillness, and the mage the only living force beyond time. Camera language must be varied and purposeful across the sequence: storm-driven wide shot, low-angle heroic gesture, extreme close-up trigger shot, macro traversal through frozen debris, intimate face-and-hand interaction, dynamic rewind shot, and monumental final reveal. Every angle must feel deliberate, original, cinematic, and worthy of a major film director. Keep the supernatural phenomenon grounded in realism. The impossible effect must emerge from fully believable physical materials: water, wood, bark, moss, leaves, mist, cloth, soil, and air. No glowing magic beams, no fantasy energy blasts, no holograms, no stylized VFX overload. The power is expressed through time control, motion contrast, tactile interaction with frozen matter, and physical reversal. Important visual rule: once time is stopped, all environmental elements must be perfectly frozen, but the mage must remain subtly animated. Her hair moves in the wind, her cloak and fibrous garment continue to ripple naturally, and she can deliberately reach out and touch a suspended droplet with her hand. No text, no titles, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no visible UI, no identity drift, no costume change, no staff change, no duplicate character, no malformed hands, no extra fingers, no synthetic skin, no cartoon motion, no low-detail background. no music, no subtitle
