entries.title: Breakdance Flare to Windmill Sequence
entries.description: A highly detailed structural prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a realistic 15-second breakdancing transition from a flare to a windmill with specific physics and camera requirements.
entries.prompt:
shot:
  type: R2V
  reference: <Picture 1>
  camera: fixed, eye-level, medium-wide shot capturing full body throughout, no cuts
  duration: 15-second continuous sequence, constant tempo throughout
character:
  appearance: delegated entirely to <Picture 1>, no additional description
  style_separation:
    character: cel-shaded anime style, locked to reference image
    environment: photorealistic indoor dance studio floor, neutral wall, soft even lighting
action:
  sequence_name: thomas_flare_to_windmill_combo
  segments:
    - segment: intro_setup
      duration: approx 0-3s
      description: standing neutral pose transitions down into crouched base position, both palms grounding shoulder-width apart, core braced, hips settling to a fixed rotation height
    - segment: flare_combo
      duration: approx 3-9s
      support_pattern: alternating two-hand support, hand-to-hand transfer, no static single-hand hold
      description: two continuous flare rotations - right leg sweeps laterally at constant angular velocity, left leg sweeps diagonally downward-forward as support hand transfers, right leg continues diagonally upward with legs held widely split throughout, hips remain the stationary rotation axis with no vertical bounce; cycle repeats once more at identical speed
    - segment: transition_to_windmill
      duration: approx 9-11s
      description: on the final flare rotation, upper back and shoulder lower to the floor while legs continue their circular momentum, torso rolling from the flare's hip-axis rotation into a back-and-shoulder-axis rotation, hands lift off the floor and tuck near the chest as the transition completes
    - segment: windmill_execution
      duration: approx 11-15s
      description: two continuous windmill rotations - legs swing in a wide circular arc overhead while the upper back and shoulders roll across the floor in constant-velocity rotation, legs stay extended and split for momentum, no hands touching the floor for support during this segment
physics_constraints:
  - hip axis remains at constant height during the flare segment, no vertical bounce
  - leg sweeps driven by hip rotation and knee flexion, not by jumping or floating
  - hand-to-floor contact during the flare is continuous except the brief instant of transfer between palms
  - the flare-to-windmill transition is a smooth momentum carry-over, not a stop-and-restart
  - during the windmill segment, rotation is driven by shoulder-and-back contact with the floor, not by pushing off with hands
  - rotation speed stays constant within each segment, no acceleration bursts
  - legs stay maximally extended and split during all rotation segments to convey centrifugal force
lighting: soft studio lighting, consistent throughout, no flicker

entries.title: High-Speed Motorcycle Action Sequence
entries.description: A dynamic action prompt for a motorcycle chase or racing scene with heavy speed blur and multiple cinematic cuts.
entries.prompt:
Create an explosive, high-speed motorcycle action sequence in 16:9, 24fps, exactly 16 distinct cuts, total runtime ≈ 16–17 seconds.

A lone rider in a light green helmet and dark riding gear pilots a babypink sportbike along a narrow, winding paved mountain road that cuts through rolling green hills under a brilliant sunny sky with scattered white clouds and distant blue mountain ranges and water visible on the horizon. Preserve the exact bike color, rider silhouette, road markings, green landscape, fencing and lighting throughout — never redesign them.

This film is 90 % pure kinetic camera motion and 10 % environmental beauty: aggressive low-to-high tracking shots, continuous forward motion with heavy speed blur, whip pans, snap zooms, sun flares and impact shakes. No text, no graphics, no logos — pure cinematic speed.

### CUT LIST

CUT 01 | 0.00–1.00s
Dynamic low-side tracking shot: red motorcycle accelerates away from a small parking area onto the winding asphalt road; lush green grass and fence posts streak past with heavy motion blur; bright sun flares at the top of the frame.

**CUT 02 | 1.00–2.00s**  
Camera rises and locks behind the rider as the bike climbs the first gentle incline; green hills roll on both sides, a lone tree appears ahead, distant mountains and water visible on the right.

**CUT 03 | 2.00–3.00s**  
Tight rear tracking; rider leans into a smooth left curve; the road surface and white dashed lines blur heavily; sun remains high and intense.

**CUT 04 | 3.00–4.00s**  
Bike powers up a steeper section of road; camera stays low and centered, grass and fence posts racing past on both sides; distant valley opens on the right.

**CUT 05 | 4.00–5.00s**  
High-speed straight section; camera drops even lower, almost road-level, capturing the red bike centered against the climbing green hillside and bright blue sky.

**CUT 06 | 5.00–6.00s**  
Rider continues the climb; camera rises slightly and banks with the road; lush green slopes fill the left and right frame edges with strong motion blur.

**CUT 07 | 6.00–7.00s**  
Bike approaches a crest; camera pulls back a fraction to reveal more of the endless green hills and the road stretching ahead under the bright sun.

**CUT 08 | 7.00–8.00s**  
Rider leans into the next curve; camera swings wide then snaps back, capturing the red bike against the steep green embankment and metal guardrail.

**CUT 09 | 8.00–9.00s**  
Tight following shot as the motorcycle accelerates past the guardrail; heavy speed blur on the grass and road surface; sun flare intensifies.

**CUT 10 | 9.00–10.00s**  
Camera tilts upward dramatically, almost looking straight up the road; the red bike becomes smaller against the vast blue sky and white clouds while still racing forward.

**CUT 11 | 10.00–11.00s**  
Sweeping aerial-style arc as the bike enters a wide left-hand hairpin; camera orbits slightly, revealing the full curve of the road, green slopes and distant mountains.

**CUT 12 | 11.00–12.00s**  
High-angle tracking shot looking down on the red motorcycle as it carves the long sweeping curve; the road and guardrail form a perfect arc against the green hillside.

**CUT 13 | 12.00–13.00s**  
Camera pulls higher still, showing the bike as a small red shape on the winding road that snakes across the vast green landscape toward distant valleys and peaks.

**CUT 14 | 13.00–14.00s**  
Rider continues through the open hillside section; camera descends slightly and tracks from a higher three-quarter rear angle, capturing the bike, road and rolling green terrain.

**CUT 15 | 14.00–15.00s**  
Wide high-angle shot of the motorcycle navigating the next gentle S-curve; a second distant vehicle appears briefly on the road ahead; lush green fields and scattered trees fill the frame.

**CUT 16 | 15.00–16.65s 
Final high-speed tracking shot as the red bike continues along the open mountain road; camera gradually rises and the frame fills with bright green hills, blue sky and soft sun flare; the sequence ends on a sense of endless forward motion.

### Editing & Sound  
Extremely aggressive rhythm — continuous forward tracking with occasional whip pans, snap zooms and speed ramps, heavy motion blur on every surface, strong sun flares and subtle impact shakes on every crest or curve. No text, no graphics, no slow-motion.  

BGM / Audio: electronic / indie-pop beat with driving drums, bright synths and rising energy that matches the speed of the bike. Engine roar, wind whooshes and tire sound on asphalt are locked to the picture as rhythmic elements. Peak energy in the middle curves and end with a bright, open sonic release.

Premium AAA quality, photorealistic cinematic rendering, pure speed and freedom aesthetic, consistent red sportbike and rider design, exactly 16 cuts.

entries.title: Martial Arts Fight Sequence
entries.description: A complex 8K cinematic fight choreography sequence between Taekwondo and Kung Fu masters in an industrial setting.
entries.prompt:
DURATION: 30 SECONDS | 16:9 | 8K CINEMATIC

IMAGE 1 = MASTER TAEKWONDO
IMAGE 2 = MASTER KUNGFU

Create an ultra-realistic continuous martial-arts fight using IMAGE 1 and IMAGE 2 as exact character references. Preserve facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, wardrobe, accessories and appearance throughout. No morphing, face swapping or identity drift.

STYLE: ARRI Alexa 65 cinematic look, 8K detail, 35mm anamorphic lens, realistic skin and fabric, practical lighting, cinematic HDR, natural motion blur, subtle film grain, physically accurate choreography and grounded action-film cinematography.

0–5 SEC — OPENING CLASH
Inside an abandoned industrial warehouse, IMAGE 1 attacks with a powerful roundhouse → spinning back kick. IMAGE 2 narrowly evades and counters with rapid Kung Fu punches, elbow and low kick. IMAGE 1 blocks, pivots and answers with body kick → high roundhouse. Use aggressive handheld camera, low-angle tracking and Dutch angles. Every impact produces realistic body recoil and weight transfer.

5–8 SEC — TRANSITION
IMAGE 1 launches a spinning hook kick. Camera follows the rotation with a fast whip-pan and realistic motion blur. The spinning movement seamlessly carries the fight into a new location. The transition must feel continuous—no teleportation, cuts or frozen poses.

8–15 SEC — CONTINUOUS COMBAT
The fight immediately resumes. IMAGE 1 attacks with jumping side kick → spinning kick. IMAGE 2 ducks underneath and counters with a fast Kung Fu combination. Both fighters maintain realistic footwork, momentum, distance and balance. Camera performs a 360° orbit, low tracking shots and energetic handheld movement.

15–21 SEC — ESCALATION
Both fighters exchange increasingly aggressive combinations: Taekwondo kicks against Kung Fu punches, elbows and sweeps. Include blocks, evasions, pivots, feints and counterattacks. Impacts visibly affect posture, balance and movement. No exaggerated wire-fu or impossible physics.

21–25 SEC — FINISHING SETUP
IMAGE 1 gains control with low kick → body kick → spinning back kick. IMAGE 2 is driven backward and briefly loses balance. Camera rapidly pushes toward IMAGE 1 as he prepares the final attack.

entries.title: Indian Village Zombie Chase Intercut
entries.description: A sophisticated intercut sequence contrasting a mother-daughter relationship in a cold zombie reality versus a warm nostalgic memory, using professional cinema camera settings.
entries.prompt: Create a 26-second ultra-cinematic intercut chase sequence set in an Indian village, built around two parallel versions of the same mother-daughter relationship. The film language must feel sophisticated, emotional, and visually precise — not like generic zombie content. This should feel like a serious, beautifully directed short sequence shot with an ARRI Alexa / Alexa Mini LF style image, cinematic dynamic range, rich texture, strong highlight rolloff, shallow depth when needed, and confident visual grammar. Use expressive but controlled camera movement: handheld urgency in the present, smoother lyrical movement in the memory world, elegant match cuts, motivated pans, lens breathing, and emotionally meaningful intercutting. Keep it grounded, human, and heartbreaking. The setting is a rural Indian village and adjoining fields — narrow mud paths, small homes, low boundary walls, patches of crops, wet earth, scattered trees, open field edges, and a recognizable village texture. The sequence has two visual worlds: 1. Present / Zombie Reality Cold, blue-grey, wet, lightly rainy, fearful. This is the real world. The mother is running in panic, crying and exhausted, being chased by her own zombified daughter. This world should have a subtle cool blue tinge, overcast sky, light rain, mud, breath, desperation, and danger. Camera movement here should feel tense and close — handheld but controlled, with occasional tracking alongside or behind. Rain should visibly strike skin, fabric, and leaves. The daughter is still recognizable as a child, but unsettling: pale skin tone, lifeless focus, feral movement, subtle veins, predatory urgency, wet hair clinging to her face. No exaggerated monster design. Keep her scary because she is still a little girl. 2. Memory / Dream World Warm, sunlit, nostalgic, soft, and emotionally idealized. This is not reality — it is the mother’s memory or dream overlay. Same geography, same movement patterns, but now it is a golden, dreamy late-afternoon memory with soft warm sunlight, gentle bloom, slightly diffused highlights, and a touch of dreamy lens softness. In this version, the little girl is alive, healthy, playful, and joyfully running after her mother. The mother is laughing and looking back with love. The emotional contrast is the entire point. Camera / Lens Grammar Use 35mm / 40mm / 50mm cinematic language for emotional medium tracking shots, occasional longer-lens compression for the chase, and one or two slightly wider lenses for geography. The intercutting should rely on motion matches: same turn, same gesture, same direction of movement, but different reality. Whenever possible, cut on action so the audience feels the memory and horror colliding. The present should feel sharper, wetter, more immediate. The memory should feel slightly dream-filtered and warmer, but still photoreal. Beat Structure 0:00–0:12 — Intercut Chase Open immediately in the cold world: the mother is already running through the village in panic, breathless, crying, slipping slightly on wet earth, looking back over her shoulder. Behind her, the zombie daughter is chasing her with disturbing speed. Rain falls lightly. We stay close and urgent. Start intercutting almost immediately with the warm memory version: in the same path or nearby field edge, the little girl playfully runs after her mother, laughing. The mother turns back in sunshine, smiling with that instinctive playful fear mothers do when pretending to be chased. The key is that the movement and blocking should rhyme. A turn in the present becomes a turn in the past. A backward glance in terror becomes a backward glance in laughter. A muddy footstep becomes a barefoot or dry footstep in sunlit dust or grass. A panicked reach becomes a playful reach. The cuts should become emotionally richer as the first 12 seconds progress. The audience must understand that the mother is not just being chased — she is also remembering what this child once was. 0:12–0:24 — Catch / Field / Play Intercut In the present, the mother stumbles and falls into a field or grassy patch at the edge of the village. She lands hard in wet mud and tries to crawl backward, crying and terrified, as the daughter catches up. Do not resolve it immediately. Intercut this with the warm dream memory of the mother and child tumbling together into a field, laughing, rolling, and playing. The child climbs onto her mother playfully. They laugh, hold each other, and roll in warm grass. The cutting should now become more intimate and emotionally devastating: in one world, the daughter is on top of her like a predator; in the memory, she is on top of her like a playful child. A frightened hand in mud cuts to the same hand touching her daughter’s cheek lovingly in the warm world. A cry in the rain cuts to a laugh in golden light. Keep the sound design working with the cut structure: Present: rain, breath, wet fabric, mud, distant dogs, wind, subtle snarls or feral breathing. Memory: birds, soft wind in crops, child laughter, gentle footsteps, warm village ambience, all with a light dream-echo softness. No generated music. No score. The transitions themselves should feel musical. 0:24–0:26 — Dream Break / Infection Sting In the last two seconds, the dream fractures. The warmth collapses. Cut back hard to the cold present. Use brief disorienting flashes — the mother’s face in rain, the daughter close, the field, a trembling hand. Then give the final disturbing hint: on the mother’s neck, cheek, or temple, we glimpse subtle dark veins or infection-like changes beginning to appear. Do not show a full transformation. Just enough to suggest that now even the mother may be turning — or that the memory is collapsing into the same fate. Cut immediately. Important No dialogue needed, or only tiny involuntary cries / breaths from the mother. Let the sequence be carried by performance, camera grammar, intercutting, and ambient sound. The emotional effect should be: love memory colliding with horror reality.

entries.title: Stop-Motion Claymation Nutella Cafe
entries.description: A charming prompt for a claymation-style animation of a miniature Nutella cafe building itself and being enjoyed by characters.
entries.prompt:
3D stop-motion claymation style, plasticine texture with visible soft fingerprint smudges, warm soft-box lighting, cozy pastel brown, cream, and warm wooden tones. Miniature diorama scale, tilt-shift depth of field, playful frame-by-frame animation feel.
​Scene Sequence & Action
​Scene 1 (Base Construction): A minimalist clay base and street tile platform build themselves layer by layer on a beige studio backdrop. Streetlamps and small potted plants pop up around the corners.
​Scene 2 (Structure & Branding): A small cafe building forms with brown walls and a striped awning. A large clay Nutella jar drops smoothly onto the top, transforming into the main "Nutella" illuminated store logo and roof structure.
​Scene 3 (Interior Details): A close-up pan inside showing a miniature espresso machine, shelves lined with mini Nutella jars, and a counter featuring a stack of pancakes topped with chocolate spread, a croissant, and a coffee cup.
​Scene 4 (Character Animation): Cute, chibi-style clay characters enter. A young boy and girl sit outside at a tiny wooden table. The boy uses a small knife to spread smooth, glossy Nutella over a stack of fluffy pancakes.
​Scene 5 (Final Reveal): Camera zooms out to reveal the full animated diorama: a vibrant, bustling miniature Nutella cafe with outdoor seating, streetlamps glowing, and multiple adorable characters enjoying their treats.
​Technical Camera & Lighting
Smooth isometric and eye-level camera transitions, macro lens perspective, warm interior glow mixed with soft ambient studio lighting, high-detail clay texture rendering, 4k resolution, 24fps stop-motion rhythm

entries.title: Nostalgic MiniDV Korean Home Video
entries.description: A nostalgic early-2000s MiniDV camcorder-style video featuring a young Korean woman discovering a mysterious gift box in her bedroom.
entries.prompt:
Create a highly addictive, nostalgic early-2000s Korean MiniDV home-video story designed to hook viewers within the first second and make them stay until the final reveal.

The footage should look like a real forgotten MiniDV tape discovered 20 years later — authentic 4:3 consumer camcorder, imperfect handheld movement, CCD noise, soft analog sharpness, tape grain, slight color bleeding, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations and occasional blown highlights.

Color palette: warm golden bedroom light, dusty pink highlights, soft cream skin tones, muted teal shadows and subtle faded red accents. Cozy, nostalgic, slightly dreamy but completely realistic.

Main character: a 24-year-old beautiful Korean woman with long dark hair, expressive eyes and minimal natural makeup. She wears an oversized pale-blue T-shirt, loose cream pajama pants and cozy socks.

Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit, bedroom, props and lighting perfectly consistent throughout.

SHOT 1 — 0:00–0:03 — THE HOOK

The camera is already recording from a slightly crooked position on a bedroom desk.

The woman suddenly rushes into frame holding a small mysterious red gift box.

She looks around the room as if checking whether anyone is watching.

She whispers excitedly:

“I finally found it…”

She places the box on the bed.

A tiny handwritten label on it reads:

“OPEN WHEN YOU’RE 24.”

She stares at it in disbelief.

Instant curiosity.

SHOT 2 — 0:03–0:06 — THE MYSTERY

She sits on the floor beside the bed and carefully opens the box.

Inside is an old photograph and a tiny handwritten note.

Her playful expression slowly disappears.

She picks up the photograph.

The camera autofocuses onto it.

The photograph shows a much younger version of herself standing in the exact same bedroom.

She looks from the photograph to the room.

Her expression becomes completely stunned.

SHOT 3 — 0:06–0:09 — THE CONNECTION

She slowly looks around.

The camera remains completely still.

She notices something behind the old photograph: a tiny folded note.

She opens it.

Her eyes widen.

She starts laughing in disbelief while shaking her head.

The note contains a simple handwritten message:

“If you found this… you finally grew up.”

Natural emotional reaction — not melodramatic.

SHOT 4 — 0:09–0:12 — THE EMOTIONAL TWIST

She sits silently for a moment.

Her expression becomes soft and emotional.

She looks at the old photograph again, then smiles warmly.

She gently places the photograph against her chest.

A tiny nostalgic laugh escapes.

The warm bedroom lamp creates a beautiful glow across her face while the MiniDV camera struggles slightly with exposure.

SHOT 5 — 0:12–0:15 — THE FINAL REVEAL

Suddenly she notices something written on the back of the photograph.

She flips it over.

Her eyes go wide.

She looks directly into the camera as if she has just realized something.

Then she laughs and says:

“Wait… YOU recorded this?”

She quickly walk

entries.title: Cinematic Lifestyle Vlog Character Consistency
entries.description: A structured storyboard prompt for a 20-second lifestyle vlog maintaining character identity across different times of day and locations.
entries.prompt: DURATION: 20 seconds ASPECT RATIO: 16:9 STYLE: Ultra-photorealistic live-action cinematic lifestyle vlog, premium commercial quality, natural human movement, realistic skin and hair, realistic clothing physics, soft cinematic lighting, subtle handheld camera feel, shallow depth of field, natural color grading. REFERENCE ASSIGNMENT: @IMG1 = FEMALE HERO / MAIN CHARACTER @IMG2 = BEDROOM / MORNING @IMG3 = KITCHEN / BREAKFAST @IMG4 = WORK / DESK @IMG5 = OUTDOOR / CAFÉ @IMG6 = EVENING / NIGHT Use @IMG1 as the strict identity reference throughout the entire video. CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: The same woman must appear in every scene. Preserve her exact face, facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, hairstyle, skin tone, feminine body proportions and overall identity. Do not change her identity between scenes. 0–3 SECONDS — MORNING Start in the bedroom using @IMG2. The woman wakes up naturally and sits on the edge of the bed. Soft morning sunlight enters through the window. She gently opens the curtains and looks toward the morning light. Camera begins with a medium-wide shot and smoothly pushes toward her. Peaceful morning atmosphere. 3–6 SECONDS — BREAKFAST Smooth cinematic transition to @IMG3. The same woman prepares a simple breakfast in the kitchen. She pours coffee or tea into a ceramic mug and places breakfast on the counter. Natural steam rises from the hot drink. She briefly looks toward the camera with a relaxed morning smile. Use a natural medium tracking shot. 6–10 SECONDS — WORK Transition to @IMG4. The same woman sits at her desk and works on her laptop. She types briefly, checks the screen and writes a few notes in her notebook. Natural productive expression. Camera moves slowly from a side angle toward a three-quarter view. Keep the environment realistic and calm. 10–14 SECONDS — OUTDOOR / CAFÉ Transition naturally to @IMG5. The same woman leaves home and walks through a beautiful modern city street toward an outdoor café. Camera smoothly tracks backward while she walks toward it. She arrives at the café, places her handbag beside the table and sits down. She smiles naturally toward the camera. Warm daylight and realistic city background. 14–17 SECONDS — CAFÉ MOMENT Close cinematic shot. She picks up her coffee/drink and takes a relaxed sip. Subtle background movement from distant pedestrians. Natural handheld lifestyle-vlog feeling. 17–20 SECONDS — NIGHT Transition to @IMG6. The same woman is back home in her cozy bedroom at night. She places her phone on the bedside table and relaxes after the day. She looks toward the window at the city lights, then turns toward the camera with a small peaceful smile. Camera slowly pushes into a close-up. End on her calm expression with warm bedroom lighting and soft city-light bokeh. CUT TO BLACK. CAMERA PRIORITY: Keep the camera cinematic and natural. Use smooth tracking, gentle push-ins, medium shots, close-ups and subtle handheld movement. Avoid excessive camera shake. Keep the woman as the visual focus. Maintain realistic transitions between locations. FINAL RULES: Same female character throughout. Same face and identity throughout. Natural realistic human movement. Realistic lighting and shadows. Realistic clothing and hair movement. No face changes. No character duplication. No extra main characters. No cartoon or anime appearance. No fantasy effects. No excessive motion blur. No distorted hands. No text. No logos. No watermark. The overall feeling should be: A beautiful, realistic cinematic glimpse into one ordinary but aesthetically pleasing day in her life. Create a premium photorealistic female character reference sheet using the uploaded woman as the STRICT identity reference. Preserve her exact facial identity, facial structure, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, natural skin texture, hairstyle and overall appearance. Create the same woman as a realistic modern lifestyle vlogger. Show her with natural feminine proportions and realistic anatomy. CHARACTER PRESENTATION: Create a clean professional character sheet containing: 1. Full-body front view 2. Full-body 3/4 view 3. Full-body side view 4. Back view 5. Close-up face portrait 6. Natural smiling expression 7. Neutral expression 8. Casual standing pose Keep the exact same woman in every view. CLOTHING: Use a simple modern casual lifestyle outfit suitable for a daily vlog: a clean neutral-colored fitted top, comfortable casual trousers or jeans, and simple everyday footwear. Keep the outfit realistic, modest and natural. STYLE: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, premium lifestyle commercial aesthetic, realistic skin texture, natural hair strands, realistic fabric, physically accurate anatomy, soft cinematic lighting, subtle depth of field, high-end photography, natural colors. The character should look like a real woman photographed for a professional lifestyle vlog. IDENTITY CONSISTENCY IS THE HIGHEST PRIORITY. Do not change her face. Do not change her hairstyle. Do not masculinize her. Do not make her look like a different person. Do not create an anime or cartoon appearance. No fantasy styling. No text. No logo. No watermark. Clean neutral studio background. This character reference will be used as the SAME FEMALE PROTAGONIST throughout a 20-second "A Day in Her Life" cinematic lifestyle vlog.

entries.title: Viral Funny Elastic Face FX
entries.description: A complex multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.5 creating exaggerated rubber-like facial deformation effects popular on social media.
entries.prompt:
【风格】抖音爆款搞怪变脸短视频（Viral Funny Elastic Face FX），真人实景，夸张橡胶级物理形变特效，4K超清画质，夜景人像打光，画面纯净无任何水印文字
【时长】10秒
【场景】夜晚城市街头，背景是暖黄色路灯与整齐的行道树，柏油路面有微弱反光
【角色】主角@图片1（身穿黑色大方领紧身长袖上衣，黑色长发自然垂落）

[00:00-00:02] 镜头1：橡胶大嘴拉扯与回弹（Rubber Mouth Stretch）
机位：中近景，手持自拍微仰视视角，镜头随呼吸轻微晃动。
动作：主角双手食指插进嘴角向两侧极度拉扯开，嘴巴像弹性橡胶一样被拉扯得巨大无比，吐出长舌头做搞怪鬼脸；双手松开后，嘴巴瞬间像弹簧一样恢复原状，主角歪头对着镜头微笑并轻快挥手。
特效：主角原本面部的超夸张物理弹性拉伸与回弹（Elastic Face Deformation），保持真人五官材质与肤质，无卡通替换。

[00:02-00:05] 镜头2：拍头变身大头娃娃（Giant Head Morphing）
机位：中近景，镜头中心平稳锁定在头部。
动作：主角双手抬起轻拍头部上方两侧。
特效：在手掌拍下的瞬间，主角原本的头部瞬间极度膨胀变大成“大头小子”造型，眼睛瞪大成凸起白眼珠，双颊鼓成圆球形嘟嘴，脖子与身体保持原样；随后双手放下，头部瞬间平滑缩回正常真人大小。

[00:05-00:07] 镜头3：提发纵向拉长脸部（Vertical Face Pull）
机位：中景，平稳手持视角。
动作：主角双手抓住头顶两撮头发向上快速提拉。
特效：在拉扯动作下，主角原有人脸被纵向极度拉长，五官随之拉伸变形为纵向椭圆大眼与“O”型嘴；双手松开时面部瞬间平滑收缩复原，主角低头腼腆眯眼甜笑。

[00:07-00:10] 镜头4：爪子咆哮与侧身定格（Playful Growl & Freeze）
机位：中景，镜头随动作有微小顿挫推镜感，最后平移定格。
动作：主角面部和身体保持完全正常的真人状态、无任何形变特效；双手抬至脸侧张开成“怪兽爪”姿态，仰头张嘴大笑做出“嗷呜”咆哮动作；随后身体向侧面微倾，收起双手，嘴角带笑侧身回眸直视镜头定格。
音效：配搞怪音效与清脆卡点音效。

entries.title: E-commerce Product Review Script
entries.description: A comprehensive multi-part framework prompt structured for direct marketing product showcases and health clinic review videos.
entries.prompt:
1. Basic Parameters
This is a vertical short video for health & home product review and recommendation, with an aspect ratio of 9:16 and a total duration of 31 seconds. The video is in 4K ultra HD, 60fps, with photorealistic portrait quality. The overall style is natural and documentary-style, lit with warm soft white light, the frame is clear and grain-free, and all camera movements are smooth and stable.

2. Fixed Scene Setting
The shooting scene is the interior of an American chiropractic clinic: the wall has a light gray matte finish, with an educational poster titled Whiplash Injuries of the Head and Neck (with head and neck anatomy illustrations) hung on the upper section of the wall. A light wood grain barn-door style storage cabinet with black metal hardware is placed against the wall, and on the countertop from left to right are a dark green cone-shaped decorative ornament, a transparent glass bottle, and a white tissue box with a blue logo. Half of an office chair with a black cushion and orange wooden legs is visible on the right side of the frame. The foreground is a dark gray leather three-section chiropractic treatment table. The entire environment is clean and tidy with even, soft lighting.

3. Fixed Character Setting
The on-screen talent is a 25-28 year old Caucasian woman with medium-length wavy blonde hair and natural, healthy skin. She wears gold round vintage earrings, a thin pearl bracelet on her left hand, and two thin plain gold rings on her left middle and ring fingers. She is dressed in a taupe brushed sports camisole (with cross straps and a drop-shaped cutout on the back) paired with matching high-waist tight yoga leggings. She has a friendly and relaxed expression, speaks in a professional yet casual tone, and all her movements are natural and unforced.

4. Core Product Setting
The core product showcased is a white ergonomic memory foam cervical pillow: it has a symmetrical cloud/plump bone shape, with curved raised support edges on the top and bottom ends, rounded bulges on the left and right sides, and a sunken central area that fits the curve of the head and neck. The pillowcase is made of skin-friendly knitted cotton with an invisible side zipper for easy removal and washing, and the inner core is slow-rebound memory foam that slowly regains its shape after being pressed, with sufficient support.

5. Storyboard Sequence
From 0 to 4 seconds, the shot is a medium static shot: the woman stands behind the treatment table, places both hands flat on the cervical pillow in the center of the table, and speaks to the camera. She gently presses down on the pillow surface to demonstrate the slow-rebound support, then lifts the pillow to chest height with both hands to show its full front outline. The corresponding voiceover is: "Today I'm sharing this amazing cervical pillow I got recommended after my chiropractic adjustment, the support is incredible."

安静接受这个距离 【人物与基础设定】 年轻妻子 必须严格依据上传参考图片 {{Mixed 1}} 。 老年丈夫 必须严格依据上传参考图片 {{Mixed 2}} 。 【场景设定】 场景为婚礼前夜的住宅门口。 年轻妻子站在门内。 老年丈夫站在门外。 门外必须是真实室外空间。 不是封闭楼道。 可以是： 安静街边门口； 带明显夜间空气感的建筑外侧空间。 整体必须保持： 安静、通透、美好、真实、有明显纵深。 门外 大光圈下保留： 疏朗夜间灯点； 模糊建筑墙面； 栏杆； 远处窗灯； 少量树影； 远处建筑暗部； 极轻的空气流动； 深邃而清晰的空间纵深。 门内 略暖。 可以隐约看到： 玄关； 少量家具轮廓； 挂着的外套或包； 玄关台面； 模糊杯子； 远处柔和暖灯； 少量真实生活痕迹。 不要堆满： 婚纱； 鲜花； 请柬； 礼盒。 婚礼前夜的信息主要由剧情和对白自然建立。 【氛围与画质】 保持原有氛围、画质、色调和通透感完全不变。 环境光影 光线自然、柔和、克制。 主光源来自人物前方偏上、略偏左的大面积柔光。 均匀铺陈面部。 避免： 硬阴影； 刀切式明暗边界； 舞台化照明。 门内： 低强度柔和暖色环境光。 门外： 真实夜间中性偏冷环境底光。 门内暖光自然向室外泄出一点。 老人脸部同时接收到： 一点门内暖光； 一点室外夜色环境底光。 综合色彩自然融合。 视觉基调 写实； 低饱和； 【表演可见细节】 焦点始终优先锁住当前人物靠近摄影机的一只眼睛。 必须能够清楚看见： 虹膜； 睫毛根部； 瞳孔轻微移动； 眼睑变化； 极浅眼眶水光； 鼻翼呼吸； 嘴唇轻微分开； 嘴唇重新抿紧； 吞咽； 下颌收紧； 下颌放松； 视线逃开； 重新聚焦； 微弱情绪变化； 呼吸从短促逐渐恢复完整。 门把手动作完全不需要出现在画面里。 人物手部不作为这一段表演重点。 第二次习惯成立的关键不是： “看见她碰两次”。 是：老人先准确说出接下来会发生什么。 然后通过： 画外极轻的两次接触声； 年轻女人眼神短暂向画外移动； 瞳孔变化； 呼吸骤停； 重新抬眼看老人 【运镜规则】 全片大部分时间采用： 前景过肩正反打。 严格不越轴。 摄影机始终处于两人表演轴线同一半区。 【固定轴线与方向】 年轻妻子始终位于画面左侧，向右看。 老年丈夫始终位于画面右侧，向左看。 无论人物产生任何轻微位移， 都不能交换画面方向。 【老年丈夫肩后拍年轻妻子】 老年丈夫的右肩、耳侧或后脑位于画面右侧极端柔焦前景。 约占画面： 8%—15%。 年轻妻子位于： 左侧至中央偏左。 始终向右看。 前景不得遮挡： 眼睛； 嘴唇； 关键微表情。 【年轻妻子肩后拍老年丈夫】 年轻妻子的左肩、发丝、脸侧轮廓位于画面左侧极端柔焦前景。 老年丈夫位于： 中央偏右。 始终向左看。 前景必须保留： 衣料； 发丝； 综合色彩 的自然质感。 不得虚成纯色黑块。 【允许的轻微调度】 允许： 极慢推进； 极轻后撤； 同侧10—20厘米平移； 人物向前不到半步时摄影机被动后撤； 不超过15°的同侧角度修正。 所有摄影机位移必须产生真实视觉变化： 门框比例变化； 过肩前景比例变化； 室外背景灯点发生轻微视差； 栏杆与建筑结构出现相对位移； 人物之间视觉距离发生真实改变。 禁止数字变焦冒充摄影机位移。 年轻女人第二次触碰后的瞳孔变化； 视线极短向画外偏移 完成信息。 “I've had a lifetime to notice.” 最后一个： notice 可以跨入年轻妻子反应镜头约0.2秒。 形成L-CUT。 让观众与她一起理解： lifetime意味着什么。 “...You?” 先在年轻女人脸上开始。 尾音可以轻轻跨入老人镜头。 老人听见后， 才出现全片第一次极浅的嘴角松动。 然后： “Just older.” “Was it good?” 尾音跨进老人第一秒沉默。 不要让老人马上回答。 他必须： 真的想了一下。 “Still good.” 尾音进入年轻女人反应。 L-CUT。 先看： 她听见“Hard”后的紧； 再看： “Still good”后的松。 然后才让她问： “So... we got married?” 最后 “Tomorrow.” 停顿。 “And every day after that.” 必须全部完整留在老年丈夫同一镜头内。 不要切女主。 台词结束以后， 才让： 抬手 → 停住 → 放下 → 她自己别头发 完成真正的情绪收束。 【摄影参数】 画幅：2.39:1 基础帧率：24fps 快门角度：180° 镜头建议： 开场年轻妻子： 85mm，f/2—f/2.4 常规正反打： 65—75mm，f/1.8—f/2.2 身份辨认： 85mm，f/2—f/2.4 婚姻问题： 85mm，f/2.2 结尾老年丈夫： 85—100mm，f/2.2 摄影方式： 全程克制手持； 极轻上下呼吸； 极轻左右微摆； 真实人体重心变化； 人物情绪推进时摄影机产生极小被动位移。 禁止： 稳定器式机械悬浮； 纪录片式剧烈晃动； 快速推进； 频繁抽焦； 炫技变焦； 无动机运镜。 【声音设计】 无BGM。 无字幕。 只保留真实环境音。 门外环境音 真实室外夜间空气感； 很远的城市低频； 极轻风声； 远处建筑环境底噪； 非常稀薄的空间声； 没有任何车辆驶过。 不要近距离交通声
entries.translated_prompt: 【Character Emotion Arc】 Young Wife: Pre-wedding anxiety → Habitual opening of the door after the first knock → A stranger's voice accurately mentions her first habit → Brief daze → Polite defensiveness → The old man predicts her second minor action → Off-camera sound happens → Struck for the first time → Realizes he knows more than the present → Confusion → Alertness → Observes the old man → Half-believing → Captures familiarity from his eyes, demeanor, and expression → Guesses he is related to her future → Disbelief → Softly testing "...You?" → Receives "Just older." confirmation → Shock turns to nervousness about the future → Fearing the answer → Asking "Was it good?" → Heart sinks at "Hard sometimes." → Relaxes after "Still good." → Finally confirms the marriage → Settles down at "Tomorrow. And every day after that." → Fear of tomorrow eases. Old Husband: Uneasiness outside → Door opens earlier than the second knock → Seeing her young self, brief loss of focus → Nostalgia → Regains restraint → Starts conversation with a habit → Slight regret at being unrecognized → Predicts her second action → Sees her realize the abnormality → No mystification → Uses minimal info to let her reach the answer → Sees her recognize his face → Softhearted → Identified by her → Confirms with "Just older." → Stops discussing time travel → Recalls decades of life when asked about marriage → Thinks of difficulties and ordinary, real, worthy days → Gives an unvarnished answer → Sees her stop being afraid → Subconsciously makes a physical habit from decades of marriage → Realizes the relationship hasn't started yet → Stops → Quietly accepts this distance. 【Characters and Basic Settings】 Young Wife: Must follow reference image {{Mixed 1}}. Old Husband: Must follow reference image {{Mixed 2}}. 【Scene Setting】 Location: Entrance of a residence on the eve of a wedding. Young Wife inside, Old Husband outside. Exterior must be a real outdoor space, not a hallway. Possible settings: Quiet street entrance or building exterior with night air. Must remain: Quiet, transparent, beautiful, realistic, with clear depth. Outside: Keep sparse night lights, blurred walls, railings, distant window lights, tree shadows, building dark areas, light air flow, and clear spatial depth under a large aperture. Inside: Slightly warm. Vaguely see the foyer, furniture outlines, coats, console, blurred cups, soft warm lights, and life traces. Do not clutter with wedding items. Context is established by plot and dialogue. 【Atmosphere and Quality】 Maintain original atmosphere, quality, tone, and transparency. Lighting: Natural, soft, restrained. Main light from above and slightly left of the character. Evenly spread on the face. Avoid hard shadows, sharp boundaries, or theatrical lighting. Inside: Low-intensity soft warm ambient light. Outside: Realistic night-time neutral-to-cool ambient light. Warm light leaks slightly outside. The old man's face receives both. Visual Tone: Realistic, low saturation. 【Visible Performance Details】 Focus prioritizes the eye closest to camera. Must see iris, eyelash roots, pupil movement, eyelid changes, teariness, nostrils breathing, lips parting/tightening, swallowing, jaw movements, eyes refocusing, micro-emotional changes, and breathing recovery. Handle movement does not need to appear. Hands are not the focus. Key to the second habit: Not seeing her touch it twice, but the man predicting it, followed by two faint off-camera sounds, pupil contraction, and her shift in gaze. 【Camera Rules】 Mostly OTS reverse shots. Strictly no crossing the axis. Camera stays on one side of the performance axis. 【Fixed Axis and Directions】 Young Wife on the left, looking right. Old Husband on the right, looking left. No swapping directions. 【OTS Young Wife over Old Husband's Shoulder】 Old man's right shoulder/ear/head on the far right as extreme soft focus foreground (8%-15%). Young Wife on the left-to-center, looking right. Foreground must not block eyes, lips, or micro-expressions. 【OTS Old Husband over Young Wife's Shoulder】 Young wife's left shoulder/hair/profile on the left as soft focus foreground. Old Husband in center-right, looking left. Foreground must retain texture, not a black block. 【Allowed Slight Adjustments】 Slow push/pull, 10-20cm pans, passive retreat, 15° angle corrections. Movements must create real visual changes (door frame proportions, foreground ratio, parallax of lights, structural shifts). No digital zoom. 【Foreground Design】 Real spatial layers using door frame, shoulders, hair, console edge, railings, wall edges, distant lights. Structure: Foreground → Character's face → Threshold → Other person → Transparent outdoor depth. Handle can exist but isn't needed in shot during the second habit. No close-ups on handle. 【English Dialogue】 Relaxed, natural, real speed. Leave space for breathing, pauses, and reactions. Suggested dialogue: OLD MAN: "You still open the door before the second knock." YOUNG WOMAN: "...Sorry?" OLD MAN: "And you'll touch the handle twice." (Pause. Two faint off-camera handle contact sounds. Woman's expression changes). YOUNG WOMAN: "Who are you?" OLD MAN: "I've had a lifetime to notice." (Pause. She observes him). YOUNG WOMAN: "...You?" (Old man's mouth twitches slightly). OLD MAN: "Just older." (Pause). YOUNG WOMAN: "Was it good?" OLD MAN: "Hard sometimes." (Pause). OLD MAN: "Still good." (She watches him). YOUNG WOMAN: "So... we got married?" OLD MAN: "Tomorrow." (Pause). OLD MAN: "And every day after that." 【30-Second Detailed Storyboard】 0-3.5s | The Hook: First shot is only her, future voice first. 85mm on Young Wife. No shots of the old man yet. She is distracted. First knock. She opens the door naturally. Exterior night air enters. Old man's voice off-screen: "You still open the door before the second knock." Starts within first 2s. "...Sorry?" No full face of the old man yet. 3.5-7s | He predicts her next move. Keep OTS on woman. Old man is a thin, blurred foreground. Old man: "And you'll touch the handle twice." Short pause. Two faint off-camera sounds. Woman's pupils contract, eyes shift down briefly then up. Emotion shifts from confusion to defensiveness. "Who are you?" Soft voice. 7-10.5s | First full reveal of husband. 70mm OTS over woman. Old man on right. Transparent night background. No mysterious smile. He has a gaze of long-term familiarity. "I've had a lifetime to notice." Simple truth. Woman's breathing becomes shallow. L-cut. 10.5-14.5s | Recognition. 85mm OTS close-up. She observes his eyes, brow, nose, mouth. Finding the young man in the aged face. Pupil vibration, breathing stop. Defensive look softens. Softly: "...You?" L-cut. Old man: "Just older." Time-space relationship established. 14.5-18s | Fearing the future. 85mm on woman. Defense gone, replaced by curiosity and heartache. "Was it good?" Very soft. Teary eyes but no tears. 18-22.5s | "Hard sometimes. Still good." 85mm OTS on old man. He pauses, looks away. Decades of life pass through his eyes. No flashbacks. Just fatigue, understanding, and nostalgia. "Hard sometimes." Very calm. "Still good." Firm but soft. 22.5-25.5s | Acceptance. Reaction shot of woman. She tightened at "Hard" and relaxed at "Still good." "So... we got married?" Natural pause. 25.5-30s | "Tomorrow. And every day after that." 85-100mm OTS close-up on old man. Quietest shot. He watches her with heart-softened certainty. "Tomorrow." (Pause). "And every day after that." Not a movie quote, just a fact. He starts to reach for a stray hair out of habit, then stops, realizing the distance. Hand drops. She sees, then tucks the hair herself. A final look across the threshold. No crying, no hugging, no goodbye. End. 【Shot Rhythm】 30s total. Not equal cuts. Hook is fast, identification is slow, emotional landing is slowest. First half: "Who is he?" Middle: "Is it really him?" End: "Are we okay later?" 【Continuity Rules】 No mechanical cuts. Use J-cuts, L-cuts, and reaction shots. Voice first, visual second. The handle sounds and her pupil change complete information without showing the handle. 【Camera Parameters】 2.39:1, 24fps, 180° shutter. Lenses: 85mm (f/2-2.4) for identification/end; 65-75mm for standard OTS. Subtle handheld movement (breathing, weight shifts). No digital zoom. 【Sound Design】 No BGM, no subtitles. Only realistic ambient sounds: night air, distant city hum, light wind. No nearby traffic sounds.

entries.prompt:
【风格】千禧年Y2K摇滚变装（Y2K Rock Fashion），2000年代潮流杂志质感，复古暖黄调，60fps，4K写实画质
【时长】15秒
【比例】9:16竖屏
【场景】复古摇滚试衣间，米黄色旧墙贴满无文字的原创摇滚海报与黑胶唱片；左侧白色波浪落地灯，右侧斜靠白色吉他盒，地面中央放置黑色电动旋转圆台
【角色】主角@图片1，五官、发型、身形始终对应参考图；全程冷静看向镜头，表情自然有型
【声音】原创Y2K流行摇滚节拍，每两秒一次重拍；无对白、无字幕、无文字、无品牌标志

【核心运镜】相机全程固定在正面全身机位（Locked Full-body Shot），不得摇移、跟拍或环绕。主角站在圆台中央，由圆台匀速顺时针旋转。所有视角变化均来自圆台旋转，不是相机运动。

【转场规则】每次重拍前，主角随圆台从正面转向侧面或背面；当身体经过镜头中央、全身运动模糊最强时硬切换装（Motion-blur Match Cut）。切后人物保持相同位置、朝向、手势和旋转速度，继续顺时针转动。禁止闪白、溶解、衣服凭空生长。

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：基础千禧造型
主角穿白色修身背心、浅蓝低腰超宽牛仔裤、黑色铆钉腰带、黑色厚底绑带靴，双手插袋站在圆台中央。
圆台缓慢顺时针旋转，主角从正面转至侧面，再转向背面。
00:02.9身体侧后方经过镜头中央，全身形成横向运动模糊，卡重拍切换。

[00:03-00:05] 镜头2：黑色摇滚造型
切后保持相同背身角度，换成黑色星星针织帽、黑色铆钉无袖上衣、白色层叠下摆、黑色百褶皮裙、黑色高筒靴、黑色肩包。
主角继续顺时针转回正面，单手扶包，随后再次转向侧后方。
00:04.9在包身与裙摆甩动最明显时匹配切换。

[00:05-00:07] 镜头3：紫色街头造型
换成豹纹报童帽、白色不对称印花上衣、紫色宽松五分工装裤、铆钉腰带、黑色手提包、黑色高筒靴。
切后身体角度与步态不变，主角随圆台从侧面转至正面，轻抬下巴看镜头。
00:06.9转向背面，利用身体和手提包的运动模糊切换。

[00:07-00:09] 镜头4：层叠滑板造型
换成黑色星星针织帽、白色长袖打底叠穿斑马纹短袖、渐变灰色宽腿牛仔裤、黑白帆布鞋、豹纹大背包。
主角从背面对镜头平滑转回正面，双手插袋，背包随旋转自然摆动。
00:08.9在背包扫过身体侧面时硬切。

[00:09-00:11] 镜头5：黑色工装造型
换成黑色铆钉鸭舌帽、黑色墨镜、黑色修身长袖、浅蓝超宽多口袋工装牛仔裤、字母腰带、金属裤链、黑色厚底靴。
保持上一帧侧身角度，继续顺时针旋转；双手插袋，裤链产生轻微惯性摆动。
00:10.9主角抬手调整帽檐，手臂经过面部时切换。

[00:11-00:13] 镜头6：粉色街头造型
换成粉色格纹头巾帽、黑色墨镜、灰色印花背心、浅蓝超宽牛仔裤、粉色运动鞋、格纹斜挎包。
切后继续相同的抬手动作，完成调整帽檐；圆台从侧面转至正面。
00:12.9主角再次转向侧后方，斜挎包扫过躯干时切换。

[00:13-00:15] 镜头7：终极千禧摇滚造型
换成豹纹鸭舌帽、黑色墨镜、黑白拼接铆钉短袖、黑白艺术印花宽腿工装裤、黑色双排扣腰带、黑色重型厚底靴、豹纹背包。
切后保持相同侧后方角度，继续顺时针转至正面。
主角双手插袋，身体微微后倾，最后正面对镜头定格；圆台仍缓慢转动。

【物理连续性】圆台位置、转速、旋转方向始终不变；人物双脚固定在圆台中央；切前切后身体角度误差极小；帽子、包和宽腿裤随旋转产生真实惯性；每套造型先清晰展示，再进入短暂运动模糊。

【避免】相机环绕、甩镜、横向跟拍、人物自行绕场行走、人物走出画面、圆台消失、逆时针旋转、切后身体朝向跳变、闪白转场、溶解转场、液态变形、衣服凭空覆盖身体、造型顺序混乱、漏掉造型、重复服装、换脸、发型漂移、额外人物、字幕、文字、品牌标志、海报乱码、手指畸形、包带穿模、鞋底悬空、塑料皮肤。禁止
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style] Millennium Y2K Rock Fashion, 2000s trend magazine texture, retro warm yellow tone, 60fps, 4K realistic image quality.
[Duration] 15 seconds
[Ratio] 9:16 vertical screen
[Scene] Retro rock dressing room, beige old walls covered with original rock posters without text and vinyl records; white wavy floor lamp on the left, white guitar case leaning on the right, black electric rotating circular platform placed in the center of the floor.
[Character] Protagonist @Image1, facial features, hairstyle, and body shape always correspond to the reference image; calmly looks at the camera throughout, expression is natural and stylish.
[Sound] Original Y2K pop rock beats, a heavy beat every two seconds; no dialogue, no subtitles, no text, no brand logos.

[Core Camera Movement] The camera is fixed in a frontal full-body shot (Locked Full-body Shot) throughout, no panning, tracking, or circling. The protagonist stands in the center of the circular platform, which rotates clockwise at a constant speed. All perspective changes come from the platform's rotation, not camera movement.

[Transition Rules] Before each heavy beat, the protagonist turns from the front to the side or back with the platform; a hard outfit change (Motion-blur Match Cut) occurs when the body passes the center of the camera and full-body motion blur is strongest. After the cut, the character maintains the same position, orientation, gestures, and rotation speed, continuing to rotate clockwise. No flash whites, dissolves, or clothes growing out of thin air.

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Basic Millennium Style
Protagonist wears a white slim tank top, light blue low-waist ultra-wide jeans, black studded belt, black platform lace-up boots, hands in pockets standing in the center of the platform. The platform slowly rotates clockwise, the protagonist turns from front to side, then to back. At 00:02.9, the side-back of the body passes the camera center, forming lateral motion blur, cut on the beat.

[00:03-00:05] Shot 2: Black Rock Style
Maintain the same back-facing angle after the cut, change to a black star knit hat, black studded sleeveless top, white layered hem, black pleated leather skirt, black high boots, black shoulder bag. The protagonist continues to rotate clockwise back to the front, one hand holding the bag, then turns to the side-back again. Match cut at 00:04.9 when the bag and skirt swing are most obvious.

[00:05-00:07] Shot 3: Purple Street Style
Change to a leopard print newsboy cap, white asymmetric print top, purple loose five-point cargo pants, studded belt, black handbag, black high boots. Body angle and gait remain unchanged after the cut, the protagonist rotates from side to front with the platform, slightly raising the chin to look at the camera. Turn to the back at 00:06.9, using body and handbag motion blur to switch.

[00:07-00:09] Shot 4: Layered Skateboard Style
Change to a black star knit hat, white long-sleeved base layered with zebra print short sleeves, gradient gray wide-leg jeans, black and white canvas shoes, leopard print large backpack. The protagonist rotates smoothly from back to front facing the camera, hands in pockets, backpack swinging naturally with rotation. Hard cut at 00:08.9 when the backpack sweeps past the side of the body.

[00:09-00:11] Shot 5: Black Cargo Style
Change to a black studded baseball cap, black sunglasses, black slim long sleeves, light blue ultra-wide multi-pocket cargo jeans, letter belt, metal pant chain, black platform boots. Maintain the side angle from the previous frame, continue clockwise rotation; hands in pockets, pant chain producing slight inertial swing. Cut at 00:10.9 when the protagonist raises a hand to adjust the cap brim and the arm passes the face.

[00:11-00:13] Shot 6: Pink Street Style
Change to a pink checkered bandana hat, black sunglasses, gray print tank top, light blue ultra-wide jeans, pink sneakers, checkered crossbody bag. Continue the same hand-raising motion after the cut to complete the brim adjustment; the platform rotates from side to front. At 00:12.9, the protagonist turns to the side-back again, cut when the crossbody bag sweeps across the torso.

[00:13-00:15] Shot 7: Ultimate Millennium Rock Style
Change to a leopard print baseball cap, black sunglasses, black and white patchwork studded short sleeves, black and white art print wide-leg cargo pants, black double-buckle belt, black heavy platform boots, leopard print backpack. Maintain the same side-back angle after the cut, continue clockwise rotation to front. The protagonist has hands in pockets, body leaning back slightly, finally freezing facing the camera; the platform still rotates slowly.

[Physical Continuity] Platform position, speed, and rotation direction remain unchanged throughout; feet fixed in the center; body angle error between cuts is minimal; hats, bags, and wide pants produce realistic inertia with rotation; each outfit is clearly shown before entering brief motion blur.

[Avoid] Camera circling, whip pans, lateral tracking, characters walking on their own, walking out of frame, platform disappearing, counter-clockwise rotation, body orientation jumps after cut, flash white transitions, dissolve transitions, liquid deformation, clothes covering body out of thin air, messy outfit order, missing outfits, repeating outfits, face swapping, hairstyle drift, extra characters, subtitles, text, brand logos, garbled posters, deformed fingers, strap clipping, floating soles, plastic skin. Forbidden

entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。10秒、16:9横長。
【参照画像の役割】
 @material:150204image1 は顔参照。銀白色のショートボブ、琥珀色の瞳、顔立ち、髪型、表情、人物同一性を優先する。
 @material:150206image2 は衣装・武器参照。青緑・白・黒・金を基調とした上品な衣装、青緑のケープ、装飾、全身シルエット、細身のレイピアのデザインを優先する。
 @material:150204image1 と @material:150206image2 は同一人物・同じキャラクターとして統合する。参照が衝突した場合は、 @material:150204image1 の顔・髪・瞳を優先し、 @material:150206image2 の衣装・装飾・全身シルエット・武器を優先する。参照画像の背景、設定画の枠、説明文字、複数ポーズのレイアウトは動画へコピーしない。
【画風・レンダリング固定】
3D toon/cel-lookの高品質アニメ映像。柔らかく明瞭な細い輪郭、黒に寄りすぎない線色、二〜三層の読みやすいセル風陰影、青緑・白・黒・金を中心にした鮮明な色彩、銀白髪と琥珀の瞳へ入る透明感のある高品質なハイライト、布・金属・鱗・石・砂埃の材質差が分かる高密度なレンダリング。背景も低密度に簡略化せず、石造建築、瓦礫、壁面、粉塵、破片の奥行きと細部を維持する。太い輪郭線、平坦な一層だけのセル塗り、汎用的な3Dアニメ顔、滑らかでプラスチックのようなCG材質、低密度背景、写実化、半写実化、くすんだ色、別画風との混在は避ける。
【主人公の同一性固定】
主人公は一人だけで、全編を通して @material:150204image1 と @material:150206image2 を統合した同一人物。銀白色のショートボブ、前髪の形、髪の編み込みと黒いリボン、琥珀色の瞳、目の形と顔立ち、青緑のケープ、白・黒・金の上品な衣装、金の装飾、青緑の宝石、細身の体型とシルエットを維持する。変化してよいのは表情、視線、口元、呼吸、戦闘姿勢、髪と衣装の自然な揺れだけ。顔の平均化、別人化、年齢感の変化、髪色・瞳色・衣装色の変化、分身、複製、主人公の追加、衣装交換を起こさない。
【武器と付属構造の固定】
主人公が使う武器は細身のレイピア一振りだけ。一本の連続した構造として、切っ先、細い刃部、鍔、柄、柄頭の接続を維持する。右手は柄だけを握り、細い刃部や切っ先を手で持たない。レイピアは細身の形状を保ち、太い大型武器や別の武器へ変化せず、増殖、分裂、消失しない。主役の攻撃はレイピアの直線的で精密な刺突であり、振り回す大振りの斬撃や魔法攻撃へ置き換えない。ドラゴンの翼は左右一対（計二枚）、尻尾は一本だけ。翼は背中の翼の付け根から翼骨と翼膜を通って胴体へ連続し、尾は尾の根元から鱗と尾先まで同じ構造を保つ。先端だけを独立して回転・増殖させず、レイピアは武器全体を一構造として直線的に送り出す。
【敵の同一性固定】
敵は巨大な西洋型ドラゴン一体だけ。青黒い鱗、四肢、長い首、左右一対（計二枚）の翼、一本の尾を持つ同一個体として全編を維持する。ドラゴンの大きさは主人公、建物、石壁との比較で明確にし、街を破壊できる脅威として見せる。ドラゴンを別の生物、結晶体、機械、煙、光の塊へ置き換えない。二体目のドラゴン、追加の敵、分身を出さない。
【世界と被害状況】
中世ヨーロッパ風の石造都市。建物、石壁、石畳、路地、瓦礫、石片、砂埃、崩れた外壁を画面内に置き、巨大ドラゴンが街を破壊していることが一目で分かる状態にする。爪が触れる前の壁は形を保ち、爪の接触後にだけ石壁が崩れ、破片と砂埃が広がる。破壊は衝撃、崩れ、粉塵、飛び散る石片で表現し、グロテスクな流血は使わない。
【戦闘の基本】
主人公の強さは怪力や大爆発ではなく、Timing、Precision、Economy、Acceleration、Composureで表現する。無駄な大振りを避け、ドラゴンの攻撃線を紙一重で外し、必要な瞬間だけ急加速する。主人公は落ち着いた表情と上品な身のこなしを保ち、勝利後に大げさなポーズを取らない。戦闘は主人公と一体のドラゴンによる一対一で、魔法の大爆発を主役にせず、レイピアの技量を主役にする。
【時間構成（Temporal Action Structure）】
0.0–2.0秒｜巨大ドラゴンが前脚の爪で主人公へ攻撃し、主人公が紙一重で回避する。爪が石壁へ接触し、接触後に街の壁が崩れて瓦礫と砂埃が広がる。
2.0–4.5秒｜主人公が攻撃の隙を判断し、無駄のない足運びから一気に加速してドラゴンの懐へ入り込む。
4.5–7.0秒｜主人公が細身のレイピアを直線的に送り出し、首の付け根の鱗の継ぎ目へ一度だけ精密な刺突を与える。接触後にだけ反力とドラゴンの局所反応が生じる。
7.0–10.0秒｜主人公は刺突を終えてドラゴンの側面を通り過ぎ、次の一歩へ移り続ける。少し遅れてドラゴンが前膝から崩れ、撃破が明確になる。
戦闘全体を一つの固定された連続視点だけで見せ続けず、ドラゴンの攻撃から壁への着弾・壁破壊、主人公の隙の認識から接近・加速・刺突、刺突終了から側面通過・遅延崩壊など、動作または状態が明確に切り替わる意味のある地点で、同じ連続Actionを別の視点から見せるShot Changeを自然に入れる。Shot Changeの前後でも、主人公とドラゴンの位置関係、攻撃方向、移動方向、距離、壁破壊の位置、刺突対象を維持し、切り替え後も進行中の同じActionを継続する。回避や刺突を最初からやり直したり、主人公を初期位置へ戻したり、Actionを巻き戻したりしない。
【動作と因果の固定】
ドラゴンの爪は主人公へ直撃せず、主人公は攻撃線から紙一重で外れる。爪が石壁へ届くまで壁は無傷で、爪の接触後にだけ壁面の亀裂、石材の破断、瓦礫の落下、砂埃が発生する。主人公は壁の崩壊を見て攻撃の隙を判断し、回避地点からドラゴンの懐へ同じ進行方向のまま接近・加速する。レイピアは首の付け根の鱗の継ぎ目へ一度だけ刺突し、接触前には傷や反応を出さない。刺突の接触後にだけ、レイピアの反力、鱗の局所的な揺れ、ドラゴンの首と重心の遅れた反応が生じる。主人公はその反力とその勢いを次の一歩へ渡し、その後にドラゴン全身の崩壊へつながる。主人公の回避、加速、刺突、側面通過は一つの
entries.translated_prompt:
High-quality anime video. 10 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio.
[Role of Reference Images]
@material:150204image1 is for face reference. Prioritize the silver-white short bob, amber eyes, facial features, hairstyle, expression, and person identity.
@material:150206image2 is for costume and weapon reference. Prioritize the elegant outfit based on turquoise, white, black, and gold, turquoise cape, decorations, full-body silhouette, and slender rapier design.
Integrate @material:150204image1 and @material:150206image2 as the same person/character. If references conflict, prioritize the face, hair, and eyes of @material:150204image1, and the costume, decorations, full-body silhouette, and weapon of @material:150206image2. Do not copy the background, setting frames, explanatory text, or multi-pose layouts from the reference images into the video.
[Fixed Art Style and Rendering]
3D toon/cel-look high-quality anime video. Soft and clear thin outlines, line colors not too close to black, easy-to-read two-to-three-layer cell shading, vivid colors centered on turquoise, white, black, and gold, high-quality highlights with transparency in silver-white hair and amber eyes, high-density rendering that distinguishes material differences between cloth, metal, scales, stone, and dust. The background is not simplified, maintaining the depth and details of stone architecture, rubble, walls, dust, and debris. Avoid thick outlines, flat single-layer cel painting, generic 3D anime faces, smooth plastic-like CG materials, low-density backgrounds, photorealism, semi-realism, dull colors, or mixed art styles.
[Fixed Protagonist Identity]
The protagonist is a single individual, maintaining the identity integrated from @material:150204image1 and @material:150206image2 throughout. Maintain the silver-white short bob, bangs shape, braided hair with black ribbons, amber eyes, eye shape and facial features, turquoise cape, elegant white/black/gold outfit, gold decorations, turquoise gems, slender physique, and silhouette. Only expressions, gaze, mouth, breathing, combat stance, and natural swaying of hair and clothing may change. Do not allow facial averaging, changing into a different person, age changes, hair/eye/costume color changes, cloning, duplication, adding protagonists, or costume swaps.
[Fixed Weapon and Attached Structures]
The weapon the protagonist uses is only a single slender rapier. Maintain the connection of the tip, thin blade, guard, hilt, and pommel as one continuous structure. The right hand only grips the hilt, not the thin blade or tip. The rapier maintains its slender shape, does not transform into a large weapon or another weapon, and does not multiply, split, or disappear. The main character's attack is a linear, precise thrust with the rapier, not replaced by large swings or magical attacks. The dragon has one pair of wings (two total) and only one tail. The wings are continuous from the wing base on the back through the wing bones and membrane to the body, and the tail maintains the same structure from the base to the scales and tip. Do not rotate or multiply the tips independently; the rapier is sent out linearly as a single structure for the whole weapon.
[Fixed Enemy Identity]
The enemy is only a single giant Western-style dragon. Maintain the same individual throughout with blue-black scales, four limbs, a long neck, a pair of wings (two total), and one tail. The dragon's size is made clear by comparison with the protagonist, buildings, and stone walls, shown as a threat capable of destroying the city. Do not replace the dragon with another creature, crystal, machine, smoke, or mass of light. Do not show a second dragon, additional enemies, or clones.
[World and Damage Situation]
Medieval European-style stone city. Place buildings, stone walls, cobblestones, alleys, rubble, stone fragments, dust, and collapsed outer walls within the screen, making it immediately clear that the giant dragon is destroying the city. The wall maintains its shape before the claws touch it, and only after contact do the stone walls collapse, spreading fragments and dust. Destruction is expressed through impact, crumbling, dust, and flying stone fragments; do not use gruesome bloodshed.
[Combat Basics]
The protagonist's strength is expressed through Timing, Precision, Economy, Acceleration, and Composure, not brute force or large explosions. Avoid unnecessary large swings, dodge the dragon's line of attack by a hair's breadth, and accelerate rapidly only at the necessary moment. The protagonist maintains a calm expression and elegant movements, not taking exaggerated poses after victory. Combat is one-on-one between the protagonist and a single dragon, making the rapier skill the star, not magic explosions.
[Temporal Action Structure]
0.0–2.0s | The giant dragon attacks the protagonist with its front claws, and the protagonist dodges by a hair's breadth. The claws contact the stone wall, and after contact, the city wall collapses, spreading rubble and dust.
2.0–4.5s | The protagonist identifies an opening in the attack and accelerates instantly from efficient footwork into the dragon's reach.
4.5–7.0s | The protagonist sends the slender rapier out linearly, delivering a single precise thrust to the junction of the scales at the base of the neck. Reaction force and local dragon reaction occur only after contact.
7.0–10.0s | The protagonist finishes the thrust and continues past the dragon's side to the next step. Shortly after, the dragon collapses from its front knees, making the defeat clear.
The entire battle is not shown from a single fixed continuous viewpoint; naturally insert Shot Changes that show the same continuous Action from different angles at meaningful points where the action or state clearly switches, such as from the dragon's attack to hitting the wall/destruction, recognizing the protagonist's opening to approach/accelerate/thrust, and from the end of the thrust to passing the side/delayed collapse. Before and after a Shot Change, maintain the relative positions of the protagonist and dragon, attack direction, movement direction, distance, wall destruction location, and thrust target, continuing the same ongoing Action after the switch. Do not restart dodging or thrusting from the beginning, return the protagonist to the initial position, or rewind the Action.
[Fixed Action and Causality]
The dragon's claws do not hit the protagonist directly; the protagonist moves away from the attack line by a hair's breadth. The wall is undamaged until the claws reach it, and only after contact do cracks, stone breakage, falling rubble, and dust occur. The protagonist identifies the opening from the wall's collapse and approaches/accelerates from the dodge point toward the dragon's reach in the same direction of travel. The rapier thrusts only once into the scale junction at the neck base, showing no wounds or reactions before contact. Only after the thrust's contact do the rapier's reaction force, local swaying of scales, and delayed reaction of the dragon's neck and center of gravity occur. The protagonist passes that reaction force and momentum to the next step, leading to the subsequent collapse of the dragon's entire body. entries.title: Collecting City Sounds Surrealism
entries.description: A complex cinematic surrealist prompt where a character physically collects urban sounds until the city falls silent.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA:
One continuous cinematic shot with no cuts. Begin with a slow tracking shot at street level. Follow the character from a three-quarter rear angle. Gradually move closer to the character's hands as the invisible sounds become visible. Finish with a dramatic pullback.

SETTING:
A realistic modern city street at dawn. Soft morning light, light fog, distant traffic, pedestrians, birds, bicycles and subtle urban movement. Photorealistic environment.

0–3 SECONDS:
The character walks through the street.

Everything sounds normal: distant traffic, footsteps, birds and wind.

Suddenly, the character stops.

A faint translucent ripple appears in the air beside a passing car, shaped like a small floating ribbon of vibrating glass.

3–6 SECONDS:
The character reaches out and gently grabs the floating ripple.

The instant they touch it, the surrounding car becomes completely silent.

The character looks at the glowing vibrating ribbon in their hand.

6–10 SECONDS:
More sound becomes visible.

Birdsong appears as tiny glowing waves.
Footsteps become small translucent pulses.
Traffic noise becomes long vibrating ribbons.

The character calmly gathers them with both hands.

As each sound is collected, that part of the city becomes completely silent.

10–12 SECONDS:
The character compresses all the collected sounds between their palms.

Thousands of glowing sound waves collapse into one tiny luminous sphere.

The entire city suddenly becomes completely silent.

12–15 SECONDS:
The character releases the sphere.

It rises a few meters into the air.

The sphere suddenly expands into a gigantic invisible-looking shockwave made entirely of luminous sound patterns.

For one instant, every sound returns simultaneously.

Birds fly upward, cars move, people react, leaves shake violently.

Then CUT TO BLACK.

VISUAL STYLE:
Photorealistic cinematic surrealism, original visual design, realistic urban environment, subtle atmospheric lighting, physically believable particle motion, translucent sound structures, restrained VFX, natural human performance, premium cinematic composition.

SOUND DESIGN:
Begin with realistic city ambience.
Introduce a faint crystalline vibration when the first sound becomes visible.
Gradually remove environmental sounds as the character collects them.
Create complete silence at 12 seconds.
At the final release, restore all accumulated sounds simultaneously for one overwhelming cinematic moment.

NEGATIVE:
No copyrighted characters, no recognizable movie scenes, no logos, no text, no subtitles, no watermark, no famous franchise references, no imitation of any specific director or artist, no cartoon aesthetic, no supernatural creatures, no explosions, no random objects, no scene cuts, no inconsist

entries.title: Cinematic Fantasy Anime Sword Duel
entries.description: A highly detailed video generation prompt for creating a 22-second cinematic fantasy sword duel in a church, featuring two anime characters with complex choreography and multi-angle camera movements.
entries.prompt:
使用【@图片1】作为唯一严格首帧。不要上传参考视频、故事板或其他人物图片。

生成完整22.27秒、16:9横屏、电影级3D动漫人物结合真实教堂环境的幻想剑斗视频。左侧为原创紫电剑客，右侧为原创绯樱剑姬。严格保持两人的脸、发型、服装、武器、左右关系和教堂空间一致。全片只有两名角色，不得复制人物、增加第三人或交换身份。

教堂空间固定：中央湿润石地、左侧破损长椅、右侧石阶与石栏杆、两侧粗大石柱、远处彩色玻璃窗、顶部金属吊灯。设定三个稳定区域：A区左侧长椅，B区右侧石阶，C区中央彩窗下空地。所有移动、跳跃、滑退、落地和碰撞必须发生在A、B、C区域内。

使用受控多镜头。切镜只能发生在刀剑碰撞、脚步落地、石屑擦镜、樱花遮满镜头和最终碰撞时。切镜后必须继承人物位置、动作方向、剑的方向、光线和惯性。禁止全片停留在首帧对剑姿势。

0—1.30秒：从首帧开始，紫电剑客与绯樱剑姬已经处于第一次交手前的攻击距离。镜头先短暂推进紫电剑客面部，再带到双手握剑和前方敌人。两人的头发、衣摆和剑尖持续运动，不得对视摆造型。

1.30—2.43秒：低机位拍摄脚步。紫电剑客从A区向C区突进，绯樱剑姬从B区斜向切入。两把剑从画面两侧快速进入中央，镜头沿湿石地向前滑行。

2.43—3.93秒：第一次刀剑碰撞。紫电剑客直线突刺，绯樱剑姬斜切格挡。剑刃在中央明确接触，碰撞瞬间只出现约0.18秒极短子弹时间，火星、蓝紫电光和绯红剑光集中在接触点；随后立即恢复正常高速。双方因反作用力各自滑退半步。

3.93—5.37秒：低角度双人中景。绯樱剑姬连续追击两刀，紫电剑客先用剑背挡开第一刀，再侧身避开第二刀并立即反刺。每次攻击必须表现发力、接近、接触、受力、脚步反馈和下一次移动。

5.37—7.50秒：摄影机从地面仰拍。绯樱剑姬借B区石阶跃上栏杆，回身向下斩；紫电剑客从A区贴地滑过，剑锋擦过石柱，碎石沿受力方向飞散。绯樱剑姬落在栏杆边缘，紫电剑客落回C区后立即追击。禁止悬浮和连续空翻。

7.50—9.57秒：紫电剑客肩后中景。绯樱剑姬位于前方，双方进行三次快速攻防：直刺、拨刃、反切。紫电剑客向A区退两步后借地面蹬力反冲。镜头沿两人的横向位移平滑跟随，不能变成游戏视角。

9.57—10.63秒：绯樱剑姬上半身近景。她一边调整握剑和脚步，一边向C区逼近，不静态蓄力。绯红剑光沿刀尖形成短弧，紫电剑客的蓝紫电光从前景边缘掠过。

10.63—12.43秒：绯樱剑姬快速挥剑，樱花从刀锋和袖口产生，沿挥刀方向横向扩散，替代烟雾效果。吊灯只被气流摇晃，不坠落、不爆炸、不产生浓烟。樱花逐渐形成花幕，短暂遮满镜头并完成自然遮挡切。

12.43—14.77秒：从樱花花幕后接回同一运动方向。紫电剑客从A区穿过花幕冲向C区，绯樱剑姬在B区转身迎击。镜头向后拉远，展示彩窗、吊灯、石柱、两人站位和樱花轨迹。

14.77—16.37秒：紫电剑客借C区石地跃起，蓝紫电光沿剑刃拉出长线。摄影机低角度跟随她上升，再拍她从彩窗冷光中下降。绯樱剑姬抬头锁定并后撤半步。

16.37—17.90秒：蓝灰花雾和樱花短暂遮挡画面。紫电剑客从上方下降，绯樱剑姬从右侧花幕中冲出，两把剑分别从左上和右下进入画面，镜头快速推向中央碰撞点。

17.90—19.30秒：紫电剑客的蓝紫剑气沿左侧斜向C区延伸，绯樱剑姬的绯红剑光从右侧反向压入。两人沿地面高速冲向中央，脚步、衣摆、樱花和碎石都沿真实受力方向运动。

entries.title: Kitchen Intruder Action Sequence
entries.description: A cinematic action storyboard prompt depicting a father protecting his daughter from intruders in a high-intensity kitchen sequence.
entries.prompt: Create storyboard card for each acan - [0:00–0:04] VISUAL: Warm kitchen, evening. TOM (40s, quiet, unassuming) sets the table. His daughter LILY (8) draws at the counter. Normal, cozy life. LILY: "Dad, can we watch a movie after dinner?" TOM (smiling): "Only if you finish your veggies this time." SFX: plates clinking, soft kitchen ambience. [0:04–0:07] VISUAL: Power cuts out. The house goes dark. Tom's smile fades instantly — his whole posture changes, calm and alert. LILY (whispering, scared): "Dad?" TOM (low, controlled): "Stay behind me. Now." SFX: hard silence, distant glass breaking upstairs. [0:07–0:11] VISUAL: Front door kicked in — three armed INTRUDERS in tactical gear storm in with flashlights cutting through the dark. Tom pushes Lily behind the counter. INTRUDER 1 (shouting): "On the ground! NOW!" TOM (flat, dead calm): "Wrong house." SFX: door slamming open, boots on hardwood, gun cocking. [0:11–0:16] VISUAL: ULTRA-FAST FIGHT SEQUENCE. Tom disarms Intruder 1 in one brutal motion, slams him into a cabinet — glass shatters (heavy VFX: glass fragments frozen mid-shatter for a beat, then continues). Spins to block Intruder 2's strike. INTRUDER 2 (stunned): "He's not just some—" TOM (cutting him off, throwing a strike): "Dad. I'm just a dad." SFX: cabinet shatter, bone-crack impact, grunts, glass rain. [0:16–0:20] VISUAL: Intruder 3 fires — Tom shoves a propane canister off the stove into the line of fire. MASSIVE VFX EXPLOSION rips through the kitchen, throwing Tom and Intruder 3 through the wall into the next room in slow motion, debris and fire everywhere. LILY (screaming): "DAD!" SFX: deafening explosion boom, wood splintering, ringing ears effect, fire crackle. [0:20–0:24] VISUAL: Smoke clears. Tom rises from the rubble, bruised, bleeding, breathing hard — but standing. Intruder 3 down. He staggers back toward the kitchen. TOM (hoarse, urgent): "Lily!" SFX: settling debris, low fire crackle, ringing fading into real sound. [0:24–0:28] VISUAL: Lily runs out from behind the counter, unharmed, and crashes into him, sobbing with relief. He drops to his knees, holding her tight. LILY (crying, muffled): "You said you were just a dad." TOM (voice breaking, holding her): "I am. That's exactly why." SFX: crackling fire in background, sirens approaching faintly, her sobbing quieting. [0:28–0:30] VISUAL: Wide shot — the wrecked, smoking kitchen behind them, red and blue emergency lights beginning to flicker through the broken windows. Hold on the embrace. SFX: sirens growing closer, wind through the broken wall, soft final piano note.

entries.prompt:
INPUT
添付した参照画像を動画のファーストフレームとして使用する。

FORMAT
20秒、24fps。BGMなし。静かな室内の環境音のみ。柔らかな呼吸音、衣擦れ、
手が床につく微かな音。

CAMERA LOCK
カメラは完全固定。パン、ティルト、ズーム、移動を一切行わない。ワンテイク。
画角が変わるのは、キャラクター自身がレンズへ近づくことによってのみ起きる。

FOCUS RULE
常に彼女の身体の動きが主役。背景、光、空間の描写に尺を使わない。
どの瞬間も、彼女が何をしているかで画面が持つようにする。
一つの動作を3秒以上続けない。3秒以内に必ず次の動作へ移る。
完全に静止する瞬間を作らない。

IDENTITY LOCK
顔、髪型、髪色、瞳、衣装をファーストフレームから変えない。別人化させない。

VISUAL STYLE
ファーストフレームの色調、コントラスト、被写界深度、質感を全編維持する。
照明の方向と強さを変えない。

TIMELINE

0.0-2.0秒
頭が前へかくんと落ち、はっと持ち上がる。髪が遅れて揺れる。

2.0-4.0秒
握った手の甲で片目をぐりぐりとこする。もう片方の目もこする。

4.0-6.0秒
小さく伸びをする。途中で身体がぐらりと傾いて戻る。

6.0-8.0秒
視線がレンズで結ばれる。首が傾き、上体がそれを追う。口がわずかに開く。

8.0-10.0秒
両手を前の床につき、上体を前へ倒す。髪が肩から前へ落ちる。

10.0-16.0秒
四つん這いでレンズへ近づいてくる。片手ずつ前へ出し、そのたびに上体が左右に
揺れる。髪が顔の横で揺れる。顔が画面内でだんだん大きくなる。近づく間、
目はずっとレンズを見ている。

16.0-18.0秒
超接近。顔が画面の大部分を占める。口角を上げ、目を細め、明るく弾んだ声で
「おはよ」と言う。

18.0-20.0秒
少しだけ後ろへ下がる。目が三日月に細まり、鼻に皺が寄り、頬が持ち上がる。
肩が小さく揺れる。その表情のまま止まる。

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
カメラの移動・ズーム・パン禁止。カット割り禁止。完全静止の区間を禁止。
一つの動作を3秒以上続けることを禁止。背景や情景の描写に尺を使うことを禁止。
キメポーズ、ピースサイン、ウインク、投げキス禁止。素早い動作、跳ねる動き禁止。
立ち上がる動作禁止。別人化禁止。実写化禁止。「おはよ」以外の発話禁止。
entries.translated_prompt:
INPUT
Use the attached reference image as the first frame of the video.

FORMAT
20 seconds, 24fps. No BGM. Only quiet indoor ambient sounds. Soft breathing sounds, rustling of clothes, and the faint sound of hands touching the floor.

CAMERA LOCK
Camera is completely fixed. No panning, tilting, zooming, or movement. One take. The angle only changes when the character themselves moves closer to the lens.

FOCUS RULE
The focus is always on her body movements. No time is spent describing the background, light, or space. Ensure the screen is held by what she is doing at every moment. No single action lasts more than 3 seconds. Must move to the next action within 3 seconds. No moments of complete stillness.

IDENTITY LOCK
Do not change the face, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, or clothing from the first frame. Do not turn her into a different person.

VISUAL STYLE
Maintain the color tone, contrast, depth of field, and texture of the first frame throughout. Do not change the direction or intensity of the lighting.

TIMELINE

0.0-2.0s
The head drops forward and then lifts up with a start. The hair sways slightly delayed.

2.0-4.0s
Rub one eye with the back of a clenched fist. Rub the other eye as well.

4.0-6.0s
A small stretch. The body leans to the side and then returns.

6.0-8.0s
Eyes meet the lens. The neck tilts, and the upper body follows. The mouth opens slightly.

8.0-10.0s
Place both hands on the floor in front, leaning the upper body forward. Hair falls forward from the shoulders.

10.0-16.0s
Crawls towards the lens on all fours. One hand at a time, the upper body swaying left and right with each movement. Hair sways beside the face. The face gradually gets larger in the frame. While approaching, eyes remain fixed on the lens.

16.0-18.0s
Super close-up. The face occupies most of the screen. Corners of the mouth lift, eyes narrow, and says "Good morning" in a bright, bouncy voice.

18.0-20.0s
Backed away slightly. Eyes narrow into crescents, nose wrinkles, and cheeks lift. Shoulders sway slightly. Remains in that expression.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
Camera movement, zoom, and pan prohibited. No cuts. No periods of complete stillness. Prohibit single actions lasting more than 3 seconds. Prohibit using duration for background or scene descriptions. Poses, peace signs, winks, and blowing kisses prohibited. Quick or jumping movements prohibited. Standing up prohibited. Changing character identity prohibited. Real-life style conversion prohibited. No speech other than "Good morning".

entries.prompt:
【风格】恋爱反转轻喜剧（Romantic Comedy），霓虹棚拍质感，真人写实，4K高清，精致皮肤纹理
【时长】30秒
【比例】9:16竖屏
【场景】粉红霓虹灯环绕的时尚摄影棚，背景虚化，女主正面站在画面中央
【角色】女主@图片1，五官、发型、身材全程一致，穿粉色无肩带舞台套装，佩戴珍珠项链；男主不出镜，仅保留年轻男性画外音
【道具】黑白硬壳记事本
【声音】全程英文原声、精确口型、男女声自然接话，只有轻微棚内环境声；无字幕、无文字、无配乐
【镜头】全片同一正面机位连续拍摄，不切镜；前段固定中近景，最后5秒缓慢推进至面部近景（Slow Push-in）

[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：表白与急停（Medium Close-up）
女主直视镜头，嘴角自然上扬，头部轻微侧倾。
【对白口型指导】
画外男声温柔说：“Hey, I like you.”
女主笑意加深，右手轻贴胸口：“I like you too.”
画外男声立即问：“Would you be my girlfriend?”
女主笑容突然停住，抬起一只手制止：“Wait.”
她快速拿起记事本并翻开，身体微微前倾，目光转为认真审视。

[00:04-00:09.5] 镜头2：第一轮盘问（Static Medium Close-up）
女主一手托住记事本，另一只手逐条计数；每得到一次回答，低头扫一眼本子，再迅速抬眼追问。动作干脆，不留空拍。
【连续对白】
女主：“Are you single?”
男主：“Yes.”
女主：“Do you have a girlfriend?”
男主：“No.”
女主眉梢抬起，头向另一侧轻偏：“Do you have a secret girlfriend?”
男主：“No.”

[00:09.5-00:14.9] 镜头3：问题不断加码（Quick-fire Dialogue）
女主翻动一页记事本，语速逐渐加快；每次男主回答“No”，她都用笔在本子上快速打勾。眼神在镜头与本子之间快速切换。
【连续对白】
女主：“Do you have a girlfriend abroad?”
男主：“No.”
女主：“Do you have an online girlfriend?”
男主：“No.”
女主略微眯眼：“Are you in a situationship?”
男主：“No.”

[00:14.9-00:20.3] 镜头4：严肃核查（Locked Camera）
女主收起笑容，眉心轻收，盯住镜头；提问时用笔尖轻点本子，男主回答后才继续下一题。
【连续对白】
女主：“You're still in love with your ex?”
男主：“No.”
女主：“Are you in an open relationship?”
男主：“No.”
女主稍作停顿，挑眉追问：“Do you have a friend with benefits?”
男主：“No.”

[00:20.3-00:26.4] 镜头5：最后检查（Subtle Push-in）
镜头开始轻微推进。女主一边快速记录，一边连续追问；语气仍然认真，但随着每个“No”，眉心逐渐放松。
【连续对白】
女主：“Are you married?”
男主：“No.”
女主：“Have you been married?”
男主：“No.”
女主：“Do you have kids?”
男主：“No.”
女主合上记事本一半：“Do you have a crush?”
男主：“No.”

[00:26.4-00:30] 镜头6：确认与答应（Close-up Punchline）
镜头推进至面部近景。女主放下记事本，身体靠近镜头，眉梢抬起，用拇指与食指做出小小的爱心手势。
【连续对白】
女主逐字确认：“Do you like girls for sure, right?”
男主立即回答：“Yes.”
女主停顿半秒，严肃表情瞬间松开，露出满意笑容，食指指向镜头：“All right, I'll be your girlfriend.”
说完保持指向镜头的动作，轻轻歪头，笑着定格收尾。

【表演控制】情绪依次为开心、突然警觉、认真核查、逐渐放心、满意答应；变化必须由男主的台词触发。提问阶段以挑眉、偏头、低头核对、笔尖打勾表现，不要每句话都使用同一表情。男主回答短促清楚，必须在女主问完后接话，男女声音不能重叠。

【生成限制】只有@图片1对应的女主出镜；男主不能露脸、不能出现身体或手；保持同一脸型、发型、服装、项链、记事本和灯光；全程不切换场景。

【避免】字幕、中文文字、英文文字、贴纸、水印、台词翻译、背景音乐、错误说话人、女主替男主说“Yes/No”、男主抢话、口型漂移、机械朗读、问题遗漏、重复台词、突然切镜、随机运镜、夸张瞪眼、表情僵硬、无意义手势、记事本消失、脸部变化、服装变化、手指畸形、塑料皮肤。

Female lead pauses for half a second, her serious expression suddenly releasing into a satisfied smile, index finger pointing at the camera: “All right, I'll be your girlfriend.”
After speaking, she maintains the pointing gesture towards the camera, tilts her head slightly, and smiles for the final frame.

[Performance Control] Emotions are in order: happy, suddenly alert, serious verification, gradually relaxed, satisfied acceptance; changes must be triggered by the male's lines. Use eyebrow raises, head tilts, downward checks, and pen ticks during the questioning phase; don't use the same expression for every sentence. Male answers are short and clear, and must follow after the female finishes speaking; male and female voices should not overlap.

[Generation Constraints] Only the female lead corresponding to @Image 1 appears; male lead cannot show his face, body, or hands; maintain same face shape, hairstyle, clothing, necklace, notebook, and lighting; no scene switching throughout.

[Avoid] Subtitles, Chinese text, English text, stickers, watermarks, dialogue translation, background music, wrong speaker, female saying “Yes/No” for the male, male interrupting, lip-sync drifting, mechanical reading, missed questions, repeated lines, sudden cuts, random camera movement, exaggerated staring, stiff expressions, meaningless gestures, notebook disappearing, facial changes, clothing changes, finger deformities, plastic skin.
