entries.prompt:
Seedance｜15秒冷面喜剧短片｜《第四个》

一、任务目标

生成一段完整连续的 15 秒中国仙侠电影短片。

整体风格要求：
电影级写实质感
纯古风中国仙侠美学
把史诗级“复仇者登场”的压迫感，逐渐瓦解成一本正经的生存型喜剧
克制冷面表演
默片式反应节奏
经典“三拍递进”
清楚的身份地位反转
Arri Alexa 电影机质感
稳定清晰的面部微细节
细腻胶片颗粒
自然体积光

二、核心喜剧逻辑
整段只保留一条最容易看懂的主线：
一名敌人气势汹汹前来替三个已经败过的师兄报仇，并且非常骄傲地把自己当成“第四个挑战者”。
直到师父随口问出一个极其普通的问题，他才突然意识到：
自己已经是师门最后一个还能站着来挑战的人。

笑点必须来自：
后知后觉
正常人的求生欲
一本正经的对话节奏
角色自己一步步意识到问题
禁止依赖：
人物突然变蠢
随机环境事故
夸张胡闹表演

三、参考锁定
人物身份锚点
@图片 1：角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐
@图片 2：角色 ID B｜小师妹

环境 DNA
本轮新上传的全部背景与地点参考图，共同决定同一套环境 DNA。
正式构图前，先无声整合并重建彼此兼容的：
真实地形
建筑语言
空间尺度
植被
水体
天气
山雾
主光方向
反射关系
空气纵深
真实可行走路线
再重新规划为一个 本轮独有、完整统一 的新空间。
环境原则
背景中的：
水体
山雾
植被
衣料
远处环境声
都要持续自然运动并保持鲜活存在。
但环境在叙事上必须 绝对中立：
不主动制造包袱
不触发剧情
不推动反转
不打断人物节奏

四、角色设定
角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐｜@图片 1
始终保持为同一个 25–30 岁东亚女性：
身材高挑纤细
椭圆脸
深色杏眼
黑色长发半挽
白玉簪固定
白色刺绣真丝汉服
半透明分层宽袖
银色腰封
玉佩
白色布靴
唯一一柄银色长剑
人物气质：
平静
克制
绝不夸张
像处理日常事务一样处理挑战者

角色 ID B｜小师妹｜@图片 2
始终保持为同一个 20–25 岁东亚女性：
身形娇小
圆润灵动的脸
黑发编辫
青绿色亚麻汉服
深色腰带
木簪
黑色布鞋
唯一一柄深色钢剑
人物气质：
反应快
喜剧判断准确
吐槽简洁
表情克制但读得懂

角色 C｜敌方剑客
一名满脸怒气的敌方剑客
气势冲天地登场
把自己当作前来复仇的英雄
前半段极有压迫感
后半段逐渐意识到自己可能不该打
最终由“报仇者”变成“唯一幸存可挑战者”

角色 D｜师父
同一个年长师父
站在两人数步后方
安静作为见证者
台词极少
但一句话完成整个核心反转
最后再做一次轻微补刀

五、15秒三镜头结构
Shot 1｜0–5s｜全景 / 远景｜复仇者登场
在根据本轮参考图自然规划出的 开放区域 中：
同一个白衣剑仙师姐
同一个青衣小师妹
同一个年长师父
地理关系稳定清楚
一名满脸怒气的敌方剑客大步进入画面。
他“锵”地拔剑，气势十足地宣布：
“我来替三个师兄报仇！”
同一个白衣剑仙完全没有紧张，只平静问：
“哪三个？”
敌人立刻回答：
“落水的、挂树的、滚下山的，都是我师兄！”

Shot 2｜5–10s｜中景 / 牛仔景｜“第四个”的含义变了
保持：
同一个白衣剑仙
同一个青衣小师妹
同一个敌人
同一个师父
同样服装
同样长剑
完全一致的地理空间
同一个小师妹终于认出来，恍然说道：
“哦，你是第四个。”
敌人瞬间挺直身体，非常骄傲地回答：
“正是！”
这里他必须完全没听出任何问题，甚至更得意。
随后镜头焦点转移到同一个师父。
师父像随口闲聊一样，平静问：
“你师父还剩几个徒弟？”
敌人完全没有思考，本能回答：
“…… 就我。”
说完之后，必须留下 一拍绝对安静。
镜头不要急着切走。
一定要保留敌人脸上的变化过程：
英雄气概还挂在脸上
脑子慢一拍才真正反应过来
他开始意识到刚才那句话意味着什么
同一个小师妹先低头看看他仍然拔着的剑，再重新看他，非常自然地问：
“那你还打？”

Shot 3｜10–15s｜特写 / 极近特写｜求生欲战胜复仇欲
保持：
同一个敌人
同一个师姐
同一个小师妹
同一个师父
同样服装
同样长剑
同样地理关系
同一个敌人先看看师姐，再看看小师妹，最后低头看看自己手里的剑。
他开始非常认真地计算后果。
然后非常缓慢地把长剑重新归鞘，以一种突然成熟起来的语气说道：
“等师父再收两个。”
完整停顿半拍。
同一个剑仙师姐竟然非常正式地朝他轻点一下头，像认可真正的武学判断一样说道：
“有长进。”
同一个小师妹顺势补一句：
“主要是会算了。”
镜头焦点转移到师父。
同一个师父一本正经地点头评价：
“至少这次没白来。”
随后进入极近特写。
敌人努力保持最后一点挑战者尊严，转身离开。
刚走出两步，他又忍不住停一下，却不肯回头，小声问：
“我三个师兄…… 都还活着吧？”
同一个师姐几乎零停顿回答：
“活着。”
敌人的肩膀要出现非常明显、肉眼可见的一次放松。
然后他脚步明显加快离开。
同一个小师妹看着他的背影，非常认真地感慨：
“这门派终于出了个谨慎的。”
最后浅景深后方，同一个师父用极小幅度藏住嘴角笑意，精准切黑。

六、表演要求
师姐表演
永远不夸张
冷静得像在处理日常宗门事务
对敌人的撤退甚至表现出一点点正式认可
“有长进”必须像真的在夸一个人终于学会判断风险

小师妹表演
反应要快
喜剧判断点要稳
“那你还打？”和“主要是会算了”都要说得极自然
不是嘲讽，是很认真地看懂了对方的处境

敌人表演
前半段：
充满复仇者气势
真心把自己当成英雄登场
中段：
先骄傲承认“第四个”
再被一句话击中
脸上必须看得见英雄叙事缓慢塌掉的过程
后半段：
求生欲升起
努力保住体面
不是闹剧式崩坏，是认真地决定先保命

师父表演
台词不多
语气像平常说话
但每句话都很准
最后那个几乎藏不住的笑意必须极轻

七、摄影与镜头气质
总时长：15 秒
画幅：16:9 横屏
三个连续清晰镜头
原生同步普通话对白
精准口型
清楚的喜剧停顿
自然电影摄影
Arri Alexa 电影机观感
稳定锐利的面部微细节
细腻胶片颗粒
自然体积光
镜头原则：
运镜克制
摄影机稳定
让反应有时间成立
不抢表演
不炫技
必须给敌人“反应过来”的时间

八、连续
entries.translated_prompt:
Seedance | 15-second Deadpan Comedy Short | "The Fourth One"

I. Mission Objective
Generate a complete and continuous 15-second Chinese Xianxia (fantasy) movie short.

Overall Style Requirements:
Cinematic realistic texture
Pure ancient Chinese Xianxia aesthetics
Deconstruct the epic "avenger's entrance" pressure into a serious survival-type comedy
Restrained deadpan performance
Silent film-style reaction rhythm
Classic "three-beat progression"
Clear status reversal
Arri Alexa cinematic texture
Stable and clear facial micro-details
Fine film grain
Natural volumetric light

II. Core Comedy Logic
Keep only one easy-to-understand main line:
An enemy enters aggressively to avenge three brothers who have already lost, proudly identifying himself as the "fourth challenger."
Until the Master casually asks a very ordinary question, he suddenly realizes: he is the last one in his sect who can still stand and come to challenge.

Humor Sources:
Delayed reaction (belated realization)
A normal person's survival instinct
Serious dialogue rhythm
The character gradually realizing the problem himself
Prohibitions:
Character suddenly becoming stupid
Random environmental accidents
Exaggerated slapstick performance

III. Reference Anchors
Character Anchors
@Image 1: Character ID A | Sword Immortal Senior Sister
@Image 2: Character ID B | Junior Sister

Environmental DNA
All newly uploaded background and location reference images determine a single set of environmental DNA. Before formal composition, silently integrate and reconstruct compatible:
Real terrain, architectural language, spatial scale, vegetation, water bodies, weather, mountain mist, main light direction, reflection relationships, atmospheric depth, real walkable paths.
Environment Principles:
Water, mist, vegetation, fabrics, and distant ambient sounds must continue natural movement. The environment must remain Neutral in narrative: no active gags, no plot triggering, no reversal pushing, no interruption of character rhythm.

IV. Character Settings
Character ID A | Sword Immortal Senior Sister | @Image 1
Always the same 25-30 year old East Asian female: Tall and slender, oval face, dark almond eyes, long black hair half-up, fixed with a white jade hairpin, white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver waist seal, jade pendant, white cloth boots, a single silver long sword.
Character Temperament: Calm, restrained, never exaggerated, handles challengers like daily sect chores.

Character ID B | Junior Sister | @Image 2
Always the same 20-25 year old East Asian female: Small build, round and lively face, black hair braided, cyan-green linen Hanfu, dark belt, wooden hairpin, black cloth shoes, a single dark steel sword.
Character Temperament: Quick reflexes, accurate comedic judgment, concise retorts, restrained but readable expressions.

Character C | Enemy Swordsman
An angry enemy swordsman enters with great momentum, viewing himself as a hero coming for revenge. Very oppressive in the first half, gradually realizing he shouldn't be fighting in the second half, eventually turning from an "avenger" to the "only surviving challenger."

Character D | Master
Same elderly Master, standing a few steps behind the two, serving as a quiet witness. Minimal lines, but one sentence completes the core reversal, followed by a final light verbal jab.

V. 15-second Three-Shot Structure
Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide / Long Shot | Avenger's Entrance
In the open area naturally planned according to the reference images: same white-robed Senior Sister, same green-robed Junior Sister, same Master. Spatial relationship is stable. An angry enemy swordsman strides into the frame. He draws his sword with a "clang" and announces heroically: "I come to avenge my three senior brothers!" The white-robed Sister is not nervous at all, calmly asking: "Which three?" The enemy immediately replies: "The one who fell in the water, the one hanging in the tree, and the one who rolled down the mountain, they are all my brothers!"

Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium / Cowboy Shot | The meaning of "The Fourth" changes
Maintain all characters, costumes, and the identical geographic space. The Junior Sister finally recognizes him and says: "Oh, you're the fourth one." The enemy instantly straightens up and proudly replies: "Correct!" He must not hear any problem, even becoming more proud. Then the focus shifts to the Master who asks casually: "How many disciples does your master have left?" The enemy answers instinctively without thinking: "... Just me." After speaking, there must be a beat of absolute silence. Don't cut away quickly. Keep the transformation on the enemy's face: heroic aura still hanging there, brain one beat late to react, then realizing what that sentence meant. The Junior Sister looks at his drawn sword, then back at him, asking naturally: "Are you still fighting?"

Shot 3 | 10–15s | Close-up / Extreme Close-up | Survival instinct defeats revenge
Maintain all characters and relations. The enemy looks at the Sister, then the Junior Sister, and finally down at the sword in his hand. He begins to seriously calculate the consequences. Then he very slowly sheathes the sword, saying in a suddenly mature tone: "Wait for Master to recruit two more." Complete half-beat pause. The Sister actually nods to him formally, as if approving a true martial judgment: "Progressing." The Junior Sister adds: "Mostly he learned how to calculate." Focus on Master who nods seriously: "At least this trip wasn't in vain." Then extreme close-up. The enemy tries to maintain his last bit of dignity and turns to leave. After two steps, he stops without looking back, whispering: "My three brothers... they are all still alive, right?" The Sister answers almost instantly: "Alive." The enemy's shoulders show a visible, physical relaxation. Then he leaves with a noticeably faster pace. The Junior Sister watches his back and sighs: "This sect finally produced a cautious one." Finally, in the background, the Master hides a tiny smile as it cuts to black.

VI. Performance Requirements
Senior Sister: Never exaggerated, calm as if handling daily chores, formally acknowledging the enemy's retreat.
Junior Sister: Quick reactions, stable comedic timing, naturally delivered lines.
Enemy: First half full of avenger's momentum; middle transition shows the slow collapse of the heroic narrative; second half shows survival instinct and trying to keep face.
Master: Minimal lines, casual tone but accurate, extremely subtle final smile.

VII. Cinematography and Tone
15 seconds total, 16:9 horizontal, three continuous clear shots. Native Mandarin dialogue, precise lip-sync, clear comedic pauses. Arri Alexa look, stable sharp facial details, natural volumetric lighting. Restrained camera movement, stable shots, giving time for reactions to land.

VIII. Continuity

entries.title: 2000s MiniDV Balcony Night
entries.description: A nostalgic 15-second video prompt designed to simulate early-2000s MiniDV home footage of a young woman on a quiet apartment balcony at night.
entries.prompt:
Authentic early-2000s MiniDV home-video footage. Young Korean woman, 24, long dark hair, minimal makeup, oversized cozy sweatshirt and loose pajama pants, wrapped in a soft blanket. Quiet apartment balcony at night, warm indoor light spilling through the open door, cool blue city light outside. 4:3 MiniDV, handheld imperfections, low-light noise, tape grain/compression, slight autofocus hunting. Natural candid behavior, no cinematic polish.

SHOT 1 — 0:00–0:03
Interior wide shot facing the balcony door. She walks toward the open door wrapped tightly in a blanket, sleepy and curious. She slides the door open a little further and steps outside.
SHOT 2 — 0:03–0:06
Cut to a balcony-side angle. She takes a few small steps outside, holding the blanket around her shoulders. She looks up at the quiet night sky and takes a deep breath.

SHOT 3 — 0:06–0:09
A sudden cold gust blows across the balcony. Her hair moves strongly in the wind and she immediately scrunches her shoulders, pulls the blanket tightly around herself, and makes a funny surprised expression.
SHOT 4 — 0:09–0:12
She quickly retreats back through the balcony door, almost stumbling from how fast she moves. She closes the door halfway, still wrapped tightly in the blanket, and looks back outside.

SHOT 5 — 0:12–0:15
She slowly peeks her head back around the door and looks toward the camera. She realizes how ridiculous her dramatic retreat was and starts quietly laughing. She shakes her head, smiles, and disappears back inside.

entries.title: Handheld Scandinavian Influencer Running Vlog
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a realistic 5 AM dawn running vlog featuring a Scandinavian woman. It utilizes a handheld Mini-DV aesthetic with intentional imperfections like camera shake and autofocus hunting to create an authentic, high-end influencer feel.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA Mini-DV tape camcorder handheld aesthetic, vertical framing. A gorgeous athletic Scandinavian running influencer films herself directly by hand in selfie-cam and first-person style during a dawn run. Keep realistic hand shake amplified by her stride, slightly crooked framing, delayed autofocus hunting in low dawn light, awkward zoom-ins and zoom-outs, occasional motion blur, wind buffeting the mic, and small framing mistakes where part of her face or the horizon briefly slips out of frame. Mix handheld selfie footage with a few fixed external shots. Important: never show her placing, adjusting, or setting up a camera. When switching from handheld footage to a fixed external angle, use a clean jump cut as if the camera had already been positioned before the shot began. The camera itself must never appear on screen.

LOOK:

Soft digital tape camcorder look with vintage DV character. Slight blur, faint tape noise, visible highlight bloom as the sun breaks the horizon, subtle auto-exposure flicker and hunting as she turns toward and away from the light, muted contrast in the shadows, realistic skin texture with visible pores and sweat sheen, cool blue pre-dawn ambient light warming to gold, realistic skin tones, real lens flare when facing the sun.

STYLE:

A realistic 5am dawn run vlog with a confident athletic lifestyle vibe. The tone is breathless, upbeat, a little self-deprecating, and natural. She is clearly attractive and charismatic, but the video must feel like a believable self-recorded run vlog, not a polished Nike commercial. Fast clean jump cuts, strong continuity, natural body language, audible real breathing that gets heavier across the video, no awkward dead moments.

CHARACTER:

An exceptionally beautiful athletic Scandinavian woman in her mid-20s. Highly photogenic face, clear pale blue eyes, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, defined jawline, a natural full mouth, fair skin flushing pink at the cheeks from cold and effort, long thick ash-blonde hair in a low ponytail with loose strands escaping around the face. She looks like a high-end running and lifestyle influencer, not an ordinary jogger. Lean, long-limbed, athletic runner's build. Bare minimal makeup, slightly glossy skin from sweat. She wears a fitted long-sleeve technical running top in muted olive, matching high-waisted running shorts, a thin black running watch, low-profile running shoes, and small wired-look earbuds. No other jewelry.

entries.title: Breathing Skyscraper Night Surrealism
entries.description: A surreal cinematic prompt showing a modern glass skyscraper appearing to inhale and exhale mist and particles in a night cityscape.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA:
Single continuous cinematic shot. Begin with a slow low-angle push toward a massive modern skyscraper at night. Camera gradually moves upward while maintaining the building centered in frame. Smooth controlled movement with subtle handheld realism. No cuts. End with a dramatic pullback revealing the full scale of the phenomenon.

SCENE:
A realistic modern city at night after light rain. Wet streets reflect thousands of city lights. One enormous glass skyscraper dominates the frame. Everything appears completely normal and photorealistic.

0–3 SECONDS:
Camera slowly approaches the skyscraper.

Nothing unusual happens.

Then every illuminated window simultaneously becomes covered in soft condensation, as if something inside the building is breathing.

3–7 SECONDS:
The entire skyscraper slowly INHALES.

Curtains behind the windows pull inward. Loose papers, mist, rain droplets and tiny particles from the street begin moving toward the building.

The movement must feel like an enormous invisible vacuum, but organic—like the building itself is breathing.

7–10 SECONDS:
The skyscraper reaches maximum compression.

For one brief moment, the entire city becomes completely silent and still.

10–13 SECONDS:
The building suddenly EXHALES.

A massive wave of glowing dust-like particles bursts outward from thousands of windows and rises into the night sky.

13–15 SECONDS:
Camera rapidly pulls backward and upward.

The particles arrange themselves above the city into the enormous silhouette of a HUMAN FIGURE floating in the clouds.

The silhouette exists for only a moment.

FINAL FRAME:
The giant human-shaped formation looks down silently over the city.

STYLE:
Photorealistic cinematic surrealism, massive architectural scale, realistic atmospheric physics, volumetric light, wet reflective streets, subtle film grain, high-end science-fiction cinema, dramatic but believable lighting.

entries.title: Isekai Elevator Secretary Cinematic Comedy
entries.description: A highly structured cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a secretary encountering dinosaurs and medieval knights through shifting elevator doors, complete with shot flow, sound design, and character reference instructions.
entries.prompt:
【REFERENCE】
image1 は主人公の秘書を定義する三面図キャラクターシート。FRONT／SIDE／BACKは別人物ではなく、同一人物を異なる方向から示した参照情報として統合して使用する。顔、髪、年齢感、肌色、体型、身長感、頭身、全身比率、制服デザイン、制服色、スカーフ、靴はキャラクターシートから継承し、動画全編で同一人物として維持する。三面図キャラクターシートのレイアウト、背景、文字、番号、枠は動画へ継承しない。

【CONDITION】
15秒、1:1スクエア。高品質な実写シネマティック・コメディ。舞台は清潔で現代的な会社のエレベーターホール。同じエレベーターと周辺空間を全編で維持する。異世界へ変化するのは、開いたエレベーター扉の向こう側だけ。扉を閉じるたび直前の世界は消え、次に開いた時は別の世界へ完全に切り替わる。順番は恐竜世界 → 中世騎士の戦場 → 南国ビーチで固定し、複数世界を混在させない。
実写映像を基調に、驚きや慌てる動作へ集中線、スピード線、衝撃線、インパクトフラッシュ、汗などの漫画的エフェクトを大胆に加える。最後の南国ビーチでは緊張感のある演出から、キラキラした明るいコミカル表現へ切り替える。

【SHOT FLOW】
CUT 1｜0.0–1.8秒
会社のエレベーターホール。ミディアムワイド。秘書が閉じたエレベーターの前で静かに待つ。到着音に反応して扉を見る。日常的で落ち着いた開始。
CUT 2｜1.8–4.3秒
カメラは会社側のエレベーターホール、エレベーター正面軸から少し左へずれた位置。開口部を画面左〜中央の約2/3、秘書を画面右の会社側約1/3に配置するミディアムワイド。秘書は敷居の外、会社側の床に立ち、エレベーター開口部の中央には立たない。扉が左右へ開くと、向こう側に巨大な恐竜が生息するジャングル世界が広がる。大きな肉食恐竜がこちらへ咆哮。秘書は開口部を見たまま大きくのけぞって驚く。集中線、衝撃フラッシュ、汗、ショックエフェクト。会社側にいる秘書と、扉の向こうの恐竜世界を同一画面で明確に見せる。
CUT 3｜4.3–5.6秒
操作パネル寄りの近距離アクション。秘書が慌てて閉ボタンを連打する。腕と上半身に強いスピード線、ボタン操作にインパクトエフェクト。扉が勢いよく閉じ、恐竜世界を完全に遮断する。

CUT 4｜5.6–8.6秒
カメラは再び会社側の同じ斜め位置。開口部を画面左〜中央、秘書を画面右の会社側に分離して配置するミディアムワイド。秘書は敷居の外に立ったまま警戒しながら再び扉を開く。扉が開くと、石造りの城塞を背景に、中世の甲冑騎士たちが剣と盾で激しく戦う世界が現れる。扉の向こう側で騎士同士が激しく剣を交える。秘書は会社側からその光景を見て一瞬固まり、直後にさらに大きく驚く。剣戟の火花、斜めのスピード線、集中線、衝撃エフェクト。秘書を開口部中央へ移動させず、会社側の人物と中世世界を明確に分離して見せる。
CUT 5｜8.6–9.9秒
近距離アクション。秘書が再び閉ボタンを必死に連打する。手の残像、強いスピード線、インパクトバースト。扉が勢いよく閉じ、中世の戦場を完全に遮断する。
CUT 6｜9.9–15.0秒
カメラは会社側の同じ斜め位置から開始。開口部を画面左〜中央、秘書を画面右の会社側に置くミディアムワイド。秘書が身構えながら慎重にもう一度扉を開く。扉の向こうに、白い砂浜、透明なターコイズブルーの海、ヤシの木、青空が広がる美しい南国ビーチ。秘書は警戒した表情から一転して目を輝かせ、嬉しそうな笑顔になる。集中線や衝撃表現は消え、キラキラ、光、軽いハートなど明るい漫画的エフェクトへ切り替える。秘書は会社側から開口部へ近づき、敷居を越えてそのままビーチの中へ進んでいく。秘書が完全にビーチ側へ入った後、別カットへハードカット。最後は南国ビーチ上空からの高い俯瞰ショット。白い砂浜、青い海、ヤシの木が広がる美しいビーチ全景の中を、秘書が嬉しそうに海へ向かって進んでいく。広大な南国ビーチと小さく見える秘書を捉えた、明るく開放的な俯瞰フレームで終了する。

【SOUND】
コミカルでテンポのよいBGMあり。場面転換とリアクションを邪魔せず、15秒全体を軽快をつなぐ。会社内の静かな環境音、エレベーターの到着音と扉の開閉音。恐竜世界ではジャングル環境音と恐竜の咆哮。中世世界では激しい剣戟、盾の衝突、騎士たちの掛け声。南国ビーチでは穏やかな波音と海風。閉ボタン連打にはテンポの速い操作音とコミカルなインパクトSE。扉が閉じると直前の異世界の音も即座に消える。台詞、ナレーションなし。

【NEGATIVE】
秘書の別人化、参照シートと異なる顔・髪・体型・制服への変化。恐竜世界、中世騎士の戦場、南国ビーチの混在や順番変更。2回の扉を閉める動作の省略。扉が閉じる前に次の世界へ切り替わること。恐竜世界・中世世界の場面で秘書をエレベーター開口部中央や異世界側へ配置すること。カメラが異世界側から会社方向を見る構図への反転。エレベーターや扉の不自然な変形。人物の手足の破綻。漫画エフェクトによる主要人物や異世界の過度な遮蔽。

entries.prompt:
镜头一 愤怒初起，0 到 4 秒，中近景。 一对年轻情侣在傍晚的客厅里对峙，女生双手抱臂，眉头紧锁眉间挤出竖纹，眼神硬直地盯住对方，嘴角向下绷紧，脸颊微微涨红，灯下侧光，固定镜头。

镜头二 情绪转委屈，4 到 10 秒，镜头缓慢推到面部特写。 女生的硬眼神松了一点，内侧眉毛轻轻抬起，视线从对方脸上滑开垂向地面，嘴角仍向下却不再绷紧，肩膀微微塌下，像被什么堵住了，暖光转冷，极缓推镜。

entries.title: Indian Village Football Documentary
entries.description: A handheld MiniDV style documentary prompt capturing the daily life and joy of a young girl playing football in an Indian village.
entries.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic Indian village documentary sequence shot entirely on an old handheld MiniDV / Hi8-style camcorder, following a young village girl who plays football every day with the local kids. Everything should feel observational and slightly amateur, like a small documentary crew has been following her life for a few days and she has become comfortable with the cameraman. Slightly faded colors, baked-in camcorder sharpness, mild interlacing, tape softness, compression noise, autofocus hunting, exposure pumping, rough handheld movement, imperfect zooms, accidental reframing, operator footsteps, wind hitting the microphone, children shouting in the distance, village ambience, birds, dogs, and natural location audio. No music. No modern cinematic grading. No gimbal. No dramatic sports-commercial photography. The camera should feel physically carried by one person. The setting is a real Indian village football ground: not a professional pitch, just an open dusty field between houses and farmland, uneven patches of grass, stones marking boundaries, homemade goalposts, children in ordinary clothes, a few slippers and bags lying near the side, bicycles nearby, villagers occasionally watching from the edge. Shot 1 — She takes the documentary crew to the ground Start with the cameraman already following the young Indian girl footballer through a narrow village lane. She walks slightly ahead of the camera carrying or lightly kicking her old football, completely natural and comfortable with the documentary crew. She turns around while still walking and says in English with a natural Indian accent: “Come with me. I’ll show you where we play football every day.” The cameraman follows behind her with slightly shaky footsteps. She walks out of the lane and onto the open field. She spreads her hand toward the rough football ground and proudly says: “This is it.” Do not make the reveal grand or cinematic. The charm is that she is incredibly proud of a very ordinary dusty village field. Shot 2 — The joy of playing Cut to the cameraman already standing close to the edge of the game while the children are playing. The same girl runs past the camera chasing the ball with other village kids. The camera operator struggles to follow them, performs a clumsy little pan, briefly loses focus, then catches them again. The cameraman laughs from behind the camera and says in English with a natural Indian accent: “See how much fun this is?” The girl glances toward him while still moving, grins, and immediately runs back into play. Keep this shot energetic and documentary-real: children shouting things like “Pass! Pass!”, feet kicking dust, someone nearly running into the camera, the operator stepping aside, an imperfect zoom toward the ball, then quickly widening again because the action changes direction. Shot 3 — Bicycle-kick goal and celebration Cut to what feels like the final moments of the same village match. The camera is handheld from the sideline, slightly too far away, trying to follow the action. Several kids rush toward the makeshift goal. One player near the side sends a high crossing ball into the middle. The cameraman reacts late and pans quickly. The same girl runs into position, watches the descending ball, turns her body— and performs a completely believable bicycle kick. Her back leaves the ground, one leg swings upward, she connects cleanly with the ball in midair, and the ball flies toward the makeshift goal. The goalkeeper reacts— goal. The children immediately explode in celebration. No slow motion. No heroic cinematic cutaway. Let the old camcorder almost miss the kick because the operator is trying desperately to keep up. The girl jumps back to her feet and starts running directly toward the documentary camera, yelling in English: “YEEEAAAH!” Her teammates chase behind her, screaming and celebrating. She reaches the camera laughing, nearly filling the lens, jumping around with the others as the operator backs away and struggles to keep everyone framed. Kids hug her, slap her hands, shout, jump, and crowd around the camera in exactly the messy way children celebrate after scoring. The lens briefly loses focus because everyone is too close. End inside that chaos — her laughing directly toward the cameraman while the other children are still celebrating around her. Overall feeling: a tiny observational documentary about an ordinary village girl suddenly becoming a football hero for one moment. It should feel warm, real, imperfect, spontaneous and completely unstaged — the camera just happened to be there when she scored the best goal of the match.

The entire film should look like a high-budget international beauty campaign, with sophisticated cinematography, realistic hair physics, elegant lighting, premium production design, and photorealistic detail.

0–3 SEC — OPENING

Extreme close-up of the girl standing in a luxurious modern bathroom. Warm morning light softly illuminates her face and wet hair. She gently runs her fingers through her damp hair as tiny water droplets glisten on individual strands.

Camera slowly moves toward her hair with an elegant macro transition.

3–6 SEC — SHAMPOO APPLICATION

Close-up of her hand dispensing a rich, luxurious pearlescent shampoo into her palm.

Cut to a beautiful close-up as she massages the shampoo gently into her wet hair. Rich creamy lather forms naturally between her fingers. Detailed hair strands, realistic foam, water droplets, and soft skin texture.

6–10 SEC — TRANSFORMATION

Cinematic slow-motion shot.

She rinses her hair under crystal-clear water. As she lifts her head, her freshly washed hair falls naturally around her shoulders.

She turns toward the camera and slowly runs her fingers through her hair.

Her hair appears silky, smooth, hydrated, voluminous, and intensely glossy, with natural movement and realistic individual strands.

Soft sunlight creates elegant highlights across the flowing hair.

10–13 SEC — HERO BEAUTY SHOT

The girl walks slowly through a luxurious minimalist setting.

She turns her head gently, allowing her long, silky hair to sweep naturally through the air in beautiful slow motion.

Camera performs a smooth cinematic orbit around her.

Confident expression. Natural beauty. Premium fashion-editorial aesthetic.

13–15 SEC — PRODUCT REVEAL

Match-cut from her flowing hair to the shampoo bottle standing on a polished marble surface.

The bottle is surrounded by subtle water droplets with a soft luxury light glowing behind it.

Elegant text appears:

[BRAND NAME]
UNLOCK YOUR HAIR'S NATURAL BRILLIANCE.

Final subtle light sweep across the logo.

STYLE:
Luxury beauty commercial, international cosmetics campaign, photorealistic, 4K/8K, cinematic slow motion, premium studio lighting, realistic wet hair, physically accurate water and foam, natural skin texture, elegant camera movement, shallow depth of field, sophisticated color grading, high-end product cinematography.

AVOID:
Cheap CGI, excessive effects, unrealistic hair movement, plastic-looking skin, distorted hands, warped facial features, messy backgrounds, excessive text, oversaturation, artificial-looking foam, cartoon aesthetics.

entries.title: Surreal Desert Mirror Fantasy
entries.description: A surreal cinematic dark fantasy prompt featuring two knights arriving at a giant circular mirror in a desert that reflects a futuristic city.
entries.prompt: SUBJECT ANCHOR 1: <<<image_1>>> — Ash Knight SUBJECT ANCHOR 2: <<<image_2>>> — Obsidian Rival PROP ANCHOR: <<<image_3>>> — Magma Greatsword DURATION: 30 seconds ASPECT RATIO: 16:9 STYLE: Surreal cinematic dark fantasy / science-fantasy CAMERA: Large-format cinema, 24mm / 35mm / 50mm / 85mm FRAME RATE: 24fps with selective 60fps STORY In the middle of an endless desert stands a gigantic circular mirror buried vertically in the sand. Ash Knight arrives from one direction. Obsidian Rival arrives from another. The mirror does not reflect them. Instead, it shows a completely different version of the desert—one thousands of years in the future. --- 00:00–00:05 — THE DESERT Open with an enormous aerial shot of an endless black-and-gold desert at sunset. Wind creates long patterns across the dunes. At the center of the landscape stands a gigantic circular metallic structure half-buried in the sand. The camera descends toward it. Ash Knight appears as a distant silhouette walking across the dunes. --- 00:05–00:09 — THE SECOND ARRIVAL Cut to a 50mm side profile. Ash Knight reaches the structure. Across the enormous circular mirror, Obsidian Rival emerges from the opposite side. Both stop. The mirror stands between them. The camera slowly moves sideways, keeping the entire structure centered. --- 00:09–00:13 — THE MIRROR 85mm close-up. The surface of the mirror is perfectly black. Ash Knight approaches it. His reflection should appear— but it doesn't. Instead, the mirror shows the same location thousands of years later. The desert has disappeared. A massive futuristic city now covers the landscape. --- 00:13–00:17 — THE FUTURE 35mm composition. Obsidian Rival steps closer. The mirror changes again. It shows a completely different future. The city is now empty. Towering structures are covered in sand. A gigantic red moon hangs above the horizon. The two warriors look toward the impossible reflection. --- 00:17–00:21 — THE SWORD 85mm macro. Ash Knight draws the Magma Greatsword. The red lava veins pulse. The mirror responds. A thin red reflection appears across its surface. The reflection of the sword suddenly becomes visible even though the warriors still have no reflections. --- 00:21–00:25 — THE FRACTURE Ash Knight slowly raises the Greatsword toward the mirror. He does not strike. The mirror surface begins developing thin luminous cracks by itself. The cracks spread outward like a massive geometric pattern. The desert wind suddenly stops. Every grain of sand becomes completely still. --- 00:25–00:28 — THE OTHER WORLD The mirror opens like a doorway. Beyond it is not another desert. It is an enormous ocean suspended vertically in the sky. Massive floating structures drift beneath the water. The camera slowly pushes forward. Both warriors remain behind the threshold. --- 00:28–00:30 — FINAL IMAGE Extreme wide shot. The circular mirror now stands open in the middle of the desert. Inside it, the impossible ocean-world stretches endlessly. Ash Knight and Obsidian Rival stand on opposite sides of the opening. The Magma Greatsword glows faintly. A single wave moves across the vertical ocean. The mirror suddenly closes. The desert returns to normal. CUT TO BLACK. No text. No title. No logo. CHARACTER CONTINUITY Preserve the exact reference appearance throughout. Ash Knight: exact armor, magma rune patterns, cape, proportions, silhouette and identity. Obsidian Rival: exact obsidian dragon-scale armor, horned helmet, orange visor, proportions, silhouette and identity. Magma Greatsword: exact blade geometry, jagged edges, handle, forged texture and red lava veins. No redesigns, identity drift, morphing, duplicates, weapon transformation, armor changes or flickering. ENVIRONMENT CONTINUITY One desert. One circular mirror. Same sunset. Same sand. Same weather. Same positions of the characters. The mirror's internal worlds may change, but the physical desert remains consistent. CINEMATOGRAPHY 24mm — vast desert. 35mm — character/environment compositions. 50mm — dramatic character shots. 85mm — mirror and sword details. Slow aerial descent. Lateral tracking. Controlled push-ins. Smooth crane movement. Subtle 60fps during the mirror fracture. Natural motion blur. Realistic sand interaction. Large-format cinematic depth. VISUAL DESIGN Golden desert. Deep blue-black shadows. Warm sunset. Black reflective mirror. Red magma glow. Cold futuristic architecture inside the mirror. Surreal vertical ocean. The color palette should evolve naturally rather than remaining monochromatic. NEGATIVE PROMPT text, subtitles, watermark, logo, modern clothing, cartoon, anime, low-poly, plastic armor, character redesign, identity drift, face morphing, weapon redesign, duplicate characters, extra limbs, malformed hands, inconsistent proportions, flickering, random camera movement, environment reset, inconsistent lighting, excessive destruction, graphic gore, blood, dismemberment, blurry subjects, flat lighting. DIRECTOR'S NOTE: Do not explain the mirror. The audience should discover its rules visually. The first reveal establishes that it shows the future; the second reveal breaks that assumption; the final reveal shows an entirely impossible world. The ending should leave the viewer with a question rather than an answer.

罪人が見上げて切迫した声で言う。{陛下……お許しください！}

罪人が叫ぶ。{違う！ 私は――}

9.5-14.4秒：カメラは女王へ約1m接近。女王の骨格と筋肉が皮膚下で連続変形し、口角が裂け、多層の牙が露出する。白金髪が舞い、背中から骨膜状器官が展開。身体が巨大化し、ドレスが裂けながら怪物形態へ変身する。
<骨格変形音、肉の伸長音>
怪物女王が咆哮する。<ステンドグラスを共振させる異質な咆哮>
左右の兵士が波状に片膝をつく。罪人が後退しながら言う。{そんな……！}

14.4-19.6秒：罪人が180度反転し、カメラ方向（王宮奥方向）へ全力疾走を開始。ここからカメラは中央通路上を王宮奥方向へ後退し続ける。「カメラ ← 罪人 ← 怪物女王 ← 玉座」の一直線の位置関係を固定。怪物女王が四肢で追跡を開始。
罪人が走りながら背後へ叫ぶ。{やめろ！ 来るな！}
<荒い呼吸、鎧の音、怪物の巨大な四肢が大理石を叩く重量衝撃音>
罪人の鎖が大理石の装飾に引っ掛かり、罪人が前方へ崩れ落ちる。カメラも後退を減速する。

19.6-23.4秒：カメラは現在の中央通路上でほぼ停止。怪物女王が背後から追いつき、右前肢で逃走経路を塞ぐ。怪物の首が伸び、巨大な顎が罪人の胴体を背後斜めから咥えて持ち上げる。
<金属圧壊音、短い絶叫、鎖が切れて床へ落ちる音>
怪物女王が顎を動かし、罪人を完全に飲み込む。罪人の身体は画面から完全に消失する。

23.4-30.0秒：怪物女王は捕食したその位置（玉座から離れた場所）から一歩も動かず、人間形態へ変身解除を開始。骨膜器官が畳まれ、身体が縮小し、裂けたドレスが金色の魔法糸で復元する。カメラは非常にゆっくり約1mだけ後退する。
<骨格収縮音、衣装修復の繊細な音>
人間の姿へ完全に戻った女王は、床に落ちた鎖のそばで少し傾いた王冠を直す。周囲の兵士が立ち上がる。画面奥から新しい罪人が引き出されてくる。
女王が新しい罪人を見据えて冷たく言う。{次。}
カメラは中央通路をさらに後退・上昇し、手前に新しい罪人、中央に女王、奥に玉座を収めて終わる。

【連続性・空間制約】
30秒間、単一の物理カメラによる連続した長回しを維持する。14.4秒以降、カメラは王宮奥方向へ後退するのみとする。怪物女王は常に罪人の背後を維持する。捕食後、罪人の身体は画面から完全に消失した状態を維持する。女王は捕食を完了した地点にそのまま留まり続け、玉座前へは戻らない。変身解除時、カメラは現在の中央通路上の軸を維持して後退するのみとし、女王の周囲を回ったり正面へ回り込んだりする動作を固く禁ずる。
entries.translated_prompt: Ultra-realistic AAA live-action dark fantasy film. 30 seconds of completely continuous single-camera, uncut long-take. Maintains strict spatial coordinates and time axis, expressing depth of field and heavy atmosphere comparable to ARRI ALEXA 65. Environment: (Ref 3) huge royal palace. Black/white/gold marble floor, volumetric light from stained glass, huge chandelier. Soldiers in silver, gold, and dark blue military uniforms are crowded on the left and right. Queen: (Ref 1) beautiful queen. Long platinum-blonde hair, golden crown with blue jewels, royal dress of white to ivory with gold embroidery and dark blue. Queen (Monster Form): (Ref 2) huge monstrosity. Retains the crown and platinum hair, has multi-layered fangs, long claws, and bone-membrane organs on the back. Sinner: (Ref 4) male soldier. Brown hair, dirt and wounds, silver-gold armor, dark blue costume, handcuffs and chains. 0.0-4.5s: Camera starts from behind the queen. Queen's back in foreground, sinner about 12m ahead in central aisle, rows of soldiers on left and right. Guard pushes sinner forward, sinner is slammed onto marble on both knees. Camera passes by the queen's right shoulder, continuously advancing toward the sinner to capture the upper chest. <Low impact sound of heavy armor colliding with floor, sharp metallic sound of chains> Sinner looks up and says in an urgent voice. {Your Majesty... please forgive me!} 4.5-9.5s: Camera doesn't stop, passes left side of sinner, draws a smooth arc to capture queen on the throne side from the front. Queen steps forward. Queen says in a quiet, cold voice. {Did you think you could steal the royal treasure and escape?} <Dry metallic sound of soldiers reaching for sword hilts simultaneously> Sinner shouts. {No! I—} Queen takes another step, emotion disappears from face. 9.5-14.4s: Camera approaches queen by about 1m. Queen's skeleton and muscles continuously deform under skin, corners of mouth tear, multi-layered fangs are exposed. Platinum hair flutters, bone-membrane organs expand from back. Body enlarges, transforming into monster form while dress tears. <Skeletal deformation sounds, meat stretching sounds> Monster queen roars. <Unusual roar that makes stained glass resonate> Soldiers on left and right drop to one knee in a wave. Sinner says while backing away. {No way...!} 14.4-19.6s: Sinner turns 180 degrees and begins sprinting at full speed toward camera (palace interior direction). From here, camera continues to retreat along central aisle toward palace interior. Fixed linear relationship: "Camera ← Sinner ← Monster Queen ← Throne". Monster queen begins chase on all fours. Sinner shouts behind while running. {Stop! Don't come!} <Rough breathing, armor sound, heavy impact sound of monster's huge limbs hitting marble> Sinner's chain gets caught on marble decoration, sinner collapses forward. Camera also slows retreat. 19.6-23.4s: Camera almost stops on current central aisle. Monster queen catches up from behind, blocks escape route with right forelimb. Monster's neck extends, huge jaws grab sinner's torso from diagonal rear and lift him up. <Metallic crushing sound, short scream, sound of chain breaking and falling to floor> Monster queen moves jaws and completely swallows sinner. Sinner's body completely disappears from screen. 23.4-30.0s: Monster queen does not move from that predation position (away from throne), begins de-transformation into human form. Bone organs are folded, body shrinks, torn dress is restored with golden magical threads. Camera retreats very slowly by about 1m. <Skeletal contraction sounds, delicate sounds of costume restoration> Queen, fully returned to human form, fixes slightly tilted crown near chains on floor. Surrounding soldiers stand up. A new sinner is pulled out from back of screen. Queen stares at new sinner and says coldly. {Next.} Camera retreats/rises further down central aisle, ending with new sinner in foreground, queen in center, and throne in background. [Continuity & Spatial Constraints] Maintain continuous long-take with a single physical camera for 30 seconds. After 14.4 seconds, camera only retreats toward palace interior. Monster queen always stays behind sinner. After predation, sinner's body remains completely disappeared. Queen remains at the spot where she completed predation and does not return to throne. During de-transformation, camera only retreats maintaining axis on current central aisle, actions like circling queen or moving to front are strictly prohibited.

entries.title: Ghibli-Style Tiny Workers

entries.prompt: Create a whimsical, Ghibli-inspired hand-drawn animation showing tiny anime workers harvesting and transporting oversized soybean sprouts inside a large white porcelain bowl on a wooden table. Some workers shovel sprouts, climb a wooden ladder, carry a giant sprout on a stretcher, and load a small wooden cart, while others direct the team and rest from exhaustion. Use warm golden lighting, soft colors, floating dust motes, cozy details, expressive characters, and gentle cinematic camera movements, ending with a wide shot of the whole miniature team working together.

entries.title: Realistic Wing Chun Kung Fu Training Video
entries.description: A professional prompt for a 20-second high-speed Wing Chun martial arts video, focusing on precise hand techniques and the iconic one-inch punch.
entries.prompt: 【风格】真人写实咏春功夫短片（Photorealistic Wing Chun Film），抖音高燃动作视频，快慢节奏切换（Ramp-mo），高速摄影（High-Speed Photography），4K电影画质，真实皮肤、汗水与木材纹理，无动漫感、无魔法特效 【时长】20秒 【比例】9:16竖屏 【场景】传统岭南老武馆，深色木地板、斑驳灰墙、木格窗；清晨阳光从侧面照进来，空气中漂浮细微尘埃。画面中央固定着一座传统实木木人桩，圆柱形桩身、三根木臂、一根斜伸木腿 【角色】咏春练习者@ 图片1，人物脸型、五官、发型、身材比例和原本服装严格参考图片，全程保持同一人物、同一造型 【声音】无对白、无字幕；突出木桩碰撞声、脚步摩擦声、短促呼吸声与结尾木材碎裂声 [00:00-00:04] 镜头1：开场高速击桩（Impact Hook） 开场第一帧直接进入高速动作，不进行环境铺垫。 近距离侧拍：主角正在快速练习木人桩，双手围绕身体中线连续完成摊手、膀手、拍手、掌击和短促冲拳；拳掌在三根木臂之间快速切换，木臂被撞得连续震动。 镜头紧贴主角双手横向移动（Close Tracking），拳掌高速掠过镜头，带有自然运动模糊；每一次击打都产生不同的木质声音：“嗒、啪、咚、嗒嗒啪”。 切低机位全身镜头：主角脚下以紧凑的小步绕过木人桩的斜伸木腿，上半身始终保持稳定，双脚不交叉，不使用大幅度跳跃。 最后一记掌击重重落在木桩中央，木人桩整体猛震一下，桩身表面的灰尘被震落，但不能出现裂缝。 [00:04-00:08] 镜头2：突然减速·精准慢练（Ramp Down） 最后一记击打结束后，所有声音突然安静，画面从高速动作切入慢动作（Ramp Down）。 侧前方中景：主角放慢速度，左手贴住上方木臂，缓慢向外化开；右手沿着木人桩中央送出一记短促直拳，拳面接触木桩后迅速收回。 主角继续缓慢完成膀手、拍手和掌击，每一个动作都清晰分开，手臂动作短小、贴身，双肘不过度张开。 镜头围绕主角与木人桩缓慢移动约90度（Slow Orbit），展示手掌擦过粗糙木纹、木臂轻微震动、汗珠沿着主角脸颊滑落。 主角目光始终锁定木桩中央，肩膀放松、嘴唇微闭，呼吸平稳；不是生气乱打，而是在观察距离和节奏。 [00:08-00:12] 镜头3：由慢到快·连续加速（Progressive Acceleration） 低沉鼓点逐渐进入，主角练习速度开始一层层提高。 第一组动作速度适中：左手化开木臂，右掌击向木桩中央。 第二组明显加快：膀手接拍手，紧接两记短促冲拳。 第三组达到最高速度：左右手连续交替拍开木臂，拳掌沿着中线快速穿梭，配合小幅转身和贴地步法绕到木人桩侧面。 镜头采用低角度贴身环绕（Low-angle Steadicam Orbit），从主角背后绕至侧前方；前景木臂快速掠过，背景木格窗 and 阳光形成轻微速度拖影。 主角动作越打越快，但身体不左右乱晃，脸部仍然沉稳，只有呼吸逐渐加重、目光越来越集中。 木人桩不断震动并发出密集木响，此时仍然保持完整，不能提前破裂。 [00:12-00:14] 镜头4：突然停手·锁定木桩（Sudden Silence） 主角完成最后一组高速连击后，双手突然停住。 所有鼓点、击打声和镜头运动同时停止。 固定正面中景：主角站在木人桩前，双脚不移动，左手收回胸前，右手自然垂在身体一侧。 木人桩仍在轻微晃动，几粒木屑从桩身落到地板上。 切面部近景：主角缓慢抬起眼睛，目光锁定木人桩中央位置；嘴唇微微收紧，深吸一口气。 画面保持安静，为最后的寸拳动作留出明显停顿。 [00:14-00:17] 镜头5：摊掌靠近·握拳蓄力（Open Palm to Fist） 侧面中近景：主角缓慢抬起右手，五指完全摊开，手掌正对木人桩中央。 必须先清楚展示一只完全张开的手掌，不能一开始就是拳头。 主角保持身体稳定，右手以非常缓慢的速度向木人桩靠近；手掌每接近一点，镜头就跟随手掌轻轻向前推进。 切极近特写（Extreme Close-up）：张开的手掌停在距离木人桩约一寸的位置，手掌没有接触木桩，五根手指保持自然伸展，掌心、指节和粗糙木纹同时清晰可见。 短暂停顿后，主角开始蓄力握拳：小指首先缓慢收拢；无名指和中指依次弯曲；食指随后收紧；拇指最后压住拳面。 五根手指逐渐收紧，完整地从摊掌变成竖直拳头。 握拳过程中，手臂不能后拉，拳头与木桩的距离始终保持极近。 主角握紧拳头的一瞬间，前臂肌肉与手背筋络轻微绷紧，肩膀仍然下沉，身体不前扑。 声音只保留手指握紧产生的细微皮肤摩擦声和主角缓慢吸气声。 [00:17-00:20] 镜头6：寸拳冲击·木桩碎裂（One-Inch Punch） 极近侧面特写：主角已经握紧的右拳停在木人桩中央前方约一寸距离。 静止约0.3秒。 主角突然短促呼气，握紧的拳头从极近距离瞬间向前冲击；拳头不向后拉、不大幅挥动，只向前移动几厘米，干净击中木桩中央。 拳头冲击必须是一个极短、极快、集中爆发的动作：摊开的手掌已经靠近木桩；手指逐渐握成拳头；拳头原地蓄力；最后才从一寸距离突然冲击。 不能把这四个阶段合并成普通直拳。 接触瞬间响起一声厚重短促的“砰”。 木人桩先整体猛烈震动，拳头落点随即出现放射状裂纹；厚重桩身从中央崩裂成数块，三根木臂和下方木腿随着裂开的桩身脱落，真实木屑向前方和左右两侧飞散。 碎裂瞬间进入高速摄影（Super Slow-mo）：晨光照亮空中翻转的木屑和厚重木块，木块带着真实重量落向木地板，连续发出“咔嚓、咚、咚”的撞击声。 没有火焰、没有烟雾、没有能量波；木桩不能像玻璃一样爆炸，必须呈现真实厚重的木材断裂。 主角完成寸拳后，右拳停在原来的木桩中心位置，身体保持稳定，没有向前跌倒，也没有被反作用力弹开。 最后0.6秒恢复正常速度：主角缓慢收回右拳，重新摆出问手姿势，平静注视散落在脚下的木块。 镜头缓慢向后拉远（Slow Pull-back），定格在主角、碎裂木人桩、满地木块和晨光尘埃组成的画面。 【寸拳动作硬性要求】 结尾动作必须严格分成五个清楚阶段：1. 主角先完全摊开右手手掌； 2. 张开的手掌缓慢靠近木人桩； 3. 手掌停在距离木桩约一寸的位置； 4. 五根手指依次收拢，慢慢握成拳头并短暂蓄力； 5. 握紧的拳头才从极近距离突然冲击。 必须让观众清楚看见“摊掌靠近”和“握拳蓄力”的全过程。 不能一开始就是拳头； 不能握拳以后再次向后拉手； 不能省略手掌逐渐握紧的过程； 不能把寸拳生成成普通长距离直拳； 不能让拳头在握紧时提前击中木桩； 必须在完全握拳并短暂停顿后，才发生最后冲击。 【导演约束】 只生成一名主角，人物全程严格保持@图片1的脸、发型、身材和服装。 木人桩始终保持三根木臂、一根木腿，不能改变结构或增加木臂。 木人桩在17秒之前保持完整，只能震动和掉落少量灰尘。 不要普通拳击摆拳、勾拳、大幅蓄力、飞踢、翻滚或杂技动作。 不要让手掌穿过木臂，不要让拳头穿透桩身。 不要多余手指、缺少手指、手指粘连、手掌变形、握拳过程跳帧。 不要魔法光效、发光拳头、冲击波、火焰、烟雾或漫画速度线。 不要让木头出现玻璃、泡沫或橡胶质感。 不要人物怒吼、咬牙切齿或击碎木桩后庆祝。 不要其他人物、对白、字幕、标题、Logo、水印或乱码文字。
entries.translated_prompt: [Style] Photorealistic Wing Chun Film, high-energy Douyin action video, Ramp-mo rhythm transitions, High-Speed Photography, 4K cinematic quality, realistic skin, sweat, and wood textures, no anime feel, no magic effects. [Duration] 20 seconds. [Aspect Ratio] 9:16 vertical screen. [Scene] Traditional old Lingnan martial arts hall, dark wood floors, mottled gray walls, wooden lattice windows; morning sunlight streaming in from the side, tiny dust motes floating in the air. A traditional solid wood wooden dummy is fixed in the center of the frame, with a cylindrical body, three wooden arms, and one slanted wooden leg. [Character] Wing Chun practitioner as per Image 1. Face, features, hairstyle, body proportions, and original clothing must strictly follow the image, maintaining the same person and look throughout. [Audio] No dialogue, no subtitles; emphasize the sound of dummy collisions, footsteps rubbing, short breaths, and the sound of wood splintering at the end. [00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Opening high-speed dummy striking (Impact Hook). The first frame enters high-speed action directly without environmental setup. Close-up side shot: The protagonist is rapidly practicing on the wooden dummy, hands continuously performing Tan Sau, Bong Sau, Pak Sau, palm strikes, and short punches around the centerline; hands switch rapidly between the three wooden arms, causing the arms to vibrate continuously. The camera tracks horizontally close to the protagonist's hands (Close Tracking), with hands flashing past the lens with natural motion blur; each strike produces different wood sounds. Cut to a low-angle full-body shot: The protagonist uses tight small steps to bypass the slanted leg of the dummy, upper body remains stable, feet do not cross, no large jumps. The final palm strike lands heavily in the center, the whole dummy shakes violently, dust falls, but no cracks appear. [00:04-00:08] Shot 2: Sudden deceleration · Precise slow practice (Ramp Down). After the final strike, all sound suddenly goes quiet, transitioning to slow motion. Side-front medium shot: The protagonist slows down, left hand against the upper arm, slowly dissolving outward; right hand delivers a short straight punch along the center of the dummy, retracting quickly after contact. The protagonist continues slowly performing Bong Sau, Pak Sau, and palm strikes, each movement clearly separated, arms short and close to the body, elbows not excessively flared. The camera orbits the protagonist and dummy about 90 degrees (Slow Orbit), showing the palm brushing the rough wood grain, slight vibration of the wooden arms, and sweat dripping down the cheek. The protagonist's gaze is locked on the center of the dummy, shoulders relaxed, lips slightly closed, breathing steady; observing distance and rhythm rather than angry flailing. [00:08-00:12] Shot 3: Slow to fast · Progressive acceleration. Low drum beats enter, the practice speed increases layer by layer. First set: Moderate speed, left hand dissolves arm, right palm strikes center. Second set: Visibly faster, Bong Sau to Pak Sau, followed by two short punches. Third set: Highest speed, left and right hands alternate rapidly, punches and palms crossing along the centerline, combined with small turns and ground-hugging footwork to the side of the dummy. Low-angle Steadicam Orbit from behind to the side-front; foreground wooden arms flash past, background windows and sunlight form slight speed trails. Movement gets faster, but the body doesn't sway, face remains steady, only breathing becomes heavier and gaze more focused. The dummy vibrates constantly with dense wood sounds, remaining intact. [00:12-00:14] Shot 4: Sudden stop · Locking on the dummy (Sudden Silence). After the high-speed combo, hands suddenly stop. All drums, strikes, and camera movement stop simultaneously. Fixed front medium shot: The protagonist stands before the dummy, feet unmoving, left hand retracted to chest, right hand hanging naturally. The dummy is still vibrating slightly, a few wood chips fall. Close-up of face: The protagonist slowly lifts eyes, locking gaze on the center of the dummy; lips tighten slightly, taking a deep breath. The scene remains quiet, pausing for the final one-inch punch. [00:14-00:17] Shot 5: Open palm approach · Clenching fist to store energy (Open Palm to Fist). Side medium-close shot: The protagonist slowly raises the right hand, fingers fully spread, palm facing the center of the dummy. Must clearly show a fully open palm first, not a fist. Body stable, right hand approaches the dummy very slowly; as the palm gets closer, the camera follows. Extreme Close-up: The open palm stops about one inch from the dummy, not touching, fingers naturally extended, palm, knuckles, and rough wood grain clearly visible. After a short pause, the fist clenches: pinky curls first, then ring and middle, index follows, thumb finally presses down. Fingers tighten completely from open palm to vertical fist. During clenching, the arm must not pull back; the distance remains one inch. Muscles and veins in the forearm tighten slightly, shoulders down, body doesn't lean forward. Sound is only skin friction and slow inhalation. [00:17-00:20] Shot 6: One-Inch Punch impact · Dummy shatters (One-Inch Punch). Extreme side close-up: The clenched right fist is one inch from the center. Still for 0.3s. Protagonist exhales sharply, the fist impacts from the close distance instantly; no pulling back, no big swing, moves only a few centimeters, clean hit. The impact must be a short, fast, concentrated explosion: Open palm approaches -> fingers clench -> store energy in place -> sudden impact from one inch. Do not combine into a normal punch. A heavy bang at contact. The dummy vibrates violently, radial cracks appear at the hit point; the thick body shatters into pieces, arms and leg fall off. Super Slow-mo for the shatter: Morning light illuminates flipping chips and heavy wood blocks falling with crack and thud sounds. No fire, smoke, or energy waves. Protagonist's fist remains at the center, body stable, not falling forward or bouncing back. Final 0.6s returns to normal speed: protagonist retracts fist, returns to Man Sau position, calmly watching the debris. Slow Pull-back to a frame of protagonist, shattered dummy, debris, and morning dust. [One-Inch Punch Hard Requirements] Must be split into 5 stages: 1. Fully open palm. 2. Approach slowly. 3. Stop at one inch. 4. Fingers clench sequentially and store energy. 5. Sudden impact. Must see the process of open palm and clenching. No starting with a fist, no pulling back, no skipping the clench, no long-distance punch, no hitting early, must pause after clenching before impact. [Director Constraints] Only one protagonist, strictly follow Image 1. Dummy always has 3 arms, 1 leg. Dummy stays intact until 17s. No boxing swings, hooks, big wind-ups, flying kicks, or acrobatics. No clipping through wood. No extra fingers, missing fingers, or deformations. No magic effects, glowing fists, shockwaves, or manga lines. No glass/foam/rubber texture for wood. No shouting or celebrating. No other characters, dialogue, titles, logos, or watermarks.

entries.title: Gym Vlog Continuous Dialogue
entries.description: A selfie-vlog style prompt designed for continuous talking and consistent character movement in a gym setting.
entries.prompt:
15-Second Gym Vlog — Continuous Dialogue

Character: The same young adult woman throughout the entire video, wearing a black T-shirt and sporty gym pants. Keep her face, hairstyle, outfit, and appearance consistent from beginning to end.

Scene: A realistic modern gym vlog. From the very first frame, the woman is already talking directly to the camera while walking through the gym. She keeps speaking continuously throughout the entire 15-second video—no silent moments and no voice-over.

0–5 sec: She walks toward the camera in selfie-vlog style, smiling naturally and talking directly to the viewer. Gym equipment and people working out are visible in the background.

Dialogue:

"Hey guys! I'm at the gym today, and I'm going to show you a little bit of my workout."

5–10 sec: While continuing to talk, she reaches the dumbbell area, picks up a moderate-sized dumbbell with one hand, briefly lifts it in a natural demonstration, and keeps speaking to the camera.

Dialogue:

"I usually start with some simple exercises like this, just to get warmed up."

10–15 sec: Still holding the dumbbell briefly, she looks at the camera and continues talking with a friendly smile, then places it back naturally.

Dialogue:

"Alright, let's get started and make this workout a good one!"

Important: Continuous talking from start to finish, natural lip-sync matching every word, no narration, no sudden cuts, no change of character or clothing. The same reference character must remain consistent throughout. Realistic gym environment, natural body movement, handheld smartphone vlog style, cinematic 4K quality.

entries.title: BBC Style Qilin Documentary
entries.description: A 10-second continuous nature documentary-style prompt for Seedance 2.5, depicting a Qilin in a prehistoric valley with high cinematic realism and realistic biological movement.
entries.prompt:
保持首帧中麒麟的外形、身体比例、四肢位置、鹿角结构、鳞片分布和整体环境完全一致。

10秒连续自然纪录片镜头，无切镜。

巨大的麒麟安静地站在史前山谷河岸，身体保持原位，不行走，不转身。它缓慢而沉重地呼吸，胸腔和腹部出现非常轻微的起伏；头部只有极小幅度的自然运动，双耳偶尔轻轻转动，眼睛缓慢眨动一次。长鬃毛和颈部毛发受到山谷微风影响缓慢飘动，背部深绿色鳞片随呼吸产生极细微的肌肉牵动。

河边的小型动物自然活动，有的低头饮水，有的缓慢走动几步，但绝不惊慌奔跑。水面持续缓慢流动，产生细小涟漪和真实倒影。山谷中的薄雾从树林和麒麟腿部之间缓慢漂移，远处树叶受到轻风影响轻微晃动。

摄影机位于低机位远处，使用70mm自然纪录片长焦摄影，极其缓慢地向麒麟推进，同时只有非常轻微的向右横移，形成克制的视差，让麒麟巨大的身体与远处山谷产生层次变化。

麒麟始终是画面唯一的绝对主体，保持真实大型生物的重量感，不做夸张动作，不发光，不产生魔法效果。

真实野生动物纪录片，BBC / IMAX自然历史摄影质感，真实生物运动，真实肌肉重量，空气透视，晨间柔光，细微风吹毛发，70mm IMAX film，庄严、安静、神秘。
entries.translated_prompt:
Maintain the Qilin's appearance, body proportions, limb positions, antler structure, scale distribution, and overall environment exactly as shown in the first frame.

10-second continuous natural documentary shot, no cuts.

A massive Qilin stands quietly on a prehistoric valley riverbank, staying in place, not walking or turning. it breathes slowly and heavily, with very slight rises and falls in the chest and abdomen; the head has only tiny natural movements, ears occasionally twitch slightly, and eyes blink slowly once. Long mane and neck hair sway slowly in the valley breeze, and the deep green scales on the back show tiny muscular ripples with each breath.

Small animals by the river move naturally, some lowering their heads to drink, others taking a few slow steps, but never running in panic. The water surface flows continuously and slowly, producing tiny ripples and realistic reflections. Mist in the valley drifts slowly between the woods and the Qilin's legs, and distant leaves sway slightly in the breeze.

The camera is at a low angle in the distance, using a 70mm natural documentary telephoto lens, moving extremely slowly towards the Qilin, with only a very slight rightward pan, creating restrained parallax that reveals the depth between the Qilin's massive body and the distant valley.

The Qilin remains the absolute single subject of the frame, maintaining the weight of a real large creature, without exaggerated movements, no glowing, and no magical effects.

Real wildlife documentary, BBC / IMAX natural history photography quality, realistic biological movement, realistic muscle weight, atmospheric perspective, morning soft light, subtle wind-blown hair, 70mm IMAX film, solemn, quiet, mysterious.

entries.title: Giant Hand Dressing Up Girl Video
entries.description: A creative prompt for a high-quality video showing a giant human hand interacting with a young girl as if dressing up a doll in a cozy living room.
entries.prompt:
生成一段21秒、9:16竖屏、超真实电影级视频。

【场景】
明亮温馨的现代米色客厅。
白色布艺沙发、原木边柜、绿植盆栽、编织地毯、落地窗透进柔和自然光。
暖米色调，干净明亮，轻微景深，高清写实质感。

【人物】
一位年轻东亚女孩（约5-8岁），长棕发带刘海，五官精致可爱，皮肤白皙，表情自然生动。
全程站在地毯中央，保持同一张脸、同一发型、同一身材比例。
动作轻微带有娃娃般的配合感，但表情真实：惊讶、害羞微笑、开心等。

【核心机制】
一双巨大真实人类手（正常人手尺寸，相对女孩像巨人）从画面上方或侧面伸入，像给娃娃换衣服一样操作她。
手部动作自然、精准、流畅，无多余手指、无畸形。
女孩全程被手摆弄时身体轻微晃动配合，但始终站立居中。

【时间线与换装】

0-2秒：开场
女孩穿着蓝米色格纹小熊印花睡衣套装（上衣+长裤+白袜），双臂微微张开，嘴巴惊讶成O型，轻微悬浮感。
巨手从上方捏住她头顶，像检查新娃娃。

2-4秒：脱掉上衣
巨手捏住睡衣上衣肩部，向上提起整件脱掉。
女孩配合举起双臂，露出米白色背心。
巨手把睡衣上衣移出画面。

4-6秒：脱掉裤子
巨手从下方把格纹长裤向下拉掉。
女孩现在只穿米白色背心+同色高腰短裤内裤，光脚站立。
巨手拿起一件米白色针织开衫（胸口和口袋有可爱小狗刺绣），从头顶套下，帮她穿好。
女孩闭眼微笑。

6-8秒：穿开衫完成
开衫穿好，女孩低头看自己，开心微笑。
巨手从画面右侧伸入，拿起一条橄榄绿工装短裤，帮她穿上。

8-11秒：穿短裤+袜子
短裤穿好，女孩双臂微张展示。
巨手拿来一双彩虹条纹堆堆袜，帮她穿上。

11-13秒：穿靴子
巨手拿来一双米色毛茸平台雪地靴（Ugg风格），帮她穿上。
女孩站稳，表情期待。

13-15秒：戴帽子
巨手拿来一顶米白色镂空针织毛线帽，轻轻戴在她头上。
女孩嘴巴微张惊讶。

15-17秒：拿包
巨手拿来一个棕色皮质手提包，递给她。
女孩用左手接过，自然握住。

17-21秒：最终展示
全套穿搭完成：米白小狗刺绣开衫 + 橄榄绿工装短裤 + 彩虹堆堆袜 + 米色毛靴 + 白针织帽 + 棕色手提包。
女孩双手微微张开，开心微笑看向镜头，轻微左右晃动展示。
巨手从画面右侧轻轻指向她，像在说“完成了”。
最后定格可爱姿势。

【镜头】
固定正面中全景，轻微电影级手持呼吸感。
女孩始终居中全身可见。
巨手进出画面自然，无遮挡关键面部。

【光线与质感】
柔和自然窗光，暖米色调，真实皮肤纹理、布料细节、毛线质感清晰。
超高清写实，无美颜过度，无塑料感。

【音频】
无音乐。
仅轻微房间环境音 + 细微布料摩擦声、手部动作声。
保持安静治愈氛围。

【严格约束】
- 女孩脸型、发型、身材全程100%一致，禁止换脸
- 巨手始终是真实人类手，比例正确，五指完整自然
- 服装逐件叠加，动作连续流畅，无瞬移
- 禁止多余人物、畸形肢体、手指异常、文字、水印、字幕
- 女孩始终保持娃娃比例，场景比例固定

entries.translated_prompt: Seedance 2.0 | 15-second short film "Shadow Play" I. Generation Goal Generate a complete continuous 15-second cinematic Chinese urban fantasy short film titled "Shadow Play". Overall features: cinematic realistic texture, fusion of traditional Chinese shadow puppetry aesthetics, silent film style spatial comedy, restrained/deadpan performance, contrast between warm yellow sodium lamps and cold blue night colors, clear depth of field. A twist in the last 5 seconds redefines the purpose of the entire "battle". II. Core Creativity This is not a real life-and-death duel. For the first 10 seconds, viewers will think two women are engaged in an epic, oriental-style fantasy shadow duel. The final 5 seconds reveal that they are actually using physical actions and projection relationships to perform a "shadow play" for an unseen child upstairs. The twist must be established through: physical actions that remain small, precise, and restrained while the wall shadows are exaggerated; a child's voiceover redefines the purpose; comedy stems from the contrast between "epic momentum" and "children's game needs". III. Workflow & Technical Preferences Organized for Seedance 2.0 multi-modal reference: supports image, audio, and video references; director-level control over performance, lighting, shadows, and camera movement. Focus on: stable character identities, stable shadow geometry, continuity of sword and bicycle, stable wall projection logic, Mandarin lip-sync, and clear cause-effect between physical and shadow actions. IV. Character Identity Anchors Character ID A (@Image1) - Sword Sister: 25-30 years old, East Asian, oval face, fair skin, sharp brown eyes, long black hair, tall/slender, white hanfu with translucent sleeves, silver sword. Temperament: calm, restrained, serious. Character ID B (@Image2) - Bicycle Sister: 25-30 years old, East Asian, ponytail, yellow jacket, blue jeans, white sneakers, same bicycle. Temperament: tacit cooperation, serious, restrained, deadpan humor at the end. V. Environment Setting Scene: narrow alley in an old town after rain. Elements: rough white plaster wall, wet slate road, warm yellow sodium street lamp, overhead wires, bamboo leaf shadows, flowing mist, reflections in puddles, a bicycle. Lighting: warm yellow sodium lamp as main source, cold blue night as ambient base. Shadows on the wall must be clear, huge, and readable. VI. Environmental Movement Principles Background must stay alive but neutral. Allowed movements: flowing mist, slight vibration of wires, swaying bamboo shadows, changing puddle reflections, hair/fabric responding to movement. Prohibited: sudden background shifts, wall deformation, street lamp jumping, bicycle disappearing, shadows detaching from light logic or人物动作, purely special-effect animation. VII. Shot Structure 0-5s | Shot 1 | Wide Fixed + Slow Dolly: Establish spatial relationship and misleading "battle atmosphere". Huge shadows on the white wall look like ancient masters about to fight. 5-10s | Shot 2 | Cowboy/Medium Shot | Smooth Lateral Tracking: Juxtapose "small real actions" with "epic wall battle". Real movements are small while shadows transform into a giant silver dragon and a phoenix-like beast made of wheels. VIII. Acting Principles Overall: restrained, not slapstick. Character A: serious, deadpan, suppressing a smile at the end. Character B: tacit cooperation, low-key funny remark at the end. Child (voiceover): natural, happy, innocent tone. IX. Photography & Visual Control Style: 16:9, 24fps, Arri Alexa cinematic texture, sharp, natural volumetric light, clear depth. Shots: wide dolly, smooth lateral track, close-up to extreme close-up. No aerial shots, shaky cam, or AI morphing. X. Continuity Requirements Must maintain stability of: character identities, faces, costumes, props (sword/bicycle), lighting, alley structure, night color temperature, shadow geometry, and physical relationships of hair/mist/reflections. XI. Final Product Requirements Total duration: 15 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio, three clean shots, native sync environmental/action sound, accurate Mandarin lip-sync, no subtitles, watermarks, or random text. entries.prompt:
Seedance 2.0 Fast｜15秒中国仙侠悬疑情感短片

一、生成目标

生成一段完整连续的 15 秒中国仙侠电影短片。

整体要求：

电影级写实质感
纯古风中国仙侠美学
成熟悬疑感
克制的情感温度
以 “物证反转” 作为核心叙事手段
使用优雅古典人物调度
Arri Alexa 电影机质感
清晰稳定的面部微细节
细腻胶片颗粒
自然体积光

二、核心叙事主题

核心共鸣重新定义 “信任”：

真正可信的关系，不是危急时突然喊一句“我相信你”，
而是多年普通相处中，一个人早已在不知不觉间记住了另一个人的小习惯。

本段必须把这个情感落点，建立在一个非常具体、可见、可验证的 物证细节 上：
一条伪造的青绿色剑穗

一个绳结方向与绕法的差异

师姐凭多年观察识破伪造
最后完成“信任不是口头表态，而是长期记得”的情感反转
三、参考与环境设定
人物身份锚点

@图片1 → 剑仙师姐

@图片2 → 小师妹

环境 DNA

本轮所有新上传的背景与地点参考图，共同决定同一套环境 DNA。
正式构图前，先无声推演彼此兼容的：

真实地形

建筑语言

空间尺度

材质年代
植被
水体
天气
云层
山雾运动
主光方向
反射关系
整体彩色与空气纵深
真实通行动线
然后重新规划成本轮独有、完整统一的新空间。
四、环境运动原则
背景必须持续鲜活，但在叙事上绝对中立。

允许持续存在的自然运动

水体持续流动

山雾按真实地形游走

植被以不同幅度响应自然风

云层与倒影缓慢变化

远处弟子保持极轻微自然活动
空间环境声持续存在
必须禁止
环境主动制造谜团
环境主动破解谜团
环境替人物给出答案

环境为了剧情刻意同步变化

背景冻结
远景静止
视差消失
五、角色设定
角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐｜@图片1
始终保持同一个人物身份与外观：
25–30 岁东亚女性

椭圆白皙面庞

深色杏眼

黑色长发半挽

以白玉簪固定

身材高挑纤细
从白色布靴到半透明宽袖，始终穿同一套白色刺绣真丝汉服
银色腰封
玉佩
唯一一柄银色长剑
人物气质要求：
平静
克制
观察力极强
不轻易替人辩解

一旦开口，判断极稳

角色 ID B｜小师妹｜@图片2
始终保持同一个人物身份与外观：
20–25 岁东亚女性
圆润灵动的脸
黑发编辫

身形娇小

同一套青绿色亚麻汉服

深色腰带

木簪
黑色布鞋
唯一一柄深色钢剑
人物气质要求：
起初克制、自辩简短
中段被师姐识破伪证的方式真正触动
结尾出现极轻、明显释然的笑意
配角设定
敌方剑客

已被擒

负责抛出伪造物证
前期神情笃定
后期逐渐失去把握

年长师父

与两名弟子同处现场

提出关键质问

是社会判断与权威视角的见证者
结尾将目光从小师妹转向敌人，形成无声定性
两名弟子
只作为次要见证者存在

保持稳定站位与轻微自然活动

不抢戏
六、核心道具
青绿色剑穗
必须全程保持连续性：

同一条青绿色剑穗

由敌方剑客抛出
后由师姐拾起并检查
绳结细节必须清楚可拍

能够明确表现：
绕法
尾端方向
伪造感

这一道具是整段反转成立的核心，绝不能模糊、变形、消失或切镜后改变样式。

七、镜头结构

0–5s｜全景或远景｜抛出物证，怀疑指向小师妹

画面内容
保持同一个师姐、同一个小师妹、同一个敌人、同一个年长师父、两名弟子，以及完全一致的地理空间。
一名被擒的敌方剑客，突然把 一条青绿色剑穗 扔到年长师父和两名弟子面前，说道：
“昨夜开阵门的人，留下了这个。”
叙事要求

所有人的目光瞬间转向同一个小师妹
小师妹只简短说一句：
"不是我。"

同一个白衣剑仙 不要立刻替她辩解

她只是安静俯身捡起那条剑穗

本段重点

建立怀疑

建立物证

建立“所有人先看向小师妹”的外部压力

建立师姐的沉静与不急于发声

5–10s｜中景或牛仔景｜从“信她”转为“识物证”

画面内容

保持同样两名女子、同样服装、同一个敌人、同一个师父，同一条剑穗和完全一致的地理空间。
年长师父看向师姐，问：

“你信她？”

师姐低头检查剑穗上的绳结，平静回答：
“这不是她系的。”

敌人冷笑：

“一个结而已，你凭什么？”
动作要求
同一个剑仙师姐用手指轻轻转动剑穗，让绳结细节清楚进入画面。
然后平静说明：

“她的结绕两圈，尾端永远朝左。”

同一个小师妹第一次真正愣住，问：

“你怎么知道？”

师姐只回答：

“看了七年。”

本段重点

必须把“物证反转”建立在清楚可拍的动作和细节上

手指检查绳结的动作要真实、清楚、克制

不靠解释性表演，而是靠道具细节与简短对白完成反转

10–15s｜特写或极近特写｜信任落点成立

画面内容

同一个敌人原本笃定的神情逐渐消失。

同一个剑仙师姐把这条 伪造的剑穗 放入师父掌心，平静说道：

“我信的不是她这一句话。”

完整保留一个有重量的半拍。

随后她真正看向同一个小师妹：

“是这七年。”

小师妹眼神明显柔软下来，轻声问：

“你连这个都记得？”

师姐面不改色地回答：
“你每天重系三遍，很难不记。”
收束

极近特写：

小师妹终于压不住一个极轻、带明显释然的笑

浅景深后方，同一个师父缓慢把目光从她身上移向敌人

同一个敌人则逐渐垂下眼睛

本段重点

情绪要轻，不煽情

师姐不能突然热烈表达

小师妹的触动必须来自“原来你一直记得”

最后以极轻的笑意结束，而不是大起大落
entries.translated_prompt:
Seedance 2.0 Fast | 15s Chinese Xianxia Suspense Emotional Short Film

I. Generation Goal
Generate a continuous 15-second Xianxia cinematic film. Style: Realistic texture, suspenseful, restrained emotional temperature, "physical evidence reversal" as core narrative tool.

II. Core Theme
Redefining "Trust" through high observation: trust is not a verbal declaration but remembering habits. The Senior Sister identifies a forged sword tassel knot because she knows the Junior Sister's specific way of tying it.

III. Characters
Character A (Image 1): Senior Sister, 25-30, calm, observant, firm judgment.
Character B (Image 2): Junior Sister, 20-25, round face, green linen hanfu, moved by the sister's observation.

IV. Timeline
0-5s: Enemy throws a green sword tassel as evidence against Junior Sister. All look at her. Senior Sister picks it up silently.
5-10s: Master asks if she trusts her. Senior Sister examines the knot and says "This isn't hers," explaining the specific tying habit. Junior Sister is shocked she knows.
10-15s: Senior Sister returns the forgery, stating she trusts the past seven years of observation, not just words. Junior Sister smiles with relief. Master turns his gaze to the enemy.

entries.title: Emotional Bedroom Dialogue Scene
entries.description: A detailed 30-second cinematic prompt focusing on vulnerability and fear between a couple in a bedroom setting, featuring specific character reactions and lighting instructions.
entries.prompt:
[PROJECT TYPE] Text-to-video. 30-second dialogue scene. Vulnerability and fear.

[Global Setting] Modern bedroom at night. Soft warm lamplight. Both lying in bed. 
Intimate but vulnerable atmosphere. Quiet, introspective setting.

[Character 1  The Woman] Mid-30s, dark long hair, wearing soft shirt. Calm but 
visibly carrying emotional weight. Eyes reflect vulnerability and fear.

[Character 2 The Man] Mid-30s, short dark hair, wearing casual shirt. Warm 
expression, patient, listening presence.

[Opening, 0–3s] Wide shot of bedroom. Both lying in bed facing each other, close 
but not touching yet. Woman stares at him with fear in her eyes. Long pause. She 
takes a breath and says quietly: "I'm scared you're going to leave me." Her voice 
is small, trembling, raw with vulnerability. Man doesn't respond immediately 
just holds her gaze.

[Reaction Moment, 3–10s] Man's expression softens with tenderness. He reaches out 
slowly and touches her face with his hand, thumb brushing her cheek gently. He 
says quietly but firmly: "I'm not going anywhere." Woman's eyes fill with tears. 
He continues: "I promise." His voice is steady, certain, safe. Woman nods slightly, 
tears falling.

[Connection, 10–20s] Man moves closer, pulls her into his chest. Woman wraps her 
arms around him, holding tight. They hold each other in silence for a moment. 
Then she whispers into his chest: "Don't ever leave me." Man responds softly, 
into her hair: "Never. I've got you." He holds her tighter. Both breathing slowly, 
finding calm in each other's presence. Lamplight catches their faces  vulnerable 
but safe.

[Final Moment, 20–30s] They pull back slightly to face each other again. Woman's 
tears are still visible but her breathing is calmer. Man wipes her tears gently 
with his thumb. He looks directly into her eyes and says softly: "You're safe with 
me. Always." Woman nods, fear slowly releasing from her face, replaced by trust. 
She leans forward and kisses him soft, tender, vulnerable. They hold the kiss 
for a moment. Pull back slightly, foreheads touching, both eyes closed. Breathing 
together in shared safety and love.

[Audio] Soft ambient sound  gentle breathing, heartbeats subtle underneath, 
barely perceptible, intimate. Maybe one sustained soft string note or piano pad. 
Very minimal. Mostly silence and breathing. The quiet is sacred. No dialogue 
overlap space between words.

[Tone] Intimate, tender, vulnerable but safe. Fear acknowledged and met with love. 
Deep emotional connection. This is about being truly seen and accepted at your 
most fragile.

[Consistency]
— Same couple throughout
— Warm soft bedroom lighting
— Intimate bed setting
— Emotions: fear → acceptance → safety → trust
— Physical connection: eye contact → touch → embrace → forehead touch
— Both equally vulnerable and present

entries.title: Supernatural Assassin Fortress Infiltration
entries.description: A high-end Hollywood action prompt for a stealthy assassin infiltration featuring supernatural phase-dodge effects.
entries.prompt:
Duration: 14 Seconds | Aspect Ratio: 16:9
STYLE: Ultra-photorealistic REAL LIVE-ACTION, AAA Hollywood supernatural assassin action, premium realistic Semi-CGI VFX, ARRI ALEXA 65, IMAX, Panavision anamorphic. Fast controlled choreography, brief micro slow-motion ONLY for phase-dodge.

CHARACTER: @Image1 = KAIA. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, body proportions and ORIGINAL CLOTHING. TWIN CURVED DAGGERS. Personality: COLD, FOCUSED, EFFICIENT, UNHURRIED—never frantic.

LOCATION: Night atop a snowbound mountain fortress: stone battlements, frost-slick walkways, watchtowers, torch braziers under a full moon. Sentries patrol separately. Fortress stays quiet—NO alarm, crowd, or large battle.

00:00–00:03 — SILENT HUNT

Camera already moving, low handheld pursuit behind Kaia as she crosses a frosted walkway. Two sentries patrol ahead along the battlement. She waits, motionless in shadow, until one turns his back.

WHOOM— short burst of SWIRLING SNOW-ASH. Kaia's REAL BODY physically accelerates past him, trailing translucent frost-grey afterimages. She stops at blade range behind him.

SHK-SHK— TWO precise dagger strikes. She catches and quietly lowers him. The second sentry begins turning—Kaia is already gone.

00:03–00:06 — BLIND SPOT

Camera slides around a watchtower as the second sentry scans the dark, breath visible in the cold. Kaia silently emerges from his blind spot, pins his weapon arm—

SHK-SHK. TWO precise strikes. She quietly lowers him and looks toward three sentries near the gatehouse, expression unreadable.

00:06–00:08 — PHASE-DODGE

Kaia crosses silently behind the gatehouse sentries. One unexpectedly notices and swings at her FROM BEHIND.

Camera rushes toward the incoming blade—MICRO SLOW-MOTION. Just before impact, Kaia's physical body visibly DISSOLVES into DRIFTING SNOW-ASH and pale moonlit vapor. The blade passes harmlessly THROUGH her swirling form.

TIME SNAP—WHOOSH! The ash sweeps around the attacker as camera performs a curved whip-pan. Kaia visibly REFORMS directly behind him—feet → torso → arms → face → TWIN DAGGERS.

He turns too late.

CROSS-SLASH. ONE precise counter. Tiny camera impact bump. Kaia catches and silently lowers him.

00:08–00:11 — ASSASSIN CHAIN

Two sentries remain. Kaia disappears behind a brazier instead of charging.

One passes—snow-ash curls behind him. Kaia emerges: TWO STRIKES, catches him, then slips back into shadow.

Final sentry sees a fading translucent afterimage and follows it, sword raised. Camera rotates around him—the REAL Kaia is already in his blind spot.

SHK-SHK. ONE controlled exchange. She catches and quietly lowers the FINAL SENTRY.

ALL ENEMIES ARE DEFEATED. NONE REMAIN.

00:11–00:14 — SILENT AFTERMATH

Absolute quiet. Camera tracks backward along the battlement, slower than before. All defeated sentries lie silently along Kaia's infiltration path. Braziers still burn; gates remain intact; NO alarm.

Kaia calmly wipes her TWIN DAGGERS and sheathes them.

CLICK.

Her eyes shift toward distant torchlight. Snow-ash curls around her feet.

WHOOM— Kaia silently bursts into the storm. Camera rushes after her but catches only translucent frost-grey afterimages fading into the blizzard, then holds on empty, drifting snow.

END.

CORE ASSASSIN LOGIC

OBSERVE → BLIND SPOT → SILENT APPROACH → PRECISE STRIKE → CONTROL FALL → DISENGAGE → NEXT TARGET.

Never frontal brawling or prolonged blade exchanges.

PHASE-DODGE: Incoming attack → micro slow-motion → blade almost connects → Kaia visibly dissolves into snow-ash → attack passes through → ash travels around attacker → Kaia visibly reforms at blind spot → precise counter. Use ONLY when directly attacked; do not spam.

VFX / CAMERA / AUDIO

Speed VFX: Drifting snow-ash + pale moonlit vapor + translucent frost-grey afterimages. During normal bursts, REAL Kaia always physically leads; VFX trails behind. Phase-dodge requires visible dissolve → ash travel → physical reformation. NO lightning, electrical arcs, or teleportation.

Camera: NEVER static. Low pursuit, over-shoulder stalking, watchtower reveals, close reactions, reactive whip-pans, curved tracking. FAST during eliminations, immediately CALM afterward: QUIET → FAST → QUIET → FAST → QUIET.

Audio: Wind, distant howling, torch crackle, soft footsteps on snow, fabric movement, subtle ash WHOOSH, dagger draw/impact, controlled body movement. No loud battle music or alarms.

NEGATIVE: No frontal mass battle, prolonged blade exchange, running fight, lightning/electricity, teleportation, excessive phase-dodge, explosions/destruction, static camera, robotic movement, air-gap dagger hits, surviving enemies, face/body/clothing/dagger drift, broken anatomy, full-3D/game look, subtitles, logo, watermark.
