光线与空气层次持续自然演化

八、Negative

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props
entries.translated_prompt:
Seedance Prompt | Dual-way Stubborn Apology Reversal

I. Project Positioning

Movie-level photorealistic quality, pure ancient Chinese Xianxia aesthetics, restrained relational comedy, elegant classical character blocking, Arri Alexa cinematic texture, clear and stable facial details, fine film grain, and natural volumetric lighting.

The core reversal of this segment is:
Two very proud people both actually want to apologize first, but neither is willing to admit they are apologizing.

The plot can only be driven by the characters' own intentions, dialogue, actions, and rhythm.
The environment is always an independently running, real-existing living world, but it must remain narratively neutral: does not actively trigger plot, solve problems, change character goals, create reversals, or express emotions for the characters.

II. Reference Controls
1. Character Reference
@Image 1: Used only as the identity anchor for Character ID A, the Sword Immortal Senior Sister.
@Image 2: Used only as the identity anchor for Character ID B, the Junior Sister.

2. Environmental Reference
All newly uploaded background and location reference images jointly determine the same environmental DNA. Before formal composition, silently deduce and integrate: actual terrain, architectural language, spatial scale, material age, vegetation ecology, water system flow, weather state, cloud and mist density, main light direction, reflection relationships, overall color system, atmospheric depth, and real walkable routes. Then recombine into a unique, complete, and unified new space that has never appeared before.

III. Character Settings
Character ID A | Sword Immortal Senior Sister
Same @Image 1 sister. 25–30 year old East Asian female, oval face, fair natural skin tone, dark almond eyes, black long hair half-tied with a white jade hairpin, tall and slender.
Always wears the same outfit: white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver waistband, jade pendant, white cloth boots. Carries a unique silver longsword.

Character ID B | Junior Sister
Same @Image 2 sister. 20–25 year old East Asian female, rounded and lively face, black hair braided, petite stature.
Always wears the same outfit: bluish-green linen Hanfu, dark belt, wooden hairpin, black cloth shoes. Carries a unique dark steel sword.

IV. Core Props
The following props must be kept strictly consistent throughout:
One unique white jade sword tassel, one unique repaired white wrist guard, Character A's silver sword, Character B's dark steel sword.

V. Storyboard Script
0–5s | Wide or Long Shot
In the location replanned according to the reference images, the same two women walk from opposite directions and stop three steps apart. Clearly having just had a quarrel, both intentionally avoid direct eye contact. The same white-clothed sister silently places the jade sword tassel on the stone surface between them, saying in a deliberately cold tone: 'Your tassel was too old yesterday, it affects your swordplay.' Almost simultaneously, the same green-clothed junior sister also places the repaired white wrist guard next to it, answering stiffly: 'Your wrist guard was also torn, it affects your drawing of the sword.'
Requirements: Both visible from head to toe, spatial relationship clear, sense of awkwardness after a fight explicit.

5–10s | Medium or Cowboy Shot
Maintain same characters, outfits, items, and geography. Both glance at the item the other put down, then immediately look away as if nothing happened. The white-clothed woman pushes the tassel two inches closer, saying calmly: 'I just happened to change it.' The green-clothed woman also pushes the wrist guard back, answering: 'I also just happened to sew it.' Pause for a beat. The moment the white-clothed woman reaches for the wrist guard, the junior sister also reaches for the tassel; their hands almost touch, then both quickly withdraw and pretend to look at distant scenery.

10–15s | Close-up or Extreme Close-up
The junior sister finally picks up the tassel and ties it to her dark steel sword, whispering: 'So... about yesterday?' The senior sister lowers her head to tie the wrist guard, not looking up, answering calmly: 'What about it?' The junior sister pauses, finally understands, and answers: 'Nothing.' They look at each other briefly for the first time. Extreme close-up: The senior sister notices the junior sister tied the tassel backward; she silently reaches out to turn it the right way, then immediately pulls back. The junior sister tries to suppress a smile, whispering: 'You just never speak properly.' The sister answers almost inaudibly: 'As long as you understand.'

VI. Technical Specs
Total duration: 15 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape. Three continuous clear shots. Native synchronized Mandarin dialogue. Lip-sync precise with dialogue. No subtitles. Only two visible characters throughout. Consistency in face, clothing, props, and geography. Real movement in hands, silk, water, and air.

VII. Performance & Blocking
Characters: Both smart, restrained, dignified. Mature stubbornness rather than childish fighting. Intent to apologize is clear but language avoids 'sorry'. Comedy comes from misaligned expression and synchronized action.
Cinematography: Elegant and restrained. Captured moments: caring while not looking, hands touching/withdrawing, correcting the tassel.
Environment: Living but not scene-stealing.

entries.prompt:
Gritty Cinéma Vérité, handheld tracking cinematography, 35mm natural film grain, soft tropical daylight, authentic documentary energy, subtle camera shake and natural operator breathing. Maldives luxury island resort, turquoise lagoon, white sand, lush palms, wooden villas and busy resort paths.

SHOT PRIORITY:
The camera must NEVER follow her from directly behind. Keep her face and front/side profile visible throughout. Primary perspective is a FRONT 3/4 TRACKING SHOT, with the camera moving backward ahead of her bicycle at matching speed. Secondary angles are FRONT-SIDE and PURE SIDE TRACKING. Camera remains physically close enough to capture facial expression, hair movement and natural body motion. No rear-view hero shots.

CHARACTER:
A beautiful young adult woman with sun-kissed skin, long flowing dark hair, wearing a minimal black high-cut swimsuit and light sandals, riding a simple white beach bicycle at a casual natural pace. Relaxed posture, soft smile, effortless expression. Hair and swimsuit fabric react naturally to the ocean breeze and bicycle movement. Stable facial identity and consistent wardrobe across every shot.

TIMELINE:

0-2s: [FRONT 3/4 TRACKING] Camera moves backward smoothly in front of her as she rides out from a wooden villa path. Her face is clearly visible. A staff member in white uniform passes in the background carrying a drinks tray and waves. Two tourists in colourful wraps walk past laughing.

2-4s: [FRONT-SIDE TRACKING] Camera shifts slightly toward her left/front side while maintaining eye contact and visible facial profile. The path opens toward a lagoon boardwalk. A giant tortoise slowly crosses ahead of her bicycle. She naturally slows and steers around it. A parrot flies low across the frame.

4-6s: [DYNAMIC FRONT TRACKING] Camera continues moving backward ahead of her as she gently accelerates past a small open restaurant. Waiters carry plates, guests turn and smile. In the lagoon behind her, a manta ray leaps from the water with a large realistic splash.

6-8s: [SIDE-FRONT TRACKING] Camera moves parallel to her front half, keeping her face visible while the sandy palm-lined path passes behind. Two giant tortoises cross in the deeper background. A whale breaches far across the lagoon, creating a tall spray.

8-10s: [FRONT 3/4 TRACKING] She rides toward camera at a relaxed pace. A group of tourists taking selfies appears behind her; one points toward the lagoon. Another manta ray jumps almost parallel to her. A resort golf cart slows behind and gives her space.

10-12s: [CLOSE SIDE TRACKING] Camera travels beside her at shoulder height, capturing her natural smile, wind moving through her hair and detailed fabric motion. The path curves along the water. A large whale surfaces in the background and rolls, its fin cutting through the lagoon. Bright parrots land on a railing and take off.

Character ID A | Senior Sword Immortal
Same as @Image 1.
25–30 year old East Asian female, oval face, fair skin, deep apricot eyes, black long hair half-up, fixed with a white jade hairpin, tall and slender.
Always wears the same outfit:
White embroidered silk Hanfu
Semi-transparent wide sleeves
Silver waist sash
Jade pendant
White cloth boots
Holds the unique silver longsword.

Character ID B | Junior Sister
Same as @Image 2.
20–25 year old East Asian female, round and nimble face, black hair braided, petite stature.
Always wears the same outfit:
Green linen Hanfu
Dark waist belt
Wooden hairpin
Black cloth shoes
Holds the unique dark steel sword.

IV. Storyboard Script

0–5s | Full Shot or Wide Shot
In the location re-planned based on the reference images, the two stop three steps apart.
The same white-clad sword immortal says solemnly:
'Let yesterday's matters end here.'
The same green-clad junior sister's body freezes slightly, and she only answers:
'Okay.'
She then immediately turns to leave.
Requirements:
Both people fully visible from shoes to head.
Clear spatial relationships.
The environment maintains continuous natural motion.
The misunderstanding starts from the semantic difference of the line.

5–10s | Medium Shot or Cowboy Shot
Maintain the same two women, same clothing, same longswords, and exactly the same spatial geographical relationship.
The white-clad woman watches her walk further away, clearly somewhat puzzled, and finally asks:
'Where are you going?'
The green-clad woman stops but doesn't turn around:
'Aren't you expelling me from the sect?'
Preserve a full half-beat pause.
The white-clad woman answers:
'I meant, stop arguing.'
Requirements:
The misunderstanding is clearly revealed in this segment.
Restrained rhythm.
Performance relies on pauses, eye contact, and tone.
The background continues its natural movement but never participates in the formation or resolution of the misunderstanding.

10–15s | Close-up or Extreme Close-up
The same junior sister slowly turns back, her embarrassment only expressed through her eyes and very slight facial changes, saying:
'You should have said so earlier.'
The same senior sister answers calmly:
'I thought you understood.'
The junior sister walks past her, muttering in a low voice:
'Every time you say it like it's a final testament.'
Extreme close-up:
The senior sister's always dignified and restrained expression finally shows a very slight smile.
After the junior sister notices it from the corner of her eye, she also tries to suppress her own smile.
Finally, the two naturally walk away in the same direction side-by-side.
Requirements:
Gentle closing.
The relationship reversal lands on the recovery of tacit understanding between the two.
Do not use exaggerated comedy acting.
The final smile must be very light.

entries.title: Dune 4 Cinematic Sci-Fi Trailer
entries.description: A complex cinematic sci-fi trailer montage prompt for Seedance 2.5, featuring detailed shot breakdowns on a desert planet with dynamic camera movements.
entries.prompt: A 15-second cinematic sci-fi epic movie-trailer montage on a vast desert planet, anamorphic widescreen 21:9, ultra-cinematic large-format look, vintage anamorphic lenses, shallow depth of field, thick atmospheric dust haze, strong horizontal lens flares, warm sand-amber highlights against deep teal shadows, filmic grade, fine 35mm grain, monumental awe-inspiring scale, no on-screen text, no watermark. A sequence of hard cuts like a prestige film trailer. THE CAMERA IS ALWAYS IN MOTION: every shot uses a different angle and a different dynamic camera move — aerial dives, low tracking, orbits, crane rises, FPV rushes — always smooth and cinematic, never shaky amateur footage. SHOT 1 (0.0-2.0s): Camera FALLS SLOWLY DOWN through a near-black cloudscape of golden dust and dark teal atmosphere, a soft horizontal anamorphic streak sweeping past, a glowing horizon rotating slowly far below, embers rushing upward past the lens. Then it SLOWLY DISSOLVES (not a cut) into: SHOT 2 (2.0-4.5s): A slow 90-degree ORBITING ARC around a bald, weathered desert leader in coarse pale robes, starting on his profile and swinging to a tight low-angle front view, sun-cracked skin, calm distant gaze; behind him an endless sea of dunes wheels past out of focus in the haze. Warm rim light travels across his face as the camera circles. SHOT 3 (4.5-5.6s): HARD CUT to a fast low AERIAL DRONE SWEEP racing over rippling dunes toward the exposed edge of a colossal ancient metal hull protruding from the sand like a buried mountain ridge; the camera rushes up its slope and crests it, revealing tiny robed figures on the ridge below. Speed and scale. SHOT 4 (5.6-6.6s): HARD CUT to a hooded engineer-priestess on a pure black background: the camera DESCENDS ON A CRANE from above her head to eye level while slowly circling, one hard side light raking across her as she raises a small glowing amber relic in both hands, dust motes swirling through the beam. Chiaroscuro in motion. SHOT 5 (6.6-7.5s): HARD CUT to a GROUND-LEVEL SKIMMING SHOT: the camera races just above the desert floor through darkness toward a lone robed figure, loose sand grains jumping and vibrating past the lens as the ground trembles, then the camera TILTS UP the figure's silhouette. Low, fast, ominous. SHOT 6 (7.5-8.6s): HARD CUT to an FPV RUSH along a crack tearing open through the desert floor: the camera flies low and fast following the running fracture as dunes avalanche inward on both sides, geysers of sand venting past the lens, robed crowds scattering on the ridges above, dust rolling. Kinetic, accelerating. SHOT 7 (8.6-9.5s): HARD CUT to a STEADICAM TRACKING SHOT pushing through the fleeing crowd behind the heroine in flowing desert robes as she strides against the flow toward the collapse; mid-shot the camera RISES INTO A CRANE MOVE above the crowd as an immense shadow slides across the dunes and swallows her. SHOT 8 (9.5-10.85s): HARD CUT to an extreme close-up of the heroine's face wrapped in a dark desert scarf, only her eyes and cheekbones lit, a bright circular halo of backlight behind her head, soft anamorphic bokeh; the camera SLOWLY SPIRALS a few degrees around her face as her eyes lift upward, widening with awe at something rising off-screen. Emotional center — the one intimate moment amid the motion. SHOT 9 (10.85-12.4s): HARD CUT to THE REVEAL from a RISING AERIAL: the camera craning up alongside a colossal kilometer-long ancient spaceship as it breaches out of the desert, entire waterfalls of sand cascading off its hull and falling PAST THE LENS, rings of dust blasting outward across the dunes below, the low sun flaring behind its silhouette, tiny human figures dwarfed beneath. The camera keeps climbing with the ship, never static. IMAX-scale. RAPID CLIMAX MONTAGE (12.4-15.0s) — a burst of very short hard cuts, roughly 0.3s each, EVERY CUT FROM A COMPLETELY DIFFERENT ANGLE, camera moving in all of them: 12.4s: TOP-DOWN AERIAL plunging toward rows of engine nozzles igniting one by one through the dust, deep orange glow rushing up at the lens. 13.1s: LOW SIDE TRACKING SHOT racing beside a wall-like shockwave of sand as it overtakes silhouetted onlookers on a ridge. 13.6s: EXTREME LOW ANGLE from the desert floor, the ship's silhouette climbing across the sun, lens flare knifing across the frame as the camera tilts up after it. 13.8s: ORBITAL SHOT whipping around the blinding column of thruster fire and sand beneath the rising hull. 14.1s: FPV THROUGH DEBRIS: torn plating and streaming sand whipping past the lens in slow-building force as the camera threads between them. 14.55s: the camera PULLS BACK FAST as the whole frame washes into a glowing golden-red haze of dust and engine fire, the trailer peaks. 15.0s: fade toward black. Consistency: one coherent desert-planet world, one warm-amber-and-teal anamorphic grade, constant fine film grain and dust haze in every shot, monumental scale, prestige-trailer pacing that accelerates into the final montage; the camera never locks off — every shot has smooth cinematic motion and its own distinct angle. Photoreal, no cartoon look, no captions, no logos. Audio: deep sub-bass "braam" trailer horns building in intensity, a low ominous choir swelling, constant desert wind, deep tectonic rumble growing under shots 5-7, then a NEAR-TOTAL SILENCE for half a second just before the reveal — only wind and one heartbeat — followed by a colossal metallic groan and roar as the ship breaches, cascading sand hiss, a sharp sub-bass impact hit on every hard cut, rapid stacked impacts through the climax, full engine thunder at the peak. No dialogue, no lyrics.

entries.title: Korean Woman Rooftop MiniDV Vlog
entries.description: An ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV style video featuring a young Korean woman on a residential rooftop in Seoul.
entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean Woman naturally attractive, realistic skin, minimal makeup, long dark hair loosely tied back. Wearing a faded sage-green oversized sweatshirt, charcoal lounge shorts, white socks, worn house slippers, and a thin silver necklace. Preserve her exact identity and appearance throughout.

Location: Weathered Seoul apartment rooftop in warm late-afternoon light. Concrete walls, rusty pipes, metal cabinets, potted plants, folding table, water containers, drying towels, tangled wires, dense neighboring rooftops, distant high-rises and hazy mountains. Gentle breeze.

Style: Ultra-realistic early-2000s Sony MiniDV home video. Authentic Korean residential details, candid behavior, natural imperfections, faded colors, soft contrast, DV compression, motion blur, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, imperfect framing, handheld shake, occasional accidental zooms. No stabilization or modern cinematic movement.

00:00–00:03: She enters carrying a small cardboard box, places it on the table, and takes out a few household items. The camera briefly points at the floor before finding her.

00:03–00:06: She notices dry leaves on the potted plants and crouches to remove them. Wind blows hair across her face; she casually brushes it away.

00:06–00:09: She waters the plants. The camera accidentally focuses on the water instead of her face. She notices, laughs softly, then continues.

00:09–00:12: She sits at the table, opens a cold canned drink, and quietly looks over the rooftops as laundry moves in the breeze.

00:12–00:15: Someone calls from a neighboring rooftop. She looks over, laughs, then turns back and raises her drink slightly toward the camera. The operator accidentally zooms in too far; autofocus struggles and the video abruptly cuts.

Audio: Natural rooftop ambience only—wind, birds, traffic, water, footsteps, rattling pipes, distant voices and AC units. No music, narration, or added effects.

Goal: Feel like a forgotten personal MiniDV recording from the early 2000s—mundane, intimate, imperfect, spontaneous, and genuinely nostalgic.

This must look like a REAL VIDEO casually recorded on an ordinary smartphone by a real person, NOT a cinematic production, NOT an AI-generated video, NOT a commercial, NOT a travel film.

entries.title: Luxury Skincare Product Commercial Video
entries.description: A photorealistic commercial prompt for a luxury skincare product, featuring a clinical-clean studio aesthetic and macro photography shots.
entries.prompt:
Format: 9:16 vertical | Style: Photorealistic premium skincare commercial

SHOT 1 — Product Introduction | 0–3s

The La Roche-Posay Effaclar Purifying Foaming Gel stands upright on a glossy white acrylic platform in a pristine luxury studio. Soft blue gradient light glows behind the tube.

Slow cinematic push-in with subtle reflections.

Product must remain exactly identical to the reference image: same tube shape, blue color, logo, typography, cap, proportions and packaging text. No redesign.

SHOT 2 — Pick Up Product | 3–5s

Close-up of a feminine hand reaching into frame and gently picking up the Effaclar cleanser.

The camera follows the movement smoothly. Keep the background minimal, white and softly illuminated with blue accents.

Packaging remains sharp, readable and unchanged.

SHOT 3 — Dispensing Cleanser | 5–8s

Macro close-up of the hand squeezing a small amount of cleanser onto the fingertips.

Show the realistic gel texture and subtle glossy highlights. Clean studio lighting, shallow depth of field and slow controlled movement.

SHOT 4 — Half-Face Application | 8–11s

Cut to the woman applying the cleanser to her face.

Only half of her face is visible. Use a tight side-angle crop showing one cheek, part of the jawline and lips. The other half of her face remains completely outside the frame.

She gently massages the cleanser in circular motions as soft white foam develops.

Never show her full face or a frontal portrait.

SHOT 5 — Rinse & Fresh Skin | 11–14s

Extreme close-up from the side as she rinses the cleanser away with clean water.

Only half of her face remains visible. Water droplets move naturally across the cheek, catching soft studio light.

Transition through a subtle water splash/ripple.

SHOT 6 — Final Hero Product | 14–18s

Return to the Effaclar tube standing perfectly centered on the glossy white platform.

A soft blue light sweeps across the background. Subtle water reflections surround the base.

Camera slowly pushes in and ends on the product front, with the packaging fully visible and legible.

Overall aesthetic: luxury French pharmacy skincare campaign, clinical-clean studio, white and soft blue palette, realistic skin texture, elegant feminine hands, cinematic macro photography, soft shadows, controlled highlights, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement, photorealistic 4K.

Negative prompt: full-face reveal, frontal face, recognizable identity, altered packaging, changed logo, incorrect text, warped tube, distorted hands, extra fingers, duplicate product, excessive foam, unrealistic skin, CGI look, cartoon style, cluttered background, watermark.

entries.title: Japanese High School Soda Commercial
entries.description: A comprehensive cinematic storyboard prompt for a Japanese youth-style soda advertisement, focusing on athlete aesthetics, film-like textures, and specific scene-by-scene transitions.
entries.prompt:
基础设定：基于这张分镜故事板的镜头语言和音频信息，生成一段充满日式高校热血运动电影美学与叙事感的 汽水专业商业广告。仅生成音效，不要背景音乐。视觉风格：现代日式青春电影美学，画面模拟 120 中画幅胶片 Medium Format Film 的通透层次，或数字电影机搭配 Black Pro-Mist 柔光滤镜的纯净质感。整体画面干净细腻，颗粒感极弱，不要粗粝胶片噪点。光影设定：使用高调逆光 High-key Backlight 与柔和漫反射环境光，人物边缘有轻微柔光包裹。高光允许轻微溢出 Bloom / Halation，呈现阳光白、淡樱花粉、浅金色的柔和辉光；暗部保持干净通透，带轻微冷青色 Cyan-blue，不要死黑阴影。色彩基调：低对比度、低饱和度、日系治愈调色。整体色彩柔和、明亮、空气感强，肤色自然干净。摄影质感：真实真人电影摄影，浅景深，自然焦点过渡，轻微手持呼吸感，运动镜头柔和流畅。人物动作自然克制，表演以眼神、呼吸、奔跑、停顿和短暂默契表达情绪。画面应像日本热血青春电影，而不是动漫、插画、MV 或偶像写真。

主要角色设定： 角色 A： 黑色短发男高中生，性格沉静，眼神坚定。 角色 B： 微卷深棕色短发男高中生，性格直接、张扬，但不是反派。 角色 C： 齐耳黑色短发女高中生，是篮球社主力后卫，也是全片主要人物。

画面内容：
Scene 01｜0.0–1.5s｜信号 地点： 教学楼走廊。 起始画面： 直接以角色 C 的面部极近特写开场。 她刚刚快速跑动过，额角带有细小汗珠，短发贴在脸侧，呼吸轻微急促。她突然抬起眼睛，锐利地望向画面外。 背景为真实日式高中走廊，浅景深虚化，只能看见模糊的旧窗框、公告栏、磨损墙面和夕阳光带。 结束画面： 镜头稍微拉开至胸部近景。 角色 C 单手抱着篮球，另一只手握着蓝紫色 RAIKU POP 塑料瓶。她迅速转身，朝走廊尽头跑去。 她穿白色校服衬衫、深色百褶裙和黑色篮球训练背心。 塑料瓶表面布满真实冷凝水珠，瓶内蓝紫液体随着跑动自然晃动。

Scene 02｜1.5–3.0s｜走廊追逐 地点： 教学楼长走廊。 起始画面： 角色 C 快速穿过走廊，篮球夹在身体一侧，汽水瓶握在另一只手中。 镜头从侧面低机位跟拍，夕阳从连续窗户间形成快速交替的明暗光带。 结束画面： 角色 A 从走廊转角出现，穿白色短袖校服衬衫和深色校裤，接住从画面外滚来的篮球。 他抬头看向角色 C，两人短暂对视，随后同时向楼梯方向移动。

Scene 03｜3.0–4.5s｜楼梯交汇 地点： 狭窄水泥楼梯间。 起始画面： 角色 B 从上层楼梯快速跑下，穿白色校服衬衫、松开的深色领带和深色校裤。 他单手拍着篮球，另一只手划过金属扶手。 镜头采用俯拍角度，突出狭窄楼梯的压迫感和移动速度。 结束画面： 角色 C 从下方楼梯出现，将 RAIKU POP 汽水瓶抛向角色 A。 角色 A 在奔跑中接住塑料瓶，角色 B 从两人之间擦肩而过。 两名男生在此场景必须穿校服，不得穿篮球球衣。

Scene 04｜4.5–6.0s｜穿越连廊 地点： 连接两栋校舍的有顶连廊。 起始画面： 三名学生从不同方向进入连廊。 镜头使用长焦压缩三人之间的距离，背景为真实日式校舍外墙、金属窗框和斜射夕阳。 结束画面： 篮球高速飞向镜头，完全遮挡画面，形成自然圆形遮挡转场。

Scene 05｜6.0–7.5s｜天台截球 地点： 教学楼天台。 起始画面： 角色 B 推开天台金属门，在强烈逆光中接住篮球。 角色 A 与角色 B 均穿校服，不穿篮球球衣。角色 C 紧随其后冲出门口。 三人的衣角和头发被强风吹动。 结束画面： 角色 C 从角色 B 手中干净利落地截走篮球，迅速转身冲向另一侧出口。 镜头紧贴人物移动。 Scene 06｜7.5–9.0s｜进入赛场 地点： 体育馆入口与器材通道。 起始画面： 角色 C 冲入昏暗的体育馆器材通道，角色 A 与角色 B 紧随其后。 两名男生此时仍穿白色校服衬衫与校裤。墙边排列着篮球架、折叠垫、旧训练器材和球衣储物柜。 结束画面： 角色 A 将 RAIKU POP 塑料瓶快速放在体育馆入口旁的旧木长椅上。 镜头先对准产品，瓶身轻微震动，冷凝水滑落，蓝紫气泡快速上升。 背景中可以看见打开的更衣区入口 and 悬挂的篮球球衣，为下一场比赛换装提供自然空间线索。

Scene 07｜9.0–12.0s｜最后一投 地点： 日式高中体育馆篮球场。 服装要求： 只有本场正式比赛中，角色 A、角色 B 和角色 C 才穿完整篮球球衣与篮球短裤。 三人的球衣属于同一套原创校园篮球视觉系统，以深海军蓝、黑色和少量蓝紫色为主。角色号码各不相同， 起始画面： 角色 C 身穿深色篮球球衣，快速运球突破。 角色 A 与角色 B 从两侧追防。 镜头贴近木地板高速跟随，球鞋急停产生真实摩擦痕迹和轻微木屑灰尘。 结束画面： 角色 C 在三分线外急停起跳。 镜头从极低角度仰拍她的真实运动姿态，篮球从指尖旋转离开。 画面使用匹配剪辑切换到角色 A 拧开 RAIKU POP 瓶盖的极近特写，随后立即切回篮球干净穿过篮网。 角色 A 的手臂边缘可见篮球球衣肩带，明确表示他已经换成比赛球衣。 镜头语言： 贴地手持跟拍 → 低角度仰拍 → 匹配剪辑 Match Cut → 产品微距 Macro Product Shot → 篮网特写 Net Close-up 环境音： 连续运球声、鞋底急停声、急促呼吸声、瓶盖防盗环“咔哒”声、开瓶“嗤——”声、篮球穿网声。

Scene 08｜12.0–15.0s｜放课后沸点 地点： 体育馆外侧室内休息区。 起始画面： 三名学生坐在靠墙长椅上，仍然穿着 Scene 07 使用的篮球球衣和篮球短裤。 角色 C 位于中央，角色 A 与角色 B 分坐两侧。 背景为体育馆磨砂玻璃门、鞋柜、球衣挂钩。 三人各自喝下一瓶包装完全一致的 RAIKU POP 蓝紫汽水。 三只 PET 塑料瓶轻轻相碰。人物没有夸张大笑，只呈现疲惫、畅快和短暂默契。 结束画面： 画面快速压暗至深海军蓝品牌背景。 中心出现原创虚构品牌标志： “RAIKU POP” 下方中文广告语： “放课后，沸点才刚刚开始。”
entries.translated_prompt:
Basic Settings: Based on the visual language and audio information of this storyboard, generate a professional soda commercial full of Japanese high school hot-blooded sports film aesthetics and storytelling. Generate only sound effects, no background music. Visual Style: Modern Japanese youth film aesthetics, the image simulates the transparent layers of 120 medium format film, or the pure texture of a digital cinema camera with a Black Pro-Mist soft focus filter. The overall image is clean and delicate, with very weak graininess and no coarse film noise. Lighting Settings: Use high-key backlight and soft diffuse ambient light, with a slight soft light wrap around the edges of characters. Highlights are allowed to have slight bloom/halation, presenting a soft glow of sun white, light cherry blossom pink, and pale gold; dark parts remain clean and transparent with a slight cold cyan-blue, no dead black shadows. Color Tone: Low contrast, low saturation, Japanese-style healing palette. The overall color is soft, bright, and airy, with natural and clean skin tones. Cinematographic Texture: Real live-action film cinematography, shallow depth of field, natural focus transitions, slight handheld breathing, and smooth motion shots. Character movements are natural and restrained, and performances express emotions through eyes, breathing, running, pausing, and brief tacit understanding. The imagery should look like a Japanese hot-blooded youth film, rather than anime, illustration, MV, or idol photo books.

Main Character Settings: Character A: Black short-haired male high school student, calm personality, determined eyes. Character B: Slightly curly dark brown short-haired male high school student, direct and flamboyant personality, but not a villain. Character C: Ear-length black short-haired female high school student, the main point guard of the basketball club, and also the main character of the whole film.

Visual Content:
Scene 01 | 0.0–1.5s | Signal Location: School building corridor. Starting Frame: Opens directly with a very close-up shot of Character C's face. She has just finished a fast run, with fine sweat beads on her forehead, short hair clinging to the side of her face, and slightly rapid breathing. She suddenly lifts her eyes, looking sharply off-screen. The background is a real Japanese high school corridor, blurred with a shallow depth of field, showing only faint old window frames, notice boards, worn wall surfaces, and sunset light streaks. Ending Frame: The lens pulls back slightly to a chest-level close-up. Character C holds a basketball in one hand and a blue-purple RAIKU POP plastic bottle in the other. She quickly turns and runs toward the end of the corridor. She wears a white school shirt, a dark pleated skirt, and a black basketball training vest. The surface of the plastic bottle is covered with realistic condensation droplets, and the blue-purple liquid inside sloshes naturally as she runs.

Scene 02 | 1.5–3.0s | Corridor Chase Location: Long school building corridor. Starting Frame: Character C quickly passes through the corridor, with the basketball tucked under one arm and the soda bottle in the other hand. The shot follows from a side low angle, as the sunset forms fast-alternating light and dark bands through continuous windows. Ending Frame: Character A appears from a corner of the corridor, wearing a white short-sleeved school shirt and dark school trousers, catching a basketball rolling in from off-screen. He looks up at Character C, the two have a brief eye contact, then they move toward the stairs simultaneously.

Scene 03 | 3.0–4.5s | Stairs Encounter Location: Narrow concrete stairwell. Starting Frame: Character B runs down quickly from the upper stairs, wearing a white school shirt, a loosened dark tie, and dark school trousers. He dribbles the basketball with one hand and slides his other hand along the metal railing. The shot uses a top-down angle to emphasize the narrow staircase's pressure and movement speed. Ending Frame: Character C appears from the lower stairs and tosses the RAIKU POP soda bottle to Character A. Character A catches the bottle while running, and Character B brushes past them. Both boys must wear school uniforms in this scene, not basketball jerseys.

Scene 04 | 4.5–6.0s | Crossing the Connecting Bridge Location: Covered bridge connecting two school buildings. Starting Frame: Three students enter the bridge from different directions. The lens uses a telephoto compression of the distance between the three, with the background showing real Japanese school building exterior walls, metal window frames, and diagonal sunset light. Ending Frame: The basketball flies at high speed toward the lens, completely blocking the screen, forming a natural circular masking transition.

Scene 05 | 6.0–7.5s | Rooftop Interception Location: School building rooftop. Starting Frame: Character B pushes open the metal rooftop door and catches the basketball in strong backlight. Character A and Character B both wear school uniforms, not basketball jerseys. Character C follows closely out of the door. The corners of their clothes and hair are blown by a strong wind. Ending Frame: Character C cleanly steals the basketball from Character B's hands, quickly turning to dash toward another exit. The camera stays tight on the characters' movement.

Scene 06 | 7.5–9.0s | Entering the Arena Location: Gym entrance and equipment passage. Starting Frame: Character C dashes into the dimly lit gym equipment passage, followed closely by Character A and Character B. The two boys are still wearing white school shirts and trousers. Basketball racks, folding mats, old training equipment, and jersey lockers line the walls. Ending Frame: Character A quickly places the RAIKU POP plastic bottle on an old wooden bench near the gym entrance. The lens focuses first on the product, the bottle vibrating slightly, condensation sliding down, and blue-purple bubbles rising rapidly. In the background, the open entrance to the changing area and hanging basketball jerseys are visible, providing natural spatial cues for the outfit change for the next game.

Scene 07 | 9.0–12.0s | The Final Shot Location: Japanese high school gym basketball court. Clothing Requirement: Only in this formal game do Character A, Character B, and Character C wear full basketball jerseys and shorts. The jerseys belong to the same original campus basketball visual system, mainly in deep navy blue, black, and a small amount of blue-purple. Their jersey numbers are different. Starting Frame: Character C wears a dark basketball jersey and breaks through with a fast dribble. Character A and Character B defend from both sides. The camera follows at high speed close to the wooden floor, shoes making real friction marks and slight wood dust as they stop suddenly. Ending Frame: Character C stops and jumps for a three-pointer. The shot uses a very low angle looking up at her realistic athletic posture as the basketball spins away from her fingertips. The scene uses a match cut to a very close-up of Character A unscrewing the RAIKU POP cap, then immediately cuts back to the basketball cleanly passing through the net. Character A's jersey strap is visible at the edge of his arm, clearly showing he has changed into his game jersey. Lens Language: Ground-level handheld tracking -> Low-angle shot -> Match Cut -> Macro Product Shot -> Net Close-up. Ambient Sound: Continuous dribbling, shoe squeaks, rapid breathing, the 'click' of the bottle cap's tamper-evident ring, the 'pssh' of opening the bottle, the sound of the ball through the net.

Scene 08 | 12.0–15.0s | After-School Boiling Point Location: Indoor rest area outside the gym. Starting Frame: Three students sit on a bench against the wall, still wearing the basketball jerseys and shorts from Scene 07. Character C is in the middle, with Character A and Character B sitting on either side. The background shows the frosted glass gym doors, shoe racks, and jersey hooks. Each of the three drinks from a RAIKU POP blue-purple soda bottle with identical packaging. Three PET plastic bottles clink gently. The characters do not laugh exaggeratedly, only showing fatigue, relief, and a brief tacit understanding. Ending Frame: The screen quickly darkens to a deep navy blue brand background. In the center appears the original fictional brand logo: 'RAIKU POP'. Below it is the Chinese slogan: 'After school, the boiling point is just beginning.'

entries.title: Handheld iPhone Style School Romance
entries.description: A realistic documentary-style video prompt simulating an iPhone handheld recording of a high school classroom interaction with a dramatic emotional twist.
entries.prompt:
以未经处理的iPhone手持拍摄的真实视频素材风格呈现，所有相机设置均为自动，无任何后期调色或特效。画面带有真实的手持轻微抖动和操作者呼吸感，自动对焦偶尔出现搜索、延迟和短暂失焦，自动白平衡随教室灯光自然微调。图像整体平坦，保留真实的镜头光晕、边缘轻微色差。仅使用画内自然环境音效（教室嘈杂、桌椅摩擦、同学低语），无背景音乐。采用教室内同学视角手持拍摄，构图偶尔不完美。 女生使用预设角色#1
，穿着预设服装#2
图片_20260812231937_391_1403
。男生为普通高二男生
hf_20260813_045948_9d269cdb-1f3b-4f73-900f-38efb50e95f1
，深色短发，神情内敛。 【旁白+字幕】低沉男声旁白，关键字幕同步出现在画面下方。 0-4秒：中景，课间教室。男生正认真用湿纸巾把同桌女生的课桌和椅子擦得一尘不染，随后把热早餐整齐放在她桌角。周围同学起哄调侃，男生低头继续收拾，完全不理。镜头轻微抖动，自动对焦短暂在早餐上搜索后回到男生。旁白：“那年高二，班里出了个‘痴情种’，每天上课前都把女同桌的桌椅擦得一尘不染，早餐准时奉上。”字幕同步。 4-8秒：几个日常片段快速切换（仍保持手持晃动）。男生继续默默伺候，同学们各种调侃，他全然不顾。有人从镜头前走过短暂遮挡。旁白：“面对同学们的各种调侃，他全然不顾，就这么默默无闻地伺候了她半年。”字幕继续。 8-11秒：正式上课，老师问起某女生请假原因。镜头转向男生。他突然眼眶发红，声音哽咽准备开口。自动对焦出现短暂延迟。旁白压低：“直到有一天，女同桌请假没来……”字幕同步。画面自然停在他即将说话的瞬间。12-18秒：接上段。男生眼眶发红，声音明显哽咽，慢慢说出：“老师，她……她以后再也来不了了……晚期。我爸是她的主治医生，让我这半年好好关心她，陪她走完最后一程。昨晚我爸告诉我……我的任务……完成了。”说完低头，肩膀轻轻发抖。全班完全安静下来，只有轻微的呼吸声和桌椅细微摩擦。老师愣住几秒，转身背对大家，抬手慢慢擦了一下眼角。自动对焦在男生脸上出现短暂延迟 and 轻微失焦后重新锁定，麦克风捕捉到他哽咽时的轻微失真。旁白压低、放慢：“他突然眼眶一红，哽咽着说出了真相。”字幕同步打出对白，停留时间更长。 18-23秒：画面自然过渡到第二天早上。教室门被推开，女生（预设角色#1，穿着预设服装#2）气势汹汹走了进来，脚步声清晰。她直接走向男生座位，一把拧住他的耳朵，语速不快但带着明显怒气：“听说你昨天在班里把我给‘走’了？我不过就是感冒请个假！”男生疼得龇牙咧嘴，想解释又说不出完整句子。镜头因她突然的动作产生明显晃动，随后重新构图，自动对焦激烈搜索后锁回两人脸上。 23-30秒：全班反应过来，爆发出笑声，有人拍桌子，有人捂嘴。女生继续拧着耳朵不放，男生一脸委屈。镜头保持轻微手持抖动，画面边缘略有倾斜。旁白用调侃语气缓缓收尾：“第二天，女同桌气势汹汹冲进教室……原来任务完成得有点早。”字幕同步。画面在哄笑声和女生拧耳朵的动作中自然结束。 画面呈现出真实的未经处理手持视频质感，纪录片级别的自然不完美感，无任何后期调色或特效。所有相机行为均符合iPhone/手机自动拍摄的物理特性。
entries.translated_prompt: Presented in the style of raw, untreated iPhone handheld video footage with all camera settings on auto, no post-color grading or special effects. The image features realistic handheld jitter and the operator's breathing. Auto-focus occasionally searches, lags, or briefly blurs, and auto-white balance adjusts naturally to classroom lighting. The overall image is flat, retaining realistic lens flare and slight edge chromatic aberration. Only natural in-scene environmental sounds (classroom noise, chairs scraping, students whispering) are used, with no background music. Filmed from a student's perspective with occasionally imperfect composition. The girl uses Preset Character #1 in Preset Clothing #2. The boy is an ordinary 11th-grade male with dark short hair and a reserved expression. Includes deep male voiceover and synchronized subtitles at the bottom. 0-4s: Medium shot of a classroom break. The boy meticulously cleans the girl's desk with wet wipes and places breakfast there while classmates tease him. 4-8s: Quick cuts of daily moments of him serving her quietly despite teasing. 8-11s: During class, the teacher asks about the girl's absence. The camera turns to the boy whose eyes redden as he prepares to speak. 12-18s: Continuation of the previous shot. The boy chokes up and says, 'Teacher, she... she won't be coming back anymore... terminal stage. My dad was her doctor and asked me to accompany her. Last night my dad told me... my mission... is complete.' He bows his head, shoulders trembling. The class falls silent. The teacher pauses and wipes an eye. 18-23s: Transition to the next morning. The classroom door bursts open; the girl (Character #1) walks in furiously, pinches the boy's ear, and yells, 'I heard you killed me off yesterday? I just took a day off for a cold!' The camera shakes from the sudden movement. 23-30s: The class bursts into laughter. The girl keeps pinching his ear while he looks aggrieved. The voiceover concludes mockingly. The footage maintains a raw documentary feel without post-processing.

entries.title: 90s Asian Art Movie Cinematic Portrait
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a 6-second cinematic dynamic portrait of a young woman with a 90s Asian arthouse aesthetic, featuring complex camera movement, depth of field changes, and continuous natural motion.
entries.prompt:
6秒真人电影感动态写真拍摄，年轻女性近距离人像特写，潮湿、朦胧、柔焦的90年代亚洲文艺电影摄影质感。

人物始终处于连续自然运动中，不要静止摆拍。

0-2秒：女性原本侧躺，脸微微偏向一侧，随后自然地抬起一点头和肩膀，同时缓慢转脸看向镜头。随着身体移动，黑色长发从肩膀和脸颊滑落，几缕湿润发丝扫过眼睛和嘴唇。她的视线先落在画面外，转头过程中自然追向摄影机。

2-4秒：她继续起身并轻轻改变身体姿态，一只手从画面下方抬起，随意拨开脸前的湿发，手指从太阳穴掠过耳侧。她在动作过程中轻轻眨眼，目光短暂避开镜头后再次看回来。头发因为身体运动产生明显但柔和的惯性摆动。

4-6秒：女性身体向摄影机靠近一些，脸从侧面逐渐转成3/4正面，发丝继续从脸颊滑过。最后她略微抬眼直视镜头，动作仍未完全停止，在运动状态中结束画面。

摄影机也持续运动：
摄影师手持摄影机围绕人物做小幅度弧形移动，同时缓慢靠近人物，不是固定机位。镜头存在轻微真实的手持呼吸感和空间视差。人物靠近镜头时摄影机轻微后撤，形成若即若离的跟拍感。

前景持续运动：
镜头前有模糊的半透明纱、玻璃反光或植物暗影缓慢横穿画面，随着摄影机移动产生明显视差。前景偶尔遮住人物半张脸，然后自然滑开，制造偷窥式、偶然捕捉到人物的摄影感。

焦点持续变化：
85mm，f/1.4，极浅景深。人物运动时焦点不是死死锁定，焦点随着距离变化在眼睛、湿润发丝、嘴唇之间快速而柔和地寻找和重新锁定，产生真实摄影师手动跟焦的轻微脱焦与重新合焦。

全程隔着潮湿空气和轻微起雾的镜片拍摄，柔焦滤镜，高光大面积柔和泛开，自然halation和bloom，低反差，黑位抬起，轻微欠曝，灰蓝、墨绿、乳白色低饱和色调。湿润皮肤产生柔和反光，背景彻底融化成抽象的大色块。

动态重点：人物转头 + 起身 + 手部拨发 + 头发惯性运动 + 视线变化 + 摄影机弧形移动 + 前景横穿 + 持续跟焦，所有运动同时发生并相互影响。

不是静态照片轻微呼吸，不是慢动作定格，不要让人物长时间保持同一个pose。动作自然流畅、有惯性、有连续性，像摄影师在人物自由活动时不断抓拍动态写真。

保持人物身份、脸型、服装稳定；即使运动 and 短暂脱焦，重新合焦后仍然是同一个人。
entries.translated_prompt:
6-second live-action cinematic dynamic portrait, close-up of a young woman, with the damp, hazy, soft-focus aesthetic of 90s Asian art films.

The character is in continuous natural motion throughout, no static posing.

0-2s: The woman is originally lying on her side, face tilted slightly. She naturally raises her head and shoulders while slowly turning to face the camera. As she moves, black long hair slides from her shoulders and cheeks, with a few wet strands brushing across her eyes and lips. Her gaze starts off-camera and naturally follows the camera during the turn.

2-4s: She continues to rise and gently shifts her posture. One hand rises from the bottom of the frame to casually brush away wet hair, fingers sweeping from the temple to the side of the ear. She blinks gently, looking away briefly before meeting the lens again. The hair has noticeable but soft inertial swinging due to movement.

4-6s: The woman moves closer to the camera, her face turning from profile to 3/4 view. Strands of hair continue to slide across her cheeks. Finally, she looks up directly into the camera, movement not yet fully stopped as the frame ends.

Continuous camera movement:
Handheld camera moves in a small arc around the character while slowly approaching; not a fixed position. The shot has slight realistic handheld breathing and spatial parallax. The camera retreats slightly as the character approaches, creating a sense of follow-shooting.

Continuous foreground movement:
Blurred translucent fabric, glass reflections, or plant shadows slowly cross the frame, creating parallax with camera movement. Foreground occasionally obscures half the face before sliding away, creating a voyeuristic sense of candidly capturing the character.

Continuous focus shifting:
85mm, f/1.4, extremely shallow depth of field. Focus is not locked but shifts quickly and softly between eyes, wet hair, and lips as distance changes, simulating a real photographer's manual follow-focus with slight blurring and refocusing.

Shot through damp air and a slightly foggy lens, soft-focus filter, highlights softly blooming, natural halation, low contrast, raised blacks, slightly underexposed, low saturation palette of gray-blue, dark green, and milky white. Moist skin creates soft reflections, and the background melts into abstract blocks of color.

Motion priorities: turning head + rising + hand brushing hair + hair inertia + gaze shifts + camera arc movement + foreground crossing + continuous follow-focus, all occurring simultaneously and influencing each other.

Not a static photo breathing, not slow-motion freeze-frame, no long poses. Movement is natural, fluid, and continuous, like a photographer capturing dynamic portraits while the subject moves freely.

Maintain character identity, face shape, and clothing stability; even with motion and temporary defocusing, it remains the same person upon refocusing.

entries.title: The Secret Garden Hidden Door
entries.description: A cinematic prompt depicting Mary Lennox finding a hidden garden door, following a robin through a soft morning setting.
entries.prompt:
The Secret Garden — The Hidden Door
Characters:
* Mary Lennox — thin ten-year-old girl with dark hair and a plain gray dress.
* Robin — small red-breasted bird.
Scene: Soft morning light fills a quiet English garden. Mary slowly follows a robin that repeatedly lands a few meters ahead of her. The bird finally perches beside an old ivy-covered wall where Mary notices the outline of a forgotten wooden door hidden beneath climbing vines. She brushes the leaves aside, finds a rusty key already in her hand, unlocks the door, and gently pushes it open to reveal a beautiful garden untouched for years. No music. Pay attention to maintain spatial consistency and respect 180 degree rule in cinematography.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Explorer Hovercraft Adventure
entries.description: An epic cinematic sci-fi prompt featuring a lone explorer on a hovercraft gliding toward a massive floating fortress over a dark ocean.
entries.prompt: A cinematic 15-second sci-fi adventure following a lone explorer aboard a small hovercraft gliding across an endless black ocean beneath a sky filled with eclipsed moons. In the distance, a colossal floating fortress slowly emerges from swirling storm clouds, suspended by glowing energy pillars. As the explorer approaches, massive mechanical gates unlock with thunderous precision, awakening ancient celestial guardians whose eyes ignite with brilliant blue light. The fortress begins to transform, revealing hidden towers, cascading waterfalls of liquid light, and floating islands orbiting its core. Thousands of luminous drones rise into the air like stars as giant space whales glide silently through the clouds overhead. The explorer steps onto a glowing crystal pathway leading toward the heart of the fortress while beams of celestial light pierce the storm. Epic cinematic camera movements, IMAX-scale visuals, breathtaking world-building, volumetric lighting, ultra-realistic weather simulation, premium VFX, emotional orchestral atmosphere, ARRI Alexa 35 aesthetic, anamorphic lenses, photorealistic textures, seamless continuity, 4K HDR, blockbuster movie quality, no text, no logos.

entries.title: Cinematic Urban Foot Chase Escape
entries.description: A high-tension prompt for an urban foot chase where a teenager evades pursuers by vanishing around a corner.
entries.prompt:
Boy = a 15-year-old teenage boy, slim and quick, short dark hair, wearing a hooded jacket, jeans, and sneakers, a backpack on his shoulders. Alert, scared, determined, athletic. Appearance only.

Chasers = three older guys in their 20s, casual streetwear, moving fast and aggressively as a group in pursuit. Appearance only.

City = a gritty urban environment — narrow streets, alleyways, brick walls, parked cars, market stalls, and a quiet side street around a corner. Overcast daytime light, realistic city textures. Environment only.

SCENE: a tense cinematic foot chase. A teenage boy with a backpack sprints through the city streets, chased by three older guys. He races through a busy street, then cuts hard around a corner into a quieter side street and quickly hides out of sight — and when the three chasers round the same corner moments later, the street is empty and they've lost him. A clever escape, no violence — pure suspense.

TECHNICAL: 16:9, cinematic handheld chase camera, dynamic tracking and running shots, urgent energy, slightly desaturated gritty urban grade, motion blur, shallow depth of field, photorealistic thriller quality.

CUTS:
CUT 1 (0-5s): The boy sprints down a busy street toward camera, backpack bouncing, glancing back in fear. Behind him, the three chasers give chase, weaving through pedestrians and market stalls. Handheld tracking shot conveying speed and panic.
CUT 2 (5-10s): The boy cuts hard around a street corner into a quieter side street. Fast tracking shot following him as he ducks behind a parked car / into a doorway / behind a wall, pressing himself out of sight, breathing hard, trying to stay silent.
CUT 3 (10-15s): The three chasers round the same corner at speed — and stop. The side street ahead is empty. They look around, confused, scanning the deserted street, having completely lost him. Hold on their frustration as the boy stays hidden. He's escaped.

RULES: References are appearance only, do not recreate. Keep the boy's appearance consistent across every cut. This is a suspenseful chase only — no weapons, no fighting, no physical contact, no violence. The tension comes from the pursuit and the clever escape. Sound design: pounding footsteps, heavy breathing, urban ambience, a tense driving score that drops to near-silence when he hides, then holds on the quiet as the chasers lose him. Final frame on the confused chasers and the empty street.

entries.title: Crayon Drawing Animated Chase
entries.description: A charming animation prompt for a continuous-shot video in a childlike crayon-drawing style, featuring a playful chase sequence with multiple characters.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second children's crayon-drawing-style animated video, one continuous shot, no cuts. A playful chase happens in a white paper crayon world: a rat runs ahead holding a cooked orange/tan crayon fish in both front paws, a cat chases directly behind, and a boy with a dog follows behind them. Maintain the chase order throughout: rat + fish → cat → boy + dog. The rat never drops the fish and the cat never catches it.

Use references only for character appearance: Image 1 = cat fur/color/body, Image 2 = rat fur/color/snout/tail, Image 3 = boy hairstyle/clothing, Image 4 = dog fur/color/floppy ears/body. Do not copy backgrounds and do not mix character traits.

Scene: clean white paper background with a green scribbled tree and brown trunk on the left, tall house with red roof and blue windows in the center, yellow crayon sun top right, blue cloud top left, wavy green grass at bottom. No hands, crayons, or drawing tools visible.

Timeline: 
0-6s: Wide establishing shot. Empty scene, then rat enters from left holding fish and looks back nervously. 

6-14s: Cat enters chasing rat. Camera smoothly pans sideways as they pass the tree toward the house. 

14-22s: Boy and dog join from behind. Camera slightly pushes in as cat gets closer. 

22-30s: Camera pulls out to a wide shot. All four continue running with small crayon dust scribbles, full landscape visible again.

Style: thick waxy crayon strokes, visible scribble texture, wobbly hand-drawn lines, childlike proportions, bright saturated colors, flat lighting, cute playful animation.
Camera: single continuous take, wide shot → lateral tracking pan → slight push-in → pull-out. No scene cuts.

Audio: playful cartoon chase music with pizzicato strings, bouncy tuba, comedic woodwinds, running footsteps, boing/slide-whistle effects, dog bark and boy laugh near the end. No dialogue.

entries.title: French Town Anime Narrative
entries.description: A comprehensive storyboard-style prompt for a 30-second anime sequence featuring specific characters and situational comedy in an 18th-century setting.
entries.prompt:
日本のフルカラーアニメ風。日本のテレビアニメ風。セルルックのアニメ。平塗り中心のアニメ風スクリーンキャプチャー。

0〜2秒:背景は18世紀のフランスの街。画像1のシルクハットをかぶった金髪の長髪の男性キャラが歩いていると、何かを見つけた様子で建物の陰に隠れる。

2〜4秒:そっと建物の陰から顔をのぞかせる画像1のシルクハットをかぶった金髪の長髪の男性キャラのアップを斜め横からの視点。

4〜6秒:画像2の黒髪メイドキャラが、八百屋の若い男性とにこやかに話している。

6〜8秒:画像2の黒髪メイドキャラキャラのアップを斜め横からの視点で。目を閉じて笑っている。拳を口元に。拳の甲をこちらに見せる。萌え背景、キラキラ✨✨と輝いている。

8〜10秒:画像1のシルクハットをかぶった金髪長髪の貴族男性キャラ、ショックを受けた漫画顔。ガーン。

10〜14秒:ここから以後のシーンは屋敷の中。画像3のキャラクターは部屋なのでこの服装で。ショックのあまり口から白い魂が出ている画像③の金髪長髪の貴族の男性。丸い白目の漫画顔でソファーに座って脱力している。
画像②の黒髪メイドキャラが画面右より登場。
画像2の黒髪メイドキャラのセリフ「ご主人様、どうしたのですか？」

14〜18秒:画像3の金髪長髪の男性キャラのうつむいた顔のアップを斜め下からの視点で。「エルサ、すごくいい笑顔で男と話してた」
ショックを隠せない顔。

18〜22秒:画像2の黒髪メイドキャラの斜め横からの視点。「アイソをよくすると、トマトをオマケしてくれるんです」

22〜25秒:画像3の金髪男性キャラ、顔を上げキラキラしたいい笑顔を上からの視点で「え、それだけ？なーんだ、てっきり……」

25〜30秒:二人を前からの視点で。ソファーに座り画像2の黒髪メイドキャラを見上げている画像3の金髪長髪キャラの男性と、彼を向いて立っている画像2の黒髪メイド女性キャラ。

:画像2の黒髪メイド女性キャラ「てっきり？」
画像3の金髪長髪男性キャラ「いや、なんでも」あわてて顔をそむける。

entries.title: Penthouse Luxury Fight Sequence
entries.description: A high-octane cinematic prompt for a 15-second stylized fight sequence in a neon-lit luxury penthouse, featuring complex choreography and dynamic lighting.
entries.prompt: 0–3s: The Ignition  Action: Standing near the grand bar of an ultra-luxurious, glass-walled penthouse lounge overlooking a neon cityscape.  Audio: Smooth jazz music distorted by the sharp pop of champagne corks and the sudden shattering of high-end crystal glassware.  Visual: She detects a hidden assassin drawing a silenced pistol from a velvet jacket; she instantly grabs a heavy crystal decanter and hurls it across the bar, shattering it against his face.  3–6s: CQC Blitz  Target A: Staggered by the glass splinters → she Vaults over the polished mahogany bar top, sweeps his standing leg, and drives his head into the hardwood floor.  Target B: Closes in with an extendable stun baton → she snatches a silk curtain sash from the floor-to-ceiling drapery, wraps it around his neck mid-swing, and chokes him back over her shoulder.  SFX: Bass-heavy lounge music, breaking glass, the heavy thud of bodies hitting hardwood, and crackling high-voltage sparks.  6–8s: Wardrobe & Atmosphere  Detail: Tailored backless evening gown made of emerald silk, slit to the thigh, wearing heavy gold cuff bracelets and red lipstick.  Environment: The penthouse ceiling sprinklers trigger, sending a warm, misting rain throughout the room that glints in the ambient blue-and-magenta LED accent lighting.  8–11s: The Grapple  Target C: Charges her with a brass-knuckled fist → she steps fluidly into his guard, catches his punch arm, and uses the wet silk drapery line to bind his arm to his torso.  Target D: Approaches from behind with a taser → she executes a tight pivot, wrenching Target C’s bound body directly into Target D's path so the taser prongs embed into Target C's jacket.  11–13s: The Finisher  Action: Snatches a heavy brass champagne bucket off a stand → spins and launches it like a hammer throw straight into the floor-to-ceiling glass wall behind the guards.  Visual: The reinforced glass spiderwebs instantly and blows outward from the wind pressure, creating a massive vacuum draft that pulls the disoriented guards off their feet toward the open ledge.  13–15s: The Aftermath  Tone: High-society elegance violently dismantled into wind-swept, high-altitude exposure.  Action: The room fills with howling wind and mist. She picks up her clutch bag from the bar, steps past the dazed attackers clinging to the floor bolting, and calmly walks into the private service elevator.  Audio: The roaring wind whipping through the shattered glass frame instantly muted as the heavy brass elevator doors slide shut.

entries.title: Midnight Apartment Cooking Scene
entries.description: A quiet, intimate cinematic video prompt for a 15-second 'slice-of-life' scene of a woman preparing noodles in a dark apartment.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-photorealistic 16:9 cinematic slice-of-life video using the provided reference image as the exact character reference. Preserve her exact face, identity, hairstyle, body proportions, and appearance throughout.

Mood: Quiet, intimate, slow and cozy midnight apartment. Dark surroundings, soft warm practical lights, faint rain outside. She is calm, relaxed and content. No rushing or exaggerated acting. The camera observes her naturally rather than constantly showing her face.

0–3 sec — Kitchen:
Wide static shot. She quietly enters the dark kitchen, turns on a small warm counter light, and begins preparing ramen.
3–6 sec — Cooking:
Close-up focused on the pot. Water gently boils as she places noodles in and slowly stirs with chopsticks. Steam rises naturally.

6–9 sec — TV:
Close-up of a remote on the living-room table. Her hand enters, picks it up and turns on the TV. The screen softly illuminates the dark room.
9–12 sec — Returning:
Separate shot from the kitchen looking toward the living room. She returns carrying the ramen. The TV is distant and slightly out of focus, with very low, muffled audio blending into the room ambience.

12–15 sec — Eating:
Close three-quarter shot. She sits down, gently blows on the steaming noodles, takes a bite and gives a tiny satisfied smile while looking toward the TV.
Cinematography: Slow observational camera, static compositions, gentle movement, realistic focus pulls, object-focused shots, shallow depth of field. Let shots breathe.

Sound: Soft rain, boiling water, chopsticks, quiet footsteps, faint refrigerator hum and distant TV audio.
Lighting: Dark midnight atmosphere, warm kitchen light, subtle TV glow, cool faint window light, deep natural shadows.

entries.title: Vintage Camcorder Runner Vlog
entries.description: A sophisticated prompt for creating a realistic 5am dawn run vlog with a vintage Mini-DV camcorder aesthetic, including handheld camera imperfections and realistic lighting changes.
entries.prompt: CAMERA Mini-DV tape camcorder handheld aesthetic, vertical framing. A gorgeous athletic Scandinavian running influencer films herself directly by hand in selfie-cam and first-person style during a dawn run. Keep realistic hand shake amplified by her stride, slightly crooked framing, delayed autofocus hunting in low dawn light, awkward zoom-ins and zoom-outs, occasional motion blur, wind buffeting the mic, and small framing mistakes where part of her face or the horizon briefly slips out of frame. Mix handheld selfie footage with a few fixed external shots. Important: never show her placing, adjusting, or setting up a camera. When switching from handheld footage to a fixed external angle, use a clean jump cut as if the camera had already been positioned before the shot began. The camera itself must never appear on screen. LOOK: Soft digital tape camcorder look with vintage DV character. Slight blur, faint tape noise, visible highlight bloom as the sun breaks the horizon, subtle auto-exposure flicker and hunting as she turns toward and away from the light, muted contrast in the shadows, realistic skin texture with visible pores and sweat sheen, cool blue pre-dawn ambient light warming to gold, realistic skin tones, real lens flare when facing the sun. STYLE: A realistic 5am dawn run vlog with a confident athletic lifestyle vibe. The tone is breathless, upbeat, a little self-deprecating, and natural. She is clearly attractive and charismatic, but the video must feel like a believable self-recorded run vlog, not a polished Nike commercial. Fast clean jump cuts, strong continuity, natural body language, audible real breathing that gets heavier across the video, no awkward dead moments. CHARACTER: An exceptionally beautiful athletic Scandinavian woman in her mid-20s. Highly photogenic face, clear pale blue eyes, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, defined jawline, a natural full mouth, fair skin flushing pink at the cheeks from cold and effort, long thick ash-blonde hair in a low ponytail with loose strands escaping around the face. She looks like a high-end running and lifestyle influencer, not an ordinary jogger. Lean, long-limbed, athletic runner's build. Bare minimal makeup, slightly glossy skin from sweat. She wears a fitted long-sleeve technical running top in muted olive, matching high-waisted running shorts, a thin black running watch, low-profile running shoes, and small wired-look earbuds. No other jewelry. SETTING: A long empty coastal boardwalk at first light. Wooden slats underfoot, low dunes and beach grass on one side, flat grey sea and a breaking orange sunrise on the other, a single wooden railing, scattered gulls, one weathered bench, faint sea mist. Completely empty, no other runners, no dog walkers, no cars, no extra people. Cold still air with visible breath at the start. IMPORTANT CONTINUITY RULES: The same woman must remain fully consistent in every shot. No face changes, no hairstyle changes, no outfit changes, no body changes, no shoe changes. Her hair gets progressively looser and more windblown but stays the same colour and length. No extra people appearing. No duplicated limbs. No broken hands. No impossible running gait. No feet sliding or skating on the boardwalk. No changing weather or sun position beyond a natural gradual sunrise. No camera visible. No camera setup shown. Keep her beautiful, athletic, and photogenic in every shot. STORYBOARD (30 seconds total, 10 cuts): 1. (~3s, arm's-length selfie) She jogs slowly onto the boardwalk holding the camera herself, visible breath in the cold air, squinting and grinning at the lens. Dialogue: "Five a.m. Why do I do this." 2. (~3s, handheld pan across the sea and back to her) The camera swings out over the water toward the orange sunrise, lens flare blooming, then swings back to her face. Dialogue: "Okay. That's worth it." 3. (~3s, low first-person shot of her feet) She tilts the camera down at her own shoes striking the wooden slats, then tilts back up to the empty boardwalk ahead. No dialogue. 4. (~3s, fixed external medium shot) Jump cut to a fixed shot from the side of the boardwalk. She is already running past camera at a steady pace, hair swinging, breathing hard. No camera setup shown. No dialogue. 5. (~3s, same fixed shot, wider) She slows to a walk, hands on hips, chest heaving, and laughs at herself as she catches her breath. Dialogue: "That hill was not on the map." 6. (~3s, handheld walking selfie) She picks the vlog back up in selfie mode, wiping her forehead with her wrist, cheeks bright red, walking a few steps. Dialogue: "Three kilometres in and I'm cooked." 7. (~3s, tight handheld close-up) She takes a long drink from a small handheld water flask, lowers it, and exhales a satisfied laugh. Dialogue: "Best water of my life." 8. (~3s, fixed external wide shot facing the sunrise) Jump cut. She stands at the railing in silhouette against the rising sun, stretches her arms overhead, then rolls her shoulders out. Dialogue: "Little stretch so nothing snaps later." 9. (~3s, handheld close selfie) Loose blonde strands stuck to her damp forehead, she brushes them back, smiling in a tired and genuinely happy way, sun now warm on her face. Dialogue: "This is the good part. Right here." 10. (~3s, arm's-length selfie ending) She walks slowly away down the boardwalk still filming herself, gives a tired little wave, and grins. Dialogue: "Okay. Coffee. Bye." FINAL INSTRUCTION: The result must feel like a real self-recorded dawn run vlog by a genuine running influencer. Prioritize realistic handheld motion driven by her stride, strong continuity, believable pacing, audible natural breathing that intensifies, sweat and flush that build over the video, attractive appearance, and subtle imperfection. Keep it warm, real, and cinematic in a documentary way. Not artificial, not stiff, not stock-footage clean.

entries.description: A highly technical, multi-layered structural prompt for Seedance 2.5 defining character identity, background synchronization, and music-driven transitions.
entries.prompt: @Image1=MAINIMG @Image2=PIPIMG MAIN="MAINIMG唯一主体";MAIN_FACE="主画面人物脸部身份";MAIN_HAIR="主画面人物发型母体";MAIN_BODY="主画面人物身体比例";MAIN_C0="主画面人物原始服装母体";MAIN_ACC="主画面人物关键饰品逻辑" PIPCHAR="PIPIMG唯一主体";PIP_FACE="左下人物脸部身份";PIP_HAIR="左下人物发型母体";PIP_BODY="左下人物身体比例";PIP_C0="左下人物原始服装母体";PIP_ACC="左下人物关键识别逻辑" WALL="背景墙层";FLOOR="地面层";CHAR="主画面角色层";PIP="左下观察窗层" subject:"仅读取MAINIMG与PIPIMG各一次并分别锁定两个主体.MAIN只属于主画面人物;PIPCHAR只属于左下PIP窗口人物.两者都是独立人物,禁止混淆,禁止提前互换,禁止把PIPCHAR误当MAIN,也禁止把MAIN误当PIPCHAR.全片绝大部分时间主画面人物=MAIN,左下PIP人物=PIPCHAR,仅在最后高速转场中执行明确位置交换." vocal:"全片使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线;歌词不预写,由生成侧自由即兴原创日语短句;清晰日语咬字与口型同步;强节奏钩子+短句+延音;禁止引用现有歌曲,禁止读提示词,禁止ah/oh/woo循环.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女切换,禁止因画面角色交换而改变歌手." music:"150BPM极强日系舞曲/电子浩室/高速俱乐部;巨大四拍踢鼓,紧凑军鼓/拍手,滚动低频,侧链合成贝斯,明亮超锯齿和弦墙,金属打击,人声切片,琶音,上升音效,冲击.无慢前奏.0-13s每段有明确重拍与切换感;13-15s进入高密度切碎终章,并在最后完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换.全片主唱保持同一个女性声线,不得变男性,不得因角色交换改变声线身份." VOCAL_IDENTITY_LOCK:"0.00-15.00s始终使用同一个原创日语女性主唱声线.声音是独立音频层,不随画面人物身份,外观,性别表现,PIP内容或最终角色交换而改变.即使PIPCHAR进入主画面,女性主唱声线也必须完全连续.禁止男性主唱,禁止男女声切换,禁止双主唱化,禁止角色交换导致歌手身份变化." priority:"1主画面MAIN识别成立 2左下PIPCHAR识别成立 3全片女性主唱固定 4主画面持续日语唱跳 5主画面同步三层转场 6左下PIP稳定存在 7CHAR描写变化清晰可见 8镜头 9最终交换成功." MAIN_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"MAIN的一致性指人物识别一致,不是外观逐项完全一致.目标不是像素级复制原图,而是无论主画面风格如何变化,观众始终一眼认出是同一个MAIN." MAIN_IDENTITY_LOCK:"MAIN固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;眼睛形状与神情基调;前发结构与发型母体;头身比,体型,身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;关键识别饰品存在逻辑.这些构成MAIN识别核心,必须持续成立." MAIN_MUTABLE_ATTRIBUTES:"MAIN允许大胆变化的属性:描画风格与媒介;线条语言;上色方式与阴影方式;材质表现;二维/三维/印刷/工艺化处理;服装颜色;服装材质;服装细节与装饰;同一服装母体上的舞台化改造;局部配饰强化或弱化;光效与轮廓强调方式;抽象程度.只要MAIN固定属性仍成立,以上变化全部合法." MAIN_FORBIDDEN_DRIFT:"MAIN禁止:变成另一个人;脸型与五官关系明显重构;发型母体消失;体型,年龄感,性别感大幅漂移;完全脱离原角色识别性的陌生服装体系;关键识别饰品逻辑彻底消失." PIP_IDENTITY_DEFINITION:"PIPCHAR也必须保持同一人物识别.左下PIP里无论角度,动作,吃东西状态如何变化,都必须始终被看作同一个PIPCHAR." PIP_IDENTITY_LOCK:"PIPCHAR固定属性:脸部骨相与五官相对关系;发型母体;身体比例;年龄感与整体气质;服装母体与关键识别点.左下PIP窗口中的人物必须始终是PIPCHAR本人." identity_repeat:"MAIN与PIPCHAR必须始终区分清楚.0-13s绝大部分时间主画面=MAIN,左下PIP=PIPCHAR.只有最终交换段才允许彼此替换位置.声音层不参与这个交换." MAIN_SCREEN_MODEL:"主画面由三个同步变化层组成:WALL=背景墙/立面/后景装置;FLOOR=地面/舞台地板/地表;CHAR=MAIN人物本体.主画面采用同步切换逻辑,每个主要切换点WALL/FLOOR/CHAR一起进入新段落,形成清晰高执行率的整体转场." SYNC_RULE:"主画面采用同步三层转场,不追求复杂异步.目标是执行率优先,每段整体变景清楚有力." CHAR_RULE:"主画面CHAR只指MAIN本体.所有主画面角色变化只作用于MAIN:脸/头/发/颈/躯干/手臂/手/腰/腿/脚/服装/饰品.变化后仍必须被看作同一个MAIN." CHAR_TRANSFORMATION_REQUIRED:"每次MAIN描写变化都必须肉眼立即可辨.只改变色温,亮度,轻微滤镜或弱纹理不算变化.每次至少明显改变以下项目中的两项:线条语言;上色方式;材质表现;媒介表现;服装颜色或服装细节." WALL_RULE:"WALL只负责巨大背景墙面/屏风/海报墙/显示墙/装置艺术墙.允许神秘人物大脸,巨大眼睛,抽象肖像,人物海报,屏幕中的脸,图形化人物印象,以及MAIN自身超大特写脸作为墙面艺术,但都只是墙面图像,不是独立角色." FLOOR_RULE:"FLOOR只负责地面层.允许巨大人物脸部影像,巨大眼睛显示,抽象肖像LED地板,以及火焰/水面/草原/霓虹网格/液态金属/花田/冰面/棱镜/像素地面/元宇宙数据地台等地表.这些只能停留在地面,不得立起成角色,不得改变MAIN身体或服装表面." BACKGROUND_EXTRA_RULE:"WALL与FLOOR可吸收两类环境语言:1元宇宙/虚拟都市/全息数据建筑/透明UI空间;2像素艺术/8-bit/16-bit/块状游戏地景.这两类只作用于环境层,不得改变MAIN身份." goal:"15秒高密度实验MV.0-13s主画面是MAIN的同步型三层MV,左下PIP是PIPCHAR黑背景吃汉堡的奇妙附加视频.13-15s最后2秒进入高速终章转场,最终完成主画面与左下PIP人物位置交换,但主唱始终保持同一个女性声线." dance:"MAIN在主画面执行150BPM高能俱乐部编舞:脚跟脚尖快速步,快速脚步,侧移,髋部重拍,肩击,胸部弹动,手臂波浪,锁舞,身体滚动,斜向移动,半转,旋转,反弹,高低位变化,短跳,节奏性转头.MAIN从0.00-15.00s持续明确日语唱跳,绝不站定展示,直到最终交换前仍是主舞台中心." dance_timeline:"0-1.5脚跟脚尖前进+肩击+手臂波浪|1.5-3斜向移动+胸部弹动+半转反弹|3-4.5低位侧步+上扬扫臂+小旋转|4.5-6快速两步+躯干扭转+后退反弹|6-7.5侧向脚步+手臂锁定+前进律动|7.5-9高低位变化+快速转向+髋部重拍|9-10.5跑步式舞步+控制旋转+扫臂|10.5-12反向步+身体滚动+跳跃落地|12-13快速交叉步+270°转身+移动收束|13-13.5高速段A|13.5-14高速段B|14-14.5高速段C|14.5-15终极爆发" MAIN_AUTONOMOUS_STYLE:"每次MAIN描写变化时,生成侧必须自主发明一种与当前描写明显不同的新视觉表现方式.不要按固定列表死板执行.可自由改变线条语言,色彩系统,材质感,二维/三维表现,印刷方式,动画媒介,实体工艺感,抽象程度,服装配色与舞台化细节.目标是让观众明确看到‘同一个MAIN被另一种视觉文化重新描写’." MAIN_STYLE_RANGE:"可联想到但不必固定命名的方向包括:漫画线描,高对比美式平面,流行平面艺术,复古手绘动画,贴纸化,收藏模型化,毛绒化,黏土化,剪纸化,拼贴化,绘本化,时装插画化,三维赛璐璐化,纸浆工艺化,像素化,低模几何化,马赛克化,彩窗化,霓虹化,全息化,蓝图化,喷绘涂鸦化,装饰艺术化,错版印刷化,丝网印刷化等." COSTUME_RULE:"MAIN服装采用‘母体固定,表现可变’原则.必须保留原服装大轮廓,核心识别结构与整体穿着逻辑.允许变化:配色;材质;局部装饰;舞台化强化;图案密度;光泽与反射;层次增减.禁止变化:完全换成陌生角色服装体系;与原角色无关的全新身份服." COSTUME_CHANGE_REQUIRED:"MAIN服装必须发生肉眼立即可辨的阶段变化.3s以后每个阶段必须明显改变颜色系统,材质或服装细节,不能只靠灯光,色温,滤镜或整体风格冒充换装.即使MAIN视觉媒介同时变化,服装本身也必须独立发生可见变化." costume_vector:"C0=原始状态;C1=保留原服装轮廓,主配色明显改为鲜艳舞台色,加入高光面料与明确装饰强化;C2=保留母体,明显改为强烈图形双色/三色色块,增加几何边饰;C3=保留母体,明显改为深黑或深色主体+高对比亮色边线,装饰锐利化;C4=保留母体,明显改为珠光/虹彩/半透明未来材质,配色与C3明显不同;C5=明确白金配色终章服装." COSTUME_VISIBILITY_RULE:"C1,C2,C3,C4,C5彼此必须肉眼明显不同.如果观众无法仅看服装判断已经进入下一阶段,视为换装失败." costume_timeline:"0-3 C0|3-6 C1|6-9 C2|9-12 C3|12-13 C4|13-15 C5终章倾向" MAIN_STAGE_TRANSITIONS:"主画面同步三层转场按段落推进.每次切换时,WALL/FLOOR/CHAR共同进入新的整体段落." main_stage_timeline:"0-1.5 Stage1:WALL=流行平面艺术墙+抽象图形+高对比色块;FLOOR=巨大陌生人物脸部特写LED地板;CHAR=接近原始高细节风格,轻度舞台化;情绪=开场抓取 1.5-3 Stage2:WALL=海报拼贴墙/广告视觉/撕裂边缘;FLOOR=巨大眼睛与虹膜动态显示地板;CHAR=明显漫画线描或高对比平面化;情绪=第一次明显风格变化 3-4.5 Stage3:WALL=屏风绘式墙面/金地/折屏结构/传统绘画印象;FLOOR=火焰地表/热浪/燃烧裂隙;CHAR=复古手绘动画感或绘本化;情绪=传统+热烈 4.5-6 Stage4:WALL=大型显示墙/CRT矩阵/投影墙/数字屏;FLOOR=透明水面/涟漪/镜面反射;CHAR=贴纸化或图形海报化;情绪=数字+流体 6-7.5 Stage5:WALL=MAIN自身超大特写脸墙面艺术,放大眼部/唇部/局部发丝;FLOOR=真实草原/风吹草浪;CHAR=收藏模型化或三维赛璐璐化;情绪=MAIN身份最强强调段 7.5-9 Stage6:WALL=元宇宙虚拟都市墙景/全息高楼/透明UI/数据拱门;FLOOR=元宇宙电子地台/高亮网格/透明数据格;CHAR=全息化/霓虹化/未来舞台化;情绪=科技夜店 9-10.5 Stage7:WALL=大型像素艺术背景墙/8-bit与16-bit混合城市;FLOOR=像素地面/8-bit砖块/像素草地/像素水面;CHAR=像素化倾向或低模几何化,但仍清楚是MAIN;情绪=游戏化电子感 10.5-12 Stage8:WALL=神秘巨大人脸墙面/抽象肖像墙/波形屏;FLOOR=液态金属波面;CHAR=马赛克/彩窗/装饰工艺感处理;情绪=异质艺术感 12-13 Stage9:WALL=喷绘涂鸦/错版印刷/霓虹标牌混合墙;FLOOR=花田向冰面棱镜渐变;CHAR=混合媒介,服装终章化前冲;情绪=终章累积 13-13.5爆发A:主画面高频同步切入新状态,压缩空间,强化速度 13.5-14爆发B:主画面继续同步切换,准备与PIP发生位置入侵 14-14.5爆发C:主画面与PIP发生边界破坏,画面互相侵蚀,开始交换 14.5-15终章:完成MAIN与PIPCHAR位置交换,主画面主体变为PIPCHAR,MAIN进入左下PIP" camera_lock:"主画面镜头必须在真实三维空间中大幅移动,不是固定机位平移/俯仰/数字变焦/抖动.每个镜头段必须改变世界坐标X/Y/Z并产生明显视差.禁止原地晃动冒充环绕,禁止仅数字变焦冒充推进." orbit_rule:"每次环绕至少完成90°明显方位变化,重点段120-180°.顺时针与逆时针必须肉眼可辨.垂直环绕必须从低位沿主体真实升高,越过头顶到高位俯拍." frame_rotation:"整画面旋转必须是明确连续镜头滚转30-90°或更大,并与环绕/推进/升降叠加,不是随机抖动." camera_timeline:"0-1.5左前低位顺时针120°环绕到右侧,膝高升至胸高|1.5-3继续顺时针90°到右后方,高速贴肩掠过后重捕脸|3-4.5背后低位启动垂直环绕,越过头顶俯拍后向前下降|4.5-6右前低位逆时针150°环绕到左后方,半径先缩小再扩大|6-7.5高位逆时针环绕同时快速下降至贴地并掠过|7.5-9贴地冲刺:远处贴地冲向MAIN,脚边急拉升,越肩后反向环绕90°|9-10.5巨大螺旋:120°环绕+明显升高+半径收缩+60°滚转|10.5-12超高位俯冲擦过肩侧,穿到背后后立刻180°翻向回正面|12-13极近脸开始极速倒飞至超广角全身+巨大WALL/FLOOR,随后高速推近|13-13.5顺时针快速环绕90°+45°滚转|13.5-14逆时针快速环绕120°+高空俯冲|14-14.5螺旋120°+90°整画面滚转+画面撕裂|14.5-15从主画面破裂中完成位置交换后重新锁定新主角" PIP_RULE:"在主画面左下加入小型观察PIP窗口.不是四分屏,不是大分割,而是独立小型画中画.面积约全画面1/16,建议宽22-25%,高22-25%,保持小而清楚,不要过大,不要明显干扰主画面.位置固定左下,可有细白线或淡发光边框." PIP_BACKGROUND:"PIP内部环境固定纯黑空间或极暗黑色虚空.不要复杂背景,不要环境变化,不要墙面艺术,不要地面花样,不要额外特效堆满.目标是清楚观看PIPCHAR吃汉堡." PIP_SUBJECT:"PIP窗口中显示PIPCHAR,不是MAIN.这是独立的奇妙附加视频.0-13s大部分时间左下PIP人物都必须是PIPCHAR." PIP_PURPOSE:"PIP窗口展示PIPCHAR在黑背景中从多个角度吃汉堡.气氛略微滑稽,略微神秘,像莫名其妙插入的无关短视频,但视觉上必须清楚,可爱,令人困惑." PIP_ACTION_CORE:"PIPCHAR手持或拿近一个完整汉堡或厚实肉排汉堡,明确执行吃汉堡动作:看汉堡,举起,张口咬下,咀嚼,吞咽,再咬,轻微满足表情或面无表情继续吃.必须明显看出在吃汉堡,不是拿着不动." PIP_HAMBURG_RULE:"汉堡必须清晰可见,面包,肉排,配料可辨识.左下PIP核心笑点就是PIPCHAR认真吃汉堡.禁止变成别的食物,禁止吃空气,禁止只摆姿势." PIP_ANGLE_RULE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR以角色展示+吃汉堡结合方式呈现.可缓慢转身,转头,半身转体,轻微姿势切换,或小幅连续转台观察.同时保持吃汉堡动作可见.可展示正面,左45°,侧面,背后回头,右45°,半身近景等." PIP_MOTION_STYLE:"PIP中的PIPCHAR可轻微动作:轻转身,轻摆头,抬手拿汉堡,咬一口,咀嚼,吞咽,再次进食.不要大幅舞蹈.重点是多角度+持续吃汉堡." PIP_AUDIO_RULE:"PIPCHAR不唱歌,不提供独立主唱,不接管歌曲声线.PIPCHAR只执行无声或弱存在感的吃汉堡动作,可有咀嚼感但不形成主唱人声.左下PIP与最终位置交换不得影响主歌曲女性主唱." PIP_TIMELINE:"0.8-2.8正面与左45°吃汉堡,首次清楚咬下一口|2.8-4.8左侧面与左后45°,一边转身一边咀嚼|4.8-6.8背面与右后45°,回头露出脸并继续拿汉堡|6.8-8.8右侧面与右45°,再次明显咬一口|8.8-10.8上半身近景转体,突出脸部与汉堡,清楚咀嚼|10.8-12.8小型连续转台观察,不同角度持续吃|12.8-13.8吃汉堡动作加快,同时开始感应主画面异变|13.8-15.0PIP边界被主画面吸入并放大,PIPCHAR从左下窗冲出成为主画面角色" PIP_STYLE_RELATION:"如果主画面变化过于激烈,左下PIP仍应优先保证PIPCHAR识别清晰与吃汉堡动作清楚.PIP风格可适度跟随终章气氛,但黑背景和汉堡核心不能丢." PIP_MAIN_SEPARATION:"0-13.8s主画面MAIN继续正常日语唱跳与主镜头运动.左下PIP只是附加层.两者同时存在,但左下PIP不改变主画面背景逻辑,不抢主体,不遮挡MAIN主脸." SWAP_RULE:"最终交换是本次实验核心事件.13.8-15.0必须发生明确位置交换:PIPCHAR从左下PIP突破边界,经高速转场放大并进入主画面中心;MAIN被压缩,缩小,拉入左下PIP窗口或其原本位置;交换完成后主画面最终主体=PIPCHAR,左下PIP中的人物=MAIN;观众必须明确看出二者位置互换成功;但音频主唱身份绝不交换,全片主唱始终是同一个女性主唱声线." SWAP_VISUAL_GRAMMAR:"交换过程可使用屏幕撕裂,镜面翻转,画中画放大,窗口爆裂,层级穿透,角色穿屏,旋转缩放,颜色爆闪,故障扭曲,画面反转等高速转场手法.交换不是简单硬切,必须有明显‘主画面与PIP互换’的视觉奇观." SWAP_FINAL_STATE:"14.7-15.0时主画面中的新主体必须已经是PIPCHAR,并可带着汉堡或吃汉堡后的状态站上主舞台;同时MAIN必须已进入左下PIP,变成被观察的一方.位置交换必须完成,不要停留在半路.女性主唱声线仍保持不变." PIP_FAILURE:"若PIP窗口过大,不是黑背景,窗口里不是PIPCHAR,没有清楚吃汉堡,或最后没有与主画面完成角色位置交换,均视为失败." typo:"少量动态文字,仅单汉字或极短英字.候选:舞,光,音,瞬/GO,UP"
entries.translated_prompt: @Image1=MAINIMG @Image2=PIPIMG MAIN="MAINIMG unique subject"; MAIN_FACE="Main screen character facial identity"; MAIN_HAIR="Main screen character hairstyle base"; MAIN_BODY="Main screen character body proportions"; MAIN_C0="Main screen character original outfit base"; MAIN_ACC="Main screen character key accessory logic" PIPCHAR="PIPIMG unique subject"; PIP_FACE="Lower left character facial identity"; PIP_HAIR="Lower left character hairstyle base"; PIP_BODY="Lower left character body proportions"; PIP_C0="Lower left character original outfit base"; PIP_ACC="Lower left character key identification logic" WALL="Background wall layer"; FLOOR="Floor layer"; CHAR="Main screen character layer"; PIP="Lower left observation window layer" subject: "Read MAINIMG and PIPIMG only once and lock the two subjects respectively. MAIN only belongs to the main screen character; PIPCHAR only belongs to the lower left PIP window character. Both are independent characters, no confusion, no premature swapping, no mistaking PIPCHAR for MAIN, and no mistaking MAIN for PIPCHAR. For most of the video, Main screen = MAIN, lower left PIP = PIPCHAR, with a clear position swap only in the final high-speed transition." vocal: "Use the same original Japanese female lead vocal throughout; lyrics are not pre-written, freely improvised Japanese short phrases by the generation side; clear Japanese articulation and lip-sync; strong rhythmic hooks + short phrases + sustained notes; no quoting existing songs, no reading prompt words, no ah/oh/woo loops. No male lead vocals, no male-female switching, no changing singer due to character swaps." music: "150BPM intense Japanese dance music/Electronic House/High-speed Club; huge four-beat kick, tight snare/claps, rolling low frequency, sidechain synth bass, bright supersaw chord wall, metallic percussion, vocal chops, arpeggios, riser effects, impact. No slow intro. 0-13s each segment has clear downbeats and transition feel; 13-15s enter high-density chopped finale, and complete MAIN and PIPCHAR position swap at the end. The lead vocal remains the same female voice, no changing to male, no changing voice identity due to role swap." VOCAL_IDENTITY_LOCK: "0.00-15.00s always use the same original Japanese female lead vocal. Sound is an independent audio layer, does not change with visual character identity, appearance, gender performance, PIP content, or final role swap. Even if PIPCHAR enters the main screen, the female lead vocal must be completely continuous. No male lead, no male-female switching, no dual lead, no changing singer due to character swap." priority: "1 Main screen MAIN recognition established, 2 lower left PIPCHAR recognition established, 3 same female lead vocal throughout, 4 main screen continuous Japanese singing/dancing, 5 main screen sync 3-layer transition, 6 lower left PIP stability, 7 CHAR description change clearly visible, 8 camera, 9 final swap successful." MAIN_IDENTITY_DEFINITION: "MAIN consistency refers to character identity recognition, not identical pixel-level appearance. The goal is not a pixel-perfect copy of the source image, but for the audience to recognize it is the same MAIN regardless of style changes." MAIN_IDENTITY_LOCK: "MAIN fixed attributes: facial bone structure and feature relative positions; eye shape and expression tone; front hair structure and hairstyle base; head-to-body ratio, physique, body proportions; sense of age and overall temperament; key accessory logic. These form the core of MAIN recognition and must be maintained." MAIN_MUTABLE_ATTRIBUTES: "MAIN attributes allowed to change drastically: drawing style and medium; line language; coloring and shading; material representation; 2D/3D/Print/Craft processing; clothing color; clothing material; clothing details and decorations; stage-style modification of the same clothing base; local accessory enhancement or weakening; lighting effects and outline emphasis; degree of abstraction. entries.title: Epic Cinematic Fantasy Realm
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a 30-second fantasy sequence featuring a massive World-Tree, liquid starlight, and majestic sky-whales in a hyper-realistic 3D environment.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-epic cinematic 3D CGI fantasy realm, pure original imagination, hyper-detailed photorealistic 3D render, Unreal Engine 5 + Octane quality, volumetric god rays, intricate crystalline geometry, living magic energy, 8K resolution, seamless continuous camera movement, 30 seconds.

Sequence:

0-7 seconds: Colossal establishing shot of an impossible world suspended in the void. A single ancient World-Tree the size of a continent grows upside-down from a shattered floating continent, its roots forming living bridges of glowing amber crystal that stretch across the sky. Rivers of liquid starlight cascade upward into the heavens instead of falling. Slow majestic orbital camera movement as twin eclipsed suns cast dramatic dual-colored light (deep gold and electric violet).

7-15 seconds: Camera dives dramatically through the glowing roots into the heart of the World-Tree. Inside, vast hollow chambers filled with floating luminous orbs that contain entire miniature galaxies. Massive ethereal titans made of living stone and constellation patterns slowly awaken and walk along the inner walls. Energy storms of pure magic swirl in slow motion. Intense volumetric lighting and particle systems.

15-23 seconds: Camera explodes outward from the tree into open sky. A colossal sky-whale made of translucent crystal and nebula gas glides past, its body containing storms and lightning. Below, an entire civilization of spiraling crystal cities grows organically from the floating landmasses like living organisms. Giant rune-covered monoliths rise and rotate in the air, releasing waves of golden energy. Epic wide tracking shot with extreme depth and scale.

23-30 seconds: Final powerful pull-back into deep space revealing the entire original fantasy cosmos: the World-Tree at the center, surrounded by orbiting islands, sky-whales, and rivers of starlight forming a living mandala. The dual suns fully align, unleashing a massive wave of pure magical light that washes across the entire scene. Cinematic slow-motion ending on the glowing silhouette of the World-Tree against the cosmic void.

Style: Pure 3D imagination only, no 2D, hyper-realistic materials, extreme scale contrast, dramatic lighting, rich atmospheric haze, intricate original designs never seen before, epic and awe-inspiring mood, seamless one-shot feeling.

entries.title: Realistic Tokyo Convenience Store Vlog
entries.description: A prompt designed to create a handheld, smartphone-style vlog sequence of a woman walking into a Tokyo convenience store, focusing on natural movement, lighting, and environmental audio.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA
Third person handheld smartphone camera operated by a friend walking a few steps behind the girl. Casual vlog footage, not professional cinematography. Natural handheld shake, subtle footsteps vibration, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus adjustment and realistic phone-camera exposure. The camera follows her naturally at walking speed.

LOOK
Ordinary smartphone video recorded by a friend. Natural lighting, realistic skin texture, natural hair movement, normal phone sharpening and compression, slightly imperfect exposure. No cinematic polish or beauty filter.

STYLE
Simple everyday lifestyle vlog. Relaxed, spontaneous and believable. No dramatic acting or cinematic choreography.

CHARACTER
@Image1

The same young American woman from the reference image. Long black hair, naturally pretty face, brown eyes, cream oversized sweatshirt, loose baggy pants and casual sneakers. Keep her exact appearance consistent throughout.

SETTING
A normal convenience store in Tokyo, Japan. Ordinary Japanese neighborhood outside, glass storefront, bright fluorescent interior, narrow aisles, refrigerated drink cases, Japanese snacks and drinks, baskets and a few ordinary customers.

STORYBOARD (15s, ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE)

(~0 to 4s, Following Shot)
The girl walks normally toward the convenience store. The camera follows casually from several feet behind her at walking speed. Her hair and oversized sweatshirt move naturally as she walks.she turns back towards the camera and gives a smile and a gesture to camera to follow her then She reaches the entrance and opens the glass door.

(~4 to 7s, Entering)
The camera follows her inside. She walks naturally down the aisle toward the refrigerated drinks. The camera stays behind and slightly to her side with realistic handheld movement.

(~7 to 11s, Refrigerator)
She reaches the refrigerator and stops. She opens the glass door, looks through the drinks, selects one bottled drink and takes it out. The camera moves slightly closer while remaining handheld.

(~11 to 15s, Ending)
She closes the refrigerator door while holding the drink. She turns naturally toward the camera, looks at the person filming her and gives a small genuine smile while holding the drink. The camera remains slightly shaky and ends naturally.

AUDIO
Realistic synchronized location audio throughout the entire recording. No dialogue, no talking, no narration, no voiceover and no music.

Include natural footsteps on the pavement and store floor, subtle clothing and hair movement, distant Tokyo street traffic, passing bicycles, faint outdoor city ambience, the glass entrance door opening and closing, the convenience-store door chime, quiet footsteps from other customers, refrigerator compressor hum, the refrigerator door seal opening, bottles and shelves making subtle sounds when she takes the drink, and normal low-level store ambience.

Audio should sound like it was captured directly by a smartphone microphon
