entries.title: UGC Skincare Brand Video Commercial
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for a sunscreen advertisement featuring a woman in a sunny city, with detailed scene cuts and product shots.
entries.prompt:
WOMAN = a 26-year-old British woman, natural relatable UGC style, warm fair skin that reddens easily in the sun, light freckles across nose and cheeks, shoulder-length wavy light-brown hair loose, soft brows, blue-grey eyes, everyday face with minimal makeup, wearing a strappy pastel summer top with sunglasses pushed up on her head. Authentic girl-next-door energy. Appearance only.

CITY = a sunny city street on a blazing hot summer afternoon, bright pavements, shopfronts, street trees, heat haze shimmering, an intensely bright sun high in a clear blue sky, harsh direct sunlight, strong warm highlights and glare. Environment only.

DELURE = a sleek modern sunscreen bottle, clean minimal pastel-and-white packaging, the brand name "DELURE" printed clearly and legibly across the front in a modern sans-serif font, premium skincare look. Product only.

SCENE: a warm, authentic UGC-style sunscreen advert. A young British woman walks through a sunny city on a blazing hot day; the harsh sun is reddening her cheeks. She stops, takes a DELURE sunscreen bottle from her bag, and applies the cream to her cheeks; the redness fades and her skin calms back to normal, healthy and happy. She smiles, relieved. The advert ends on a clean product shot of the DELURE bottle.

TECHNICAL: 16:9 (or 9:16 vertical if preferred for UGC), bright natural handheld UGC-style camera, warm sunny summer color grade, crisp and clean, realistic self-filmed advert feel, shallow depth of field on the product shots, photorealistic.

CUTS:
CUT 1 (0-3s): Zoom straight into the blazing bright sun high in the clear blue sky, intense glare and lens flare, heat haze. Then tilt down to the woman walking along the sunny city street, squinting slightly against the heat, fanning herself.
CUT 2 (3-6s): Camera zooms in on her FACE — warm and sunlit, her cheeks visibly flushed and reddened from the harsh sun, a slightly uncomfortable expression. Close on the reddened cheeks.
CUT 3 (6-9s): She stops, reaches into her bag, and pulls out the DELURE sunscreen bottle. She squeezes a little cream onto her fingertips and gently applies it to her reddened cheeks, smoothing it in.
CUT 4 (9-12s): Close-up on her CHEEKS — the redness visibly fading and calming, her skin returning to its normal healthy warm-fair tone, soothed and even. She relaxes, the discomfort gone, and smiles softly with relief.
CUT 5 (12-15s): Camera shifts to a clean hero product shot of the DELURE sunscreen bottle held up in the sunlight (or resting on a bright surface), the brand name "DELURE" sharp and clearly legible, sunlight catching the packaging. A polished final beat.

RULES: References are appearance only, do not recreate. Keep the woman's face and identity consistent across every cut. The brand name "DELURE" must be spelled correctly

entries.title: Kyoto Solo Date Travel Film
entries.description: A photorealistic travel-style prompt following a woman through traditional alleys and scenic locations in Kyoto, Japan.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic travel video set in Kyoto, Japan, following a young blonde woman on a peaceful solo date through traditional Kyoto streets.

0–2 sec: Front-facing medium shot of the woman standing outside a traditional Kyoto machiya townhouse with dark wooden lattice doors. She smiles naturally and makes a small playful hand gesture toward the camera. Warm late-afternoon sunlight, realistic skin and hair movement, shallow depth of field.

2–4 sec: Cut to a smooth handheld tracking shot from behind as she walks through a narrow traditional Kyoto alley. Wooden buildings, textured walls, small plants and warm sunlight create beautiful natural depth. Camera follows closely with subtle realistic motion.

4–6 sec: Wide rear tracking shot as she continues walking down a quiet stone-paved alley lined with traditional wooden houses and potted greenery. Soft golden-hour sunlight creates long shadows and gentle lens flare.

6–8 sec: She reaches a small canal and pauses beside the stone wall. A friendly orange-and-white cat walks along the edge of the canal. She looks toward it with a gentle smile. Natural water reflections, subtle breeze moving her hair and clothing.

8–10 sec: Cut to a close cinematic shot beside a Japanese vending machine. She buys a small red canned drink and takes a sip, smiling naturally. Realistic hand movement, authentic vending-machine details, shallow depth of field.

10–12 sec: Golden-hour street scene. She stands near a Kyoto road, casually looking around while a traditional yellow taxi passes behind her. Strong sun flare, realistic traffic movement, cinematic backlight.

12–15 sec: Return to the narrow wooden alley. She walks toward the camera holding her drink, then briefly turns and looks back with a soft smile. Camera slowly pulls backward, revealing the beautiful traditional Kyoto architecture as the scene fades naturally.

Overall style: photorealistic Japanese travel film, authentic Kyoto atmosphere, natural human motion, realistic walking physics, subtle breathing and blinking, detailed hair and fabric movement, warm golden-hour lighting, soft cinematic lens flare, shallow depth of field, natural handheld/gimbal camera movement, realistic shadows and reflections, documentary-style cinematography, 35mm film look, premium travel commercial, highly detailed, seamless transitions, no artificial-looking CGI, no distorted hands or face, consistent character appearance throughout.

entries.title: Korean Horror Zombie Convenience Store Attack
entries.description: An intense, multi-stage prompt for a zombie attack sequence in a convenience store, utilizing a reference character image for the transformation.
entries.prompt:
Character (image) A scans items behind a convenience-store counter, blank hollow stare; uneasy customer nearby, flickering fluorescent lights, realistic Korean horror.
Her fingers freeze on the scanner; repeated beeps, tense silence, cold atmosphere.
She violently convulses against the counter; customer stumbles, snack rack falls.
She collapses behind the counter; arm twitches at an unnatural angle.
She rises again with slack face, wide unfocused eyes, and unnaturally bent joints.
Customers scream and back away as others freeze in panic.
Her jaw stretches impossibly wide as she lunges over the counter.
She vaults over the counter with backward-bending limbs, moving unnaturally fast.
She stands between the aisles, back to camera, head tilted at a broken angle, blocking the exit.
A young customer looks up at her in terror, tears forming.
Another customer freezes by the drink fridge, her reflection flickering in the glass.
She charges down the narrow aisle, knocking shelves and cans down.
Customers shove toward the exit; one trips over a basket and scrambles up.
She crashes through a shelf display near the door, reaching for fleeing customers.
She grabs a customer's jacket and yanks them back.
A customer grabs the fire extinguisher and pulls the pin with shaking hands.
White powder blasts her face; she recoils into the drink cooler.
Another customer keeps her back with a mop.
She knocks the mop aside and grabs the hot-water kettle; steam bursts as she recoils.
She staggers toward the glass door, silhouetted by flickering neon.
She crashes through the glass door into the empty night street, shards scattering.
Powder-covered customers stare into the empty street through the shattered doorway. Final CCTV angle, quiet horror ending.

entries.title: Stylized 3D Animation: Old Man and Pigeon
entries.description: A charming 3D animation prompt about an eccentric elderly man and a mischievous pigeon sharing a comedic and sweet moment on a balcony.
entries.prompt: [Global Setting] Cozy old apartment balcony in warm golden morning light, colorful flower pots, wooden chair, hanging laundry, small table with bird seeds. 3D stylized animation with rounded appealing characters, expressive faces, playful physical comedy and sincere warmth. [Character 1: The Eccentric Old Man] Age 75+, round belly, wispy white hair, faded cardigan, loose trousers, worn slippers, spectacles sliding down his nose. Speaks rarely, mostly communicates through facial expressions and body language. Same appearance and cardigan throughout. [Character 2: The Mischievous Pigeon] One plump gray pigeon with shiny feathers, curious expressive eyes and a smug personality. Mostly silent, communicates through head movements, expressions and body language. [Opening, 0–6s] Old man sits on his balcony chair and places a small pile of sunflower seeds on his palm. He smiles at the pigeon and warmly says: “Come on, little friend.” The pigeon slowly approaches and stares at him suspiciously. [Funny Moment, 6–14s] The pigeon suddenly grabs the seed and jumps onto the old man's head. The old man freezes completely, eyes wide. He slowly looks upward while the pigeon casually looks down at him with a smug expression. The old man sighs and shakes his head. [Sweet Moment, 14–23s] The old man carefully lifts the pigeon from his head and holds it gently against his chest. The pigeon relaxes and nuzzles into him. The old man smiles and softly says: “You win, little friend.” He gently strokes its feathers. [Closing, 23–30s] The old man sits peacefully in the golden sunlight with the pigeon resting beside him. The pigeon closes its eyes comfortably. The old man smiles, closes his eyes and quietly laughs. Camera slowly pulls back, revealing the cozy balcony. [CONSISTENCY] One old man, one gray pigeon, same clothing, same balcony and same lighting throughout. No cuts, no scene changes, no character duplication. No subtitles or text. [Voice & Audio] Warm natural elderly male voice, gentle and slightly humorous. Only 2 short dialogue lines. Natural pigeon coos, soft wing flaps, morning birds, gentle wind, subtle comedic music during the funny moment, warm nostalgic during the ending.

entries.translated_prompt:
Seedance Video Prompt | 15 Seconds | Sword Training Correction
I. Generation Goal
Movie-grade realistic texture, pure ancient Chinese Xianxia aesthetics.
Overall features:
Elegant and clear martial arts choreography
Restrained relationship-based comedy
Arri Alexa film camera texture
Clear and stable facial details
Natural morning volumetric light
Fine film grain
Core Reversal Principle
The plot is entirely driven by the characters' own personalities, goals, and interactions. The environment is just an independent, real, and living world; it must not trigger the plot, solve problems, change character goals, or comment on the plot.
II. Environment Generation Principles
Before formal composition, all reference images jointly determine the environment's DNA.
Co-evolve compatible features: Terrain, Architecture, Spatial Scale, Age of materials, Vegetation, Water systems, Weather, Clouds, Fog density, Lighting direction, Reflection relationships, Color systems, Atmospheric depth.
Then reorganize this information into a unique, complete, and logical new space.
Environment Requirements
Background movement must be continuous, natural, and physically accurate. The environment must be 'alive' but remain neutral in narration. The environment must not steal the spotlight or actively create gags or drive character relationships.
III. Scene Setting
Location: A stone sword-training platform at a mountain gate reorganized from all reference images.
Environmental Anchors: Moist stone slabs after rain, carved stone railings, ancient pines, bamboo forest, distant tiled-roof halls, a continuous flowing narrow water channel, layered distant mountains, slowly moving valley fog. These elements establish a clear, stable, and real spatial relationship.
IV. Character Settings
Character ID A | Senior Sister Sword Immortal
Strictly maintain the same identity as @Image 1.
25–30 year old East Asian female, oval face, fair natural skin tone, dark almond eyes, long black hair half-tied with a white jade hairpin. Tall and slender, wearing white cloth boots, white embroidered silk Hanfu with semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver waist seal, and a jade pendant. Holds a unique silver longsword.
Character ID B | Junior Sister
Strictly maintain the same identity as @Image 2.
20–25 year old East Asian female, rounded and lively face, black hair in braids, petite build. Wearing blue-green linen Hanfu, dark belt, wooden hairpin, and black cloth shoes. Holds a unique dark steel sword.
V. Lens Structure
Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide or Long Shot
Establish the entire sword-training platform space. Both characters enter the frame completely from feet to head, formally bow with swords, then raise swords simultaneously.
Dialogue
Junior sister says seriously: 'No letting me win today.'
Camera and Environment Requirements
The frame first clearly establishes the spatial relationship of the platform. The two characters are the main focus. The water channel flows continuously, valley fog moves slowly, pine branches and bamboo sway at different magnitudes in the wind. Reflections on the wet stone surface exist naturally. These changes are for spatial realism only and do not participate in the plot.
Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium or Cowboy Shot
Enter the sparring process. Junior sister launches a serious and clean frontal thrust.
Action Design
Junior sister completes a clear frontal thrust. Senior sister takes only one side step and blocks once. After blocking, she naturally holds the junior's sword wrist and gently adjusts the angle downward. Senior sister says: 'Wrist is high again.' Junior sister immediately pulls away, attacks again, senior sister blocks again while gently tapping the junior's front foot with her white boot to narrow her stance. Senior sister adds: 'Feet too wide.'
Environment Requirements
The same training platform remains stable. The water channel, fog, and vegetation continue their natural movements. Reflections change naturally with the camera angle. Background changes must remain neutral.
Shot 3 | 10–15s | Close-up or Extreme Close-up
Junior sister suddenly stops, her sword still in an offensive posture. She finally can't help asking.
Dialogue and Action
Junior sister asks: 'Sister, are you here for a duel or to teach me?'
Senior sister remains expressionless, only uses two fingers to gently push the junior's slightly tilted sword tip straight. Senior sister answers calmly: 'Win over your bad habits first.'
Complete pause for half a beat. Then: Junior sister glares at her but doesn't argue, instead silently adjusts her wrist angle and foot position as instructed. Then she strikes again.
Ending
Extreme close-up captures a very slight, almost imperceptible satisfied smile at the corner of the senior sister's mouth. The two longswords touch precisely off-screen with a single crisp metallic 'Clang' to end.
VI. Technical Requirements
Strict total duration: 15 seconds. 16:9 horizontal screen. Three continuous clear shots. Native synchronized Mandarin dialogue. No subtitles generated.
VII. Stability Requirements
Must strictly ensure: facial stability, clothing stability, sword stability, clear geographic relationships, clear spatial axes, logical actions, real body mechanics, and clean, restrained, readable martial arts movements.
VIII. Physical and Environmental Requirements
Elements like body movements, silk fabric, hair, water flow, mountain fog, vegetation, reflections, and spatial ambient sound must be real and natural. Only the two visible characters should appear.

[00:02-00:04.2] 镜头 2：生气离席 镜头保持原机位。猫皱眉、耳朵略向后、眼神不满，前爪放开筷子，边回怼边从餐椅跳到地面，从餐桌侧边走开；跳下与落地动作必须符合真实猫的身体运动。 台词口型： [00:02.07-00:04.19] 猫气呼呼、语速稍快：“那你不爱我，我也不爱你了。”
[00:04.2-00:06.5] 镜头 3：撒娇哭着挽回 短暂停顿。猫走到餐桌侧前方后忽然回头望向镜头，刚才的生气瞬间转成委屈：眼眶湿润、眉眼耷拉、嘴角向下，鼻头轻轻抽动。它不是夸张嚎哭，而是可爱地带着哭腔、着急求和；一只前爪轻抬，像想挽留镜头外的人。 台词口型： [00:04.95-00:06.47] 画外音，急切地说：“我爱我爱，快回来吧。”
[00:06.5-00:10] 镜头 4：哭着走近，傲娇答应 猫从餐桌侧边继续朝镜头小跑靠近，眼睛还带泪光，边走边有轻微委屈抽泣；镜头内猫脸逐渐变大、最后近距离占满画面。 台词口型： [00:08.03-00:08.27] 猫带鼻音、轻轻回应：“嗯。”（哭腔） [00:08.27-00:10.00] 不再说话，猫委屈巴巴地直视镜头，保留原声尾部的安静停顿，自然收尾。，9:16，10s

entries.prompt:
A vibrant K-pop stage performance under bright purple and pink LED lights. Three young East Asian women idols with long dark hair stand in a line on stage, wearing headset microphones and stylish crop tops.

Characters and outfits:

Left idol: lime-green sleeveless top with white “BOYS LIE SPORT” text and heart logo.

Center idol: baby-pink spaghetti-strap crop top with white piping.

Right idol: navy-and-green horizontal striped collared crop top.

Sequence — approximately 17 seconds:

0–2s: The three idols begin by dancing lightly and naturally in sync to the beat. The center idol flips her long hair and turns slightly while dancing. The right idol dances with a playful expression. Do not have them cover their faces yet. Soft stage lighting and large LED screens show a big red “5” and heart graphics in the background.

2–6s: While continuing their dance movement, all three suddenly bring both hands up to cover their mouths, reacting with genuine surprise and laughter. Their shoulders shake as they giggle and they gently bounce in place. The center idol laughs hardest, with her long hair naturally swaying.

6–12s: They continue the synchronized cover-mouth-and-laugh motion while still subtly dancing to the beat. Keep their bodies moving naturally rather than freezing in place. Their expressions are joyful, playful, and genuinely amused. Medium camera framing captures all three idols clearly.

12–15s: The dancing continues at 12 seconds as they smoothly transition from covering their mouths into making double peace signs with both hands raised near their faces. They keep moving rhythmically while smiling and laughing. The center idol briefly turns and then faces forward again.

15–17s: Final pose while the dance energy continues subtly — all three hold double peace signs near their faces, beaming directly at the camera with bright, cheerful expressions. Soft stage haze and colorful LED lighting create a high-energy yet adorable K-pop concert atmosphere.

Visual style: high-quality live concert footage, sharp details, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, dynamic but soft purple-and-pink stage lighting, subtle handheld camera shake for realism, natural hair movement, believable body motion, polished K-pop performance cinematography, cute, energetic, wholesome atmosphere.

Important motion requirements: The idols must dance first before putting their hands on their faces. Do not start with their hands covering their mouths. The dancing continues throughout the sequence, including after the 12-second mark. No frozen poses before the final moment. No text overlays.

entries.title: Cinematic Beast Transformation Sequence
entries.description: A sophisticated multi-part cinematic prompt for an urban night scene where a woman transforms into an ancient beast under a blood-red moon.
entries.prompt: Format: 16:9 | Look: Photorealistic, 8K, 35mm film, cool-toned night grade, shallow depth of field, lens grain, cinematic hard cuts, dynamic camera per shot CHARACTER DESCRIPTION The Woman (pre-transformation): Mid-20s, Western/European features, strikingly attractive and beautiful. Fair, luminous skin with a soft cool undertone that catches the neon well. Long, wavy chestnut-brown hair loose around her shoulders. High cheekbones, full lips, expressive light hazel-green eyes. Slim, toned, elegant build, roughly 5'8". Wardrobe: a fitted black leather jacket over a simple fitted top, dark high-waisted jeans, ankle boots — modern, stylish, urban-night aesthetic. Minimal jewelry (thin gold necklace) that will later echo the beast's gold markings. The Beast (post-transformation): Tall, lean, unmistakably feminine — never bulky or male-coded, and not wolf-like. Slender long-limbed frame, long legs ending in black-clawed paws. Thick ruff of cream-white fur across the chest. Coat mottled black, gold and cream. Crown of tall branching gold horns. Fine gold facial markings tracing her cheekbones and brow (echoing the woman's features). Amber-gold slit-pupil eyes. Long membranous black-and-gold wings. Trailing golden tendrils drifting from the horns and spine. The transformation is progressive and layered — skin to hide, fur in a traveling wave, muscle lengthening, nails to claws, horns branching, wings unfurling — surface-level morphing only, no wounds, no tearing, no blood. SETTING A generic Shibuya-style crossing at night — no real landmarks, brands, or logos; invented signage text only. Neon in magenta, cyan and violet, wet asphalt mirroring the light, drifting steam, light rain haze. A huge blood-red moon dominates the sky above the skyline throughout. PART 1 — 0:00–0:15 — "THE OMEN AND THE COLLAPSE" Shot 1 (0–4s) — The Red Moon Opens tight on the enormous blood-red moon above the skyline. Long continuous extreme crane-down past glowing tower screens (invented neon kanji-style signage) toward the crowded crossing below, then pushes through the crowd to settle on the woman walking among them, one hand pressed to her temple, head down, unsteady, hair damp with mist. Shot 2 (4–7s) — First Tremor Hard cut to a low tracking shot at hip height following her boots across wet asphalt — reflections of neon rippling with each step — as her stride breaks rhythm and she catches herself against an invisible wave of dizziness. Shot 3 (7–11s) — The Collapse Cut to handheld medium pushing with her through the crowd. She stumbles, breath shallow, face pale under the neon wash. Her knees buckle and she drops to the pavement. Shot 4 (11–15s) — The Empty Ring Wide crane shot as the crowd scatters back in a widening ring, phones raised, murmurs rippling outward, until she is alone, kneeling, at the dead center of the empty crossing — rain haze drifting through the neon light around her. PART 2 — 0:15–0:30 — "THE TRANSFORMATION" Shot 5 (15–26s) — One Unbroken Take Extreme low angle at asphalt level, 24mm wide lens, only her right hand in frame, pressed flat on the wet asphalt, oversized by wide-lens perspective. Camera zooms hard on the back of her hand: pale skin darkens into hide, cream-white and mottled gold-black fur emerges strand by strand, fingers lengthen, nails darken into black claws that gouge the asphalt. Camera tracks and pushes along the forearm following the wave of fur, rises to the shoulder, swings around to find her face in tight close-up — still human, jaw clenched, terror in her hazel-green eyes — then pushes into an extreme close-up of her eyes as the irises flood amber-gold, pupils narrowing to slits, the last trace of the woman vanishing. Camera pulls back into a fast orbiting handheld shake as the white ruff floods her chest, gold markings spread across her face, golden horns branch from her temples, wings unfurl behind her. The orbit whips to the front as the fully formed beast rises to full height. Shot 6 (26–30s) — The Roar Low, wide-angle hold as she plants her clawed paws and throws her head back — a full-body roar, wings snapping open to full span, golden tendrils whipping outward, neon light rippling across her mottled coat. PART 3 — 0:30–0:45 — "PANIC, PURSUIT AND THE HOWL" Shot 7 (30–33s) — Panic Fast handheld at street level as the beast sweeps her clawed limbs and lunges forward, wings flaring wide. The crowd breaks and scatters, people sprinting past the lens, camera whip-panning through the chaos as neon streaks smear across the wet asphalt. Shot 8 (33–36s) — The Chase Beat Low tracking shot alongside her as she bounds on all fours between stalled cars and scattering crowds, claws sparking faintly off metal and asphalt, wings half-folded for speed, camera struggling to keep pace — motion blur and lens flare from passing neon signs. Shot 9 (36–39s) — The Climb Fast upward-tracking shot as she launches from the crossing and scales a building face in fluid bounds, claws punching into the facade, mottled coat and white ruff catching the neon, wings half-folded. Camera rises with her, orbiting outward to reveal the city sprawling below. Shot 10 (39–42s) — The Perch Cut to a slow dolly-in on the rooftop ledge as she lands in a low crouch, wings settling against her back, chest heaving, gold facial markings glowing faintly under the moon, ears (horn-crown) tracking the city sounds below. Shot 11 (42–45s) — The Howl Low-angle wide on the rooftop tower — she stands tall, lit by neon from below, the enormous red moon directly behind her, her crown of golden horns and outstretched wings rim-lit against it. She rears back and howls, fur and golden tendrils rippling in the wind. Camera cranes slowly up and back into a vast wide, city lights sprawling out, rain drifting across the frame as the shot holds on the silhouette-and-glow composition for the final beat. EXTRA ACTION BEATS (optional inserts to extend further / alternate cuts) Insert after Shot 4: a tight cutaway of a dropped phone on wet asphalt, screen cracked, still recording, neon reflected in the cracked glass. Insert after Shot 6: a low static shot of scattered crowd members frozen mid-flight, silhouetted against a neon billboard, as the beast's shadow sweeps over them. Insert after Shot 9: a brief aerial drone-style shot circling the tower as steam vents hiss below her perch, city traffic streaking far beneath. Alternate ending extension: slow-motion feather/fur wisp caught in the wind drifting past camera as the howl fades, rain intensifying, screen fading to the red moon.

entries.title: Warehouse Parkour Ballet
entries.description: A vertical video prompt for a static smartphone-shot scene of a girl performing balletic parkour movements in a warehouse.
entries.prompt:
Real iPhone 15 Pro Max, 9:16
vertical, one continuous static shot - camera on the ground, no movement, zoom, cuts or grade, real grain, daylight.
POV: the camera IS the phone on the ground - never visible: not in hand, in shot, or as a reflection.
Warehouse: rusted beams 15m up, god rays in dusty air, graffiti walls, cracked concrete.
THREAD: each time she opens a palm and a white semitransparent strand SHOOTS from it to the beam, then she grabs and swings - never pre-attached; fired threads stay hanging.
She walks in, crouches, hand to the ground, stands, exits left.
Runs back - palm to upper
RIGHT beam, thread shoots, connects, swings up; at the peak a slow balletic somersault, pointe shoes pointed. Airborne, the other palm fires to upper LEFT beam, swings to the LEFT wall, pushes off both feet, a clean backward somersault, lands in a low crouch. She walks to us, crouches, hands reach for the lens, face above - light smile. auiet exhale. Hold. Cut.

entries.title: Japanese Game Show Obstacle Challenge
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a Japanese-style variety show obstacle course video, specifying character design, camera movement, and on-screen broadcast graphics.
entries.prompt: [Style] Large-scale Japanese variety show water obstacle challenge special program (Japanese TV Game Show, Live-Action Broadcast), multi-camera real-time broadcast, 4K photorealistic photography, high-saturation summer colors, real-time throughout without slow motion. [Duration] 30 seconds [Reference] @ Image1 defines the challenger's face, hairstyle, body proportions, and full outfit. Use only the person. Do not use the grey studio background, the reference-sheet grid layout, or the multiple-view composition. Only one HANEUL exists in the video at all times. [Character] HANEUL — adult Korean female, early 20s, strong and healthy athletic build. Straight black chin-length bob with full blunt bangs, brown eyes, small stud earrings. Outfit exactly as @ Image1: fitted black short-sleeve crop tee, grey pinstripe pleated micro skirt with a plain white elastic waistband (no legible text), white ankle socks, black chunky platform derby shoes. She speaks only Korean. [Scene] Sunny outdoor large leisure pool obstacle course, five stages lined up from left to right. Stage 1: 5-meter high wooden jumping platform, Tarzan rope with pulley on overhead cable. Stage 2: 3-meter diameter red and yellow circular floating disc on the water, rotating continuously at a constant speed on an underwater axis, slippery surface. Stage 3: Four square floating blocks of varying distances, bobbing up and down with the waves. Stage 4: A slanted blue slippery climbing wall with grab ropes hanging from the top. Stage 5: A huge yellow cylindrical pipe spanning the water, wet reflective vinyl surface printed with red flame patterns, rotating continuously at a constant speed by a motor, just thick enough to be hugged by arms and legs, the right end connected to a small finish platform, directly below is a clear pool with no safety mats. Background includes palm trees, large water slides, light stands, commentary booth, temporary stands full of spectators. The entire film moves from left to right. [Screen Graphics] Top-left corner: a fictional program emblem — a hexagonal blue-and-red shield with a stylized white water-splash silhouette and the invented wordmark "SPLASH ATTACK". Fixed position and size, semi-transparent, present in every shot. Not based on any real brand or broadcaster. Top-right corner: a digital countdown timer in a rounded white box, large bold numerals with one decimal place. It reads 90.0 when the start buzzer sounds and counts down continuously and visibly in 0.1 steps (90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...) for the entire run. It never counts up and never resets. It freezes at 63.0 the instant she falls into the water and stays frozen and dimmed for the final shot. Opening telop (visible 00:00-00:03 only, lower third): a pink-and-white broadcast nameplate — a magenta circle on the left containing the number "07"; to its right the name "HANEUL" in large bold letters with small katakana furigana "ハヌル" printed above it; directly below, a red banner strip reading "アイドル練習生". The nameplate slides in from the left, holds, then slides out. No other on-screen text anywhere in the video. [Fixed Items] The position, size, color, and connection of the five stages remain unchanged throughout the film; only one challenger is always in the frame; hair and clothes are dry at the start and only naturally soaked after falling into the water; the circular floating disc and yellow pipe must be continuously rotating in all shots where they appear; the corner emblem and the countdown timer stay in the same corners at the same size in every shot. [00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Tarzan rope launch (Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back, ENG Camera) Visual: She stands on the edge of the 5-meter platform holding the rope, toes gripping the edge. Opening nameplate telop on screen. Timer reads 90.0 and starts running down on the buzzer, reaching 87.0. Dialogue (Korean): {무조건 클리어합니다!} Action: When the buzzer sounds, she kicks off forcefully, the pulley slides right along the cable, her body swings over the water in a pendulum arc, black bob and bangs blown back by the wind. Commentary (Japanese): {まずはターザンロープ!} SFX: Start buzzer, pulley sliding, crowd cheering. [00:03-00:07] Shot 2: Landing on rotating disc (Fixed Side Shot) Visual: Fixed camera on the side of the floating disc, showing the person, rope, and disc. Timer runs from 87.0 down to 83.0. Scene: The red and yellow circular floating disc is rotating continuously at a constant speed on the water, the slippery surface reflecting light. Action: She releases the rope and lands on the disc; as soon as her platform soles touch, she is carried sideways and backwards by the rotation. She spreads her arms and takes small, rapid steps in the opposite direction to offset the rotation, knees bent and center of gravity low, stabilizing after a few wobbles. Expression: Eyebrows fly up, teeth clenched, then a quick grin. Commentary (Japanese): {回転板だ! 耐えた!} SFX: Low-frequency hum of the turntable axis, sound of soles rubbing, a burst of cheers. [00:07-00:12] Shot 3: Floating board jumps (Dolly Track L→R) Camera: Dolly camera moving parallel to the direction of progress, tracking from left to right. Timer runs from 83.0 down to 78.0. Visual: Four square floating blocks bobbing up and down with the waves, unevenly spaced. Action: She jumps from the edge of the turntable, crossing the floating blocks with four consecutive single-foot jumps. On the second block she missteps, the block sinks sharply, her upper body lunges forward and arms circle wildly for balance. Her right foot splashes in the water before she manages to step onto the third block, and the final jump lands both feet on the fourth block. Dialogue (Korean): {아, 위험해...!} Commentary (Japanese): {二枚目で崩れた! でも繋いだ!} SFX: Muffled sound of blocks hitting water, splashing, intermittent gasps from the audience. [00:12-00:17] Shot 4: Slippery climbing wall (Front 3/4 Medium Shot) Visual: Front diagonal medium shot, showing the person, the sloped wall, and the grab ropes at the top. Timer runs from 78.0 down to 73.0. Scene: The blue slanted wall is covered in running water, reflecting light. Action: She runs up the wall, takes three steps, then her soles slip and she slides down a bit. She immediately drops her body to grab the wall, fingertips digging into the surface texture, and climbs again, right hand grabbing the rope hanging from the top, pulling herself up with arm strength. Expression: Neck muscles tensed, forehead creased, wet bangs stuck to her forehead, breathing heavily. Dialogue (Korean): {영차, 영차...!} Commentary (Japanese): {滑る壁! 腕だけで登った!} SFX: Friction on the wet wall, rope tightening, applause from the crowd. [00:17-00:21] Shot 5: Hugging the rotating log (Rear Side Fixed Shot) Visual: Slightly rear fixed side shot, clearly showing the pipe is rotating. Timer runs from 73.0 down to 69.0. Scene: The yellow cylindrical pipe rotates continuously by a motor, a layer of water on the wet vinyl surface, red flame patterns rolling across the screen as it turns. Action: She jumps from the top of the slope and straddles the base of the pipe, clamping it with her chest, stomach, arms, and legs. The rotation immediately carries her to the right; she adjusts her center of gravity in the opposite direction and shuffles toward the finish by moving her arms and legs in small increments. Dialogue (Korean): {어, 돌아간다!?} Commentary (Japanese): {回転丸太だ! これが最難関!} SFX: Low-frequency motor sound, wet vinyl friction. [00:21-00:26] Shot 6: Flipped over - Limit before finish (Front Close-up → Medium Pull-back) Camera: Front close-up at the finish side slowly pulling back to a medium shot, camera axis remains unchanged. Timer runs from 69.0 down to 64.0. Action: The pipe continues to rotate, slowly flipping her body to the right. Her center of gravity passes the highest point of the pipe and she can't pull it back. Her right leg detaches first, flailing

Stage 5: A huge yellow cylindrical pipe spanning the water, wet reflective vinyl surface printed with red flame patterns, rotating continuously at a constant speed by a motor, just thick enough to be hugged by arms and legs, the right end connected to a small finish platform, directly below is a clear pool with no safety mats. Background includes palm trees, large water slides, light stands, commentary booth, temporary stands full of spectators. The entire film moves from left to right. [Screen Graphics] Top-left corner: a fictional program emblem — a hexagonal blue-and-red shield with a stylized white water-splash silhouette and the invented wordmark "SPLASH ATTACK". Fixed position and size, semi-transparent, present in every shot. Not based on any real brand or broadcaster. Top-right corner: a digital countdown timer in a rounded white box, large bold numerals with one decimal place. It reads 90.0 when the start buzzer sounds and counts down continuously and visibly in 0.1 steps (90.0 → 89.9 → 89.8 ...) for the entire run. It never counts up and never resets. It freezes at 63.0 the instant she falls into the water and stays frozen and dimmed for the final shot. Opening telop (visible 00:00-00:03 only, lower third): a pink-and-white broadcast nameplate — a magenta circle on the left containing the number "07"; to its right the name "HANEUL" in large bold letters with small katakana furigana "Haneul" printed above it; directly below, a red banner strip reading "Idol Trainee". The nameplate slides in from the left, holds, then slides out. No other on-screen text anywhere in the video. [Fixed Items] The position, size, color, and connection of the five stages remain unchanged throughout the film; only one challenger is always in the frame; hair and clothes are dry at the start and only naturally soaked after falling into the water; the circular floating disc and yellow pipe must be continuously rotating in all shots where they appear; the corner emblem and the countdown timer stay in the same corners at the same size in every shot. [00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Tarzan rope launch (Eye-level Medium → Wide Pull-back, ENG Camera) Visual: She stands on the edge of the 5-meter platform holding the rope, toes gripping the edge. Opening nameplate telop on screen. Timer reads 90.0 and starts running down on the buzzer, reaching 87.0. Dialogue (Korean): {I'll definitely clear this!} Action: When the buzzer sounds, she kicks off forcefully, the pulley slides right along the cable, her body swings over the water in a pendulum arc, black bob and bangs blown back by the wind. Commentary (Japanese): {First up, the Tarzan rope!} SFX: Start buzzer, pulley sliding, crowd cheering. [00:03-00:07] Shot 2: Landing on rotating disc (Fixed Side Shot) Visual: Fixed camera on the side of the floating disc, showing the person, rope, and disc. Timer runs from 87.0 down to 83.0. Scene: The red and yellow circular floating disc is rotating continuously at a constant speed on the water, the slippery surface reflecting light. Action: She releases the rope and lands on the disc; as soon as her platform soles touch, she is carried sideways and backwards by the rotation. She spreads her arms and takes small, rapid steps in the opposite direction to offset the rotation, knees bent and center of gravity low, stabilizing after a few wobbles. Expression: Eyebrows fly up, teeth clenched, then a quick grin. Commentary (Japanese): {It's the rotating disc! She held on!} SFX: Low-frequency hum of the turntable axis, sound of soles rubbing, a burst of cheers. [00:07-00:12] Shot 3: Floating board jumps (Dolly Track L→R) Camera: Dolly camera moving parallel to the direction of progress, tracking from left to right. Timer runs from 83.0 down to 78.0. Visual: Four square floating blocks bobbing up and down with the waves, unevenly spaced. Action: She jumps from the edge of the turntable, crossing the floating blocks with four consecutive single-foot jumps. On the second block she missteps, the block sinks sharply, her upper body lunges forward and arms circle wildly for balance. Her right foot splashes in the water before she manages to step onto the third block, and the final jump lands both feet on the fourth block. Dialogue (Korean): {Ah, it's dangerous...!} Commentary (Japanese): {She stumbled on the second one! But she recovered!} SFX: Muffled sound of blocks hitting water, splashing, intermittent gasps from the audience. [00:12-00:17] Shot 4: Slippery climbing wall (Front 3/4 Medium Shot) Visual: Front diagonal medium shot, showing the person, the sloped wall, and the grab ropes at the top. Timer runs from 78.0 down to 73.0. Scene: The blue slanted wall is covered in running water, reflecting light. Action: She runs up the wall, takes three steps, then her soles slip and she slides down a bit. She immediately drops her body to grab the wall, fingertips digging into the surface texture, and climbs again, right hand grabbing the rope hanging from the top, pulling herself up with arm strength. Expression: Neck muscles tensed, forehead creased, wet bangs stuck to her forehead, breathing heavily. Dialogue (Korean): {Heave-ho, heave-ho...!} Commentary (Japanese): {The slippery wall! She climbed it using only her arms!} SFX: Friction on the wet wall, rope tightening, applause from the crowd. [00:17-00:21] Shot 5: Hugging the rotating log (Rear Side Fixed Shot) Visual: Slightly rear fixed side shot, clearly showing the pipe is rotating. Timer runs from 73.0 down to 69.0. Scene: The yellow cylindrical pipe rotates continuously by a motor, a layer of water on the wet vinyl surface, red flame patterns rolling across the screen as it turns. Action: She jumps from the top of the slope and straddles the base of the pipe, clamping it with her chest, stomach, arms, and legs. The rotation immediately carries her to the right; she adjusts her center of gravity in the opposite direction and shuffles toward the finish by moving her arms and legs in small increments. Dialogue (Korean): {Uh, it's turning!?} Commentary (Japanese): {It's the rotating log! This is the most difficult part!} SFX: Low-frequency motor sound, wet vinyl friction. [00:21-00:26] Shot 6: Flipped over - Limit before finish (Front Close-up → Medium Pull-back) Camera: Front close-up at the finish side slowly pulling back to a medium shot, camera axis remains unchanged. Timer runs from 69.0 down to 64.0. Action: The pipe continues to rotate, slowly flipping her body to the right. Her center of gravity passes the highest point of the pipe and she can't pull it back. Her right leg detaches first, flailing

entries.title: Finger Frame Video Effect Prompt
entries.description: A technical prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a live-action video of a woman making viewfinder finger frames with precise two-phase motion control.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic live-action video, shot on cinema camera, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, 16:9 horizontal.

Setting: A cozy indoor room with warm ambient lighting, posters on wall, hanging lamp, modern furniture.

Subject: A young blonde American woman with shoulder-length golden blonde hair, fair skin, wearing a gray hooded jacket. She faces the camera from waist up.

The video has TWO distinct phases — do NOT repeat the same motion throughout.

=== FIRST HALF (seconds 0–5): Horizontal spring stretch ===
- Both hands at face height. Thumb and index finger on each hand form L-shaped viewfinder corners facing inward.
- Purely horizontal motion: hands close together in front of her face, then pull outward left and right to shoulder width, then pull back to center. Repeat this lateral spring cycle 2–3 times.
- Smooth, elastic sideways pull. Forearms stay level. Elbows move outward as hands spread.

=== SECOND HALF (seconds 5–10): Varied finger-frame gestures ===
- Transition naturally into different finger-frame poses. She rotates and flips her wrists so the thumb-index frame orientation changes.
- Always keep thumb and index finger extended upright forming the corner of a viewfinder on BOTH hands.
- End with hands at a relaxed wide finger-frame pose.

NOT animated, NOT cartoon, NOT 3D render, NOT anime — real filmed footage. Stable camera, no zoom, no cuts.

entries.title: Emotional Breakdown Sequence
entries.description: A high-emotion prompt for a woman's crying sequence with specific fabric interactions and character consistency.
entries.prompt:
Use the reference image as the starting frame. Maintain exact character consistency: young East Asian woman, grey sleeveless top, large thin silver hoop earrings, soft overcast lighting, and a completely blurred coastal background. Maintain a subtle, continuous handheld camera drift, with her hair gently moving in the wind throughout.

Sequence of actions:

1. She suppresses a cry—lips press tightly together, chin trembles, chest heaves with a sharp inhale. Tears pool in her eyes but do not fall.
2. The emotion breaks. Her eyes squeeze shut, her mouth opens into a sob, and tears begin rolling down both cheeks. Her head tilts slightly downward.
3. The front collar of her grey shirt is pulled straight upward from the bottom edge of the frame, naturally stretching over her chin, mouth, and nose. The fabric must deform realistically around her facial features. No hands, fingers, or arms enter the frame.
4. The fabric releases and naturally falls back to her collarbones. Her face is revealed again—eyes slightly open and looking downward, mouth open as she takes heavy, exhausted breaths.

entries.title: Vintage 16mm Jerusalem Travel Vlog
entries.description: A first-person travel vlog prompt that simulates a vintage 16mm handheld camcorder aesthetic, detailing a sequence of spontaneous interactions and scenes in Old Jerusalem.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA:
Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic, first-person/selfie POV. CHASE always holds the camera. Natural hand shake, imperfect framing, delayed autofocus, clumsy zooms, occasional face cropping. The camcorder is never visible.

LOOK:
Soft vintage DV tape quality with slight blur, subtle tape noise, mild highlight bloom, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, natural skin tones.

STYLE:
Raw, candid travel vlog. Genuine reactions, eye contact, spontaneous energy, quick handheld shots capturing real people and everyday life around Old Jerusalem. Nothing feels staged or professionally filmed.

CHARACTER:
CHASE, British female traveler in her 20s. Long straight brown hair, natural fair skin, soft British features, blue eyes, natural lips, slim figure. Wearing modest casual travel clothing with natural makeup and simple accessories.
SETTING:
Historic streets of Old Jerusalem surrounding Masjid al-Aqsa with narrow ancient stone alleyways, crowded markets, small shops, food vendors, wooden doors, stone arches, local families, elderly people, children, pedestrians, and worshippers naturally passing by.

SEQUENCE:

1. Selfie: walks into a crowded Old Jerusalem street, turning the camera toward the people, shops, vendors, and busy street around her. “There’s so much happening here.”
2. Whip pan toward a busy market street. A vendor prepares food while people walk closely past the camera. Someone notices CHASE filming and naturally smiles.
3. Walks through a narrow stone alley, filming elderly men sitting outside shops, families walking together, children passing by, and vendors interacting with customers. Ambient street audio only.
4. Turns a corner and suddenly sees Masjid al-Aqsa ahead. She stops walking and slowly raises the camera toward it as people continue moving naturally around her. “Wow…”
5. Walks into the courtyard with the crowd, filming the historic architecture, worshippers, families, children, and people quietly moving through the space. Ambient audio only.
6. Walks slowly through the courtyard, occasionally turning the camera toward herself before pointing it back toward the people and surroundings. “This place feels so peaceful.”
7. Sits quietly in the courtyard and films the people passing through the frame. She says nothing, letting the natural conversations, footsteps, birds, and surrounding atmosphere fill the audio.
8. Selfie ending: walks back through the old streets during golden hour, turns the camera toward herself with a quiet smile, then points it back toward Masjid al-Aqsa and the people around her. “I’ll never forget this.”

entries.title: Smartphone Selfie Vlog Market Tour
entries.description: A smartphone selfie vlog prompt for Seedance 2.5 featuring a young woman touring a traditional market, using a reference image for character consistency.
entries.prompt:
<<<image_1>>> = the woman's facial identity and hair only, do not inherit her outfit, pose, background or lighting from it. One continuous handheld front-facing phone selfie vlog, always her own point of view with the phone in her own hand at arm's length — no third-person or external camera, no tripod, no cinematic move. Real modern-smartphone look: mild handheld shake, walking bounce, occasional autofocus hunting, small exposure shifts, minor framing flaws, natural front-lens distortion; soft warm natural daylight turning to early evening, natural uncorrected phone color, no color grade, no beauty filter, no skin smoothing. The same one woman with the same face and hair throughout, holding the phone herself in every shot. Two casual, trendy outfits only, the exact styling chosen naturally — one look from the market entrance through the gift shop, a clearly different one from the photo booth onward, each identical within its half, her face and hair unchanged across the single outfit change. No subtitles, no on-screen text, no logo, no watermark; no brand or character names. Never render a reference sheet or duplicate a subject. Diegetic sound only, no background music: market bustle and chatter, footsteps, a sizzling street-food stall, quiet shop room-tone, café ambience, a photo-booth shutter, wind at the lookout, a bus engine and street sounds; each spoken line delivered frontally and lip-visible.

A young Korean woman in her early twenties, natural everyday beauty, is walking into a lively traditional street market on her day off, already holding her phone out at arm's length to film herself; she sweeps the phone across the bustling stalls then back to her own grinning face and says, upbeat: "I’m at the market!" She keeps walking through the busy market, naturally bouncing the phone with her steps, glancing at colorful stalls and briefly turning the camera toward interesting food and people before bringing it back to her smiling face; she laughs softly and continues walking without dialogue. She stops at a sizzling street-food stall, picks up a hot skewer and holds it right up to the selfie camera, eyeing how good it looks, and says, delighted: "Wow, this looks freaking amazing..!" She gives a quick happy reaction after tasting it, then continues walking through the market while holding the phone herself. She steps into a tiny gift-and-stationery shop full of cute little things, browsing the shelves with a grin; she picks up a small item, looks at it and then at the camera with a playful worried expression, and says: "I think my wallet might be in danger here." After leaving the shop, she briefly stops at a cozy little café or drink stand, holds a simple takeaway drink close to the selfie camera, takes a quick sip and smiles contentedly at the lens before continuing on, with only natural café and street ambience.

entries.title: Everyday Morning Routine Bathroom Vlog
entries.description: A realistic 19-second bathroom vlog prompt using a 'found-phone' aesthetic to capture a morning routine including yawning, hair brushing, and choosing clothes.
entries.prompt:
Subject: Person from Image1. Face and hairstyle must match Image1 exactly; do not change identity. Ignore its outfit, background, pose, and text. Outfit: oversized casual sleepwear, messy morning look. 9:16 vertical.

Old iPhone everyday-video aesthetic throughout: static phone propped on bathroom sink, standard 1x lens, no distortion, heavy noise/compression, slight mirror steam, warm/off-white overhead lighting. Natural skin, pores, flyaways, under-eye tiredness. No beauty filter, grading, cinematic/CG look, fisheye, vignette, or legible text.

0–4s: Groggy, walks in yawning, glances at phone/mirror, rubs eyes.
4–8s: Brushes messy hair and mutters, “okay... five more minutes wasn't enough.”
8–12s: Steps on bathroom scale, looks down, gives a subtle eye-roll/sigh/shrug, steps off.
12–16s: Opens small closet, holds up two shirts one after another, indecisive.
16–19s: Chooses the first, tosses the other aside, looks at camera and says softly, “…this one. good enough for today,” with a tired smile; freeze final frame.

Bathroom clutter: toothpaste/skincare bottles, but all labels illegible. Sound only: bathroom ambience, hairbrush, scale beep/click, fabric rustle, close muffled sleepy voice with slight bathroom reverb. Keep all cuts and actions; no skipped scenes or on-screen text.

entries.title: Epic Chinese Fantasy MiniDV Self-Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed Seedance 2.0 prompt for a 15-second MiniDV-style self-vlog capturing a massive floating gate above an ancient city.
entries.prompt:
《天门悬在城上》——15秒MiniDV自拍视频｜新增倒数第二段 参考锁定 当前新增参考图
xin1_Ultimate_epic_Chinese_fantasy_landscape_surreal_colossal_2834e7b3-d08a-4c28-be63-299917fd35f2_0
当前新增参考图：只负责草坡、下方古城与河道、巨型悬空天门、红色立柱、青绿色重檐、穿过建筑的云层、中央暗月、阳光束和高空鸟群。 参考图中的背影女性不采用，不得作为女主角，也不得生成第三人称背影镜头。 24岁成年虚构东亚女主角 @
，穿着 @
。人物面容、发型、服装、发饰和配件保持统一。 本段发生在白昼，安排在《云城晚安》夜晚终章之前。 成片定位 15秒连续单镜头，真实、偶然发现般的MiniDV自拍视频。 女主始终亲自用右手握持银灰色MiniDV，腕带牢固套在右手腕上。没有摄影师、没有第三人称镜头、没有无人机、没有外部广角机位。 自拍距离约45厘米。她先以自拍视频登上草坡，看到天门后自然停步，再通过身体与右手腕转动，将镜头从自己连续转向风景，最后转回半自拍构图。 16:9 MiniDV宽屏模式，保留行走起伏、风力抖动、不完美构图、短暂失焦、曝光呼吸、自动白平衡迟疑、动态模糊、轻微隔行拖影、细小DV颗粒 and 高光溢出。 重点是记录天门真实存在于城市上空的尺度感，不能变成平滑的奇幻建筑宣传片。 场景锁定 女主站在云城外围一片缓缓隆起的高处草坡上。 草坡表面有长短不一的真实草叶、少量裸露土壤和细小水洼。高空风吹过时，草叶从近处向远处依次伏低，而不是整片草地同步摆动。 草坡下方是规模庞大的中国古代城市： 青黑瓦顶和红棕色建筑密集排列； 数条河道从城中穿过，水面反射天空； 小型桥梁、码头和街道保持固定位置； 城市居民只表现为远处细小而缓慢的活动； 城市不能漂浮、折叠或在镜头转动时改变布局。 巨型悬空天门位于城市正上方远处，宽度覆盖大半天空。青绿色重檐、深色木构、红色巨柱与中央巨大门洞保持参考图比例。 云层不断从天门下方、柱间和屋檐周围缓慢穿过，但不能遮挡整个建筑。天门本体极其沉重、稳定，没有上下浮动或旋转。 中央门洞远方悬着一轮暗色月体，边缘带有一圈细窄冷白光弧。它是遥远天体，不是传送门，不发射光束，也不快速移动。暗月始终位于中央门洞附近，只因女主手腕角度变化产生轻微构图位移。 右侧阳光穿过云隙形成两三束稳定的斜向光柱。鸟群以多个疏密不同的小群飞过屋檐和云层，不围绕女主，也不突然扑向镜头。 严格时间分镜 0—4秒：翻过草坡看见天门 录像开始时，女主正走完草坡最后几步。 MiniDV保持手臂长度的自拍视角。她只有约三分之二张脸进入画面，额头上方被裁掉少许；身后暂时只能看见被风吹动的草地、天空和少量云层。 上坡脚步使画面产生真实的上下晃动。她略微喘气，左手自然整理被草叶碰到的衣料。走到坡顶后，她突然放慢脚步，视线越过摄像机看向前方。 她的眼睛轻微睁大，但没有夸张惊叫。短暂停顿后说道： “我刚翻过这道坡……就看到它了。” 她说完仍看着前方，没有立即把注意力转回镜头。 4—9秒：巨型天门完整出现 女主先站稳脚步，再通过腰部转动和右手腕缓慢转向前方。 镜头连续经过她的脸侧、发饰、肩部衣料和草坡边缘，随后逐渐露出下方城市与天空中的巨型天门。 自动对焦先停留在近处随风晃动的草叶上，约半秒后才重新找到远处建筑。明亮天空进入画面时发生一次明显曝光呼吸，天门短暂偏白，随后青绿色屋檐、红色巨柱、穿行云雾和下方城市逐渐恢复细节。 女主在镜头外带着难以信的轻笑说道： “我没拉近……它真的就这么大。” 她的嘴偏离MiniDV麦克风，声音变闷，最后几个字受到风噪影响。 9—12秒：暗月正好停在门中 女主保持环境朝向，没有进行自动推镜或数字变焦。 右手只做一次小幅向上的调整，让中央门洞与暗月落在画面中部。因为手臂受到风力影响，构图始终有细微漂移，不能像三脚架一样绝对稳定。 云层缓慢穿过巨柱后方；鸟群从左上方向右侧飞过；阳光束照亮部分屋檐和云边。暗月保持稳定，细窄光弧清晰但不刺眼。 她在镜头外压低声音说道： “你们看中间……那轮月刚好在门里。” 自动对焦在近处鸟群与远处天门之间迟疑一次，但不能完全丢失主体。 12—15秒：在坡顶多停一会儿 她缓慢将MiniDV转回自己，但只转到一半。 最终形成不完美的半自拍构图：女主半张脸位于画面一侧，身后的天门、云层和暗月仍占据大部分画面。强风吹动少数碎发，她自然眯眼，回头看了一次天门，呼吸逐渐放缓。 她没有正对镜头摆姿势，只露出一个很轻的微笑： “我想先在这里……待一会儿。” 说完后，她没有关闭录像，也没有继续解释。镜头重新偏向远景少许，最后一秒保留风吹草坡、缓慢穿行的云层、远处天门与稀疏鸟鸣，录像自然结束。 天门与环境动态锁定 天门始终悬停在城市上空，不下降、不旋转、不向女主移动； 云层只缓慢通过柱间和屋檐，不形成爆炸或漩涡； 暗月是固定远方天体，不变大、不打开、不发射能量； 鸟群按照统一方向飞行，拍翼节奏略有差异； 鸟群具有远近尺度变化，但不瞬移、不复制； 光束位置基本稳定，只因薄云经过产生轻微明暗变化； 草地受到阵风后分区域起伏； 下方河水缓慢流动，反光随风产生细小变化； 天门尺度必须明显远大于整座城市建筑。 表演与现场收音 女主的情绪变化为： 上坡时轻微疲惫 → 意外发现天门 → 判断真实尺度 → 注意中央暗月 → 安静停留。 表演依靠自然喘息、短暂停步、眼神越过镜头、轻微眯眼、说话停顿和克制笑意完成。禁止尖叫、夸张瞪眼、张开双臂或主播式高声介绍。 MiniDV内置麦克风收录： 持续的高处草坡风声； 草叶彼此摩擦； 女主脚步踩过草地与松软泥土； 衣袖和裙摆被风吹动的摩擦声； 高空鸟群远近不同的鸣叫； 城市方向传来的极微弱钟声与人声； 女主近距离但带有风噪的自然说话声。 无背景音乐、无AI旁白、无干净棚录音。 负面约束 无摄影师、无第三人称女主背影、无参考图背影女子、无无人机、无航拍、无外部全景、无镜头绕女主旋转；MiniDV始终在女主右手中。 无天门坠落、无宫殿飞向女主、无建筑变形、无巨柱弯曲、无屋檐无限延伸、无城市折叠。 无暗月变成黑洞、无传送门、无爆炸、无闪电、无能量光束、无末日事件。 无鸟群攻击、无鸟撞镜头、无鸟突然变成巨兽、无鸟群随机复制或静止悬空。 无人物换脸、无年龄变化、无服装重绘、无发饰变化、无裙摆或衣袖违反风向。 无自动推镜、无数字变焦、无稳定器漂移、无商业航拍质感、无慢动作、无史诗配乐、无电影黑边、无字幕、Logo或水印。
entries.translated_prompt: "Celestial Gate Over the City" — 15-second MiniDV Selfie Video | Added Penultimate Section Reference Lock. Current added reference images: Responsible only for the grassy slope, the ancient city and river below, the giant suspended Celestial Gate, red pillars, turquoise double-eaves, cloud layers passing through buildings, central dark moon, sunbeams, and high-altitude bird flocks. The female figure in the reference image is not to be used, shall not be the female protagonist, and no third-person back-view shots shall be generated. 24-year-old fictional East Asian female protagonist @, wearing @. Consistent facial features, hairstyle, clothing, hair accessories, and accessories. This segment occurs during daylight, set before the "Goodnight Cloud City" night finale. Positioning: 15-second continuous single shot, realistic, serendipitous MiniDV selfie video. The protagonist always holds the silver-grey MiniDV with her right hand, wrist strap securely around the right wrist. No photographer, no third-person shots, no drones, no external wide-angle positions. Selfie distance approx 45cm. She first ascends the grassy slope in the selfie video, naturally stops upon seeing the Celestial Gate, then rotates the camera from herself to the landscape via body and right wrist movement, and finally turns back to a semi-selfie composition. 16:9 MiniDV widescreen mode, preserving walking undulations, wind-induced jitter, imperfect composition, brief focus loss, exposure breathing, auto-white balance hesitation, motion blur, slight interlacing streaks, fine DV grain, and highlight clipping. The focus is to record the sense of scale of the Celestial Gate existing above the city, not a smooth fantasy architectural promotional film. Scene Lock: Protagonist stands on a slowly rising grassy slope on the outskirts of Cloud City. Grassy surface has realistic blades of varying lengths, some bare soil, and small puddles. As high-altitude wind blows, blades flatten sequentially from near to far, not all at once. Below the slope is a massive ancient Chinese city with dense black-tile roofs and reddish-brown buildings; several rivers pass through with water reflecting the sky; small bridges, piers, and streets remain fixed; city residents are only tiny, slow activities in the distance; the city must not float, fold, or change layout during camera rotation. The giant suspended Celestial Gate is far above the city, covering most of the sky. Turquoise double-eaves, dark wood structures, red pillars, and a massive central portal maintain reference image proportions. Clouds continuously pass slowly beneath the gate, between pillars, and around eaves, but without obscuring the entire structure. The gate itself is extremely heavy and stable, with no bobbing or rotation. A dark moon hangs in the distance within the central portal, with a thin cold-white light arc at its edge. It is a distant celestial body, not a portal, doesn't emit beams, and doesn't move fast. The dark moon stays near the central portal, with slight framing shifts only due to the protagonist's wrist angle. Sunbeams from the right form two or three stable diagonal light columns through cloud gaps. Birds fly in scattered small groups across eaves and clouds, not surrounding the protagonist or diving at the camera. Strict Time Breakdown: 0—4s: Cresting the slope to see the gate. Recording starts with the protagonist finishing the last steps of the slope. MiniDV at arm-length selfie view. About two-thirds of her face is in frame, forehead slightly cropped; only wind-blown grass, sky, and few clouds visible behind. Walking steps create realistic vertical camera shake. She pants slightly, left hand naturally tidying clothes touched by grass. Reaching the top, she slows down, looking past the camera. Her eyes widen slightly, but no exaggerated scream. After a short pause: "I just crested this slope... and I saw it." She remains looking ahead, not immediately refocusing on the camera. 4—9s: Full gate appearance. She stands firm, then slowly pans forward via waist and right wrist rotation. The camera passes her cheek, hair accessories, shoulder fabric, and slope edge, gradually revealing the city below and the gate in the sky. Auto-focus lingers on near grass before finding the distant architecture. A visible exposure breath occurs as bright sky enters; the gate whitens briefly before details return to eaves, pillars, clouds, and city. Off-camera, she laughs incredulously: "I didn't zoom in... it's really this big." Her mouth is away from the mic, voice muffled by wind noise. 9—12s: Dark moon aligned in portal. Maintains orientation, no auto-zoom or digital zoom. Right hand makes one small upward adjustment to center the portal and moon. Due to wind, composition has fine drift, not tripod-stable. Clouds pass behind pillars; birds fly from top-left to right; sunbeams light parts of the eaves. Moon remains stable, light arc clear but not blinding. She whispers off-camera: "Look at the center... that moon is perfectly in the gate." Auto-focus hesitates between birds and gate but doesn't lose the subject. 12—15s: Lingering at the top. Slowly turns the MiniDV halfway back to herself. Final imperfect semi-selfie framing: half her face on one side, gate, clouds, and moon still occupying most of the frame. Strong wind blows hair strands; she squints naturally, looks back at the gate once, breathing slows. No posing, just a light smile: "I want to stay here... for a while." Recording doesn't stop; she doesn't explain further. Camera pans slightly back to the landscape; final second keeps wind-blown grass, moving clouds, distant gate, and sparse bird calls; recording ends naturally. Environment Dynamic Lock: Gate remains suspended, no descent/rotation/movement towards protagonist. Clouds only move slowly through pillars/eaves. Moon is fixed, no enlargement/emission. Bird flight directions unified, wing rhythms slightly varied. Birds have scale change but no teleporting/cloning. Light beams stable. Grass ripples in gusts by zone. River flows slowly. Performance & Sound: Emotion path: fatigue -> discovery -> scale realization -> moon observation -> quiet presence. Rely on natural breathing, pauses, eye movement, squinting, and restrained smiles. No screaming/gaping/broad gestures. Mic captures: constant slope wind, grass friction, footsteps on soil, fabric rustle, bird calls, faint city bells/voices, close-range wind-muffled speech. No BGM, no AI narration. Negative Constraints: No photographer, no third-person back-views, no reference woman, no drones, no aerials, no external panoramas, no rotations around protagonist. No gate falling, no buildings flying or deforming. No moon turning into black hole, no explosions, no lightning, no doomsday. No bird attacks, no cloning, no static birds. No face swapping, no clothing redraws. No auto-zoom, no cinema black bars, no subtitles, no logos.

entries.title: Rainy Bookstore Lifestyle Cinematic Prompt
entries.description: A comprehensive cinematic script for Seedance 2.0 that creates a realistic, candid bookstore scene with consistent character actions during a rainy afternoon.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic video using the reference image. Preserve the exact same woman, facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, bookstore interior, warm lighting, bookshelves, wooden furniture, and rainy weather outside. The video should feel like an authentic candid lifestyle moment, not a staged performance.

0–3 sec — Realizing the rain:
Wide shot from inside the bookstore looking toward the large rain-covered window. She walks toward the window holding her book, then stops when she notices the heavy rain outside. She looks through the glass at people walking past with umbrellas, her expression subtly changing to mild disappointment.

3–5 sec — Checking:
Medium side shot. She casually reaches into her bag, searches for a moment, then realizes she has no umbrella. She gives a tiny amused sigh and smiles at herself. Keep the expression subtle and natural.

5–8 sec — Giving up:
Close-up three-quarter shot. She looks back toward the cozy bookstore, glances at the rain again, then shrugs lightly as if deciding to wait it out. A loose strand of hair falls near her face and she casually tucks it behind her ear.

8–11 sec — Coffee instead:
Low tabletop angle. She walks to the nearby table, places her book beside the latte, sits down, and picks up the coffee. She takes a small sip while watching the rain through the window.

11–15 sec — Making the best of it:
Over-the-shoulder shot transitioning into a front three-quarter close-up. She opens her book and reads for a moment. She notices the camera, looks up, gives a small genuine smile and slightly raises her eyebrows as if saying “I guess I'm staying here.” She then turns back toward the book while rain continues outside.

Camera: Each shot should have a clearly different perspective — wide establishing shot, side profile, close-up, low tabletop angle, and over-the-shoulder/front portrait. Smooth natural cuts, subtle handheld camera movement, realistic autofocus and depth of field.

Realism: Photorealistic skin texture, natural blinking, subtle breathing, realistic hand and finger movements, physically accurate hair and clothing, believable walking and sitting motion, natural facial micro-expressions. Rain should behave realistically on the window. Warm indoor light should contrast naturally with the cool gray rainy exterior.

Overall aesthetic: Cozy Korean bookstore café, rainy afternoon, candid lifestyle vlog, understated K-drama atmosphere, natural cinematic photography, soft bokeh, realistic motion blur, 24fps, high detail.

Avoid: exaggerated acting, dramatic gestures, excessive camera movement, slow motion, sudden zooms, distorted hands, extra fingers, face morphing, identity changes, outfit changes, unrealistic walking, artificial smiles, or overly polished beauty-filter appearance.

entries.title: Gym Bathroom Found-Footage Horror
entries.description: A chilling 16-second psychological horror scene in a gym bathroom using an old iPhone found-footage aesthetic, where a mysterious shadowy figure appears in a mirror reflection.
entries.prompt:
Person from Image1; facial features and hairstyle must match exactly. Disregard the reference outfit, background, pose, and any text. Subject is wearing a black gym tank top, visibly sweaty after an intense workout. 9:16 vertical format.

16-second late-night gym psychological horror / found-footage scene: Captured as if on an old iPhone using a 1x standard lens, static propped-on-sink perspective, pronounced phone noise and compression artifacts, harsh cool-green fluorescent lighting, raw unedited low-quality phone footage. Almost empty gym bathroom late at night, eerie silence and realistic bathroom echo.

0–3s: She enters the empty bathroom exhausted and breathless. She places her phone near the sink, drinks water, and wipes sweat from her face.

3–6s: She looks into the mirror while catching her breath. Suddenly, a strange dark human-like monster silhouette is faintly visible behind her in the mirror. She doesn't notice it and continues looking at herself.

6–9s: She lowers her gaze, then slowly looks back into the mirror. The shadowy figure is now slightly closer behind her. She notices it and freezes, her expression changing from exhaustion to genuine fear.

9–12s: She slowly turns around, but there is absolutely nothing behind her. She looks back toward the mirror and the figure is still there, now much closer. She gasps, grabs her phone, and immediately rushes toward the bathroom door.

12–16s: She bursts out of the bathroom and runs rapidly down the empty gym corridor, breathing heavily and repeatedly looking over her shoulder. She disappears around the corner. She looks back one final time, but the monster is no longer visible. Freeze mid-run.

Realistic pores, sweat, flushed skin, damp hair, natural movement, authentic fear reaction. Bathroom echo, water sounds, heavy breathing, quick footsteps, door movement, faint distant gym ambience. The monster should remain subtle, shadowy, unsettling, and realistic rather than looking like exaggerated CGI.

No BGM, no dialogue, no text, no readable signage, no cinematic color grading, no beauty filter, no fisheye, no distortion, no vignette, no jump cuts, no scene skipping, no exaggerated CGI, no gore.

entries.title: Cinematic Running Shoe Commercial Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed, single-shot video prompt for a professional shoe commercial featuring falling sneakers against a vibrant blue background and a stylistic transition to a runner.
entries.prompt: Live-action running-shoe commercial. 20 seconds. No cuts are used. The background is one flat electric blue from beginning to end. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no shadows. The shoes fall continuously from the top of the frame towards the bottom. Dozens of running shoes are in frame at any one moment. They are all the same single model and differ only in colour: a light, thin running shoe with a thick white foam midsole under a brightly coloured knit mesh upper, with one small silver tab at the heel. That tab is the same silver on every colourway, and there is no gold or black metal anywhere on the shoe. The colours run through orange, lime, coral, dark grey, white and pale blue. Every shoe falls from top to bottom. They all fall the same way; what differs is that each tumbles on its own axis, so in any one frame some show their outsoles, some their sides, and some are seen from above. Any shoe that comes close to camera enters from the top of the frame and leaves through the bottom; none of them appears or disappears in the middle of the frame. The near ones are large and sharp; the far ones read only as small blurred patches of colour. Focus holds on one plane and everything in front of and behind it falls softly away. The camera holds its position, breathing very slightly. What carries the frame is the shoes. Partway through, a torn paper edge sweeps across the frame and opens the layer beneath it. Along every tear the white core of the paper is left ragged and fibrous, and a soft shadow falls onto the layer below. Wherever she appears, the camera is in front of her. It never follows her back or the back of her head; her face is turned towards camera. The photograph under the paper is black and white: high-key, with the sky blown out to white, and coarse darkroom-print grain. Even inside that black and white, the shoes keep their colour. One woman appears and she is the same person throughout: a Korean woman in her early twenties, with clearly defined features, long eyes and a narrow jawline. Her hair is deep auburn, falling in heavy waves to her waist, with a few fine braids running sideways from the crown. She ties it back in a single tail to run. She wears three things: a pale blue halter crop top underneath, a dark grey sheer cropped bolero over it with long sleeves and thumbholes that cover the backs of her hands, and dark grey joggers gathered at the ankle with a pale blue drawstring at the waist. She stays in all three while she runs; they never turn into a running vest or short athletic shorts. On her feet is the white-foam-midsole running shoe described above. (0:00–0:03) The film opens on the side of a coral running shoe filling the upper left of the frame, close enough that individual strands of the knit upper, the grain along the midsole and the stitching all read. It tumbles on its axis towards the lower right until the inside of the shoe comes into view. Behind it, dozens more come down at varying sizes. (0:03–0:05) A lime pair catches on the top edge of the frame with only the toes pushing in, close enough that the individual strands of knit mesh and the texture of the midsole are visible. The rest of the frame is blue, with only a few small shoes coming down far away in it. (0:05–0:07.5) LAND LIGHT fades up at the centre of the frame in white serif capitals with very wide letter spacing, fixed in place. Printed on paper, its strokes show horizontal printing lines inside them. One falling shoe drops in front of the letters and another behind them. From the lower right corner a torn paper edge rises at an angle and peels the blue layer away. (0:07.5–0:13) Where the edge has peeled back, a bright black-and-white photograph fills in. The camera sits low on the polyurethane track directly in front of her, facing her head-on and retreating as she runs towards it. The white foam midsole reaches forward, compresses as it meets the ground and springs back. The shoes alone hold their coral; everything else is black and white. The camera rises from her feet to her face and frames her from the front, chest up and large. Her eyes fixed straight ahead, her face wet with sweat and her dark auburn hair swinging all read clearly. The stands and the sky behind her fall softly out of focus, and the sky is blown out to white. (0:13–0:16) The torn edge rises from the bottom of the frame and the blue layer comes back. A coral pair falls through dead centre with one shoe crossing over the other, the camera further back now so the whole shoe reads. A single highlight travels across the small silver tab at the heel. (0:16–0:17.5) A single sheet of electric blue paper, come down from the top, covers the frame. Its lower edge is torn, with the white core of the paper showing. (0:17.5–0:20) A bright off-white paper field. At the centre, two lines of thin capitals: LAND LIGHT, RUN LONG. No other lettering and no symbol. A torn edge crosses the lower part of the frame at a very shallow angle. The final frame settles on exactly this. This has to read as a real commercial film. The print grain applies to the black-and-white layer only; the blue layers are sharp. Lettering appears in exactly two places: LAND LIGHT at 0:05–0:07.5 and the two lines on the final frame. No brand name and no logo symbol appear anywhere.

entries.title: Giant Cat at Tokyo Station Video Prompt
entries.description: A multi-shot cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a surreal scene where a massive black cat appears behind Tokyo Station and playfully taps the clock tower.
entries.prompt:
0:00–0:04 — Completely ordinary Tokyo Station establishing shot. Pedestrians crossing the plaza. Nothing unusual.

0:04–0:06 — People suddenly stop. Several slowly tilt their heads upward toward something behind the station.

0:06–0:09 — Two enormous furry triangular ears slowly rise behind the skyscrapers.

0:09–0:12 — A colossal realistic black cat, larger than the surrounding towers, raises its head behind Tokyo Station. Only its head and shoulders are visible. Its huge glowing eyes stare curiously down into the plaza.

0:12–0:14 — The giant cat slowly extends one paw between two skyscrapers and gently taps the central clock of Tokyo Station.

0:14–0:15 — DING! The clock swings like a tiny bell. The cat's pupils suddenly widen enormously.

entries.title: Misty Valley Cinematic Twist Video
entries.description: A professional Seedance 2.0 prompt for a cinematic sequence featuring two swordswomen in a misty canyon, utilizing environmental visual tricks for a surprising reveal.
entries.prompt:
1. 片段定位

电影级写实质感。
采用“参考图驱动的活世界系统”，融合诗意仙侠紧张感、空间误导式喜剧、克制表演、清冷银蓝色清晨、温暖日出反光、自然体积山雾，以及真实湿润石材和水体物理效果。
最终反转必须完全通过 可见度变化 完成。
地理结构始终连续，绝不允许突然换景，绝不允许地形变形。
2. 参考职责
Seedance 2.0 支持图像、音频、视频参考，因此本次所有参考图统一视为 同一个世界设定库，不得把它们当作彼此孤立的背景图。
参考图共同负责

连续地形

建筑逻辑

空间尺度
材质年代
植被生态
水位与水系
天气状态
云层运动
雾气密度
主光方向
反射关系
声音距离感
人物真实可行的行进路线
生成前的内部环境推演
先执行一轮无声环境推演。
综合全部参考图，重新排列出一个本轮独有的新空间。
这个空间必须：
物理统一
结构连续

可被摄影机真实调度
拥有稳定前景、中景、远景锚点
保持同一世界的环境 DNA

3. 角色锁定
角色 ID A｜白衣剑仙
同一个 25–30 岁东亚剑仙女子。
严格保持：
@图片1 同一张脸
黑色长发
纤细身材比例
白色刺绣真丝汉服

玉石饰品
白色布靴

唯一一柄银色长剑
角色 ID B｜青衣宿敌
同一个 20–25 岁东亚宿敌女子。
严格保持：
@图片2 同一张脸
黑色编发
娇小身材比例
青绿色汉服
深色布鞋

唯一一柄深色钢剑
4. 分镜设计

Shot 1｜0–5s｜全景或远景
画面目标
建立误导性的空间关系，让观众与两位角色一起相信前方隔着一座深不见底的巨大峡谷。
场景内容
两人从鞋到头完整站在两块布满湿润青苔的古老石台上。
她们之间被浓重云雾遮挡，看起来仿佛隔着一座万丈深谷。
必须保留的环境锚点
瀑布落入雾层后消失
不同纵深的松枝以不同幅度随风摇动
石面水珠缓慢流动

远处瓦顶建筑在山雾中时隐时现

正在升起的朝阳持续从侧面推动雾层横向移动

表演
两人都保持谨慎、克制、如临大敌的状态。
暂不急着动作，先让空间误导成立。

Shot 2｜5–10s｜中景或牛仔景
画面目标
两人都误判空间尺度，以为彼此之间隔着真正深谷，于是同时准备使用高消耗的正式御剑跨谷招式。
连续性要求
必须保持：
同样两名女子
同样服装

同样长剑
完全相同的地理空间

同一雾层与石台逻辑
同样的松林、瀑布、瓦顶建筑等环境锚点

动作

两个人同时进入蓄势状态：

宽袖被气流轻轻托起

剑身发出低沉共鸣
山雾沿脚踝旋转
身体姿态庄严、正式、克制
对白

Seedance 2.0 supports image, audio, and video references; thus, all reference images are treated as a single world setting library, not isolated backgrounds. Reference images collectively determine:
Continuous terrain, architectural logic, spatial scale, material era, vegetation ecology, water levels and systems, weather status, cloud movement, mist density, main light direction, reflection relationships, sound distance perception, and realistic character movement paths.

Execute a silent environmental deduction first. Reorganize a unique new space based on all reference images. Character ID A | White-clad Sword Immortal: Same 25–30 year old East Asian female sword immortal. Strictly maintain: @Image 1 (same face), black long hair, slender body proportions, white embroidered silk Hanfu, jade accessories, white cloth boots, and a unique long silver sword.

Shot 1 | 0–5s | Wide or Extreme Wide Shot
Goal: Establish a misleading spatial relationship, making the audience and characters believe there is a bottomless canyon ahead.
Content: Two characters stand fully from head to toe on two ancient stone platforms covered in wet moss. Heavy mist blocks the view between them, making it look like a bottomless chasm.
Anchors: Waterfall disappears into the mist; pine branches sway naturally at different depths; water droplets flow slowly on stone; distant tiled buildings appear and disappear in the mist; rising sun pushes the mist horizontally.
Performance: Both remain cautious and restrained, as if facing a great enemy. Establish the spatial misdirection first.

Shot 2 | 5–10s | Medium or Cowboy Shot
Goal: Both misjudge the spatial scale and prepare high-consumption sword-crossing moves.
Continuity: Maintain same characters, outfits, swords, geography, mist/platform logic, and environment anchors (pines, waterfall, tiled buildings).
Action: Both enter a charging state. Wide sleeves are lifted by airflow; sword blades emit low-frequency resonance; mist swirls around ankles. Dignified, formal, and restrained posture.

Camera: Slow orbital shot around the duo. Anchors must remain visible to verify space.

Goal: Complete the reversal through visibility changes. The truth must come from clearing the existing environment, not generating a new one.

Native synchronous Mandarin dialogue; consistent spatial sound; unified physical logic for wind, mist, water, and reflections; continuous natural motion and parallax; realistic movement for silk, hair, and droplets.
