entries.title: Morning Routine Vlog Aesthetic
entries.description: A photorealistic video prompt for a multi-shot morning vlog sequence featuring a Korean woman in her bedroom, utilizing selfie and mirror shots with soft sunlight.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic vertical video, 10 seconds. A beautiful young Korean woman enjoys a peaceful slow morning in her cozy bedroom, wearing an oversized cream-white T-shirt. Soft golden sunlight enters through sheer curtains, creating a fresh dreamy atmosphere. Natural smartphone selfie vlog aesthetic.
Shot 1 (0–2s): Close selfie beside the window. She opens the curtain slightly, squints gently at the sunlight, then smiles at the camera.
Shot 2 (2–4s): High-angle selfie sitting on the bed. She stretches her arms naturally, yawns softly, then laughs at herself.
Shot 3 (4–6s): Mirror selfie. She casually fixes her messy hair while looking at her reflection, then turns the phone toward herself with a relaxed smile.
Shot 4 (6–8s): Side selfie at the desk. She picks up a warm cup of coffee, takes a small sip, and looks toward the camera with sleepy morning eyes.
Shot 5 (8–10s): Front close-up. She sits by the window holding the cup with both hands, smiles warmly, and slowly lowers the phone.
Style: Ultra-photorealistic, natural Korean beauty, realistic smartphone camera, subtle handheld motion, authentic morning expressions, soft sunlight, realistic skin texture, lifelike hair, shallow depth of field, cinematic color grading, 24fps, 8K.

entries.title: Xianxia Comedy Needle Search Magic
entries.description: A cinematic 15-second multi-shot prompt featuring a senior swordswoman using grand magical powers to find a tiny sewing needle in a mountain courtyard.
entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0

【视频规格】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，三个干净清晰的镜头。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，纯古风中国仙侠美学，克制的冷面喜剧，古典武侠式空间调度，清晨冷雾、温暖轮廓光、低饱和象牙白、玉绿色与风化钢铁色调，以及细腻胶片颗粒；核心反转采用 “尺度误导”：先让观众误以为发生了严重的兵器事件，最后揭示剑仙如此隆重的仙术，只是为了寻找世上最小的 “兵器”。针对 Seedance 2.0 的参考图角色一致性、道具运动连续性、多镜头叙事、原生普通话对白和同步空间声音进行优化。

【场景设定】

安静的山门兵器庭院，灰色石板地面、木制剑架、严格保持六柄带鞘长剑、一座青铜兵器架、竹影、缓慢升起的香烟、一棵老松和远处瓦顶殿宇，共同建立清楚稳定的空间关系。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐

剑仙师姐 @图片 1，25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩 and 白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜小师妹

小师妹 @图片 2，20–25 岁的东亚女性，圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小，穿青绿色汉服、深色腰带、木簪 and 黑色布鞋。

【核心道具】

木制剑架、六柄带鞘长剑、青铜兵器架、细小银色绣花针。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景缓慢跟拍】

安静的山门兵器庭院，灰色石板地面、木制剑架、严格保持六柄带鞘长剑、一座青铜兵器架、竹影、缓慢升起的香烟、一棵老松和远处瓦顶殿宇，共同建立清楚稳定的空间关系。

同一个小师妹正焦急地低头寻找石板缝隙，同一个剑仙师姐从容走近。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景牛仔景缓慢环绕】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐抬起两指，淡然说道：“凡铁有声，无处可藏。”

同样六柄带鞘长剑按照顺序逐一震动，金属共鸣声层层升高；地面灰尘轻颤，竹叶被微风带动，一根藏在石板旁草叶之间的细小银色绣花针也开始发出极轻的嗡鸣。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜近景跟随转极近特写】

同一个剑仙师姐缓慢转身，让同一根细小银针从地面平稳悬起，飞入她两指之间，随后递给同一个小师妹。

恢宏配乐瞬间停止。

小师妹低头看着银针，愣了一下，说道：“师姐…… 这么大阵仗，就找根针？”

剑仙师姐面不改色，平静回答：“兵器，不分大小。”

极近特写：她身后同样六柄长剑仿佛赞同般同时发出一声庄严而短促的金属嗡鸣。

【技术要求】

人物面部与服装稳定，金属震动、真丝衣料、头发、灰尘、香烟和银针运动真实自然，不生成字幕，始终只出现两名可见角色。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props
entries.translated_prompt:
[Generation Mode]

Seedance 2.0

[Video Specs]

Strict 15-second total duration, 16:9 widescreen, three clean and clear shots.

[Overall Style]

Cinematic realistic texture, pure traditional Chinese Xianxia aesthetics, restrained deadpan comedy, classical martial arts spatial staging, early morning cold fog, warm rim lighting, low-saturation ivory white, jade green, and weathered steel tones, plus fine film grain. The core twist uses 'scale misdirection': the audience is first led to believe a serious weapon-related event is occurring, only for it to be revealed that the grand immortal technique was merely used to find the world's smallest 'weapon'. Optimized for Seedance 2.0's character consistency from reference images, prop motion continuity, multi-shot narrative, native Mandarin dialogue, and synchronized spatial audio.

[Scene Setting]

Quiet mountain gate weapons courtyard, gray stone slab floor, wooden sword rack, strictly maintaining six sheathed long swords, a bronze weapon rack, bamboo shadows, slowly rising incense smoke, an old pine tree, and distant tiled roof halls, establishing a clear and stable spatial relationship.

[Characters]

Character ID A | Senior Sister Immortal

Senior Sister @Image 1, East Asian female aged 25–30, oval face, fair skin, dark almond eyes, long black hair half-tied with a white jade hairpin, tall and slender, wearing white embroidered silk Hanfu, translucent wide sleeves, silver waistband, jade pendant, and white cloth boots.

Character ID B | Junior Sister

Junior Sister @Image 2, East Asian female aged 20–25, round and lively face, black hair in braids, petite, wearing teal green Hanfu, dark belt, wooden hairpin, and black cloth shoes.

[Core Props]

Wooden sword rack, six sheathed long swords, bronze weapon rack, tiny silver embroidery needle.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low-angle Full Shot, Slow Tracking]

Quiet mountain gate weapons courtyard... The same Junior Sister is anxiously looking down at the stone slab gaps; the same Senior Sister approaches calmly.

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Medium Cowboy Shot, Slow Orbit]

The same Senior Sister in white embroidered silk Hanfu raises two fingers and says calmly: 'Every piece of iron has a voice; nowhere to hide.'

The same six sheathed swords vibrate one by one in sequence, metal resonance rising in layers; dust on the ground trembles, bamboo leaves are moved by the breeze, and a tiny silver embroidery needle hidden among the grass by the stone slab also begins to emit a faint hum.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Medium Shot following into Extreme Close-up]

The same Senior Sister turns slowly, letting the same tiny silver needle rise steadily from the ground, fly between her two fingers, and then hands it to the same Junior Sister.

The grand background music stops instantly.

Junior Sister looks down at the needle, stunned, and says: 'Senior Sister... all this grand display, just to find a needle?'

Senior Sister's expression remains unchanged as she replies calmly: 'Weapons do not distinguish by size.'

Extreme Close-up: Behind her, the same six long swords emit a solemn and short metallic hum in agreement.

[Technical Requirements]

Stable facial features and clothing, realistic and natural movement for metal vibration, silk fabric, hair, dust, smoke, and the silver needle. No subtitles, only the two visible characters throughout.

[Negative Prompts]

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

entries.prompt:

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜全景或远景】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐在同一口青铜问心铃旁抬起两指，平静说道：“问心铃，只为真话而鸣。”

她转眼看向同一个穿青绿色汉服的小师妹，问道：“你说，我最厉害的是什么？”

同一个小师妹迟疑片刻，小心回答：“剑法？”

问心铃完全没有任何反应；背景始终保持同一座问心殿、同样的香烟和青铜灯，在突然出现的尴尬安静中完整停顿半拍。

同一个小师妹认真打量同一个剑仙师姐，突然无比真诚地回答：“脸皮。”

同一口问心铃瞬间爆发一声巨大、毫无歧义的 “咚 ——”，强烈钟声震得香灰轻落、丝幡颤动。

原生普通话对白，钟声具有明确空间共振，真丝衣料、香烟、青铜震动和面部微表情真实自然，不生成字幕，始终只出现两名可见角色。

entries.description: A sophisticated cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 involving a floor manager in a high-end rotating restaurant, featuring detailed shot breakdowns and physics controls.
entries.prompt:
【REFERENCE】
@image1は人物と舞台をまとめた参照シート。上段3パネルと下段右の顔パネルを、動画に一人だけ登場する同一女性の顔、髪、体型、衣装、全身の固定参照にする。下段左のレストランパネルだけを舞台参照とし、内装、パノラマ窓、夜景、照明、床、テーブル、椅子、素材感、色調を継承する。白背景、枠、見出し、文字、資料配置を映像へ出さず、開始フレームにも使用しない。
【CONDITION DEFINITION】
15秒、1:1、写実的な実写映画表現、夜の高層回転レストラン、4ショット、ハードカット。開始フレームでは全食器、グラス、ナプキン、カトラリーがテーブル上に接地し、空中物体はゼロ。女性、身体、髪、衣装、カメラは常に現実の通常速度。異変後だけ、飛び上がった食器類と液体の滴を世界座標上で完全停止する。夜景、水平線、建物外殻、中央柱、カメラは固定し、円形床、テーブル、椅子だけが中央柱の周囲を回転する。画面は回転させない。非常停止装置は固定中央柱の黄黒取付板にある黒い金属製手動レバー。赤ボタン、縦ポール、別装置へ変えない。女性が中央柱へ接触するのはレバー直前の一度、0.4秒以下だけ。
【SHOT / FLOW】
SHOT 1｜0～2.5秒｜正常から異変発生
固定広角。0～1.4秒、女性が客席間を普通に歩く。全食器はテーブル上に接地し、床と客席は完全静止。空中物体、警報、振動、回転はない。1.4秒で強い振動と警報が同時発生。食器類が明確にテーブルから飛び上がり、1.7秒で空中停止する。その後にだけ円形床と客席が動き始める。女性は流れる床へ踏ん張り、遠いレバーを見て即座に走り出す。2.5秒でハードカット。
SHOT 2｜2.5～9.5秒｜長い障害走
中央軸側の水平カメラが斜め前からパンで追う。固定夜景を背景に、床模様と家具が右から左へ流れ続ける。女性は画面内の位置と距離を変えながら中央へ走り、同じ場所に留まらない。
2.5～4.5秒、横流れする床へ逆らって長く全力疾走するが大きく滑り、レバーから遠ざけられる。通過する椅子の背を一瞬だけつかみ、すぐ離して再加速。4.5～6.8秒、停止した皿の下へ身を低くして潜り、グラスを上体で避け、迫るテーブルの間を斜めに抜ける。6.8～8.2秒、横切る椅子で進路を塞がれ、テーブル端へ一度手をついて鋭く方向転換。8.2～9.5秒、レバーまで残り5mを全力で詰めるが、床がさらに加速し、中央柱の直前で横へ流される。全身、足の接地、切迫した表情、髪と衣装の揺れを見せる。停止物は女性や家具に追随しない。
SHOT 3｜9.5～12秒｜一瞬の支持からレバー操作
中景。9.5～10.0秒、女性は流されながら最後の一歩で固定中央柱へ手を伸ばす。柱をつかむのは9.8～10.2秒の一度だけ。柱へ抱きつかず、周囲を回らず、静止しない。反動で身体を前へ投げ、10.2秒までに柱から手を離す。10.2～11.1秒、黄黒取付板の黒いレバーを両手でつかみ、一度の力強い動作で最後まで引き下ろす。11.1～12.0秒、床が急制動し、女性はレバーから手を離して横へ二歩よろめき、低い姿勢で踏みとどまる。下がったレバーを明確に見せてハードカット。
SHOT 4｜12～15秒｜時間復帰と解放
広角。右前景に下がった黒いレバーと黄黒取付板、中央から外れた位置に柱から離れて立つ女性、背景に停止物と客席を入れる。12.0～12.5秒、床と客席が完全停止。12.5秒に空中物体の時間が戻り、13.3秒までにすべて床とテーブルへ一斉落下。女性は柱から離れる方向へ走り、落下する皿を避けてテーブル脇へ滑り込む。13.3～15.0秒、警報が止まり、女性は柱に触れず立ち上がって息を整える。最終フレームに下がったレバー、停止した床、落下物、女性、固定夜景を残す。
【CAMERA / EDITING】
水平安定した広角、中景、短い寄り。床回転は固定夜景、固定柱、流れる床模様、横切る家具の視差で示す。女性を長時間画面中央へ固定しない。カメラロール、画面全体の回転、窓外の回転、長い後方追走、クロスフェード、速度ランプ、全体スローなし。
【SOUND】
BGM、台詞、ナレーションなし。正常時の静かな室内音、1.4秒の振動と警報、加速する機構音、速い足音、滑走音、家具の摩擦、荒い呼吸、短い柱接触音、レバーの重い機械音、急制動音。制動後の短い無音と食器の一斉落下音。
【NEGATIVE】
開始時から浮く食器、開始時から回転する床、異変発生の省略、静止した店内の単純走行、女性が柱・ポールにつかまり続ける、柱へ抱きつく、柱の周囲を回る、女性が画面中央で長時間停止、障害なし、床の回転不足、画面・カメラ・夜景・中央柱の回転、全体スロー、女性の浮遊・複数化・外見変更、停止物の追随、時間操作ジェスチャー、赤ボタン、縦ハンドル、レバー変形・移動・消失、新しい液体、13.3秒以降の空中物体、最終画面からレバーが消える構図、参照シートの枠・文字・白背景。

entries.prompt: Create a 15 second cinematic outdoor food film in a 16:9 frame, set in a quiet autumn woodland cooking camp during warm late afternoon light. Show only the cook’s natural adult hands and forearms, never the face. Keep every hand anatomically correct with five fingers, realistic skin texture, short clean nails, and consistent sleeves and wristwatch throughout. 0 to 2 seconds. Begin with a tight macro shot of a thick fresh beef patty landing on a richly grained live edge wooden board. A real wood fire burns softly in the background with drifting blue smoke and circular forest bokeh. The camera is almost locked, with a tiny human handheld settling motion. Natural sunlight comes from camera left and warm firelight adds a subtle orange rim. 2 to 5 seconds. Cut on hand movement to close details of coarse salt, cracked pepper, dried herbs, and finely chopped garlic falling onto the meat. The cook presses a deep center pocket, fills it generously with shredded mozzarella, folds the beef around the cheese, and seals it into one thick burger. Show true meat compression, moisture, fingerprints, loose herb fragments, and small crumbs on the board. Use shallow depth of field and physically believable contact between fingers and food. 5 to 9 seconds. Place the stuffed burger onto a black cast iron grate above glowing hardwood coals. Capture loud natural sizzle, tiny grease sparks, curling smoke, and one brief controlled flame flare. Use a low three quarter food level angle, then a precise match cut to metal tongs flipping the burger. Reveal an irregular dark brown crust with visible grill marks, rendered with realistic heat shimmer and no exaggerated fire. 9 to 12 seconds. Cut to a toasted rustic bun on the same board. Add thick slices of fresh mozzarella, then place the cooked burger onto the lower bun. Keep ingredient positions, hand direction, board grain, clothing, fire, and sunlight continuous. Make the camera perform a gentle five percent push closer while steam rises naturally. 12 to 15 seconds. Finish with a centered hero close up as both hands slowly pull the burger into two halves. A heavy ribbon of molten mozzarella stretches between the charred beef layers, trembling and thinning under gravity before partially breaking. Steam, glistening juices, toasted bread texture, ash, smoke, and fire bokeh must feel completely photographic. Hold the final cheese stretch for the last half second. Visual treatment. Premium food cinematography, realistic 4K detail, 30 frames per second, natural motion blur, 50 millimeter macro lens character, shallow depth of field, warm but restrained color grade, rich reds and browns, soft forest greens, preserved highlight detail, mild sensor grain, subtle focus breathing, practical imperfections, no artificial smoothness. Compose all key actions in the central safe area while using the wide frame to reveal fire, foliage, smoke, and rustic tools at the edges.

entries.title: Epic Hero Greek City Ascent
entries.description: A professional 15-second action sequence prompt for Seedance 2.0 depicting a hero's traversal through a crumbling Greek city. It emphasizes consistent character models and realistic physics across multiple high-speed shots.
entries.prompt:
THE ODYMAN (SMART SHOT)

THE LAST ASCENT

Duration: 15 Seconds

Use the exact same visual lock throughout.

The character, world, monsters, lighting, and physics must remain identical so the entire sequence feels like one continuous cinematic shot.

---

SHOT LIST

1–2 seconds

A powerful pull from the Athena statue.

The character launches at extreme speed between two towering marble columns.

The web is fully taut.

His armor vibrates from the intense velocity.

---

2–3 seconds

He releases the web.

Performs a smooth half-spin in midair.

Fires a new web from the opposite hand.

THWIP.

The web anchors to the peak of a massive temple.

A sharp turn with realistic centrifugal force.

---

3–4 seconds

Low-angle tracking shot.

He skims only centimeters above the ancient stone road.

Dust erupts beneath him.

Horse riders instinctively duck as he flashes past.

---

4–5 seconds

A colossal monster smashes apart a giant marble statue.

Massive stone fragments explode across the street.

He swings directly through the raining debris without losing momentum.

---

5–6 seconds

Side tracking shot.

Still attached to the web, he runs several steps along the temple wall.

He pushes off and launches back into open air.

---

6–7 seconds

Extreme wide aerial shot.

The entire Greek city stretches into the distance.

The monster relentlessly pursues dozens of fleeing soldiers.

Smoke and dust engulf the city.

He remains the only figure moving at extraordinary speed above the chaos.

---

7–8 seconds

He executes two rapid consecutive swings.

THWIP.

THWIP.

Each swing naturally increases his momentum.

The rhythm feels fast, fluid, and physically accurate.

---

8–9 seconds

He narrowly misses the gigantic head of a Zeus statue.

With only a slight tilt of his body, he slips past by inches.

The camera subtly follows the evasive movement.

---

9–10 seconds

He threads between towering marble pillars.

His cape snaps violently in the wind.

The web remains fully stretched as gravity and momentum pull him through a sweeping arc.

---

10–11 seconds

He swings through the center of a collapsing marketplace.

Citizens scatter.

Broken columns crash behind him.

Dust and sunlight fill the air.

---

11–12 seconds

He releases one web.

Half-rolls through the air.

Fires another.

THWIP.

The web locks onto the tallest tower in the city.

---

12–13 seconds

The final swing accelerates.

An immense pull launches him upward.

His body arches naturally under gravity.

His cape ripples with realistic weight.

---

13–14 seconds

The camera follows from below as he rises above the city.

Below, horse riders, fleeing soldiers, shattered temples, drifting dust, and the colossal monster continue in chaos.

---

14–15 seconds

Hero ending.

He soars into the glowing golden sky.

He becomes a striking silhouette against the sun.

Cut to black.

---

AUDIO

No music.

Use only natural sounds:

- Wind
- Air rushing past
- Ocean waves
- Seagulls

entries.title: Townhouse Reading Physical Comedy
entries.description: A photorealistic comedy scene of an East Asian woman reading a book, involving physics-based chaos with a medicine ball in a townhouse.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15 second photorealistic live action comedy in a horizontal 16:9 frame, 4K detail, 30 frames per second. The lead is a strikingly attractive adult East Asian woman in her late twenties with long glossy black hair in loose waves, elegant natural makeup, expressive dark eyes, and a confident sensual screen presence. She wears a fitted midnight blue satin lounge dress with a tasteful neckline and turquoise socks. She holds an ornate navy and gold hardcover book respectfully against her chest. The cover has decorative geometry only, with no readable writing.

The location is a real lived in townhouse bedroom connected to a narrow hallway. Show warm honey oak floors, cream walls, framed art, a beige patterned bed, a grey velvet bench, a faded Persian rug, sheer curtains glowing with daylight, a cast iron radiator, and a vintage brass and white ceiling fan. Place one heavy black medicine ball in the hallway. Keep every object, facial feature, garment, and room detail consistent through all cuts.

From 0 to 3 seconds, use a locked wide camera at waist height with a natural 24 millimeter phone lens look. She walks toward camera while calmly reading, centered in the hallway. Her socked foot clips the medicine ball. She stumbles with believable weight and momentum, instinctively protects the book, and falls sideways onto the bed. Show realistic hair inertia, fabric folds, foot placement, motion blur, and mattress compression.

From 3 to 6 seconds, cut to a close side angle near the bed. She sits upright without losing her place, still reading with total focus. The medicine ball rebounds through the room. She leans back just before it passes, then calmly pulls the blanket over herself while keeping the book open. Use quick hard cuts and one brief imperfect whip pan timed to the impacts.

From 6 to 10 seconds, cut to a low upward angle of the slowly rotating ceiling fan. The ball arcs into the blade path and is redirected through a chain of physically believable collisions. The fan wobbles subtly, dust shakes loose, and each impact has accurate contact, spin, gravity, and rebound. Cut to the radiator as the ball strikes the metal ribs, drops to the wooden floor, and rolls out of frame.

From 10 to 15 seconds, return to a wider bedside composition. She lies comfortably under the blanket, still reading and completely unbothered. The ball rolls back into the foreground, lightly bumps the bed frame, and stops. She gives the camera one brief deadpan glance, then returns to the page. Hold the final image for one second.

Use soft window daylight, gentle bounced fill, realistic shadow falloff, small phone auto exposure shifts, natural skin texture, slight lens distortion, deep focus, and restrained handheld vibration. Avoid polished commercial perfection. Edit with fast impact cuts while preserving screen direction. Add playful music

entries.title: Cyberpunk RPG Anime Action
entries.description: A high-intensity urban fantasy RPG-style animation prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a spear-wielding protagonist in a melee battle against a massive armored goblin in a neon cyberpunk setting.
entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。都市奇幻アクションRPG風、高レアリティ3D toon / cel-look animeの高速近接戦闘。最重要は、ハイテンポ、槍撃から尾撃へ渡る反動、尾の明確な直撃、重量級の吹き飛び。スローモーション、待機、睨み合い、長い構え、長いタメは作らない。

【参照の使い方】
画像1を主人公の同一性固定の唯一の参照として使う。画像1のキャラクターを同じ人物として維持し、顔、目の形、虹彩色、髪型、髪色、前髪、衣装、装飾、体格、全身シルエット、雰囲気、キャラクターカラーを最優先で反映する。参照画像そのものの背景、部屋、家具、ポーズ、画角、フレーミング、文字、設定表、UIは再現しない。変化してよいのは、表情、視線、口元、戦闘姿勢、呼吸、自然な髪と衣装の揺れだけ。特徴の混合、顔の平均化、衣装交換、別人化、クローン化、余計な人物の追加は禁止。
主人公は、画像1の人物そのものとして描く。ただし固定シーン成立のため、一本の長槍と一本の尻尾を持つ近接戦闘キャラクターとして統一する。槍と尻尾の形状、表面質感、装飾、発光色、小物の意匠は、画像1のキャラクターカラーと雰囲気に合わせて自然に調整する。衣装の金属部、布の差し色、装飾、槍の発光、尾の鱗色、画面全体の補助色も、画像1に合わせて変えてよい。場所と戦闘構成は固定、武器は長槍固定。

【主人公固定】
主人公は全Cutで同じ人物。画像1の顔立ち、目、虹彩、髪、衣装、装飾、体型、シルエット、雰囲気、固有色を維持する。一本の長槍だけを使う。穂先、柄、石突を一体の剛体として保ち、両手で柄だけを握る。穂先だけを回転させない。尻尾は一本だけ。腰後ろ中央につながり、根元は太く、先端へ自然に細くなる。全身回転の反動で尾撃へつなげる。

【敵固定】
敵は同じ一体だけの巨大甲冑ゴブリン。灰緑色の顔と皮膚、長い尖り耳、低い鼻、下顎から出る二本の牙、小さな琥珀色の目、幅広く重い体型、煤けた黒鉄の全身甲冑、大型肩甲、革ベルト、古銅の鋲、短い暗赤色の腰布、一本の戦斧を維持する。主人公の約1.8倍の身長。黒鉄胸当ての右脇腹には、三つの大きな古銅鋲が縦に並ぶ幅広い長方形の補強板があり、これを尾撃の接触目標として固定する。最後まで生身と甲冑の実体を保ち、結晶化、粒子化、消滅はしない。
【画風固定】
高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックの一系統だけ。完全な立体モデル感、細くクリーンなアニメ輪郭、顔・髪・衣装・槍・尻尾・甲冑への明快な2〜3段セルシェーディング。瞳と髪は多層ハイライト、肌は清潔なトゥーンマット、布は低反射、金属は硬い縁反射、尻尾は鱗の面が読める。劇場版クラスのキーアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のある照明、密度の高い背景美術。太い黒輪郭、平坦な単層影、汎用3D美少女顔、低密度背景、写実寄り、画風混合は避ける。

【舞台と光】
舞台は固定。ネオン都市を見下ろすネオゴシック大図書館塔の雨上がりの屋上。濡れた黒石床、低いガラス壁、尖塔、大型金属製通気設備、遠景の高層ビル、浅いネオンボケ. 場所は変えない。光と色味は画像1に合わせて微調整し、主人公のキャラクターカラーを主役にする。背景は低彩度寄りで、主人公、槍、尻尾、甲冑との接触点を優先して目立たせる。
【アクション】
Cut1：主人公側の低い三分の四後方から地表すれすれに追従。ゴブリンが戦斧を振り上げる瞬間、主人公は一歩だけ鋭く踏み込み、長槍全体による大きな斜め薙ぎを一度だけ放つ。穂先が黒鉄胸当て中央へ命中した瞬間だけ短いhit-stop。金属火花が散り、ゴブリンの上体が後方へ開く。主人公は構え直さず、槍撃の反動をそのまま全身回転へ渡し、次の尾撃へ直結する。Cut終端では、尻尾の先端側三分の一の幅広い鱗面が、ゴブリン右脇腹の補強板から拳一つ分だけ離れた位置にすでに入っている。

Cut2：尻尾接触専用の固定クローズアップ。ゴブリンの胸から腰までを画面の約70%に置く。主人公の顔や槍には戻らない。ゴブリン胴体、右脇腹の補強板、画面左から入る一本の尻尾だけを主役にする。開始時から、尻尾の幅広い鱗面と補強板の間に拳一つ分の空間を見せる。尻尾は低い水平円弧で入り、細い尾先ではなく幅広い鱗面を補強板へ一度だけ強く直撃させる。命中前の空間、鱗面の接近、単一接触、接触後の装甲反応を同じ固定近景の中で順番に見せる。命中の瞬間だけ0.04〜0.06秒のhit-stop。速度線を消し、鱗面、三つの古銅鋲、補強板の接触境界を鮮明に止める。補強板は深くへこみ、胴体は接点から横へ折れ、その勢いで画面外へ押し出される。
Cut3：ゴブリンが押し出される方向へ高速ウィップパンし、地表すれすれのローアングル中遠景へ戻す。ゴブリンは尾撃の衝撃で画面奥左へ約3メートル、少なくとも自分の一体長ぶん、濡れた床すれすれに高速で水平吹き飛ぶ。両足は命中後にだけ床から離れる。自分から跳躍せず、空中で勝手に回転しない。戦斧は両手に握られたまま。背面装甲と肩甲が大型金属製通気設備の側板へ真正面から激突し、側板が深くへこみ、水膜と短い火花が外側へ噴く。全身移動は衝突で完全停止し、戦闘不能の実体として設備前へ崩れて残る. 主人公は追いかけず、その場で反作用を収束させる。

Cut4：水しぶきワイプが抜けると、主人公の斜め前三分の四、中距離固定。頭から両足と槍全体が入る。背景奥には、へこんだ通気設備と戦闘不能のゴブリンを残す。主人公は尾撃地点で完全停止. 体重を片脚へ自然に預け、視線は倒れたゴブリンへ向ける。尻尾は両脚の後ろで低い自然な弧を作って収まる。主人公は槍を身体の横へ移し、片手で柄の中央付近を握り、もう片手は自然に下ろす。穂先を真上、柄を垂直、石突を真下へ一直線に揃え、石突を濡れた黒石床へ短く下ろす。石突と床の隙間、単一接触点、接触後の小さな水輪を順番に見せる。最終フレームは、主人公が完全停止し、槍が身体の横で垂直に立ち、石突が床へ接地し、尻尾が背後で低く収まり、背景のゴブリンがへこんだ設備前で戦闘不能になっている状態。
【重要ガード】
主人公一人、巨大甲冑ゴブリン一体、長槍一本、尻尾一本、戦斧一本だけ。Cut2は尻尾接触だけの独立固定クローズアップ. 接触なしで先に敵を飛ばさない. ゴブリンは軽い怯みで終わらず、実体のまま水平吹き飛び、設備へ激突して止まる. 尾撃後の主人公はその場で完全停止し、前方スライド、横滑り、膝滑り、カメラ方向への接近をしない. 終盤は、頭、両足、槍全体、石突の床接触を同時に見せる中距離固定. 分身、人型残像、槍複製、戦斧複製、尻尾分岐

entries.title: Cinematic Exercise Bike Cavalry Charge Misdirection
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot video generation prompt for Seedance 2.0 that uses cinematic lighting and high-speed motion to transform a mundane indoor cycling session into a dramatic, heroic cavalry charge through visual misdirection and character consistency.
entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0

【视频规格】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，三个干净镜头。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，采用克制型冷面运动喜剧、高级商业电影灯光、默片式反应节奏和明确的视觉误导，将一堂普通室内动感单车课伪装成恢宏的骑兵冲锋；最终包袱由两位角色共同承担，不再使用现实处罚、意外摔倒、法术失灵或单方面出丑。

针对 Seedance 2.0 的统一多模态参考、双角色稳定动作、连续摄影机空间关系，以及普通话对白、音乐、环境声和动作音效的原生音画同步生成进行设计。

【场景设定】

昏暗的高级室内动感单车教室，黑色镜面墙、前后两排固定单车、流动的红蓝色灯光、轻微舞台薄雾、折叠毛巾、银色水瓶、持续旋转的车轮和空置的教练台清晰可见。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙姐

同一个来自 @图片 1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，严格保持参考图中的同一张脸、锐利深色眼睛、黑色长发、玉簪、高挑纤细身材、白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明宽袖、银色饰品、飘动长裙和白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜单车姐

同一个来自 @图片 2 的单车姐，严格保持同一张脸、马尾、身材比例、服装、鞋子和饰品。

【核心道具】

两辆并排的固定动感单车、折叠毛巾、银色水瓶、空置教练台。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景缓慢推轨】

昏暗的高级室内动感单车教室，黑色镜面墙、前后两排固定单车、流动的红蓝色灯光、轻微舞台薄雾、折叠毛巾、银色水瓶、持续旋转的车轮和空置的教练台清晰可见。

角色 ID A 为同一个来自 @图片 1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，严格保持参考图中的同一张脸、锐利深色眼睛、黑色长发、玉簪、高挑纤细身材、白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明宽袖、银色饰品、飘动长裙 and 白色布靴；她从鞋到头完整坐在最前方的固定单车上，双手紧握车把，以即将奔赴战场般的严肃神情快速骑行。

角色 ID B 为同一个来自 @图片 2 的单车姐，严格保持同一张脸、马尾、身材比例、服装、鞋子 and 饰品，在剑仙姐旁边并排骑行。

摄影机从两辆单车之间稳定向前跟拍，车轮旋转声、链条节奏、呼吸声、马蹄般的打击乐 and 英雄式弦乐逐渐融合，制造千军万马冲锋的错觉。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜牛仔景中景侧面跟拍】

同一个单车姐压低上半身，将踏频提升到极限，大喊：“最后十秒，冲！”

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙姐从车座上站起，同样双手紧握车把，同一头长发 and 宽袖猛烈向后飘动。

同一个动感单车教室始终不变，红色灯光轨迹 and 镜面倒影看起来如同数千名骑兵同时冲锋。

两人的肩膀因发力而轻微颤抖，皮肤自然出现汗珠，却始终保持悲壮而坚定的英雄表情，音乐上升到最大高潮。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写进入极近特写】

英雄音乐突然停止，普通白色顶灯瞬间亮起。

画外教练用平静语气播报：“热身结束，正式课现在开始。”

同样两位女性同时僵住，缓慢转头互面对视，随后默契地同时停止踩踏。

同一个剑仙姐抬起一只轻微颤抖的手，严肃说道：“修炼讲究循序渐进。”

同一个单车姐立刻点头：“同意。”

极近特写两人疲惫却强行维持尊严的表情，身后的两个车轮仍在高速空转。

画面定格。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，三个干净镜头。

普通话口型准确，人物始终保持清楚的左右空间关系，踩踏、汗水、头发、真丝衣料、车轮 and 镜面倒影物理效果真实，不生成画面字幕，不增加前景人物。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props
entries.translated_prompt:
[Generation Mode]

Seedance 2.0

[Video Specifications]

Strict total duration of 15 seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio, 24fps, three clean shots.

[Overall Style]

Cinematic realistic texture, using a restrained deadpan sports comedy style, high-end commercial film lighting, silent film-style reaction pacing, and clear visual misdirection. It disguises an ordinary indoor cycling class as a grand cavalry charge; the final punchline is shared by both characters, avoiding realistic penalties, accidental falls, failed magic, or one-sided embarrassment.

Designed for Seedance 2.0's unified multi-modal reference, dual-character stable movement, continuous camera spatial relationships, and native audio-visual synchronization for Mandarin dialogue, music, ambient sounds, and action sound effects.

[Scene Setting]

A dimly lit high-end indoor cycling studio. Black mirror walls, two rows of fixed exercise bikes, flowing red and blue lights, slight stage mist, folded towels, silver water bottles, continuously spinning wheels, and an empty instructor platform are clearly visible.

[Characters]

Character ID A | Sword Immortal Sister

A 25–30 year old East Asian 'Sword Immortal' sister from @Image 1. Strictly maintain the same face from the reference image, sharp dark eyes, long black hair, jade hairpin, tall and slender build, white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent wide sleeves, silver accessories, fluttering long skirt, and white cloth boots.

Character ID B | Cycling Sister

The same cycling sister from @Image 2. Strictly maintain the same face, ponytail, body proportions, clothing, shoes, and accessories.

[Core Props]

Two side-by-side fixed exercise bikes, folded towels, silver water bottles, empty instructor platform.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low-angle Full Shot Slow Tracking]

Dim high-end indoor cycling studio. Character ID A, the 25–30 year old East Asian Sword Immortal sister from @Image 1, is fully seated on the frontmost fixed bike, hands gripping the handlebars, riding fast with a serious expression as if about to head into battle. Character ID B, the cycling sister from @Image 2, rides side-by-side with her. The camera tracks steadily forward from between the two bikes. Sounds of spinning wheels, chain rhythm, breathing, horse-hoof-like percussion, and heroic strings blend to create the illusion of thousands of troops charging.

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Cowboy Medium Shot Side Tracking]

The same cycling sister lowers her upper body, pushes her cadence to the limit, and shouts: "Last ten seconds, charge!" The same Sword Immortal sister in white embroidered Hanfu stands up from the seat, hands gripping the handlebars, her long hair and wide sleeves fluttering violently backward. The cycling studio remains unchanged, but the red light trails and mirror reflections look like thousands of cavalrymen charging simultaneously. Their shoulders tremble from the effort, sweat beads appear naturally on their skin, yet they maintain a tragic and determined heroic expression as the music peaks.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up to Extreme Close-up]

The heroic music stops abruptly, and ordinary white overhead lights flash on. An off-screen instructor announces calmly: "Warm-up finished, the formal class starts now." The same two women freeze simultaneously, slowly turn their heads to look at each other, and then both stop pedaling in unison. The Sword Immortal sister raises a slightly trembling hand and says seriously: "Cultivation requires gradual progress." The cycling sister immediately nods: "Agreed." Extreme close-up of their exhausted yet dignity-maintaining expressions, while the two wheels behind them continue to spin empty at high speed. Frame freeze.

[Technical Requirements]

Strict 15-second total duration, 16:9 wide screen, 24fps, three clean shots. Accurate Mandarin lip-sync, characters maintain clear left-right spatial relationships. Physical effects of pedaling, sweat, hair, silk fabric, wheels, and mirror reflections must be realistic. No generated captions, no added foreground figures.

[Negative Prompt]

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

Use the uploaded reference image as the exact character identity. Keep the same face, facial proportions, hairstyle, eyebrows, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, body build, and overall appearance in every scene. Do not redesign, replace, or alter the character. Maintain 100% identity consistency throughout the video.

Outfit Lock
Keep the exact same outfit in every clip: premium matte black snowboarding jacket, black insulated snow pants, matte black helmet, reflective black ski goggles, black gloves, black snowboard boots, black snowboard with subtle silver accents. No outfit changes, no color changes, no accessory changes. Maintain perfect outfit consistency throughout the video.

 Style: Ultra-photorealistic live-action cinematic, IMAX scale, 8K HDR, 120 FPS, physically accurate snow simulation, premium Hollywood action film, realistic human movement, NOT animation, NOT CGI style, NOT cartoon.

CLIP 1
Use the uploaded reference image as the exact character identity. Keep 100% facial identity consistency and the exact same snowboard outfit throughout the video.
A towering alpine mountain covered in pristine deep snow during a dramatic golden sunrise. Powerful mountain winds blow across the ridge, creating drifting snow particles. A handsome athletic Korean male snowboarder wearing a premium matte black snowboarding jacket, insulated black snow pants, matte black helmet, reflective black ski goggles, black gloves, black snowboard boots, and a matte black snowboard with subtle silver accents stands on the mountain ridge.

0–2 seconds: Extreme cinematic close-up of his face. Cold breath is visible in the freezing air. Wind moves loose snow around him while his eyes lock onto the slope ahead with calm determination. Slow cinematic push-in camera.

2–4 seconds: He explosively pushes forward and begins descending the steep mountain. Powerful carving turns send enormous clouds of powder into the air. The camera tracks extremely close beside the snowboard, capturing detailed snow spray and realistic board flex.

4–6 seconds: A high-speed FPV drone races only meters behind him as he rapidly weaves between snow-covered pine trees, exposed rocks, and natural ice formations. The speed continuously increases with intense kinetic camera movement.

8–10 seconds: He glances over his shoulder, immediately lowers his body into an aggressive racing stance, and accelerates even faster. Snow explodes behind his board while the avalanche rapidly closes the distance. End the clip just as he launches toward a massive natural snow cliff, cutting before takeoff for a seamless transition.

entries.title: Korean Street Food Vlog
entries.description: A realistic seven-shot cinematic video prompt for a Korean night market food vlog, featuring authentic textures and movements.
entries.prompt:
7-shot cinematic handheld smartphone food vlog, ultra-photorealistic, authentic travel VLOG aesthetic. Natural handheld movement with subtle focus breathing, casual framing, realistic exposure shifts, warm evening lantern lighting, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, immersive documentary realism.

A young woman (reference image) explores a lively Korean night market and sits at a small outdoor street-food stall. The reference image determines only her facial identity and hairstyle. Outfit: oversized cream linen shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, dark relaxed-fit trousers, white sneakers, simple canvas shoulder bag. She stays seated at the same counter facing the camera throughout the meal. No other faces are visible—only the vendor's hands occasionally enter the frame while preparing food.

The counter is filled with a sizzling black stone plate of Korean cheese dakgalbi (spicy chicken, melted mozzarella, cabbage, rice cakes, sweet potatoes, sesame seeds, green onions), chilled barley tea, stainless chopsticks, wooden spoon, pickled radish, kimchi, and paper napkins. The background features glowing neon Korean signs, hanging lanterns, rising steam, distant conversations, food stalls, and a vibrant summer evening atmosphere.

Shots

1. The sizzling dakgalbi arrives with steam rising dramatically. She smiles excitedly and says:
"와... 냄새 진짜 좋다!"

2. Close overhead shot as the vendor stretches the melted cheese across the pan with metal tongs.

3. She wraps cheesy chicken around a rice cake, takes a big bite, laughs, and fans her mouth playfully from the heat.

4. She sips cold barley tea, exhales with relief, then quietly says:
"이 조합 최고다."

5. She picks up kimchi and pickled radish between bites while enjoying the smoky flavors.

6. Nearly finished meal. She gives a satisfied nod and says:
"다음에 또 와야겠다."

7. Empty sizzling plate remains on the counter. She leans back smiling while colorful neon reflections glow behind her as the bustling night market continues.

Audio Design

Only authentic environmental sound: sizzling grill, bubbling cheese, chopsticks, metal utensils, tea pouring, distant market chatter, footsteps, soft breeze, and ambient city nightlife. No background music, subtitles, logos, watermarks, duplicate reference images, or artificial sound effects.

entries.title: Analog Fitness Vlog Gym Diary
entries.description: A detailed Seedance prompt for creating a realistic 16mm analog-style fitness vlog featuring a character named Chase in a gym setting.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA:
Handheld DV 16mm vlog footage. CHASE films herself at arm’s length and occasionally places the camera on a bench, gym bag, or near the stretching mat. Keep subtle hand movement, drifting composition, autofocus hunting, rushed reframing, uneven zooms, and brief accidental face cropping. The camera itself is never visible.

LOOK:
Warm analog tape texture with gentle grain, slightly reduced sharpness, soft halos around overhead lights, small exposure shifts, low contrast, and realistic skin tones.

STYLE:
An intimate end-of-workout diary filmed in a mostly empty gym. The mood is casual and unpolished: tired breathing, small pauses, quiet humor, relaxed movements, and natural smiles.

CHARACTER:
CHASE — a beautiful white Brazilian Instagram fitness model and lifestyle creator in her 20s. Long wavy chestnut-brown hair tied in a loose ponytail, expressive brown eyes, glowing skin, and a slim athletic figure. She wears a fitted long-sleeve workout top, high-waisted leggings, white socks, sneakers, and a towel loosely resting around her shoulders.

SETTING:
A quiet boutique gym late in the evening. Stretching mats, a mirrored wall, dumbbell racks, a workout bag, and a protein shake nearby. Warm overhead lighting with a few darker corners in the background.

SCENES:
CHASE drops onto the mat and catches her breath.
“Okay… that session is officially over.”
She stretches forward over one leg and smiles at the camera.
“I definitely pushed that last set too far.”
She rolls one shoulder and slowly switches sides.
“Tomorrow is going to be interesting.”
Close-up as she reaches into her gym bag and pulls out a protein shake.
She takes a sip, pauses, and looks pleasantly surprised.
“Wait… this one is actually good.”
She raises both arms above her head and le both arms above her head and leans gently to the side.
“I’d call today a solid eight and a half.”
She rests her arms on one knee, still slightly out of breath.
“Exhausted, but in the best way.”
She stands, throws the bag over her shoulder, and gives the camera a small wave.
“I’m calling it. See you at the next workout.”

entries.prompt:
[스타일]
실제로 촬영된 영상 그 자체의 질감. 유튜브 홈쿠킹 브이로그의 한 클립처럼 — 일반 미러리스 카메라를 손에 들고 찍은 핸드헬드 실촬영. 자동 노출이 밝기 변화에 살짝 출렁이고, 오토포커스가 가끔 한 박자 늦게 잡히며(짧은 포커스 헌팅), 프레이밍은 조금씩 어긋난 채 손으로 다시 맞춘다. 카메라는 항상 손에 들려 실시간 속도로만 움직인다. 렌즈에 낀 미세한 먼지 플레어, 디지털 센서 특유의 또렷하고 샤프한 질감.
[색·조명]
따뜻한 여름 아침, 큰 창으로 들어오는 자연광 하나가 유일한 광원. 색보정 없는 카메라 그대로의 자연색 — 리얼 화이트밸런스, 창가 하이라이트는 살짝 날아가고(부드운 클리핑), 그림자는 평범하게 뜬 일상 노출. 토끼 털의 결과 김의 반투명함이 실물 그대로 보이는 생활 화면.

[씬]
밝고 모던한 일본 가정집 주방. 살짝 생활감 있는 오크 카운터 — 쓰던 행주, 물방울 자국. 주방 아일랜드 위 주물 다코야키 팬. 곁에 스테인리스 믹싱볼, 흰 도자기 접시, 대나무 꼬치, 다코야키 소스, 일본 마요네즈, 아오노리, 가쓰오부시, 깍둑 문어, 송송 썬 파, 베니쇼가, 바삭한 텐카스. 조리 내내 김이 피어오른다.
[주인공 — <image1>]
<image1>의 롭이어 토끼가 주인공. 크림색 복슬복슬한 털, 축 늘어진 긴 귀, 동그란 까만 눈 — 털색·무늬·얼굴·체형을 전 컷 동일하게 유지. 화면에는 이 토끼 한 마리만 등장하며, 모든 조리는 토끼의 두 앞발과 입으로만 이루어진다. 앞발은 실제 토끼 발 그대로 — 폭신한 패드와 짧은 발가락이 대나무 꼬치를 야무지게 감싼다. 실제 토끼의 몸무게와 관절 가동범위 안에서만 움직인다.

[연기 법칙]
수백 번 구워본 장인의 여유. 조리 내내 몸통과 늘어진 귀가 앞발 리듬에 맞춰 잔잔히 흔들린다 — 춤이 아니라 즐거움이 배어나온 무의식적 스웨이. 감정은 토끼의 언어로만: 코 씰룩임, 늘어진 귀가 쫑긋 섰다 다시 내려앉음, 수염 떨림, 볼 오물거림. 시선은 언제나 팬과 접시에 고정.
[오디오]
카메라 내장 마이크로 녹음된 듯한 현장음만: 은은한 룸톤 위로 반죽 지글거림, 꼬치가 팬을 두드리는 금속 클릭, 소스 짜는 소리, 가쓰오부시 바스락, 도자기 접시 소리, 후- 부는 숨, 멀리서 매미와 아침 생활 소음.

[컷 리듬]
컷마다 화각과 앵글을 첫 문장에서 확립. 순간 인서트는 극단적으로 짧게. 팬은 항상 화면 아래쪽, 토끼는 팬 너머 — 이 좌우·전후 축을 전 컷 유지.
cut1 (0:00–0:01) 미디엄 클로즈업, 카운터 높이. <image1> 토끼가 몸을 잔잔히 흔들며 두 앞발로 스테인리스 볼을 기울인다. 매끈한 반죽 줄기가 뜨거운 주물 몰드마다 살짝 넘치게 흘러들고, 즉시 지글 — 잔기포가 오르며 얇은 김이 창광 속으로. 김 때문에 노출이 한 번 살짝 출렁. SFX: 반죽 시즐.

cut2 (0:01–0:02) 바짝 들이댄 클로즈업, 초점이 한 박자 늦게 맞는다. 리듬을 유지한 채 앞발이 빠르고 정확하게 문어·파·베니쇼가·텐카스를 몰드마다 떨어뜨린다. 입에 문 대나무 꼬치로 몰드 가장자리를 돌려 넘친 반죽을 동그랗게 쓸어 담는다 — 꼬치가 팬에 닿는 경쾌한 금속 클릭. SFX: 톡톡 클릭.
cut3 (0:02–0:03.6) 클로즈업. 양 앞발에 하나씩 쥔 꼬치 두 개가 놀라운 속도와 정확도로 다코야키를 회전시킨다. 하나가 몰드에서 미끄러져 뜨거운 그릴 위를 데굴데굴 — 촬영자가 급히 카메라를 살짝 틀어 쫓아간다. 토끼는 리듬을 깨지 않고 꼬치 하나로 따라가, 회전 중인 다른 다코야키 사이로 살살 몰아 빈 몰드에 한 번의 연속 동작으로 되돌린다. 귀가 자랑스럽게 한 번 쫑긋. SFX: 데굴데굴, 클릭.

cut4 (0:03.6–0:04.8) 바짝 들이댄 클로즈업. 완벽한 황금빛. 유연한 앞발 스냅으로 다코야키를 흰 접시에 옮기고, 곧장 윤기 나는 소스를 지그재그로, 이어 크리미한 마요네즈를 겹쳐 뿌린다. SFX: 소스 스퀴즈.
cut5 (0:04.8–0:06.3) 바짝 들이댄 클로즈업. 아오노리를 뿌리고 초박 가쓰오부시 한 줌을 넉넉히 — 조각들이 열기에 즉시 춤추기 시작한다. 호기심에 얼굴을 바짝 대고 후- 한 번 불자 더 격렬하게 파닥. 코가 씰룩, 고개를 갸웃하고는 꼬치로 하나를 집어 든다. SFX: 바스락.

cut6 (0:06.3–0:08) 미디엄 클로즈업. 꼬치를 앞발 사이에서 한 바퀴 빙그르 돌리고, 후- 후- 두 번 불고 자신 있게 한입. 속은 아직 몰텐 — 눈이 살짝 커지고 늘어진 귀가 번쩍 선다. 앞발로 입가를 가리고 코로 숨을 호- 내쉬며 볼을 오물오물, 수줍게 코를 씰룩. SFX: 후- 숨, 오물오물.
cut7 (0:08–0:10) 미디엄 핸드헬드. 같은 다코야키를 조금 더 오래 불고 두 번째 한입 — 완벽. 눈을 잠시 감고 만족스럽게 고개를 끄덕, 꼬치로 접시를 리듬 있게 톡톡 두 번, 다음 다코야키로 앞발을 뻗는다. 김은 계속 오르고 전경의 가쓰오부시는 계속 춤춘다. 카메라가 손에 들린 채 옆으로 천천히 흐르다, 다음 다코야키를 집는 동작 중간에 영상이 그냥 끝난다 — 홈비디오처럼. SFX: 톡톡, 아침 앰비언스.

entries.prompt: Cinematic slow motion point of view shot on a bright sandy beach during golden hour. A fluffy white Samoyed dog sprints toward the camera across the wet sand. entries.title: Macro Golden Morphing Animation
entries.description: A highly sophisticated video prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a continuous, high-speed macro animation of melting gold morphing into various forms and looping back.
entries.prompt:
漆黒の背景に浮かぶ、溶けた黄金の一滴を起点として、自由な連想の連鎖を始めろ。

高速展開、途切れない連続モーフィング。制作予算5億円級、超高精細マクロ撮影のハイクオリティ映像。

連鎖の法則：
- どのような物語にするか、具体的な指示は与えない。冒頭のモチーフ「特徴的な性質」（曲線、光沢、質感、色）から、AI自身が次の形を1つ連想し、絶え間なく別のモチーフへ変容させ続けろ。
- 一つの形に静止・完成させてはならない。常にその次の変容の途中でなければならない。カットを割らず、なめらかに溶け合いながら移り変わること。
- 直前の形が持っていた色・質感・光の性質を、次の形も必ず引き継ぐこと。無関係な飛躍は禁止。ただし変容先のモチーフそのものは幾何学的な形にとどめず、AI自身が自由に選んでよい（生き物、植物、天体、鉱物、液体、炎、なんでもよい）。
- 常に動き続けること。テンポは徐々に加速していく。
- 最後の瞬間、連想は再び冒頭の姿へと戻り、シームレスにループする。

テキストなし、ロゴなし、字幕なし、キャラクターなし、人物なし、セリフなし。カメラは画面中央に固定する。
entries.translated_prompt:
Start with a drop of molten gold floating against a jet-black background and begin a chain of free associations.

High-speed development, uninterrupted continuous morphing. High-quality video with a 500-million-yen production budget, ultra-high-definition macro photography.

Laws of the Chain:
- Do not give specific instructions on what kind of story to create. Based on the 'characteristic properties' (curves, luster, texture, color) of the starting motif, the AI itself should associate the next shape and continuously transform it into another motif.
- Never let it stop or complete a single shape. It must always be in the middle of its next transformation. Do not cut; transitions should melt and flow smoothly into one another.
- The next shape must always inherit the color, texture, and light properties of the previous shape. Unrelated jumps are prohibited. However, the AI is free to choose the target motif itself, not limited to geometric shapes (creatures, plants, celestial bodies, minerals, liquids, fire, anything).
- Keep moving at all times. The tempo should gradually accelerate.
- At the final moment, the association returns to the starting form, looping seamlessly.

No text, no logos, no subtitles, no characters, no people, no dialogue. The camera is fixed in the center of the screen.

entries.title: Nostalgic Idol Home Video Storyboard
entries.description: A multi-scene video prompt designed for Seedance 2.0 to create a vintage, nostalgic camcorder-style vlog following a K-pop idol's day.
entries.prompt:
PROJECT STYLE:
Create a nostalgic behind-the-scenes home video following CHASE before a fan meeting. The video should feel personal, like private memories, building anticipation until she steps onto the stage.

FILMING STYLE:
Vintage consumer camcorder look. CHASE films herself throughout the day, sometimes placing the camera on tables/shelves. Use natural handheld movement, slight wobble, autofocus shifts, imperfect framing, soft zooms, tape grain, analog blur, faded colors, and exposure changes.

VISUAL TONE:
Warm dressing room lights, cool daylight in the van, muted rehearsal lighting, and bright backstage spill light before the entrance.

CHARACTER:
CHASE (Image1): Korean female idol in her twenties, long straight black hair, glowing skin, expressive eyes, soft coral lips. Starts in a comfortable robe, then changes into a modest elegant fan-event outfit with long sleeves and minimal accessories.

SCENES:

1. Makeup room: CHASE watches herself in the mirror while her stylist finishes her hair.
VO: "Everything starts long before anyone sees us."

2. Close-up of stylist fixing her final hair accessory. Quiet room ambience.

3. Moving van: CHASE watches the streets through the window, rubbing her fingers.
VO: "The closer we get... the quieter I become."

4. She looks down, exhales, and smiles softly.

5. Empty venue rehearsal: CHASE tests the microphone, her voice echoes.
VO: "It's strange how empty a place can feel just before it's full of people."

6. Close-up of her hand adjusting the microphone stand. Silence.

7. Backstage: She hears fans cheering behind the curtain.
VO: "Just one more step..."

8. CHASE takes a breath, smiles, and walks into the stage lights.
VO: "And suddenly... it feels like home."

entries.title: Hyper-Realistic Seattle Urban Chase Sequence
entries.description: An intense, high-speed action prompt featuring a woman sprinting through a Seattle flower shop and busy sidewalks, focusing on cinematic lighting and realistic camera movement.
entries.prompt: A fast paced 15 second hyper realistic action video in 16 by 9 aspect ratio driven by energetic electronic drum and bass music. The scene opens with a tight close up of a lush green potted bonsai tree on a florist counter. A hand swiftly grabs the pot. Cut to a dynamic handheld tracking shot following a young athletic woman wearing a bright yellow windbreaker and dark fitted athletic pants. She bursts out of the flower shop and breaks into a full speed sprint down a busy Seattle sidewalk. The camera shakes realistically to match her intense footfalls. She effortlessly vaults over a concrete planter and slides beneath a metal delivery cart. The lighting is cinematic midday sunlight creating high contrast shadows and bright lens flares bouncing off glass skyscrapers. Cut to a low angle shot pointing upward as she sprints underneath a moving elevated monorail train. The camera movement is frantic and urgent. She dashes up a set of steep stone stairs taking them three at a time. The frantic action suddenly cuts to a perfectly still calm static shot inside a sleek modern corporate office. The woman gently places the intact bonsai tree onto a polished glass desk in front of a stunned executive. Her breathing is slightly heavy but her expression is completely casual. The video must look entirely photorealistic with natural motion blur and authentic urban textures.

entries.title: Seoul Street Food MiniDV Nostalgia
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for a nostalgic, early-2000s handheld camera aesthetic featuring a young woman exploring a Seoul food alley.
entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean woman, 24, natural everyday appearance, shoulder-length black hair worn loose with soft bangs, realistic skin texture with a natural evening glow, minimal makeup, relaxed and cheerful personality. Wearing an oversized charcoal bomber jacket over a white hoodie, loose light-wash jeans, black Converse-style sneakers, a small black nylon shoulder bag, and silver hoop earrings. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout.

Location: A quiet neighborhood street food alley in Seoul on a cool autumn evening. Small pojangmacha tents, folding tables, warm hanging lights, light steam rising from food stalls, parked scooters, narrow side streets, and a handful of local residents enjoying dinner. Cozy, authentic, and non-touristy.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Natural, candid behavior with genuine interactions and subtle body language. Warm tungsten lighting mixed with cool streetlights creates an authentic early-2000s nighttime atmosphere.

Camera Style: Early-2000s Sony MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, autofocus hunting in low light, soft focus, faded colours, visible digital noise, slight motion blur, exposure pumping around bright stall lights, MiniDV compression artifacts, no stabilization.

00:00–00:03
She walks through the food alley, smiling as steam drifts from a tteokbokki stall. The camera briefly focuses on the steaming food before correcting.

00:03–00:06
She orders a cup of tteokbokki, thanks the vendor with a polite smile, and carefully accepts the warm cup with both hands.

00:06–00:09
Standing beside the stall, she takes a small bite, laughs quietly because it's still too hot, and gently fans the food with her hand. Autofocus shifts between the steam and her face.

00:09–00:12
She continues walking, sipping a canned drink while watching people pass under the glowing streetlights. The operator accidentally tilts the camera upward toward the lights before reframing.

00:12–00:15
She notices the camcorder, raises the snack cup with a playful smile as if inviting the viewer to join, then walks farther into the softly lit alley. The recording abruptly cuts to black.
Audio: Natural ambience only–quiet conversations, sizzling food, chopsticks clinking, distant traffic, scooter engines, footsteps, light wind, and soft laughter. No music. No narration.

Goal: A forgotten MiniDV home video from autumn 2004, capturing a cozy evening enjoying street food in a quiet Seoul neighborhood–warm, imperfect, nostalgic, and completely believable.

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐

剑仙师姐 @图片 1，25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩和白色布靴。

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐拈起唯一一枚黑色棋子，庄严说道：“此局，我以星河为盘。”

一张巨大的半透明围棋盘随即在云海上展开，黑色星辰棋子依次亮起，远处传来低沉雷鸣，克制的剑风托起她的宽袖与长发。

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

The Bicycle Girl checks the manual, passing hinges from the bike basket, catching a falling shelf, commanding: 'Left board, beam, back panel!' Background remains consistent. Sound: screw turning, sword whistling, board clicking with heroic percussion.

【Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up to Extreme Close-up】

The assembled cabinet stands upright. They nod with a sense of mission accomplished. The Bicycle Girl finds one dowel left: 'Where does this go?' The Sister answers: 'A spare.' Half-second silence; the cabinet groans and folds in three stages, flattening on the floor. Extreme close-up: they freeze in place as the bicycle bell dings once.

【Technical Requirements】

Character/clothing stability, prop continuity, realistic physics for weight, collapse, and materials. Accurate Mandarin lip-sync. No subtitles.

【Negative Prompts】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

entries.prompt:
参考映射：@图一为泰蒂亚娜角色卡，@图二为沃瓦角色卡。

场景一（零秒至十五秒）：请求 → 反驳 → 对峙 → 崩溃
镜头结构：六个镜头，十五秒，画幅十六比九

全球风格说明：
• 拍摄媒介：苹果十七专业版手机原始格式视频，每一帧具有原始照片质感。非专业手机拍摄审美，轻微手持微抖，构图带有即时抓拍感，曝光与白平衡在全部剪辑中保持连续
• 光学系统：黑柔扩散滤镜结合现代临床级高解析镜头。滤镜只柔化高光过渡并产生极轻微光晕，面部轮廓与细节保持清晰。十六光圈，深焦，前景至背景全部清晰，画面中心至边缘保持锐度
• 灯光：阴天傍晚的天空光作为唯一主光。光线柔和、低反差并完全扩散。浅色混凝土地面向面部提供自然反射，阴影开放，双眼与泪水保留干净白色反光点
• 色彩：中性阴影，抬升的石墨灰阴影，柔和开放的黑色，自然暖中性肤色，真实中间调，平坦低反差中间调，自然高光，柔和干净的亮部，白色反光点清洁，高光保留完整层次。自然饱和度受控并整体压低，颜色平衡、柔和、轻微去饱和
• 真实质感：保留毛孔、眼下纹理、轻微皮肤油光、泪膜、泪痕、鼻尖泛红与湿润睫毛。衣料保持真实重量、褶皱和接触阴影。每秒二十四帧，自然运动模糊
• 场所：乌克兰基辅霍洛西伊夫区，一栋现代私人住宅的后院露台，浅色混凝土墙、垂直木条外墙、落地玻璃门、白桦与松树
• 环境音：远处城市交通，树叶摩擦，微风，人物呼吸与抽泣清晰。对白出现时环境音降低
• 人物：
  泰蒂亚娜对应@图一，保持脸部、灰绿色眼睛、中央分线的黑色长直发、黑色缎面中长连衣裙、黑色细带高跟鞋完全一致。声音为中高音区，语速由克制转为急促，音量升至喊叫，尾音因哭泣断裂。每个镜头保持一致。
  沃瓦对应@图二，保持脸部、棕色眼睛、短棕色纹理头发、浅胡茬、黑色西装、敞开领口的白衬衫、黑色皮鞋完全一致。声音为中低音区，开始压低音量，随后变得响亮而短促。每个镜头保持一致。
• 空间调度：泰蒂亚娜站在画面右侧，背后是花园。沃瓦站在画面左侧，背后是玻璃门。两人相距两步。镜头始终保持同一百八十度轴线，确保视线方向连续
• 对白语言：自然英语

序列列表：
镜头一（零秒至一点二秒）建立
• 摄影机：中景双人镜头，视线高度，两人侧面九十度，深焦
• 摄影机运动：非专业手持，从两人之间横向漂移三十厘米，出现一次轻微迟到的构图修正
• 动作画面：泰蒂亚娜向沃瓦迈出半步，拳头贴在身体两侧，胸口快速起伏，眼眶积满泪水。沃瓦肩膀绷紧，下颌收紧。最后零点二秒，泰蒂亚娜急促吸气并提前开始第一句
• 退出：泰蒂亚娜的声音先于画面进入下一个角度
（声音先行剪接到）

镜头二（一点二秒至四点五秒）请求爆发
• 摄影机：越过沃瓦左肩拍摄泰蒂亚娜近景，视线高度，正面零度。沃瓦肩膀、泰蒂亚娜面部与背景花园全部保持清晰
• 摄影机运动：不稳定手持，向泰蒂亚娜前推十五厘米，构图随她突然提高音量产生细微水平偏移
• 动作画面：泰蒂亚娜先吞咽一次，下唇颤动，眉头向上并向内收紧。说到“dream”时鼻翼张开，说到“forever”时第一滴眼泪滑过右脸。泪水具有真实表面张力并反射白色天空光。句末继续直视沃瓦
• 对白：泰蒂亚娜用快速上升并逐渐破裂的声音说：'Vova, I want a red panda! It's been my dream forever!'
• 退出：最后一个词延续到沃瓦反应镜头的前三分之一秒
（声音延续剪接到）

镜头三（四点五秒至八点五秒）反驳
• 摄影机：越过泰蒂亚娜右肩拍摄沃瓦中近景，视线高度，三分之四侧面四十五度，前后景保持清晰
• 摄影机运动：手持前推十二厘米，随着沃瓦音量上升增加细小横向抖动
• 动作画面：沃瓦在最后一个词结束时用力眨眼一次，下颌肌肉收紧，短促鼻吸。前半句压低声音，后半句突然提高音量，右手掌短暂指向住宅。句末嘴唇紧闭，视线固定。最后零点二秒，泰蒂亚娜的下一句提前闯入
• 对白：沃瓦用由压低转为响亮的短促声音说：'We already have a cat and a Labrador! Our home is not a zoo!'
• 退出：泰蒂亚娜的喊声覆盖沃瓦最后的面部反应
（声音先行剪接到）

镜头四（八点五秒至十一秒）失控
• 摄影机：越过沃瓦肩膀拍摄泰蒂亚娜极近景，低角度十度，正面零度，深焦，湿润睫毛、泪痕、皮肤毛孔与沃瓦前景肩膀同时清晰
• 摄影机运动：不规则手持前推十厘米，第一次喊叫时构图短暂向右偏移，随后人工拉回双眼
• 动作画面：泰蒂亚娜双眼睁大，泪水连续流下，鼻尖发红，嘴角向下拉，肩膀随每次吸气抽动。第一句喊出，第二句声音突然破裂。句末嘴唇保持张开，只发出一次颤抖呼吸
• 对白：泰蒂亚娜用带哭腔的高音量说：'It's my dream! Why don't you care?'
• 退出：沃瓦说出“Tania”时画面仍停留在泰蒂亚娜脸上
（声音先行剪接到）

镜头五（十一秒至十三点五秒）界限
• 摄影机：越过泰蒂亚娜右肩拍摄沃瓦近景，轻微高角度五度，三分之四侧面四十五度，深焦
• 摄影机运动：开始静止，随后缓慢前推十厘米，保持手机手持的低幅度呼吸
• 动作画面：沃瓦保持直视，鼻翼张开，下颌持续绷紧。说到“red panda”时音量升高，说到“pet”时声音突然压低。句末目光落向泰蒂亚娜的泪水，嘴唇重新紧闭
• 对白：沃瓦用响亮而克制的声音说：'Tania, a red panda is not a pet!'
• 退出：最后一个词延续到泰蒂亚娜的最终反应
（声音延续剪接到）

镜头六（十三点五秒至十五秒）崩溃
• 摄影机：泰蒂亚娜双眼与嘴部极近景，视线高度，正面零度。沃瓦肩膀、泰蒂亚娜面部和背景全部保持清晰
• 摄影机运动：手持停止前推，只保留低幅度自然微抖
• 动作画面：最后一个词结束后，泰蒂亚娜下唇失去控制，嘴角向下收缩，肩膀向前塌落，发出一次压抑抽泣。新的泪滴在下眼睑形成，随后沿旧泪痕滑落。沃瓦在前景中抬起手，却停在半空。环境音降至接近安静一拍，随后远处交通声恢复
• 退出：停留在泰蒂亚娜无法说出口的呼吸

技术限制：
• 人物身份、服装、身高比例、空间位置、光线方向、曝光、白平衡和露台环境在全部镜头中保持一致
• 每个镜头为单次连续拍摄，剪辑严格遵守一百八十度轴线
• 十六光圈与深焦效果贯穿全部镜头，前景、中景、背景均保持清晰
• 黑柔滤镜只影响高光扩散，面部结构、眼睛、毛孔与画面边缘保持锐利
• 所有英语对白与指定人物准确同步口型
• 小熊猫仅作为对白主题，画面实体只包含泰蒂亚娜和沃瓦
• 无字幕，无画面文字，无水印，无标志，无背景音乐，无额外对白，无人物形变

优先生成：镜头四，泰蒂亚娜从喊叫转入声音破裂。镜头六，真实泪水运动、最终抽泣与沃瓦停在半空的手。
entries.translated_prompt:
Reference mapping: @Image1 for Tetiana's character card, @Image2 for Vova's character card.

Scene 1 (0-15 seconds): Request → Refutation → Confrontation → Breakdown
Shot structure: Six shots, fifteen seconds, 16:9 aspect ratio

Global Style Description:
• Shooting medium: iPhone 17 Pro original format video, each frame with raw photo quality. Non-professional mobile aesthetic, slight handheld jitter, snapshot composition, consistent exposure and white balance.
• Optical system: Black Pro-Mist diffusion filter combined with modern clinical-grade high-resolution lenses. The filter only softens highlight transitions and creates a slight bloom, keeping facial contours and details clear. f/16 aperture, deep focus, sharp from foreground to background, and from center to edges.
• Lighting: Overcast evening sky light as the sole main source. Soft, low contrast, and fully diffused. Light concrete ground provides natural bounce to faces, shadows are open, and eyes/tears retain clean white catchlights.
• Color: Neutral shadows, lifted graphite grey shadows, soft open blacks, natural warm neutral skin tones, authentic midtones, flat low-contrast midtones, natural highlights with full detail retention. Saturation is controlled and slightly lowered, with a balanced, soft, and slightly desaturated color palette.
• Realistic texture: Retains pores, under-eye texture, slight skin oiliness, tear film, tear tracks, redness on the tip of the nose, and wet eyelashes. Clothing maintains realistic weight, folds, and contact shadows. 24fps with natural motion blur.
• Setting: Backyard terrace of a modern private residence in Holosiiv, Kyiv, Ukraine, with light concrete walls, vertical wood slats, floor-to-ceiling glass doors, birch, and pine trees.
• Ambient sound: Distant city traffic, rustling leaves, gentle breeze, clear character breathing and sobbing. Ambient sound dips when dialogue occurs.
• Characters:
  Tetiana (corresponds to @Image1): consistent face, grey-green eyes, center-parted long straight black hair, black satin midi dress, black strappy heels. Voice is mid-high range, pace changes from restrained to frantic, volume rises to a shout, ending broken by tears. Consistent across all shots.
  Vova (corresponds to @Image2): consistent face, brown eyes, short brown textured hair, light stubble, black suit, open-collar white shirt, black leather shoes. Voice is mid-low range, starts low then becomes loud and curt. Consistent across all shots.
• Spatial Blocking: Tetiana stands on the right, garden behind her. Vova stands on the left, glass door behind him. Two steps apart. Camera maintains a strict 180-degree axis for eye-line continuity.
• Dialogue: Natural English

Sequence List:
Shot 1 (0s-1.2s) Establishing
• Camera: Medium two-shot, eye level, 90-degree profile, deep focus.
• Movement: Non-professional handheld, lateral drift of 30cm between them with one slight late framing correction.
• Action: Tetiana takes a half-step toward Vova, fists at her sides, chest rising rapidly, eyes filling with tears. Vova's shoulders tense, jaw tightens. In the last 0.2s, Tetiana takes a sharp breath and begins the first line.
• Exit: Tetiana's voice leads into the next angle.

Shot 2 (1.2s-4.5s) Request Outburst
• Camera: Close-up on Tetiana over Vova's left shoulder, eye level, 0-degree front. Vova's shoulder, Tetiana's face, and the background garden all stay sharp.
• Movement: Unstable handheld, pushes 15cm toward Tetiana, framing shifts slightly as her volume peaks.
• Action: Tetiana swallows, lower lip quivers, brows knit inward and up. Nostrils flare at 'dream', first tear rolls down right cheek at 'forever'. Tear has realistic surface tension reflecting white sky light. Stares fixedly at Vova.
• Dialogue: Tetiana says in a rising, cracking voice: 'Vova, I want a red panda! It's been my dream forever!'
• Exit: Last word carries into the first 0.3s of Vova's reaction shot.

Shot 3 (4.5s-8.5s) Refutation
• Camera: Medium close-up on Vova over Tetiana's right shoulder, eye level, 45-degree three-quarter view, all planes sharp.
• Movement: Handheld push 12cm, adding small lateral jitters as Vova's volume rises.
• Action: Vova blinks hard as the last word ends, jaw muscles clench, short nasal inhale. Voice starts low then turns loud and curt, right palm briefly gestures toward the house. Lips tight at the end. Tetiana's next line cuts in during the last 0.2s.
• Dialogue: Vova says in a voice turning from low to loud: 'We already have a cat and a Labrador! Our home is not a zoo!'
• Exit: Tetiana's shout overlaps Vova's final reaction.

Shot 4 (8.5s-11s) Losing Control
• Camera: Extreme close-up on Tetiana over Vova's shoulder, 10-degree low angle, 0-degree front, deep focus. Wet lashes, tear tracks, pores, and Vova's shoulder all sharp.
• Movement: Irregular handheld push 10cm, framing briefly drifts right during the first shout, manually corrected back to eyes.
• Action: Tetiana's eyes widen, tears flow continuously, nose reddens, mouth pulls down, shoulders twitch with every breath. First line is shouted, second voice breaks. Lips stay open at the end with one shaky breath.
• Dialogue: Tetiana says in a high, tearful volume: 'It's my dream! Why don't you care?'
• Exit: Vova's 'Tania' leads the audio into the next shot while still on Tetiana's face.

Shot 5 (11s-13.5s) Boundaries
• Camera: Close-up on Vova over Tetiana's right shoulder, 5-degree high angle, 45-degree three-quarter view, deep focus.
• Movement: Starts static, then slow 10cm push, maintaining low-amplitude phone handheld breathing.
• Action: Vova maintains eye contact, nostrils flare, jaw tensed. Volume rises at 'red panda', drops at 'pet'. Eyes drop toward Tetiana's tears at the end, lips tight.
• Dialogue: Vova says in a loud but restrained voice: 'Tania, a red panda is not a pet!'
• Exit: Last word carries into Tetiana's final reaction.

Shot 6 (13.5s-15s) Breakdown
• Camera: Extreme close-up on Tetiana's eyes and mouth, eye level, 0-degree front. Vova's shoulder and the background remain sharp.
• Movement: Handheld push stops, retaining only natural micro-jitter.
• Action: After the last word, Tetiana's lower lip loses control, corners of the mouth pull down, shoulders slump forward into a suppressed sob. New tear forms on lower lid and follows old track. Vova raises a hand in the foreground but stops mid-air. Ambient sound drops to near silence for one beat before traffic resumes.
• Exit: Lingers on Tetiana's unable-to-speak breath.

Technical Constraints:
• Identity, clothing, height ratio, position, lighting direction, exposure, and environment remain consistent across all shots.
• Each shot is a continuous take; editing follows the 180-degree rule.
• f/16 deep focus throughout; foreground, midground, and background remain sharp.
• Pro-Mist filter only affects highlights; facial structure and edges remain sharp.
• All English dialogue accurately lip-synced.
• Red panda is only mentioned; visuals contain only Tetiana and Vova.
• No subtitles, text, watermarks, logos, music, extra dialogue, or morphing.

Priority Generation: Shot 4 (voice break), Shot 6 (tear movement, final sob, Vova's hand).

entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0 Fast

【视频规格】

严格生成 15 秒视频，16:9 横屏，三个连贯清楚的镜头。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，以庄严仙侠悬疑开场，逐渐反转为温暖克制的冷面喜剧；采用宏大的古典中国山水构图、克制表演、清冷风暴蓝阴影、暖色火光、浓郁空间纵深、具有真实重量的灵兽动作，以及清楚明确的三段式叙事递进。

【角色锁定】

角色 A｜剑仙师姐

使用 @图片 1 严格锁定角色 A 剑仙师姐：25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙自然肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩 and 白色布靴。

角色 B｜小师妹

使用 @图片 2 严格锁定角色 B 小师妹：20–25 岁的东亚女性，圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小，穿青绿色汉服、深色腰带、木簪 and 黑色布鞋。

【核心生物设定】

始终只出现一条成年巨龙和三只幼龙。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景跟拍】

黄昏时分，一座巨大的悬崖龙窟入口，黑色岩壁、盘曲古松、残破石柱、古老爪痕、缓慢漂浮的山雾、散落兽骨，以及洞穴深处暗淡的橙色火光，共同建立清楚稳定的空间关系。

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐手持唯一一柄银色长剑向前行进，同一个穿青绿色汉服的小师妹跟在她身后三步。

震耳欲聋的龙吟让崖壁尘土落下；两人同时停步，黑暗中缓缓睁开一双巨大的金色眼睛。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景牛仔景】

同一条覆盖黑色鳞片的古老巨龙从洞穴中缓慢低下龙首，鼻孔逸出弯曲烟气。

同一个剑仙师姐拔出同一柄银色长剑，挡在同一个小师妹身前，厉声说道：“孽龙，离开此地！”

巨龙只展开一侧翅膀，强烈气流将山雾、两人的头发 and 衣袖同时向后推开；英雄式鼓声 and 剑气嗡鸣逐渐升起。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜近景揭晓转极近特写】

摄影机沿巨龙翅膀后方平稳环绕半圈，清楚揭示翅膀内侧保护着一个温暖巢穴，巢中正睡着三只幼小龙崽。

同一条古老巨龙小心收拢翅膀护住它们，压低声音说道：“小声些，刚哄睡。”

其中一只小龙崽轻轻打了个喷嚏，喷出一颗微小火星，随后向巨龙怀中靠近。

同一个小师妹缓慢压下剑仙师姐的剑锋，轻声说道：“师姐，它只是护崽。”

entries.title: Tornado VFX Miniature City Destruction
entries.description: A cinematic VFX-style prompt of a tornado destroying a miniature city inside a professional special effects soundstage.
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic 15 second cinematic video in 16:9 as one continuous handheld shot inside a vast professional special effects soundstage. Use a natural 24 millimeter wide angle lens at eye level, 24 fps, deep focus, slight operator sway, mild rolling shutter, realistic exposure breathing, and accurate motion blur. The camera begins at the corner of a large rectangular water tank. Blue water fills the lower frame, bordered by concrete, safety cones, and loose production papers. A small red and white model rescue boat floats near center. Above it hangs an enormous ribbed gray fabric funnel suspended from a circular ceiling rig. Green screen walls with tracking markers, black ceiling trusses, bright rectangular studio lamps, yellow wind machines, and a detailed miniature coastal city fill the background. From 0 to 2 seconds, hold the wide composition as the fabric tightens, wrinkles crawl upward, and its narrow tip begins rotating. The movement feels driven by real wind and tension, while reflections tremble across the water. From 2 to 4 seconds, the fabric collapses inward and becomes a dense rotating column of gray mist, dust, and atomized water. The funnel narrows toward the pool and descends with believable turbulent airflow. Drift slightly right while keeping it centered. From 4 to 6 seconds, the vortex strikes the water with a violent white eruption. Concentric waves race outward, the boat pitches and rolls, and heavy spray obscures the far edge. React with a quick controlled pan toward the miniature city. From 6 to 9 seconds, track the tornado across the shoreline. Water surges between buildings, a red vehicle is lifted, windows burst, rooftop objects spin away, and apartment blocks buckle in stages. Every fragment shows weight, collision, drag, gravity, and changing rotational speed. From 9 to 12 seconds, continue panning as miniature towers fold, shear, and fall into the street. A special effects technician appears naturally in the right foreground, wearing a plain black crew shirt and orange hearing protection, bracing against a railing. A tall glass skyscraper remains standing in the left background to provide scale. Keep the tornado dark and volumetric, with layered dust, mist, paper, roof panels, and vehicle parts orbiting at different depths. From 12 to 15 seconds, arc back toward the pool. The vortex returns to the center of the widescreen frame while a broad foamy wave curves around the tank and rushes toward camera. Fine droplets hit the lens, creating soft circular highlights without hiding the action. End with the tornado still spinning over violently churning water. Use harsh overhead studio lighting, cool cyan water reflections, mild green spill, realistic shadows, humid haze, and no stylized color filter. Preserve tiny imperfections, uneven water motion, slight camera shake, lens moisture, and natural debris randomness.

entries.title: Handheld DV Influencer Montage
entries.description: A multi-scene storyboard prompt designed to mimic a 16mm camcorder aesthetic, following an influencer's daily routine from a bedroom to a concert stage.
entries.prompt: CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic. CHASE records herself throughout every location, mostly holding the camera directly and occasionally setting it down for brief hands-free shots. Preserve natural hand tremors, crooked composition, slow autofocus correction, awkward zooms, accidental face cropping, and moments where the framing briefly loses her. The physical camcorder is never visible. LOOK: Authentic soft tape-image texture with mild blur, subtle electronic grain, glowing highlights, small automatic-exposure fluctuations, restrained contrast, and natural skin tones. The lighting changes realistically between locations: warm morning light in the apartment -> cooler daylight inside the car -> intense colorful lighting backstage and onstage. STYLE: A fast, energetic day-in-the-life montage with sharp cuts between locations and slightly accelerated transitional movement. Reflective voiceover plays over the footage instead of synchronized dialogue. The pace gradually builds from a quiet sleepy morning into a high-energy performance finale. Character CHASE -- an exceptionally beautiful Instagram influencer and rising pop performer in her 20s. Long glossy dark-brown hair, striking symmetrical features, large expressive eyes, flawless glowing skin, and soft pink lips. Slim, toned figure. Her outfit changes with each location: cozy loungewear at home, stylish casual clothing during the ride, and a glamorous performance outfit for the final scene. Each outfit fully covers her arms and torso. Setting Progression Stylish apartment bedroom in the morning -> luxury van interior during the day -> busy backstage area and concert stage at night. Storyboard -- 15 seconds, 5 cuts (~3s, bedroom, camera resting on a table, soft morning light) She slowly sits up, stretches, fixes her messy hair, and hurriedly packs a small bag. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "Some mornings begin before I'm even fully awake." (~3s, van interior, handheld selfie footage, natural window light) She sits beside the window as sunlight moves across her face, casually checking messages on her phone. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "I spend so much time on the road, this place almost feels like home." (~3s, van interior, macro detail shot) Close-up of her fingers choosing a song from a playlist while passing sunlight flickers across the screen and her hand. No voiceover, only natural road noise. (~3s, backstage, fast handheld montage) Quick glimpses of makeup brushes, hair styling, costume adjustments, staff rushing past, and her taking one focused breath before going onstage. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "And then everything suddenly starts moving at once." (~3s, stage, wide shot moving into a close-up, energetic finale) Bright stage lights ignite as she steps through the curtains. The camera catches her silhouette, then a brief confident smile before the image cuts to black. VOICEOVER (CHASE): "This moment is why I keep doing it."

entries.title: Seoul Night Market FPV Food Tour
entries.description: A continuous FPV drone-style video prompt capturing the atmosphere of a Seoul night market and a woman enjoying spicy tteokbokki.
entries.prompt: One single CONTINUOUS FPV shot, no cuts, no edits, one unbroken take. Real-time speed throughout, controlled and fluid — never frantic. Only ever moves forward in time — never loops, reverses or rewinds. NO slow motion except one half-second beat at the first bite, then an instant snap back to full speed. The image is clean and fully exposed edge to edge in every frame, all four corners as sharp and bright as the centre — no vignette, no dark frame edges, no goggle mask, no lens artefacts of any kind. The camera is INVISIBLE — no shadow or reflection ever appears in frame; it stirs no steam and leaves no trace. The take runs continuously until time runs out, still inside the market. CINEMATIC CAPTURE Clean sharp glass, 180-degree shutter with natural motion blur only on genuinely fast movement, fine grain, warm tungsten and red-neon colour over rich night tones held at natural saturation, skin tones true and unpushed, light filling the frame fully into all four corners — the texture of night street footage shot on a cinema camera in flight, NOT a game engine, NOT animation. The camera opens already inside a busy open-air Seoul night food market, moving between the stalls at a steady 20 km/h — a low roof of tangled bulbs and hanging plastic sheeting overhead, steam and grill smoke pouring across the aisle from every side, radios and shouting under it. It passes a man at arm's length turning skewers over coals and fanning the smoke away with a cardboard flap, swings around a couple leaning over a shared paper tray of fried chicken who step back laughing to let it by, and drifts past a grandmother at a folding table cracking mussels open with a knife and dropping the shells into a bucket. A stray dog trots the length of the aisle ahead of it. The camera turns into a glowing orange stall at the end of the row and settles into one smooth unbroken orbit around a young Korean woman in her twenties on a plastic stool at the counter — round warm face, short black bob with a red clip, cream puffer jacket beaded with rain — as the vendor, a broad woman in her sixties in a floral apron, ladles tteokbokki into a paper bowl in front of her. The camera drifts past her shoulder to the grill where skewers sizzle and snap in oil, then comes back as she lifts the first rice cake on a wooden skewer, thick red sauce clinging to it in uneven runs, and blows on it once — and the frame holds one half-second on her face as she takes the bite: her eyes close and her cheeks puff against the heat. Snap back to full speed. She laughs through her nose immediately, still chewing, fanning her open mouth with one hand and stamping one foot. The camera pulls wide enough to hold them both as the vendor laughs behind the counter and a man waiting behind her laughs too, and the woman takes the paper cup of broth already at the counter's edge and drinks, exhaling hard over the rim. She wipes her mouth with her thumb, still grinning, and points at the grill for another. The camera drops to the iron as the vendor's tongs come down and fresh skewers hit the hot surface in a burst of oil and smoke, sizzling hard, the market noise rolling on all around, as time runs out. SCORE Bright playful K-indie groove from the first frame — bouncing bass, crisp funk drums, a plucky electric guitar riff. Everything cuts dead at the bite for the half-second hold: sizzle and market noise alone. Then the groove slams back with handclaps and a keyboard hook, brighter than before, riding at full energy and unresolved at the last frame. Ambience sits beneath the score throughout. AUDIO A full market underneath — overlapping voices, radios, shouted orders, sizzling from several directions, a ladle knocking a pot, the dog barking somewhere behind, rain on plastic sheeting, her laugh, the vendor's laugh — all beneath the score. No sound tied to the camera itself. STYLE LOCK Hyper-detailed photoreal. The market is alive but never crowded with distant figures — every person in frame is within a few metres of the lens, individually detailed, and doing one specific readable action. EVERY figure keeps moving — nothing stands still. Real food physics — sauce thick and irregular, clinging and breaking in uneven drips, never falling as an even string; steam and grill smoke rising in patchy uneven wisps, thicker in some places than others, never an even cloud; oil spitting only on the grill; rain beading on the puffer jacket. Her reaction is quick and involuntary rather than performed — small, fast, real. The camera orbit is smooth and continuous with no jitter or floating in close framings. The skewer, the bowl and the amount of sauce stay consistent from the moment it is served. The market stalls and their lights never leave frame. The image stays clean and fully exposed edge to edge, all four corners sharp and bright — no vignette, no dark frame edges, no goggle mask. No subtitles, no watermarks, no text. 16:9.

entries.description: A professional structured video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a female protagonist in an intense school rooftop fight scene with detailed camera logic.
entries.prompt:
【画质风格】

真人实拍级韩国电影写实质感,全程手持微晃镜头叠加院线级冷调色,青灰偏蓝的阴天色温,肤色保留冷白通透;针织开衫的绒感、百褶裙摆的翻动、发丝飘散、雨前阴云的压抑层次全部写实还原;粗粝胶片颗粒,浅景深人物特写为主;8K 电影级拍摄质感,2.39:1 宽画幅。

【角色设定】

· @她(女主,图片1):按参考图还原——黑发渐变粉色中长卷发,珍珠耳饰,白衬衫系酒红色蝴蝶结领结,米色针织开衫,黑色百褶短裙,黑色中筒袜配黑色乐福鞋;眼神从隐忍低垂到抬眼锐利,动作干脆利落,发力刚猛,擅长近身直拳、肘击与利落的扫踢。

· 围堵人群:五六名穿深色制服风衣着的高个身影,面目始终处于虚焦或背光中,不给正面特写,只作为压迫感群像存在。

· 场景:阴天放学后的教学楼天台,水泥地面,四周是锈迹斑驳的绿色铁丝网围栏,远处城市天际线灰蒙,风把云压得很低,地面散落着被扔掉的书包和课本。

【运镜逻辑】

开场手持镜头从她低垂的脸缓推,建立压抑;书包落地为爆发信号,镜头骤然一沉切入极速;随即进入六连切快速蒙太奇,每一切都是反击特写,快切之间插入两次不到一秒的微慢动作(Micro Slow-mo)拉出"快慢快慢"的爽剧节奏;群体溃退后镜头绕至她背后仰拍全景;最后一击时间放慢,镜头绕侧定格;收尾镜头缓缓后拉,全程张弛交替。

【完整画面流程】

开场:手持镜头微晃,天台上,她被五六道深色身影围在铁丝网前,低着头,粉色发梢被风吹得贴在颊侧,酒红色领结微微歪斜。一只手从画面外伸来,狠狠拍掉她怀里的书包——书包砸在水泥地上,课本散开的一瞬,她垂着的眼睫抬起,眼神骤然锐利。

爆发:她贴着最近一道身影欺身而进,不退反进的瞬间镜头一沉,画面切入六连切快速蒙太奇,快慢交替,节奏抓人:

1. 第一切【快】:近身直拳特写,她拧腰送肩一记直拳打在迎面身影胸口,对方整个人向后踉跄撞进同伴怀里,两人一起跌退,她的粉发梢甩出一道弧线

2. 第二切【微慢】:抓腕反制特写,侧后方一只手抓向她肩膀,画面骤慢——她反手扣住对方手腕拧转,针织开衫的袖口绷紧,对方身体被带得侧翻,悬在半空的瞬间发丝与裙摆同时展开,随即画面弹回极速,对方摔在水泥地上滑出半米

3. 第三切【快】:低位扫踢特写,她顺势沉身一记扫堂腿,乐福鞋鞋跟贴地划出半圆,正面扑来的身影被扫得双脚离地、横着摔倒,黑色中筒袜绷直的小腿线条利落有力

4. 第四切【快】:肘击连段特写,两道身影同时从左右合围,她左肘后顶、右肘横扫,两声闷响连成一线,左右身影各自捂着腹部弯腰跪地,她站在两人中间,裙摆还在惯性摆动

5. 第五切【微慢】:躲拳反击特写,最高的一道身影抡起拳头当头砸下,画面再度骤慢——她只侧头半寸,拳风擦着粉色发梢掠过,几缕断发缓缓飘起,她的眼睛在慢镜里冷冷抬起看向对方;画面弹回极速,她一记膝撞顶在对方腹部,对方弓身抱腹跪倒

6. 第六切【快】:拽领终结特写,她一把拽住最后一人的衣领往下带,对方重心前栽的同时她抬膝再进半步急停——膝盖停在距对方面门一寸处,风压掀起对方额发,对方吓得瘫坐在地连连后爬

六次切镜一气呵成,快慢两档交替咬合,每一帧都拉满反击张力。

收束:镜头绕至她背后低角度仰拍全景,五六道身影或坐或爬,连滚带爬地退向天台门,门"哐"一声撞开又弹回。风掀起她的裙摆和开衫下摆,粉色发尾狂舞,她站在原地缓缓松开攥紧的拳,指节还微微发颤。

终镜:画面放慢,她转过身,弯腰捡起地上的书包,一本一本把散落的课本拾回怀里,拍掉封面的灰。起身时她理了理歪掉的酒红色领结,对着镜头方向抬起眼——眼神已经恢复平静,只是不再低头。镜头缓缓后拉,她独自立在空旷天台正中,铁丝网外阴云翻涌,画面定格。

【环境音效与台词】

全程无背景音乐,原生天台空旷混响,风声持续作底:

· 开场压抑:风穿过铁丝网的呜呜声,人群逼近的杂乱脚步与嗤笑低语(内容模糊不清),书包砸地的一声闷响,课本散落的哗啦声

· 爆发瞬间:她蹬地欺身的一声鞋底摩擦,第一拳命中的厚重闷响瞬间盖过所有嘈杂

· 六连切:拳肘命中的闷响错落密集,扫踢带起的低沉风声,摔地与滑地的连续钝响;两次微慢段所有声音骤然压低拉长,只剩衣料绷紧声、断发飘落的极轻声与她一次沉稳的呼吸,弹回极速时音效同步炸回

· 群体溃退:杂乱仓皇的脚步与爬地声,天台铁门撞开又弹回的哐当声,随后只剩风声

· 收尾:课本拾起的纸页摩擦声,拍灰的两下轻响,理领结的细微布料声,风声渐大,收在一声干净的定格静默

· 人物状态:她全程不发一言,仅出招瞬间伴随极短促的吐气声;终镜前一次绵长的呼气,平静收场

entries.title: Street Photographer Shibuya Interaction
entries.description: A first-person perspective prompt capturing a realistic interaction between a street photographer and a stylish woman in the busy Shibuya Scramble Crossing.
entries.prompt:
POV: First-person handheld shot of a young adult male street photographer walking casually through the extremely crowded streets of Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan on a bright sunny day. Hundreds of pedestrians rush across the famous Shibuya Scramble Crossing, surrounded by towering buildings covered with massive digital billboards, colorful signage, and a vibrant urban atmosphere.

The photographer notices a beautiful young Japanese woman standing at the edge of the sidewalk. She has long silky black hair, fair skin, expressive brown eyes, and wears a stylish modern outfit consisting of an elegant white blouse, a beige pleated skirt, white sneakers, and a small crossbody bag. She is completely focused on her smartphone.

0–4 seconds:
Natural handheld walking motion through the bustling crowd. The photographer spots the woman standing near the sidewalk, looking down at her phone.

4–7 seconds:
He gently walks toward her through the crowd.

Photographer (friendly, clear English):
"Hey there!"

7–10 seconds:
The woman looks up from her phone, makes eye contact, and smiles warmly.

Photographer:
"You look absolutely beautiful in that outfit!"

10–13 seconds:
The photographer continues:
"I'm a street photographer, and I'd really love to take some photos of you if you're okay with that?"

13–15 seconds:
The woman nods enthusiastically and replies in clear English:
"Sure, that sounds fun! I'd love to pose for you."

She gracefully strikes a natural pose. The photographer raises a DSLR camera into the foreground (both hands and camera visible from the first-person perspective), perfectly framing her just before pressing the shutter. A gentle camera shutter click is heard.

Style:
Ultra-realistic cinematic video, vibrant urban colors, bright natural daylight, authentic Shibuya atmosphere, smooth handheld camera movement, shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the woman, dynamic moving crowds in the background, highly detailed textures, realistic facial expressions and body language, clear synchronized English dialogue, subtle ambient sounds including footsteps, crowd chatter, traffic, and city ambience, respectful and friendly interaction, 15-second video.

entries.title: Magic Baking Kitchen Cat Transformation
entries.description: A creative video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a magical baking scenario where cream squeezed onto a conveyor belt instantly turns into realistic, expressive kittens.
entries.prompt:
【风格】超写实烘焙厨房魔术短视频（Photoreal Kitchen Magic Comedy）。真实现代烘焙厨房、白色食品传送台、金属裱花嘴、透明手套和写实的参考图的猫；核心魔术是：白色奶油从裱花袋挤到传送台上，0.2 秒内瞬间变成一只完整、毛发真实的小猫。不是奶油喷猫，也不是猫身上挤奶油。竖屏 9:16，约 10 秒，24fps，固定手机中近景，暖白柔光，无字幕、无水印。
【场景】干净明亮的烘焙厨房，白色食品传送台横向贯穿画面，两侧有灰色金属轨道；背景虚化可见白色橱柜、银色厨师机和烘焙工具。画面右上方是一只戴透明一次性手套的手，握着银色金属裱花袋，白色奶油袋装在其中，花嘴始终对准传送台空白处。
【角色】
参考图的猫，毛发干燥蓬松，不沾奶油
裱花袋：银色金属花嘴，每次只挤出一小滴白色奶油。奶油落在传送台后立刻变猫，绝不接触任何已经出现的猫。
【变身规则】
每次变身严格按同一顺序：裱花嘴挤出一小团白色奶油 → 奶油落在台面 → 停顿不超过 0.2 秒 → 奶油 “噗” 地快速膨胀为一只完整的小猫。变身后不保留奶油、没有半猫半奶油、没有拉丝或融化过程。
【声音】无人物台词。保留传送台轻微机械声、奶油挤压声；每次变猫配短促柔和的 “噗” 声和小猫奶声 “喵”；结尾配夸张惊讶弹簧音。
00:00-00:02.25] 镜头 1：第一只猫，始终趴着
传送台一开始为空，但是一直在转动。裱花袋在中央挤出一根白色奶油柱，奶油柱在 0.2 秒内变成第一只小猫。第一只猫出生后立刻肚皮贴着传送台趴低，四只爪子向前伸开，始终不坐起；它先眯眼，随后睁大眼睛、张嘴 “喵” 一声，接着向画面左侧低伏挪动。
[00:02.25-00:04.5] 镜头 2：第二只猫坐起鼓脸
第一只趴着的猫已经移到画面左侧前景，只露出部分身体 and 尾巴。裱花袋在画面中央偏右再次挤出白色奶油柱，奶油瞬间变成第二只同款小猫。第二只猫一出现就是端正坐姿，前爪并拢；它很快闭眼、皱眉，双侧脸颊夸张鼓起，露出气鼓鼓的表情。约 4.2 秒，裱花袋在第二只猫右侧开始挤第三次奶油。
[00:04.5-00:06.5] 镜头 3：第三只猫落地翻滚
第三根白色奶油柱瞬间变成第三只小猫。第三只猫在变身完成时短暂四脚朝上、像刚落到传送台上；随后翻身、低头走两步，再舒服地侧躺露出白肚皮，一只后爪抬起，闭着眼睛露出满足表情。约 6.3 秒，裱花袋在它右侧再次挤出第四根白色奶油柱。
[00:06.5-00:09] 镜头 4：第四只猫蚊香眼逃跑
第四根奶油柱在 0.2 秒内变成第四只同款小猫。第四只猫刚站稳、抬头看裱花袋，眼睛立即变成夸张蚊香眼，嘴巴张成 “O” 形，尾巴竖起。它惊慌地小跳一步，随即快速跑出画面右侧；裱花袋仍悬在传送台上方，画面在荒诞的 “奶油生产猫咪” 场景中结束。
【负面约束】
奶油挤在猫身上、奶油遮住猫脸、半猫半奶油、缓慢拉丝变形、融化的猫、额外肢体、变形手、文字、水印。

Not cream sprayed on a cat, nor cream squeezed onto a cat. Vertical 9:16, approx. 10 seconds, 24fps, fixed medium-close shot, warm white soft light, no subtitles, no watermarks.
