entries.title: 15-Second Social Sports Video
entries.description: A highly detailed social media video prompt featuring a basketball and tennis ball interaction on a lawn, using complex camera movements and slow-motion effects.
entries.prompt: Create a 15 second 16:9 photorealistic social video in one continuous handheld smartphone shot at 30 frames per second. Bright late morning on a freshly cut green lawn beside a large matte tan industrial building. A black metal fence, a narrow road, and one parked white car sit in the deep background. The sky is pale blue with soft white clouds. Sunlight is clear but slightly diffused, producing realistic skin tones, soft ground shadows, and mild automatic exposure changes. Frame the scene from chest height. A young man stands in the foreground on the left in three quarter back view, medium length light brown hair, dark forest green shirt with a large white graphic on the back, navy athletic shorts, holding a fluorescent yellow tennis ball. A young woman stands farther away on the right, dark hair tied back, burgundy sleeveless top, loose white trousers. Keep the center of the frame open against the plain wall so both balls remain easy to follow. Seconds 0 to 2. The woman tosses an orange basketball high through the upper center of frame. The man crouches slightly, turns his shoulders, and studies its path while drawing the tennis ball beside his right ear. Use natural hand movement, subtle hair motion from the breeze, distant traffic, birds, and quiet field ambience. Seconds 2 to 4. He completes a believable overarm throw. His weight shifts from back foot to front foot, hips rotate before the shoulder, elbow extends, wrist snaps, and the tennis ball leaves his fingertips with accurate motion blur. The camera operator reacts a fraction late, then tilts upward with small human micro shake. Seconds 4 to 8. Track both balls in the same frame. The basketball drifts diagonally toward camera and grows gradually in size. The tennis ball travels on a faster rising arc from lower right toward the basketball. Maintain physically coherent speed, gravity, spin, scale, shadows, and depth. Add a very gentle digital crop only as the gap closes. The man remains partly visible at the lower left, watching the flight. Seconds 8 to 9.2. Use a clean speed ramp into crisp high speed slow motion. The tennis ball contacts the outer side of the basketball with precise edge contact and a tiny compression at impact. Hold the impossible moment for only a few frames. Seconds 9.2 to 12.5. Trigger a seamless comedic visual effect that looks intentionally edited rather than synthetic. A compact orange fireball, dusty smoke, glowing fragments, and small pieces of basketball material expand from the contact point. The tennis ball remains visible near the right edge of the blast. Leave a clean bright center area for adding the words JESUS SAVES during editing. Add a deep impact, brief bass drop, one beat of silence, then a warm gospel choir chord. Seconds 12.5 to 15. Let the smoke thin naturally. Tilt down slightly to catch the man staring upward in disbelief and the woman reacting with both hands raised. End

entries.title: Korean Idol Vlogger Documentary Aesthetic
entries.description: A multi-scene video prompt for Seedance 2.0 that mimics a 16mm camcorder aesthetic, capturing a Korean idol's journey from her dressing room to a fan meeting stage.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA:
DV-style 16mm camcorder aesthetic with natural handheld movement. The entire sequence is filmed from CHASE's perspective as she records herself, occasionally setting the camera down for hands-free shots. Expect subtle shake, uneven framing, slow autofocus, awkward zooms, and the occasional partial crop of her face. The camcorder itself is never visible.

LOOK:
Soft analog tape texture with slight blur, faint tape grain, blooming highlights, auto-exposure flicker, muted contrast, and lifelike skin tones. Lighting evolves naturally across each location: warm vanity bulbs → cool daylight through the van window → dim soundcheck lighting → bright backstage entrance before the event.

STYLE:
Fast-paced anticipation montage with rapid cuts connecting each location. Transitional movement is slightly sped up to maintain momentum. A reflective voiceover carries the narrative instead of live dialogue. The mood gradually shifts from quiet preparation to nervous anticipation, ending with excitement just before greeting fans.

Character

CHASE — Korean idol (Image1), in her 20s. Long, straight black hair that is fully styled by the end. Dewy glass skin, large expressive eyes, and soft coral-pink lips. She begins in a dressing robe and later changes into a modest fan-meeting outfit with long sleeves, full coverage, and understated accessories.

Location Progression

Dressing room vanity (afternoon) → Moving van (daytime) → Empty venue during soundcheck (early evening) → Backstage entrance behind the curtain (evening).

Storyboard (15 seconds, 8 shots)

1. (~2s | Vanity | Camera on tripod | Warm lighting)
CHASE quietly sits as someone off-camera finishes styling her hair while she looks into the mirror.
Voiceover: "Every fan meeting begins with these peaceful moments."

2. (~2s | Vanity | Close-up)
Tight shot of hands carefully securing a hairpin in place. Only soft room ambience is heard.

3. (~2s | Van | Handheld | Window light)
Sitting beside the window, she absentmindedly fidgets with her hands while watching the city drift past.
Voiceover: "The butterflies always arrive during the drive."

4. (~2s | Van | Close handheld)
She exhales slowly and looks down at her folded hands. Quiet road ambience only.

5. (~2s | Empty stage | Handheld)
Standing alone on stage, she tests the microphone as her voice echoes through the venue.
Voiceover: "Hearing my own voice in an empty hall always feels surreal."

6. (~2s | Soundcheck | Macro detail)
Close-up of her hand adjusting the microphone stand while the echo fades into silence. No narration.

7. (~1.5s | Backstage | Medium handheld)
Waiting behind the curtain, she takes one deep breath as the muffled cheers from the audience grow louder.
Voiceover: "Then suddenly..."

8. (~1.5s | Backstage | Final shot)
A genuine smile appears as she steps toward the bright stage lights.
Voiceover: "...I remember they're all here for me."

entries.title: Luxury Portable Blender Commercial featuring Aria

entries.prompt: A beautiful young woman named Aria is standing in a bright, modern kitchen wearing a stylish cream outfit. She is holding a premium portable blender filled with colorful fresh fruits. She looks directly into the camera with a warm smile and speaks naturally with perfect English lip sync. Character Dialogue (Voice): Hi everyone! I'm Aria. If you love fresh smoothies as much as I do, you're going to love this portable blender. It's USB rechargeable, incredibly powerful, and perfect for home, work, the gym, or travel. Just add your favorite fruits, press one button, and enjoy a fresh, healthy smoothie anytime, anywhere. Make every sip count!" Actions: Aria smiles and shows the blender to the camera. She adds strawberries, kiwi, mango, and spinach into the blender. She presses the power button and the blender starts blending smoothly. Close-up shots of the spinning blades and vibrant smoothie. She pours the smoothie into a glass, takes a sip, smiles confidently, and gives a thumbs-up. Final cinematic close-up of the blender with the brand logo. Ending Text on Screen: "Fresh Smoothies. Anytime. Anywhere." Style: Ultra-realistic, luxury commercial, cinematic camera movement, premium product advertisement, 4K UHD, soft natural lighting, realistic facial expressions, synchronized English voice, accurate lip sync, shallow depth of field, clean modern kitchen, vibrant colors, professional advertising quality, no subtitles, high-end brand aesthetic.

entries.title: Cinematic Popcorn Sword Comedy
entries.description: A complex cinematic prompt for a 15-second multi-scene video featuring a swordswoman and a cyclist making popcorn using a magical contraption.
entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0 Fast

【视频规格】

严格生成 15 秒视频，16:9 横屏，三个干净镜头。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，融合灾难大片式宏大尺度、雅克・塔蒂式空间喜剧、巴斯特・基顿式冷面反应、温暖居家灯光和精准视觉误导；最终包袱由两位角色共同承担，不让任何一方成为固定受害者。针对 Seedance 2.0 的多模态参考控制、多主体连续动作和统一音画联合生成进行设计。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙姐

同一个来自 @图片 1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，严格保持参考图中的同一张椭圆脸、锐利深色眼睛、黑色长发、高挑纤细身材、玉簪、白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、银色饰品、飘动长裙和白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜单车姐

同一个来自 @图片 2 的 25–30 岁东亚单车姐，严格保持同一张脸、马尾、身材比例、服装、饰品和自行车。

【场景设定】

夜晚的现代高层住宅客厅。城市夜景、沙发、电视、零食桌、电线、锅具、电磁炉和自行车共同建立清楚空间关系。

【核心道具】

前景的电磁炉、一只透明爆米花锅、同一辆自行车、室内骑行台、同一柄银色长剑、一个巨大食物碗。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景远景】

夜晚的现代高层住宅客厅，角色 ID A 为同一个来自 @图片 1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，严格保持参考图中的同一张椭圆脸、锐利深色眼睛、黑色长发、高挑纤细身材、玉簪、白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、银色饰品、飘动长裙和白色布靴；角色 ID B 为同一个来自 @图片 2 的 25–30 岁东亚单车姐，严格保持同一张脸、马尾、身材比例、服装、饰品 and 自行车。

前景的电磁炉上放着一只透明爆米花锅，两位女性从鞋到头完整站在锅具后方，锅内玉米粒像即将撞击地球的陨石一样持续震动。

单车姐将同一辆自行车固定在室内骑行台上，并连接电磁炉；剑仙姐将同一柄银色长剑举到锅具上方，严肃说道：“阵眼已热。”

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜牛仔景中景】

同一个单车姐快速踩动自行车，同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙姐控制同一柄银色长剑，将它作为悬浮锅盖压在锅具上方。

爆米花在透明锅内猛烈炸开，蒸汽和玉米粒形成一场微缩宇宙风暴。

两人的长发、宽袖、车轮旋转、长剑震动、爆裂节奏、英雄式鼓点和电视声音精确同步；背景始终保持同一个客厅。

两人以完全严肃的表情进行高度默契的配合。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写进入极近特写】

两人带着完成重大使命般的神情，将爆米花倒入一个巨大食物碗中。

焦点转移到电视，屏幕已经播放电影片尾字幕。

同一个单车姐缓慢说道：“姐，电影演完了。”

同一个剑仙姐停顿一下，吃下一颗爆米花，平静回答：“那看彩蛋。”

电视声音立刻播报：“本片没有彩蛋。”

极近特写两人沉默咀嚼、尊严受挫的表情，同一柄银色长剑也悄悄垂下剑尖。画面定格。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，三个干净镜头，普通话口型准确，爆米花、蒸汽、玻璃、头发、真丝衣料、自行车和飞剑物理效果真实，不生成画面字幕。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Generation Mode]

Seedance 2.0 Fast

[Video Specifications]

Strictly generate a 15-second video, 16:9 landscape, with three clean shots.

[Overall Style]

Cinematic realistic texture, merging disaster-movie-style grand scale, Jacques Tati-style spatial comedy, Buster Keaton-style deadpan reaction, warm domestic lighting, and precise visual misdirection; the final punchline is shared by both characters, ensuring neither is a fixed victim. Designed for Seedance 2.0's multi-modal reference control, multi-subject continuous motion, and unified audio-visual generation.

[Characters]

Character ID A | Sword Heroine

The same 25-30 year old East Asian Sword Heroine from @Image 1, strictly maintaining the same oval face, sharp dark eyes, black long hair, tall and slender figure, jade hairpin, white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver accessories, flowing long skirt, and white cloth boots from the reference image.

Character ID B | Cyclist

The same 25-30 year old East Asian Cyclist from @Image 2, strictly maintaining the same face, ponytail, body proportions, clothing, accessories, and bicycle.

[Scene Setting]

A modern high-rise residential living room at night. Urban night view, sofa, TV, snack table, wires, pots, induction cooker, and bicycle together establish clear spatial relationships.

[Core Props]

The induction cooker in the foreground, a transparent popcorn pot, the same bicycle, an indoor riding platform, the same silver long sword, and a giant food bowl.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low-angle Panorama Wide Shot]

Modern high-rise residential living room at night. Character ID A is the same 25-30 year old East Asian Sword Heroine from @Image 1, strictly maintaining the same oval face, sharp dark eyes, black long hair, tall and slender figure, jade hairpin, white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver accessories, flowing long skirt, and white cloth boots; Character ID B is the same 25-30 year old East Asian Cyclist from @Image 2, strictly maintaining the same face, ponytail, body proportions, clothing, accessories, and bicycle.

On the induction cooker in the foreground sits a transparent popcorn pot. Both women stand fully from head to toe behind the cookware. The corn kernels inside the pot vibrate continuously like asteroids about to strike Earth.

The Cyclist fixes the same bicycle on the indoor riding platform and connects it to the induction cooker; the Sword Heroine lifts the same silver long sword over the pot and says solemnly: 'The formation eye is heated.'

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Medium Medium Shot]

The same Cyclist pedals the bike rapidly. The same Sword Heroine in white embroidered silk Hanfu controls the same silver long sword, using it as a levitating lid over the pot.

Popcorn explodes violently inside the transparent pot; steam and kernels form a miniature cosmic storm.

The long hair, wide sleeves, spinning wheels, vibrating sword, burst rhythm, heroic drumbeats, and TV sound of both individuals are precisely synchronized; the background remains the same living room.

The two cooperate with high tacit understanding and completely serious expressions.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up to Extreme Close-up]

With expressions as if completing a major mission, the two pour the popcorn into a giant food bowl.

The focus shifts to the TV, which is already playing the end credits of a movie.

The same Cyclist says slowly: 'Sister, the movie is over.'

The same Sword Heroine pauses, eats a piece of popcorn, and answers calmly: 'Then watch the post-credit scene.'

The TV sound immediately announces: 'This movie has no post-credit scene.'

An extreme close-up of their silent chewing and wounded dignity; the same silver long sword also quietly lowers its tip. The screen freezes.

[Technical Requirements]

Strictly 15 seconds total duration, 16:9 landscape, three clean shots, accurate Mandarin lip-syncing; realistic physical effects for popcorn, steam, glass, hair, silk fabric, bicycle, and flying sword. Do not generate on-screen subtitles.

entries.title: Epic Mecha Battle Cinematic Video
entries.description: A high-intensity video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a cinematic mecha battle with city-scale destruction and hyper-speed aerial combat.
entries.prompt:
0–4s: A massive enemy war machine descends through storm clouds above a flooded coastal city. A compact blue-white combat mecha launches from a damaged carrier deck, boosters igniting as ocean spray explodes outward. Fast low-angle tracking.

4–8s: The two machines collide above the skyline. The smaller mecha dodges missile trails, folds through narrow gaps between towers and slices incoming drones with an energy blade. Rapid camera switches, hard acceleration and heavy mechanical inertia.

8–12s: The enemy machine charges a city-destroying beam. The pilot forces the smaller mecha straight through the beam’s unstable edge, armor panels burning away, then drives the energy blade into the exposed reactor core.

12–15s: The enemy machine shuts down and falls into the ocean beyond the city. The damaged hero mecha lands on one knee atop a skyscraper as the storm clears. End on the pilot’s cockpit lights fading into sunrise.

Premium cinematic mecha anime, extreme sakuga, hyper-speed aerial combat, precise mechanical animation, large-scale destruction, realistic weight, strong impact frames, decisive heroic ending.

entries.title: Live Concert Music Video Generator
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt designed to create a 15-second live concert music video with Japanese vocals, emphasizing strict character identity and dynamic stage lighting.
entries.prompt:
15 seconds, 16:9, live concert music video with an original Japanese song.

Use <Picture 1> as the strict identity reference for the performer. Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and style from <Picture 1>.

Create an original Japanese pop song about:
「私を見つけてくれてありがとう」
Make it sincere, emotional, and uplifting. Compose original Japanese lyrics, melody, vocals, and instrumental music. The singing must be clearly in Japanese.

Preserve the performer’s original visual texture from <Picture 1>. If the reference is anime, illustrated, chibi, cel-shaded, or non-photoreal, keep the performer fully in that same drawn style. Do not make the performer photoreal or semi-photoreal. If the reference is photoreal, keep the performer photoreal.

Create a dynamic indoor concert performance. The performer sings with a handheld wireless microphone, moves naturally, and connects with the audience and camera. Start slightly emotional and become brighter and more joyful by the end.

Keep one main performer only. No extra featured performers or clones.

Do not use static shots. Every shot should have motion: push-ins, pull-backs, side tracking, curved moves, low-angle hero shots, wide stage shots, and a final hero shot.

Use concert lighting, moving beams, haze, audience lights, and stage depth. The large monitor behind the performer should show the performer singing.

Keep the video energetic, polished, and social-media-ready.

Avoid clone duplication, identity drift, costume changes, face drift, broken anatomy, subtitles, lyric text, logos, watermarks, intrusive UI graphics, and rendering-style drift.

entries.title: Cyberpunk Parkour Anime Script
entries.description: A massive, professional-grade script for a parkour animation in a rainy futuristic city, optimized for high-density 3D toon rendering.
entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。
ジャンル：近未来都市型パルクール。高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルック。
【参照画像とキャラクター固定】
参照画像1を、登場する唯一のキャラクターの顔、身体、衣装、装飾、配色の最優先参照として使用する。参照画像1の人物をそのまま同一人物として維持し、顔の輪郭、目の形、虹彩色と模様、瞳内ハイライト、眉、鼻、口元、肌色、年齢感、髪型、髪色、前髪、髪飾り、衣装構造、素材、装飾、体格、身長比率、全身シルエット、雰囲気、固有カラーを全編で固定する。

参照画像はキャラクター情報だけに使用し、元画像の背景、室内、家具、文字、UI、設定表、分割レイアウト、画角、フレーミング、ポーズ、表情、照明、構図は本編へ再現しない。
全編で同一人物は一人だけ。変化してよいのは、集中した表情、視線、まばたき、口元、姿勢、呼吸、走行に伴う髪、衣装、装飾の自然な遅れ運動だけ。顔の平均化、特徴の混合、別人化、衣装交換、髪型変更、体型変更、分身、クローン、余計な人物の追加を禁止する。高速移動中も顔と身体の立体形状を崩さない。

参照画像に武器や手持ち小物がある場合も、本編では携行させない。両手は空。髪飾り、イヤリング、珠飾り、ベルト、ポーチ、衣装付属品など、身体に固定された装飾だけを維持する。

【可変デザイン調整】
場所、空間経路、パルクール動作、接触順序、カメラ経路は固定する。

色味、小物的な装飾反射、光のアクセント、ネオンの補助色、粒子、素材反射、空気感は、参照画像1のキャラクターに合わせて調整する。キャラクターの固有色を主役にし、背景側のネオン反射と補助光を同系色または補色へ寄せる。ただし、舞台そのものを別の場所へ変更しない。

参照画像に花、宝石、機械、蝶、星、炎、水、電気などの象象的モチーフがある場合は、髪飾り、衣装装飾、反射光、短い残光、微細な粒子として控えめに反映してよい。新しい武器、生物、乗り物、大型オブジェクトは追加しない。読める文字やロゴは出さない。
【表情変化】
顔演技は、目が斜面下端を捉える → 眉がわずかに寄る → まぶたが少し細まる → 口元が集中した小さな笑みになる → 視線が対岸の着地点へ固定される、の順で最小限に変化する。

参照キャラクター本来の性格や表情傾向を壊さず、過剰な笑顔、恐怖顔、叫び、歌唱口形にしない。

【絵柄・レンダリング固定】
全編を高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックだけで描く。細い線画と繊細な色付きトゥーン輪郭を使用し、輪郭色は参照キャラクターの髪色と衣装色に調和する暗色へ調整する。顔、髪、衣装には明快な二段から三段のセル影と、透明感のある中間影を置く。

主光は暖かな金色、補助光は参照キャラクターの固有色に合わせる。瞳と髪には複数層の鋭いハイライトを維持する。布、金属、宝石、革、濡れたガラス、金属床を素材ごとに描き分ける。
劇場版クラスの精密な3Dキャラクターアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のある照明、遠近の看板骨格、梁、保守通路、高層ビルまで情報量のある高密度背景を維持する。

太い黒輪郭、平坦な単層セル影、汎用的な3D美少女顔、滑らかなプラスチックCG、低密度背景、半写実、写実、くすんだ色、画風混合にしない。

【固定舞台と空間経路】
雨上がりの夜、高層ビルの間に巨大なネオン広告看板の裏面と保守用構造物が立体的に連なる。
手前の狭い上層保守通路、中景の幅広く濡れた傾斜ネオンパネル、奥の深いビル間空隙、対岸屋上の着地デッキを一本の消失軸上へ置く。狭い通路から巨大な空隙へ開け、最後は対岸の着地デッキと次の走行路へ抜ける。

ネオンパネルは抽象的な発光面とし、参照キャラクターの固有色を反射へ取り入れる。背景の青とシアンは低彩度に抑え、顔、瞳、髪、衣装を最も明るく見せる。文字、数字、ロゴ、字幕は表示しない。

【連続パルクール動作】
開始時点からキャラクターは上層保守通路を全速で走っている。待機や構えを挟まず、濡れた傾斜ネオンパネルの上端へ右足から入り、身体を低くして前向きのパワースライドへ移る。

顔、胸、腰、両膝は斜面の下り方向へ向ける。右脚を下り方向へ伸ばし、左膝を深く曲げ、両腕を低く開いて均衡を取る。背中を斜面へ向けず、手で壁や縁をつかまない。

靴底と濡れたパネル面の接触から扇状の細い水膜が後方へ飛び、ネオン反射線、梁、高層ビルは画面上方へ流れる。表情は指定順序で変化し、最後に視線を対岸へ固定する。
斜面下端が迫っても速度を落とさない。右脚を引き戻すのと同時に左足を揃え、補強された下端へ両方の靴底を同時に明瞭に接触させる。

接触した瞬間だけ足首、膝、腰が深く圧縮され、濡れた金属面が低く振動し、水滴が後方へ広がる。その圧縮を止めずに両脚を伸ばし、下降速度と前進速度を一つの放物線へ変えて対岸屋上へ射出される。

踏み切り後から着地まで空中で停止しない。腕、胸、腰、視線を対岸へ向ける。髪、袖、裾、装飾は身体より半拍遅れて後方へ伸びる。

対岸の着地デッキへ右足の靴底、左足の靴底の順に接触する。右足接触後にだけ足首、膝、腰が沈み、続く左足が着地荷重を受け止める。濡れた床の水しぶきと反射の揺れは、各靴底接触と同時に発生する。
停止せず、沈み込みの反動を次の走行一歩へ直結させ、正面のカメラへ走り込む。集中した瞳と小さな笑みを保ったまま、カメラの右脇を鋭く通過する。

右肩、袖、髪飾り、髪がレンズ右端を満たして通り過ぎる。身体は次のルートへ前進し続け、背後のネオン反射、水しぶき、髪と衣装の遅れ運動も同じ方向へ流れ続けている瞬間に映像を切る。

【カメラ】

entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0 Fast

【视频规格】

严格生成 15 秒视频，16:9 横屏。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，融合诗意仙侠的宏大气韵、古典中国壁画美学、克制的双人群像喜剧、对称式场面调度、温暖灯火与清冷殿堂阴影的对比、陈旧朱砂红、水墨黑与低饱和金色调，以及细腻胶片颗粒；吸取 “画龙点睛、破壁而飞” 的文化精髓，但将其重构为角色关系笑点，不再重复法术失败式反转；针对 Seedance 2.0 的多参考身份锁定、灵兽动作连贯、多镜头连续性和原生音画同步进行设计。

【场景设定】

古老山寺的壁画大殿内，风化石板地面、雕花木柱、青铜灯、垂挂丝帘、缓慢上升的香烟、墨碟、竹制画笔，以及墙上一条尚未完成的巨大龙形壁画，共同建立清楚稳定的空间关系。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐

剑仙师姐 @图片 1，25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙自然肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩和白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜小师妹

小师妹 @图片 2，20–25 岁的东亚女性，圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小，穿青绿色亚麻汉服、深色布腰带、木簪 and 黑色布鞋。

【核心主体】

始终只出现一条巨龙。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景缓慢推轨】

古老山寺的壁画大殿内，风化石板地面、雕花木柱、青铜灯、垂挂丝帘、缓慢上升的香烟、墨碟、竹制画笔，以及墙上一条尚未完成的巨大龙形壁画，共同建立清楚稳定的空间关系。

同一个剑仙师姐与同一个小师妹神情庄重地共同完成同一幅龙形壁画：剑仙师姐画出一只流畅优雅的弯曲龙角，小师妹则把另一只龙角画成分叉过多、略微歪斜的形状。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景侧面镜头】

摄影机缓慢环绕半圈：同一个剑仙师姐与同一个小师妹同时为龙的双眼点睛。

雷声响起，同一条水墨金纹巨龙从墙面平稳剥离，在木柱之间盘旋一圈，逐渐从平面壁画变成具有真实体积的灵龙，同时严格保留同样一优雅、一歪斜的两只龙角。

两名女子维持庄重仪式感，骄傲地仰头观看。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜双人近景转极近特写】

同一条巨龙突然停下，把巨大龙首缓缓低到同样两名女子之间，分别看向自己的两只龙角，用低沉清晰的普通话问道：“这两只角，谁画的？”

同一个剑仙师姐与同一个小师妹毫不迟疑，在完全相同的瞬间抬手指向对方。

画面定格在两人一本正经、坚决甩锅的表情上，巨龙无奈地长叹一声。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，原生普通话音频，不生成字幕，人物面部与服装稳定，始终只出现一条巨龙，水墨、香烟、真丝衣料、头发、龙角、壁画剥离和灵龙腾空运动真实自然。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

entries.prompt:
日本の劇場アニメ風、セルルック、平塗りのアニメ。映像は全体的にパースを極端にきかせること。

屋敷に押し入ったギャングたちをメイドが撃退するアニメです。このプロンプトをそのままSeedance2.5に渡してください。4:3の横長の画角。30秒でお願いします。

0〜3秒:ギャングたちが屋敷に押し入るシーン。ギャングたちの足が右から出てきて、立ち止まる。→カット切り替え。拳銃を持ったギャングたちの上半身を斜め前から。彼らはたじろいだ表情と仕草。

3〜8秒:画像1のメイドが、ゆっくりと剣を鞘から抜くシーン。手のアップ→全身へとカット切り替え。→顔のアップへカット切り替え。剣の刃が映り、光る。

8〜10秒:ギャングたちが手に持った拳銃を次々と発砲する。横からの視点。

10〜15秒:画像1のメイドがかがむ様子を上半身のアップ。足は見せない。斜め前からの視点。スローモーションで、弾は彼女の頬や髪をかすめて後方に飛んでいく。→カット切り替え。後ろからの視点。メイドの足裏のアップから。彼女は奥のギャングたちへと急加速し接近する様子を定点カメラで。奥ではギャングたちが彼女に拳銃を向け、冷や汗をかいている。

15秒〜:19秒:画像1を見下ろす視点。斜め構図。画面に向かって走りながら、下を向いていた彼女が顔を上げ、そのままの勢いで下から斜め上に剣を振る。剣の先のアップ。彼女の体にオーラのエフェクト。背景は色彩や効果線となり奥へと流れる。

19〜23秒:ギャングたちの手から拳銃が離れ、拳銃が真っ二つに割れる(拳銃が剣で斬られた表現。剣は映像に登場しない。剣で真っ二つに斬られた拳銃のみ宙に浮いている表現)を、それぞれ別の視点、角度から3カット。複数の銃が斬られたシーン。

23〜27秒:画像1のキャラクターの上半身を下から上へパン。彼女のアゴが映ったところでカット切り替え。彼女の顔のアップを下からの視点。自慢げな表情。

27秒〜30秒:画像1のななめ背後からの視点。ギャングたちがあわてて、画面奥の出口へと逃げていく。

entries.prompt:
Montage, 8-shot handheld phone vlog, photorealistic home-video style. Slight handheld shake, natural framing, bright summer daylight, soft breeze, fine film grain.

A woman (image) returns to the same traditional hanok courtyard restaurant for another summer meal. (Image) provides only her face and hairstyle; outfit: light beige linen short-sleeve shirt with shoulders fully covered, top button open, casual and relaxed. She remains seated on the same side facing the camera throughout. No other faces appear; only a server's hands enter the frame.

The table holds a steaming bowl of handmade kimchi mandu, crispy potato jeon, small side dishes (kimchi, pickled radish), chilled barley tea, soy dipping sauce, chopsticks, spoon, napkin, and a small fan gently moving in the breeze. Traditional wooden beams, tiled roofs, green plants, and afternoon cicadas create a cozy summer atmosphere.

Shots

1. Server places the hot dishes on the table. Steam rises dramatically. She smiles with excitement and says: "이번엔 뜨거운 거!"

2. Close-up as she breaks a kimchi dumpling in half with chopsticks. Steam pours out and the filling stretches slightly. She softly blows on it.

3. First bite. Loud crispy wrapper followed by juicy filling. She widens her eyes and quietly says: "와... 육즙 미쳤다."

4. She dips a piece of potato jeon into soy sauce and takes a crunchy bite. She gives a thumbs up while chewing naturally.

5. She sips cold barley tea after the hot food and smiles with relief: "이 조합 최고다."

6. Close-up of another dumpling dipped generously in sauce. She enjoys several satisfying bites with natural chewing sounds while nodding happily.

7. She finishes the last bite, wipes her mouth with a napkin, leans toward the camera, and whispers: "다음엔 뭐 먹지?"

8. She laughs softly, waves goodbye, and walks out through the peaceful hanok courtyard as leaves sway in the breeze and cicadas continue singing.

Audio

Natural Korean dialogue only where specified. Live ambient audio only: steaming food, crispy bites, chopsticks, dipping sauce, chewing, tea pouring, birds, cicadas, light wind, and courtyard ambience. No music, subtitles, logos, watermarks, exaggerated facial expressions, or duplicated reference image.

entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0 Fast

【视频规格】

严格生成 15 秒视频，16:9 横屏，三个清楚镜头。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感的悬疑转时尚反转喜剧，采用受控的蓝调时刻光线、精准视觉误导、优雅仙侠动作、克制冷面表演，以及清楚的身份地位反转：观众起初以为正在进行危险的飞剑仪式，最后揭露这只是一场认真过头的人像拍摄。

针对 Seedance 2.0 官方描述的多模态参考、人物表演控制、灯光控制、摄影机调度和统一音画生成能力进行设计。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙姐

同一个来自 @图片 1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，完整保持同一张椭圆脸、自然白皙皮肤、锐利深棕色眼睛、黑色长直发、高挑纤细身材、玉簪、银色腰饰、白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、飘动长裙和白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜单车姐

同一个来自 @图片 2 的 25–30 岁东亚单车姐，完整保持同一张圆润而富有表情的脸、棕色短马尾、黄色外套、蓝色牛仔裤、白色运动鞋、饰品和自行车。

【核心道具】

同一柄银色长剑、七柄悬浮飞剑、安装在小型三脚架上的一部竖放手机、同一辆自行车。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景缓慢推轨】

蓝调时刻的现代城市楼顶，湿润混凝土地面倒映城市天际线，金属护栏、通风管道、远处霓虹招牌、流动薄雾、被风吹动的衣料，以及安装在小型三脚架上的一部竖放手机清晰可见。

角色 ID A 为同一个来自 @图片 1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，完整保持同一张椭圆脸、自然白皙皮肤、锐利深棕色眼睛、黑色长直发、高挑纤细身材、玉簪、银色腰饰、白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、飘动长裙和白色布靴。

角色 ID B 为同一个来自 @图片 2 的 25–30 岁东亚单车姐，完整保持同一张圆润而富有表情的脸、棕色短马尾、黄色外套、蓝色牛仔裤、白色运动鞋、饰品和自行车；她静止站在自行车旁，背对角色 A。

同一个剑仙姐缓慢拔出一柄银色长剑，将剑举到单车姐身后，制造即将行刑的错误印象；低沉剑鸣和紧张弦乐逐渐增强。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜牛仔景中景】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙姐转动双指；同一柄银色长剑分化成七柄悬浮飞剑，在同一个单车姐周围组成充满威胁感的阵列。

飞剑没有攻击，而是分别发出受控柔光 —— 温暖轮廓光、冷色面部补光和银白色发丝光；同一个单车姐若无其事地调整下巴角度与身体姿势。

背景始终保持同一个楼顶、手机三脚架、自行车、薄雾和城市天际线。

摄影机进行一次平稳半圆环绕，飞剑呼啸声逐渐转化成精确同步的相机快门声。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写进入极近特写】

揭露手机屏幕正在录制一段时尚人像视频。

同一个单车姐检查拍摄预览，说道：“右边轮廓光，再暖一点。”

同一个剑仙姐调整其中一柄飞剑，一侧眼皮轻微抽动，回答：“拍张头像，比渡劫要求还多。”

单车姐重新摆好姿势，继续说道：“再来一条，刚才风不够仙。”

极近特写剑仙姐无言凝视她的表情，七柄飞剑同时疲惫地垂下剑尖。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，三个清楚镜头，角色身份和服装全程稳定，灯光交互、头发、真丝衣料、飞剑、薄雾、自行车和手机物理效果真实，普通话口型准确，原生同步生成风声、剑鸣、快门声与对白，不生成画面字幕。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

entries.prompt:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld footage feel. Point of view of JAY holding the camera directly in hand. Maintain hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pull, clumsy zoom in/out, occasional self-cam framing where the face gets cut off, and imperfect shots that lose the subject. DV 16mm tape camcorder footage look. Soft, slightly blurry digital tape quality, faint tape noise, highlights that bloom subtly in bright daylight, gentle auto-exposure shifts as the camera moves between sunlight and shade, muted color contrast, realistic skin tones.

STYLE:
Relaxed daytime vlog with a calm, genuine, low-energy-but-happy vibe. Slightly tired after a long walk or outdoor workout, but satisfied and enjoying the fresh air. Handheld throughout, natural pauses between lines, occasional quiet breathing, authentic unposed expressions, documentary realism.

Character

JAY — a handsome Korean man in his 20s. Thick black hair slightly tousled from being outdoors, sharp yet warm Korean facial features, healthy glowing skin with a light sheen of sweat, expressive eyes, athletic slim build. Wearing a modest long-sleeve athletic top or lightweight hoodie, loose-fit joggers or athletic pants, comfortable sneakers. Fully covered arms and torso. No jewelry.

Setting

A peaceful public park during the daytime under natural sunlight. Wide green lawns, mature trees casting soft shadows, paved walking paths, park benches, trimmed bushes, birds occasionally flying overhead, gentle breeze moving the leaves, distant people walking or jogging naturally in the background without drawing attention, bright blue sky with soft clouds. (~2s, camera propped against a park bench, medium shot)
He walks into frame breathing slightly heavier from a walk or light workout, wipes his forehead with the back of his hand, gives a small relaxed smile.

JAY:
""Okay... just finished my walk, such a nice day.""

(~2s, handheld, slow pan across the park)

(~1.5s, macro insert, shallow DOF)

(~2s, medium handheld, open grassy area)

entries.title: 2000s MiniDV Jeju Island Beach Walk
entries.description: A highly detailed Seedance 2.0 prompt recreating the authentic aesthetic of an early-2000s MiniDV camcorder home video on a beach in Jeju Island.
entries.prompt:
Main Subject: Young Korean woman, 23, natural everyday appearance, long black hair worn loose and slightly messy from the sea breeze, realistic skin texture with lightly sun-kissed cheeks, minimal makeup, cheerful and carefree personality. Wearing a loose white oversized linen shirt over a light blue tank top, beige linen shorts, white sandals, a woven straw hat, and a small canvas tote bag. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout.

Location: A quiet beach on Jeju Island during an early summer morning. Soft golden sunlight, gentle ocean waves, black volcanic rocks, clear turquoise water, seashells scattered along the sand, a few distant fishermen, and a peaceful, uncrowded shoreline.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior, natural body language, authentic vacation atmosphere, warm morning light, rich environmental details.

Camera Style: Early-2000s Sony MiniDV camcorder. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting between the waves and her face, faded colours, soft contrast, slight motion blur, exposure pumping toward the bright ocean, MiniDV compression artifacts, no stabilization.

00:00–00:03
She walks barefoot along the shoreline carrying her sandals in one hand. Small waves wash over her feet as the camera briefly focuses on the water before finding her face.

00:03–00:06
She crouches to pick up a unique seashell, smiling as she brushes the sand away with her thumb. The operator moves closer, causing slight autofocus breathing.

00:06–00:09
Standing on a black volcanic rock, she watches the horizon while the sea breeze moves her hair and oversized shirt naturally.

00:09–00:12
She skips a flat stone across the calm water, laughing softly after it bounces several times. The camera shakes as the operator reacts a little too late.

00:12–00:15
She turns toward the camcorder with a warm smile, places the seashell inside her tote bag, and continues walking down the empty beach. The recording drifts toward the waves and abruptly cuts to black.

Audio: Natural ambience only–gentle waves, seabirds, light wind, distant fishermen talking, footsteps on wet sand, water splashing, and rustling fabric. No music. No narration.

entries.description: A comprehensive multi-act narrative prompt for a Pixar-style 3D animated short film about a man being stalked by a vengeful pigeon, detailing scenes from the initial encounter to a humorous reveal.
entries.prompt: MY NEMESIS IS A PIGEON” Style: Pixar-Inspired 3D Animation • Comedy • Family-Friendly • Viral Short Film ⸻ 🚪 ACT 1 — THE DAILY FEAR Dave is getting ready to leave his apartment. But something feels wrong. Before stepping outside, he carefully checks every direction. Left. Right. The sky. Behind a nearby tree. Even under a parked car. He’s clearly done this many times before. The audience immediately wonders: “What is this guy afraid of?” Dave finally relaxes. Maybe today will be different. ⸻ 🐦 ACT 2 — THE ENEMY RETURNS The moment Dave steps outside, everything changes. A shadow slowly moves across his face. He looks up. Perched high above him sits an angry pigeon. Not an ordinary pigeon. This pigeon looks like a movie villain. It stares directly at Dave. Waiting. Watching. The audience instantly understands: These two have history. ⸻ 🏃 ACT 3 — THE CHASE Without warning, the pigeon launches. Dave immediately panics. The chase begins. He runs through the city. Dodging pedestrians. Jumping around benches. Desperately trying to escape. The pigeon follows every move perfectly. No matter what Dave does, the pigeon always seems one step ahead. The audience starts laughing because the pigeon behaves less like a bird and more like a supervillain. ⸻ 🚌 ACT 4 — FALSE HOPE Dave spots a bus and jumps onboard. Finally safe. He collapses into a seat. Relieved. Then he hears a familiar sound. Coo. The pigeon is already inside the bus. Dave completely loses it. He screams for help. Begs the driver to stop. The bus screeches to a halt. Dave jumps out and runs. The audience realizes there is absolutely no escaping this bird. ⸻ 🌳 ACT 5 — THE PARK Dave runs into a nearby park. Exhausted. Breathing heavily. He hides behind a giant statue. Silence. No flapping. No cooing. Nothing. For the first time all day, he believes he has finally escaped. The danger seems over. ⸻ 🍟 ACT 6 — THE REVEAL A single french fry suddenly falls from the sky. Landing directly at Dave’s feet. His face drops instantly. He already knows what it means. Slowly, he looks up. The pigeon stands triumphantly on top of the statue. Then another french fry falls. As it drops— The story flashes back in black and white. Months earlier. A tiny baby pigeon excitedly approaches its favorite french fry. Just before it reaches the snack— Dave casually grabs it and eats it. The baby pigeon watches in absolute heartbreak. The audience finally discovers the truth. This entire feud started because of one stolen french fry. ⸻ 💩 ACT 7 — REVENGE COMPLETE Back in the present. Dave stares at the pigeon in disbelief. After all this time… The pigeon is still angry. The pigeon slowly nods. Then delivers one final perfectly aimed attack. Direct hit. Dave stands frozen in defeat. The pigeon proudly celebrates from atop the statue. Cut to black.

entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic 10-second continuous handheld smartphone video, filmed entirely on an iPhone 17 Pro Max rear camera. Behind-the-scenes inside a massive Tokyo practical-effects soundstage. The unseen camera operator stands approximately five meters from an incredibly detailed 1:15 scale tabletop miniature of futuristic Neo-Shinjuku, featuring illuminated neon billboards, elevated monorails with moving miniature trains, tiny glowing vehicles on multi-level overpasses, rain-slicked miniature streets, micro LED windows, and intricate rooftop air-conditioning units. The miniature clearly sits on a massive production stage surrounded by exposed steel trusses, blue screens, industrial liquid nitrogen fog vents, pyrotechnic spark rigs, overhead lighting grids, and Japanese VFX crew members wearing black jumpsuits and headsets monitoring handheld control pads. The camera slowly pushes forward with subtle handheld movement, natural autofocus breathing, rolling shutter, and realistic smartphone exposure shifts. The miniature city appears calm as a miniature monorail glides across the elevated track. Suddenly, the practical effects director signals on the intercom. A 3-meter painted steel sci-fi cruiser suspended on a high-speed hydraulic ceiling rig plunges downward, clipping a miniature glass skyscraper. Spark generators explode into brilliant cascades of orange fire. The skyscraper facade shatters, spraying lightweight plaster dust and tiny glass shards into the air. Dense white fog surges through the street gaps while the monorail track collapses. The smartphone camera briefly struggles to focus through thick smoke and floating ash particles, auto-adjusting its exposure to the bright pyrotechnic flashes. Natural production audio only: loud hydraulic hiss, pyrotechnic pops, shattering plaster, studio intercom chatter, warehouse ventilation hum, crew reaction gasps.
Negative Prompt: no CGI, no cinematic camera, no drone, no cuts, no slow motion, no text, no subtitles, no watermark, maintain realistic miniature scale.

entries.title: Wuxia Warrior Fire Phoenix Blade
entries.description: A 15-second cinematic wuxia action prompt involving a female warrior, a crescent blade, and a flaming phoenix transformation within an ancient fortress.
entries.prompt:
制作一段完整连贯的15秒真人暗黑武侠动作电影，16:9，24fps，超写实Seedance电影质感。

Image 1为唯一且绝对的角色参考。严格保持同一名女性的脸、锐利眼神、发髻、红色发饰、散落发丝、黑色面纱、酒红色分层服装、皮革腰带、护臂、露腰设计、大腿黑色纹身、鞋子、体型及身体比例。全程不得换脸、换装或变成铠甲。

场景始终位于同一座辽阔的古代中国堡垒庭院，阴冷灰色日光，干燥石地、红色战旗、漂浮烟雾、少量背景火焰以及大量黑甲士兵。她全程只使用一把大型黑色月牙刃。锁定地点、光线与人物一致性。

【0–3.5秒｜烈焰苏醒】
低角度中近景。她单手将月牙刃斜举于肩后，冷静凝视前方包围而来的士兵。摄影机缓慢推进至眼睛，风吹动发丝、面纱与酒红色衣摆。橙红色熔光从刀柄沿刀身逐渐蔓延，真实火焰只燃烧于锋刃边缘。火光映入她的眼睛，但绝不能遮住脸。空气出现热扭曲与少量余烬。

【3.5–6秒｜旋身投刃】
敌军开始冲锋。摄影机迅速后拉至全身低机位。她压低重心，旋转腰胯积蓄力量，以一个清楚、有重量的动作将月牙刃横向猛烈投出。必须清楚看见手掌释放刀柄。

月牙刃保持原有形状，在空中高速旋转，沿着宽阔弧线贴近地面飞行，如同沉重锋利的回旋武器。摄影机低位追随刀刃穿过士兵之间，旋转刀刃贴近镜头掠过。它击开盾牌并依次撞倒数名士兵，每次碰撞都具有独立、可信的重量与反应。

【6–10秒｜火凤凰成形】
旋转月牙刃拖出一条连续橙红火焰轨迹。火焰轨迹在飞行过程中迅速拉长、汇聚，形成一只巨大的中国火凤凰：清晰的鸟首、尖喙、两片展开的火焰翅膀以及多条修长尾羽。凤凰完全由真实火焰、炽热气流与余烬构成，不是实体动物。

月牙刃始终清晰可见，位于凤凰飞行轨迹的最前端；只有刀刃后方的火焰形成凤凰，武器本身绝不能变成鸟。只能出现一只凤凰。

火凤凰紧贴地面随月牙刃高速穿过敌阵，双翼掠过两侧士兵，释放强烈热浪与压力，将他们依次掀翻。战旗剧烈摆动，尘土、火星和碎片被卷向镜头。禁止所有士兵同时飞起。

【10–13秒｜凤凰升空回旋】
月牙刃完成地面弧线后突然向上盘旋。摄影机快速甩镜仰拍，火凤凰展开巨大双翼冲向高空，在女战士上方只环绕一次，形成壮观的火焰圆弧。

随后月牙刃转向并高速飞回她的方向，凤凰收拢双翼紧随其后俯冲。使用极短速度渐变突出俯冲力量，禁止定格、慢速漂浮或第二只凤凰。

【13–15秒｜接刃爆发】
低角度正面镜头。她站稳脚步，在最后一刻伸手准确接住高速返回的月牙刃，手臂与身体必须表现真实冲击力。接住瞬间，她顺势完成一次强力横向挥斩。

火凤凰从她身后完全展开双翼，发出无声怒吼般的火焰爆发，随后化成一道宽阔半圆形火浪冲向远处敌军。她本人始终清晰位于画面中央，身体与服装不着火。结束于月牙刃斜向身侧、凤凰轮廓在背后逐渐崩解成余烬的英雄全景。

ARRI Alexa 65，变形宽银幕景深，真实火焰与热力模拟，可信武器重量、人体惯性、布料物理、丰富前景视差、克制运动模糊、细腻35mm胶片颗粒，以及“专业控制下的手持震动”。

无背景音乐、无对白。仅保留刀刃破风、金属撞击、奔跑盔甲、火焰燃烧、凤凰气流、重击、尘土与战场环境声。

严格限制：全片只有一名女性、一把月牙刃和一只火凤凰。武器必须被她亲手投出并最终回到手中。禁止武器变成凤凰、复制武器、凤凰变成实体鸟、出现西方龙、额外翅膀长在人物身上、换脸、换装、铠甲变身、身体着火、随机爆炸、蓝色火焰、魔法阵、夜景、下雨、文字、字幕、Logo或水印。

entries.title: Urban Battlefield Action Scene
entries.description: An explosive, high-tension boss fight sequence between a techwear heroine and a heavy axe-wielding clown in an industrial ruin.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic action scene in strict 16:9 landscape, native 4K, 24fps. Tone: explosive, dangerous, fast, high-tension, and visually thrilling. This is Scene 1 of a two-part boss-fight-style action sequence and must end on a cliffhanger that naturally leads into Scene 2. REFERENCE ROLES: image1 = Pyona, the main heroine. Use image1 as the strict reference for Pyona’s face, facial proportions, light pastel-blue bob hairstyle, hair color, white cloud hair clip, blue fish hair clip, body proportions, age impression, exact outfit, styling, and overall recognizable identity. Preserve her exact cropped urban-techwear action outfit throughout: light gray cropped hooded jacket, clearly visible white crop-top feel underneath, black asymmetrical utility mini-skirt / short-bottom styling, black utility pouch or crossbody detail, black socks, and black combat boots. Do not redesign her. image2 = the clown enemy. Use image2 as the strict reference for the clown’s identity, proportions, terrifying costume, giant heavy axe, and overall menacing appearance. Preserve the same clown and same weapon consistently throughout. CORE ACTION RULE: Pyona must never block the axe blade with her bare body. She survives and fights through prediction, timing, footwork, body-angle control, narrow dodges, aerial repositioning, spacing, and fast counters. The clown must feel physically overwhelming, heavy, and destructive. Pyona stays alive and gains control through speed and precision, not brute force. ENVIRONMENT: A ruined urban battlefield at night, like a collapsed industrial ruin or destroyed concrete structure. Broken walls, exposed rebar, cracked ground, rubble piles, dust clouds, shattered concrete, and damaged surfaces everywhere. The axe attacks must visibly damage the environment: scraping the ground, throwing sparks and debris, cracking walls, carving trenches, and blasting rubble outward. Maintain clear spatial consistency. STYLE: Live-action photorealism with strong action readability. High-end cinematic fight energy, like a boss fight in a dark action film. Realistic body weight, believable recoil, sharp contact, strong debris simulation, and dangerous near-miss tension. No comedy. No magical powers. No fantasy effects. CAMERA: Use dynamic but readable cinematic camera coverage: - low-angle handheld push-ins - side tracking shots - medium rotating follow shots - brief wide shots for scale and aftermath - one brief slow-motion emphasis only during the most dangerous near-miss. Cuts may be dynamic, but action must remain clear, coherent, and easy to follow. TIMELINE: 0.0–3.8s — Opening 3-hit pressure sequence Start immediately in motion with no pause. The clown launches an aggressive three-part attack sequence: 1. a huge horizontal axe sweep toward Pyona, 2. an immediate reverse backhand sweep, 3. a heavy downward slam. The first swing scrapes the ground and throws sparks, broken stone, and debris. Pyona performs a fast lateral slip-step dodge, narrowly avoiding the blade as it passes just beside her shoulder. Without pause, the clown reverses into the second sweep. Pyona ducks and twists her upper body under the returning blade, avoiding it by centimeters. The clown then commits into the third attack, a brutal overhead slam. Pyona instantly side-jumps or rolls diagonally away just before impact. The axe slams into the ground and carves a trench, blasting dust and rubble upward. The whole opening must feel relentless, like Pyona is under constant lethal pressure with no breathing room. 3.8–6.8s — Fast first counter / control disruption As the axe is briefly stuck or slowed from the heavy slam, Pyona instantly takes the opening. She leaps lightly off broken rubble or a damaged concrete edge and darts in with a short, sharp three-hit counter: - first, a quick strike to the clown’s weapon-control arm or axe-handle area, - second, another fast disrupting hit to the grip / forearm zone, - third, a clean straight punch to the clown’s chest. These hits are not about overpowering the clown, but about disrupting his balance and force generation. The clown stumbles backward and crashes against part of a ruined wall, creating visible cracks and shaking loose concrete dust. Pyona lands and immediately side-steps out again, never staying directly in front of the axe. 6.8–10.2s — Most dangerous near-miss The clown recovers faster than expected and instantly retaliates with a violent reverse horizontal axe sweep aimed directly at Pyona’s torso. This is the most dangerous beat of Scene 1. Use one brief slow-motion emphasis here. Pyona sharply twists her waist and slides half a step sideways at the very last moment. The axe blade misses her body by only a few centimeters, slicing past the side of her outfit and strongly disturbing the hem / edge of her cropped top and jacket without actually injuring her. Ground fragments and dust fly through frame. The near miss must feel terrifyingly close. The slow motion should be very brief, then snap back to full speed immediately. 10.2–12.8s — Clean momentum-based knockout counter Using the dodge momentum from the near miss, Pyona spins fluidly into a fast, powerful roundhouse kick. The kick lands cleanly and forcefully on the clown’s side face / jaw. The impact must feel sharp and real. The clown is blasted backward and crashes through part of a ruined wall or major concrete section. Broken concrete, rubble chunks, and a heavy dust burst explode across the frame. Pyona lands balanced and alert, not posing, already ready for the next move. 12.8–15.0s — Cliffhanger ending Wide aftermath shot. Dust and debris settle around the collapsed wall area. For a brief moment it seems Pyona has finally created space. Then movement appears inside the wreckage. The clown plants one hand into the rubble, grabs the giant axe, and forcefully rises again from the debris, still dangerous and not defeated. Pyona remains in the foreground or mid-ground in a guarded stance, breathing hard, watching him carefully and maintaining distance. End on the clown partially risen in the rubble with the axe in hand, clearly setting up Scene 2. AUDIO: No dialogue. Use only strong cinematic fight sound design: heavy axe swings, metal scrape on stone, ground carving, sparks, concrete cracking, rubble spray, debris fall, air displacement, fast footwork, body impact, wall collapse, dusty low-end impact booms, and tense dark action ambience. No spoken lines. IMPORTANT RULES: Pyona must never tank the axe blade. She must always evade first, then counter. The clown’s axe must feel extremely heavy and lethal. The clown’s attacks must come in chained pressure, not one isolated swing at a time. Pyona’s counters must be short, precise, and opening-based. Environmental damage must match the axe impacts. Keep both characters visually consistent with image1 and image2. Scene 1 must end with the clown rising again, not fully defeated. NEGATIVE: No direct body-blocking of the axe, no weak impact, no fake contact, no floating, no teleporting, no wire-fu, no random extra enemies, no comedy, no magical powers, no repeated identical attack loops, no unreadable blurry action, no identity drift, no hairstyle change, no outfit redesign, no loss of the visible crop-top feel in Pyona’s outfit, no soft or low-energy choreography.

entries.title: Titanic Sinking BTS Smartphone Footage
entries.description: A realistic behind-the-scenes prompt for recreating smartphone footage of a practical-effects shoot for the Titanic sinking.
entries.prompt:
Behind-the-scenes phone footage from inside a large practical-effects soundstage, shot vertically on a handheld modern smartphone.

>> Scene context: a film crew is shooting the sinking of a miniature RMS Titanic. A gigantic practical ocean tank set, dressed as the North Atlantic, contains a 1:24 scale Titanic complete with illuminated portholes, four funnels, lifeboats, deck railings, rigging, cargo cranes, and miniature passengers. Above the tank, a scaffold gantry carries a row of huge dump tanks loaded with practical seawater; two techs stand on the gantry at the release levers.

>> First frame: already loaded and ready — the ship and ocean tank fill mid-ground screen-right, dump tanks looming above the set; in the foreground screen-left, within 1 meter of the phone, three crew in black EFFECTS CREW t-shirts stand behind a low containment wall, one on a cinema camera on rails, another on a headset with a hand raised. A huge blue chroma-key wall with orange cross markers rises behind the horizon. A technocrane hangs above the set.

>> Action and physics: a shout of “Action!” — the dump tank gates bang open in sequence and a massive surge of real water crashes across the ocean set with real weight and turbulence, the first wave breaking over the bow before racing along the decks, tearing away lifeboats, snapping miniature railings flat, then slamming into the ship: lower decks disappear beneath the waterline, the bow plunging under the surface, the stern rising higher under the hydraulic gimbal, funnels collapsing one after another as the rigging whips, the hull splitting apart at midships before the stern slides beneath the churn; the water bursts over the containment lip and a fine spray cloud rolls across the stage floor, whiting out the frame as the crew shield their faces and stumble back.

>> Camera: operator standing then backing away, phone in one hand at chest height, fast handheld pan following the action from bow to stern, framing loose and reactive, hard jolt as the spray cloud hits, autofocus hunting through the whiteout, water droplets clinging to the lens in the final beat, 84° wide diagonal FOV, camera about 2 meters from the containment wall.

【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0 Fast

【视频规格】

严格生成 15 秒视频，16:9 横屏，三个干净镜头。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，融合默片式追逐喜剧节奏、现代劫案电影的清晰空间调度、优雅仙侠动作语言和克制冷面表演；采用明确的观众误导结构：开场让人误以为两位角色正在追夺价值连城的神秘物件，最后才揭露她们只是为了保住火锅排队资格。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙姐

剑仙姐 @图片 1，同一个 25–30 岁东亚女性，椭圆脸、自然白皙皮肤、锐利深棕色眼睛、黑色长直发、高挑纤细身材，穿白色布靴、飘动的白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、银色腰饰并佩戴玉簪；严格保持参考图中的同一身份。

角色 ID B｜单车姐

单车姐 @图片 2，同一个 25–30 岁东亚女性，圆润而富有表情的脸、棕色短马尾、黄色外套、蓝色牛仔裤、白色运动鞋、参考图饰品和同一辆自行车；严格保持参考图中的同一身份。

【核心道具】

同一张纸质排队号码、同一柄银色长剑、同一辆自行车。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景跟拍】

傍晚蓝调时刻的热闹滨河商业广场，拥挤火锅店外悬挂温暖红灯笼，湿润石材地面形成清晰倒影，室外等位凳、布满蒸汽的玻璃窗、停放的电动车、被风吹动的树木、散落纸巾和强烈晚风共同构成稳定环境。

一张小小的纸质排队号码从角色 B 手中滑落，被风吹向广场深处。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景侧面追逐跟拍】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的女人脚踩同一柄银色长剑，悬浮于地面半米高度平稳滑行；同一个穿黄色外套的单车女人在她身旁快速骑行。

同一张号码纸在同一个红灯笼广场中不断翻滚飘飞；角色 A 用一侧宽袖改变局部风向，角色 B 按响自行车铃，让前方行人下意识让出通道，两人保持精确默契，不发生碰撞。

英雄式鼓点、剑鸣、自行车链条节奏和强风声同步组成夸张动作配乐。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写进入全景反转】

同一个剑仙姐从同一柄银色长剑上跃起，在号码纸距离积水一厘米时，用两根手指准确夹住。

英雄音乐瞬间安静。

火锅店扩音器播报：“A108 号，请立即进店，过号重新排队。”

两人先看号码纸，再同时望向火锅店，异口同声大喊：“冲！”

随后立刻以最快速度原路返回，同一柄银色长剑与同一辆自行车并排前进。

画面定格在两人无比严肃的脸上，同时角色 B 大喊：“修仙可以等，火锅不能！”

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，三个干净镜头，16:9 横屏，角色身份稳定，道具运动轨迹连贯，强风、纸张、自行车、头发和真丝衣料物理效果真实，原生同步生成普通话对白、扩音器播报、环境声与音乐，不生成画面字幕。

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

entries.prompt:
【Seedance 2.5／15秒／9:16】

参照画像を唯一のキャラクター参照として使用する。15秒、9:16縦型、ワンカット、固定カメラ。開始から終了までカメラは完全固定。ズーム、パン、チルト、回転、手持ち、カット、トランジション、リフレーム、スロー、静止演出は禁止。

【構図・立ち位置】

画面左側45％に実写のBBQグリルと骨付き肉を配置する。画面右側30％に2Dキャラクターを配置する。中央にはトングと肉を移動させるための空間を20％程度確保する。

キャラクターは右側の砂浜に立ち、頭から黒いビーチサンダルまで全身を常に表示する。キャラクターをグリルの前、グリル脚の上、テーブルの上には置かない。キャラクターとグリルの間には明確な空間を残し、開始から終了まで立ち位置を維持する。

グリル、肉、人の手、トング、コチュジャンボトルをキャラクターの身体と重ねない。キャラクターが肉やグリルを隠さない。人の手やトングがキャラクターの顔や身体を不自然に横切らない。物体同士の奥行きと前後関係を正確に維持する。

【映像スタイル】

真夏の美しい海辺で行われる実写BBQ映像と、平面2Dアニメーションステッカーキャラクターを組み合わせたコミカルな映像。

青い海、白い波、明るい青空、黄金色の砂浜、遠景の海岸線、風に揺れるヤシの葉を描く。明るい昼の自然光. 海風によってヤシの葉、グリルの煙、キャラクターの白いシャツの裾が自然に揺れる。

背景、海、砂、グリル、炭火、煙、炎、骨付き肉、脂、肉汁、コチュジャン、ボトル、人の手、金属トングはすべて高品質な実写表現。白飛び、過度なブルーム、霞、露出のちらつきは禁止。

キャラクターだけは最後まで平面2Dアニメーションステッカーとして維持する。実写化、半実写化、3D化、CGフィギュア化、ゲームモデル化、Pixar風、クレイアニメ風は禁止。鮮明な線画、セル塗り、平面的な陰影、細い白フチを維持する。

【キャラクター固定】

参照画像の男性キャラクターをそのまま使用する。柔らかなアッシュシルバーのウェーブヘア、前髪の形、髪の長さと毛量、灰青色の瞳、若く整った顔、細身で長い手足の体型を固定する。

白いノースリーブインナー、透け感のある白い半袖オープンシャツ、白いドローコード、黒いペイズリー柄ショートパンツ、黒いビーチサンダル、シルバーネックレス、ピアス、ブレスレット、リングを固定する。

顔、髪型、体型、衣装、柄、色、靴、アクセサリーを変更しない。帽子、サングラス、エプロン、手袋、新しい小物を追加しない。キャラクターを複製しない。別の2Dキャラクターを追加しない。

キャラクターは冷たい無表情ではなく、非常に可愛く表情豊かに動く。大きく輝く目、頬の赤み、嬉しそうな笑顔、首を傾げる仕草、肩を小さく揺らす動き、頬を膨らませた拗ね顔、涙目、慌てて手を振る動きを明確に見せる。棒立ち禁止。

【BBQと骨付き肉】

画面左側の実写BBQグリルで、大きな骨付きトマホークステーキを焼く。長い骨が肉に物理的につながったまま明確に見える。肉は十分に焼けており、濃い焼き目、香ばしい焦げ目、艶のある肉汁、溶けた脂、軽い湯気を描く。

肉を生肉、黒焦げ、骨なし肉、変形した肉にしない。肉や骨を複製しない。骨を途中で消さない。

実写の成人女性の手が画面左端から入る。ピンク色のネイルアート、細いシルバーリング、正常な5本指を維持する。金属製BBQトングで肉を返し、持ち上げる。手、指、リング、トング、肉、グリルを融合させない。

【コチュジャン】

ラベル、文字、ブランドロゴのない透明なスクイーズボトルを使用する。中身は濃厚で艶のある深い赤茶色のコチュジャン。ケチャップのような明るい赤色や水っぽい液体にはしない。

コチュジャンはボトルのノズルから太く連続して流れ、肉の表面に直接落ちる。ソースを空中から突然出現させない。ボトルの底や側面から漏らさない。

【00:00–00:03】

固定されたワイド構図で開始する。左側では骨付きトマホークステーキが大きな音を立てて焼けている。女性の実写の手が金属トングで肉を一度ゆっくり返す。脂が炭に落ち、小さな炎が一瞬だけ上がる。薄い煙が海風に流れる。

右側の2Dキャラクターは肉を見つめ、目を大きくキラキラ輝かせる。両手を顎の下で合わせ、肩を上げ、膝を少し曲げて小さく2回弾む。口元に小さな2Dのよだれが一滴だけ現れて消える。

【00:03–00:05】

キャラクターがコチュジャンボトルを見つける。目を輝かせ、首を傾げ、片手でボトルを指さす。嬉しそうにボトルを両手で持ち、胸の前で一瞬だけ抱き締める。

その後、片目を閉じたイタズラっぽい笑顔になり、ノズルを左側の肉へ向ける。キャラクター自身は右側の立ち位置から移動しない。

【00:05–00:07】

キャラクターがボトルを強く絞り、骨付き肉の上へコチュジャンを大量にかける。濃い赤茶色の太いソースがノズルから肉まで連続して伸び、肉の表面に大量のジグザグ模様を作る。

ソースは熱で軽く泡立ち、肉汁と混ざって艶を出す。肉全体を完全に隠さず、骨と焼き目は見える状態を維持する。

キャラクターは得意げに笑い、舌先を少し出し、肩を可愛く左右に揺らしながらボトルを絞る。女性の手はトングを持ったまま驚いて止まる。

【00:07–00:09】

女性の手がトングでコチュジャンボトルを素早く取り上げ、左側へ戻す。その直後、閉じたトングの先端でキャラクターの頭頂部を軽く一度だけ「こん！」と叩く。

トングの先端がキャラクターの髪へ明確に軽く接触する。接触と同時に、頭の上へ小さな黄色い2Dの星形衝撃エフェクトを出す。強く殴らない。痛々しくしない。完全に可愛いカートゥーン式のツッコミにする。

叩かれた瞬間、キャラクターの頭が右へ傾き、銀髪が弾み、肩と胴体が左、右へ大きく揺れる。膝が曲がり、両腕を広げてバランスを取る。足は砂浜から離れず、グリル側へ移動しない。

頬を膨らませ、目をぎゅっと閉じ、小さな涙を一滴だけ出す。頭だけではなく、全身が可愛く揺れる動きを約1秒間はっきり見せる。

【00:09–00:11】

女性の手がトングをグリルへ戻し、コチュジャンの付いた焼き肉を一口サイズに持ち上げる。持ち上げた肉には焼き目、肉汁、繊維、濃いコチュジャンが見える。

トングは中央の空間を通り、肉をキャラクターの口の前まで運ぶ。キャラクターは頭を叩かれたことに拗ね、腕を組んで顔を横へ向け、頬を膨らませる。

すぐに目だけで肉をちらっと見る。目が再び輝き、腕をほどき、両手を背中へ回し、上半身を少し前へ傾ける。口を大きく開け、肉へ近づく。

【00:11–00:12】

キャラクターが肉を明確

Zooming, panning, tilting, rotating, handheld movement, cuts, transitions, reframing, slow motion, and freeze-frame effects are prohibited.

[Composition/Positioning]
Place a live-action BBQ grill and meat on the bone in the left 45% of the screen. Place a 2D character in the right 30% of the screen. Reserve about 20% of space in the center for tongs and moving the meat.

Do not place the character in front of the grill, on top of the grill legs, or on the table. Do not overlap the grill, meat, human hands, tongs, or gochujang bottle with the character's body. The character must not hide the meat or grill. Human hands or tongs must not unnaturally cross the character's face or body. Accurately maintain depth and foreground-background relationships between objects.

A comical video combining live-action BBQ footage at a beautiful midsummer seaside with a flat 2D animated sticker character.

Draw a blue sea, white waves, bright blue sky, golden sand, a distant coastline, and palm leaves swaying in the wind. Bright daytime natural light. Palm leaves, grill smoke, and the hem of the character's white shirt sway naturally in the sea breeze.

The background, sea, sand, grill, charcoal fire, smoke, flame, meat on the bone, fat, meat juice, gochujang, bottle, human hand, and metal tongs are all high-quality live-action expressions. Blown-out highlights, excessive bloom, haze, and exposure flickering are prohibited.

Only the character remains a flat 2D animated sticker until the end. Live-action, semi-live-action, 3D, CG figure, game model, Pixar style, or clay animation styles are prohibited. Maintain clear line drawings, cell shading, flat shadows, and thin white borders.

[Character Persistence]
Use the male character from the reference image exactly as they are. Fix the soft ash-silver wavy hair, bangs shape, hair length and volume, grey-blue eyes, young well-formed face, and slim long-limbed body type.

Fix the white sleeveless innerwear, sheer white short-sleeved open shirt, white drawcord, black paisley shorts, black flip-flops, silver necklace, earrings, bracelet, and ring.

Do not change the face, hairstyle, body type, clothing, patterns, colors, shoes, or accessories. Do not add hats, sunglasses, aprons, gloves, or new props. Do not duplicate the character. Do not add another 2D character.

[BBQ and Meat on the Bone]
Grill a large Tomahawk steak on the bone in the live-action BBQ grill on the left side of the screen. Long bones are clearly visible and physically connected to the meat. The meat is well-grilled, showing deep sear marks, savory char, glossy juices, melted fat, and light steam.

Do not make the meat raw, charred black, boneless, or deformed. Do not duplicate meat or bones. Do not let bones disappear midway.

A live-action adult woman's hand enters from the left edge of the screen. Maintain pink nail art, thin silver rings, and normal five fingers. Turn and lift the meat with metal BBQ tongs. Do not fuse the hand, fingers, ring, tongs, meat, or grill.

[Gochujang]
Use a transparent squeeze bottle with no label, text, or brand logo. The content is thick, glossy, deep reddish-brown gochujang. Do not make it bright red like ketchup or a watery liquid.

The gochujang flows in a thick continuous stream from the bottle nozzle and falls directly onto the meat surface. Do not make the sauce appear suddenly from mid-air. Do not leak from the bottom or sides of the bottle.

[00:00–00:03]
Start with a fixed wide composition. On the left, a Tomahawk steak on the bone is sizzling loudly. A woman's live-action hand slowly turns the meat once with metal tongs. Fat falls onto the charcoal, and a small flame rises for a moment. Thin smoke drifts in the sea breeze.

The 2D character on the right stares at the meat, their eyes sparkling large. They put their hands together under their chin, raise their shoulders, bend their knees slightly, and bounce twice. A small 2D drop of drool appears at the mouth for a moment and disappears.

[00:03–00:05]
The character finds the gochujang bottle. Their eyes sparkle, they tilt their head, and point at the bottle with one hand. They happily hold the bottle with both hands and hug it to their chest for a moment.

Then, with a mischievous smile and one eye closed, they point the nozzle toward the meat on the left. The character themselves does not move from their standing position on the right.

[00:05–00:07]
The character squeezes the bottle hard, pouring a large amount of gochujang onto the meat on the bone. A thick reddish-brown sauce extends continuously from the nozzle to the meat, creating a large zigzag pattern on the meat surface.

The sauce bubbles lightly with the heat and mixes with the meat juice to create a gloss. Maintain visibility of the bone and grill marks without completely hiding the whole meat.

The character smiles proudly, sticks out their tongue slightly, and shakes their shoulders cutely while squeezing the bottle. The woman's hand stops in surprise while holding the tongs.

[00:07–00:09]
The woman's hand quickly takes the gochujang bottle with the tongs and returns it to the left. Immediately after, she lightly taps the top of the character's head once with the tip of the closed tongs.

The tip of the tongs clearly and lightly touches the character's hair. At the moment of contact, a small yellow 2D star-shaped impact effect appears over the head. Do not hit hard. Do not make it painful. Make it a completely cute cartoon-style reprimand.

The moment they are hit, the character's head tilts to the right, their silver hair bounces, and their shoulders and torso shake greatly to the left and right. Knees bend, and they spread their arms to balance. Feet do not leave the sand, and they do not move toward the grill.

They puff their cheeks, close their eyes tight, and shed a single small tear. Clearly show the cute shaking movement of the whole body, not just the head, for about 1 second.

[00:09–00:11]
The woman's hand returns the tongs to the grill and lifts a bite-sized piece of grilled meat with gochujang on it. The lifted meat shows grill marks, juice, fibers, and thick gochujang.

The tongs pass through the center space and carry the meat to the front of the character's mouth. The character sulks about being hit on the head, crosses their arms, turns their face away, and puffs their cheeks.

Immediately they glance at the meat with just their eyes. Their eyes sparkle again, they uncross their arms, put both hands behind their back, and lean their upper body slightly forward. They open their mouth wide and approach the meat.

[00:11–00:12]
The character clearly [eats] the meat

entries.title: Authentic Korean Samgyupsal Vlog
entries.description: A highly detailed multi-shot video prompt for a realistic food vlog, utilizing character reference images and specific timestamp-based actions.
entries.prompt: 7-shot handheld phone vlog with snapshot realism, slight tilt, natural handheld shake, warm indoor lighting, fine film grain, photorealistic. A woman Image1 eats lunch alone at a rustic Korean samgyupsal restaurant. Image1 defines only her face and hairstyle. She wears a loose olive-green cotton short-sleeve shirt tucked into dark trousers. She remains seated on the same side facing the camera throughout. Only her face is visible; the grill attendant appears only as hands. A wooden table holds a charcoal grill, tongs, scissors, ssamjang, garlic, sesame oil, lettuce, and napkins. Thick pork belly sizzles as smoke rises under warm pendant lights. Natural, subtle reactions throughout. Shot 1 (0–2s): Hands place pork belly on the grill. She watches the sizzle and says, "오 소리 봐." Camera gently pulls back. Shot 2 (2–4s): Overhead shot as she cuts the pork with scissors on the grill. Slight handheld shake. Shot 3 (4–6s): She makes a lettuce wrap with pork, garlic, and ssamjang, takes a bite, closes her eyes, and says, "음~~ 대박." Shot 4 (6–8s): She grabs a hot piece with chopsticks, blows on it, eats, and smiles: "So good it's dangerous." Shot 5 (8–10s): She wipes her fingers and mouth while watching the grill continue to sizzle. Shot 6 (10–13s): A hand places a frosty beer (or soju). She lifts the glass toward the camera and says, "캬 이거지." Shot 7 (13–15s): She takes a long sip, sets the glass down, leans back with a satisfied smile as the grill continues sizzling. Audio: No music. Only authentic restaurant ambience—grill sizzling, scissors, tongs, chewing, glass sounds, soft chatter, and her natural dialogue. No subtitles, text, logos, watermarks, or duplication of the reference image.

entries.title: Poetic Xianxia Visual Illusion Comedy Video
entries.description: A detailed cinematic multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a poetic Xianxia-style comedy with visual illusions inspired by Buster Keaton.
entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0 Fast

【视频规格】

严格生成 15 秒视频，16:9 横屏，三个清楚镜头。

【整体风格】

诗意仙侠视错觉喜剧，真实电影高清质感，采用古典中国留白构图、克制的冷面表演、清晨柔光、低饱和玉绿色与象牙白色调、细腻胶片颗粒，并借鉴巴斯特・基顿式空间错觉，通过可控的摄影机旋转揭示真相，而不是依赖法术失败制造笑点；全片为纯古代中国世界，不出现任何现代元素。

【角色锁定】

使用 @图片 1 和 @图片 2 严格锁定角色身份、面部、发型、身材比例、服装、鞋子与饰品。

角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐

25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙自然肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩和白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜小师妹

20–25 岁的东亚女性，圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小，穿青绿色亚麻汉服、深色腰带、木簪和黑色布鞋。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜全景或远景】

画面整体有意顺时针旋转 90 度，让一面陡峭山壁在视觉上变成水平地面。

角色 ID A：剑仙师姐，25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙自然肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩和白色布靴。她从鞋到头完整出现在画面中，看似双手负后、从容不迫地沿垂直绝壁笔直向上行走，头发和衣袖自然垂向画面中的万丈深渊。

角色 ID B：小师妹，20–25 岁的东亚女性，圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小，穿青绿色亚麻汉服、深色腰带、木簪 and 黑色布鞋，看似正抓着下方一棵古松。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景或牛仔景】

同一个穿青绿色亚麻汉服的小师妹仰头问道：“师姐，这就是踏壁登天？”

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐继续平静前行，淡然回答：“心正，天地自平。”

背景始终保持同一面山壁、同一棵古松、同样的漂浮山雾、石台和远处瓦顶水榭；必须维持错误的垂直方向，但不能改变人物身体结构。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写或极近特写】

摄影机平稳逆时针旋转 90 度，恢复真实水平线，清楚揭示同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐其实只是在一面矮墙旁的平坦石台上普通行走，而同一个穿青绿色亚麻汉服的小师妹只是随意靠在古松旁。

小师妹面无表情地说道：“师姐，天地平了，镜头歪了。”

极近特写：剑仙师姐努力维持的端庄微笑瞬间凝固，一侧眉毛轻轻抽动，随后若无其事地回答：“这是考你眼力。”

最后以一声干涩古琴拨弦和一颗松果落在石板上的声音收尾。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，三个清楚镜头，原生普通话对白，人物面部与服装稳定，场景几何关系连续，山雾、真丝衣料、头发、古松与重力方向真实一致，不生成画面字幕，始终只出现两名可见角色。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props
entries.translated_prompt:
[Generation Mode]

Seedance 2.0 Fast

[Video Specifications]

Strictly generate a 15-second video, 16:9 aspect ratio, with three clear shots.

[Overall Style]

Poetic Xianxia visual illusion comedy, realistic cinematic high-definition texture. Uses classical Chinese negative space composition, restrained deadpan performance, soft morning light, low-saturation jade green and ivory white tones, and fine film grain. Borrows from Buster Keaton-style spatial illusions, revealing the truth through controlled camera rotation rather than relying on failed magic for laughs. The entire film is set in a pure ancient Chinese world with no modern elements.

[Character Locking]

Use @Image 1 and @Image 2 to strictly lock character identity, face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, shoes, and accessories.

Character ID A | Senior Sister Sword Immortal

An East Asian female aged 25-30, oval face, natural fair skin tone, dark almond eyes, black long hair half-tied and fixed with a white jade hairpin, tall and slender build. Wearing white embroidered silk Hanfu with semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, silver waist seal, jade pendant, and white cloth boots.

Character ID B | Junior Sister

An East Asian female aged 20-25, rounded and agile face, black hair in braids, petite build. Wearing bluish-green linen Hanfu, dark belt, wooden hairpin, and black cloth shoes.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Wide Shot or Long Shot]

The frame is intentionally rotated 90 degrees clockwise, making a steep mountain wall appear horizontally as the ground. 

Character ID A: Senior Sister, appearing in full from head to toe, seems to be walking upright and calmly along the vertical cliff with hands behind her back, while her hair and sleeves naturally hang toward the vast abyss in the frame.

Character ID B: Junior Sister seems to be hanging onto an ancient pine tree below.

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Medium Shot or Cowboy Shot]

The same Junior Sister in green linen Hanfu looks up and asks: "Senior Sister, is this 'Treading the Wall to Heaven'?"

The same Senior Sister in white silk Hanfu continues walking calmly and replies indifferently: "If the heart is upright, heaven and earth will naturally be level."

The background remains the same mountain wall, pine tree, floating mist, stone platform, and distant roofed water pavilion; the incorrect vertical orientation must be maintained without altering character anatomy.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up or Extreme Close-up]

The camera smoothly rotates 90 degrees counter-clockwise to restore the true horizontal line, revealing that the Senior Sister is simply walking on a flat stone platform next to a low wall, while the Junior Sister is just casually leaning against the pine tree.

Junior Sister says expressionlessly: "Senior Sister, the world is level, but the camera is crooked."

Extreme Close-up: The Senior Sister's hard-maintained dignified smile instantly freezes, one eyebrow twitches slightly, and she then replies as if nothing happened: "This is to test your eyesight."

[Shot 2: Eyes]
Close-up on the [Main Character]'s eyes. Only one blink. The mouth smiles slightly.

[Shot 3: Signal]
The [Main Character] slowly raises her right hand and snaps her fingers next to her face. Include only the 'snap' sound strongly.

[Shot 4: First Activation]
One of the background [Anomaly Gimmicks] glows red. The camera rapidly zooms into its lens, eye, or screen.

[Shot 5: Chain Activation]
With a match cut, another [Anomaly Gimmick] and then another activate one after another. Red lights chain into the depth of the screen.

[Shot 6: Full Activation]
Ultra-wide pull back. Countless [Anomaly Gimmicks] on walls, floor, ceiling, and desks all glow red at once. The [Main Character] becomes a black silhouette against the backlight.

[Shot 7: Declaration]
Rapid zoom back to the [Main Character]'s face. With an overwhelmingly calm smile, she looks at the camera and says, 'I saw everything.' Stop the last frame with red backlighting.

entries.title: Japanese Idol Lifestyle Vlog
entries.description: An intimate and nostalgic personal vlog prompt for a Japanese idol's daily life, including morning routines and playful pet interactions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 1-minute Japanese-style idol personal vlog. The video should feel like a young Japanese idol casually filming her private daily life for her fans. Not a commercial, not a music video, but a genuine personal diary captured with a small camera or smartphone. The mood is warm, intimate, soft, and slightly nostalgic. The main character is a young female idol with a gentle personality. If a reference image is provided, keep her exact face identity, hairstyle, facial features, body proportions, and overall appearance consistent throughout the entire video. She should feel natural and comfortable in front of the camera: small smiles, shy reactions, fixing her hair, looking away while thinking, small laughs, casual expressions. Camera style: handheld selfie vlog, compact digital camera feeling, Japanese lifestyle vlog aesthetic, soft CCD-like image quality, subtle film grain, slightly warm tones, gentle highlight bloom, natural skin texture, soft focus, slight autofocus adjustments, imperfect framing. The camera should feel like she is holding it herself or placing it casually around her room. No commercial lighting. No perfect poses. No dramatic acting. No artificial influencer energy.
0-8s: Morning bedroom introduction. The vlog starts with a close selfie shot. Soft sunlight comes through white curtains. The room feels cozy and personal: small decorations, books, cute accessories, a desk, plants, everyday objects. She looks into the camera with a sleepy smile. She waves softly and says: "Good morning. I'm filming a little vlog today." She laughs quietly, fixes her hair, and adjusts the camera. The feeling is like a private message to her fans.
8-18s: Introducing herself. She walks around her room while talking casually. She introduces herself: her personality, what kind of person she is, and what she likes doing in her free time. Show small everyday details: choosing clothes, making a drink, checking her schedule, looking through photos on her phone. She occasionally looks away from the camera naturally while talking. She feels like a real person, not performing.
18-30s: Introducing her cat Bubble. The mood becomes warmer and more playful. She calls: "Bubble..." The cat walks into the room. She smiles immediately and follows Bubble with the camera. Show cute natural moments: Bubble jumping onto the bed, sitting near the window, rubbing against her, looking curiously at the camera. She picks Bubble up gently and introduces: "This is Bubble. Bubble is my little family." She laughs because Bubble does not cooperate with the camera. The interaction feels spontaneous and real.
30-45s: Her everyday hobbies. A soft lifestyle montage filmed casually. Show her doing things she enjoys:
listening to music with headphones
writing in a diary
reading a magazine
making coffee or tea
taking selfies

entries.title: Cinematic Casino Card Handling
entries.description: A highly detailed technical prompt for Seedance 2.0 focused on maintaining character identity and realistic physics during intricate card tricks in a cinematic casino setting.
entries.prompt: 720P, portrait 9:16 format to create a 15-second video. Please utilize Seedance 2.0's ability to generate a 15-second video in a single pass. Ultra-realistic live-action cinematic short film, 15 seconds, set inside an upscale casino. Use the uploaded character image@【人物三视图】 as the sole identity reference for the protagonist. Preserve the exact same facial identity, facial proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, age impression, body proportions, clothing, accessories, and overall presence from the uploaded character image. The protagonist must remain visually consistent throughout the entire film. Use the uploaded five action reference videos only to control the corresponding card actions. These action reference videos must influence only the hand movements, finger articulation, grip, deck handling, card trajectories, motion rhythm, timing, release force, catching motion, and finishing poses. Do not inherit any character appearance, wardrobe, background, framing, lighting, composition, camera angle, or visual style from the action reference videos. SCENE: A real upscale casino interior with a deep green felt card table positioned at the center. The distant casino environment remains dim and subdued, with only faint silhouettes of tables, chairs, chandeliers, and architectural elements visible in the darkness. The setting feels premium, restrained, and cinematic. LIGHTING: A single focused warm-white overhead spotlight illuminates the protagonist’s upper body, hands, cards, and the green felt table. The rest of the casino falls into near darkness. Add a very subtle soft frontal fill light only to preserve detail in the eyes, finger joints, and card edges without flattening the dramatic shadows. The lighting must create realistic depth, directional contrast, natural falloff, and physically believable shadow behavior. The cards, hands, and fingers must cast consistent and dynamically changing shadows onto the green felt table. As cards move, flip, arc, rotate, and fall, their brightness, reflections, motion blur, occlusion, and shadows must respond naturally to their angle and position under the overhead light. Avoid flat lighting, decorative rim lighting, fantasy glow, neon effects, or unmotivated light sources. ACTION CHAIN: CARD WATERFALL PULL Strictly reference the uploaded “【拉牌】” video for the movement only. Begin already in motion. Extreme close-up from a front-right angle near hand level. Show only both hands, part of the sleeves, the deck, and a small area of green felt. One hand releases the cards in a continuous controlled stream into the other hand. Preserve the exact rhythm, hand spacing, release pattern, falling arc, and receiving motion from the reference. The receiving hand catches the full deck and squares it cleanly. The overhead light creates thin moving highlights along the card edges and layered moving shadows across the receiving hand and table. ONE-HANDED CHARLIER CUT Strictly reference the clean one-handed Charlier cut segment from the uploaded “【查理切】” video for the movement only. Use only one complete Charlier cut. Do not add any extra one-handed flourishes or multi-packet variations. Close hand shot from the protagonist’s left-front side, slightly below hand level. The frame includes the operating hand, the other hand resting naturally near the table edge, a small portion of the torso, and the green felt table. The deck separates into two packets, the lower packet drops, the finger pushes through, the packets pass, and the deck closes as one. The camera remains locked off. One side of the hand is lit by the overhead light while the opposite side falls into natural shadow, clearly showing the thickness and layers of the cards. VERTICAL TWO-HAND FLOURISH Strictly reference the uploaded “【花切】” video for the movement only, specifically the segment where the cards form a continuous stepped vertical chain between the upper hand and the lower receiving hand. Do not include the crossed-arm ending. Front-facing medium close-up at chest height. Frame the upper hand, the vertical chain of cards, the lower receiving hand, and part of the torso. The face should be only partially visible or remain secondary to the card action. Preserve the exact hand spacing, stepped structure, curved path, release rhythm, downward flow, and final catching motion from the reference. As the cards pass through the overhead beam, each card briefly moves from shadow into highlight and back into shadow, producing flickering natural edge highlights and layered moving shadows on the hands, torso, and table. TABLE RIBBON SPREAD AND PROGRESSIVE TURNOVER Strictly reference the uploaded “展牌” video for the movement only. Use an overhead 90-degree top-down view. The frame contains only both hands and the full ribbon spread on the green felt table. The protagonist spreads the deck smoothly into one long evenly spaced ribbon with card backs facing upward, then progressively turns the entire ribbon over from one end to the other with a continuous finger motion, revealing the card faces in sequence. Preserve the reference movement direction, spreading speed, card spacing, ribbon length, turnover rhythm, and finish. The camera remains completely static. The overhead spotlight creates a soft oval pool of light across the center of the table, with fine contact shadows between the cards and a traveling hand shadow moving along the ribbon during the turnover. Multiple one-handed cuts in rapid succession, the silver ring flashing with every movement. Wide shot of him seated at the card table with the dark casino behind him, alternating with tight close-ups of his hands and a sharp side profile. He suddenly launches the entire deck high into the air. The cards explode upward, spinning rapidly and catching the overhead light. HERO MOMENT. The instant the cards reach their highest point, time slows dramatically into a bullet-time effect. The camera orbits around him as hundreds of cards hang suspended in mid-air, rotating slowly under the light. He remains completely still, then turns his eyes directly toward the camera for the first time—cold, controlled, unflinching. Time suddenly accelerates again and the cards begin falling rapidly around him. Without looking away from the camera, he reaches into the collapsing cloud of cards and cleanly catches a single card between two fingers. All remaining cards fall onto the table. Close-up: he slowly turns the captured card toward the camera—the seven of clubs. Faintest smile. Cut to black. Jazz fades into AND EDITING RULES: Each action must be fully completed before the next cut. Use clean hard cuts only. No dissolves, no morphing transitions, no flash transitions, no AI-style warping, and no continuous blending between different actions. Every new shot begins with the hands and deck already in the correct starting pose for that action. Do not visibly transform one grip into another on screen. AUDIO: It should remain subtle and never overpower the card sounds. Every action must have synchronized, realistic card audio: friction, sliding, snapping, dropping, spreading, flipping, flying, and not generate background music for the entire video except for SFX. VISUAL STYLE: Ultra-realistic live-action cinema. Real actor, real casino environment, real card material, real hand structure, and physically believable movement. Skin must show natural pores, slight tonal unevenness, knuckle creases, and realistic tension in the fingers. Cards must have believable thickness, slight edge wear, realistic flexibility, and consistent physical inertia. Use restrained exposure, soft highlight roll-off, deep layered shadows, realistic focus transitions, subtle sensor noise, and natural motion blur.
