entries.title: Japanese Inspired Psychedelic Abstract Animation
entries.description: A complex multi-stage prompt for creating a fast-paced, vivid, and hand-drawn psychedelic abstract animation with fluid transitions and organic textures.
entries.prompt: Japanese-inspired psychedelic abstract animation Core Style: Fast, vivid, unstable. Fully hand-drawn with rich organic textures. Every transition is fluid and natural—never rigid or mechanically cut. The entire frame, including the background, remains in constant motion, driven simultaneously by emotion, gravity, and heat. Every frame should feel alive, unpredictable, and physically reactive. [0–7.5s: Origin and Chain Reaction] [0–1.5s] A central abstract figure erupts into violent motion. Its emotional color core radiates outward as irregular pulsating waves while its silhouette tears apart in multiple directions. The background bends around the figure like compressed soft paper. Fine hand-drawn textures crawl rapidly across the entire frame, moving significantly faster than the figure itself, creating intense tension between body, skin, and surface. [1.5–3s] The separated contours accelerate into nervous linear forms. The figure's colorful core stretches into sharp ribbons and liquid stains. Some ribbons snap backward while others whip violently forward, leaving trembling trails behind. Empty spaces between movements ignite into new forms that emerge to fill emotional voids. [3–4.5s] Every shape surges diagonally across the composition. One massive form folds like fabric, revealing layered textures of grain, chalk, wet ink, scratched paint, and rough pigment beneath its surface. The background folds together with it, twisting into entirely new color fields. Smaller forms are dragged into constantly evolving speed lines. [4.5–6s] The image fractures into four emotional forces: calm, violence, vulnerability, and ecstasy. Each absorbs color from the others. Shadows appear before their objects, behaving like prophecies. The original forms chase these shadows, but the shadows mutate faster—becoming brighter, thicker, and more dominant until they surpass the objects themselves. [6–7.5s] A rapid chain reaction begins. Colliding forms generate visual motifs derived from the reference imagery: fragments, symbols, silhouettes, stains, and expressive linework. These newly born motifs accelerate in different directions. Frozen traces solidify into new entities before melting again and splitting into tiny emotional echoes. --- [7.5–15s: Compression and Extreme Transformation] [7.5–9s] The entire frame collapses toward an invisible point beneath the center. Every visual layer compresses inward at a different speed. Maximum compression lasts for only one frame before exploding upward and outward with vertical smears, shaking outlines, and exaggerated overshoot motion. Every element vibrates before settling into a completely new position. [9–10.5s] Textures migrate between forms. Dry rough textures sharpen previously fluid shapes into angular structures. Liquid textures soften rigid forms until they sag and drip. Luminous colorful textures dissolve into the background, causing the environment itself to pulse rhythmically. Every object changes behavior according to the texture it inherits. [10.5–12s] A massive rotational force sweeps across the frame. Every form flips, inverts, or turns inside out, exposing hidden reverse sides possessing qualities of hands, hooks, flames, or waves. Every collision triggers escalating chain reactions, transforming the entire visual world into an entirely new emotional reality. [12–13.5s] All boundaries dissolve. Forms merge, repel, and merge again, generating hybrid entities that inherit the colors and movement of their predecessors while becoming completely different beings. The background pushes forward into the foreground, becoming part of the forms themselves while releasing new shapes from within. [13.5–15s] Every previous process returns simultaneously at maximum intensity: contour separation, color bleeding, texture migration, and shadow-leading motion. Every frame is densely packed with intentional visual impact, fully absorbing and reinterpreting every reference element introduced earlier. --- [15–22.5s: Fragmentation and Neurotic Storm] [15–16.5s] The storm collides with an invisible barrier. The center explodes into countless shards of water-covered broken glass. Within each fragment, glowing spiral irises rotate violently, generating centrifugal force that stretches and tears at the shard edges. Neon magenta and electric blue leak through every crack. [16.5–18s] The fragments fuse into overlapping collaged human faces. The faces are composed of purple stains, scratched paint, and rough pigment. Their expressions oscillate continuously between terror and ecstasy. Jagged lightning-like lines pierce through them like exposed nerve fibers, violently stitching the faces together. [18–19.5s] Color saturation reaches its peak. Electric blue lines solidify into physical cables stretching throughout space, twitching uncontrollably while releasing neon magenta sparks. The compressed paper background burns away, transforming into a charred, granular carbon-black surface. [19.5–21s] Gravity reverses. Liquid elements such as water droplets and wet ink surge upward while broken glass continues falling downward, producing intense visual tearing. Vertical smears appear along the edges of the frame as though an unseen force is physically wiping the entire animation off the canvas. [21–22.5s] Every form is pulled into countless miniature spiral-iris black holes. The irises rapidly expand until they dominate the entire screen, spinning at an increasingly suffocating speed. The rough tactile quality of chalk and dry brush textures contrasts violently against the brilliant electrical center, creating overwhelming sensory overload. --- [22.5–30s: Aftershock and Eternal Echo] [22.5–24s] The giant iris evolves into pulsating biological tissue. The image breathes with a neurotic rhythm. Hidden symbols and textures appear and disappear beneath muscular contractions. Paint seepage creates convincing depth, as though layered across multiple transparent sheets of film. [24–25.5s] The animation enters an intense high-frequency vibration. Every object freezes in place while its edges oscillate violently like strings stretched to their breaking point. Violet shadows crawl across every surface, attempting to consume the remaining light. [25.5–27s] Rainbow-colored glass fragments and water droplets sweep across the frame like rain, refracting and distorting everything behind them through lens-like optical effects. Colors become heavy fluid masses that sink downward, leaving behind anxious, restless linear marks. [27–28.5s] The entire composition collapses into a single glowing horizontal jagged line. The background becomes a dark neon field filled with coarse grain. The line contains all accumulated energy, twisting violently while alternating flashes of electric blue and neon magenta pulse across it. [28.5–30s] The glowing line disintegrates into hand-drawn dust particles that drift rhythmically across the screen before gradually reassembling into one enormous blurred luminous silhouette. The final frame ends with tiny blocks of color continuing to vibrate subtly, leaving behind an everlasting emotional aftershock.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Lost Pyramid Civilization
entries.description: A cinematic sci-fi fantasy prompt depicting an ancient pyramid civilization integrated with futuristic technology, featuring a misty rainforest setting and a blue energy portal.
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic sci-fi fantasy scene of a lost pyramid civilization hidden within a vast misty rainforest. A colossal stepped pyramid, ancient stone temples, towering obelisks, waterfalls, rivers with boats, lush jungle, and crowds of people blend seamlessly with futuristic grounded spacecraft, giant bipedal mechs, and a glowing blue energy portal inside the pyramid. Begin with a wide aerial flyover, then smoothly push toward the grand pyramid entrance as golden-hour sunlight filters through the mist, contrasting with the portal's vibrant blue glow. End by flying into the radiant portal, fading to white, with an epic orchestral soundtrack and powerful choral atmosphere.

entries.title: Stealth Fighter Jet Missile Evasion
entries.description: An intense aerial combat sequence prompt depicting a stealth fighter jet performing evasive maneuvers against a surface-to-air missile.
entries.prompt: Opens with a low-angle view of a modern stealth fighter jet soaring through partly cloudy bright blue sky, banking sharply. Cut to a close-up of a ground-based air defense radar locking on, followed by a rapid cut to a missile battery firing—bright orange fire and thick white smoke erupting as a supersonic surface-to-air missile blasts off. The camera tracks the missile arcing upward at high speed, then cuts back to the jet’s cockpit warning lights flashing red. The missile streaks toward the target with a bright glowing exhaust trail, heat haze rippling around it, as the jet jinks and deploys flares in a desperate evasive maneuver. Intense dramatic lighting, sharp motion blur, authentic military sound atmosphere implied, epic and tense combat atmosphere.

entries.title: Mecha Front Commercial Ad
entries.description: A 15-second horizontal sci-fi commercial prompt comparing MiniMax H3 and Seedance 2.0, featuring a mecha suit in a futuristic hangar with UI overlays.
entries.prompt:
生成一支15秒16:9横版科幻机甲手游新赛季商业广告。
虚构游戏品牌 MECHA FRONT，主角是银白与深蓝配色的限定机甲 AETHER-07，机体外形、装甲结构和配色在全片保持一致。
画面只允许出现以下文字，且必须拼写完全正确，MECHA FRONT、AETHER-07、限定机甲、攻击 920、机动 88、现在解锁。 
 0至4秒，黑色未来机库中，一束冷白顶光依次扫过机甲头部、胸甲与机械关节，镜头从低机位快速推进，完整机体从黑暗中亮起，MECHA FRONT 与 AETHER-07 清晰出现。  
4至10秒，机甲在原地缓慢转身，半透明蓝色游戏 UI 围绕机体依次展开。左侧显示限定机甲，右侧准确显示攻击 920 与机动 88，三枚无文字技能图标顺序点亮。UI 不能遮挡机甲主体，机甲造型不得变化。  
10至15秒，UI 卡片沿轨迹收拢，机甲完成半周转身后正面定格。背景形成蓝白能量环，结尾只保留 MECHA FRONT、AETHER-07 与现在解锁，所有文字完整可读。  
整体采用顶级 3A 游戏 CG 宣传片与新品发布广告质感，冷黑、银白、电光蓝配色，金属材质真实，轮廓光锐利，镜头运动干净有力量。
不要人物，不要战斗剧情，不要爆炸，不要新增文字，不要乱码，不要水印。原创声音使用低频机械启动、UI 点击和克制的电子鼓点，结尾一记厚重机械锁定音。

entries.prompt:
【生成模式】

Seedance 2.0 Fast

【视频规格】

严格生成 15 秒视频，16:9 横屏，三个干净清晰的镜头。

【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，采用经典冒险电影式视觉误导、默片式冷面节奏、暴风雨海岸氛围、克制人物表演、清楚的前后景空间调度，以及由摄影机运动推动的尺度揭示；喜剧来源于两位角色以过度严肃的英雄姿态处理一个无害物体，并在结尾追加第二次视觉反转。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙女性

使用 @图片 1 作为角色 ID A 的严格身份参考：同一个 25–30 岁东亚剑仙女性，椭圆脸、自然白皙皮肤、锐利深棕色眼睛、黑色长直发、高挑纤细身材，穿白色布靴、飘动的白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、银色腰饰，佩戴玉簪并携带银色长剑。

角色 ID B｜单车女性

使用 @图片 2 作为角色 ID B 的严格身份参考：同一个 25–30 岁东亚单车女性，圆润而富有表情的脸、棕色短马尾、黄色防风外套、蓝色牛仔裤、白色运动鞋、黑色头盔和同一辆自行车。

【核心道具】

同一柄银色长剑、同一辆自行车、一条红色长绳、一只巨型充气龙风筝，以及一只体积更大的粉色小猪风筝。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景】

傍晚狂风中的海边楼顶，湿润混凝土地面、金属护栏、被风扯动的警示带、远处高楼、黑色云层、海雾和猛烈阵风共同建立环境。

一条巨大的黑色飞龙轮廓在城市天际线上方疯狂挣扎，雷电照亮它展开的双翼，并传来低沉咆哮。

角色 A 从鞋到头完整入镜，拔出银色长剑；角色 B 在她身旁稳住自行车，两人神情凝重地仰头观察。

摄影机缓慢稳定推近；配雷声、衣料拍打声、车链轻响和低沉管弦鼓点。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景侧面跟拍】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙女性将同一柄银色长剑射向空中，同一个穿黄色防风外套的单车女性快速踩动同一辆自行车，绷紧一条连接 “飞龙” 的红色长绳。

同一个楼顶、统一风向、金属护栏、红绳 and 城市天际线始终保持一致。

银色长剑准确勾住怪物翅膀上的绳圈；两人同时发力向后拉，白色布靴和自行车轮胎在湿润地面上真实滑动，巨龙逐渐下降。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜揭示特写进入极近特写】

摄影机跟随坠落的怪物移动，随后快速升高并向后拉开，揭露所谓 “巨龙” 其实是一只缠在楼顶天线上的巨型充气龙风筝。

同样两位女性小心将风筝放到地面，同时松了一口气。

画外传来小孩声音：“阿姨，我的是粉色小猪！”

两人缓慢转头。

焦点转移到她们身后，一只体积更大的粉色小猪风筝正随风越飘越远。

极近特写两人同步变得呆滞的表情；银色长剑默默自动回到剑鞘。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，三个镜头，物体运动轨迹连贯，人物面部与服装稳定，强风、绳索张力、湿润地面、风筝面料、头发和真丝衣料物理效果真实，原生同步生成普通话对白与空间声音，不生成画面字幕。

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

entries.title: Dark Fantasy Dragon Rider Sequence
entries.description: A detailed cinematic sequence featuring an ancient dragon and an armored rider inside a mountain cave, focusing on consistent character design across multiple shots.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic dark-fantasy sequence in 16:9 widescreen. The video must contain exactly three clearly separated cinematic shots connected by clean hard cuts. No dissolves, morphing transitions or continuous camera orbit. MASTER DRAGON LOCK: Show one enormous ancient dragon with a broad powerful body, charcoal-black overlapping scales, subtle dark crimson colouring across its head and neck, two swept-back horns, smaller facial spikes, glowing amber-orange eyes, one long tail and one pair of enormous bat-like wings with dark leathery membranes. The dragon has four legs: two forelegs and two hind legs. Its design, size, horns, colour, anatomy and facial structure remain identical in all three shots. The dragon must feel extremely heavy, ancient and physically realistic. MASTER RIDER LOCK: One adult armoured rider is already seated securely in a dark leather saddle on the dragon from the very first frame. The rider wears detailed weathered silver plate armour, dark under-clothing, a fitted medieval helmet with a narrow shadowed visor and a long dark cloak. The rider’s face is never clearly visible. The rider holds leather reins connected to the saddle and remains seated throughout the entire sequence. The rider does not suddenly appear, mount, dismount or change clothing. During the first shot, the rider is naturally hidden behind the dragon’s large head, neck and folded wings. ENVIRONMENT AND LIGHTING: The sequence takes place inside a gigantic ancient mountain cave. The cave contains rough black rock walls, enormous stone formations, drifting mist, scattered bones and faint glowing embers between cracks in the ground. The far interior is almost black, but the dragon must remain readable through soft amber reflections and cold blue rim light entering from the cave mouth. The cave entrance opens from a high mountain cliff into a vast dramatic landscape of jagged mountains, deep valleys, distant waterfalls, rolling clouds and pale stormy daylight. Maintain a cinematic cold-blue and muted-amber colour palette with deep shadows, volumetric light rays and realistic atmospheric haze. Dark and mysterious, but never so underexposed that the dragon or rider becomes blurry or invisible. SHOT 1 — DRAGON EMERGES, 0–5 SECONDS: Begin with a symmetrical low frontal wide shot positioned near the cave entrance, facing deep into the darkness. The camera slowly tracks backward toward the entrance as the enormous dragon walks forward out of the black cave interior. The dragon’s wings remain completely folded against both sides of its body. Its glowing amber eyes appear first, followed by its horned head, shoulders and powerful forelegs becoming visible through the mist. Each heavy footstep shakes the cave floor and dislodges small stones and dust from the ceiling. The dragon exhales dense vapour from its nostrils and releases a deep restrained growl. Its head moves naturally with the weight of each step. The dragon looks directly past the camera toward the cave opening. The rider is already seated but remains hidden behind the dragon’s head and neck. Do not reveal the rider clearly during this shot. SHOT 2 — RIDER REVEAL, 5–9 SECONDS: Clean hard cut to a low three-quarter side tracking shot beside the moving dragon. Begin close to the dragon’s horned head and sharply detailed scales. Track smoothly backward along the dragon’s neck and folded wing while the dragon continues walking toward the cave entrance. As the camera reaches the dragon’s shoulder, reveal the single armoured rider seated in the saddle between the folded wings. Hold the composition long enough to clearly show the rider’s silver armour, helmet, dark cloak and both hands gripping the reins. The rider looks toward the bright cave exit and leans slightly forward in preparation for takeoff. The dragon and rider remain in continuous forward motion. Do not show a separate rider anywhere else in the cave. SHOT 3 — REAR TAKEOFF AND FLIGHT, 9–15 SECONDS: Clean hard cut to an epic wide rear view positioned behind and slightly above the dragon and rider. The bright cave mouth and vast mountain landscape fill the background ahead of them. The dragon accelerates into a powerful run toward the cave opening while its wings remain folded enough to pass safely through the cave. The dragon reaches the cliff edge and makes one forceful leap completely out of the cave. Only after clearing the rock opening, it spreads both enormous wings to their full symmetrical width. The sudden wing expansion pushes mist, dust and loose stones outward from the cave entrance. The rider leans forward, grips the reins and remains firmly attached to the saddle. The dragon performs one enormous downward wingbeat, catches the air and transitions naturally into stable forward flight. Loose stones fall from the cliff beneath it. The camera rapidly follows from behind as the dragon and rider soar away over the deep valley between jagged mountain peaks. The long tail streams naturally behind the dragon and the rider’s cloak whips in the wind. End on a majestic wide rear silhouette of the dragon flying into the open mountain landscape as sunlight breaks through the storm clouds. CAMERA AND MOTION: Premium cinematic camera movement with realistic scale and parallax. Shot one is a controlled backward dolly. Shot two is a smooth low side-tracking reveal. Shot three is a dynamic rear pursuit shot that follows the takeoff out of the cave. Use natural motion blur only during the leap and wingbeat. Keep the dragon’s movement heavy on the ground and powerful but graceful in the air. No shaky chaotic framing and no extreme close-ups that obscure the action. CINEMATIC QUALITY: Big-budget photorealistic dark-fantasy visual effects, highly detailed scales and armour, realistic creature muscles beneath the skin, physically accurate wing membranes, believable foot contact, convincing dust and falling-rock physics, volumetric cave mist, dramatic rim lighting, strong depth, atmospheric perspective and stable character consistency. AUDIO: No dialogue and no music. Deep dragon breathing, restrained growl, heavy echoing footsteps, claws scraping stone, armour movement, leather saddle creaking, falling pebbles, rushing cave wind, powerful wingbeat and a deep dragon roar as it enters open air. STRICT CONSISTENCY: Exactly one dragon and one rider. The rider is seated on the dragon from the beginning and never disappears. No additional people, dragons or creatures. No dragon transformation or colour change. No extra heads, horns, tails, wings, legs or riders. The wings remain folded inside the cave and open only after the dragon has completely cleared the cave mouth. The wings must not clip through the cave walls. The rider must not float above the saddle or merge into the dragon. No fire breathing, combat, dialogue, text, logos, blood or visible injuries.

entries.prompt:
FORMAT
15 seconds | 16:9 | Live-action mountaineering survival drama
Fictional dramatization. Documentary-style visual realism.

SETTING
K2 during a summit push above Camp II.
Steep snow-covered ridge with exposed rock faces, fixed ropes, deep ice walls and extreme alpine terrain.
Altitude above 6,500 meters.
Time: early morning.
Thin air, sub-zero temperatures, powerful winds, drifting snow and distant mountain echoes.

CLIMBERS
A small expedition team of experienced high-altitude climbers ascending together on fixed ropes.

Maintain consistent climbing suits, helmets, harnesses, oxygen equipment, backpacks and character identities throughout the sequence.
Movement reflects realistic fatigue and the physical effects of extreme altitude.

STORY

00–04s — ESTABLISHING
Wide documentary shot reveals the climbing team carefully ascending a narrow exposed ridge above Camp II.
The immense slopes of K2 dominate the background while fixed ropes stretch upward into the clouds.
Snow blows continuously across the ridge.

04–08s — TENSION
Cut to a handheld perspective following directly behind the climbers.
Ice axes strike firmly into hard snow while crampons bite into the icy surface.
Heavy breathing is audible through oxygen masks.
One climber briefly looks uphill as subtle cracks appear in the snow above.

08–12s — CLASH
A massive slab avalanche suddenly fractures high above the ridge.
The snowfield collapses naturally before accelerating downhill.
Climbers instinctively attempt to anchor themselves to the fixed rope as a powerful wall of snow engulfs the ridge.
The camera is violently swept into the avalanche, tumbling with realistic momentum, rapidly alternating between snow, sky, ice and rock while visibility disappears beneath dense powder.
Avoid graphic injuries or gore.

12–15s — AFTERMATH
The camera lies partially buried beneath fresh snow, tilted toward the shattered ridge where pieces of rope and scattered climbing equipment remain visible.
Fine snow falls across the lens while distant wind echoes through the mountains.
End on unresolved tension.

CAMERA
Grounded expedition-documentary cinematography.

Natural handheld instability.
Realistic operator movement.
Plausible helmet-mounted and shoulder-level perspectives.
No impossible drone transitions.
No excessive slow motion.

LIGHTING
Lighting originates entirely from the natural alpine environment.

Cold early-morning sunlight diffuses through thin clouds and blowing snow.

PHYSICS
Real gravity and momentum.

Climbers remain physically attached to fixed ropes until realistic force overwhelms anchors.
Snow fractures, accelerates and behaves according to believable avalanche dynamics.
Loose snow responds naturally to wind.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE
Restrained, believable behaviour under extreme stress.

Heavy breathing from altitude.
Careful foot placement.
Constant balance corrections.
Natural communication through brief gestures and shor

星际飞船采用厚重可信的工业结构，主体为深灰金属、玉白色陶瓷装甲和暗红色结构线。船体轮廓具有克制的中式轴线对称、飞檐折线和龙脊般的纵向结构，但不是宫殿、宝塔或卡通龙造型。装甲表面分布细密机械舱门、散热片、微弱红色状态灯和若隐若现的抽象云纹压印。 摄影机贴近飞船外壳掠过船体顶部。大型装甲板、结构梁和散热格栅从镜头下方高速通过，运动方向始终连续。摄影机随后越过船体中轴，自然进入飞船后方视角。 最终画面中，巨型东方星际飞船尾部位于画面中心，多组圆形蓝白色离子引擎由内向外依次点火。发动机亮度迅速增强，冷蓝光反射在玉白陶瓷与深灰金属装甲表面。 飞船产生明确加速度，带着巨大质量感驶向深空. 摄影机逐渐停止追随，飞船越来越小，最终缩成远方红蓝星云前的一颗明亮光点。星际飞船消失后，星云轮廓短暂呈现出类似水墨山脉的自然层次，但仍保持真实宇宙影像质感。 【摄影与物理】 飞行物镜头使用29°至47°对角视场角，摄影机与主体保持稳定伴飞距离。主体始终位于画面中心并保持锐利，背景保留高速运动模糊和清楚的时代环境线索。 每种物体具有正确质量、惯性、空气阻力、旋转轴和材质反光：石块旋转不规则；石槌受木柄影响产生偏心旋转；长矛与弩箭沿长轴稳定；震天雷沉重且旋转较慢；神火飞鸦依靠尾部火箭保持姿态；战机、航天器和星际飞船依靠气动面或推进系统稳定飞行。 匹配剪辑只发生在主体经过画面中心、轮廓短暂重叠或旋转至相同角度的瞬间。每次变化都是干净利落的一帧MATCH CUT，不是渐变、融化或零件生长。飞行方向、视觉中心和总体动量始终连续。 【声音】 只生成画面内自然音效：女侠发力时的短促呼气、鞋底摩擦、衣料与发带破风声、手臂挥动声、石块和石槌划破空气的呼啸、青铜矛头的低沉风鸣、弩箭尾羽振动、火箭矢燃烧声、震天雷引线火花、远处爆炸、神火飞鸦火箭喷射、战斗机喷气发动机、航天器推进器轰鸣，以及星际引擎逐级充能和点火声。 声音随时代升级逐渐由原始风声和金属声，发展为火药爆燃、喷气轰鸣 and 深沉的星际推进器低频震动。无旁白、无对白、无背景音乐。 【写实后缀】 真实电影级运动物理，细腻材质，稳定主体一致性，准确匹配剪辑，真实景深和速度模糊。中国古代女侠面部自然真实，身体结构正确，投掷动作具有明确的脚步支撑、腰部扭转、肩臂传力和释放惯性。 禁止古代女侠变脸、手指异常、服装穿模或宽大袖子缠绕手臂；禁止武器漂浮、橡胶变形、突然减速、反向飞行或改变轨迹；禁止渐变变形、粒子重组和魔法光效；禁止把神火飞鸦生成真实乌鸦；禁止把星际飞船生成宫殿、宝塔或卡通巨龙。 画面内不出现文字、字幕、标志、水印或UI。各时代环境连续升级，飞行主体的方向、视觉中心、旋转节奏和动量始终保持一致。

entries.prompt: A photorealistic smartphone selfie vlog that looks exactly like a real mobile phone recording. A young woman (image = her face and hair) is exploring a lively shopping street in Japan on a bright afternoon, filming herself in selfie mode with natural handheld movement, subtle hand shake, realistic autofocus, authentic smartphone stabilization, and true-to-life colors. She smiles at the camera and says, "Let's see what we find today!" As she walks through the busy street, she suddenly hears live music and turns the camera to reveal a talented Japanese street musician playing an acoustic guitar while a small crowd gathers around. Curious, she walks closer, stands quietly for a few moments, gently sways to the music, and smiles with genuine enjoyment. She continues walking through the street, gives a warm wave to the camera, smiles brightly, and says, "See you in my next vlog. Bye!" before reaching toward the phone to stop the recording. The video should feel exactly like a genuine smartphone vlog with natural human movement, consistent facial features, authentic Japanese street atmosphere, realistic crowd behavior, no beauty filters, no CGI, no AI-plastic appearance, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, and no background music—only real street ambience, conversations, footsteps, applause, and the live acoustic performance as part of the environment.

entries.title: Ancient Style Fashion Outfit Swap
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt for a traditional Chinese fashion catalog style, featuring a character who changes outfits through flying 'stickers' in a seamless studio setting.
entries.prompt:
【整体风格】

大师级电影写实风格结合精致古风时装画册美学，写实真人，严格参考上传图片，场景为浅灰白无缝无影棚，背景与地面自然连成一体，采用柔和通透的前上方漫射光，保留细腻肤质与轻盈半透明面料质感，镜头为 9:16 竖屏固定高机位前方俯拍，向下约 30–35 度。

【主体设定】

一位 20–24 岁的东亚年轻女子，身形修长匀称、气质清冷温婉，鹅蛋脸，冷白肤色，大杏眼，平直眉，小巧鼻尖，柔和粉唇，黑色古风长发，半盘发造型，银色花簪头饰，珍珠垂坠耳饰。

初始造型为同一位女子身穿白色外披大袖袍、蓝色绣纹交领内层、浅蓝色长裙，腰间银色腰饰与流苏，裙摆向画面下方展开。

【固定贴纸设定】

画面四周全程固定悬浮四个完整人物贴纸，均为真实身体轮廓抠像并带清晰白色虚线描边，绝不是矩形缩略图：

左上为白色上衣 + 浅蓝色百褶长裙 + 蓝色腰带
右上为白色内搭 + 蓝色无袖马甲式长裙并带银色绣纹
左侧中部为浅蓝色内裙 + 深蓝色交领层次 + 白色外披长袖袍
左下为浅灰紫色外披 + 米白色内搭 + 深蓝色绣纹下裙

【镜头段落 1｜0.00–2.95 秒】

同一位女子穿初始造型，从画面下方偏右轻缓靠近镜头，身体微微前倾，宽大袖摆与裙摆自然轻摆，抬眼看向高机位镜头；

一个白色手形鼠标指针点击左上贴纸，复制出一个相同的完整人物贴纸，从左上斜向飞向中央并迅速放大，放大过程中白色虚线描边始终紧贴人物轮廓，约 1.25 秒时与头部、肩膀、腰部和动作姿势完全重合，中央同一位女子无缝换装成左上白衣浅蓝长裙造型并继续原来的靠近动作；

随后她一只手自然落在腰前，另一只手轻提袖口，带淡淡微笑，向左缓慢转身，逐渐露出侧面与半背面，发丝与头饰轻轻摆动。

【镜头段落 2｜2.95–5.40 秒】

白色鼠标点击右上贴纸，复制出的完整人物贴纸从右上斜向飞入中央，约 2.95 秒时同一位女子切换成白色内搭 + 蓝色无袖马甲式长裙，背景始终保持同一浅灰白无影棚，四个原始贴纸人物也始终固定保留；

同一位女子继续同一个转身方向，随后转回正面，衣摆与发丝自然回落，身体短促下沉，双臂轻微向两侧展开，让袖摆自然打开，然后鼠标点击左侧中部贴纸，该贴纸复制体从左侧飞向中央，约 4.40 秒时同一位女子无缝换装成浅蓝内裙 + 深蓝交领层次 + 白色外披长袖袍，脸部、发型、头饰、耳饰和身材比例完全一致。

【镜头段落 3｜5.40–8.00 秒】

同一位女子双手收于身前，低头轻摆肩膀，连续左右自然歪头，随后抬眼看向镜头，再将视线转向左下贴纸人物；

鼠标点击左下贴纸，复制出的完整人物抠像从左下斜向右上飞入中央并快速放大，约 6.55 秒时与中央人物完美重合，完成第四次换装，变为浅灰紫外披 + 米白内搭 + 深蓝绣纹下裙；

接着她一只手轻扶衣襟，另一只手自然垂落，先看向侧面，再转回正面，自然歪头，抬眼直视高处镜头，以优雅、清冷、强古风感的姿态结束，长袖与裙摆在结尾轻微自然垂落。

【换装时间点】

四次换装卡点严格落在：

1.25 秒
2.95 秒
4.40 秒
6.55 秒

【技术要求】

全程固定机位，不推拉、不摇镜、不俯仰、不旋转、不变焦；

换装必须仅由完整人物贴纸飞入、放大、重合实现，不能出现单独衣服飞入、人物残影、双重人物、服装叠穿；

声音仅保留鼠标点击声、贴纸飞入时的短促移动音效、换装完成时清晰利落的卡点音效，以及轻微衣料摩擦声，不要背景音乐。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

entries.title: Glitch Mirror DNA Transformation
entries.description: A cinematic video sequence featuring a woman in front of a mirror with multiple visual glitch effects, including a DNA helix and voxel cubes.
entries.prompt: Medium shot, vertical framing. A beautiful young woman stands in front of a tall mirror in a dimly lit room. Her reflection is perfectly clear and sharp - every detail of her face is visible. She stares into the mirror, completely still. First glitch - A glowing DNA double helix materializes inside the mirrors reflection. It slowly rotates and spirals across her face, as if projected from behind the glass. The strands tangle and untangle while her features remain visible underneath. Second glitch - Her reflection suddenly breaks apart into 8-bit voxel cubes. The small pixelated blocks scatter outward from the center of her face, float in the air for a moment, then snap back together to reform her image perfectly. Third glitch - A chromatic color wave sweeps across the reflection. Random patches of her face shift between intense red and cyan with RGB color splitting. The background behind her begins to ripple and warp like a damaged CRT screen, while yellow and blue geometric particles - thin triangles and lines - flash and strobe across the frame. Throughout the glitches, the real woman remains completely calm and unaffected, staring into the mirror. Cinematic lighting, smooth motion, high quality.

entries.title: Realistic Handheld Travel Vlog
entries.description: A long-form video prompt for Seedance 2.5 designed to generate a realistic handheld travel vlog from an apartment to a beach.
entries.prompt: A realistic handheld travel vlog filmed by a friend following the main character throughout the day. Use the woman from the reference image as the main subject. Maintain her exact facial identity, hairstyle, facial features, and body proportions throughout the entire video. The camera feels like a real personal vlog camera, not a commercial production. Natural handheld movement, casual framing, imperfect human camera motion, authentic everyday atmosphere. No scripted acting. The woman behaves naturally, interacting with the environment like a real travel vlog. 0-5s: Morning departure. The woman leaves a cozy apartment with a small backpack. She checks her phone, smiles at the camera, adjusts her hair, and starts walking outside. The camera follows her from behind, slightly shaky like a friend filming. Morning sunlight, quiet neighborhood streets, people starting their day. 5-12s: Exploring the city. The camera follows her walking through local streets. She visits a small cafe, buys a drink, briefly talks to the camera, laughs naturally. She walks through a street market, looks at small shops, takes casual photos. The camera stays close, capturing spontaneous moments. 12-20s: Arriving at the beach. She takes public transportation or walks toward the coast. The environment gradually changes from city streets to a seaside town. Ocean breeze moves her hair. She looks excited when she sees the ocean. The camera follows her walking along the beach. She picks up a seashell, watches waves, and interacts naturally with people nearby. 20-27s: Summer beach afternoon. She meets friends at the beach. Everyone chats, laughs, plays near the water. The camera moves naturally between people, capturing real candid moments. She looks back at the camera and smiles. 27-30s: Ending moment. Golden hour sunset. She sits near the ocean, holding a drink, watching the sunset. The camera slowly moves backward, revealing the beach, waves, and the peaceful evening. A feeling of a real personal travel memory. Visual style: Authentic travel vlog footage. Realistic smartphone or mirrorless camera look. Natural daylight. Casual handheld movement. Slight camera shake. Real human reactions. Documentary realism. No cinematic commercial look. No dramatic posing. No artificial transitions. No text overlays. No logos. No face changes. No identity changes.

entries.title: Sakuga Style Anime Arena Fight
entries.description: A complex multi-shot prompt for a 2D hand-drawn anime battle in a shattered arena, featuring stylized effects and specific character designs.
entries.prompt: Multi-shot (7 shots). TSUBAME (Spear Girl) — 17, lean and small, sharp jawline, short black bob with long straight bangs, fierce dark-teal eyes; sleeveless white gi top with teal trim, black shorts, bandaged forearms and shins, split-toe boots; carries a two-meter spear with a slim leaf-blade head — the spearhead and her motion trails read cyan. GARAN (Brawler) — huge, over two meters, slab-muscled, shaved head, heavy brow, small pale eyes; bare-chested with a cracked stone-grey harness strap, massive taped fists, canvas trousers, iron-shod boots. Every slab he rips from the floor glows ember-orange in its tear-lines, and orange dust light clings to his hands. Style: 2D hand-drawn cel animation, film-grade sakuga action. Clear line art, flat cel shading with hard shadow boundaries; non-photoreal — no pore-level skin, no 3D volumetric render feel. Fighter colors LOCKED: Tsubame = cyan (spear-tip glint, afterimage trails, speed-lines), Garan = ember-orange (molten glow in every floor tear, rubble rim-light). All glows two-tone — white-hot core, saturated colored rim, trailing dust and embers that linger after each impact. World: desaturated slate-grey shattered arena with a huge faded mosaic emblem in the floor, so both hues detonate off it. The nearest glow is the key light — cyan rim on her, orange bounce on him and the rock. Bold corner-to-corner diagonals on action; fast beats drawn as key poses, smear frames, and impact frames — never continuous legible travel. Real mass everywhere: slabs are tons, not props. Camera: animation camerawork — snap-zooms, speed-lines, orbits, held frames, hit-stops all allowed. ⚠️This video has STRICTLY 7 shots — do not add extra shots. ⚠️SPATIAL LAYOUT (MAIN VIEW = from the SOUTH side, top-down axis west–east; screen-left = west, screen-right = east): Tsubame starts at the west edge facing east (screen-right, toward Garan); Garan stands ~18m east of her, facing west (screen-left, toward her). Her vault path travels west→east, rising diagonally toward the upper frame as she climbs the airborne chunks. 180° LINE: camera stays on the south side all clip — Tsubame on screen-left, Garan on screen-right, no swapping. ⚠️ACTION VECTORS: (V1, SHOT 2) Garan hurls a car-sized slab two-handed, east→west (screen right→left), at Tsubame's center mass — she slides flat under it; it detonates on the floor west of her. (V2, SHOT 3) Garan's right-arm sweep flings a fan of rubble east→west — she runs into it and vaults the chunks. (V4, SHOT 5) Garan's right backhand sweeps east→west at her head as she reaches the fourth chunk — she plants the spear in the chunk and corkscrews around the shaft past the fist; one shard grazes her LEFT cheek. (V5, SHOT 7) Tsubame's spear thrust travels west→east (screen left→right) through the center of his final slab into Garan's crossed-forearm guard at chest height — he is driven east, heels carving trenches. ⚠️Continuity across cuts: designs, colors, and arena damage stay identical and only progress, never reset — the left-cheek cut appears in SHOT 5 and persists bleeding a thin line through SHOTS 6–7; rubble and craters only accumulate. [SHOT 1] · Anticipation (~2s): scale-wide, static with a slow drift — two tiny figures on the vast cracked mosaic. Garan RIPS a car-sized slab out of the floor, orange light flaring in the tear-lines, and shoulders it; across the arena Tsubame drops low, spear leveled flat, one toe carving the dust. Her breathing is even; his grin is wide. entries.title: Scientific Documentary Research Interview
entries.description: A professional documentary-style prompt capturing a scientist preparing for an interview in a laboratory, emphasizing realistic human behavior and camera language.
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic 15-second observational documentary interview inside a modern scientific research laboratory. The video should feel like authentic behind-the-scenes footage captured by a professional documentary crew, emphasizing realism, subtlety, and natural human behavior. A brilliant female scientist with dark hair tied in a relaxed low bun, thin black rectangular glasses, and a dark blazer over a neutral shirt prepares for an important interview. Preserve her exact facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and accessories throughout the entire sequence. Authentic skin texture, natural imperfections, and realistic facial details. 0–3 seconds: A locked eye-level 50mm interview shot. She quietly enters frame, gently pulls out a stool, sits down, smooths her blazer, adjusts the lavalier microphone cable, and takes a calm breath. Every movement is slow, deliberate, and naturally timed. 3–7 seconds: She straightens her posture, lightly rolls her shoulders back, adjusts her glasses with one finger, folds her hands in her lap, briefly looks downward, then settles into complete stillness. Small blinks, subtle breathing, and realistic micro-expressions only. 7–11 seconds: Cut to a reverse over-the-shoulder angle revealing the filming environment. A large soft light, camera tripod, monitor cart, microphones, and scientific equipment are visible in the softly lit laboratory. She remains composed and motionless while the camera quietly observes. 11–15 seconds: Return to the original interview framing with an almost imperceptible slow push-in. She takes one controlled breath, slowly raises her eyes to the lens, maintains unwavering eye contact, gives the slightest confident expression, and quietly says, "Alright. I'm ready." Hold on her gaze until the final frame. Lighting is soft, natural, and motivated by practical sources with cool laboratory ambience. Neutral color palette, realistic exposure, natural depth of field, subtle handheld micro-vibrations, and authentic documentary camera language. Audio consists only of natural room ambience: ventilation hum, distant equipment fans, fabric movement, stool scrape, microphone handling, subtle breathing, and clean close-recorded dialogue. No background music.

entries.title: Inferno Hot-Rod Ambush
entries.description: An aggressive, hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence featuring a futuristic armored hot-rod escaping an ambush in a fiery lava wasteland.
entries.prompt:
Inferno Hot-Rod Ambush  Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.  One futuristic armored hot-rod is the main subject. It is ultra pimped out, low and aggressive, with heavy plated bodywork, hidden weapon mounts, integrated twin gun turrets, side-mounted machine guns, exposed pistons, heat vents, exhaust stacks, riveted metal panels, enclosed cockpit with bulletproof canopy glass, flame decals, and deep orange, red, matte black, and white markings. The setting is a bleak fiery wasteland with cracked lava ground, ruined industrial structures, dust, smoke, and a stormy orange-red sky.  The goal is simple: the hot-rod must blast through a deadly ambush and escape the collapsing road.  The action starts with the hot-rod roaring across the lava-cracked wasteland at high speed, tires throwing sparks and dust. Heat shimmer rises from the ground. As it races past the ruins of an old industrial refinery, a hidden mechanical roadblock suddenly erupts out of the ground ahead, and automated gun towers unfold from the wreckage on both sides.  The hot-rod swerves hard into a violent powerslide as the first shots tear across the road. Hidden twin gun turrets rise from the bodywork and fire back. Side-mounted machine guns erupt in short bursts, blasting one gun tower apart in sparks and metal. 

The car straightens, rockets forward, then the lava-cracked road begins splitting open in front of it.  Now the set piece escalates. A huge slab of roadway collapses into a glowing lava fissure. The hot-rod hits full throttle, jumps the broken section, lands hard, and smashes through the mechanical roadblock while fire, debris, and broken metal explode around it. One side panel scrapes sparks off the wreckage, but the car keeps charging forward.  At the end, the hot-rod bursts clear of the ambush zone and powers through smoke and ember glow while the ruined refinery behind erupts in secondary explosions and the cracked lava road continues collapsing.  

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense, aggressive, dark and moody, award-winning automotive editorial feel, dramatic three-quarter low-angle energy, clear readable action, one hero vehicle only, no extra hero cars, the hot-rod must remain the star, sleek armored dieselpunk military engineering, flaming wasteland atmosphere, smoke, embers, heavy shadows, subtle reflections on dusty or heated surfaces, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no famous driver face, no celebrity resemblance. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

entries.title: Savanna FPV Drone Cheetah Hunt
entries.description: An intense, high-speed FPV drone shot capturing a cheetah hunting an impala in the African savanna with realistic documentary-style camera effects.
entries.prompt:
One CONTINUOUS FPV drone shot, no cuts, one unbroken take, EXTREME real-time speed. The footage NEVER reverses or plays backward. NO slow motion except one half-second beat at the reveal, then an instant snap back to full speed. Photoreal point-blank FPV framing. GROUND LOCK: the animals stay on the ground at all times — NOTHING rises into the sky, ever. The camera flies LOW, at grass and knee height, its only altitude change one downward drop off the riverbank. NO ESCAPE, no fade to black — the take runs until time runs out, still inside the chaos.

CINEMATIC CAPTURE: real FPV drone footage — ultra-wide 14mm lens, barrel distortion, 180-degree shutter, heavy motion blur on fast pans, fine 35mm grain, lens flares off the low sun, dust and water hitting the lens. Golden-hour light under a bruised storm sky, one shaft of low gold raking the plain, a living savannah, herds and birds throughout. Grade: dry ochre and bleached gold, documentary contrast — the texture of a BBC nature documentary from a racing drone, NOT a game engine, NOT animation.

The shot opens ALREADY at full speed, skimming grass tips inches behind a sprinting cheetah at 110 km/h, claws throwing dirt at the lens. Ahead — seen ONLY from behind and flank, NEVER its face — an impala jinks hard right; the camera BANKS 90 degrees with it, tearing sideways through grass as guinea fowl burst around the lens. The impala zigzags; the camera snaps left, right, left with each cut, the cheetah's shoulder filling frame. Ahead a zebra herd grazes; the two tear into it and the herd EXPLODES — zebras rear, wheel and bolt in every direction, throwing a wall of dust. The camera stays LOW and threads THROUGH the stampede at knee height, swerving between hammering legs and striped bodies, dust raking the lens, then bursts out the far side back onto the cheetah's tail. Ahead a SHALLOW RIVER CHANNEL cuts the plain — muddy water, black mud. The impala plunges in; the camera drops VERTICALLY off the bank lip after it, out across the water, spray hitting the lens. THE ENTIRE CLIMAX HAPPENS HERE, IN THE WATER AND MUD — the channel never leaves frame. THE REVEAL: half-second slow motion — the cheetah at full stretch in its final lunge, low and flat over the shallows, claws out, seen from behind — then an INSTANT SNAP back to full speed. The paw hooks the flank at an angle; both crash sideways into the shallows, muddy water erupting, the camera driving THROUGH the splash, orbiting tight and low as they thrash, bodies soaked black. The jaws lock; the cheetah drags the kill through the mud, water streaming off its coat, the camera circling recklessly close. It plants its feet in the water over the body, flanks heaving with ragged open-mouthed panting, and lets rip a HIGH, PIERCING CHEETAH YOWL — a rasping chirp-scream breaking into a snarl and hiss, teeth bared, NO

entries.title: UFO Crash Forest Escape
entries.description: An intense sci-fi action sequence of an injured alien pilot escaping a burning UFO wreck in a dark forest under military searchlights.
entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic sci-fi action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect  ratio 16:9. 

Night in a dark dense forest. One damaged UFO crashes through the trees  and slams into the ground. One alien pilot only. The alien pilot is  injured but conscious and must escape the wreck before the ship  explodes. The environment is simple and clear: tall trees, mud, broken  branches, smoke, fire, flashing ship lights, and sweeping military  searchlights moving between the trunks from somewhere deeper in the  forest. 

The action starts with the UFO tearing through the trees and crashing  hard into the forest floor. Dirt, sparks, and broken wood explode  outward. The saucer skids to a stop at an angle, half-buried in mud,  with one side glowing and pulsing dangerously. A hatch blows open and the alien pilot crawls out of the wreck, weak and  unsteady. Behind the alien, the damaged UFO starts exploding in pulses,  not one giant explosion, but repeated bursts of fire, sparks, and  pressure from inside the hull. Each pulse throws debris outward and  lights up the forest. The alien tries to move into the trees, but military searchlights begin  sweeping through the forest and pass across the wreck. The alien ducks  behind a fallen log or tree root as another explosion pulse hits the  ship and a burning panel blasts into the woods nearby. 

The searchlights  keep moving closer through the smoke. Near the end, the UFO gives off a stronger pulse and starts breaking  apart. The alien makes one desperate move, limps or stumbles deeper into  the forest, and disappears behind thicker trees just as the ship erupts  in a larger final blast that lights the whole forest white for a  moment. End with the alien hidden in the darkness between the trees while the  wreck burns behind and searchlights continue sweeping through the smoke. 

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, dark, intense, clear readable action,  one alien pilot only, one crashed UFO only, one forest only, one clear  goal, crashing ship, pulsing explosions, smoke, fire, broken trees,  sweeping military searchlights, no extra soldiers on screen, no space  battle, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no famous  celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no  public-figure likenesses. entries.title: Frozen Time 1950s Diner Sequence
entries.description: A complex cinematic prompt for a 1950s diner scene that features time-freezing effects, dynamic orbital camera moves, and a liquid physics rewind.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic 1950s American diner, chrome stools, red vinyl, neon glow and checkerboard floor, shot with modern lived-in realism and soft natural window light. Subtle handheld texture, warm practicals, rich period detail, heavy film grain.
0-2s: [Medium Wide] A striking young woman sits alone at the counter, calmly sipping a milkshake. Behind her a waitress approaches with a tray of eggs, bacon and a coffee pot. An older lady starts rising from a nearby booth.
2-5s: [Dynamic Tracking] The older lady collides into the waitress. Tray, plate, eggs and coffee explode upward in slow motion liquid ribbons and suspended droplets. Camera orbits the impact. Time locks at the peak. Every face frozen in shock. Only the girl at the counter keeps moving, unfazed.
5-11s: [Slow 360° Orbital] Camera glides through the frozen diner. Coffee hangs as glassy ribbons, food floats weightlessly, patrons locked in startled expressions. The girl takes one slow sip, half-lidded eyes, while the frozen world reverses every droplet and person rewinding back to start.
11-13s: [Medium Shot] Rewind lands perfectly. Waitress stands balanced again. The girl raises two fingers, softly calls her name. Waitress turns just as the older lady begins to stand, avoiding collision. A tiny smile crosses the girl's face.
13-15s: [Extreme Close-Up] Hard cut to her face, one last slow sip, soft knowing smile, eyes almost closed. Shallow depth of field, creamy neon bokeh behind her.
Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fluid physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Alien Tunnel Rover Chase
entries.description: An intense cinematic sci-fi action prompt featuring a rover escaping a living, predatory alien tunnel.
entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic sci-fi action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.

Inside a living alien tunnel deep underground, one scout drives a small rugged rover through a glowing organic-mechanical passage. The tunnel is not just closing. It reacts like a predator. The walls pulse, ribs unfold, tendrils snap out, and the floor shifts under the rover like moving muscle and metal.

The goal is simple: the scout must survive the living tunnel and force a way out before the passage crushes the rover.
The action starts with the rover speeding through the tunnel as glowing ribs slam down behind it one by one.

Suddenly the floor rises under the front wheels and throws the rover sideways onto the tunnel wall. The scout fights the steering as the rover drives half on the wall, half on the floor, sparks scraping from the side.

A rib-like structure snaps across the path and hooks the rover’s rear frame. The rover is yanked backward for a second. The scout slams the emergency release, the rear cargo rack tears off, and the rover breaks free just before the rib crushes the detached rack flat.
The tunnel pulses harder. 

The passage ahead seals into a circular iris, leaving only a shrinking hole. The scout cannot simply drive through it. They fire a front-mounted anchor hook into the edge of the opening, the cable tightens, and the rover is dragged forward at violent speed. The vehicle bounces over shifting alien plates, clips the wall, loses one side panel, but stays moving.

At the last second, the scout hits the booster. The rover rockets through the closing iris as the living tunnel slams shut behind, clipping the rear bumper and ripping sparks into the air.

End with the damaged rover bursting out of the tunnel into a vast alien cavern, skidding sideways to a stop while the sealed tunnel mouth pulses behind like an angry living door.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, aggressive action, clear readable set pieces, one scout only, one rover only, one living alien tunnel only, no simple straight driving, tunnel must grab, throw, block, and damage the rover, wall-driving moment, rear cargo rack ripped away, anchor hook escape, shrinking iris exit, sparks, impacts, strong claustrophobic danger, no extra creatures, no extra vehicles, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no famous celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no public-figure likenesses, no clear facial close-ups. entries.title: First-Person Magic Combat Strike
entries.description: A gritty first-person perspective video prompt of a magic-user fighting guards and a giant boss in a muddy quarry using magnetic pulses.
entries.prompt: Strict first-person POV, male hero, face never visible. Visible only the hero’s hands, fingers, and forearms when needed for casting, dodging balance, and the final magnetic strike. Broad male hands, pronounced knuckles, short nails, pale or cool-toned skin, dark gray or black sleeves, thin geometric magic lines glowing cold white with a faint blue tint across the skin and wrists. The hands move with force, precision, and short controlled gestures, never soft or decorative. One continuous shot, no cuts, vertical cinematic dark fantasy, realistic body-driven camera motion, professional action cinematography with physical momentum and readable combat beats. In a vast abandoned stone quarry under a gray overcast sky, high rock walls, two dark mine tunnel arches in the background, old metal rails cutting through wet red-brown mud, overturned mine carts, scattered stones, chains, broken timber, iron scrap, discarded armor, and bodies of fallen guards. The space feels cold, damp, heavy, and dusty, with a steel-gray, dirty brown, graphite, and cold white palette. A squad of dark armored quarry guards charges first across the rails and muddy ground, helmets closed, carrying short spears, shields, and hammers. Behind them, emerging from the shadow of the mine arch, comes the boss: a giant one-eyed heavy warrior, 4 to 5 meters tall, rough gray-pink skin, one large round eye in the center of the face, partial metal armor and leather straps across the chest, a massive shoulder plate on one side, thick legs, immense weight, and a huge heavy battle axe carried with brutal momentum. The hero briefly raises one hand holding a smooth semi-transparent magnetic orb, tennis-ball sized, silver-white with a pale blue core, a dense metallic vortex inside, thin rings of light rotating around it. The orb already exists when first shown and does not appear from nowhere. As the smaller guards rush in, the hero crushes the orb. A cold magnetic pulse flashes through both forearms and into the ground. Weapons rip out of the charging soldiers’ hands, shields twist sideways, bolts, chains, rail spikes, loose armor plates, and metal fragments shudder and begin lifting from the quarry floor. Some smaller enemies are violently disarmed and thrown off balance immediately. The boss accelerates forward through the chaos and swings the giant axe in a heavy horizontal attack. The hero performs a fast professional sidestep and body lean at the last instant; the blade tears across the foreground with dangerous proximity, kicking mud and dust past the camera. The boss recovers with heavy inertia, plants a foot, and launches a second brutal overhead strike. The hero ducks and slips under it in a sharp Hollywood-style evasive motion, the axe crashing into the ground and rails with a shower of dirt, sparks, and metal shock. The camera reacts like a real head-and-torso dodge: fast lateral movement, recoil, breath, then immediate refocus on the boss. Now the magnetic field fully takes hold. The hero spreads both hands outward. Metal rises from every direction in a controlled field, not chaotic: torn rails, chains, bolts, iron rings, armor plates, mine cart fragments, shield metal. The pieces lift, align, and begin orbiting the giant in three clear rotating bands: a lower ring around the knees, a middle ring around the waist and abdomen, and a top ring around the chest and shoulders. The boss tries to wrench the axe free and charge again, but the orbit tightens around him. Tight center framing, with strong tracking drift and a low-angle hold to emphasize mass and danger. The hero then sharply pulls both hands inward. All three magnetic rings slam tighter at once. Chains snap taut, rails bend into crushing arcs, armor plates collide and lock, metal fragments hammer into the boss’s torso and arms. The giant loses balance, staggers, and is forced down, the axe slipping and dropping into the mud. The metal cocoon constricts harder with brutal industrial weight and magnetic pressure, locking his body in place. Dust rises in waves, small rocks skitter, chains strain, and the one eye flares with panic and rage. The hero thrusts both hands forward for the finisher. A narrow concentrated magnetic impulse forms between the palms, not fire, but a dense electromagnetic strike with a bright white core and pale blue edges. Brief micro push-in to the center of the boss’s chest. The pulse hits. Every piece of metal bound around the giant clamps inward simultaneously with one final crushing lock. The boss drops fully to his knees, torso compressed under chained rails and armored fragments, while a deep metallic shock ripples through the quarry and a wave of dust spreads across the ground. End on the giant kneeling and trapped in a brutal iron cocoon, chains stretched tight, rails embedded across the torso, the fallen axe half-buried in mud, drifting dust, and a few small metal fragments still hovering and spinning before they finally drop. entries.title: Chinese Swordswoman and Spirit Fox
entries.description: A poetic martial arts video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring character consistency for a swordswoman and her mischievous spirit fox in a snowy courtyard.
entries.prompt:
【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，融合诗意仙侠的克制美学、古典中国山水式构图、悬疑推动的视觉喜剧、清冷雪蓝与温暖象牙白色调、清晨柔和逆光、细腻胶片颗粒、克制可控的法术效果和冷面反应表演；针对 Seedance 2.0 的参考图角色一致性、连续多镜头叙事、真实动作表现，以及普通话对白与环境声音同步进行设计。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐

剑仙师姐 @图片 1，25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙自然肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、浅银色腰封、玉佩和白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜小师妹

小师妹 @图片 2，20–25 岁的东亚女性，圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小，穿青绿色亚麻汉服、深色布腰带、木簪和黑色布鞋。

其他生物

始终只出现一只幼小的白色灵狐。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景缓慢推轨】

一场新雪过后的僻静宗门庭院，灰色石板部分覆盖积雪，一面白色粉墙、深色瓦檐、古松、竹篱、青铜灯、缓慢飘动的香烟，以及石阶旁一个空着的小藤编睡篮，共同建立清楚稳定的空间关系。

同一个穿青绿色汉服的小师妹抱着空藤篮，焦急说道：“师姐，守山灵狐不见了。”

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐平静抬起两指，回答：“封住山门，我来寻它。”

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景侧面跟拍】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐结出一次精准清楚的追踪法印；一串淡金色狐狸脚印出现在雪地上，绕过同一座庭院，从同一个穿青绿色汉服的小师妹身旁经过，最终直接朝剑仙师姐延伸。

她神情严肃地沿着发光脚印缓慢追踪；背景始终保持同一座雪后庭院、同样的古松、青铜灯、空藤篮和石阶。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜近景跟随揭晓转极近特写】

同一串发光狐狸脚印沿着同一件白色刺绣真丝汉服的衣摆向上延伸，最后消失在她宽大的衣袖下方。

同一个小师妹轻轻托起那只宽袖，清楚揭示一只幼小的白色灵狐正蜷缩在衣袖里面睡觉，毛茸茸的尾巴缠绕着剑仙师姐的手腕。小灵狐打了一个哈欠，睁开一只眼睛，又重新闭眼睡去。

小师妹面无表情地说道：“师姐，它没失踪，只是换了个窝。”

极近特写：同一个剑仙师姐的一侧眉毛轻轻抽动，她缓慢放下衣袖，假装这一切原本就在预料之中。

最后以英雄式古琴声戛然而止、小灵狐一声细小鸣叫和青铜灯轻响收尾。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，三个干净清晰的镜头，人物面部与服装稳定，原生普通话音频，口型准确，积雪、真丝衣料、头发、香烟、发光脚印和灵狐运动真实自然，不生成画面字幕，始终只出现两名可见人物和一只灵狐。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props
entries.translated_prompt:
[Overall Style]

Cinematic realistic texture, merging poetic Xianxia's restrained aesthetics, classical Chinese landscape composition, suspense-driven visual comedy, cool snow blue and warm ivory white tones, soft morning backlight, fine film grain, restrained controllable spell effects, and deadpan reaction performances; designed for Seedance 2.0 character consistency based on reference images, continuous multi-shot narrative, realistic action, and synchronized Mandarin dialogue and ambient sound.

[Characters]

Character ID A | Sword Immortal Sister

Sword Immortal Sister @Image 1, 25–30 year old East Asian female, oval face, fair natural skin tone, dark almond eyes, black long hair half-up fixed with a white jade hairpin, tall and slender, wearing white embroidered silk Hanfu, semi-transparent layered wide sleeves, light silver waistband, jade pendant, and white cloth boots.

Character ID B | Junior Sister

Junior Sister @Image 2, 20–25 year old East Asian female, round and lively face, black braided hair, petite figure, wearing teal linen Hanfu, dark cloth belt, wooden hairpin, and black cloth shoes.

Other Creatures

Only one young white spirit fox appears throughout.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low-angle wide shot slow dolly track]

A quiet sect courtyard after fresh snow, gray stone slabs partially covered in snow, a white powder wall, dark tiled eaves, ancient pines, bamboo fences, bronze lamps, slowly drifting incense smoke, and an empty small wicker sleeping basket by the stone steps, establishing a clear and stable spatial relationship.

The same Junior Sister in teal Hanfu holding the empty basket says anxiously: 'Senior Sister, the mountain-guarding spirit fox is gone.'

The same Sword Immortal Sister in white embroidered silk Hanfu calmly raises two fingers and replies: 'Seal the mountain gate, I will find it.'

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Medium shot side tracking]

The same Sword Immortal Sister in white embroidered silk Hanfu forms a precise and clear tracking mudra; a string of faint golden fox footprints appears on the snow, bypassing the same courtyard and the same Junior Sister, finally extending directly toward the Sword Immortal Sister.

She follows the glowing footprints with a serious expression; the background remains the same snow-covered courtyard, ancient pines, bronze lamps, empty basket, and stone steps.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up following reveal to Extreme Close-up]

The same string of glowing fox footprints extends up the hem of the same white embroidered silk Hanfu, finally disappearing under her wide sleeve.

The same Junior Sister gently lifts the wide sleeve, clearly revealing a young white spirit fox curled up sleeping inside the sleeve, its fluffy tail wrapped around the Sword Immortal Sister's wrist. The little fox yawns, opens one eye, and falls back asleep.

Junior Sister says expressionlessly: 'Senior Sister, it's not missing, it just moved nests.'

Extreme Close-up: One of the Sword Immortal Sister's eyebrows twitches slightly; she slowly lowers her sleeve, pretending this was expected all along.

Ends with a heroic Guqin sound stopping abruptly, a small cry from the little fox, and the soft clink of the bronze lamp.

[Technical Requirements]

Strict total duration of 15 seconds, 16:9 widescreen, three clean and clear shots, stable character faces and clothing, native Mandarin audio with accurate lip-syncing, realistic movement for snow, silk fabric, hair, smoke, glowing footprints, and spirit fox, no on-screen subtitles, only two visible characters and one fox throughout.

[Negative Prompts]

entries.title: Clock Tower Thief Action Sequence
entries.description: A detailed cinematic action prompt featuring a thief navigating a dangerous old clock tower filled with giant swinging bells and moving gears.
entries.prompt: Inside a giant old clock tower at night, one thief is trapped high inside the tower while trying to escape downward. The setting is clear and dangerous: huge swinging bells, narrow wooden platforms, steep ladders, turning gears, heavy chains, dusty beams, and open gaps looking down through the tower. Wind and storm light flash through the tower openings. The goal is simple: the thief must cross the bell chamber and reach the exit stair before the moving bells and collapsing ladders trap them. The action starts with the thief stepping onto a narrow platform just as a giant bell swings across the tower. The bell misses by inches and slams back the other way. The thief ducks, grabs a hanging chain for balance, and moves toward the next ladder. The first ladder breaks underfoot. The thief drops, catches the side rail, and swings onto a lower platform beside the turning clock gears. The gears are moving slowly but powerfully, forcing the thief to climb over them and time each step carefully. One loose plank snaps and falls into the darkness below. The thief reaches the final upper platform near the largest bell. That bell suddenly swings hard across the chamber, filling the whole path. The thief tries to cross, but the bell nearly knocks them off the platform. They stumble, grab the rail at the edge, pull back up, then leap past the swinging bell toward the exit stair. End with the thief landing hard on the far platform and rushing through the stair doorway while the giant bell swings past behind them. Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense, clear readable action, one thief only, one clock tower only, one clear goal, giant swinging bells, breaking ladder, moving gears, narrow platforms, strong height danger, no extra crowd, no fight scene, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no famous celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no public-figure likenesses, no clear facial close-ups. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

entries.title: Fantasy Broom Flight Cinematic
entries.description: A complex, 30-second long-take prompt involving seamless transitions between various fantasy environments.
entries.prompt: 16:9, 30 seconds, an epic photorealistic fantasy cinematic long take, original worldbuilding, one continuous shot, continuous camera movement, no hard cuts, and no references to any existing film, character, actor, or recognizable cinematic scene. OVERALL STYLE: A high-budget fantasy film aesthetic with realistic cinematography, monumental world scale, and a beautiful protagonist with natural skin, realistic expressions, and believable body proportions. The overall tone is intelligent, elegant, mysterious, and courageous, never childish, cartoonish, or exaggerated cosplay. Four locations are connected through one continuous flight path: Iceland’s black coastline, an alternate Victorian London, a Paris-inspired city at night in the rain, and a futuristic New York-inspired aerial metropolis. UNIFIED COLOR PALETTE: Deep black, silver-gray, and warm gold remain the dominant colors throughout the film. Iceland adds cold blue; London adds gray-green and amber; Paris adds deep blue and wet gold; New York adds deep teal, silver-white, and gold. Maintain realistic atmospheric perspective, thin mist, rainfall, wet surfaces, glass reflections, and volumetric light throughout. Avoid a video-game look, concept-art appearance, and plastic materials. MAIN CHARACTER: There is only one female protagonist throughout the entire video. She is approximately 28 years old, slender, exceptionally beautiful, intelligent, elegant, and quietly determined. Her refined facial features are completely original and must not copy any real actor or movie character. She has naturally bright eyes, clearly defined eyebrows, a soft but strong facial structure, natural skin tone, realistic skin texture, and a restrained, focused expression. She has warm chestnut-brown hair reaching her waist, naturally wavy at the ends. Part of her hair is blown behind her shoulders by the wind. Her hairstyle must remain identical throughout the entire film. She wears a deep forest-green long coat, an ivory high-neck blouse, a dark-red knitted scarf, brown leather wrist guards, dark-gray trousers, and worn leather boots. Her costume has an elevated British fantasy aesthetic, but she does not wear a school uniform or pointed hat. Do not include badges, school emblems, magical-school symbols, recognizable character costumes, or elements from any existing film. She rides the same original flying broom throughout the sequence: a dark, aged wooden handle with silver-gray metallic fibers at the rear and a small warm-gold light at the front. The broom’s shape, size, color, and materials must never change. HER OBJECTIVE: She is flying through different cities to carry the small warm-gold light toward the far edge of the clouds. She is not a combat character. She does not attack anyone or cast explosive magic. She simply continues forward through cities, coastlines, fog, rain, and high-altitude air. Her emotional progression moves from concentration to wonder, then finally to freedom and determination. 0-5 SECONDS: TAKEOFF FROM ICELAND’S BLACK-SAND BEACH The shot begins extremely low above a black volcanic beach using a 24mm wide-angle lens. Black ocean waves are on the left, towering basalt columns on the right, and blue-white glacial mountains in the distance. Cold blue clouds press down across the sky, while a narrow line of warm golden sunset remains near the horizon. The beautiful female traveler rapidly enters from the rear right of the frame, riding her broom just above the ocean surface. Her chestnut-brown hair streams backward in the sea wind. Her dark-red scarf creates a clean motion line behind her, while her deep forest-green coat moves naturally in the airflow. The warm-gold light at the front of the broom illuminates the sea mist and droplets of water. The camera follows her from behind with a stable FPV movement, keeping her slightly right of center. It must not circle around to the front or allow her to leave the frame. Her body leans slightly forward; one hand holds the broom handle while the other maintains balance. She flies toward a massive wall of blue ice. At the fourth second, she enters a natural裂缝 beneath the ice wall. The ice passes rapidly along both sides of the camera. Cold blue crystals briefly intersect with the warm-gold light, creating the first natural transition. No explosion, magical smoke, or sudden transformation. 5-12 SECONDS: VICTORIAN LONDON IN THE FOG As the ice clears the lens, the environment naturally becomes an alternate Victorian city at night. The protagonist and broom retain exactly the same direction, speed, clothing, appearance, and flying posture. The camera continues following from behind. Below are wet dark-gray stone streets. Red-brick buildings, black iron bridges, narrow windows, and old amber streetlamps line both sides. Several dark-red double-decker public vehicles without text or branding move slowly through the fog. The city should evoke Victorian London without reproducing real landmarks. The camera gradually transitions from fast FPV pursuit into a smooth three-quarter rear tracking shot, moving approximately 45 degrees to her left side. Her beautiful profile appears briefly. Her eyes remain focused, and her hair and scarf maintain stable continuity. The warm-gold light leaves only a short trail through the rain and fog. She passes beneath a black elevated iron bridge. Its steel structure moves across the top of the frame as a brief physical occlusion. The camera does not cut, and when the obstruction clears, she remains on the same movement axis. At the tenth second, she flies into a massive arched railway station. Its roof is made from black steel beams and wet glass, with rainwater flowing across the surface. The roof completely covers the frame, creating the second natural transition. 12-19 SECONDS: PARIS-INSPIRED CITY IN THE RAIN When the glass roof clears the camera, the environment becomes a romantic, original Paris-inspired city at night in the rain. Do not reproduce real landmarks. Preserve only the atmosphere of stone bridges, a river, narrow streets, classical stone buildings, wrought-iron balconies, and warm window light. The protagonist flies low above a broad river. The water reflects golden windows and the deep-blue night sky. Pale-gray stone buildings, tall narrow windows, wet rooftops, and fine rain lines extend along both sides. Her deep-green coat and dark-red scarf form a clear silhouette against the blue city, while her chestnut hair streams backward. The camera moves into a parallel tracking position on her right side. The broom stays approximately three meters above the river. The camera remains slightly below shoulder level, preserving the spatial relationship between the woman, broom, river, and architecture. She passes beneath a sequence of classical stone bridges whose arches form continuous reflections in the water. At the seventeenth second, she enters a long mirror corridor made from wet glass walls. The reflections may show only the same woman, the same broom, and the same warm-gold light. Do not create duplicate people. Rainwater, city lights, and reflections slide along the glass surfaces. A powerful warm-gold light appears at the end of the corridor. She flies toward it, creating the third natural transition. 19-24 SECONDS: FUTURISTIC NEW YORK-INSPIRED CITY The mirror corridor opens into an original futuristic New York-inspired metropolis. The camera rapidly but smoothly shifts from the three-quarter rear position into a controlled forward-facing FPV shot moving backward in front of her. Her beautiful, focused face, chestnut hair, dark-red scarf, and the golden broom light are briefly visible. Below are wet streets, glass skyscrapers, metallic elevated bridges, and enormous urban canyons. T
