entries.prompt: A high-end luxury cosmetics commercial shot in 8k resolution, cinematic lighting. Extreme macro close-up of vibrant purple lavender flowers covered in sparkling dewdrops at golden hour sunrise, camera rack focus revealing a beautiful young woman with long wavy brown hair wearing a flowing lilac silk dress. She is holding a glass cosmetic jar labeled "ROZINO LAVENDER BLISS". Macro close-up of her applying smooth purple cream onto her wrist, then bringing her wrist to her nose, closing her eyes with a peaceful smile to inhale the calming scent. The scene transitions to her opening a lilac compact case and swiping cream, followed by an aerial cinematic wide shot of her standing gracefully in symmetrical rows of a misty blooming lavender field during sunset. Soft warm sunlight, atmospheric haze, dreamy aesthetic, ultra-realistic, shot on 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, slow-motion 60fps.

entries.title: Fashion Outfit Transformation Office Vlog
entries.description: A complex 30-second prompt for a fashion vlog featuring multiple outfit transitions in a static office environment.
entries.prompt:
Create a 30 second photorealistic fashion transformation video in a 16:9 landscape frame. A stylish young woman with long softly waved brown hair, warm medium skin, round black glasses, small earrings, natural makeup, and consistent facial features stands in the same modern office washroom or dressing area for the entire video. The background has large charcoal gray stone tiles, a pale ceiling, a slim black wall rail on the left, and a narrow metal partition line on the right. Keep every architectural line perfectly fixed across all cuts.

Camera is locked on a tripod at eye level, medium full shot from mid thigh upward, using a natural 35 mm equivalent smartphone lens. The subject remains centered with enough space on both sides for the landscape composition. No camera shake, zoom, reframing, or perspective change. Use crisp realistic detail, true skin texture, fine hair strands, believable fabric folds, accurate hands, subtle breathing, and tiny posture adjustments. Lighting is soft cool overhead office lighting with gentle facial fill, mild reflections on the gray tiles, consistent exposure, and realistic shadow direction.

Begin with her palm very close to the lens, briefly obscuring most of the frame. She pulls her hand away and reveals the first outfit, a sleeveless pale blue floral office dress with a light scarf over one shoulder. She looks calmly into the camera, lowers her arm, places one hand on her hip, glances upward with a mildly unimpressed expression, then folds her arms. Match this exact folded arm pose for the first invisible jump cut.

Across the next twenty four seconds, reveal nine distinct office outfits through clean pose matched cuts timed to the music. Use a lemon yellow floral kimono blouse, a relaxed ivory button shirt with navy trousers, a fitted black sleeveless top with dark tailored pants and a brown belt, a soft blush pink top with black trousers, a deep green crew neck blouse, a vivid blue paisley shift dress, a black and white dotted peplum blouse, a camel blazer over a cream top, and a final elegant burgundy wrap dress. Between changes, give her natural confident gestures such as a small shoulder bounce, two thumbs up, hands settling on hips, crossing her arms, turning her chin, smoothing a cuff, lightly flicking her hair, pointing toward her cheek, and smiling directly at camera. Each gesture should begin in one outfit and end in the next so the cut feels practical and intentional, never like body morphing.

Hold each look long enough to read clearly, roughly two seconds per outfit, with cuts landing on strong beats. Preserve identical body position, hair direction, glasses placement, limb anatomy, background geometry, and lighting at every transition. Avoid warped fingers, changing facial identity, floating clothing, cloth melting, duplicated accessories, sudden camera motion, or artificial beauty smoothing.

entries.title: Lisbon Travel Vlog Sequence
entries.description: A detailed multi-scene prompt for a travel Vlog in Lisbon, featuring transitions between landmarks like the Santa Luzia viewpoint and local cafes with consistent character outfits.
entries.prompt:
【基本条件】
@image1 は、同一女性と3種類の旅行衣装を整理した簡易キャラクターシート。15秒、1:1スクエア、高品質な実写。スマートフォンで撮影した、明るく華やかな旅行Vlog／SNSリール。朝から夜までの5つの旅の出来事を、明確なハードカットでつなぐ。移動過程は描かず、各シーン開始時点ですでに目的地にいる。シート内の人物表示はすべて同一女性。白背景、分割、見出し、カラーパレット、部分拡大は映像に出さない。PERSON＝シート内のすべての人物表示に共通する同一女性。顔立ち、髪型・髪色、年齢感、体型、頭身、全身比率を全編で維持する。

衣装参照に使用するのは、上段左側に並ぶ3つの全身パネルのみ。
OUTFIT_A＝上段左端の全身衣装一式。
OUTFIT_B＝上段左から2番目の全身衣装一式。
OUTFIT_C＝上段左から3番目の全身衣装一式。
それ以外の領域は衣装選択、衣装形状、バッグ、靴、ポーズの参照に使用しない。A・B・Cの服、靴、バッグを混在させない。小道具は場面ごとに切り替える。朝の白い陶器カップは最初の場面だけに限定し、以降の場面へ持ち越さない。

【ショット構成】
0.0〜2.5秒｜早朝・サンタ・ルジア展望台
PERSONはOUTFIT_A。
赤い屋根、青空、テージョ川を一瞬見せた直後、女性本人がスマートフォンを自分へ向ける短い自撮り。片手に、装飾やロゴのない小さな白い陶器のコーヒーカップを持つ。カップをカメラに向かって乾杯するように軽く掲げ、朝風で髪が動く中、楽しそうに自然に笑った瞬間にハードカット。同行者のカップは出さない。
2.5〜5.5秒｜午前・黄色い路面電車
PERSONはOUTFIT_A。
停車中の黄色い路面電車を低めの広角側面で撮影。女性が真鍮の手すりを握り、一段だけ軽快に乗り込む。入口近くの乗務員が笑顔で短く迎え、ベルが鳴る。女性が入口からカメラへ明るく振り返ったところでハードカット。走行中の車両へ飛び乗らない。
5.5〜8.5秒｜昼・屋外カフェ
PERSONはOUTFIT_B。
白いテーブル越しの近距離手持ち。コーヒーとパステル・デ・ナタは最初からテーブルに置かれている。女性がパステル・デ・ナタを一つ手に取り、小さくきれいに一口食べる。口元を清潔に保ったまま、味を楽しんで同行者を見て自然に笑う。5.5〜8.5秒はこのカフェ画面を維持し、食べ物、手元、コーラルの衣装、顔を同時に見せてハードカット。
8.5〜11.5秒｜ゴールデンアワー・川辺の広場
PERSONはOUTFIT_Bの服と靴を着用し、この場面ではバッグを持たない。
テージョ川沿いの広場で、少人数の現地音楽家が軽快に演奏し、数人の旅行者や地元の人が楽しそうに踊っている。同行者による広い手持ち撮影。
PERSONはすでに、PERSONとは異なる現地女性に手を取られ、踊りの輪へ招かれている。PERSONは手ぶらで、バッグ、飲み物、カップ、皿、食べ物、その他の小道具を持たない。笑いながらすぐ一度だけ軽く回転し、コーラル系ラップワンピースの裾と髪が華やかに広がる。全身と周囲の笑顔を見せてハードカット。
11.5〜15.0秒｜夜・アルファマの路地テラス
PERSONはOUTFIT_C。
深いコバルトブルーの夜。暖かな照明が灯るアルファマの石畳の路地に、小さな屋外テラスが広がっている。数卓のテーブル、ポルトガルギターを演奏する音楽家、笑顔で手拍子する客が同じ画面に見える。女性がテラスの人々と音楽を楽しみながらカメラへ振り返って笑い、片手を差し出す。そのままカメラを見ながらテラス側へ一歩だけ後退し、カメラも女性に合わせて半歩前進する。女性の上半身と差し出した手を画面内に残し、背後に暖かなテラス、演奏者、客の笑顔が見える状態で、PERSONを画面外へ出さず、屋外テラスの中で動作を続けながら終了する。静止や疑似フリーズを作らない。

【撮影・色・音】
最初の場面のみ自撮り。以降は同行者によるスマートフォン撮影。撮影者本人は映さない。自然な広角、軽い手振れ、近距離と広角の変化、被写体を見失わない短い追従。大型映画カメラやジンバルのように滑らかすぎる動き、激しい揺れ、背景変形、モーフィングは行わない。全編を明るく鮮やかな高品質トラベルリールにする。低彩度、灰色のベール、白い霞、黄土色の濁り、黒い逆光シルエットを避ける。清潔な白、澄んだ青、鮮やかな黄色、コーラル、ワインレッドを明確に分離し、自然な肌色、明るい露出、鮮明なコントラスト、豊かなハイライトを保つ。朝は澄んだ青と赤い屋根、午前は鮮やかなレモンイエロー、昼は黄金色の菓子とコーラル、夕方は金色の夕日と淡い青の川と鮮やかなコーラル、夜は深いコバルトブルーと暖かなアンバー光を明瞭に見せる。全場面で顔と衣装を明るく見せる。全編に、軽快で洗練されたオリジナル旅行BGMを流す。明るく爽やかで少しロマンチック。夕方と夜はBGMを少し下げ、現地の演奏と手拍子を前面に出し、音楽同士を競合させない。風、カップ、路面電車のベル、カフェ、夜のテラスの環境音も短く重ねる。既存曲、特定歌手、明瞭な歌詞、台詞、ナレーションは使用しない。字幕、タイトル、ロゴ、透かし、複数の同一女性、顔や髪型の変化、衣装混在を入れない。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Basic Conditions]
@image1 is a simple character sheet organizing the same woman and 3 types of travel outfits. 15 seconds, 1:1 square, high-quality live-action. A bright and glamorous travel Vlog/SNS reel shot on a smartphone. Connects 5 travel events from morning to night with clear hard cuts. Do not depict the travel process; stay at the destination at the start of each scene. All character displays in the sheet are the same woman. White background, splits, headings, color palettes, and partial enlargements are not shown in the video. PERSON = the same woman common to all character displays in the sheet. Maintain facial features, hairstyle/hair color, age feel, body type, head-to-body ratio, and overall proportions throughout.

Only use the three full-body panels aligned on the upper left side for outfit reference.
OUTFIT_A = full body outfit set on the far upper left.
OUTFIT_B = full body outfit set second from the upper left.
OUTFIT_C = full body outfit set third from the upper left.
Other areas are not used for outfit selection, outfit shape, bags, shoes, or pose reference. Do not mix clothes, shoes, and bags from A, B, and C. Props switch by scene. The white ceramic cup in the morning is limited to the first scene only and not carried over to subsequent scenes.

[Shot Composition]
0.0-2.5s | Early Morning, Santa Luzia Viewpoint
PERSON is OUTFIT_A.
Immediately after showing red roofs, blue sky, and the Tagus River for a moment, the woman herself takes a short selfie with her smartphone. Holds a small white ceramic coffee cup without decorations or logos in one hand. Holds the cup up slightly as if toasting the camera, and hard cuts the moment she laughs naturally and happily as the morning breeze moves her hair. The companion's cup is not shown.
2.5-5.5s | Morning, Yellow Tram
PERSON is OUTFIT_A.
Shot from a low wide-angle side of a stationary yellow tram. The woman grabs the brass handrail and lightly steps on one step. The crew member near the entrance welcomes her briefly with a smile, and a bell rings. Hard cut when the woman brightly looks back from the entrance to the camera. Do not jump onto a moving vehicle.
5.5-8.5s | Lunch, Outdoor Cafe
Close-up handheld shot across a white table. Coffee and pastel de nata are on the table from the beginning. The woman takes one pastel de nata and takes a small, clean bite. While keeping her mouth clean, she enjoys the taste, looks at her companion, and laughs naturally. Maintain this cafe screen from 5.5 to 8.5s, showing food, hands, coral outfit, and face simultaneously, then hard cut.
8.5-11.5s | Golden Hour, Riverside Plaza
PERSON wears OUTFIT_B clothes and shoes; no bag in this scene.
In a plaza along the Tagus River, a small group of local musicians plays lightly, and several travelers and locals dance happily. Wide handheld shot by a companion.
PERSON is already being taken by the hand by a different local woman and invited into the dancing circle. PERSON is empty-handed, without a bag, drink, cup, plate, food, or other props. Briefly spins once while laughing, with the hem of the coral wrap dress and her hair spreading glamorously. Show full body and surrounding smiles, then hard cut.
11.5-15.0s | Night, Alfama Alley Terrace
PERSON is OUTFIT_C.
Deep cobalt blue night. A small outdoor terrace spreads out in a cobblestone alley in Alfama with warm lighting. Several tables, musicians playing Portuguese guitars, and guests clapping with smiles are seen in the same frame. The woman looks back at the camera and laughs while enjoying the music and people on the terrace, and reaches out one hand. She takes one step back toward the terrace side while looking at the camera, and the camera also moves half a step forward with the woman. Keep the woman's upper body and outstretched hand in the frame, with the warm terrace, performers, and guests' smiles visible behind, ending while continuing action within the outdoor terrace without leaving the screen. Do not create static or pseudo-freezes.

[Shooting, Color, Sound]
Selfie in the first scene only. Smartphone shooting by a companion from then on. Do not show the shooter themselves. Natural wide-angle, light hand shake, changes between close range and wide-angle, short tracking without losing the subject. No movements that are too smooth like large cinema cameras or gimbals, violent shaking, background deformation, or morphing. Make the whole video a bright and vivid high-quality travel reel. Avoid low saturation, gray veils, white haze, ochre turbidity, and black backlit silhouettes. Clearly separate clean white, clear blue, vivid yellow, coral, and wine red, maintaining natural skin tones, bright exposure, clear contrast, and rich highlights. Clearly show clear blue and red roofs in the morning, vivid lemon yellow in the forenoon, golden sweets and coral at noon, golden sunset and light blue river and vivid coral in the evening, and deep cobalt blue and warm amber light at night. Keep faces and outfits bright in all scenes. Play light and sophisticated original travel BGM throughout. Bright, fresh, and slightly romantic. Lower the BGM slightly in the evening and night, bringing local performances and clapping to the front, without competing music. Layer environmental sounds of wind, cups, tram bells, cafes, and night terraces briefly. Do not use existing songs, specific singers, clear lyrics, dialogue, or narration. Do not include subtitles, titles, logos, watermarks, multiple identical women, changes in face or hairstyle, or mixed outfits.

entries.title: Burning Barn Horse Escape Scene
entries.description: An intense action prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a stable hand rescuing a panicked horse from a collapsing, burning wooden barn at night.
entries.prompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9. Inside a burning wooden barn at night, one stable hand tries to get one panicked horse out before the structure collapses. The barn is clear and simple: narrow central aisle, horse stalls, hanging tack, loose straw, wooden beams, one main door at the far end, and one smaller side exit. Fire is spreading fast through the rafters. Smoke is thick. Firelight flashes through the haze. The goal is simple: calm the horse just enough to move it through the burning barn and escape before the exits are blocked. The action starts with the horse rearing and pulling back inside its stall while sparks and embers fall from above. The stable hand grabs the lead rope, opens the stall, and gets the horse moving into the aisle. A burning beam suddenly crashes down behind them, blocking the path back and filling the aisle with sparks. Now the stable hand must force the horse forward through the smoke. The horse panics, slips on scattered straw, and jerks sideways as flames spread along the wooden wall. The stable hand pulls hard, stays close to the horse’s head, and guides it past falling debris. Ahead, the main barn doors try to open but one side jams halfway. There is no time to force the main exit. The stable hand turns the horse sharply toward the smaller side door. A second beam drops and showers the aisle with sparks. The stable hand kicks the side door open, pulls the horse through the narrow opening, and the horse lunges out into the night just as part of the barn roof begins collapsing behind them. End with the stable hand and horse stumbling out into open air, backlit by flames, while the burning barn continues collapsing behind them. Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense, clear readable action, one stable hand only, one horse only, one barn only, one main danger, one clear goal, panicked horse behavior, falling beams, jammed door, smoke, firelight, sparks, strong urgency, no extra people, no firefighting scene, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no famous celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no public-figure likenesses, no clear facial close-ups. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

entries.title: Three Kingdoms Battle Epic
entries.description: A highly detailed historical battle prompt featuring LU BU, GUAN YU, and ZHANG FEI, designed for intense historical action with specific weapon and horse descriptions.
entries.prompt:
Duration: 20s | 16:9 | 24fps
A three-way duel from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, late Han dynasty.
Relentless combat from the first frame. No pauses, no posing.

REFERENCES
@Image 1 — 呂布 LU BU   @Image 2 — 関羽 GUAN YU   @Image 3 — 張飛 ZHANG FEI
Use for IDENTITY ONLY: face, beard, hair, headwear, armour, cloak colour,
build, proportions. IGNORE their white studio background, flat lighting and
standing pose — none of it appears here. All three are mounted and fighting
outdoors from the very first frame.

STYLE (all beats)
An empty dust plain below a huge stone mountain pass at dusk. NO armies, NO
crowds, NO banners, NO spectators — only these three men, their horses, dust
and rock. Overcast sky, low copper sun cutting through blowing dust.
Palette: iron grey, ochre dust, blood red, bronze. Desaturated and earthy.
50mm, shallow focus, heavy haze, film grain, high contrast, hard rim light.
Photorealistic historical epic, sweat, grime, scarred armour, horses lathered
and wild-eyed. No fantasy glow, no magic.
IMPACT: on every heavy strike, sparks burst, grit sprays toward the lens, and
the frame shudders for a single frame. Dust and spray repeatedly streak across
the lens. Keep exactly one camera move per beat — never combine moves.

WEAPONS — no reference. Keep identical throughout, each 1.5x its owner's
height, never swapped.
呂布: ji halberd — straight spear point, one crescent side blade below it on
one side, long dark shaft, bronze fittings.
関羽: guandao — one heavy broad curved blade with a hook on its back edge,
joined to a long dark shaft by a bronze dragon head.
張飛: serpent spear — slender steel blade forged in an S-shaped wave, on a
plain dark shaft bound with cord.

HORSES — no reference. Anatomically correct, four legs, correct joints.
呂布: large red-chestnut stallion, black mane, bronze fittings, red tassels.
関羽: tall dark bay, black mane and lower legs, plain leather tack.
張飛: heavy solid black, thick neck, shaggy fetlocks, battered iron tack.

BEAT 1 (0-4s) 張飛 — bristling beard, black iron armour, serpent spear, black
horse — is already at full gallop, roaring, and rams the spear at 呂布's chest.
呂布 — clean-shaven, gold headdress with two pheasant feathers, red cloak,
halberd, red-chestnut horse — slams it aside with the haft. The two horses hit
chest to chest and rear. The spear tip whips past the lens, a hand's width
from it.
Camera: low at hoof height looking up, tracking alongside the charge.

BEAT 2 (4-8s) 呂布 attacks. Three halberd blows in succession — hacking down,
sweeping across, driving up. 張飛 blocks, blocks, and the third blow tears a
shoulder plate off his armour, sending it spinning. His black horse skids
sideways. Sparks spray into the lens.
Camera: MCU, tilted dutch angle, hard push-in on 呂布.

BEAT 3 (8-12s) 関羽 — long smooth black beard, ruddy face, dark green robe,
green headwrap, guandao, dark bay horse — cra

entries.title: Hulao Pass Historical Battle
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for a historical battle scene from the Three Kingdoms era, focusing on identity preservation for Lu Bu, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei.
entries.prompt:
Duration: 20s | 16:9 | 24fps Duel from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, battle at Hulao Pass, late Han dynasty. REFERENCES 
Image 1
 — 呂布 LU BU 
Image 2
 — 関羽 GUAN YU 
Image 3
 — 張飛 ZHANG FEI Use them for IDENTITY ONLY: face, beard, hair, headwear, armour, cloak colour, build, proportions. IGNORE their white studio background, flat studio lighting and standing pose — none of it appears here. Every shot is outdoors, and all three men are mounted and fighting. STYLE (all beats) A dusty plain before a huge stone mountain pass at dusk. Two vast armies on either side, banners rippling, dust in the air. Overcast sky, low copper sun breaking through. Palette: iron grey, ochre dust, blood red, bronze. Desaturated and earthy. 50mm, shallow focus, heavy haze, film grain, high contrast, hard rim light through the dust. Photorealistic historical epic, sweat and grime, worn scratched armour. No fantasy glow, no magic. WEAPONS — no reference exists. Build from this, keep identical throughout. Each is 1.5x its owner's height. Never swap them. 呂布: ji halberd — straight spear point, one crescent side blade below it on one side, long dark shaft, bronze fittings. 関羽: guandao — one heavy broad curved blade with a hook on its back edge, joined to a long dark shaft by a bronze dragon head. 張飛: serpent spear — slender steel blade forged in an S-shaped wave, on a plain dark shaft bound with cord. HORSES — no reference exists. Anatomically correct, four legs, correct joints. 呂布: large red-chestnut stallion, black mane, bronze fittings, red tassels. 関羽: tall dark bay, black mane and lower legs, plain leather tack. 張飛: heavy solid black, thick neck, shaggy fetlocks, battered iron tack. BEAT 1 (0-4s) 呂布 — clean-shaven, gold headdress with two pheasant feathers, red cloak, halberd, red-chestnut horse — sits alone between the two armies, halberd across his saddle. The horse stamps and turns a half step. He raises the halberd and levels it at the enemy line. Camera: WS from low, slow push-in. BEAT 2 (4-8s) 張飛 — bristling beard, black iron armour, dark cloak, serpent spear, black horse — bursts from the line at a gallop, roaring, and drives the spear at 呂布. 呂布 turns the halberd across his body and knocks it aside. Sparks and dust. The horses wheel past each other. Camera: tracking alongside at horse height, moving with the charge. entries.description: A complex multi-shot Seedance 2.0 prompt for generating a realistic cinematic video of a character switching between seven different historical Hanfu styles through smooth cover-the-lens transitions.
entries.prompt:
【整体风格】

电影级写实古风质感，采用真实唐、宋、明制汉服语言，强调可信的布料物理、自然室内日光、克制含蓄的古典气质、真实皮肤纹理、无美颜滤镜，所有换装依靠真实遮镜完成，不使用魔法CG。

【人物设定】

人物 ID｜HANFU-01

同一位23–28岁东亚女性，椭圆脸，暖象牙肤色，深棕色杏眼，黑色及腰直发，半束发并带细辫，身材纤细匀称。

【造型设定】

造型1

从绣花布鞋到浅玉色百褶马面裙、象牙白交领上衣、深红织纹腰带、珍珠发簪 and 小型玉佩完整呈现。

造型2

蓝色宋制褙子。

造型3

黑红明制飞鱼服。

造型4

白金配色唐制襦裙。

造型5

深绿色马面裙与织锦短袄。

造型6

月白刺绣汉服。

造型7

深绯色金凤刺绣婚服。

【场景设定】

安静的木构厅堂内，背景有格栅窗、铜香炉、矮桌、垂落纱帘、空气浮尘和偏冷的晨间侧光。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜全景】

人物ID HANFU-01，同一位23–28岁东亚女性，椭圆脸，暖象牙肤色，深棕色杏眼，黑色及腰直发，半束发并带细辫，身材纤细匀称；造型1从绣花布鞋到浅玉色百褶马面裙、象牙白交领上衣、深红织纹腰带、珍珠发簪和小型玉佩完整呈现。

她站在安静的木构厅堂内，背景有格栅窗、铜香炉、矮桌、垂落纱帘、空气浮尘和偏冷的晨间侧光；低机位锁定，24mm镜头，缓慢推轨。

她抬起一侧膝盖，用整片裙摆横扫镜头，直到丝绸100%占满画面，在完全遮挡内部硬切为造型2蓝色宋制褙子，再切为造型3黑红明制飞鱼服；每次转换都保持同一条腿、相同方向、相同速度、连续重心、同一张脸、同一发型、同一首饰和同一背景。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜牛仔景】

同一位女性，同一座木构厅堂，此时穿造型4白金配色唐制襦裙；她扭转腰胯，侧目看向镜头，露出克制而俏皮的浅笑，随后迅速打开一把圆形绢扇。

扇面完整遮镜3–5帧后，显现同一位女性身穿造型5深绿色马面裙与织锦短袄；她延续完全相同的手腕动作，原地旋转一次，再用超长水袖横向甩过画面形成快速摇摄，在完全遮镜内部切换为造型6月白刺绣汉服，背景仍保持同一座木构厅堂。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写】

同一位女性身穿月白汉服，保持同一枚玉佩与珍珠发簪，50mm镜头，稳定凝视并带轻微手持呼吸感。

一层半透明红色面纱缓缓升起，完全遮住镜头后再落下，显现造型7深绯色金凤刺绣婚服；她的深棕色眼睛始终位于画面中心，睫毛清晰，毛孔可见，嘴角轻轻上扬，下眼睑有一处泪光高光，香烟在背景缓慢漂浮。

结尾从金色发饰缓慢焦点转移到她直视镜头的双眼。

【技术要求】

15秒，9:16竖屏，30fps，遮挡靠近时出现真实连续自动对焦迟疑，自然运动模糊、布料惯性、丝绸光泽、刺绣厚度、轻微衣料摩擦声、扇面弹开声和水袖破风声；所有硬切只能发生在镜头100%被遮挡时，全片无对白、字幕、Logo或水印。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

[Overall Style]

Cinematic realistic ancient style texture, utilizing authentic Tang, Song, and Ming dynasty Hanfu language. Emphasizes believable fabric physics, natural indoor daylight, restrained and subtle classical temperament, real skin texture, and no beauty filters. All outfit changes are achieved through real lens obscuration, avoiding magical CGI.

[Character Setting]

Character ID | HANFU-01

The same 23–28 year old East Asian female with an oval face, warm ivory skin, deep brown almond eyes, black waist-length straight hair, half-tied with fine braids, and a slender, balanced physique.

[Outfit Settings]

Outfit 1: Complete presentation from embroidered cloth shoes to a light jade-colored pleated Mamian skirt, ivory-white cross-collar top, deep red woven belt, pearl hairpin, and small jade pendant.
Outfit 2: Blue Song-style Beizi.
Outfit 3: Black and red Ming-style Feiyufu.
Outfit 4: White-gold Tang-style Ruqun.
Outfit 5: Dark green Mamian skirt with a brocade short jacket.
Outfit 6: Moon-white embroidered Hanfu.
Outfit 7: Crimson gold-phoenix embroidered wedding dress.

[Scene Setting]

Inside a quiet wooden hall, the background features lattice windows, bronze censers, low tables, hanging gauze curtains, floating dust motes, and cool morning side-lighting.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Wide Shot]

Character ID HANFU-01; Outfit 1 fully presented. She stands in the quiet wooden hall. Low-angle locked 24mm lens with slow tracking. She lifts one knee and sweeps the lens with her skirt until silk fills 100% of the screen. A hard cut occurs behind the obscuration to Outfit 2, then to Outfit 3. Each transition maintains the same leg, direction, speed, center of gravity, face, hairstyle, and background.

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Cowboy Shot]

The same woman in the same hall wearing Outfit 4. She twists her waist, looks toward the camera with a subtle smile, and quickly opens a round silk fan. After the fan obscures the lens for 3–5 frames, she appears in Outfit 5, continues the same wrist movement, rotates once, and uses extra-long water sleeves to sweep across the screen for a fast pan, switching to Outfit 6 behind the obscuration.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up]

The same woman in Outfit 6, 50mm lens with steady gaze and slight handheld breathing. A semi-transparent red veil rises, fully covers the lens, and falls to reveal Outfit 7. Her eyes stay centered, with visible lashes and skin pores. Ends with a slow focus pull from gold hair ornaments to her eyes.

[Technical Requirements]

15 seconds, 9:16 vertical, 30fps. Realistic continuous autofocus hesitation during obscuration, natural motion blur, fabric inertia, silk luster, embroidery thickness, and ambient sounds (fan opening, sleeves swishing). Hard cuts only when 100% obscured. No dialogue, subtitles, or logos.

[Negative Prompt]

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

A lone female courier stands on top of a speeding armored freight vehicle crossing a vast desert scrapyard. A giant magnetic crane suddenly locks onto the vehicle, pulling the entire metal roof upward while she is still standing on it. 

She drives a steel hook into the roof and hangs on as the panel tears free and swings high above the moving convoy. An enemy drone charges directly at her. She kicks away from the swinging roof, lands on the drone for one second, forces it downward, then leaps onto the next vehicle as the drone crashes into a tower of scrap behind her. Fast, physical, realistic weight and momentum, dramatic low angles and an object-mounted camera on the swinging roof. 

No slow motion. No gore. No text. No famous celebrity faces, recognizable actor faces, movie-star resemblance, or public-figure likenesses. Keep one main character and clear continuous action. Aspect ratio 16:9.

entries.title: Literal Wuxia Comedy Bicycle Scene
entries.description: A comedic interaction between a modern character and a wuxia swordswoman who takes the instruction to 'watch the bike' too literally, resulting in a dramatic sword intervention.
entries.prompt:
【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，采用雅克・塔蒂式空间喜剧调度、巴斯特・基顿式冷面节奏、温暖的傍晚自然光、克制表演和清楚完整的因果关系，通过 “仙侠人物严格按照字面理解现代口语” 制造荒诞反差。

针对 Seedance 2.0 的多模态参考、导演级控制、稳定动作和原生音画同步生成进行设计。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙姐

剑仙姐 @图片 1，同一个 25–30 岁东亚女性，椭圆脸、自然白皙皮肤、锐利深棕色眼睛、黑色长直发、高挑纤细身材，穿白色布靴、飘动的白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、银色腰饰并佩戴玉簪；完整保持参考图中的全部细节。

角色 ID B｜单车姐

单车姐 @图片 2，同一个 25–30 岁东亚女性，圆润而富有表情的脸、棕色短马尾、黄色外套、蓝色牛仔裤、白色运动鞋、参考图中的饰品和同一辆自行车。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景建立镜头】

16:9 横屏，现代便利店旁略带坡度的滨河广场，湿润石材地面、混凝土花池、玻璃店面倒影、自动售货机、行道树、远处城市车流，以及坡道尽头清楚可见的路缘石。

单车姐将自行车停在轻微斜坡上，但没有完全锁紧脚撑；她指向自动售货机，说：“姐妹，帮我看一下车。”

剑仙姐严肃点头：“放心。”

摄影机缓慢稳定横移，清楚交代两人、自行车、坡度和路缘石之间的空间关系。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景侧面跟拍】

同一个单车姐只向自动售货机走出几步，始终保留在纵深背景中。

同一辆自行车开始缓慢沿坡道向下滑动。

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙姐完全不动，双手负在身后，只用眼睛和缓慢转动的头部精准追踪自行车，像执行重要任务一样全神贯注地 “看着它”。

英雄式音乐逐渐消失，只留下车轮转动声和一次轻微轮胎摩擦声。

同一个单车姐回头发现自行车正在滑走，瞬间僵住；背景始终保持同一个广场、店面、斜坡和路缘石。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写配合焦点转移】

特写同一个单车姐大喊：“你怎么不拦啊？”

焦点转移到同一个剑仙姐，她平静回答：“你只让我看，没让我拦。”

她面不改色地抬起两根手指；同一柄银色长剑平稳射入画面，在同一辆自行车距离路缘石一厘米的位置将它准确挡停。

极近特写剑仙姐镇定的双眼，她补充说道：“下次说清楚。”

同一个单车姐无言凝视她，自行车铃自行发出一声细小脆响，画面定格。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，三个镜头，16:9 横屏，人物与道具的左右运动方向连贯，角色面部和服装稳定，自行车重量、车轮转动、制动、头发和真丝衣料物理效果真实，普通话口型准确，环境声与动作音效同步，不生成字幕。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Overall Style] Cinematic realism using Jacques Tati-style spatial comedy and Buster Keaton-style deadpan rhythm. Features warm evening natural light, restrained performances, and clear causal relationships, creating absurd contrast through a wuxia character interpreting modern slang literally. Designed for Seedance 2.0 multi-modal reference and native audio-visual synchronization.

[Characters] Role A | Swordswoman: @Image 1, 25-30 year old East Asian female, oval face, natural fair skin, sharp brown eyes, long black hair, tall slender build. Wearing white boots, white embroidered silk hanfu, translucent layered sleeves, silver waist ornaments, jade hairpin.
Role B | Biker: @Image 2, 25-30 year old East Asian female, expressive face, short brown ponytail, yellow jacket, blue jeans, white sneakers, same bicycle as reference.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low Angle Wide Establishing] 16:9 landscape. Riverside plaza with a slight slope near a convenience store. Wet stone ground, concrete planters, glass shop reflections, vending machine, trees, distant city traffic, and a visible curb. Role B parks the bike on the slope without locking it; she points to the vending machine and says: "Sister, watch the bike for me." Swordswoman nods seriously: "Rest assured."

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Medium Side Tracking] Role B walks a few steps toward the vending machine. The bike starts sliding down the slope. The swordswoman remains motionless, hands behind back, tracking the bike only with her eyes and head, intensely focused on "watching it" as if on a mission. Heroic music fades, leaving only wheel sounds. B looks back, sees the bike sliding, and freezes.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up with Focus Shift] Close-up of Role B shouting: "Why didn't you stop it?" Focus shifts to Swordswoman who calmly replies: "You only told me to watch it, not stop it." She raises two fingers; a silver sword shoots into the frame, stopping the bike exactly one centimeter from the curb. Extreme close-up of her calm eyes as she adds: "Be clear next time." B stares speechlessly, the bike bell dings once, freeze frame.

[Technical] 15 seconds, three shots, 16:9 aspect, consistent motion direction, stable faces/clothing, realistic bike and fabric physics, accurate Mandarin lip-sync, synchronized environmental sounds.

entries.title: Smelly Tofu Wuxia Plot Twist
entries.description: A suspenseful Wuxia-themed sequence that builds tension with a demon-tracking compass only to reveal the 'monster' is a jar of fermented tofu.
entries.prompt:
【整体风格】

电影级写实质感，纯古风中国仙侠美学，前半段以灵异悬疑制造紧张感，后半段反转为克制的冷面喜剧；采用古典留白构图、清冷月光、温暖灯笼光、墨蓝与陈旧象牙白色调、细腻胶片颗粒、明确的空间声音和克制的法术细节，针对 Seedance 2.0 的多参考连续性与原生音画联合生成进行设计。

【角色】

角色 ID A｜剑仙师姐

剑仙师姐 @图片 1，25–30 岁的东亚女性，椭圆脸，白皙自然肤色，深色杏眼，黑色长发半挽，以白玉簪固定，身材高挑纤细，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明分层宽袖、银色腰封、玉佩和白色布靴。

角色 ID B｜小师妹

小师妹 @图片 2，20–25 岁的东亚女性，圆润灵动的脸，黑发编辫，身形娇小，穿青绿色亚麻汉服、深色布腰带、木簪和黑色布鞋，双手提着一个紧闭的竹制食盒。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景缓慢跟拍】

午夜荒废的山门祖祠庭院，湿润石板倒映着两盏青铜灯，竹林被夜风压弯，香烟在深色瓦檐下缓慢飘动，一尊古老石兽正对紧闭的木质祠门，枯叶擦过地面。

同一个剑仙师姐与同一个小师妹谨慎穿过庭院，一阵若有若无的冒泡声始终跟在两人身后。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜双人中景牛仔景】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的剑仙师姐突然停下，举起同一个古老青铜寻妖罗盘，压低声音说道：“妖气就在我们之间。”

同一个罗盘的指针开始疯狂旋转，青铜铃轻轻震动，两盏灯的火苗同时朝同一个小师妹倾斜，随后指针精准指向她手中的同一个竹制食盒。

同一个剑仙师姐缓慢拔出唯一一柄银色长剑，同一个小师妹困惑地低头看向食盒；背景始终保持同一座祖祠、石兽、青铜灯、竹林和湿润庭院。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜近景揭晓转极近特写】

同一个小师妹小心打开同一个竹制食盒，露出里面唯一一只密封陶罐，罐中装着发酵豆腐；罐盖伴随一声轻微的 “啵” 弹开，一股浓烈酸味让两盏灯的火苗同时颤动，也让剑仙师姐的双眼瞬间泛起泪光。

小师妹说道：“师姐，这是我腌了七日的豆腐。”

同一个剑仙师姐缓慢将长剑归鞘，面不改色地回答：“封好，莫放它出来。”

极近特写：一滴眼泪沿着她的脸颊滑落，她仍然强行维持绝对端庄的高人姿态。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，16:9 横屏，三个连贯清楚的镜头，参考图人物面部与服装稳定，原生同步普通话对白，口型准确，香烟、真丝衣料、头发、灯笼、罗盘、陶罐和夜风运动真实自然，不生成画面字幕，始终只出现两名可见角色。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Overall Style] Cinematic realism, pure Chinese xianxia aesthetic. The first half creates tension through supernatural suspense, reversing into deadpan comedy. Uses classical negative space composition, cold moonlight, warm lantern light, ink blue and antique ivory tones, fine film grain, clear spatial audio, and restrained magic details. Designed for Seedance 2.0 multi-reference continuity and native audio-visual generation.

[Characters] Role A | Senior Swordswoman: @Image 1, 25-30 year old East Asian female, white silk embroidered hanfu. Role B | Junior Sister: @Image 2, 20-25 year old East Asian female, green linen hanfu, carrying a bamboo food box.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Low Angle Wide Tracking] Midnight abandoned ancestral hall courtyard. Wet stone reflects bronze lamps, bamboo bent by wind, incense smoke under eaves. A faint bubbling sound follows the characters.

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Duo Medium Cowboy Shot] Role A stops, raises a bronze demon-seeking compass, whispers: "The demon energy is between us." The compass needle spins wildly, bells vibrate, lamp flames tilt toward Role B, and the needle points to the food box. Role A slowly unsheathes her silver sword; Role B looks down at the box in confusion.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up Reveal] Role B opens the box, revealing a sealed clay jar of fermented tofu. The lid pops with a "pop," releasing a strong sour smell that makes Role A's eyes tear up. Role B: "Sister, this is the tofu I pickled for seven days." Role A slowly sheathes her sword, maintaining a poker face: "Seal it, do not let it out." Extreme Close-up: A single tear falls as she maintains her dignified master persona.

[Technical] 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape, three shots, stable characters, native Mandarin dialogue, accurate physics for silk, hair, and wind.

entries.title: Luxury Fashion Elevator Commercial
entries.description: A high-end retail campaign prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring outfit changes and product reveals inside a luxury mall elevator.
entries.prompt:
Style: Luxury fashion commercial, cinematic realism, premium retail campaign, ultra-fast-paced editing, bright luxury mall lighting, polished marble interiors, energetic pop-electronic soundtrack, crisp footsteps, shopping bag rustles, smooth gimbal movement, whip pans, dynamic tracking shots, macro product close-ups, seamless match cuts, premium HDR color grading, shallow depth of field, editorial fashion aesthetic.

0:00–0:02
A pair of luxurious elevator doors slowly slide open inside a premium shopping mall. The elevator is completely filled with perfectly arranged shopping bags from the same luxury fashion brand, stacked from floor to ceiling. Soft golden light spills out, creating an irresistible reveal. Fast push-in camera.

0:02–0:04
A stylish young woman confidently walks into the elevator. She smiles, grabs the nearest shopping bag, and instantly pulls out a pair of elegant designer sunglasses. Match cut as she effortlessly puts them on. The moment the glasses touch her face, the lighting becomes brighter and more glamorous.

0:04–0:07
Without missing a beat, she reaches for a second shopping bag. Inside is a luxurious lip gloss. Macro close-up as she twists it open, smooth glossy texture catching the light. She applies it in one confident swipe while looking toward the elevator mirror. Quick beauty close-ups and whip-pan transitions.

0:07–0:10
She grabs a third shopping bag. Inside is a premium oversized jacket. With a seamless match cut, she swings it over her shoulders in one fluid motion. Slow-motion fabric movement mixed with fast editorial cuts as the jacket settles perfectly.

0:10–0:13
Rapid montage: close-up of the sunglasses, glossy lips, jacket details, luxury shopping bags, brand logos, confident poses, mirror reflections, hands adjusting the jacket collar, fast spins, walking toward the elevator doors with effortless confidence. Every cut syncs perfectly to the music beat.

0:13–0:15
The elevator doors open again onto the luxury shopping mall. She confidently walks out carrying the remaining branded shopping bags, looking effortlessly chic. The camera follows from behind before orbiting to a final hero shot as she smiles at the camera. Premium fashion campaign ending with the luxury brand logo appearing on screen against a clean white background.

entries.title: Stylish Street Dance Music Video Prompt
entries.description: A comprehensive timestamped video prompt designed for Seedance, detailing specific dance moves, camera work, and VFX synchronized to a 118 BPM rhythm.
entries.prompt:
参照キャラクター画像を1枚使用する。参照画像の顔立ち、髪型、体型、衣装シルエット、表情、雰囲気を維持する。

参照画像がイラストの場合でも、実写の人物として自然に再解釈する。参照画像の印象、髪型、目元、衣装、空気感を保ちながら、現実に存在する俳優・モデルのような質感にする。

背景・VFX・色・記号・装飾は、参照画像の衣装、色、アクセサリー、世界観からランダム生成する。背景は固定の場所にせず、屋上、路地、ステージ裏、廃ビル、夜の街、抽象グラフィティ空間、ライブ会場裏、ネオン街など、参照画像に合う場所をランダムに選ぶ。全体はグラフィティ系実写MV風に統一する。

60fps。118 BPM基準。1拍は約0.508秒。半拍は約0.254秒。四分割は約0.127秒。

高品質な実写MV。リアルな人物、肌、髪、布、アクセサリー、靴。自然な照明と現実のカメラ質感。背景には実写と馴染むグラフィックモーションVFXを重ねる。

男性にも女性にも似合う、スタイリッシュで見栄えの良いストリートダンス。表情や空気感は参照画像のまま、身体の動きは118 BPMに正確に合わせる。脚のライン、重心移動、ターン、手先の表情を綺麗に見せる。低重心は禁止。膝は曲げ続けず、ビートのアクセントで一瞬だけ柔らかく使い、すぐ自然に伸ばす。基本姿勢は高めの重心を保ち、沈み込まず、立ち姿の美しさと流れる連続動作を優先する。

背景は映像開始時点から動いている。参照画像の世界観に合う抽象記号、短い文字断片、模様、アイコン、グラフィックパーツ、スプレー跡、光の線、ノイズ、影、図形、装飾をランダムに配置する。文字や記号の意味は固定しない。毎回違う背景になるようにする。

VFXは身体の動きに反応する。足の接地で粒子や波紋が広がる。かかとのひねりで短い軌跡が出る。肩ヒットで背景の線や図形が震える。手首スナップでインクや光の斬撃が飛ぶ。指フリックで衣装アクセサリーから小さなスパークが出る。布の揺れに合わせて衣装カラー由来の短い残像が出る。VFXは人物の顔や身体を隠さない。

カメラは実写MVのカメラワーク。開始直後から中距離の全身ショット。人物は映像開始時点ですでに踊っている。カメラは完全停止しない。短い押し込み、軽い引き、低位置の足元カット、短いスナップズーム、小さな半円回り込み、自然な手持ちの揺れを使う。横追跡やサイドスライド演出は禁止。ダンスのラインと衣装が読めるように撮影する。

0.0s - 0.5s
開始直後からダンス中。中距離の全身ショット。最初の強拍で片足を前へ踏み込み、膝を一瞬だけ柔らかく使ってすぐ伸ばす。半拍遅れて肩を軽くヒット。オフビートで片手首を外へスナップ。背後のランダムグラフィックVFXが跳ね、足元から粒子の波紋が弾ける。

0.5s - 1.0s
タイトなヒールトゥ。かかとをひねる。つま先をタップ。小さくクロスステップ。ステップごとに脚が自然に伸びる。靴の動きに短い粒子軌跡がつく。重心は高めに保ち、沈み込まない。

1.0s - 1.6s
カメラが軽く押し込む。クロスした足をほどき、身体の向きを斜めに切り替えながら、前後の小さなステップへつなぐ。脚のラインを見せながら、歩くように自然なグルーヴを作る。両腕は身体の近くでコンパクトに保つ。片手を下方向へフリック。衣装の差し色を元にしたインク斬撃や光の軌跡が背景に走る。

1.6s - 2.2s
上半身フレーズ。左肩ヒット。右肩ヒット。小さな胸ヒット。首を左右へ短くスナップ。中央へ戻す。下半身は自然な立ち姿勢を保つ。背景グラフィックが衣装カラーに合わせて揺れる。膝は固定せず、軽い弾みだけで処理する。

2.2s - 2.8s
低角度の足元カット。速いつま先タップを2回。かかとを軽く引く。片膝を一瞬だけ使い、すぐ自然に立ち上がる。足元で粒子波紋と影残像が反応する。低くしゃがむ動きは禁止。

2.8s - 3.4s
カメラが全身へ戻る。鋭いクロスステップで斜め前へ出る。片腕を身体の下側で低く切る。もう片方の手は、参照画像の衣装で一番特徴的な部分の近くに置く。手首からリング状VFXが広がり、粒子に砕ける。姿勢は高く、シルエットを綺麗に保つ。

3.4s - 4.0s
コンパクトなランニングマン変形。後ろへ軽く引く。膝を少しだけ引き上げる。前へ戻す。肩を落とす。脚は曲げっぱなしにせず、伸びる瞬間を作る。背景の図形や文字断片が同期してグリッチする。

4.0s - 4.6s
身体を斜めにピボット。衣装の縁取り、チェーン、布の端、リボン、アクセサリーが自然に揺れる。小さな指フリックでスパークや粒子が出る。身体は沈みすぎず、ターンのラインを綺麗に見せる。

4.6s - 5.2s
カメラが短く半円移動。片足クロス。反対の足をオープン。小さな胸ヒット。頭を軽く下げてすぐ戻す。目元や表情は参照画像の雰囲気を保つ。背景にはランダムな文字断片や図形が流れる。立ち姿は崩さない。

5.2s - 5.8s
速い手のフレーズ。手首スナップ。反対の手首スナップ。指フリック。手を衣装ディテールの近くへ落とす。手先や指先を綺麗に見せる。それぞれの手の動きに短いドット軌跡が出る。足元は軽いステップで自然につなぐ。

5.8s - 6.4s
半拍で左足、右足、左足へ細かく体重を乗せ替える。上半身はしなやかに反応する。肩がリズムに合わせて小さく遅れて動く。脚は沈むのではなく、弾むように伸び縮みする。背景レイヤーが身体の動きに合わせて上下する。

6.4s - 7.0s
小さな斜めシャッフル。ヒールトゥ切り替え。速いつま先スクレイプ。回収。下半身の影残像が0.2秒だけ複製され、粒子に崩れる。脚の曲げ伸ばしにメリハリを作る。低い姿勢は禁止。

7.0s - 7.7s
カメラが上半身へ押し込む。人物らしい短い視線や表情を入れる。片手で目立つ衣装ディテールを少し引き、すぐ離す。参照画像の雰囲気に合うインク波や光の波が壁を走る。上半身はシャープに、脚は自然に立つ。

7.7s - 8.4s
タイトな半回転で正面へ戻る。肩ヒット。手首スナップ。小さな胸ヒット。指フリック。ターン後の立ち姿が綺麗に見えるようにする。背景記号が一度だけ脈打つ。重心は落とさず、余韻で次の動きへつなぐ。

8.4s - 9.1s
反対方向へ身体の向きを切り替え、前後のステップでグルーヴ

entries.title: Ancient Stargazer 2D/3D Hybrid Comedy
entries.description: A 15-second comedic sequence blending a flat 2D sticker-style character with a realistic 3D ancient observatory, featuring synchronized audio and character physics.
entries.prompt:
【整体风格】

古风诗意视觉喜剧融合真人实拍写实质感与纯 Flat 2D Q版贴纸合成，针对 Seedance 2.0 的多镜头连续性、稳定角色参考、同步拟音、可控运镜与清晰因果物理反馈进行设计；采用含蓄克制的武侠美学、默片式喜剧节拍、温暖烛光与清冷月光的冷暖对照、磨旧黄铜反光、缓慢漂浮的香雾，并以“专业权威意外失控后迅速维持体面”的喜剧弧线，跳脱捣乱、惩罚与倒地模式。

【角色锁定】

Subject ID：一名21-25岁的Q版东亚女性小星官，圆润大头约占全身高度的56%，浅桃色平涂肤色、深棕色豆豆眼、细小沉着的嘴巴，黑色直发束成一个高发髻，佩戴银色弯月发簪，从脚到头穿白色布靴、深蓝绑腿、浅蓝色亚麻交领短袍、深靛蓝百褶裙、窄银腰带，腰间挂迷你星图袋，并系一条半透明长蓝丝带，全程只保持赛璐璐平涂、粗墨线描边与僵直纸片景深；

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜全景】

锁定机位配合极缓慢推轨建立一座真实古代观星台，空间位于高处木质露台，画面包含深色屋梁、透入月光的格栅屏风、巨大黄铜浑天仪、卷起的星图、竹制量尺、油灯、散落毛笔、红漆书案，以及薄雾笼罩下的远山；

她站在浑天仪下方黄铜圆环上，举起一根竹制指星杆，神情庄重地指向星图。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜中景偏牛仔景】

同一个穿浅蓝短袍和深靛蓝百褶裙的Q版女性小星官、同一座黄铜浑天仪、同一座观星台，background remains the same moonlit wooden terrace；

一只皮肤细节真实的真人手从画面右侧伸入，缓慢转动一层黄铜圆环，同一个穿浅蓝短袍和深靛蓝百褶裙的Q版女性小星官只完成一个连续平衡动作——她被旋转圆环带向上方，双脚踩稳后绕轴心转身，用长蓝丝带勾住第二层圆环，最后落入一个意外优雅的悬挂姿态；

黄铜吱呀声、丝带掠风声、木质轻敲声与一记清脆铃音精准同步动作。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写】

同一个穿浅蓝短袍 and 深靛蓝百褶裙的Q版女性小星官，background remains the same moonlit observatory；

她头顶的银色弯月发簪意外接住油灯光线，在真实纸质星图上投射出一组完整星宿影子，她的豆豆眼先惊讶睁大一拍，随后立刻镇定地整理衣袖，伸出指星杆指向那组影子，假装一切都是有意安排，并对真人手做出一个极小却权威的点头动作，同时一缕散发因尴尬而轻轻颤动；

镜头停留在她强行镇定的小嘴、反光的银色发簪与几乎无法察觉地发抖的蓝色丝带上，形成干脆喜剧定格。

【技术要求】

9:16竖屏，使用最高可用原生分辨率，电影级8K观感细节，首镜之后加入轻微手持呼吸感，角色身份与服装强一致性锁定，道具连续性准确，黄铜重量感与丝带运动物理可信，贴纸角色不接受体积化写实重打光，无对白，无可识别文字，不出现动物，不做拟物角色。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props
entries.translated_prompt:
[Overall Style] Ancient poetic visual comedy blending realistic live-action textures with pure flat 2D chibi-style sticker synthesis. Designed for Seedance 2.0's multi-shot continuity, stable character reference, synchronized foley, controlled camera movement, and clear causal physical feedback. Uses restrained wuxia aesthetics, silent-film comedic beats, contrast between warm candlelight and cold moonlight, worn brass reflections, slowly drifting incense smoke, and a comedic arc of "maintaining dignity after losing control."

[Character Lock] Subject ID: A 21-25 year old chibi-style East Asian female stargazer. Round head approx 56% of body height, light peach flat-shaded skin, dark brown dot eyes, small calm mouth, black straight hair in a high bun with a silver crescent hairpiece. Wearing white boots, dark blue leg wraps, light blue linen cross-collar short robe, dark indigo pleated skirt, narrow silver belt, a mini star-map pouch, and a translucent long blue ribbon. Maintains cel-shading, thick ink outlines, and stiff paper-like depth throughout.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | Wide Shot] Locked camera with slow tracking shot establishing a realistic ancient observatory on a high wooden terrace. Includes dark beams, lattice screens with moonlight, a giant brass armillary sphere, rolled star maps, bamboo rulers, oil lamps, scattered brushes, red lacquered desk, and misty distant mountains. She stands on a brass ring below the armillary, solemnly pointing a bamboo rod at the star map.

[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Medium/Cowboy Shot] Same chibi female stargazer, same brass armillary, same observatory. A realistic human hand enters from the right, slowly turning a brass ring. The chibi character performs a continuous balance move—she is carried upward by the ring, turns around the axis, hooks the second ring with her blue ribbon, and lands in an unexpectedly elegant hanging pose. Brass creaks, ribbon wind sounds, wood knocks, and a crisp bell ring are precisely synchronized.

[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up] Same chibi female stargazer in the same observatory. Her silver crescent hairpiece catches the lamp light, projecting a set of constellations onto the paper star map. Her dot eyes widen in surprise for a beat, then she immediately calmly straightens her sleeves and points the rod at the shadows, pretending it was intentional, giving a tiny authoritative nod to the human hand while a stray hair quivers in embarrassment. Camera freezes on her forced-calm mouth, reflective hairpiece, and trembling blue ribbon for a comedic finish.

[Technical Requirements] 9:16 vertical, max native resolution, 8K cinematic detail, slight handheld breathing after the first shot, strong identity/outfit lock, accurate prop continuity, credible brass weight and ribbon physics. Sticker character does not accept volumetric lighting. No dialogue, no text, no animals.

entries.title: Cozy Coffee Preparation ASMR Vlog
entries.description: A detailed video prompt for a morning coffee-making vlog with an ASMR aesthetic, including shots for bean grinding, milk frothing, and tasting.
entries.prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright kitchen morning light. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.
STYLE: Cozy coffee-prep vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: bean grinder whirring, portafilter tamping, steam wand hissing, cup clinking, milk frothing.
SUBJECT: Young man in his mid-20s, plain t-shirt, hair slightly tousled, minimal accessories. Calm, focused energy while making his morning coffee.
SETTING: Small kitchen counter with an espresso machine on a bright morning. Natural daylight, coffee beans and a mug nearby, quiet atmosphere.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the counter, switches on the machine. "Morning coffee, the proper way."
→ (3s, overhead shot) Grinds fresh coffee beans, fine grounds falling into the portafilter.
→ (3s, close-up) Tamps the grounds down firmly and evenly.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Locks the portafilter into the machine. "Here we go."
→ (3s, detail shot) Espresso streams slowly into a small cup. No dialogue.
→ (3s, medium shot) Pours cold milk into a small steel pitcher. "Time for the milk."
→ (3s, macro shot) Steam wand hissing as it froths the milk.
→ (3s, propped shot) Pours frothed milk carefully over the espresso, forming light layers.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Holds the finished cup, takes a small sip, satisfied smile. "That's exactly what I needed."
→ (3s, final shot) Reaches toward camera, still holding the cup. "See you later." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural kitchen ambience — grinder whirring, tamping, steam hissing, milk pouring should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine focused smiles, occasional careful pauses while pouring, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright morning light shifts. Should resemble a genuine personal coffee vlog on a consumer camcorder, not a commercial or AI-generated production.

entries.title: AI Puppy Acting Challenge Scene Script
entries.description: A detailed multi-scene prompt script for creating a humorous acting video of puppies in a rural setting, featuring specific camera movements and expressive character reactions.
entries.prompt:
视频时长：10 秒
画面比例：16:9
核心主题：田园背景下三只幼犬的幽默 “演戏” 挑战

分镜 1：[0-1 秒]
镜头指令： 中特写 (Medium Close-up)，水平固定视角。
画面描述： 背景是色彩饱和度极高的郁郁葱葱的玉米地，叶片纹理清晰可见。两只胖乎乎的幼犬并排坐在干燥的泥地上。一只人类的手突然入镜，对准左侧的花白小狗比出 “手枪” 手势。
动作 / 视觉效果： 听到模拟枪声后，花白小狗配合地向后翻倒，展示出毛茸茸的白色肚皮，动作憨态可掬，伴随轻微的泥土扬尘。
分镜 2：[1-3 秒]
镜头指令： 中特写 (Medium Close-up)，镜头平滑向右横移 (Pan Right)。
画面描述： 手势移向中间的浅黄色小狗。
动作 / 视觉效果： 随着手势发出指令，浅黄色小狗闭上眼睛，顺势向后仰倒。此时，镜头右侧露出了第三只黑色幼犬（小黑），它紧闭双眼，表情严肃且纹丝不动，呈现出一种 “拒不配合” 的滑稽感。
分镜 3：[3-8 秒]
镜头指令： 特写 (Close-up)，固定镜头聚焦于 “小黑”。
画面描述： “小黑” 处于画面中心，它的毛发在自然的阴天柔光下泛着微光。它原本紧闭双眼，倔强地保持坐姿。
动作 / 视觉效果： 当它听到旁白提到的 “鸡腿威胁” 时，瞳孔瞬间发生微细的收缩并猛地睁大眼睛，眼神从迷茫瞬间转化为充满渴望的惊讶，这是表演转折的核心点，表情极具拟人化张力。
分镜 4：[8-10 秒]
镜头指令： 特写 (Close-up)，固定视角。
画面描述： “小黑” 为了美食决定展现极致演技。
动作 / 视觉效果： 手势再次发出 “Biū” 的指令，黑色小狗张大嘴巴做出夸张的惨叫状，全身肌肉紧绷，以一种充满戏剧性的张力向后翻滚。动作与前两只狗形成鲜明对比，充满了表演的热情与喜剧冲突。

场景风格总结：
视觉纹理： 极致细腻的幼犬毛发质感，背景玉米地的绿色要清新明亮，与泥土地的土褐色形成对比。
灯光： 自然明亮的户外柔光，模拟阴天环境，避免生硬的阴影，确保聚焦于小狗的面部微动作。
氛围： 幽默诙谐的纪实风格，强调宠物与人之间的戏剧互动
entries.translated_prompt:
Video Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9
Core Theme: Humorous "acting" challenge of three puppies in a rural setting.

Scene 1: [0-1s]
Camera Instruction: Medium Close-up, fixed horizontal perspective.
Visual Description: Background is a lush cornfield with high color saturation, clear leaf textures. Two chubby puppies sit side-by-side on dry mud. A human hand enters the frame, making a "pistol" gesture toward the white-spotted puppy on the left.
Action/Visual Effect: Upon hearing the simulated gunshot, the puppy cooperatively falls backward, showing its fluffy white belly, adorably clumsy, with a slight dust cloud.

Scene 2: [1-3s]
Camera Instruction: Medium Close-up, smooth pan right.
Visual Description: The hand gesture moves to the light yellow puppy in the middle.
Action/Visual Effect: As the gesture gives the command, the yellow puppy closes its eyes and falls backward. Now, a third black puppy ("Xiao Hei") appears on the right, eyes tightly shut, expression serious and motionless, showing a hilarious "refusal to cooperate."

Scene 3: [3-8s]
Camera Instruction: Close-up, fixed focus on "Xiao Hei."
Visual Description: "Xiao Hei" is at the center, its fur shimmering under natural overcast light. It keeps its eyes shut, stubbornly maintaining its sitting posture.
Action/Visual Effect: When it hears the mention of a "chicken leg threat" in the narration, its pupils contract slightly and eyes snap wide open. The expression shifts from dazed to surprised desire—the core turning point of the performance with anthropomorphic tension.

Scene 4: [8-10s]
Camera Instruction: Close-up, fixed perspective.
Visual Description: "Xiao Hei" decides to show extreme acting for food.
Action/Visual Effect: The hand makes the "Biū" gesture again. The black puppy opens its mouth wide in an exaggerated scream, muscles tensed, rolling backward with dramatic tension. The movement contrasts sharply with the first two dogs, full of performative passion and comedic conflict.

Style Summary:
Visual Texture: Extremely detailed puppy fur texture, fresh and bright green cornfield background contrasting with earthy brown soil.
Lighting: Natural bright outdoor soft light, simulating an overcast environment, avoiding harsh shadows, ensuring focus on the puppies' micro-expressions.
Atmosphere: Humorous documentary style, emphasizing the dramatic interaction between pets and humans.

entries.prompt: 스타일: 실제 콘서트 다큐멘터리 영화, 핸드헬드 카메라 에너지, 실용적인 무대 조명, 거친 리얼리즘, Sony A7S3으로 촬영, 35mm 렌즈, 고에너지 현대 라이브 콘서트 공연. 지속 시간: 30초. [전역 주제 및 참조]: 주제는 자연스럽게 자신감 있고 카리스마 넘치는 30세 여성으로 첨부 이미지를 100% 따른다, 캐릭터와 조명 참조로 기반. 그녀는 매진된 아레나 콘서트를 공연 중. entries.title: 3D Soccer Energy Drink Commercial
entries.description: A detailed storyboard-style prompt for a Pixar-inspired 3D animated sports commercial featuring an underdog soccer player and a heroic transformation.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second 16:9 premium 3D animated commercial in a Pixar / Illumination-inspired style with bright saturated colors, sunny outdoor lighting, playful humor, and strong cinematic sports energy. Main character: a short, chubby soccer player wearing blue jersey number 7. Supporting characters: several tall, slim teammates/opponents, creating a strong comedic contrast. Tone: starts funny and awkward, then turns energetic, uplifting, and heroic after drinking an energy drink. Story flow: Scene 1 (0–3s) – Underdog setup On a bright soccer field, tall players dominate the game. Camera tilts down to the short chubby player. He tries to dribble, slips in a clumsy funny way, and falls. From his low-angle POV, the tall players look down at him with smug expressions. He feels discouraged. Scene 2 (3–6s) – Energy appears A glowing blue “ENERGY” sports drink rolls to his side. He sits up, grabs it, opens it, and drinks. Immediately his eyes light up and a blue-red electric aura bursts around him. He jumps to his feet, now full of power and confidence. Scene 3 (6–10s) – Comeback dribble Game resumes. A streak of blue energy flashes past the tall players as the short player steals the ball. Show low-angle dynamic tracking shots of his rapid footwork. He dribbles at high speed, weaving through defenders, nutmegging one player, and charging toward the goal. His movements are fast, agile, and visually exciting. Scene 4 (10–13s) – Hero goal In dramatic slow motion, he leaps and winds up for a powerful kick. Then the action snaps into full speed as he strikes the ball hard. The soccer ball turns into a glowing fireball with a bright energy trail, flies past the shocked goalkeeper, and smashes into the net. The crowd erupts in celebration with confetti flying. Scene 5 (13–15s) – Packshot ending The hero stands proudly at midfield with one foot on the ball and one hand holding up the ENERGY drink. The sunlight behind him casts a long shadow shaped like a tall, strong soccer champion. Final close-up on the drink bottle as the product hero shot. entries.title: Cinematic Gymnastics Balance Beam
entries.description: An extremely detailed multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.0 depicting a professional balance beam routine with cinematic lighting and slow-motion technical details.
entries.prompt:
【风格】竞技体操平衡木大片（Artistic Gymnastics Balance Beam），电视转播+电影感混合质感（16:9 Cinematic, Photorealistic），高速摄影升格（Super Slow-mo），体操馆暖顶光+深色背景影调，国家队级动作规格

【时长】15秒

【场景】体操比赛馆：一条标准平衡木（10厘米宽木面）居于画面中央，木下铺蓝色缓冲垫，背景观众席和裁判席虚化成暗色块，顶棚射灯把木面照得发亮，空气中有镁粉微尘

【角色】主角

[00:00-00:02] 镜头1：上木前（The Chalk）

近景：主角站在平衡木一端下方，双手互搓镁粉，白色粉尘在射灯光柱里缓缓飘散；她抬眼望向木面，下颌收紧，向裁判方向举手示意。

【音效】全场安静，只有镁粉摩擦的沙沙声和一次深呼吸。

[00:02-00:04] 镜头2：上木（The Mount）

侧面中景：她助跑两步踏跳板腾起，双手撑木顺势成直角支撑再立起，稳稳站上10厘米宽的木面，双臂展开成一条直线，脚尖绷直。

【音效】踏板一声闷响，落木后木身轻微的震颤声。

[00:04-00:08] 镜头3：木上翻腾串（The Acro Series, Super Slow-mo）

升格慢动作，机位沿木侧平行跟移：她在木上完成后手翻接直体后空翻的连接串，双脚每次都精准落回巴掌宽的木面正中，落木瞬间脚踝微调、双臂快速展开控制平衡，发髻甩出的碎发悬在空中，镁粉从脚下炸起一小团白雾。

【音效】升格段每次手掌和脚掌拍在木面上的"砰"声被拉长放大，木身震颤的嗡声清晰可闻。

[00:08-00:10.5] 镜头4：跳步与转体（Leap + Turn）

恢复常速，正侧面机位：她起跳完成一个交换腿大跳，双腿在空中劈成一条直线，落木后紧接单脚立转两周，另一条腿盘于膝侧，转速均匀，裙摆式的动作线条干净利落。

【音效】跳起落木两声轻响，转体时只有脚掌与木面的摩擦声。

[00:10.5-00:13] 镜头5：下法（The Dismount）

侧面机位微仰拍：她朝木端连接两个后手翻加速，从木端腾空而起，完成直体后空翻转体720度，身体在空中拧成一条紧绷的线，落地双脚砸进垫子——纹丝不动，一步未挪，双臂瞬间上举亮相。

【音效】腾空后风声，落垫一声厚实的闷响，随后全场爆发出掌声与欢呼。

[00:13-00:15] 镜头6：亮相定格（The Salute）

正面中景缓慢推近：她保持亮相姿势，胸口快速起伏，额角有汗珠反光，随后转向裁判席再次举手行礼，嘴角上扬，画面在她的笑容上定格。

【音效】掌声持续，定格配一声上扬收束音。

【备注】所有木上动作双脚必须始终落在木面上，落木瞬间允许小幅手臂调整但身体不摇晃；下法落地必须"钉"在垫上纹丝不动（Stuck Landing），这是全片最重要的记忆点

entries.title: Psychedelic Horror Abstract Art Animation
entries.description: An emotional and intense abstract animation prompt combining psychedelic horror themes with neon aesthetics, hand-drawn textures, and unstable, fast-paced transformations.
entries.prompt: abstract art animation, hand-drawn, emotional kinetic transformation. {{Image 1}} through {{Image 2}} are five psychedelic and horror-inspired anime art compositions featuring glowing spiral-patterned irises, overlapping face collages, jagged lightning-like slashes, neon magenta/electric blue/violet palettes, shattered glass with water droplets, and claustrophobic intensity. Extract every form, motif, color, line quality, texture, rhythm, and emotional tension from the references. The animation must feel fast, alive, unstable, and emotionally charged. Every transformation seamless and continuous. No hard cuts. No static pauses except single-frame impact holds. Entire composition including background constantly transforms. All elements behave as if pulled by memory, gravity, heat, sound, and emotion simultaneously. [0-1.5s] A central abstract figure appears as if already in motion. Its inner color pulses outward in uneven emotional waves, while its outline tears away in multiple directions. The background bends around the figure like soft paper under pressure. Fine hand-drawn textures crawl across the surface faster than the main form moves, creating tension between body and skin. [1.5-3s] The detached outlines accelerate and become nervous thread-like forms. The figure's color core stretches into sharp ribbons and liquid stains simultaneously. Some ribbons snap back, others whip forward, each leaving a trembling residue. Empty spaces between moving parts ignite into new shapes, as if the composition is creating forms to fill its own emotional gaps. [3-4.5s] All forms suddenly surge diagonally across the frame. One large shape folds over itself like fabric, but the fold reveals a completely different texture beneath: grain, chalk, wet ink, and scraped paint all visible at once. The background follows the fold, twisting into a new color field. Smaller forms are dragged behind the motion, stretching into speed lines that remain alive and continue transforming. [4.5-6s] The composition fractures into several emotional forces: one calm, one violent, one fragile, one ecstatic. Each force pulls color from the others. Shadows appear before the objects that cast them, moving ahead like predictions. Original forms chase their own shadows, but the shadows mutate faster, becoming brighter, thicker, and more dominant than the objects. [6-7.5s] A rapid chain reaction begins. Every collision between forms produces a new motif taken from the references: fragments, symbols, textures, silhouettes, stains, lines, and color fields. These new motifs immediately accelerate in different directions. Trails do not simply fade — they harden into new bodies, then melt again, then split into smaller emotional echoes. [7.5-9s] The entire frame compresses toward a single invisible point near the lower center. All lines, colors, textures, shadows, and background layers squeeze inward at different speeds. Hold maximum compression for one single frame. Then everything explodes upward and outward with vertical smears, wobbling contours, and overshooting motion. Each element lands in a new position but continues vibrating from impact. [9-10.5s] Textures begin migrating between forms like exchanged emotions. A rough dry texture enters a fluid form, making it move in broken angular steps. A liquid texture enters a rigid form, causing it to sag, drip, and breathe. A glowing color texture passes into the background, making the entire environment pulse. Every form changes behavior based on the texture it receives. [10.5-12s] A cascade of rotations crosses the frame. Each form flips, twists, or turns inside out, revealing a hidden back face with a dramatically different color and emotional quality. Revealed faces reach toward neighboring forms like hands, hooks, flames, or waves. When touched, the next form rotates immediately, continuing the cascade faster and faster until the entire frame has transformed into a new emotional world. [12-13.5s] Boundaries dissolve everywhere at once. Forms merge, reject each other, separate, then merge again. New hybrid shapes inherit colors, textures, and motion behaviors from their parents but never become identical to them. The background no longer sits behind the forms — it becomes one of the forms, pushing forward, swallowing edges, and releasing new figures from within itself. [13.5-15s] Every previous process returns simultaneously at maximum speed: outlines detach, colors seep and drip, textures migrate, shadows lead, forms chase, trails solidify, hidden faces rotate, boundaries dissolve, backgrounds fold, and hybrid shapes multiply. Each element performs multiple transformations at once. Final second feels emotionally overloaded but visually intentional — a fast, hand-drawn abstract storm where every reference has been fully absorbed and transformed until the last frame.

Shot 1 (0–3 sec):
Extreme wide cinematic shot of an ancient ruined arena surrounded by rocky mountains at sunset. A powerful woman wearing a rugged warrior outfit stands alone in the center while three massive lions slowly approach from the shadows. Dust moves through the air, dramatic atmosphere, intense tension.

Shot 2 (3–6 sec):
Low-angle action shot as the lions charge toward her. The camera moves quickly around the scene as she dodges the first attack with incredible agility, sliding across the ground while dust explodes around her. Realistic lion movement, detailed fur, cinematic motion blur.

Shot 3 (6–10 sec):
Fast-paced combat sequence. The woman uses her skills and intelligence to fight back, avoiding attacks and overpowering the lions one by one. Dynamic camera angles, close-ups of her determined expression, slow-motion moments showing powerful movements, realistic physics and intense action choreography.

Shot 4 (10–13 sec):
The final lion makes a dramatic leap toward her. The camera rotates in slow motion as she blocks the attack and defeats the lion with a powerful final move. Dust fills the air as the arena becomes silent.

Shot 5 (13–15 sec):
Epic hero shot. The woman stands victorious in the center of the arena as the defeated lions retreat into the distance. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the vast landscape, golden sunset, wind moving her hair and clothes, cinematic victory moment.

Style:
Ultra-realistic Hollywood action film, epic scale, realistic animal movement, dramatic lighting, cinematic camera work, detailed textures, 4K quality, natural motion, intense atmosphere.

Negative Prompt:
cartoon, fantasy CGI look, unrealistic animals, blurry, bad anatomy, extra limbs, unnatural fighting, blood, gore, distorted face, flickering, low quality, watermark.

entries.title: Nostalgic Han River VHS
entries.description: A detailed prompt for creating an authentic 15-second analogue handheld camcorder video set at the Han River featuring specific brand branding.
entries.prompt: Create an authentic 15-second analogue home-video recording filmed with a handheld Hi8/VHS-C camcorder. The camcorder is never visible. The viewer only sees the recorded footage, as if watching a digitized family videotape. This is not a vlog, commercial, or cinematic film, just a friend casually filming another friend. Use genuine analogue camcorder aesthetics: soft SD resolution, VHS grain, faint interlacing, analogue colour bleed, mild tracking noise, autofocus breathing, slight exposure fluctuations, imperfect handheld shake, natural motion blur, washed-out colours, and subtle tape hiss. A young Korean woman in her early twenties wears a pastel fitted crop top, mid-rise vintage blue denim shorts, white ankle socks, classic white sneakers, a lightweight windbreaker tied around her waist, and carries a simple canvas shoulder bag. The scene takes place beside the Han River on a warm summer afternoon. She walks naturally toward the riverside railing before stopping to admire a massive floating HIGGSFIELD installation in the river. The word HIGGSFIELD is built from giant three-dimensional block letters, mounted on a realistic floating platform. The camera gently pans between her and the installation, keeping both in frame. She smiles naturally, takes a few steps closer, then notices the unseen camera operator. She laughs softly, gives a warm wave, points excitedly toward the giant HIGGSFIELD sign, gives a subtle thumbs-up, then looks back at the river with a smile before continuing her walk. One continuous 15-second recording with no cuts or transitions. The HIGGSFIELD installation must stay prominent, crystal clear, and naturally integrated into the environment. Include realistic ambient sounds such as wind, birds, distant conversations, bicycles, and water.

entries.title: Military Carrier Emergency Documentary Prompt
entries.description: A detailed 15-second documentary-style prompt for an emergency landing on an aircraft carrier with realistic camera work.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT
15 seconds | 16:9 | live-action military documentary footage
Fictional aircraft-carrier emergency at sea.
Hyper-realistic raw footage.
Fast multi-shot storytelling across handheld, telephoto and deck cameras.

STORY
A carrier-based fighter returns over rough open water with an apparent mechanical problem. The flight deck enters emergency recovery mode. Crew clear the landing area as the fighter approaches and lands safely.

00–03s — EMERGENCY
Wide handheld footage on an active carrier deck under heavy overcast skies.

Strong sea wind, grey ocean, wet worn deck.

Crew receive an alert and urgently clear the landing area.

One crew member signals others away as the camera quickly turns toward the ocean.

03–06s — FINAL APPROACH
Hard cut to long telephoto footage.

A fictional fighter approaches low over the ocean, landing gear down.

Aircraft makes subtle roll and yaw corrections against turbulent air.

Heat distortion behind engines.

Camera operator struggles slightly to maintain framing.

06–09s — DECK SCRAMBLE
Shoulder-mounted footage among crew.

Personnel rapidly move equipment and take safe positions.

One crew member crosses foreground, briefly blocking the lens.

Camera pans toward the approaching fighter.

Controlled professional urgency, no theatrical panic.

09–12s — TOUCHDOWN
Low deck camera from a safe side position.

Fighter touches down firmly.

Landing gear compresses, tyres produce a small realistic puff, aircraft rapidly decelerates.

Camera makes a fast imperfect pan following it.

No explosion or exaggerated sparks.

12–15s — SAFE STOP
Three-quarter handheld footage.

Aircraft reaches a controlled stop, engine still running and heat haze visible.

Crew cautiously approach, signal toward the cockpit and inspect the aircraft.

Final frame holds briefly on the fighter surrounded by responding crew with rough ocean behind.

CAMERA
Real military documentation/news footage.

Mix handheld deck camera, shoulder-mounted footage, long telephoto tracking and fixed low deck camera.

Hard cuts.
Reactive pans.
Foreground obstruction.
Autofocus corrections.
Telephoto compression.
Wind-induced micro-shake.
Natural motion blur.

Camera operators react to events rather than anticipating them.

ENVIRONMENT
Working aircraft carrier in rough open ocean.

Wet non-slip deck, painted markings, deck equipment, parked fictional aircraft, heavy clouds and strong maritime wind.

PHYSICS
Aircraft has convincing mass, momentum and aerodynamic behaviour.

Approach remains aligned with the carrier.
Landing gear compresses naturally.
Deceleration has believable inertia.

Crew clothing and straps react continuously to wind.
Jet engines produce realistic heat distortion.

AUDIO
Powerful wind, ocean ambience, carrier machinery, shouted instructions, approaching jet roar, tyre contact, aircraft deceleration and crew communication.

Sound perspective changes naturally between shots.

entries.title: Tuscany Villa Vacation Cinematic

entries.prompt:
A radiant woman in her late 20s enjoys a luxurious, peaceful solo weekend getaway on the terrace of a stone villa in the rolling hills of Tuscany. She has long wavy chestnut hair loosely tied back, warm olive skin, and wears a soft linen white off-shoulder dress with delicate gold jewelry and bare feet. Maintain perfect facial consistency, genuine relaxed joy, and natural, unhurried movements throughout the entire video.
The setting features a flower-filled stone terrace with olive trees, climbing vines, terracotta pots of lavender and geraniums, a rustic wooden table, and distant golden hills under soft late-afternoon sunlight with gentle bokeh and warm cinematic color grading. Ultra-realistic, premium film-like photography, subtle film grain, smooth stabilized camera, gentle push-ins, slow orbits, and elegant rack focus in horizontal 16:9.
00:00–00:03 Wide establishing shot of the villa terrace as she steps out barefoot, smiling, carrying a woven basket of fresh fruit and a book. 00:03–00:06 Close-ups of her pouring sparkling water into a glass, arranging peaches and cheese on the table, and settling into a cushioned chair with soft laughter. 00:06–00:09 She reads a few pages of her book, then stretches contentedly, closing her eyes to feel the warm breeze. 00:09–00:12 She stands and walks to the terrace railing, leaning on it while gazing at the golden hills and taking a deep, peaceful breath. 00:12–00:15 Soft smile toward the camera as she raises her glass in a quiet toast to herself; scene slowly fades with warm bokeh and drifting petals.
