entries.prompt: 【风格】 真实工业液压机实拍场景与扁平2D动漫贴纸角色结合的反差喜剧短片。 工业设备、金属工作台、车间背景保持真实摄影质感；水豚噜噜始终保持纯粹的扁平2D动漫贴纸风格：平面卡通色块、清晰稳定的深色描边、轻微纸片质感、简洁二维阴影和明显贴纸感。 角色只有轻微脚底接地阴影，不产生三维实体质感。 【时长／画幅】 视频时长约14秒，9:16竖屏。 全程固定机位、连续单镜头、一镜到底，无剪辑、无转场。 【场景】 真实工业车间内部。 画面中央下方是一座圆形厚重金属工作台，画面正上方是一台大型液压机的圆形金属压头。压头、角色和工作台位于同一条垂直中心轴线上Mess 工作台表面存在真实金属划痕、油渍和冷硬反光。背景可见液压机框架、管线和工业设备结构，环境照明为冷白色车间灯光。 水豚噜噜从第一帧开始站在圆形工作台中央。 【角色】 主角为水豚噜噜（Capybara Lulu）。 Q版拟人卡通水豚，淡黄色圆润身体，大头短身比例，短小圆润的双臂和双腿，豆状手爪和脚爪，穿橙色短裤和黄色围兜式小围裙，头顶固定一颗小橘子。 角色全程保持相同的五官、身体颜色、服装、描边、头身比例和二维贴纸质感。 头顶小橘子、橙色短裤和黄色围裙始终与身体连接，压扁时跟随身体产生二维挤压形变，恢复后回到原本结构和位置。 【核心道具】 大型工业液压机。 圆形金属压头只能沿垂直方向稳定下降和上升。压头首先接触水豚噜噜头顶的小橘子，然后继续压到头部、身体和四肢。 人物形变必须由压头真实接触触发。压头尚未接触角色时，水豚噜噜保持正常高度和比例。 【剪辑手法】 整条视频只有一个固定正面镜头。 摄影机不移动、不推拉、不变焦、不摇镜。所有画面变化仅来自液压压头上下运动、水豚噜噜的表情动作以及身体压扁和恢复。 结尾不切镜，通过“完全压扁后的停顿—突然恢复—奶凶回应”形成反转笑点。 【镜头1】 水豚噜噜站在金属工作台中央，身体自然放松，左右轻微晃动，嘴巴微微开合，发出软萌的： “嗯呜～唔唔～” 它先看向前方，随后听见上方传来轻微机械声，抬起头观察液压压头，表情从呆萌逐渐变成疑惑。 它歪头发出短促声音： “嗯？唔？” 【镜头2】 液压机启动，压头沿垂直方向稳定向下移动。 水豚噜噜抬头盯着逐渐靠近的压头，眼睛睁大，双臂紧张地抬到胸前，双脚仍站在工作台中央。 它连续发出慌张的小动物叫声： “呜？呜呜！” 压头未接触身体前，角色保持完整正常比例。 【镜头3】 压头首先碰到水豚噜噜头顶的小橘子。 接触瞬间，小橘子、头部和身体开始产生连续的二维挤压形变。随着压头持续下降，角色纵向高度逐渐缩短，头部变矮，脸部五官的上下距离缩短，身体和四肢逐渐被压低，整体轮廓向左右铺开Mess 水豚噜噜睁大眼睛，嘴巴张开，发出逐渐拉长的可爱惊叫： “呜哇——！呜呜呜——！” 声音随着身体被压低逐渐变闷，但角色脸部始终位于身体中央并保持清晰可识别。 【镜头4】 压头继续稳定下降。 水豚噜噜被逐层压成低矮、宽扁的贴纸形态。头顶小橘子变成横向压扁形状，耳朵、脸颊、双臂、身体、橙色短裤和黄色围裙一起向左右铺开。 角色底部始终紧贴金属工作台，不能悬空。 压头到达最低位置后，水豚噜噜被完全压成一张摊在工作台上的扁平二维贴纸。脸仍位于中央，眼睛委屈地眯起，嘴巴保持可见。 接触区域短促爆出少量橙黄色金属火花，同时出现清晰的金属冲击声。 【镜头5】 液压压头快速向上回升。 压头离开后，水豚噜噜仍然保持完全压扁的薄片状态，安静停留片刻，没有马上恢复。 它从压扁的脸部发出微弱、闷闷的： “唔……呜……” 随后眼睛慢慢变成不爽的半眯状态，眉眼向内压，表情从委屈转为奶凶生气。 【镜头6】 水豚噜噜进行快速两段式恢复Mess 第一阶段：压扁身体的中央突然向上鼓起，形成极短暂的矮胖中间形态，左右铺开的轮廓同时向中心收拢。 第二阶段：头部、身体和双腿极速向上拉伸，瞬间恢复成最初的完整Q版站立比例，脚底仍落在原来的工作台中央位置。 恢复瞬间发出短促、弹性的： “啵！” 恢复后，水豚噜噜立即双手叉腰，双脚分开站稳，身体略微前倾，半眯眼、鼓起脸颊，面对镜头和操作者连续发出奶凶的小动物抗议声： “哼唔！呜呜！哼！” 嘴巴随叫声连续开合，声音清楚有力。最后停在双手叉腰、生气又可爱的回应姿势。 【环境声与音效】 全片无背景音乐。 保留真实工业车间环境底噪、液压设备启动声、持续下压的机械轰鸣、金属摩擦和挤压声、最低位置的短促冲击声、少量火花爆裂声以及压头回升时的液压释放声。 水豚噜噜的所有声音均来自角色本人，并与嘴型、表情和身体状态同步。 压扁时声音逐渐变闷；恢复瞬间加入短促的卡通弹性回弹音；恢复后奶凶叫声重新变得清晰响亮。
entries.translated_prompt: [Style] A contrast comedy short film combining a realistic industrial hydraulic press scene with a flat 2D anime sticker character. Industrial equipment and background maintain realistic photographic texture; Capybara Lulu remains in a pure flat 2D anime sticker style with cartoon color blocks and clear dark outlines. [Duration/Aspect Ratio] Approx. 14 seconds, 9:16 vertical screen. Fixed camera, continuous single shot, no cuts or transitions. [Scene] Realistic industrial workshop with a heavy metal workbench and a circular hydraulic press head. Capybara Lulu stands in the center from the first frame. [Character] Capybara Lulu: A chibi humanoid cartoon capybara, pale yellow body, large head, short limbs, wearing orange shorts and a yellow bib apron with an orange on its head. [Core Prop] Large industrial hydraulic press. [Editing] Single fixed frontal shot. All changes come from the movement of the press and Lulu's expressions and deformation. [Shot 1] Lulu stands on the workbench, swaying slightly, making soft 'un-wu' sounds. It looks up at the approaching press with confusion. [Shot 2] The press moves down. Lulu stares with wide eyes, arms raised nervously. [Shot 3] The press hits the orange on Lulu's head. Lulu, the orange, and the body undergo 2D squeezing deformation, widening as they flatten. Lulu screams as the sound becomes muffled. [Shot 4] Lulu is completely flattened into a paper-thin 2D sticker. Metal sparks and an impact sound occur. [Shot 5] The press rises. Lulu remains flat for a moment, making weak moans, then eyes turn into a grumpy squint. [Shot 6] Lulu restores in two stages: first bulging in the center, then snapping back into the original chibi proportions with a 'pop' sound. It immediately puts hands on hips, squinting and puffing out cheeks to make angry but cute protest sounds at the camera. [Sound Effects] No background music. Real industrial noise, mechanical hums, metal impact, and synchronized character voices that become muffled when flattened and clear when restored.

entries.title: Olympic Platform Diving Cinematic Video
entries.description: A highly detailed, structured prompt for generating a 15-second cinematic video of a professional platform diving performance, including shot breakdowns, camera angles, and sound effects.
entries.prompt:
【风格】竞技跳水体育大片（Olympic-style Platform Diving），电视转播+电影感混合质感（16:9 Cinematic, Photorealistic），高速摄影升格（Super Slow-mo），室内跳水馆冷色水蓝影调，国家队级动作规格
【时长】15秒
【场景】室内跳水馆：20米高台，台面铺防滑垫，下方是碧蓝泳池，池底有波光，观众席在背景虚化成暗色块，顶棚射灯列阵
【角色】主角@

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：台端静止（The Stillness）
低角度仰拍大远景：主角站在20米跳台最边缘，脚尖扣住台沿，双臂前平举，全场安静得只剩水声。
切近景：她深吸一口气，胸口起伏一次，手指微微绷直，眼神锁定前下方水面，下颌收紧。
【音效】场馆环境音骤然安静，只有池水轻微晃动声和一次深呼吸声。

[00:03-00:05] 镜头2：起跳（The Takeoff）
侧面中景固定机位：她双臂向下压、双腿蹬台，向上跃起离台，身体在最高点收紧抱膝，整个人像上了发条的陀螺开始向后翻转。
【音效】蹬台的一声闷响，随后只剩风声。

[00:05-00:10] 镜头3：空中翻腾（The Flight, Super Slow-mo）
升格慢动作，镜头从跳台高度垂直跟随下坠：她在空中完成向后翻腾三周半抱膝，翻转匀速干净，每一周身体姿态都收得极紧，水珠从发梢甩出悬在空中；
翻转到位后突然打开身体，双臂上举合拢成一条直线，笔直指向水面，下落加速，射灯光在她身上快速掠过。
【音效】升格段风声被拉长，翻转时衣料细微的呼呼声，打开身体瞬间一声干脆的"咻"。

[00:10-00:12] 镜头4：压水花入水（Rip Entry）
恢复常速，水面高度侧面机位：她像一根针一样垂直扎入水中，入水点只弹起一圈细小的水纹和几粒水珠，几乎没有水花，水面很快恢复平静。
【音效】入水只有一声短促干净的"噗"，随后场馆爆发出观众的惊呼和掌声。

[00:12-00:15] 镜头5：水下与出水（Underwater + Rise）
水下机位：她入水后身体舒展，气泡呈一条笔直的银色柱状拖在身后，她在蓝色水中翻身向上；
切水面机位：她破水而出甩了下头发，抬手抹去脸上的水，望向记分牌方向露出笑容，画面定格。
【音效】水下低频的咕噜声转为出水瞬间的清亮水声，掌声持续，定格配一声上扬收束音。

【备注】全片入水水花越小越好（Rip Entry压水花技术），空中翻腾必须姿态紧凑、转速均匀，避免肢体松散
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style] Olympic-style Platform Diving, mixed TV broadcast + cinematic texture (16:9 Cinematic, Photorealistic), super slow-mo, indoor diving hall with cool blue tones, national team level movements.
[Duration] 15 seconds.
[Scene] Indoor diving hall: 20m platform, anti-slip mats, clear blue pool below with shimmering light, audience blurred in the background, array of ceiling spotlights.
[Character] Protagonist@

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: The Stillness. Low-angle wide shot: Protagonist stands at the edge of the 20m platform, toes gripping the edge, arms raised, the hall is silent except for the sound of water. Close-up: She takes a deep breath, chest rising, fingers tensed, eyes locked on the water below, jaw tightened. [Audio] Ambient hall sounds quiet down, only the light sloshing of pool water and one deep breath.

[00:03-00:05] Shot 2: The Takeoff. Side-view medium shot, fixed camera: She pushes down with her arms and legs, leaps off the platform, tucks her body into a tight ball at the peak, and starts spinning backwards like a wound-up gyroscope. [Audio] A dull thud of the takeoff, followed only by the sound of wind.

[00:05-00:10] Shot 3: The Flight (Super Slow-mo). Slow-motion, camera vertically follows the fall from the platform height: She completes three and a half back somersaults in a tucked position, the rotation is steady and clean, her body posture remains extremely tight in every rotation, water droplets spin off her hair and hang in the air; she suddenly opens her body after the rotation is complete, arms raised and joined in a straight line, pointing straight at the water surface, accelerating downwards, spotlights flash across her body. [Audio] The sound of wind is stretched in slow-mo, a subtle whirring of fabric during the spins, and a crisp 'shoo' at the moment of opening the body.

[00:10-00:12] Shot 4: Rip Entry. Normal speed, side-view at water level: She enters the water vertically like a needle, the entry point only creates a circle of small ripples and a few droplets, almost no splash, the water surface quickly returns to calm. [Audio] The entry is just a short, clean 'plop,' followed by the audience's gasps and applause bursting in the hall.

[00:12-00:15] Shot 5: Underwater + Rise. Underwater camera: Her body extends after entry, bubbles trailing behind in a straight silver column, she flips upwards in the blue water; cut to water surface shot: she breaks the surface, shakes her hair, wipes water from her face, looks towards the scoreboard and smiles, the frame freezes. [Audio] Low-frequency bubbling underwater transitions to the clear sound of breaking the surface, applause continues, freeze frame with a rising closing sound.

[Note] The smaller the splash at entry, the better (Rip Entry technique). The mid-air flips must have a compact posture and steady rotation speed, avoiding loose limbs.

entries.title: Cinematic Subway Flood Escape
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a 15-second survival sequence featuring a woman escaping a flash flood in a subway station with specific camera movements and technical directions.
entries.prompt:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
参照画像なし。15秒、1:1スクエア、実写、共有用、BGMあり。深夜の地下鉄駅を舞台にした、高品質でスリリングなシネマティック脱出動画。豪雨で排水設備が破損し、ホーム側から大量の濁流が構内へ流入している。第1フレームから危機の最中にあり、改札突破、閉じるシャッター、崩落床、中盤の急旋回障害、巨大な濁流、垂直脱出、地上での最終離脱までを15秒で明確に見せる。単に走り続ける映像にはせず、速度、画面方向、カメラ位置、動作の種類を段階的に変え、全体に明確な緩急を作る。

主人公は25歳の白人女性。長身で脚が長く、細身で洗練されたモデル寄りの体型だが不自然に誇張しない。ライトブラウンのセミロングヘアを低い位置でまとめ、都会的で整った顔立ち。服装は普通の通勤・外出用のややフォーマルな装い。バーガンディの細身テーラードジャケット、白いブラウス、黒のスリムスラックス、黒のローヒール・アンクルブーツ。スポーツウェアではなく、普通の上品な女性が突然の危機で大胆なアクションを見せるギャップを重視する。バッグ、帽子、大きなアクセサリー、ロゴはない。全カットで同じ人物、同じ髪型、同じ衣装を維持する。

駅内部の主動線は左側から右奥。5.9秒で一度だけ側方の保守通路へ90度転進し、その先の非常用シャフトへ到達する。最後は上方向へ脱出する。地上出口は、シャフト上端と連続した一つだけの開放された長方形メンテナンス出口。カメラが切り替わっても、この位置関係と進行方向を維持する。冒頭の改札ジャンプと、終盤の濁流および地上の巨大な水柱を二つの強いアクセントにする。

[SEQUENCE DESIGN]
0.0〜1.2秒。高い斜め俯瞰ワイド。左奥のホームから濁流が噴き出し、中央左の主人公が右奥の非常用シャフトへ走り始める。危機の発生地点、主人公、脱出方向を一画面で明確に見せる。
1.2〜3.0秒。低い斜め側面カメラが主人公と短く並走し、改札への高速接近を捉える。主人公は改札へ体当たりせず、直前で強く踏み切り、全身を明確に浮かせて改札機を跳び越える。踏み切りからジャンプ頂点までの約0.4秒だけ短いスローモーションにし、ジャンプ中の全身と改札上の空間を横から明瞭に見せる。着地直前に実時間へ戻り、強い着地音と同時に再加速する。直後、背後の濁流が改札を破壊する。
3.0〜4.5秒。防水シャッターの先に置いた低い固定カメラ。主人公が走行から一気に低い滑走へ移り、急降下するシャッターの最後の隙間を抜ける。足先が通過した瞬間にシャッターが床へ激突する。
4.5〜5.9秒。真上に近い短い俯瞰。床が後方から連続して崩れ、主人公は左下から右上へ進路を切り替えて残った床へ斜めに跳び移る。最後に蹴った床が直後に崩落する。
5.9〜7.6秒。主人公の前方へ巨大な天井案内板が斜めに落下し、進路を塞ぎ始める。主人公は減速せず、落下直前に鋭い90度の急旋回で側方の狭い保守通路へ飛び込む。カメラは主人公が目前を通過した瞬間に高速ホイップパンし、進行方向の変化を強く見せる。直後、巨大な案内板が背後へ激突し、元の通路を完全に塞ぐ。
7.6〜9.4秒。非常用シャフトの根元を広く捉えた低い固定ワイド。主人公が到達した瞬間、背後のシャッターが水圧で破壊され、白い飛沫を伴う巨大な濁流が通路全体へ突入する。主人公は止まらず、最後の一歩から梯子へ跳びつく。濁流が靴の直下へ達する寸前のニアミスにする。
9.4〜11.5秒。シャフト上部から真下を見下ろすカメラ。主人公は跳びついた勢いを保ち、梯子を高速で登る。カメラも上方へ急速に引き、噴き上がる水位が主人公との距離を縮める。主人公は単一の長方形メンテナンス出口の上端へ到達し、両手を縁にかけ、頭と肩が地上へ出た瞬間にカットする。
11.5〜15.0秒。ニュートラルな夜色の地上道路を捉えた低い広角。白く逆光を受ける雨粒と暖色の街灯を明瞭に分離する。同じ長方形メンテナンス出口から主人公の全身が勢いよく飛び出し、濡れた路面へ着地した瞬間から前方へ走り出す。立ち止まらず、振り返らず、逃走姿勢のまま離脱を続ける。直後、背後の同じ開口部から高圧の巨大な水柱が垂直に噴き上がり、白い飛沫が夜の路上へ爆発的に広がる。主人公がすでに走りながら画面前方または斜め前方へ離脱している状態で終了する。

[VISUAL AND AUDIO DIRECTION]
駅構内は明るくクリアなニュートラルホワイトLED照明を基調にし、鮮やかなアンバーと赤の非常灯を加える。壁は明るいニュートラルグレー、金属は清潔なシルバー、濡れた床は鮮明な反射を持ち、濁流は白い泡と飛沫を多く含んで背景から分離する。主人公のバーガンディのジャケット、白いブラウス、自然で温かい肌色を明瞭に見せる。共有用動画として、明るい露出、透明感のあるコントラスト、豊かなハイライト、鮮明な色分離を優先する。
BGMは高速のシネマティック・パーカッション主体で、危機の上昇に合わせて強くする。着地、シャッター激突、案内板激突、濁流突入、最後の水柱噴出の瞬間だけ効果音をBGMより前へ出す。

[NEGATIVE]
改札への体当たり、長いスローモーション、途中での別人化や衣装変更、同じ後方追従の反復、状況を判別できない暗さ、青緑に沈んだ低彩度映像、脱出後の停止や長い余韻、救助隊や別の主要人物の追加。
entries.translated_prompt:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
No reference image. 15 seconds, 1:1 square, live-action, for sharing, with BGM. A high-quality, thrilling cinematic escape video set in a subway station at midnight. Heavy rain has damaged drainage facilities, and a large amount of muddy water is flowing into the station from the platform side. The video shows the crisis from the first frame, clearly depicting jumping over the ticket gate, closing shutters, collapsing floors, sharp turn obstacles in the middle, massive torrents of water, vertical escape, and final departure onto the ground within 15 seconds. Rather than just a continuous running sequence, change speed, screen direction, camera position, and action types step-by-step to create a clear rhythm throughout.

The protagonist is a 25-year-old white female. She is tall with long legs and a slender, sophisticated model-like physique, but not unnaturally exaggerated. Her light-brown semi-long hair is tied back low, and she has urban, well-defined features. Her clothing is a slightly formal outfit for normal commuting or outings: a burgundy slim tailored jacket, a white blouse, black slim slacks, and black low-heel ankle boots. Emphasize the gap of an ordinary elegant woman showing bold action in a sudden crisis, rather than wearing sportswear. No bags, hats, large accessories, or logos. Maintain the same person, hairstyle, and outfit across all cuts.

The main movement line inside the station is from left to right back. At 5.9 seconds, make a 90-degree turn once into a side maintenance passage to reach the emergency shaft beyond. Finally, escape upwards. The ground exit is a single open rectangular maintenance exit connected to the top of the shaft. Maintain this positional relationship and movement direction even if the camera cuts. The ticket gate jump at the beginning and the torrent and massive water column on the ground at the end serve as two strong accents.

[SEQUENCE DESIGN]
0.0–1.2s. High diagonal wide overhead shot. Muddy water gushes from the platform at the back left, and the protagonist in the center-left starts running toward the emergency shaft at the back right. Clearly show the crisis origin, protagonist, and escape direction in one frame.
1.2–3.0s. Low diagonal side camera runs parallel to the protagonist for a short time, capturing her fast approach to the ticket gate. She doesn't crash into the gate but jumps strongly just before it, lifting her entire body clearly over the turnstiles. Use a short slow-motion for about 0.4s from takeoff to the peak of the jump to clearly show her body and the space above the gate from the side. Return to real-time just before landing, re-accelerating simultaneously with a loud landing sound. Immediately after, the torrent behind destroys the gate.
3.0–4.5s. Low fixed camera placed beyond a waterproof shutter. The protagonist transitions from running into a low slide, passing through the final gap of the rapidly descending shutter. The shutter crashes into the floor the moment her toes pass.
4.5–5.9s. Short overhead shot nearly from above. The floor collapses continuously from behind; the protagonist switches direction from bottom-left to top-right and jumps diagonally to the remaining floor. The last floor tile she kicks collapses immediately after.
5.9–7.6s. A massive ceiling sign falls diagonally in front of the protagonist, starting to block the path. She doesn't slow down but makes a sharp 90-degree turn just before it falls, diving into a narrow side maintenance passage. The camera does a high-speed whip pan the moment she passes, strongly showing the change in direction. Immediately after, the huge sign crashes behind her, completely blocking the original path.
7.6–9.4s. Low fixed wide shot capturing the base of the emergency shaft. The moment she arrives, the shutter behind is destroyed by water pressure, and a massive torrent with white spray bursts into the passage. She doesn't stop, jumping onto the ladder with her last step. Make it a near-miss where the water reaches just below her shoes.
9.4–11.5s. Camera looking straight down from the top of the shaft. She maintains the momentum of the jump and climbs the ladder at high speed. The camera also pulls back rapidly upwards as the rising water level narrows the distance. She reaches the top of the single rectangular maintenance exit, places her hands on the edge, and the cut happens the moment her head and shoulders emerge on the ground.
11.5–15.0s. Low wide-angle shot capturing neutral night-colored ground road. Clearly separate rain droplets backlit in white from warm streetlights. Her whole body bursts out from the same rectangular maintenance exit, starting to run forward from the moment she lands on the wet road. She doesn't stop or look back, continuing her departure in an escape posture. Immediately after, a high-pressure massive water column gushes vertically from the same opening, with white spray exploding onto the night street. End with her already departing toward the front or diagonal front while running.

[VISUAL AND AUDIO DIRECTION]
The station interior is based on bright, clear neutral-white LED lighting with vivid amber and red emergency lights added. Walls are bright neutral grey, metal is clean silver, the wet floor has sharp reflections, and the muddy water contains many white bubbles and spray to separate from the background. Clearly show her burgundy jacket, white blouse, and natural warm skin tone. Prioritize bright exposure, transparent contrast, rich highlights, and sharp color separation for the shared video.
The BGM is primarily high-speed cinematic percussion, intensifying as the crisis escalates. Sound effects for landing, shutter impact, sign impact, torrent intrusion, and the final water column burst should be brought forward over the BGM.

[NEGATIVE]
Crashing into ticket gates, long slow-motion, changing into a different person or outfit mid-way, repeating the same rear-following shot, darkness where the situation cannot be identified, low-saturation images sunken in blue-green, stopping after escape or long lingering shots, adding rescue teams or other major characters.

entries.title: Anime and Live-Action Basketball Mix

entries.title: DV Style Idol Montage
entries.description: A Seedance 2.0 video template for a 15-second K-pop idol montage using 16mm handheld DV aesthetics, featuring multiple scene transitions.
entries.prompt:
摄像机：DV 16mm磁带手持感，第一人称POV，偶尔架在旁边解放双手。手持晃动、构图偏移、对焦延迟、笨拙的变焦推拉、偶尔切到脸的构图，不完美但有真实感。摄像机本身不入镜

画面质感：柔和微糊的磁带画质，轻微噪点，过曝高光，自动曝光闪烁感，低对比度，真实肤色。光线随场景自然变化（宿舍暖光→车内冷光→舞台强光）

风格：快节奏蒙太奇，场景间快速跳切，加速过渡。旁白铺在画面上方，不卡口型。从慵懒早晨到舞台高潮，能量层层推高

角色：CHASE，韩国偶像，20多岁。黑色长直发，精致韩系五官，水光肌，珊瑚粉唇，大眼睛。服装随场景切换：宿舍穿宽松家居服，车里穿便装，舞台上穿演出服，均遮盖手臂和躯干

场景顺序：宿舍（早晨）→ 面包车内（白天）→ 后台/舞台（夜晚）

分镜（15秒，5个镜头）：

镜头1（3秒，宿舍，固定机位，晨光）：她伸懒腰揉眼睛，头发凌乱，抓起包。旁白："每天开始得都太早了"

镜头2（3秒，车内，手持，窗光）：她靠窗坐着，日光掠过脸庞，刷着手机。旁白："这辆车基本是我的第二个家"

镜头3（3秒，车内，微距特写）：手部调整歌单，阳光透过车窗闪烁。无旁白，只有环境路噪

镜头4（3秒，后台，手持，快速过渡）：化妆做发型快速闪过，工作人员在周围穿梭，肾上腺素开始飙升。旁白："然后突然就该上台了"

镜头5（3秒，舞台，远景→近景，高能收尾）：舞台灯光大亮，她的剪影走上台，镜头捕捉最后一眼后黑屏. 旁白："就为了这一刻，什么都值了"

entries.title: 90s Downtown Manhattan Cinema Verite
entries.description: An authentic 1990s documentary-style prompt capturing the energy of Manhattan street life and skaters with 16mm film texture.
entries.prompt:
Gritty 16mm cinéma vérité, authentic 1990s downtown Manhattan documentary footage, organic film grain, pure natural daylight, heavy shoulder-mounted handheld shake, no stabilization, soft focus falls, subtle light leaks, raw and elegant, lived-in realism.

0–3s: [Close Handheld Tracking] Young woman in her mid-20s, completely natural face with no makeup, soft features, wind-tousled hair, simple 1990s leather jacket and scarf. She walks past a corner newsstand on a downtown side street, steam drifting from a subway grate behind her. Camera stays tight on her profile and upper body as she slows for half a second, glances at the magazine covers, then looks toward camera with a quiet, unguarded expression. Instant natural beauty and presence.

3–7s: [Unsteady Following Shot] She continues into a sunlit granite plaza ringed with steps and handrails. Camera stays behind and slightly to the side, bouncing with every step. Teenage skaters are everywhere: pushing hard across the flat ground, popping ollies off the curb cuts, wheels clattering over the seams, pigeons scattering, office workers cutting through with coffee. Pure dynamism and street energy.

7–11s: [Handheld Medium] A skater grinds down the handrail beside the stairs and pops off the end just as she passes below — he lands rolling, cutting across her path so close his jacket brushes her sleeve. She doesn't startle and doesn't stop; she just tilts her head after him with a small amused smile, completely unbothered, like she's seen a thousand of these kids. He throws her a quick apologetic grin over his shoulder mid-roll. The plaza stays alive and chaotic around them.

11–15s: [Raw Tracking] She keeps walking through the plaza at the same easy pace, camera following close and imperfect, skaters weaving and regrouping behind her, the light shifting across her face between the buildings, and the natural rhythm of 1990s New York street life without ever settling.

Photorealistic 16mm film emulation, heavy organic grain, authentic period New York details, natural skin texture, imperfect handheld physics, subtle film weave, coherent motion, pure cinéma vérité texture, no artifacts, no text, no logos, 16:9 aspect ratio.

entries.title: Futuristic Cyberpunk Parkour Animation
entries.description: A highly detailed animation prompt for generating continuous parkour footage in a rainy near-future city using Seedance 2.0 with strict character consistency.
entries.prompt:
高品質アニメ映像。
ジャンル：近未来都市型パルクール。高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックによる、途切れない連続パルクール。
【参照画像の役割】
画像1をキャラクターの顔と同一人物性の最優先参照として使用する。画像2がある場合は、髪型、髪色、衣装、装飾、体格、靴、全身シルエットの参照として使用する。参照画像が1枚だけの場合は、画像1を顔と全身デザインの両方へ使用する。

参照画像から、顔立ち、目の形、虹彩色、瞳のハイライト、肌色、年齢感、髪型、髪色、衣装、装飾、体格、靴、全身シルエット、雰囲気、キャラクターカラーを抽出し、同じ一人の人物として統合する。
参照画像そのものの背景、部屋、家具、設定表、文字、UI、分割レイアウト、ポーズ、画角、フレーミングは映像へ持ち込まない。
全編で変化してよいのは、表情、視線、口元、姿勢、呼吸、動作に伴う髪と衣装と装飾の自然な遅れ運動だけ。顔の平均化、別人化、特徴の混合、衣装交換、髪型変更、体格変更、クローン化、余計な人物の追加を行わない。

【キャラクター固定】
全編で参照画像の同じ一人だけを描く。顔、瞳、髪、衣装、装飾、体格、靴、全身シルエットを維持する。
武器や新しい携行物は追加せず、両手は空にする。参照画像に武器や手持ち品が写っていても、この映像では持たせない。衣装をパルクール用の服へ置き換えず、元のデザインを保ったまま自然に動かす。
高速運動中も顔と身体の立体形状、衣装の層、装飾の位置、左右の手足を維持する。
【画風固定】
全編を高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックだけで描く。細い色付き輪郭、顔・髪・衣装の明快な二段から三段のセル影、透明感のある中間影、瞳と髪の多層ハイライトを維持する。
布、革、金属、宝石、樹脂などは、参照衣装の素材に合わせて質感を描き分ける。濡れた屋上床、換気ダクト、壁面は、細く制御された反射を持たせる。
劇場版クラスの精密な3Dキャラクターアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のある照明、高密度な都市背景。
太い黒輪郭、平坦な単層セル影、汎用的な3D顔、滑らかなプラスチックCG、低密度背景、半写実、写実、画風混合にしない。
entries.translated_prompt:
High-quality anime footage.
Genre: Near-future urban parkour. Continuous, uninterrupted parkour with high-density 3D toon/cel-shaded style.
[Role of Reference Image]
Use Image 1 as the highest priority reference for character face and identity. If Image 2 is present, use it for hair style, hair color, outfit, decorations, physique, shoes, and full-body silhouette. If only one reference image is present, use Image 1 for both face and full-body design.
Extract facial features, eye shape, iris color, pupil highlights, skin tone, age feeling, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, decorations, physique, shoes, full-body silhouette, atmosphere, and character colors from the reference images and integrate them into a single person.
Do not carry over the background, room, furniture, setting sheets, text, UI, split layouts, poses, angles, or framing from the reference image itself.
Only changes allowed are expressions, gaze, mouth, posture, breathing, and natural delayed movement of hair/clothing/decorations accompanying motion. Do not allow face averaging, character swapping, blending features, costume changes, hairstyle changes, physique changes, cloning, or adding extra people.
[Character Consistency]
Only depict the same single person from the reference throughout the footage. Maintain the face, eyes, hair, outfit, decorations, physique, shoes, and silhouette. Do not add weapons or new carried items; keep hands empty. Even if the reference has items, do not show them. Do not replace the outfit with parkour-specific clothes; move the original design naturally. Maintain 3D shapes, clothing layers, decoration positions, and limbs during high-speed motion.
[Style Consistency]
Render exclusively in high-density 3D toon/cel-shaded style. Maintain thin colored outlines, clear 2-to-3 level cel shadows on face/hair/clothing, transparent mid-shadows, and multi-layered highlights in eyes/hair. Distinguish textures for cloth, leather, metal, gems, resin, etc., based on reference materials. Wet rooftop floors, ventilation ducts, and walls should have finely controlled reflections. The result should be theatrical-grade precision 3D character animation with high-quality compositing, transparent lighting, and high-density urban backgrounds.

entries.title: Cyberpunk Idol Anime Live
entries.description: A complex cinematic video prompt for a dual-character anime idol performance in a massive cyberpunk arena with synchronized choreography and lighting.
entries.prompt:
@画像1を二人の人物・顔・髪型・衣装の厳密な参照とし、黒髪ロングのアイドルを常に画面左、茶髪ショートのアイドルを常に画面右に保つ。
@画像2は一つの巨大サイバーライブ会場を示す環境デザイン資料として参照し、2×2グリッドや白い境界線は映像内に表示しない。
高精細な劇場版アニメ調、人物は参照画像の透明感あるセルルック、会場は奥行きのあるシネマティックCG、青・シアン・紫のレーザー、音声波形LED、満員の観客と無数の青いサイリウム。

0-1.8s: 前置きなしでサビの最高潮から開始。超広角の正面全景、二人はすでにセンターステージでマイクを持って全力歌唱と同期ダンス、最初の一拍でレーザーと観客のサイリウムが一斉に爆発的点灯、カメラが高速で二人へ接近

 [cut] 1.8-3.8s: 低角度の全身二人ショット、左右対称の力強いステップと腕の振りをビートへ同期し、黒髪、茶髪、半透明の袖、スカート、背中のリボンが慣性に従って大きく揺れる。踏み込むたび床面からシアンの光波が広がる 

[cut] 3.8-5.9s: 正面近景の二人ショット、カメラが二人の間へ滑らかに寄り、黒髪ロングと茶髪ショートが交互にレンズへ歌いかけ、最後に同時に笑顔でウインク。明瞭な歌詞は指定せず、自然な女性デュオ歌唱として口の動きと声を完全同期、マイクは各自一本を維持

 [cut] 5.9-8.0s: 横移動する中景、二人がステージ前方へ並んで駆け寄り、観客へマイクと片手を差し出して煽る。観客がサイリウムを一斉に突き上げ、歓声の音圧に反応して背後の音声波形LEDが大きく跳ねる 

[cut] 8.0-10.2s: 中央の全身ショット、二人が背中合わせになって同時スピン。カメラは二人を中心に半円旋回し、衣装のシアンと紫の発光ラインが円形の光跡を描き、レーザーが放射状に広がる

 [cut] 10.2-12.6s: 極低角度、二人が同時に小さくジャンプし、着地の瞬間に床から青紫の巨大な光のリングが観客席まで拡散。カメラは着地から一気にティルトアップし、マイクを高く掲げる二人の笑顔を捉える

 [cut] 12.6-15.0s: カメラが滑らかに後退して巨大アリーナ全景を見せる。二人は肩を寄せ、空いた腕を観客へ大きく広げて完全に同期した最終決めポーズ。背後の音声波形LED、レーザー、火花、サイリウムが最後の一拍で最大輝度になり、オリジナルBGMは力強い終止和音とドラムヒットで明確に完結、歓声の短い余韻を残し、最後の0.5秒は決めポーズを安定して保持。

音楽：冒頭0秒からサビ全開、約160 BPMの高揚感あるオリジナル・サイバーJ-POP、四つ打ち、鋭いシンセアルペジオ、太いエレクトロベース、迫力あるドラム、明るい女性デュオ歌唱、観客のコール、広いアリーナ残響、映像の動作・照明・着地へ完全同期、フェードインなし、静かな導入なし。

二人だけを登場させ、顔・髪型・衣装・体格・左右関係を全カットで維持。人物の増殖、第三のアイドル、顔や衣装の変化、手足の変形、指の異常、身体の融合、マイクの増殖、歌声と口のずれ、文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、次編を示す終わり方は禁止。
entries.translated_prompt:
Use @Image 1 as a strict reference for the identity, faces, hairstyles, and outfits of two individuals, keeping the black-haired idol on the left and the short brown-haired idol on the right. @Image 2 serves as environmental design material for a massive cyber live venue; do not include 2x2 grids or white borders. High-definition theatrical anime style with a transparent cel-look for characters and deep cinematic CG for the venue. Featuring blue, cyan, and purple lasers, audio waveform LEDs, a packed audience, and countless blue glow sticks.

0-1.8s: Start immediately at the peak of the chorus. Ultra-wide front view, the two are already on center stage singing and dancing in sync. Lasers and glow sticks explode in light on the first beat as the camera zooms in fast.

[cut] 1.8-3.8s: Low-angle full-body shot, powerful symmetrical steps and arm swings synced to the beat. Hair, translucent sleeves, and ribbons sway with inertia. Cyan light waves spread from the floor with each step.

[cut] 3.8-5.9s: Frontal close-up, camera glides between them as they take turns singing to the lens and wink together at the end. Lips move in perfect sync with the female duo vocals.

[cut] 5.9-8.0s: Panning mid-shot, the two run to the front of the stage, reaching out to the audience. Glow sticks rise in unison and background LEDs react to the sound pressure.

entries.title: Rainy Night Supernatural Reverse Comedy Video Script
entries.description: A high-fidelity multi-shot video prompt designed for Seedance 2.0, creating a cinematic transition from a horror atmosphere to a suburban comedy using character consistency and environmental storytelling.
entries.prompt:
【整体风格】

冷面超自然反转喜剧，以真实电影质感开场，前半段伪装成压迫感强烈的都市鬼故事，后半段揭露为一个普通的雨夜误会；采用冷青色路灯、便利店溢出的暖光、湿润柏油路倒影、克制的面部表演、精准的空间调度，以及从恐怖音效自然切换到喜剧声音的节奏设计。

【角色】

角色 A｜剑仙姐

使用 @图片 1 作为角色 A 的严格身份与服装参考：同一个 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，椭圆脸、锐利深色眼睛、黑色长直发、白皙自然皮肤、高挑纤细身材，穿白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、银色腰饰、玉簪和白色布靴。

角色 B｜单车姐

使用 @图片 2 作为角色 B 的严格参考：同一个 25–30 岁东亚单车姐，完整保持同一张脸、马尾、身材比例、服装、饰品，以及被半透明白色雨披覆盖的同一辆自行车。

【镜头 1｜0-5s｜低角度全景缓慢推轨】

16:9 横屏，夜晚空旷的现代城市地下通道，暴雨、混凝土立柱、滴水管道、忽明忽暗的日光灯、远处霓虹招牌、散落树叶和浓重水雾清晰可见。

同一个剑仙姐从鞋到头完整站在灯光下，握紧同一柄银色长剑。

画面纵深处，同一个单车姐披着宽大的白色雨披，骑同一辆自行车无声靠近；两个自行车反光片看起来像发光的眼睛，一只细长塑料购物袋在风中拍打，如同鬼怪伸出的长舌。

配低沉恐怖氛围音、雨声和车链轻响，不说台词。

【镜头 2｜5-10s｜牛仔景中景】

同一个穿白色刺绣真丝汉服的女人突然转身，拔出同一柄银色长剑，宽袖被风猛然扬起，大喝：“何方妖孽！”

同一个被雨披遮住的身影没有回答，仍然平稳向前滑行。

摄影机以相同速度向后跟退，恐怖低频逐渐增强，随后突然响起一声细小清脆的自行车铃。

【镜头 3｜10-15s｜特写进入双人镜头】

同一个单车姐在便利店暖光下刹车，掀开湿润的雨披帽子，露出始终一致的面孔，面无表情地说道：“姐，我刚下班。你这身才像白无常。”

英雄式剑鸣瞬间停止。

极近特写：同一个剑仙姐低头看了看自己全白的汉服，沉默地把银色长剑藏到背后，强行保持高冷地点了一下头，一侧眼皮轻微抽动。

画面定格在单车姐无声凝视她的瞬间。

【技术要求】

严格总时长 15 秒，三个镜头，角色身份稳定，运动方向连贯，雨水、雨披、长发、真丝衣料、自行车和地面倒影具有真实物理效果，原生同步生成普通话对白与空间声音，不生成画面字幕。

角色参考与音画指令对应 Seedance 2.0 官方说明的多模态输入和导演级控制能力。

【负面词】

blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error; deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured; inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props

Medium close-up from the passenger side. An elegant woman drives the cream convertible along a quiet countryside road with one hand resting lightly on the steering wheel. chrome headlight, Mercedes badge, spinning wheel, leather-gloved hand touching the gear lever, dashboard needles, sunlight moving across the cream paint and polished chrome.

Soft mechanical clicks, leather movement, warm engine note, light wind.

Wide tracking shot as the Mercedes enters a historic countryside manor beneath tall oak trees. She parks, steps out naturally, closes the door, then looks back at the car once. The low afternoon sun wraps the vehicle in warm gold.

Narration:
“It’s about knowing where you belong.”

Static hero shot. The cream Mercedes-Benz 190 SL rests beneath ancient oak trees with the manor softly visible behind it. Leaves and branches move gently in the wind. Slowly fade toward black.

Narration:
“Some journeys never grow old.”

Mercedes-Benz 190 SL

Timeless isn’t remembered.
It’s lived.

Natural human movement, realistic skin texture, physically accurate chrome reflections, believable scarf and fabric motion, authentic vintage-car proportions, subtle film exposure changes, restrained luxury composition.

Avoid:
Modern vehicles, crowded roads, artificial lens flares, plastic skin, unstable car design, changing colors, warped wheels, incorrect reflections, exaggerated acting, fast commercial editing, excessive camera shake, subtitles, extra logos, or watermark.

Maintain real skin texture with visible pores, baby hairs, and natural skin oil. Beauty filters, excessive retouching, CG texture, and cinematic color grading are prohibited. Golden hour lighting, orange backlighting, film grain, and noise are also prohibited.

Camera imperfections are used only once in each specified section. From 0 to 2 seconds, indoor to outdoor exposure delay. From 2 to 4 seconds, autofocus hunting. From 10 to 12 seconds, digital zoom quality degradation. All other sections must remain sharp.

Whenever signs, menus, or price boards enter the frame, all text must remain completely out of focus. Background people are shown only as out of focus silhouettes. The face is always captured directly by the camera, never through reflections. Stainless steel reflective surfaces may only show lights and clothing. Do not include close up shots of knives or knife blades. Do not create shots where the feet, shoes, or legs are the main subject.

No on screen captions. No shot merging or omissions. The subject does not speak.

Audio consists of low volume lo fi background music layered with the sound of oil sizzling on a hot plate, ventilation fan humming, bowls and ladles clinking, and distant crowd ambience. No human voices.

Night at Gwangjang Market Arcade, walk in, finish one plate, then return to the passage

0 to 2 seconds
At the entrance of the market arcade, she walks in from the dark outdoors beneath rows of ceiling incandescent bulbs. The camera tilts upward and sweeps across the ceiling, revealing rusted steel trusses and tangled electrical wiring in a wide shot. As she enters the brightly lit interior, the exposure lags slightly, causing the screen to briefly overexpose before settling. As the camera lowers to her face, she squints slightly from the sudden brightness.

2 to 4 seconds
She walks through the narrow passage. Each food stall is lit by fluorescent lights with different color temperatures. A shoulder height handheld camera follows her from the front, while people on both sides remain only as blurred silhouettes. The illuminated signs at the end of the passage bloom, and all lettering stays completely out of focus. Autofocus hunts twice between the crowd and her face before locking on. She tucks her chin and slightly raises one shoulder in response to the surrounding noise.

4 to 6 seconds
She stops in front of a hot plate food stall. The light source is the blue flame beneath the griddle. A macro shot captures oil droplets jumping from the heated steel plate while white steam rises in columns. As the steam reaches her face, she squints, tilts her head back, and wipes her nose from the smoky air. She looks at the camera for only 0.5 seconds.

6 to 8 seconds
She sits inside the stall seating area and removes the leather jacket, placing it on her lap. Underneath she continues wearing the same black turtleneck. The light source is a bare incandescent bulb overhead. A tight shot captures the long reflection of the bulb across the stainless steel countertop and the wrinkled texture of the plastic canopy covering it. As the plastic chair slides backward, she steadies herself with her shoulders, raises her eyebrows from the heat, and exhales.

8 to 10 seconds
She remains seated in the same place. The lighting combines the incandescent bulb with fluorescent light from the neighboring stall. A tight shot shows a brass bowl, a well worn ladle, and a wooden chopstick holder tied together with a rubber band arranged on the counter. She takes one bite from the plate in front of her using one hand. Because the food is hot, she parts her lips slightly and exhales. The final second is an unexplained insert shot of a single empty plastic chair gently swaying beyond a gap in the canopy.

10 to 12 seconds
She stands up, puts the jacket back on while standing, and after fully wearing it, walks back into the passage. The light sources are the red warming lamp of a neighboring display case and the blue light from a refrigerator. The handheld camera follows her as alternating red and blue light sweeps across the medium shot. As the camera digitally zooms toward a distant red light at the end of the passage, the image quality noticeably degrades. She blinks several times from the glare.

12 to 15 seconds
She stands still facing forward in the middle of the passage in a full body shot. Behind her, the steel arcade ceiling and rows of incandescent lights extend toward a distant vanishing point in a wide shot. During the ending hold, only the camera moves with a very slight handheld shake. She looks at the camera for 0.5 seconds, then shifts her gaze to the side and remains standing.

entries.title: Sinking of the Battleship Yamato
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for generating a high-quality war film sequence depicting the sinking of the Battleship Yamato under heavy air assault.
entries.prompt:
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
15秒、1:1スクエア、共有用、参照画像なし。戦艦大和は全長約263メートル、全幅約39メートル、第二次世界大戦期最大級の超大型戦艦として描く。第1フレームから米海軍艦載機群による波状総攻撃の最中。多数の爆弾、魚雷、近接爆発による損傷が蓄積し、最後は船体中央部を起点とする一度の致命的大爆発で撃沈が決定する。明るくクリアな高品質実写戦争映画映像。鮮やかな青空、青から青緑の海、暗灰色の鋼鉄船体、白い水柱、橙色の爆炎、濃い黒煙を明確に色分離する。

[SUBJECT / SCALE]
主役は戦艦大和。長大で幅広い船体、巨大な主砲塔群、高い塔型艦橋、多数の対空砲を備えた実物大の超大型戦艦。艦載機は大和より明確に小さく、複数方向から次々に襲来する。大和は単独攻撃では沈まず、総攻撃の蓄積によって最後の致命傷へ至る。

[SHOT / FLOW]
0.0〜2.1秒、左前方からの高い斜め俯瞰ワイド。戦艦大和の長い全長を画面中央に大きく見せる。多数の小さな艦載機が左右と上空から高速で横切り、対空砲火、爆弾着弾、不規則な水柱が広範囲に発生する。カメラは艦載機を追わない。
2.1〜4.2秒、右側面寄りの中高度斜め俯瞰ワイド。艦首から艦尾まで読める角度を維持し、別方向の複数編隊が前景・中景・遠景を高速で交差する。甲板と船体周囲への攻撃が続き、火災と黒煙が増える。
4.2〜5.8秒、高高度の超俯瞰ワイド。カメラは固定。一機の小さな急降下爆撃機だけが画面上方から大和へ高速降下して接近し、爆弾を投下した後、側方へ一瞬で抜ける。大和の全長と艦載機の小ささを同じ画面で維持する。
5.8〜8.3秒、海面すれすれの超低空。カメラは波頭の直上を一直線に猛烈な速度で進み、海水の飛沫が画面手前とレンズ脇へ激しく跳ね上がる。前方の巨大な大和へ急接近し、魚雷本体は大きく映さず、海面上の白い魚雷航跡とともに左舷水線下へ迫る。命中と同時に船体より高い巨大な水柱が立ち上がる。
8.3〜12.2秒、左側面寄りの高い斜め俯瞰ワイドを一つの連続ショットとして維持する。大和を画面内の最大対象とし、前方、左右、上空から艦載機群が途切れず高速横断する。魚雷航跡、爆弾直撃、近接爆発、不規則な水柱、対空砲火が長い船体全体へ集中する。攻撃を止めず、火災、黒煙、損傷、速度低下だけを増加させる。12.2秒までは致命的大爆発を起こさない。
12.2〜15.0秒、同じ斜め側面ワイドと同じ戦闘の流れを維持する。攻撃が継続する中、蓄積した損傷が限界に達し、船体中央部への最後の直撃を起点として一度の致命的大爆発が発生する。独立した球形火球や複数段の爆発にはせず、船体中央から横長に噴き上がる橙白色の爆炎、濃い黒煙、衝撃波、水しぶきを一体化する。大和の船体と爆発の起点を同じ画面内に残し、カメラは大きく動かさず、少し広い全景で終了する。

[CAMERA / EDITING]
左前方斜め俯瞰 → 右側面寄り斜め俯瞰 → 固定超俯瞰の急降下攻撃 → 海面超低空의 魚雷追跡 → 左側面寄り斜め俯瞰の連続総攻撃 → 同一ショットの致命的大爆発。後方斜め俯瞰は使わない。艦載機を追跡せず、画面を一瞬で横切らせて速度を表現する。カメラが激しく直線移動するのは魚雷シーンだけ。

[SOUND]
効果音のみ。多数の航空機音、風切り音、対空砲火、爆弾炸裂、魚雷命中、水しぶき、鋼鉄のきしみ、連続着弾、最後の巨大爆発。BGM、台詞、ナレーションなし。

[NEGATIVE]
後方斜め俯瞰、艦載機を追い続けるカメラ、魚雷シーン以外の直線追従、寄りすぎた画角、艦載機が大和より大きく見える構図、似た俯瞰カットの反復、カット順の入れ替え、魚雷シーンの省略、12.2秒以前の致命的大爆発、総攻撃が途中で止まる展開、傾斜、転覆、船体破断、複数段の球形火球、船体から切り離された爆発、夜戦、暗くくすんだ色調、現代戦闘機、ジェット機、ミサイル、特攻、文字、字幕、ロゴ、人体損傷、死体、ミニチュア感、玩具感、安いCG表現。

5.8-8.3s: Super low altitude just above the sea surface. 8.3-12.2s: Maintaining a high diagonal overhead wide shot closer to the left side as a single continuous shot. 12.2-15.0s: Maintaining the same diagonal side wide shot and battle flow. As the attack continues, the accumulated damage reaches its limit, and a single fatal massive explosion occurs starting from a final direct hit to the center of the hull. Do not make it independent spherical fireballs or multi-stage explosions; integrate the orange-white explosive flames, thick black smoke, shockwaves, and water splashes erupting horizontally from the hull center. Keep Yamato's hull and the explosion's origin in the same frame; the camera does not move much, ending with a slightly wider panorama.

[CAMERA / EDITING]
Front-left diagonal overhead → right-side diagonal overhead → fixed super overhead dive attack → sea surface super low-altitude torpedo tracking → front-left diagonal overhead continuous general attack → fatal massive explosion in the same shot. Do not use rear diagonal overhead. Do not track aircraft; represent speed by having them cross the screen in an instant. The camera moves violently in a straight line only in the torpedo scene.

[SOUND]
Sound effects only. Sounds of numerous aircraft, whistling wind, anti-aircraft fire, exploding bombs, torpedo hits, splashing water, creaking steel, continuous hits, and the final giant explosion. No BGM, dialogue, or narration.

[NEGATIVE]
Rear diagonal overhead, camera following aircraft, straight tracking except for the torpedo scene, angle of view too close, composition where aircraft look larger than Yamato, repetition of similar overhead cuts, changing cut order, omitting the torpedo scene, fatal massive explosion before 12.2s, development where the attack stops midway, listing, capsizing, hull breaking, multi-stage spherical fireballs, explosions separated from the hull, night battle, dark and dull tones, modern fighters, jets, missiles, kamikaze, text, subtitles, logo, human injury, corpses, miniature feel, toy feel, cheap CG representation.

entries.title: Alchemist Elixir Transformation Horror
entries.description: A dark fantasy storytelling prompt involving a magical transformation and frantic rescue in a clocktower observatory.
entries.prompt:
PROMPT 1 — "THE ELIXIR" (0–15 seconds)

0–3s: Exterior establishing shot — the clocktower observatory looms over a fog-drowned city skyline at midnight, its great clock face glowing violet. Wind screams past cracked windows. The camera pushes toward a glowing round window, then glides seamlessly through the glass into the observatory. Inside, gears grind, orbs of violet fire drift lazily near the ceiling, star charts flutter on their pins.

3–6s: Camera circles slowly to reveal Dr. Vex standing atop a spiral staircase platform beside a massive brass astrolabe rig. She holds up a swirling silver-violet elixir in a cracked crystal flask, admiring it like a jewel. Her silver topknot catches the firelight. Below her, Milo and Senna trade a worried glance.

6–10s: She uncorks the flask with a sharp crack — violet smoke coils upward. She lifts it toward the astrolabe as it groans and spins faster. Camera pushes into close-up on her face, calm and certain. She drinks it in one motion. The apprentices freeze, bracing. Nothing happens for a beat. She smiles, satisfied, and begins to speak.

10–15s: Her smile locks in place. Silence. Her fingers twitch, one by one. Silver-violet light spiderwebs beneath the skin of her throat and jaw. Her pupils contract to pinpricks. The astrolabe overhead lurches and sparks. Every violet flame-orb in the room flares and dims in unison. Glass instruments rattle off their shelves. Her spine arches backward with a sharp crack. Her head lolls, then rises slowly — eyes now milky white, mouth stretched into a grin too wide to be human. A low, grinding growl rolls through the tower. The apprentices stumble back against the railing. The thing that was Dr. Vex turns its head toward them.

PROMPT 2 — "THE COUNTER-REAGENT" (15–30 seconds)

15–18s: The transformed Vex descends the last few stairs toward the apprentices, movements jerky and unnatural. She lunges and seizes Milo by the vest collar, hoisting him half off his feet. He kicks and yelps, goggles askew.

18–22s: Senna's eyes dart across the cluttered workbench without breaking her stare on Vex. She spots a small vial of glowing amber counter-reagent tucked among the star charts — the one Vex brewed "just in case," Senna always suspected. She edges toward it, slow, silent, one hand out.

entries.title: Water Slider to Summer Festival
entries.description: A surreal cinematic video prompt where a woman slides down a water park tube and emerges at a traditional Japanese Bon Odori festival.
entries.prompt:
「タイトル： 「ウォータースライダーの先は夏祭り」
参照画像の人物を主人公として使用。主人公は参照画像と同一人物の成人女性。顔立ち、髪型、髪色、体型、表情の特徴を忠実に維持する。衣装はシンプルで上品なデザインのビキニ水着。フォトリアル、映画品質、超高精細、リアルな水表現、シネマティックライティング、24fps、15秒、16:9。

0～3秒
大型ウォーターパーク。
主人公はウォータースライダーのスタート地点で笑顔。
期待に胸を膨らませながらスタッフに手を振り、勢いよく滑り始める。
カメラは主人公を正面や斜め前から追い、表情を中心に撮影。
水しぶき、髪が風になびく様子、躍動感のあるカメラワーク。
明るく楽しい夏の雰囲気。

3～8秒
POV（一人称）視点へ切り替わる。
主人公の伸ばした脚だけが画面下部に見えている。
高速で筒状のウォータースライダーを滑走。
外は一切見えず、完全に密閉されたチューブ。
水流が勢いよく流れ、左右へ大きくバンクしながら進む。
青や白の照明が高速で流れ、スピード感を演出。
カメラには水滴が付き、リアルな疾走感。
最後に出口から強い光が差し込む。

8〜11秒
主人公がウォータースライダーの出口から勢いよく飛び出す。
到着した場所は、夜の公園で開催されている盆踊り会場。中央には提灯で飾られた大きな櫓があり、その周囲で浴衣姿の大勢の人々が輪になって盆踊りをしている。
主人公は濡れたまま立ち上がり、目を大きく見開いて周囲を見回す。最初は状況が理解できず、驚いた表情で一瞬固まる。
カメラは引きのワイドショットで、ウォータースライダーの出口、主人公、櫓、盆踊りをする人々を同時に映す。

11〜15秒
主人公は戸惑いながらもすぐに笑顔になり、周囲の人の動きを真似して盆踊りを始める。最初は少しぎこちないが、すぐにリズムをつかみ、両手を上げながら楽しそうに踊る。
濡れた髪や肌から水滴が落ちているが、主人公も周囲の人々も全く気にしない。主人公は満面の笑顔で盆踊りの輪に溶け込む。
最後はカメラが少し上昇し、提灯の明かりに包まれながら、主人公と浴衣姿の人々が一緒に楽しそうに踊る様子を映して終了。

映像スタイル・演出指定
フォトリアルな実写映画品質
日本の夏祭りらしい温かくノスタルジックな雰囲気
赤やオレンジの提灯による柔らかな照明
浴衣、櫓、太鼓、屋台などを自然に配置
水や濡れた髪、肌、水滴をリアルに表現
前半はスピード感のあるアクション
後半は明るく楽しいシュールコメディ
主人公の驚きから笑顔への表情変化を明確に描写
盆踊りの手振りや足運びを自然に表現
主人公の顔、髪型、体型、水着のデザインを全編で一貫させる
過度に性的なカメラアングルや身体の強調は避ける
セリフ、字幕、文字、ロゴ、ウォーターマークなし
顔崩れ、手指の崩れ、身体の変形、不自然な関節、人物の増殖を避ける
明るく健全で、見ていて楽しい夏祭りコメディとして描く
盆踊り会場は水に浸かっていない」
entries.translated_prompt:
Title: "The End of the Water Slider is a Summer Festival"
Use the person in the reference image as the main character. The protagonist is an adult woman, the same person as in the reference image. Faithfully maintain features of face, hairstyle, hair color, body type, and expression. The costume is a simple and elegant bikini swimsuit. Photorealistic, movie quality, ultra-high definition, realistic water representation, cinematic lighting, 24fps, 15 seconds, 16:9.

0-3s
Large water park. The protagonist smiles at the start of the water slider. She waves to the staff with expectation and starts sliding vigorously. The camera follows from the front or diagonal front, focusing on her expression. Water splashes, hair fluttering in the wind, dynamic camera work. Bright and fun summer atmosphere.

3-8s
Switch to POV (first-person) perspective. Only the protagonist's extended legs are visible at the bottom of the screen. Sliding at high speed through a cylindrical water slider. Completely sealed tube with no view of the outside. The water flows vigorously, banking greatly left and right. Blue and white lighting flows at high speed to create a sense of speed. Water droplets on the camera, realistic racing feel. Finally, strong light shines from the exit.

8-11s
The protagonist bursts out of the water slider exit. The arrival location is a Bon Odori festival venue held in a night park. In the center is a large tower decorated with lanterns, and many people in yukata are dancing in a circle around it. The protagonist stands up wet, eyes wide, looking around. Initially unable to understand the situation, she freezes for a moment with a surprised expression. A wide pull-out shot shows the water slider exit, the protagonist, the tower, and the dancing people simultaneously.

11-15s
Though confused, the protagonist immediately smiles and begins to dance, mimicking the movements of those around her. Initially a bit awkward, she quickly catches the rhythm and dances happily while raising both hands. Water droplets fall from her wet hair and skin, but neither she nor the people around care. She blends into the Bon Odori circle with a big smile. Finally, the camera rises slightly to show the protagonist and the people in yukata dancing happily together, enveloped in the light of the lanterns.

Visual Style/Directional Specifications:
Photorealistic live-action movie quality. Warm and nostalgic atmosphere typical of a Japanese summer festival. Soft lighting from red and orange lanterns. Natural placement of yukata, towers, drums, and food stalls. Realistic representation of water, wet hair, skin, and droplets. High-speed action in the first half. Bright and fun surreal comedy in the second half. Clear depiction of the transition from surprise to a smile. Natural hand and foot movements for Bon Odori. Consistent character face, hair, body, and swimsuit design throughout. Avoid overly sexual camera angles or body emphasis. No dialogue, subtitles, text, logos, or watermarks. Avoid face distortion, hand/finger distortion, body deformation, unnatural joints, or multiplication of people. Depict as a bright, healthy, and fun summer festival comedy. The festival venue is not submerged in water.

entries.prompt:
Inside a traditional Japanese countryside farmhouse, a young Japanese woman and a young Japanese man turn an ordinary homemade dinner into a memory they'll never forget. She playfully steals the last bite of perfectly grilled river fish with her chopsticks, sparking a lighthearted chopstick battle filled with genuine laughter and warm chemistry. They continue sharing steaming rice, miso soup, seasonal vegetables, handmade pickles, and freshly brewed green tea while exchanging quiet conversations and comfortable silence. As the evening slows, they gently toast with handcrafted ceramic cups before sharing a single ripe strawberry, ending the night with peaceful smiles as rain softly falls outside.

Shot with nostalgic handheld cinematography, warm lantern light, authentic Japanese farmhouse interiors, vintage Kodak Vision3 35mm film texture, subtle film grain, soft cinematic depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural micro-expressions, physically accurate body movement, gentle focus breathing, emotionally rich storytelling, and the quiet warmth of a timeless Japanese slice-of-life film. entries.prompt: 创作一个高端生活方式饮料广告，贯穿整个序列始终使用同一位年轻东亚女性。保持每帧中相同的面部特征、柔顺的浅棕色长波浪发、发光的肌肤、身体比例和服装。她穿着合身的黑色罗纹露脐上衣、浅蓝色破洞高腰牛仔裤、白色运动鞋、银色圆形耳环、多层银色项链、墨镜搁在头上，以及一个小巧的白色肩背包。现代市中心充满壁画、咖啡馆、精品店、屋顶露台、高端果汁吧，充满活力的夏日氛围，明亮的自然阳光，奢华商业摄影手法，清新绿色和白色调色板，灵感来源于新鲜苹果。视频以她自信地对着镜头微笑开始，她站在一家时尚果汁吧外。她注意到展示在冰上的冰镇气泡苹果饮料，兴奋地拿起它，将瓶子转到脸旁，水珠在阳光下闪闪发光，然后微笑并说：“新鲜从这里开始！”一个电影般的微距主角镜头展示冰镇苹果饮料，周围环绕着清脆的绿色苹果、冰块、闪耀的水珠和新鲜薄荷叶。她拧开瓶盖，发出令人满足的清脆爆响。慢动作特写捕捉到她啜饮时微小的气泡向上涌动的瞬间，她的笑容立刻变得更加明亮。她自信地穿过色彩斑斓的市中心街道，那里装饰着壁画、花盆、咖啡馆和精品店面。流畅的手持跟踪镜头跟随她，微风自然地吹动她的头发。她随意浏览时尚精品店，试戴墨镜，欣赏橱窗，继续享受她的苹果饮料。她在俯瞰城市天际线的时尚屋顶咖啡馆与朋友们见面。他们拥抱问候，一起欢笑，点一些清淡餐点，将冰镇苹果饮料放在桌上，同时享受温暖的午后阳光。随着金色时段的临近，一行人穿过屋顶露台。附近街头表演的音乐激发了即興舞蹈和欢乐时刻。手持和稳定器镜头捕捉真实的笑声、头发摆动和充满活力的编舞，每个人都手持他们的苹果饮料。庆祝活动继续进行，他们在日落时聚集在屋顶边缘。温暖的金色光芒照亮天际线，每个人一起举起冰镇苹果饮料，欢笑并欣赏景色。电影般的特写镜头捕捉闪耀的水珠和瓶内逼真的液体流动。最终电影般的英雄镜头：年轻女性手持冰镇苹果饮料走向镜头，直接置于镜头前。城市天际线在她身后闪耀，她温暖地微笑并说，“保持新鲜。保持活力。”镜头缓缓拉远，展现令人惊叹的屋顶天际线、闪耀的日落、朋友们一起庆祝，以及充满活力的市中心氛围。仅使用自然环境音：城市氛围、脚步声、咖啡馆闲聊、鸟鸣、轻柔微风、精品店门开启、购物袋沙沙声、瓶盖开启、气泡嘶嘶声、冰块叮当声、屋顶对话、笑声、远处街头艺人、树叶沙沙声。没有背景音乐，没有字幕，没有标志，没有水印，也没有屏幕文字。高端商业品质摄影，超逼真皮肤纹理，逼真液体物理，手持和稳定器动态相机运动，物理精确照明，浅景深，充满活力的绿色和清脆白色调色板，奢华饮料广告，16:9 宽屏，4K HDR。
entries.translated_prompt: Create a high-end lifestyle beverage advertisement featuring the same young East Asian woman throughout the entire sequence. Maintain the same facial features, soft light brown long wavy hair, glowing skin, body proportions, and clothing in every frame. She wears a fitted black ribbed crop top, light blue ripped high-waisted jeans, white sneakers, silver hoop earrings, layered silver necklaces, sunglasses resting on her head, and a small white shoulder bag. The modern downtown is filled with murals, cafes, boutiques, rooftop terraces, and high-end juice bars, with a vibrant summer atmosphere, bright natural sunlight, luxury commercial photography style, a fresh green and white color palette, inspired by fresh apples. The video begins with her smiling confidently at the camera, standing outside a stylish juice bar. She notices a chilled sparkling apple drink displayed on ice, picks it up excitedly, turns the bottle next to her face as water droplets sparkle in the sun, then smiles and says, "Freshness starts here!" A cinematic macro hero shot shows the chilled apple drink surrounded by crisp green apples, ice cubes, sparkling water droplets, and fresh mint leaves. She twists open the cap, making a satisfying crisp pop. A slow-motion close-up captures tiny bubbles surging up as she sips, her smile immediately brightening. She walks confidently through colorful downtown streets decorated with murals, planters, cafes, and boutique storefronts. A smooth handheld tracking shot follows her as the breeze naturally blows her hair. She casually browses stylish boutiques, tries on sunglasses, admires windows, and continues to enjoy her apple drink. She meets friends at a trendy rooftop cafe overlooking the city skyline. They embrace, laugh together, order light meals, and place chilled apple drinks on the table while enjoying the warm afternoon sun. As the golden hour approaches, the group walks across the rooftop terrace. Music from a nearby street performance inspires impromptu dancing and joyful moments. Handheld and stabilizer shots capture authentic laughter, hair swinging, and vibrant choreography, with everyone holding their apple drinks. The celebration continues as they gather at the edge of the rooftop at sunset. Warm golden light illuminates the skyline as everyone raises their chilled apple drinks together, laughing and enjoying the view. Cinematic close-ups capture sparkling water droplets and realistic liquid flow inside the bottles. Final cinematic hero shot: the young woman walks toward the camera holding a chilled apple drink, placing it directly in front of the lens. The city skyline sparkles behind her, she smiles warmly and says, "Stay fresh. Stay vibrant." The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the stunning rooftop skyline, sparkling sunset, friends celebrating together, and the vibrant downtown atmosphere. Use only natural ambient sounds: city atmosphere, footsteps, cafe chatter, birds chirping, gentle breeze, boutique doors opening, shopping bag rustling, bottle cap opening, bubble fizzing, ice clinking, rooftop conversation, laughter, distant street performers, rustling leaves. No background music, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks, and no on-screen text. High-end commercial quality photography, ultra-realistic skin textures, realistic liquid physics, dynamic handheld and stabilizer camera movements, physically accurate lighting, shallow depth of field, vibrant green and crisp white palette, luxury beverage advertisement, 16:9 widescreen, 4K HDR.

entries.title: Knight vs Stone Titan Epic Battle
entries.description: A dark heroic fantasy video prompt with detailed scene choreography for an epic battle between a lone knight and a colossal stone titan.
entries.prompt:
Premium dark heroic-fantasy, insane sakuga, hyper-dynamic camera choreography, monumental scale, explosive stone physics, dramatic cloth movement, cinematic lighting, clean full narrative ending.

0–4s: A lone armored knight stands on a shattered bridge above a bottomless canyon while a colossal stone titan rises from the ancient ruins. Lightning flashes behind enormous floating mountains. Slow push-in on the knight drawing a glowing sword.

4–8s: The titan brings down one massive fist. The knight sprints forward, jumps across falling bridge fragments and runs along the titan’s arm. Fast tracking shot, rotating camera, extreme scale contrast and powerful impact animation.

8–12s: The knight reaches the titan’s shoulder, dodges sweeping stone spikes and drives the glowing sword into a bright rune beneath its neck. Energy cracks spread across the titan’s entire body.

12–15s: The titan freezes, separates into thousands of glowing stone fragments and falls harmlessly into the canyon. The knight lands on the remaining bridge section and lowers the sword as sunlight breaks through the storm. End on an epic hero frame.

entries.title: Viral Masked Dancer Tutorial
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a realistic dancing video, focusing on consistent attire, rhythmic punching movements, and specific camera angles.
entries.prompt: 参考图图片1 中的女生开始跳舞。镜头全程完全静止，不推不摇不移，机位偏低略微仰拍，像手机随手架在矮柜上拍的。取景保持四分之三身：从大腿中部到头顶，人物占满画面高度。她图片1 全程戴着 图片2 口罩，穿浅灰色短袖紧身T恤和深灰色高腰紧身运动长裤。动作按时间推进：开头四秒，她握紧右拳，朝镜头快速冲拳，每次冲到最近处拳头几乎贴到镜头、占满整个画面并轻微失焦，然后迅速收回，踩着节拍连续重复五次。接着收回双手开始跳舞：身体侧转四十五度面向镜头，重心压在一条腿上，胯部随节拍左右顶动，肩膀与胯部反向扭转，形成流畅的身体波浪；双臂动作贴近身体和脸部，手腕翻转，指尖划过颈侧和发梢；原地小幅度转身切换朝向，长发大幅甩动飘起。最后再次把手伸向镜头。 画面保持参考图的光线 and 质感：头顶吸顶灯的平淡正面光，墙上影子很淡，白平衡偏暖黄，普通手机画质，不锐利，像随手录的日常视频。双手手指始终结构清晰完整自然。
entries.translated_prompt: The girl in Reference Image 1 begins dancing. The camera remains completely still throughout, without zooming, panning, or tilting. The angle is low, slightly looking up, as if a phone were placed on a low cabinet. The framing is three-quarters: from mid-thigh to the top of the head, with the subject filling the height of the frame. Throughout, she wears the mask from Image 1 and Image 2, a light grey short-sleeved tight T-shirt, and dark grey high-waisted tight leggings. Actions follow a timeline: In the first four seconds, she clenches her right fist and punches towards the camera rapidly. Each time the fist reaches the closest point, it almost touches the lens, filling the frame and slightly blurring, then quickly retracts, repeating five times to the beat. She then brings her hands back and starts dancing: turning 45 degrees to face the camera, weight on one leg, hips rocking left and right to the beat, with shoulders and hips twisting in opposite directions to create smooth body waves. Arm movements are close to her body and face, with wrists turning and fingertips skimming her neck and hair. She makes small turns to change direction, with long hair swinging and flying. Finally, she reaches towards the camera again. The visual maintains the lighting and texture of the reference image: flat front lighting from a ceiling lamp, faint shadows on the wall, warm yellow white balance, standard mobile phone quality, not sharp, resembling a casual daily video. Fingers remain clearly structured and natural throughout.

entries.title: Cinematic IMAX Laboratory Fight Scene
entries.description: An intense hand-to-hand combat scene between an East Asian woman in a white silk dress and a male attacker in a grimy, abandoned chemical laboratory at night.
entries.prompt: 使用IMAX 70mm胶片摄影机手持动态跟拍，一段夜晚黑暗肮脏化学实验室中的高强度原始徒手格斗。画面充满真实胶片颗粒、轻微闸门抖动和手持呼吸感，冷调青绿色调色，强烈的运动模糊与不完美构图，荷兰角与低角度戏剧性视角交替。16:9，电影级高细节。 东亚女性，约35岁，黑色长发及肩在动作中狂野甩动并带惯性，脸部有几道新鲜划痕和淤青，眼神锐利、眉毛紧锁、嘴唇紧抿，充满愤怒与力量。她穿着精致飘逸的白色真丝吊带连衣裙，细肩带，轻薄真丝面料在激烈动作中大幅翻飞、旋转并出现轻微撕裂，裙摆飞扬与暴力动作形成鲜明对比。皮肤有逼真毛孔纹理、汗水反光和划痕细节，动作中可见肌肉紧绷和急促呼吸。在整个视频中保持完全一致的身份、服装、发型和外貌。 男性袭击者，约40岁，体格壮实，深色长袖上衣和裤子在扭打中凌乱，脸上有血迹和肿胀。 场景为夜晚废弃化学实验室：剥落白色墙壁露出水泥和锈迹，成排生锈金属实验台和架子，散落破碎玻璃试管、烧杯遍布混凝土地面，金属手推车歪斜，闪烁不稳的头顶灯光投射移动青绿阴影，空气中漂浮尘土颗粒，地面有化学残留斑块和反光碎玻璃。 打斗序列开始于手持跟拍侧面缠斗，女子凶狠表情特写，头发与白色真丝裙摆飞舞，灰尘被动作扬起。突然起跳旋风踢正中男子头部，男子头部受强力冲击变形、嘴唇破裂出血、身体失去平衡重重撞上实验台，砸碎大量玻璃仪器发出清脆碎裂声。落地后女子连续猛拳击打男子躯干，扭打中男子抓住她一条手臂反击击中她脸部。她愤怒表情特写大喊，连续快速踢腿猛踹男子肋部和小腹，男子捂腹连连败退。她追上一步将男子摔倒在地，用肘部连续猛击身体发出沉闷声响，然后戏剧性旋转用膝盖死死压制男子胸口。男子挣扎着从地上抓起一支试管用力刺向她腰侧但擦身而过，突然停止动作不动。女子甩头发力站起，头发飞扬，向男子脸上吐了一口唾沫，剧烈喘息着以英雄姿态环绕走向镜头，低角度手持跟拍。她脚踩碎玻璃的嘎吱声在空旷实验室回荡，明显剧烈喘息。 强调真实物理效果：真丝面料的翻滚撕裂与空气阻力、头发甩动的自然惯性、拳脚冲击的力道与身体晃动、玻璃碎裂的粒子飞溅、尘土扬起、人物喘息与重力反馈。手持镜头在快速踢腿和旋转时出现明显晃动、短暂失焦和运动模糊，操作者追赶动作时构图偏离中心，灯光闪烁导致曝光轻微波动。真实粒子效果，电影级自然灯光与胶片质感，情感化赋权基调，高细节4K电影质量。 结尾她喘息着走向前景，画面保留手持不完美质感与轻微呼吸感，逐渐以她为中心构图后切黑。仅自然环境音与现场收音：沉重喘息、拳脚闷响、真丝裙摆沙沙声与撕裂声、玻璃碎裂清脆声、金属撞击钝响、女子愤怒大喊、男子痛苦呻吟、脚踩碎玻璃嘎吱回响。没有背景音乐、没有音效设计、没有旁白。
entries.translated_prompt: Shot with an IMAX 70mm film camera using handheld dynamic tracking, an intense, raw hand-to-hand fight scene in a dark, grimy chemical laboratory at night. The footage is filled with authentic film grain, slight gate jitter, and handheld breathing. Cold cyan-green color grading, strong motion blur, and imperfect framing with alternating Dutch angles and dramatic low-angle perspectives. 16:9, cinematic high detail. An East Asian woman, about 35 years old, with shoulder-length black hair wildly swinging with inertia during action. Her face has fresh scratches and bruises; her eyes are sharp, brows locked, and lips tight, full of anger and power. She wears a refined, flowing white silk slip dress with thin straps. The thin silk fabric flips, rotates, and shows slight tearing during intense movements, the flying hem contrasting sharply with the violent action. Skin features realistic pore textures, sweat reflections, and scratch details; muscle tension and rapid breathing are visible during movement. Consistent identity, clothing, hair, and appearance throughout the video. A male attacker, about 40 years old, solidly built, in dark long-sleeved top and pants messy from the struggle, with blood and swelling on his face. The scene is an abandoned chemical laboratory at night: peeling white walls revealing cement and rust, rows of rusted metal lab benches and shelves, scattered broken glass tubes and beakers on the concrete floor, a lopsided metal trolley, and flickering overhead lights casting shifting cyan shadows. Dust particles float in the air, with chemical residue patches and reflective broken glass on the floor. The fight sequence begins with a handheld side tracking shot of the struggle, a close-up of the woman's fierce expression, hair and white silk dress hem flying, dust kicked up by action. Suddenly she performs a jumping whirlwind kick hitting the man's head; the man's head deforms under the strong impact, lips break and bleed, and he loses balance, crashing heavily into a lab bench, smashing many glass instruments with a sharp shattering sound. Upon landing, the woman delivers a series of heavy punches to the man's torso. During the struggle, the man grabs one of her arms and counters, hitting her face. Close-up of her angry expression as she shouts, delivering rapid kicks to the man's ribs and abdomen; the man retreats clutching his belly. She follows up with a throw, slamming him to the ground, and uses her elbow for consecutive heavy strikes with a dull thud, then dramatically rotates to pin the man's chest with her knee. The man struggles to grab a test tube from the floor to stab her side but misses. He suddenly stops moving. The woman stands up forcefully, hair flying, spits on the man's face, and walks around toward the camera in a heroic stance, low-angle handheld tracking. The crunching sound of her feet on broken glass echoes in the empty lab, with audible heavy breathing. Emphasize realistic physics: the tumbling and tearing of silk fabric with air resistance, natural inertia of swinging hair, force of strikes and body swaying, particle splashes of breaking glass, rising dust, character breathing, and gravity feedback. Handheld camera shows obvious shaking, brief loss of focus, and motion blur during rapid kicks and rotations; the operator's tracking movements lead to off-center framing, and flickering lights cause slight exposure fluctuations. Realistic particle effects, cinematic natural lighting and film texture, emotional empowerment tone, high-detail 4K cinematic quality. Ending with her walking toward the foreground breathing heavily, the frame retaining handheld imperfection and subtle breathing rhythm, gradually centering on her before cutting to black. Only natural ambient sounds and on-site audio: heavy breathing, thuds of strikes, rustling and tearing of silk dress, sharp shattering of glass, dull metal impacts, the woman's angry shouts, the man's painful groans, and the crunching of glass underfoot. No background music, no sound design, no narration.

entries.title: Cinematic Snowy Cabin Solitude
entries.description: A 15-second cinematic video prompt depicting a peaceful winter retreat, following a woman from an aerial cabin view to intimate indoor moments and a sunset walk.
entries.prompt:
Style: Ultra-realistic, cinematic winter documentary, 4K HDR, natural lighting, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement, soft colour grading, peaceful atmosphere. Maintain the same woman throughout every scene (mid-20s, natural appearance, long dark brown hair tied in a loose ponytail, cream knitted sweater, dark leggings, wool socks, no makeup-heavy look).

Scene 1 (0–3s)

Aerial drone shot of a small wooden cabin hidden deep inside a snow-covered pine forest. Heavy snow falls gently while warm golden lights glow from the windows. Thin smoke rises from the chimney as the camera slowly descends toward the cabin.

Scene 2 (3–6s)

Inside the cabin, the same woman sits beside a crackling stone fireplace wrapped in a soft wool blanket, reading a book. Steam rises naturally from a ceramic mug of hot chocolate on a rustic wooden table. Firelight flickers across the room, creating a warm contrast with the cold blue light outside.

Scene 3 (6–10s)

She opens the wooden front door and steps onto the snowy porch. Snowflakes land softly on her sweater and hair. She smiles, takes a slow deep breath, and looks across the silent forest while the camera gently circles around her.

Scene 4 (10–13s)

Close-up cinematic shots: boots leaving fresh footprints in untouched snow, her gloved hand brushing snow from pine branches, snowflakes settling on the warm cabin window, and smoke drifting into the crisp winter air.

Scene 5 (13–15s)

Wide cinematic pullback from the cabin at dusk. Snow continues falling as the glowing cabin becomes smaller among the vast white forest. The scene ends with a calm, peaceful atmosphere and the feeling of complete solitude.

Camera

Slow drone movements
Smooth gimbal tracking
Gentle push-ins
Macro close-ups
No fast cuts or shaky movement

Audio

Gentle wind
Soft snowfall ambience
Fireplace crackling
Distant birds
Quiet piano or acoustic instrumental

Colour Grade

Warm amber tones indoors, cool blue-white winter tones outdoors, creating a cosy contrast.

End Text

Sometimes the quietest places leave the strongest memories.

entries.title: Whimsical Fantasy Candy Workshop Animation
entries.description: A comprehensive video prompt for a whimsical 3D animation featuring Professor Crumble in a candy-filled workshop with cinematic lighting and expressive character movement.
entries.prompt: Duration: 15 Seconds Aspect Ratio: 16:9 Genre: Whimsical Fantasy Animation Style: Premium animated feature film, ultra-detailed stylized 3D, cinematic lighting, warm golden sunlight streaming through giant candy-glass windows, magical volumetric dust, soft bloom, rich pastel color palette, handcrafted fantasy architecture, highly expressive animation, Pixar-inspired quality (original world and characters), playful orchestral energy, buttery-smooth camera movement, shallow depth of field, subtle magical particles, cozy fantasy atmosphere. Character Reference Use the exact approved character sheets for: Professor Crumble Mochi Whisk Jello Sprinkle STRICT CHARACTER & IDENTITY LOCK Maintain identical facial features, body proportions, hairstyles, clothing, accessories, colors, materials, and personalities exactly as shown in their character sheets throughout every shot. No redesigns or inconsistencies. 0–3 Seconds Camera A sweeping FPV cinematic drone shot glides through enormous candy-colored stained-glass windows before gently diving into the magical workshop. The camera flies between floating cupcake chandeliers, spinning sugar gears, glass tubes carrying glowing syrup, and tiny pastry robots crossing wooden bridges. The workshop feels impossibly huge, alive, and full of wonder. As the camera slows, Professor Crumble comes into view at the center of the room. Characters Professor Crumble is happily humming while carefully sketching a recipe upside down. Whisk quietly polishes copper mixing machines. Mochi floats overhead carrying an enormous bag of sparkling Cloud Flour that's clearly too heavy. Jello secretly peeks from behind a cookie jar with a mischievous grin. Sprinkle flutters through flowering vines, gently waking magical strawberries with glowing fairy dust. 3–6 Seconds Camera A smooth dolly move circles Professor Crumble as he suddenly gasps with excitement. The camera pushes in dramatically as his amber eyes sparkle. His Spectra Goggles rotate automatically. Tiny magical sugar particles begin swirling around him. Action Professor Crumble raises his glowing Wonder Spoon. He smiles warmly. "Now then... let's discover something impossible." Every machine in the workshop softly comes alive. Copper pipes glow. Glass bottles gently vibrate. Tiny lights flicker across the ceiling. 6–9 Seconds Camera Fast overhead crane shot transitions into a rotating close-up around the giant enchanted mixing bowl. Action Mochi excitedly tosses Cloud Flour into the bowl. Sprinkle adds glowing Crystal Berries. Whisk precisely pours shimmering Moon Vanilla. Everything is going perfectly... Until... Jello quietly stretches into a long jelly arm... ...and drops one mysterious sparkling ingredient into the mixture. Nobody notices. The bowl instantly flashes with rainbow light. 9–12 Seconds Camera The camera rapidly orbits the mixing bowl before switching to an extreme slow-motion close-up. Action Rainbow batter floats into the air. Sugar butterflies appear. Miniature constellations swirl inside the mixture. Chocolate ribbons spiral around glowing fruit. Professor Crumble laughs with childlike joy instead of panic. Mochi spins happily in midair. Whisk's eyes widen in astonishment. Jello tries to look innocent. 12–15 Seconds Camera A slow cinematic push-in reveals the finished dessert floating above the workshop. Everyone gathers beneath it. The dessert slowly blossoms like a magical flower. Golden sparkles drift through the room. Professor Crumble takes one tiny bite. His eyes light up. He laughs warmly. "Perfection is delicious... but surprises are unforgettable." The camera gently pulls back through the workshop as all five characters admire the glowing dessert together. The final frame freezes into a beautiful storybook illustration while shimmering golden text appears: "Professor Crumble's Wonder Workshop" Tiny sugar sparkles continue drifting across the screen as the music ends on a magical, uplifting note. 🎥 Cinematic Notes Smooth FPV fly-throughs with graceful, weightless movement. Gentle dolly and crane shots to emphasize scale and wonder. Macro close-ups for magical ingredients and expressive character moments. Warm golden lighting with soft bloom and volumetric sun rays. Rich environmental animation: bubbling syrup, rotating gears, floating flour dust, drifting sparkles, gently swaying vines, and glowing glass tubes. Every character should remain active in the background, making the workshop feel like a living, breathing place where magic is always happening. This makes the world feel endlessly alive and invites viewers to rewatch to catch all the little details.

0:00–0:02 | Street Assault

VFX: Concrete dust, electrical sparks, collapsing steel beams, cascading glass.

0:05–0:08 | City Charge
Camera: High aerial tracking shot with controlled movement.

VFX: Exploding puddles, cracked roads, smoke, debris trails.

0:12–0:15 | Final Charge

电影级写实冷面音乐喜剧，精致商业电影质感，针对 Seedance 2.0 的多参考角色锁定、多镜头连续性、人物表演控制，以及普通话演唱、对白、环境声、音乐和动作音效的原生音画同步进行设计；华丽仙侠演唱会的幻觉逐步坍塌为尴尬普通的私人 KTV 包厢，依靠克制表演、逐层升级的环境反应和一句清晰的声音包袱完成反转。

高级私人 KTV 包厢，深色镜面墙、红色丝绒沙发、矮玻璃桌、水果盘、两支麦克风、旋转的蓝金色灯光和一块大型点歌屏清晰可见。
角色 ID A 为同一个来自 @图片 1 的 25–30 岁东亚剑仙姐，严格保持参考图中的同一张脸、锐利深色眼睛、黑色长发、妆容、高挑纤细身材、玉簪、银色饰品、白色刺绣真丝汉服、半透明层叠宽袖、飘动长裙 and 白色布靴；她从鞋到头完整站在玻璃桌上，将同一柄银色长剑竖直握在嘴边，像握着麦克风。

[Character A] 25-30yo East Asian 'Sword Fairy' from @Image 1, strictly maintaining face, eyes, long black hair, white embroidered silk Hanfu. She stands on a glass table holding a silver sword like a microphone.
[Character B] 'Bike Sister' from @Image 2, maintaining face, ponytail, and position on the sofa.

[Shot 1 | 0-5s | 24mm Wide Low Angle] A luxury private KTV room with mirrored walls, red velvet sofa, fruit platter. Character A stands on the table holding a sword while Character B watches. Sword qi particles gather as epic strings swell.
[Shot 2 | 5-10s | Medium Shot] Camera circles. Character A closes eyes and belts out an exaggerated Mandarin opera high note. Hair and sleeves float, glasses vibrate, and the KTV screen turns into a cloud sea. Character B looks genuinely shocked.
[Shot 3 | 10-15s | Close-up] The high note ends, silence for half a second. The KTV system announces: "Score: 12 points." The cloud sea collapses into cheap disco lights. Character B claps twice and says: "Sister, plenty of sword qi, not enough breath." Character A lowers her sword, her face twitching as she tries to maintain a cold smile. Freeze on her broken expression.

[Technical] 15s total, 16:9, 24fps, accurate lip-sync, no identity drift.

entries.title: Parallel Lives Transformation Video
entries.description: A high-concept Seedance 2.0 prompt for a social media style video showcasing different parallel life versions of the same person through rapid cuts and environment changes.
entries.prompt:
平行人生变装展示，竖屏 9:16，10 秒，真实影棚人像 + 电影感生活切片，固定人物一致性，快节奏卡点硬切，社交媒体爆款短视频质感。

使用上传的人物参考图，始终保持同一张脸、同一五官、同一年龄感、同一肤色和身材比例。每次变装只能改变服装、发型细节、环境、气质和道具，不得换脸，不得变成另一个人。

同一个人站在画面中央，每一次眨眼、转身、抬头或镜头遮挡，都硬切到一种完全不同的人生版本。每个版本画面中间偏下方出现简短中文标签，白色粗体黑描边，像短视频测试题。

固定中近景或半身构图，人物始终在画面中央，脸部大小基本一致。每次切换必须落在音乐重拍上，使用干净单帧硬切，不要魔法粒子，不要复杂转场。人物每个镜头都有一个自然小动作，不能呆站。

0:00-0:01.2
版本1：都市打工人。浅灰西装外套，白衬衫，脖子上挂工牌，背景是早高峰地铁站虚化灯光。人物低头看手机，疲惫但克制，标签：“打工人”。

0:01.2-0:02.4
版本2：自由摄影师。宽松衬衫，斜挎相机，背景是傍晚街头，暖色夕阳。人物抬起相机对准镜头，轻轻一笑，标签：“摄影师”。

0:02.4-0:03.6
版本3：深夜赛车手。黑色机车夹克，手拿头盔，背景是雨夜停车场，霓虹反光。人物戴上手套，眼神变锋利，标签：“赛车手”。

0:03.6-0:04.8
版本4：海边咖啡店老板。亚麻衬衫，围裙，手里端着咖啡杯，背景是明亮海边小店。人物把咖啡放到镜头前，表情放松，标签：“咖啡店老板”。

0:04.8-0:06.0
版本5：雪山旅人。厚羽绒服，毛线帽，脸颊微红，背景是雪山和风雪。人物呼出白气，转头看远方，标签：“雪山旅人”。

0:06.0-0:07.2
版本6：舞台歌手。黑色亮片演出服，手握麦克风，背景是小型 livehouse 舞台灯。人物闭眼唱出一句，灯光扫过脸，标签：“歌手”。

0:07.2-0:08.4
版本7：科研实验员。白色实验服，护目镜，手拿透明试管，背景是干净实验室蓝白光。人物认真观察试管，随后抬眼看镜头，标签：“研究员”。

0:08.4-0:10.0
版本8：岛上退休的人。宽松白衬衫，草帽，背景是安静海岛阳台和远处蓝海。人物靠在椅子上，慢慢摘下墨镜，对镜头露出释然微笑，标签：“退休生活”。

轻快电子鼓点，每次硬切有清脆 click 声。环境声很轻：地铁声、快门声、雨声、海浪声、风声、舞台人声、实验室轻微电流声、海边鸟鸣。整体节奏要爽，但画面要真实。

真实摄影质感，自然皮肤纹理，服装材质清晰，光影真实，人物一致性强，不卡顿，不漂移。中文标签清晰可读，不要多余字幕。

换脸，五官变化，年龄忽大忽小，身材比例变化，手指畸形，多余肢体，服装融化，背景混乱，标签乱码，英文字幕，水印，logo，过度磨皮，塑料感，AI感，魔法粒子转场，闪白转场，人物位置大幅漂移。
entries.translated_prompt:
Parallel Lives transformation showcase, 9:16 vertical, 10 seconds, realistic studio portrait + cinematic life slices, fixed character consistency, fast rhythmic hard cuts, viral social media video quality.

Use the uploaded character reference image, keeping the same face, features, age, skin tone, and body proportions throughout. Changes allowed only in clothing, hair details, environment, temperament, and props. No face-swapping or turning into another person.

One person standing in the center. Every blink, turn, or head lift hard-cuts to a completely different version of life. Each version features a short Chinese label in bold white with black outline at the bottom center. Fixed medium shot, character centered.
