entries.title: Giant Crocodile Dam Breach Sequence
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot narrative prompt featuring a giant crocodile attacking a boat near a massive dam, culminating in a dramatic spillway release.
entries.prompt:
LOCATION: A massive concrete dam in bright stormy daylight, a wide grey-green reservoir behind it, a small maintenance boat on the water near the dam wall, a glass control room perched on top of the dam, the huge dry spillway ramp and turbine house far below.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Water-level tracking shot. A mega crocodile the size of a bus has its jaws clamped on the maintenance boat's stern, dragging it backward through the reservoir toward the dam wall, the hull groaning, gear sliding off the deck. The lone worker aboard clings to the rail, screaming into his radio: "IT'S PULLING ME INTO THE WALL! I'M JUMPING!"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Inside the control room on the dam crest. The control officer, headset on, hands already spread across the floodgate console for the scheduled release, looks down through the glass at the croc hauling the boat toward the gates. His eyes flick to the access ladder on the wall. Into the radio: "JUMP NOW! LADDER'S TEN METERS TO YOUR LEFT! SWIM!"

Shot 3 (6–9s): Handheld from the dam wall. The worker dives off the boat and swims hard for the ladder, hauling himself up the rungs as the croc crushes the empty boat flat in its jaws behind him — then turns, gliding straight along the wall, directly over the massive submerged spillway gates.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The officer slams every gate lever at once. Bullet time — all the spillway gates blast open together, and the reservoir tears downward in slow motion, a monstrous whirlpool ripping the croc under, its body twisting and dragged through the gates, fired down the concrete spillway inside a white cannon of floodwater — and slammed straight through the turbine house wall below. Impact. The building detonates, water and fire exploding outward together.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The flood thunders down the spillway through the burning wreckage, spray and smoke boiling up the dam face as the worker clings to the ladder above, staring down.

entries.title: Mega Croc vs Giant Turbine Battle
entries.description: An intense, multi-shot action sequence for Seedance 2 featuring a massive crocodile attacking a wind farm construction site and a dramatic cinematic payoff.
entries.prompt: LOCATION: A coastal wind farm construction site in bright harsh daylight, giant white turbine towers along the cliffs, a massive crawler crane mid-lift with a 70-meter turbine blade hanging from its hook, scattered containers and a fenced transformer station humming at the site's edge, sea wind whipping dust. Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Ground-level tracking shot through the site. A mega crocodile the size of a bus has its jaws clamped on the rear of a worker's ATV, dragging it backward across the gravel with the worker still on it, wheels spinning, gear flying. He clings to the handlebars, screaming into his radio: "IT'S GOT MY QUAD! SOMEBODY DO SOMETHING!" Shot 2 (3–6s): High shot from inside the crane cab. The crane operator, hands already on the slew levers mid-lift, the enormous white blade hanging off his hook, looks down at the croc dragging the ATV directly across his lift zone. His eyes go from the blade to the croc to the transformer station behind it. Into his radio: "GET OFF THE QUAD! ROLL LEFT! NOW!" Shot 3 (6–9s): Low handheld at ground level. The worker kicks free of the ATV and rolls hard across the gravel behind a container. The croc shakes the empty quad apart in its jaws, then rises up on its hind legs to full height, bellowing at the fleeing man — fully exposed in the open lift zone. Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The operator slams the slew levers full over. Bullet time — the crane whips around and the 70-meter blade sweeps across the site in slow motion like a giant sword, dust curling off its edge — and scythes into the rearing croc's body, slicing through and smashing the monster off its feet, hurling it through the transformer station fence. Impact. The transformers erupt in a chain of explosions, arcs of lightning and fire ripping upward around the broken body. Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. Sparks rain across the site, the blade still swinging overhead, the worker rising from behind the container to stare at the burning, arcing wreckage.

entries.title: Giant Scorpion Ridge Ambush
entries.description: A structured multi-shot action prompt for a desert military ambush featuring a giant scorpion attack on a relay post.
entries.prompt:
A rocky ridge above an army camp in bright daylight, a small radio relay post with an antenna mast standing at the top. A giant scorpion, armored with a whipping stinger tail, bursts up from the rocks near the relay post and grabs the operator. Lower on the ridge slope, a gunner is already loaded, posted there to watch this signal ridge every day. Sound: cracking rock, scraping armor, shouting, the scorpion's hiss, radio voices.   

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot at the relay post. The giant scorpion bursts up from between the rocks, claws snapping around the operator's arm, its tail whipping over its back near the antenna mast. He shouts into his radio: "IT'S GOT ME AT THE RELAY POST!"   

Shot 2 (3–6s): Lower on the slope, the gunner lifts the bazooka onto his shoulder, tracking the scorpion up near the ridge line — but holds his fire, the operator still too close. He calls on the radio: "Slide down the slope! Now!"   

Shot 3 (6–9s): The operator wrenches free and slides down the loose rock slope away from the relay post. The scorpion turns and climbs onto the open ridge line above him, alone now, claws snapping against the empty sky.   

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The scorpion stands alone on the open ridge now. The gunner fires from lower on the slope. Bullet time — the bazooka kicks back, smoke bursting from the tube, the rocket streaking up the ridge in slow motion, dust and loose rock hanging in the air.   

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. A massive blast tears through the scorpion at the top of the ridge, fire and rock scattering against the sky. The operator lies flat lower on the slope, safe, as smoke drifts off the ridge line.

entries.title: Crocodile Ambush Action Sequence
entries.description: A multi-shot narrative prompt featuring a giant crocodile attacking a mechanic at an army vehicle repair shed, including specific shot breakdowns and synchronized audio cues.
entries.prompt:
An army vehicle repair shed in bright daylight, a wide open doorway leading out into a dusty yard, tools and fuel drums stacked along the walls inside. A mega crocodile, huge as a truck, drags a mechanic out of the shed toward the open yard. At the shed's corner, a gunner is already loaded, posted there to watch this repair yard every day. Sound: scraping metal, groaning tools, croc hissing, shouting, radio voices.   

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot at the shed doorway. The mega crocodile drags the mechanic by his overalls out through the open doorway, tools clattering off a workbench as he claws at the ground. He shouts into his radio: "IT'S DRAGGING ME OUT OF THE SHED!"   

Shot 2 (3–6s): At the shed's corner, the gunner lifts the bazooka onto his shoulder, tracking the crocodile through the doorway — but holds his fire, the mechanic still too close. He calls on the radio: "Roll behind the drum! Now!"   

Shot 3 (6–9s): The mechanic twists hard and breaks free, rolling behind a stacked fuel drum at the edge of the yard. The crocodile drags itself fully into the open shed doorway, alone now, no one near it, jaws snapping at empty air.   

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The croc stands alone in the open doorway now. The gunner fires. Bullet time — the bazooka kicks back, smoke bursting from the tube, the rocket streaking straight at the doorway in slow motion, dust rising off the ground.   

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. A massive blast tears through the shed and the crocodile together, fire and twisted metal bursting out through the doorway. The mechanic peers out from behind the fuel drum as smoke rolls across the yard.

entries.title: Alien Ambush Action Sequence
entries.description: A multi-shot action prompt describing an alien attack at a military motor pool, including specific shot timing and slow-motion effects.
entries.prompt:
An army motor pool yard in bright daylight, rows of parked trucks and jeeps, tool racks along one side, open ground between the vehicles. A mechanic lies working under a truck when a tentacled alien — brownish-black and slimy — wraps around his legs and drags him out into the open yard. At the yard's watch post, a gunner is already loaded, covering the motor pool the way he does every shift. Sound: dragging tools, wet tentacles slapping, shouting, the alien's low roar, radio voices.   

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot across the yard. The alien's slimy tentacles wrap around the mechanic's legs and drag him out from under the truck, tools scattering across the ground. He claws at the dirt and shouts into his radio: "IT'S GOT ME! PULLING ME OUT!"   

Shot 2 (3–6s): At the watch post, the gunner drops behind his weapon, tracking the alien across the open yard — but holds his fire, the mechanic still too close. He calls on the radio: "Roll under the next truck! Get clear!"   

Shot 3 (6–9s): The mechanic twists hard and rolls sideways under a parked jeep nearby, breaking the tentacle's grip. The alien, empty-handed, slides forward into the open middle of the yard, rearing up tall and alone among the parked trucks, tentacles spread wide.   

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The alien stands alone in the open yard now, fuel drums stacked nearby. The gunner opens fire. Bullet time — the long burst rips across the yard in slow motion, muzzle flashes lighting the parked trucks, dust kicking up as it tears into the alien and the drums behind it.   

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The fuel drums ignite together with the alien in one huge fireball across the motor pool, fire rolling between the parked trucks. The mechanic peers out from under the jeep as smoke drifts over the yard.

【リップシンク・セリフ】
日本語・男性・60代・低くゆったりした張りのある声。
昭和の政治家特有の重々しい演説調。語尾を伸ばし、句読点で間を取る。
「国民生活の安定こそが、政治に課せられた最大の使命であります。
政府といたしましては、物価の安定と経済の発展に、
全力を尽くしてまいる所存でございます。」
【動きの指示 — 画面内の全員が常に動き続けること。静止した人物を作らない】
●総理(話者):
・口の動きをセリフに正確に同期
・話しながら頭が小さく揺れ、肩が呼吸で上下する
・「最大の使命であります」で右手を持ち上げて振り、強調のジェスチャー
・文の区切りで原稿に視線を落とし、顔を上げて正面を見る
・まばたきを自然な頻度で入れる
●背景の議員たち(全員に個別の動きを割り当てる):
・左の議員:手元の資料をめくり、身を乗り出してメモを取る
・中央奥の議員:うなずきながら隣と小声で言葉を交わし、顔の向きを変える
・右奥の議員:頬杖を外して座り直し、眼鏡に手をやる
・全員が呼吸・まばたき・細かい姿勢の変化を続け、
 マネキンのように固まった人物が一人もいない状態を保つ
【カメラ・映像スタイル】
・正面やや下からのバストショット。完全固定ではなく、
 手持ち中継カメラのようなごく僅かなドリフトと揺れを常に入れる
・1970年代のNHK国会中継風:白黒、走査線、フィルムグレイン、
 フリッカー、ブラウン管特有の周辺減光
【音声】
・マイク越しのややこもった音質、議場の残響
・環境音:ざわめき、紙をめくる音、咳払い
・セリフ終わりに、まばらな「異議なし」の声と拍手が遠くで起こる
entries.translated_prompt:
[Scene Setting]
Early 1970s, Japan's National Diet, House of Representatives Chamber. A policy speech at an extraordinary session.
Standing at the rostrum is a Prime Minister around 60 years old. Gray hair neatly parted 70/30, wearing a dark suit with a white pocket square and a legislator's badge on the lapel.
He possesses a calm dignity and is answering questions grandly with a manuscript before him.
[Lip-sync/Dialogue]
Japanese, Male, 60s, a low, relaxed, and resonant voice.
The heavy oratorical style characteristic of Showa-era politicians. Stretching word endings and pausing at punctuation.
"The stability of the people's lives is the greatest mission assigned to politics.
The government intends to exert its full efforts toward price stability and economic development."
[Movement Instructions — Everyone on screen must move constantly. No static figures]
- Prime Minister (Speaker):
* Synchronize mouth movements accurately with the dialogue.
* Head sways slightly while speaking, and shoulders move up and down with breathing.
* At "it is the greatest mission," raises and waves the right hand in an emphatic gesture.
* Looks down at the manuscript at sentence breaks, then raises his head to look forward.
* Natural blinking frequency.
- Background Legislators (Assign individual movements to everyone):
* Legislator on the left: Flipping through materials and leaning forward to take notes.
* Legislator in the center background: Nodding while whispering with the person next to them, changing head direction.
* Legislator on the right background: Removing hand from chin, adjusting posture, and touching glasses.
* Everyone continues breathing, blinking, and making subtle posture changes, ensuring no one is frozen like a mannequin.
[Camera/Visual Style]
- Bust shot from slightly below front. Not perfectly fixed; always include very slight drift and shake like a handheld broadcast camera.
- 1970s NHK Diet broadcast style: Black and white, scan lines, film grain, flicker, and CRT-specific vignetting.
[Audio]
- Slightly muffled sound through a microphone, chamber reverberation.
- Ambient sounds: Murmurs, paper flipping, throat clearing.
- Sparse shouts of "No objection!" and distant applause occur at the end of the dialogue.

entries.title: Creative Confession with AR Magic Effects
entries.description: A highly detailed 15-second video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a female character performing a playful dance in a park. The video includes complex AR magic effects, such as a floating head avatar that transforms into a heart shape and seamless character-layer animations.
entries.prompt:
时长：15秒

画幅：9:16竖屏

结构：固定机位连续长镜头，全程无切镜

整体风格：照片级写实人物结合轻松可爱的AR魔术特效，甜蜜、俏皮、无厘头，类似创意表白短视频。所有异常变化必须呈现为明显的数字贴纸、遮罩与弹性图层动画，不呈现任何写实生理细节。

SUBJECT：

主角100%匹配输入参考图。脸、发型、身形、服装、鞋子和配饰全程保持参考图原样，不重新设计穿着。飞行AR头像也必须保持主角同一张脸、同一发型和同一头部配饰。

ENVIRONMENT：

晴朗夏日的户外公园广场，浅灰铺装地面，背景左侧为浓密绿树，右侧为深色木质廊架，上方保留大面积纯净蓝天。强烈自然日光从画面右上方照射，人物影子投向左下方。

CAMERA：

固定低机位略微仰拍，24mm完整全身广角。@主角始终位于画面中央，双脚完整可见，上方蓝天必须留出足够空间。摄影机不推拉、不摇移、不变焦、不跟随AR头像；所有远近变化均由特效图层主动靠近或远离镜头产生。

SHOT 1（0:00–0:05.8）— AR头像弹跳与冲镜飞吻

0:00–0:00.4

@主角面对镜头开心微笑，随着节拍做轻快原地跑步舞：抬膝、交叉步、轻轻前踢，双手自然摆动。第一帧已经开始运动。

0:00.4–0:02.2

@主角的面部图层无缝切换为一个独立飞行的AR圆形头像，从原位向蓝天上方弹起。原位置同步使用平滑、干净的深色椭圆遮罩，明确表现为手机短视频抠像魔术。

AR头像按照清晰轨迹弹跳：

正上方高点→身体右侧腰部→右膝附近→被抬起的膝盖颠起→再次飞到身体上方。

人物主体持续完成抬膝、交叉步、前踢和叉腰舞步，像在用膝盖颠一个可爱的头像气球。头像保持正常大小、清晰五官和开心表情，不能随机瞬移。

0:02.2–0:02.4

AR头像准确回到原位置，遮罩消失，@主角恢复完整画面，微笑耸肩半拍。

0:02.4–0:04.0

@主角屈膝左右摆胯，双手抬至肩膀高度，用掌心做左右推送动作。面部图层再次切换为飞行AR头像，并严格配合手掌节拍移动：

向右飞出画框→从左侧返回→横穿画面飞到右侧→再次甩向左侧出画。

头像带自然运动模糊，但五官、发型 and 配饰始终稳定。

0:04.0–0:05.4

人物主体继续完成指天、侧跨、扭腰、抬膝和小碎步。AR头像从右上方重新出现，在人物上方翻滚旋转，沿大弧线绕到左上方，随后逐渐朝摄影机飞来。

0:05.4–0:05.8

AR头像沿镜头轴快速靠近，放大成面部极近特写。@主角自然闭眼、脸颊微鼓、嘴唇嘟起，向镜头送出一个可爱飞吻。

多枚鲜红色半透明口红吻痕从嘴部向四周扩散，中央吻痕最大。吻痕只作为二维AR贴纸出现，不改变人物面部结构。

SHOT 2（0:05.8–0:10.8）— 心形头像与穿梭笑点

0:05.8–0:07.6

极近AR头像柔性变形成约正常头像三倍大的照片级爱心轮廓：上方形成两个圆弧，下方收成爱心尖角。仍然保持@主角同一张真实面孔，双眼闭合，持续做甜蜜飞吻表情。

人物主体转为背对镜头，双脚分开、向前弯腰，随着节拍左右摆胯；双臂向两侧下方自然展开。

巨大爱心头像作为独立AR图层，在人物正上方和一侧臀胯高度之间规律弹跳：

上方→侧面低位→上方→稍微下降→再次上浮。

0:07.6–0:09.1

爱心头像开始翻滚旋转，同时平滑缩回正常头像大小并飞向高空。

人物主体从弯腰状态起身，完成转身、交叉步、扭胯和双臂展开。缩小后的头像在高空同步自转，逐渐下降，准确回到原位置；深色遮罩同步消失。

@主角恢复完整，面对镜头开心微笑，双臂高举庆祝半拍。

0:09.1–0:10.8

@主角先俏皮耸肩，随后大幅后仰并快速扭肩，再次启动AR头像飞行效果。

头像向人物右侧滑动，再沿腰部向下移动，最终停在抬起的大腿和宽松下装前方，形成“头像钻进服装图层”的错位视觉笑点。头像只在前景重叠，不与服装纹理融合。

随后AR头像快速飞出画面，原位置继续使用干净的深色椭圆遮罩，为下一次爱心魔术留出空间。

SHOT 3（0:10.8–0:15.0）— 心中有心与图层升空

0:10.8–0:11.4

人物主体站在画面中央，先在胸腹前快速搓动双手，再将双臂向左右展开，十指张开，像在召唤新的表白特效。

0:11.4

蓝天中央突然显现一颗亮粉色、饱满、有厚度的立体果冻爱心。爱心正面嵌入同一@主角的粉色心形面孔，表情甜蜜微笑。

爱心必须是浪漫AR造型，表面光滑柔软，不采用写实材质。

0:11.4–0:12.5

@主角双臂启动弹性卡通形变，从肩膀处连续向左右上方延伸至正常长度约三倍。

双臂先形成巨大V形，随后从顶部向内弯曲。肩膀、肘部、手腕和五指结构始终清楚，双手在画面顶部中央靠近，手指轻微交叉形成爱心凹口。

两条延展手臂围成巨大的外层爱心，粉色爱心头像准确悬浮在中央，形成清晰的“心中有心”。保持这个构图约半秒。

0:12.5–0:13.1

双手逐渐分开，双臂平滑缩回正常长度。粉色爱心头像下降，颜色恢复自然，轮廓恢复正常头像，并准确回到人物原位置；深色遮罩同步消失。

0:13.1–0:13.8

完整@主角双臂高举成V形，面对镜头开心微笑，随着脚步原地旋转：正面→背面→重新转回正面。动作轻快流畅。

0:13.8–0:14.1

@主角做宽幅侧弓步，双臂笔直举过头顶，整体画面沿竖直方向充分伸展。

人物画面在腰线位置切换为上下两个独立AR图层：包含头像、双臂与上装的“上方角色图层”像弹簧一样垂直升空，迅速飞出画面顶部；包含下装、双腿和鞋子的“下方角色图层”保持站在原地。

这个过程必须像明显的短视频剪纸动画，不呈现任何写实内部细节。

0:14.1–0:15.0

摄影机保持完全固定，只保留下方服装与双鞋的AR图层。

鞋底始终接触地面，下方图层按照“拉高→压低→再次拉高→再次压低”的节奏做两次弹簧伸缩，振幅逐渐减小。

最后0.3秒保持低位宽站姿，上方角色图层不再返回，直接结束在明亮公园画面，不淡出、不转黑。

PERFORMANCE：

@主角全程保持开心、俏皮的表演状态。完整人物时直视镜头微笑；AR头像弹跳时表情轻松；冲镜时自然闭眼嘟嘴；爱心头像出现时甜蜜微笑。人物主体的舞蹈不能因特效暂停。

AUDIO：

俏皮轻快的流行舞曲，鼓点与头像弹起、横飞、冲镜、爱心出现及角色图层升空严格同步。加入轻柔的“咻、啵、弹簧回弹”喜剧音效。无对白，无字幕。

CONSTRAINTS：

所有效果必须明确呈现为AR贴纸、遮罩、剪纸图层或弹性动画。@主角和参考图中的原始造型全程稳定。只有一个头像图层和一个人物主体图层。固定单镜头、固定背景、固定光线；所有变形过程平滑连续，不出现写实生理表达。

---

Negative：

惊悚氛围，写实伤害表达，生理细节，第二个头像，人物复制，脸部漂移，五官扭曲，头像透明，头像与服装粘连，多余手臂，多余手指，手指融合，手臂断线，手臂互穿，图层边缘破碎，心形变成写实物体，服装变化，鞋子变化，配饰消失，背景跳动，摄影机推拉，摄影机跟踪头像，突然切镜，突然场景变形，塑料CG皮肤，动漫渲染，字幕
entries.translated_prompt:
Duration: 15 seconds

Aspect Ratio: 9:16 vertical screen

Structure: Fixed camera, continuous long shot, no cuts throughout.

Overall Style: Photorealistic character combined with light and cute AR magic effects—sweet, playful, and nonsensical, similar to creative confession short videos. All abnormal changes must be presented as obvious digital stickers, masks, and elastic layer animations, without showing any realistic physiological details.

SUBJECT:

The protagonist 100% matches the input reference image. Face, hairstyle, body shape, clothing, shoes, and accessories remain exactly as in the reference image throughout, with no redesign of the outfit. The flying AR avatar must also maintain the same face, hairstyle, and head accessories as the protagonist.

ENVIRONMENT:

A sunny summer day at an outdoor park plaza with light gray paved ground. Dense green trees are on the left background, a dark wooden pergola on the right, and a large area of pure blue sky above. Strong natural sunlight shines from the top right, casting the character's shadow toward the bottom left.

CAMERA:

Fixed low-angle slightly upward shot, 24mm full-body wide angle. The protagonist is always centered in the frame with feet fully visible; sufficient space must be left in the blue sky above. The camera does not push, pull, pan, zoom, or follow the AR avatar; all distance changes are produced by the effect layers actively moving toward or away from the lens.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:05.8) — AR Avatar Bouncing and Kissing Toward the Lens

0:00–0:00.4

The protagonist smiles happily at the camera, doing a light jog-in-place dance to the beat: knee lifts, cross steps, light front kicks, with arms swinging naturally. Movement begins from the first frame.

0:00.4–0:02.2

The protagonist's face layer seamlessly switches to an independently flying circular AR avatar, bouncing upward into the blue sky from its original position. A smooth, clean dark elliptical mask is used at the original position simultaneously, clearly expressing it as mobile short video cutout magic.

The AR avatar bounces along a clear trajectory:

High point directly above → waist height on the right side → near the right knee → kicked up by the lifted knee → flying back above the body.

The main character continues the knee lifts, cross steps, front kicks, and hands-on-hips dance moves, appearing to bounce a cute avatar balloon with their knee. The avatar maintains normal size, clear features, and a happy expression, without random teleportation.

0:02.2–0:02.4

The AR avatar returns accurately to its original position, the mask disappears, and the protagonist returns to the full frame, shrugging with a smile for half a beat.

0:02.4–0:04.0

The protagonist bends their knees and swings their hips left and right, raising hands to shoulder height, performing pushing motions with palms. The face layer switches to the flying AR avatar again, moving strictly in sync with the palm rhythm:

Flying right out of the frame → returning from the left → crossing the screen to the right → being flung left out of the frame again.

The avatar carries natural motion blur, but features, hairstyle, and accessories remain stable.

0:04.0–0:05.4

The main character continues pointing to the sky, side-stepping, twisting the waist, lifting knees, and doing small steps. The AR avatar reappears from the top right, tumbling and rotating above the person, circling to the top left along a large arc, then gradually flying toward the camera.

0:05.4–0:05.8

The AR avatar approaches quickly along the lens axis, enlarging into an extreme close-up of the face. The protagonist naturally closes their eyes, cheeks slightly puffed, lips pursed, blowing a cute kiss to the lens.

Multiple bright red semi-transparent lipstick kiss marks spread outward from the mouth, with the center kiss mark being the largest. The kiss marks appear only as 2D AR stickers and do not change the character's facial structure.

SHOT 2 (0:05.8–0:10.8) — Heart-Shaped Avatar and Comedic Passing

0:05.8–0:07.6

The extreme close-up AR avatar flexibly transforms into a photorealistic heart-shaped outline about three times the size of a normal head: two arcs at the top, tapering to a point at the bottom. It still maintains the same real face of the protagonist, eyes closed, continuing the sweet blowing-kiss expression.

The main character turns to face away from the camera, feet apart, leaning forward and swinging hips left and right to the beat; arms are naturally extended downward to the sides.

The giant heart avatar, as an independent AR layer, bounces regularly between the area directly above the person and the height of one hip/thigh:

Above → low side position → above → slightly descending → floating up again.

0:07.6–0:09.1

The heart avatar begins to tumble and rotate while smoothly shrinking back to normal size and flying high into the sky.

The main character rises from the leaning position, completing the turn, cross steps, hip twists, and arm extensions. The shrunken avatar rotates synchronously in the high sky, gradually descending to return accurately to the original position; the dark mask disappears simultaneously.

The protagonist is restored to full frame, smiling happily at the camera, raising both arms in celebration for half a beat.

0:09.1–0:10.8

The protagonist first shrugs playfully, then leans back significantly and twists shoulders quickly, triggering the AR avatar flight effect again.

The avatar slides to the person's right, then moves down along the waist, finally stopping in front of the lifted thigh and loose clothing, creating a visual comedic point of the 'avatar entering the clothing layer.' The avatar overlaps only in the foreground and does not blend with the clothing texture.

Subsequently, the AR avatar flies quickly out of the frame, and the original position continues using a clean dark elliptical mask, leaving space for the next heart magic.

SHOT 3 (0:10.8–0:15.0) — Heart Within a Heart and Layer Liftoff

0:10.8–0:11.4

The main character stands in the center of the frame, first quickly rubbing hands in front of the chest and abdomen, then extending arms left and right with fingers spread, as if summoning a new confession effect.

0:11.4

A bright pink, full, and thick 3D jelly heart suddenly appears in the center of the blue sky. The front of the heart is embedded with the same pink heart-shaped face of the protagonist, showing a sweet smile.

The heart must be a romantic AR design with a smooth and soft surface, not using realistic textures.

0:11.4–0:12.5

The protagonist's arms initiate elastic cartoon deformation, extending continuously from the shoulders to about three times their normal length toward the top left and right.

The arms first form a giant V-shape, then curve inward from the top. Shoulder, elbow, wrist, and five-finger structures remain clear. Hands approach at the top center of the frame, with fingers lightly crossing to form a heart notch.

The two extended arms encircle to form a giant outer heart, with the pink heart avatar suspended accurately in the center, creating a clear 'heart within a heart.' Hold this composition for about half a second.

0:12.5–0:13.1

Hands gradually separate, and arms smoothly shrink back to normal length. The pink heart avatar descends, color returns to natural, the outline returns to a normal head, and it accurately returns to the character's original position; the dark mask disappears simultaneously.

0:13.1–0:13.8

The complete protagonist raises arms in a V-shape, smiling happily at the camera, rotating in place with their footsteps: front → back → turning back to front. The movement is light and fluid.

0:13.8–0:14.1

The protagonist does a wide side lunge, arms held straight above the head, with the overall frame fully extended vertically.

The character image at the waistline switches into two independent AR layers: the 'upper character layer' (including head, arms, and top) shoots up vertically like a spring and quickly flies out the top of the frame; the 'lower character layer' (including bottom, legs, and shoes) remains standing in place.

This process must look like an obvious short video paper-cut animation, without showing any realistic internal details.

0:14.1–0:15.0

The camera remains completely fixed, retaining only the AR layer of the lower clothing and shoes.

The soles of the shoes always contact the ground. The lower layer performs two spring-like stretches and compressions according to the rhythm of 'pull high → press low → pull high → press low,' with the amplitude gradually decreasing.

Keep a low, wide stance for the final 0.3 seconds. The upper character layer does not return, ending directly on the bright park scene without fading or turning to black.

PERFORMANCE:

The protagonist maintains a happy and playful performance state throughout. Smiles and looks directly at the lens when in full character; expression is relaxed during AR avatar bouncing; eyes close naturally and lips purse when blowing a kiss; sweet smile when the heart avatar appears. The main character's dancing must not pause due to effects.

AUDIO:

Playful and light pop dance music, with the beat strictly synchronized with avatar bounces, horizontal flights, kisses to lens, heart appearances, and character layer liftoffs. Add soft 'whoosh, pop, spring rebound' comedy sound effects. No dialogue, no subtitles.

CONSTRAINTS:

All effects must be clearly presented as AR stickers, masks, paper-cut layers, or elastic animations. The original styling of the protagonist and the reference image remains stable throughout. There is only one avatar layer and one main character layer. Fixed single shot, fixed background, fixed lighting; all deformation processes are smooth and continuous, without showing realistic physiological expressions.

---

Negative:

Horror atmosphere, realistic injury expression, physiological details, a second avatar, character duplication, face drift, feature distortion, transparent avatar, avatar sticking to clothing, extra arms, extra fingers, fused fingers, disconnected arms, arms passing through each other, broken layer edges, heart turning into a realistic object, clothing changes, shoe changes, disappearing accessories, jumping background, camera pushing/pulling, camera tracking the avatar, sudden cuts, sudden scene deformation, plastic CG skin, anime rendering, subtitles.

entries.title: Realistic Beach Vacation Documentary
entries.description: An ultra-detailed prompt for an authentic 2026-style vacation video of a young Japanese woman on a beach, featuring timeline-based actions and camera physics.
entries.prompt: A young Japanese woman in her early 20s with effortless natural beauty, warm expressive eyes, realistic sun-kissed skin, minimal makeup, and black straight hair tied in a loose low ponytail wears an oversized sand-beige linen shirt over a muted seafoam ribbed tank top, ivory drawstring linen pants, delicate gold necklace, silver hoop earrings, carrying cream canvas sneakers while walking barefoot on a quiet Japanese Pacific beach during golden hour. Maintain identical identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, skin tone, and accessories throughout the video. The location features untouched sand, gentle Pacific waves, driftwood, rocky shoreline, weathered seawall, distant fishing boats, native grasses, and a small lifeguard tower with no crowds or commercial activity. entries.title: Anime RPG Magic Library Battle
entries.description: A comprehensive multi-cut cinematic prompt for a high-quality 3D anime battle sequence, focusing on magic effects, character consistency, and dynamic environment interaction.
entries.prompt:
近未来幻想アクションRPG風の魔法図書館決戦。高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルック。

【参照画像の役割】
ソース参照画像のキャラクターを参照し、全Cutで同じ一人の人物として厳密に維持する。参照画像は主人公の顔、目の形、虹彩色、まつ毛、眉、鼻、口元、輪郭、顎、年齢感、肌色、髪型、髪色、髪の長さ、衣装、装飾、体格、全身シルエット、雰囲気、固有配色、画風の参照にのみ使用する。参照画像そのものの背景、部屋、家具、文字、罫線、枠、複数パネル、説明図、UI、開始構図、ポーズ、画角、フレーミングは再現しない。
参照画像に複数の人物がいる場合は、画面内で最も大きく中心的に描かれた一人だけを主人公として採用する。主人公の特徴を他人物や敵へ混ぜない。表情、視線、口元、戦闘姿勢、重心、呼吸、髪、衣装、装飾の自然な遅れだけ変化してよい。顔の平均化、別人化、成熟化、幼児化、衣装交換、体型変更、分身、クローン、余計な人物の追加は禁止。

【主人公と固定装備】
主人公は一人。装備として固定する小物は一冊だけの魔導書のみ。他の武器、杖、本、薬瓶、道具、携行品を追加しない。参照画像に武器や小物があっても映像へ持ち込まない。

魔導書は主人公の固有配色と装飾意匠に合わせて外装だけを調整するが、常に一冊だけの同一の本として維持する。表紙、背表紙、裏表紙、紙ページを一冊の連続構造として開く。左手だけで背表紙と裏表紙を保持し、右手だけで魔法を指揮する。途中で杖、盾、別の本、浮遊する本へ変形させない。
【キャラクター適応】
背景、魔法、魔法薄片、照明、小物、建築装飾、空気感、色温度、粒子、反射、図書館の細部意匠は、参照画像の主人公が持つ固有色、衣装素材、文化圏、時代感、モチーフ、性格、雰囲気へ自然に合わせる。

可憐なキャラクターなら繊細で軽い意匠、荘厳なキャラクターなら重厚で儀礼的な意匠、機械的なキャラクターなら幾何学的で精密な魔法図形、和風なら紙、紐、紋、花、金属細工、西洋幻想なら紋章、ステンドグラス、真鍮、古書装飾などへ置き換える。ただし舞台は必ず夜の巨大魔法図書館であり、戦闘の構造、敵、拘束方法、攻撃の順序、4Cutの流れは変えない。

【画風固定】
参照画像のキャラクター描写を核にした高密度アニメゲーム3D。細い色付き輪郭線、明快な二段から三段のセルシェーディング、透明感のある中間影、精密な瞳、自然な肌、髪束、布、革、金属、紙、ガラス、角、皮膚の素材差を描く。劇場版クラスのキーアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、滑らかで重心の読める連続動作、透明感のある照明、密度の高い背景美術。
汎用3D美少女顔、能面顔、平坦な単層セル影、滑らかなプラスチックCG、半写実、写実、低密度背景、太い黒線、くすみ、画風混合にしない。主人公の顔、目、髪、衣装の重要部分を強い発光や粒子で隠さない。

【舞台】
新規の夜の巨大魔法図書館。高い書架、複層回廊、螺旋階段、魔法灯、文字の読めない古書、天井装飾、床反射が縦方向へ深く連なり、激しいカメラ移動で強いパララックスを作る。書架、金属、石材、照明、装飾、小物、空気中の粒子、反射色は主人公の世界観と固有配色へ合わせる。建築へ主人公の顔、髪飾り、身体装飾をそのまま複製しない。

【敵】
敵は一体だけ、主人公の約二倍の巨大な有機的デーモン。粗い暗色の皮膚、頭蓋から後方へ連続して伸びる角二本、暗く発光する両目、牙、太い首、肩に接続された二本の筋肉質な腕、腰に接続された二本の脚、破れた腰布。敵の色は主人公の固有色と明確に区別し、主人公の顔、髪、衣装、装飾、キャラクターカラーを混ぜない。
背中は滑らかな有機的皮膚だけで、背中から生える付属物は0個。翼、尻尾、触手、追加腕、武器、鎧、機械部品なし。左右の角は頭蓋の根元から先端まで一本ずつの連続構造を保つ。右腕全体を肩、肘、手首、爪まで一体として振り下ろし、その反動を肩と胴へ返す。

【拘束魔法】
拘束は主人公のモチーフと固有配色へ合わせた、柔らかな花弁状または薄片状の魔法素材。参照画像に花の要素がなくても、布片、紙片、羽片、結晶片、紋章片など、主人公に自然に合う薄く柔らかな単位へ置き換えてよい。ただし最後まで同一素材を維持し、鎖、縄、金属拘束具、太い光線、球体、殻へ変化させない。

五本の細い独立した帯が、左右の足首、左右の手首と前腕、胸下の胴へ別々に一周だけ巻きつき、それぞれ別の床魔法陣へ斜めに固定される。帯同士を融合させず大きな隙間を残し、デーモンの顔、角、胸、四肢と身体表面の70%以上を見せる。首、顔、角を巻かない。五本すべての接触点、床アンカー、張力方向を明確に見せる。
【連続アクション】

Cut 1:
正面寄りの胸上三分の四近景。主人公の顔と両目を大きく読みつつ、奥からデーモンの右手の爪が迫る同時フック。主人公は敵の両目へ視線を固定し、身を低く沈めながら左手の一冊の魔導書を一気に開く。表紙が開く反動で主人公のモチーフに合う一枚の魔法薄片がレンズ前を横切り、即座に低い斜め側面へワイプする。
Cut 2:
主人公が右手を横へ鋭く払うと、高・中・床すれすれの三層に魔法薄片が爆発的に展開し、選ばれた五本だけが床を滑走する。二本が左右の足首、二本が左右の手首と前腕、一本が胸下へ接触し、別々の床魔法陣へ固定される。

デーモンが踏み込みと腕振りを続けた瞬間、弛んだ五本が一斉に直線へ張り、足裏を後方へ滑らせ、肩と腰を逆方向へ引き戻す。床の古書、埃、腰布、周辺の軽い小物が張力方向へ短く反応する。カメラは低く前進し、接触点、床アンカー、引く方向を一画で読む。

Cut 3:
引き戻されたデーモンの反動と同時に、主人公は支持脚を沈めて半歩踏み込み、開いた魔導書を左胸前に保持したまま右掌を胸中央へ真っ直ぐ突き出す。
魔導書中央から一発だけの細く鋭い星晶状の決定打が発射され、五本の帯の隙間を通ってデーモンの胸中央へ命中する。主人公の世界観に合わせて光の形、紋様、粒子、色は調整してよいが、発射は一発だけ。短いヒットストップ、一点閃光、胸から外へ走る星形亀亀裂、五本の帯が異なる方向へさらに張る局所反応を同時に見せる。全画面を白飛びさせず、主人公の顔と胸の命中点を隠さない。

Cut 4:
星形亀裂が胸から角、腕、腰、脚へ一気に枝分かれし、デーモンの身体、腰布、影、床反射まで乾いた暗色の灰片へ崩れて完全消滅する。五本の帯は灰片を外へ引き離した後、元の独立した魔法薄片へほどける。

最後の灰片と薄片がレンズ前を横切り、映像を終了する。
entries.translated_prompt:
Near-future fantasy action RPG magic library battle. High-density 3D toon/cel-shaded look.

[Role of Reference Images]
Maintain a single character from the source image strictly across all cuts. Use for face, eyes, hair, costume, and silhouette only. Do not reproduce the background, UI, or specific posing from the source. Ensure features don't blend with enemies.

[Protagonist and Fixed Gear]

[Style]
High-density anime game 3D. Fine colored outlines, clear cel-shading (2-3 levels), theatrical quality animation. Smooth, weight-aware movement. No generic 3D faces or flat shading.

[Setting]
A giant magical library at night. High bookshelves, spiral staircases, and glowing lamps. Intense camera movement with deep parallax.

A single giant organic demon, roughly twice the protagonist's size. Dark rough skin, two horns, glowing eyes. Clear color contrast with the protagonist.

[Action Sequence]

entries.prompt: [Slot Execution Instructions] No replaceable slots are configured. Bracketed sections like [Project Overview] and [Output Checklist] are fixed column names, not slots. Execute directly according to these specifications without inquiring. Do not alter the game genre, model names, 3-column layout, art style, shot count, target duration, or audio design. If limited by the model's single-generation duration, use last-frame continuation to produce sequential segments. The next segment must seamlessly connect from the last frame of the previous one, inheriting the spaceship, enemies, barrages, items, background scrolling, and HUD visual style. Unified Speed Multiplier: If the total duration of the raw sequential footage in a column exceeds 28 seconds, it is strictly forbidden to crop the clips, delete intermediate actions, or only keep the first few seconds. You must apply a unified speed multiplier (speed_factor = Total Duration / 28) to compress the entire continuous track. Action coverage must be 100%, preserving the sequence from the first frame to the final frame. Continuity: Do not use hard cuts, black/white flashes, or cross-dissolves to mask discontinuities. If a segment fails to inherit the state, it must be regenerated. Audio Resync: After video retiming is complete, resync and produce the BGM and game sound effects. Use pitch-preserving time stretching if original audio must be retained; never delete video actions to match audio length. [Project Overview] Duration & Framerate: Approx. 28 seconds, ~30fps. Aspect Ratio: Horizontal 16:9 (Reference: 1212×720 or proportional HD). Theme: Side-by-side comparison of vertical space shooter games generated by three AI models: Fable 5, Kimi K3, and GPT-5.6 Sol. [Three-Column Detailed Differences] The three game windows are identical in size and alignment, separated by light gray vertical lines. Headers and HUDs are locked as stable graphic layers in post-production. Fable 5 (Left): Minimalist near-black space with sparse stars. Cyan triangular wireframe spaceship firing thin cyan bullets. Magenta geometric wireframe enemies with low density and weak explosion feedback. Top HUD displays score, WAVE, and 3 hearts. Kimi K3 (Center): Traditional arcade style. Deep blue-purple gradient sky. Blue solid spaceship with exhaust flames firing vertical yellow bullets. Magenta, purple, and orange geometric enemies dropping items and showing +100/+200 points upon destruction. Top HUD displays SCORE, LEVEL (advancing 1–6), and heart lives. GPT-5.6 Sol (Right): High-density neon style. Scrolling perspective grid with a planet in the upper right. Fast-moving cyan-white glowing spaceship firing dense yellow-white bullets. Neon-colored enemies entering in scattered, diagonal, or full-row formations, causing massive bullet hells and intense particle explosions. Top HUD displays SCORE, SECTOR, and heart lives. [Storyboard Rhythm] This is a single continuous shot with escalating combat intensity: 00:00–00:08: Simultaneous base shooting. Center column enters Level 2; Right column adds colored enemies and barrages. 00:08–00:20: Intensity increases. Center column reaches Level 4; Right column forms complete formations and drops power-up items; Left column maintains a minimalist pace. 00:20–00:28: Climax. Center column reaches Level 6; Right column unleashes massive bullet hells and multi-row enemy arrays. The video ends abruptly while intense combat is still ongoing. [Standard Execution Steps] Setup Parameters: Initialize fixed specifications (16:9, 28s, 1 shot, 3 parallel tracks, no cropping) in project_spec.json. Video Generation: Generate the three vertical game tracks independently. Maintain strict state inheritance using continuity_state.json at every continuation point to track spaceship, enemies, and UI. Retiming & Assembly: Combine all sequential clips per column and apply the calculated speed_factor to compress each full timeline to exactly 28 seconds. Embed the three tracks into the static white tech frame. UI & Audio Post-Production: Overlay and lock the Logos, titles, and HUD layers. Create a retro electronic arcade audio track with fast synth pulses and 8-bit game SFX (lasers, explosions, level-ups) synchronized to the retiming. entries.title: Anime Stumble Impact Scene

entries.prompt:
【主役】黒髪ボブの小学2年生
【舞台】夜の学校の体育館

【動画スタイル】
15秒。日本のフルカラーアニメ。予算5億円規模の高密度2Dアニメーション。緻密な背景美術、なめらかな中割り、映画品質の撮影処理。 同じような絵が続かないように、構図、カメラアングル、画面サイズ、キャラクターの距離感を変えて魅力的に展開する。字幕なし、透かしなし、BGMなし。環境音あり。

【映像構成】主役キャラのささやかなずっこけが、なぜか惑星級の物理現象を引き起こす。空撮で被害の規模を見せつつ、本人は真顔で日常を続ける。最後は自分で片づけて何事もなかったことにする。

【（Shot5〜7のどこかに必ず入れる）】クレーターの中心で照れ隠しに体育座りし、床の木目が同心円の年輪になる

Shot1（衝撃フック）: 夜の学校の体育館。主役キャラのずっこけで、地面に本物の衝撃波が走る。当の本人はいたって真顔。
Shot2（規模）: 空撮に切り替わる。ずっこけの中心から円形に、街のスケールで影響が広がっている。主役は何も気づいていない様子。
Shot3（日常）: 当の本人は真顔のまま、いつもの日常動作を続けている。飄々とした涼しい表情。
Shot4（二発目）: うっかりもう一度ずっこけをしてしまい、二つ目の円が一つ目に重なる。主役はきょとんと首をかしげる。
Shot5（避難）: 周囲の鳥や猫が、慣れた様子で静かに避難していく。主役はまったく気づかず淡々としている。
Shot6（収束）: 主役が咳払いをすると、なぜか地面と街が元どおりに巻き戻る。すまし顔で澄ました表情。

entries.title: School Monster Transformation Battle
entries.description: A complex 11-shot cinematic action sequence featuring a schoolgirl transformation into a monster and a subsequent tactical battle in a classroom.
entries.prompt:
Shot 1 (0–3s) — girl collapsed, sick. Low static shot, black-bob girl in white sailor uniform slumped on the floor between the desk rows of a cool grey-teal classroom, overcast daylight through the tall windows on the right, overturned desks and scattered notebooks near her, sweat soaking her bangs, hand pressed to her stomach, breath ragged.
Shot 2 (3–5s) — close-up transformation burst. Rapid three-frame cut: spine cracking through torn fabric, jaw distending into fangs, a second eyelid tearing open on her collarbone — hard cuts, no transition, wet cracking sounds, cold blue-grey light on wet tissue.
Shot 3 (5–6.5s) — wide reveal, monster stands. Fast vertical tilt up her growing mass as the uniform shreds and a horned white-boned skull with one massive central eye rises to full height, floor tiles cracking under her weight, guttural roar against the pale walls and green chalkboard.
Shot 4 (6.5–7.5s) — arrival from the hallway. Camera in the dim corridor, blue-haired girl and black-haired boy sprinting toward the wooden classroom door on the left, scythe and hammer in hand; they burst through into the grey daylight room and freeze, eyes wide at the sight.
Shot 5 (7.5–8.5s) — boy's first strike, low angle. Low dutch-angle shot, boy charging first, hammer swinging in a wide arc into the monster's leg; camera whip-pans as the impact throws him sideways through a desk into the corkboard wall, papers scattering off the pins.
Shot 6 (8.5–9.5s) — close-up slow-mo, girl's counter. Close-up slow motion, blue-haired girl vaulting past the wreckage, scythe blade connecting across the monster's forearm, hot pink ichor spraying in thick suspended arcs against the cool window light.
Shot 7 (9.5–10.5s) — mid-fight dialogue, both hit. Wide shot, monster backhands the girl toward the cracking chalkboard as the boy is simultaneously swatted into a row of desks on the other side; camera holds a static two-anchor frame catching both impacts in the same beat.
Boy (Japanese, groaning): 「まだやれる…お前は?」 (Translation: "Still good… you?") Girl (Japanese, pushing up): 「当然。」 (Translation: "Obviously.")
Shot 8 (10.5–11.5s) — boy re-enters, close-up. Close-up on the boy's gritted face as he rises and charges back in, hammer rising into a two-handed grip, eyes locked on the monster's exposed rib-plating.
Shot 9 (11.5–12.5s) — slow-mo, hammer impact. Extreme close-up slow motion, hammer connecting into the plating, bone-white shards and hot pink fluid bursting outward frame by frame, monster staggering off-balance.
Shot 10 (12.5–13.5s) — flanking, orbit shot. Fast orbiting camera around both fighters as they flank the staggered monster from opposite sides, scythe hook and hammer both rising for the final blow.
Shot 11 (13.5–15s) — scream and kill, slow motion.

entries.title: Kitten Rescue in Residential Alley
entries.description: A heartwarming video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a girl rescuing a kitten in a narrow alley, designed with a retro DV camera aesthetic.
entries.prompt: The girl and her friend walked into a narrow residential alleyway when they first heard the persistent meowing of a kitten coming from above. She stopped in her tracks, followed the sound around a pile of plastic crates and old flower pots, and discovered a small orange-and-white kitten huddled on top of a fixed storage cabinet by the outer wall, too afraid to jump down. She turned a short plastic stool that had been upside down against the wall right side up and pushed it under the cabinet. After crouching down and gently patting the seat, the kitten jumped down using the lower step; the girl breathed a sigh of relief and crouched on the ground as it scampered over to her shoes. Her friend’s camcorder was a split second too slow to capture the moment she broke into a smile.

entries.title: Canyon Rope Bridge Action Sequence
entries.description: An intense, hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring explorers on a collapsing rope bridge.
entries.prompt:
Canyon Rope Bridge Break

Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.

Daytime. Two explorers cross a long rope bridge suspended over a deep canyon. The canyon is विशाल and dramatic, with steep rock walls, strong wind, dust in the air, and a rushing river far below. The bridge is old and unstable, made of wooden planks, rope handrails, and thick support ropes tied into the cliff on both sides.

Wide opening shot: the two explorers move quickly across the rope bridge high above the canyon floor. The bridge sways in the wind and the height feels dangerous from the start.

Tracking shot: as they move farther across, one of the support ropes suddenly snaps. The bridge jerks violently. Wooden planks shift under their feet and the rope handrails twist. The explorers lose balance, grab the ropes, and try to keep moving.

Side shot: more ropes begin snapping one by one. The bridge twists sideways and starts hanging at a steep angle. Some planks break loose and fall into the canyon. The explorers cling to the bridge and begin climbing upward along the ropes and planks toward the cliff side while the whole bridge swings hard in open air.

Final 5 seconds: the action becomes extreme. The bridge swings and slams against the cliff wall. One explorer nearly slips free, the other grabs them and helps pull them upward. They climb the tilted bridge like a hanging ladder, reach the rocky ledge, and scramble onto the cliff just as more planks and ropes break away below them.

Final moment: both explorers pull themselves onto the narrow cliff ledge, breathing hard, while the ruined rope bridge hangs and swings beside the canyon wall.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, intense, stressful, clear readable action, strong sense of height and danger, deep canyon, swinging rope bridge, snapping ropes, falling planks, dust and wind, dynamic but readable camera movement, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no famous celebrity faces, no recognizable actors, no movie-star resemblance, no public-figure likenesses, no clear facial close-ups. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

entries.title: Bus Stop Flyer Mishap
entries.description: A comedic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 showing a girl at a bus stop dealing with a flyer stuck to her shoe, captured with a nostalgic DV aesthetic.
entries.prompt: 白天的街边公交站，女孩从长椅起身准备往前走，却没发现一张轻薄宣传单被鞋底踩住。她走出一步，纸张跟着鞋拖到身后，发出细小摩擦声；她回头才发现，单脚轻轻甩了两次都没甩掉，最后低头忍笑。朋友的旧 DV 先拍到她的鞋和地面，等她回头才慢半拍推近她尴尬的表情。
entries.translated_prompt: A roadside bus stop during the day. A girl stands up from a bench to walk forward, unaware that a thin flyer is stuck to the sole of her shoe. As she takes a step, the paper drags behind her shoe, making a small rustling sound. She turns around to discover it and tries to shake it off twice with one foot, but it remains stuck. Finally, she looks down, stifling a laugh. The friend's old DV camera first captures her shoes and the ground, then pans up slightly delayed to a close-up of her embarrassed expression.

entries.title: Cinematic Masked Woman Beach Walk
entries.description: An incredibly detailed technical prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a masked woman walking through a bright, saturated beach environment with specific camera optics and spatial blocking.
entries.prompt: SCENE CONTEXT Scorching midday beach, aggressively bright and saturated. Turquoise water, red beach umbrellas, children's plastic toys scattered across the sand, a sand castle built near the shoreline path. Into this she walks — entirely in black, long dark hair, white-painted face — moving through the crowd toward an empty lounger ahead. ACTIVE REFERENCES <<<image_1>>> — the woman: long straight black hair falling to the waist, pale white-painted face with elongated white eye corners giving an otherworldly mask quality, black feather-trimmed jacket, black tulle midi skirt with ruffled floral rosettes, black leather combat boots. Reference controls face identity, hair, and full outfit throughout. Reference does not control beach environment or lighting color. <<<image_2>>> — the beach location: wide white sand beach, clear turquoise water, beach chairs, people in summer clothes, bright open midday sky. Reference controls environment, color saturation, and atmospheric brightness. <<<image_3>>> — the black umbrella with black lace fringe trim: folded and closed, tied shut, tucked firmly under her left arm with the lace tip pointing slightly downward behind her. Reference controls umbrella design. In this scene it stays closed under her arm for the entire shot. LOCATION MAP Wide white sand beach, hot and bright. Children's plastic toys scattered on the sand surface in the foreground and midground — small buckets, shovels, a toy boat. A sand castle approximately knee height sits in the path directly ahead of her, built on the right side of the walking corridor. A large inflatable pink flamingo is visible on the sand 3 to 4 meters to screen-right, clearly legible in the frame. An empty beach lounger sits in the midground approximately 15 meters ahead of her, slightly left of center. People — adults seated, a child running — are present between her and the lounger. FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING First frame: low angle close shot, camera positioned at sand level looking up the length of her legs. Her black combat boots are in the foreground filling the lower frame, walking toward camera. The sand surface between her steps shows scattered plastic toys — a small bucket at screen-left, a plastic shovel near her right boot. The sand castle is visible ahead of her boots in the near midground. She enters already in motion. FORMAT MODE Single continuous take, 8 seconds, horizontal cinematic format. OPTICS SEGMENT 1 — 0.0s to 3.0s 65° diagonal field of view, wide low-angle lens character, camera at sand level approximately 1.5 meters ahead of her boots, angled upward slightly. Her boots, lower skirt hem, and the sand surface with toys are the primary elements. The inflatable flamingo is readable at the right edge of frame. Lens lock: 65°, no drift. SEGMENT 2 — 3.0s to 8.0s 45° diagonal field of view, normal cinematic eye-level lens character, camera cuts to a position 4 meters to her screen-left side, at eye level. Her full figure is visible — face, body, umbrella under arm — as she continues walking and passes through the crowd toward the lounger. Lens lock: 45°, no drift. CAMERA SEGMENT 1: Camera locked at sand level, static. She walks toward it. SEGMENT 2: Camera locked at eye level to her left, static. She walks through the frame left to right, past camera, continuing toward the lounger. No pan. She crosses through the static composition. ACTION TIMING 0.0s to 1.5s Her black boots advance across the sand, navigating around a plastic bucket and stepping past a toy shovel. Her pace is deliberate and unhurried. The sand castle is directly ahead of her path — she does not deviate. Low angle reads her boots large against the bright beach background. 1.5s to 2.5s Her right boot makes full contact with the sand castle. She steps directly onto it — not a stomp, not dramatic, simply the natural consequence of walking without diverting. The castle collapses under her boot: the packed sand walls crumble outward, the small turrets fall. She does not stop. She does not look away yet. Then her eyes drop to the sand beneath her for one beat — she looks down at what she crushed with a faint expression of contempt, not guilt, the white-painted face briefly visible angled downward. In this downward glance the closed black umbrella tucked under her left arm becomes clearly visible — the folded black canopy pressed against her side, lace tip trailing behind her elbow. 2.5s to 3.0s She raises her gaze back to forward and continues walking. The inflatable pink flamingo is visible at screen-right, large and vivid pink. CUT. 3.0s to 8.0s Eye level shot. She walks in front of seated beachgoers — people in swimsuits on towels and loungers who glance at her briefly and look away. She passes them without acknowledgment. The closed umbrella under her left arm is clearly visible — black fabric, the lace fringe at the tip moving very slightly with her stride. The empty lounger is visible ahead and she moves toward it with complete certainty. She arrives at its edge, stops, looks at it for one beat, then looks out toward the water. PHYSICS Combat boots on dry packed sand: each step has slight resistance, the sand compressing under the boot sole with visible displacement. The sand castle collapse is physically accurate — the walls of packed sand crumble outward from the point of contact, the top structure falls and scatters, loose sand fans away from the boot. Her tulle skirt hem swings with a slow natural arc from her stride. The umbrella stays completely still under her arm — it is gripped firmly, no bounce, no sway. LIGHTING Harsh overhead midday sun producing short hard shadows on the sand. The plastic toys cast small bright shadows. The sand castle held its own small shadow before she destroyed it. She, in all black, absorbs the direct sun without reflecting it — her figure reads as a dark void in the saturated scene. Her white face catches the full overhead sun and reads pale and precise against the warm beach environment. AUDIO Full beach ambient: radio from a distance, children's voices nearby, gentle wave sound, faint wind. Her boots on the sand — dry compressed footfalls. At the moment of the sand castle impact: a brief muffled crunch as the packed sand gives way, small and unremarkable. Then her footsteps continue. No music. POSITIVE LOCKS She does not avoid the sand castle — she walks through it without stopping or changing pace. Her downward glance is brief and contemptuous, not apologetic. The umbrella stays closed and tucked under her left arm for the entire shot without exception. The inflatable pink flamingo is visible and clearly pink in Segment 1 at screen-right. Her face identity, hair, and full black outfit stay identical to the reference throughout. The beach stays fully saturated and bright — no desaturation in this scene.

entries.title: Korean Idol Backstage Vlog
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for creating a realistic Korean idol backstage vlog with a vintage camcorder aesthetic and natural handheld motion.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 16:9

VIDEO CONCEPT: "Hidden Rooftop Break"
A highly realistic self-recorded backstage vlog captured entirely by a Korean female idol using a consumer camcorder. The footage should feel genuinely accidental and unscripted, like personal footage never intended for broadcast. Natural hand movement, realistic autofocus behavior, occasional slight framing mistakes, authentic walking motion, believable exposure adaptation, and smooth physical interactions with the environment. No glitches, no duplicated limbs, no warped objects, no facial distortion, no sudden appearance/disappearance of people or items.
VISUAL STYLE
Early digital camcorder realism. Soft detail, mild sensor noise, subtle compression artifacts, natural skin texture, realistic indoor-to-outdoor exposure transitions, accurate lighting physics, authentic motion blur. No cinematic effects, no artificial lens flares, no beauty filters, no exaggerated color grading.
CHARACTER
HANA, Korean female idol in her twenties. Long dark hair, natural makeup, clear skin, expressive eyes, slim figure. Wearing a comfortable oversized zip-up hoodie over her stage outfit, in-ear monitors around her neck.
LOCATION
Upper maintenance level of a large music-show building. Emergency stairwells, rooftop access doors, ventilation units, concrete walls, safety railings, distant city skyline, evening sunlight. Occasional staff members pass naturally in the background.
The recording starts mid-walk inside a quiet stairwell.
HANA pushes open a rooftop access door and steps outside into the evening air.
She immediately smiles at the camera.
"I come up here whenever I need two minutes of peace."
She walks toward the railing overlooking the city. Wind lightly moves her hair and clothing.
The camera naturally turns to reveal the skyline, traffic below, and the glowing broadcast building behind her.
"Most people downstairs don't even know this spot exists."
She leans casually against the railing while watching the sunset.
For several seconds there is no dialogue. Only distant traffic, faint wind, and venue sounds below.
She notices a small airplane crossing the sky and instinctively points the camera toward it.
"I always get distracted up here."
A vibration from her phone in her pocket causes her to laugh.
She checks the message briefly.
"Yep... they're looking for me."
She starts walking back toward the rooftop door.
Before entering, she turns around one last time and records the sunset.
"Five minutes of freedom. That's all I needed."
She opens the door and re-enters the building.
The atmosphere immediately changes from quiet rooftop ambience to busy backstage noise.
Crew members move through the hallway ahead.
Someone calls her name from off-screen.
She laughs and begins walking faster.
"Okay, okay, I'm coming!"
The recording continues naturally while she heads down the stairwell, then ends abruptly as if she simply stopped recording and put the camera away

entries.title: K-Pop Idol Backstage Vlog
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt simulating a handheld MiniDV camcorder recording of a K-pop singer's backstage journey.
entries.prompt:
A worn handheld MiniDV camcorder records an authentic backstage diary. The footage feels accidentally captured rather than directed. Slightly unstable hands, occasional focus breathing, imperfect exposure adjustments, brief moments where the subject drifts partially out of frame, realistic motion blur during fast movement. The camera remains entirely first-person and is always held by the idol herself.
The image carries genuine early-digital camcorder characteristics: soft detail, subtle tape grain, mild compression artifacts, natural indoor lighting, gentle highlight clipping from overhead fixtures, and realistic color shifts caused by automatic white balance.
SUBJECT
YUNA, a Korean pop singer in her twenties. Long dark hair tied loosely into a low ponytail, natural radiant skin, minimal touch-up makeup after rehearsals, expressive eyes, fashionable oversized hoodie layered over her performance outfit, wireless microphone pack clipped at her waist.
LOCATION
The quiet upper level of a large concert venue shortly before a live broadcast. Empty seating sections, concrete walkways, production offices, catering carts, equipment storage rooms, security checkpoints, distant stage lights glowing below. Crew members occasionally pass through the background without interacting with the camera.
SCENE FLOW
The recording begins abruptly as YUNA opens a heavy backstage door and steps into a long arena corridor.
She lowers her voice and smiles.
"Everyone's downstairs getting ready. I escaped for five minutes."
She continues walking through the mostly empty upper concourse while casually talking to the audience. The camera briefly drifts toward the enormous arena bowl visible through an opening.
She pauses near a railing overlooking the venue floor. Far below, technicians adjust lights while music echoes through the building.
"It always looks so different before people arrive."
A sudden burst of stage lighting illuminates the arena. She reacts naturally and laughs.
Continuing her walk, she discovers a forgotten catering cart and jokingly inspects the snacks.
"I think performers and staff survive entirely on these."
She steals a small snack and keeps moving.
While talking, an announcement comes through the venue speakers requesting performers to report for final preparation.
She freezes dramatically.
"That's definitely for me."
The camera swings toward the arena entrance tunnel where staff members are gathering.
The pace quickens as she starts jogging through the corridor, breathing lightly and laughing at the same time.
Near the end of the tunnel she slows down, turns the camera back toward herself, and gives a quick wave.
"Okay, this is the last calm moment before everything gets crazy."
She flashes a playful smile and disappears through the entrance tunnel as crowd noise, stage effects, and production activity grow louder in the background. The recording ends naturally without a clean outro, as if she simply

entries.title: Animated Jungle Expedition Multi-Shot
entries.description: A comprehensive multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a Pixar-quality 3D animated scene of creatures discovering a jungle treasure.
entries.prompt:
montage, multi-shot 3D animated feature film, Don't use one camera angle or single cut, vibrant glossy CGI render, Pixar-quality stylized animation, expressive cartoon character performance, subsurface-scattered fur and skin, cinematic lighting, sharp focus, high detail texture, depth of field mastery, dappled bright daylight, lush saturated jungle palette

In a lush overgrown jungle temple bathed in dappled bright daylight, three goofy creatures stand among giant mushrooms and mossy ancient ruins. A big shaggy orange horned monster with a rolled bedroll on his backpack bounces with excitement, a small round blue scaly dragon with little dorsal spikes clutches a glowing old treasure map in his clawed hands, and a towering mossy tree-creature with a goofy wide-eyed grin looms behind them. A tiny green creature peeks from the ferns in the foreground. The look is stylized 3D animated feature quality — vibrant, glossy, soft and warm, with playful expressive character animation.

Shot 1: Medium shot with a smooth playful push-in, the shaggy orange monster bounces on his feet and waves both furry arms overhead with a huge toothy grin, green eyes sparkling. Bursting with excitement he says: "Okay — today's the day, I can feel it in my fur!"

Shot 2: Close-up, the little blue dragon holds the old map up close as the parchment glows warm gold under his clawed fingers, his eyes darting across it then snapping wide. He taps the map and whispers: "Wait... the lost chamber — it's real."

Shot 3: Wide shot, the whole trio reacts together as the blue dragon thrusts a claw dramatically toward the overgrown temple, the orange monster gasping with joy and the towering tree-creature beaming behind them, while the tiny green creature pops up out of the ferns with wide eyes. They all gasp: "WHOA!"

Shot 4: Medium tracking shot bouncing along with them, the excited trio surges forward in a huddle, the orange monster sprinting in place and kicking up leaves and petals, the dragon clutching the map to his chest. The orange monster shouts back gleefully: "Last one there hatches a rotten egg!"

Shot 5: Close-up insert, the tree-creature's giant mossy foot slowly lifts off the ground to reveal a glowing golden treasure chest squashed into the moss right underneath it, soft light spilling out around it.

Shot 6: Wide shot, the orange monster and blue dragon screech to a frozen halt and stare slack-jawed at the chest under the tree-creature's foot, a beat of stunned silence, the tiny green creature face-palming in the ferns. The tree-creature gives a sheepish little wave and grins: "...Was it important?"

Total: 15s / 6 shots / 16:9

entries.title: Stop-Motion Wolf Attack Sequence
entries.description: A visceral stop-motion animation prompt for Seedance 2.0 that describes a brutal wolf attack sequence during a blizzard, focusing on physics and camera motion.
entries.prompt: Style: STOP-MOTION ANIMATION — stepped, frame-by-frame motion brought to a HAND-PAINTED 2D look, a moving oil painting, NOT clay, NOT puppets, NOT 3D. True 12fps, ANIMATED ON TWOS: 12 distinct hand-painted drawings per second, each pose held two frames then snapping to the next, never gliding — even at full gallop the action steps pose to pose with the strobing cadence of hand-drawn animation. Constant painterly BOIL. NO smooth interpolation, NO motion blur, NO morphing, real frame-by-frame animation not AI slop. Style from <<<image_1>>>, the wolves from <<<image_2>>>, RIDER 1 from <<<image_3>>> riding HIS horse from <<<image_4>>> — the same lead rider and the same horse as one consistent pair throughout, never another horse, never another man. The dusk snowfield from <<<image_5>>>. Blizzard haze and blowing snow drift SMOOTHLY; figures, horses, wolves and drawn snow-spray effects step on twos with secondary action. DIRECTOR'S NOTES: 1/ THE SCENE — full-gallop chase in the dusk blizzard, brutal and fast. RIDER 1, the lead rider, chases a sprinting wolf, leans low off the saddle in the manner of a kok-boru player reaching for the ulak, seizes the wolf by the scruff — and the wolf twists and savages his arm. A second wolf hits him from his blind side. He is torn from the saddle at full speed and the pack swarms him. Savage, dynamic, with REAL PHYSICS and a visible causal chain — every wound has its on-screen cause. 2/ REAL PHYSICS AND CAUSALITY — the horse (<<<image_4>>>) gallops with true four-beat weight; RIDER 1 hangs low off the side of the saddle, one hand braced, reaching down; the wolf is a heavy animal — when seized it twists its WHOLE body mid-stride, and that twisting weight plus the clamping bite WRENCHES the rider off balance; the bite is shown on screen: jaws clamp and crush onto his forearm, tearing sleeve and flesh, dark blood — cause before effect, always; the second wolf launches from his blind side and slams full-body into his chest like a missile; torn from the saddle at gallop speed he hits the snow HARD and TUMBLES with momentum, rolling over and over, loose powder snow bursting around each impact (drawn snow-spray effects on twos), the riderless horse galloping on; the pack converges as a fast dark stream and swarms over him, a savage thrashing dark mass. 3/ BRUTALITY STAGED, NOT LINGERED — the violence is fast, hard and physical: the crunching bite, the dark blood across the snow, the swarming pack. Show the savagery through motion, dark mass and sound, not slow anatomical detail. 4/ AGGRESSIVE HANDHELD CHASE CAMERA — racing alongside at gallop, violently jolting with the speed, whipped by wind, jerky corrections, the horizon tilting and never level; on the fall a hard DUTCH TILT as the world goes over with him. Never gimbal-smooth, never tripod-locked. 5/ SECONDARY ACTION on twos — RIDER 1's chapan skirts and fur hat whipping with follow-through, the horse's mane and tail streaming, the wolves' fur rippling along their backs, harness swinging, breath-vapor of horse and man tearing off in the wind, snow bursting from hooves as drawn powder on twos. 6/ LIGHT — deep dusk in a blizzard, dim cold blue-grey storm light, soft, no rays, no beams, no god rays, the figures dark masses against the pale snow. Correct neutral white balance, NOT a blue filter, muted desaturated; the blood a dark muted red, stark on the snow but never glossy, never bright. SHOT 1 — FULL-GALLOP TRACKING, ~35mm, aggressive handheld racing alongside. COMPOSITION: RIDER 1 on his horse a large dark mass driving in from the RIGHT third, the sprinting wolf low ahead of him on the LEFT third, both tearing diagonally through the frame left-and-deeper — the diagonal of the chase as the line of dynamics; the pale storm-lit snowfield from <<<image_5>>> streaking past as negative space. RIDER 1 drops LOW off the side of the saddle in a kok-boru lean, one hand braced on the saddle, the other arm stretching down for the wolf's scruff, his chapan and the horse's mane whipping on twos, hooves throwing bursts of powder. He bares his teeth, hoarse over the wind, lips on twos: "Ustadym!.." His fist closes on the wolf's scruff — HARD CUT to SHOT 2 — CLOSE DYNAMIC, ~50mm, aggressive handheld slammed in tight: the wolf, seized, TWISTS its whole heavy body mid-stride in one violent stepped motion — and its jaws clamp CRUSHING onto RIDER 1's forearm, on screen, tearing through sleeve and flesh, dark blood whipping across the snow and the wolf's muzzle. His raw scream tears over the wind. The wolf's twisting weight and the bite WRENCH him sideways off his balance, his body dragged half out of the saddle, his fur hat ripping away with follow-through. Cause and effect brutal and readable, all stepping on twos. HARD CUT to SHOT 3 — MEDIUM WIDE with a hard DUTCH TILT, ~35mm, aggressive handheld: from his blind side a SECOND wolf launches — a dark missile — and slams full-body into his chest. Torn from the saddle at gallop speed RIDER 1 hits the snow HARD and TUMBLES, rolling over and over with real momentum, powder snow bursting at each impact as drawn effects on twos, the horizon tilted and reeling, his riderless horse (<<<image_4>>>) galloping on into the storm. And then the pack pours in — a fast dark stream of wolves from <<<image_2>>> out of the storm, varied coats, converging from all sides and SWARMING over him, a savage thrashing dark mass on the pale snow, dark blood spreading, snow scattering, his cries swallowed by the blizzard and the snarling. The dark mass of the pack traps and frames him. Hold one brutal beat in the howling wind. End. Audio: NO MUSIC — the roar of the blizzard, pounding gallop, the wolf's snarl and the wet crunch of the bite, the rider's raw scream, the heavy tumbling impacts, the converging snarls of the pack, the wind swallowing everything. No subtitles. Natural diegetic sound only, absolutely no music. Constraints: stop-motion stepped cadence on twos at 12fps with painterly boil even at full gallop, every action stepping pose to pose never gliding, NO smooth interpolation NO motion blur NO morphing, blizzard haze smooth while all figures animals and drawn snow-spray effects step on twos, hand-painted oil look from <<<image_1>>> not photoreal not 3D not glossy, three shots with hard cuts — full-gallop tracking with the kok-boru lean and the grab "Ustadym!..", close dynamic of the twisting wolf and the crushing on-screen bite with dark blood and the scream, dutch-tilted wide of the second wolf's full-body slam the hard tumbling fall at speed and the pack swarming him as a savage dark mass — RIDER 1 from <<<image_3>>> and his horse from <<<image_4>>> the SAME consistent pair in every shot never swapped, REAL PHYSICS AND VISIBLE CAUSALITY every wound caused on screen the wolf's twisting weight wrenching the rider the bite before the blood the slam before the fall the momentum carrying the tumble, AGGRESSIVE HANDHELD racing jolting wind-whipped horizon never level hard dutch tilt on the fall never gimbal-smooth, SECONDARY ACTION on twos chapan hat mane tail wolf fur harness breath-vapor all whipping with follow-through, wolves from <<<image_2>>> varied in coat tone size and stride never mirrored never cloned, deep dusk blizzard dim cold storm light soft no rays no beams, correct neutral white balance not a blue filter muted desaturated dark muted blood never bright never glossy, brutality fast hard and physical staged through motion dark mass and sound not lingering gore, spoken Kazakh in Latin transliteration pronounced as written, NO MUSIC only storm hooves snarls and screams.

entries.title: Miniature Harbour Island Construction
entries.description: A unique prompt for an architectural diorama assembly video, featuring a large-scale harbour island coming to life with satisfying miniature physics.
entries.prompt: Create a **15-second cinematic miniature-diorama formation video** in a **1:1 square format**. Use **@reference_image** as the exact visual reference for the completed harbour island. The final island layout, coastline, harbour structure, architecture, lighthouse, roof colours, bridges, canals, piers, terrain, and overall appearance should closely match the reference image. The video shows an enormous harbour town rapidly assembling across an entire island surrounded by a bright blue sea. The visual style should feel like a **premium handcrafted architectural diorama, luxury collector model, and highly detailed practical film miniature**—not a cheap toy. Preserve the charm, organised beauty, and satisfying construction quality of a miniature world while making the island feel expansive and cinematic. Bright, clear daylight, sparkling blue water, white waves, red, blue, and white rooftops, wooden piers, stone seawalls, bridges, canals, a lighthouse, hillside neighbourhoods, and multiple harbour districts. The harbour island itself is the main subject. No prominent human characters. ## SCENE 1 — ISLAND FOUNDATION **0.0–3.0 seconds** Begin with a high, wide aerial view showing the entire empty island surrounded by a vast blue sea. The island should already feel large and expansive, not like a small tabletop model. The coastline, bays, cliffs, hills, harbour entrances, canals, breakwaters, multiple docks, bridges, main roads, stone terraces, and layered town districts rapidly emerge from the terrain. Landforms rise smoothly while roads, waterways, harbour walls, and structural outlines assemble with precise, satisfying movements. By the end of the scene, the complete large-scale foundation of the island and harbour is clearly visible. **Camera:** High aerial wide shot, slowly descending and pushing toward the main harbour. **Motion:** Fast, precise miniature construction with pieces locking naturally into place. ## SCENE 2 — HARBOUR TOWN ASSEMBLY **3.0–6.5 seconds** Maintain a wide cinematic composition as the camera gradually descends toward the harbour. Wooden piers extend across the water. Stone streets, stairs, railings, warehouses, fishing huts, canal-side buildings, and rows of houses with red, blue, and white roofs rapidly assemble. Narrow roads climb from the waterfront toward the hillside neighbourhoods. Buildings should form in organised layers, with walls, roofs, doors, windows, chimneys, balconies, and small architectural details snapping smoothly into position. Do not move too close. The harbour, hillside town, lighthouse area, and open sea should remain visible to preserve the island’s scale. **Camera:** Wide forward-moving aerial shot with a gradual descent toward the waterfront. **Motion:** Rhythmic, premium assembly animation with wood, stone, and architecture fitting together cleanly. ## SCENE 3 — HARBOUR DETAILS **6.5–10.0 seconds** Use a seamless cinematic transition into a medium-wide harbour-level view. Multiple piers, small boats, sailing vessels, mooring ropes, wooden crates, fishing equipment, compact cranes, streetlights, flags, bridges, canals, and stone seawalls appear in rapid succession. Detailed wooden planks form across the docks. Stone joints assemble along the quay. Boats lower gently into the water while ropes connect naturally to the piers. This should be the most satisfying construction moment, with the entire harbour district rapidly becoming rich, organised, and highly detailed. Avoid focusing only on tiny objects. Continue showing the wider harbour district growing in density and complexity. **Camera:** Smooth harbour-side tracking movement with layered foreground, midground, and background. **Motion:** Fast detail formation with clean mechanical clicks, sliding components, and natural placement. ## SCENE 4 — LIGHTHOUSE AND FINAL DISTRICTS **10.0–12.5 seconds** Transition toward the lighthouse and hillside town while maintaining a wide view of the island. The lighthouse tower assembles upward from its stone foundation. Its windows, railings, roof, lantern room, and rotating light mechanism lock into position. Additional hillside houses, bridges, windows, streetlights, boats, rooftops, harbour districts, and flags complete the island. Reveal the multiple harbour sections, the bay leading toward the open sea, and the fully developed town climbing across the hills. The completed harbour should now closely match **@reference_image**. **Camera:** Gentle orbit around the lighthouse before beginning to pull away. **Motion:** Final architectural components assemble with elegant, precise movements. ## SCENE 5 — THE DIORAMA COMES ALIVE **12.5–15.0 seconds** The completed harbour island comes to life. Sunlight sparkles across the water. Small boats gently rock with the waves. Flags and ropes move in the coastal breeze. The lighthouse beam slowly rotates. Windows and streetlights softly illuminate across the town. Tiny waves move against the seawalls and wooden piers. End with a grand, wide aerial pullback revealing the entire completed harbour island: the hillside town, lighthouse, bridges, canals, multiple piers, harbour districts, surrounding bay, and open sea. The final image should feel charming, alive, premium, expansive, and cinematic. **Camera:** Large cinematic aerial pullback into a complete island-wide hero shot. **Ending:** The harbour remains subtly animated rather than becoming completely still. ## VISUAL STYLE Premium handcrafted miniature diorama, luxury collector model, highly detailed architectural miniature, practical film model quality, realistic painted wood and stone, precise handcrafted textures, subtle miniature scale depth of field, cinematic daylight, bright blue sea, clean white waves, rich coastal colours, polished professional craftsmanship, large-scale island composition, charming but realistic, highly detailed, sharp, cinematic and visually satisfying. ## CAMERA AND EDITING Prioritise wide-angle compositions that continuously communicate the scale of the island. Use: * High aerial opening * Smooth descending push toward the harbour * Medium-wide waterfront tracking * Gentle lighthouse orbit * Grand aerial pullback for the final reveal Include two or three seamless cinematic transitions during the 15-second video. Use layered foreground, midground, and background compositions so the harbour, hillside town, lighthouse, bay, and open sea can frequently appear together. The pacing should be fast, energetic, and focused on the satisfying formation process. Avoid long static shots, repetitive straight-line camera motion, or extreme close-ups that make the environment appear like a tiny cheap toy. ## SOUND DESIGN Include bright, uplifting cinematic background music with a subtle sense of adventure and discovery. The music should support the excitement of the harbour being completed without becoming overly dramatic. Add detailed sound effects: * Small construction clicks * Wooden pieces locking together * Stone blocks sliding into position * Soft mechanical assembly sounds * Water movement * Gentle waves * Harbour ropes moving * Flags fluttering * Wooden ships creaking * Distant seagulls * Subtle lighthouse machinery No dialogue. No narration. ## NEGATIVE PROMPT Small island, tiny enclosed tabletop scene, cramped harbour, only a few houses, limited environment scale, cheap toy appearance, glossy plastic materials, low-quality craft project, rough handmade construction, narrow composition, empty harbour, dark cloudy weather, muddy water, oversized humans, human characters as the main subject, full-size people walking through the miniature, excessive macro shots, extreme shallow depth of field, chaotic building placement, incorrect island layout, design that does not match @reference_image, repetitive linear camera motion, long static shots, frozen ending, text, captions, subtitles, logos, branding, watermark.

45秒垂直短劇，9:16，電影感，明朝末年聊齋風，電影級光影。

場景： 明朝末年荒廢的蘭若寺，深夜陰森恐怖，斷壁殘垣、蜘蛛絲遍布、破敗石碑上斑駁刻著「兰若寺」三字，月光慘白。

角色：  
書生甯采臣<<<Image1>>>  ：25歲，文弱俊秀，穿淺藍色書生長衫，頭戴方巾。  
小倩<<<Image2>>>  ：甜美女鬼，長黑直髮及腰，雪白肌膚，穿淡粉色薄紗古裝，氣質柔弱。  
姥姥<<<Image3>>>  （樹妖）：半男半女妖怪，初始黑袍黑長指甲，後變身為誇張美式drag queen（大膽藍色眼影、鮮豔紅唇、誇張假睫毛、緊身亮片變裝皇后服裝）。

風格： 淒美浪漫鬼片風格，陰冷藍調與暖黃燭光對比，極致細節，最後突然轉為搞笑。

第一段（0-15秒）：
0-3s：深夜荒廢的蘭若寺外，陰森恐怖，破敗石碑刻著「兰若寺」。
3-6s：書生甯采臣在昏暗破舊廂房內點著一盞燭光，用毛筆寫帳簿。
6-9s：突然傳來敲門聲，書生打開廂房門。
9-12s：小倩站在門口哭泣求救，用中文說：「公子救我！外面有怪物在追我！」
12-15s：書生趕緊拉小倩的手進門關上。

第二段（15-30秒）： 
15-18s：在昏暗破舊廂房內，小倩突然將書生壁咚在牆上，眼神曖昧，用中文輕聲說：「公子…你人真好…」 
18-21s：書生臉紅害羞抗拒：「姑娘…這、這不合禮數…」 21-24s：小倩貼得更近，吐氣如蘭，用中文催促道：「今夜只有我們兩人…公子還怕什麼呢？」 
24-27s：書生逐漸招架不住，呼吸急促，兩人臉靠極近，氣氛極致浪漫。 
27-30s：畫面轉到廂房外，姥姥等得不耐煩，用陰森聲音說：「這兩個年輕人在搞什麼？」

第三段（30-45秒）：
30-33s：姥姥黑袍黑長指甲的妖怪模樣在一陣黑煙後，變身成妖豔drag queen（藍色眼影、鮮紅唇、誇張假睫毛、緊身亮片變裝皇后服）。
33-36s：drag queen動作做作地敲門，小倩開門不耐煩地問：「誰啊？」看到drag queen立刻嚇得低頭化為黑煙逃走。
36-39s：書生（結實上身赤裸，額頭微微冒汗，只穿被汗水浸溼的白色古裝長睡褲）來到門邊，看見妖豔的drag queen，瞬間臉紅心跳。
39-42s：書生心虛東張西望，用中文問：「小倩…走了嗎？」
42-45s：drag queen假裝害羞地說：「嗯，她走了～」書生突然一把摟住drag queen後腰熱情親吻，小倩躲在樹枝上用不解又震驚的眼神看著這一切（小倩內心旁白：「怎麼會？」），畫面定格在搞笑又詭異的瞬間。
