The call disconnects.

Flat electronic tone.

Mateo continues listening to the dead line for another second, refusing to lower the phone.

24.0–27.0 sec | PANEL 3 — DESPERATION

Camera

Handheld side tracking shot.
Medium-wide framing.
Natural movement.

Mateo lowers the phone slowly.

His breathing becomes heavier.

Frustration overwhelms him.

He punches a nearby concrete pillar with his free hand.

He immediately winces in pain.

His knuckles become slightly bloodied.

He doesn't care.

Still clutching Elena's pendant tightly in the other hand, he leans against the pillar for a brief second, trying to regain control.

He wipes the tears from his eyes with the back of his sleeve.

Then straightens up.

His expression changes completely.

Fear is gone.

Only determination remains.

27.0–30.0 sec | PANEL 4 — THE PROMISE

Camera

Wide cinematic shot.

Very slow dolly forward.
Long abandoned industrial road disappearing into darkness.
Action

Mateo steps forward into the empty roadway.

His fist remains tightly closed around Elena's pendant.

Far ahead—

A single red taillight flickers once before disappearing behind an abandoned warehouse.

Mateo never looks away.

He quietly says:

"I'm coming for you."

No music for a beat.

Only distant wind.

Freeze exactly as the taillight disappears.

Hold the frame for two full beats.

Hard cut to black.

END CARD

Black background.

Elegant gold serif typography.

Slow two-second fade in.

EPISODE 2 COMING SOON

Hold for at least two seconds before fading out.

entries.title: Mint Scooter Coastal Road Ride
entries.description: A bright, cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a young couple riding a vintage mint scooter along a coastal road.
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A bright summer afternoon on the coastal road: the young man drives the mint scooter down toward the sea with the young woman riding behind him, arms around his waist — an easy, happy ride past the railway crossing along the water.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<image_1>>> — young woman, 20 years old, 165 cm tall, slender, straight dark brown hair with side-swept bangs pinned by a small black clip, freckles across her cheeks and nose. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_2>>> — young man, 22 years old, 178 cm tall, lean, sun-tanned, messy dark hair under a tan baseball cap worn backwards. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_3>>> — vehicle: vintage mint-green scooter with a brown leather saddle, chrome mirrors and silver wheels. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_4>>> — location: coastal road curving downhill past a railway crossing with yellow-and-black crossbuck signs, utility poles and wires, stone embankment walls, an orange convex traffic mirror on a pole, the open sea with white-capped waves behind.

LOCATION MAP
The road from <<<image_4>>> curves downhill through the midground toward the railway crossing, the sea filling the background beyond it. Stone embankments rise on both sides, the orange convex mirror stands on the right shoulder in the near foreground, utility poles line the curve. Their path: down the curve, past the crossing, along the water toward screen-left. Primary light: bright seaside daylight, sun high, wind off the sea.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains <<<image_3>>> rolling down the curve with both riders aboard — <<<image_2>>> driving, hands on the grips, <<<image_1>>> seated close behind him, arms wrapped around his waist, her head just above his shoulder, a full head shorter than him. No empty establishing frame, no delayed reveal. He drives in every segment; she is always the passenger.

FORMAT MODE
Controlled four-segment multi-shot sequence: one INSERT CUT and two HARD CUTS. Real-time motion at an easy unhurried scooter pace. Every segment is shot handheld — no static shot anywhere in the sequence.

OPTICS
LENS LOCK SEGMENT 1 = 47° diagonal field of view, standard normal lens character, camera 12 to 15 meters at the roadside, the scooter and both riders full in frame with the crossing and sea behind, straight lines rectilinear, no fisheye. Soft vintage lens rendering: gentle edge softness, mild halation in the bright sky and sea glare, even brightness across the whole frame — no vignette, corners stay as bright as the center. This rendering applies to every segment.
LENS LOCK SEGMENT 2 = 29° diagonal field of view, short telephoto character, camera 3 to 4 meters tracking alongside from a following vehicle, close two-shot of their faces and shoulders, the sea streaming soft behind them.
LENS LOCK SEGMENT 3 = 29°, camera 1.5 to 2 meters, tight insert on her hands clasped at his stomach, the mint body and brown saddle below, road surface blurring past.
LENS LOCK SEGMENT 4 = 47°, camera 10 to 12 meters behind the orange convex mirror on the right shoulder, the mirror large in the near foreground reflecting the road, the real scooter passing through the frame and receding along the sea.
No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Handheld in every segment with no exceptions — a real operator at the roadside and in a following vehicle: the frame breathes with shoulder sway and soft micro-tremor visible in every second, small late reframes chasing the scooter and easing back; the tracking shot carries gentle road vibration on top of the hand movement; the insert trembles slightly more; the mirror wide breathes slower but never freezes. No tripod stillness, no gimbal smoothness, no stabilization anywhere. On top, the footage behaves like an old film print running through a projector: constant subtle gate weave, faint exposure flicker, occasional tiny dust specks and hairline scratches, image soft and slightly diffused like an aged 16mm print — never sharp, never digitally clean, no vignette or darkened corners at any moment.

ACTION TIMING
0.0s to 3.5s — Roadside wide: the mint scooter putters down the curve at an easy pace, leaning gently with the bend; <<<image_2>>> relaxed at the grips, <<<image_1>>> pressed close behind him, her hair and skirt hem streaming in the sea wind; they pass the yellow-and-black crossing signs with the white-capped sea glittering beyond.
3.5s HARD CUT
3.5s to 6.5s — Tracking close two-shot: she rests her chin almost on his shoulder and says something teasing into his ear — lips moving without audible words; he barks a laugh, shaking his head, cap holding snug; she grins wide against the wind, bangs whipping, eyes squinting happily.
6.5s INSERT CUT
6.5s to 8.5s — Tight insert: her hands clasped over his stomach, fingers laced, giving a little squeeze as the scooter sways through a bend; the mint body flexes light reflections, the road surface streams underneath in soft blur.
8.5s HARD CUT
8.5s to 12.0s — Wide past the orange convex mirror: the tiny reflection of the scooter slides across the round mirror in the foreground a beat before the real scooter enters and crosses the frame, unhurried, the two of them small against the vast bright sea; she tips her head back and laughs into the wind as they recede along the coast; the engine putter fades.

PHYSICS
The scooter carries real combined weight: soft suspension compression over road seams, a gentle lean into each bend with both bodies tilting as one, slight throttle sway she counterbalances by gripping tighter; engine vibration trembles through their sleeves; wind at riding speed streams her hair, his tee and her skirt hem backward continuously with fabric flutter; the sea wind adds gusts; the convex mirror reflection tracks their motion with true optics.

LIGHTING
Bright seaside daylight only — no artificial light. Aged film print look: the sky and the glittering sea bloom into a soft white-gold haze with visible halation rings, gentle glow hanging in the air, creamy highlights rolling off softly. Faded pastel grade of an old print: lifted milky blacks, warm ivory and honey tones over softened sea blues, the mint scooter body reading as a gentle washed pastel green, the orange mirror and yellow-black signs as warm muted accents — never oversaturated; slightly yellowed whites, low contrast, colors gently washed as if the print has aged for twenty years, heavy visible film grain crawling in every frame, delicate haze. Exposure stays natural across the frame — no added vignette, no darkened edges or corners. The whole image reads as an old 2000s Japanese film discovered on a dusty reel. No crisp modern digital look, no cool color cast.

AUDIO
SFX only, with the worn texture of an old optical soundtrack — slightly muffled, faint constant hiss: the soft putter of the small scooter engine rising and fading with the throttle, wind buffeting past, waves breaking below the road, gull cries, her bright laugh snatched by the wind, the faint tick of the engine at the far end. No music, no intelligible spoken words, no captions, no score.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Identities lock 100% to <<<image_1>>> and <<<image_2>>> in every segment — same outfits as their references throughout, her natural 165 cm and his 178 cm with true relative proportions, his cap staying backwards and snug at riding speed in every shot. <<<image_2>>> drives in every segment; <<<image_1>>> rides pillion with her arms around his waist from first frame to last, hands unclasping never. The scooter stays 100% <<<image_3>>> — mint-green body, brown saddle, chrome mirrors — in every shot. Road geography stays consistent with <<<image_4>>> across all cuts: downhill curve, crossing signs, embankments, orange mirror on the right shoulder, sea always beyond the road; travel direction constan

entries.title: Sci-Fi Space Station Crash Scene
entries.description: A dramatic science fiction cinematic prompt of an orbital station falling into an alien mushroom forest, featuring intense lighting and physics.
entries.prompt:
Style: 8K cinematic. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic.
Cinematography: naturalistic master cinematography.
Lighting: Surrealistic, vibrant alien twilight. High-contrast dramatic light. Cold ambient purple and indigo sky vs. blinding fiery orange-red illumination from the falling debris. The environment is underlit by colorful bioluminescent fungal glow.
Color: 60:30:10 — dominant deep indigo and violet (alien sky & ground) / secondary toxic green, magenta, and cyan (glowing mushrooms) / accent fiery orange-red and bright electrical blue (falling station & explosions).
Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur. Continuous handheld operator shake motivated by the shockwaves.
Physics: Gravity and inertia respected. Debris, smoke, and spores obey atmospheric physics.

SUBJECTS:

@truck: The heavy, battered off-road hauler (inspired by 'CHIMERA-7' from watermarked_img_14909239665213110893.png), modified for a damp alien environment—covered in strange moss and glowing fungal spores instead of frost. A wrapped rider is braced low on the cargo bed, clothes snapping in the wind, wearing a rebreather mask. The truck trails a heavy column of dark, iridescent chemical smoke.

@station: A colossal orbital space station (or ancient technomagic citadel), breaking apart and falling through the upper atmosphere directly behind the truck. A massive lattice of metal, alien alloys, and glowing power-cores tearing itself to pieces.

LOCATION: A bizarre alien plain covered in a dense forest of towering bioluminescent mushrooms with thick twisted stalks and massive glowing caps. Spores drift like glowing dust through the air. The horizon is dominated by the orbital descent.

ACTION — ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, single unbroken handheld tracking shot, NO cuts. 15 seconds.

0:00–0:05 — Medium-Wide Shot on @truck: The camera tracks alongside the hauler as it zigzags through a clearing in the giant glowing mushroom forest. Giant caps snap and burst under the truck's heavy tires, releasing luminous spores. Behind it, the purple sky is torn open as a massive burning section of the space station enters frame, trailing fire and thick purple-black smoke. Smaller debris shatters distant mega-mushrooms.

0:05–0:10 — Slow Continuous Zoom-In / Tilt Up: The camera smoothly zooms past the truck, tilting up through the glowing fungal canopy to focus entirely on the falling @station. A violent explosion rips through a main power-core, sending out a shockwave that distorts the atmosphere with a horizontal optical lens flare. Electrical blue arcs crackle across its superstructure.

0:10–0:15 — Extreme Close-Up on @station: The camera settles into a tight telephoto compressed view of the disintegrating station against the alien sky. Giant metallic beams twist and snap, burning orange-hot, shedding glowing fragments, ash, and burning debris toward the camera, illuminated by the colorful world below.

entries.title: Studio Ghibli Style Cooking Animation
entries.description: A Studio Ghibli-style 2D animation prompt featuring a cozy kitchen, warm lighting, and the process of making dumplings, with a fluffy tabby cat observer.
entries.prompt:
Core Concept
Style: Studio Ghibli-style 2D animation, warm homey atmosphere, magical realism, soft natural lighting, delicate hand-painted texture, watercolor-toned backgrounds, 4K resolution.
Setting: A warm wooden kitchen, morning to early afternoon natural light, view of a small garden and greenery through the window.
Characters: A young woman (or silver-haired grandmother) wearing a simple apron; a fluffy orange tabby cat.
Main Action: Making dumplings → folding → arranging in bamboo steamers → steaming → serving with soy sauce → the cat watches and eventually dozes off.
Shot Sequence (15 seconds)
0–3s | Kneading & Rolling
Wide shot: On the wooden kitchen counter, flour gently rises. A pair of hands (visible only from elbows down) kneads dough on the board. A small bowl of filling sits nearby. The orange tabby cat sits on a chair, its tail gently swaying, watching the counter.
Sound: Soft kneading sounds, distant muffled street noises, the cat’s gentle purr.
3–6s | Hand-Folding Dumplings
Close-up: A pair of nimble hands places filling into the centre of each wrapper, delicately folding the edges with fingers, pinching even pleats. Several rows of plump, white dumplings are already lined up on the board. Sunlight slants across the counter, dust motes floating in the light beam.
Sound: The subtle press of fingers against dumpling edges, the low simmer of water in the pot, steam beginning to rise.

6–9s | Stacking the Steamers
Medium shot: A bamboo steamer is carefully placed onto a steaming pot. Steam wafts gently through the gaps between the basket layers, forming soft white mist. The cat stands up from the chair, stretches, and curls back into a sleepy ball.
Sound: The soft "click" of the bamboo steamer settling, water gently bubbling, a light sigh from the cat as it stretches.
9–12s | Steaming & Plating
Side tracking shot: The steamer lid is lifted — white steam billows out, revealing glossy, plump dumplings. Dumplings are lifted out one by one and neatly arranged on a white ceramic plate. A small dish of dark soy sauce is placed beside the plate, a pair of chopsticks lightly stained with sauce.
Sound: The hiss of escaping steam, the light sound of dumplings being picked up with chopsticks, the soft "clink" of the soy sauce dish being set down.
12–15s | Serving & the Cat’s Nap
Wide shot: The table is set with the dumplings, sunlight streaming through the window lattice. A hand (entering frame) gently pushes the plate toward the centre. The cat curls up on the chair, head tucked into its tail, slowly closing its eyes. The scene is filled with quiet warmth and satisfaction.
Sound: The crisp clink of chopsticks resting on the edge of the dish, the cat’s last contented purr, ambient sounds gradually fading away.
Visual & Atmospheric Details
Lighting: Warm natural light coming obliquely through the window, slightly yellowish, with floating dust motes.

entries.title: NYC Bodega Rap Performance Music Video
entries.description: A rhythmic rap performance prompt set in a classic NYC bodega, using crash zooms and precise lip-sync mapping for high energy.
entries.prompt:
@ Image1 is the performer — preserve her exact identity: cornrow braids into long dark curls, silver chain-drop earring, gold pendant necklace, washed-green denim corset top, glossy lips. @ Audio1 is the finished master track — the only audio; no invented music, no new vocals.

SHE RAPS THE VOCAL ON CAMERA — PRECISE LIPSYNC IS THE TOP PRIORITY. Mouth articulates every syllable of @ Audio1 exactly on time; face visible and sharp through every vocal line, no cutaways mid-word.

LIPSYNC MAP:
0.0–0.5 instrumental.
0.5–2.8 "I'm standing on the edge / Say it with your chest / Or keep it on the deck" + "Hey!"
3.2–6.7 "I walk in, whole room gets tense / I don't need luck, I'm the consequence / If you really want to test my intent / Come correct, come correct or get bent" + "Woo!"
7.5–13.7 same hook verbatim second time, escalated.
14.5–15.0 instrumental hold.

Music-video route: performance, NYC bodega. Director thesis: bodega princess — she raps through the aisles and at the counter of a classic New York corner bodega like she owns the register. Black girlie hustle vibe.

Visual world: cramped NYC bodega interior — stacked shelves of chips and canned goods, glowing deli counter, cooler doors with glass fronts, lotto signs, a bodega cat on a shelf; warm fluorescent mixed with window daylight. 2 background dancers: Black girls in Y2K glam — one in a fur-trim cropped puffer and door-knocker earrings, one in a velour tracksuit with a silk scarf; both with fresh manicures. Palette: bodega warm yellows, product-shelf color chaos, denim green, gold. No neon effects, no particles.

Shot flow (crash zooms punch through the cramped space):
0–0.5s static frame down a narrow aisle, empty; she steps into frame at the far end.
0.5s CRASH ZOOM IN down the whole aisle to her face on the first word — she raps walking straight at the lens, trailing fingers along the shelves.
2.8–3.2s on "Hey!" whip-pan to the two girls posted at the cooler doors snapping them shut in unison.
3.2–6.7s she raps moving through the aisle to the counter, camera weaving backward; CRASH ZOOM punch-ins on "tense" and "consequence" slamming to her mouth; girls vogue-lean against shelves hitting freezes on snares; she slaps a dollar on the counter on "come correct", finger to lens.
7.5s CRASH ZOOM IN on the kick — tight close-up at the deli counter, second hook doubled intensity, she leans over the counter into the lens.
10–13.7s slow orbital in the cramped space, girls flanking her at the counter doing synchronized shoulder rolls and hair flips on snares; one more crash zoom on the last "come correct"; the bodega cat watches deadpan.
13.7–15s on "Woo!" CRASH ZOOM OUT through the door to the street: the three of them framed in the bodega doorway under the awning, frozen, hold.

entries.title: Flooded Office Intense Close-up
entries.description: An intense, hyperrealistic slow-motion close-up of a man struggling in a flooded office, focusing on facial details and water droplets.
entries.prompt: Slow-motion extreme hyper close-up, 16:9. Shaky organic handheld shot pushed in tight and intimate on the face of a man in his thirties with dark wet side-parted hair plastered to his forehead, mid-lunge through the flood his face fills the entire frame, jaw clenched with teeth bared and gritted in a snarl of effort, brow deeply furrowed, eyes narrowed and locked forward with raw desperate determination. Water streams and beads down his skin, droplets clinging to his eyelashes and running off his chin, spray bursting across his face in slow suspended flecks. Every pore, water bead, and strand of wet hair rendered in sharp tactile detail. The chaotic flooded office and blurred panicking crowd fall completely out of focus behind him. In slow motion the droplets hang and drift, sweat and water glistening. Dynamic unsteady handheld movement right at his face, breathing with the motion. Sickly institutional palette muted seafoam green and cold reflective water bokeh behind him. Face anatomically correct, stable, hyperrealistic, genuine intense emotion, natural human proportions, no warping or distortion. Heavy coarse analog 35mm film grain baked into every frame, thick and consistent, grain crawling over highlights and shadows, like a scanned celluloid film print, never clean, never digital-looking. Flat overhead fluorescent light, dramatic slow-motion intensity, shallow depth of field, cinematic photorealistic, ultra-detailed.

舞台は、磨かれた深い色のウォールナットまたはマホガニーの机を備えた、上質なアンティーク書斎・機械工房。
背景は柔らかくぼかし、暖かく高級感のあるシネマティックな空間にする。

真鍮と黒鉄の精密な質感、暖かい琥珀色の内光、深い茶色、明確な明暗差、美しい金属反射を重視する。
灰色にくすませない。低彩度で鈍い映像にしない。
暖かな金色と琥珀色を中心に、透明感と奥行きのある色彩にする。

【導入 0〜1.5秒】
磨かれた机の上に平置きされたアンティーク懐中時計を、斜め上からの少し広い構図で一瞬見せる。
リューズ、吊り下げ用の輪、机上に伸びる細身のチェーンを画面内に入れ、最初から懐中時計であることを明確にする。

直後にカメラが素早く接近する。
針、使い込まれた金属表面、彫刻された縁、曲面ガラス、その奥の内部機構へ、短く滑らかな近接ショットで移行する。
長い静止や無駄な待ち時間を作らない。

【時間逆行の起動 1.5〜3.5秒】
時計の針が明確に逆回転し、内部の歯車列全体が通常動作から逆動作へ切り替わる。
隣接する歯車同士の自然な噛み合いを保ちながら、機構全体が時間を巻き戻すように動く。

曲面ガラスの下から暖かい琥珀色の光が立ち上がる。
針の逆回転、歯車列の逆動作、琥珀色の光、金属部品の振動を、連続性のある短いマクロカットでテンポよく見せる。
カメラは素早く寄り、懐中時計の周囲をわずかに回り込む。
この段階では機関車を走らせない。

【機関車の組み立て 3.5〜8.5秒】
時計機構の逆動作をきっかけに、曲面ガラスの内側でミニチュア蒸気機関車が高速再構成される。

機関車は、懐中時計の文字盤面に存在する浅いミニチュア内部世界として形成する。
機関車をガラスの外側、時計の上、机の上には出さない。
内部空間を深い箱型空間にせず、懐中時計の薄い携帯型ケースを維持する。

文字盤上に細いミニチュアレールが素早く形成される。
続いて、車輪、シャーシ、ボイラー、ピストン、運転室、煙突、真鍮部品が順番に組み上がる。

組み立て途中の変化が少ない状態を長く見せない。
部品がゆっくり浮遊する魔法的な生成にはしない。
部品が正確な位置へ高速移動し、短い金属音とともに素早く固定される、明確で気持ちのよい機械組み立てにする。

レール形成、車輪装着、ボイラー固定、ピストン接続、煙突設置、完成を、連続性のある短いマクロカットで次々と見せる。
曲面ガラス越しの斜めアングルや歯車越しの構図を交え、同じ正面構図を長く続けない。

【完成・起動 8.5〜11秒】
機関車が完成した直後、すぐに起動する。
煙突から柔らかな蒸気が噴き、車輪が回転し、ピストンが規則的に動き始める。

機関車は煙突側を先頭にして、時計内部のレール上を短く自然に前進する。
後退しない。
時計機構の逆動作と、完成後の機関車の進行方向を連動させない。

懐中時計の内部から琥珀色の光が強まり、時計と機関車が一体化した、生きた小型タイムマシンのように見せる。

【ラスト 11〜15秒】
曲面ガラス越しに、前進する機関車、回転する車輪、動くピストン、柔らかな蒸気を、短い近接ショットで見せる。

その後カメラが滑らかに引き、机上に平置きされた懐中時計全体へ戻る。
ラストの懐中時計は、冒頭と同じ外形、大きさ、薄さ、姿勢を維持する。
12時位置のリューズと吊り下げ用の輪、そこから机上へ伸びる細身のチェーンを明確に見せる。

時計を縦向きに立てない。
脚、スタンド、台座を作らない。
置き時計、卓上時計、目覚まし時計のシルエットにしない。

最後は、平置きされた懐中時計を斜め上から捉えた、少し広めのシネマティックなヒーローショット。
時計全体と、その曲面ガラス内部に存在する機関車が一目で分かる構図にする。
機関車が軽く蒸気を吐き、内部の歯車と琥珀色の光が動き続ける状態で、機械的な生命感と余韻を残して終わる。

カメラ構成:
・平置きされた懐中時計を見せる短い斜め俯瞰ショット
・時計内部への高速接近
・時間逆行を見せる短いマクロカット
・組み立て工程を圧縮した高速カット割り
・曲面ガラス越しの斜めアングル
・機関車の短い前進
・平置きされた懐中時計へ戻る斜め俯瞰ヒーローショット

カット数を増やしても、懐中時計、レール、機関車の位置関係と組み立ての連続性を維持する。
導入と組み立て工程を圧縮し、完成、起動、ラストには十分な視認時間を残す。

音は効果音のみ。
時計の金属的な刻音、歯車のクリック音、部品がはまる短い金属音、蒸気の噴出音、小さな車輪がレール上を走る音、低く穏やかな機械駆動音を入れる。
歌声、ナレーション、台詞は入れない。
entries.translated_prompt:
15-second, 1:1 square cinematic mechanical fantasy short video.
No characters. No text. No logo. No watermark.
No BGM. Sound effects only.

The protagonist is a single antique pocket watch that fits in the palm of a hand.
An open-face type without a lid, with a round, thin portable case.
A winding crown and a suspension loop are at the 12 o'clock position, and a slim metal chain extends from the loop.

The external shape, size, thin case, crown, suspension loop, and chain of the pocket watch remain identical from start to finish.
The watch is placed flat on a desk or at a very shallow angle from beginning to end.
It does not stand vertically. It does not stand on the edge of its case.
It is not transformed into a table clock, desk clock, or alarm clock.
No legs, standing stands, bases, or bell-shaped decorations are added.
Even if a locomotive is formed inside, the case does not become thick or large.

The setting is a high-quality antique study or mechanical workshop with a polished dark walnut or mahogany desk.
The background is softly blurred to create a warm, luxurious, cinematic space.

Emphasis on the precise texture of brass and black iron, warm amber internal light, deep brown, clear contrast, and beautiful metal reflections.
Do not make it dull grey. Do not use low saturation or dull imagery.
Focus on warm gold and amber colors with a sense of transparency and depth.

[Introduction 0–1.5s]
Show the antique pocket watch lying flat on the polished desk from a slightly wide diagonal overhead angle for a moment.
Include the crown, suspension loop, and slim chain extending onto the desk within the frame, making it clear from the start that it is a pocket watch.

Immediately after, the camera quickly approaches.
Transition to a short, smooth close-up shot of the hands, worn metal surface, engraved edges, curved glass, and the internal mechanism behind it.
Do not create long pauses or useless waiting time.

[Activation of Time Reversal 1.5–3.5s]
The hands of the watch clearly rotate in reverse, and the entire internal gear train switches from normal operation to reverse operation.
While maintaining natural meshing between adjacent gears, the entire mechanism moves as if rewinding time.

Warm amber light rises from under the curved glass.
Show the reverse rotation of the hands, the reverse motion of the gear train, the amber light, and the vibration of metal parts in a well-paced series of short macro cuts.
The camera quickly moves closer and slightly circles around the pocket watch.
Do not let the locomotive run at this stage.

[Locomotive Assembly 3.5–8.5s]
Triggered by the reverse operation of the watch mechanism, a miniature steam locomotive is rapidly reconfigured inside the curved glass.

Form the locomotive as a shallow miniature internal world existing on the face of the pocket watch.
Do not let the locomotive come outside the glass, on top of the watch, or on the desk.
Do not make the internal space a deep box-like space; maintain the thin portable case of the pocket watch.

Thin miniature rails are quickly formed on the dial.
Subsequently, wheels, chassis, boiler, pistons, cab, chimney, and brass parts are assembled in order.

Do not show a state with little change for a long time during assembly.
Do not make it a magical generation where parts float slowly.
Create a clear and satisfying mechanical assembly where parts move quickly to precise positions and are quickly fixed with short metal sounds.

Show rail formation, wheel attachment, boiler fixing, piston connection, chimney installation, and completion in a series of short macro cuts.
Mix diagonal angles through curved glass and compositions through gears; do not continue with the same frontal composition for long.

[Completion/Activation 8.5–11s]
Immediately after the locomotive is completed, it starts up.
Soft steam puffs from the chimney, wheels rotate, and pistons begin to move regularly.

The locomotive moves forward naturally on the rails inside the watch, chimney-first.
It does not move backward.
Do not link the reverse motion of the watch mechanism with the forward direction of the completed locomotive.

The amber light from inside the pocket watch intensifies, making the watch and locomotive look like a single, living miniature time machine.

[Ending 11–15s]
Show the moving locomotive, rotating wheels, moving pistons, and soft steam through the curved glass in short close-up shots.

Then the camera smoothly pulls back to return to the entire pocket watch lying flat on the desk.
The pocket watch at the end maintains the same external shape, size, thinness, and posture as at the beginning.
Clearly show the crown and suspension loop at the 12 o'clock position and the slim chain extending onto the desk from there.

Do not stand the watch vertically.
Do not create legs, stands, or bases.
Do not create the silhouette of a table clock, desk clock, or alarm clock.

The final shot is a slightly wider cinematic hero shot capturing the flat-lying pocket watch from a diagonal overhead angle.
A composition that makes both the entire watch and the locomotive inside its curved glass visible at a glance.
End with a sense of mechanical life and resonance as the locomotive lightly emits steam and the internal gears and amber light continue to move.

Camera Composition:
- Short diagonal overhead shot showing the flat-lying pocket watch
- Rapid approach into the watch interior
- Short macro cuts showing time reversal
- High-speed cut segments compressing the assembly process
- Diagonal angles through curved glass
- Short forward movement of the locomotive
- Diagonal overhead hero shot returning to the flat-lying pocket watch

Even if the number of cuts increases, maintain the continuity of the positional relationship and assembly of the pocket watch, rails, and locomotive.
Compress the introduction and assembly process, leaving sufficient viewing time for completion, activation, and the ending.

Sound is sound effects only.
Include metallic ticking of the watch, clicking of gears, short metal sounds of parts fitting together, bursts of steam, the sound of small wheels running on rails, and low, calm mechanical driving sounds.
Do not include singing, narration, or dialogue.

entries.title: Elven vs Orc Epic Battle
entries.description: An epic high-budget fantasy battle sequence for Seedance 2.0 featuring elves, orcs, and unique warriors like the Forest Knight and Stone Warrior.
entries.prompt: STYLE: photoreal cinematic, 8K, ultra-detailed, high-budget epic fantasy film look. Natural skin / stone / bark / iron / leaf / cloth textures with pore-and-grain micro-detail, macro texture on grass, soil and dew, real organic film grain, strong motion blur on fast moves, filmic dawn grade. Diegetic SFX only, no music. REFERENCE LEGEND: <<<image_1>>> = dawn grass field below a white-and-gold spired elven citadel on a misty grey mountain, low sun flaring screen-right (img 1) <<<image_2>>> = blonde elven warrior, silver-and-gold leaf-filigree armor, pale-blue cape, elven longsword (img 2) <<<image_3>>> = massive dark grey-green orc, battered black-iron plate, tusks, amber eyes (img 3) <<<image_4>>> = forest knight, carved wooden face, glowing amber eyes, orange flower-petal mane, green leaf mantle, vine-wrapped spear + glowing amber-cored shield (img 4) <<<image_5>>> = STONE warrior — humanoid built from grey moss-flecked boulders, craggy carved face, pale glowing eyes, rope belt, chipped raw-stone sword (img 5) SCENE CONTEXT: an epic large-scale battle of an elven army against an orc horde on the dawn grass field below the white-gold citadel. Told in four cuts: a roaring orc, a continuous FPV-drone dive from the giant battle down to a tiny ground-level duel, an elven swordswoman cutting through orcs, then a grand super-wide of the whole clash. ACTIVE REFERENCES: <<<image_1>>>: green grass field rising to the white-and-gold spired elven citadel on a misty grey mountain, low dawn sun flaring screen-right, drifting haze. 100% matches. <<<image_2>>>: blonde elven warrior in silver-and-gold leaf-filigree armor, pale-blue cape, fighting ONLY with an elven SWORD (no bow, no arrows, no archery) — each elf UNIQUE. 100% matches. <<<image_3>>>: massive grey-green orcs in dark battered black-iron plate, tusks, amber eyes, heavy weapons — each orc UNIQUE. 100% matches. <<<image_4>>>: forest knight, carved wooden face with glowing amber eyes, orange flower-petal mane, green leaf mantle, bark skin, vine-wrapped spear and a glowing amber-cored shield. 100% matches. <<<image_5>>>: STONE warrior woven from grey moss-flecked boulders, craggy carved stone face, pale glowing eyes, rope belt, gripping a chipped raw-stone sword. 100% matches. SCALE LOCK: in CUT 2 at ground level <<<image_4>>> and <<<image_5>>> are TINY — each about the size of a human palm, miniature warriors on the soil between towering blades of grass. The elves and orcs are full-size GIANTS by comparison; down low only their massive legs, feet and stomping boots tower above and crash near the two tiny knights. Standing elves and orcs read as tall as four humans stacked head to toe relative to the grass. FORMAT MODE: SEQUENCE OF CUTS — CUT 1 … CUT 2 … CUT 3 … CUT 4, described in order. Cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own. CUT 2 is itself one continuous free-flying FPV-drone take. OPTICS: CUT 1 — 18° tight portrait on the orc, shallow focus. CUT 2 — opens ~84° wide for scale and speed, tightening to ~47° weaving through the fighters, then macro ~18° at ground level among the grass (deep focus high, shallow macro focus low). No drift mid-segment. CUT 3 — 47° neutral medium following the elf, shallow-ish focus separating her from the orcs. CUT 4 — 107° architectural ultra-wide, deep focus. CAMERA: CUT 1 — locked tight handheld, eye-level, micro-tremor, holding on the orc's face. CUT 2 — aggressive, weightless, dynamic FPV-drone. Open on a wide SIDE view: elven swordsmen charging from screen-LEFT, orcs charging from screen-RIGHT, the two lines rushing together across <<<image_1>>>, citadel and dawn sun behind. The drone flies fast and low THROUGH the middle of the clash, weaving and banking between colliding elves and orcs, dodging swinging swords, then whips downward and punches between the TALL grass blades to the soil, threading dynamically around the two palm-sized knights while giant legs and boots stomp and crash overhead. CUT 3 — fluid tracking move orbiting with the elven swordswoman, eye-level, following her blade. CUT 4 — slow high crane pull-back revealing the full battlefield, citadel and mountain screen-right-back. ACTION: CUT 1 — extreme tight on <<<image_3>>>: the orc throws its head forward and ROARS in fury, jaw wide over the tusks, amber eyes blazing, neck veins bulging, spit and breath-fog bursting toward camera. CUT 2 — up top the armies collide: elven swordsmen trade blows with orcs across the line, swords ringing. As the drone reaches the grass, the two tiny knights fight ONE-ON-ONE, fast and dynamic — <<<image_4>>> lunging and thrusting the vine spear, <<<image_5>>> the stone warrior parrying and counter-swinging the heavy stone sword, both dodging, spinning and clashing, leaves and amber embers scattering, stone chips flaking, while enormous orc and elf feet pound the earth nearby, near-missing them. CUT 3 — <<<image_2>>> the elven swordswoman moves through the orc ranks at speed, blade flashing: she parries an orc's heavy chop, spins past it and cuts it down, then drops a second charging orc with a clean diagonal slash, cape streaming. Sword only. CUT 4 — super-wide grand view: the two armies fully engaged across the dawn field, hundreds of elves and orcs clashing, dust and haze rolling, the white-gold citadel and rising sun screen-right-back. PHYSICS: realistic momentum and weight. Giant footfalls send tremors, bursting dust and dew droplets at macro scale; tall grass blades whip and bend in the drone's wake; the stone warrior moves with heavy grinding mass, the forest knight fast and agile with weighty organic creak; the elf moves light and fluid, cape and braids carrying inertia. Mass has weight, correct contact shadows, no teleporting poses. LIGHTING: cinematic dawn from <<<image_1>>> — warm low backlight and sun flare screen-right, soft mist rolling down the mountain at ~40% density. CUT 1: hard low key on the orc's right side, half the face in shadow. CUT 2: sun glints through the tall wet grass at ground level, giant legs casting moving shadows over the tiny knights, the forest knight's amber glow and the stone warrior's pale eye-glow reading against shadowed soil; bright blurred battle bokeh above. CUT 3: warm rim light catching the elf's filigree armor and blade. CUT 4: volumetric god-rays through the haze across the whole field. White balance 5000K. COLOR: cold steel-grey orc iron and stone against warm dawn-gold light; the forest knight's orange petals and amber core glowing warm; the elf's silver-gold armor catching the low sun; green grass deep and wet, soil dark and shadowed. AUDIO (SFX only): CUT 1 — guttural roaring war cry, wet breath. CUT 2 — thundering charge, clashing steel and sword rings, thundering giant footsteps overhead, and up close the fast sharp clashes of the two tiny weapons, stone grinding, creaking wood, scattering leaves, bursting dew, wind through tall grass. CUT 3 — fast steel clashes, orc grunts, cape snap. CUT 4 — vast roaring battle wash. No music. POSITIVE LOCKS: - Four cuts in order: roaring orc → FPV-drone dive into the grass → elf cutting down orcs → grand super-wide. Cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own. - Elves fight only with SWORDS — no bows, no arrows, no archers anywhere. - At ground level only TWO tiny palm-sized knights: <<<image_4>>> (forest) versus <<<image_5>>> (STONE), one-on-one among towering grass while giant orc and elf legs fight and stomp above. - Each orc and each elf is unique. Citadel, sun direction, dawn light and wardrobe identical across all cuts. - Dynamic motion throughout, stable readable picture, no ghosting, no flickering.

entries.title: Early 2000s Asian Drama Hair Toss
entries.description: A nostalgic 2000s Asian TV drama prompt featuring a comedic hair toss moment into a soy sauce dish with specific lighting and audio cues.
entries.prompt:
LIGHTING
High-key early-2000s television lighting: bright, soft, flattering frontal fill on both faces, no hard shadows, flat neutral daytime — not golden.

AUDIO
No music. Her warm chatty murmur carrying the take, his agreeing hums going slightly strained ("うん…… うん……"), room tone, soft koi water, her bright final "……でしょ？"

POSITIVE LOCKS
Early-2000s Asian broadcast drama texture: heavy soft diffusion, blooming highlights, mild halation, warm muted palette, fine telecine grain. Ultra photoreal skin and teeth — the fleck reads clearly at every smile. His discomfort stays polite and fond, never disgusted. Static frame; focus pulls are the only movement.

SCENE CONTEXT
Close-up at a low table beside a koi pond in a traditional Japanese tatami dining hall: charmed mid-laugh, the young woman does a flirty hair toss — and the ends of her hair land straight into the soy sauce dish. Early-2000s Asian television drama.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
Girl reference: early 20s, LONG wavy honey-brown hair with bangs, white knit beret, hot-pink coat, flirty then deflated. Her hair ends are action-critical. 100% matches the reference.
Man reference: off-frame; only his warm laugh and one tiny nasal snort are heard. 100% matches the reference.
Location reference: tatami hall with koi pond; the low table closest to the pond on the right platform. On the bare lacquered table: a small shallow soy sauce dish near her side. Background: soft warm bokeh.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
First frame: close-up in three-quarter profile — her head and shoulder frame-left, x 40%, y 42%, laughing toward screen-right at her off-frame date; the small soy dish sharp on the tabletop at lower frame-right, x 68%, y 78%. Both her face and the dish present from frame one.

FORMAT MODE
Single continuous take, 4 seconds. Real-time. No subtitles, no music.

OPTICS
29° short telephoto, camera 1.3 meters back, focus deep enough to hold her face and the dish in the same close composition.

CAMERA
Locked-off tripod base with ONE slow, smooth TILT as the only movement: the frame TILTS DOWN following her swept hair to the soy dish, holds on the dipped tips, then TILTS BACK UP to her face for the realization. Gentle, deliberate, 2000s-drama pace. No zoom, no pan, no handheld.

ACTION TIMING
0.0s–1.2s: she laughs at something he said — bright, flattered — and does a flirty full hair toss, sweeping the long side of her hair over her shoulder with a graceful hand.
1.2s–2.2s: TILT DOWN with the falling hair: the swept ends swing past her shoulder and land directly INTO the shallow soy dish, settling in the dark liquid; one slow drip gathers at the tips. She keeps laughing

entries.title: Producer's Office Dialogue Scene
entries.description: A character-driven cinematic prompt for a dialogue scene in a mid-century producer's office, featuring realistic handheld camera work and emotional acting.
entries.prompt:
INT. mid-century producer's office, day. Walnut-paneled walls hung with film posters and black-and-white photo collages, deep blue carpet, brown leather Eames chairs, a cluttered wooden desk with books and a film canister, tall windows behind with an overcast city skyline, warm circular ceiling lights overhead. A young East Asian woman — dark hair in a messy high bun with loose strands, black over-ear headphones pushed back on her head, blue-and-rust tie-dye cropped tee — sits across the desk from a bald man with a grey-flecked beard, white shirt sleeves rolled to the elbow. Entire scene shot on a restless handheld camera: the frame breathes, sways, drifts and reframes with every movement, never locked off.
Shot 1 — handheld medium on the woman, frame loose and shifting: she leans forward on one forearm against the desk edge, the other hand turning a pen slowly between her fingers. Her body stays contained — a quick lift of the eyebrows, a small tilt of the head, a half-grin pulling one corner of her mouth. She stops the pen, taps it once on the desk, and holds his eyes. "I've got an idea." A flicker of a smile after the line; she lets the silence sit. The camera drifts slightly, breathing with her.
Shot 2 — handheld over-the-shoulder onto the man, the frame snapping to him and settling unevenly: he slaps a palm flat on the desk, shoves his chair back, throws his head back and rubs his face with both hands, then jabs a finger at her, exasperated. "Stop — STOP. Voices like that, generated, for a real film? Kid—" he spreads his hands, shaking his head hard, "—that's not a thing." The handheld drifts in on his frustrated face.
Shot 3 — handheld push-in on the woman, the camera creeping closer through the natural sway: she goes completely still. The pen lowers to the desk. Shoulders drop. The grin fades into calm, level certainty. She holds his eyes, and the frame tightens to a close-up as she says one quiet word: "Watch." The man stops moving; his hand freezes mid-gesture. The handheld settles on her steady face.
Soft overcast daylight from the windows mixed with warm tungsten from the ceiling rings, natural color, shallow background. Dialogue in English, delivered with full emotion — hers calm and certain, his loud and rattled, then both dropping to stillness on the turn.

entries.title: Brutalist Sculpture Atrium Rap Video
entries.description: A sophisticated music video prompt utilizing precise lip-syncing and brutalist architectural themes to create a cinematic rap performance.
entries.prompt:
@ Image1 is the performer — preserve her exact identity: cornrow braids, septum ring, statement earrings, sculptural white designer top, dark indigo denim. @ Audio1 is the finished master track — the only audio; no invented music, no new vocals.

SHE RAPS THE VOCAL ON CAMERA — PRECISE LIPSYNC IS THE TOP PRIORITY. Mouth articulates every syllable of @ Audio1 exactly on time; face visible and sharp through every vocal line, no cutaways mid-word.

LIPSYNC MAP:
0.0–0.5 instrumental.
0.5–2.8 "I'm standing on the edge / Say it with your chest / Or keep it on the deck" + "Hey!"
3.2–6.7 "I walk in, whole room gets tense / I don't need luck, I'm the consequence / If you really want to test my intent / Come correct, come correct or get bent" + "Woo!"
7.5–13.7 same hook verbatim second time, escalated.
14.5–15.0 instrumental hold.

Music-video route: performance, brutalist sculpture garden. Director thesis: she raps at the lens while six dancers on concrete plinths snap between statue poses on her words — her voice animates the architecture.

Visual world: brutalist concrete atrium, massive raw plinths at staggered heights, cold skylight shafts, natural dust in the light. 6 background dancers in oatmeal and bone knitwear, sculptural museum-figure styling. Palette: bone, oatmeal, concrete grey, indigo accent on her. No neon, no artificial particles.

Shot flow:
0–2.8s medium shot at the atrium floor: she raps the opening lines to camera, statues frozen on plinths behind her.
2.8–3.2s on "Hey!" every statue snaps a new pose simultaneously.
3.2–6.7s lateral tracking shot with foreground column parallax: she walks and raps between the plinths, each snare triggering a cascading pose-change wave across the dancers above; her face stays center, mouth in focus; finger to lens on "come correct".
7.5–10s cut on the kick to a low-angle close-up against a light shaft: second hook harder, dust drifting, jaw snapping consonants, head isolations between phrases.
10–13.7s slow crane-orbital rising around her as she raps and all six dancers move continuously in individual orbits on their plinths, stop-motion cadence on the hats.
13.7–15s on "Woo!" she steps up onto the lowest plinth and freezes arm high, dancers frozen mid-pose below, hold.

Performance rules: stoic, precise, museum-quiet menace; crisp readable articulation; dancers expressionless. Continuity: same seven people, same atrium. Audio intent: @ Audio1 only, mouth locked to it; faint room tone and steps. Quality bar: museum-grade art-directed rap video, no AI gloss.

entries.title: Y2K Basketball Court Cause-and-Effect
entries.description: A stylized Y2K music video prompt with a focus on physics-defying effects synced to a rap vocal track at a basketball court during golden hour.
entries.prompt:
LYRIC-THEME SCENE 10 — NATIVE 21:9 4K: I'M THE CONSEQUENCE. Theme: she is what happens after — cause and effect made visible. <<<image_1>>>is the performer — exact identity: cornrow braids into long dark curly ponytail, silver chain-drop earring, gold pendant necklace, glossy lips. <<<image_2>>> is WARDROBE REFERENCE ONLY (ignore mannequin head, copy outfit exactly): hot-pink halter bandana top, grey acid-wash ultra-wide baggy jeans with star studs, black studded belt, chain bracelets, pink manicure. <<<image_3>>> is LOCATION REFERENCE — this exact caged basketball court at golden hour. <<<audio_1>>> is the master track — the only audio.

LIPSYNC — ABSOLUTE TOP PRIORITY: she performs the rap vocal of <<<audio_1>>> LIVE; mouth follows the audio EXACTLY, closed in instrumental stretches; audio is the sole truth, no invented words. Lips readable and tack-sharp through every vocal stretch.

SCENE: physics obeys her one beat late — she is the consequence of everything on the court. The crowd (30 Y2K-styled neighbors) plays casual cause-and-effect around her: someone shoots a basketball — it refuses to drop, circling the rim endlessly, until SHE glances at it on a vocal accent and it falls dead through; a domino line of standing bottles topples only when her boot hits the beat; a jump-rope pair's rope stops mid-arc when she raises a hand and resumes when she lowers it; a thrown cap hangs in the air until she walks past, then lands. Every effect fires exactly on her vocal accents — the world syncs to her voice. No dancing, no breakdance — pure cause-and-effect theater.

CAMERA — Xiaolong Liu in CINEMASCOPE: HANDHELD following her walk through the stations of consequence — each physics-gag staged in a different band of the scope while her lipsync owns a third; breathing frame, tilted horizon, golden flares. NOTHING CENTERED.

Staging: opens on the ball circling the rim in the left expanse, her entering frame right rapping; her glance drops it on the first accent — the shooter stares at his hands; she walks on — the bottle-dominos ripple down the sideline exactly on her boot-beats; the suspended jump-rope resumes as she passes under it without ducking; the hanging cap lands on its owner's head, backwards, on an accent; final stretch — she reaches center court, raises one hand and the entire crowd's murmur STOPS, lowers it and thirty heads nod on her final beats; she finishes the vocal deadpan into the lens as the ball rolls to rest against her boot, exactly on the last sound. Continuity: gold pendant. Audio: <<<audio_1>>> only; rim rattle, bottle clinks, rope slap in gaps, each landing on the beat. Quality bar: anamorphic cause-and-effect handheld, audio-locked lipsync, no breakdance, no AI gloss.

entries.title: Anime Wall Running Action Scene
entries.description: A Japanese anime action prompt featuring a primary school student performing a wall-running and gliding sequence through a shopping district.
entries.prompt:
【主役】黒髪ボブの小学2年生
【舞台】シャッター街の商店街

【動画スタイル】
15秒。日本のフルカラーアニメ。予算5億円規模の高密度2Dアニメーション。緻密な背景美術、なめらかな中割り、映画品質の撮影処理。 同じような絵が続かないように、構図、カメラアングル、画面サイズ、キャラクターの距離感を変えて魅力的に展開する。字幕なし、透かしなし、BGMなし。環境音あり。

【映像構成】ビルから落ちる主役キャラが、壁の看板蹴りを使って落下をジグザグの滑空に変える。落下速度を殺して一瞬だけ空中を水平に走り、最後は地面すれすれの前転で勢いを前方への疾走へ変換する。

【この1本だけの見せ場（Shot5〜7のどこかに必ず入れる）】蹴った看板の電源が入り、降りた軌跡どおりに店の灯りが点いていく

Shot1（落下フック）: シャッター街の商店街。落下する主役キャラが壁の看板蹴りを使い、落下の向きがぐんと曲がる。驚きの中にも冷静さを残す表情。
Shot2（ジグザグ）: 壁の看板蹴りを続けて使う。軌道が折れ線になり、速度が殺されていく。集中しきった真剣な顔つき。
Shot3（水平走）: 一瞬だけ空中を水平に走る。窓の中の人と目が合う。主役はいたずらっぽく小さく手を振る。
Shot4（減速）: 壁の看板蹴りで最後の減速。髪と服が風で大きく膨らむ。歯を食いしばる真剣な表情。
Shot5（すれすれ）: 地面すれすれで前転し、落下の勢いを前方への疾走へ変換する。埃が輪になって広がる。着地の衝撃に一瞬顔をしかめる。
Shot6（整え）: 走り続けながら身なりを整える。髪だけがまだ落下の風を覚えている。落ち着きを取り戻した涼しい顔。
Shot7（決め）: 走りながら振り返らずに、飄々とした声で「エレベーター待つより速い」と言う。
entries.translated_prompt: [Protagonist] 2nd grade elementary school girl with black bob hair. [Setting] A shuttered shopping district. [Style] 15s high-density 2D anime, movie quality. The protagonist falls from a building and uses signs on the walls to kick off, turning the fall into a zigzag glide. She runs horizontally in the air for a moment, waves to someone in a window, then rolls on the ground to convert the momentum into a sprint. Key highlight: the signs she kicks turn on, lighting up the path behind her. Ending with her saying nonchalantly, 'Faster than waiting for the elevator.'

entries.title: Chinese Shan Shui Ink Wash Animation
entries.description: A cinematic animation prompt that transitions from a vibrant mythical landscape to a traditional black ink brushstroke style on rice paper.
entries.prompt: Create a 19-second cinematic animation in the style of a traditional Chinese Shan Shui ink wash painting with vibrant digital watercolor. Begin with a fully colored mythical landscape of towering karst mountains, waterfalls, mist, a circular lake, and an ancient pagoda. A single black ink drop falls, expanding into a dramatic splash that covers the scene before receding to reveal a blank rice-paper canvas. The landscape redraws itself with flowing black ink brushstrokes, then vivid watercolor gradually fills the mountains, architecture, and blooming cherry blossom trees. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the complete paradise with drifting clouds, cascading waterfalls, and a perfectly circular ring of water surrounding the pagoda, ending on a serene, majestic wide shot with smooth cinematic motion, painterly textures, and high-detail lighting.

entries.title: Flooded Office Surrealism Cinematic
entries.description: A surreal cinematic video prompt featuring a calm girl in a chaotic, flooded office environment with a 35mm film grain aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Use the attached image as the exact first frame. Do not regenerate or restyle the face — keep the same girl, same blue goggles, same skin, and crucially keep the same heavy 35mm film grain texture of the original photo throughout the entire video, on every frame.

At the very start, the girl rises slightly so her mouth and chin lift just above the waterline into the pose shown, water sheeting and dripping off her face and goggles, ripples spreading around her. She then holds that exact position — calm, deadpan, nonchalant, eyes steady behind the goggles, never reacting, totally unbothered. Her face stays stable, natural, and anatomically correct the entire time, no warping or distortion.

The camera pulls back smoothly and steadily in one continuous unbroken shot, drifting backward and slightly upward, her face shrinking in the frame as more of the scene is revealed around her.

The pull-back uncovers that she is floating calmly in the middle of a flooded fluorescent-lit office breakroom in total chaos — knee-to-waist-deep churning water filling the room, dozens of office workers in business clothes panicking all around her: people scrambling onto a vending machine, leaping from tables, climbing the walls toward the ceiling tiles, wading and falling through the water, hauling each other up, papers and plastic chairs and a floating monitor swept up in the surge, water gushing in through a doorway like a waterfall along the back wall. She remains the one still, calm point at the center of the panic.

Every face in the video remains anatomically correct, stable, and realistic at all times — natural human proportions, clean facial features, genuine readable expressions of fear and panic. No melting, no warping, no distorted or smeared faces, no extra or misshapen eyes or mouths, no uncanny morphing as people move.

Everything moves continuously: the flood water churns, sloshes, and reflects the harsh ceiling lights, spray flies, the panicking people thrash and climb and scramble in motion, hands reach up out of the water, debris floats and bobs, the doorway waterfall pours steadily, fluorescent light flickers on the surface. The camera keeps gliding back to take in the full wide chaotic scene.

Sickly institutional palette throughout — seafoam green walls, cream, muted teal, harsh fluorescent white, cold reflective water. Consistent heavy analog film grain and 35mm photographic texture baked into every frame from start to finish, matching the grain of the source image, never clean or smooth, never digital-looking. Flat overhead light, absurd deadpan calm at the center against frantic drowning panic around it, smooth steady continuous camera motion, cinematic photorealistic, ultra-detailed.

entries.title: Pianist on Cliff Edge Cinematic Oner
entries.description: A high-detail 15-second cinematic single-take prompt featuring a pianist on a mountain cliff, including complex FPV camera dives and macro details.
entries.prompt:
single continuous shot, one take no cuts, cinematic oner, cinematic lighting, photorealistic, 35mm film quality, professional color grading, sharp focus, high detail texture, film grain, depth of field mastery, steadicam fluidity
Photorealistic live-action, not animation: an epic mountaintop cliff above a vast sea of glowing clouds at golden hour, distant jagged peaks catching warm light. A young woman pianist in a long flowing gown plays a black grand piano with intense expressive emotion, body swaying, hands flying across the keys, hair and dress whipping violently in a rising wind, while flocks of birds sweep upward through shafts of god-light and embers and petals swirl through the gusting air. The single take is built as one aggressive FPV descent — banking flight, a plunge into the piano's resonant interior, then an explosive pull-back to epic scale — with warm golden light, anamorphic flares, and volumetric beams held consistent so feather, ember, skin, and string textures all read in razor 4K macro detail.

Single continuous shot 15s: The camera banks fast and low around the cliff edge through churning golden clouds, embers and petals streaking past the lens as it swings toward the pianist, her gown and hair whipping in the wind, hands flying across the keys. Accelerating forward, the camera dives straight into the open piano lid and ramps to slow motion as it threads the tight gap between copper-wound strings and felt hammers, the hammers striking and the strings shivering in pore-deep macro detail, dust and light vibrating in the resonant wooden interior. Then the camera bursts back out of the piano, snapping to full speed as it pulls away and rises, birds sweeping upward through shafts of light, until it settles into a soaring extreme wide that reveals the whole cliff, the lone pianist, and the endless sea of glowing clouds below.
Total: 15s / 1 shot / 16:9

entries.title: Japanese Romance Drama Getting-Ready Montage
entries.description: A complex narrative prompt for Seedance 2.0 utilizing specific time-stamped shots to create a soft, cinematic romance story montage.
entries.prompt:
A young woman in her twenties, same person as — long dark wavy hair in low pigtails, navy cardigan over white shirt, green-striped school tie, plaid skirt. A fluffy white long-haired cat, same as <<<image_2>>>, sits on top of an ornate pink dollhouse. <<<image_3>>> — environment reference: cluttered pink bedroom, soft morning light through sheer curtains. — identity anchor for the young man revealed at the end: messy light-brown hair, plain white t-shirt.

[00-07s] Shot 1: Getting-ready montage, quick match cuts. She presses pastel lip color onto her lips, then fastens the knot of her green-striped tie, then slings a solid pastel-pink backpack with a clean plain surface over one shoulder. Handheld, subtle sway, warm morning light. 
[07-11s] Shot 2: She steps to the white cat sitting on an ornate pink dollhouse, cups its cheek with one hand and strokes it once and playfully touches its nose, then turns and hurries toward the door. Gentle push-in, shallow depth of field. 
[11-15s] Shot 3: The cat leaps onto the window sill between sheer curtains; through the glass she walks away from home in a moody japanese street,only her back seen. . The cat lifts one front paw and waves it gently. Static locked-off frame, subject centered

Warm Japanese drama romance aesthetic, Shunji Iwai soft natural window light, warm pastel pink palette, lifted blacks, fine 35mm film grain, 50mm lens feel, soft background bokeh.

Maintain face and clothing consistency. High detail. Natural smooth movements. 4K Ultra HD. Sharp clarity. Stable lighting. Consistent frame rate. Clean picture. Avoid blurry motion. Generate video without subtitles. SFX only.

entries.title: Urban Fantasy RPG Car Chase
entries.description: A comprehensive cinematic prompt for a high-quality 3D toon/cel-shaded car chase scene. It includes specific instructions for drifting, lighting, and maintaining character consistency based on reference images.
entries.prompt:
スマートフォン向け都市幻想アクションRPGの、最高レアリティキャラクター登場シネマティック。写実的な自動車広告ではなく、高品質3Dトゥーン／セルルックのアニメゲーム映像。

【参照画像の役割】

ソース参照画像のキャラクターを、全編で同じ一人の人物として厳密に維持する。参照画像は、顔立ち、年齢感、顔の輪郭、目の形、虹彩色と内部構造、キャッチライト、眉、口元、前髪、顔まわりの髪、髪型、髪色、衣装、装飾、体格、全身シルエット、雰囲気、固有配色、キャラクターカラーの参照にのみ使用する。

参照画像が複数ある場合は、各画像から矛盾しない特徴を統合し、同じ一人のキャラクターとして固定する。顔参照、髪型参照、衣装参照、全身参照などの役割が指定されている場合は、その優先順位を厳守する。

参照画像そのものの背景、部屋、家具、乗り物、文字、UI、白い設定表、分割レイアウト、ポーズ、画角、フレーミング、構図は再現しない。今回は新規の夜間都市カーチェイス場面として描く。

【キャラクター固定】

全編で同じ一人のキャラクター。顔、目の形、虹彩色、髪型、髪色、髪飾り、衣装、装飾、体格、固有配色、キャラクターらしい雰囲気を維持する。衣装は参照画像どおりの構造と配色を保ち、車内で自然に収まる範囲だけ袖、裾、髪、装飾の位置を整理する。別衣装、レーシングスーツ、制服、ドレスなどへ変更しない。

変化してよいのは、表情、視線、口元、ハンドル操作に伴う姿勢、呼吸、重心移動、髪と衣装の自然な揺れだけ。特徴の混合、顔の平均化、別人化、年齢変更、体格変更、衣装交換、髪型変更、クローン化、分身、余計な人物の追加は禁止。

【画風】

参照画像のキャラクターデザインと相性のよい、高密度な3Dトゥーン／セルルックへ統一する。細く清潔なアニメ線。太い黒輪郭は避ける。複数段階の透明感あるセルシェーディングと、柔らかなグラデーションを併用する。髪には細い毛束、繊細な高光、環境光の反射を入れる。瞳には参照画像どおりの複雑な虹彩、左右それぞれの自然なキャッチライト、宝石のような透明感を持たせる。

髪、まつ毛、装飾、衣装の布、ベルト、金具、車内の革、ガラス、濡れた路面、都市照明まで、同じ精緻なcel shader世界で統一する。高級品質アニメゲームシネマティック、繊細なキーアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のあるライティング、密度のある都市背景。背景は高密度だが、顔とキャラクターより目立たせない。

【参照キャラクターに合わせる可変要素】

固定されたカーチェイスの流れは維持しつつ、背景意匠、小物、都市装飾、照明色、反射色、光跡、ナビゲーションリング、空気感、季節感、紙片や花びらなどの舞う要素を、参照キャラクターの衣装、装飾、属性、世界観、固有色、性格に合わせて調整する。

キャラクターが上品なら洗練された高級商業街、幻想的なら魔法都市、近未来的ならサイバー商業街、和風なら和風都市街区、ゴシックなら夜の石造街区など、キャラクターの世界観に自然につながる都市幻想背景にする。ただし、道路、交差点、店舗、ガラス面、濡れた路面、走行可能な都市構造は維持し、別ジャンルの場所へ逸脱しない。

色彩の主導権は常にキャラクターに置く。主光、補助光、影色、輪郭光、ネオン、車体反射、速度線、タイヤの光跡は、参照キャラクターの固有色を引き立てる補色・近似色から選ぶ。背景の発光色が髪、瞳、衣装、装飾より目立たないよう彩度と明度を抑える。顔の表面には不要な点状発光、紋様、強い光線を置かない。

【固定シーン】

夜の開放型都市商業街. 店舗照明、ガラスのショーウィンドウ、抽象的な幾何学模様だけを映す電子案内板、発光する自動販売機、横断歩道、濡れた路面反射、遠景の通行人、風で舞う軽い小物。

主役は終始、同じ艶のあるグラファイトブラックの小型スポーツクーペの同じ運転席にいる。車の形状、色、状態を全編で変更しない。

濡れた路面反射を、地面すれすれの低いカメラが高速でなぞる。直後、スポーツクーペが交差点へ鋭くドリフト進入する。タイヤは参照キャラクターの固有色と都市照明を混ぜた、一つの明確な光の弧を描き、周囲の軽い小物が気流で巻き上がる。同じ一画のフロントガラス越しに、運転席のキャラクターの両目と、自信を感じる表情をすでに大きく読ませる。

車窓を流れる反射を短い遮蔽ワイプにして、同じ運転席の胸上近景へ受け渡す。キャラクターは両手でハンドルを確実に握り、ドリフトの反作用へ即座にカウンターステアを当てる。肩と上半身が自然に傾き、髪、装飾、衣装が遅れてしなやかに揺れる。都市照明が顔を交互に照らすが、顔の造形、瞳、表情を常に明確に読ませる。

カメラは間を置かず車体外側の低い斜め前方へ抜ける。追跡を振り切る最後の加速から、商業街中央で一回だけの正確なドリフト停止へ接続する。車はカメラへ斜めに向いた完全で清潔な状態で止まり、道路の曲線、タイヤの光跡、淡く発光するナビゲーションリングが美しい円形構図を作る。

停止の反動が収まる前に、カメラがボンネット上を滑ってフロントガラスへ急接近し、運転席の顔の特写へ着地する。キャラクターは片手を短くハンドルから離し、顔にかかった毛束、前髪、衣装の襟、装飾など、その人物らしい仕草で静かに整える。

瞳の内部に元からある左右のキャッチライトだけが同時にわずかに明るくなり、参照キャラクター本来の性格を保った、自信と余裕のある印象的な表情を見せる。

最終画面で、顔、瞳、髪型、髪色、主要な髪飾り、衣装、ハンドル、フロントガラス、キャラクターに合わせて調整された夜の都市背景を同時に明確に読ませる。顔と瞳を第一主役とし、衣装と固有シルエットを第二主役、車と背景を補助要素にする。
entries.translated_prompt:
A cinematic introduction for a top-rarity character in a mobile urban fantasy action RPG. High-quality 3D toon/cel-shaded anime game footage, not a realistic car commercial.

[Role of Reference Images]
Strictly maintain the character from the source reference image as the same individual throughout. Use the reference for facial features, age, face shape, eye shape, iris color/structure, catchlights, eyebrows, mouth, bangs, hair around the face, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, decorations, physique, silhouette, atmosphere, and specific color palette.

[Character Consistency]
Maintain the same character throughout. Keep face, eyes, hair, outfit, and body type identical to the reference. Only expressions, gaze, and posture during steering should vary. Do not change the outfit, age, or physique.

[Art Style]
High-density 3D toon/cel-shaded style compatible with the character design. Thin, clean anime lines. Avoid thick black outlines. Use multi-layered transparent cel-shading combined with soft gradients. Eyes should have complex irises and jewel-like transparency as per the reference. 0.0–0.5 instrumental — stillness.

Visual world: raw concrete studio hall, cold window daylight plus one tungsten pool, reflective floor. 4 background dancers (mixed gender) in matte black tanks and cargo trousers, anonymous, faces neutral. Palette: bone white, black, concrete, indigo. No neon, no particles.

0–3s wide-to-medium push-in: she raps dead center, crew frozen in a diamond formation behind her in shadow; they snap alive on the first "Hey!".

13.7–15s final tableau on "Woo!": she freezes one arm high, crew drops to one knee around her, hold. Loopable.

entries.title: Astronaut in Abandoned Amusement Park
entries.description: A cinematic sci-fi prompt for Seedance 2.0 depicting an astronaut exploring a haunting, decaying amusement park at twilight.
entries.prompt: An astronaut in a full white suit walks alone through an abandoned amusement park at twilight. Rusted rides stand motionless, faded carnival lights flicker sporadically, and fog drifts low across cracked pavement. The helmet visor reflects broken roller coasters, carousel horses, and shredded flags fluttering in the wind. The camera follows from behind in a slow tracking shot, then cuts to low angles and haunting wide frames that emphasize the surreal contrast between the futuristic astronaut and the decaying park. As the astronaut passes the giant Ferris wheel, it suddenly creaks into motion on its own. Old speakers crackle with distant carnival music. The sequence feels eerie, dreamlike, and cinematic, like a science-fiction mystery with emotional loneliness at its core.

entries.title: Surreal Nighttime Alley Rain Scene
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a woman in a vinyl trench coat in a frozen-time rainy alley with neon lights and a 360-degree camera orbit.
entries.prompt: Scene & Mood: Surreal nighttime alley editorial with suspended rain and cold neon stillness. A pale skinned woman with sleek black bob hair stands motionless mid stride in a narrow rain-soaked alley, dressed in a long black vinyl trench coat, silver chain harness over the coat, black leather gloves, and mirrored aviator sunglasses. Around her, raindrops hang frozen in mid air at every distance, catching pink and cyan neon bleed from unreadable signage glow above. The mood is cold, graphic, hypnotic, and cinematic, with suspended time treated as completely real inside a grounded urban alley. Frame Map: Begin in a full body centered composition, low angle. Subject stands center frame, weight on her back leg, front foot lifted mid step, coat frozen mid swing to one side. Frozen raindrops occupy all depth layers: dense near camera droplets soft blurred in foreground, mid layer droplets sharp around her torso, distant droplets faint near the alley's vanishing point. Wet asphalt fills the lower frame, brick walls and fire escapes frame both sides, a single glowing signage silhouette (shape only, no legible letters) glows at the far end of the alley. Subject Lock: Subject keeps the same face, hair, wardrobe, body shape, and silhouette throughout. Preserve her black bob, mirrored sunglasses, calm closed-mouth expression, black vinyl trench coat frozen mid-swing, silver chain harness, black gloves, and mid stride frozen pose with front foot lifted. Do not change her hair length, coat color, harness position, glove style, or stride angle. Coat hem and chain links remain fixed in their suspended arc. Cross Frame Rules: Keep the subject as the only person and main subject. Maintain the same frozen mid stride pose, wardrobe, and suspended raindrop field for all 15 seconds. No new figures enter the alley, no raindrops fall or reset, no duplicated limbs, no body warping, no coat re draping, no sudden pose change. The 360 camera orbit may reveal different sides of the alley, but the subject and raindrop field remain centered, stable, and fully readable. No on screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame. Movement: 15 seconds total. Subject remains locked mid stride, body held in suspended animation as if time paused around her alone. Micro motion: slow steady breathing visible in coat fabric, faint hair strands drifting almost imperceptibly, sunglasses catching shifting neon reflections as the camera moves, a single strand of chain swaying by a fraction of an inch. Environmental motion: frozen raindrops hold position but shimmer faintly with internal light refraction, distant signage glow pulses slowly, thin steam rises static frozen from a nearby grate, puddle surface holds a rippling reflection loop of the neon glow. Camera motion: one smooth 360 degree orbit around her over the full 15 seconds, gliding through gaps in the frozen raindrop field without disturbing them, circling from front stride view, around her side, past her back, and returning to the starting angle. Last Frame: At 15 seconds, the camera completes the 360 orbit and settles back near the original centered low angle composition. Subject remains frozen mid stride, coat suspended mid swing, sunglasses reflecting soft neon glow, raindrops still hanging motionless around her at every depth. Camera eases to a steady centered frame with no visible shake. No on screen text, no captions, no signage typography, no rendered text in the frame. World Plate: Narrow urban alley at night, wet black asphalt, aged brick walls, iron fire escapes, a single distant glowing sign shape with unreadable light bleed, thin static steam from a street grate, deep atmospheric haze softening the far end of the alley. Cold neon pink and cyan light mix with practical amber window glow from upper floors. The environment stays grounded and physically real, making the suspended rain feel clean, deliberate, and photographed rather than digitally generated. Sound Bed: Diegetic audio only: distant city hum, faint dripping from unfrozen gutter runoff, soft creak of a fire escape in wind, low electrical buzz from the neon sign, subtle fabric tension in the frozen coat, faint distant traffic murmur. No music, no soundtrack, no score, no lyrics. Capture Realism: Natural skin texture, matte skin under gloves, realistic vinyl coat sheen, believable chain metal weight, grounded wet asphalt reflections, soft neon highlight rolloff, lifted shadows in the brick shadows, mild 35mm grain, realistic frozen droplet light refraction, clean night exposure with controlled highlight bloom. Avoid AI gloss, plastic skin, over sharp puddle reflections, warped hands, melted chain links, duplicated body parts, crushed blacks, clipped highlights, and fake motion blur on the frozen rain. Camera Capture: 15 seconds, 24fps, 180 degree shutter, wide latitude cinema capture, smooth stabilized 360 degree orbit with subtle handheld breath, 35mm lens for full body environmental fashion framing, fine 35mm grain, soft highlight rolloff, cool neon and amber night color grade, realistic motion blur, stable subject tracking, and practical editorial realism.

entries.title: Miniature Tiny Person Parkour
entries.description: A macro-photography style prompt for a miniature athletic woman performing complex parkour moves through a convenience store with realistic physics.
entries.prompt:
STYLE: Miniature Tiny-Person FX, photorealistic live-action, cinematic macro photography, ultra-shallow depth of field, bright modern convenience store, realistic fluorescent lighting, ultra-detailed 8K, vertical 9:16, dynamic viral short-video style.

DURATION: 15 seconds.

SETTING: A huge modern convenience store packed with towering shelves of colorful snack bags, instant noodles, bottled drinks, soda cans, candy, cereal boxes, refrigerators, shopping baskets, and hanging price tags. Everything feels enormous from the perspective of a palm-sized woman.

CHARACTER: One athletic miniature woman (1:15 scale), identical appearance throughout: lightweight adventure jacket, cargo pants, sneakers, utility backpack, same face, hairstyle, proportions, and size in every shot.

00:00–00:03 — Snack Shelf Swing

Standing on a giant chip bag, she sprints and leaps toward a hanging price tag, grabs it with both hands, swings across the aisle, and launches onto the next shelf. The tag swings behind her.

Camera: Low-angle macro tracking.
SFX: Plastic crinkles, tiny footsteps, rushing air, swinging tag.

00:03–00:06 — Bottle Cap Parkour

She lands on a giant drink bottle and parkours across colorful bottle caps. One bottle wobbles beneath her; she regains balance and performs a forward flip onto the next shelf.

Camera: Fast side-tracking macro.
SFX: Footsteps, bottle creaks, liquid slosh, hard landings.

00:06–00:09 — Shopping Basket Zipline

She grabs a hanging promotional cord and ziplines above snacks and noodles. Releasing at the perfect moment, she lands inside a moving shopping basket among giant chocolate bars and noodle cups.

Camera: Overhead to low-angle transition.
SFX: Zipline whistle, wind, basket wheels, impact.

00:09–00:12 — Runaway Soda Can

A giant soda can rolls inside the basket. She jumps onto it, balances like a surfer, and rides it across the polished floor, narrowly avoiding shoppers' shoes, baskets, and scattered snacks.

Camera: Ultra-low floor-level macro tracking.
SFX: Rolling metal, wind, store ambience.

00:12–00:15 — Victory Finale

Using the rolling can as a launch ramp, she leaps to a freezer handle, swings up, and stands triumphantly on top of the freezer. The massive store stretches behind her as sparkling particles appear and large golden text reads:

"CHALLENGE COMPLETE"

She raises one fist while the camera slowly pulls back, emphasizing her tiny scale.

Camera: Cinematic pullback.
SFX: Leap whoosh, metallic grab, victory chime, sparkles, store ambience.

VISUAL REQUIREMENTS: Maintain a consistent 1:15 miniature scale, realistic physics, smooth continuous action, photorealistic packaging, authentic reflections, cinematic macro DOF, and consistent character identity. No animation, cartoons, narration, subtitles, outfit changes, or scale inconsistencies.

entries.title: Pixar-Style Football Grandma Animation
entries.description: A comprehensive multi-scene prompt for a 3D Pixar-style animation featuring a grandmother showcasing elite soccer skills in a backyard.
entries.prompt:
Pixar-quality 3D animation, highly expressive characters, warm cinematic lighting, colorful suburban backyard with World Cup decorations, exaggerated squash-and-stretch, playful camera movement, vibrant colors, ultra-detailed textures, no dialogue, expressive reactions only.

Scene 1 (0–4s)

Three energetic grandkids play an intense backyard soccer match. One attempts an ambitious bicycle kick and accidentally launches the ball toward Grandma. Grandma peacefully knits in a rocking chair under a tree, wearing glasses, cozy slippers, and a knitted cardigan, completely unaware. The kids freeze in horror as the camera follows the spinning ball toward her.

Scene 2 (4–8s)

Just before impact, Grandma casually lifts one slipper and effortlessly cushions the ball without looking up or stopping her knitting. She gently begins juggling with her slippers while continuing to knit perfectly. The rocking chair rocks naturally as the kids stare in disbelief. Birds stop, a squirrel freezes, and the camera slowly circles Grandma to emphasize how effortless she is.

Scene 3 (8–12s)

Without changing expression, Grandma escalates into impossible freestyle: around-the-world, rainbow flick, heel stall, neck stall, slipper rolls, and a tiny seated bicycle kick. She never misses a stitch or loses balance. The scarf keeps growing while everyone—including a neighbor and a confused golden retriever—watches in complete shock.

Scene 4 (12–15s)

Grandma casually volleys the ball without looking. It curves perfectly into the goal. The kids erupt in celebration and run toward her like she's a football legend. Grandma simply smiles, adjusts her glasses, keeps knitting, and gently rocks back and forth as the camera pulls back on the joyful backyard.

Animation Notes: Strong Pixar facial expressions, readable reactions, smooth soccer physics, only one soccer ball visible at all times exaggerated anticipation and follow-through, subtle secondary motion (fluttering yarn, rocking chair, leaves), wholesome comedy, no dialogue or subtitles, only ambient backyard sounds, ball impacts, knitting clicks, and uplifting orchestral music.

entries.title: Magic Popcorn Machine Transformation
entries.description: A sophisticated multi-shot prompt for a magical realism video where a popcorn machine transforms a photo into a real person.
entries.prompt:
时长：15秒
画幅：9:16竖屏
整体风格：照片级写实的魔幻现实主义爱情喜剧，轻松荒诞、节奏明快，真实电影摄影，温暖日光，人物表演自然，无字幕。

人物与道具：
@男主保持人物参考图100%一致，穿着清爽日常服装，性格憨厚、认真又有一点滑稽。
@女主保持人物参考图100%一致，女主真人与照片中的脸、发型、服装完全相同。
男主手中是一张普通亮面照片，照片上清晰呈现@女主的正面形象。
一台复古手摇爆米花机：黑色金属圆筒、黄铜把手、压力表、旋转支架和爆米花收集网袋，正常人类尺寸，具有真实重量和金属质感。

SHOT 1（0:00–0:04）
Subject：@男主、@女主照片、复古手摇爆米花机。
Action：0:00–0:01.5，男主站在温暖明亮的小院中，神神秘秘地左右看一眼，然后把@女主的照片举到镜头前。照片上的女主面容清晰，和稍后出现的真人完全一致。0:01.5–0:03，男主露出期待又认真的表情，把照片从爆米花机的小投放口塞进去，手指不能遮住照片上的脸。0:03–0:04，他快速关紧盖子，扣上金属锁扣，双手握住摇杆，身体前倾，准备发力。
Environment：带有生活气息的中式小院，木桌、矮墙、绿植和柔和阳光，背景简洁，没有围观人群。
Camera：35mm中景开始，轻微向前推进；展示照片时短暂切至50mm手部与照片特写，再回到男主和爆米花机的双主体中景。
Style：自然暖色喜剧电影质感，动作清楚，机器结构真实，照片内容稳定。
Constraints：照片上的女主必须和真人女主完全一致；照片只能有一张；机器大小和结构保持稳定；男主手指正常五指，不能遮挡照片脸部。

SHOT 2（0:04–0:09）
Subject：@男主与正在运转的复古爆米花机。
Action：0:04–0:06，男主双手握着机器摇杆，按照“咚、咚、摇、摇、摇、摇、摇”的节奏，用力来回摇动金属圆筒；机器具有明显重量，男主的肩膀、手臂和身体跟着节奏左右晃动。0:06–0:07.5，机器内部传出越来越密集的爆米花撞击声，压力表指针轻微抖动，盖子缝隙冒出少量白烟。男主停顿半拍，睁大眼睛，紧张地把身体向后缩。0:07.5–0:09，机器突然发出清脆有力的“嘣！”爆米花向上炸开，大量白色爆米花和蓬松白烟扑向镜头。男主受到惊吓，肩膀一抖，双臂本能地向前张开。烟雾必须迅速扩散并100%遮住机器、男主双手和背景，在完整烟雾遮挡期间隐藏硬切。
Environment：延续同一个小院，桌椅、墙面和光线位置保持一致。
Camera：28mm略低机位中全景，轻微手持跟随男主摇动，但不能剧烈晃动；爆开的瞬间快速小幅后拉，让爆米花和烟雾朝镜头飞来。
Style：真实重量感与夸张喜剧节奏结合；爆炸是安全、柔软的魔法爆米花效果，不是火药爆炸，不出现火焰和破坏。
Audio：金属锁扣声、沉重的“咚、咚”声、连续摇动声、机器内爆米花撞击声，以及清晰的“嘣！”；无背景音乐。
Constraints：爆米花只能从机器出口炸开；机器不能碎裂；没有火焰、危险冲击波或人物受伤；女主不得在烟雾完全遮屏前出现；禁止照片直接变成人、身体从机器小口畸形挤出或半个人挂在机器上。

SHOT 3（0:09–0:15）
Subject：@男主与从魔法烟雾中出现的@女主。
Action：0:09–0:10，浓密白烟和爆米花仍然覆盖大半画面。只在烟雾100%遮挡的瞬间，将照片隐藏硬切为全尺寸真人@女主。0:10–0:11.5，@女主从逐渐散开的白烟中被柔和地向前弹出，身体完整、比例正常，双腿自然屈起，双臂因惊讶轻轻张开；她不是从机器小口钻出来，而是直接从烟雾中央以完整真人形态出现。0:11.5–0:12.5，男主后退半步、屈膝卸力，一只手托住女主后背，另一只手托住她的膝弯，稳稳把她接成公主抱。女主先睁大眼睛愣住半拍，随后看向男主，惊讶地眨一下眼。0:12.5–0:13.5，爆米花像轻柔的白色花瓣一样从两人周围落下。男主确认自己真的抱住女主后，表情从紧张迅速变成欣喜若狂；女主略显无奈又忍不住微笑。0:13.5–0:15，男主继续稳稳抱着女主，转头直视摄影机，咧嘴笑着用普通话清晰说道：“哎呀，这下终于有女朋友了！”女主听见后转头看他，露出又好气又好笑的表情。最后停留在两人的完整双人中景，不淡出、不转黑。
Environment：烟雾散去后仍是同一个小院，爆米花落满地面和机器周围；爆米花机保持完整，位于两人身后。
Camera：烟雾揭开时使用35mm中景并自然拉焦；女主弹出时轻微后拉，完整容纳她的身体；男主接住后平滑推进到双人中近景，结尾稳定锁定两人的脸和拥抱姿势。
Performance：男主的惊吓、接住、确认、狂喜必须有清晰的表情递进；女主先错愕、眨眼，再露出无奈微笑。对白口型必须与普通话逐字同步，语气惊喜、憨厚、有喜剧停顿。
Audio：烟雾“噗”声、爆米花落地声、接住女主时的衣料摩擦声；男主对白清晰居中：“哎呀，这下终于有女朋友了！”女主不说话。无字幕，无背景音乐。
Constraints：@女主真人必须与照片及参考图100%一致；女主以完整正常比例从烟雾中出现，不能缩小、变大或从机器内部爬出；男主必须真实托住女主的后背和膝弯，手臂不能穿过身体；两人的手指、四肢和脸部结构正确；爆米花不得遮住最终表情；结尾不裁掉女主身体。

Negative：人物脸部扭曲，人脸变化，真人与照片不一致，身份漂移，服装漂移，多余肢体，多余手指，手指融合，断腕，手臂穿过身体，男女身体粘连，错误公主抱姿势，女主从狭小机器口畸形钻出，半截身体，女主尺寸异常，照片可见时直接变形，烟雾遮挡不足，两套状态同时出现，机器变形或碎裂，真实火焰，危险爆炸，烧伤，瞬移，背景突然变化，爆米花变成其他物体，塑料CG质感，卡通渲染，僵硬表演，口型不同步，双嘴，乱码文字，字幕，Logo，水印，镜头角度漂移，突然场景融化。
