entries.title: Psychological Horror Baby Monitor Scene
entries.description: A suspenseful psychological horror video prompt featuring a mother witnessing a double of herself on a baby monitor, utilizing dark domestic lighting and a slow handheld shot.
entries.prompt: 15 seconds, 16:9 cinematic, single continuous handheld shot following the character, minimal cuts (one hard cut at the hook moment for shock value), unhurried until the final beat. Global setup: Prestige psychological horror aesthetic. Warm domestic lighting turning cold and blue as dread builds. Setting: a quiet suburban house at night, a baby monitor screen glowing on a kitchen counter, hallway leading to a nursery visible in the background. Subject: a young mother, tired but calm, doing a late night check before bed. Ambient sound: soft house hum, distant white noise machine from the monitor, low ambient drone rising gradually, single sharp static burst at the hook moment. [0:00–0:03] She stands in the kitchen, glances casually at the baby monitor screen on the counter on it, the nursery looks normal, crib visible, nothing unusual. She yawns, reaches for a glass of water. Static ambient hum. [0:03–0:06] She looks at the monitor screen again and on it, she sees herself already standing inside the nursery next to the crib, even though she's still standing in the kitchen. She freezes, eyes locking on the screen, confused rather than instantly terrified. [0:06–0:09] Hard cut: extreme close up on the monitor screen the \"her\" inside the nursery slowly turns to face the camera on the screen, tilts its head unnaturally slow. Sharp static burst sound. [0:09–0:12] Cut back to her in the kitchen, breathing faster now, she looks up from the monitor toward the dark hallway leading to the nursery, torn between checking and staying frozen in place. [0:12–0:15] She takes one slow step toward the hallway, camera pushing in tight on her face, hallway light flickers once she doesn't move again. Sound cuts to complete silence. Fade to black. Style: restrained psychological horror, no jump-scare overload, no gore, no visible monster dread built through wrongness and implication, believable naturalistic acting. Constraints: consistent character appearance and setting throughout, the \"double\" on the monitor stays ambiguous and unexplained, no distorted anatomy, no text overlays, tension escalates through pacing rather than shock.

entries.title: POV Suspense Anime Chase
entries.description: A cinematic Japanese anime prompt for a suspenseful point-of-view chase scene between a girl and a cat, featuring high-quality 2D animation and dynamic camera movements.
entries.prompt:
[主役キャラ] =  黒髪の女の子
[相手/対象] = 白い猫
[舞台] =サスペンス要素のある暗くて大きい家の中

【動画スタイル】
15秒。日本のフルカラーアニメ。予算5億円規模の高密度2Dアニメーション。高速カット、強い低角度、急速プッシュイン、横移動トラッキング、マッチカット。字幕なし、透かしなし、BGMあり。音は足音、息、衣擦れ、環境音、最後の短い一言だけ。

【映像構成】
[相手/対象]の主観カメラで、[主役キャラ]に追われる。普通の追いかけっこではなく、[主役キャラ]は走り続けず、画面の先回りをする。[異常ギミック]が全ショットをつなぎ、最後に[主役キャラ]がレンズのすぐ近くで静かに勝つ。

【Shot 1：2秒フック】
低い主観視点。[舞台]の床すれすれから始まる。画面端に[主役キャラ]の足元だけが入る。[異常ギミック]が一瞬だけ前景を横切る。

【Shot 2：逃走開始】
[相手/対象]が急に後退して逃げる。カメラは手持ちの揺れを少し残したまま床近くを滑る。足音が速くなる。

【Shot 3：先回り】
曲がり角を抜けた瞬間、遠くの廊下中央に[主役キャラ]がもう立っている。カメラは一瞬だけ止まり、すぐ横へ逃げる。

【Shot 4：障害物の下】
机、ソファ、手すり、など低い隙間をすり抜ける。[異常ギミック]が隙間の奥で光り、追跡方向を示す。

【Shot 5：上からの俯瞰】
真上からの高速カット。[相手/対象]の逃走ルートを見せる。

【Shot 6：一瞬の安心】
[相手/対象]が物陰に隠れる。音が消える。カメラは固定され、画面の奥だけが静かに暗くなる。

【Shot 7：発見】
ピントが手前から奥へ移動し、そこに[主役キャラ]がいる。[主役キャラ]は大きく動かず、目だけでこちらを見る。

【Shot 8：終わりの一言】
急速なクローズアップ。[主役キャラ]がレンズのすぐ近くで短く可愛い声で「みぃつけた♪」と言う。最後のフレームは笑顔で静止。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Main Character] = Girl with black hair
[Target/Subject] = White cat
[Setting] = Inside a large, dark house with suspenseful elements

[Video Style]
15 seconds. Japanese full-color anime. High-density 2D animation with a 500 million yen budget feel. Fast cuts, strong low angles, rapid push-ins, lateral tracking, match cuts. No subtitles, no watermarks, with BGM. Sounds include footsteps, breathing, rustling clothes, ambient noise, and one short final phrase.

[Visual Composition]
Subjective POV camera of the [Target/Subject], being chased by the [Main Character]. Instead of a normal chase, the [Main Character] doesn't just run but gets ahead of the camera. An [Abnormal Gimmick] connects all shots, and finally, the [Main Character] wins quietly close to the lens.

[Shot 1: 2-Second Hook]
Low POV. Starts from the floor of the [Setting]. Only the feet of the [Main Character] enter the edge of the frame. An [Abnormal Gimmick] crosses the foreground for a moment.

[Shot 2: Escape Starts]
[Target/Subject] suddenly retreats to flee. The camera slides near the floor with slight handheld shakiness. Footsteps speed up.

[Shot 3: Getting Ahead]
As soon as turning a corner, the [Main Character] is already standing in the middle of a distant hallway. The camera stops for a moment then escapes to the side.

[Shot 4: Under Obstacles]
Passing through low gaps like tables, sofas, or handrails. The [Abnormal Gimmick] glows deep in the gap, indicating the pursuit direction.

[Shot 5: High Angle Bird's Eye]
High-speed cut from directly above. Shows the escape route of the [Target/Subject].

[Shot 6: Moment of Relief]
[Target/Subject] hides behind an object. Sound cuts out. Camera is fixed, only the back of the screen quietly darkens.

[Shot 7: Discovery]
Focus shifts from foreground to background, where the [Main Character] is located. The [Main Character] doesn't move much, just looks here with their eyes.

[Shot 8: Final Word]
Rapid close-up. The [Main Character] says 'Found you♪' in a short, cute voice very close to the lens. The final frame is a still image with a smile.

entries.title: Convenience Store Raccoon and Pug Comedy
entries.description: A humorous video prompt featuring a smooth-talking raccoon con-man and a suspicious security pug in a convenience store at night, complete with dialogue and physical comedy.
entries.prompt: 15-second ultra-realistic comedy short, photorealistic live-action style, harsh fluorescent store lighting with neon spill, high detail fur and whiskers, realistic physics, smooth motion, cinematic camera work, funny animal voices with expressive faces. Setting: a small 24-hour convenience store at night, fluorescent overhead lighting mixed with neon window signs glowing outside, cramped snack aisles, a humming drink fridge, a counter with a lottery display, light rain visible through the glass storefront. Dialogue (spoken naturally with funny voices): Ziggy (smooth con-man voice): \"Evening, officer. Lovely fluorescents tonight.\" Sarge (gravelly, suspicious): \"Paws where I can see 'em.\" Ziggy (offended): \"This? I'm just holding it.\" Sarge (barking into radio): \"10-31! DONUT DOWN!\" Deb (flat monotone): \"Not my problem.\" Shot-by-shot timing: [0-3s] Low tracking shot down a snack aisle: a plump grey raccoon with a black bandit mask marking, wearing a tiny open Hawaiian shirt, with remarkably dexterous little black hands, strolls casually while one hand — behind his back — juggles a glazed donut. He nods at the camera: \"Evening, officer. Lovely fluorescents tonight.\" [3-6s] Whip-pan to a stocky fawn-colored pug with a black wrinkled face, wearing a tiny navy-blue security vest with a gold \"SECURITY\" badge and a small utility belt with a mini flashlight, standing at the end of the aisle, flashlight beam hitting Ziggy's face like an interrogation lamp. Sarge growls: \"Paws where I can see 'em.\" [6-9s] Close-up: Ziggy slowly raises both empty hands — while his tail, curled behind him, is visibly holding the donut. He says, deeply offended: \"This? I'm just holding it.\" [9-12s] The donut slips off the tail, rolls down the aisle in a perfect line like a wheel, realistic wobble physics. Both animals watch it, frozen. Then Sarge scrambles after it, tiny legs sliding on polished floor, barking into a shoulder radio: \"10-31! DONUT DOWN!\" [12-14s] Quick cutaway: a scruffy grey Virginia opossum wearing a red employee vest with a crooked name tag reading \"DEB\" watches the donut roll past the counter, deadpan, and says: \"Not my problem.\" The donut rolls out the automatic door into the rain. [14-15s] Freeze-frame hero shot: Sarge and Ziggy side by side at the open door, both staring into the rain at the lost donut, equally devastated. Text overlay optional: \"Nobody won tonight.\" Global style: Extremely realistic fur, whisker, and skin details, harsh fluorescent store lighting with soft neon spill from window signs, realistic reflections on the polished floor and fridge glass, subtle dust particles in light beams, flawless physics for all objects, highly expressive animal faces, comedic timing, 4K photoreal quality, no deformities.

entries.title: Miniature Bakery Pancake Tower
entries.description: An elaborate macro video prompt describing a miniature world where tiny chefs work on a massive stack of pancakes, featuring complex continuous camera movements.
entries.prompt:
A cinematic 10-second macro video inside a miniature bakery world built around a towering stack of fluffy golden pancakes covered with flowing honey, fresh strawberries, blueberries, mint leaves and powdered sugar. Tiny chefs continuously work without stopping, each performing a unique task. The camera movement is one continuous shot with no jump cuts or abrupt transitions.

The video opens with a smooth cinematic push-in from a medium-wide macro view toward the pancake tower. As the camera approaches, warm honey slowly drips over the pancakes while one chef pours fresh honey from a tiny bucket. The camera continues its forward movement and naturally begins a gentle clockwise orbit around the stack.

Without cutting, the orbit becomes faster as the camera glides past a chef carefully placing blueberries onto the honey-covered pancakes. Continuing the same motion path, the camera swoops slightly downward and circles upward to reveal another chef arranging sliced strawberries and fresh mint leaves on the top pancake.

The camera flows seamlessly toward the opposite side of the stack, passing close beside dripping honey before revealing a chef sweeping spilled powdered sugar from the tabletop. Maintaining the same continuous movement, the camera performs a dramatic low FPV fly-through between scattered berries and miniature tools, passing a chef pushing a wooden cart loaded with fresh strawberries and blueberries.

The movement rises smoothly into a higher orbit, revealing another chef dusting powdered sugar from a ladder while honey glistens under warm golden light. The camera continues its uninterrupted circular flight, weaving naturally between ladders, scaffolding and workers, creating beautiful parallax while every chef remains busy with their own task.

For the final seconds the orbit widens into a spectacular cinematic 360-degree hero shot around the completed pancake tower. Honey cascades down every layer, berries shine with fresh moisture, powdered sugar floats through the air, all miniature chefs continue working simultaneously, warm bakery atmosphere, shallow depth of field, macro photography, volumetric lighting, smooth FPV drone movement, elegant speed ramps, cinematic motion blur, ultra-realistic textures, premium food commercial quality, seamless continuous camera movement, no cuts, no text, no logos, 9:16.

entries.title: Abandoned Factory Dream Sequence
entries.description: A surreal cinematic video concept involving glass jars of dreams in an industrial setting, though the author notes it was generated using a different model.
entries.prompt:
A gigantic abandoned factory stretches into darkness, filled with conveyor belts, rusted machines, hanging cables, and thousands of glass jars containing glowing fragments of dreams. The lighting is industrial green and sickly amber, with steam leaking from old pipes.

Opening frame: slow dolly through the factory floor. Machines are still moving even though no workers are present. Conveyor belts carry strange objects: a child’s red shoe, a miniature moon, a burning letter, a tiny sleeping city inside a jar.

At the 2-second mark, one glass jar cracks.

A dream escapes.

It leaks into the air as glowing vapor, forming a floating doorway to an impossible childhood bedroom. Then more jars begin cracking across the factory. Dreams spill out everywhere ,oceans flooding metal floors, birds made of paper flying through sparks, giant hands pressing against the walls from the other side of sleep.

The camera follows the escaped dream vapor as it moves through the machinery. Every machine transforms what it touches: gears grind memories into dust, pistons compress nightmares into black cubes, conveyor belts stretch into infinite roads.

VFX escalation: the entire factory begins producing dreams uncontrollably. Machines speed up, sparks become stars, smoke becomes human faces, and the ceiling opens into a vast sleeping sky.

Velocity ramp: a glass jar explodes in slow motion, releasing a miniature storm containing a full city inside it.

Final moment: the camera reaches the central machine , a giant mechanical heart pumping blue light ,and all dreams collapse into it at once, causing the factory to blink like an eye.

Industrial surrealism, dream manufacturing, glowing vapor simulations, mechanical poetry, rust textures, cinematic darkness, 4K.

Made in @Hailuo_AI

entries.title: 1980s Tokyo Bubble Era VHS Video Prompt
entries.description: A comprehensive cinematic prompt designed for Seedance, creating a nostalgic 1980s Tokyo street scene with a distinct VHS home-video aesthetic and detailed character movement across multiple time-coded segments.
entries.prompt:
Main subject: a beautiful young Japanese woman, early 20s, delicate pretty features, sleek glossy black hair, long and smooth with soft side-swept bangs (NOT permed, NOT frizzy), tasteful natural makeup. 1980s Tokyo street fashion — a bright oversized blazer over a high-waisted skirt, gold hoop earrings, charming warm expression. Maintain the exact same identity, hairstyle, and outfit throughout.

Visual Style: authentic 1980s VHS home-video look — heavy tape grain, visible scanlines, chromatic color bleeding, blooming highlights, warm faded nostalgic colors, a small on-screen date stamp in the corner, occasional soft tracking wobble. Strong retro-vintage feeling.

Camera Style: 1980s camcorder held by a friend, MOSTLY STEADY with only a gentle natural float — light sway, no violent shaking, no fast whip movements. Slow casual reframing.

FIRST HALF — DAYTIME (bustling bubble-era Tokyo streets):
00:00–00:02 A busy 1980s Shibuya daytime street. She walks toward the camera through period pedestrians, boxy cars and hand-painted shop signs behind her, smiling. HARD CUT.
00:02–00:04 Outside a record shop, she flips through vinyl records, then grabs a canned drink from a retro vending machine. HARD CUT.
00:04–00:06 A quiet Showa backstreet with potted plants and a pay phone; she crouches to pet a stray cat. HARD CUT.
00:06–00:08 A wide crosswalk under an elevated train line, city-pop energy, she waits and glances at the camera. HARD CUT.

SECOND HALF — NIGHT (dazzling Shinjuku / Roppongi neon):
00:08–00:10 A neon-drenched Shinjuku Kabukicho alley, glowing kanji signboards everywhere, she walks looking up at the bright lights. HARD CUT.
10:10–00:12 A Roppongi crossing at night, dazzling neon, taxis passing, she laughs toward the camera as light reflections wash over her face. HARD CUT.
00:12–00:13 Close shot under a huge glowing neon sign, colorful light on her face. HARD CUT.
00:13–00:15 She walks away down a vibrant neon street, glances back with a small warm smile, then the recording cuts to VHS static and black.

Environment details throughout: retro vending machines, glowing neon kanji signboards, pay phones, boxy 1980s taxis and kei cars, elevated trains, arcade lights, izakaya paper lanterns, dense overhead wires — nostalgic bubble-era Tokyo.

Audio: natural ambient only — city crowd, passing trains, traffic, arcade beeps, faint 1980s city-pop drifting from a storefront, footsteps. No narration, no added soundtrack.

Goal: a beautiful, nostalgic 1980s Tokyo day-to-night street video that feels like a treasured VHS home movie from Japan's bubble era.

Scene:
An Indian girl is on a rooftop during the rain, quickly picking up clothes that were left to dry on a wire. She looks slightly rushed because it is raining and she is trying to save the clothes from getting wetter. She reaches toward the clothesline, grabs one or two pieces of clothing, pulls them off the wire, gathers them in her arms, and looks focused while moving naturally.

Action timing:
0-1 second:
She stands near the clothesline on the rooftop in the rain, reaching toward the hanging clothes.
1-3 seconds:
She quickly removes clothes from the wire, one after another, with natural hurried movements.
3-5 seconds:
She gathers the clothes in her arms and continues pulling down the remaining item, looking mildly urgent because of the rain.

Camera:
Single continuous shot. Medium-wide framing. Slightly cinematic and stable. No cuts.

Environment:
Typical Indian rooftop, cloudy sky, visible rainfall, damp concrete floor, nearby houses or buildings visible in the background, realistic wet atmosphere.

Performance:
She should feel natural, focused, and slightly hurried. Not overdramatic. Just a realistic reaction to unexpected rain while collecting drying clothes.

Style:
Realistic, cinematic, natural daylight, believable rain, smooth body movement, authentic Indian setting.

Important constraints:
- Keep the same girl identity and outfit as the reference image
- Keep the same rooftop environment
- Clothes should be hanging on a wire
- It must be raining throughout the video
- Her action should clearly be picking up clothes from the rooftop clothesline
- No extra people
- No subtitles
- No text on screen
- No distorted hands or limbs
- No scene cuts

entries.title: Japanese Shitamachi Neighborhood Slice-of-Life
entries.description: A beautifully detailed cinematic vlog-style prompt for Seedance 2.0, depicting a serene afternoon in a quiet Japanese neighborhood with unhurried transitions.
entries.prompt:
SUBJECT : Young Japanese woman, early 20s, natural refined everyday look. Oversized cream cardigan over a white tee, wide-leg light denim, plain leather loafers, hair in a low loose ponytail with a few soft strands framing her face. Minimal makeup, realistic skin, calm and warm reflective presence. Keep her identity, clothing, and hair consistent all the way through.
SETTING: A quiet Japanese shitamachi neighborhood, soft overcast late afternoon. Narrow lanes
between low houses, potted plants along the doorsteps, a small canal with a low
footbridge, power lines overhead, a parked mamachari, a quiet corner shrine, a red
mailbox on the corner. Lived-in and peaceful — no stores, no crowds, no tourists.
LOOK: Cinematic slice-of-life vlog. Composed, intentional framing, quiet and observational.
Soft muted natural tones, cool and gentle, realistic skin. Shallow depth of field,
fine film grain, soft natural light. Smooth cinematic camera movement throughout —
calm, unhurried, letting each moment breathe.
SEQUENCE: [0–3s]
She rides a mamachari slowly down the quiet lane, cardigan and loose strands drifting
in the breeze. The camera travels beside her, power lines sliding past overhead.
sound: soft bicycle wheels / distant cicadas / gentle wind / faint neighborhood ambience
[3–5s]
She stops at the low footbridge over the canal, rests her arms on the railing, and
gazes down at the still water. The camera moves gently toward her and past her shoulder
to the water.
sound: quiet water / cicadas / a faraway train / soft wind
[5–8s]
She sits on the shrine steps, opens a small notebook, and writes something slowly,
pausing to think. The camera moves evenly around her, focus soft on her hands then
her face.
sound: pen on paper / cicadas softening / wind through leaves / distant wind chime
[8–11s]
She crouches by a doorway and gently lifts a red furin wind chime, watching it turn.
The camera rises slowly from the chime up to her face.
sound: single clear furin chime / soft breeze / cicadas / faint chatter
[11–13s]
She walks along the lane holding a cold canned tea, the red mailbox passing softly
behind her. The camera moves ahead of her at an even pace, keeping her centered.
sound: unhurried footsteps / cicadas / distant bicycle bell / wind
[13–15s]
She reaches a quiet stone stairway, climbs the first steps, and glances back over her
shoulder with a small calm smile before continuing up into the softening light.
sound: footsteps on stone / cicadas / soft wind / slow fade
AUDIO: Natural ambient only — summer cicadas, quiet canal water, a distant train, wind through
the power lines, a single furin chime, unhurried footsteps, faint neighborhood ambience.
FEEL: A serene, composed afternoon in a quiet Japanese neighborhood — smooth, warm in feeling
but cool in tone, an unhurried and beautiful slice of everyday life.

entries.title: Argentina Fan World Cup Celebration
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for generating a sports-themed video of an Argentina fan celebrating at the FIFA World Cup final, focusing on facial consistency and stadium atmosphere.
entries.prompt:
Reference Character: Use the exact woman from the reference image. Same face, same hairstyle, same Argentina #10 jersey, same earrings, same youthful appearance. Preserve identity consistency throughout the entire video. Scene: FIFA World Cup Final atmosphere. Night match. Fully packed stadium with 80,000+ Argentina fans. Giant flags waving everywhere. Stadium lights glowing. Blue-and-white confetti ready to explode. Ultra-cinematic realism. Audio Design: Authentic stadium ambience, crowd chants, football kicks, commentator voice, whistles, roaring fans, drums. 

0s–3s Extreme wide aerial stadium shot. Argentina attacks the penalty area. Crowd standing nervously. Camera flies through thousands of waving Argentina flags. Loud crowd chanting: "Argentina! Argentina!" Football passing sounds. Commentator: "Argentina building up here..." 

3s–6s Cut to medium close-up of the woman. She is sitting in the stands holding an Argentina flag. Beautiful nervous smile. Hair moving naturally in the stadium wind. Slow cinematic push-in. Crowd noise rising. Commentator: "Messi... finds space..." 

6s–9s POV angle from her eyes toward the pitch. Striker receives the ball. Loud football kick sound. Fast zoom toward goal. Crowd gasps. Commentator screaming: "SHOOOTS!" 

9s–12s Goal scored. Net ripples dramatically. Massive stadium eruption. Camera shake from crowd reaction. Fireworks begin. Commentator screaming: "GOOOOOOOOOAAAAAL ARGENTINAAAAAA!" Huge roar. 

12s–15s Close-up of her face. Her eyes widen. Instant pure joy. She jumps from her seat. Huge genuine smile. Hair flying. Flags waving around her. Slow motion mixed with real-time speed ramp. Confetti explodes behind her.

Part 2 Prompt: 
Continue with the same woman and same stadium. Increase excitement level dramatically.

15s–18s Low-angle hero shot. She raises both hands high. Argentina flags everywhere. Thousands of fans jumping. Camera rotates around her 360°. Crowd screaming. Drums beating. 

18s–21s Ultra close-up. Beautiful laughing smile. She shouts: "Vamos Argentina!" Face glowing under stadium lights. Confetti falling in foreground. Shallow depth of field. 

21s–24s Fast handheld fan-perspective shot. She hugs nearby supporters. Everyone celebrating wildly. Flags covering the frame. Commentator: "What a moment for Argentina!" Massive crowd roar. 

24s–27s Cinematic drone shot. Entire stadium illuminated. Blue-and-white fireworks. Camera rapidly dives from the sky toward her section. Fans bouncing in unison. Chants echoing throughout the arena. 

27s–30s Epic final sequence. Alternating shots every second: Front close-up smile Side profile cheering Flag waving overhead Laughing with crowd Looking toward the pitch Slow-motion victory moment Final frame: She raises the Argentina flag high above her head. Huge radiant smile. Confetti storm. Fireworks filling the sky. Commentator screaming: "Argentina fans will remember this forever!" Crowd chant fades out: "Ole Ol"

entries.title: Surreal Mirror Lake Temporal Cinema
entries.description: A surreal video prompt depicting a mirror-like lake in a mountain valley at dawn, showing impossible alternate versions of the landscape and future selves beneath the surface.
entries.prompt:
A vast mirror-like lake sits in the middle of a silent mountain valley at dawn. The water is perfectly reflective, showing not the sky above but alternate versions of the landscape: cities that do not exist, forests that have not grown yet, ruins from futures that may never happen.

Opening frame: slow aerial descent toward the lake surface. Mist moves gently across the water. The real mountains above are cold and grey, but their reflection is filled with impossible golden architecture.

At the 2-second mark, the reflection moves before the real world does.

A future version of a person appears under the water, walking upside down beneath the surface. Then dozens of future selves appear ,older, younger, wounded, joyful, faceless , all moving in different directions beneath the lake.

The camera descends through the water surface without a splash, entering the reflected world. Underwater, there is no water ,only an inverted valley where time flows in visible currents. Memories fall from the sky like leaves. Roads grow out of people’s shadows. Mountains slowly turn into buildings, then back into mountains.

VFX escalation: the different futures begin colliding. A futuristic city rises through an ancient forest. A ruined bridge repairs itself while simultaneously collapsing. The lake surface above fractures like glass, revealing the real world watching from the other side.

Velocity ramp: a future self reaches toward the camera ,time slows as their hand breaks into thousands of reflective shards, each shard showing a different life.

Final moment: the camera rises back above the lake. The surface is still again. Only one word appears as ripples across the water: CHOOSE.

Experimental time-reflection cinema, mirror water physics, alternate futures, surreal temporal landscapes, dawn mist, cinematic poetry, 4K.

entries.title: Street Musician Magical Realism Film
entries.description: A magical realism prompt for a street performance video featuring an older musician whose violin music causes subtle, impossible environmental changes in a cobblestone square.
entries.prompt: 15 second cinematic video, 16:9 aspect ratio. Single continuous handheld POV shot with smooth dreamlike transitions and no hard cuts. A surreal magical realism street performance film set in a quiet cobblestone city square at dusk. Soft anamorphic lens, subtle lens flare, slow handheld drift, shallow depth of field, warm painterly color grade. String lights hang overhead, with a few scattered onlookers nearby. An older street musician in a weathered coat sits on a wooden crate, playing a violin. His appearance, clothing, hands, and violin remain consistent and realistic throughout. As he plays, the weather and light around him subtly respond to the music, impossible but treated as completely natural. Ambient sound: emotional live violin melody, distant city hum, gentle wind. 0:00–0:03 He draws the bow across the strings, eyes closed, fully absorbed. As the first note rings out, a single leaf detaches from a nearby tree and slowly drifts upward instead of down, catching the streetlight. The camera slowly pushes in toward his face. 0:03–0:06 The music quickens. Soft ripples of wind swirl around his feet, gently lifting loose papers and flower petals from a nearby cart into a slow spiral above the crowd. Onlookers watch with quiet delight, not fear. The camera smoothly pans across their faces. 0:06–0:09 He plays a soaring high note. The streetlights above dim and flicker, then bloom into a soft shower of glowing ember-like particles drifting like fireflies. A child reaches up to touch one, and it dissolves into light. The camera slowly dollies around the musician. 0:09–0:12 The melody slows. The petals and glowing embers gently settle. For a brief moment, light rain begins to fall upward, evaporating into mist just above head height and catching the last orange light of dusk. The camera pulls back into a wider view. 0:12–0:15 He finishes the final note and opens his eyes. Everything returns to stillness, becoming an ordinary square again. He smiles faintly, bows his head, and his open violin case rests at his feet for tips. Fade to black. Style notes: grounded human performance, subtle atmospheric magic, no CGI heavy spectacle, warm cinematic realism, physically plausible handheld camera movement, no distorted hands, no broken violin anatomy, no text overlays. Audio: soft emotional violin music, gentle city ambience, light wind. No vocals, no dialogue, no lyrics.

entries.title: Retro Egyptian God Animation
entries.description: A stylized 1980s retro OVA animation prompt featuring Egyptian gods Anubis and Sobek in a comedic strength trial inside a royal palace.
entries.prompt: Hand-drawn detailed animation, retro 1980s OVA style. Ancient Egyptian royal palace interior, warm torchlight, carved stone pillars, gold ornaments, cinematic shadows. Dramatic 16:9 scene, expressive acting, smooth motion. No subtitles, no text, no logo, no watermark. English dialogue only. Deep powerful voices. Anubis: muscular jackal-headed god, arm rings, neck collar. Sobek: muscular crocodile-headed god with tail, arm rings. Pharaoh: human ruler, calm and commanding. Scene 1 — Strength Trial Inside the palace, Anubis and Sobek stand one meter apart, each holding a massive stone block overhead. Both strain with tense faces and shaking arms. The Pharaoh walks slowly in front of them, hands behind his back, observing. He says: “Only one of you may join me on the next mission. Only the strongest.” Scene 2 — Sobek’s Trick Sobek suddenly smirks. He glances sideways at Anubis while keeping his stone raised. His tail quietly stretches toward Anubis’s armpit. Anubis stays focused, staring forward. Scene 3 — Ticklish Close-Up Close-up of Sobek’s tail tip gently brushing Anubis’s armpit. Anubis tries to stay serious but begins suppressing deep laughter. Scene 4 — Anubis Breaks Close-up of Anubis struggling. His eyes squeeze shut, his grin grows wider, and his body trembles as Sobek keeps tickling him. He fights to keep the stone overhead. Scene 5 — Sobek Wins Anubis bursts into loud laughter, loses control, throws the stone behind him, hugs himself, and falls to the floor curled up laughing. Sobek stands proudly, still holding his stone overhead. Scene 6 — Final Judgment The Pharaoh nods to Sobek and says: “It seems you are the one.” Sobek stands victorious. Anubis remains on the floor, still giggling.

entries.title: Realistic 2000s Chinese DV Vlog
entries.description: A meticulous prompt for simulating an early 2000s Chinese home video aesthetic, featuring a young woman in a traditional southern residential area with low-fidelity digital camera characteristics.
entries.prompt:
主要角色：
年轻中国女性，22岁左右，普通但耐看的长相，自然淡妆，没有网红妆感。褪色的炭灰色无袖露脐背心，宽松浅蓝色高腰水洗牛仔裤，黑色帆布鞋，黑色编织细绳项链。黑色长发扎成略显凌乱的低马尾，额前几缕碎发自然垂落。真实皮肤纹理，略带夏天晒出的健康肤色，笑容自然亲切，不摆拍。整个视频中保持一致的人物身份、服装、发型和外貌。

地点：
中国南方普通居民区（类似广东、福建、江西、浙江老城区），下午三四点的夏天。

狭窄的水泥巷子，两三层自建房，外墙略有岁月痕迹，绿色防盗门，老式铝合金窗户，防盗网，空调外机，电动车，自行车，竹竿晾衣架，晾晒的床单和衣服，塑料花盆，绿植，电线杆和密集架空电线，大树投下摇曳树影。

没有商业街，没有广告牌，没有奶茶店，没有咖啡馆，没有游客，没有摆拍，没有现代网红元素。

视觉风格：
超现实纪录片真实感。
像2002—2008年家庭DV摄像机随手拍摄。
没有剧情，没有表演，没有刻意镜位。
真实生活碎片。
人物动作具有生活随机性。
大量真实世界细节。
像小时候家里DV留下来的录像。

摄影风格：
2000年代初消费级DV摄像机画质。
强烈手持抖动。
自动曝光不断调整。
自动对焦频繁拉风箱。
轻微运动模糊。
滚动快门。
CCD数码相机色彩。
轻微软编码压缩伪影。
略偏暖的白平衡。
轻微噪点。
低动态范围。
画面偶尔轻微过曝。
没有稳定器。
没有电影运镜。
没有无人机镜头。
没有现代HDR。
没有电影调色。
没有胶片滤镜。
⸻
00:00–00:02
一栋普通中国居民楼门口。
她坐在低矮的水泥台阶上，双手举起整理马尾。
夏天微风吹起几缕碎发。
镜头自动寻找焦点，略微虚焦后恢复。
⸻
00:02–00:04
她沿着狭窄居民小巷慢慢走着。
路边摆着各种盆栽和电动车。
一只流浪橘猫从墙角走出来。
她笑着蹲下。
摄像机因为跟拍而构图略偏。
⸻
00:04–00:06
她轻轻抚摸流浪猫。
拿出一点猫粮放在地上。
自动对焦不断在人物和猫之间切换。
阳光透过树叶形成不断变化的光斑。
⸻
00:06–00:08
居民楼前的小院。
她站在竹竿晾衣架前晒衣服。
床单和衣服随风轻轻摆动。
天空飘过一片云，曝光短暂降低。
⸻
00:08–00:10
她坐在自家门口的小院里。
手里拿着一个白色陶瓷茶杯。
安静望着居民区。
偶尔把头发拨到耳后。
镜头轻轻漂移。
⸻
00:10–00:12
近距离侧脸。
远处邻居喊了一声：
“回来啦？”
她回头挥挥手，
自然笑着回答：
“嗯，刚回来。”
摄像机慢半拍才跟过去。
⸻
00:12–00:15
她端着茶杯慢慢走在树荫覆盖的小路上。
发现镜头后，
露出一个不好意思的小笑容，
随后继续向前走。
录像突然结束，
画面直接黑屏，
像DV摄像机关机一样。
⸻
音频：
只有真实环境声：
夏季蝉鸣。
远处电动车经过。
偶尔狗叫。
树叶沙沙声。
居民聊天声。
锅碗瓢盆碰撞声。
猫叫。
脚步踩在水泥地上的声音。
风吹晾衣服的声音。
没有背景音乐。
没有音效设计。
没有旁白。
⸻
目标：
呈现一段仿佛2003—2008年中国普通家庭DV摄像机拍下来的生活录像，真实、自然、不完美，没有表演痕迹，没有网红感，没有电影感，没有AI感，让观众第一眼误以为是一段多年后重新翻出来的旧家庭录像。

entries.title: Intimate Emotional Drama Scene
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt for an emotional drama scene featuring a woman looking at an old photograph, with detailed instructions for acting and lighting.
entries.prompt: 15 seconds, 16:9 cinematic, single continuous handheld close up shot, slow subtle push-in, no cuts. Global setup: Intimate emotional drama scene, soft natural lighting from a nearby window, slightly desaturated color grade, shallow depth of field with soft background blur. Setting: a quiet living room at dusk, muted blue grey light mixing with a single warm lamp. Subject: a woman in her late 20s, simple clothing, seated on the edge of a couch, holding something small in her hands (an old photograph). Ambient sound: quiet room tone, her breathing, soft distant rain against a window, faint melancholic piano underneath. [0:00–0:03] She sits still, looking down at the photograph in her hands, eyes glistening, jaw tightening as she tries to hold composure. Slow push-in on her face. [0:03–0:06] Her breath catches, a single tear falls, voice trembling, she says quietly, "I just... I wasn't ready to say goodbye." She wipes her cheek quickly, almost embarrassed by the tear. [0:06–0:09] She looks up briefly, eyes red, voice breaking further, "Everyone keeps saying it gets easier. It doesn't feel like that yet." A shaky exhale, she presses her lips together. [0:09–0:12] She looks back down at the photo, thumb gently tracing its edge, whispers, "I just miss you. That's all." Her shoulders drop slightly, a quiet release of tension rather than a breakdown. [0:12–0:15] She closes her eyes, takes a slow breath, holds the photograph to her chest, a faint sad smile forming despite the tears. Soft fade to black. Style: naturalistic acting, realistic tears and skin tone, restrained emotional performance (not exaggerated), cinematic but grounded, no over stylized filters. Constraints: consistent character appearance and lighting throughout, natural lip sync to dialogue, no distorted facial features, no text overlays, subtle and believable emotional pacing throughout

entries.title: Rural African Village Life Documentary
entries.description: A detailed narrative video prompt for Seedance 2.0 capturing a slice-of-life morning in an African village with a realistic handheld camcorder aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Main Subject:

Young African woman, early 20s, native to the region. Warm brown skin with realistic skin texture, minimal to no makeup. She has dark hair tied in a simple low ponytail with a few loose strands. She wears a faded sleeveless light-colored blouse, a simple long wrap skirt with a faded colorful pattern, and worn sandals. Small beaded bracelet on one wrist. Warm, approachable, and grounded personality. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout the entire video.
Location:
Authentic rural African village during a calm late morning. Dirt paths, simple mud-brick and concrete block houses with corrugated metal or thatched roofs, scattered trees and vegetation, chickens roaming freely, low stick fences, laundry hanging on lines, plastic basins, simple wooden benches, and water containers. Quiet village atmosphere with natural daily life. No modern buildings or urban elements.
Visual Style:
Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior. Natural body language. Unscripted slice-of-life feeling. Strong environmental authenticity. Rich real-world details and believable human motion.
Camera Style:
Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. Friend casually recording everyday moments. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, frequent autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping when moving between sun and shade, occasional motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise. No stabilization. No cinematic camera moves. No modern color grading.

00:00–00:02Outside a small village house. She sits on a low wooden bench adjusting her ponytail with both hands. A light breeze moves loose strands of hair. She smiles naturally while the camera struggles to hold focus.
00:02–00:04The camera follows her as she walks along a dirt path through the village. She notices a chicken running freely nearby and slows down to watch it. Framing drifts slightly as the operator tries to keep up.

entries.title: Takeshi's Castle Roller Game Recreation
entries.description: A comprehensive video prompt for Seedance 2.0 to recreate the 1980s Japanese game show Takeshi's Castle with authentic broadcast aesthetics.
entries.prompt:
Authentic 1980s Japanese television game show broadcast footage, realistic recreation of original Takeshi's Castle ENG camera footage, natural handheld camera with subtle shake and tracking, broadcast video noise, analog grain, limited dynamic range and color saturation of the era, slight color bleeding on highlights, chaotic energetic atmosphere of the original show.

No reference images provided. Generate the entire scene from the text description.

0-3s: [Wide handheld tracking shot from the side] A determined young Japanese male contestant in his mid-20s, short black hair, wearing a bright orange tracksuit with white stripes, white sneakers and a white headband, sprints confidently from the wooden starting platform onto the first of several large spinning cylindrical logs floating over a murky pond. He runs with pumping arms and focused expression as the log begins to rotate slowly beneath his feet, causing his body to wobble slightly. Water ripples and splashes lightly around the base of the logs.

3-6s: [Dynamic medium tracking shot moving alongside] He leaps to the second spinning log at a slightly higher level, landing with bent knees to absorb the impact. The faster-rotating drum spins his feet out from under him; he flails his arms dramatically to regain balance, torso leaning left then right, face shifting from concentration to surprise. The log's wet surface glistens as he struggles to stay upright.

6-9s: [Closer side profile action shot with motion blur] Pushing forward to the third log, his right foot slips on the spinning wet wood. He lurches forward violently, arms windmilling, body twisting as he tries to recover by crouching low. His left leg dips into the water creating a splash, but he pulls it out and continues with desperate momentum, the rotating cylinder throwing off his rhythm.

9-12s: [Dynamic tracking shot from a three-quarter angle] He attempts a running jump to the next log but the combined spin and his forward speed causes him to lose all balance. His body tilts backward sharply, legs kicking in the air, arms reaching out for nothing as he begins to fall off the side of the log.

12-15s: [Impact focused shot with water dynamics] The contestant falls backward off the spinning log into the pond with a huge explosive splash, water shooting up around his body. He submerges briefly, then resurfaces gasping and flailing, completely soaked, as the logs continue their relentless spinning in the background. His expression is one of shocked defeat mixed with the show's signature comedic failure.

High fidelity recreation of 1980s analog broadcast video, visible natural grain and broadcast noise, realistic motion characteristics of old ENG cameras, coherent but slightly imperfect physics and movement as seen in original Takeshi's Castle episodes, era-accurate color response and limited dynamic range, stable character with the natural imperfections of analog footage

entries.title: Multi-Panel Shutter MV Anime
entries.description: A highly detailed structured prompt for Seedance 2.0 Mini to create a multi-panel anime music video with shutter transitions and specific color grading.
entries.prompt:
A Japanese full-color anime with no captions, no background music, rapid-fire editing, a high frame count, and 24 FPS.

Use 「アット」imageA as the start frame and master layout reference.
Use 「アット」imageA only for the opening composition, the four-panel vertical split layout, and the final poster-like arrangement.
Use 「アット」imageB as the first panel content reference.
Use 「アット」imageC as the second panel content reference.
Use 「アット」imageD as the third panel content reference.
Use 「アット」imageE as the fourth panel content reference.
Preserve the original face structure, eye shape, hair silhouette, line quality, manga texture, collage texture, and graphic sliced-panel feeling of each image.

Goal:
Create a 10-second 480p anime-style motion graphic video in 16:9.
The video begins from 「アット」imageA as the opening frame.
The screen layout is a four-column vertical panel composition.
After starting from 「アット」imageA, the panels are reintroduced one by one from left to right with a crisp shutter-card insertion effect.
The panel content order must be strictly:
left panel = 「アット」imageB with orange color grading
second panel = 「アット」imageC with yellow color grading
third panel = 「アット」imageD with blue color grading
right panel = 「アット」imageE with green color grading

0-0.8s:
Start directly from 「アット」imageA full screen.
The first frame should clearly resemble 「アット」imageA.
Show the four tall vertical panel layout already arranged in 16:9.
Add a subtle push-in, faint glow, light grain, and slight scanline texture.
No text, no subtitles, no logos.

0.8-1.3s:
A sharp shutter blink passes across the frame.
The panel contents reset into dark or neutral placeholder slots while the four-column layout remains visible.
Keep the overall split-screen structure from 「アット」imageA intact.

1.3-3.0s:
The far-left panel activates first.
「アット」imageB slides in from the left edge and locks into the far-left column.
Apply strong orange color grading.
The motion should feel like a graphic card being inserted into place, not a fade.
Use a subtle push-in toward the eyes.

3.0-4.7s:
The second panel activates.
「アット」imageC slides in from the left and locks into the second column.
Apply vivid yellow color grading.
Keep the fragmented face-panel feeling.
Add a slight layered parallax effect and a tiny downward drift.

4.7-6.5s:
The third panel activates.
「アット」imageD slides in from the left and locks into the third column.
Apply deep blue color grading.
Preserve the monochrome manga texture and paper grain.
Use a slow dolly-in and keep the abstract collage feeling.

6.5-8.2s:
The fourth panel activates.
「アット」imageE slides in from the left and locks into the far-right column.
Apply rich green color grading.
Preserve the pose, peace sign, bob haircut, soft expression, rough ink texture, and geometric collage background.

entries.title: Alternative Football Reality Penalty Goal

entries.prompt: PART 1 – THE REALITY (15s) 15s • 16:9 • Ultra-photorealistic • Broadcast football cinematography • World Cup stadium at night Shot 1 (0–3s) – The Pressure Extreme close-up of WOLTEMADE's face under intense pressure. Stadium lights reflect in his eyes as the crowd falls silent. Shot 2 (3–7s) – The Penalty Wide broadcast angle. WOLTEMADE takes his run-up and strikes the ball. The goalkeeper dives as the shot bends toward the corner. Shot 3 (7–11s) – The Miss The ball smashes against the post instead of going in. The stadium freezes. The goalkeeper looks back in relief. Shot 4 (11–15s) – Heartbreak WOLTEMADE stands frozen in disbelief. Teammates collapse, fans react with shock and tears. End on a tight close-up of his face as a subtle broadcast glitch flickers across the screen. PART 2 – THE ALTERNATIVE REALITY (15s) 15s • 16:9 • Ultra-photorealistic • Broadcast football cinematography • Same stadium, same player, same framing Shot 1 (15–18s) – The Glitch The broadcast glitches and resets. The same close-up returns, but WOLTEMADE looks calmer. Reality has changed. Shot 2 (18–22s) – The Perfect Strike Same run-up, same camera angle. He connects perfectly, sending the ball low toward the bottom-left corner. Shot 3 (22–27s) – The Goal The ball slams into the net. Realistic net physics. The goalkeeper misses by inches as the stadium erupts and fans explode with celebration. Shot 4 (27–30s) – The Chosen Reality WOLTEMADE celebrates, then suddenly stops and looks directly into the camera. Hard cut to black with the text: "The ball went in." "Somewhere, it always did." Silence.

entries.title: Nostalgic Early 2000s DV Style Korean Vlog
entries.description: A comprehensive video generation prompt that replicates the aesthetic of a consumer DV camera from the early 2000s, featuring a young Korean woman in a quiet residential setting with realistic movements and camera imperfections.
entries.prompt:
**主体人物（Main subject）**：
韩国年轻女性，20岁出头，自然日常的装扮，身穿泛旧的炭灰色无袖短款露脐上衣、宽松的高腰浅色水洗牛仔裤，搭配黑色帆布运动鞋 and 黑色细绳项链。黑色的波浪卷发扎成略显凌乱的侧马尾，留有轻盈的碎刘海。逼真的皮肤纹理，化着淡妆，性格温暖且平易近人。在整个视频中，需保持人物身份、服装、发型和外貌的高度一致。

**场景地点（Location）**：
午前时分、宁静且真实的韩国居民区。狭窄的水泥小巷、低层住宅、小露台、盆栽植物、晾衣绳、自行车、电线杆、半空中纵横交错的电线，茂密的树木投下斑驳摇曳的树影，充满安静的居住氛围。没有商店、广告、咖啡馆、人群或商业活动。

**视觉风格（Visual Style）**：
超写实的纪录片风格。真实不做作的抓拍感行为。自然的肢体语言。无剧本的生活日常片段感。强烈的环境真实感。包含丰富的现实世界细节和自然逼真的人体动态。

**镜头风格（Camera Style）**：
2000年代初消费级DV摄像机的美学风格。营造出朋友在随意记录日常瞬间的感觉。强烈的手持镜头抖动，不完美的构图，频繁的自动对焦搜索（拉风箱现象），镜头呼吸效应，在阳光和阴影间移动时出现的曝光起伏（闪动），偶尔的运动模糊，轻微的果冻效应，轻微的数字压缩瑕疵，色彩泛旧/褪色，对比度柔和，伴有轻微的传感器噪点。无防抖处理。无电影级别的运镜。无现代调色痕迹。

**00:00–00:02**
在一栋小房子的入口外。她坐在低矮的水泥墙上，举起双手整理自己的马尾辫。微风吹动散落的发丝。她自然地微笑着，而此时摄像机正在努力尝试对焦。

**00:02–00:04**
摄像机跟随着她走进一条两侧布满盆栽和水泥墙的狭窄小巷。她注意到一只流浪猫，便蹲下身来。由于拍摄者试图跟上她的动作，画面构图出现了偏离重心的偏移。

**00:04–00:06**
她温柔地抚摸并喂食那只猫。摄像机的自动对焦在她的脸和猫之间反复切换。上午的阳光透过头顶的树叶斑驳地闪烁着。

**00:06–00:08**
在她房子旁边的小前院里。她正在晾衣绳上晾晒衣服，布料在微风中摇曳。当云朵短暂地从头顶飘过时，画面曝光随之发生变化。

**00:08–00:10**
在一个安静的露台上，手里拿着一个陶瓷咖啡杯。她惬意地坐着，观察着周围的街区，偶尔将头发挽到耳后。采用随意、松散的侧面手持视角，伴有自然的镜头漂移。

**00:10–00:12**
侧面近景特写。画外有人向她打招呼。她转过头，抬起手，温暖地微笑着，随口说了一句：“安妞（你好）”。摄像机的抓拍反应稍微慢了半拍。

**00:12–00:15**
她手里拿着咖啡杯，沿着绿树成荫的居民小路慢慢走着。她注意到了摄像机，露出了一个微小而真诚的微笑，然后移开视线继续向前走。视频在她动作进行到一半时突然切断并黑屏，就像摄像机被突然关掉了一样。

**音频（Audio）**：
仅保留自然的环境音——晨间的鸟鸣，远处的摩托车声，微风声，树叶的沙沙声，隐约的街坊聊天声，猫叫声，水泥地上的脚步声，晾衣绳上布料的飘动声，以及微妙的居民区氛围音。无音乐。无声音设计。无旁白。

**目标（Goal）**：
捕捉真实的韩国社区生活，使其看起来就像是一段被遗忘的2000年代初家庭录像——随性抓拍、不完美、写实、温暖，且极具真实说服力。

entries.title: Alien Ambush in Jungle Army Base
entries.description: A cinematic action sequence prompt featuring a giant alien attacking a rainforest military base at night, involving complex character interactions and explosive slow-motion effects.
entries.prompt:
A jungle army base at night, deep in thick wet rainforest. Tents, sandbags, floodlights, an open dirt yard, and a low concrete ammo bunker stacked with shells. A giant alien — brownish-black, slimy, with long whipping tentacles — has torn open the ammo bunker and is dragging a soldier across the ground toward the stacked shells. On the watchtower, a gunner loads a mounted gun. Sound: tearing concrete, wet tentacles slapping, shouting men, the alien's low roar, radio voices.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot across the floodlit yard. The giant alien rips the steel door off the ammo bunker with one set of tentacles while another wraps a soldier's legs, dragging him backward across the mud toward the open bunker full of shells. He claws at the ground. Men scatter between the tents. One shouts into his radio: "IT'S DRAGGING HIM TO THE SHELLS!"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Up on the watchtower. The gunner swings his mounted gun toward the alien, but holds his fire — the soldier still in the tentacles, the bunker right there. He calls down on the radio: "Break loose! Run clear!"

Shot 3 (6–9s): At the soldier. He pulls a knife and slashes the slimy tentacle around his legs, breaks free, and runs clear of the bunker across the open yard. The alien, now empty-handed, slides forward out of the bunker into the open middle of the yard, rearing up tall and clear in the floodlights, the stacked shells behind it.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The alien is out in the open now, the ammo bunker right behind it. The gunner fires. Bullet time — a stream of heavy rounds flies across the yard in slow motion, smoke and shell cases hanging in the air, smashing into the alien and ripping into the bunker behind it. The shells catch — a huge fireball blooming around the alien.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The whole bunker goes up in one massive rolling fireball, shells cooking off in bursts, fire and slime shooting into the night sky. Soldiers dive into the mud as the rescued man scrambles clear of the blast. Cut.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low rear shot across the slope. The giant alien wraps its slimy tentacles around the loaded trailer and hauls it backward up the hill toward the trees, the tractor's wheels spinning and tearing through the tea bushes. The driver wrestles the wheel and shouts into his radio: "IT'S DRAGGING ME TO THE TREES!"

Shot 2 (3–6s): On the ridge above. A soldier drops to one knee and lifts a rocket launcher onto his shoulder, aiming down the slope — but holds his fire, the alien wrapped on the trailer with the driver right there. He calls on the radio: "Cut the trailer! Break free!"

Shot 3 (6–9s): At the tractor. The driver pulls the trailer release pin, and the tractor lurches forward, suddenly free, bouncing down through the bushes. The alien, still wrapped around the loose trailer, is left behind and spills out onto the open hill slope, rearing up tall and clear, tentacles spread wide.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The alien is out in the open on the slope now. The soldier fires from the ridge. Bullet time — the rocket streaks down the hill in slow motion, smoke trailing behind it, straight into the alien. The hit throws its slimy body up off the slope, tentacles flinging outward, torn tea leaves hanging in the air.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. A big burst of fire and slime rolls across the hillside as the alien drops and lies still in the bushes. The tractor bounces to a stop further down the slope, the driver looking back up the hill. Smoke drifts over the tea estate. Cut.

entries.title: Futuristic Sky Garden Dome Chase
entries.description: A hyper-realistic action sequence prompt for Seedance 2.0 involving two agents escaping through a collapsing glass dome garden high above a neon city.
entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds Night. Inside a futuristic rooftop glass dome high above a neon city, two agents, one man and one woman, sprint through a luxury sky garden while a security team chases from behind and pursuit drones close in overhead. No hoods, no helmets, no masks. 
Dark fitted tactical clothing, visible hair, no celebrity resemblance. The glass dome is unstable. Alarms flash red. Rain pounds the curved glass. Metal support ribs shake. The floor is wet and reflective. The space is filled with plants, glass walkways, shallow pools, and narrow paths. 

Wide opening shot: the two agents burst through the rooftop garden at full speed. Security rushes in behind them while two drones sweep overhead. Red alarm light flickers across the dome. 

Fast tracking shot: the agents sprint along a narrow wet path between plants and reflecting pools. The drones dive lower and force them to change direction. Cracks spread across the glass dome overhead. Small shards begin falling around them. 

The agents duck, swerve, and keep moving while the security team gains behind. Side shot: the dome starts breaking in a chain reaction. Large glass panels begin dropping behind and around them. One drone clips a support beam and sparks burst. 
Water splashes from broken pools, shattered glass litters the path, and the agents are trapped between the collapsing dome, the closing security team, and the drones above. 

Final 5 seconds: make this part extreme. The normal exit doors are no longer a safe escape. Ahead, a side section of the dome wall and floor has broken open, revealing a narrow exterior maintenance ledge lower down outside the building. The agents accelerate into a final desperate sprint. One nearly slips on the shattered wet floor, the other catches them without stopping. 

They duck under a falling support beam, leap over a broken walkway section, reach the broken edge, and jump downward out of the dome to the lower ledge outside the skyscraper. 
They land hard on the narrow ledge and drop low for balance as glass crashes down behind them and drones sweep past above. 

Final moment: the two agents cling to the narrow exterior ledge outside the dome, high above the city, while the shattered glass dome collapses behind them. 

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, intense, stressful, urgent, clear readable action, strong sense of danger and height, collapsing glass dome, pursuit drones, red alarms, rain, wet reflections, falling debris, dynamic camera movement, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion. Keep proportions. Keep style and features.

entries.title: Cinematic NYC Hyperlapse Walking Story

entries.prompt:
Generate a video: A young female Oval heart-shaped face, clean bright fair porcelain skin with natural pores and subtle micro imperfections (no over-smoothing), soft almond eyes, refined nose, polished natural makeup with soft highlights, face must remain clearly visible, sharp, and consistently recognizable across all shots (FACE LOCK, no distortion, no blur on face during motion), expression calm, confident, slightly observant urban vibe.

Streetwear casual — oversized hoodie / tee, relaxed pants, **Nike Air Jordan sneakers**, subtle accessories, realistic fabric movement.

ENVIRONMENT:
New York City streets — skyscrapers, crosswalks, traffic, crowds, subway entrances, storefront reflections  
**Time progression: morning → afternoon → golden hour → night (hyperlapse feel)**

Cinematic urban walking sequence  
Macro cut + motion camera + hyperlapse transitions  
Focus: **movement + environment + face tracking**

CAMERA SYSTEM (MULTI MOTION + FACE TRACK):
- Front tracking cam (primary face lock)
- Side tracking cam (walking profile)
- Wide cinematic cam (city scale)

Ambient city sound + light cinematic beat

TIMELINE (10s CINEMATIC WALK + HYPERLAPSE):

1.5–3.0s

→ close-up sneakers stepping (Nike Jordan detail)  
→ hand brushing jacket  
→ quick whip to face close-up  
→ side tracking resumes

3.0–4.5s (MIDDAY SHIFT)  
Crowd increases → faster movement  
→ side cam + wide cam alternating

4.5–6.0s  
Crosswalk moment → overhead + push-in combo  
→ macro: traffic light change → cut to face

6.0–7.5s (GOLDEN HOUR)  
Warm light hits face

Hyperlapse shift → lights turn on, sky darkens  
→ whip pan transitions  
→ macro: neon sign → cut to face

9.0–10.0s (NIGHT FINAL)  
City fully lit → neon + headlights  
→ front tracking close-up  
→ slight slow-down step  
→ **FULL FACE LOCK CLOSE-UP**, confident urban expression

PHYSICS & EFFECTS:
Hyperlapse background motion, realistic footstep impact, cloth movement, light reflections, motion blur on environment only (NOT face)

LOOK & COLOR:
Ultra cinematic, NYC tone, high contrast, morning soft light → golden hour warm → neon night glow

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Cinematic POV Delivery Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a realistic first-person interaction with a delivery person, featuring professional lighting, texture, and multi-shot continuity.
entries.prompt: 风格：8K电影质感。真实摄影——非3D渲染，非游戏引擎，无游戏过场动画感。 摄影：自然主义大师级摄影。 布光：仅自然光——逆光轮廓光，机位在阴影侧，空气中有薄雾。主光仅来自天光与窗光。 色彩：60:30:10——主色/辅色/点缀色。 镜头：物理电影镜头。180°快门运动模糊。 皮肤：毛孔级真实——汗毛、不对称痣点、毛细血管泛红、毛孔阴影与现场光匹配。 表演：顶级电影级——反应前的微停顿、精准视线、湿润有神的眼睛带眼神光、可见呼吸与胸口起伏。 物理：遵守重力与惯性——质量有真实重量，接触阴影正确，无悬浮道具。 构图：三分法+黄金比例。第一帧起每个人都在动。 连贯性：角色、道具、环境每个镜头完全一致，无身份漂移。 技术：24fps平滑运动。8K细节。无抖动。 音频：仅环境音效。无音乐。无字幕。 SUBJECT（主体）—— 配送员就是上传的首帧画面本人：高盘发髻，黄黑撞色冲锋衣内搭浅卡其背心与灰色运动裤，右手提黑色保温配送箱。视频从这张首帧直接往后延续动作，外形、服装、发型、保温箱始终与首帧一致。WB 5200K。MULTISHOT——在门口打招呼、走进屋、放下外卖、临走带着害羞俏皮的回眸。中文台词，口型同步。 LOCATION（场景）—— 现代公寓电梯口走廊，米色大理石与暖色廊灯，向内过渡到整洁玄关。视频从首帧的走廊空间自然向室内延展，配送员在真实空间中移动。 ACTION（动作）—— POV第一人称：镜头即"你"（顾客）开门并注视她进屋的视线。画面从首帧（她站在走廊抬眼看镜头）开始动起来。 SHOT 1 (0:00–0:05) —— 承接首帧：配送员抬眼直视镜头，温暖的浅笑，右手提箱。她说："你好，你的外卖到了。" 画外男声（顾客/镜头）回应："好的，帮我送进来吧。" 硬切。 SHOT 2 (0:05–0:10) —— 镜头随她进门轻微后退，她跨过门槛进入玄关，弯腰将保温箱放在玄关柜旁，取出餐盒并摆放整齐，直起身理了理冲锋衣下摆。画外音："谢谢。" 她微微低头，脸颊泛红，一个害羞的停顿，然后说："不用谢，祝您用餐愉快。" 硬切。 SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15) —— 她转身欲走，又停下，回头越过肩膀看向镜头，眼睛弯起，手指轻拨背包带。一个俏皮的微停顿，然后说："要不要我留下来陪你一起吃呢？" 定格在她过肩回眸的微笑上，暖光柔化。 CAMERA（镜头）—— SHOT 1：POV平视，门口锁定机位，35mm质感，轻微手持呼吸感；动机——初次照面。 SHOT 2：POV胸高缓慢后拉跟随她进屋，28mm，细微手持晃动；动机——为她进门让出空间。 SHOT 3：POV推进到50mm中近景，落在她回头的脸上；动机——俏皮的钩子。 STYLE（风格）—— 主色 暖米色大理石与廊灯钨丝光 60% / 辅色 冷灰运动裤与黑色保温箱 30% / 点缀 黄色冲锋衣 10%。WB 5200K。主光来自走廊顶灯与画外室内灯，轻薄雾感。 CONSTRAINTS（约束）—— 9:16竖屏。无慢动作，全程自然24fps。视频严格从上传首帧延续，不改动首帧人物外形与构图。POV保持第一人称，镜头不展示顾客身体（最多隐含双手）。配送员身份、服装、发髻与保温箱三镜头完全一致。取景自然得体。三句中文台词干净口型同步。无眼睛发光，无烧录字幕。

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:05): Continues from the first frame: The delivery person looks up directly at the camera with a warm slight smile, box in right hand. She says: 'Hello, your delivery is here.' Off-screen male voice (customer/camera) responds: 'Okay, help me bring it in.' Hard cut. SHOT 2 (0:05–0:10): Camera pulls back slightly as she enters, crossing the threshold into the entryway. She bends over to place the box by the cabinet, takes out the meal containers and arranges them neatly, then stands up and straightens the jacket hem. Off-screen voice: 'Thank you.' She bows her head slightly, cheeks blushing, a shy pause, then says: 'You're welcome, enjoy your meal.' Hard cut. SHOT 3 (0:10–0:15): She turns to leave, then stops, looks back over her shoulder at the camera, eyes crinkling, fingers lightly plucking the backpack strap. A playful micro-pause, then she says: 'Would you like me to stay and eat with you?' Freezes on her over-the-shoulder smile, softened by warm light. CAMERA: SHOT 1: POV eye-level, locked position at the door, 35mm feel, slight handheld breathing; Motive—initial encounter. SHOT 2: POV chest-high slow pull-back following her inside, 28mm, fine handheld shake; Motive—making space for her entry. SHOT 3: POV push-in to 50mm mid-close-up on her face as she turns; Motive—playful hook. STYLE: Primary warm beige marble/hallway tungsten light 60% / Secondary cold gray pants and black box 30% / Accent yellow jacket 10%. WB 5200K. Main light from hallway ceiling and off-screen interior lights, light fog. CONSTRAINTS: 9:16 vertical screen. No slow motion, natural 24fps throughout. Video strictly follows the uploaded first frame without altering character appearance or composition. POV remains first-person; camera does not show customer's body (implied hands at most). Delivery person's identity, clothes, bun, and box are identical across three shots. Natural and appropriate framing. Three Chinese lines with clean mouth-sync. No glowing eyes, no burnt-in subtitles.

entries.title: Crane Cabin Lockdown Action Sequence
entries.description: A high-tension cinematic prompt describing a chase scene where a woman is pursued by alien creatures onto a construction crane.
entries.prompt:
A hyper-real cinematic action sequence set in an active construction site at dusk. Exposed rebar, scaffolding, unfinished concrete floors, and a tall tower crane dominate the scene. Dust hangs in the air. Sound design: heavy breathing, metallic clanks, distant machinery, and guttural alien screeches.
The video starts mid-chase.

sprints across a half-built floor, leaping over gaps and dodging debris. Behind her, three alien —slick, elongated, with pale skin and wet, sinewy movement—pursue aggressively, closing in.

She spots a tower crane ladder and veers hard toward it, grabbing on and climbing fast. The camera stays tight, tracking her ascent as the creatures scale the structure with unnatural speed.

One creature lunges upward and grabs her ankle. She kicks violently, freeing herself, scraping against metal. No pause—she climbs the last few rungs and pulls herself onto the crane cabin platform.

She yanks the cabin door open, dives inside, and slams it shut.
Immediate silence shift—muffled exterior sounds.
She stumbles back, breathing hard.
Seconds later, the creatures reach the cabin. Slimy hands and distorted faces press against the glass, leaving streaks. The cabin rattles under their weight.
She watches, frozen, as they claw and slide across the windows.

Close on her face—panic, controlled breathing.
Exterior noise builds.
No hard cut.

entries.title: Pixar Style Robot Inventor Animation
entries.description: An energetic 3D cartoon prompt in the style of Pixar or Illumination, featuring a small blue robot causing a chain reaction in a chaotic inventor's workshop.
entries.prompt: Style: High-quality, vibrant 3D animated cartoon (Pixar/Illumination style). Frantic pace, squash-and-stretch physics, exaggerated expressions, dynamic lighting, and detailed textures. Characters: Gears, a small, overly enthusiastic, bright blue inventor’s robot with tread-wheels, multiple springy arms, and big, expressive digital eyes. He is constantly moving and beep-booping excitedly. Duration: 15 Seconds Setting: A colorful, chaotic, Rube Goldberg-esque inventor's workshop, filled with giant gears, conveyor belts, tubes, levers, and sparking gadgets. 15-Second Animation Breakdown: (0-3 seconds: The Start): The camera starts with a rapid zoom following Gears as he races through the workshop on his treads. He’s bouncing off cushions, weaving through moving mechanical legs, and juggling three shiny silver cogs. His arms are a blur of motion. He narrowly dodges a swinging giant pendulum with a comical "whoosh" sound effect. (3-7 seconds: The Chain Reaction): Gears accidentally bumps into a large, messy workbench, tripping a large red lever. This triggers a chaotic chain reaction.A boxing glove pops out, punching a ball down a spiral ramp.The ball triggers a fan that blows colorful feathers everywhere.A tube starts rapidly firing brightly colored ping-pong balls. Gears is in the middle of this chaos, wide-eyed and sputtering, frantically ducking the boxing glove, batting away feathers, and comically trying to catch the ping-pong balls, spinning around wildly on his treads. (7-11 seconds: Escalation): A conveyor belt speeds up fast, loaded with wobbly, jelly-like robotic parts. Gears tries to sort them but they bounce everywhere. He grabs a spring that stretches ridiculously far, launching him across the room. He lands on another conveyor belt, which quickly pulls him towards a large, goofy mechanical claw. (11-14 seconds: Maximum Chaos): The mechanical claw grabs Gears and a wobbly, half-assembled robot toy he was holding. It spins them both in a dizzying circle high above the workshop chaos. The workshop background is a blur of motion, flying parts, sparks, and steam. Gears has a look of comical terror, but is also trying to fix the toy while spinning. (14-15 seconds: The Punchline): The claw abruptly stops. The workshop goes instantly quiet, but everything is messy and askew. Gears is hanging upside down from the claw, dizzy, eyes swirly. He finally places the last cog on the wobbly robot toy. The toy instantly springs to life, makes a cheerful beep-boop sound, and wiggles its arms. Gears gives a dizzy grin and a "thumbs-up" to the camera as the scene fades. Camera: Constantly moving, dynamic, tracking Gears closely, utilizing rapid pans and zooms to match the frantic pacing. Audio: Fast-paced, cartoon music, lots of vibrant sound effects (boings, whizzes, clangs, beeps).

entries.title: Kawaii Hyper-Pop Anime MV
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for a fast-paced, chaotic kawaii anime music video featuring fisheye lens effects and rapid character switching.
entries.prompt:
Use the uploaded images as character and style references.

15-second kawaii hyper-pop music video at BPM 174.

No lip-sync. No singing focus.

Create a fast, chaotic, cute visual sequence with rapid character switching among all uploaded reference characters.

Style:

Pastel neon anime, pink, cyan, yellow, mint, lavender, bold outlines, flat shading, stickers, flowers, bows, spirals, halftone dots, manga panels, candy glitch accents.

Main motion:

Fast BPM174 rhythm, rapid cuts every 0.1–0.4 seconds, cute dance bursts, sudden poses, bouncing, spinning, mob-dance energy, exaggerated reactions, clone echoes, split panels, and visual overload.

Lens effects:

Use strong fisheye and ultra-wide distortion.

Make the center bulge forward.

Stretch and curve the edges clearly.

Use obvious barrel distortion, warped perspective, tunnel zooms, crash zooms, rotating camera, dutch angles, whip pans, and sudden push-ins.

Variation:

Do not repeat similar shots.

Each section should introduce a different effect:

fisheye close-up,

spinning camera,

split-panel shatter,

clone multiplication,

kaleidoscope mirror,

mob-dance burst,

sticker tunnel,

wide-angle distortion,

radial explosion,

multi-character chaos.

Timeline:

0–3s: extreme fisheye close-ups, fast character switching, sticker bursts.

3–6s: rotating camera, panel splits, shattered manga frames.

6–9s: clone multiplication, mob-dance bouncing, wide-lens warping.

9–12s: kaleidoscope mirrors, tunnel zooms, crash zoom reactions.

12–15s: maximum chaos, rapid effect relay, all characters in fast succession, final distorted cute impact frame.

Important:

Make the fisheye distortion visually obvious, especially at the edges.

Keep faces cute and readable.

Use many different visual tricks, not one repeated effect.

Negative prompt:

weak fisheye, only round frame, static camera, repetitive shots, slow motion, lip-sync, realistic style, horror, grotesque face, broken anatomy, extra limbs, muddy colors, low energy

entries.title: Futuristic Crane Chase Action Sequence
entries.description: A high-intensity action prompt for a 15-second cinematic sequence showing agents navigating a construction crane between skyscrapers during a violent storm.
entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.  

Night. High above a futuristic city during a violent storm, two agents, one man and one woman, run across the long horizontal arm of a giant construction crane connecting one skyscraper to another unfinished tower. Both wear dark fitted tactical clothing with no hoods, no helmets, and no masks. 
Their hair is visible and moves in the wind. No celebrity resemblance and no famous actor look. Heavy rain lashes the metal surface, wind shakes the crane, warning lights blink red, and the glowing city stretches far below through mist.  

Wide opening shot: the two agents sprint along the crane arm high above the city while several chasers follow behind from the rooftop access point. Rain, wind, and height create immediate danger.  

Tracking shot: the agents continue running along the narrow crane arm. The crane sways in the storm, loose tools and metal parts slide past them, and the surface becomes slick with rain. They keep low for balance while the chasers gain behind.  

Side exterior shot: a powerful gust makes the crane swing harder. One section rattles violently, a hanging cable whips across the frame, and debris flies away into the night. The agents keep moving toward the unfinished tower ahead.  

Final 5 seconds: the sequence becomes more intense. The crane arm tilts and shakes. One agent nearly loses footing but the other grabs and steadies them without stopping. They reach the far end of the crane and make a fast desperate jump from the crane arm onto the unfinished floor of the next skyscraper. They land hard, roll across the wet concrete, and regain balance as the crane continues swaying behind them.  

Final moment: the two agents rise on the unfinished tower floor, storm raging around them, while the giant crane swings behind against the glowing city skyline.  

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, suspenseful, clear and readable action, strong sense of height and danger, storm, rain, wind, blinking warning lights, metal structure, dynamic but readable camera movement, visible hair, no hoods, no helmets, no masks, no celebrity resemblance, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

entries.title: Tokyo Summer Travel Vlog Montage

Use the reference grid image as the source of the same girl and her 10 summer travel scenes in Tokyo.
Create a single 15-second feel-good travel-vlog montage, 16:9 horizontal, flowing through all 10 scenes
in order as quick handheld phone shots, about 1.5 seconds each, snappy cuts on the beat.
The same girl in every shot with consistent face and hairstyle; in each shot her outfit matches that scene in the reference.
Throughout, she radiates excitement and joy — bright eyes, easy smiles, playful energy — and each shot shows off
what makes that spot special. Authentic smartphone look, natural ambient light, subtle grain, light handheld motion.
Bright, joyful sightseeing music that conveys the fun of travel, around 125 bpm.

Shot 1 — Inokashira pond swan boat: she laughs with delight and rocks the pedal boat, sparkling water and a swan boat gliding behind, warm sun flare.
Shot 2 — cafe matcha kakigori: eyes lighting up, she lifts a spoonful of fluffy shaved ice toward the camera and beams, the towering dessert in frame.
Shot 3 — Harmonica Yokocho alley at night: she strolls through the glowing red-lantern alley, glances back with an excited grin, lively izakaya signs around her.
Shot 4 — hotel mirror selfie: a happy, relaxed mirror selfie, she tilts her head and smiles softly, calm window light, cozy room mood.
Shot 5 — summer festival night: she bites a bright candy apple and bursts into a giggle, swaying paper lanterns and a buzzing crowd behind her.
Shot 6 — golden-hour window selfie: an arm's-length selfie bathed in warm sunset light, soft hair movement, a contented joyful smile.
Shot 7 — ivy-covered Ghibli-style museum: she gazes up in wonder, spinning slightly to take it all in as the camera tilts up the lush green facade.
Shot 8 — Inokashira park path: she crouches with a delighted laugh and points as a small squirrel scampers by, dappled sunlight, playful energy.
Shot 9 — Harajuku shop window with bubble tea: she sips happily through a straw, her reflection shimmering in the glass, the bustling colorful street behind.
Shot 10 — on the train home: a calm, satisfied selfie, hand on her cheek, city skyline streaking past the window, a soft fulfilled smile.

Smooth energetic flow from shot to shot, consistent color and grain throughout, upbeat happy travel-diary mood.

entries.title: Ancient Oak Tree Seasonal Orbit Time-Lapse
entries.description: A conceptual time-lapse sequence of an ancient oak tree as seasons and centuries pass in a single uninterrupted orbital camera shot.
entries.prompt: A single uninterrupted cinematic shot begins at sunrise in the middle of a vast peaceful meadow. At the center stands one enormous ancient oak tree with a wide trunk, sprawling branches, and deeply textured bark. The surrounding landscape is calm, covered in fresh green grass with distant mountains beneath a soft golden sky. Gentle birdsong fills the air as the camera slowly begins orbiting the tree in a perfectly smooth circular motion. The tree remains at the exact center of the frame throughout the entire film. As the camera completes the first quarter of its orbit, spring awakens instantly around the tree. Tiny buds emerge along every branch. Fresh green leaves unfurl in beautiful synchronized motion. Wildflowers bloom across the meadow in waves of color. Butterflies flutter through the warm air while birds begin building nests among the branches. Soft morning mist lifts from the grass as sunlight grows brighter. Without stopping, the camera continues its orbit. The landscape gradually transforms into vibrant summer. The tree's canopy becomes dense and full. Long grass sways gently in the warm breeze. Bees collect pollen from blooming flowers. A nearby stream sparkles under intense sunlight. Children briefly appear beneath the tree enjoying a picnic before naturally fading as time continues moving forward. Everything feels alive with warmth and abundance. The camera never cuts. As it reaches the opposite side of the tree, summer slowly gives way to autumn. The sunlight becomes warmer and lower in the sky. Leaves transition through brilliant shades of emerald, yellow, orange, crimson, and deep red. Gentle wind carries thousands of leaves into elegant swirling patterns around the camera. The meadow changes into rich golden tones while migrating birds cross the distant horizon. Time accelerates. The final leaves drift gracefully to the ground. The orbit continues. A quiet snowfall begins. Within moments the landscape transforms into winter. Snow blankets every branch with delicate crystalline detail. Frost slowly spreads across the bark. The nearby stream freezes into clear ice. The sky becomes pale blue while soft snowflakes fall silently through the air. The entire world feels peaceful and still. The camera completes one full orbit. Instead of stopping, it continues circling faster. Each complete revolution now represents decades instead of seasons. Spring, summer, autumn, and winter flow continuously around the tree in increasingly rapid succession. Blossoms bloom and disappear. Leaves grow, change color, and fall. Snow arrives and melts.

preview_videos.caption: Ancient Oak Tree Seasonal Orbit Time-Lapse

entries.title: Korean Neighborhood DV Vlog
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt capturing a young woman's slice-of-life moments in a Korean residential area, using a 2000s camcorder aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Main subject: young Korean woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, faded charcoal-grey sleeveless crop top, loose high-waisted light-wash jeans, black canvas sneakers, black cord necklace, black wavy hair in a messy side ponytail with wispy bangs. Realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, warm and approachable personality. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout the entire video.
Location: Authentic Korean residential neighborhood during a calm late morning. Narrow concrete alleys, low-rise homes, small terraces, potted plants, laundry lines, bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, mature trees casting moving shadows, quiet residential atmosphere. No stores, advertisements, cafés, crowds, or commercial activity.
Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior. Natural body language. Unscripted slice-of-life feeling. Strong environmental authenticity. Rich real-world details and believable human motion.
Camera Style: Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. Friend casually recording everyday moments. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, frequent autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping when moving between sun and shade, occasional motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise. No stabilization. No cinematic camera moves. No modern color grading.
00:00–00:02
Outside a small house entrance. She sits on a low concrete wall adjusting her ponytail with both hands raised. A light breeze moves loose strands of hair. She smiles naturally while the camera struggles to hold focus.
00:02–00:04
The camera follows her into a narrow alley lined with potted plants and concrete walls. She notices a stray cat approaching and crouches down. Framing drifts off-center as the operator tries to keep up.
00:04–00:06
She gently pets and feeds the cat. Autofocus repeatedly shifts between her face and the animal. Morning sunlight flickers through leaves overhead.
00:06–00:08
Small front yard beside her house. She hangs laundry on a clothesline while fabrics sway in the breeze. Exposure changes as clouds briefly pass overhead.
00:08–00:10
On a quiet terrace with a ceramic coffee cup. She sits comfortably watching the neighborhood, occasionally brushing hair behind her ear. Loose handheld side angle with natural camera drift.
00:10–00:12
Close side profile. Someone off-camera greets her. She turns, raises her hand, smiles warmly, and casually says, “Annyeong.” The camera catches the moment slightly late.
00:12–00:15
Walking slowly down a tree-lined residential lane holding her coffee cup. She notices the camera, gives a small genuine smile, then looks away and continues walking. Recording cuts abruptly to black mid-motion as if the camcorder was switched off.

Audio: Natural ambient sound only — morning birds, distant motorcycles, light wind, leaves rustling, faint neighborhood
