entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a cooking commentary video that features a VTuber-style character overlay and realistic cooking visuals for Black Pepper Beef.
entries.prompt: 参照画像のキャラクターをVTuber風の実況アバターとして使用する。緑色の多角形マスク、黒い縁取り、細い目、黒い眉、紫色の大きな舌、白い頭部、黒い服の印象を維持。キャラクターは画面右下に2D/Live2D風の小さな配信者アバターとして重ね表示される。背景の料理映像には干渉しない。アバターは上半身のみ表示、軽い上下揺れ、瞬き、口パク、表情変化、ツッコミ動作、リアクションを行う。映像は青椒肉絲を作っている料理実況動画。メイン画面は実写またはシネマティックな料理映像。まな板の上でピーマン、たけのこ、牛肉または豚肉を細切りにする。包丁の音、油のはねる音、中華鍋を振る音、食材が炒められる音をリアルに入れる。料理工程は、肉に下味をつける、片栗粉をまぶす、ピーマンとたけのこを切る、強火で肉を炒める、野菜を加える、オイスターソース・醤油・酒・砂糖で味付け、最後に照りが出るまで炒めて皿に盛る流れ。画面構成はゲーム実況・料理配信風。メイン料理映像を全画面にし、右下にVTuberアバターを固定表示。左上に小さく「COOKING LIVE」風の配信UIを表示してもよいが、実在サービスのロゴは使わない。字幕やコメント欄を入れる場合は架空UIとして控えめに配置する。文字が不要な場合はUIなしでもよい。アバターの実況内容：「はいどうもー、今日は青椒肉絲を作っていきます」「まずはピーマン、細く切る。ここ雑にいくと全部終わります」「肉に下味を入れて、片栗粉でうま味を閉じ込める。ここ、地味に大事」「中華鍋、火力が命。音がもう勝ってる」「ピーマン入った瞬間、色が一気に料理になるのよ」「オイスターソース入れたら勝ち確。香りが反則」「はい完成。白ごはん、逃げてください」キャラクターのリアクション演出：包丁で細切りがきれいに決まる瞬間、アバターが目を細めてうなずく。肉を強火で炒める瞬間、アバターが少し前のめりになりテンション高めに口パク。ソースを入れて湯気が上がる瞬間、紫の舌を強調しながら「これはうまい」と驚く。完成時はアバターが画面右下で小さく拍手し、満足そうにうなずく。映像スタイル：料理映像は高品質、清潔なキッチン、自然光または暖色の照明。食材の色が鮮やかに見えるようにする。油の照り、湯気、ソースのツヤ、ピーマンの緑を強調。カメラは手元の接写、斜め上からの調理台、鍋のローアングル、盛り付けのクローズアップを切り替える。VTuberアバターは常に右下に固定し、サイズや位置が途中で変わらない。料理映像の邪魔をしない。禁止事項：キャラクターの顔やマスクのデザインを変えない。舌の色を変えない。別キャラ化しない。アバターを実写人物にしない。実在する配信サービスのロゴを使わない。料理工程を飛ばしすぎない。手元とアバターが重なって見づらくならない。食材が途中で別料理に変化しない。完成品は青椒肉絲として認識できるように、細切り肉、ピーマン、たけのこ、茶色い照りのあるソースを明確に見せる。

entries.title: Pixar Style World Cup Animation
entries.description: A complex narrative prompt for a 10-second cinematic video featuring the Statue of Liberty and a child playing soccer, transitioning from reality to a surreal World Cup stadium.
entries.prompt: Pixar-style cinematic animated feature film, 4K vertical video, 10 seconds duration, smooth camera movement, emotional storytelling, vibrant colors, shallow depth of field, highly detailed animated textures, warm sunrise lighting in New York City. The scene begins at the base of the Statue of Liberty in New York City during a golden sunrise. A small curious child stands in the foreground holding a perfectly round FIFA World Cup soccer ball. The child looks up at the Statue of Liberty with wonder and excitement. The statue is completely static and monumental. The child gently throws the soccer ball toward the Statue of Liberty. The camera follows the ball in a smooth cinematic motion as it travels through the air. The ball approaches the statue. The Statue of Liberty slowly leans forward for the first time and her eyes subtly come to life. She carefully catches the soccer ball in one hand and examines it with fascination. Her expression feels curious and slightly magical. As she holds the ball, a glowing animated dream bubble forms above her head. Inside the bubble, a football stadium slowly appears with bright floodlights and cheering energy. The camera pushes upward into the dream bubble. The world transitions seamlessly into a surreal World Cup stadium. The Statue of Liberty is now a living football player on a pitch, with the same FIFA World Cup soccer ball at her feet. Opposing abstract football players appear ahead of her. She begins a short dribbling motion, moving forward with smooth agility, performing one clean directional change past a defender. Suddenly the dream begins to fade. The stadium dissolves into glowing particles. The camera snaps back to real New York City at the base of the Statue of Liberty. The child runs forward and gently pulls the soccer ball back from the statue. The Statue of Liberty returns to her original static monument pose. The child holds the ball and looks up. Final frame holds briefly with cinematic silence. On-screen text appears: “FIFA WORLD CUP 2026” No dialogue, no watermark, no cuts, continuous cinematic motion, seamless transitions between reality and imagination.

entries.title: Snappy Anime Character Animation
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt designed to unlock expressive and cartoony animation styles in Seedance, focusing on principles like squash and stretch and snappy timing.
entries.prompt:
Emphasize snappy animation with lively energy, pose-to-pose, strong anticipation, overshoot, squash and stretch, quick switches in facial expressions, and follow-through on hair and sleeves. 
Give the movements a distinctive rhythm with variation in pacing: Hold still poses firmly for a split second, then transition to the next movement with a quick, bouncy snap. Make it comical and well-timed, but keep the actions easy to read. 
Movements follow: "stillness → preparatory action → sudden acceleration → large overshoot → sharp stop → hair and sleeves sway delayed." 
Facial changes are exaggerated and comical. 
Poses are clear in silhouette, with a solid hold of 0.1–0.2 seconds at the end of each action. 
Use cartoonish squash & stretch, motion blur, short afterimages, dramatic smear frames and speed lines sparingly. 
Physics are slightly exaggerated beyond reality, but the character's footing and center of gravity don't break.

entries.title: Pixar Style Supermarket Comedy Animation
entries.description: A high-end Pixar/Disney style 3D animation prompt for a supermarket scene where a stern father melts emotionally over his toddler daughter's reaction to ice cream.
entries.prompt:
Vertical 9:16, 15 seconds, high-end Pixar/Disney-style 3D animated supermarket comedy scene. Warm glossy cinematic look, soft amber supermarket lighting, cool teal freezer glow, reflective polished floor, realistic fabric, hair, glass and ice cream textures. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks.

Characters:
A large tall bearded father, broad-shouldered, heavy build, dark hair with grey temples, thick black beard, deep navy blazer, warm grey turtleneck, charcoal trousers, black shoes, silver watch. He walks with heavy confident steps, holding a phone to his right ear and a blue shopping basket in his left hand.
A small red-haired toddler daughter with copper curly hair in two side bunches, big green eyes, freckles, bubblegum-pink dress, small pink shoulder bag, pink shoes. She moves with light bouncy steps, expressive and cute.

Scene:
Modern supermarket aisle with upright glass-door freezers glowing cool aqua, condensation on glass, shelves blurred in the background, polished reflective floor.

TIMING AND SHOTS:

0.0–1.0 sec — Low opening shot from the glossy floor. Camera tilts up from the father’s black shoes and reflection, past his trousers, blue basket, navy blazer and silver watch, to his stern bearded face. He is walking and talking on the phone.

1.0–2.5 sec — Side wide shot. The father walks through the freezer aisle. His tiny daughter follows behind, dwarfed by him and the tall freezer cases. Her hair bunches bounce as she takes quick little steps.

2.5–4.0 sec — The girl stops at a freezer door, reaches up, opens it, cool mist and teal light spill out. She happily takes one waffle ice cream cone and holds it with both hands. The freezer door closes behind her.

4.0–5.2 sec — Front medium shot. The father walks toward camera, still on the phone. The girl trots beside him holding the ice cream and looking up hopefully. The father says firmly into the phone: “No.” He is answering the call, but the girl thinks he is refusing her ice cream.

5.2–8.0 sec — Extreme close-up of the girl’s face. Her smile disappears. Her lower lip trembles, eyebrows rise into a sad inverted-V, big green eyes fill with huge glossy tears. One large tear rolls down her freckled cheek, then another. She looks devastated and adorable.

8.0–10.5 sec — Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the father. He suddenly stops. His basket swings and settles. He lowers the phone from his ear and slowly turns over his left shoulder. His stern expression softens as he notices her crying.

10.5–11.5 sec — Hold on the father’s face as he completely melts emotionally. His brow relaxes, eyes soften, mouth loosens into a tender look of surrender.

11.5–15.0 sec — Final front wide payoff. The father now pushes a huge metal shopping cart absurdly overloaded with dozens of ice cream cones: cream, pink, mint soft-serve swirls, waffle cones stacked into a wobbling mountain. The girl walks beside him beaming, laughing, arms raised in victory, taking happy bouncy

entries.description: A highly detailed, professional-grade prompt for Seedance 2.0 designed to generate a 15-second 4K video of an ancient Chinese woman with synchronized dialogue and realistic emotional transitions.
entries.prompt:
首帧 FIRST FRAME（=上传参考图，100%锁定）：

古风女子，金步摇发钗、珍珠流苏垂面，绛红描金外袍罩白色里衣，

手持山水折扇与一枝白梅/樱枝；站于红柱长廊，黄昏金色侧光，

银杏叶飘落，湿青石地面有反光。人物五官、发型、服饰、配饰、

扇面纹样、构图与首帧完全一致，全程不得变形、不得换脸。

人物·表情·动作·台词（情绪戏，口型与台词严格对齐）：

0-2秒：微微低头垂眸，目光落在折扇上，嘴角噙含蓄淡笑。

〔轻声·气声〕"这长廊的风，又起了。"

2-4秒：笑意缓缓收敛，轻抬头，视线转向画面右侧，神情转认真。

〔语气微顿〕"你说过……要回来看这树叶落满阶。"

4-6秒：眉眼浮起一丝浅淡疑惑与担忧，唇瓣微动，欲言又止——不皱眉。

〔半句收住〕"如今……"（话音停住，未说完）

6-8秒：视线缓缓下沉，安静失落，眼底沉下来，不落泪。

〔几乎无声·只唇形〕"算了。"

8-10秒：低头轻阖双眼，唇角牵起一抹极淡的自嘲式浅笑。

〔自语·气声笑〕"是我等得太久了吧。"

10-12秒：抬头迎向暖光，神情克制，眼里温柔却委屈。

〔轻而稳〕"我不怪你，真的。"

12-15秒：目视前方/画面右侧，眼神柔和微润，唇瓣轻动似欲语还休，

最终归于安静凝视，定格在温柔清冷、略带忧郁。

〔最后一句气声·渐弱〕"……只盼你，安好。"

声音设定：女声，温柔清冷，气声偏多，语速偏慢，尾音轻微下沉；

情绪克制不外放，似自语呢喃，全程贴合面部口型。

镜头 CAMERA：

固定中近景，极缓慢推近（轻微 push-in），始终对准面部与眼神；

浅景深，背景红柱与飘叶虚化。一镜到底，无切换、无转场。

氛围·光线：

黄昏金色侧逆光，暖调柔和；银杏/花瓣随微风自然飘落，

湿石地面反光，空气感细腻；基调温柔清冷、含蓄忧郁。

CONSTRAINTS（约束）：

- 4K 超清，15秒，画面与首帧人物/服饰/场景 100% 一致

- 台词与口型严格同步，发音清晰自然，气声质感，不假唱、不错位

- 表情按 7 段情绪曲线递进，过渡连贯，不跳帧、不卡顿

- 眼神有戏；禁止眼睛发光、禁止瞳孔异常

- 风动、落叶、流苏、扇穗符合真实物理，轻柔不夸张

- 结尾无黑屏、无转场，自然定格

- 无字幕、无水印、无任何标记符号、无文字
entries.translated_prompt:
FIRST FRAME (= upload reference image, 100% locked):

Ancient Chinese woman, golden hairpin with pearl tassels over her face, crimson and gold-embroidered outer robe over white inner garment, holding a landscape folding fan and a branch of white plum/cherry blossom; standing in a corridor with red pillars, golden side light at sunset, ginkgo leaves falling, reflections on the wet bluestone ground. The character's facial features, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, fan pattern, and composition are 100% consistent with the first frame, with no deformation or face-swapping throughout.

Character · Expression · Action · Dialogue (Emotional scene, mouth movements strictly aligned with dialogue):

0-2s: Slightly lowers head and gaze, eyes on the folding fan, corners of the mouth holding a reserved, subtle smile.
[Softly · Breathily] "The wind in this corridor has picked up again."

2-4s: The smile slowly fades, head lifts slightly, gaze shifts to the right side of the frame, expression becomes serious.
[Slight pause] "You said... you would come back to see the leaves cover these steps."

4-6s: A trace of faint doubt and worry appears in the eyes, lips move slightly as if wanting to speak but stopping—do not frown.
[Sentence cut short] "Now..." (Voice stops, unfinished)

6-8s: Gaze slowly sinks, quiet disappointment, eyes dimming, no tears.
[Almost silent · Lips only] "Never mind."

8-10s: Lowers head and slightly closes eyes, corners of the mouth forming an extremely faint, self-mocking smile.
[Self-muttering · Breath-like laugh] "I suppose I've waited too long."

10-12s: Looks up toward the warm light, expression restrained, eyes gentle but aggrieved.
[Lightly but steadily] "I don't blame you, really."

12-15s: Looks straight ahead/to the right, eyes soft and moist, lips move slightly as if about to speak, finally settling into a quiet gaze, frozen in a gentle, cold, and slightly melancholic state.
[Final sentence breathy · Fading out] "...I only hope you are well."

Voice Setting: Female, gentle and cold, high breathiness, slow speed, end of sentences slightly dipping; emotions are restrained, like a whisper to oneself, perfectly matching the facial mouth movements throughout.

CAMERA:

Fixed medium close-up, very slow push-in, always focused on the face and eyes; shallow depth of field, red pillars and falling leaves in the background blurred. One continuous shot, no cuts, no transitions.

Atmosphere · Light:

Golden side-backlighting at sunset, warm and soft; ginkgo leaves/petals falling naturally with the breeze, reflections on wet stone ground, fine air quality; the tone is gentle, cold, reserved, and melancholic.

CONSTRAINTS:

- 4K Ultra HD, 15 seconds, character/clothing/scene 100% consistent with the first frame.
- Dialogue and mouth movements strictly synchronized, clear and natural pronunciation, breathy texture, no fake singing or misalignment.
- Expressions progress according to a 7-stage emotional curve, smooth transitions, no dropped frames or stuttering.
- Meaningful gaze; no glowing eyes, no abnormal pupils.
- Wind movement, falling leaves, tassels, and fan tassels follow real physics, soft and not exaggerated.
- No black screen or transition at the end, natural freeze-frame.
- No subtitles, no watermark, no marking symbols, no text.

4-8s: the giant tears up another stone and throws again, then swings a heavy arm; the archer teleports to dodge and repositions to the giant's RIGHT, loosing another arrow that opens a second black hole deliberately beside him — a real back-and-forth exchange.

entries.title: Realistic Soccer Match 4K Highlight
entries.description: A comprehensive, multi-scene video generation prompt for a realistic soccer match in 4K using Seedance 2.0, focusing on physics and cinematic broadcast style.
entries.prompt:
镜头结构: 7个镜头, 15秒, 竖屏9:16。写实真人实拍 — 图生视频。

参考图:

@Image1 = 主角球员／进球者 — 每个镜头都保持他的脸、浅棕色后梳头发、白皙肤色和淡淡胡茬完全一致。忽略照片里的灰色T恤; 他穿下面描述的球队队服。

人物:

主角球员的队服(他的10名队友也穿同样队服): 黑色短袖球衣, 领口和袖口有白色内衬／滚边(露出白色), 红色球裤带黑色侧插片, 红色球袜带黑色滚边, 深色球鞋。11名对手全部穿白蓝队服; 他们的门将穿绿色长袖球衣并戴手套。

场所: 夜晚的世界杯决赛。满座的环形看台, 冷白色泛光灯照明。深绿色草皮, 湿润的草地, 上方飘着细雾, 下方有清晰的鞋钉印。

音乐: 低沉、快速的电子鼓点 and 低频体育场贝斯, 像心跳一样。

风格: 写实真人实拍画面 — 看起来像真实比赛的电视转播画面, 不是动画。真实的皮肤带毛孔、汗光和因用力而泛红的脸; 真实的布料会起皱、贴身并随动作飘动; 真实的草叶、草坑、水花和泥点; 快速摇镜时有真实的运动模糊, 近景有浅景深, 自然的泛光灯色彩。真实物理 — 动量、重量、平衡, 真实的球旋转和球网形变。不要动漫、不要卡通、不要赛璐璐着色、不要插画或数字绘画; 不要平涂色块、不要塑料感的游戏CG、不要光滑的广告渲染。

镜头1 0:00-0:02: 中近景, 28mm, 接近草地高度, 侧视角 / 他(见@Image1)带球冲进白蓝防线。他的右脚连续绕球两圈做踩单车假动作。他放低外侧肩膀; 第一名后卫跟上。他用右脚外脚背轻推, 然后用内脚背回扣。球从后卫伸出的脚旁滚过; 他压低身体, 从另一侧带球过人。鞋钉扎入湿草地, 溅起水珠。远处两队都保持完整阵型, 或回防或前压

镜头2 0:02-0:04: 脚部特写加全身中景, 50mm, 正面视角 / 第二名后卫蹲低铲球, 一条腿伸出。他用右脚尖把球挑起。球越过那条腿, 升到接近膝盖高度。他收起双腿越过后卫。左脚先落地; 右脚外脚背控住下落的球并向前送出。后卫在湿草地上滑出, 扬起雾气

镜头3 0:04-0:06: 侧面中近景, 35mm, 两人都可见 / 第三名后卫从右前方逼近。他用左脚停球并把球拖到身后。他的右肩转向后卫, 以支撑脚为轴转身。他的右脚底接球, 然后把球推到后卫身后。他结束时面向球门并继续奔跑。后卫继续前冲, 然后交叉脚步, 身体倾斜

镜头4 0:06-0:08: 全身广角, 32mm, 后侧视角 / 他追上球进入禁区, 用右脚内侧把球横拨避开追防者, 然后左脚迈到球外侧。其他后卫从两侧包夹。队友从中路和远侧插入。绿衣门将出击离开球门线。他看向球门, 收短步幅, 让球从右脚外侧滚出

镜头5 0:08-0:10: 侧面中远景, 65mm, 球员和球门都可见 / 他左脚踩在球旁, 胸和髋朝向远角, 右腿后摆。门将向左移动,压低身体, 开始扑救。在触球前, 他收回髋部, 用右脚外脚背擦过球的右下方。球被挑起, 旋转着飞向球门

镜头6 0:10-0:13: 门将视角, 18mm, 平视高度 / 球从禁区深处飞来, 黑白拼块旋转着在画面中越来越大。门将向左扑出, 双手从下往上伸。在小禁区附近, 球向右上方拐弯, 越过手套指尖和脸。他回头看着球继续飞向右上死角

镜头7 0:13-0:15: 球门内侧广角, 24mm, 草皮和球门区域都可见 / 球击中右上死角。球网向后绷起; 网结抖动回弹, 溅起水珠和草屑。门将落在对侧的湿草地上。两队仍各有11名球员。禁区内和后场的白蓝球员转身看向球门。队友从不同位置向前奔跑。射门后他直立站着, 安静地注视。全场观众一同起身; 欢呼声充满整个体育场。最后一帧: 球网仍绷紧, 球仍在旋转, 球员在远处。

注: 所有镜头按竖屏9:16构图(画面更高, 动作居中)。每个镜头的焦段、机位高度和视角都严格按上面所写保持不变。全程保持11对11全员在场; @Image1的脸在每个镜头中保持一致。
entries.translated_prompt:
Shot Structure: 7 shots, 15 seconds, vertical screen 9:16. Realistic live-action filming — image-to-video.

Reference Image:

@Image1 = Main player/scorer — Keep his face, light brown slicked-back hair, fair skin, and light stubble consistent across every shot. Ignore the gray T-shirt in the photo; he wears the team uniform described below.

Characters:

Main player's uniform (his 10 teammates also wear the same): Black short-sleeved jersey, white lining/piping at the collar and cuffs, red shorts with black side inserts, red socks with black piping, dark shoes. All 11 opponents wear white and blue uniforms; their goalkeeper wears a green long-sleeved jersey and gloves.

Location: World Cup final at night. Full circular stands, cold white floodlight illumination. Deep green turf, wet grass with mist floating above and clear cleat marks below.

Music: Low, fast electronic drum beats and low-frequency stadium bass, like a heartbeat.

Style: Realistic live-action footage — looks like a real television broadcast of a match, not an animation. Real skin with pores, sweat, and faces reddened from exertion; real fabric that wrinkles, fits closely, and moves with action; real blades of grass, divots, splashes, and mud; real motion blur during fast pans, shallow depth of field in close-ups, natural floodlight colors. Real physics — momentum, weight, balance, real ball spin, and net deformation. No anime, no cartoon, no cel-shading, no illustration or digital painting; no flat color blocks, no plastic game CG, no smooth commercial rendering.

Shot 1 (0:00-0:02): Medium close-up, 28mm, near grass level, side view / He (see @Image1) dribbles into the white-and-blue defense. His right foot circles the ball twice in a step-over feint. He drops his outer shoulder; the first defender follows. He pushes with the outside of his right foot, then cuts back with the inside. The ball rolls past the defender's outstretched foot; he stays low and dribbles past from the other side. Cleats dig into the wet grass, splashing water. In the distance, both teams maintain full formations. 

Shot 2 (0:02-0:04): Foot close-up plus full body medium shot, 50mm, front view / A second defender slides low to tackle, one leg extended. He chips the ball up with his right toe. The ball clears the leg, rising to near knee height. He tucks his legs to clear the defender. Left foot lands first; right outer foot controls the falling ball and sends it forward. The defender slides out on the wet grass, kicking up mist. 

Shot 3 (0:04-0:06): Side medium close-up, 35mm, both visible / A third defender approaches from the front right. He stops the ball with his left foot and drags it behind him. His right shoulder turns toward the defender, pivoting on his support foot. His right sole takes the ball, then pushes it behind the defender. He ends facing the goal and continues running. 

Shot 4 (0:06-0:08): Full body wide angle, 32mm, back view / He catches up to the ball entering the penalty area, taps it across with the inside of his right foot to avoid a pursuer, then steps outside the ball with his left foot. Other defenders close in from both sides. Teammates cut in from the middle and far side. The green-clad goalkeeper comes out off his line. He looks at the goal, shortens his stride, and lets the ball roll off the outside of his right foot.

Shot 5 (0:08-0:10): Side medium-long shot, 65mm, player and goal both visible / He plants his left foot by the ball, chest and hips toward the far corner, right leg swinging back. The goalkeeper moves left, staying low, starting to dive. Before contact, he pulls his hips back, grazing the bottom right of the ball with the outside of his right foot. The ball is chipped up, spinning toward the goal.

Shot 6 (0:10-0:13): Goalkeeper's POV, 18mm, eye-level / The ball flies in from deep in the box, the black and white panels spinning larger and larger in frame. The goalkeeper dives left, hands reaching up from below. Near the six-yard box, the ball curves toward the top right, clearing the glove tips and face. He looks back as the ball continues toward the top right corner.

Shot 7 (0:13-0:15): Wide angle inside the goal, 24mm, turf and goal area visible / The ball hits the top right corner. The net bulges back; the knots shake and rebound, splashing water and grass debris. The goalkeeper lands on the opposite wet grass. Both teams still have 11 players each. White-and-blue players in the box and backfield turn toward the goal. Teammates run forward from various positions. After the shot, he stands upright, watching quietly. The entire stadium rises; cheers fill the air. Last frame: Net still taut, ball still spinning, players in the distance.

Note: All shots composed for vertical 9:16. Focal lengths, camera heights, and perspectives strictly maintained as written. Full 11v11 presence throughout; @Image1's face remains consistent in every shot.

entries.title: Cinematic Rainy City Sword Action
entries.description: An incredibly detailed multi-shot cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a magical swordsman fighting obsidian magical soldiers in a rainy intersection.
entries.prompt:
敵は生命体ではなく、黒曜石と金属で造られた無人の魔導兵。黒い多面体装甲、角のような突起、青く輝く魔力核を持つ。内部も石材、歯車、青い光だけで構成されている。

魔導兵は道路、車両周辺、左右の路地、壁面、高架上へ不規則に点在する。大きさ、向き、距離、姿勢を少しずつ変え、等間隔や左右対称に配置しない。それぞれ異なる速度とタイミングで、走る、跳躍する、蛇行する、壁を移動する、立ち止まって照準を合わせる。

Shot 1（0–4秒）：
雨の交差点。リラは画面左手前、魔導兵は画面右の中景から遠景へ自然に散らばっている。カメラは水たまりの反射を横切りながらリラへ接近し、その横を通過して、都市の各所で別々に起動する魔導兵を見せる。青い魔力核が不規則な順番で点灯する。

Shot 2（4–10秒）：
リラが水しぶきを弾いて加速。低い横移動で並走するカメラ。リラの刀が魔導兵の装甲を通過すると、斬撃線に沿って黒曜石の外殻へ青い亀裂が走る。次の瞬間、魔導兵は大小の幾何学的な石片と金属部品へ砕け、内部の青い魔力が光の粒となって上空へ消える。

リラは突進型の脚部を砕き、蛇行型を横薙ぎで粉砕。車上から跳ぶ二体の間を前転で抜け、立ち上がりながら青白い斬撃を放つ。壁面から降下する個体を空中回転斬りで破壊する。砕けた黒曜石片が路面を滑り、雨水を跳ね上げる。

Shot 3（10–15秒）：
多数の魔導兵がリラの目の前まで迫っている。最前列の三体は刀が届く距離で腕を振り上げ、中景の個体は左右から接近し、遠景の大型個体も突進中。リラと接近中の敵を必ず同じ画面内に映す。

リラが鞘のない刀を右手で低く構える。青白い光が刀身へ集中。最前列の三体が攻撃を放つ直前、リラが腰を回転させ、水平180度の巨大な扇状斬撃波を放つ。

横からの広い構図で、リラ、刀、眼前の魔導兵、斬撃波を同時に映す。斬撃波が最前列から奥へ進み、魔導兵の黒曜石装甲へ一本の青い亀裂を刻む。一拍遅れて、近い個体から遠い個体へ連鎖的に砕け散る。何百もの黒曜石片、金属片、青い光粒が雨の交差点を覆い、路面のネオンへ反射する。

最後の大型個体が巨大な石片へ崩壊すると、青い魔力核が静かに消灯。リラだけが交差点に立ち、刀を下げて息を吐く。砕けた黒曜石片が雨に打たれ、白いドレスがゆっくり静まる。

重要：
敵は無人の石造・金属製構造物として一貫させる。破壊時は黒曜石片、金属部品、青い光粒だけを描く。柔らかい身体表現や有機的な内部構造を描かない。

最後の大斬撃は、複数の魔導兵がリラの眼前まで接近し、攻撃動作に入った瞬間に放つ。敵が消えた後や空の道路へ向けて斬撃を放たない。
entries.translated_prompt:
The enemies are not living beings, but unmanned magical soldiers made of obsidian and metal. They have black polyhedral armor, horn-like protrusions, and blue glowing magic cores. The interiors consist only of stone, gears, and blue light.

The soldiers are irregularly scattered on roads, around vehicles, in side alleys, on walls, and on elevated tracks. Their size, orientation, distance, and posture vary slightly, and they are not arranged in equal intervals or symmetry. Each moves at different speeds and timings, running, leaping, zig-zagging, moving along walls, or stopping to aim.

Shot 1 (0–4s):
A rainy intersection. Lyra is in the foreground left, while magical soldiers are naturally scattered from the mid-ground to the background on the right. The camera moves close to Lyra across puddle reflections, passes her side, and shows the soldiers activating separately throughout the city. Blue magic cores light up in an irregular sequence.

Shot 2 (4–10s):
Lyra accelerates, splashing water. The camera moves low and parallel to her. As Lyra's sword passes through the soldiers' armor, blue cracks run along the obsidian shell following the slash line. In the next moment, the soldier shatters into geometric stone fragments and metal parts, and the internal blue magic vanishes into the sky as particles of light.

Lyra crushes a rushing leg-type, and shatters a zig-zagging type with a horizontal sweep. She rolls between two jumping from a car, stands up, and releases a pale blue slash. She destroys a descending individual from a wall with an aerial spin cut. Shattered obsidian pieces slide across the road, splashing rainwater.

Shot 3 (10–15s):
Numerous magical soldiers close in on Lyra. The front three raise their arms within sword range, mid-ground individuals approach from the sides, and a large distant individual is charging. Always keep Lyra and the approaching enemies in the same frame.

Lyra holds her sheathless sword low in her right hand. Pale blue light concentrates on the blade. Just before the front three attack, Lyra rotates her waist and releases a massive 180-degree horizontal fan-shaped shockwave. 

From a wide side angle, show Lyra, the sword, the enemies in front, and the shockwave simultaneously. The shockwave advances from front to back, carving a blue crack into the obsidian armor. With a split-second delay, they shatter chain-link style from near to far. Hundreds of obsidian fragments, metal pieces, and blue light particles cover the rainy intersection, reflecting the neon streetlights.

As the final large individual collapses into massive stone pieces, the blue magic core quietly goes out. Only Lyra stands at the intersection, lowering her sword and exhaling. Shattered obsidian pieces are hit by rain, and her white dress slowly settles.

Important:
Maintain consistency of enemies as unmanned stone and metal structures. When destroyed, draw only obsidian fragments, metal parts, and blue light particles. Do not depict soft body expressions or organic internal structures.

The final massive slash must be released at the moment multiple soldiers close in and enter their attack motion. Do not release the slash after enemies have disappeared or toward an empty road.

人物·表情·动作 —— 风起，发丝、广袖、垂落珠串与满空银杏叶随风轻摆，地面倒影微漾。她睫毛轻颤、眼神由远山缓缓收回，唇瓣微启，浮起一缕怅惘；随台词，左手将白梅轻抬至胸前低头一嗅，再抬眼望向夕阳，右手折扇缓缓半合。气息可见，胸口轻起伏，眼里有湿润光泽。

"又是一年花落时……（一声轻叹）他说过会回来的，可这满廊金黄，都快等白了头。"

镜头 CAMERA —— 自首帧构图起，极缓慢推近（中景→中近景）并带轻微横移，捕捉风动发丝与她回眸；末段微微上扬掠过飘落的银杏叶，光斑流动。全程平稳如电影运镜，无抖动。

氛围·光线 —— 延续黄金时刻逆光暖调，丁达尔光穿廊，暖橙60% / 绛红汉服与红柱30% / 金步摇与白梅高光10%。空气微尘与落叶，柔焦电影质感。

约束 CONSTRAINTS —— 4K 超清，24fps，21:9。正常速度，无慢动作、无变形。人物面貌、发饰、服装、手中扇与花枝严格保持与首帧一致，不得突变.风动与落叶受真实物理，飘落自然不乱飞。眼神戏细腻克制。无字幕无水印，画面无标记符号。禁止眼睛发光。

entries.title: National Geographic Style Chameleon Macro Documentary
entries.description: A highly detailed video generation prompt for Seedance 2.0 that mimics a National Geographic macro documentary. It features a chameleon in a Madagascar rainforest, showcasing its camouflage, eye movement, skin texture, and a 1000fps slow-motion capture of it hunting a grasshopper.
entries.prompt:
【风格】国家地理热带雨林微距纪录片（National Geographic Macro Wildlife），4K超清，微距摄影（Laowa 24mm Macro Probe Lens），超高速升格（Phantom TMX 1000fps），电影级自然光，浅景深
【时长】10秒
【场景】马达加斯加热带雨林树冠层，一根布满地衣和湿苔藓的粗枝上，背景是层叠的深绿色叶片虚化成均匀的圆形光斑（Bokeh），几束阳光穿过树冠缝隙打在枝干上形成明暗交界
[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：完美伪装（Slow Lateral Tracking, Macro Close-Up）
微距缓慢横移，逐渐揭示隐藏在苔藓中的高冠变色龙全貌。它全身呈与苔藓近乎一致的墨绿色，一动不动。
皮肤微距细节：每一片锥形颗粒鳞片（tubercular scales）像微型宝石切面，鳞片顶端有细微的光泽高光点，鳞片之间的沟缝是更深的墨绿。头冠（casque）表面的骨质脊棱粗糙干燥，像风化的岩石微缩。
眼部特写：两只炮塔式眼球各自独立缓慢旋转扫描——左眼向前，右眼向后。眼球外层覆盖鳞片化的圆形眼睑，只留中心一个小圆孔露出瞳孔。虹膜是精密的金棕色放射状纤维纹理，瞳孔是一个极小的漆黑针孔。
前爪细节：五趾分成二三两组形成钳状，紧握树枝，趾底的粗糙肉垫纹路和微小的弯曲趾甲清晰可辨。
[00:04-00:07] 镜头2：变色锁定（Push-In to Head, Split Diopter Focus）
镜头缓慢推进到头部侧面。两只眼睛突然同时转向同一方向——前方30厘米处一只翠绿色蚱蜢停在叶脉上。
变色过程（核心4K测试点）：从尾部开始，鳞片像LED矩阵逐区点亮，颜色从墨绿向鲜黄绿波浪式推进。每一片鳞片独立变色，先是底色变浅，然后表面浮现黄色素点。变色波前经过身体中段时能看到过渡带——同一片鳞片上半绿半黄的瞬间状态。
身体微动：后脚重新抓紧枝干，趾甲在树皮上刻出弧形小划痕，几粒树皮碎屑掉落。整个身体极其缓慢地前倾5度蓄力，喉部微微鼓胀。
[00:07-00:10] 镜头3：弹射猎杀（Ultra High-Speed 1000fps, Side Profile Macro）
侧面超高速升格微距：嘴部张开露出粉白色口腔内壁，舌头根部肌肉猛然收缩——
弹射过程（升格慢动作）：粉红色的弹性舌头以体长1.5倍的距离弹射而出，舌体在空中像一根展开的弹簧逐节伸长。舌尖是一个球状黏液垫，表面密布乳突状微结构。
命中瞬间：黏液垫精准包裹蚱蜢，能看到透明的黏液丝在猎物和舌面之间拉出数根细丝，黏液在逆光下折射出微弱的彩虹色。
回弹：舌头以同等速度回缩，蚱蜢被拽入口腔。变色龙合嘴，两腮缓慢鼓动咀嚼。最后一帧：一只眼球不紧不慢地转向镜头方向，瞳孔微微放大——定格。

entries.title: Osprey Plunge Wildlife Documentary
entries.description: A multi-shot National Geographic style sequence capturing an osprey hovering and plunging into a misty glacial lake to strike a trout.
entries.prompt:
【Style】National Geographic Wildlife Documentary, IMAX-grade imaging, 4K ultra-sharp, Photorealistic, high-frame-rate slow motion
【Duration】10 seconds
【Scene】A glacial highland lake at first light, 1,200 meters elevation. The water is black and mirror-still, ringed by drifting mist; low dawn light rakes across the surface. A faint breeze carves fine ripples near the far shore, where dark pine ridges dissolve into grey fog.
[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: The Hover (Telephoto close-up, 600mm)
Super-telephoto close-up: an osprey hangs almost motionless in the air, wings beating in tight powerful strokes, head locked dead-still and angled straight down. Every feather barb is razor-sharp — chocolate-brown back, snow-white underparts trembling in its own downdraft. In the pale-yellow iris the pupil snaps to a pinpoint as it fixes on a trout finning just beneath the surface. Tiny beads of mist cling to the leading edges of the wings.
[00:04-00:07] Shot 2: The Plunge (High-speed tracking, 240fps super slow motion)
Side-tracking high-speed shot: the osprey folds its wings and drops like a thrown spear, body stretched into a single straight line, talons swung forward and wide, dawn light sliding along the wet curve of the beak. Slow motion captures the instant of impact — the bird punches through the mirror surface and a crown of water bursts outward in a perfect ring, individual droplets hanging suspended in the air, each one catching the light like a glass bead. A translucent nictitating membrane sweeps across the eye a split second before contact.
[00:07-00:10] Shot 3: The Strike (Extreme close-up, macro lens)
Extreme macro close-up: the moment the talons close on the trout — scaled yellow toes spreading apart, black hooked claws sinking through flashing silver fish-scales, a thin sheet of water peeling off the feathers. Shallow depth of field blurs the spray streaking past the lens. Freeze-frame on a single droplet rolling off the tip of a claw, the fish's gill flaring open, cold light glinting on the soaked, curved talon.

entries.title: Iced Latte Coffee Commercial

entries.prompt:
A beautiful young South Asian woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a soft beige casual t-shirt, smiling warmly in a bright modern kitchen. Cinematic, warm natural lighting, shallow depth of field, high-end commercial style, ultra-realistic, 4K.

0-3 sec: Close-up of her hand using metal tongs to elegantly drop crystal-clear ice cubes into a stylish transparent glass on a round wooden coaster. Coffee beans scattered on the table, soft bokeh background.

3-6 sec: Smooth transition to the Golda Coffee Dolce Latte bottle (white plastic with gold cap, brown liquid, visible condensation droplets) on the table. Camera slowly circles the premium bottle showing the label clearly.

6-9 sec: Close-up of the bottle being tilted by her hand, rich creamy brown iced latte pouring smoothly into the glass filled with ice cubes in slow motion. The liquid swirls beautifully around the ice creating a tempting marbled effect.

9-12 sec: Top-down view of the glass as the creamy coffee mixes with ice, creating beautiful swirling patterns. Then medium shot: the woman gently stirs the iced latte with a golden straw, smiling softly.

12-15 sec: She lifts the glass with both hands, brings it close to her face, inhales the aroma with eyes closed in pleasure, then takes a sip. Final shot: Golda bottle and finished iced latte glass side by side on the table. Elegant text appears: "Nikmatnya Lembut, Bikin Hari Makin GOLDA!" in stylish white font.

Ultra-realistic, smooth transitions, appetizing food commercial style, warm color grading, premium product focus, 15 seconds total duration, vertical 9:16 format for social media.

entries.title: Tokyo Travel Vlog Cinematic Script
entries.description: A comprehensive script for a 15-second Tokyo travel vlog including specific timestamps, dialogue, and camera lens details for a realistic smartphone aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
TOKYO TRAVEL VLOG — 15 SEC MUSIC CUT

Subject: Same girl. Long dark wavy hair, Japanese streetwear. 26mm phone lens, deep focus, realistic skin texture, mild HDR, neutral iPhone color science, unedited candid, no cinematic grading, no studio lighting, no light trails, no motion blur effects.

(0:00–0:01) — walking shot, Tokyo Tower  reveal Selfie, low angle. Tower behind her, sky overexposed. Natural smile. Neutral daylight, deep focus. Dialogue: "Okay… we're in Tokyo…!" Transition: Hard cut / beat drop

(0:01–0:02) — Shibuya Crossing Mid-stride into crowd. Turns head toward camera. Neon signs sharp behind her. Real night exposure. Transition: Fast cut on beat

(0:02–0:03) — Convenience Store Holds onigiri up to camera, eyebrows raised. Harsh fluorescent interior. Cool white light, realistic skin. Transition: Snap cut on beat

(0:03–0:04) — Yoyogi Park Seated, looking away. Dappled light, lens smudge visible. Music drops one beat — wind, birds — snaps back. Transition: Cut on natural movement

(0:04–0:06) — Takoyaki Reaction Bites, eyes wide, pulls back laughing. Warm practical lantern light. Realistic skin in amber. Dialogue: "It's so hot — oh my god." Transition: Cut on laugh end

(0:06–0:07) — Vending Machine Night Stands before glowing vending machine. Mixed LED light on face. Slight smirk. No glow fx. Transition: Single beat cut

(0:07–0:08) — Train Window Face reflected in window. City blurred naturally outside. She looks out, not at camera. Transition: Snap cut

(0:08–0:09) — Torii Gate Low angle. Walks toward and through shrine gate. Gate fills top of frame. Natural daylight. Transition: Snap cut

(0:09–0:11) — Digital Light Exhibit ★ SIGNATURE Looks up slowly. Blue, violet, gold projection on face. Rack focus — face sharp, lights diffused. Just projection on skin, no bloom. Speed: ~60% slow motion Transition: Soft cut mid-upward motion

(0:11–0:12) — Gundam Reveal Face → camera tilts up → full statue in frame. Small impressed smile. Wide angle, natural daylight. Transition: Sharp cut after smile

(0:12–0:13) — Lantern Alley Follow from behind. Lanterns warm, shadows dark. Natural low light. She glances back once. Transition: Cut on forward movement

(0:13–0:14) — Rooftop Skyline Close selfie → arm extends → skyline revealed. Wind moves hair. Natural night phone exposure. Dialogue: "I don't think I've ever seen anything like this." Transition: Hard cut on last word

(0:14–0:16) — Nara Deer Park, She crouches, holds out a deer cracker. Deer bows toward her — she bursts out laughing. Another nudges her from behind, she nearly topples. Handheld, slightly off-balance. All real. Dialogue: "Wait— oh my god he actually bowed—" Transition: Fade to black

entries.title: Cute Clingy Girlfriend POV Interaction
entries.description: A highly detailed video generation prompt for creating a first-person perspective interaction with a clingy girlfriend in a gaming room environment, featuring multi-shot coordination and audio instructions.
entries.prompt:
【风格】甜蜜撒娇女友互动短剧（Cute Clingy Girlfriend POV），真人实拍质感（Photorealistic），电竞房RGB氛围光（紫蓝色调为主+粉色点缀），夜间室内，8K超清
【时长】15秒
【场景】夜间电竞房间，粉色电竞椅，桌上双屏显示器发出蓝紫色光，RGB灯带将整个房间笼罩在紫蓝色氛围中，桌面有发光机械键盘、游戏鼠标、粉色鼠标垫，桌角摆着一罐饮料和零食袋，电竞椅旁边的地面上有一双毛绒拖鞋
【角色】女主@图片1（黑色吊带背心、灰色抽绳运动短裤、粉色猫耳头戴式耳机挂在脖子上或戴在头上，黑色长发带粉色挑染发尾，黑色choker项圈、金色圈形耳环，面部毛孔真实可见，表情从气鼓鼓到撒娇到嘟嘴）
【视角】全程锁定第一人称男友视角（First-Person Boyfriend POV），镜头=男友的眼睛，机位在房间门口站立高度，带轻微自然呼吸晃动

[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：委屈转头求助（POV Static, She Turns Around）
画面：女主坐在粉色电竞椅上背对镜头，双手还搭在键盘上，显示器画面闪着蓝光映在她头发上。她猛地转过电竞椅面向镜头方向，猫耳耳机歪了一边，额前碎发凌乱，眉头皱起嘴巴微微鼓着，双眼瞪大带着委屈，像是刚输了一场。她一只手指向屏幕方向，另一只手拍了一下自己大腿表示气愤。
机位：第一人称男友视角，站在房间门口位置，距女主约两米，略俯视（身高差），轻微呼吸晃动（Subtle Breathing Sway），不推不拉。
【对白口型指导】语气急促带委屈，像小孩告状："老公！快来教我打游戏！刚刚又输了，气死了！"
音效：电竞椅转动的"吱——"声，键盘敲击的残余声，显示器里隐约的游戏音效。

[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：撒娇拉扯（POV Approaching, She Reaches Out）
画面：镜头从门口位置缓缓向女主靠近（模拟男友走过去），女主看到男友走来，整个人靠回电竞椅椅背，头往后仰，双脚离地在椅子上晃了两下（像小孩耍赖），然后身体前倾伸出双手朝镜头方向做"快过来"的抓握动作，五指反复张合，眼神从委屈切换成撒娇，下嘴唇微微前突嘟起来，猫耳耳机上的粉色灯光一闪一闪。
机位：第一人称视角保持，模拟男友缓步走近（Slow Dolly Forward），距离从两米缩到半米，视线自然微微下移跟随她仰头再前倾的动态。
【对白口型指导】语气从急切变成撒娇拉长音，带哼唧感："快来嘛～快来教我嘛～"
音效：毛绒拖鞋踩地板的轻响（男友脚步），电竞椅弹簧的轻微吱呀声。

[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：凑近撒娇定格（Intimate Close-up POV）
画面：女主直接从电竞椅上站起来，脸凑到镜头正前方不到二十厘米，整张脸占满画面大半，紫蓝色RGB灯光打在她左半脸，粉色猫耳耳机的灯光映在她右半脸，形成冷暖对比。她歪着头，左手伸到画面外（暗示抓住了男友的手臂），右手食指点了一下镜头方向（像戳男友胸口），然后突然露出一个灿烂笑容，露出上排牙齿，眼睛弯成月牙，碎发贴在脸颊上。
机位：第一人称视角不变，女主主动凑近形成极度亲密特写（Extreme Intimate Close-up），男友视角不后退，她的脸充满画面。
【对白口型指导】最后几个字声音变小变甜，像确认胜利的猫咪："老公～"（拖长尾音，带轻轻的笑声收尾）
音效：她憋不住的轻笑声，然后安静，只剩显示器低沉的电流嗡鸣声和远处键盘灯的微弱噼啪声。

【音频总指导】中文女声独白，甜美撒娇但不做作，语速前快后慢（前半急切后半拖音撒娇），咬字清晰偶尔带气音，唇形同步准确（Lip-Sync）。全程无背景音乐，仅电竞房间环境音效（设备运转的低频嗡鸣+偶尔的游戏音效），安静氛围突出女主声线的亲密感。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style] Cute Clingy Girlfriend POV interaction short drama, photorealistic quality, e-sports room RGB atmosphere lighting (predominantly purple-blue with pink accents), indoor at night, 8K ultra-clear. [Duration] 15 seconds. [Scene] Nighttime gaming room, pink gaming chair, dual monitors on the desk emitting blue-violet light, RGB light strips enveloping the whole room in a purple-blue atmosphere, illuminated mechanical keyboard, gaming mouse, pink mouse pad, a can of drink and a bag of snacks on the corner of the desk, a pair of plush slippers on the floor next to the chair. [Character] Female protagonist based on @Image1 (black camisole, grey drawstring sports shorts, pink cat-ear headphones around the neck or on the head, long black hair with pink highlights, black choker, gold hoop earrings, realistic skin pores, expressions ranging from pouting to acting cute). [Perspective] Locked First-Person Boyfriend POV throughout, camera equals boyfriend's eyes, standing height at the door, with slight natural breathing sway.

[00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Turning around in grievance (POV Static, She Turns Around)
Visual: The girl sits in the pink gaming chair with her back to the camera, hands still on the keyboard, the monitor's blue light reflecting on her hair. She suddenly turns the chair to face the camera, cat-ear headphones tilted, messy bangs, brow furrowed with a slight pout, eyes wide and aggrieved like she just lost a game. She points one hand at the screen and slaps her thigh with the other to show frustration.
Camera: First-person boyfriend POV, standing at the doorway, about two meters from her, slightly looking down (height difference), subtle breathing sway, no zoom.
[Lip-sync/Dialogue Guide] Hurried and aggrieved tone, like a child complaining: "Hubby! Come and teach me how to play! I lost again, I'm so mad!"
SFX: The creak of the gaming chair turning, remaining sound of keyboard clicking, faint game sound effects from the monitor.

[00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Acting cute and pulling (POV Approaching, She Reaches Out)
Visual: The camera slowly approaches her from the doorway (simulating the boyfriend walking over). Seeing him approach, she leans back into the chair, tilts her head back, kicks her feet off the ground twice (acting like a spoiled child), then leans forward reaching both hands toward the camera in a "come here" grasping motion, fingers opening and closing, eyes switching from aggrieved to acting cute, lower lip slightly protruding, pink lights on the cat-ear headphones flashing.
Camera: Maintaining first-person POV, simulating a slow walk forward (Slow Dolly Forward), distance closing from two meters to half a meter, gaze naturally following her dynamic movement from leaning back to forward.
[Lip-sync/Dialogue Guide] Tone changing from urgent to a long, cute whine: "Come on~ come teach me~"
SFX: Soft sound of plush slippers on the floor (boyfriend's footsteps), slight creak of the chair springs.

[00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Close-up cute freeze (Intimate Close-up POV)
Visual: The girl stands up directly from the chair, face moving to within twenty centimeters of the camera, filling most of the frame. Purple-blue RGB light hits the left side of her face while pink light from the headphones reflects on the right, creating a warm-cold contrast. She tilts her head, left hand reaching off-camera (implying she grabbed the boyfriend's arm), right index finger tapping toward the camera (like poking his chest), then suddenly breaks into a brilliant smile, showing upper teeth, eyes curving into crescents, stray hair sticking to her cheek.
Camera: First-person POV remains unchanged, her face filling the screen in an extreme intimate close-up as she moves in.
[Lip-sync/Dialogue Guide] The last few words become quieter and sweeter, like a cat confirming victory: "Hubby~" (trailing off with a soft laugh at the end).
SFX: Her muffled soft chuckle, then silence, leaving only the low electrical hum of the monitor and the faint crackle of keyboard lights in the distance.

[General Audio Guide] Chinese female monologue, sweet and coquettish but not forced, speed fast at first then slowing down with trailing tones, clear articulation with occasional breathy sounds, accurate lip-sync. No background music throughout, only ambient e-sports room sound effects (low-frequency equipment hum + occasional game sounds), emphasizing the intimacy of her voice in the quiet atmosphere.

entries.title: National Geographic Snow Leopard Hunt
entries.description: A multi-shot cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 that generates a realistic 4K wildlife documentary sequence of a snow leopard stalking and striking its prey.
entries.prompt:
【风格】国家地理自然纪录片（National Geographic Wildlife Documentary），IMAX电影画质，4K超清，真实摄影（Photorealistic），高帧率升格慢动作
【时长】10秒
【场景】海拔4500米的雪山岩壁，灰白碎石坡上薄雪覆盖，背景是青灰色的连绵山脊，天空阴沉，雪粒在风中横飞
[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：潜伏（Telephoto Close-Up, 600mm）
超长焦特写：一只雪豹趴在岩石后方，只露出半张脸和前爪。风吹动它脸颊两侧蓬松的灰白长毛，每一根毛尖带冰晶。琥珀色虹膜中瞳孔猛地收缩——它锁定了猎物。前爪无声地收紧，爪垫上粗糙的肉垫纹理清晰可见。
[00:04-00:07] 镜头2：爆发（High-Speed Tracking, 240fps Super Slow-mo）
侧面高速跟拍：雪豹从岩石后弹射而出，四肢完全伸展成一条直线，脊椎弯弓蓄力。后腿蹬踏岩面的瞬间，碎石和雪末被踢成扇形飞散。升格慢动作捕捉：尾巴像一条粗绳在空中画弧维持平衡，腹部的白色长毛在气流中翻卷。
[00:07-00:10] 镜头3：一击（Extreme Close-Up, Macro Lens）
极端特写：雪豹前爪拍击地面的瞬间，五指张开，弯曲的黑色利爪刺入薄雪层，溅起细碎的冰晶粒子在镜头前飞过（浅景深虚化）。定格在爪尖没入雪面的一帧，能看到爪钩弧度上反射的冷光。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style] National Geographic Wildlife Documentary, IMAX cinematic quality, 4K ultra-clear, photorealistic, high frame rate slow motion.
[Duration] 10 seconds.
[Scene] Snow mountain rock wall at an altitude of 4500 meters, thin snow covering gray-white scree slopes, background of continuous gray-blue ridges, overcast sky, snow particles flying in the wind.
[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Ambush (Telephoto Close-Up, 600mm)
Extreme telephoto close-up: A snow leopard lies behind a rock, showing only half of its face and front paws. The wind blows the fluffy long gray-white hair on both sides of its cheeks, each hair tip tipped with ice crystals. The pupil in the amber iris contracts sharply—it has locked onto its prey. The front paw tightens silently, and the coarse texture of the paw pads is clearly visible.
[00:04-00:07] Shot 2: Eruption (High-Speed Tracking, 240fps Super Slow-mo)
Side high-speed tracking: The snow leopard catapults from behind the rock, limbs fully extended into a straight line, spine arched for power. The moment the hind legs kick the rock surface, debris and snow dust are kicked up and scattered in a fan shape. Captured in slow motion: The tail arcs in the air like a thick rope to maintain balance, and the long white hair on the belly rolls in the airflow.
[00:07-00:10] Shot 3: The Strike (Extreme Close-Up, Macro Lens)
Extreme close-up: The moment the snow leopard's front paw strikes the ground, fingers spread, curved black claws pierce the thin snow layer, splashing fine ice crystal particles past the camera (shallow depth of field blur). Freeze-frame at the moment the claw tip enters the snow surface, showing the cold light reflected on the curve of the claw hook.

entries.title: Realistic Cinematic Skydiving Scene
entries.description: A detailed multi-scene prompt designed for maximum character consistency, describing a 15-second skydiving sequence from aircraft exit to a soft meadow landing.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic skydiving video using the uploaded photo as the exact character reference. The person's face must remain identical to the uploaded image throughout the entire video. Preserve facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin texture, hairstyle, and overall identity with maximum consistency. No face changes, no beautification, no age changes, no identity drift. The person is wearing a realistic skydiving jumpsuit and a visible parachute backpack securely attached to their back before the jump. The parachute bag should be clearly visible in multiple shots. Scene 1 (0–3s) Inside an aircraft at high altitude. The person stands near the open aircraft door wearing the parachute backpack. Wind blowing naturally. Close-up cinematic shots of the face, hands adjusting straps, and the parachute pack. Bright blue sky and clouds outside. Scene 2 (3–8s) The person slowly exits the aircraft and begins a controlled, graceful freefall. Do not make the fall appear excessively fast. Create the feeling of floating through the sky. Use smooth cinematic slow-motion photography. Camera angles: •Front-facing shot with face clearly visible •Side profile shot •Camera above looking downward •Camera below looking upward toward the person against the blue sky •Wide aerial shot showing the vast landscape below The parachute backpack remains visible and realistic. Scene 3 (8–11s) Alternate between: •First-person POV looking down at Earth •Ultra-wide aerial shots showing rivers, forests, valleys, clouds, and distant mountain ranges •Close-up shots of the person's face enjoying the experience The descent feels calm, smooth, and majestic rather than extreme or aggressive. Scene 4 (11–13s) The parachute opens smoothly. Realistic canopy deployment. The person gently glides through the air above a beautiful green meadow surrounded by mountains. Golden sunlight, cinematic atmosphere, floating sensation. Scene 5 (13–15s) Soft landing in a lush green meadow with mountains in the background. The person removes one hand from the parachute controls and walks toward the camera naturally. Dialogue (natural lip sync): "That was a good adventure. Try this." Cinematography •Hollywood adventure film quality •Ultra-realistic live-action footage •Slow-motion aerial photography •Smooth drone movements •Camera above, below, side, front, and POV perspectives •Blue sky, white clouds, breathtaking Earth views •Green meadow landing zone •Mountain panorama •Natural lighting •Realistic wind interaction •Professional color grading •4K cinematic quality Identity Lock •Face consistency: maximum •Identity preservation: maximum •Same person in every frame •No facial modifications •No face swapping •No AI beautification •No age change •No hairstyle change •No facial flicker •Face clearly recognizable throughout the video

Style: Japanese anime with a high frame count. An animated film using action movie techniques.
Action scene.

entries.title: Japanese 2D Anime Ramen Cooking
entries.description: An ASMR-focused anime cooking prompt that uses storyboards as composition references to create a vibrant 15-second sequence of a ramen bowl being prepared.
entries.prompt: Use rough pencil sketch storyboards as visual references. Use the storyboards only for composition, camera angles, hand movements, food placement, and cooking continuity, and convert the final video into a full-color, high-quality Japanese 2D anime cooking video. Do not retain the appearance of black-and-white pencil sketches in the final video. As a 15-second high-quality Japanese 2D anime cooking video, depict a sinfully indulgent raen contimentae r. Full-color anime style, vibrant and appetite-stimulating anime colors, fast-paced editing, quick-tempo cuts. However, not fast cooking, not sped-up cooking, and not time-lapse cooking. Make each cooking action easy to read, physically natural, and handle hand movements with care. Maintain natural tool handling and clear food continuity. No live-action, no photorealism, no 3D CGI, no game-like style, no subtitles, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no narration, no dialogue, no BGM. The food is the star, and a character appears only at the end to happily take a bite. Chronological Action Sequence (0:00 - 0:15): [0:00 - 0:02] The Teaser: Extreme macro close-up of a finished bowl of shoyu ramen. Thick, volumetric steam billows gracefully. The camera focuses on the glossy surface of an ajitama (marinated egg) and a crisp sheet of nori. [0:02 - 0:03] The Prep: Quick cut to a close-up of a chef's hand swiftly slicing a thick, juicy roll of chashu pork belly on a wooden cutting board with a heavy knife. [0:03 - 0:04] The Boil: Low-angle dynamic shot. A teppo (noodle basket) filled with raw yellow noodles is plunged into a roaring pot of boiling water. A massive cloud of steam erupts toward the lens. [0:04 - 0:05] The Base: Extreme close-up. A ladle pours a thick, dark, glossy tare (soy sauce base) into the bottom of a pristine ceramic bowl. [0:05 - 0:06] The Shake: Fast-motion cut. The noodle basket is pulled from the water and vigorously shaken twice. Drops of hot water fly off the noodles in slow-motion anime style. [0:06 - 0:07] The Fold: Close-up of chopsticks gracefully sliding the perfectly cooked, steaming noodles out of the basket, folding them neatly into the bowl of tare. [0:07 - 0:08] The Sear: Extreme close-up of a blue kitchen blowtorch flame blasting the surface of the chashu slices. The fat aggressively sizzles, pops, and chars. [0:08 - 0:10] The Broth: Slow-motion beauty shot. A ladle pours golden, steaming, rich pork broth over the folded noodles. The broth swirls and mixes dynamically with the dark tare at the bottom. [0:10 - 0:11] The Assembly: Rapid montage cuts. Chopsticks perfectly place the charred chashu, crisp bamboo shoots, and bright green scallions on top of the noodles. The ajitama is dropped gently into the broth, making a tiny ripple. [0:11 - 0:13] The Bite: Camera pulls back slightly. A cute, heavily stylized anime supporting character grabs a massive pinch of noodles with chopsticks

entries.title: 1980s Sitcom Nostalgia Scene
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a nostalgic 1980s sitcom scene, including visual aesthetics, dialogue, and specific camera movements.
entries.prompt:
A cozy suburban living room in 1987. Warm tungsten lamps, wood paneling, houseplants, VHS tapes, and a bulky CRT television create an authentic 1980s atmosphere. A handsome 18-year-old young man with feathered hair and a denim jacket sits on a plaid couch beside a pretty 18-year-old young woman with curly shoulder-length hair, pastel sweater, and jeans. They are relaxed, smiling and talking like lifelong friends. The scene has the look of a classic prime-time sitcom, with soft film grain, slight VHS color bleed, and gentle audience laughter after humorous moments.

The camera starts in a medium two-shot with subtle dolly movement. Both actors have natural eye contact, realistic facial expressions, blinking, and casual hand gestures. Warm practical lighting and slight halation around bright lamps evoke Kodak film stock.

Dialogue:

Young man (thoughtfully):
 "You know, maybe someday computers will get smart enough to help make movies."
Young woman (laughing softly):
 "Movies? Come on. You mean like robots writing scripts and making whole scenes?"

Young man:
 "Yeah, maybe. Imagine typing an idea and watching it come to life."
Young woman (smiling):
 "That sounds crazy. I wonder if AI will ever be able to make movies."

They exchange amused looks and laugh together. The audience chuckles lightly. The camera slowly pushes in as the CRT television flickers in the background.

Authentic 1980s sitcom aesthetics
Kodak 5247 film stock colors

Soft halation and analog grain

Multi-camera sitcom lighting
Gentle dolly camera movement
Natural lip sync and facial expressions
Slight VHS artifacts and color bloom
Cozy nostalgic mood

Live-action realism

entries.title: Celestial Star Transformation Sequence
entries.description: An ultra-cinematic cosmic prompt depicting an astronaut transforming into a solar being near a colossal star.
entries.prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic cosmic transformation sequence near the surface of a colossal star.

A lone astronaut floats above an ocean of blazing solar plasma. Gigantic solar flares erupt across the horizon while rivers of molten light flow beneath swirling magnetic storms.

The atmosphere is awe-inspiring, cosmic, and immense.

The camera slowly circles around the astronaut as intense golden sunlight floods the frame. The spacesuit glows brighter and brighter under impossible stellar energy.

Suddenly the star responds.

Solar plasma begins rising from the surface and spiraling around the astronaut in gigantic luminous ribbons. Magnetic arcs connect the body to the star below.

The transformation begins.

Golden cracks appear across the spacesuit. Blinding stellar light emerges from within. The suit fragments into glowing particles that dissolve into streams of plasma.

The camera pushes closer as the astronaut's body becomes translucent. Inside, miniature stars ignite beneath the skin. Veins transform into flowing rivers of solar energy.

The transformation accelerates.

Massive solar flares orbit around the body. Golden plasma wings emerge behind the figure. The surrounding space bends under immense heat and radiation.

The astronaut rises above the stellar surface while the body evolves into living fusion energy. Flesh becomes incandescent light. Limbs are formed from rotating solar storms, magnetic fields, and radiant plasma.

Entire coronal eruptions respond to the transformation.

At the climax, the astronaut becomes a Solar Being ,a magnificent cosmic entity composed of starfire, plasma currents, golden fusion energy, and radiant celestial light. Their body shines brighter than the surrounding star.

Gigantic wings of solar fire stretch across space while magnetic arcs connect them to the stellar surface below.

Final cinematic moment: the Solar Being extends both arms. A colossal solar flare erupts from the star and spirals around them like a cosmic crown. The camera pulls back to reveal the radiant figure standing above the star as a newborn god of stellar fire.

Style: ultra cinematic cosmic fantasy, stellar transformation, realistic solar plasma simulation, coronal mass ejections, magnetic field visualization, radiant golden energy, space-scale cinematography, photoreal astrophysics aesthetic, godlike celestial presence, AAA visual effects quality, no text, no overlays.

Audio: epic cosmic orchestral score, celestial choir, deep stellar resonance, solar plasma surges, magnetic energy hums, cosmic ambience, rising cinematic crescendo, transcendent godlike atmosphere.

entries.title: World Cup Penalty Kick Celebration

The camera quickly moves back to maintain a frontal follow. Argentine teammates rush up from behind to embrace the protagonist, forming a celebration circle, but the protagonist's face remains visible throughout, positioned in the center of the frame. entries.title: Cinematic Ancient Palace Cat-Girl Drama

entries.prompt:
45秒短劇，16:9，電影感，電影級光影，高級古風皇宮，超現實質感。

場景： 深夜奢華帝王寢宮，巨大龍床金絲帳幔，窗外月光灑落，燭火搖曳與冷藍月光對比，空氣中漂浮淡淡白霧。

角色： 男主是高大冷峻的霸道皇帝，臉龐輪廓分明、劍眉星目、深邃眼神帶有強烈壓迫感，龍袍墨黑金邊，氣場極強；女主是化形後的白貓女孩，雪白長髮帶軟萌貓耳，褐色眼睛配淡紫色眼影，如同SD娃娃般精緻妝容，薄紗白裙，身材玲瓏，氣質慵懶又倔強；太后是威嚴刻薄的美豔中年女子，鳳冠霞帔，華貴雍容，眼神凌厲；刺客是清瘦俊朗的中年男子，氣質冷冽，眼神銳利如刀。

風格： 電影級打光，淺景深，高級古風時尚攝影質感，電影色彩分級，極致細節，貓耳細毛隨風微動。

分鏡：
0-3s：皇帝獨坐龍床邊，冷峻側臉在月光下格外深刻，手輕撫身旁雪白貓咪。
3-6s：白貓舒服蜷縮在他懷裡，皇帝罕見露出柔和眼神。
6-9s：切到太后寢殿，太后美豔臉龐帶著刻薄怒意，重重拍桌：「皇帝夜夜抱貓同眠，拒絕選秀，立刻給我查清楚！」
9-12s：幾名太監低頭退下，畫面快速切到黑衣刺客潛入皇宮。
12-15s：刺客身影如鬼魅逼近寢宮，皇帝警覚抬頭，白貓突然竄起警戒。

第二段（15-30秒）：
15-18s：刺客破窗而入，長刀直取白貓，皇帝瞬間起身將貓護在身後。
18-21s：白貓在月光中爆發刺眼白光，瞬間化形成帶貓耳的美女孩，薄紗輕舞，褐色眼睛在淡紫眼影襯托下格外迷人。
21-24s：刺客眼神從殺意瞬間變成驚艷與迷戀，刀停在半空。
24-27s：貓耳女孩輕盈落地，尾巴微微晃動，抬眸望向皇帝，眼神倔強。
27-30s：皇帝眼神一沉，低沉霸道開口：「敢動朕的貓，你們找死。」

第三段（30-45秒）：
30-33s：貓耳女孩輕笑，貓耳抖動，主動擋在皇帝身前，精緻妝容在月光下如瓷娃娃般完美。
33-36s：刺客痴痴上前，聲音微顫：「姑娘……你究竟是何方仙子？」
36-39s：皇帝一把將女孩拉回懷裡，冷冷掃視刺客：「她是朕的人，誰也別想碰。」
39-42s：貓耳女孩抬頭看皇帝，眼神從倔強逐漸變成依戀，低聲：「陛下……今晚還要抱我睡嗎？」
42-45s：皇帝嘴角微揚，俯身靠近她耳邊，極低霸道地說：「不僅今晚，以後每晚你都逃不掉。」鏡頭停留在兩人充滿張力的對視與刺客呆滯的表情上。

entries.title: Football Broadcast Fan Goal Scenario
entries.description: A highly detailed video prompt for a realistic football broadcast where a fan leaps from the stands to score a world-class goal.
entries.prompt:
Official television football broadcast feed, ultra-realistic live sports coverage, 4K 60fps, professional stadium camera system, smooth tripod tracking, high-angle zoom lens. The main character is the exact man from the reference image: young South Asian male, neatly styled black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a fitted dark brown polo shirt, beige trousers, luxury watch, athletic build.
A packed football stadium during a championship match. Permanent TV graphics remain visible throughout: top-left digital scoreboard displaying "MATCHWEEK 24 | NAS 2 | SHB 1", top-right "SSC 1 LIVE" logo. Natural daylight, authentic broadcast color grading, realistic crowd atmosphere.
The camera pans across the audience and stops on the man casually sitting among fans. He is eating a burger and holding a blue soda can while watching the game. He suddenly notices himself on the giant stadium screen and gives a surprised, confident smile directly toward the broadcast camera. Nearby fans cheer and point at the screen.
Without hesitation, he calmly places the burger and soda on his seat, stands up, and smoothly vaults over the stadium barrier with impressive athleticism. The broadcast camera quickly follows him with professional sports-camera tracking as he runs down to the pitch.
A professional football player in a white uniform notices him and passes the ball directly to his feet. The man perfectly controls the ball, dribbles confidently across the grass, then unleashes a powerful long-range strike. Cinematic slow motion as the ball rockets through the air toward the top corner of the goal.
The goalkeeper dives at full stretch but cannot reach it. The ball smashes into the upper corner of the net. Massive crowd eruption. Thousands of fans leap to their feet cheering. Stadium atmosphere becomes electric.
The man raises both arms in celebration, laughing and smiling. Teammates and fans react with disbelief and excitement. The camera zooms closer as he walks directly toward the lens. He gives a charismatic grin and playfully places his hand over the camera, completely covering the frame.
Authentic stadium audio, crowd chants, distant announcer commentary, realistic footsteps on grass, ball impact sounds, explosive crowd roar after the goal. Photorealistic textures, broadcast-quality realism, natural motion physics, cinematic sports storytelling, seamless camera movements, no glitches, no distortions, no extra limbs, no text errors.

entries.title: Summer Park Kindness Story
entries.description: A heartwarming cinematic prompt depicting a boy's act of kindness in a park during golden hour, featuring character consistency and emotional close-ups.
entries.prompt: **Style:** Ultra-realistic cinematic short film, heartwarming atmosphere, golden hour lighting, vibrant summer colors, natural acting, realistic facial expressions, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, smooth camera movement, Hollywood-quality cinematography, 4K HDR. **Character Consistency:** Same 8-year-old boy throughout the video, cheerful face, short dark hair, yellow T-shirt, denim shorts, sneakers. Same ice cream vendor throughout, middle-aged man with a warm smile, white apron and cap. Maintain identical appearances in every shot. **0–5 Seconds** A lively neighborhood park during golden hour. Children play in the distance, birds chirp, and warm sunlight bathes the scene. An 8-year-old boy excitedly approaches a colorful ice cream cart, takes out a few coins, and buys a vanilla ice cream cone from the friendly vendor. He beams with happiness as he walks away admiring his treat. Smooth cinematic tracking shot. **5–10 Seconds** The boy suddenly notices three children nearby quietly watching his ice cream with hopeful expressions. He pauses, looks at his cone, then at the children. After a brief moment of thought, his face lights up with kindness. He walks over and happily offers them his ice cream. The children smile gratefully, touched by his generosity. Cinematic close-ups capture the warm emotions. **10–13 Seconds** The vendor watches the exchange with admiration. Inspired by the boy's selfless act, he smiles broadly and begins handing out fresh colorful ice cream cones to all the children nearby. Laughter erupts as children cheer and gather around the cart. **13–15 Seconds** Wide cinematic shot of the park glowing under the golden sunset. Children laugh, enjoy their ice creams, and play together while the boy smiles contentedly. The camera slowly pulls back and gently fades. **On-screen Subtitle (Appears only during the final 2 seconds):** "Kindness is contagious. One small act can sweeten everyone's day."

entries.title: Global Football Cinematic Journey
entries.description: A high-production video prompt following a football across Pakistan, Brazil, France, Africa, and Japan with smooth cinematic transitions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-cinematic global football video showing a single football traveling across different countries and cultures.

The video starts in a narrow street in Pakistan, where kids are playing barefoot football. One powerful kick sends the ball flying into the air. As the ball spins in slow motion, it transitions seamlessly into Brazil, where it is controlled by a street freestyle player in a colorful favela.

With another kick, the ball flies through a glowing motion blur and lands in France, where it is passed on a clean urban pitch under sunset lights. The camera follows the ball as it continues its journey.

Next transition: Africa, where children play joyfully on dusty ground with raw energy and celebration. Then the ball is kicked again and transitions into Japan, where it is controlled with precision in a futuristic, neon-lit street football scene.

Each transition is smooth, magical, and cinematic—using light trails, match cuts, and speed ramps.

Final shot: the ball rises into the sky, transforming into a glowing globe made of stadium lights. The world rotates inside it.

End text on black screen:
“One Ball. Millions of Dreams. One World.”

Style: cinematic, hyper-realistic, emotional, smooth transitions, global cultures, 4K, dramatic lighting, inspirational soundtrack, slow motion + speed ramp mix.

entries.title: Wuxia Action Duel Between Chinese and Japanese Swordsmen
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a choreographed combat sequence between a Chinese swordsman and a Japanese martial artist in a sunset courtyard setting.
entries.prompt:
【风格】武侠动作电影（Wuxia Action Film），真人电影质感（Photorealistic），IMAX画质，8K超清，快慢镜切换（Ramp-mo），凌厉剪辑风格，2人出镜

【时长】15秒

【场景】黄昏逆光的户外空旷石板广场，四周散落着残破石柱，地面有浅浅积水，天空橘红晚霞，微风卷起枯叶

【角色】中方剑客@图片1（深棕色长发带刘海的东亚女性，穿米白色袖口带深蓝色条纹的针织开衫、米色吊带内搭、棕色格纹短裙、黑色丝袜、深色乐福鞋，右手持一柄中式环首长刀）、日方剑客@图片2（粉色卷发双马尾的东亚女性，穿粉色樱花纹和服、深红色宽腰封配金色绳结，双手持一柄日式太刀）

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：无声对峙（Silent Standoff — Extreme Close-up）

交叉快切（Cross Cut）：中方剑客的眼睛特写——瞳孔骤然收缩，睫毛微颤；切到日方剑客的眼睛特写——目光锐利，嘴角微收。

低角度特写：中方剑客右手握紧刀柄，指节发白；切到日方剑客双手缓缓将太刀抬至肩侧，和服宽袖垂落。

全景：两人相距五步对立，逆光剪影，一片枯叶从两人中间飘落——叶片触地的瞬间，两人同时踏地冲出，积水被脚步炸成水花。

[00:03-00:07] 镜头2：第一轮交锋·四连击（Rapid Blitz — Steadicam Tracking）

环绕跟拍（Arc Shot 180°）：中方剑客冲刺贴近，环首刀从右侧低位斜撩上挑，刀锋划破空气带出尖锐的破风声；日方剑客侧身太刀竖挡，两刃碰撞迸出一簇金属火花（Practical Sparks），冲击将两人的头发同时向后吹起。

快切：日方剑客借格挡之力顺势旋身，太刀拖出一道弧光反手横扫；中方剑客向后仰身闪避，刀尖贴着她的刘海尖端掠过，几根发丝被气流带起飘散。

中景：中方剑客仰身未稳立刻反击，环首刀从下往上崩刀上架，刀背与太刀再次硬碰，火花与积水水珠同时飞溅在镜头前。

[00:07-00:11] 镜头3：缠斗升级·压制与反杀（Escalation — Slow-mo to Ramp）

极致慢动作（Super Slow-mo）：日方剑客高高跃起，和服下摆在空中展开如伞面，太刀双手高举过顶全力纵劈而下，金色腰绳在空中甩出弧线。

升格转正常速（Ramp-mo）：中方剑客单膝跪地，环首刀横举过头硬接这一劈——巨大的力量将石板地面从她膝下向外震出放射状裂纹，积水被冲击波掀成一圈环形水墙。

特写：中方剑客从刀刃交锁的缝隙间抬眼，眼神从隐忍骤然变为凶狠，牙关紧咬猛然发力将太刀弹开。

[00:11-00:15] 镜头4：终极对冲·定格（Final Rush — Freeze Frame）

全景/高速摄影：两人同时后退三步各自蓄力，中方剑客将环首刀反握压低至腰侧，日方剑客太刀收至右肩侧呈居合起手式。

正面对称构图（Symmetrical Shot）：两人同时全力冲向对方，开衫衣摆与和服长袖在奔跑中疯狂翻飞，脚下积水被踏出两道平行的水浪。

定格画面（Freeze Frame）：两人在画面正中交错而过的瞬间骤停——中方剑客刀锋已划过日方剑客身侧，日方剑客太刀已穿过中方剑客身旁，碎裂的水珠和火花悬浮在两人之间，逆光将飞溅的水滴染成金色。黄昏的光从两人交错的身体间穿透，衣袂与发丝凝固在风中。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Style] Wuxia action film, photorealistic cinematic quality, IMAX quality, 8K Ultra HD, ramp-mo transitions, sharp editing style, 2 people on screen.

[Duration] 15 seconds

[Scene] An empty stone plaza outdoors at dusk with backlight. Scattered broken stone pillars, shallow puddles on the ground, orange-red sunset sky, a breeze swirling withered leaves.

[Characters] Chinese Swordsman @Image 1 (East Asian female with deep brown long hair and bangs, wearing an off-white knitted cardigan with deep blue stripes on the cuffs, beige camisole, brown plaid skirt, black stockings, dark loafers, holding a Chinese ring-pommel broadsword in her right hand); Japanese Swordsman @Image 2 (East Asian female with pink curly twin tails, wearing a pink cherry blossom pattern kimono, dark red wide obi with gold cord knots, holding a Japanese katana with both hands).

[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Silent Standoff — Extreme Close-up

Cross Cut: Close-up of the Chinese swordsman's eyes—pupils suddenly contract, eyelashes tremble slightly; cut to close-up of the Japanese swordsman's eyes—sharp gaze, mouth slightly tightening.

Low Angle Close-up: Chinese swordsman grips the hilt tightly with her right hand, knuckles turning white; cut to Japanese swordsman slowly raising the katana to shoulder level, the kimono's wide sleeves draping down.

Panoramic: The two stand five paces apart, silhouetted against the light. A withered leaf falls between them—the moment the leaf touches the ground, both charge simultaneously, the puddles exploding into spray.

[00:03-00:07] Shot 2: First Round Exchange / Four Consecutive Strikes — Steadicam Tracking

Arc Shot 180°: Chinese swordsman rushes close, the ring-pommel sword swinging diagonally upward from the right low position, the blade cutting through the air with a sharp wind sound; Japanese swordsman parries vertically with her katana, the collision of the two blades producing a shower of practical sparks, the impact blowing both their hair back.

Quick Cut: Japanese swordsman uses the momentum of the parry to spin, her katana tracing an arc in a backhand horizontal sweep; Chinese swordsman leans back to dodge, the blade tip grazing the tip of her bangs as hair strands are tossed by the airflow.

Medium Shot: Chinese swordsman counters immediately before stabilizing, using the ring-pommel sword to block upward. The back of her blade clashes with the katana again, with sparks and water droplets splashing in front of the lens.

[00:07-00:11] Shot 3: Escalated Combat / Suppression and Counter — Slow-mo to Ramp

Super Slow-mo: Japanese swordsman leaps high, her kimono hem spreading like an umbrella in the air. She holds the katana with both hands overhead, slashing down with full force. The golden waist rope traces an arc in the air.

Speed Ramp (Slow to Normal): Chinese swordsman kneels on one knee, holding the ring-pommel sword horizontally overhead to catch the blow—the enormous force causes the stone floor to crack radially beneath her knee, and puddles are thrown into a circular water wall by the shockwave.

Close-up: Chinese swordsman looks up from the gap where the blades are locked, her expression turning from endurance to ferocity as she grit her teeth and forcibly repels the katana.

[00:11-00:15] Shot 4: Final Rush — Freeze Frame

Panoramic/High-Speed Photography: Both retreat three steps to gather strength. Chinese swordsman holds her sword in a reverse grip low at her waist; Japanese swordsman holds her katana at her right shoulder in an Iaido stance.

Symmetrical Shot: Both rush at each other with full strength, the cardigan hem and kimono sleeves flapping wildly. Their footsteps kick up two parallel waves in the puddles.

Freeze Frame: The moment they cross in the center of the frame, everything stops—the Chinese swordsman's blade has swept past the Japanese swordsman's side, and the katana has passed the Chinese swordsman. Shattered water droplets and sparks are suspended between them, colored gold by the backlight. The dusk light penetrates between their intersecting bodies, with clothes and hair frozen in the wind.

entries.title: Elevator Celebrity Encounter POV
entries.description: A highly detailed multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.0 designed to create a realistic first-person perspective of meeting a celebrity in an elevator, emphasizing specific button interactions and character consistency.
entries.prompt:
整体风格：第一人称手机实拍感，真实电梯内视角，生活化短视频，轻微手持抖动，普通室内白色顶灯，像随手拍到的电梯偶遇。主角使用上传参考图中的女性，保持她的脸、发型、五官、身材比例和气质一致。

核心剧情：

拍摄者站在电梯里面拿手机拍摄。电梯门正在慢慢关闭，门缝越来越窄。透过门缝看到走廊里有一位漂亮女生正朝电梯走来。拍摄者突然紧张起来，急忙把镜头转向电梯按钮面板，连续多次按下“开门键”。这个按钮不是文字按钮，而是两个箭头向左右分开的电梯开门图标。电梯门重新打开，女生走进电梯。

镜头 1（0-2 秒）

主体：电梯门正在缓慢关闭，门缝外出现参考图中的女性。

动作：

0-1 秒：第一人称站在电梯内，手机竖屏拍摄电梯门口。电梯门从两侧慢慢向中间合拢。

1-2 秒：门缝中看到参考图女性从走廊远处走来或小跑过来，拍摄者明显注意到她。

环境：现代公寓/办公楼电梯间，灰色瓷砖地面，白色墙面，走廊顶灯，电梯金属门框。

镜头：手机在电梯内向外拍，门框和逐渐变窄的门缝形成压迫感。

风格：真实手机随手拍，轻微手抖，带一点“差点错过”的紧张感。

约束：必须看出电梯门正在关闭，女主在门缝外出现。

镜头 2（2-4 秒）

主体：拍摄者的手 and 电梯按钮面板。

动作：

2-2.5 秒：镜头突然慌忙转向电梯按钮面板，画面快速晃动。

2.5-4 秒：拍摄者用手指连续快速按下电梯开门按钮 3-5 次，动作急促。按钮是“两个箭头向左右分开”的开门图标，按钮亮起绿色光圈。

环境：电梯内部金属墙，圆形楼层按钮，扶手，按钮面板反光。

镜头：近距离手持拍摄按钮，快速推近，手指连点按钮。

风格：紧张、急忙、真实反应，不是从容摆拍。

约束：按钮上不能写“开”、不能写“开门”、不能写文字；必须是两个箭头向两边分开的图标。

镜头 3（4-7 秒）

主体：电梯门重新打开，参考图女性走进来。

动作：

4-5 秒：镜头转回电梯门口，门从快要合拢的状态重新向两侧打开。

5-7 秒：参考图女性走到门口，看向镜头，进入电梯。

环境：走廊、电梯门、电梯内金属墙同时可见。

镜头：第一人称站在电梯内拍摄，女主从门外靠近镜头。

风格：真实电梯偶遇短视频，轻微运动模糊。

约束：女主必须是参考图女性。

镜头 4（7-11 秒）

主体：参考图女性站在电梯内。

动作：

7-9 秒：她进入电梯后靠近金属墙边站定，微微整理姿态。

9-11 秒：她看向镜头，轻轻微笑或自然转头，画面结束。

环境：电梯内部深色金属墙，按钮面板，扶手，安全提示牌。

镜头：手机竖屏中近景，拍摄者稍微后退调整角度。

风格：生活化手机实拍，轻微美颜感，但不要过度磨皮。

约束：全程只有一个女主，保持参考图人物身份一致。

负面提示词：

按钮写着“开”，按钮写着“开门”，按钮出现中文文字，按钮出现英文 open，按错关门键，按钮图标错误，电梯门一直开着，电梯门没有关闭过程，没有紧张感，没有连续按按钮，镜头太稳定，女主凭空出现，女主不进电梯，换脸失败，脸部漂移，五官变化，发型变化，身材比例变化，多余手指，手指融合，电梯空间变形，按钮乱码，随机文字，字幕，logo，水印，动漫风，CG 动画感，过度电影化
entries.translated_prompt:
Overall Style: First-person smartphone handheld feel, authentic elevator interior view, lifestyle short video, slight camera shake, ordinary indoor white ceiling light, like a candid elevator encounter. Use the woman from the reference image as the main character, keeping her face, hairstyle, facial features, body proportions, and temperament consistent.

Core Plot:
The camera holder is in the elevator filming with a phone. The elevator doors are slowly closing, the gap getting narrower. Through the gap, a beautiful woman is seen approaching the elevator from the hallway. The camera holder suddenly gets nervous and hurriedly turns the lens to the elevator button panel, pressing the 'open door' button multiple times. This button is not a text button, but an icon with two arrows pointing outward. The doors reopen, and the woman enters the elevator.

Shot 1 (0-2s)
Subject: Elevator doors closing slowly with the reference woman appearing outside the gap.
Action: 0-1s: First-person view from inside, filming the doorway vertically. 1-2s: The woman is seen running or walking from the hallway, noticed by the filmer.
Environment: Modern apartment/office elevator lobby, gray tile floor, white walls, hallway lights, metal door frame.
Style: Authentic phone capture, slight jitter, sense of urgency.
Constraint: Must show doors closing with the lead appearing in the gap.

Shot 3 (4-7s)
Subject: Doors reopen, the woman enters.
Action: 4-5s: Lens turns back to the door as it reopens. 5-7s: The woman reaches the door, looks at the camera, and enters.

entries.title: Jungle Supply Convoy Snake Ambush
entries.description: A detailed action-oriented video prompt for a cinematic sequence showing a giant python attacking an army truck convoy in a muddy rainforest, complete with specific shot directions and sound cues.
entries.prompt:
A muddy dirt track through thick green rainforest in grey daylight. An army supply convoy of trucks drives along the narrow track, jungle pressing in on both sides. A giant python, thick as a bus with dark green scales, has wrapped around the last truck and is dragging it backward into the trees. At the front, a gunner stands at a mounted gun on the lead gun-truck. Sound: roaring engines, groaning metal, soldiers shouting, snake hissing, rifle fire, radio voices.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low rear shot in the mud. The giant python squeezes the last truck and hauls it backward off the track into the trees, wheels sliding in the mud. Soldiers on the truck fire their rifles into the thick coils, but the bullets do nothing. The rear driver wrestles his wheel and shouts into his radio: “IT’S PULLING ME INTO THE TREES!”

Shot 2 (3–6s): At the front of the convoy. The gunner swings his mounted gun around to point back down the line, but holds his fire — the snake is wrapped on the truck with men still on it. He calls on the radio: “Cut your trailer! Get it on the track!”

Shot 3 (6–9s): At the rear truck. The driver pulls the trailer release. The truck breaks free and lurches forward onto the track — and the python, still wrapped around the heavy trailer, is yanked out of the trees with it, spilling onto the open muddy track, rearing its head up in the clear.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The snake is out in the open on the track now. The lead gunner opens fire. Bullet time — a long stream of heavy rounds flies down the line in slow motion, smoke and shell cases hanging in the air, tearing into the coiled python, mud and broken branches bursting up around it.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The python drops and lies still across the muddy track beside the wrecked trailer, smoke rising off it. The freed rear truck pulls up the line to the others, soldiers climbing down into the mud. Smoke drifts through the trees. Cut.

entries.title: Monochrome Text City Surreal Transformation
entries.description: A surreal monochrome art-film prompt where city buildings are covered in handwritten text that detaches and transforms into weather phenomena like lightning and birds.
entries.prompt:
A vast monochrome city under a blank white sky. Every building facade is covered with handwritten words in black ink poems, warnings, names, unfinished sentences. The streets are empty except for loose paper drifting across the pavement.

Opening frame: the camera glides down a silent boulevard between towering buildings covered in text. The ink moves slightly, as if breathing.

At the 2-second mark, one word detaches from a wall.

It floats into the air and becomes a cloud.

Then thousands of words peel away from buildings, rising into the sky. Some become rain, some become birds, some become lightning, some become black snow. Sentences unravel into long ribbon storms that whip through the streets.

The camera follows a single phrase as it transforms into a tornado of letters, pulling street signs, papers, and window reflections into its spiral.

VFX escalation: the weather becomes linguistic. Rain falls as tiny punctuation marks. Thunder appears as giant words flashing across the sky. Fog forms from erased sentences.

Velocity ramp: a lightning bolt made of handwritten text strikes the street , individual letters suspended in mid-impact, glowing white against the monochrome city.

Final moment: all text vanishes from the buildings, leaving the city completely blank. A single new word appears on the ground beneath the camera: REMEMBER.

Experimental typographic surrealism, monochrome art-film aesthetic, ink particle simulation, atmospheric word-weather VFX, cinematic minimalism, 4K.

entries.title: Cinematic Water Transformation Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for an elemental water transformation on a storm-battered coast, specifically attributed to Leonardo AI in the metadata.
entries.prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic elemental transformation sequence on a storm-battered coastline at twilight.

A lone figure stands on black volcanic rocks facing a violent ocean. Massive waves crash against the cliffs while dark storm clouds gather across the horizon. Rain and sea spray fill the air.

The atmosphere is primal, immense, and realistic.

The camera slowly circles around the figure as the ocean begins behaving unnaturally. Nearby waves stop for a brief moment as if listening.

Water starts flowing upward around the figure's feet instead of falling back into the sea.

The transformation begins.

Thin streams of seawater wrap around the body like living ribbons. The skin becomes translucent in places, revealing swirling currents, bubbles, and glowing blue ocean energy beneath the surface.

The camera pushes closer as the body gradually dissolves into moving water. Arms become liquid currents. Hair transforms into flowing streams of sea foam. The lower body merges with spiraling ocean waves.

The transformation accelerates.

Entire sections of the surrounding ocean rise into the air and orbit around the figure. Schools of fish, fragments of coral, shells, and bioluminescent particles become suspended inside the water.

Thunder crashes overhead.

The figure expands dramatically in scale. Their silhouette becomes a gigantic humanoid tsunami composed of roaring waves, rotating currents, foam, spray, and deep ocean energy.

Massive walls of water rise behind them, towering higher than cliffs. The sea itself appears connected to the transformation.

At the climax, the Living Tsunami stands at colossal scale above the coastline, a giant formed entirely from moving ocean water and storm energy. Lightning illuminates the immense translucent body while entire waves flow through its arms and chest.

Final cinematic moment: the Living Tsunami raises one arm toward the horizon. An enormous tidal wave rises from the ocean and follows the gesture. The camera pulls back to reveal the colossal water titan standing between sea and sky as the storm revolves around it.

Style: ultra cinematic realism, elemental water transformation, photoreal ocean simulation, tsunami-scale water effects, storm atmosphere, realistic fluid dynamics, massive environmental scale, bioluminescent ocean details, AAA visual effects quality, no text, no overlays.

Audio: epic cinematic orchestral score, crashing waves, deep ocean resonance, hurricane winds, thunder, water surges, distant whale calls, atmospheric storm energy, colossal elemental power.

Made in @LeonardoAi

entries.prompt: 经典的唐·布鲁斯动画风格。场景一：在埃及宫殿内，我们看到两个人类盗贼带着一顶金冠逃跑，一位人类法老在几米外注视着他们，愤怒地指着他们大声喊道：“阿努比斯，追上去！”然而我们只听到阿努比斯的咯咯笑声，这让法老大吃一惊。法老转过头，看到以下景象：稳住镜头，威猛的胡狼神阿努比斯跪倒在地，双臂高举，双手抱头，闭着眼睛咯咯地笑着。一个人类盗贼蹲在地上，用羽毛轻柔流畅地在阿努比斯的腋窝上上下拂动。场景二：盗贼继续用羽毛挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯咯咯地笑着，盗贼一边说着“咯咯咯”，一边扭动着上半身，但双手仍然抱在头上，腋窝敞开着，任由羽毛挠痒。场景三：盗贼继续用羽毛挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯咯咯地笑着，扭动着身体。场景四：盗贼停止挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯还发出几声咯咯的笑声。人类盗贼也逃走了，阿努比斯慢慢坐起身，双臂环抱着自己，脸上仍带着一丝被挠痒痒的坏笑，略显疲惫。场景5：镜头切换到法老，阿努比斯双手背在身后，以威严的姿态出现在他身边，神情既漫不经心又严肃，对法老说：“看来他们逃走了，主人。”法老失望地低下头，说道：“我看到了。”阿努比斯是一只黑色的拟人化肌肉发达的胡狼，手臂和脖子上都戴着环。对话为英语。

entries.prompt:
A young woman with long dark hair and side-swept bangs stands on a tree-lined park pathway during warm golden-hour sunlight. Lush green trees and grass fill the background, while a few distant pedestrians walk along the path.

She wears a gray cardigan over a white V-neck top and initially looks calmly into the camera with a relaxed, natural expression.

Jerry lands safely on her shoulder and celebrates victoriously. Tom appears frustrated and defeated.

- Natural facial expressions

- Highly detailed rendering

entries.prompt:
风格定位：
竖屏国风玄幻 3D CG 动画，偏游戏宣传片 / 手游大招过场 CG / AI 仙侠短片质感。
整体风格：东方玄幻仙侠动作大片，白衣女战神，折扇破阵，万军战场，金色灵力风刃，巨大透明神女法相，赤焰龙群轰炸，乌云压顶，沙尘爆裂，电影级慢动作，高速运镜，竖屏史诗构图。不要字幕，不要文字叠加。
镜头 1（0-3 秒）
主体：一名白衣仙侠女战神，黑色长发，金色发饰，白金长裙，手持白金折扇。
动作：开场先展示乌云下密密麻麻的古代军阵；随后女主从高空俯冲降临，衣袖和披帛展开；切到折扇微距特写，手指压住金色扇骨，白色扇面金花纹发出微光。
环境：荒芜古战场，远山，压低乌云，数万黑甲士兵。
镜头：超远景转近景，再切折扇微距特写，慢动作推进。
约束：折扇必须清楚，是白色扇面、金色扇骨，不要变成剑。
镜头 2（3-7 秒）
主体：女主面对冲锋的黑甲军阵。
动作：敌军向她冲来，女主贴地旋身挥出折扇；一道金色半月形风刃横扫地面，沙尘炸开，前排士兵被冲击波掀飞；女主单脚落地收势，白裙和长袖随风飞扬。
环境：战场地面裂开，沙尘墙扩散，士兵被卷入空中。
镜头：敌军视角高速冲锋，随后镜头倾斜旋转跟随女主挥扇。
约束：核心动作是“折扇横扫千军”，不要用刀剑砍杀，不要血腥。
镜头 3（7-10 秒）
主体：女主升空并召唤巨大神女法相。
动作：女主脚下升起金色光柱，把她托向天空；背后浮现巨大的半透明白色神女法相，法相双手环绕，随后结印，背后出现圆形神环。
环境：乌云翻滚，战场士兵在下方显得渺小，空气中有金白色粒子。
镜头：从地面仰拍女主升空，再推到巨大神圣法相正面。
约束：法相要庄严透明，像仙侠神力显化，不要变成机械或怪物。
镜头 4（10-13.5 秒）
主体：赤红火焰龙形能量从战场裂隙中爆发。
动作：地面出现红色裂缝，两条赤焰龙先冲出；随后多条火焰龙首从地面盘旋爆发，形成巨大爆炸云团，横扫整片军阵。
环境：战场被红色火光照亮，沙尘和火焰冲天，倒地士兵散落四周。
镜头：俯瞰战场，再快速拉近火焰龙群爆发。
约束：火焰龙是能量形态，不要变成真实动物撕咬；表现冲击波和爆炸，不要血腥。
镜头 5（13.5-15 秒）
主体：女主完成大招后站在战场中央。
动作：女主冷静站立，手持折扇，长发和白裙在余风中飘动；身后烟尘、火光 and 倒地敌兵逐渐散开。
环境：乌云战场，破碎地面，远处军阵崩散。
镜头：胸像特写转全身定格，慢动作收尾。
约束：女主保持冷静、优雅、强大，不要怒吼，不要表情崩坏。
负面提示词：
字幕，文字叠加，logo，水印，现代城市，现代武器，枪械，血腥，断肢，过度恐怖，折扇变成剑，折扇消失，女主换脸，发型变化，服装变化，手指融合，多余手指，多余肢体，身体变形，脸部崩坏，法相变怪物，火焰龙变真实动物撕咬，敌兵冻结不动，冲击波不可读，动作混乱，镜头完全失控，廉价游戏画面，随机文字，乱码。
