entries.title: Samurai Castle Siege Action
entries.description: A detailed historical action prompt for a samurai's final charge from a burning castle, with complex camera work and atmospheric sound design.
entries.prompt:
Reference Image:
@image1
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
約15秒、シネマティックで高精度な歴史アクション短編。参照画像の人物を唯一のキャラクターアンカーとして使用し、性別、顔立ち、目の印象、髪型、髪色、年齢感、鎧の構造、配色、布飾り、武器を維持し、同一人物として描写する。参照画像が実写なら高品質な実写のまま、アニメ・イラストなら元の線、彩色、質感を保った高品質なアニメ映像として描写し、途中で画調を変えない。参照画像の無地背景、立ち姿、待機ポーズ、構図は継承しない。

舞台は夜明け直前、落城寸前の日本の城。炎上する城門から、参照画像の騎馬武者が少数の騎馬兵を率いて最後の突撃を開始する。主役は常に先頭の参照人物1人。少数の騎馬兵は背後や周囲に短く見える補助的存在とする。

[OPTIONAL PERFORMER LOOK]
勇敢で気品があり、命を懸けた覚悟を感じる武者。顔を煙や髪で隠しすぎず、騎乗中でも同一人物と分かるようにする。鎧、布飾り、武器は途中で変化させない。

[SHOT / FLOW]
0.0–3.5秒：崩壊する城門からの出陣。低い引きで炎上する城門、崩れかけた木門、煙、火の粉、破れた旗を見せ、木材が崩れ落ちた直後に騎馬武者が勢いよく飛び出す。短いジェットカットで、目元、髪、手綱を握る手、武器の柄、揺れる鎧と布飾り、地面を蹴る蹄を連続して見せる。

3.5–8.0秒：高速加速と矢の集中。超低位置の後方斜め追尾で蹄と前脚を至近距離から追い、土煙を強く見せる。顔へ急接近し、激しい振動の中でも前方を鋭く見据える表情を見せる。側面高速追従に切り替え、城壁、炎、旗、敵兵を高速で流す。上空と前方から矢が降り、武者は上体を低くしてかわす。カメラは正面斜めから側面へ素早く回り込み、立体的な突撃にする。

8.0–12.5秒：敵前線への衝突と突破。前方に槍と盾の列が迫る。前方低位置から騎馬武者と馬がカメラへ高速で迫り、直前で横へ抜ける。武者は停止せず槍の隙間へ進路を変えて突入し、武器で敵の槍の柄を一度だけ強く弾き、短い金属火花を散らす。蹄、目元、手綱、武器と槍の接触、鎧、馬の肩、土煙を高速で切り替え、速度を維持したまま前線を突破する。

12.5–15.0秒：速度を止めない余韻。土煙の中から前方へ抜け、朝焼けに照らされた戦場へ走り続ける。背後には炎上する城、崩れた城門、乱れた敵前線、破れた旗。前方には金色の朝焼け。武者は停止せず、一瞬だけ顔を横へ向けるか、前方だけを見据えたまま走り続ける。最後はカメラが後方上空へ引き上がり、先頭の参照人物、少数騎馬、燃える城、朝焼けの戦場を同じ画面に収める。勝敗や生死は断定せず、勇敢さと悲壮感を残して締める。

[CAMERA / EDITING]
非常にダイナミックな8〜10カット構成。燃える城門の低い引き、目元の寄り、手綱と武器の寄り、蹄の超低位置追尾、側面高速追従、正面からの急接近、斜め前から側面への回り込み、敵前線への高速プッシュイン、突破後の上昇俯瞰を使用する。馬の全身を遠景や真横から長時間固定しない。蹄、前脚、馬の肩、顔、上半身、手、鎧、武器を短く切り替え、騎馬の重量感と速度を表現する。顔や足元のジェットカットは0.2〜0.6秒、主要アクションは0.8〜1.5秒、最後のみ1.5〜2秒。背景を高速で流し、風圧、土煙、火の粉、髪、布飾りで速度を強化する。

[SOUND]
BGMは絶対に入れない。音楽、歌、ナレーションなし。効果音と環境音のみ。重い蹄音、地面の振動、鎧と金属装飾の揺れる音、手綱、武器と槍の短い金属衝突音、矢の風切り音、炎、崩壊する木材、旗、風、土煙、遠くの叫び声を強調する。

[NEGATIVE]
文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、実在する家紋、ブランド、UI、分割画面、コラージュ、参照画像そのもの、無地背景の人物シートを映像内に出さない。主役を複数人に増やさない。別の人物を主役にしない。参照画像の性別、顔、髪型、髪色、年齢感、鎧、配色、布飾り、武器、画調を途中で変更しない。武器の消失、変形、複製、持ち替えを起こさない。馬や騎手の融合、複製、脚の本数異常、不自然な大跳躍を避ける。遠景だけの騎馬走行、単調な横移動、長い直線走行、静かな出陣、長時間のスローモーション、停止した決めポーズ、過度なファンタジー、発光武器、機械的な鎧、巨大な炎エフェクト、暗すぎる画面、低コントラスト、濁った煙、人物が炎や煙に埋もれる映像を避ける。
entries.translated_prompt:
Reference Image:
@image1
[CONDITION DEFINITION]
A cinematic and high-precision historical action short of approximately 15 seconds. Use the person in the reference image as the sole character anchor, maintaining gender, facial features, eye impression, hairstyle, hair color, sense of age, armor structure, color scheme, fabric decorations, and weapons to depict them as the same person. If the reference image is live-action, depict it as high-quality live-action; if it is an animation or illustration, depict it as high-quality animated footage preserving the original lines, coloring, and texture, without changing the art style mid-video. Do not inherit the solid background, standing posture, idle pose, or composition of the reference image.

The setting is a Japanese castle on the verge of falling just before dawn. From the burning castle gate, the mounted samurai from the reference image leads a small group of cavalry in a final charge. The protagonist is always the single reference character at the front. The small group of cavalry acts as a brief auxiliary presence behind or around them.

[OPTIONAL PERFORMER LOOK]
A warrior who is brave and noble, conveying a sense of resolve at the risk of their life. Do not obscure the face too much with smoke or hair, and ensure they are recognizable as the same person even while riding. Armor, fabric decorations, and weapons must not change mid-scene.

[SHOT / FLOW]
0.0–3.5s: Departure from the collapsing castle gate. Use a low wide shot to show the burning gate, crumbling wooden doors, smoke, sparks, and torn flags; the mounted warrior bursts out immediately after the wood collapses. Use short jump cuts to show the eyes, hair, hands gripping reins, weapon hilt, swaying armor/fabric, and hooves kicking the ground in succession.

3.5–8.0s: Rapid acceleration and arrow volley. Follow the hooves and front legs from a very low rear diagonal angle at close range, showing heavy dust clouds. Zoom in on the face to show a sharp gaze forward even amidst intense vibration. Switch to high-speed side tracking, blurring the castle walls, flames, flags, and enemy soldiers. Arrows fall from above and in front; the warrior ducks low to evade. The camera swiftly orbits from front-diagonal to the side for a three-dimensional charge.

8.0–12.5s: Impact and breakthrough at the enemy front line. A row of spears and shields looms ahead. From a low front position, the mounted warrior and horse rush toward the camera at high speed, breaking away to the side just before impact. The warrior does not stop, changing course to plunge into gaps between spears, striking an enemy spear hilt once with force, sending off short metallic sparks. Quickly cut between hooves, eyes, reins, weapon-to-spear contact, armor, horse shoulders, and dust clouds, breaking through the line while maintaining speed.

12.5–15.0s: The aftermath without stopping. Emerging from the dust clouds into the battlefield illuminated by the morning sun. Behind them are the burning castle, collapsed gates, disordered enemy lines, and torn flags. Ahead is the golden sunrise. The warrior does not stop, briefly turning their face or continuing to stare straight ahead. Finally, the camera pulls up and back into an aerial view, capturing the lead reference figure, the small cavalry group, the burning castle, and the sunlit battlefield in the same frame. Do not conclude the outcome of victory or death, leaving a sense of bravery and pathos.

[CAMERA / EDITING]
A very dynamic 8–10 cut composition. Utilize low wide shots of the burning gate, close-ups of eyes, reins, and weapons, ultra-low hoof tracking, high-speed side tracking, rapid frontal approaches, diagonal-to-side orbits, high-speed push-ins at the enemy line, and an ascending aerial view after the breakthrough. Avoid long static shots of the horse from a distance or side. Use short cuts of hooves, legs, shoulders, face, torso, hands, armor, and weapons to express the weight and speed of the cavalry. Use 0.2–0.6s jump cuts for faces/feet, 0.8–1.5s for major actions, and 1.5–2s only for the final shot. Use blurred backgrounds, wind pressure, dust, sparks, hair, and fabric to enhance the sense of speed.

[SOUND]
Do not include BGM. No music, singing, or narration. Sound effects and ambient noise only. Emphasize heavy hoof beats, ground vibrations, the rattling of armor and metal decorations, reins, short metal-on-metal spear impacts, the whistling of arrows, flames, collapsing wood, flags, wind, dust, and distant shouts.

[NEGATIVE]
No text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, real-world family crests, brands, UI, split screens, collages, or the reference image itself; no character sheets on solid backgrounds within the video. Do not increase the number of protagonists or change the lead. Do not change the reference character's gender, face, hair, age, armor, colors, weapons, or art style mid-way. Avoid weapon disappearance, transformation, or duplication. Avoid horse-rider merging, extra legs, or unnatural high jumps. Avoid long-distance static shots, simple lateral movement, long straight runs, silent departures, excessive slow motion, frozen poses, over-the-top fantasy, glowing weapons, mechanical armor, giant fire effects, overly dark screens, low contrast, or muddy smoke. Ensure the character is not buried in fire or smoke.

entries.title: Origami Football Match Narrative

entries.prompt:
PART 1 — “THE MORNING OF THE MATCH”

Cut A (0–5s): Jessy wakes up in her origami-paper bedroom as the alarm shows “MATCH DAY,” sunlight glowing through folded curtains, she smiles and says, “Today’s the day!”

Cut B (5–10s): Fast gear-up montage—she ties shoes, grabs her skateboard, wraps her scarf, and steps into the glowing paper city, saying, “Let’s go meet my hero!”

Cut C (10–15s): She skates through origami streets with speed-line motion blur, rushes through the city, and reaches the train just in time, breathing, “Made it… just in time!”

PART 2 — “INTO THE STADIUM”

Cut D (0–5s): On the train, Jessy sees the glowing stadium in the distance, holding her skateboard tightly, whispering, “Almost there… I can’t believe it.”

Cut E (5–10s): Outside stadium plaza, crowds flood in as she checks her watch, panics, and runs through the crowd, “Come on—kickoff’s in ten minutes!”

Cut F (10–15s): At the security gate, a guard stops her, then softens and lets her through, saying, “Go on, kid—enjoy the match.”

PART 3 — “THE GOAL & THE ADVICE”

Cut G (0–5s): Stadium explodes with energy as Jessy watches her hero score a stunning goal; she jumps up screaming, “YES—that’s my player!!”

Cut H (5–10s): After the match, the player walks to her, notices her skateboard, and says, “Dreams just need courage.” Jessy replies softly, “Then I’m chasing mine.”

Cut I (5–10s continuation feel): Emotional moment—he signs her jersey on the chest, she freezes in shock, then smiles as stadium lights glow behind them.

entries.prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic fantasy transformation sequence deep within an ancient primordial forest at dawn.

A lone traveler stands in a sacred forest clearing surrounded by colossal trees older than kingdoms. Golden morning light filters through the canopy while mist drifts across the moss-covered ground.

The atmosphere is peaceful, ancient, and alive.

The camera slowly circles around the traveler as the forest begins responding to their presence. Leaves rustle despite the absence of wind. Birds fall silent. Tiny glowing spores drift through the air.

Roots emerge gently from the earth around the traveler's feet.

The transformation begins.

Thin root structures spread across the skin like living veins. Moss and bark textures gradually appear along the arms and neck. Small leaves sprout from the shoulders and hair.

The camera pushes closer as the body becomes increasingly intertwined with nature. Fingers lengthen into branch-like structures. The skin develops intricate bark patterns while glowing sap-like energy flows beneath the surface.

The surrounding forest awakens. Flowers bloom instantly. Vines climb nearby trees. Ancient roots rise from the earth in response to the transformation.

The transformation accelerates.

Massive branches grow from the back like a living crown. The body expands in size and strength. Moss, vines, leaves, and flowering plants spread naturally across the growing wooden form.

Birds, butterflies, and forest creatures gather around the transforming figure as if witnessing the return of an ancient protector.

At the climax, the traveler becomes an Ancient Tree Guardian , a majestic humanoid giant composed of living wood, roots, bark, moss, flowers, and glowing emerald sap.

The forest itself appears connected to the guardian through an immense network of roots extending beneath the ground.

Final cinematic moment: the Ancient Tree Guardian places a giant hand against the earth. A wave of life spreads through the forest. Trees bloom, rivers sparkle, and sunlight floods the woodland as the camera pulls back to reveal the colossal guardian standing among the ancient giants.

Style: ultra cinematic fantasy realism, living forest transformation, realistic bark and root growth, moss and vegetation simulation, primordial forest atmosphere, volumetric dawn light, magical nature realism, majestic environmental storytelling, AAA fantasy film quality, no text, no overlays.

Audio: epic nature-inspired orchestral score, forest ambience, creaking wood, growing roots, birdsong, flowing water, rustling leaves, deep natural resonance, atmospheric wonder and majesty.

entries.prompt: 制作一段15秒的超电影感单镜头极限越野摩托车视频。图 hf_20260618_193451_5e17d142-cdf2-4356-80a5-7dc057741c77 是人物的形象、服装、和摩托车的参考。面部参考 保留她白皙的皮肤、黑色的眼睛、头发、身材比例、飘逸的裙摆、以及同一款摩托车。场景设定在阳光明媚的白天，一条尘土飞扬的山路，周围环绕着岩石山丘、松散的碎石、悬崖峭壁，营造出原始的越野氛围。使用一个连续的15秒镜头，没有任何剪辑、隐藏剪辑、转场或蒙太奇。镜头从她骑行时靠近她的上半身和面部开始，然后平滑地转向她的身后，并保持在该位置直至视频结束。镜头以较低的摩托车高度紧贴她的背部、座椅和后轮，使她和摩托车都占据画面的大部分空间。整个拍摄过程绝不能给人以远距离扬尘跟随的感觉。镜头移至她身后后，她随即做出一个优雅而精准的前轮抬起动作，以类似翘头的流畅姿态抬起摩托车前轮，镜头始终聚焦于她的姿态和摩托车的平衡。接着，她继续在崎岖不平、尘土飞扬的道路上行驶，运用精湛的技术动作、微妙的身体移动以及平稳的操控，轻松越过颠簸和松散的碎石，然后猛地加速冲向悬崖边缘。她以一次长距离跳跃而非垂直跳跃的方式，跃过峡谷的缝隙。当她完全腾空而起时，时间仿佛进入了戏剧性的慢动作，但摩托车仍需清晰地朝着对面的山脊前进。镜头始终紧贴摩托车后方，以低角度拍摄，几乎正对着车尾，使骑手和摩托车始终占据画面中心。在慢动作的空中飞行阶段，她表演了一个受参考图片启発的精彩自由式越野摩托车特技。这并非旋转，她也没有围绕自身旋转。相反，她做出的动作仿佛是在即将松开摩托车的同时，仍然保持着对它的控制。她将臀部完全抬离座椅，身体向外向上推离摩托车，双腿高高伸展，摆出一个大胆的杂技姿势。她的躯干向外打开，仿佛短暂地将摩托车抛在身后，几乎像是要放手。视觉焦点在于她身体与摩托车的分离。她通过双手和控制点保持与摩托车的连接，使这个动作既危险又充满技巧性。她的脸部尽可能地保持可见，头发和飘逸的裙摆随风飘扬。短暂保持这个姿势后，她抓住车把将摩托车拉回自己身边，然后将其收回身下，平稳地回到座椅上，重新调整重心。就在那一刻，慢动作结束，向前跳跃的动作继续进行。随后，她干净利落地落在对面的山脊上，强烈的悬挂压缩带来扬起的尘土，而镜头紧随其后。落地后，她保持控制，继续向前跳跃了一小段距离。没有文字、没有标志、没有字幕。

Use a continuous 15-second shot without any cuts, hidden cuts, transitions, or montages. The shot starts close to her upper body and face as she rides, then smoothly pans behind her and stays in that position until the end of the video. The camera stays close behind her back, seat, and rear wheel at a low height, making both her and the motorcycle occupy most of the frame. The entire shoot must not feel like following from a distance with dust kicking up. After moving behind her, she immediately performs an elegant and precise front-wheel lift in a smooth wheelie-like posture, with the camera focused on her posture and the motorcycle's balance. Then, she continues riding on the rugged road, using masterful technical moves and subtle body shifts to easily navigate bumps and gravel before accelerating towards a cliff edge. She leaps over a canyon gap in a long-distance jump. While airborne, time enters dramatic slow motion, but the motorcycle progresses toward the opposite ridge. The camera stays low and close behind the motorcycle. During the slow-motion flight, she performs a spectacular freestyle motocross stunt. She lifts her hips off the seat, pushing her body out and up in a bold acrobatic pose. Her torso opens outward as if briefly leaving the motorcycle behind. Visual focus is on the separation of her body from the motorcycle while maintaining connection through hands and control points. Her face remains visible with hair and skirt fluttering. After holding the pose, she pulls the motorcycle back, returns to the seat, and re-adjusts her center of gravity as slow motion ends. She lands cleanly on the opposite ridge with intense suspension compression, and the camera follows closely. After landing, she maintains control and continues for a short distance. No text, logos, or subtitles.

entries.description: A highly detailed multi-scene video script for generating a 15-second ancient Chinese period drama with specific character consistency and comedic timing.
entries.prompt:
生成15秒9:16竖版古装轻喜剧短剧《房中秘术》。参考@图1的近身照和三视图，保持女主同脸、同发型、同服装、富家千金白月光气质；参考@图2的近身照和三视图，保持男主同脸、同发型、同服装、俊美贵公子气质。不要生成字幕，不要画面文字。

场景：夜晚古风贵公子书房，红木书案、古籍、竹简、烛台、青瓷茶盏、木格窗、轻纱帘，窗外细雨与冷蓝月光，室内暖金烛光，冷暖对比，浅景深，柔焦镜头，高端女频古装短剧质感。书案旁散落屋顶梁架图、瓦片排列图、漏雨位置草图。

0-2秒：男主坐在书案前，低头认真翻看一本古旧书册，神情专注，眉头微蹙，像在研究重要事情。门外传来轻微脚步声，他忽然一惊，慌忙合上书，眼神闪躲，耳根微红，袖口差点碰倒茶盏。镜头从书案缓慢推近男主脸部。音乐为轻柔古风弦乐，合书瞬间加入短促拨弦音效。

2-4秒：女主推门进入，衣袖和发丝被夜风轻轻吹动。她看见男主藏书，先是疑惑，随后目光落到书封《房中秘术》，脸颊迅速泛红，眼睛微微睁大，表情震惊但努力维持清冷端庄。女主冷声质问：“你……在看什么啊？”语气克制、羞恼、带一点不敢相信。镜头切女主半身近景和眼神特写。

4-6.5秒：男主立刻站起，把书往身后藏，动作越藏越可疑。他想保持端方，却明显慌乱，嘴唇动了几次才说出口。男主低声解释：“不是你想的那样，我只是……研究房中之事。”语气紧张、尴尬、越说越乱。女主听完脸更红，眼神从震惊变成羞恼，眉心轻蹙，误会加深。音乐停顿半拍，加入轻微喜剧滑音。

6.5-8.5秒：女主快步走到书案前，强装镇定但明显羞恼，一把抢过男主手里的书。男主下意识想拦，又怕碰到她，只能伸手停在半空，表情无奈又委屈。女主压低声音说：“你还敢藏？”语气羞恼、克制、带千金小姐的压迫感。镜头跟随书本移动，烛火在前景虚化，节奏略微加快。

8.5-11秒：女主翻开书，准备质问。镜头切书页特写，里面不是暧昧内容，而是屋顶梁架图、瓦片排列图、漏雨位置草图，还夹着女主院落屋顶漏雨的简图。女主翻页动作突然停住，表情从羞恼变成僵硬尴尬，眼神轻轻移开，嘴唇抿住，脸上还残留红晕。男主站在旁边，小心翼翼看她，委屈又认真地说：“你屋顶漏雨，我想修好再告诉你。”语气真诚、无辜、略带不好意思。翻书后音乐突然停顿，加入轻巧“叮”的反转音效。

11-13秒：女主慢慢合上书，尴尬但不愿承认自己误会，仍强撑富家千金的冷静气势。她不看男主，视线飘向烛台，脸颊微红，语气小声又嘴硬：“那你为什么脸红？”镜头给女主近景，男主在背景略虚化，烛光照亮女主侧脸。

13-15秒：男主抬眼看她，表情无辜，眼底有一点忍笑，但语气仍认真克制：“因为你刚才……想歪得很大声。”女主瞬间僵住，脸更红，眼神闪躲，羞恼地把书塞回男主怀里，转身快步离开。男主接住书，看着她背影，嘴角轻轻上扬。结尾加入轻巧拨弦喜剧音效，古风弦乐短促收尾。

要求：无字幕，无画面文字；台词口型自然，表情变化清楚；男女主角色一致，不变脸，不换发型服装；真实古装短剧拍摄质感，不要插画、二次元、数字人CG、游戏建模、低俗擦边。
entries.translated_prompt:
Generate a 15-second 9:16 vertical ancient costume light comedy short play 'Room Secret Art'. Refer to the close-up and three-view drawings of @Figure 1, maintaining the same face, hairstyle, and clothing of the female lead, with a wealthy young lady's elegant temperament; refer to the close-up and three-view drawings of @Figure 2, maintaining the same face, hairstyle, and clothing of the male lead, with a handsome nobleman's temperament. Do not generate subtitles or text on the screen.

Scene: Nighttime ancient-style nobleman's study with rosewood desk, ancient books, bamboo slips, candlesticks, celadon tea cups, wooden lattice windows, and light gauze curtains. Outside is light rain and cold blue moonlight; inside is warm golden candlelight, creating a cold-warm contrast. Shallow depth of field, soft focus lens, high-end female-oriented ancient costume drama texture. Roof beam diagrams, tile arrangement diagrams, and leak location sketches are scattered by the desk.

0-2s: The male lead sits at the desk, looking down intently at an old book, focused with a slightly furrowed brow. Footsteps are heard outside; he is startled, hurriedly closes the book, looks away with shifting eyes and slightly red ears, almost knocking over a teacup. The camera pushes in slowly toward his face. Soft ancient string music with a short pluck sound when the book closes.

2-4s: The female lead enters, her sleeves and hair fluttering in the night breeze. She sees him hiding the book, first confused, then her eyes land on the title 'Room Secret Art.' Her cheeks flush, eyes widen, looking shocked but trying to maintain her cool poise. She asks coldly: 'What... are you looking at?' tone restrained and annoyed. Cut to a half-body shot and eye close-up.

4-6.5s: The male lead stands up, hiding the book behind him suspiciously. He tries to stay composed but is clearly flustered, stuttering: 'It's not what you think, I'm just... studying room matters.' Tone nervous and awkward. The female lead's face turns redder, eyes turning from shock to annoyance. Music pauses with a slight comedic slide.

6.5-8.5s: The female lead walks quickly to the desk, pretending to be calm but visibly annoyed, grabbing the book. He tries to stop her but hesitates, looking helpless and aggrieved. She whispers: 'You still dare to hide it?' with the pressure of a wealthy lady. Camera follows the book movement with blurred candlelight in the foreground.

8.5-11s: The female lead opens the book. Close-up on pages showing roof beam diagrams and leak sketches, including a map of her own courtyard's roof leaks. She stops, her expression turning from annoyed to stiff and embarrassed, looking away and pursing her lips. The male lead stands beside her, saying sincerely: 'Your roof leaks, I wanted to fix it before telling you.' Music adds a light 'ding' sound for the reversal.

11-13s: She slowly closes the book, embarrassed but unwilling to admit the misunderstanding. She doesn't look at him, staring at the candle with red cheeks, whispering stubbornly: 'Then why did you blush?' Close-up on her with him blurred in the background.

13-15s: He looks at her with an innocent expression and a hint of a smile: 'Because just now... you thought out loud very loudly.' She freezes, face turning redder, stuffs the book back and walks away quickly. He catches the book and smiles at her back. Ends with a light comedic pluck sound.

Requirements: No subtitles/text; natural lip-sync and clear expressions; consistent characters (no face/hair/outfit changes); realistic filming texture; no illustrations, 2D, digital humans, or game modeling.

entries.title: 90s Cyberpunk Military One-Shot Transition
entries.description: A complex prompt for a seamless one-shot video transition in 90s cel-shaded anime style, featuring six characters and cinematic camera moves.
entries.prompt:
90年代風セル画ライクなSFミリタリーアニメのワンショットシークエンス。
BGMは低音ドローンと心拍音、セリフなし、環境音あり。

# 制約
基本的にカメラは静止せず前進または回り込みで動き続ける。
被写体の脇を通り抜けて奥の暗闇に入っていくことを基本とする。
ただし指定カットでは地下からの垂直上昇、瞳孔の中への侵入、
クライマックスでのバレットタイム360度回り込みを行う。
発光をフラッシュやパルスとして使用しないこと。画面全体の白飛びは禁止。
各キャラのリファレンス画像の顔・髪・装備の特徴を厳守すること。
画質が粗い場合はリファレンスとして画像を一から作り直すこと。
4K高精細、ノイズなし、ブレなし、ちらつきなし。
キャラの顔と服装の一貫性を維持、歪みなし、自然で滑らかな動作。

# 登場人物
## キャラ1 
## キャラ2 
## キャラ3 
## キャラ4 
## キャラ5 
## キャラ6 

# 情景
崩壊した近未来都市、夜。
瓦礫、機体格納庫、配管の絡む通路、立ちのぼる蒸気、地下の暗渠、戦場の煙。
照明：遠方の炎の鈍いオレンジ、薄い月明かりの青。
暗闇の領域が広く、光は局所的にだけ存在する。
6人の戦士はそれぞれ別の場所に立っているが、同じ夜のひとつながりの戦場の中にいる。

# シーン
カメラが暗闇を一筆書きで泳ぎ、6人の戦士のもとを順に巡るワンショットシークエンス。
前半は瓦礫・配管・蒸気の暗闇を抜けて3人を巡り、
4人目は地下からの垂直上昇で登場する。
5人目からは瞳孔の闇を通って6人目の戦場へリレーされ、
最後はバレットタイム360度で銃を連射する6人目のクライマックスを贅沢に描く。

cut1:
暗い瓦礫の隙間からカメラが低くゆっくり前進する。
正面の暗闇に瓦礫の影でうずくまっていたキャラ1の輪郭が現れる。
キャラ1が顔を上げてカメラの方を睨む。
カメラはそのままキャラ1の顔の右脇をかすめて背後の暗闇へ抜けていく。
環境音：瓦礫が崩れる低い音、風、遠くの炎のかすかな鳴り。

cut2:
カメラは機体の関節パイプの隙間を通り抜けるように前進する。
パイプの暗がりの向こうに格納庫の暗がりに立つキャラ2の輪郭が現れる。
キャラ2は拳銃を頬の横まで構えセーフティを外す。
カメラはキャラ2の銃を構えた腕の脇を通り抜け、肩越しに格納庫の奥の暗闇へ進む。
環境音：金属機構音、セーフティのカチッという音、機体の低い駆動音。

cut3:
カメラは立ちのぼる蒸気の塊の中をゆっくり進んでいく。
蒸気の向こうから、煙の中に立つキャラ3の背中が現れる。
キャラ3は髪を耳にかけながらゆっくり振り返り、カメラの方を見据える。
カメラはキャラ3の頬の脇を通り抜け、振り返った先の暗闇へ前進する。
環境音：蒸気が漏れる音、衣擦れの音、配管の遠い軋み。

cut4:
カメラは地下の暗渠から地上に向かって急速に上昇する。
瓦礫の隙間を縦に通過し、地上の戦場に出る。
カメラはそのまま片膝をついたキャラ4の足元に到達し、ゆっくりとティルトアップしてキャラ4の全身を捉える。
キャラ4は立ち上がりながら長銃を肩に担いで構え、カメラを見据える。
カメラはキャラ4の頭上をゆっくり通り過ぎ、夜空の暗闇へ抜けていく。
環境音：地下から響く反響音、瓦礫が崩れる音、衣擦れ、長銃の金属音。

cut5:
カメラは暗い建物の崩れた壁の隙間を通り抜けるように前進する。
壁の向こうから室内の暗がりに立つキャラ5の姿が現れる。
キャラ5はゆっくりまばたきし、カメラの方を静かに見据える。
カメラがキャラ5の瞳孔にスローでゆっくりドリーインし、瞳孔の黒の中へ飲み込まれていく。
環境音：壁の崩れた音、深い呼吸音、心拍音。

cut6:
真っ黒な暗闇からカメラがゆっくり前進し、闇が徐々に戦場の薄い煙へと変化する。
正面の煙の向こうに両手で銃を構えるキャラ6の輪郭が現れる。
キャラ6が銃を連射し始め、マズルフラッシュが連続して瞬き、薬莢が排出されて空中に漂う。
【バレットタイム360度回り込み】
カメラはキャラ6の周囲をゆっくり360度回り込みながら、連射の瞬間を時間を引き伸ばして捉える。
キャラ6の体が反動でわずかに揺れ、もう一発、もう一発と銃が火を吹く。漂う薬莢が空中で回転する。
カメラはキャラ6の正面で静かに減速して止まる。
キャラ6は連射を止めて完全に静止しする。
周囲には硝煙と戦場の薄い煙が漂い続ける。
環境音：時間が引き伸ばされた銃声の連続、薬莢が空気を切る音、最後に低音ドローンと心拍音だけが残る。
entries.translated_prompt:
A one-shot sequence of a 90s-style cel-shaded SF military anime. Background music is a low-frequency drone and heartbeat; no dialogue, with environmental sounds.

# Constraints
Basically, the camera should not stop, constantly moving forward or circling around. The rule is to pass by the subject and enter the darkness beyond. However, in specific cuts, perform vertical ascent from underground, penetration into a pupil, and a 360-degree bullet-time rotation at the climax. Do not use flashing or pulses for lighting. Total whiteout of the screen is prohibited. Strictly follow the facial, hair, and equipment features of the reference images for each character. If image quality is poor, recreate reference images from scratch. 4K high-definition, no noise, no blur, no flicker. Maintain consistency of character faces and clothing; no distortion, natural and smooth movement.

# Characters
Character 1 to Character 6

# Setting
A ruined near-future city at night. Rubble, mecha hangars, pipe-cluttered corridors, rising steam, underground sewers, and battlefield smoke. Lighting: Dull orange from distant fires, pale moonlight blue. Wide areas of darkness with localized light sources. Six warriors stand in different locations but within a single connected battlefield on the same night.

# Scene
A one-shot sequence where the camera swims through the darkness, visiting the six warriors in order. The first half navigates through rubble, pipes, and steam to visit three warriors. The fourth appears via vertical ascent from underground. From the fifth, it relays through the darkness of a pupil to the sixth warrior's battlefield, ending with a luxurious depiction of the sixth warrior's climax firing guns in 360-degree bullet time.

Cut 1: Camera moves low and slowly through gaps in dark rubble. The silhouette of Character 1, crouching in the shadow of the rubble, appears. Character 1 looks up and glares at the camera. The camera passes the right side of Character 1's face into the darkness behind.

Cut 2: Camera moves forward through gaps in mecha joint pipes. Beyond the pipe shadows, the silhouette of Character 2 standing in a hangar appears. Character 2 raises a handgun to their cheek and releases the safety. The camera passes by Character 2's raised arm into the hangar's depth.

Cut 3: Camera slowly advances through a mass of rising steam. Beyond the steam, the back of Character 3 standing in smoke appears. Character 3 brushes hair behind their ear and slowly turns to face the camera. The camera passes by Character 3's cheek into the darkness.

Cut 4: Camera rapidly ascends from an underground sewer to the surface. It passes vertically through rubble gaps into the surface battlefield. The camera reaches the feet of Character 4, who is kneeling, and tilts up to capture their full body. Character 4 stands up, hoisting a long gun to their shoulder and staring at the camera. The camera passes over Character 4's head into the night sky.

Cut 5: Camera moves forward through a gap in a collapsed building wall. Beyond the wall, Character 5 stands in the indoor darkness. Character 5 blinks slowly and stares silently at the camera. The camera slowly dollies into Character 5's pupil, being swallowed by the blackness.

Cut 6: From pitch-black darkness, the camera advances as the darkness turns into thin battlefield smoke. The silhouette of Character 6 aiming guns with both hands appears. Character 6 starts firing; muzzle flashes blink continuously, and shell casings drift in the air. [Bullet Time 360 Rotation] The camera circles Character 6, capturing the firing moment in slow motion. Character 6's body sways from recoil as more shots fire. The camera stops in front of Character 6. Character 6 stops firing and stands still. Environmental sounds: stretched-out gunshots, casings cutting through air, finally leaving only the drone and heartbeat.

entries.prompt:
Use the picture as reference. Ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a Western woman with long wavy blonde hair, standing in soft natural daylight. She has a calm yet powerful expression, slightly intense eyes reflecting determination and depth. Subtle wind moves strands of her golden hair across her face. Make the parents’ facial expressions extremely relatable, like every parent who has ever tried to sleep with a toddler. entries.title: Space Station Solar Flare Emergency

entries.prompt:
15-second hyper-realistic cinematic sci-fi sequence inside a space station during an extreme solar flare. 

A massive solar flare erupts outside the windows, flooding the corridor with blinding orange-white light and violent reflections. Red alarms flash. The station rotates slightly, making the corridor unstable and disorienting. Several astronauts in full suits sprint in panic while emergency shielding panels slam shut behind them, each one missing by inches. 

Debris rattles, sparks burst from the ceiling, alarms strobe, solar light flashes across the walls. Chaotic, stressful, breathless, edge-of-disaster mood.  Start with a fast low tracking shot from behind the astronauts running through the rotating corridor. The flare is visible through side windows, growing brighter and more violent. Shielding panels crash shut behind them, closer each time.  

Cut to a dramatic side angle. The astronauts sprint across frame, stumbling from the shaking station. One almost falls, another pulls them forward. Massive shield doors crash down with sparks, smoke, vibration, and impact.  

Ending control: the astronauts do not escape. 
They are trapped inside a sealed emergency corridor chamber. One huge shielding door slams shut behind them, then another huge shielding door slams shut in front of them, sealing both ends. All astronauts remain visible inside the locked section, alive but trapped between the closed doors. No one gets out. No one exits frame. No open doorway remains.  

Final frame: astronauts trapped inside the sealed corridor, breathing heavily between two fully closed shielding doors. Solar flare light burns outside the windows and reflects in their helmets. Corridor trembles, alarms flash, sparks flicker. Danger continues.  

Visual style: intense, cinematic, hyper-realistic, claustrophobic, realistic astronaut motion, detailed futuristic corridor, fast pacing. No gore, no text on screen, no logos. Keep proportions. Keep style and features.

entries.translated_prompt: Rendered in the style of unprocessed authentic iPhone handheld video footage, with all camera settings on automatic and no post-processing color grading or special effects. The image includes realistic handheld micro-shaking and the sense of the operator's (bystander) breathing, with the lens naturally sinking or tilting due to walking before quickly correcting. Autofocus occasionally searches, delays, or briefly loses focus, especially during following motions or hand movements. Automatic white balance naturally switches between cool and warm tones as street light and tree shadows change. The overall image is flat, preserving real lens flares, slight chromatic aberration at the edges, and optical imperfections like motion blur. Simulates CCD sensor effects with slight vertical smearing, color bleeding, grain noise, and purple/green fringes on high-contrast edges. Only uses in-camera natural environmental sound effects, including street traffic, footsteps, and wind through leaves; the microphone may slightly distort when people speak. Uses a street third-person bystander perspective (shot by a nearby passerby), with lens movement following the bystander's instinctive reactions. Retain 100% of the model's age, facial features, bone structure, eye distance, jaw geometry, temperament, skin tone, and hairstyle from the reference image. No skin smoothing, over-softening, or shifting toward an 'average face.' 15-second timeline (Scene: Phone misunderstanding -> Woman thinks she's being insulted -> Embarrassed turn -> Reversal): At 0s, the lens shakes slightly from a bystander perspective, aiming at a street lined with golden sycamores. A slender, long-haired woman in a mask and specific outfit walks toward the camera. On the right, a man in a black jacket is on the phone. Ambient traffic sounds are natural. Autofocus locks on their interaction; slight overexposure and CCD grain are visible. At 1-3s, as the woman approaches, the man yells into his phone, 'You dare go out dressed like that?' The woman stops and glares angrily. The man looks at her innocently and shows his phone screen. The lens follows slightly with a brief autofocus search and noticeable CCD smearing. At 4-7s, the woman looks embarrassed, apologizes, and continues walking. The man continues his loud phone conversation. The lens follows her naturally with slight walking jitters. At 8-11s, after walking away, the woman suddenly turns back and raises her hand as if to strike the man. The man looks bewildered and shows his phone again. The bystander lens turns quickly to follow, with autofocus lag and handheld jitters intensifying. Microphones capture the angry woman and the man's helpless explanation. At 12-15s, she finally waves dismissively and leaves. The lens tilts slightly as the bystander shifts weight. The overall feel is an unprocessed, handheld street interaction with documentary-level natural imperfections.

entries.title: Cinematic Lightning Avatar Transformation Sequence
entries.description: An epic prompt for a 15-second cinematic video featuring a lone figure transforming into a lightning avatar during a mountain summit storm.
entries.prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic elemental transformation sequence on a mountain summit during a supercell thunderstorm at night.

A lone figure stands atop a jagged mountain peak surrounded by hurricane-force winds. Massive storm clouds rotate overhead while lightning flashes continuously inside the sky.

The atmosphere is immense, primal, and realistic.

The camera slowly circles around the figure as rain lashes against their body. Their clothing whips violently in the wind. Thunder rolls across the mountains.

Suddenly a lightning strike hits the summit.

The figure remains standing.

Electricity begins crawling beneath the skin like living veins of blue-white energy. Tiny arcs of lightning jump between fingers, arms, and the surrounding rocks.

The transformation accelerates.

Every heartbeat releases electrical pulses into the air. Hair lifts from static charge. Rain droplets freeze momentarily around the body before exploding outward from electromagnetic pressure.

The camera pushes closer as glowing lightning patterns spread across the entire body. The eyes ignite with brilliant white-blue light.

A second lightning strike hits directly.

This time the body begins dissolving into pure electrical energy. Flesh becomes plasma. Limbs fragment into branching lightning channels. The surrounding storm rotates faster and faster around the transformation.

Massive bolts connect the figure to the clouds above and the mountain below. Floating rocks rise from the ground under the electrical force.

At the climax, the human becomes a Lightning Avatar , a radiant being composed of living thunder, plasma, and storm energy. Their silhouette remains humanoid, but their body is made of crackling lightning and glowing electrical currents.

Final cinematic moment: the Lightning Avatar rises above the summit and extends an arm toward the sky. A colossal lightning strike tears through the clouds, illuminating the entire mountain range while the storm obeys their command.

entries.title: Surreal Upside-Down Ocean World
entries.description: A complex 3-shot cinematic prompt depicting an Asian man on a dry beach under an upside-down ocean sky, featuring whales swimming past a golden sunset.
entries.prompt:
【风格】超 surreal 奇观氛围片（Surreal Atmospheric），杜比视界宽色域，IMAX画幅感，8K超清，真实摄影质感（Photorealistic）+ 超现实粒子特效（Surreal VFX），柔光逆光体系，画面以深海蓝-琥珀金-珍珠白为主调
【时长】15秒
【场景】黄昏的无人海岸，湿沙滩延伸至天际线。天空没有云——取而代之的是一整片倒悬的深蓝色海洋，海水的波纹和涌浪在头顶缓慢翻涌，透过海水能看到暗金色的落日。海洋生物在天空中游动。地面是干燥的沙滩，没有一滴水。
【角色】一名赤脚的亚洲男性（约二十出头，白色宽松亚麻衬衫，卷起的裤脚，被风吹散的黑色短发，皮肤被琥珀色光染暖）
[00:00-00:05] 镜头1：天地倒悬（Epic Wide Establishing + Slow Tilt Up）
低角度广角镜头从男性赤脚踩在干裂湿沙上的特写起——脚趾微微陷入沙粒，沙面没有任何水迹。镜头缓慢上摇（Slow Tilt Up），经过他的亚麻衬衫下摆被风鼓起，继续上摇越过他仰起的下巴线——天空炸入画面：一整片深蓝色的海洋悬挂在头顶，巨大的涌浪在两百米高空无声翻卷，浪花的白沫向上碎裂成细密的水珠粒子悬浮在半空中，像倒着下的雪。暗金色的夕阳透过头顶海水折射，在他脸上投下波光粼粼的水纹焦散（Caustic Light Patterns）。他微微张嘴，眼睛里倒映着整片天海。
@Audio：低频深海水压声（Low-frequency Oceanic Drone），远处闷雷般的浪涌回响，风声穿过空旷沙滩。
[00:05-00:10] 镜头2：鲸从太阳旁游过（Slow Push-in + Parallax）
中景：男性站在画面左下三分之一处，衬衫被风持续吹动。镜头缓慢向他推进（Slow Dolly In）。天空中，一头成年座头鲸（真实比例，皮肤纹理清晰可见，腹部藤壶和疤痕细节）从画面右侧缓缓游入，从倒悬海洋的"水面"向下探出半个身体，穿过落日的金色光晕，鲸的腹部被夕阳染成暖铜色。鲸鱼经过时，它庞大身躯的阴影扫过整片沙滩和男性的脸，光线在明暗之间缓慢交替。鲸尾在天空中极慢地摆动，尾鳍切开头顶的海面，溅起的水花向上飞散成金色的碎光粒子（Golden Particle Burst）。他缓缓抬起一只手，掌心朝上，向天空伸出去。
声音：鲸歌回声（Whale Song Reverb），极远处传来的共鸣，在空旷的沙滩上回荡。水花碎裂的细碎簌簌声。
[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：一滴水落入掌心（Extreme Close-up + Crane Pull-out）
极近特写（Macro Shot）：他伸出的手掌。一颗拳头大小的海水球体从天空缓缓降落，球体内部有微型的洋流在旋转，折射出整个倒悬天海的缩影。水球触碰他掌心的瞬间——轻轻弹跳一下，然后安静地停在那里，在他手心缓慢自转。水球内部的微缩海洋里，一条小鱼影掠过。他的嘴角微微上扬。
镜头猛然切换为高速上升的航拍（Rapid Crane Pull-out to God's Eye）：俯瞰整个海岸——干燥的白色沙滩上只有他一个渺小的人影，而他头顶是一整片浩瀚的、倒悬的、波光万顷的海洋，鲸群在云层的位置结队游过夕阳。最后一帧定格。
声音：水球落入掌心的一声清脆水滴音（Single Water Drop），随即所有声音退潮归于寂静。最后两秒：一声悠远的鲸歌尾音淡出。

entries.title: Cinematic Time Traveler Transformation Sequence
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a surreal sci-fi fantasy video where a traveler in a frozen train station transforms into the embodiment of time.
entries.prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic sci-fi fantasy transformation sequence inside an abandoned train station frozen between different eras of history.

A lone traveler stands beneath a massive clock suspended above the station. The architecture feels strange, with elements from the past, present, and distant future blending together. Dust floats through shafts of golden light.

The station is silent.

The giant clock suddenly stops.

The camera slowly circles around the traveler as reality begins to distort. Nearby clocks freeze. Falling dust particles hang motionless in the air. Time itself appears broken.

A faint golden light emerges beneath the traveler's skin.

The transformation begins.

Multiple versions of the traveler appear simultaneously around them ,elderly, adult, child, and future selves flickering in and out of existence like overlapping timelines.

The camera pushes closer as the body continuously shifts through different ages. Wrinkles appear and disappear. Hair changes color. Clothing cycles through centuries of fashion. Different lifetimes flash across the same face.

The station reacts violently. Walls alternate between ancient ruins, modern architecture, and futuristic structures. Trains appear and vanish from different eras. Ghostly passengers walk through conflicting moments in time.

The transformation accelerates. Floating clock fragments, gears, calendar pages, memories, and temporal particles orbit around the traveler.

Their body begins dissolving into streams of golden sand, clockwork mechanisms, stars, and flowing timelines.

At the climax, the traveler rises above the station floor and becomes the Embodiment of Time — a magnificent cosmic figure composed of rotating clock rings, luminous gears, flowing sand, constellations, and shifting ages existing simultaneously.

Past and future spiral around them like galaxies.

Final cinematic moment: the colossal temporal entity extends a hand. Every clock in the station begins moving again. The camera pulls back to reveal the entire station suspended inside an infinite vortex of time stretching across eternity.

Style: ultra-cinematic sci-fi fantasy, temporal distortion VFX, age-shifting transformation, reality-bending environments, floating clocks, cosmic clockwork, golden and blue energy palette, surreal cinematic atmosphere, AAA visual effects quality, no text, no overlays.

Audio: epic cinematic score, evolving orchestra, deep pulses, clock ticking, temporal resonance, reality distortion sounds, emotional crescendo, cosmic ambience, mysterious time-warp effects.

entries.title: Anime Slam Dunk Storyboard Animation
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a continuous 15-second cinematic slam dunk video based on an 8-panel storyboard in a minimalist anime style.
entries.prompt:
Reference Sheet:
01_man_SV_V1

[CONDITION DEFINITION]
15秒。日本の漫画・アニメ調による、ミニマルでシネマティックなバスケットボール・ダンク動画。

参照シート「01_man_SV_V1」の8パネルを、左上から右、上段の後に下段へ進む連続した時系列として使用する。人物、動作順、構図、カメラ、ゴールとの位置関係を参照するが、シート本体、黒いボード、分割画面、文字、番号、枠、静止画スライドは映像内に出さない。8ポーズの羅列ではなく、最初から最後まで途切れない一連の動きとして映像化する。

舞台は純白のシームレスな無限空間。存在するのは、同一の成人男性選手1人、ボール1個、ゴール1基、薄い接地影のみ。観客、コート、壁、背景物なし。

選手は参照シートと同じ人物、短い黒髪、手足が長いしなやかなアスリート体型、無地のネイビーユニフォームとシューズを全編で維持する。ロゴ、文字、番号、スリーブ、タイツ、追加アクセサリーなし。過度に筋肉質・重量級にしない。

遠い位置から片足で跳び、現実よりやや長い距離と滞空時間で、空中を舞うようにゴールへ滑空する片手ロンググライド・ダンク。

[SHOT / FLOW]
0.0〜1.6秒：
画面左から右へ動き始める。片手でボールを扱う中距離の前側3/4導入。ゴールはまだ見せない。

1.6〜3.8秒：
片手ドリブルで加速。低い前側3/4から並走しながら後退し、歩幅、ボールの上下動、前進速度を強調する。

3.8〜5.3秒：
最後の片手ドリブルから同じ手で滑らかにボールをすくい上げる。両手で抱えて停止せず、腕を後方から前上方へ連続して振る。低い側面寄り3/4へ移り、ゴールが右上に現れる。

5.3〜6.5秒：
ゴールから距離を残した位置で片足を強く接地し、斜め前上方へ離陸。接地、圧縮、踏み切りを止めない。強いローアングルから離陸に同期して上昇する。

6.5〜8.6秒：
片手でボールを保持し、全身を伸ばして長く前方へ滑空。高さと水平移動を同時に見せる。やや引いた見上げ3/4で、全身、ゴール、両者の長い距離を同一画面に収める。

8.6〜10.4秒：
腕を前上方へ伸ばしてリムへ接近。カメラはリム側の斜め前へ先回りし、短いプッシュイン。顔、腕、ボール、リムを明確に見せる。

10.4〜11.9秒：
強いローアングルから片手ダンク。ボールがネットを突き抜け、ネットが大きく下へ伸びる。接触前後だけ短い速度変化。押し込んだ直後に手を離し、長くぶら下がらない。

11.9〜15.0秒：
下降追従から自然に着地。必要なら小さく1歩だけ体勢を整え、その場で静止。カメラはゆっくり引き、全身とゴールを見せる。ボールは一度だけ弾むか静かに転がる。最後約0.8秒はネットの揺れだけを残す。

[CAMERA / EDITING]
進行方向は全編左から右。アクション軸を越えない。

中距離導入
→低い追従
→側面寄りアプローチ
→ローアングル踏み切り
→引いた空中追従
→リム側プッシュイン
→近接ダンク
→下降追従と後退。

マッチ・オン・アクションで接続し、動作を繰り返さない. ボール、腕、身体、速度、ゴールとの距離を連続させる。意味のない回転、ランダムズーム、激しい手持ち揺れなし。

[SOUND]
BGM、歌唱、実況、観客音なし。効果音のみ。ドリブル、シューズ摩擦、衣服と空気の風切り、踏み切り、ダンク時のリムとネット、着地、ボールが一度弾む音。最後はネットの揺れだけ。

[NEGATIVE]

entries.title: Motorcycle and Bear Forest Encounter
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot video generation prompt depicting a tense and humorous night-time encounter between a motorcyclist and a brown bear in a forest, captured in a realistic vertical POV style.
entries.prompt: 整体风格：手机竖屏实拍感，夜间森林土路，摩托车第一视角，强车灯照明，低清晰度真实短视频质感，轻微抖动，紧张又荒诞搞笑的野外偶遇。不要字幕，不要文字叠加。音频风格：真实手机录音，摩托车低速发动机声，轮胎压过碎石土路声，夜晚树林环境声，熊的低吼声，骑手紧张的喘气和小声惊呼。不要配乐，不要电影音效。镜头 1（0-4 秒）主体：一只成年棕熊突然出现在夜间森林土路上，摩托车第一视角正面靠近它。动作：0-2 秒：骑手骑摩托车沿着黑暗土路前进，画面底部能看到摩托车车头、车灯罩和部分车把，车灯照亮碎石路面。2-4 秒：摩托车差点撞到或轻轻顶到棕熊，熊被惊到，猛地转身面对镜头。环境：漆黑森林小路，两侧灌木和树干，路面有碎石和尘土。镜头：头戴或手持手机竖屏 POV，摩托车车灯强光中心过曝，边缘一片黑。风格：真实野外骑行视频，粗糙、紧张、未经剪辑。约束：必须明确是摩托车第一视角，不是步行视角。镜头 2（4-7 秒）主体：棕熊站起来发怒，骑手在前景掏出一把枪。动作：4-5.5 秒：棕熊后腿站起，张嘴低吼，前爪抬起，像要发怒扑过来。5.5-7 秒：骑手从画面下方或右下方迅速抬起一把黑色猎枪/长枪，枪管指向熊，但不射击。环境：摩托车车灯照在熊胸口和脸上，熊的眼睛反光，树林背景漆黑。镜头：第一人称视角突然抖了一下，车头 and 枪管同时进入画面，制造紧张反转。风格：真实短视频里的危险瞬间，但带荒诞喜剧感。约束：枪只作为吓住熊的视觉反转，不开枪，不出现火光、血或伤害。镜头 3（7-11 秒）主体：棕熊看到枪后瞬间傻眼，开始装傻充愣地扭起来。动作：7-8 秒：熊看到枪管后突然僵住，张着嘴愣住，凶狠表情变成懵住的表情。8-10 秒：熊开始左右扭身、摆胯、晃肩，前爪悬在胸前，像假装无事发生一样尴尬跳舞。10-11 秒：熊一边扭一边慢慢后退，像在装傻充愣地化解尴尬。环境：车灯强光照着熊，路边灌木和树叶被光束扫到，背景仍然全黑。镜头：摩托车停在原地，第一人称画面微微发抖，枪管仍在前景但没有动作。风格：紧张突然变搞笑，荒诞短视频反转。约束：重点表现“熊看到枪后傻眼，然后装傻扭起来”，不要写成普通逃跑。镜头 4（11-15 秒）主体：棕熊结束装傻，慢慢转身跑走。动作：11-12.5 秒：熊停止扭动，尴尬地低头转身，像假装什么都没发生。12.5-15 秒：熊沿着土路慢慢跑进黑暗树林，屁股左右晃，背影逐渐消失。环境：夜间森林土路，摩托车车灯追着熊的背影，路边灌木摇晃。镜头：第一人称摩托车视角轻轻跟上去，画面底部保留车头和车把轮廓，枪管逐渐放低。风格：网友拍到的离谱野外瞬间，笑点是熊从发怒到傻眼再到装傻跑路。约束：不要让熊受伤，不要出现攻击命中，结尾是熊自己跑掉。负面提示词：开枪，枪口火焰，血腥，动物受伤，猎杀，子弹命中，伤口，残忍画面，熊攻击到人，人与熊身体接触，缺少枪管，缺少摩托车车头，缺少摩托车第一视角，普通步行视角，汽车视角，熊不傻眼，熊不扭动，熊只普通逃跑，熊过度拟人化，卡通熊，怪物熊，熊身体变形，多余肢体，错误动物结构，白天场景，城市背景，横屏构图，字幕，文字叠加，logo，水印，随机文字，画面过度电影化，动作不可读，突然换场景。

entries.title: Biomechanical Leviathan Emergence
entries.description: A dark, cinematic montage prompt for Seedance 2.0 depicting a massive biomechanical creature rising from the flooded ruins of a megacity during a storm.
entries.prompt:
Montage, multi-shot cinematic, don't use one camera angle or 
single cut. Photorealistic, 35mm film quality, ARRI ALEXA 
aesthetic, film grain, apocalyptic color grade.

SUBJECT: Colossal biomechanical leviathan — matte black armored 
hull body shaped like an elongated war-vessel, single glowing red 
optical lens at the front, dozens of segmented mechanical tentacles 
extending from beneath the hull, organic pilot-entity fused at the 
rear — pale wired humanoid head with cybernetic tendrils, exposed 
pink bioluminescent core radiating energy through the chest. 
Follow @image_1.
ENVIRONMENT: Flooded ruined megacity at dusk — half-submerged 
skyscraper skeletons, dark storm clouds, still grey water 
reflecting the structure, distant intact skyline on the horizon.
MOOD: Submerged dormancy → rising awareness → full emergence.
MUSIC: Deep sub-bass drone building slowly, 50 BPM, distant thunder.
COLOR LOGIC: Storm-grey base — pink bioluminescent core the only 
warm light source.
LOGIC RULE: Maintain hull proportions, tentacle count and 
placement, pilot-entity position, and red lens across all shots.

SHOT 1: WS, 14mm low angle / The water surface is still. Then it 
begins to tremble — concentric ripples spreading outward as 
something vast shifts beneath. The red lens ignites first, 
piercing the murky water from below. / SFX: deep underwater 
rumble, water tension, distant thunder.
SHOT 2: ECU, 85mm static / The pink bioluminescent core at the 
pilot-entity's chest pulses once, then steadies into a slow 
rhythmic glow — like a heartbeat returning. Wired tendrils along 
the head twitch and extend slightly. / SFX: core pulse tone, 
organic servo whir.
SHOT 3: WS, 24mm rising / The hull breaks the surface — water 
cascading off the armored plating in heavy sheets, sending 
displacement waves rippling outward across the flooded ruins. 
Tentacles emerge one by one, water sliding off each segmented 
limb. / SFX: water displacement roar, mechanical joint sounds, 
cascading runoff.
SHOT 4: WS, 14mm low angle pull-back / Full silhouette now towers 
above the waterline against the storm sky, tentacles spreading 
wide for balance, the pilot-entity's head tilting back as the 
bioluminescent core flares brighter. Camera pulls back revealing 
the true scale against the ruined skyline. / SFX: full-scale 
reveal tone, thunder crack, core flare hum.

ワードローブ: @[image1] < キャラクターの衣装とパーソナルカラーをここから抽出。

ショット1: [Telephoto 85mm Close-up] 足元のクローズアップ。ステップと共に、@[image1]の色を宿した液体塗料が床のない空間へ激しく飛び散る[cite: 1]。 / SFX: 重厚なベース音と塗料の飛散音。

ショット3: [Snap Push-in] 交互の腕振り。シアンとライムのX字ペイントが空中交差。筆の先端から滴る塗料の質感を強調。

ショット4: [Ultra Wide 14mm Low Angle] 高速回転。遠近感を誇張したパースで、巨大なカラースプラッシュが画面を覆う[cite: 1]。

ショット5: [Vertical Push-in] ジャンプ。筆を垂直に振り上げ、重力に抗うような太いペイントのストリークを生成。

ショット6: [Wide Orbit] 空中半回転。放射状に広がるのはペイントの飛沫のみ。宝石状の粒子は一切排除する。

ショット7: [Ground-level Drift] 着地。足元からカラーペイントのリングが広がり、波紋のように消えていく。

ショット8: [Telephoto Close-up] 筆を握る手のアップ。連続ターン中も筆を離さず、完全な円環状の軌跡を描く[cite: 1]。

ショット9: [Handheld Low Angle] 前方へ3歩突進。一歩ごとに@[image1]由来の色が爆発。背景のボケ味を強調[cite: 1]。

ショット10: [Extreme Macro] ブラシがカメラレンズ横を高速通過。被写界深度による美しいボケと、レンズフレアの干渉[cite: 1]。

ショット11: [Rotating Wide] 全身ターン。キャラクターを包み込むカラーペイントリング。筆は右手に固定。

ショット12: [Stabilized Slow Motion] 一瞬の静止。大きく引いた筆から、粘り気のある塗料が長い糸を引くように流動する。

ショット13: [Low Profile Dolly] 低姿勢のグローヴ。静止したペイントの軌跡の中を、筆を持ったまま滑らかに移動。

ショット14: [Ultra Wide Push] 爆発的ダッシュ。画面全体へ@[image1]のキーカラーが拡散し、白を塗りつぶす。

ショット15: [Theatrical Close-up] 正面。筆をカメラへ叩き込む。画面全体が濃厚なペイントで埋め尽くされ、ドラマチックに暗転。 / SFX: 衝撃波と深い残響。

entries.title: Cinematic Ink Demon Transformation Sequence
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a dark fantasy sequence where a sketch inside an artist's studio comes to life, transforming the artist into an ink demon.
entries.prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic dark fantasy transformation sequence inside a lonely artist studio at night.

A human artist sits at a wooden desk under a single flickering lamp, sketching strange occult shapes inside an old sketchbook. Rain taps against the windows. The room is quiet, filled with paper, ink bottles, charcoal, torn drawings, and shadows.

Suddenly the black ink on the page begins moving by itself. It spreads across the sketchbook like liquid darkness, forming eyes, claws, and twisted symbols.

The camera slowly pushes closer as ink spills upward from the page instead of downward, floating into the air like living smoke. The artist freezes, staring in disbelief.

Thin black ink tendrils crawl from the sketchbook onto the artist’s hands and arms. The ink spreads across the skin like moving tattoos, rewriting the body with sharp manga-style lines, black veins, and liquid shadow patterns.

The transformation accelerates. Fingers lengthen into ink-black claws. The face becomes partially covered by dripping brushstroke shadows. Horn-like shapes form from splashing ink above the head.

Pages tear loose from the sketchbook and orbit around the artist. Each page shows animated drawings that move independently, screaming silently in charcoal lines.

The artist rises from the chair as the body becomes a living ink demon -half human, half sketch, made of black liquid ink, paper texture, jagged outlines, and distorted shadow anatomy.

Final cinematic moment: the Ink Demon fully emerges, stepping out from the collapsing sketchbook as the studio walls become covered in rapidly drawing occult illustrations. The creature opens glowing white eyes while ink drips upward into the darkness.

entries.title: Watercolor and Ink Nautical City Video

紙へ水が滲む表現、墨のにじみ、鉛筆による細かな線画を重ねた芸術的スタイル。
キャラクターとジェットスキーのデザイン・配色・形状は参照画像を忠実に維持。
世界観は「海の都」。

都市の道路は存在しない。
建物は海上へ建ち並び、水路が高速道路となっている。
巨大な運河、石造りの橋、ガラスの水門、海上マーケット、浮遊灯台、水上駅、海に浮かぶ住宅街。
遠景には巨大な海上都市と港湾タワー。
水面には空が映り込み、水彩の滲みで幻想的に描写される。

Scene1（0〜3秒）
朝焼け。
静かな海の都。
キャラクターがSEA YR2へ跨る。
エンジン始動。
水面に水彩絵の具が広がるような波紋。

一気に加速。
巨大な運河を高速走行。
橋の下を低空で抜ける。

市場の横、水上住宅街、港を縫うように高速コーナリング。
建物のガラスへ機体が映り込む。
カメラはドローン、追尾、横移動、ローアングルを高速切替。

Scene4（9〜12秒）
大きなジャンプ。
運河を飛び越えながら都市全景。
着水時、水彩が紙へ広がるような飛沫演出。

Scene5（12〜15秒）
夕日に染まる海の都。
巨大な海上大橋へ向かって一直線。

・水面反射
・速度感重視
・自然なモーションブラー
・リアルな水しぶき
・文字・字幕・ロゴなし

entries.prompt: 【风格】物理违和氛围短剧，雨夜霓虹冷调，超慢动作（120fps感），水珠粒子悬浮。 【时长】15秒 【角色】撑着透明伞站在街头的女子（黑色风衣，神情漠然）。  [00:00-00:03] 镜头1：仰拍特写。雨——在往天上落。水珠从地面升起，穿过她的伞，飞向乌云。她抬头看着这一切，毫无波澜，霓虹灯在湿漉漉的脸上流淌。 【钩子点】雨倒流 = 第一秒物理崩坏，眼睛立刻警觉。  [00:03-00:09] 镜头2：固定中景。整条街的雨都在逆流，路过的行人却像正常人一样低头快走，只有她站着不动。她伸手接住一颗"落"向天空的雨珠，雨珠在她掌心停住、悬浮、旋转。  [00:09-00:15] 镜头3：缓慢推进至极近。她松开手，那颗雨珠里浮现出一张一闪而过的脸（一个男人的微笑）。她瞳孔骤缩。下一秒所有的雨同时静止在半空，整个世界定格，只有她还能动。 【对白口型指导】她低语："时间……又卡住了。"

entries.title: Frozen Matrix-Style Liquid Splash Video
entries.description: A complex video prompt for creating a 3D frozen-time effect where only the camera moves around a static liquid sculpture.
entries.prompt: The entire scene is completely frozen in time, like a hyper-detailed sculpture. The ONLY element in motion is the camera. Everything else — the person, their pose, facial expression, hair, clothing, the red cup, the suspended liquid splash with all its ribbons, arcs and individual droplets frozen midair, the background, shadows and reflections — stays 100% static and identical throughout, absolutely no movement, no wind, no falling droplets, no shifting light. The camera performs a slow, smooth cinematic arc, starting from the original viewpoint and gradually orbiting to one side around the frozen action, traveling through three-dimensional space to reveal the suspended liquid sculpture, the subject and the environment from changing angles. Strong spatial parallax: foreground droplets, liquid strands, the subject and background elements shift relative to one another, creating powerful depth and dimensionality. Premium wide-angle cinema lens. Movement perfectly smooth — no shake, no jitter, constant speed, no acceleration. Lighting stays consistent and unchanged, shadows fixed, reflections stable. Hyper-realistic, cinematic, ultra-detailed, 3D stop-motion frozen-time illusion, photorealistic liquid, film-quality, museum-like suspended motion sculpture. Negatives: no movement of the liquid, no movement of the subject, no change of pose or expression, no environmental motion, no wind, no shifting shadows, no flickering, no camera shake, no morphing, no text, no watermark.

entries.prompt:

手前の白い服の天使が主人公。後ろの4人は敵キャラ。主人公が敵キャラ4人と戦いを繰り広げており、参照画像の背景を基調としたダークファンタジーの世界で次々に参照画像の敵キャラが画面右手前から超クローズアップで出てきて左に向けてそれぞれの個性的な武器で画面いっぱいに激しい派手なエフェクト（火・水・雷・土・光・闇・デジタル…など）や魔法陣や発光を伴う必殺技を様々なアクション性のあるキレのいいモーションで繰り出し、すぐ右奥に消えながら次のキャラが手前から出てきて入れ替わっていく。

entries.description: A high-budget disaster movie sequence featuring a dock worker being hunted by a giant octopus in a stormy harbor, concluding with a container trap.
entries.prompt:
Subject: A dock worker in rain-soaked work clothes, sprinting for his life through a storm-ravaged fishing harbor while being hunted by a gigantic octopus.

Action/Emotion: Panic, survival, desperation, quick thinking under pressure.

Environment: Massive commercial fishing harbor during a violent storm. Towering shipping containers, cargo cranes, fishing trawlers, crashing waves, flying debris, rain-lashed docks.

Camera: Handheld chase camera, low-angle tracking shots, aerial drone fly-throughs, whip pans, speed ramps during sprints, bullet-time during the payoff.

Lighting & Mood: Dark stormy daylight, flashing harbor warning lights, heavy rain, ocean spray, blockbuster creature-feature chaos.

Technical: Ultra-realistic, 4K HDR, 35mm anamorphic lens, cinematic motion blur, practical creature realism, high-budget disaster movie energy.

SHOT 1 — 0–3s (THE HOOK)

The sequence begins mid-action.

A giant octopus is already climbing through the harbor.

Its massive tentacles wrap around cargo containers and rip them from their stacks.

Metal screams.

Containers crash into the docks below.

A dock worker sprints across the tops of stacked shipping containers.

The camera races backward in front of him.

Behind him—

A gigantic tentacle smashes down, crushing the container he was standing on seconds earlier.

SHOT 2 — 3–6s

The worker leaps across a gap between container stacks.

Barely making it.

The octopus follows.

Tentacles sweep across the harbor.

One wraps around a crane tower.

Another tears apart a fishing boat below.

The camera flies through the chaos as waves crash against the docks.

The worker keeps running.

SHOT 3 — 6–9s

He reaches the final container in the stack.

Dead end.

Nothing ahead but open air and stormy ocean.

He turns.

The octopus rises higher.

Its enormous body emerging from the harbor.

Tentacles spreading outward.

Blocking every escape route.

Then—

The worker notices a massive shipping container suspended from a crane directly above the creature.

SHOT 4 — 9–12s

The octopus advances.

Tentacles reaching.

Closer.

Closer.

The worker pulls a crane remote from his belt.

Rain pouring down.

He waits until the last possible second.

Then slams the release button.

SHOT 5 — 12–15s (BULLET-TIME PAYOFF)

Bullet time.

The suspended shipping container drops.

Rain droplets hang frozen in the air.

Steel cables whip loose.

The octopus looks up.

Too late.

The container crashes directly onto its head.

The impact drives the entire creature backward.

Tentacles flailing.

Water exploding upward.

Time snaps back.

A colossal splash engulfs the harbor.

The worker drops to his knees on the container stack.

The giant octopus disappears beneath the stormy water.

Cut.

entries.title: Alien Creature Highway Bridge Attack
entries.description: A dramatic multi-shot cinematic prompt featuring a giant alien attacking a highway bridge and being countered by a soldier and a brave police officer.
entries.prompt:
A gigantic alien creature — wet black skin, many glowing eyes, and a long whip-like tongue — stands over a busy highway bridge in bright daylight. It uses its tongue to grab moving cars off the road and lift them up to its mouth. An army truck with a big anti-aircraft gun is parked further down the bridge. Sound: screaming traffic, crunching metal, the alien's wet roar, gun motors, radio chatter. 

 Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot along the bridge. The giant alien's tongue whips out and wraps around a speeding car, lifting it high into the air toward its open mouth full of teeth. Other cars swerve and crash. Inside a police car, our hero — a young cop — slams the brakes, staring up through the windshield, shouting into his radio: "IT'S PICKING UP CARS! IT'S EATING THEM OFF THE ROAD!"  

Shot 2 (3–6s): At the army truck down the bridge. A soldier sits behind the big anti-aircraft gun, swinging the barrel up toward the alien, but holding fire — the alien's mouth is shut. He shouts on the radio: "I can only hurt it when its mouth opens! Somebody make it open wide — then I fire!"  

Shot 3 (6–9s): The alien creatures tongue suddenly wraps the hero's police car and lifts it upside down, high over the alien's open jaws. Inside, hanging from his seatbelt, the cop pulls out his shotgun, points it down through his own windshield at the alien's mouth below, and yells: "OPEN WIDE!" He fires. The alien roars in pain, its huge mouth opening wide.  

Shot 4 (9–14s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The mouth is open. Bullet time — the soldier in the tank sees his chance fires the anti-aircraft gun in slow motion, a stream of glowing shells flying across the bridge straight into the alien creatures open mouth, the alien's head jerking back, black blood and broken teeth hanging in the air. The tongue lets go of the car.  

Shot 5 (14–15s): Time snaps back. The huge alien folds backward and crashes down over the bridge railing, sliding off into the river below. The police car drops onto the road and bounces, the cop climbing out, shotgun still in hand. Smoke drifts across the bridge.

entries.title: Crocodile Floodgate Jungle Escape

entries.prompt:

Environment: Massive flooded jungle water-treatment plant deep inside the rainforest. Giant concrete water channels, rusted maintenance walkways, roaring spillways, floodgates, pumping stations, tropical storm conditions.

SHOT 1 — 0–3s (THE HOOK)

The sequence begins mid-chase.

The ranger is already sprinting across a narrow maintenance walkway suspended above a raging water channel.

Behind him—

A gigantic crocodile explodes through a metal safety barrier.

The barrier twists and flies into the floodwater below.

The crocodile charges forward.

Its enormous body sends spray everywhere.

The camera races backward in front of the ranger as he leaps over broken sections of walkway.

A radio on his vest crackles with static.

SHOT 2 — 3–6s

The ranger reaches a junction of elevated catwalks.

He jumps across a gap.

Barely makes it.

The crocodile doesn’t slow down.

It crashes straight through the handrails and follows.

Concrete chunks tumble into the rushing water below.

The distance between them is shrinking fast.

SHOT 3 — 6–9s

The ranger reaches the end of the platform.

Dead end.

Nothing ahead except a giant floodgate control station.

Nowhere left to run.

He turns.

The crocodile advances.

Water dripping from its jaws.

The camera pushes in.

Then—

He notices a massive red emergency floodgate lever beside him.

SHOT 4 — 9–12s

The crocodile charges.

Full speed.

The ranger waits.

Waits.

Waits.

At the last possible second he grabs the lever and yanks it downward with both hands.

Warning sirens activate.

Massive machinery begins moving.

SHOT 5 — 12–15s (BULLET-TIME PAYOFF)

The floodgate blasts open.

Bullet time.

A colossal wall of water erupts from the channel.

The crocodile’s eyes widen.

Concrete fragments.

Rain.

Water droplets.

Everything suspended in the air.

The torrent slams directly into the charging crocodile.

The giant body is launched backward through concrete barriers and into the roaring spillway beyond.

Time snaps back.

A thunderous wave crashes through the facility.

The ranger clings to the railing.

Watching the crocodile disappear into the floodwaters below.

entries.title: Ronaldo vs Messi Stage Battle
entries.description: A documentary-style handheld camera prompt showing a supernatural stage battle between football legends with elemental powers in front of a live crowd.
entries.prompt:
@Image1 as the first frame. 16:9, 15s, one continuous wide shot from far back in the audience, phone held above the crowd. Camera stays distant, framing the full stage with crowd heads in the foreground. Slow drifting push-in, slight micro-shake, no cuts. Crowd with raised phones stays reactive throughout. Stadium stands, floodlights, and rigs stay fixed in the background.

0–3s: The fire around the left performer pulls inward and condenses into a single glowing football at his feet. He strikes it hard toward the right performer, and mid-air it splits into many footballs streaking across the stage. The right performer rises from his kneel, his blue orb flaring brighter, lightning arcing across his body. The crowd roars.

3–6s: The swarm of footballs rushes the right performer. He thrusts the orb forward and lightning bolts blast outward, zapping the footballs one by one into bursts of sparks and smoke. A few slip through and force him to dodge low. The crowd gasps.

6–9s: The left performer sprints forward, kicking football after football, each one multiplying mid-air into more that hammer toward the right performer. The right performer fires rapid lightning bolts to smash them down, struggling to hold the line. The crowd shouts loudly.

9–12s: Both break apart, breathing hard. The left performer juggles a glowing football upward and it swells into a massive ball above his head. The right performer crouches low and a dense ball of crackling lightning gathers between his hands.

12–15s: Both launch forward at once. The left performer kicks the giant football and it bursts into a huge swarm of footballs. The right performer hurls his lightning ball into the swarm and they collide at center stage in a massive flash of sparks, smoke, and scattering footballs. Both skid back to opposite edges in fighting stances. The crowd erupts into applause, phone lights wave.

Audio: crowd murmur and night ambience at start. Sharp kick-thwack on each strike. Whoosh of flying footballs. Electric zap on each bolt. Concussive boom on each clash. Loud gasp at 5s. Cheers escalate to a massive roar by 15s. Effort grunts on each strike. No music. No dialogue. Photorealistic, documentary handheld aesthetic, shot from a distance.

entries.title: Megalodon vs Seaplane Cinematic Chase
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot video prompt depicting a massive megalodon attacking a seaplane in a high-speed chase across a lake, featuring a patrol boat intervention and a cinematic rocket explosion payoff.
entries.prompt:
A massive megalodon, huge as a whale with grey scarred skin, has clamped onto the left float of a small seaplane as it races across a wide lake in bright daylight. The plane is at full speed, hopping and banging across the water with the big fish holding on. A patrol boat speeds alongside, a crew member braced at the front with a launcher on his shoulder. Sound: roaring propeller, splashing water, creaking metal, water churning, radio voices.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Fast side tracking shot just above the water. The seaplane rushes across the lake at full power, spray flying everywhere — and the megalodon has its huge mouth shut tight on the left float, pulling the plane's nose down. The plane skips and leans hard to one side. Inside, the pilot wrestles the controls and shouts on his radio: "IT'S PULLING ME DOWN! DROP THE FLOAT — I'LL SHAKE IT LOOSE!"

Shot 2 (3–5s): On the patrol boat racing beside the plane. The crew member kneels at the front, lowers his eye to the launcher sight, and aims steadily at the water beside the plane, finger ready on the trigger. He gives one short nod and speaks low: "Drop it. I'm ready."

Shot 3 (5–8s): Inside the shaking cockpit. The pilot reaches down, grips the red release handle, and pulls it hard. Outside — the pins pop and the damaged float breaks away. The megalodon drops back into the lake with the float in its mouth, and the plane leaps forward, suddenly light and free.

Shot 4 (8–12s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: On the boat, the crew member FIRES — a clear shot of the launcher kicking back, smoke bursting from the tube, the rocket streaking out across the water. At that exact moment the megalodon bursts up out of the lake and leaps high into the air, the broken float still in its mouth. Bullet time — the giant fish hangs at the top of its leap, and the rocket flies straight into its side. A huge burst of fire, water, and spray fills the air.

Shot 5 (12–13s): Time snaps back. Glowing pieces fall into the lake as the megalodon splashes down hard. The seaplane, leaning on its one float, lifts off the water and climbs up into the sky through the smoke.

entries.title: Macro Biological Surreal Skin Forest
entries.description: An experimental prompt for a macro cinematic video exploring human skin transforming into a glowing biological forest.
entries.prompt:
Extreme macro shot of human skin under soft clinical light. At this scale, pores resemble craters, fine hairs look like translucent forests, and sweat droplets sit like tiny glass lakes.

Opening frame: the camera travels slowly across the surface of the skin like an aerial landscape. The sound is intimate and abstract , heartbeat, distant wind, low organic resonance.

At the 2-second mark, one pore opens like a flower.

A miniature glowing forest begins growing from beneath the skin. Transparent roots spread under the surface, visible through the tissue like luminous veins. Tiny white flowers bloom from pores, releasing pollen that floats upward in slow motion.

The camera dives beneath the skin surface into a surreal inner garden: capillaries become red rivers, nerves glow like golden roots, and microscopic petals drift through warm biological light.

VFX escalation: the garden expands rapidly. The skin surface becomes a translucent dome above the forest. A human eye appears in the sky, watching from outside the body.

Velocity ramp: a single pollen grain spins toward the lens inside it, an entire memory of a childhood field plays like a tiny hologram.

Final moment: the camera pulls back to reveal the person sitting still in a white room, with faint flowers glowing beneath their skin.

Experimental body-landscape surrealism, macro biological textures, luminous root systems, soft medical realism, poetic body horror without gore, 4K.

entries.title: Stormy Cargo Ship Runner Action
entries.description: A hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence of a runner navigating the top of stacked containers on a cargo ship during a violent ocean storm.
entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9.  

At night during a violent ocean storm, a lone runner in dark waterproof gear races across the tops of stacked cargo containers on a massive cargo ship. The sea is rough, waves crash against the ship, rain lashes the deck, and powerful wind shakes everything. The containers are wet, slippery, and unstable. No visible face.  

Wide opening shot: the cargo ship cuts through the stormy sea. The runner sprints across the top of stacked containers as lightning flashes in the distance. Some containers shift and tilt as the ship rolls with the waves.  Side tracking shot: the runner jumps from one container to another while nearby containers slide out of position. Metal scrapes against metal, rain hits hard, and ocean spray bursts upward from below.

Dynamic front three-quarter shot: the ship tilts sharply. A row of containers begins to slip and fall toward the edge. The runner keeps moving, making quick jumps across narrowing gaps as containers drop away into the sea.  Final 5 seconds: the action becomes more intense. Several containers slide at once, creating a chain reaction. One container tips and crashes off the ship into the ocean. 

The runner leaps across a widening gap, lands hard on a tilted container, regains balance, then makes one final desperate jump to a stable section near the ship’s upper deck while waves explode below.  Final moment: the runner reaches safer footing as more containers crash into the sea behind, with storm, lightning, and spray filling the background.  

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, fast-paced, strong sense of danger and motion, stormy ocean, rain, wind, metal surfaces, crashing waves, dynamic but readable camera movement, no visible face, no celebrity resemblance, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion. Keep proportions. Keep style and features.

entries.prompt:
Pixar-Inspired 3D Animated World Cup 2026 Story

At the ticket booth, disaster strikes.

A giant sign reads:

SOLD OUT

Her smile disappears.

She checks her savings again.

Too late.

No tickets remain.

Heartbroken, she sits alone outside the stadium gates while thousands of fans enter. The atmosphere grows louder. Stadium lights illuminate the sky. Chants echo from inside. She watches families and supporters celebrating while she remains outside holding her jar of savings.

Kickoff approaches.

The stadium roars.

Tears begin to form.

Just when all hope seems lost, a kind football fan notices her sadness. He walks over and reveals something incredible:

An extra World Cup ticket.

The girl freezes.

She can't believe it.

Her eyes widen with excitement.

She thanks him and runs toward the entrance as fast as she can.

The gates open.

She enters the stadium just as the players walk onto the pitch.

The crowd erupts.

Fireworks explode.

Flags wave everywhere.

The girl stands completely speechless as she sees the glowing stadium from inside for the very first time.

As the match begins, she joins thousands of fans singing, cheering, and celebrating together. The game becomes everything she imagined and more. Every goal, every chant, every moment feels magical.

Final cinematic shot: the girl standing among thousands of fans under dazzling stadium lights, holding her ticket close to her heart while fireworks burst above the arena.

entries.title: Pixar Style World Cup Animation
entries.description: A heartwarming Pixar-style 3D animated short prompt about a young girl who catches the match ball at the FIFA World Cup.
entries.prompt:
Create a heartwarming Pixar-style 3D animated short set during the FIFA World Cup 2026. A cheerful young girl wearing her favorite national team jersey attends her very first World Cup match with her family. The stadium is packed with passionate fans waving flags, singing chants, and celebrating together. The girl is overwhelmed with excitement as she takes in the bright lights, giant screens, and electric atmosphere.
As the match unfolds, the crowd erupts with every attack and near miss. The girl watches in awe, completely absorbed in the game. Suddenly, a powerful shot sails high into the stands. The ball rockets toward the crowd. Fans duck, cover their heads, and scramble out of the way.
But the girl instinctively reaches out.
She catches the match ball.
Silence.
Then the entire section explodes with cheers.
The stadium cameras immediately find her. Her smiling face appears on the giant screen. Thousands of fans celebrate and applaud. The girl holds the ball tightly, shocked and thrilled by what just happened.
Word spreads across the stadium. Even the players notice. One of the star players points toward her and smiles. The crowd begins chanting as she proudly raises the ball above her head. She suddenly becomes the most famous fan in the stadium.
After the match, as fans begin leaving, stadium staff approach her and invite her closer to the field. The star player walks over, thanks her for supporting the team, and signs the match ball. The girl can barely believe it. Cameras flash while fans applaud from the stands.
As the sun sets and stadium lights glow against the night sky, she takes a photo with the player and holds the signed ball close to her heart. Looking out at the field one last time, she dreams bigger than ever before.
Final cinematic shot: the girl walks through the stadium tunnel carrying the signed match ball. She turns back for one last look at the pitch, smiling as the lights shine brightly ahead.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Anti-Gravity Rider Video
entries.description: A high-octane sci-fi video storyboard prompt featuring an anti-gravity rider escaping a collapsing floating megacity in a synthwave atmosphere.
entries.prompt:
Style: 3D cinematic retrofuturistic sci-fi, stylized realism, colossal floating megacity collapsing from orbit, synthwave atmosphere, dramatic volumetric clouds, impossible scale, dynamic camera movement, high-speed action, cinematic destruction, 15-second vertical video pacing 
Pilot: lone anti-gravity rider in sleek white flight armor with illuminated blue accents, aerodynamic helmet, fearless expression, riding a futuristic hoverbike Camera points upward through thick clouds. A gigantic floating city is breaking apart overhead. Entire skyscrapers drift downward like asteroids. Monorails twist through the sky. The Pilot bursts into frame on a hoverbike, diving through the falling debris field. SFX: atmospheric roar, distant structural collapse, deep synth drone. 
Tracking shot beside the Pilot racing between collapsing towers. Buildings rotate slowly in freefall. Neon signs tumble through the air. A giant transit station tears apart behind her. VFX: sparks, falling holograms, debris trails. SFX: rushing wind, metal tearing, engine scream. 
A colossal orbital defense machine awakens among the wreckage. Rotating rings spin around its glowing core. The machine locks onto the Pilot and begins pursuit through the collapsing city. VFX: targeting lasers, reactor glow, energy pulses. SFX: warning alarms, reactor hum, heavy machinery. 
The Pilot accelerates through an upside-down skyscraper drifting through the atmosphere. Windows explode outward. Debris rushes past the camera as the defense machine fires massive energy blasts through the falling city. SFX: energy cannon discharge, sonic booms, collapsing steel. 
Epic ultra-wide shot. The Pilot escapes the debris field as the entire floating metropolis ignites during atmospheric reentry. Thousands of burning structures streak across the sky behind her like a man-made meteor shower. SFX: orchestral synth climax, atmospheric burn, final cinematic impact.
