entries.title: Cinematic Anime Multi-Attack Sequence
entries.description: A comprehensive Japanese prompt for a 15-second theatrical anime action sequence featuring a lavender-haired character in a palace setting with extreme close-ups and wide shots.
entries.prompt:
[メタデータ]
尺: 15秒
テンポ: 約128BPM
構成スタイル: シネマティック・マルチアタック・フィニッシュ / Extreme Close-Up & Wide Alternation
ショット数: 12ショット
画質: 劇場版アニメスタイル / ウルトラハイエンド / 4K / Theatrical Anime, Highly Detailed, Cinematic Lighting, Ray Tracing, Artistic Composition, dramatic Depth of Field, low-angle action cinematography, exaggerated foreshortening, controlled motion blur, clean anatomy, no duplicated limbs.

[ワードローブ・主人公]
@[image1] を完全固定。主人公はラベンダー色のツインシニヨン髪、紫の瞳、小柄なチビキャラ寄りの体型、黒 and 紫を基調にした星飾り付きのドレス風コート、リボン、金色の装飾、紫黒のボーダーソックス、紫の靴を全ショットで一貫させる。顔立ち、髪型、衣装、装飾、色彩、シルエットを絶対に変えない。

[人体固定ルール]
主人公と敵は常に自然な人間解剖学。腕は二本、脚は二本のみ。高速回転、蹴り、ジャンプ、着地、サマーソルト中でも余分な脚、重複した腕、分裂した足、実体化した残像を生成しない。モーションブラーは身体の外側に薄く流れるだけ。すべての攻撃は骨盤の回転、肩のひねり、踏み込み、重心移動に基づく。

[世界観]
星詠み貴族の廃宮殿。巨大な円形ホール、紫水晶の柱、金細工の階段、星座模様の大理石床、割れた天窓から差し込む月光、浮遊する粉塵、遠景に機械仕掛けの天球儀。主人公の黒紫と金の衣装に合わせ、背景は冷たい青紫の月光と金属反射で統一。

[敵]
仮面をつけた宮廷執行者たちが複数方向から連続で襲撃。長身で黒灰色の戦闘服、銀色の仮面、短剣や警棒を持つ。主人公と同じ顔・髪型・衣装に見えないよう完全に差別化。

[ムード]
最初は包囲される静かな緊張。主人公は無表情で腕を組み、眠たげな目のまま一瞬で加速する。ラストはサマーソルトキックで敵を宙へ弾き飛ばし、何事もなかったように着地する余裕の決着。

[ミュージック]
低音ドローン、鋭い和太鼓風パーカッション、金属的なクリック音。攻撃ごとに短いヒット音。最終サマーソルト直前だけ一瞬無音、蹴り抜きでストリングスが急上昇し、着地で音がすっと引く。

[カメラ・演出]
Extreme Close-Up と Wide Shot を極端に交互配置。アップでは目、口元、靴底、リボン、衝撃の瞬間を誇張。ワイドでは複数敵との位置関係と空間全体を明快に見せる。低角度、魚眼気味の誇張パース、ドリーイン、スピードランプ、マッチカットを多用。

ショット1: 0.0-1.3秒 / Wide。廃宮殿の円形ホール中央、主人公が腕を組んだまま無表情で立つ。周囲を8人の仮面執行者が半円状に包囲。天窓の月光が紫の髪と金の星飾りを縁取る。カメラは超ローアングルからゆっくり回り込み、空間の広さと包囲を見せる。

ショット2: 1.3-2.2秒 / Extreme Close-Up。主人公の半目の紫の瞳。瞳に迫る敵の影が反射する。口元がわずかに不機嫌そうに歪む。リボンの星飾りが小さく揺れ、次の瞬間だけ完全な無音。

ショット3: 2.2-3.4秒 / Wide。右前方から突っ込む敵の警棒を、主人公が最小動作で半身になって回避。小さな身体を沈め、踏み込みと同時に前蹴りを腹部へ叩き込む。敵が後方の大理石床を滑る。カメラは横移動ドリーで蹴りのラインを追う。

ショット4: 3.4-4.3秒 / Close-Up。紫の靴底が画面いっぱいに迫る。靴の金飾りが光り、命中直前に短いスピードランプ。衝撃波で敵の仮面の端が震える。モーションブラーは薄く、脚は一本だけ明確。

ショット5: 4.3-5.7秒 / Wide。左側から二人同時に斬り込む。主人公は一人目の腕を受け流し、回転しながら横蹴りで膝を崩す。続けて背後の敵へ肘打ちを入れ、さらに肩で押し込むカウンターで柱へ弾く。カメラは円形レールで360度回り込み。

ショット6: 5.7-6.8秒 / Extreme Close-Up。主人公の小さな手が敵の袖をつかむ。金の星チャームが鋭く揺れる。布のしわ、指先の力、敵の重心が崩れる瞬間を超接近で描写。背景は強い被写界深度で溶ける。

ショット7: 6.8-8.2秒 / Wide。主人公が敵の腕を引き込み、足払いで一人を転ばせる。倒れる敵を踏み台にして低く跳び、空中で半回転しながら別の敵の肩へ踵落とし。小柄な体格に反した鋭い重量感。カメラは床すれすれから見上げ、誇張されたパースで靴と敵の距離を強調。

ショット8: 8.2-9.2秒 / Close-Up。主人公の髪のツインシニヨンとリボンが回転の遠心力でふわりと遅れて流れる。半目の表情は変わらない。背後で敵の短剣が空を切り、金属音だけが鋭く響く。

ショット9: 9.2-10.7秒 / Wide。背後から迫る大柄な執行者に対し、主人公は振り向きざまの後ろ蹴りを胸部へ命中させる。さらに着地と同時に膝を抜き、低い姿勢から掌底で別の敵の顎を跳ね上げる。敵が星座模様の床上で連鎖的に崩れる。カメラは一気に引いて全体の連続処理を見せる。

ショット10: 10.7-11.8秒 / Extreme Close-Up。最後の強敵の足が床を踏み砕く。次のカットで主人公の紫の瞳、さらに靴のつま先へ高速カット。主人公が体を低く沈め、サマーソルトの予備動作に入る。音楽が一瞬止まり、髪飾りの星だけがきらりと光る。

ショット11: 11.8-13.5秒 / Dramatic Wide + Slow Motion。最終アクション。主人公が地面を蹴って後方へ宙返り、完全に美しい弧を描くサマーソルトキック。紫の靴先が下から上へ強敵の顎を正確に蹴り抜く。月光を背負った逆光シルエット、スカートとリボンが円形に広がる。敵は縦方向に吹き飛び、背後の天球儀の光と重なる。脚は左右二本のみ、回転中も人体構造を厳密に維持。

ショット12: 13.5-15.0秒 / Long Telephoto Pull Back。主人公がふわりと片足で着地し、すぐに両足を揃える。腕を組み直し、半目のまま小さく息を吐く。周囲の敵が遅れて崩れ落ち、紫水晶の粉塵が月光に舞う。カメラは望遠でゆっくり引き、廃宮殿の広大な静寂と、主人公の小さくも圧倒的な存在感を残してフェードアウト。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Metadata]
Length: 15 seconds
Tempo: Approx. 128BPM
Composition Style: Cinematic Multi-Attack Finish / Extreme Close-Up & Wide Alternation
Number of Shots: 12 shots
Image Quality: Theatrical Anime Style / Ultra High-End / 4K / Theatrical Anime, Highly Detailed, Cinematic Lighting, Ray Tracing, Artistic Composition, dramatic Depth of Field, low-angle action cinematography, exaggerated foreshortening, controlled motion blur, clean anatomy, no duplicated limbs.

[Wardrobe - Protagonist]
@[image1] is completely fixed. The protagonist has lavender twin-bun hair, purple eyes, a small petite physique, a black and purple dress-style coat with star ornaments, ribbons, gold decorations, purple-black striped socks, and purple shoes, consistent across all shots. Facial features, hairstyle, clothing, decorations, colors, and silhouette must never change.

[Human Anatomy Rules]
Protagonist and enemies always follow natural human anatomy. Only two arms and two legs. Do not generate extra legs, overlapping arms, split feet, or materialized afterimages during high-speed rotations, kicks, jumps, landings, or somersaults. Motion blur only flows thinly on the outside of the body. All attacks are based on pelvic rotation, shoulder twisting, stepping, and center-of-gravity movement.

[World Setting]
Ruined palace of star-gazing nobles. Giant circular hall, amethyst pillars, gold-worked stairs, marble floor with constellation patterns, moonlight shining through broken skylights, floating dust, and a mechanical armillary sphere in the background. Consistent with the protagonist's black-purple and gold outfit, the background is unified with cold blue-purple moonlight and metallic reflections.

[Enemies]
Multiple masked court executioners attacking in succession from various directions. Tall with black-gray combat suits, silver masks, holding daggers or batons. Completely differentiated so they do not look like the protagonist's face, hair, or outfit.

[Mood]
Quiet tension at first while being surrounded. The protagonist stands with arms crossed, expressionless, and accelerates instantly with sleepy eyes. The finale is a decisive somersault kick that blows the enemy into the air, ending with a composed landing as if nothing happened.

[Music]
Bass drone, sharp Japanese taiko-style percussion, metallic clicks. Short hit sounds with each attack. Silence for a moment just before the final somersault, strings surge with the kick-through, and the sound fades out upon landing.

[Camera & Direction]
Extreme alternation between Extreme Close-Up and Wide Shot. Close-ups exaggerate eyes, mouth, shoe soles, ribbons, and the moment of impact. Wide shots clearly show position relative to multiple enemies and the entire space. Use low angles, fish-eye-like exaggerated perspective, dolly-ins, speed ramps, and match cuts extensively.

Shot 1: 0.0-1.3s / Wide. Center of the circular hall in the ruined palace, protagonist stands expressionless with arms crossed. 8 masked executioners surround in a semicircle. Moonlight from the skylight edges the purple hair and gold star ornaments. Camera circles slowly from an ultra-low angle to show space and encirclement.

Shot 2: 1.3-2.2s / Extreme Close-Up. Protagonist's half-closed purple eyes. Enemy's shadow approaching is reflected in the eyes. The mouth distorts slightly in annoyance. The star ornament on the ribbon shakes small, then complete silence the next moment.

Shot 3: 2.2-3.4s / Wide. Protagonist avoids an enemy's baton rushing from the front-right with minimal movement. Crouches low and delivers a front kick to the abdomen simultaneously with a step-in. The enemy slides across the marble floor. Camera dolly-pans the kick line.

Shot 4: 3.4-4.3s / Close-Up. Purple shoe sole fills the screen. Gold decoration on the shoe shines, with a short speed ramp just before impact. The edge of the enemy's mask shakes from the shockwave. Motion blur is thin, leg is clearly one.

Shot 5: 4.3-5.7s / Wide. Two people slash in simultaneously from the left. Protagonist parries the first's arm and breaks their knee with a side kick while rotating. Continues with an elbow strike to the enemy behind, then a shoulder-push counter into a pillar. 360-degree camera rotation on a circular rail.

Shot 6: 5.7-6.8s / Extreme Close-Up. Protagonist's small hand grabs the enemy's sleeve. Gold star charm shakes sharply. Depict cloth wrinkles, finger strength, and the moment the enemy's center of gravity collapses in ultra-close-up. Background melts with strong depth of field.

Shot 7: 6.8-8.2s / Wide. Protagonist pulls in the enemy's arm and trips one. Uses the falling enemy as a stepping stone to jump low, doing a half-turn in mid-air to land a heel drop on another enemy's shoulder. Sharp sense of weight despite small stature. Camera looks up from the floor, emphasizing distance between shoe and enemy with exaggerated perspective.

Shot 8: 8.2-9.2s / Close-Up. Protagonist's twin-bun hair and ribbons flow slightly late due to centrifugal force. Half-closed expression remains unchanged. Behind, the enemy's dagger cuts through air, only the metal sound rings sharply.

Shot 9: 9.2-10.7s / Wide. To a large executioner approaching from behind, the protagonist lands a spinning back kick to the chest. Then, upon landing, pulls the knee and strikes another enemy's jaw with a palm heel from a low posture. Enemies collapse in a chain on the constellation-patterned floor. Camera pulls back sharply to show sequential processing.

Shot 10: 10.7-11.8s / Extreme Close-Up. The final strong enemy's foot crushes the floor. High-speed cuts to protagonist's purple eyes, then shoe tip. Protagonist crouches low, entering somersault preparation. Music stops for a moment, only the hair ornament star glints.

Shot 11: 11.8-13.5s / Dramatic Wide + Slow Motion. Final action. Protagonist kicks off the ground into a backflip, a perfectly beautiful somersault kick arc. Purple shoe tip accurately kicks through the strong enemy's jaw from bottom to top. Backlit silhouette against moonlight, skirt and ribbons spread in a circle. Enemy is blown vertically, overlapping with the armillary sphere's light. Exactly two legs, strictly maintaining human structure even during rotation.

Shot 12: 13.5-15.0s / Long Telephoto Pull Back. Protagonist lands softly on one foot and immediately brings both feet together. Re-crosses arms, breathing out small with half-closed eyes. Surrounding enemies collapse late, amethyst dust dances in the moonlight. Camera pulls back slowly with a telephoto lens, fading out leaving the vast silence of the ruined palace and the small yet overwhelming presence of the protagonist.

entries.title: Abandoned Gothic Cathedral with Shadow Figures
entries.description: A cinematic prompt for generating a surreal video of an abandoned cathedral where shadows wake and transform under a pale eclipse.
entries.prompt:
A gigantic abandoned cathedral stands in an endless black desert under a pale eclipse. The architecture is impossible: gothic arches bending inward, columns made of black marble, stained-glass windows showing moving silhouettes instead of saints. Fine ash drifts through the air like slow snow.

Opening frame: a slow dolly forward through the cathedral entrance. The floor is covered with thousands of sleeping shadows lying flat like bodies without owners.

At the 2-second mark, the eclipse light touches the floor.

The shadows begin waking.

They peel away from the stone surface, stretching upward into thin humanoid forms. Their movements are slow, fluid, and unnatural, like ink rising through water. The stained-glass windows crack from inside, releasing beams of inverted light , black rays cutting through pale dust.

The camera glides between the shadow figures as they silently turn toward the altar. Their edges flicker, sometimes solid, sometimes smoke. Every step they take leaves a ripple across the floor as if the stone were liquid.

VFX escalation: the cathedral walls begin breathing, expanding and contracting with low pressure waves. The ceiling fractures open, revealing a sky filled with rotating eclipses. The sleeping shadows fuse together into a massive winged silhouette above the altar.

Velocity ramp: a stained-glass window explodes inward ,shards suspended mid-air, each shard reflecting a different impossible sky.

Final moment: the winged shadow lowers its face toward the camera, but its face is only a doorway filled with moving stars.

Hyper-artistic gothic surrealism, slow cinematic motion, volumetric ash, inverted light beams, liquid shadow simulation, dreamlike horror atmosphere, 4K.

entries.title: Smartphone POV Fantasy Stage Battle

entries.prompt:
Audience-POV realistic smartphone video of an original fantasy outdoor stage performance. The footage is filmed vertically from inside a crowded live audience, with the phone held slightly above people’s heads. The frame has natural handheld sway, small breathing movement, brief focus hunting, mild digital noise, compressed phone microphone sound, ordinary smartphone exposure, and crowd silhouettes blocking the lower edge of the frame.
The stage is a large wooden outdoor performance platform built as a fictional mountain shrine arena: a cracked red shrine gate at the back, carved stone dragon statues on both sides, bamboo fencing, hanging cloth banners with invented calligraphy, dark wooden steps, sculpted rock formations, small ember bowls near the stage corners, and thin theatrical mist drifting behind the set. Tall trees and pale afternoon sky are visible beyond the stage. Audience members fill the foreground with dark hair silhouettes, raised phones, small cameras, and occasional hands pointing toward the stage.
Two original fantasy performers face each other on stage.
On frame-left stands the Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian: a tall male dragon-humanoid stage performer with a strong athletic build, deep bronze skin visible around the jaw and hands, short backward-curving dark red horns, subtle cheek-scale prosthetics, amber glowing contact lenses, and layered crimson scale armor made of matte leather plates. He wears a heavy dark waist sash, black stage boots, a short thick dragon-tail costume piece attached behind the armor, and a long blackened spear with a red ember-like tip. His movement feels heavy, grounded, and ceremonial, like an ancient fire guardian entering combat.
On frame-right stands the Shadow-Reed Ninja: a lean young stage performer with quick controlled movement, ash-black layered ninja clothing, dark green cloth wraps around the forearms, a plain charcoal hood, a half-face fabric mask, soft split-toe stage boots, and two short curved matte-black blades. A narrow strip of deep green fabric trails from his back and moves with each step. His movement feels light, precise, and tactical, like a forest assassin using speed and misdirection.
0s to 4s: The phone camera rises slightly above the crowd as the audience reacts to the two performers entering their fighting marks. The Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian steps forward from frame-left with slow weighty footwork, the spear tip dragging once across the wooden stage and creating a brief orange ember spark from a hidden stage effect. The Shadow-Reed Ninja lowers his stance on frame-right, turns one shoulder toward the dragon warrior, and shifts his blades into a crossed defensive position. The audience grows quieter for a moment, then a few people cheer as both performers begin circling toward center stage.
4s to 7s: The ninja moves first with two fast but readable diagonal blade strikes. The dragon warrior blocks the first strike with the spear shaft, turns his armored shoulder into the second strike, then answers with one broad horizontal spear sweep. The ninja ducks under the sweep, slides one foot across the stage, and lets the trailing green cloth flick behind him. Their weapons meet at center stage with a staged metallic clack. A small controlled dust burst rises from the floorboards around their boots. The phone camera jolts slightly as people in front lift their phones higher.
7s to 10s: The duel shifts into a fantasy stage illusion. The dragon warrior plants the spear into the stage with both hands, lowers his head, and the red glow inside his chest armor brightens from hidden LEDs. Thin orange smoke vents from the spear tip and curls upward. The ninja steps backward into a shadowed patch near the bamboo fence, flicks both blades outward, and two black silk ribbons snap open behind him like fast-moving shadow wings pulled by stage wires. The crowd gasps. The camera tries to keep both performers in frame, drifting slightly left then correcting back to center.
10s to 13s: Both performers charge toward the center mark in a controlled stage-combat rhythm. The dragon warrior drives the spear forward with a heavy two-handed thrust while the ninja spins aside and crosses both blades near the spear tip. At the exact contact point, a practical stage flash pops low to the floor, followed by a ring of dry leaves and dust pushed outward by a hidden air burst. The dragon warrior holds a powerful low stance, armor still glowing red. The ninja lands in a crouched side stance, one blade forward, one blade behind. The two freeze in a final dramatic face-off as the audience erupts into cheers, applause, whistles, and raised phones shaking in the foreground.
Camera behavior: continuous handheld smartphone POV from the audience, raised above shoulder level, slightly unsteady but physically grounded. The camera never becomes a professional cinematic camera. It keeps the crowd silhouettes in the lower foreground, occasionally catches nearby phone screens, and follows the performers with natural human reaction timing. The framing stays mostly medium-wide so the full stage combat remains readable, with brief focus hunting when the stage flash occurs.
Lighting: natural late-afternoon daylight from above and slightly frame-right, mixed with warm red practical stage lights hidden inside ember bowls, the dragon chest armor, and the spear tip. The ninja stays slightly cooler and darker near the bamboo-shadow side of the stage. The stage flash briefly lifts exposure on the center floorboards and nearby dust, then the image returns to ordinary phone-camera contrast.
Audio: live outdoor crowd ambience, phone microphone compression, excited audience voices close to the camera, wooden stage footwork, leather armor creaks, cloth ribbon snaps, staged metal weapon clacks, a low ember hiss from the dragon spear effect, a short smoke vent burst, one floor-level flash pop, dry leaves scattering, and loud applause at the final freeze pose.
Keep the Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian’s horns, cheek scales, amber eyes, crimson scale armor, blackened spear, tail costume piece, heavy movement rhythm, and frame-left origin stable throughout. Keep the Shadow-Reed Ninja’s charcoal hood, half-face mask, ash-black outfit, dark green arm wraps, twin short blades, trailing green fabric, light movement rhythm, and frame-right origin stable throughout. Keep the shrine gate, stone dragon statues, bamboo fencing, ember bowls, wooden floorboards, audience silhouettes, phone POV, daylight direction, red stage glow, weapon scale, and final center-stage face-off consistent from start to finish.
Preserve original fantasy character identity, readable stage choreography, practical live-show effects, stable costume shapes, clear weapon positions, natural hand anatomy, believable body weight, consistent performer scale, grounded audience-camera movement, ordinary smartphone contrast, mild digital noise, realistic crowd reactions, and physically motivated fantasy stage spectacle.

entries.title: Psychological Horror Short Film

entries.prompt:
Cinematic horror short film, 15 seconds, ultra-realistic, seamless continuous story progression, dark and suspenseful atmosphere, professional horror movie cinematography.

0s–2s

The scene opens in a dark upstairs bedroom at night. A man is sleeping peacefully in bed. Soft moonlight enters through the window, creating long shadows across the room. The camera slowly glides from the doorway toward the bed in a smooth cinematic dolly shot. The house is completely silent.

2s–4s

A faint disturbing crawling sound suddenly emerges from somewhere downstairs. The sound resembles wet claws slowly scraping across wooden floors. The sleeping man slightly reacts. The camera slowly pushes closer to his face. The sound grows louder and more unsettling. His eyes abruptly open.

4s–6s

Close-up on his frightened expression. He listens carefully. Another crawling noise echoes from below. He slowly sits upright. The camera circles around him in a slow arc while the sounds continue moving somewhere beneath the bedroom floor.

6s–8s

He cautiously gets out of bed. Tracking shot from behind as he walks toward the bedroom door. The camera follows closely over his shoulder. The hallway outside is dark. The crawling noises continue downstairs, sometimes stopping, then starting again from another location.

8s–11s

He steps into the hallway and slowly approaches the staircase. The camera switches to a low-angle shot in front of him as he descends the stairs carefully. Every step creaks. The sound below becomes clearer and more aggressive. The camera alternates smoothly between:

Over-the-shoulder tracking shots

Side profile shots

Low staircase shots looking upward

Slow handheld movements that increase tension

11s–13s

Reaching the bottom of the stairs, he stops. The camera slowly rotates around him. Horrific sounds suddenly begin coming from different rooms of the house—first the kitchen, then the living room, then directly behind him. Each sound is matched by subtle camera turns and quick pans toward the source, but nothing is visible.

13s–15s

Total silence.

The man stands frozen.

Suddenly a deep demonic laugh erupts from upstairs inside the bedroom he just left.

The camera instantly whips upward toward the staircase. At the top of the stairs, only darkness is visible. The laugh echoes through the house as the camera slowly pushes toward the darkness.

Fade to black.

Visual Style

Realistic horror movie

Psychological dread

Smooth scene-to-scene flow

No visible monster

Dynamic camera work driven by sound direction

Dark blue moonlit color grading

Volumetric lighting

Realistic shadows

Slow tension build-up

Hollywood horror cinematography

Natural character movement

Seamless transitions

entries.title: Neon City Zipline Action
entries.description: A high-action cinematic prompt describing a courier navigating skyscrapers via zipline in a futuristic neon city.
entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 
Night in a futuristic neon city. 

A courier in a sleek helmeted suit escapes between two glass skyscrapers using a real zipline cable. The courier is always physically attached to the zipline: both hands gripping a visible metal handle, the handle connected to a rolling pulley clipped around the cable, body hanging below the cable. No flying, no hovering, no standing on the cable.

Opening close shot: both gloved hands grab the metal zipline handle. The pulley locks onto the cable with sparks. The courier hangs below the line and launches forward.
Wide shot: the courier slides fast along the cable between skyscrapers, body hanging beneath the zipline, legs trailing behind from the speed. 

The city glows far below. Two drones follow behind.
Side tracking shot: the courier continues gripping the handle tightly as the pulley rolls across the cable. Wind pulls at the suit. The cable is clearly visible above the courier in every shot.

Mid-sequence: the zipline cable begins sparking and shaking. The courier still hangs from the handle as the pulley speeds toward a nearby office tower.

Final 5 seconds: the cable snaps near the end. The courier, still holding the handle, swings forward with the broken cable like a pendulum, crashes through a large glass office window, slides across the floor, gets up immediately, and runs toward the rooftop exit as drones enter behind.

Final moment: the courier bursts onto the rooftop, still holding the broken zipline handle, with shattered glass and neon city lights behind.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense, fast but readable, strong height, clear zipline mechanics, visible cable, visible handle, visible pulley, no flying person, no hovering, no standing on cable, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

Solene immediately leaps upward from the platform, kicking dust and stone fragments loose. The city falls away beneath him as the dark gray cloud ceiling above slowly twists into a vortex. Solene steadies himself in the air and raises the bow high toward the sky, clearly aiming at the vortex before release. He draws a glowing starlight arrow while holding the bow in a strong skyward silhouette. Pale blue energy gathers along the string, limbs, and arrowhead. Makes the action intention unmistakable: he is invoking the sky. The leap peaks into a held aiming pose, creating a clean breath before release. 4.8–6.0 Shot 4 — Solene releases. The starlight arrow shoots straight upward into the center of the vortex, carving a luminous path through the cloud mass. Sparkling fractures spread across the clouds like cracks in the sky. This is the trigger event that activates the large-scale technique. Hold the raised-bow pose for a beat, then cut on release and follow the arrow upward. 6.0–7.4 Shot 5 — Street-level among the demon horde. Multiple demons look up as glittering star-like points begin appearing inside the cracked cloud vortex. Their faces are lit by pale blue light as the sky starts to shimmer. Match the arrow’s upward movement to the demons’ eyeline looking skyward. 7.4–8.8 Shot 6 — Tight close-up On Solene, suspended in the air. His luminous blue eyes glow; wind moves through his white curls and coat collar. He lowers the bow slightly and calmly speaks the name of his technique: “Starlight Cataclysm.” Gives the attack a signature identity and creates a final beat before the payoff. Cut from demon fear back to Solene’s calm control. 8.8–12.2 Shot 7 Explosive arrow rain One beat later, the cloud vortex tears open. Millions of luminous arrows begin raining down across the ruin city in massive layered sheets. Every arrow impact causes a massive explosion — huge bursts of starlight, expanding shockwaves, collapsing rooftops, shattered towers, flying rubble, and chained detonations ripping through demon formations and entire streets. Main payoff shot: overwhelming destruction at city scale. The spoken technique name becomes the cue for instant celestial bombardment. 12.2–15.0 Shot 8 Camera pulls far back to an extreme wide. The whole ancient ruin city is engulfed in explosive celestial impacts, demons erased in waves, plazas vanishing under light and debris, towers collapsing under chained detonations. Solene remains high beneath the vortex as a small, calm figure above the devastation. Final scale reveal and strong visual landing. Pull back from local destruction to total battlefield consequence.

He jumps across one final collapsing gap and lands near the exit while firelight and smoke burst outward from the temple interior.  Final moment: the explorer emerges onto a rocky ledge outside the volcano, holding the glowing artifact, while smoke, embers, and fiery light pour from the temple entrance behind him. 

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense and fast-paced, ancient temple atmosphere, volcanic lighting, lava glow, smoke, embers, collapsing stone, dramatic scale, strong sense of danger and motion, fast but readable camera movement, high detail, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion.

【角色】校霸（高大男性，校服外套敞开，神态傲慢）、被霸凌者（瘦弱男性，校服整齐，抱着课本）、复仇者（身穿整齐校服的男性，神情冷静，眼神坚定）

[00:00-00:04] 镜头1：走廊霸凌铺垫（35mm Handheld Push-in）
本段只有推搡和言语威胁，无任何其他肢体冲突。
中景缓慢推进：校霸把被霸凌者逼到储物柜旁，单手推搡他的肩膀，课本散落一地，被霸凌者低头忍耐不敢对视。
轻微手持晃动，配储物柜金属撞击声。
【对白口型指导】校霸（英文，居高临下嘲笑）："Nobody is coming to save you."

[00:04-00:08] 镜头2：第一记耳光（Whip Pan + Low Angle）
画面侧面突然甩入一只手，一记响亮耳光抽在校霸侧脸，快速甩镜（Whip Pan）跟随手的轨迹，清脆声响带走廊回音。
低角度：校霸旋转半圈踉跄倒地，捂着脸撑地爬起，眼眶通红抬头瞪向画面外。
【对白口型指导】校霸（英文，咬牙切齿）："Who the hell did that?"

[00:08-00:11] 镜头3：对峙揭示（Counter Shot）
反打镜头：复仇者立于走廊冷光中，俯视校霸，语气平静。
【对白口型指导】复仇者（英文，低沉冷静）："Someone here to teach you a lesson."
校霸怒吼着从地上弹起，挥拳冲向复仇者。

[00:11-00:15] 镜头4：连环耳光+俯拍终结（Rapid Cuts → Top-down → Smash Cut）
复仇者侧身避开来拳，单手揪住校霸衣领。快速剪辑（Rapid Cuts）：正反手连续扇打校霸的脸，校霸的头随之左右甩动、发丝飞舞。
最后2秒切换机位：摄像机移到两人正上方垂直向下俯拍（Top-down Overhead Shot），画面中校霸瘫坐在地面、脸朝上，复仇者揪着他的衣领。
复仇者另一只手向上高高扬起、靠近镜头（手背朝向镜头），停顿一瞬，随后这只手猛然向下扇落、远离镜头、直奔下方校霸的脸——在巴掌即将接触校霸脸部的瞬间硬切黑屏（Smash Cut to Black）并静音。
巴掌全程扇向地上的校霸，绝不朝向镜头方向挥打。

【音效设计】走廊环境声、耳光声清脆带回音、最后一掌强烈破风声后瞬间静音切黑. 无BGM或仅低沉弦乐铺底。

[Style] Korean school anti-bullying revenge short film (Korean School Revenge Drama), authentic live-action cinematic texture, cold white corridor lighting, cool tones (Teal & Cold Grade), handheld photography, shallow depth of field (Shallow DOF), 9:16 vertical screen, English dialogue. All characters are played by adult actors as high school students, movements are cinematically styled, no gore or harmful outcomes.
[Duration] 15 seconds
[Scene] Modern Korean-style high school corridor, lockers on one side, classroom doors, cold white ceiling lights, floor tile reflections

[00:00-00:04] Scene 1: Corridor bullying setup (35mm Handheld Push-in)
This segment involves only pushing and verbal threats, no other physical conflict.
Medium shot slowly pushing in: The bully corners the victim against the lockers, pushes his shoulder with one hand, textbooks scatter on the floor, the victim lowers his head in endurance, avoiding eye contact.
Slight handheld shake, accompanied by the metallic sound of lockers banging.
[Dialogue/Lip Sync Guide] Bully (English, condescendingly mocking): "Nobody is coming to save you."

[00:04-00:08] Scene 2: The first slap (Whip Pan + Low Angle)
A hand suddenly enters from the side of the frame, a loud slap hits the bully's cheek, quick whip pan following the hand's trajectory, sharp sound with corridor echo.
Low angle: The bully spins half a turn, stumbles to the ground, holding his face as he crawls up, eyes red, looking up off-camera.
[Dialogue/Lip Sync Guide] Bully (English, gritting teeth): "Who the hell did that?"

[00:08-00:11] Scene 3: Confrontation reveal (Counter Shot)
Reverse shot: The avenger stands in the cold corridor light, looking down at the bully, tone calm.
[Dialogue/Lip Sync Guide] Avenger (English, low and calm): "Someone here to teach you a lesson."
The bully roars, leaping up from the ground and punching at the avenger.

[00:11-00:15] Scene 4: Chain slaps + overhead ending (Rapid Cuts → Top-down → Smash Cut)
The avenger dodges the punch and grabs the bully's collar. Rapid cuts: Consecutive slaps to the bully's face, the bully's head whipping left and right, hair flying.
Last 2 seconds camera angle change: Camera moves directly above the two for a vertical top-down overhead shot, showing the bully slumped on the floor, face up, avenger holding his collar.
The avenger's other hand rises high toward the camera (back of hand toward lens), pauses for a split second, then the hand slams down, moving away from the camera toward the bully's face below—smash cut to black and mute the instant the slap is about to touch the face.
The slap is aimed at the bully on the ground throughout, never toward the camera.

[Sound Design] Corridor ambient sound, sharp slaps with echo, intense wind-breaking sound on the last slap followed by instant silence and black. No BGM or only low string music in the background.

entries.title: Coastal Downhill Skateboarding Chase
entries.description: A high-speed 15-second cinematic chase video of a woman skateboarding down a steep coastal hill towards a turquoise ocean, featuring realistic physics and a handheld camera feel.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second realistic cinematic video of a woman skateboarding fast down a steep coastal hill road toward the ocean. Open with a dynamic rear chase angle from slightly above and behind her capturing the dramatic downhill slope and expansive ocean view ahead. The environment is a bright, sunny seaside town with narrow roads, stone walls, utility poles, small houses, rooftops, side streets, and lush green hills leading down to a vivid turquoise-blue coastline with large waves and towering white clouds.
The woman has long black hair, soft natural facial features, warm light-medium skin, and a slim youthful build. Dress her in a stylish casual coastal outfit: an oversized blue shirt, denim pants, white sneakers, and a small slingbag. Her hair and clothing move naturally in the wind as she rides.
She is skateboarding continuously and quickly downhill, carving gently and smoothly with believable balance and natural physics. The motion should feel exciting, free, and grounded in reality.
Add a small number of cars on the road to make the scene feel alive - only a few, not heavy traffic. Include perhaps one car driving farther ahead in her lane, one parked vehicle near the roadside, and one occasional passing or oncoming car at a safe distance. The vehicles should feel natural and integrated into the town, adding realism and motion without becoming the focus. The road should still feel mostly open so the skateboarder remains the clear subject.
Use realistic lighting, natural motion blur, subtle camera shake, and an immersive handheld/chase-camera feel. Keep the entire scene fully photorealistic, not animated or illustrated.
For most of the video, keep the camera behind her as she rides fast downhill with the ocean stretching out in front of her. In the final few seconds, the camera glides from behind to the side and then arcs around to the front, revealing her face clearly while she is still riding. She looks calm, focused, and slightly smiling, enjoying the ride. End on the face reveal while she continues moving downhill.
Audio: no background music. Ambient sound only - skateboard wheels rolling on pavement, wind, distant ocean, and light neighborhood traffic sounds.

entries.description: A complex video prompt for a soccer goal scene, using diagrammatic reference images to control ball trajectory and physical movement.
entries.prompt: Use @image1 side-view trajectory diagram) and @image2 (top-down trajectory diagram) as the exact reference for the ball's flight path. The red line in @Image1 defines the ball's vertical arc — rising sharply after the kick, peaking around the halfway line, then dipping down hard into the left goal (knuckleball dip). The red line in @Image2 defines the ball's horizontal route — traveling diagonally from the kick spot near the halfway line straight toward the goal in the lower-left, curving only slightly at the very end into the corner. The ball is kicked from the point labeled "キック" and ends inside the goal labeled "ゴール". Shot count: 4 | Duration: 10s | Aspect ratio: 16:9 CONTEXT: Fictional FIFA World Cup match, Japan vs Denmark. Packed stadium under bright daylight, green striped pitch. A Japanese national team player — blonde hair, left-footed (southpaw), blue Japan home kit — takes a long-range direct free kick. The ball is struck with no spin (knuckleball), so it flies fast and straight, then suddenly dips and dives into the top corner of the Denmark goal. STYLE: cinematic sports broadcast realism, 4K ultra-high resolution, natural daylight, sharp detail, realistic grass and stadium crowd, smooth slow-motion accents, stable footage, no jitter, no distortion, no deformation, photorealistic players. [0s – 2.5s] SHOT 1 — THE STRIKE. Low-angle medium shot behind the blonde left-footed Japanese player. He plants his right foot and swings his left foot through the ball with a clean, flat no-spin contact. Camera: slow push-in. Crowd noise swells. [2.5s – 5s] SHOT 2 — RISING FLIGHT (side view). Side-on tracking shot following the ball as it rises and climbs over the halfway line, exactly matching the upward arc of the red line in @Image1. The ball wobbles slightly with no rotation. Camera: smooth lateral tracking with the ball. [5s – 7.5s] SHOT 3 — THE DIP (overhead transition). High overhead angle showing the ball cutting diagonally across the pitch toward the lower-left goal, matching the route of the red line in @Image2, then dipping downward. Camera: high aerial following the ball's path. [7.5s – 10s] SHOT 4 — THE GOAL. Behind-the-goal shot. The ball dives into the top corner of the Denmark net, rippling the netting. The goalkeeper dives too late. Camera: slow pull-out as the crowd erupts. Slow-motion on the net ripple. Audio: live stadium ambience, rising crowd roar, sharp ball-strike sound, explosive goal celebration. Avoid: jitter, distortion, blur, deformation, extra players blocking the ball, wrong-footed kick (must be LEFT foot), spinning/curling ball (must be knuckleball, no spin). NO SUBTITLES. NO TEXT ON SCREEN. NO CAPTIONS. NO WATERMARKS.

entries.prompt:
【风格】世界杯电视直播实拍质感（Live Sports Broadcast），真实转播机位、轻微信号扫描线，科幻元素写实化（Photorealistic Robots），8K超清
【时长】15秒
【首帧】以上传图片为第一帧：观众席上穿红色背心的长发女性与周围挥舞红旗的球迷一起欢呼，画面带直播比分条
【场景】2030年世界杯决赛现场，座无虚席的巨型体育场，绿茵球场。中国队全部为银白色金属质感的人形机器人球员（关节处有液压结构、胸前红色队徽），美国队为穿白色球衣 of 普通人类球员

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：观众席开场
延续首帧画面：穿红色背心的女性和身后球迷挥舞红旗呐喊助威，看台一片红色海洋，人群躁动，直播扫描线轻微闪动。现场环境音：山呼海啸的助威声、鼓声。

[00:03-00:10] 镜头2：机器人传切+倒挂金钩（Broadcast Wide → Slow-mo）
切换到标准转播机位俯瞰球场：三名中国机器人球员在禁区前沿快速地面传球，一脚出球传来传去，金属脚掌触球声清脆，美国人类球员上抢扑空。
边路机器人突然挑传到禁区中路，中路机器人腾空跃起，整个金属身体在空中后仰旋转，一记倒挂金钩（Bicycle Kick，切极致慢动作 Super Slow-mo）——皮球直挂死角入网，球网剧烈鼓起。
画面左上角比分条数字跳变为 CHN 2 - 0 USA。
现场解说激动嘶吼（英文）："Unbelievable! A bicycle kick! 2-0 China!"

entries.title: Cargo Plane Action Sequence
entries.description: A high-altitude action scene featuring secret agents battling on the wing of a military cargo plane at sunset.
entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9. 

A large military cargo plane is flying high above the clouds at sunset. The rear cargo ramp is open, violent wind tears through the aircraft, and two fighters are battling on the wing of the plane. One is a skilled secret agent in a dark tactical suit, the other is a dangerous enemy operative in black combat gear. The metal wing vibrates, engines roar, clouds rush past below, and loose cargo inside the aircraft is being pulled toward the open ramp.  

Camera angle 1: wide exterior shot, the cargo plane cuts through the sky above the clouds, the rear ramp is open, and the two fighters struggle on the wing near the engine while wind rips at their clothing.  

Camera angle 2: close dynamic shot on the wing, the secret agent and enemy operative exchange fast punches and kicks while trying to keep balance on the vibrating metal surface. Their hands grip the edge of the wing, boots slide, and the wind is powerful and dangerous.  

Camera angle 3: dramatic side shot, the enemy almost throws the agent off the wing. The agent slips, hangs from the edge with one hand, then pulls himself back up and counterattacks. Inside the plane, cargo crates break loose and slide toward the open rear ramp.  

Final action beat: the agent defeats the enemy with one hard strike, then sprints across the wing and leaps through the open rear cargo ramp back into the aircraft just as the enemy loses balance and falls away into the clouds.  Final moment: inside the cargo plane, the agent lands hard and rolls across the metal floor as loose cargo slides past, the open ramp behind him framing the sky. 

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense action, realistic wind force, dramatic sky, strong sense of altitude and danger, fast but readable camera movement, detailed aircraft surface, rushing clouds, no text, no logos, no cartoon style, no slow motion, no extra main characters. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio

entries.prompt: 画像1= 絵コンテの参照。 添付された絵コンテ画像{{Image 1}}をもとに、15秒・横型16:9の、超高品質なフォトリアリスティック映像を作成してください。テーマ「現実の都市にある標識や信号の中の記号たちが、誰も見ていない間に自由気ままに遊んでいる世界」映像の基本コンセプト舞台は実在感の強い都市の交差点・道路空間。 全体の見た目は、映画のワンシーンのように美しく、シネマティックで、空気感のあるフォトリアル映像。 ただし非現実なのは、標識や信号機や道路表示の“中に描かれている記号・人物・数字・矢印・自転車マークなど”だけであり、それらが生きているかのように自由に、楽しく、ダイナミックに動く。重要なのは、周囲に派手なVFXを足して盛ることではない。 面白さの中心は、標識の中の表記そのものが動くことにある。 光の軌跡、粒子、オーラ、魔法のような演出は最小限に抑え、必要ならごく控えめな残像やブラー程度に留める。 “中の記号が何をしているか”が一目で分かることを最優先する。世界観・見せ方のルール標識本体・信号機本体・街並み・道路・電柱・建物・人物は現実的に存在する。 動くのは主に、標識や信号の中の絵柄・ピクトグラム・数字・矢印・記号。 それらは標識の枠内で動くことを基本としつつ、 一部のカットでは少しだけ枠をはみ出す、飛び出しかける、外へ身を乗り出す、また枠内へ戻るような遊びがあってよい。 動きはコミカルで可愛らしいが、幼稚すぎない。 どこか「本当にこうなっていそう」と思える絶妙なリアリティを保つ。エフェクト主体にしない。 面白さは、走る、踊る、跳ねる、増える、並ぶ、譲り合う、急ぐ、戸惑う、振り向く、伸びる、縮む、回るといった“記号そのものの演技”から作る。 人物がこちらに背を向けて歩いている、あるいは交差点を見つめている。 一見すると普通の街だが、よく見ると信号の緑の人型が通常の歩行ではなく、少し楽しげにステップしている。 観客に「ん？今ちょっと動いた？」と思わせる導入。2〜5秒信号や標識のクローズアップをテンポよくつなぐ。青信号の人型が歩く→走る→軽く跳ねる→仲間が増えて横並びで進む赤信号の人型が仁王立ち→腰に手を当てる→踊る→腕を振るカウントダウン数字が、ただ減るだけでなく、数字自体が揺れる、跳ねる、急ぐように前のめりになる矢印標識が、矢印の先端や線そのものをぐにゃりと変形させながら進行方向を示す それぞれの動きがひと目で分かるように大きく、明確に見えること。5〜8秒標識の種類を増やし、街全体の賑わいを見せる。 横長の歩行者信号の中で、複数の人型が行進、追い抜き、隊列を組む自転車マークがペダルをこぐように動く通行止め・進入禁止系の丸標識の白帯や内部記号が、むっとした顔のような雰囲気を出したり、少し横にずれたり戻ったりする工事・注意・学校付近などの標識に描かれた人物やシルエットが、慌てたり駆けたり、ちょっと会話しているように見える電光掲示板の矢印が連続して流れ、波のようにつながる ここでは**“標識の数が多く、あちこちで違う動きが起きている”密度感**を重視する。8〜12秒動きがさらにダイナミックになるセクション。 青信号の人型が標識の枠ギリギリまで走っていき、少しだけフレーム外へ身を乗り出して戻る 赤信号の人型が**「待て待て」と言わんばかりに踊りながら制止する** 矢印マーク同士が互いに向きを主張し合い、くるっと回って整列する カカウントダウン表示が残り秒数に合わせて焦るように縮んだり弾んだりする 道路の両側、奥の信号、頭上の案内板など遠景にも複数の標識が同時に動いている このパートは、エフェクトではなく“演技と編集”でテンションを上げる。12〜15秒ラストはやや引きの画で、街中の多くの標識が同時に生きていることを見せる。 交差点の中景〜広角ショット。 多数の信号・矢印標識・案内板・注意標識・自転車標識などが画面内に存在し、それぞれの中の記号たちが自由に動いている。 しかし街の雰囲気自体は美しく、映画的で、どこか静かな余韻がある。 最後は、通行人は気づいていないまま歩き去り、標識の中だけで小さな祝祭が続いているような印象で締める。スタイル超高品質フォトリアリスティックシネマティック美しい実写映画風自然光を活かした空気感レンズ感のある映像実在の都市空間の質感都市の標識・信号・案内板のディテールをリアルに再現可愛さはあるが子供向けすぎず、映画的な品を保つカメラ スタートは広めの導入ショット その後、寄りカット、標識のクローズアップ、中景、奥行きのある街並みショットをテンポよく切り替える 軽いドリー、パン、ティルト、前進、横移動を使って、静止画のスライドショーにならないようにする 標識の中の動きが分かるよう、寄るときはしっかり寄る ラストは標識が多数存在する都市空間を俯瞰気味または広角気味に見せる構図が望ましい編集 15秒の中でテンポ良く切り替える ただし速すぎて何が動いているか分からなくならないようにする1カットごとに“何がどう遊んでいるのか”が明確に伝わる長さを確保する リズム感はあるが、MV的な過剰フラッシュ編集ではなく、映画のモンタージュ的な上質さを保つ動きの方向性（最重要）標識の中の記号や人物や数字や矢印は、以下のように自由気ままに演技してください。 歩く 走る スキップする 跳ねる 並ぶ 増える 減る 踊る 手を振る 慌てる 怒る 誇らしげに立つ 追い抜く 枠から少しだけはみ出す また戻る 他の標識の中の記号と呼応する 同じ標識内で複数体に分身する 数字が弾む、傾く、急ぐ、縮む、伸びる 矢印がうねる、曲がる、方向を主張する 自転車マークがペダルをこぐ 注意標識の人物が駆ける、止まる、振り返るすべての動きは、“標識そのものが喋る”のではなく、“中の記号が生きている”という見せ方で統一する。色・光 朝、昼、夕方、夜いずれでも成立するが、美しい自然光または映画的な都市照明を重視 コントラストは上品に 色は現実的に 信号の緑・赤・標識の青・黄・赤などは鮮明に見せる ただし発光しすぎてCGっぽくならないように注意重要な禁止事項派手なVFXを主役にしない 魔法の光、粒子、爆発、オーラ、過剰な発光でごまかさない 標識全体が完全に人格化して歩き回るのは禁止 標識本体が大量に宙に浮く、街全体がファンタジー化するのは禁止 ただのスライドショーは禁止 文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れない 子供向けアニメ調に寄せすぎず、あくまで実写映画級の美しさを維持する
entries.translated_prompt: Image 1 = Storyboard reference. Based on the attached storyboard image {{Image 1}}, create a high-quality 15-second, 16:9 landscape photorealistic video. Theme: 'A world where symbols inside road signs and signals in a real city play freely when no one is looking.' Basic Concept: The stage is a highly realistic urban intersection and road space. The overall look is a beautiful, cinematic, atmospheric photorealistic film scene. However, the surreal element is that only the 'symbols, people, numbers, arrows, bicycle marks, etc.' drawn inside the signs, traffic lights, and road markings move freely, happily, and dynamically as if they were alive. The key is not to add flashy VFX around them. The focus of interest is the movement of the markings within the signs themselves. Minimize traces of light, particles, auras, or magical effects; if necessary, limit them to subtle afterimages or blurs. Priority is given to making what the symbols inside are doing immediately clear. Rules for Worldview/Presentation: Sign bodies, traffic light bodies, cityscapes, roads, utility poles, buildings, and people exist realistically. Primarily, the designs, pictograms, numbers, arrows, and symbols inside the signs and signals move. They should basically move within the sign's frame, but in some cuts, they can slightly protrude, almost jump out, lean out, or play by returning inside the frame. Movements are comical and cute but not too childish. Maintain an exquisite reality where one might think 'this could really be happening.' Do not rely on effects. Interest should come from the 'acting of the symbols themselves'—running, dancing, jumping, multiplying, lining up, yielding, rushing, being puzzled, looking back, stretching, shrinking, turning. Feature many signs, signals, and guide displays in the urban space, and show different movements happening in various parts of the screen to give the feeling that the entire city is secretly alive. Video Flow: Based on the storyboard panel order, follow this flow: 0-2s: A beautiful establishing shot of a city intersection or road. Could be evening/magic hour or a clear morning/afternoon. A person is walking away or looking at the intersection. It looks like an ordinary street at first, but upon closer look, the green pedestrian figure in the signal is not walking normally but stepping happily. An introduction to make the audience think, 'Wait, did it just move?' 2-5s: Quick close-ups of signals and signs. The green signal figure walks -> runs -> jumps lightly -> more companions appear and move in line. Red signal figure stands tall -> hands on hips -> dances -> waves arms. Countdown numbers don't just decrease but shake, jump, and lean forward as if in a hurry. Arrow signs deform their tips or lines to show the direction of travel. Each movement must be large and clearly visible at a glance. 5-8s: Increase the variety of signs and show the bustle of the whole city. In a wide pedestrian signal, multiple figures march, overtake, and form ranks. Bicycle marks move as if pedaling. Round signs for 'No Entry' or 'Road Closed' have their white bands or internal symbols showing a grumpy face or shifting slightly. Signs for construction, caution, or school zones feature people or silhouettes looking panicked, running, or having a short conversation. Arrows on electronic boards flow continuously, connecting like waves. Emphasize the density here—'many signs are present, with different movements happening everywhere.' 8-12s: Section with more dynamic movement. The green signal figure runs to the edge of the sign frame, leans slightly out, then returns. The red figure dances while signaling 'Wait, wait!' Arrow marks compete for direction, then spin and line up. Countdown displays shrink or bounce according to the remaining seconds. Signs in the distance, overhead boards, etc., all move simultaneously. This part raises tension through 'acting and editing' rather than effects. 12-15s: Final wide shot showing many signs throughout the city alive at once. Mid-to-wide angle of the intersection. Numerous signals, arrow signs, guide boards, caution signs, and bicycle signs exist in the frame, with their symbols moving freely. However, the city atmosphere itself is beautiful, cinematic, and leaves a quiet resonance. Finally, pedestrians walk away without noticing, leaving an impression of a small celebration continuing only within the signs. Style: Ultra-high quality photorealistic cinematic; beautiful live-action film style; atmospheric use of natural light; cinematic lens feel; texture of real urban space; detailed reproduction of city signs, signals, and guide boards. Cute but not too childish, maintaining cinematic quality. Camera: Start with a wide intro shot, followed by close-ups of signs, mid-range shots, and deep cityscapes. Use light dolly, pan, tilt, forward movement, and lateral movement to avoid a static slideshow. Zoom in enough to see the movements inside the signs. Ideally, the final shot should be a slightly high or wide-angle view of the urban space with many signs. Editing: Tempo is brisk within 15 seconds, but ensure movements are clear. Maintain length for each cut to convey 'what is playing and how.' Rhythmic but maintains high-quality film montage style, not excessive flashy MV editing. Movement Direction (Most Important): Symbols, people, numbers, and arrows inside signs should act freely as follows: walking, running, skipping, jumping, lining up, increasing, decreasing, dancing, waving, panicking, getting angry, standing proudly, overtaking, protruding slightly from the frame and returning, responding to symbols in other signs, splitting into multiple bodies within the same sign, numbers bouncing/leaning/hurrying/shrinking/stretching, arrows undulating/curving/asserting direction, bicycle marks pedaling, caution sign figures running/stopping/looking back. All movements should be unified by showing the 'symbols inside are alive,' not the 'sign itself talking.' Color/Light: Can be morning, day, evening, or night, but prioritize beautiful natural light or cinematic urban lighting. Elegant contrast and realistic colors. Green/red signals and blue/yellow/red signs should be vivid but avoid looking too CG-like. Prohibited: No flashy VFX; do not hide behind magical light, particles, explosions, or excessive glow. Signs as a whole are not allowed to be personified or walk around. No large-scale floating signs or city-wide fantasy transformations. No simple slideshows. No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. Do not lean too far into children's animation; maintain live-action film-level beauty.

entries.title: Hair Salon Transformation Ad Prompt
entries.description: A cinematic beauty commercial prompt showing a realistic transformation from wavy to straight hair in a luxury salon setting.
entries.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as the exact character reference. Maintain the same face, eyes, skin tone, hair color, and identity throughout the entire video.

15-second cinematic salon transformation video.

Scene 1 (0-3s):
Close-up of the beautiful young woman with long wavy dark brown hair. She looks at the camera and smiles softly. Luxury salon background, warm lighting, shallow depth of field. Slow camera push-in.

Scene 2 (3-8s):
A professional hairstylist begins straightening her hair with a silver flat iron. Steam gently rises from the straightener. The camera follows the flat iron moving smoothly through the hair. Detailed hair strands transform from soft waves into sleek straight hair. Cinematic slow motion.

Scene 3 (8-12s):
Multiple beauty shots from different angles. The hair flows naturally as more sections become perfectly straight, silky, and glossy. Dramatic lighting reflections on the hair. Premium luxury salon atmosphere.

Scene 4 (12-15s):
Final reveal. The woman stands in front of a large illuminated mirror, touching her ultra-smooth glass-like straight hair. She smiles confidently and admires the transformation. Hair shines beautifully under salon lights. Camera slowly rotates around her and ends with a stunning close-up.

Pixar-quality 3D animation, realistic hair physics, smooth motion, beauty commercial style, luxury salon, cinematic camera movement, ultra detailed, glossy hair reflections, professional advertisement quality, 9:16 vertical video, high realism, masterpiece, 8K.

Negative Prompt:
low quality, blurry, face distortion, changing face, identity change, extra fingers, bad hands, flickering, duplicate person, deformed hair, ugly face, text, watermark, logo, cropped face, unstable animation.

entries.title: Industrial Corridor Fugitive Chase
entries.description: An intense chase sequence prompt involving a fugitive running from a drone swarm in an industrial corridor with collapsing structures and dynamic camera work.
entries.prompt: A fugitive sprints through a dense industrial corridor as a massive drone swarm floods the space behind. Harsh artificial lighting, flashing signals. Environment is unstable: tight geometry, moving machinery, sparks, collapsing structures. Action is immediate. The fugitive runs at full speed while the swarm surges like a fluid, filling space. Continuous seamless camera. Start wide in the corridor, then dive toward the runner. Lock into tight chase. Whip through turns, rise overhead to reveal swarm, drop low through tight gaps. Mid-sequence, the corridor collapses inward. The floor gives way. The fugitive drops into a lower level. Camera pulls wide to show collapse, then dives down with the fall, locking back into pursuit. End wide: narrowing path ahead, swarm consuming everything behind.

entries.title: Cinematic Macro Latte Art Formation
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for creating a macro video of latte art being poured, where specific patterns or text gradually emerge on the surface of the espresso crema.
entries.prompt:
真上から見たマクロ撮影。白い陶器のカップに注がれたエスプレッソラテの表面を映す。美しいキャラメル色のクレマの上に、バリスタがステンレス製ミルクピッチャーから滑らかなスチームミルクをゆっくりと注ぎ始める。

ミルクが広がるにつれて、白いフォームの模様が少しずつ現れる。最終形の参照画像の文字が徐々に完成していく。

ミルクの流れやピッチャーの繊細な動きがはっきり見える。ラテアートは段階的に形作られ、完成に近づくにつれて細部が洗練されていく。フォームの質感はなめらかで繊細。温かみのあるカフェの照明。リアルなコーヒーの質感。浅い被写界深度。高級カフェのプロモーション映像のような美しい映像表現。

最終的に、参照画像の文字ラテアートと完全に一致するデザインが完成する。超高精細、フォトリアル、4K、シネマティック、スムーズな動き。

注ぎ始めから完成までをワンカットで撮影。ミルクがクレマの上に広がる様子が気持ちよく見える。フォームの境界は鮮明で、ラテアートが自然に出現するように形成される。完成直前には細かな修正が加えられ、文字ラテアートのディテールが際立つ。

ネガティブプロンプト
崩れたラテアート、不自然な模様、ロゴ、透かし、ミルクの飛び散り、カメラブレ、低解像度、ぼやけ、過度な装飾、不自然な色合い、未完成のラテアート、奇形、非対称なデザイン。

【时长】15秒
【场景】以@图片1画面为起点的足球场直播信号：看台蓝色球衣球迷海洋，场内草坪顶光鲜绿

[00:03-00:08] 镜头2：切场上攻防（Hard Cut → Broadcast Wide + Tracking）

entries.prompt:
A tall faceless figure stands motionless beneath a flickering roadside motel sign at night. The motel is old and nearly empty, with cracked asphalt, rain puddles, buzzing neon, and a few dim room windows in the background. The figure wears a long dark coat, head slightly lowered, face completely hidden in shadow with no visible features.

Camera starts in a wide establishing shot across the wet parking lot, framing the figure as a black silhouette under the unstable neon sign. As the camera reaches a medium shot, the figure tilts its head slightly toward the camera without stepping forward. A motel room curtain shifts in the background. The sign cuts out for one second, leaving only darkness and rain sound, then flashes back on with the figure now standing a few feet closer.

entries.title: Introspective Surreal Art Film
entries.description: A detailed storyboard and prompt for a surreal art film exploring identity through reflections in a glass-filled studio.
entries.prompt:
Task: Create a 15 second cinematic realistic surreal introspective art film video titled Photosensitive Self. One central woman moves through a minimal dark reflective studio with glass, mirrors, soft directional light, shadows, subtle haze, and abstract reflective textures. The film is silent except for breath, glass resonance, low ambient drone, and one whispered inner voiceover near the end.

Story flow:
0:00–0:01.2 Extreme close up of her eye reflected through fractured/layered glass. Low drone begins. Static, intimate, mysterious.
0:01.2–0:02.5 Close up of fingertips grazing fogged glass. Subtle glass scrape and breath condensation.
0:02.5–0:03.7 Side profile close up. A narrow beam of light reveals half her face, half in shadow. Slow dolly-in.
0:03.7–0:04.9 Reflection split frame. Her real face is still while the reflection feels slightly delayed, suggesting fragmented identity.
0:04.9–0:06.1 Detail shot of her hand and lips near glass. Breath blooms on the reflective surface.
0:06.1–0:07.3 Wider abstract studio view. She stands among reflective planes, small and vulnerable. Slow dolly back.
0:07.3–0:08.5 Over the shoulder shot into mirror. Multiple reflections appear, each slightly offset.
0:08.5–0:09.7 Extreme close up of her eye, moisture catching a thin light streak. Nearly silent except heartbeat-like low pulse.
0:09.7–0:10.9 Abstract reflection fragments multiply her face across glass panels. Slow lateral camera slide.
0:10.9–0:12.1 Medium shot. She tilts her face upward into a soft overhead light, accepting the exposure.
0:12.1–0:13.3 Close up. She reaches toward her reflection, fingertips almost touching its fingertips. Slow push-in.
0:13.3–0:15.0 Final close up. Her real face and reflection align perfectly. Hold stillness. Whispered voiceover: “I was never one face… only light learning where to stay.”

Camera: Use controlled luxury editorial camera movement: static close ups, slow dolly in, slow lateral slide, over the shoulder reflection framing, one slow dolly back wide shot, and final locked close up. No fast cuts, no handheld shake.

Visual style: Cinematic realistic, abstract reflective luxury editorial, dark silver black palette, deep blue gray shadows, soft warm skin highlights, high contrast, natural skin texture, reflective glass, subtle haze, minimal set design, poetic vulnerability.

entries.prompt:
参照画像の少年の外見、服装、スケートボードを維持すること。キッチンのレイアウトは変更してもよい。主人公はマグカップほどの身長のミニチュアサイズ。アニメ映画のような高品質な映像表現。
明るく清潔なキッチン。ミニサイズの少年がスケートボードの上でスタート姿勢を取る。

0～3秒、少年は前方を見据えながら勢いよく地面を蹴り、キッチンカウンターの上を加速し始める。カメラは低い位置から追従し、少年と巨大なキッチン用品とのサイズ差を強調する。

3～7秒、少年は高速でカウンター上を滑走する。巨大なマグカップやボウル、調理器具の間を軽快にすり抜ける。スケートボードの車輪は自然に回転し、身体はバランスを取りながら滑らかに動く。暖かな朝日が窓から差し込み、キッチン全体を明るく照らしている。

7～11秒、まな板を利用して小さくジャンプ。空中でボードを軽く傾けながら飛び越え、スムーズに着地する。カメラは少年の横を並走し、その後やや広角になって巨大なキッチン空間を映し出す。スピード感と冒険感を強調する。

11～15秒、少年はさらに加速しながらキッチンの奥へ向かう。巨大な食器や調理器具が次々と現れ、これから続く冒険を予感させる。最後は後方からの追従ショットで、少年が画面奥へ走り去っていく。ワクワク感のある余韻を残して終了。

映像スタイル

・映画的ライティング
・ダイナミックなカメラワーク
・ローアングル主体
・スケール差を強調

・冒険アニメ風
・鮮やかな色彩

・一貫したキャラクターデザイン
・ネガティブプロンプト

文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、UI、矢印、説明書き、吹き出し、画面分割、キャラクターの変形、余分な手足、フリッカー、不自然なカメラワープ、極端なモーションブラー、ホラー表現、暗い雰囲気、物理法則を無視した動き、キャラクターのサイズ変化。

entries.prompt:

Black background. Thin white divider in center. Semi-transparent "Omegla dot com" watermark bottom-left. Faint text at top: "You're now chatting with a stranger."
LEFT PANEL:
South Asian male @ img , mid-20s, plain dark hoodie, realistic webcam quality, warm desk lamp lighting, clean room background. Natural skin texture, visible pores, no beauty filter, slightly off-center framing.
RIGHT PANEL:
Japanese female @2WfwPnB8Z80h2z8kSc4s , early 20s, casual bedroom background, low-bitrate phone camera quality, slight handheld shake, soft overexposed window light, mild compression artifacts.
TIMELINE
0-3s
Connection established.
Both casually wave.
Male:
"Hey."
Female:
"Hi."
3-7s
Male:
"Where are you from?"
He stops speaking and waits.
Female:
"I'm from Japan."
Male gives a small nod.
Male:
"Oh nice, Japan."
7-10s
Natural silence.
Both maintain eye contact.
No one speaks.
10-14s
Male:
"Okay... say anything random."
He finishes speaking completely and waits.
Female thinks briefly.
Female:
"Golf ball."
She stops speaking.
14-18s
Natural pause.
Male remains completely calm.
His right hand is already a closed fist resting near his chest.
He slowly raises the closed fist toward the webcam.
No object visible.
18-21s
Male slowly opens his fist.
A real white golf ball is revealed resting in his palm.
No visual effects.
No glow.
No transformation effect.
21-24s
Male casually tosses the golf ball a few inches upward.
Realistic physics.
Clean catch.
He turns his palm toward the camera.
Male:
"This is what you said."
Small smirk.
24-28s
Female freezes for about one second.
Slight call lag.
Then she leans forward instinctively.
Autofocus briefly shifts.
Female:
"How is that possible?"
Eyes widen.
Jaw drops slightly.
One hand rises toward her face.
Reaction feels genuine and unscripted.
28-30s
Hold on her shocked expression.
Hard cut.
STYLE
Authentic Omegle screen recording.
Webcam compression artifacts.
Ambient room noise only.
No music.
Natural conversational pacing.
1-2 frame video-call delay during reaction.
Realistic body language.
Grounded emotions.

"say anything random"
"SHE SAID GOLF BALL 💀"
"HOW IS THAT POSSIBLE 😭"
NEGATIVE PROMPT
No AI skin.
No plastic faces.
No VFX.
No glowing golf ball.
No object visible before fist opens.
No extra fingers.
No warped hands.
No beauty filters.
No cinematic grading.
No overacting.
No screaming.
No dramatic reaction.
No studio lighting.
No rushed pacing.

entries.prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, 15 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9. A glass elevator is falling down the outside of a modern skyscraper at night, surrounded by rain, city lights, reflections, sparks, and broken metal cables. A skilled spy with gray hair and beard in a dark tactical suit is trapped inside as the elevator drops fast along the building exterior.

Camera angle 1: wide exterior shot of the skyscraper, the glass elevator suddenly breaks loose and begins falling down the side of the building, lights flickering inside, emergency sparks flying from the elevator rails.

Camera angle 2: interior close shot, the spy is thrown against the glass wall as the elevator drops. He grabs the handrail, kicks open the emergency ceiling hatch, and climbs upward while loose objects float and slam around him from the falling motion.

Camera angle 3: dramatic exterior tracking shot, the spy pulls himself onto the roof of the falling elevator. Rain hits hard, wind is violent, broken cables whip around him, sparks burst from the rails as the city blurs below.

The spy jumps from the falling elevator onto a passing maintenance platform attached to the skyscraper. He barely catches the edge with one hand, swings hard, pulls himself up, then rolls onto the platform just as the glass elevator crashes far below in a huge burst of glass, sparks, and smoke.

Final moment: the spy stands on the shaking maintenance platform, breathing hard, rain pouring over him, the destroyed elevator burning far below, city lights glowing behind him.

Style: hyper-realistic, cinematic, intense vertical action, realistic physics, rain, glass reflections, sparks, smoke, dramatic lighting, fast but readable camera movement, high detail, no text, no logos, no slow motion, no cartoon style, no extra main characters. Keep proportions. Keep style and features. Aspect ratio 16:9.

参照画像あり。1:1、15秒のシネマティックな音同期ダンス映像。舞台は白い大理石のクラシック美術館中央ホール。高いアーチ天井、白い柱、彫刻、額縁、反射する床を持つヨーロッパ風の美術館空間を全編で維持する。主役は参照画像の女性1人のみ。女性は彫刻ではなく実在の人物。重低音とクラシック音楽に反応して、美術館空間に大理石の波紋、白い石粉、大理石の破片、金色の粒子が現れる。高級感、静けさ、神秘性、ドラマ性を重視。ループ必須ではない。

[OPTIONAL PERFORMER LOOK]
参照画像の女性を唯一の主役として使う。顔立ち、髪型、髪色、目の印象、年齢感、体型、衣装の印象、全体の雰囲気を維持し、別人化させない。大理石彫刻にはしない。衣装は動きに合わせて自然になびいてよいが、元の印象は保つ。

[SHOT / FLOW]
0:00-0:03
女性が白い美術館中央に静かに立つ。カメラはゆっくりプッシュイン。静寂と緊張感を作る。

0:03-0:06
重低音で覚醒。床の大理石に波紋が広がり、彫刻や額縁がわずかに震え、白い石粉と金色の粒子が浮かぶ。女性がゆっくり動き始める。

0:06-0:11
女性が音に同期して優雅で力強いダンスを行う。足技よりも、腕、上半身、ターン、衣装の流れを中心に見せる。大理石の破片と金色の粒子がビートに合わせて舞う。舞台は美術館のまま維持。

0:11-0:15
クライマックス。床の波紋、金色の粒子、大理石の破片が広がる。女性は参照画像の印象を保ったまま、力強く美しい決めポーズで締める。

[CAMERA / EDITING]
冒頭はゆっくりしたプッシュイン。中盤以降は、なめらかな回り込み、ややローアングル、手元・顔・衣装・床反射を活かす寄りカットを使う。静→覚醒→高揚→頂点の流れを明確にする。過度な手ブレや雑な高速カットは避ける。

[SOUND]
重低音＋クラシックの気配。大理石の波紋、石粉、破片、粒子の動きは音に強く同期。冒頭は静かな美術館の残響。石の震え、ひびき、破片が弾けるような効果音を重視。セリフ不要。

[NEGATIVE]
別人化しない。女性を完全な大理石彫刻にしない。舞台を美術館以外に変えない。文字、ロゴ、ウォーターマーク、字幕、群衆を入れない。コミカルにしない。無秩序な破壊にしない。過剰なブラーや手ブレを避ける。高級感と神秘性を壊さない。

entries.description: A cinematic sequence of a mountaineer transforming into a golden eagle atop a sunrise cliff, attributed to Runway ML.
entries.prompt:

A lone mountaineer stands at the edge of a towering cliff above a sea of clouds. Golden sunlight slowly illuminates the mountains while powerful winds sweep across the summit.

The atmosphere is realistic, majestic, and grounded.

The camera slowly circles around the figure as subtle physical changes begin. The person's vision sharpens. Eyes gradually shift to intense golden eagle eyes. Tiny feather structures emerge along the forearms and neck.

Wind currents become increasingly visible around the body. Clothing flutters violently while the transformation accelerates.

The camera moves closer as bones and muscles begin restructuring. Arms lengthen. Shoulders broaden dramatically. Feather growth spreads across the arms, back, and chest.

Thousands of detailed golden-brown feathers emerge naturally through the transformation. Every feather reacts realistically to the wind. The body becomes lighter, more aerodynamic, and increasingly avian.

The spine shifts. The arms transform into immense wing structures while retaining believable anatomy throughout the metamorphosis. Powerful talons emerge gradually from the feet.

The camera follows closely as the newly formed wings unfold for the first time. Massive feathered wings catch the sunrise light, revealing intricate textures and realistic motion.

The transformed golden eagle steps toward the cliff edge. Wind rushes upward from the valley below. Feathers ripple naturally in the mountain air.

Final cinematic moment: the giant golden eagle launches from the cliff. The camera follows in a breathtaking aerial shot as it glides above the clouds, wings fully extended, illuminated by the rising sun. The eagle disappears into the golden sky while mountain peaks emerge through the clouds beneath it.

entries.title: Tokyo Urban Ink Splash Montage
entries.description: A high-energy video prompt for Seedance 2.0 that merges cinematic Tokyo cityscapes with dynamic, physical ink and paint effects that interact with the environment.
entries.prompt:
添付された絵コンテ画像をもとに、15秒、横型16:9の高品質な動画を作成してください。

テーマ

実写映像とエフェクトの共存

全体コンセプト

東京の実写都市風景の中に、カラフルなインク、ペイント、スプラス、飛沫、垂れ、塗膜、着弾跡、にじみ、粉状の飛散、スタンプのような塗りの痕跡が現れ、街そのものが反応しているように見える映像にしてください。
単なる上乗せのエフェクトではなく、道路、標識、壁、電柱、空、川面、電車、歩道、ガードレール、建物の表面にペイントが実在するように密着し、実写空間と自然に一体化していることが重要です。

流れ

絵コンテのパネル順に沿って、テンポの速い颯爽としたモンタージュ映像として動画化してください。

映像の流れは以下のようにしてください。

東京の都市全景 / スカイツリーの見える街並み
実写の東京の街並みからスタート。街の空気を切り裂くように、鮮やかなインク飛沫やペイントスプラッシュが画面内に炸裂する。
ペイントは空中に浮くのではなく、建物や道路のパースに沿って着弾し、街に色が走る。
俯瞰のスクランブル交差点
人の流れと交差点の幾何学に合わせて、ペイントが四方に弾ける。
横断歩道の白線や道路面にペイントが広がり、跳ね、飛び散る。
群衆の流れとエフェクトの広がりがシンクロする。
歩行者信号の超接写
信号の発光と同時に、周辺にインク粒子や塗料の飛沫が爆発する。
金属フレームや支柱にペイントが付着し、雫が垂れる。
実写の立体感を保ったまま、グラフィカルな勢いを加える。
電柱と電線のローアングル
青空に向かって伸びる電柱と電線に沿って、色のついた塗料やインクが弧を描く。
ただしリボン状ではなく、飛沫、しぶき、引き裂かれた塗膜、スプレーの軌跡のような表現を使う。
鳥居のカット
鳥居の柱や足元、周囲の地面に大胆なペイントが着弾し、神聖な静けさの中に都会的で攻めたグラフィックが入り込む。
色の衝突感を強く見せる。
川沿い / 運河 / 水辺の東京風景
水辺の反射と連動して、ペイントが地面や欄干、空気中に散る。
水面にも色の気配が映り込み、実写ならではの反射を活かす。
都市の大通り / ビル群 / 繁華街
街のエネルギーが頂点に向かうように、複数色のペイント爆発を重ねる。
ただし視認性は保ち、画面が潰れないように整理する。
実写の街並みのディテールと、塗料の激しさが同時に見えるようにする。
路地裏 / 自販機のある細道
濃密な東京の路地空間の中で、壁や自販機にインクが飛び散り、垂れ、染み込む。
狭い空間ならではの圧縮感と、ペイントの密度を見せる。
電車 / 踏切 / 線路のカット
電車の通過に合わせて、塗料の爆発や飛沫が風圧で煽られる。
踏切の警告灯、車体、鉄骨、架線にインクやペイントが絡むように見せる。
海辺 / 水辺の遊歩道
東京の開けた景色の中で、風に散る微粒子と大きなペイント飛沫を組み合わせる。
狭い街中から開放感のある画へ抜けることで、映像の呼吸をつくる。
池や公園の静かな風景
一瞬だけ密度を落とし、静かな実写風景の中に少量の色の漂いを残す。
ここでは動きすぎず、余白を活かす。
夕景 / 水辺の都市シルエットで締め
夕日の反射とともに、最後に大きなインクスプラッシュやペイントの爆発が空へ広がる。
映像のラストとして、開放感と余影のある締めにする。
スタイル
実写ベースの東京風景
2.5次元的な見え方
実写の中にグラフィックなペイントエフェクトが実在しているような表現
高品質、シネマティック、スタイリッシュ、躍動感が強い
カラーはシアン、マゼンタ、イエロー、オレンジ、ピンク、ブルー、ブラック、ホワイトなどを中心に、鮮やかでパンチの強い配色
ただし単なる派手さだけでなく、実写の空間認識、奥行き、パース、光の整合性を保つ
街を彩るエフェクトは、塗料、インク、飛沫、スプレー、しぶき、垂れ、塗り跡、粒子、着弾、爆ぜるようなビジュアルを中心にする
リボン状の流線、花びら主体の演出、ふわふわした可愛い表現は避ける
都市のエネルギーとグラフィックの衝突を重視する
編集
リズム感のある高速カット
寄りカット
超接写
ローアングル
俯瞰ショット
素早いパン
気持ちのいいマッチカット
実写の動きとペイントの炸裂タイミングを同期させる
カット切り替え時に、ペイントの飛沫・塗膜の広がり・色の衝突を使って次のカットへつなぐ
一部カットではスピード感のあるモーションブラーを使い、勢いを強調する
緩急を作り、全編ずっと同じ密度にしないこと
重要
静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。
すべてのカットの中で、カメラも実写空間もエフェクトも確実に動いている映像にしてください。
エフェクトは画面の手前に貼っただけに見せず、実写世界の中で発生しているようにしてください。
インクやペイントは、表面に付着する、跳ね返る、垂れる、飛散する、にじむ、といった物理感を持たせてください。
文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないでください。
ゲーム風UI、説明テロップ、コミック吹き出しなどは不要です。
全体を通して、東京のリアルな街の魅力と、グラフィックなペイント表現の強さが共存する映像にしてください。
entries.translated_prompt:
Create a high-quality 15-second horizontal 16:9 video based on the attached storyboard image. 
Theme: Coexistence of live-action footage and effects. 
Overall Concept: In a live-action Tokyo cityscape, incorporate colorful ink, paint, splashes, drips, coatings, impact marks, and powdery dispersals as if the city itself is reacting. It's crucial that paint appears to actually adhere to roads, signs, walls, utility poles, the sky, river surfaces, trains, sidewalks, and buildings, integrating naturally with the 3D space. 
Flow: Follow the storyboard panels for a fast-paced montage. Sequence: 
1. Full cityscape with Skytree: Start with live-action Tokyo; vibrant ink splashes explode, following the perspective of buildings and roads. 
2. Overhead scramble crossing: Paint bursts in all directions synced with the flow of people, spreading across crosswalk lines. 
3. Extreme close-up of pedestrian signal: Ink particles explode as the light changes, dripping from the metal frame. 
4. Low angle of utility poles/wires: Arcs of paint follow the wires against a blue sky, using spray and torn film textures. 
5. Torii gate: Bold paint impacts around the gate, blending urban graphics with sacred stillness. 
6. Waterfront/Canal: Paint scatters on railings and in the air, with color reflected in the water. 
7. Major boulevard/Buildings: Layer multiple paint explosions to peak the energy while maintaining clarity. 
8. Back alley/Vending machine: Paint splashes and seeps into narrow spaces. 
9. Train/Railroad crossing: Paint bursts are blown by the wind pressure as the train passes. 
10. Seaside promenade: Combine fine particles with large splashes for an open-air feel. 
11. Quiet pond/Park: Lower the density for a quiet scene with subtle drifting color. 
12. Sunset/City silhouette: Final large ink splash spreads into the sky with the sunset reflection. 
Style: Live-action Tokyo base, 2.5D look, high-quality cinematic graphics. Colors: Cyan, magenta, yellow, orange, pink, blue, black, white. Maintain spatial consistency and lighting. Avoid cute or ribbon-like effects. 
Editing: Rhythmic fast cuts, zooms, low angles, and motion blur to emphasize energy. 
Important: No static slideshows; ensure everything (camera, environment, effects) is moving. Ink/paint must have physical properties (bouncing, dripping). No text, logos, or UI.

entries.title: Day in the Life Continuous Tracking Shot
entries.description: An ultra-cinematic 15-second single-take sequence following a woman through her daily routine with seamless environmental transitions.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic continuous horizontal tracking shot, 16:9 aspect ratio, 15 seconds, single-take sequence with no cuts. The camera glides smoothly from left to right, following a Taiwanese woman through an entire day as the surrounding environments transition seamlessly around her.

The scene opens in a dimly lit bedroom. An alarm clock rings. A woman stirs beneath the blankets, rolls over sleepily, and reaches out to silence the alarm. The camera continues moving right into a bathroom, where she splashes cold water on her face, brushes her teeth, and briefly studies her reflection in the mirror.

The camera keeps drifting right into a kitchen. Fresh coffee brews with a gentle gurgle, toast crackles in the toaster, and she hurriedly eats breakfast while standing. Warm morning sunlight streams through the windows.

The camera moves right again into the outdoors. The city awakens around her. Crowds surge through a busy metro station. Wearing headphones, she walks forward with quiet determination, focused on the day ahead.

The camera continues right into an office lobby. Elevator doors open. She strides quickly toward her desk, still wearing her coat as her computer powers on.

The camera keeps moving right as the workday intensifies. She is deeply focused at her desk, surrounded by scattered documents. Phones ring, keyboards clatter, conversations hum in the background, and her coffee slowly grows cold.

The camera glides right into lunchtime. She sits alone on an outdoor bench holding a sandwich. It is one of the few peaceful moments of the day. She closes her eyes briefly, lifting her face toward the warm sunlight.

The camera moves right once more as the workday ends. She loosens her tie, picks up her bag, exhales deeply, and steps back into the city.

The camera continues right into the evening commute. It is the same metro train, but now quieter. Fatigue is visible on her face as she leans against the window, watching the city pass by.

The camera moves right one final time, returning home. She removes her shoes at the doorway and collapses onto the sofa. City lights glow outside the window. For the first time all day, she sits completely still, closes her eyes, and relaxes as the room gradually darkens.

Sound design is perfectly synchronized with every environment: alarm clock ringing, running water, coffee machine bubbling, toast crackling, metro rumbles, crowd ambience, office chatter, keyboard typing, city atmosphere, and the quiet stillness of night.

Ultra-realistic visuals, IMAX cinema-quality imagery, razor-sharp detail, emotionally immersive storytelling, natural lighting, cinematic depth of field, highly expressive and feminine presence, relatable and human. The character's face must match the reference image exactly, maintaining consistent facial features and identity throughout the entire shot.

entries.title: Global Football World Cup Journey
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt tracing a football's journey across the world from Rio to Buenos Aires, Casablanca, Tokyo, Lahore, and London, ending at the World Cup final.
entries.prompt:
A cinematic celebration of football around the world. The video begins in a vibrant street in **Rio de Janeiro, Brazil**, where a young boy skillfully kicks a football. As the ball leaves his foot, the camera follows it in a seamless transition across the globe.

The ball arrives in **Buenos Aires, Argentina**, where children play in a crowded neighborhood. One player volleys the ball forward. The camera follows the spinning ball as it flies across the ocean.

The ball lands in a colorful street match in **Casablanca, Morocco**. A player performs a skill move and passes it forward. The ball transitions into a fast-paced game beneath neon lights in **Tokyo, Japan**, where a young girl strikes a powerful shot.

The camera continues following the ball as it arrives in **Lahore, Pakistan**, where children play football in a dusty neighborhood ground. A smiling kid sends a perfect long pass.

The ball then reaches a rainy community pitch in **London, England**. A young player controls it and launches a spectacular final pass into the sky.

The camera follows the ball soaring through clouds before descending into a packed World Cup Final stadium filled with fans from every nation. The ball reaches a star player who scores the winning goal. The crowd erupts. Fireworks explode above the stadium.

For the final moment, players from different countries gather together and lift the World Cup trophy as confetti fills the air. The camera pulls back to reveal millions of fans worldwide celebrating simultaneously. Epic, emotional, inspiring, realistic crowd reactions, seamless transitions, cinematic lighting, global unity through football, no text, no watermark, no subtitles.

entries.title: Office Boardroom Tension with Twist
entries.description: A dramatic 15-second cinematic scene featuring an employee slapping his boss during a simulated apocalypse in a high-tech boardroom.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic 16:9 live-action, 15s. Sleek high-rise boardroom, long dark conference table, black leather chairs, coffee cup, papers, cool LED lighting. Entire back wall is a seamless floor-to-ceiling LED display perfectly disguised as a glass window overlooking a hyper-realistic Southeast Asian megacity skyline under grey skies.

Two men confront each other: young South Asian employee (olive polo, beige chinos), tense; older executive (navy suit), calm and authoritative. Slow push-in.

At 2s, a massive distant city explosion erupts on the wall, flooding the room with orange light. Employee notices first, becomes terrified. At 4s, convinced the world is ending, he turns and delivers a hard open-palm slap to the boss. Sharp impact, slight camera shake. Boss slowly turns back, completely emotionless.

Employee calmly lights a cigarette and watches as a gigantic tsunami with shadowy monster claws rises over the skyline, cold blue-grey light filling the room. He exhales smoke in total resignation.

Boss slowly pulls a small black remote from his jacket, raises it. Employee notices and freezes. Boss presses one button. Instantly the entire wall cuts to pure black—explosion, tsunami, monsters, city all gone in one frame. Using the bright orange flash of the exhaust backfire as a transition, the camera executes a vicious, motion-blurred whip-pan 180 degrees to the right—snapping perfectly onto a pit crew chief in a sponsor-heavy fire suit, capturing the exact frame she throws a checkered flag down and points a gloved finger directly at the lens.
