entries.title: High-Tempo 9-Image Glitch Edit
entries.description: A technical 15-second video prompt designed for rapid-fire transitions and complex grid layouts using nine reference images for an MV/CM-style density.
entries.prompt:
15秒・9枚画像ハイテンポ編集プロンプト

使用画像はimage1、image2、image3、image4、image5、image6、image7、image8、image9のみ。指定以外の画像は生成しない。映像全体はMV・CMレベルのテンポ感と編集密度を重視し、常に画面が変化し続ける構成とする。

0〜2秒

0.1秒ごとに高速切り替え。

表示順
image1→image2→image3→image4→image5→image6→image7→image8→image9→以降ランダム。

Flash Cut、Smash Cut、Glitch、RGB Split、White Flash、Strobe、Film Burn、Motion Blurをランダム使用。

---

2〜4秒

3×3グリッド表示。

9マスに

image1
image2
image3
image4
image5
image6
image7
image8
image9

を配置。

0.3〜0.5秒ごとに各マスが独立してランダム入れ替えされ、全マス同時ではなくバラバラに更新される。

Split Screen、Sliding Panel、Tile Shuffle、Push、Pull、Flip、Mask Revealを使用。

---

4〜6秒

画面を多数の小さなタイルへ分割。

各タイルにはimage1〜image9をランダム表示。

タイルは高速でシャッフルされ、Checker、Random Block、Diagonal、Crossパターンへ次々変化する。

---

6〜8秒

円形グリッド演出。

image1〜image9を円周上へ均等配置。

高速回転しながら配置順がランダムに入れ替わる。

Rotate、Spin、Circular Wipe、Radial Blurを組み合わせる。

---

8〜10秒

縦9分割、横9分割、ストライプ分割を高速で切り替える。

各帯にはimage1〜image9をランダム表示。

帯は左右・上下からスライドし、絶えず画像が入れ替わる。

---

10〜12秒

コラージュ演出。

大小さまざまな矩形へimage1〜image9をランダム配置。

出現・消失・拡大・縮小・回転を高速で繰り返し、画面全体が絶えず再構成される。

Grid Animation、Mosaic Reveal、Tile Shuffle、Alpha Dissolveを使用。

---

12〜14秒

9枚を同時表示。

グリッド配置→円形配置→横一列→縦一列→ランダム配置を高速で切り替える。

各レイアウト間はFlash Cut、Glitch、Sliding Panelで接続する。

---

14〜15秒

9枚が高速シャッフルされながら一瞬ずつ全面表示。

最後に最も印象的な1枚を画面いっぱいに表示し、

White Flash
→Bloom
→Light Leak
→Freeze Frame

で締める。

使用推奨トランジション・編集効果

Flash Cut、Smash Cut、Jump Cut、Match Cut、Glitch、RGB Split、Strobe、Film Burn、White Flash、Split Screen、Grid Animation、Tile Shuffle、Mosaic Reveal、Sliding Panel、Push、Pull、Flip、Rotate、Spin、Circular Wipe、Diagonal Wipe、Checker Wipe、Random Block、Mask Reveal、Alpha Dissolve、Motion Blur、Radial Blur、Zoom Cut、Freeze Frame、Echo Frame。

同じ演出を連続使用せず、15秒間を通して画面構成が絶えず変化する、情報量と勢いのある映像として表現する。
entries.translated_prompt:
15-Second / 9-Image High-Tempo Editing Prompt

Use only image1, image2, image3, image4, image5, image6, image7, image8, and image9. Do not generate images other than those specified. The overall video should emphasize an MV/CM-level sense of tempo and editing density, with a composition that constantly changes the screen.

0–2 seconds:
High-speed switching every 0.1 seconds.
Display order: image1→image2→image3→image4→image5→image6→image7→image8→image9→random thereafter.
Use Flash Cut, Smash Cut, Glitch, RGB Split, White Flash, Strobe, Film Burn, and Motion Blur randomly.

---

2–4 seconds:
3x3 grid display.
Place image1 through image9 in the 9 slots.
Each slot independently and randomly switches every 0.3 to 0.5 seconds; slots update separately rather than all at once.
Use Split Screen, Sliding Panel, Tile Shuffle, Push, Pull, Flip, and Mask Reveal.

---

4–6 seconds:
Split the screen into many small tiles.
Randomly display image1 through image9 in each tile.
Tiles are shuffled at high speed, changing through Checker, Random Block, Diagonal, and Cross patterns.

---

6–8 seconds:
Circular grid effect.
Arrange image1 through image9 evenly on a circumference.
Rotate at high speed while the arrangement order switches randomly.
Combine Rotate, Spin, Circular Wipe, and Radial Blur.

---

8–10 seconds:
High-speed switching between 9 vertical divisions, 9 horizontal divisions, and stripe divisions.
Randomly display image1 through image9 in each band.
Bands slide from left/right or top/bottom, with images constantly switching.

---

10–12 seconds:
Collage effect.
Randomly place image1 through image9 into various rectangular shapes of different sizes.
Repeat appearing, disappearing, enlarging, shrinking, and rotating at high speed, with the entire screen constantly reconfiguring.
Use Grid Animation, Mosaic Reveal, Tile Shuffle, and Alpha Dissolve.

---

12–14 seconds:
Simultaneous display of 9 images.
Switch rapidly between grid layout→circular layout→single horizontal row→single vertical row→random layout.
Connect each layout with Flash Cut, Glitch, and Sliding Panel.

---

14–15 seconds:
9 images shuffle at high speed, each shown full-screen for an instant.
Finally, display the most impressive single image full-screen and close with White Flash → Bloom → Light Leak → Freeze Frame.

Recommended Transitions/Editing Effects:
Flash Cut, Smash Cut, Jump Cut, Match Cut, Glitch, RGB Split, Strobe, Film Burn, White Flash, Split Screen, Grid Animation, Tile Shuffle, Mosaic Reveal, Sliding Panel, Push, Pull, Flip, Rotate, Spin, Circular Wipe, Diagonal Wipe, Checker Wipe, Random Block, Mask Reveal, Alpha Dissolve, Motion Blur, Radial Blur, Zoom Cut, Freeze Frame, Echo Frame.

Do not use the same effect consecutively; express as a high-information, energetic video where the screen composition constantly changes throughout the 15 seconds.

entries.title: Red Carpet Cinematic Hero Reveal
entries.description: A complex single-shot prompt for a character reveal at a red carpet event, using a face reference for consistent acting.
entries.prompt:
Single continuous uninterrupted cinematic shot, no cuts, one flowing 15-second take. Celebrity hero reveal arrival sequence, bright sunny daytime, glamorous red carpet event outside a grand building. Hyper-realistic professional film look, realistic textures, crisp natural daylight, polished surfaces, vibrant color, shallow depth of field. Absolutely no plastic CGI look.

The shot opens on an intimate close-up at ground level of a clean paved street / red carpet edge, sunlight catching the asphalt. A luxurious glossy red sports car drives forward into frame, moving ahead in a normal forward direction, and pulls up to a smooth stop. The car door opens. The camera holds low as a pair of feet in polished elegant dress shoes steps out of the car onto the ground — this is the man [IMAGE], wearing a sharp, tailored elegant suit, sophisticated movie-star style.

As he stands, the camera slowly cranes upward along his body from his shoes toward his face. During this rise, he smoothly closes the car door behind him and adjusts his suit jacket and cuffs, composed and confident. When the camera reaches his face, he removes his sunglasses with a smooth motion, revealing his charismatic, composed expression.

The camera then orbits around him, circling smoothly until it settles behind him — revealing, in front of him, a large crowd of press photographers and excited fans waiting behind barriers, cameras flashing, people cheering. The man begins to walk forward toward them.

The camera stays behind him but gradually cranes upward, rising higher until it looks down from above and behind his head in a high angle, showing him from above as he walks the carpet, waving and greeting the cheering fans, then continues forward and enters through the doors into the grand building.

STYLE: cinematic, bright glamorous natural lighting, vibrant color grade, lens flare from sunlight, realistic motion blur, shallow depth of field, blockbuster red-carpet film quality.

entries.title: Serene Morning Yoga Flow

entries.prompt:
A peaceful sunrise garden surrounded by lush greenery, blooming flowers, and golden morning light. A young woman walks into the garden carrying a rolled yoga mat and a water bottle. Cinematic wide shots establish the tranquil environment. She finds a quiet spot on the grass, gently unrolls her mat, removes her shoes, and takes a deep refreshing breath. Soft breeze moves through the trees, birds chirp in the background, creating a calm wellness atmosphere.

The camera follows her with smooth cinematic movements as she stretches her neck, shoulders, arms, and back. Close-up shots capture mindful details—her tying her hair into a ponytail, adjusting her yoga outfit, placing her hands on the mat, and feeling the warmth of the morning sun. Natural light creates beautiful lens flares and soft highlights across the garden.

She sits cross-legged on the mat and closes her eyes. Slow push-in shots capture her calm breathing and peaceful expression. As relaxing music builds, she transitions into gentle warm-up movements and graceful yoga poses. The camera alternates between close-ups of focused expressions and wide shots showcasing her surrounded by colorful flowers, green trees, and glowing sunlight.

Cinematic drone shots reveal the entire garden as she flows effortlessly through yoga poses. Slow-motion moments emphasize balance, flexibility, and inner peace. Golden sun rays stream through the trees, creating a dreamy wellness-commercial aesthetic. Every movement feels natural, elegant, and meditative.

End with a stunning hero shot of the woman holding a beautiful yoga pose in the center of the garden, bathed in warm sunrise light. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the serene landscape, creating a feeling of harmony, mindfulness, wellness, and connection with nature. Ultra-realistic, cinematic photography, premium wellness brand commercial, shallow depth of field, soft natural colors, peaceful mood, smooth gimbal movements, photorealistic, 16:9 aspect ratio.

entries.prompt:
第一人称手机手电筒视角，夜晚推开一扇老旧公寓房门，镜头进入一间脏乱、潮湿、昏暗的卧室。房间里有一张凌乱的床，地上散落衣物、破纸箱、空水瓶和发霉的外卖盒。角落里蹲着一位明显成年的女性
hf_20260602_030359_fe9adf4d-7a5d-4c92-9517-3e9d2f2e0da1
穿着
图片_20260608230651_1029_183(1)
，看起来像被困很久。整体是写实恐怖短片质感，手持镜头轻微颤抖，呼吸声清晰，无音乐。 Shot 1 (0-3s) - THE HOOK: 第一人称慢慢推开门，门轴发出刺耳声。手电光扫过脏乱地面、凌乱床铺 and 墙上的水渍，最后停在房间角落。角落里的成年女性抬起头，眼神从害怕变成惊喜。 Shot 2 (3-6s): 她看到有人进来后非常开心，立刻站起来，朝镜头方向小跑过来。她脸上带着获救般的笑容，双手微微抬起，像是在求助和感谢。第一人称后退半步，镜头轻微晃动，画面里能听见紧张的呼吸声。 Shot 3 (6-9s): 第一人称以为救援成功，镜头稍微放低，像是准备扶她离开。女性越来越靠近，笑容仍然明亮，但房间灯光突然闪烁，床底下传来低沉的拖拽声。她停在距离镜头很近的位置，轻声说：“你终于来了。” Shot 4 (9-12s) - REVERSAL: 她的声音突然变得冰冷沙哑，表情僵住，笑容变得不自然。她缓缓歪头，眼睛在手电光里反射出异常的暗光，然后用完全不同的低哑声音说：“我等的不是救援……是替身。” Shot 5 (12-15s) - PAYOFF: 手电筒开始疯狂闪烁。她的脸在每次闪光中变得更像女恶鬼：苍白、扭曲、头发无风飘动，但不出现血腥画面。最后一次闪光时，她瞬间贴到镜头前，张开黑暗的眼睛，画面猛地失焦并切黑，只留下房门砰然关闭的声音。 Style: 第一人称手持手机录像，真实恐怖短视频质感，低光、手电筒硬光、数字噪点、轻微运动模糊、潮湿房间氛围、压抑呼吸声、门轴声、远处城市低频噪声、灯光闪烁、电流杂音。无音乐，无字幕，无水印，无额外角色，无血腥暴力，女性为明确成年角色。
entries.translated_prompt: First-person mobile phone flashlight perspective. At night, push open an old apartment door; the camera enters a messy, damp, and dim bedroom. There is a cluttered bed, and the floor is scattered with clothes, broken cardboard boxes, empty water bottles, and moldy takeout containers. An obviously adult woman is crouching in the corner, wearing hf_20260602_030359_fe9adf4d-7a5d-4c92-9517-3e9d2f2e0da1 and Image_20260608230651_1029_183(1), appearing trapped for a long time. The overall texture is that of a realistic horror short film, with a slight handheld camera shake, clear breathing sounds, and no music. Shot 1 (0-3s) - THE HOOK: The first-person pushes the door open slowly, the hinge making a piercing sound. The flashlight sweeps across the messy floor, the cluttered bed, and water stains on the wall, finally stopping in the corner of the room. The adult woman in the corner looks up, her expression turning from fear to pleasant surprise. Shot 2 (3-6s): She is very happy to see someone enter, stands up immediately, and jogs towards the camera. She has a rescued-like smile on her face, hands slightly raised as if asking for help and expressing gratitude. The first-person takes half a step back, the camera shakes slightly, and heavy breathing can be heard. Shot 3 (6-9s): The first-person thinks the rescue is successful; the camera lowers slightly as if preparing to help her leave. The woman gets closer, her smile still bright, but the room light suddenly flickers, and a low dragging sound comes from under the bed. She stops very close to the camera and whispers: 'You're finally here.' Shot 4 (9-12s) - REVERSAL: Her voice suddenly becomes cold and raspy, her expression freezes, and her smile becomes unnatural. She slowly tilts her head, her eyes reflecting an abnormal dark light in the flashlight, then says in a completely different low, raspy voice: 'I wasn't waiting for a rescue... but a replacement.' Shot 5 (12-15s) - PAYOFF: The flashlight begins to flicker wildly. In each flash, her face becomes more like a female demon: pale, distorted, hair fluttering without wind, but no bloody scenes appear. At the final flash, she instantly sticks to the camera, opens her dark eyes, the screen suddenly loses focus and cuts to black, leaving only the sound of the door slamming shut. Style: First-person handheld mobile video, real horror short video texture, low light, hard flashlight light, digital noise, slight motion blur, damp room atmosphere, oppressive breathing, hinge sounds, distant low-frequency city noise, flickering lights, electrical noise. No music, no subtitles, no watermarks, no extra characters, no gore or violence, the female is clearly an adult character.

entries.title: City Doodles and Urban Fairies Montage
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt that blends realistic urban transit scenes with 2D hand-drawn doodles of magical creatures, creating a whimsical urban montage.
entries.prompt:
{{Image 1}} =絵コンテの参照。

添付された絵コンテ画像{{Image 1}}を基に、15秒、横型16:9の高品質な動画を作成してください。

テーマは「実写映像とエフェクトの共存」。

全体として、駅、改札、ホーム、車内、跨線橋、鉄橋、都市夜景を舞台にした、移動のリズムと、実在しない2D手描き風の妖精ドゥードルたちが共存する映像にしてください。
静止画のスライドショーにはせず、各カットの中でカメラも人も電車もエフェクトも確実に動いている、テンポのよい都市モンタージュにしてください。

映像全体の方向性：
実写ベースの駅空間。改札、駅サイン、ホーム、車両、車内、発車の瞬間、橋を渡る列車、子どもが窓を見るカット、駅構内時計、夜のホーム、屋上や高所から見る都市夜景。
その中に、2D手描き風の可愛い妖精・動物・星・惑星・軌道線・リボン線・小さな飛行体が大量に共存する。
重要なのは、駅という機能的な空間に対して、エフェクトがただ可愛いだけでなく、移動の流れ・時間の流れ・旅情を補強する存在として見えること。
全体として、軽快で都会的、少し夢があり、移動そのものが魔法に包まれている印象。

カット構成：
1カット目：改札の人波。行き交う通勤客。改札機の上や周囲に妖精ドゥードルが舞う。前進移動。
2カット目：駅サインやホーム案内の寄り。星、惑星、小さな生き物たちが周囲を流れる。素早い寄り。
3カット目：走る電車の外観。車体の上空や周囲に軌道線と妖精たち。斜め構図でスピード感。
4カット目：エスカレーター。乗客の流れに沿って、小さな妖精が上下に移動する。見上げ気味。
5カット目：ホームで待つ人々と停車中の電車。列車と人物の静かな間に妖精が溶け込む。横移動。
6カット目：車内。スマホを見る若者。吊り革や窓辺にドゥードルたちが共存。寄りカット。
7カット目：駅員が発車を見送る。列車の動きに合わせてリボン線と星が流れる。動きのあるカット。
8カット目：橋を渡る列車のワイド。空に月や惑星や妖精たち。開放感のある引き。
9カット目：子どもが窓越しに手を伸ばす。妖精が窓の向こうにいるような演出。感情的な寄り。
10カット目：駅構内の時計やサイン。小さな生き物たちが案内板に座る。テンポのよい差し込みカット。
11カット目：夜のホーム。カーブした線路とホームの奥行き。妖精ドゥードルたちが夜気の中に浮かぶ。やや引き。
12カット目：屋上または高所から都市夜景を見る人物。隣に大きめのうさぎ風ドゥードル.空に星や軌道線が広がり、余韻で締める。

演出・編集：
テンポ良く、都市の移動感を重視する。
列車の進行方向、人物の歩行方向、エフェクトの流れでマッチカットを作る。
寄り、斜め、引き、前進、横移動をバランス良く配置。
駅の無機質さと、ドゥードルの柔らかさの対比を大切にする。

画作り：
高品質、シネマティック、駅の金属感、ガラス、人工照明、夕方から夜にかけての都市の光。
エフェクトはパステルカラー中心、白い線を混ぜる。
量は多めだが、駅情報や人物、車両の視認性を失わない。

重要事項：
静止画のスライドショー禁止。
各カット内でカメラ、人物、電車、エフェクトが確実に動くこと。
文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは禁止。
形状崩れ、不自然な増殖、エフェクトの貼り付き感は禁止。
実写の駅空間の中に、移動と共に生きる見えない妖精たちが自然に共存する15秒映像にしてください。
entries.translated_prompt:
{{Image 1}} = Storyboard reference.

Based on the attached storyboard image {{Image 1}}, create a high-quality 15-second horizontal 16:9 video.

Theme: "Coexistence of real-life footage and effects."

As a whole, create a video set in stations, ticket gates, platforms, train interiors, overpasses, railway bridges, and urban nightscapes where the rhythm of movement coexists with non-existent 2D hand-drawn style fairy doodles.
Do not make it a slideshow of still images; ensure it is a fast-paced urban montage where the camera, people, trains, and effects all move within each cut.

Overall direction of the video:
Real-life based station spaces including ticket gates, station signs, platforms, vehicles, interiors, moments of departure, trains crossing bridges, shots of children looking out windows, station clocks, night platforms, and urban night views from rooftops or high vantage points.
Within these, a large number of cute 2D hand-drawn style fairies, animals, stars, planets, orbital lines, ribbon lines, and small flying objects coexist.
The important thing is that the effects should not just be cute but should also reinforce the flow of movement, the passage of time, and the feeling of travel in the functional station space.
The overall impression should be light, urban, slightly dreamy, and as if the movement itself is enveloped in magic.

Cut composition:
1st Cut: Crowds at ticket gates. Commuters coming and going. Fairy doodles dancing over and around ticket gates. Forward movement.
2nd Cut: Close-up of station signs or platform guides. Stars, planets, and small creatures flowing around. Quick zoom-in.
3rd Cut: Exterior of a moving train. Orbital lines and fairies above and around the car body. Speed and diagonal composition.
4th Cut: Escalator. Small fairies moving up and down along with the flow of passengers. Low-angle shot looking up.
5th Cut: People waiting on the platform and a stopped train. Fairies blending into the quiet space between the train and people. Lateral movement.
6th Cut: Inside the car. A young person looking at a smartphone. Doodles coexisting on straps and by windows. Close-up cut.
7th Cut: Station staff seeing off the train. Ribbon lines and stars flowing with the movement of the train. Dynamic cut.
8th Cut: Wide shot of a train crossing a bridge. Moon, planets, and fairies in the sky. Expansive pull-back shot.
9th Cut: A child reaching out through the window. Direction as if a fairy is on the other side of the window. Emotional close-up.
10th Cut: Station clocks or signs. Small creatures sitting on the information board. Fast-paced insert cut.
11th Cut: Night platform. Curved tracks and depth of the platform. Fairy doodles floating in the night air. Slightly pulled-back shot.
12th Cut: A person looking at the urban night view from a rooftop or high place. A large rabbit-like doodle next to them. Stars and orbital lines spreading in the sky, closing with a lingering finish.

Direction/Editing:
Keep the tempo brisk and emphasize the sense of urban movement.
Create match cuts based on the train's direction, people's walking direction, and the flow of effects.
Balance close-ups, diagonals, pull-backs, forward movement, and lateral movement.
Value the contrast between the inorganic nature of the station and the softness of the doodles.

Visual style:
High quality, cinematic, metallic feel of the station, glass, artificial lighting, urban lights from evening to night.
Effects centered on pastel colors with mixed white lines.
The amount is plentiful but does not obscure the visibility of station information, people, or vehicles.

Important points:
No still image slideshows.
Ensure the camera, people, trains, and effects move in each cut.
No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

The ball arcs upward in clear view. 12–15s: RIVAL B leaps and strikes the airborne ball with a lightning-charged mid-air volley. The ball rockets toward the goal trailing blue electricity. Final frame: the ball hitting the net. Continuity rule: one single ball exists for the entire video and never disappears between cuts. A cheerful young boy approaches a colorful ice cream truck and excitedly buys his favorite ice cream cone. Close-up of his smiling face as he admires the perfect scoop. He happily walks away, taking a careful first step.

Suddenly the cone slips from his hand in slow motion. The ice cream falls onto the sidewalk and splatters. Close-up of the boy's shocked expression turning into disappointment. As the boy sadly watches from a distance, the ice cream truck driver notices what happened through the service window. The driver looks concerned and smiles warmly. He steps out of the truck holding a fresh ice cream cone.

The boy happily enjoys his replacement ice cream. Nearby, a friendly stray puppy watches curiously. The boy kneels down and shares a small bite with the puppy. The puppy wags its tail excitedly, creating a heartwarming connection.

Final cinematic sequence: the ice cream truck drives away down the glowing suburban street, the boy and puppy walking side by side through golden sunlight. Wide aerial pullback revealing a peaceful neighborhood, long sunset shadows, warm emotional atmosphere, wholesome family-friendly ending, cinematic depth of field, realistic animation physics, expressive facial acting, emotional orchestral music, Pixar-inspired storytelling, theme of kindness turning disappointment into happiness.

entries.title: Bioluminescent Night Underwater Creature
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt featuring a mythical sea creature swimming through a glowing bioluminescent forest, based on a 12-panel storyboard reference.
entries.prompt:
幻想的な夜の水辺、バイオルミネセンスに包まれた森、青緑に発光する水面、水中を泳ぐ巨大で神秘的な水棲生物を主人公として扱ってください。 

 @画像1＝絵コンテの参照。 
 @画像1の12コマの流れ、構図、カメラアングル、光、反射、水中表現を参照してください。
ただし、絵コンテの黒枠、番号、パネル分割、文字は完成映像に絶対に出さないでください。 添付された絵コンテをもとに、15秒の横型16:9「幻想的な夜の水辺を巨大水棲生物が優雅に泳ぐ神秘的シネマティックシーン」動画を作成してください。 テーマ：映像の美しさで魅了する神作画 絵コンテのパネル順に沿って、夜のバイオルミネセンス湿地、水面、水中世界、巨大水棲生物の出現、接近、優雅な遊泳、そして静かな余韻までを、1本の流れるような美しい映像として動画化してください。 激しい戦闘やホラーではなく、圧倒的な映像美、光の反射、水の揺らぎ、水中粒子、巨大生物の優雅な動きで観客を魅了する映像にしてください。 

流れ： 0.0〜1.2秒： 水面を境に、上は青緑に発光する幻想的な森、下は深い水中世界が見えるスプリットレベルの超ワイドショット。水面には細かな波紋、蓮の葉、反射光。水中の奥には巨大水棲生物の影がゆっくり横切る。 

1.2〜2.4秒： カメラが水面ギリギリを低く滑るように前進する。発光するツタ、湿った葉、浮かぶ水草、青緑の反射が画面手前を流れていく。水面の揺れと反射を美しく見せる。 

2.4〜3.4秒： 葉先の水滴の超接写。透明な水滴の中に森の青緑の光が反射している。水滴が震え、ゆっくり落下する。背景は美しいボケ、発光粒子が漂う。 

3.4〜4.6秒： 水滴が水面に落ち、水中へ光の輪が広がる。小さな発光魚が一斉に散る。水中に泡、波紋、粒子、光の筋が広がり、静かな一滴が世界全体を動かしたように見せる。 

4.6〜5.9秒： 水中の広角ショット。巨大な水棲生物が遠くに現れる。恐怖ではなく、神秘的で優しい存在感。上から青い光芒が差し込み、周囲を小魚と発光粒子が漂う。 

5.9〜7.1秒： カメラが水中植物の間をすり抜けながら、巨大水棲生物の横を追跡する。前景には揺れる水草、奥には巨大な体.魚群がカメラ前を横切り、奥行きとスケール感を強調する。 

7.1〜8.3秒： 水中の根や巨大な樹の根元から、上方向へカメラがティルトアップする。水面の向こうに巨大な発光樹と垂れ下がるツタが見える。水中から森を見上げる、神秘的で壮大な構図。 

8.3〜9.5秒： 俯瞰ショット。水面に浮かぶ蓮の葉、円形の波紋、下を通る巨大生物の影。水面全体がゆっくり歪み、巨大な存在が近くにいることを視覚的に伝える。 

9.5〜10.7秒： 半水面ショット。画面上半分には発光する夜の森、画面下半分には水中を泳ぐ巨大水棲生物。水面の境界が美しく揺れ、上下の世界が同時に見える。カメラはゆっくり横移動する。

 10.7〜12.0秒： 巨大水棲生物の頭部または目元の超接写。体表には微細な発光模様、青緑の粒子、柔らかな水中光。目は穏やかで知性を感じる。怪物ではなく、古代から森を守っているような神秘性を出す。 

12.0〜13.7秒： クライマックス。巨大水棲生物が優雅に体をひねって泳ぎ、水中に光の軌跡、泡、粒子、波紋が広がる。上から差し込む光芒が体表をなぞり、水面にも美しい反射が生まれる。水と光のVFXは実写映画級の質感で、重さ、透明感、屈折、揺らぎをリアルに表現する。 

13.7〜15.0秒： 最後は再び広いスプリットレベルの静かな構図。上には発光する森、下には青い水中世界。巨大水棲生物は奥の深みにゆっくり消えていく。水面の波紋が落ち着き、粒子だけが漂う。観客に余韻と神秘を残して終了する。 

スタイル： 高品質アニメ映画風、神作画、シネマティック、ハイディテール、幻想的な夜の森、バイオルミネセンス、青緑の発光、深いネイビーの夜、水面反射、水中の透明感、実写映画級VFX、繊細な水しぶき、泡、粒子、光芒、屈折、コースティクス、霧、湿度感、静かな神秘性。 人物は登場させない。世界そのものと巨大水棲生物を主人公として描く。 

編集： リズム感のある美しいカット展開、ワイドショット、超接写、ローアングル、水面ギリギリの低空移動、俯瞰、水中トラッキング、斜め構図、半水面ショット、ゆっくりしたプッシュイン、滑らかなパン、気持ちのいいマッチカットを使用してください。 テンポは速すぎず、映像美を味わえる流れにしてください。ただし静止画の連続にはせず、常に水、光、魚、粒子、植物、カメラが自然に動き続ける映像にしてください。
entries.translated_prompt:
Set a mystical night waterside, a forest enveloped in bioluminescence, a water surface glowing blue-green, and a giant mysterious aquatic creature swimming underwater as the protagonist.

@Image 1 = Storyboard reference.
Refer to the flow, composition, camera angles, light, reflections, and underwater expressions of the 12 panels in @Image 1.
However, absolutely do not output the storyboard's black frames, numbers, panel divisions, or text in the final video. Based on the attached storyboard, create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 'Mysterious Cinematic Scene of a Giant Aquatic Creature Gracefully Swimming in a Mystical Night Waterside' video. Theme: God-tier art that captivates with visual beauty. Following the panel order of the storyboard, animate the night bioluminescent wetland, water surface, underwater world, emergence of the giant aquatic creature, its approach, graceful swimming, and the quiet lingering finish as a single flowing beautiful video. Ensure it is not about intense combat or horror, but a video that captivates the audience with overwhelming visual beauty, light reflections, water ripples, underwater particles, and the giant creature's graceful movements.

Flow:
0.0–1.2s: A split-level ultra-wide shot showing a mystical forest glowing blue-green above and a deep underwater world below. Fine ripples, lotus leaves, and reflected light on the water surface. The shadow of a giant aquatic creature slowly crosses deep underwater.
1.2–2.4s: The camera moves forward sliding low just above the water surface. Glowing vines, wet leaves, floating water plants, and blue-green reflections flow past the foreground. Beautifully show the water's sway and reflections.
2.4–3.4s: Super close-up of a water drop at the tip of a leaf. The forest's blue-green light reflects inside the transparent drop. The drop trembles and slowly falls. Beautiful bokeh background with floating luminous particles.
3.4–4.6s: The drop hits the water surface, and a ring of light spreads underwater. Small luminous fish scatter all at once. Bubbles, ripples, particles, and light rays spread underwater, showing as if a single quiet drop moved the entire world.
4.6–5.9s: Wide underwater shot. The giant aquatic creature appears in the distance. Not scary, but a mystical and gentle presence. Blue light rays shine from above, surrounded by small fish and luminous particles.
5.9–7.1s: The camera slips through underwater plants while tracking alongside the giant aquatic creature. Swaying water plants in the foreground, the massive body in the back. A school of fish crosses in front of the camera, emphasizing depth and scale.
7.1–8.3s: Camera tilts up from underwater roots or the base of a giant tree. Beyond the water surface, a massive luminous tree and hanging vines are visible. A mystical and grand composition looking up at the forest from underwater.
8.3–9.5s: Bird's-eye view shot. Lotus leaves floating on the water, circular ripples, and the shadow of the giant creature passing below. The entire water surface slowly distorts, visually conveying that a massive presence is nearby.
9.5–10.7s: Semi-submerged shot. Top half of the screen is the glowing night forest; bottom half is the giant aquatic creature swimming underwater. The water boundary sways beautifully, showing both worlds simultaneously. The camera moves slowly sideways.
10.7–12.0s: Super close-up of the giant aquatic creature's head or eyes. Minute luminous patterns, blue-green particles, and soft underwater light on the body surface. Eyes are calm and show intelligence. Evoke a sense of mystery as if it has been protecting the forest since ancient times, rather than being a monster.
12.0–13.7s: Climax. The giant aquatic creature gracefully twists its body to swim, with trails of light, bubbles, particles, and ripples spreading underwater. Light rays from above trace its body surface, creating beautiful reflections on the water. Use live-action movie grade VFX for water and light, realistically expressing weight, transparency, refraction, and swaying.
13.7–15.0s: Finally, return to a wide split-level quiet composition. Glowing forest above, blue underwater world below. The giant aquatic creature slowly disappears into the depths. Water ripples settle, leaving only particles floating. End with a lingering sense of mystery.

Style: High-quality anime film style, god-tier art, cinematic, high detail, mystical night forest, bioluminescence, blue-green glow, deep navy night, water reflections, underwater transparency, live-action grade VFX, delicate splashes, bubbles, particles, light rays, refraction, caustics, mist, humidity, quiet mystery. Do not include people. Portray the world itself and the giant aquatic creature as protagonists.

Editing: Use a beautiful cut sequence with rhythm, wide shots, super close-ups, low angles, low-altitude movement just above the water, bird's-eye views, underwater tracking, diagonal compositions, semi-submerged shots, slow push-ins, smooth pans, and pleasing match cuts. Keep the tempo not too fast to allow viewers to savor the visual beauty. However, do not make it a series of still images; ensure water, light, fish, particles, plants, and the camera constantly move naturally.

entries.title: Shark Chasing Tuna on Fishing Boat
entries.description: An incredibly detailed prompt for a realistic, high-tension video of tuna leaping onto a boat deck to escape a giant shark.
entries.prompt: 生成 10 秒竖屏 9:16 视频，真实手机偷拍视频风格。场景是夜晚海上的大型渔船甲板，右侧是漆黑的大海，左侧和远处是白色船体结构、栏杆、工作灯和几名船员。甲板湿滑反光，有海水、金属舱盖、绳索和船用挂钩。强烈白色船灯照亮甲板，远处海面几乎全黑，画面有低清手机压缩感、手持抖动、运动模糊和夜间噪点。 内容是几条大型金枪鱼为了躲避巨大鲨鱼追捕，慌不择路地从海里跳到渔船甲板上。整体氛围真实、混乱、荒诞、带一点黑色幽默，像船员手机突然拍到的离谱瞬间。 画面开始时，镜头站在甲板靠左位置，斜拍右侧船舷和黑色海面。几名船员穿着黄色、橙色或深色防水围裙、雨衣和手套，站在甲板后方。他们原本在看海面，突然被跳上来的鱼吓到，身体后退、抬手、惊叫。 动作节奏： 0-2 秒：第一条大型金枪鱼从右侧黑色海面突然跃过船舷，重重摔到湿滑甲板上。鱼身银白、流线型、体型很大，尾巴剧烈拍打甲板，水花四溅。船员被吓得后退。 2-4 秒：第二条、第三条金枪鱼接连从右侧海面跳上船，一条落在甲板中间，一条滑向船员脚边。它们疯狂扭动、拍尾、滑行，甲板上水花和反光更加混乱。船员惊慌地躲开，有人扶着栏杆，有人张嘴喊叫。 4-6 秒：镜头轻微后退和晃动，跟随甲板上的鱼群。几条金枪鱼在甲板上乱跳，尾巴高速拍打，身体反光明显。右侧黑色海面忽然出现巨大的水花和阴影，暗示有更大的东西正在逼近。 6-8 秒：巨大鲨鱼从右侧船舷外的黑海里猛地冲出水面，但不要跳到船上。它停留在船外，身体大部分仍在海里，只把巨大的头部和上半身冲到船舷高度。鲨鱼张开血盆大口，露出多排尖牙，嘴巴朝向甲板上的金枪鱼，像马上要咬上来。水花猛烈拍打船舷，船员被吓得猛然后退。 8-10 秒：鲨鱼的大嘴贴近船舷和镜头方向，占据画面右侧前景，张口咆哮般逼近但没有上船。甲板上的金枪鱼还在乱跳，船员在背景中惊叫、抬手、后退。镜头剧烈晃动，像拍摄者被鲨鱼张嘴吓到往后缩。最后定格在鲨鱼血盆大口、船员惊恐和湿滑甲板鱼群混乱的瞬间。 镜头语言：全程手持竖屏手机拍摄，一镜到底，不要切镜。镜头站在甲板上，始终能看到右侧黑色海面和船舷。鱼跳上船时镜头轻微跟随和后退；鲨鱼张嘴冲出水面时镜头明显惊慌抖动，但鲨鱼不能爬上甲板，不能完全落到船上。 声音：夜晚海风声、船体机械低频声、海浪拍船声、鱼摔到湿甲板上的沉重拍击声、鱼尾疯狂拍打声、水花声、船员惊叫声。鲨鱼冲出水面张嘴时有巨大水声、船员尖叫和惊呼，最后是混乱的喊叫和镜头后退的声音。 视觉重点：黑色夜海、白色渔船甲板、几条大型银白金枪鱼先后跳上船、船员惊慌后退、最后巨大鲨鱼在船舷外张开血盆大口逼近但没有上船。画面要真实、低清、离谱但可信，像突发偷拍视频。 负面要求：不要让鲨鱼跳到甲板上，不要让鲨鱼完全上船，不要卡通风，不要动画片质感，不要干净电影感，不要白天海滩，不要血腥，不要把金枪鱼变成小鱼，不要把鲨鱼变成鲸鱼或海豚，不要多只鲨鱼，不要让鲨鱼太早出现，不要切镜，不要文字，不要水印。
entries.translated_prompt: Generate a 10-second vertical 9:16 video in a realistic leaked phone footage style. The scene is a large fishing boat deck at night, with the dark sea on the right and white boat structures, railings, work lights, and crew members on the left and far end. The deck is wet and reflective with seawater, metal hatches, ropes, and boat hooks. Bright white boat lights illuminate the deck, while the distant sea is almost pitch black. The footage has low-def mobile compression, handheld shakiness, motion blur, and night noise. The content features large tuna jumping onto the deck to escape a giant shark. The atmosphere is realistic, chaotic, and absurd with a touch of dark humor. Timeline: 0-2s: First tuna jumps from the dark sea onto the deck; 2-4s: More tuna jump on board as crew retreats in shock; 4-6s: Camera follows the jumping fish while shadows lurk in the water; 6-8s: A giant shark lunges out of the water near the railing, mouth wide open with rows of teeth; 8-10s: The shark's mouth fills the foreground as it roars before the footage ends in chaos. Camera: Handheld, one-shot, no cuts. Audio: Sea wind, mechanical hum, waves, fish flopping, crew screaming, splashing water. Visual focus: Dark night sea, white deck, tuna jumping, panicked crew, and the shark's final approach. Negative prompts: No shark on deck, no animation style, no daylight, no blood, no text or watermarks.

entries.title: Torpedo vs Megalodon Ocean Chase
entries.description: A thrilling marine action sequence prompt featuring a megalodon chasing a navy speedboat through a shipwreck with a torpedo climax.
entries.prompt:
A megalodon, whale-sized with scarred grey hide, is chasing a navy speedboat across open ocean in dramatic stormy daylight. Huge swells, a half-sunken rusted cargo ship ahead, a submarine's periscope cutting the water beyond it. Sound: screaming engines, crashing waves, sonar pings, radio chatter, shark breaching.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Aerial tracking shot. The megalodon breaches fully out of the speedboat's wake, jaws wide as a garage door, crashing back down meters behind the stern in an eruption of white water. The boat crew hangs on, soaked, the commander roaring into his radio: "IT'S RIGHT ON US! SUB, YOU READY?"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Periscope POV with crosshairs, then cut inside the submarine. The captain at the scope: "Torpedo armed. Bring it through the wreck — we'll meet it on the other side." Weapons officer slams the launch panel. Underwater shot — a torpedo bursts from the tube, screwing through dark water.

Shot 3 (6–9s): Water-level tracking shot. The speedboat races straight at the half-sunken cargo ship, threading through a torn gash in its rusted hull at full speed — sparks off the bow rail — out the other side. Behind, the megalodon doesn't turn. It accelerates.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The shark smashes THROUGH the cargo ship's hull after them — rusted steel plates exploding outward in slow motion. Bullet time — the megalodon erupts from the wreckage, jaws open, sheet metal and rivets suspended around its head — and meets the incoming torpedo nose-first. Detonation. Ship, shark, and sea vanish inside a colossal dome of fire and white water, debris frozen mid-bloom.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The blast wave overtakes the speedboat, nearly swamping it as flaming wreckage rains across the swells. The crew rises from the deck, drenched, staring at the burning ship carcass settling behind them. The commander keys his radio, grinning: "Good tag." Periscope drops below the surface.

entries.title: Anime Style Underwater to Beach Transition
entries.description: An elaborate anime-style prompt featuring a fast-paced transition from a detailed bioluminescent underwater city to a sunny Hawaiian beach bar with cats playing volleyball.
entries.prompt:
日本のフルカラーアニメーション。壮大で幻想的な海底都市を舞台にした高速シネマティック映像。色鮮やかな珊瑚の高層建築、発光するクラゲ型の街灯、透明な水中道路。無数の魚、エビ、カニ、タツノオトシゴたちが人間の服を着て歩き回り、レトロフューチャーな水中飛行艇や潜水スクーターを操縦している。カメラは超高速の鞭パンショットで海底都市を駆け抜け、人々の活気あふれる生活を映し出す。

やがて巨大で古びた城壁に囲まれた区域へ到達する。苔むした汚れた石壁の中央には巨大な木製の門。門の前には無表情なタコの門番兼切符係が立っている。タコは古風な車掌・チケット係の制服を着用し、静かに巨大な木の門を押し開く。カメラはその隙間へ猛スピードで突入する。

門を通過した瞬間、世界が一変する。海水が一気に引いていき、壮大なトランジション。眩しい太陽、青い空、揺れるヤシの木。そこは活気あふれるハワイアンビーチバー。陽光に照らされた白い砂浜では、海水パンツを履いた猫たちが大歓声を上げながらビーチバレーを楽しんでいる。カラフルなカクテル、サーフボード、トロピカルな装飾、陽気なウクレレとサマー・ジャズの演奏。

すると画面右側から巨大なぽっちゃりしたオレンジ猫が勢いよくフレームインする。オレンジ猫は貝殻のネックレスを首に掛け、青いトロピカルカクテルを片手に持っている。眉をひそめ、怒った表情でカメラへ近づく。超クローズアップ。オレンジ猫は観客を睨みながら英語で叫ぶ。

"Bro, where is your ticket?"

直後、オレンジ猫が拳を振り上げ、カメラへ向かって強烈なパンチを繰り出す。衝撃で画面が大きく揺れる。映像が破損したようなデジタルノイズ、グリッチ、信号障害音。激しい電子ノイズとともに画面は完全なブラックアウト。シネマティック、ユーモラス、予測不能な異世界アドベンチャー、ダイナミックなカメラワーク、映画級アニメーション品質、豊富な環境ディテール、鮮やかな色彩、圧倒的なスピード感。
entries.translated_prompt:
Japanese full-color animation. High-speed cinematic video set in a grand and fantastical underwater city. Features colorful coral skyscrapers, bioluminescent jellyfish streetlights, and transparent underwater roads. Countless fish, shrimp, crabs, and seahorses walk around in human clothes, piloting retro-futuristic underwater flying boats and diving scooters. The camera rushes through the underwater city with ultra-fast whip pan shots, capturing the vibrant life of the inhabitants.

Eventually, it reaches an area surrounded by a massive, ancient wall. In the center of the mossy, stained stone wall is a giant wooden gate. In front of the gate stands an expressionless octopus gatekeeper and ticket collector. The octopus wears an old-fashioned conductor/ticket collector uniform and silently pushes open the giant wooden gate. The camera charges into the gap at high speed.

The moment it passes through the gate, the world changes completely. The seawater recedes instantly in a grand transition. Dazzling sun, blue sky, and swaying palm trees appear. It's a lively Hawaiian beach bar. On the sun-drenched white sand, cats in swimming trunks are enjoying beach volleyball with loud cheers. Colorful cocktails, surfboards, tropical decorations, and cheerful ukulele and summer jazz music.

Then, a huge, chubby orange cat bursts into the frame from the right. The orange cat wears a seashell necklace and holds a blue tropical cocktail. It approaches the camera with a scowl and an angry expression. Super close-up. The orange cat glares at the audience and shouts in English: 'Bro, where is your ticket?'

Immediately after, the orange cat raises its fist and throws a powerful punch toward the camera. The screen shakes violently from the impact. Digital noise, glitches, and signal interference sounds as if the footage is corrupted. With intense electronic noise, the screen goes completely black. Cinematic, humorous, unpredictable otherworldly adventure, dynamic camerawork, movie-grade animation quality, rich environmental details, vivid colors, and an overwhelming sense of speed.

entries.title: Mega Crocodile vs Dam Military Operation
entries.description: A cinematic action prompt for a giant crocodile chasing a speedboat down a dam spillway with military intervention.
entries.prompt:
A giant crocodile, big as a bus, is chasing a military speedboat down a massive concrete dam spillway channel in bright stormy daylight. White water thundering, towering dam wall ahead, floodgate slowly closing. Sound: screaming outboard engines, crashing water, crocodile bellowing, klaxon alarm, radio chatter.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low rear tracking shot skimming the water. The speedboat rips down the spillway channel at full throttle, and the giant crocodile smashes through the floating boom barriers behind it, splintering them like matchsticks, jaws snapping at the engine wake. The driver glances back, yelling into his radio: "IT'S STILL ON US! IS THE GATE OPEN?"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Wide dramatic shot down the channel. Ahead, the huge steel floodgate is grinding downward, the gap beneath it shrinking, water roaring through. On the dam wall high above, a gunner with a rocket launcher sprints into position, screaming into his radio: "GATE'S CLOSING! YOU'VE GOT ONE SHOT — GO NOW!"

Shot 3 (6–9s): Side tracking shot at hull level. The boat hits maximum speed, spray exploding off the bow, the crocodile's jaws closing on the stern — its teeth clip the engine cowling — the driver throws his whole body forward as the boat threads under the descending gate with inches to spare, scraping steel.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The crocodile lunges through after it. Bullet time — the massive steel gate slams down across its back mid-lunge, pinning it, jaws thrashing wide in slow motion, white water and sparks suspended — and the rocket streaks down from the dam wall, straight into the pinned skull. Direct hit. The explosion blossoms against the dam face, fire and concrete dust blooming over the churning spillway.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The shockwave flattens the water. The speedboat skids out into the open river below, the driver looking back at the burning gate, fist raised. Above, the gunner lowers the smoking launcher and keys his radio: "Gate's closed." Cut.

entries.title: T-Rex vs Military Cargo Plane Action Scene
entries.description: A high-octane multi-shot action sequence featuring a T-Rex chasing a military cargo plane down a runway with a explosive payoff.
entries.prompt:
A T-rex-scale giant lizard is chasing a military cargo plane down a long runway at full takeoff speed in bright harsh daylight. Heat shimmer, dust clouds, scattered burning vehicles along the airstrip. Sound: screaming turboprops, thundering footsteps, roaring, ramp hydraulics, radio chatter.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Rear tracking shot from inside the open cargo ramp. The colossal lizard sprints down the runway behind the accelerating plane, head low, jaws snapping shut meters from the ramp where a lone soldier stands braced against the wind. Its footsteps crater the tarmac. The soldier screams into his headset: "IT'S FASTER THAN US! WE'RE NOT GONNA MAKE ROTATION!"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Cockpit shot. Pilots shoving throttles to the wall, runway end markers rushing closer in the windshield, the airframe shaking. Pilot: "Dump the load! DUMP EVERYTHING!" Behind them through the fuselage, the soldier slashes the cargo straps on a parked humvee with his knife.

Shot 3 (6–9s): Low side tracking shot at wheel height. The lizard lunges, jaws closing on the ramp edge — steel shrieks and buckles — the plane's tail dips. The soldier kicks the final strap loose and throws his whole body against the humvee as the deck tilts: "EAT THIS!"

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BULLET TIME PAYOFF: The humvee rolls off the ramp. Bullet time — it tumbles through the air in slow motion straight into the lizard's open mouth mid-stride. The monster bites down on three tons of steel, its sprint breaks, legs tangling — it trips at full speed, and the humvee's fuel tank detonates between its jaws. The giant body cartwheels down the runway inside a rolling fireball, tarmac chunks and flame suspended around it.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The cargo plane lifts off at the runway's last meter, climbing steeply over the burning, tumbling carcass below. The soldier hangs onto the mangled ramp, wind howling, laughing like a madman. The wreck burns down the runway behind them. Cut.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Time Traveler Cinematic Video Sequence
entries.description: A comprehensive multi-shot prompt for a sci-fi narrative featuring a time traveler in a collapsing laboratory, including specific camera directions like zooms and macro shots for a cinematic feel.
entries.prompt:
Traveler running slowly into a crumbling lab as machinery sparks and ceiling beams fall, dust in shafts of light, camera zooming out, cinematic entrance, shallow depth of field.
Traveler cranking a brass dial as gauges spike into the red, hands burning on hot metal, amber alarms flashing, cinematic close-up.
Extreme close-up of a chronometer spinning out of control, gears glowing and grinding, energy overloading, macro lens.
A ring of light tearing open violently, lightning arcing across the room, debris sucked toward it, dramatic backlight, extreme slow motion.
The portal destabilizing slowly, swirling energy spitting bolts that scorch the walls, room shaking apart, cinematic slow motion.
Traveler bracing against the pull, jaw clenched, hair and coat whipping in the storm, cinematic portrait.
Traveler lunging a hand toward the portal as a falling beam crashes behind them, ripples bursting from fingertips, dramatic spotlight, cinematic close-up.
Traveler diving slowly through the threshold as the lab collapses, swallowed by blinding light, cinematic reveal, volumetric light.
Traveler standing tall on the far side as the portal violently seals behind them, slow cinematic zoom out, hero moment, anamorphic look.
Extreme close-up of the portal imploding into a single point, sparks dying, slow cinematic push forward, glittering detail, dramatic light.

entries.title: Viral Shark Attack Fishing Boat
entries.description: A cinematic and high-tension prompt for creating a viral-style video of a shark attack on a fishing boat at night, featuring raw handheld movement and dramatic lighting.
entries.prompt:
Handheld mobile phone footage at night on a fishing boat deck in the open ocean. Bright boat lights illuminate the wet deck as large silver tuna suddenly leap out of the dark water and crash onto the boat. The fish flop and thrash violently while fishermen in orange and yellow rain gear react in panic, dodging and trying to grab the jumping tuna. Chaotic energy with people moving quickly and shouting. The shaky phone camera captures the wild scene with motion blur and raw handheld movement. In the final two seconds, a massive shark suddenly bursts out of the water right in front of the camera, mouth open - cut to static like the camera got damaged. 

Viral social media style, realistic night lighting, wet reflective surfaces, high tension and excitement, documentary-style handheld footage

entries.title: Road Rage Absurdist Comedy Scene
entries.description: A comprehensive two-shot video prompt for a realistic comedy short involving a road rage incident that transitions into a surreal bedroom sequence with comedic props.
entries.prompt: 写实固定机位短视频喜剧，两个分镜，所有角色均为明确成年人，衣着完整。道具全部是塑料卡通玩具或安全喜剧道具。整体是荒诞反转喜剧，不是真实暴力，不血腥，不血腥，不暧昧，不露骨。 [00:00-00:07] Shot 1 - 车内固定镜头： 夜晚汽车驾驶室内，镜头固定在中控台位置，完全静止：无推拉、无摇晃、无变焦、无重新构图。画面中一名邋遢成年男子 hf_20260506_032645_e6665446-0056-40fc-b99f-8d85619f8789 穿着脏白色背心正在开车，副驾驶坐着一名成年女性 穿着 。突然前方像是有人加塞，男子猛地急刹车，身体向前一顿，愤怒地拍方向盘。 他从座位旁边抽出一把夸张廉价的塑料卡通玩具刀，气冲冲地打开车门。副驾驶女性急忙劝他：“别去！都说了太危险！”男子完全不听，嘴里嘟囔：“我就问他两句！”然后下车移动出镜头外。车门“砰”地关上，女性留在车内，表情崩溃又无奈。 [00:07-00:15] Shot 2 - 室内固定镜头反转： 切到普通卧室内，镜头固定中景，完全静止。刚才的邋遢成年男子衣着完整地趴在床上，脸埋在枕头边，表情难受又忍耐，像刚被现实狠狠教育了一顿。女性座在男子背后（位置参考 hf_20260609_173858_0a2ea93a-89fc-4376-a250-0d2e8ea60474 (1) ），表情又气又无奈。 [00:07-00:09] 女性先隔着衣服在男子臀侧靠近后腰的位置狠狠拍了一下，配合夸张喜剧“啪”音效，然后生气地说：“看吧都跟你说了，不要去，太危险！” [00:09-00:12] 她从男子衣物遮挡住的后腰隐藏道具袋位置 hf_20260609_173858_0a2ea93a-89fc-4376-a250-0d2e8ea60474 (1) ，先拉出那把塑料卡通玩具刀，又拉出一只羽毛球拍。男子皱眉忍耐，露出滑稽后悔表情，背景响起夸张的婴儿哭声音效。 [00:12-00:15] 女性继续从同一个被遮挡的隐藏道具袋里拉出一长串连接不断的彩色布条，越拉越长，像魔术失败现场。男子把脸埋进枕头里，做出崩溃忍耐表情。女性最后拎着彩色布条看向镜头，满脸“早说了你不听”的无语表情，画面停在荒诞喜剧反转上。 Sound: 第一镜头有急刹车声、轮胎轻微摩擦声、方向盘拍击声、车门开启和关闭声、男子生气嘟囔、女性焦急中文劝阻。第二镜头有夸张喜剧“啪”音效、塑料玩具摩擦声、羽毛球拍被拉出的轻响、彩色布条连续沙沙声、床垫轻微吱呀声、滑稽婴儿哭声背景音效。无音乐，无真实痛苦惨叫。 Style: 写实低成本短视频喜剧质感。第一幕是夜晚车内冷色路灯光，第二幕是普通卧室暖色顶灯。人物动作生活化但反应夸张，道具明显廉价塑料感，整体节奏像固定机位拍摄的荒诞反转短剧。 Avoid: 禁止真实刀具、真实伤害、血迹、虐待感、裸露、性暗示、露骨身体部位、未成年人、额外角色、字幕、水印、镜头移动、镜头抖动、肢体扭曲、重复手臂、道具变形、房间变化、角色闪烁。
entries.translated_prompt: Realistic fixed-camera short video comedy, two scenes, all characters are adults, fully clothed. Props are all plastic cartoon toys or safe comedy props. Overall absurd reversal comedy, not real violence, not bloody, not ambiguous, not suggestive. entries.title: Anime Chibi Fusion in Tokyo
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a cinematic fusion video where 2D anime chibi characters interact naturally with real-world Tokyo cityscapes and magical effects.
entries.prompt:
現実の東京街並みの中に、ちびキャラが存在し、2Dエフェクトが現実と強く融合した世界観。エフェクトは画面に貼りついたように見えず、実写の空間・光・遠近感に完全に溶け込み、キャラクターの動きや感情に呼応して自然に発生・変化する。現実とエフェクトとちびが一体となった、爽やかで軽やか、少し魔法のような融合映像。

エフェクトは大幅に増量し、以下のものを多層的に配置：
- カラフルなリボン軌跡（ピンク・水色・黄色・白など）
- 手描き風の白い線、点線、円弧、矢印、軌道線
- 軽いスケッチ風オーバーレイと幾何学図形
- 紙吹雪・粒子・光の粒
これらは実写の奥行きに沿って前後左右に存在し、キャラクターの動きに反応して発生・変化する。

カット構成：

1カット目：眠そうに目をこすりながら歩道に出てくる。彼女の周囲にカラフルなリボン軌跡と白い手描き線が優しく舞い、足元から粒子がふわっと立ち上がる。カメラがゆっくり前進。

2カット目：のんびり歩きながら、彼女の体からリボン軌跡が何本も自然に伸びて周囲をなぞるように流れる。紙吹雪と白い軌道線が彼女の周りを優しく包み込む。カメラが横からトラッキング。

3カット目：あくびをする瞬間に、口元から優しい光の粒子と白い円弧がふわっと広がる。顔の周りに手描き風の記号線や小さな図形が軽やかに浮かぶ。カメラがゆっくり寄る。

4カット目：お店や車の横を歩く際、リボン軌跡が看板や車を優しくなぞるように通り抜ける。白い点線や矢印が彼女の歩く軌跡を強調するように出現。カメラが横移動。

5カット目：公園の桜の前で手を伸ばすと、桜の花びらとカラフルなリボン軌跡が融合して大きく舞い上がる。彼女の周囲に光の粒と手描き円弧が優しく回転。カメラが少し寄る。

6カット目：ビルを見上げながら歩く。ビルの高さに沿って長いリボン軌跡が空に向かって伸び、青空に白い軌道線と幾何学図形が浮かぶ。彼女の体から優しい光の粒子が舞う。ローアングル気味のカメラ。

7カット目：水たまりをふわっとジャンプする瞬間、周囲に水しぶき＋カラフルなリボン軌跡＋白い手描き線が大きく広がる。粒子と光の粒が跳ねて美しく舞う。カメラが少し引いて捉える。

8カット目：夕暮れのベンチに座る。彼女を中心にリボン軌跡と手描き線が優しく包み込み、夕陽の光に溶け合うように粒子がゆっくり舞う。カメラがゆっくり横移動しながら柔らかく締めくくる。

全体として、現実の東京風景・ちびきゃら・エフェクトが強く融合した世界観。エフェクトは過剰にSFっぽくせず、爽やかで軽やかで、少し詩的. エフェクトの量と動きをかなり増やし、各カットで密度高く、キャラクターの動きや感情にしっかり反応させる。カメラも各カットで確実に動いている。

Hyperrealistic anime style, warm golden lighting, cinematic. ### Scene 4 — 揚げたカツを切る A perfectly fried golden-brown tonkatsu rests on a wooden cutting board. Anime-style hands guide a large sharp knife, slicing the cutlet into even uniform strips. The crispy crust cracks cleanly with each cut, revealing tender white meat inside. Subtle steam escapes the cuts. Hyperrealistic anime style, dramatic top-angle kitchen lighting. ### Scene 5 — 出汁と玉ねぎを煮る Inside a wide shallow pan on a gas stove, thinly sliced onion rings simmer slowly in dashi broth. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm stovetop glow, cinematic close-up. ### Scene 6 — カツを出汁の上に置く Anime-style hands use chopsticks to carefully lay sliced tonkatsu strips side by side over the gently simmering onion and dashi broth in a shallow pan. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm amber kitchen lighting, close-up cinematic framing. ### Scene 7 — 溶き卵を回しかける A slow, steady pour of beaten golden egg from a small bowl, spiraling gently over the simmering tonkatsu and onions in the pan. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm stovetop light, macro cinematic detail. ### Scene 8 — 卵がゆっくり固まる Inside the shallow pan over low heat, the poured egg slowly coagulates across the surface of the tonkatsu and onions. Hyperrealistic anime style, soft warm glow, intimate close-up framing. ### Scene 9 — どんぶり茶碗にご飯を盛る A pristine white ceramic donburi bowl placed on a stainless steel counter. Light steam rises from the surface. Hyperrealistic anime style, clean soft kitchen lighting, close-up cinematic. ### Scene 10 — カツと卵をご飯の上に乗せる Anime-style hands use chopsticks to carefully slide the softly set egg-and-tonkatsu mixture from the pan directly onto the mound of white rice in the donburi bowl. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm overhead lighting, close-up cinematic detail. ### Scene 11 — 卵のグレーズが自然に落ち着く The finished katsudon bowl rests still on the counter. The soft golden egg glaze slowly settles and spreads naturally over the tonkatsu strips and rice, pooling gently at the sides. The surface is lightly trembling, semi-set, glossy with broth. No hands visible — pure still life in motion. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm diffused lighting, slow cinematic push-in. ### Scene 12 — 完成したカツ丼を提示する A beautifully finished katsudon is presented in a traditional blue-and-white ceramic donburi bowl on a wooden surface. Golden soft egg drapes over crispy tonkatsu strips atop glossy white rice. A small sprig of green mitsuba garnish is placed delicately on top. Wisps of steam rise gracefully. Camera slowly orbits the bowl in a cinematic arc. Hyperrealistic anime style, warm dramatic food photography lighting, cinematic. ## Audio: Upbeat Japanese city pop melody (80s-inspired, bright and breezy) layered with light Koto plucking and chime-like percussion, evoking a cheerful summer lunch atmosphere. Tempo around 110–120 BPM to match the energetic cooking pace. Crisp, satisfying ASMR cooking sound effects throughout: - Sharp, rhythmic knife chopping on a wooden board - Rapid bubbling and rolling boil of noodle water - Crisp clinking of ice cubes dropping into a glass bowl - Rushing water as noodles are rinsed under cold running water - Soft ceramic clink as the finished bowl is set on the counter - Final sound: a single light wind-chime tone as the completed Hiyashi Chuka is revealed, evoking a refreshing summer breeze ## AVOID: - Do NOT show storyboard panels, panel borders, panel numbers, arrows, camera notes, action notes, captions, subtitles, UI overlays, or any annotations in the final video. - Do NOT replicate or display any reference image or sketch passed as input. - Do NOT show any source material, wireframe, or illustration used as reference.

entries.title: Urban Square Giant Vision Assembly
entries.description: A structured prompt for creating a dynamic 15-second video showing the high-speed assembly and lighting up of a giant digital billboard in a modern urban square.
entries.prompt:
Title: Urban Square Giant Vision Assembly

1. [CONDITION DEFINITION]
   参照画像1枚を使用。1:1スクエア、15秒。現代的な都市広場の空きスペースに、スクエア型の巨大オーロラビジョンが高速モンタージュでゼロから組み上がる。周囲には高層ビル、都市建築、舗装された広場、街灯がすでにある。都市全体を建設するのではなく、広場の中に巨大イベントビジョンだけが新しく建設される。冒頭は明るい昼、建設が進むにつれて時間が流れ、完成時は夜。最後はライトアップされたイベント会場風になる。参照画像はスクリーン内の表示映像としてのみ使う。中盤からLEDパネルの一部に参照画像の色や輪郭が断片的に現れ、最後に全面へ美しく鮮明に表示される。参照画像の白背景はそのまま使わず、人物や主題を中心にイベントビジョン向けの洗練された表示ビジュアルとして再構成してよい。

2. [OPTIONAL PERFORMER LOOK]
   人物を主役にしない。観客がいても、夜のイベント会場の遠景シルエット程度。主役は巨大ビジョンの建設、点灯、完成表示。

3. [SHOT / FLOW]
   最初は地上目線で都市広場の空きスペースを見せる。すぐにカメラが一気に上昇して俯瞰になり、高速モンタージュ開始。土台、支柱、鉄骨フレーム、背面構造、ケーブル、LEDパネル、外装、照明機材が次々に組み上がる。中盤でLEDパネルが部分点灯し、参照画像の断片が少しずつ見え始める。後半は夕方から夜へ変化し、周辺照明とビジョンが起動。最後に参照画像がスクリーン全面に高精細で美しく表示される。ラストは少し引いて、夜の都市広場に完成した巨大ビジョン全体を見せる。

4. [CAMERA / EDITING]
   カメラは自由でダイナミック。地上目線、一気に俯瞰、斜め俯瞰、低い前進、スクリーン横通過、LEDパネルの寄り、完成後の引き全景を自然に組み合わせる。15秒内で2〜3回の自然な場面転換。高速モンタージュの気持ちよさ、パネルがはまる快感、昼から夜への時間変化、最後のライトアップ完成を重視。完成表示では参照画像を大きく、鮮明に、美しく見せる。

5. [SOUND]
   BGMなし。効果音のみ。金属フレームの組み立て音、支柱固定音、LEDパネルのクリック音、ケーブル接続音、機械駆動音、電子起動音、点灯音、ライトアップ起動音、都市広場の環境音、遠い観客のざわめき。セリフなし。ナレーションなし。no clear spoken commentary, no narration, no understandable dialogue.

6. [NEGATIVE]
   参照画像の人物や被写体をスクリーン外に実体として出さない。参照画像は巨大ビジョンの表示映像としてのみ使う。人物を主役にしない。観客をはっきり見せすぎない。都市全体をゼロから作らない。横長スクリーンにしすぎない。文字、ロゴ、透かし、ラベル、字幕、ブランドロゴ、実在イベント名、実在企業名を出さない。BGM、歌、実況、ナレーションを入れない。暗すぎる映像、くすんだ色、低コントラスト、雑なLED表示、崩れた参照画像、白背景のまま単調な表示を避ける。

entries.title: Street Soccer Bicycle Kick Action Sequence
entries.description: A comprehensive video generation prompt for a high-intensity street soccer match, featuring complex dribbling moves and a cinematic bicycle kick finish.
entries.prompt:
参考图 主角：使用角色卡人物。主角是街头足球高手，带球向前推进，身体重心低，眼神专注自信，动作灵活、有爆发力，脚法干净。主角始终是画面核心。

其他球员：场上有多名防守者，不是一个人防守。防守者从不同方向上前逼抢，有人侧面封堵，有人正面拦截，有人从后方追赶。每个防守者动作都像真实踢足球的人：伸脚抢断、转身追防、急停、失去重心、被过掉后回头追。

动作流程：
0-3 秒：主角在中前场带球启动，低身快速推进。第一名防守者从正面上来抢球，主角用脚内侧轻拨、身体假晃，从他身侧过掉。足球贴近脚下，滚动清晰。
3-6 秒：第二和第三名防守者从左右两侧夹击。主角连续做踩单车、拉球转身、脚外侧变向，足球在两脚之间快速切换，主角从夹缝中穿过。两名防守者被晃开，一个停顿失位，一个转身追赶。
6-9 秒：主角继续带球高速推进，第四名防守者从侧面伸脚抢断。主角轻巧挑球过脚，足球短暂弹起越过防守者的脚面，然后落回主角前方。主角加速追上球，场边人群开始明显惊呼。
9-11 秒：主角接近禁区或小球门前，最后一名防守者和门将同时压上。主角用脚尖把足球挑到半空，球带着清晰旋转飞到自己前上方。主角调整步伐，准备倒挂金钩。
11-14 秒：主角后仰腾空，完成完整倒挂金钩。动作要清楚、有力、真实：背部向后倾倒，双腿剪刀式摆动，一条腿精准踢中空中的足球，另一条腿保持平衡。足球被踢出后高速飞向球门，穿过防守者和门将之间，进入球门，球网明显震动。
14-15 秒：主角落地后保持酷炫姿态，场边人群爆发欢呼，防守者和门将转头看向球门，露出震惊反应。人群可以跳起、举手、喊叫，但不要冲进场内包围主角。最后画面停留在进球后的震撼瞬间。

镜头语言：手持竖屏跟拍主角推进。开头从场边中景拍主角带球，突破时镜头跟随主角横向和向前移动，有真实手抖和运动模糊。过多人时镜头保持主角和足球在画面中心。倒挂金钩时镜头自然上抬，确保能看清主角腾空、踢中足球、足球飞进球门。不要切镜，不要多机位，不要无人机，不要稳定器。

声音：足球滚动和摩擦地面的声音，球鞋快速踩踏地面声，防守者急停和追赶声，围观人群逐渐升高的惊呼声。主角连续过人时人群喊叫越来越大，倒挂金钩踢中球时有清脆有力的击球声，进球后球网震动声和全场爆发欢呼声。

视觉重点：主角连续带球过掉多名防守者，足球始终清楚可见，最后倒挂金钩进球。动作要像真实足球进攻：带球、变向、摆脱、挑球、射门。不要写成单挑，不要让所有人站着不动，不要让防守者只摆姿势。
entries.translated_prompt:
Reference: Main Character: Use a character card persona. The protagonist is a street soccer expert, driving the ball forward with a low center of gravity, focused and confident eyes, agile and explosive movements, and clean footwork. The protagonist is always the core of the scene.

Other Players: There are multiple defenders on the field, not just one. Defenders press from different directions—some blocking from the side, some intercepting from the front, and some chasing from behind. Every defender's movement mimics real soccer play: lunging for a tackle, turning to chase, sudden stops, losing balance, and looking back to chase after being dribbled past.

Action Sequence:
0-3 seconds: The protagonist starts dribbling in the mid-front field, advancing rapidly with a low stance. The first defender comes from the front to steal the ball; the protagonist uses the inside of the foot to flick the ball and a body feint to bypass them. The soccer ball stays close to the feet, rolling clearly.
3-6 seconds: The second and third defenders pin from both sides. The protagonist performs consecutive step-overs, drag-back turns, and outside-foot direction changes, with the ball switching quickly between feet, passing through the gap. The two defenders are shaken off—one stalls out of position, the other turns to chase.
6-9 seconds: The protagonist continues advancing at high speed, and a fourth defender lunges from the side. The protagonist deftly chips the ball over the defender's foot, the ball bouncing briefly over the foot before landing back in front of the protagonist. The protagonist accelerates to catch up, as the crowd on the sidelines starts to gasp audibly.
9-11 seconds: Approaching the penalty area or small goal, the last defender and the goalkeeper press up simultaneously. The protagonist uses the toe to flick the ball into the mid-air, with it spinning clearly in front and above. The protagonist adjusts their steps, preparing for a bicycle kick.
11-14 seconds: The protagonist leaps backward into the air, completing a full bicycle kick. The action must be clear, powerful, and realistic: back leaning backward, legs performing a scissor-kick motion, one leg accurately striking the airborne ball while the other maintains balance. The kicked ball flies into the goal at high speed, passing between the defender and the goalkeeper, with the net shaking visibly.
14-15 seconds: After landing, the protagonist maintains a cool pose; the crowd erupts in cheers, and the defenders and goalkeeper turn to look at the goal with shocked reactions. The crowd can jump, raise hands, and shout, but do not swarm the protagonist. The final shot freezes on the impactful moment after the goal.

Cinematography: Handheld vertical follow shot of the protagonist's advance. Start with a medium shot from the sidelines; during the breakthrough, the camera follows the protagonist laterally and forward, with realistic hand shake and motion blur. When passing multiple people, keep the protagonist and the ball at the center of the frame. During the bicycle kick, the camera naturally tilts up to ensure a clear view of the protagonist airborne, striking the ball, and the ball entering the net. No jump cuts, no multi-camera setups, no drones, no gimbals.

Sound: Sounds of the ball rolling and friction with the ground, rapid footsteps of sneakers, defenders' sudden stops and chasing sounds, and the rising gasps from the spectators. The shouting gets louder as the protagonist bypasses people consecutively, with a crisp and powerful striking sound during the bicycle kick, followed by the net vibration and a global eruption of cheers after the goal.

Visual Focus: The protagonist consecutively dribbling past multiple defenders, with the ball always clearly visible, ending with a bicycle kick goal. Movements should mimic real soccer offense: dribbling, direction changes, shaking off opponents, chipping the ball, and shooting. Do not make it a 1-on-1 duel, do not have everyone standing still, and do not have defenders just posing.

entries.prompt:
A rookie pizza delivery boy receives an urgent order and rushes through a vibrant city on his scooter. Already running late, he is determined to deliver the pizza on time. But the day quickly turns into chaos. A sudden storm floods the streets, traffic blocks every shortcut, and an angry bulldog starts chasing him through the city.

Trying to escape, he accidentally rides into a bicycle race, gets swept into a city marathon, and then crashes into a colorful parade. Every obstacle somehow pushes him forward instead of slowing him down. The bulldog keeps chasing him, the crowds keep cheering, and the delivery boy has no idea that people now think he's competing in a major race.

The chaos grows bigger and bigger as he runs through packed streets, cheering spectators, and city landmarks. Still holding the pizza, he unknowingly takes the lead and sprints toward the finish line. Confetti cannons explode as he crosses first place. The crowd goes wild. Reporters surround him. He is handed a giant trophy and celebrated as a champion.

Proud of his victory, he rushes to complete the delivery. He finally arrives at the customer's door, exhausted but smiling, and proudly hands over the pizza.

The customer checks the receipt, looks up, and casually says:

"I ordered this yesterday."

The delivery boy freezes in shock. The bulldog finally catches up and sits happily beside him. The crowd laughs, the trophy feels meaningless, and all that chaos was for a pizza that was already a day late.

中景广角。

空气突然安静。

0.0-0.8秒
空拍鏡頭高速俯衝進入豪華飯店會議廳，數百名賓客盛裝出席。舞台中央，英俊霸總身穿深藍色高級訂製西裝站在講台上演講。背後巨大LED螢幕顯示璀璨杜拜飯店夜景與巨大紅色英文字「Celebration」。史詩交響樂響起。

0.8-1.6秒

1.6-2.4秒

2.4-3.2秒

3.2-4.0秒
主觀視角。賓客們的臉逐漸模糊變形，畫面輕微旋轉暈眩。

4.0-4.8秒
霸總腳步踉蹌。慢動作。講稿從手中滑落。

4.8-5.6秒
身穿白色鑲鑽晚禮服的美麗女司儀立刻衝上舞台。高速跟拍鏡頭。

5.6-6.4秒

6.4-7.2秒

7.2-8.0秒

8.0-8.8秒
一隻穿灰色道袍、手拿黃皮紙袋的橘貓從畫面外高速衝入，電影級滑軌跟拍。

8.8-9.6秒

9.6-10.4秒

10.4-11.2秒

11.2-12.0秒

12.0-12.8秒

12.8-13.8秒

entries.title: First-Person POV Broomstick Chase

entries.prompt: First-person POV flying on a broomstick in a fast cinematic one-take chase through the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium during a live FIFA World Cup match. A small golden glowing football stays ahead as the object being chased, moving naturally across the frame instead of staying locked in the centre — let it shift left, right, higher, and lower during the sequence so the pursuit feels dynamic and real. Keep the motion smooth and continuous with no cuts. Do not show guide lines, arrows, extra characters, broken broom parts, duplicate body parts, or any face reflections. entries.title: Deep Space Convoy Failure
entries.description: A sci-fi action prompt for a deep space scenario where a cargo convoy suffers a catastrophic collision chain reaction.
entries.prompt:
Deep space cargo convoy: massive containers and industrial modules being transported when a single failure triggers a cascading chain reaction.  
Wide shot: convoy moving in formation, huge cargo blocks linked together. 
Failure point: one connector snaps, a container drifting slightly off-path. 
Immediate danger: another module clips it, sending both into slow but unstoppable rotation. 
Chain reaction: collisions spread across the convoy, each impact changing trajectories. 
Close tracking: a ship weaving through spinning cargo, gaps constantly closing. 
Near-crush: two massive containers slam together just behind the ship. 
Tight squeeze: pilot threads through a collapsing corridor of shifting metal blocks. 
Momentum shift: a giant module starts drifting directly into the escape path. 
Last-second dive: ship drops under it, barely clearing the edge. 
Final moment: debris field expanding, everything still moving, no stable space left.  
Heavy, readable motion, physical weight, constant “closing gaps” tension.

entries.title: Confectionery Cat Tractor Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed technical prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a kitten driving a tractor through a candy-themed landscape with complex physics.
entries.prompt:
SCENE: A surreal confectionery topography. Undulating hills composed of high-viscosity pink strawberry buttercream frosting with realistic subsurface scattering (0.4cm mean free path), bisected by a slow-moving river of molten golden caramel with a refractive index of 1.43. Giant semi-buried chocolate-chip cookies with cracked, matte-textured surfaces are embedded in granular crystalline sucrose sands.

SUBJECT: A juvenile ginger tabby cat. Fur is modeled with individual hair-strand physics featuring anisotropic specular reflection. Wearing a miniature 12oz indigo denim trucker cap with distinct orange double-needle chain-stitching and a pair of distressed lambskin leather driving gloves with functional brass snap closures. Eyes show distinct amber irises, radial pupillary contraction, and a wet corneal reflection of the environment.

ACTION: The subject operates a vintage 1950s green-and-yellow farm tractor. The oversized, deep-tread rubber tires rotate at 120 RPM, creating mechanical shear displacement against a cohesive substrate of moist, crumbly chocolate-brownie soil. This action ejects high-velocity particulate ejecta: cohesive dollops of viscoelastic whipped cream and granular cake crumbs. The vertical steel exhaust stack emits periodic puffs of carbon-soot particulate matter, which instantly nucleate and wrap around suspended micro-particles of dry powdered sugar in a helical vortex.

CAMERA: Dynamic low-angle tracking camera mounted on a 3-axis gyro-stabilized gimbal, running parallel to the left rear tire at a 15-degree offset. Filmed on a Panavision Panaflex Millennium XL2 with C-Series Anamorphic Prime Lenses (35mm, T1.8), creating characteristic horizontal blue flare, oval bokeh, and a razor-thin 5cm depth-of-field focused on the cat's lateral eye profile. Organic high-frequency vibration artifacts match the 15Hz diesel engine oscillation.

RENDER: Photoreal spectral ray-tracing. Volumetric participating media simulating a warm, humid atmosphere suspended with crystalline sugar dust using Mie scattering. Multi-phase fluid simulation tracking the viscous caramel splash mechanics with surface-tension adhesion to the metal chassis. Color grading mapped to a Kodak Vision3 500T 5219 profile, emphasizing deep warm undertones and rich, saturated earth tones.

MODEL OPTIMIZATION: Configured for Seedance 2's advanced physics solver. The prompt details boundary interactions between three distinct material phases (viscoelastic whipped cream, granular brownie soil, and rigid rubber tires) alongside high-frequency mechanical vibration to lock spatial coherence across sequential frames.

entries.title: Cinematic Anime Motorcycle Touring
entries.description: A high-budget anime style prompt for a multi-cut sequence of a female rider touring highlands on a cruiser bike, including specific VFX and camera directions.
entries.prompt:
制作費30億円規模の架空アニメ映画PV。

# テーマ
黒いクルーザーバイクで高原道路を走る紫髪の女性ライダー。疾走の快感だけでなく、風を受けた一瞬の表情、停車した時の深呼吸、空へ抜ける祝福の余韻まで描く。観客が「この旅に出たい」と感じる、15秒のオリジナル・シネマティックアニメPV。

### VFX指定
路面反射、背景パララックス、風で揺れる髪、透明シールド反射、レザーの光沢、タイヤ周りの薄い砂埃、草原の波、太陽フレア、飛行機雲、白い雲文字

# 制約
- チープでB級映画のような粗雑な表現は絶対にしない。
- カメラ技法、ライティング、エフェクト、CG効果を最大限に高める。
- 登場人物やアイテムの破綻禁止。
- BGM無し
- テキスト、ロゴ、透かし、UI表示を入れない。ただし最終Cutの飛行機雲文字「Have a wonderful day to you」だけは例外。
- 女性の顔、紫髪、毛先ピンク、オッドアイ、黒レザー衣装、ブーツ、体型を維持。
- バイクは黒いロー＆ロング系クルーザーバイクを維持。
- ヘルメットは黒いジェットヘルメット、透明シールド、丸いシェル、サイドヒンジを維持。ラベルや文字は出さない。
- 走行中は透明シールドを下げる。停車時はシールドを額側へ跳ね上げる。別体ゴーグルは禁止。
- 危険運転、事故、ジャンプ、極端な蛇行は禁止。

# 情景
晴れた高原リゾート道路。やまなみハイウェイ風の緑の丘陵、遠い山並み、広い青空、白い雲。道路の白線とガードレールが奥へ伸び、草原が風で波打つ。実在看板や地名は出さない。

# 参照素材
### キャラクター
主人公の外見固定。ヘルメット装備時も顔立ち、紫髪、オッドアイを読めるようにする。

### バイク
黒いクルーザーバイク固定。

### ヘルメット
黒いジェットヘルメット固定。透明シールド、丸い黒シェル、サイドヒンジ、黒い縁取りを維持。

# シーン
Cut 1: -0:02.0
Camera: extreme low angle tracking shot、路面すれすれで前輪と白線を高速に見せ、最後に主人公のシルエットへ tilt up。
Action: 主人公が黒いクルーザーバイクで高原道路を走る。
Effect: 白線の流れ、タイヤ周りの薄い砂埃、黒い車体の反射。
Detail: 顔とバイク形状は崩さず、スピード感は背景で出す。
Mood: 冒頭から視線を掴む疾走感。

Cut 2: .0-0:04.5
Camera: side tracking shot から close-up へ smooth push in。
Action: 主人公が風を受け、シールド越しに小さく微笑む。
Effect: 透明シールドに青空が映り、紫髪の毛先が風で揺れる。
Detail: オッドアイがシールド越しに見える。
Mood: 自由、透明感、ヒロインの魅力。

Cut 3: .5-0:06.6
Camera: whip pan transition で走行から見晴らし駐車場へ転換。
Action: バイクが静かに停車する。
Effect: 車体の軽い沈み込み、草原の風、遠景の山並み。
Detail: 看板や文字は出さない。
Mood: スピードから静けさへの転調。

Cut 4: .6-0:09.5
Camera: medium shot から slow orbit dolly、最後に close-up。
Action: 主人公が透明シールドを額側へ跳ね上げ、背伸びしながら「うーん！きもちいいー！」と言う。
Effect: 髪と衣装が風で揺れ、柔らかい逆光が顔を照らす。
Detail: 口パク同期. 字幕なし. シールドは手に持たずヘルメットに接続されたまま。
Mood: 解放感、かわいらしさ、旅の喜び。

Cut 5: .5-0:12.2
Camera: rear low angle から crane up。
Action: 主人公が再び走り出し、まっすぐな道路の奥へ小さくなる。
Effect: エンジン音が遠ざかり、道路の線が画面奥へ吸い込まれる。
Detail: 黒いバイクとヘルメットのシルエットを維持。
Mood: 旅の続き、余韻。

Cut 6: .2-0:15.0
Camera: vertical tilt up、道路から青空へ抜ける。
Action: 飛行機雲が「Have a wonderful day to you」と空に描く。
Effect: 白い雲文字、澄んだ青空、柔らかな光。
Detail: 英文は正確に「Have a wonderful day to you」。字幕ではなく飛行機雲。
Mood: 祝福、開放、記憶に残るラスト。

# 音声
BGM無し。低いエンジン音、風音、タイヤ音、高原の環境音。Cut 4 の台詞「うーん！きもちいいー！」のみ明瞭に聞かせる。
entries.translated_prompt:
A fictional anime movie PV with a production budget of 3 billion yen.

# Theme
A purple-haired female rider riding a black cruiser motorcycle on a highland road. It depicts not only the thrill of speed, but also the momentary expression when catching the wind, a deep breath when stopped, and the lingering sense of blessing that escapes into the sky. A 15-second original cinematic anime PV that makes the audience feel 'I want to go on this journey.'

### VFX Specifications
Road surface reflections, background parallax, hair swaying in the wind, transparent shield reflections, leather gloss, thin dust around tires, waves in the grassland, solar flare, contrails, white cloud text.

# Constraints
- Absolutely no cheap or crude expressions like a B-movie.
- Maximize camera techniques, lighting, effects, and CG effects.
- No breakdown of characters or items.
- No BGM.
- No text, logos, watermarks, or UI displays. However, the contrail text 'Have a wonderful day to you' in the final cut is an exception.
- Maintain the woman's face, purple hair, pink tips, heterochromia (odd eyes), black leather outfit, boots, and body shape.
- Maintain the motorcycle as a black low & long cruiser.
- Maintain the helmet as a black jet helmet with a transparent shield, round shell, and side hinges. Do not show labels or text.
- Lower the transparent shield while driving. Flip the shield up toward the forehead when stopped. Separate goggles are prohibited.
- Dangerous driving, accidents, jumps, and extreme zigzagging are prohibited.

# Scene
A sunny highland resort road. Green hills like the Yamanami Highway, distant mountain ranges, a wide blue sky, and white clouds. The white lines on the road and guardrails extend into the distance, and the grassland waves in the wind. Do not show real signs or place names.

# Reference Materials
### Character
Fix the protagonist's appearance. Ensure her facial features, purple hair, and odd eyes are legible even when wearing a helmet.

### Motorcycle
Fixed as a black cruiser motorcycle.

### Helmet
Fixed as a black jet helmet. Maintain the transparent shield, round black shell, side hinges, and black trim.

# Scenes
Cut 1: -0:02.0
Camera: extreme low angle tracking shot, showing the front wheel and white line at high speed right above the road surface, finally tilting up to the protagonist's silhouette.
Action: The protagonist rides a black cruiser motorcycle on a highland road.
Effect: Flowing white lines, thin dust around the tires, reflections on the black body.
Detail: Speed is expressed through the background without breaking the face or motorcycle shape.
Mood: A sense of speed that grabs the viewer's attention from the beginning.

Cut 2: .0-0:04.5
Camera: side tracking shot to smooth push in for a close-up.
Action: The protagonist catches the wind and smiles slightly through the shield.
Effect: The blue sky is reflected in the transparent shield, and the pink tips of her purple hair sway in the wind.
Detail: Her odd eyes are visible through the shield.
Mood: Freedom, transparency, the heroine's charm.

Cut 3: .5-0:06.6
Camera: whip pan transition from riding to a scenic parking area.
Action: The motorcycle stops quietly.
Effect: Slight sinking of the vehicle body, wind in the grassland, distant mountain ranges.
Detail: No signs or text.
Mood: A transition from speed to stillness.

Cut 4: .6-0:09.5
Camera: medium shot to slow orbit dolly, finally a close-up.
Action: The protagonist flips the transparent shield up to her forehead, stretches, and says, 'Ugh! It feels so good!'
Effect: Her hair and outfit sway in the wind, and soft backlighting illuminates her face.
Detail: Lip-sync. No subtitles. The shield is attached to the helmet, not held in hand.
Mood: A sense of release, cuteness, the joy of the journey.

Cut 5: .5-0:12.2
Camera: rear low angle to crane up.
Action: The protagonist starts riding again, becoming smaller as she moves down the straight road.
Effect: The engine sound recedes, and the lines of the road are sucked into the back of the screen.
Detail: Maintain the silhouette of the black motorcycle and helmet.
Mood: Continuation of the journey, lingering memory.

Cut 6: .2-0:15.0
Camera: vertical tilt up, moving from the road into the blue sky.
Action: A contrail draws 'Have a wonderful day to you' in the sky.
Effect: White cloud text, clear blue sky, soft light.
Detail: The English text must be accurately 'Have a wonderful day to you'. It's a contrail, not a subtitle.
Mood: Blessing, liberation, a memorable ending.

# Audio
No BGM. Low engine sound, wind noise, tire noise, highland environmental sounds. Only the dialogue in Cut 4 'Ugh! It feels so good!' should be clearly audible.

entries.title: Celestial Dragon Mythology Transformation

entries.prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic mythological fantasy transformation sequence atop a sacred mountain above the clouds during a violent celestial storm.

A lone ancient warrior stands at the summit holding a ceremonial spear. Dark storm clouds swirl around the mountain while golden sunlight breaks through gaps in the heavens.

The camera slowly circles around the warrior as powerful winds intensify. The clouds begin spiraling unnaturally toward him. Lightning flashes across the sky, illuminating ancient symbols carved into the mountain peak.

The camera pushes closer as floating cloud ribbons wrap around his body. Pieces of the storm itself become part of the transformation. His silhouette grows larger and more powerful with every second.

Gigantic dragon claws emerge from his hands. Golden scales spread across his body. The surrounding storm rotates faster and faster, creating a colossal vortex around the mountain summit.

At the climax, the warrior launches upward into the sky. His body dissolves into swirling clouds, golden light, and celestial energy before reforming into a magnificent eastern dragon made of living storm clouds, radiant scales, and divine light.

The dragon spirals through the heavens above the mountain, weaving between thunderclouds while lightning follows its movement.

entries.title: Post-Apocalyptic Cinematic Warrior Sequence
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot cinematic prompt for a post-apocalyptic action scene featuring a warrior, a mechanical bird, and a colossal monster.
entries.prompt:
Post-apocalyptic ruined city in dark cloudy daylight. Hyper-realistic professional film look, weathered concrete, rusted metal, drifting dust, smoke and haze across collapsed skyscrapers, broken highways, distant fires. Wind carries ash and debris through the air.

CHARACTER: male warrior [IMAGE REFERENCE] in futuristic tribal hunter armor — layered leather and tactical fabric, metallic plates, glowing blue accents, ropes and utility pouches, weathered battle detail; dirty sweaty face, scars, natural skin texture, absolutely no plastic CGI look. He carries a futuristic energy spear.

SHOT 1 (2s) — Close-up of the warrior standing on the edge of a tall ruined skyscraper. He raises a hand to his face, places two fingers in his mouth and gives a loud sharp whistle — a hunter's calling signal. Wind moves through his hair and armor straps; camera slowly pushes in toward his face.

SHOT 2 (1s) — Low-angle shot of the smoky cloudy sky. A gigantic mechanical-organic bird bursts dramatically through the clouds, wings spreading wide, metal feathers rattling, mist and debris exploding outward from its emergence.

SHOT 3 (2s) — Aggressive handheld tracking shot. The warrior sprints across the ruined rooftop, boots smashing cracked concrete, and leaps powerfully off the edge into open air. The giant bird swoops past beneath him at high speed; his hand violently grabs onto the bird's massive clawed leg at the last second. Strong wind, dust, motion blur.

SHOT 4 (2s) — Wide cinematic shot. The warrior hangs from the giant bird's clawed leg, body swinging in the wind as the bird flies fast and straight directly over the battlefield. Below, a colossal monster rampages through the ruined streets while soldiers in similar armor fight it with futuristic energy weapons amid explosions and collapsing buildings. The bird passes precisely above the monster's back. Smoke and sparks streak past, intense motion blur.

SHOT 5 (1s) — Extreme close-up of the warrior's hand letting go of the bird's massive clawed leg. Fingers uncurl from the metallic-organic talon, wind whipping past, slight slow-motion feel as the contact breaks.

SHOT 6 (2s) — The warrior falls vertically straight down through smoky air toward the monster, gripping the futuristic spear in both hands in front of him. Mechanical sections of the spear unfold and rotate open with sharp metallic movements; intense blue energy floods the glowing lines along the weapon, crackling with electric arcs, pulsing brighter and brighter as the air distorts around the tip. His face is fierce, focused, roaring.

SHOT 7 (2s) — The warrior lands directly on top of the colossal monster and drives the fully charged spear deep into its back, the blade sinking in to the hilt.

entries.title: Surreal Hakone Ekiden Gliding Marathon
entries.description: A surreal video prompt mimicking a low-resolution Japanese sports broadcast of a marathon runner who glides motionless across the screen.
entries.prompt: 一段 10 秒竖屏 9:16 的日本箱根駅传电视直播录像，画质像低清体育转播录屏，480p 压缩感，强日光，普通电视台色彩，轻微锐化和运动模糊。画面是一条宽阔城市公路赛道，冬天晴天蓝天，路边裸树，观众站在护栏后，远处有跑者队伍和白色转播摩托。画面中央固定着一名清瘦日本男长跑选手，穿深蓝色无袖比赛服和短裤，胸前白色号码布写着 3，戴白色手套、白袜、鲜红跑鞋，短黑发，表情呆滞严肃，身体笔直，双臂垂直放在身体两侧，双脚并拢。他完全不像在跑步，而是像一个真实的人被定格后放进比赛直播里，始终正对镜头站着不动；但是背景道路、白色车道线、观众、摩托和其他选手都在不断向后流动，制造出他“站着滑行穿过赛道”的荒诞错觉。镜头是日本体育直播的长焦摩托车跟拍机位，不要电影感，不要稳定器质感，要像真实转播摄像机在车上倒退拍摄，主体始终居中，构图有点笨拙。前 2 秒是全身正面，2 到 4 秒突然切到低机位脚部特写，红色跑鞋并在一起贴着地面，路面在脚下流动但脚没有迈步；4 秒后切回全身，镜头稍微拉远，背景变得更空旷，摩托在他身后，计时器继续跳动。画面顶部左侧有白底黑字的日文赛段图形，顶部右侧有大号黑白计时器，底部有蓝白渐变选手姓名条和“残り 2.3km”之类的距离信息，文字可以略微不准但必须像日本直播字幕。整体要真实、低清、荒诞、冷幽默，像早期 Sora 生成的电视直播梦境，不要让选手跑起来，不要让他迈步，不要夸张表情，不要电影调色，不要动漫，不要现代短视频字幕，不要真实电视台 logo，不要明显 CGI，不要多余肢体，不要脸变形。
entries.translated_prompt: A 10-second vertical 9:16 video of a Japanese Hakone Ekiden TV live broadcast, with quality like a low-res sports broadcast screen recording, 480p compression feel, strong sunlight, ordinary TV station colors, slight sharpening, and motion blur. The scene is a wide urban road track, a sunny winter day with a blue sky, bare trees on the roadside, spectators standing behind guardrails, and a group of runners and a white broadcast motorcycle in the distance. Fixed in the center of the frame is a thin Japanese male long-distance runner, wearing a dark blue sleeveless racing uniform and shorts, with a white bib number 3 on his chest, white gloves, white socks, and bright red running shoes, short black hair, with a dull and serious expression, body straight, arms hanging vertically at his sides, and feet together. He doesn't look like he's running at all; instead, he looks like a real person frozen and placed into a live broadcast, always facing the camera and standing still. However, the background road, white lane lines, spectators, motorcycles, and other runners are constantly flowing backward, creating the absurd illusion that he is "gliding through the track while standing." The camera is a telephoto motorcycle follow shot from a Japanese sports broadcast; do not make it cinematic, do not use a stabilizer texture, make it look like a real broadcast camera filming backward from a vehicle, with the subject always centered and a somewhat clumsy composition. The first 2 seconds are a full-body frontal shot, from 2 to 4 seconds it suddenly cuts to a low-angle foot close-up, red running shoes together close to the ground, the road surface flowing under the feet but the feet not stepping; after 4 seconds it cuts back to full-body, the camera zooms out slightly, the background becomes more open, the motorcycle is behind him, and the timer continues to run. There is a Japanese segment graphic with black characters on a white background at the top left of the screen, a large black and white timer at the top right, and a blue and white gradient runner name bar at the bottom with distance information like "残り 2.3km". The text can be slightly inaccurate but must look like Japanese broadcast subtitles. The overall tone should be realistic, low-res, absurd, and dry humor, like an early Sora-generated TV broadcast dream; do not let the runner run, do not let him step, no exaggerated expressions, no cinematic color grading, no anime, no modern short video subtitles, no real TV station logos, no obvious CGI, no extra limbs, and no face distortion.
