entries.translated_prompt: Presented in the style of unprocessed iPhone handheld vertical video footage, with all camera settings on automatic and no post-color grading or effects. The footage carries a realistic sense of the operator's breathing and slight irregular handheld jitter, with autofocus occasionally searching and briefly losing focus, and automatic white balance naturally switching between outdoor sunlight and shadows. The image is overall flat and slightly whitish, preserving realistic lens flares, slight motion blur, and a subtle sense of edge compression characteristic of mobile phone shooting. Uses only in-camera natural environmental sound effects (golf course wind, grass rustling, faint footsteps, fabric swaying, the subtle sound of the ball being hit), with no background music and slight microphone distortion during loud sounds. Employs a pure first-person handheld POV perspective (subjective view of a girl lying on the ground), with lens movement following the operator's instinctive reactions, occasionally imperfect composition, and authentic breathing jitter. 0-2 seconds: The camera is positioned very low, lying on the golf course grass in a first-person handheld vertical POV. A woman wearing [Image Asset 1] is giggling close to the lens, showing half a smiling face and shoulder, looking mischievous and happy. A golf ball and tee are placed in the center of her hips for composition reference [Image Asset 2]. In the background, another woman stands on the grass, holding a golf club in a prepared swing pose reference. Bright sunlight, lush green grass, with tall trees and blue sky with white clouds in the background. The footage features slight handheld jitter and natural wind sounds. 2-5 seconds: The woman in black in the background performs a forceful, complete swing. The strong airflow instantly drives ground currents; the hips and back of the woman in the foreground lying down are violently vibrated by the airflow, and her white qipao skirt shows intense and obvious waving. The golf ball is 'hit' and flies out from the center of her hips. She continues to smile at the camera, but her body is clearly affected by the airflow and the ball flying away. Autofocus briefly searches during the swing, body waving, and the flying ball before relocking; the image shakes slightly. 5-7 seconds: The woman in black completes her follow-through and pants slightly. The woman in the foreground in the qipao is still smiling at the camera; the golf ball and tee at the center of her hips are gone. Autofocus switches back and forth between the two; the camera maintains a low angle, with the compression and breathing sounds of a real phone selfie throughout. 7-9 seconds: A middle-aged male golfer in a white golf shirt, white shorts, and a white hat walks into the frame from the back left, standing at the edge of the grass looking at them, club in hand, looking confused yet amused. The two girls spot him simultaneously; the qipao woman in the foreground laughs instantly, and the black-clad woman in the background also breaks character and squats down laughing. Autofocus searches intensely before relocking on the middle-aged man's appearance; the screen shakes noticeably. 9-10 seconds: The two girls lose it completely; the qipao woman in the foreground moves the phone even closer laughing, and the black-clad woman in the background squats on the ground doubled over in laughter. The lens continues to jitter slightly, capturing the moment of their natural laughter until the video ends naturally. The footage presents a realistic unprocessed handheld vertical video texture, documentary-level natural imperfection, without any post-color grading, effects, or exaggerated performance. All camera behaviors conform to the physical characteristics of iPhone automatic shooting.

entries.title: Magnetic Archipelago Sci-Fi Animation
entries.description: A complex multi-shot sci-fi animation prompt describing a magnetic archipelago with floating metallic islands and high-speed flight craft weaving through shifting terrain.
entries.prompt:
SHOT 1
Camera is already racing just above a vast sky-sea made of floating metallic islands suspended in a magnetic field, each island slowly drifting and rotating like ships frozen in time. Two high-speed flight craft skim across the surface layer between islands, one white with blue energy lines and one dark graphite with orange magnetic pulses, weaving through shifting terrain that rises and sinks unpredictably.
SHOT 2
The white craft slips between two massive floating landplates as they slide apart. The dark craft follows through the narrowing gap. Camera tilts and rolls as entire islands rotate like gears around them.
SHOT 3
They drop into a low corridor formed by stacked magnetic debris fields, where floating metal fragments orbit like storms. The camera stays tight, threading through spinning structures and drifting industrial ruins held together by invisible force fields.
SHOT 4
Inside a transparent control sphere embedded in a floating island, a lone operator floats weightless, watching as the craft streak past outside. Reflections ripple across the curved glass as islands rotate around the capsule.
SHOT 5
The craft ascend through a vertical magnetic lift zone where islands align into a spiral staircase in mid-air. Camera corkscrews upward with them.
SHOT 6
They exit above the magnetic sea, revealing thousands of floating islands slowly rotating in synchronized orbital motion across the horizon.

entries.title: Lays World Cup 2026 Commercial

WORLD CUP 2026 × LAYS COMMERCIAL

30-second cinematic sports commercial, 16:9, ultra-realistic FIFA World Cup ad style.

A modern living room transformed into an Argentina fan zone. Friends watch the FIFA World Cup 2026 Final on a giant screen. Argentina flags everywhere. World Cup anthem, TV commentary, crowd noise, and excited chatter fill the room.

The crunch transports Ava into a packed World Cup 2026 stadium surrounded by thousands of unique Argentina supporters. No cloned faces. Real crowd behavior. Massive flags wave as the crowd roars.

Broadcast-style coverage follows the final attack. Fans hold their breath. The shot is taken.

GOAL.

The stadium erupts. Confetti falls. Argentina are World Cup 2026 Champions. Ava celebrates with supporters as fireworks light the stadium.

Match cut back to the living room. The goal is happening on TV. Friends explode into celebration, hugging, cheering, and jumping with realistic physical continuity.

entries.prompt:
Photorealistic first person FPV drone fly through starting from the front garden pathway of the Taj Mahal at sunrise. The camera glides rapidly forward over the Mughal garden, flying low above the symmetrical water canal with the Taj Mahal reflection shimmering beneath. Soft golden sunrise light touches the white marble dome and minarets, creating a warm glowing pink gold atmosphere. entries.title: Alien Spacecraft Orbital Duel

entries.prompt:
Alien sky above a glowing planet: two massive capital ships in a high-speed orbital duel, constantly repositioning, never stationary, supported by a small wing of elite fighters. Combat is tactical, fast, and asymmetric.  
Wide orbital shot: both ships curve along different trajectories around the planet, never aligned, trading long-range fire across distance. 
Dynamic sweep: camera arcs with one ship as it rolls to present shielded sections, deflecting incoming fire while returning calculated shots. 
Cut across space: the opposing ship accelerates laterally, changing angle, forcing shots to miss or glance off shields. 
Fighter deployment: small units launch mid-maneuver, already compensating for velocity, diving toward predicted intercept points. 
High-speed tracking: camera follows a fighter cutting diagonally across the battle, threading between long-range beams and debris. 
Near-miss moment: a capital ship’s main weapon fires slightly off-target due to motion, the beam slicing past and grazing structure instead of a direct hit. 
Tactical shift: one ship uses the planet’s curvature, dipping lower into atmosphere glow, partially obscured, forcing the other to adjust trajectory. 
Precision breach: fighters exploit a brief shield misalignment during a turn, striking a localized section without stopping the flow of battle. 
Damage response: the hit ship doesn’t stall; it rolls, vents energy, and accelerates away, stabilizing while still firing backward. 
Final escalation: both ships now on intersecting but offset paths, firing continuously while moving at high speed, the battlefield stretching across space instead of collapsing into a single point.  
No hovering, no direct standoffs, constant motion, realistic spacing, tactical positioning, momentum-driven combat, cinematic but physically grounded, high-detail sci-fi realism.

entries.title: The Woman Who Stopped Time Narrative
entries.description: A narrative video prompt describing a street performer who freezes time in a busy city square, creating a surreal frozen-moment aesthetic.
entries.prompt:
Title: The Woman Who Stopped Time

A vibrant city square glows beneath the warm light of golden hour, crowded with people, movement, and everyday sounds. At the center stands a captivating young street performer, dressed in a flowing dark coat, fingerless lace gloves, and a wide-brimmed hat that casts a subtle shadow over her face. Her presence is calm yet enigmatic, drawing attention without demanding it.

She slowly raises her hand, fingers extended, her gaze fixed and unwavering. With a crisp snap of her fingers, time comes to an immediate halt.

The entire square freezes in an instant. Pigeons remain suspended in midair. A man’s laughter is trapped on his face. A child hangs motionless at the peak of a jump. Coins tossed moments earlier float weightlessly like scattered fragments of light. An eerie silence settles over the scene as rose petals from a nearby flower stand linger motionless in the warm amber glow.

Moving effortlessly through the frozen world, she explores the stillness with quiet confidence. She gently straightens a woman's crooked glasses, plucks a hovering coin from the air, and gracefully spins between two motionless street vendors, a playful smile appearing on her lips. The camera glides smoothly beside her at shoulder height, drifting through the frozen city like a silent observer.

Eventually, she returns to the exact spot where it all began. She adjusts the brim of her hat, closes her eyes, and takes one slow, measured breath.

Another snap.

Time rushes back all at once. Pigeons burst into flight, conversations resume mid-sentence, laughter echoes through the square, and coins fall to the pavement with sharp metallic clinks. The crowd continues moving as though nothing unusual ever happened.

Amid the chaos, she lowers her gaze to her hand. Resting in her palm is a single gold coin she claimed from the frozen moment. A subtle, satisfied smile appears.

The camera slowly pulls away as the bustling city swallows her back into the crowd, leaving only the lingering feeling that, for a brief instant, time itself belonged to her.

entries.prompt:
角色参考：

使用角色参考图 1作为光头男 MMA 选手。

使用角色参考图 2 作为大码女性 MMA 选手。

整体风格：

超写实 AI 体育转播质感，专业 MMA 八角笼比赛现场，UFC 风格但不要真实可读 Logo，笼边手持摄影机视角，浅景深，前景有虚化铁笼网格，强烈竞技场顶光，暗色观众席，真实比赛垫质感，慢动作冲击瞬间，真实汗水、头发甩动、拳套皮革质感、皮肤纹理和身体重量感。画面像社交媒体上的 MMA 高光短片，不要字幕，不要搞笑文字贴片，不要水印。

镜头 1（0-4 秒）

主体：

光头男 MMA 选手与大码女性 MMA 选手在八角笼中对峙。两人服装、脸和体型严格参考角色图 A 与角色图 B。

动作：

0-1 秒：两人靠近笼边移动试探，双手举起护脸，身体微微下沉，像真实 MMA 比赛开局。

1-2 秒：光头男选手突然向左侧跨步，身体旋转蓄力，腰胯快速带动腿部，镜头快速跟随他的转身动作。

2-4 秒：他打出一记转身侧踢，脚掌正中大码女性选手腹部。命中瞬间进入轻微慢动作，她的腹部和身体产生真实冲击反馈，身体向侧后方晃动，头发和汗水颗粒在竞技场灯光下飞散。她仍然保持非常大的体型，不要变瘦。

环境：

黑色铁笼网格，八角笼地面，虚化观众席，蓝白色角柱垫，强烈顶光，真实比赛现场氛围。

镜头：

低机位笼边中景，前景铁笼轻微虚化，50mm 体育镜头，快速横向跟拍转身侧踢，击中瞬间轻微慢动作。

镜头 2（4-9 秒）

主体：

同一名光头男选手和同一名大码女性选手，服装、脸、体型完全保持一致。大码女性选手必须保持超重量级体积感、宽躯干、丰满腹部和厚重大腿。

动作：

4-6 秒：大码女性选手被踢后后退到笼边，双手抬起护脸，表情恼怒又吃痛，试图重新站稳并压回来。

6-8 秒：光头男选手快速贴近，身体重心压低，打出一记短促左勾拳击中她的脸侧。

8-9 秒：击中瞬间轻微慢动作，脸颊产生真实压缩，头发甩动，汗雾在顶光下散开。她继续被逼向角柱，身体沉重地撞近铁笼。

环境：

八角笼角落区域，铁笼网格占据部分前景，背景观众和摄影师模糊，角柱垫靠近画面右侧。

镜头：

手持中近景，轻微晃动，像真实转播摄影师在笼外追踪动作。击打瞬间短暂慢动作，随后恢复正常速度。

镜头 3（9-15 秒）

主体：

同一名光头男 MMA 选手将同一名大码女性 MMA 选手逼到八角笼角柱旁。大码女性选手必须保持非常大的超重量级体型，圆脸、双下巴、宽躯干、丰满腹部、厚重大腿和整体重量感清晰可见。画面中出现一名男性裁判，穿黑色短袖裁判服、黑色裤子、黑色手套，起初站在背景边缘观察比赛。

动作：

9-10.5 秒：大码女性选手背靠铁笼和角柱，双手高举护头，身体缩紧防守。光头男选手贴近她，连续打出短距离组合拳，拳套击中她的护臂、肩膀和身体侧面。动作快速、有压迫感，但不血腥。

10.5-12 秒：光头男选手后撤半步，突然再次前冲，打出一记强力近距离打击。大码女性选手的防守被打散，身体重心失去平衡，肩膀向后撞到铁笼，头发和汗水被冲击甩起。

12-13.5 秒：大码女性选手沿着铁笼和角柱向下滑落，先是膝盖弯曲，随后整个人沉重地坐倒到八角笼地垫上。她背靠铁笼，双手仍然半护着头，表情恍惚吃痛，身体体积和重量感非常明显。光头男选手收住动作，站在她面前半步距离，拳套仍然抬起。

13.5-15 秒：裁判从画面后方快速走出来，进入两名选手之间，伸手示意光头男选手停止进攻，并低头查看倒地的大码女性选手。镜头轻微推进到倒地选手、光头男选手 and 裁判三者同框。最后一秒停在真实 MMA 转播式画面：大码女性选手坐倒在笼边，裁判正在介入，光头男选手向后退开。

环境：

黑色铁笼，蓝白色角柱垫，暗色观众席，强烈竞技场顶光，笼网前景虚化，地面有真实比赛垫质感。画面保持专业 MMA 比赛现场，不要突然换成街斗、舞台表演或训练馆。

镜头：

笼边手持转播镜头，从中景推进到中近景。9-12 秒镜头跟随组合拳轻微晃动，12-13.5 秒跟随大码女性选手向下滑落，13.5 秒裁判入画时镜头轻微横移，把裁判、倒地选手和光头男选手都收入画面。最后保持纪实体育转播感，不要过度戏剧化定格。

动作约束：

所有击打都是体育比赛动作，不要血腥，不要骨折，不要严重伤口。重点表现速度、冲击、失衡、倒地、身体重量感、裁判介入和真实转播现场感。大码女性选手倒地时不能变瘦，不能变成普通女性运动员，不能漂浮，必须有沉重坐倒到地面的真实重量感。

entries.prompt: 아이폰으로 촬영한 보정되지 않은 핸드헬드 영상 스타일로 제작되었으며, 모든 카메라 설정은 자동이고 색 보정이나 특수 효과는 후처리되지 않았습니다. 영상에는 실제 핸드헬드 촬영 특유의 미세한 흔들림과 촬영자의 숨소리가 담겨 있으며, 자동 초점의 탐색 및 지연 현상과 따뜻한 자연광과 주변 그림자 사이를 자연스럽게 전환하는 자동 화이트 밸런스가 특징입니다. 전체적인 이미지는 평면적이며, 사실적인 렌즈 플레어, 약간의 과다 노출, 모션 블러가 그대로 표현되어 있습니다. 바람 소리, 멀리서 들려오는 새소리, 오두막 내부 소리, 미묘한 여성의 숨소리 등 카메라에 내장된 자연스러운 주변 음향 효과만 사용되었습니다. 1인칭 시점의 핸드헬드 촬영으로 카메라 움직임은 자연스럽고 피사체의 움직임을 역동적으로 따라가며, 장면 변화에 따라 앵글이 조정됩니다. 젊은 아시아 여성의 외모는 [hf_20260531_070256_ba357bcb-4f12-41b9-8c19-c74da1eb1603]에서, 그녀의 옷과 배경은 [image_20260527072336_306_19(1)]에서 완전히 참조되었습니다. 그녀는 시골 오두막 안에 서 있었고, 검은 머리는 올려 묶은 스타일이었으며, 검은색 긴팔 크롭탑과 검은색 꽃무늬 스커트를 입고 반짝이는 하이힐을 신고 있었습니다. 배경에는 누더기 커튼, 나무 테이블, 커다란 테라코타 화분, 그리고 여러 가지 잡동사니가 있었고, 왼쪽에서 들어오는 자연광이 소박하고 따뜻한 분위기를 자아냈습니다. 0초에 카메라는 미디엄 샷으로 그녀에게 초점을 맞추었습니다. 그녀는 프레임 중앙에 서서 손을 자연스럽게 옆구리에 늘어뜨리고 있었고, 표정은 차분하면서도 약간 사색에 잠긴 듯했습니다. 부드럽고 따뜻한, 애틋한 감성이 담긴 여성의 목소리가 들려왔다. "억울한 일이 있을 때, 왜 어떤 사람들은 허공에 대고 반항하는지 아세요?" 1초 후, 그녀는 천천히 고개를 숙여 땅을 바라보았다. 눈빛은 멍했고, 몸은 무언가를 떠올리는 듯 살짝 흔들렸다. 그러다 천천히 몸을 돌려 왼쪽의 누더기 커튼 쪽으로 걸어갔다. 카메라가 옆에서 그녀를 따라갔다. 2초 후, 목소리는 더욱 부드럽고 온화해졌다. "어렸을 때, 할아버지와 함께 마당에서 채소에 물을 주곤 했어요. 할아버지는 물을 주면서 작은 소리로 욕을 중얼거렸는데, 무슨 욕이었는지는 모르겠어요." 그녀는 커튼으로 걸어가 창밖을 내다보았다. 입술은 살짝 오므리고 있었다. 카메라가 뒤에서 살짝 줌인했다. 4초 후, 그녀는 고개를 들었다. 눈에는 혼란과 슬픔이 가득했고, 몸을 돌려 천천히 나무 테이블 쪽으로 걸어갔다. 카메라가 옆에서 그녀를 따라갔다. 내레이션은 계속된다. 목소리는 여전히 부드럽다. "나중에 저는 학교를 그만두고, 일을 하고, 결혼하고, 이혼했어요. 어느 날, 음식을 배달하러 가는 길에 갑자기 허공에 대고 욕을 하기 시작했죠." 6초, 그녀는 나무 탁자로 걸어가 몸을 살짝 앞으로 기울인다. 손은 탁자 가장자리에 가볍게 얹고, 시선은 약간 흐릿해진다. 입술은 마치 허공에 속삭이듯 움직이고, 억눌린 감정이 가득한 표정을 짓는다. 카메라가 그녀의 어깨 위에서 줌인한다. 8초, 그녀는 천천히 몸을 바로 세우고, 시선은 부드러워지며, 안도감이 감도는 듯 입꼬리가 살짝 올라간다. 그녀는 몸을 돌려 커다란 토기 항아리 쪽으로 걸어가고, 카메라가 뒤에서 그녀를 따라간다. 내레이션은 계속된다. 이해심 많고 부드러운 어조로. "욕을 하는 순간, 문득 할아버지 생각이 났어요. 그 순간, 할아버지는 남에게 욕을 하는 분이 아니었다는 걸 깨달았죠." 11초, 그녀는 항아리로 걸어가 고개를 살짝 들고 카메라를 똑바로 바라보았다. 그녀의 눈빛은 차분하고 온화했으며, 이해와 안도감이 가득했다. 카메라가 천천히 옆에서 그녀의 얼굴로 이동했다. 부드럽고 진솔한 목소리로 내레이션이 마무리되었다. "그는 자신을 저주하고 있었습니다. 억울한 일을 당했지만 어떻게 맞서 싸워야 할지 몰랐던 자신을." 13초, 그녀는 몸을 살짝 이완했지만 시선은 여전히 ​​카메라에 고정되어 있었고, 입가에는 희미하고 온화한 미소가 걸려 있었다. 그녀는 천천히 화면 중앙으로 걸어왔다. 14초, 카메라가 살짝 흔들렸다. 그녀는 여전히 서 있었고, 표정은 차분하고 안도되어 있었다. 15초, 따뜻하고 자연스러운 빛 속에서 장면은 자연스럽게 끝났다. 이 영상은 아이폰으로 손으로 들고 촬영한 영상 특유의 사실적이고 보정되지 않은 모습, 다큐멘터리 수준의 자연스러운 불완전함을 보여주었으며, 후반 작업에서 색 보정이나 특수 효과를 전혀 사용하지 않았다. 모든 카메라 움직임은 실제 시골 통나무집에서 손으로 들고 촬영했을 때의 물리적 특성을 반영했다. 내레이션은 부드럽고 섬세한 감정을 담은 여성의 목소리로, 마치 그녀가 자신의 이야기를 조용히 들려주는 듯하다. 카메라 앵글은 주인공의 위치에 따라 자연스럽게 변화한다.
entries.translated_prompt: It was produced in an uncorrected handheld video style filmed with an iPhone, and all camera settings were automatic, and color correction or special effects were not post-processed. The video contains subtle shakes unique to actual handheld filming and the breath of the photographer, and features automatic focus search and delay, and automatic white balance that naturally transitions between warm natural light and surrounding shadows. The overall image is flat, and realistic lens flares, slight overexposure, and motion blur are expressed as they are. Only natural ambient sound effects built into the camera were used, such as the sound of the wind, the sound of birds in the distance, the sound of the inside of the cabin, and the subtle breathing of a woman. It is a handheld shot from a first-person point of view, and the camera movements are natural and dynamically follow the subject's movements, and the angles are adjusted according to scene changes. The appearance of the young Asian woman was completely referenced from [hf_20260531_070256_ba357bcb-4f12-41b9-8c19-c74da1eb1603], and her clothes and background were completely referenced from [image_20260527072336_306_19(1)]. She was standing in a rural cabin, her black hair was tied up, and she was wearing a black long-sleeved crop top, a black floral skirt, and shiny high heels. In the background, there were tattered curtains, a wooden table, a large terracotta pot, and various miscellaneous items, and the natural light coming from the left created a simple and warm atmosphere. At 0 seconds, the camera focused on her in a medium shot. She was standing in the center of the frame with her hands naturally hanging by her sides, and her expression was calm yet slightly contemplative. A soft, warm, and poignant female voice was heard. "Do you know why some people rebel against the air when something unfair happens?" One second later, she slowly lowered her head and looked at the ground. Her eyes were blank, and her body swayed slightly as if she was remembering something. Then she slowly turned around and walked towards the tattered curtain on the left. The camera followed her from the side. Two seconds later, the voice became softer and gentler. "When I was little, I used to water the vegetables in the yard with my grandfather. He would mutter curses in a small voice as he watered them, but I don't know what they were." She walked to the curtain and looked out the window. Her lips were slightly pursed. The camera zoomed in slightly from behind. Four seconds later, she looked up. Her eyes were filled with confusion and sadness, and she turned around and slowly walked towards the wooden table. The camera followed her from the side. The narration continues. The voice is still soft. "Later, I dropped out of school, worked, got married, and got divorced. One day, on my way to deliver food, I suddenly started cursing at the air." At 6 seconds, she walks to the wooden table and leans forward slightly. Her hands are placed lightly on the edge of the table, and her gaze becomes slightly blurred. Her lips move as if whispering to the air, and she wears an expression full of suppressed emotions. The camera zooms in over her shoulder. At 8 seconds, she slowly straightens her body, her gaze softens, and the corners of her mouth rise slightly as if a sense of relief is spreading. She turns and walks towards the large earthen jar, and the camera follows her from behind. The narration continues. In a sympathetic and soft tone. "The moment I cursed, I suddenly thought of my grandfather. In that moment, I realized that he wasn't someone who cursed at others." At 11 seconds, she walked to the jar, raised her head slightly, and looked straight at the camera. Her gaze was calm and gentle, full of understanding and relief. The camera slowly moved from the side to her face. The narration ended with a soft and sincere voice. "He was cursing himself. Himself, who had been wronged but didn't know how to fight back." At 13 seconds, she relaxed her body slightly but her gaze was still fixed on the camera, and a faint and gentle smile hung on the corner of her mouth. She slowly walked to the center of the screen. At 14 seconds, the camera shook slightly. She was still standing, and her expression was calm and relieved. At 15 seconds, the scene ended naturally in the warm and natural light. This video showed the realistic and uncorrected look and natural imperfections of a documentary level unique to video filmed by hand with an iPhone, and did not use any color correction or special effects in post-production. All camera movements reflected the physical characteristics of being filmed by hand in a real rural log cabin. The narration is in a soft and delicate female voice, as if she is quietly telling her own story. The camera angle changes naturally according to the protagonist's position.

entries.title: Golden Royal King Rap Music Video
entries.description: A highly descriptive music video prompt featuring a king character rapping with Snoop Dogg swagger across multiple opulent and futuristic locations.
entries.prompt:
A man wearing an ultra-luxurious golden royal king costume with a jeweled crown, rapping with confident Snoop Dogg swagger throughout the entire video.
SCENE 1: Low angle slow push-in shot inside a grand opulent palace with marble pillars and golden chandeliers, he raps looking straight into camera with bold confidence.
SCENE 2: 360 degree orbit shot as he walks through a breathtaking royal garden with blooming flowers, golden fountains, and lush greenery, rapping smoothly with cool swag.
SCENE 3: Dutch angle lateral tracking shot as he walks through a futuristic royal marketplace filled with glowing golden stalls, exotic goods, and wealthy merchants bowing, rapping with street swagger.
SCENE 4: Wide establishing shot then fast dramatic zoom in to his face as he walks through a massive royal courtyard lined with armored royal guards standing at attention.
SCENE 5: Bird's eye view slowly craning down to reveal him sitting on a magnificent jeweled throne, beautiful women in elegant luxurious modest royal dresses standing on both sides fanning him with golden fans, he raps with ultimate king energy.
MUSIC: West Coast hip hop beat, heavy bass, slow-rolling g-funk style like Snoop Dogg and Dr. Dre, deep 808 kicks, smooth synth melody, royal orchestral strings layered over the beat, fast rap flow, energetic and powerful.
LYRICS SUNG BY CHARACTER: "I'm the king on the throne, crown shining so bright My kingdom's so rich, everything feels right My people don't beg, they laugh every day Justice and gold, yeah we living that way From the palace to the market, glory on display I'm the king of it all — and it's gonna stay!"
Cinematic 4K, hyper-luxurious, dynamic camera movements, golden dramatic lighting, epic royal atmosphere, fast-paced cuts synced to rap rhythm.

entries.title: Blockbuster Supercar Chase Scene
entries.description: An epic cinematic prompt for a high-octane supercar chase involving aerial shots, extreme speeds, and massive explosions in a modern city.
entries.prompt: [Cinematography]: Dynamic camera work transitioning from low-angle tracking shots to sweeping aerial drone perspectives. Shot on Arri Alexa 65 with anamorphic lenses, utilizing high frame rates for ultra-smooth slow motion during extreme stunts, featuring intense motion blur and anamorphic lens flares. [Subject]: A sleek, aerodynamic glossy black supercar with aggressive styling, carbon-fiber detailing, and glowing LED taillights. [Action]: The supercar races at extreme speeds, weaving through heavy traffic with pinpoint precision before drifting flawlessly under a moving semi-truck, launching off a concrete ramp, and flying weightlessly between towering skyscrapers in dramatic slow motion as a massive, fiery explosion erupts directly behind it. [Context]: A sprawling, ultra-modern city highway at sunset, surrounded by towering glass-paneled skyscrapers, dense with civilian traffic, scattering debris, flying sparks, and swirling dust kicked up by the high-speed chase. [Style & Ambiance]: High-octane blockbuster action film aesthetic with intense energy and epic cinematic tone. Dramatic golden-hour lighting casts long, dynamic shadows and vibrant orange hues that reflect off the glass buildings and the car's polished exterior, hyper-realistic rendering with cinematic smoke and fire.

entries.prompt: {{Image 1}} =絵コンテの参照。 添付された絵コンテ画像{{Image 1}} を基に、15秒、横型16:9の高品質な動画を作成してください。テーマは「実写映像とエフェクトの共存」。全体として、東京の街並みを舞台にした、テンポが速く、爽快感があり、実写風景の中にカラフルな動くエフェクトが自然に溶け込む映像にしてください。静止画のスライドショーにはせず、各カットの中でカメラもエフェクトも確実に動いている、映像として気持ちの良いモンタージュにしてください。映像全体の方向性：実写ベースの東京風景。青空、電柱、電線、交差点、鳥居、路地、川沿い、電車、水辺、公園、夕景を用いた都市モンタージュ。実写の中に、2D的なカラフルなリボン軌跡、紙吹雪、図形、白い手描き風の記号線、矢印、円弧、点線、軌道線、軽いスケッチ風オーバーレイが共存する。エフェクトは画面の上に貼りついて見えるのではなく、実際の空間の遠近感や流れに沿って存在し、実写の奥行きに馴染んで見えるようにする。エフェクトはそれぞれが独立し、個性的な動きをしている。全体として、爽やかで軽やか、少し詩的で、街そのものが生きているような印象。過剰にSFやサイバーにはしない。明るい昼の透明感と、終盤の夕景の余韻を大切にする。カット構成：1カット目：東京の大通り。奥に東京スカイツリーが見える広めのストリートビュー。ローアングル気味。街並みと電線の奥行き。カラフルなリボン状エフェクトが道路に沿って流れ、紙吹雪と白い線が空気中に舞う。ゆるく前進するカメラ。2カット目：都市の中の大きな鳥居。道路標識や街の看板と鳥居が共存する不思議な構図。リボンエフェクトが鳥居をくぐるように走り抜ける。素早いパン気味のカメラ。3カット目：歩行者用信号機の超寄り。青空を背景に、信号機の緑の歩行マークが印象的に見える。周囲に道路標識。白い手描き線、円弧、粒子、図形が信号の周囲で軽やかに動く。寄りから少し煽る。4カット目：電柱と大量の電線を見上げるローアングル。空を大きく見せる。ピンク、水色、黄色、白のリボンエフェクトが電線の流れと絡み合いながら空間を横切る。紙片や小さな図形も風に流れる。カメラは見上げながらわずかに回り込む。5カット目：交差点を俯瞰気味に見下ろす。道路標識が多く、道路のラインに沿ってエフェクトが流れる。交差点の動線を強調するようにリボン軌跡が走る。テンポの良いカット。6カット目：桜の咲く川沿い。花と水辺、遊歩道、東京の街。リボン状エフェクトが遊歩道から川沿いへ自然につながる。花びら、紙吹雪、白いスケッチ線が春風のように舞う。少し穏やかな横移動。7カット目：白背景に近いスケッチ風の抽象化カット。川沿いの風景を線画化したような印象。実写から一瞬だけ2D世界へ移行したような演出。細い線、手描きの軌道線、軽い図形、音符のような記号が流れる。短く印象的に。8カット目：細い路地。赤い自販機、路地の奥行き、店先や植物。リボンエフェクトが路地を縫うように流れる。白い記号線が点在。カメラは前へ抜けるように進む。9カット目：踏切と走る電車。踏切の警報機や遮断機、車体のスピード感。リボンと紙片エフェクトが列車の通過に巻き込まれるように流れる。ダイナミックな斜め構図。10カット目：水辺の遊歩道。花壇と柵、遠くの都市景観、広い空。エフェクトは少し広がりを見せ、白いラインが空へ抜ける。ここで少し開放感を出す。11カット目：公園の池。水鳥、木々、奥に都市。穏やかで静かな空気感の中にも、細い白い線や淡い紙吹雪、やわらかなリボンの余韻が漂う。やや俯瞰からゆるく移動。12カット目：夕方の水辺と都市のシルエット。空に大きく弧を描くリボンエフェクト。夕陽の反射。ここは一番詩的で余韻のある締め。カメラは静かに前進、またはゆるく横移動して終わる。演出・編集：テンポの良い高速カット構成。各カットは短めだが、映像として繋がりが気持ちよく見えるように、リボンエフェクトや進行方向、空の色、被写体の流れでマッチカットを作る。寄り、超接写、ローアングル、俯瞰、斜め構図、前進移動、素早いパンを織り交ぜる。ただし、カメラが暴れすぎて見づらくならないよう、爽快感と視認性を両立する。実写の質感は保ちつつ、2.5次元的に、実写の中へアニメ的エフェクトが自然に入り込んでいる印象にする。画作り：高品質、シネマティック、明るい自然光、透明感のある青空、繊細な街のディテール、清潔感のある色彩設計。エフェクトはピンク、水色、黄色、白を中心に、軽やかで爽やかな色設計。エフェクト量はしっかり多めだが、被写体を見失うほどの過密にはしない。実写とエフェクトが対立せず、同じ世界に存在しているように見せること。重要事項：静止画のスライドショー禁止。各カット内で確実にカメラとエフェクトが動くこと。文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは一切入れない。過度なノイズ、ぐにゃぐにゃした形状崩れ、不自然な点滅、破綻した文字表現は禁止。実写風景の中に動くエフェクトが自然に共存する、爽快で美しい15秒映像にしてください。
entries.translated_prompt: {{Image 1}} = Storyboard reference. Based on the attached storyboard image {{Image 1}}, create a high-quality 15-second horizontal 16:9 video. The theme is "Coexistence of live-action footage and effects." Overall, set the stage in the streets of Tokyo, making it fast-paced, refreshing, and ensuring colorful moving effects naturally blend into the live-action scenery. Do not make it a slideshow of still images; create a pleasant montage where both the camera and effects are clearly moving in each cut. Overall direction: An urban montage based on live-action Tokyo scenery featuring blue skies, utility poles, power lines, intersections, torii gates, alleys, riversides, trains, waterfronts, parks, and evening scenes. Within the live action, 2D-style colorful ribbon trails, confetti, shapes, white hand-drawn symbolic lines, arrows, arcs, dotted lines, orbital lines, and light sketch-style overlays coexist. Effects should not look like they are pasted on top of the screen but should exist according to the perspective and flow of the actual space, appearing integrated with the depth of the live action. Each effect should be independent with unique movements. Overall, the impression should be fresh, light, slightly poetic, and as if the city itself is alive. Do not make it excessively sci-fi or cyberpunk. Value the transparency of the bright daytime and the lingering afterglow of the evening scene at the end. Cut Composition: 1st Cut: A main street in Tokyo. A wide street view with Tokyo Skytree in the distance. Low-angle shot. Depth of cityscape and power lines. Colorful ribbon-like effects flow along the road, while confetti and white lines dance in the air. Camera slowly moves forward. 2nd Cut: A large torii gate in the city. A mysterious composition where road signs, city billboards, and the torii gate coexist. A ribbon effect runs through the torii gate. Quick pan-like camera movement. 3rd Cut: Extreme close-up of a pedestrian signal. The green walking symbol looks impressive against the blue sky. Surrounding road signs. White hand-drawn lines, arcs, particles, and shapes move lightly around the signal. Slightly low-angle close-up. 4th Cut: Low angle looking up at utility poles and power lines. Show a lot of sky. Pink, light blue, yellow, and white ribbon effects cross the space while intertwining with the lines. Scraps of paper and small shapes flow in the wind. Camera slightly orbits while looking up. 5th Cut: High-angle view overlooking an intersection. Many road signs, with effects flowing along the road lines. Ribbon trails run to emphasize movement lines. A well-paced cut. 6th Cut: Riverside with cherry blossoms. Flowers, waterfront, promenade, and the city. Ribbon effects naturally connect from the promenade to the river. Petals, confetti, and white sketch lines dance like a spring breeze. Gentle horizontal movement. 7th Cut: A sketch-like abstract cut close to a white background. An impression as if the riverside scenery has been turned into line art. A brief transition from live action to a 2D world. Thin lines, hand-drawn orbital lines, light shapes, and musical note-like symbols flow. Short and impactful. 8th Cut: A narrow alley. Red vending machine, alley depth, storefronts, and plants. Ribbon effects weave through the alley. Scattered white symbolic lines. Camera moves forward as if passing through. 9th Cut: Railroad crossing and a passing train. Crossing signal, barrier, and the speed of the train. Ribbon and paper scrap effects are caught in the train's passage. Dynamic diagonal composition. 10th Cut: Waterfront promenade. Flower beds and fences, distant urban landscape, wide sky. Effects spread out, with white lines escaping into the sky for a sense of openness. 11th Cut: Park pond. Water birds, trees, city background. Calm and quiet atmosphere with lingering white lines, soft confetti, and gentle ribbons. Moves slowly from a high angle. 12th Cut: Evening waterfront and city silhouette. A ribbon effect drawing a large arc in the sky. Sunset reflection. A poetic finish. Camera ends by quietly moving forward or slowly moving horizontally. Direction & Editing: High-speed cut composition with good tempo. Use match cuts based on ribbon effects, direction, sky color, and subject flow. Mix close-ups, low/high angles, diagonal compositions, forward movement, and quick pans. Balance exhilaration with visibility. Create a 2.5D impression where anime-style effects naturally enter the live action. Visual Style: High quality, cinematic, bright natural light, transparent blue sky, delicate city details, clean color design. Effects centered on pink, light blue, yellow, and white. Substantial but not overcrowded effect volume. Ensure live action and effects exist in the same world. Important Items: No still image slideshows. Ensure movement in every cut. No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. No excessive noise, distorted shapes, or flickering. Create a refreshing 15-second video where effects naturally coexist with live-action scenery.

entries.title: Sports Player POV Camera Signing Template
entries.description: A structural video generation template for Seedance 2.0 designed to recreate the post-match tradition of an athlete signing a camera lens, including specific instructions for movement and interaction.
entries.prompt:
【15秒動画テンプレート】

人物参照画像：＠ image1 サッカーユニフォーム
背景：サッカー場（観客多数）
サイン名：SIGN_NAME＝ぱか猫
感情表現：EMOTION＝両手ハートを作って満面の笑顔
締めポーズ：ENDING_POSE＝ウインクしながら投げキッス
────────────────────
全編を通して人物と背景は参照画像に忠実に再現する。
視聴者視点（POV）。
視聴者自身がカメラである。
人物は常に視聴者へ自然なアイコンタクトを行う。
サインを書く際、カメラ本体・レンズ・ガラス板・鏡・撮影機材は一切映さない。
サイン文字は画面前面へ自然に出現する。
サインとハートマークは動画終了まで消えない。
────────────────────
① 登場（0～3秒）
背景参照画像の環境。
人物が自然に立っている。
視聴者へ気付いて微笑む。
ゆっくりカメラへ歩き始める。
────────────────────
② 接近（3～6秒）
人物が視聴者へ近付く。
親しみやすい表情。
自然なアイコンタクト。
髪や衣装が自然に揺れる。
────────────────────
③ カメラ注視（6～9秒）
バストアップ。
人物が視聴者を見つめる。
少し身を乗り出す。
マーカーを取り出す。
サインを書く準備。
────────────────────
④ レンズへサイン（9～12秒）
POV視点。
人物が視聴者へ向かってマーカーを動かす。
カメラ本体やレンズは映さない。
「SIGN_NAME」をサインする。
続けて小さなハートマークを描く。
サインとハートは画面前面に残る。
動画終了まで消えない。
────────────────────
⑤ 感情表現（12～14秒）
サインとハートが画面前面に残った状態。
人物はサイン越しに視聴者を見る。
EMOTION を行う。
常にアイコンタクトを維持する。
サインは消えない。
────────────────────
⑥ 締めポーズ（14～15秒）
サインとハートが画面前面に残った状態。
人物はサイン越しに視聴者へ向けて ENDING_POSE を行う。
最後までサインは表示されたまま。
明るい表情で終了。
────────────────────
スタイル：
高品質
フォトリアル
自然な動作
映画的ライティング
浅い被写界深度
SNSショート動画
人物中心
高精細
滑らかなカメラワーク
────────────────────
NG：
カメラ本体が映る
レンズが映る
ガラス板が映る
鏡へサインする
撮影機材の映り込み
自撮り棒
サインが途中で消える
サインがぼやける
サインが最終フレーム前に消失する

纯正泰国神脑洞广告。前10秒是极度高压悬疑惊悚大片，最后5秒极其生硬地切入亮堂堂的沙雕美食家电广告。

时长 15秒
场景 从极度压抑、打着幽暗蓝光的废弃仓库，瞬间变为阳光明媚、温馨过头的家庭厨房。

分镜脚本

00:00-00:05 镜头1：生死倒数与极致高压
机位：极端的微距特写与面部特写交替，手持剧烈晃动，冷峻的青蓝色调。
画面：数字定时器正在疯狂倒数：00:04、00:03。豆大的汗珠从一个男人的额头滑落。他穿着极其厚重、专业的绿色防爆服，戴着战术头盔，双手颤抖着举起一把巨大的老虎钳，死死盯着眼前缠绕在一起的红蓝电线。气氛极其压抑，背景音只有沉重的呼吸声和巨大的心跳声。

Style: Pixar-quality animated short film, warm Indian village atmosphere, emotional storytelling, cinematic lighting, expressive characters, shallow depth of field, highly detailed textures, heartwarming tone.

A charming Indian village at golden sunrise. A cheerful 10-year-old village boy carries a bamboo pole across his shoulders with two clay water pots hanging from either side. Final cinematic shot: the boy walks away down the village road carrying both pots equally, surrounded by vibrant flowers glowing in golden sunlight.

Camera: Starts with medium tracking shot behind the boy, close-up on dripping water, slow reveal of flowers along the path, emotional close-up of cracked pot, wide cinematic ending shot.
Lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight, soft volumetric rays, cozy Pixar-style color grading.
Mood: Heartwarming, hopeful, uplifting.
No text, no subtitles, no narration.

entries.title: Pixar Style Animated Short Storyboard
entries.description: A comprehensive narrative prompt designed for creating a Pixar-quality animated short about a boy and his sister flying a kite on a village rooftop, complete with camera directions and lighting moods.
entries.prompt:
“The Kite That Wouldn’t Fly”

Duration: 15 seconds

Style: Pixar-quality animated short film, colorful Indian neighborhood rooftop setting, expressive animation, cinematic storytelling, warm family-friendly atmosphere, vibrant textures, emotional visual payoff.

On a sunny afternoon in a small Indian town, an excited 10-year-old boy proudly stands on a rooftop holding a handmade kite. Beside him, his younger sister eagerly offers advice, but he confidently waves her away. The boy launches the kite. It immediately spins out of control and crashes onto a nearby rooftop. He tries again. Another crash. Frustration grows. The sister quietly picks up the kite and notices it’s missing a tail. Without saying anything, she ties a simple cloth tail to the bottom. The boy launches it one last time. This time the kite catches the wind perfectly and soars high above the town, dancing gracefully against the blue sky. The boy looks surprised, then realizes what his sister did. He smiles sheepishly and offers her the kite string reel. Together they fly the kite as it rises higher and higher. Final cinematic shot: brother and sister standing side by side on the rooftop, laughing while the colorful kite soars above the village skyline at sunset.

Camera: Dynamic rooftop tracking shots, close-ups on failed launches, focus on the sister quietly attaching the tail, dramatic upward camera tilt following the successful flight, wide cinematic ending shot above the rooftops.

Lighting: Bright afternoon sunlight transitioning into warm golden-hour glow during the final moments.

Mood: Joyful, uplifting, playful, heartwarming.

No text, no subtitles, no narration.

entries.title: Fantasy Epic Ocean Conductor Spectacle
entries.description: A comprehensive cinematic script for Seedance 2.0 featuring a female conductor commanding massive ocean waves during a golden sunset.
entries.prompt:
奇幻史诗视觉奇观 (Fantasy Epic Visual Spectacle)。顶级电影特效，大场面交响乐节奏感。视觉风格核心对比：渺小的人体 vs 无垠的海洋力量，一根指挥棒掌控万顷狂涛。整体色调黄昏暖金色，大逆光，水雾体积光贯穿始终。

【场景】
黄昏时分，无边无际的深蓝色大海，天际线燃烧着橙红色晚霞，低沉的暗色云层压在海面上方，光线从云层缝隙中倾泻而下形成上帝光柱。

【角色】
年轻亚洲女性音乐指挥家：齐腰黑色长发，身穿剪裁利落的黑色拖地长裙，裙尾在风中如旗帜般翻飞。右手持一根发出淡金色光芒的指挥棒。表情专注而充满力量，如同在指挥一场命运级别的交响乐。脚下悬浮在海面上空约二十米处，下方有一圈淡淡的金色光环托举。

【分镜脚本 · 15秒】
[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：孤身凌空 · 万籁俱寂

机位：超级远景缓慢推进 (Slow Push-in from Ultra Wide)

画面：极致的大远景。无边无际的海面占据画面下方三分之二，上方是燃烧的黄昏云层。海面此刻诡异地平静如镜，倒映着天空。画面正中央，一个渺小的黑色人影悬浮在海天之间——这就是指挥家。镜头缓慢推近，逐渐能看清她飘飞的长裙和长发。她缓缓举起右手，指挥棒尖端亮起一点金色光芒。万籁俱寂，只有风声。一切蓄势待发。

[00:03-00:06] 镜头2：第一乐章 · 海浪听令

机位：中景侧面跟拍 (Medium Side Tracking)→ 快切广角俯拍 (Quick Cut to Aerial Wide)

画面（中景）：指挥家猛然挥下第一棒！指挥棒划出一道金色弧线光迹。她的头发和裙摆被自身释放的气浪猛然向后扬起。

画面（快切俯拍）：从高空俯视海面——以指挥家为圆心，一圈巨大的环形海浪从她正下方炸开向四周扩散，如同一颗石子投入平静水面但被放大了一万倍。海浪高度迅速攀升至数十米。

她开始有节奏地挥动指挥棒——向左挥，左侧海面拔起一道百米长的浪墙；向右挥，右侧海面应声升起同等高度的浪墙。两道浪墙如同交响乐的左右声道，交替起伏，韵律分明。浪尖被黄昏阳光照透，呈现出琥珀色半透明质感。

[00:06-00:10] 镜头3：高潮乐章 · 狂涛共舞

机位：环绕上升镜头 (Rising Orbital Shot)，360度围绕指挥家旋转同时升高

画面：节奏陡然加快！指挥家的动作变得激烈而狂放——指挥棒上下翻飞，每一次挥动都带出金色光弧残影。她的整个身体都在随节奏律动，长裙被四面八方的气场撕扯翻飞如同黑色火焰。

海面完全疯狂——数十道巨浪从不同方向同时拔起，高度从几十米飙升到上百米，如同一根根巨大的水柱围绕着指挥家呈圆形阵列排列，像管风琴的音管一样此起彼伏。海水在空中扭曲成螺旋形，水雾弥漫在半空中，黄昏的阳光穿透水雾形成无数道金色体积光。整个海面变成了一个以她为中心的巨大旋涡漩涡，气势吞天。

镜头在环绕中逐渐升高，视角越来越广，展现出这个"海洋交响乐"的惊人规模——她一个人在指挥方圆数公里的海洋。

[00:10-00:13] 镜头4：终曲 · 万浪归一

机位：正面中景 (Front Medium Shot) → 极速后拉至超级远景 (Hyper Pullback)

画面（正面中景）：指挥家突然停住所有动作。所有海浪也瞬间凝固在半空中，如同时间暂停。她深吸一口气，双手将指挥棒高举过头顶，全身金色光芒大盛。

然后——她以全部力量猛然向下劈落最后一棒！

画面（极速后拉）：镜头瞬间急速后拉。以她为中心，所有凝固在空中的巨浪同时向天空猛然炸射——几十根冲天水柱如导弹般直冲云层穿透云霄，将低沉的暗云撕裂出一个巨大的圆形缺口，露出上方金碧辉煌的晚霞和星空。

[00:13-00:15] 镜头5：余韵 · 归于宁静

机位：远景静止 (Static Wide Shot)

画面：水柱缓缓回落，化作漫天水雾和细密水珠如同下了一场金色的雨。指挥家悬浮在被撕裂的云层缺口正中央，周围是环形排列的彩虹光晕，无数水珠如钻石般折射着最后的阳光。她缓缓放下指挥棒，长发和裙摆在水雾中轻轻飘动。海面重归平静，倒映着她的剪影和被打开的星空。
entries.translated_prompt:
Fantasy Epic Visual Spectacle. Top-tier cinematic effects with the rhythmic feel of a large-scale orchestral performance. The core visual contrast is between a small human figure and the immense power of the ocean, with a single baton controlling vast waves. The overall tone is a warm dusk gold, with heavy backlighting and volumetric light throughout the mist.

[Scene]
At dusk, an infinite deep blue sea with the horizon burning with orange-red sunset clouds. Low, dark clouds press down on the sea surface, and light pours through the gaps in the clouds to form God rays.

[Character]
A young Asian female music conductor with waist-length black hair, wearing a sleek black floor-length dress that flutters in the wind like a flag. She holds a baton in her right hand that emits a faint golden light. Her expression is focused and powerful, as if conducting a symphony of destiny. She is suspended about twenty meters above the sea surface, held up by a faint golden halo beneath her feet.

[Storyboard - 15 Seconds]
[00:00-00:03] Shot 1: Alone in the Air · Silence
Camera: Slow Push-in from Ultra Wide.
Visual: An extreme wide shot. The infinite sea occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, with burning sunset clouds above. The sea surface is eerily calm as a mirror, reflecting the sky. In the center of the frame, a small black figure is suspended between the sea and sky—the conductor. The camera slowly pushes in, gradually revealing her flowing dress and long hair. She slowly raises her right hand, and the tip of the baton lights up with a golden glow. Everything is silent except for the sound of the wind. Everything is ready to burst.

[00:03-00:06] Shot 2: First Movement · Waves Obey
Camera: Medium Side Tracking → Quick Cut to Aerial Wide.
Visual (Medium): The conductor suddenly brings down the first beat! The baton traces a golden arc of light. Her hair and skirt are blown back by the air pressure she releases.
Visual (Quick Cut Aerial): Looking down at the sea from a high altitude—with the conductor as the center, a huge circular wave explodes from directly below her and spreads outward, like a pebble dropped into calm water but magnified ten thousand times. The wave height quickly climbs to dozens of meters.
She begins to wave the baton rhythmically—waving left, a hundred-meter-long wall of water rises from the left sea; waving right, a wall of the same height rises on the right. The two walls of water are like the left and right channels of a symphony, rising and falling with distinct rhythm. The crests of the waves are illuminated by the sunset sun, showing an amber translucent texture.

[00:06-00:10] Shot 3: Climax Movement · Dancing with the Storm
Camera: Rising Orbital Shot, rotating 360 degrees around the conductor while rising.
Visual: The pace suddenly quickens! The conductor's movements become intense and wild—the baton flips up and down, each swing leaving a golden arc shadow. Her entire body moves with the rhythm, her long dress torn and fluttering in the surrounding aura like black flames.
The sea surface goes completely crazy—dozens of giant waves pull up from different directions simultaneously, their height soaring from dozens of meters to over a hundred meters, arranged in a circular array around the conductor like the pipes of a pipe organ, rising and falling one after another. The seawater twists into spirals in the air, mist fills the atmosphere, and the sunset light penetrates the mist to form countless golden volumetric lights. The entire sea becomes a massive whirlpool centered on her, with a momentum that swallows the sky.
The camera gradually rises during the orbit, the perspective getting wider, showing the amazing scale of this "ocean symphony"—she is conducting several square kilometers of the ocean alone.

[00:10-00:13] Shot 4: Finale · All Waves Become One
Camera: Front Medium Shot → Hyper Pullback.
Visual (Front Medium): The conductor suddenly stops all movements. All waves also freeze in mid-air instantly, as if time has paused. She takes a deep breath and holds the baton high above her head with both hands, her entire body glowing intensely with golden light.
Then—she strikes down the final beat with all her strength!
Visual (Hyper Pullback): The camera pulls back extremely fast. Centered on her, all the giant waves frozen in the air burst toward the sky simultaneously—dozens of towering water columns shoot up like missiles into the clouds, tearing a huge circular gap in the low, dark clouds to reveal the magnificent sunset and starry sky above.

[00:13-00:15] Shot 5: Aftermath · Return to Peace
Camera: Static Wide Shot.
Visual: The water columns slowly fall back, turning into a mist and fine droplets like a golden rain. The conductor is suspended in the center of the gap in the torn clouds, surrounded by circular rainbow halos, with countless water droplets reflecting the last sunlight like diamonds. She slowly lowers the baton, her long hair and dress gently moving in the mist. The sea returns to calm, reflecting her silhouette and the opened starry sky.

15秒のシネマティックなファンタジー・タイムラプス短編。人物なし。文字なし、ロゴなし、透かしなし。暗い卓上に、古びて壊れた電球が置かれている。映像は、ひび割れたガラスと切れたフィラメントの極端なクローズアップから始まる。電球の中で小さな電気火花が走り、光る粉塵が素早く渦を巻き始める。カメラは電球の内部へ入っていくように素早く寄り、少し回り込む。

entries.title: Hospital Corridor Creature Horror
entries.description: A detailed 12-second horror sequence prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring an abandoned hospital setting, a suspenseful fake-out, and a high-impact creature jump scare.
entries.prompt:
Hospital Corridor Fake-Out (12 Seconds)

Scene / Setting

Night. Large abandoned Indian hospital corridor. Flickering fluorescent lights. Wheelchairs, rusted stretchers, peeling paint, long empty hallway. Everything clearly visible.

Camera

Medium shot from behind and beside an elderly Indian woman sitting in a wheelchair. Stable handheld smartphone footage. Slight shake.

Subject / Action

An elderly Indian woman sits alone in a wheelchair in the middle of an abandoned hospital corridor.

A nurse is pushing her.

A voice calls from off-screen:

“Sister, ek minute idhar aana!”

The nurse responds:

“Ek second.”

The nurse walks away, leaving the elderly woman alone.

The woman watches her disappear.

Silence.

At the far end of the corridor is a large cross-passage.

The woman stares toward it.

A massive shadow slowly appears on the wall.

Then an enormous creature walks across the distant opening.

Tall and inhuman.

Glossy black skin.

Long limbs.

Slightly wet, slimy appearance.

Its silhouette fills the entire cross-passage as it slowly walks from one side to the other.

The elderly woman freezes in terror.

The creature disappears from view.

Silence.

Nothing happens.

The woman exhales in relief.

Then she hears a faint sound above her.

A wet scraping noise.

She slowly looks upward.

Suddenly the same creature drops from the ceiling directly in front of her wheelchair.

Its face fills the frame.

It releases a violent screech.

The woman screams.

Hard cut to black.

Audio

Wheelchair sounds, distant hospital hum, flickering lights, wet scraping from above, final creature screech.

Style

Ultra-realistic horror, realistic creature movement, strong fake-out, fast escalation, high-impact jump scare, found-footage realism, no animation.

The minion keeps tickling Anubis's armpits, and Anubis finally bursts into laughter. A colossal rhinoceros-like titan storms through a futuristic metropolis, its body encased in fused metallic armor and split by glowing magma veins. Superheated steam blasts from its nostrils with every breath, turning the air around it into a haze of heat and destruction.

entries.title: 90s Disney Style Anubis Animation
entries.description: A detailed multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0 creating a 90s Disney style animation where the god Anubis is defeated by tickling.
entries.prompt: 经典的90年代迪士尼动画风格。场景1 [0-3秒]：在沙漠中一座宫殿前，强大的豺狼神阿努比斯正在施展魔法。他微微抬起双臂，利爪掌心凝聚着闪电魔法，用他那威严的声音说道：“人类，你们将为你们的傲慢付出代价！” 闪电在他附近划过数次。在他面前，三个人类（两男一女）紧张地看着他，想要阻止邪恶的阿努比斯，却不知该如何下手。场景2 [4-6秒]：阿努比斯的脸部特写。阿努比斯带着邪恶的笑容威胁道：“你们完了。” 然后发出邪恶的笑声。他继续邪恶地笑着，然后闭上眼睛，笑声变成了一种痒痒的笑声，表明 he 很怕痒，而且有什么东西在挠他。场景3 [7-9秒]：镜头缓缓拉远，展现出站在阿努比斯身旁的女子，她正用羽毛轻轻地在阿努比斯的腋下上下拂动，并不断重复这个动作。阿努比斯闭着眼睛，咧嘴大笑，双臂高举，露出腋窝，发出咯咯的笑声。场景4 [10-12秒]：女子继续用羽毛在阿努比斯的腋下上下拂动，阿努比斯依然咯咯地笑着。与此同时，轻盈的魔法逐渐消失，只剩下太阳。阿努比斯笑着笑着，无法集中注意力去感受魔法。阿努比斯笑得单膝跪地，一只胳膊高高举起，露出腋窝，任由羽毛挠痒，另一只空着的手则捶打着地面，笑声不断。场景5[13-14秒]：女人继续用羽毛挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯则继续大笑，用咯咯笑的声音喊道：“别折磨我了！别这样！”然后继续咯咯地笑。两个男人看着这一幕，如释重负，庆幸自己制止了邪恶的阿努比斯。阿努比斯肌肉发达，手臂和脖子上都戴着环。他赤裸着上身。他的声音低沉而富有磁性，却又充满力量。他的手是爪子。语音为英文。
entries.translated_prompt: Classic 90s Disney animation style. Scene 1 [0-3 seconds]: In front of a palace in the desert, the powerful jackal god Anubis is performing magic. He raises his arms slightly, lightning magic gathering in his clawed palms, and says in his majestic voice: 'Humans, you will pay for your arrogance!' Lightning flashes near him several times. In front of him, three humans (two men and one woman) look at him nervously, wanting to stop the evil Anubis but not knowing how. Scene 2 [4-6 seconds]: A close-up of Anubis's face. Anubis threatens with an evil smile: 'You are finished.' Then he lets out an evil laugh. He continues to laugh evilly, then closes his eyes, and the laughter turns into a ticklish laugh, indicating he is very ticklish and something is scratching him. Scene 3 [7-9 seconds]: The camera slowly pulls back to show the woman standing next to Anubis, gently moving a feather up and down under Anubis's armpit and repeating the action. Anubis closes his eyes, grins broadly, raises his arms to reveal his armpits, and giggles. Scene 4 [10-12 seconds]: The woman continues to move the feather up and down under Anubis's armpits, and Anubis continues to giggle. Meanwhile, the light magic gradually fades, leaving only the sun. Anubis laughs and laughs, unable to focus on feeling the magic. Anubis laughs so hard he falls to one knee, one arm raised high to reveal his armpit, letting the feather tickle him, while the other empty hand pounds the ground, laughing continuously. Scene 5 [13-14 seconds]: The woman continues to tickle Anubis's armpit with the feather, and Anubis continues to laugh heartily, shouting in a giggling voice: 'Stop torturing me! Don't do this!' then continues to giggle. The two men watch this scene, relieved that they stopped the evil Anubis. Anubis is muscular, with rings on his arms and neck. He is shirtless. His voice is deep and magnetic, yet full of power. His hands are claws. Audio in English.

Pure black. A single red line appears in darkness. The line glows softly. The camera follows it. As it moves forward, enormous concrete walls begin rising from the ground. Massive slabs. Raw geometry. Monolithic forms. The line is literally building architecture.

VOICEOVER: "Every structure begins with a line."

0:03–0:06

MUSIC: Minimal industrial pulse, mechanical rhythm, slow cinematic build.

VOICEOVER: "A line becomes a wall." "A wall becomes a city."

0:06–0:10

The camera rises thousands of feet above the metropolis. The full scale is revealed. A breathtaking brutalist world stretching to the horizon. Then the impossible happens. The entire city begins lifting from the ground. Buildings detach. Bridges separate. Concrete fragments float upward. The audience realizes the city was never a city. It was a product.

SFX: Structural groans, concrete fractures, low-frequency shockwaves, massive whooshes.

0:10–0:13

Millions of concrete particles and rusted steel elements spiral inward. Everything converges. The megastructure collapses into a single object. Your brutalist Rotring emerges. Raw. Scarred. Unbreakable. Floating in white space.

MUSIC: Full orchestral rise, massive cinematic hit.

VOICEOVER: "Some tools create architecture." "This one became it."

0:13–0:15

Hero shot. The Rotring slowly rotates. Dust falls from the concrete surface. The red ring catches the light. Silence. A precise mechanical click.

VOICEOVER: "Rotring." Pause. "Drawn from concrete."

END FRAME

Style: Prestige drama film tone, dry deadpan comedy, warm amber-mahogany palette, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. Audio: Tense orchestral underscore with low brass swells, sharp SFX punctuation on each cat action, muffled office ambiance, AC hum. Action: The orange cat in a suit stands at the head of the table, raising one paw and tapping a bar chart on the display screen behind him. [3-6s] — Employees React Camera: Fixed medium shot across the table, facing the employees. Hard cut from previous shot. Action: Six nervous employees begin clapping stiffly, eyes wide, smiles strained and hollow. Lighting: Even cool overhead office light, slight shadow under each face. SFX: Slow, uncertain applause, a throat-clear, shuffling papers. [6-10s] — Laptop Incident Camera: Low tabletop angle, fixed. Hold. 編集： リズム感のある高速カット、寄りカット、超接写、ローアングル、俯瞰ショット、素早いパン、気持ちのいいマッチカットを使用してください。 盗む瞬間の手元寄り、走り出しの表情寄り、群衆をすり抜ける追従カット、足場を飛び越える俯瞰、着地の足元超接写、ロープや布を使った移動のダイナミックな斜め構図などを織り交ぜてください。 エネルギッシュでスタイリッシュな映像にしつつ、祝祭都市ならではの高低差と混雑を活かしたスリリングな逃走にしてください。 

重要： 静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。 走りや盗みなど自然にアニメーションさせてください。 動画全体を通して、同じ祭りのきのこ都市の雰囲気と高品質アニメスタイルを維持してください。 文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないでください。 颯爽シーンとしてハラハラドキドキを演じてください。 主人公の顔、青いフード、衣装、背負った籠、発光きのこの形状を全編で一貫して維持してください。

entries.title: Arctic Titan Awakening Dark Fantasy Prompt
entries.description: A suspenseful dark fantasy sequence featuring a colossal ancient titan trapped beneath an iceberg in a snowstorm.
entries.prompt:
15-second cinematic dark fantasy sequence inside a frozen arctic wasteland during a violent snowstorm.

A colossal ancient titan sleeps trapped beneath a massive iceberg larger than mountains, barely visible under layers of translucent ice and deep frozen cracks. Only vague shapes of its gigantic face and body can be seen beneath the frozen surface.

The camera slowly glides across the icy landscape with heavy wind, drifting snow particles, frozen fog, and deep blue-white moonlight reflecting through the glacier.

As the camera pushes closer, subtle tremors begin beneath the ice. Tiny fractures spread slowly across the frozen surface. Deep muffled resonance echoes from below like an ancient heartbeat awakening after centuries.

The titan’s enormous eye slowly opens beneath the translucent ice. A massive glowing iris appears under the glacier, illuminating the frozen depths with cold cyan light. Snow and frost slide from the surface as the eye moves for the first time.

The surrounding iceberg creaks violently, frozen dust falling into deep cracks. The camera holds on the gigantic eye staring upward from beneath the ice while distant thunder rolls through the blizzard.

Style: ultra cinematic dark fantasy, colossal scale, ancient god atmosphere, frozen textures, realistic snow simulation, volumetric fog, moody blue lighting, atmospheric depth, glacier translucency, slow suspense pacing, photorealistic ice details.

Audio: ONLY cinematic sound effects, no music. Arctic wind, distant ice cracking, deep subsonic rumbles, frozen debris shifting, muffled titan breathing beneath the glacier, low resonance pulses.

entries.title: Viking Werewolf Frozen Lake Hunt Prompt
entries.description: An epic Viking action sequence involving a survival chase on a frozen lake with realistic ice and snow physics.
entries.prompt:
Epic Viking fantasy action set on a vast frozen lake beneath a stormy northern sky. Endless snowfields, distant mountains, harsh winds, blowing snow. High-speed chase with brutal survival energy. Sound: crunching ice, roaring wind, heavy breathing, cracking frozen surfaces, monstrous growls.

0–3s — HOOK

A Viking warrior carrying a flaming torch sprints across a frozen lake.

His boots hammer across the ice.

Behind him—

A gigantic frost-covered werewolf bursts through drifting snow.

White fur coated in ice crystals.

Blue eyes glowing.

Its massive paws crack the frozen surface beneath every step.

⸻

3–6s — ESCALATION

The warrior pushes harder.

The werewolf rapidly closes distance.

Chunks of ice break apart behind them.

The creature occasionally lunges forward, nearly catching him.

Its claws leave deep fractures spreading across the lake.

⸻

6–9s — BUILD

Ahead, a huge pressure crack cuts across the lake.

The warrior spots it.

He lowers his center of gravity and accelerates.

The werewolf roars and commits fully to the chase.

Snow and ice explode behind it.

⸻

9–12s — THE TRAP

The warrior reaches the pressure crack and dives into a controlled slide.

He skims across the narrow gap and reaches solid ice beyond.

The werewolf charges after him.

Bullet time.

Its front paws hit the weakened section.

Cracks spread outward in every direction.

⸻

12–15s — PAYOFF

The entire frozen surface collapses beneath the werewolf.

Massive sheets of ice explode upward.

The beast drops into the freezing black water below.

The warrior rolls onto the snowy shoreline and scrambles to safety.

Behind him, enormous ice slabs crash back into the lake.

Silence.

The warrior stands, breathing heavily, torch still burning.

entries.title: Medieval Werewolf Rooftop Chase
entries.description: An intense, multi-stage action prompt for a werewolf pursuit across European stone rooftops featuring speed ramps and bullet time.
entries.prompt:
High-action medieval fantasy chase beneath a massive full moon. Ancient European city of stone towers, narrow streets, cathedral spires, smoking chimneys, fluttering banners. Silver moonlight reflects off wet rooftops from recent rain. Fast-paced, chaotic cinematography with aggressive tracking shots, speed ramps, handheld energy, and dramatic moonlit silhouettes. Sound: distant church bells, heavy breathing, tile cracking, werewolf roars, rushing wind.

0–3s — HOOK

A rogue thief in a dark leather cloak sprints across steep medieval rooftops.

He leaps a gap between buildings.

The instant he lands—

A gigantic werewolf crashes onto the roof behind him.

Eight feet tall.

Jet-black fur.

Yellow eyes glowing in the moonlight.

The roof caves beneath its weight.

Tiles explode everywhere.

⸻

3–6s — ESCALATION

The thief races along the rooftops, vaulting chimneys and sliding over wet tiles.

Behind him, the werewolf ignores every obstacle.

It smashes through chimneys instead of avoiding them.

Bricks and debris rain into the streets below.

The creature gains ground rapidly.

⸻

6–9s — BUILD

Ahead, the thief reaches a steep roof overlooking a massive cathedral square.

He slides uncontrollably down slick tiles.

The werewolf launches after him.

The gap between them shrinks to almost nothing.

The beast’s claws scrape sparks from the stone.

⸻

9–12s — THE ESCAPE

At the edge of the roof hangs a giant ceremonial banner suspended above the square.

The thief leaps and grabs it.

The banner tears loose from its mountings.

He swings across the moonlit square.

The werewolf follows without hesitation.

Bullet time.

Both suspended over open air.

⸻

12–15s — PAYOFF

The thief draws a knife and slices the banner rope.

He swings clear.

The werewolf loses its trajectory.

It crashes directly through the cathedral’s enormous stained-glass rose window.

Colored glass explodes outward.

The beast disappears into darkness inside the cathedral.

The thief lands on the opposite rooftop and turns back.

A massive crash echoes from within the cathedral.

entries.title: Moonlit Werewolf Forest Chase Prompt
entries.description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action sequence featuring a warrior being chased by a colossal werewolf through a dense forest.
entries.prompt:
Dark fantasy action sequence. Dense moonlit forest at night. Thick fog. Silver moonlight cutting through trees. Fast handheld tracking shots. Chaotic action. Sound: heavy breathing, snapping branches, pounding hooves, werewolf growls.

0–3s — HOOK

A young warrior sprints through dense forest carrying a spear.

Branches whip past his face.

Behind him—

A colossal werewolf crashes through trees.

Massive shoulders.

Silver-gray fur.

Glowing amber eyes.

Every step sends dirt flying.

The creature is gaining fast.

3–6s — ESCALATION

The warrior vaults fallen logs and dodges tree trunks.

The werewolf tears straight through obstacles instead of avoiding them.

Entire trees snap and fall.

The forest explodes around them.

The warrior glances back.

The werewolf is only meters away.

6–9s — BUILD

The warrior bursts into a giant moonlit clearing.

Ahead—

A herd of enormous elk-like creatures stampedes across the field.

Towering antlers.

Dozens of them.

The ground shakes beneath their charge.

9–12s — CHAOS

The warrior dives into the middle of the stampede.

Bodies thunder past on both sides.

The werewolf charges directly after him.

Antlers slam into the beast.

Hooves strike.

Dirt and debris fill the air.

The clearing becomes complete chaos.

12–15s — PAYOFF

The warrior reaches a cliff edge hidden beyond the clearing.

He leaps.

The werewolf bursts through the stampede behind him and jumps too.

The warrior catches a tree growing from the cliff face.

The werewolf misses.

It sails past him and disappears into the darkness below.

The warrior hangs from the tree, breathing hard.

Cut.

entries.title: Purikura Booth Comedy Scene
entries.description: A high-tempo animated comedy scene inside a photo booth where three characters fight to be at the center of the frame for each shutter flash, featuring vibrant lighting and expressive reactions.
entries.prompt:
画像 1 = 3人のキャラクター参照。顔、髪型、服装、雰囲気を全編で一貫して維持すること。
画像 2 = 絵コンテ参照。パネル順、テンポ感、表情変化、立ち位置の奪い合い、コメディ演出の流れを参照すること。
添付された画像 1と画像 2をもとに、15秒の横型16:9のプリクラ機コメディシーン動画を作成してください。  テーマ  プリクラ機の中で、3人がシャッターのたびにセンター争奪戦を繰り広げる、ハイテンポで可愛くて騒がしいコメディシーン。

シーン設定  舞台はプリクラ機の内部。 カメラは固定されたプリクラ機のレンズ視点であり、カメラ本体や外側から見たショットは出さないこと。 画面は常に、プリクラ機の撮影画面に映る3人を中心に見せる。
3人は画像 1のキャラクターそのままで、  左の黒髪男性 中央の女の子 右の金髪男性 の関係性・見た目・表情の魅力を維持すること。 動画の基本コンセプト  3人が「自分が一番盛れる位置＝画面の中心」を奪い合う。 シャッターが切られる直前になるたびに、誰かが急に前へ出たり、横から割り込んだり、押しのけたり、顔を突っ込んだりして、センターを奪い合う。 コミカルで大げさなリアクション、可愛いポーズ、変顔寸前の焦り、嫉妬、驚き、ぶりっこ、強引な割り込みなどを盛り込み、プリクラらしい“盛れたい欲”のバトルとして描く。 最終的には3人ともフレームに収まり、仲良く可愛く決まるオチにする。

流れ（15秒構成）
0.0秒〜2.0秒  3人が最初のポーズに入る。 中央の女の子がかわいくポーズを決め、左右の2人がそれぞれ「自分も写りたい」と身を乗り出す。 まだ平和だが、すでにセンターの奪い合いの気配がある。 表情は、黒髪男性はクールに狙っている感じ、金髪男性は大げさでテンション高め、女の子は少し戸惑いながらも可愛く決めている。  2.0秒〜4.0秒  最初のシャッター直前、右の金髪男性が勢いよくセンターへ顔を突っ込む。 顔が大きく前に来て、他の2人が押しのけられそうになる。 女の子はびっくり、黒髪男性は不満げに睨む。 “誰かが急に前に出てくる”面白さを強く出す。
4.0秒〜6.0秒  次のシャッター前、今度は左の黒髪男性が素早く前へ入り、クールにキメ顔でセンターを奪う。 金髪男性は「えっ！？」というオーバーリアクション、女の子は2人に挟まれて困り顔。 顔の寄り、視線のぶつかり、微妙な押し合いで笑いを作る。
6.0秒〜8.0秒  女の子が「ちょっと！」という感じで2人を押し返し、自分でセンターを取り返す。 かわいいウインク、ほっぺを手で包むポーズ、ぶりっこポーズなど、プリクラらしい盛れる仕草を決める。 左右の2人は奥や端に追いやられて悔しがる。  8.0秒〜10.0秒  シャッター音のタイミングに合わせて、3人が一斉にセンターへ雪崩れ込む。 顔同士が近づきすぎる、肩がぶつかる、片方が顔を押し込む、もう片方が横から入り込むなど、わちゃわちゃした密度の高いコメディにする。 ここはテンポ最速。 それぞれの表情は、焦り、ムキ、驚き、笑い、必死さが入り混じる。
10.0秒〜12.5秒  一瞬バランスを崩しかけるが、3人ともなんとかフレーム内に収まろうと調整する。 押し合いから、徐々に「せーの」でまとまる空気に変化。 女の子が中央、黒髪男性が左、金髪男性が右に入り、3人の顔が綺麗に見える位置へ収束していく。
12.5秒〜15.0秒  ラストシャッター。 3人が同時にベストポーズを決める。 女の子はかわいく、黒髪男性は少しクールに微笑み、金髪男性は元気に明るく笑う。 最後は仲良し感のある、盛れたプリクラの決めカットで締める。 ラストに向かって空気が喧嘩ではなく、可愛いカオスから仲良しオチへ変わること。

スタイル  超高品質・超高精細・フォトリアル寄りの実写風映像。 ただし空気感はプリクラらしいポップで可愛い世界観。 全体として、  明るく柔らかい高キー照明 美肌感 ほんのりピンク、ラベンダー、水色系の可愛い色調 キラキラ感 ポップでラブリーな雰囲気 若者向けのテンション感 を持たせること。 平成〜令和の可愛いプリクラ文化のノリを感じる、ハイテンポで盛れるビジュアル。 演出 カメラは原則固定されたプリクラ機のレンズ視点 ただし、完成映像として気持ちよく見えるように、軽微なデジタルパンチイン、微細な揺れ、勢いを感じる前後運動感、顔の寄り引き感は可 外から見た引きショットは禁止 カメラ本体が画面に映る構図は禁止 面白さは、被写体側の動き、顔の出入り、押し合い、割り込み、表情芝居で作ること シャッターのタイミングごとに、一瞬“決めポーズ”になりそうで崩れる→誰かが割り込むという流れを明快にすること 編集  リズム感のある高速展開、寄りカット感、超接写感、勢いのある前後運動、表情の切り替えを重視してください。 実際のカメラ位置は固定でも、被写体がレンズへ近づいたり離れたり、左右から割り込んだりすることで、映像に大きな変化を作ってください。 テンポの良いシャッタータイミング、可愛い間、コミカルな詰め合い、ぴたっと決まるラストを意識してください。 静止画のスライドショーにはしないでください。 3人の顔、髪、服、アクセサリー、年齢感、雰囲気を保ったまま、自然で豊かなアニメーションとして動かしてください。  感情トーン 可愛い コメディ わちゃわちゃ ちょっと恋愛っぽい空気 軽い嫉妬 全員が自分を一番可愛く／かっこよく写したい必死さ 最後は仲良し 重要 カメラ本体を画面に出さないこと ショットはプリクラ機のレンズ視点で統一すること 画像 1の3人の顔、髪型、服装、キャラクター性を全編で一貫して維持すること 画像 2の絵コンテのテンポ感、立ち位置の奪い合い、コメディ性を踏襲すること 静止画のスライドショー禁止 文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かしは入れないこと 過度な人数追加禁止 別人化禁止 ラストは3人がしっかり盛れて、可愛くまとまること
entries.translated_prompt:
Image 1 = Reference for 3 characters. Maintain face, hairstyle, clothing, and atmosphere consistently throughout. Image 2 = Reference for storyboard. Follow panel order, tempo, facial expression changes, competition for positions, and comedy direction. Based on attached Image 1 and Image 2, create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 purikura booth comedy scene video. Theme: A high-tempo, cute, and noisy comedy scene inside a purikura booth where three people fight for the center spot every time the shutter clicks.

Scene Setting: Inside the purikura machine. The camera is a fixed lens view from the purikura machine; do not show shots from outside or include the camera body itself. The screen always shows the three people as seen on the purikura machine's capture display. The three characters should be exactly as in Image 1, maintaining the appeal of the relationship, looks, and expressions of the black-haired male on the left, the girl in the center, and the blonde male on the right. Basic concept: The three compete for the 'best position = center of the screen.' Just before the shutter clicks, someone suddenly moves forward, interrupts from the side, pushes others away, or sticks their face in to steal the center. Include comical and exaggerated reactions, cute poses, anxiety on the verge of making funny faces, jealousy, surprise, playing coy, and forceful interruptions, depicting it as a battle of the desire to 'look good' in a purikura way. Finally, all three should fit in the frame and end with a cute, friendly pose.

Flow (15-second composition): 0.0s-2.0s: The three enter their first pose. The center girl poses cutely, while the two on the sides lean in saying they want to be in it too. It's peaceful but the center battle is already brewing. Expressions: the black-haired male looks like he's coolly aiming for it, the blonde male is exaggerated and high-tension, and the girl is a bit puzzled but posing cutely. 2.0s-4.0s: Just before the first shutter, the blonde male on the right vigorously sticks his face into the center. His face comes close to the front, almost pushing the others out. The girl is surprised, and the black-haired male glares at him unhappily. Emphasize the humor of someone suddenly coming forward. 4.0s-6.0s: Before the next shutter, the black-haired male on the left quickly moves forward and steals the center with a cool pose. The blonde male gives an overreaction ('What?!'), and the girl looks troubled between them. Create laughs through facial close-ups, clashing gazes, and subtle pushing. 6.0s-8.0s: The girl pushes the two back as if to say 'Wait a minute!' and reclaims the center for herself. She performs typical purikura poses like a cute wink or cupping her cheeks. The two on the sides are pushed to the background or edges and look frustrated. 8.0s-10.0s: Matching the shutter sound timing, all three scramble for the center at once. Faces get too close, shoulders bump, one pushes their face in, another enters from the side, making it a chaotic and dense comedy. This is the fastest tempo. Expressions are a mix of panic, stubbornness, surprise, laughter, and desperation. 10.0s-12.5s: They momentarily lose balance but adjust to try and fit within the frame. The pushing changes to an atmosphere of coming together on 'ready, set, go.' The girl moves to the center, the black-haired male to the left, and the blonde male to the right, converging into positions where all three faces are clearly visible. 12.5s-15.0s: The last shutter. All three strike their best poses simultaneously. The girl is cute, the black-haired male smiles coolly, and the blonde male smiles energetically and brightly. End with a final cut of a great purikura photo showing their friendship. Ensure the atmosphere changes from cute chaos to a friendly ending toward the finish.

Style: Ultra-high quality, ultra-high definition, photorealistic live-action style video. However, the atmosphere should be the pop and cute world of purikura. Overall, use bright and soft high-key lighting, smooth skin texture, slightly pink, lavender, and light blue cute tones, sparkling effects, and a pop, lovely vibe with a youthful energy. A high-tempo visual that feels like the cute purikura culture from the Heisei to Reiwa eras. Direction: The camera is primarily a fixed lens view from the purikura machine. However, to make the final video look pleasing, slight digital punch-ins, subtle shakes, forward/backward movement for momentum, and facial zooming are allowed. Wide shots from the outside are prohibited. Compositions showing the camera body are prohibited. The humor should be created through the subjects' movements, faces entering/exiting, pushing, interruptions, and facial acting. Clearly show the flow of 'almost striking a pose' then collapsing because someone interrupts at each shutter timing. Editing: Emphasize rhythmic high-speed development, close-up cuts, extreme close-ups, momentum-filled forward/backward motion, and facial expression switching. Even if the actual camera position is fixed, create significant changes in the video by having subjects approach/distance themselves from the lens or interrupt from the sides. Be mindful of well-timed shutters, cute pauses, comical crowding, and a perfectly landing finale. Do not make it a slideshow of still images. Move the three naturally and richly as animation while maintaining their faces, hair, clothes, accessories, age, and atmosphere. Emotional Tone: Cute, comedy, chaotic, slightly romantic air, light jealousy, everyone desperate to look their best/coolest, and finally friendly. Important: Do not show the camera body in the frame. Unify shots from the lens perspective of the purikura machine. Maintain consistency in the faces, hairstyles, clothing, and character traits of the three from Image 1 throughout. Follow the tempo, competition for positions, and comedic nature of the storyboard in Image 2. No slideshows. No text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. Act out the suspenseful excitement as a quick-moving scene. Ensure the three look good and come together cutely at the end.

entries.title: Fantasy Dragon Bridge Escape Sequence

0–3s — HOOK

A female huntress with braided hair, leather armor, and a bow sprints across an ancient stone bridge.

Behind her—

A gigantic armored werewolf bursts through the bridge entrance.

Seven feet tall.

Black fur.

Steel armor plates fused into its shoulders and forearms.

3–6s — ESCALATION

entries.title: Telekinetic Corridor Action Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed telekinetic action scene involving a high school girl in a weightless environment with frozen-time dynamics.
entries.prompt: In a telekinetic action scene, a South Korean high school girl in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt stands calmly in the middle of a corridor. She is being attacked from both sides; some attackers, wearing brown school uniform jackets, wield short sticks, while others are dressed as black ninjas, creating a tense standoff in the corridor. As the enemies rush towards her, the girl unleashes a powerful telekinetic attack. Suddenly, everything around her enters a state of weightlessness and time freezes. Dozens of items—open textbooks, notebooks, a red soda can, and a wooden school chair—leave the ground, perfectly suspending themselves in mid-air. The attackers, in their lunging movements, are frozen in mid-air by an invisible force. Paper pages, scraps of paper, and dust float and swirl around her weightlessly. The camera slowly zooms in on the girl, perfectly freezing the chaotic corridor in the telekinetic-induced state of stillness and suspension. In the extreme stillness of the slowly zooming-in, frozen image, the girl's calm eyes narrow slightly. Immediately afterward, she calmly raised her right hand, her fingers loosely clenched, and then made a light yet decisive flick of her sleeve to either side of her body. In an instant, frozen time and gravity seemed to explode with this subtle gesture. A low rumble echoed in the air, and dozens of objects that had been suspended in mid-air—a heavy wooden school chair, scattered textbooks, even the red soda can—transformed into a dense projection, carrying powerful air currents, and were precisely launched towards the enemies attacking from both sides. At the same time, an invisible circular psychic shockwave violently spread out from the girl. The brown-uniformed attackers and black-clad ninjas, who had been frozen in mid-air, were instantly struck by this immense force, their bodies jolted violently, and they were sent flying backward like kites with broken strings to either end of the corridor. As gravity instantly returned, the wooden chairs shattered upon impact, textbooks scattered into a flurry of pages, and with the dull thud of heavy objects hitting the ground, the attackers collapsed onto the corridor floor, incapacitated. Silence returned to the corridor, broken only by countless tattered papers and fine dust drifting slowly in the air. The aftershocks of the shockwave ruffled the girl's bangs and hair. She remained composed, not even glancing at her fallen opponent. The girl slowly lowered her right hand, raised her slender left, and gracefully and calmly tucked a strand of black hair behind her ear, revealing her delicate and serene profile. The camera froze on this moment, the white papers falling around her like snowflakes, highlighting her still figure in a white short-sleeved shirt and gray pleated skirt. Then, the image faded out.

entries.title: Cyberpunk Mumbai Werewolf Pursuit
entries.description: A cinematic 15-second action sequence set in a dystopian Mumbai with a robotic werewolf chasing a cyberpunk woman on a motorcycle.
entries.prompt:
Fast-paced dystopian cyberpunk action in a ruined Indian megacity at night. Burnt cars, neon Hindi signs flickering, smoke vents, broken flyovers, puddles reflecting pink and blue neon. Chaotic shaky cinematography, aggressive handheld tracking, dirty lens flares, speed ramps, practical lighting. Sound: roaring engines, distorted radio chatter, hydraulic servos, metallic growls, distant explosions.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK

A tattooed Indian cyberpunk woman with shaved punk hair races through a destroyed street on a junkyard-built motorcycle made from exposed engine parts, welded scrap, and glowing cables.

Behind her—

A gigantic half-real, half-robotic werewolf crashes through burnt cars at full speed.

Metal claws scraping asphalt.

Hydraulic limbs flexing.

One glowing red cybernetic eye.

⸻

2–4s — ESCALATION

Low shaky side-tracking shot.

The cyber-werewolf runs unnaturally fast, sometimes on all fours, sometimes launching itself over wrecked vehicles.

Its exposed mechanical spine sparks while flesh and metal shift together violently.

Radio crackles in her ear.

Male voice:

“Get it in position!”

⸻

4–7s — BUILD

She drifts hard around a pile of overturned taxis.

The werewolf slams through one car completely, sending debris flying across the road.

It gains ground fast.

The woman shouts into the radio:

“I’m trying!”

Ahead through smoke and neon haze—

a broken flyover ramp appears.

⸻

7–10s — COMMIT

She accelerates directly toward the ramp.

Cut to rooftop—

A man with a bazooka steadies his aim through heat distortion.

Radio:

“Bring it closer…”

The cyber-werewolf launches itself forward in massive leaps, nearly reaching the bike.

⸻

10–13s — BULLET TIME PAYOFF

The woman hits the ramp and flies into the air.

Bullet time engages.

The cybernetic werewolf leaps upward behind her, claws reaching inches from her back.

The bazooka fires.

Rocket streaks through frame in slow motion.

Direct impact into the werewolf’s chest.

Explosion of sparks, fire, metal fragments, fur, and smoke.

⸻

13–15s — FINAL BEAT

Time snaps back.

The woman lands hard, bike wobbling violently—

she regains control and speeds forward.

Behind her, the burning cyber-werewolf crashes through wrecked cars and explodes into debris.

She laughs into the radio:

“Got him.”

The man cheers over comms.

Cut.

entries.prompt: 采用复古动漫风格。巨龙将那个孩子举在头顶，正准备将其扔出去；然而，一只漂浮着的白色魔法手套突然凭空出现，令巨龙略感诧异——他目不转睛地盯着那只戴着手套的手，看着它缓缓伸向自己的腋下。镜头随即拉近，特写展示了那只手套如何用灵活蠕动的指尖去挠巨龙的腋窝凹陷处；其动作轻柔流畅，伴随着一阵滑稽的音效声。就在手套指尖触及腋下的那一瞬间，巨龙的表情瞬间变得滑稽可笑——他双眼紧闭，咧开大嘴傻笑不止，口中发出阵阵闷声的窃笑。手套继续挠着巨龙的腋下，巨龙也随之放声大笑；随后，他猛地松开抓着孩子的双手，转而紧紧抱住自己的身体，试图以此止住那挥之不去的痒意与笑声。随着手套凭空消失，巨龙终于从那阵狂笑中平复下来；他既对刚才发生的一切感到困惑不解，又因觉得对方“作弊”而感到恼火，遂将怒气发泄到了那个孩子身上。配音语言为日语。巨龙的声音低沉浑厚。

00:00–00:03（星空の亀裂・宇宙の脈動）
カメラ：少女が宙を見上げるカットから、急激にカメラが上昇し空のパースへ。
アクション：少女が頭上でパチンと指を鳴らす。その瞬間、頭上の虚空にガラスが割れるような幾何学的な「空間のひび割れ」が発生する。

00:03–00:06（星座の獣・星狼の降臨）
カメラ：少女を俯瞰する360度超高速回転ショット。
アクション：少女は空中で両手を大きく広げ、天空の光を胸に引き寄せるようなダイナミックなポーズを取る。
エフェクト：空間の裂け目から、純粋な星光で形成された「コズミック・ウルフ（星狼）」の半透明な巨体が咆哮しながら飛び出す。星狼の体は星座の線（星座グラフ）で繋がっており、走るたびに宇宙の塵を撒き散らす。
雰囲気：天体の覚醒、星との契約。

00:06–00:09（天体融合・コズミックアーマー）
カメラ：背後からのローアングルから、少女の横顔への超クローズアップ。
アクション：星狼が少女の背中から衝突するように融合。少女は衝撃で両腕を十字に交差させ、鋭い眼光で正面を睨みつける。
エフェクト：制服が光の粒子に分解され、星の結晶でできた重厚かつスタイリッシュな白い天体装甲（宇宙の騎士甲冑）へと一瞬で変貌する。髪は重力を無視して逆立ち、先端がネオンブルーに発光する。
雰囲気：絶対的な防御力とパワーの覚醒。

00:09–00:12（巨剣顕現・重力崩壊）
カメラ：引きの全身ショットから、武器のディテールへ超高速ズーム。
アクション：交差した両手を引き剥がすと、光の粒子が凝縮され、彼女の身長を超えるほどの巨大な「大剣（グレートソード）」が物質化する。少女は両手で大剣を握り、大振りに一閃して地面に突き立てる。
エフェクト：大剣の刀身は宇宙の星々が流れる液晶のようになっており、突き立てた瞬間、周囲の空間に重力波の歪み（黒い同心円の波紋）が広がる。
雰囲気：一撃必殺の威圧感。

00:12–00:15（戦闘開始・臨戦態勢）
カメラ：大剣の切っ先から少女の顔へと抜けるダイナミックな広角ショット。
アクション：大剣を肩に担ぎ直し、不敵な笑みを浮かべる。彼女の足元から星の光が爆発的に噴き出し、いつでも突撃できる前傾姿勢を取る。
エフェクト：背後に巨大な星座の紋様が静かに明滅し、全エネルギーがブレードに集中していく。
雰囲気：嵐の前の静けさ、圧倒的な破壊力の予感。

entries.title: Prehistoric Titan Dinosaur Battle
entries.description: An epic cinematic sequence featuring a T-Rex and Spinosaurus in a high-octane prehistoric jungle battle.
entries.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic dinosaur sequence set in a prehistoric world untouched by humans. The video must feel like a fusion of Hollywood blockbuster filmmaking, BBC Earth realism, IMAX nature cinematography, and next-generation photoreal VFX. Scene opens at sunrise inside a colossal ancient jungle valley covered in fog, towering cliffs, volcanic mountains, giant waterfalls, and dense tropical forests. Massive dinosaurs roam through the environment with cinematic scale and realism. Opening shot: A gigantic Tyrannosaurus Rex slowly emerges from dense mist while the ground shakes beneath its footsteps. Rain droplets fall from its scarred skin in ultra slow motion. Camera moves low through wet grass and mud with dramatic cinematic depth. Cut to: A herd of enormous Brachiosaurus walking beside gigantic waterfalls while flying Pterosaurs soar across the glowing orange sky. Sun rays pierce through clouds creating epic god rays and atmospheric haze. Suddenly — the jungle becomes silent. A terrifying roar echoes across the valley. A colossal Spinosaurus explodes out of dark water in ultra slow motion, creating massive splashes, flying debris, shaking trees, and cinematic shockwaves. The T-Rex turns aggressively. Final sequence: Both apex predators charge toward each other through mud, rain, smoke, and fire as volcanic eruptions begin in the background. Camera rapidly switches between extreme close-ups, ground-shaking footsteps, teeth detail, water splashes, flying dust, and ultra cinematic wide shots. Final frame: Both dinosaurs freeze face-to-face before impact while lava erupts behind them and lightning flashes across the sky. TEXT ON SCREEN: “WHEN TITANS RULED THE EARTH” Style: ultra photorealistic, cinematic masterpiece, IMAX scale, volumetric lighting, realistic dinosaur anatomy, dramatic atmosphere, HDR, film grain, shallow depth of field, dynamic camera movement, Hollywood VFX quality, epic color grading, emotional orchestral tension, 4K, 8K, legendary cinematic realism.

entries.title: Surreal Eye Ocean Macro
entries.description: A hyper-surreal cinematic prompt starting with an extreme macro of a human eye that transforms into a deep ocean world with impossible physics.
entries.prompt: Extreme macro shot of a human eye under soft natural light. Tiny reflections visible across the iris surface. At the 2-second mark, the pupil begins expanding unnaturally. Inside the eye, an entire ocean becomes visible. Massive waves crash beneath floating clouds contained entirely within the iris. The camera dives into the pupil and enters the ocean world. The environment feels physically impossible: — giant whales swim through clouds — rain falls upward — moonlight refracts beneath the water surface — colossal waves freeze mid-motion before collapsing again. Human eyelashes become giant black structures on the horizon. Velocity ramp: a wave crashes toward the camera, freezing into suspended crystal water droplets reflecting the original human face. Final moment: the camera exits the eye again — now the entire room around the person is flooded silently with ocean water. Hyper-surreal macro cinematography, dream physics, volumetric water light interaction, 4K.
