Action: She springs up instantly, using her core strength. She smooths her jacket and hair in a hurried, embarrassed motion.
Lighting: Bright sun illuminating her face as she stands.

[10-13s] She glances around rapidly, eyes darting to see if anyone noticed her fall, then immediately forces a bright, calm smile to compose herself.
Camera: Slow push-in to a medium close-up, focusing on her expression.
Action: Her face transitions from a brief moment of shock to a polished, confident expression. She looks directly into the camera lens with a nothing happened  smile.
Lighting: Warm, soft natural light on her face.

[13-15s] She turns slightly and resumes walking away from the camera, blending back into the crowd.
Camera: Slow pull-out to follow her as she walks away, keeping her in frame.
Action: She continues walking with a brisk, natural step, putting distance between her and the spot of the fall.
Lighting: Natural daylight, soft lens flare as she moves forward.

Avoid: Identity drift, teleporting limbs, distorted face during the fall, unnatural rapid animation.

entries.title: Reality-Shattering Glitch Metamorphosis
entries.description: A complex video prompt for a digital glitch sequence where reality shatters to reveal a character stepping through multiple artistic styles.
entries.prompt:
Video begins as a completely black screen. A single digital cursor blinks. Code begins scrolling upward, then FRACTURES. The screen shatters like glass, and through the cracks, golden light bleeds in. A hand reaches through, then a FULL FIGURE steps out of the broken screen into reality. Camera pulls back dramatically revealing a young man standing in an empty infinite white void, dressed in a sharp monochrome suit, completely still. He looks down at his hands 
they're glitching, flickering between art styles. He looks up at the camera — and smirks. CHARACTER DESCRIPTION: Male figure, late 20s, striking angular features, calm but electric presence. Sharp jawline, dark expressive eyes, short textured hair. Tall, lean, perfectly composed. Wears a base outfit of an all-black slim-fit suit with no tie, open collar  this suit morphs in texture/material each scene but silhouette stays constant. CORE ACTION — THE ARCHITECT'S WALK: He walks. Not dances — walks. But every step is intentional, cinematic, powerful. Slow-motion stride. Each footfall sends ripples of color and style transformation radiating outward across the entire frame. He gestures — points, adjusts his collar, looks over his shoulder — every micro-movement triggering a reality shift. The void around him constructs and deconstructs entire worlds per frame. THE WORLD TRANSFORMS WITH HIM (not just his clothing): Each style shift changes the entire environment, not just him: Neo-Tokyo cyberpunk alley — rain, neon signs, holographic billboards Ancient Roman marble courtyard — columns, golden hour, white stone Floating Japanese zen garden — cherry blossoms frozen mid-fall 1920s jazz club — smoky amber light, art deco geometry Arctic ice cave — bioluminescent blue, crystalline formations Abstract geometric void — Mondrian color blocks, pure math Baroque oil painting universe — dark chiaroscuro, dramatic shadows Brutalist concrete megastructure — raw texture, harsh overhead light Deep ocean abyss — bioluminescent creatures drifting past Burning desert at golden hour — heat shimmer, cracked earth STYLE TRANSFORMATION (Full frame shifts — not just the character): Photorealistic cinematic rendering (Arri Alexa look) Ukiyo-e woodblock print style 3D isometric illustration Brutalist graphic poster art Expressionist oil painting (thick brushstrokes) Blueprint / architectural draft style 16-bit pixel art Linocut print style (high contrast carved look) Risograph print (limited palette, slight misprint offset) Byzantine mosaic tile style Technical wireframe / hologram rendering Sumi-e ink wash (extreme minimalism) Constructivist propaganda poster style Stipple engraving illustration Studio Ghibli background painting style STYLE BURSTS: Occasionally two aesthetic universes collide mid-frame — one half of the screen is Ukiyo-e, the other is cyberpunk. They fight for dominance, then snap to a new unified style.

entries.title: Magical Cinema Hall Deer Rescue
entries.description: A cinematic video prompt where a girl stands up in a theater and pulls a live deer out of the screen, blending high-stakes wildlife action with magical realism.
entries.prompt: A luxurious auditorium hall with elegant architecture, high ceilings, and soft ambient lighting. The hall is filled with rows of comfortable seats. At the front, there is a massive ultra-HD screen spanning almost the entire wall. In the front rows, a group of young boys are sitting on the floor, watching the screen with full attention. Behind them, a mix of women and a few adults are seated on chairs, also focused on the screen. On the giant screen, a dramatic wildlife scene is playing: a group of fast, powerful cheetahs chasing a deer across an open savannah. The chase is intense, filled with dust, speed, and tension. After a long pursuit, the cheetahs finally catch the deer and begin to attack it. Suddenly, something magical and unexpected happens. A beautiful young girl sitting in the audience stands up with determination. She runs toward the giant screen. As if the screen is a portal, she reaches into it and pulls the frightened deer out from the scene into the real auditorium. The cheetahs inside the screen stop and stare in shock, one of them roaring angrily toward the audience, confused and furious that its prey has disappeared. Meanwhile, inside the hall, the rescued deer appears alive and safe. The young children sitting in front become excited and gather around it, gently petting it with love and curiosity. The deer, now calm and grateful, wags its tail softly and responds affectionately to the children. The entire scene blends realism with fantasy — cinematic lighting, emotional expressions, high detail, magical realism, 4K, ultra-detailed, immersive atmosphere.

entries.title: Street Dance Battle Highlights

entries.title: Dark Deserted Street Horror
entries.description: A terrifying horror narrative featuring sequential blackouts on a deserted street and lurking creatures outside a streetlight's glow.
entries.prompt:
A deserted street at night suddenly starts going dark one streetlight at a time — fast. Each blackout is followed instantly by distant screaming and violent crunching sounds. A terrified man realizes something is moving between the lights faster than humanly possible. He sprints toward the final working streetlight at the end of the road while shadows race beside him. Reaching the light, he looks around in relief… then realizes the creatures are circling just outside the glow.

Shot 1 (0s–2s) — 

Wide empty street at night.

Streetlights begin shutting off RAPIDLY one after another toward camera.

POP. POP. POP.

Each blackout comes with screaming in the darkness.

A shadow darts impossibly fast between the dead lights.

Shot 2 (2s–5s)

A man hears the screams and starts running instantly.

Handheld chaos.

Lights continue dying behind him in sequence as if something is chasing the electricity itself.

Cars alarms start going off.

A shape briefly sprints across a dark gap beside him at impossible speed.

Shot 3 (5s–8s)

He reaches the final remaining streetlight.

Breathing hard.

Darkness surrounds him on all sides now.

Low growls echo nearby.

Then glowing alien eyes begin appearing one by one just outside the light radius.

Moving constantly.

Circling.

Shot 4 (8s–11s)

The creatures start testing the light.

One lunges partially into the glow — black fur, elongated limbs, glowing jaws — then recoils violently.

Another races behind him so fast it creates wind.

The light above flickers hard.

The man panics and backs toward the pole.

Shot 5 (11s–15s) — PAYOFF

The streetlight suddenly dies.

Pure darkness.

Instant screaming and snarling all around him.

Then —

The light flickers back ON for half a second.

The man is gone.

Only the creatures remain standing calmly beneath the light, staring upward toward camera before everything cuts black again.

Key Visual Hook

Streetlights shutting off sequentially toward camera while something impossibly fast moves between them.

entries.title: Dunhuang Mural Dance Transition
entries.description: A cinematic multi-scene script for Seedance 2.0 that transitions a modern dancer into a traditional Dunhuang mural world with complex motion blur and physical obstruction transitions.
entries.prompt:
镜头一：现代装扮与展示敦煌画卷
时间段：0:00 - 0:03
景别与镜头类型：近景转中景，固定镜头，带有轻微手持呼吸感。
运镜轨迹与速度感：镜头基本固定，通过人物极具爆发力的拉开画卷动作带动画面节奏，速度极快。
主体动作、表情与长相：视频主角（程潇）长相精致，五官立体，鼻梁高挺，面部轮廓流畅，带着清透的日常妆容。她留着黑色长直发，身穿一件现代的粉色连帽拉链卫衣。起初她双眼微闭，神态恬静，双手交叠握着一卷未展开的画轴。随后她猛地睁开眼，双手迅速向两侧发力，将画卷在镜头前用力拉开。拉开的画卷上，清晰地展现出一幅色彩浓郁、极具古典美感的敦煌壁画。
画面特效：画卷被拉开的瞬间产生强烈的运动模糊。这幅铺开的敦煌壁画直接占满并遮挡住整个镜头，形成物理遮挡转场，营造出强烈的视觉吸入感。
整体色调与情绪：白色极简背景配合粉色现代服装，色调明亮、生活化；随着敦煌壁画的展露，情绪瞬间被神秘的东方色彩填满。

镜头二：破壁而出与华丽起舞
时间段：0:03 - 0:06
景别与镜头类型：全景推至中景。
运镜轨迹与速度感：镜头穿透画卷转场后快速向前推进，随后速度放缓，完美契合背景乐的古典节奏。
主体动作、表情与长相：伴随转场，震撼的视觉奇观出现：人物仿佛直接从刚才那幅2D的敦煌壁画中走了出来，一步跨入3D立体的古风场景中，并瞬间完成了华丽.变装。她的古典美被彻底激发：眉心点缀鲜红的额钿，眼妆深邃拉长，配以复古红唇，五官更显明艳动人。她头戴巨大的红色牡丹发冠和金色步摇，身穿金、红、绿撞色的抹胸古装与长裙，臂挽轻纱。她在古色古香的圆台上起舞，挥舞长袖，神情惊艳、高贵。
画面特效：极具空间感的无缝变装转场，完美呈现了人物从壁画中剥离并走向现实的破壁视觉效果；空间中飘落着粉色的花瓣粒子特效；周围悬挂的青色、橙色纱幔随风飘动；人物舞动时带有轻微的慢动作处理，凸显仙气。
整体色调与情绪：进入画中世界后，色调转为浓郁的暖金调，色彩极度丰富且富丽堂皇；情绪转为古典、华贵，极具视觉冲击力。

镜头三：魅惑舞姿与侧颜绝杀
时间段：0:06 - 0:09
景别与镜头类型：中近景，跟镜头与摇镜头。
运镜轨迹与速度感：镜头跟随着人物的转身动作平滑摇摄，速度适中，如丝般顺滑。
主体动作、表情与长相：她转身并向两侧挥舞手臂，展示繁复的金色颈饰与手部饰品。当她侧脸面对镜头时，展现出极其优越的下颌线和立体的侧颜，眼神微微上挑，流露出一种神秘而魅惑的古典风情。
画面特效：花瓣粒子特效持续，舞台后方的暖色屏风透出柔和的光晕，光影在人物光洁的肩颈和丝带上流转。
整体色调与情绪：环境光以温暖的金色和暗红色为主，情绪神秘、充满女性魅力与东方韵味。

镜头四：极具压迫感的凝视特写
时间段：0:09 - 0:10
景别与镜头类型：面部特写。
运镜轨迹与速度感：短暂的固定定格，节奏在这一瞬间凝固。
主体动作、表情与长相：这是全片最惊艳的定格瞬间。人物正面直视镜头，完全展现了其建模脸般的精致长相：大且深邃的双眼、小巧的鼻头、花瓣般的红唇，以及华丽的金色流苏发饰。眼神凌厉、自信且极具穿透力，仿佛刚刚从壁画中走出的神女在注视着凡人。
画面特效：面部使用了高级的柔光处理，突出了无暇的皮肤质感和精致的古风妆面。
整体色调与情绪：光线精准聚焦于面部，色彩浓烈，情绪极具压迫感，将绝美的东方美学推向高潮。

镜头五：柔韧下腰与大气的空间感
时间段：0:10 - 0:12
景别与镜头类型：中景拉至全景，带有高角度的俯拍。
运镜轨迹与速度感：镜头快速向后拉出并稍微抬高，制造出强烈的空间纵深感。
主体动作、表情与长相：人物在圆台中央做出了一个极具力量感与柔韧性的向后下腰动作，双臂向两侧完全展开，水袖和披帛垂落，身段极其柔软优美。
画面特效：明显的慢动作处理拉长了这一高难度动作的视觉停留时间；地面伴有浓郁的白色烟雾特效，营造出仙境般的氛围。
整体色调与情绪：场景全貌展现，红、黄、绿纱幔交织，氛围宏大、梦幻，充满舞蹈艺术的张力。

镜头六：一舞终了与绝美收势
时间段：0:12 - 0:15
景别与镜头类型：中景，环绕摇镜头。
运镜轨迹与速度感：镜头跟随着人物的收尾动作，进行小幅度的平滑环绕移动。
主体动作、表情与长相：人物从下腰状态起身，继续舞动双臂，双手在面部附近摆出优美的古典舞蹈指诀造型，最后动作定格。她微微扬起下巴，眼神重新回到高冷、不可侵犯的状态，长相在华丽头饰的衬托下更显清冷脱俗。
画面特效：花瓣特效渐渐减少，整体画面笼罩在柔和、朦胧的光晕中。
整体色调与情绪：温暖华丽的基调延续到最后，情绪余韵悠长，仿佛一曲终了，壁画中的神女即将再次沉睡，留给观众强烈的视觉震撼。

entries.title: Restroom Fight Long Shot
entries.description: A John Wick-inspired continuous long shot prompt featuring a sophisticated woman fighting an assassin in a public restroom.
entries.prompt:
A single continuous 15-second cinematic long shot inside a sterile, dimly lit public restroom. White subway tiles, large wall mirror, white ceramic sink, flickering fluorescent overhead lights, wet reflective floor. 
[0:00–0:02] Medium shot. A sophisticated woman in {argument name="reference image" default="@/image1"} with sharp green eyes, bold dark brows, and deep red lips - dressed in a tailored matte black suit and navy silk blouse - washes her hands at the sink, calm and composed, eyes locked on her reflection in the mirror. [0:02–0:04] In the mirror's reflection, a broad-shouldered assassin in a dark charcoal tactical suit bursts from a stall and locks a chokehold around her from behind. Camera subtly pushes in. Both figures slam into the tiled wall. Strained expressions, desperate struggle.
[0:04–0:06] She drives her elbow back hard, breaks free, spins and seizes the assassin - camera pans fluidly - executing a powerful Judo shoulder throw that launches the attacker into a metal stall door with crushing impact. Debris and shadows scatter under flickering lights.
[0:06–0:09] Camera drops low, tracks laterally through the brawl - rapid punches, parries, blocks - she slips a strike and counters with a devastating blow. Realistic motion blur, gritty handheld energy, sharp focus on her determined green eyes and gritted red lips.
[0:09–0:11] Camera swings wide then CRASHES close - she seizes the assassin's head and drives it into the mirror with full force. Ultra slow-motion: thousands of glass shards explode toward the lens, a massive spiderweb crack blooms across the mirror surface. High contrast, visceral impact, dramatic light burst.
[0:11–0:13] Slow camera pull-back. She stands tall over the unconscious assassin on the wet restroom floor. She coolly adjusts her silk blouse, straightens her blazer. Her fractured reflection multiplied across broken mirror shards. Cool-toned cinematic grade.
[0:13–0:15] Extreme close-up profile. She produces a white handkerchief, wipes a single drop of blood from the corner of her red lips, takes one final look at her distorted cracked reflection - then walks out of frame. Camera lingers on the shattered mirror. Fade to black.
Style: Photorealistic, 4K cinematic, John Wick-inspired gritty elegance, cool blue-grey color grade, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting from flickering fluorescents, continuous fluid camera movement throughout.

entries.title: Top Gun Maverick F-35 Dogfight

Tom Cruise as Maverick piloting a modern F-35 Lightning II with special skull markings on the tail, engaged in intense close-range dogfight against a Russian Su-57 Felon fighter jet.

entries.title: Dramatic Female Football Nutmeg Sequence
entries.description: A visceral cinematic sequence of a female footballer performing three nutmegs and scoring a winning goal in a packed stadium.
entries.prompt: A packed stadium roaring under floodlights, the pitch a vivid emerald green slicked with evening dew, white yard lines glowing under the intense overhead lights. The scoreboard reads 89th minute — one goal down. Tension crackling through every seat in the house. A female footballer receives the ball just inside the opposition half — number 10 on her back, boots worn and mud-streaked, jaw set with absolute iron determination. First defender charges in — she rolls the ball through his legs with surgical precision — nutmeg — the crowd gasps. She explodes forward, low and fast, hair flying behind her. Second defender closes aggressively from the right — she barely glances up — slides the ball calmly through his legs without breaking stride — second nutmeg — the stadium erupts louder. She enters the box at full sprint, third defender lunges desperately — she drags the ball back one touch then pings it clean through the final gap — third nutmeg — the goalkeeper comes off her line — the striker takes one composing breath in real time slow motion — drives the ball low and hard into the bottom left corner. The net ripples violently. A split second of complete silence. Then the entire stadium detonates — seventy thousand people exploding to their feet simultaneously. The girl wheels away screaming at the top of her lungs, face contorted with pure raw emotion, sprinting full speed toward the corner flag, fists clenched, tears streaming down her face. She reaches the flag and screams into the night sky — teammates pile onto her from every direction — an avalanche of bodies and joy. Camera pulls back wide — the entire stadium a wall of noise and light — one girl at the center of it all. Cinematic. Visceral. Unforgettable. SCENE BREAKDOWN: Scene1 0–2s Establishing stadium shot packed stands under floodlights, emerald pitch glistening, scoreboard reading 89th minute2 2–4s Female footballer receives ball in opposition half close up on boots, jaw, determined eyes crowd tense3 4–6s First defender charges ball rolled through legs nutmeg crowd gasps she explodes forward4 6–8s Second defender closes from the right second nutmeg without breaking stride stadium erupts louder5 8–10s Third defender lunges in the box third nutmeg goalkeeper rushes out slow motion composing breath6 10–11s Ball drives low and hard into bottom left corner net ripples violently split second of silence7 11–13s Stadium detonates seventy thousand on their feet girl wheels away screaming tears streaming fists clenched8 13–14s Full sprint to corner flag screams into the night sky teammates avalanche onto her from every direction9 14–15s Wide pull back entire stadium wall of noise and light one girl at the glorious center of it all

entries.title: Ethereal Cathedral Forest Wedding
entries.description: A cinematic and heartbreakingly beautiful sequence of a bride walking through an ancient forest transformed into a glowing cathedral of white petals and ivory candles.
entries.prompt:
A breathtaking ancient forest transformed into a cathedral of light and nature. Towering oak trees draped in cascading white silk ribbons, their branches intertwined overhead forming a living canopy. Thousands of ivory candles line a petal-strewn aisle, flames perfectly still despite the open air, casting a warm trembling gold across everything they touch. Thousands of flowers — white roses, baby's breath, wisteria, cherry blossoms — float impossibly in the air at every height, slowly rotating, petals drifting downward like the gentlest snowfall ever witnessed. A hush falls over the gathered crowd seated on either side, their faces bathed in flickering candlelight. Then she appears. A bride at the far end of the aisle, silhouetted in soft ethereal backlight, her cathedral veil catching every floating petal that grazes it. She moves slowly, deliberately, radiantly — each step releasing a subtle ripple of light through the candles on either side. Close up on her face — eyes glistening, lips softly parted, a single tear escaping down a perfectly powdered cheek. The floating flowers part gently as she passes, as though the forest itself is making way for her. Camera glides alongside her in a smooth cinematic tracking shot — candle flames bowing slightly as she passes as if in reverence. The crowd dissolves into silence and tears. Wide shot from above — the full breathtaking aisle of light and floating blooms — the bride a single luminous figure moving through a dream made real. Cinematic. Ethereal. Heartbreakingly beautiful.

SCENE BREAKDOWN:

Timing Scene
1 0–2s Establishing wide shot ancient forest transformed, candle-lined aisle, floating flowers, silk-draped trees, golden light
2 2–4s Low angle shot thousands of candles flickering, petals drifting downward like snowfall, crowd seated in reverent silence
3 4–6s Bride appears at far end of aisle silhouetted in ethereal backlight cathedral veil catching floating petals
4 6–8s Smooth cinematic tracking shot alongside bride  candles bowing as she passes flowers parting gently around her
5 8–10s Extreme close up bride's face glistening eyes, soft lips, single tear on perfectly powdered cheek
6 10–12s Crowd reactions tears, hands over mouths, soft smiles all bathed in warm trembling candlelight
7 12–14s Wide overhead drone shot full breathtaking aisle of light and floating blooms bride a single luminous figure 
8 14–15s Final frame bride reaches the end of the aisle candles flare softly petals cascade all around her

entries.title: Manhattan Street Supercar POV Footage
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt simulating raw, handheld iPhone footage of a supercar on a busy Manhattan street, featuring natural lighting and ambient sound effects.
entries.prompt: global_rule: No music, diegetic SFX only. Raw handheld iPhone footage, auto-everything, bystander POV on a bustling Manhattan street — no styled lighting, no grading, auto white balance flickering between warm and cool as the camera pans across shade and sun. At 0s the camera is already unsteady, pointed loosely down a bustling Manhattan street, slightly over-exposed on the asphalt, the operator clearly reacting in real time — you can hear ambient noise from the environment, distant traffic, a faint crowd murmur, wind buffeting the mic with a low crackle. At 1s the deep, authoritative low-frequency rumble of an exotic supercar engine rolls in from off-screen left — raw, unfiltered, the phone mic distorting slightly at the low-end peaks — and the camera swings fast to track it, momentarily cutting off the top of the frame and catching a blurred pedestrian shoulder in the foreground. At 2s a matte black Lamborghini Huracán slides into frame, the engine rumble stretching into a thick, resonant growl that vibrates the audio channel. The auto-focus hunts aggressively — the car body goes soft and the background sharpens for half a second before snapping back to the car's low roofline. At 3s the driver's window is fully down and the man in the all-black suit is visible from the chest up — a figure with an athletic build wrapped in a perfectly tailored outfit, every detail immaculate against the raw, unpolished context of a bustling Manhattan street. Their face is sharply lit by harsh overhead sun casting a hard shadow under their jaw, no fill light, completely natural and unflattering in the best paparazzi sense. Their expression is calm, composed, a barely-there smirk playing at the corner of their mouth, steely eyes scanning forward. At 4s a bystander on the sidewalk — a young individual in a casual outfit — steps partially into the left edge of frame, half-obscuring the car's front bumper, and calls out toward the open window over the crowd noise, their voice raw and unpolished against the ambient audio: 'Excuse me, what do you do for a living?' The camera auto-focus briefly loses the man in the all-black suit's face and locks onto the bystander's outfit before hunting back. At 5s the man in the all-black suit turns their head slightly toward the window, the smirk deepening just a fraction, their posture relaxed and unhurried despite the slow rolling momentum of the car. At 6s in a voice that is crystal clear, confidently projected, unmistakably standard American English — cutting cleanly above the engine rumble and street noise with natural authority — the man in the all-black suit says: 'I'm a prompt engineer.' The words land with casual precision, no affectation, just clean American vowels and a tone that suggests the statement is both completely mundane and somehow the most interesting thing anyone in a bustling Manhattan street has said all day. At 7s the camera operator exhales audibly into the mic, a small laugh or breath of surprise, and the frame dips slightly downward catching the car's rear quarter panel and spinning rim in slow motion — the wheel spokes strobing beautifully in the harsh sunlight, lens flare clipping the upper right corner of frame in a raw uncorrected streak of yellow-white blown highlight. At 8s the auto-focus completely loses the car and locks onto a chain-link fence twenty feet behind — the entire foreground goes buttery soft — before snapping back with a micro-jolt at 9s just as the rear of the Huracán begins to slide past frame. Chromatic aberration bleeds purple and green along the high-contrast edge of the car's matte black bodywork against the pale sky. At 10s the camera pans to track the rear of the car — slightly too slow, cutting off the exhaust pipes — the engine note shifting and deepening as the car rolls forward, the slow-motion audio turning the rumble into a cinematic subsonic throb that the phone mic renders with slight clipping distortion on the peaks. At 11s a pedestrian walks fully through frame between the camera and the car, completely blocking the shot for nearly a full second — the operator doesn't cut, just holds and waits, the frame partially obscured by the back of someone's jacket. At 12s the car is three-quarters past, the rear wing visible, and the camera is now slightly under-exposed as the operator has tracked into a shaded zone — the auto exposure struggling to compensate, the image briefly darkening and then lurching brighter. At 13s the camera drops almost to waist height, catching the car's exhaust and rear diffuser low and wide, the slow-motion engine sound tapering as the Huracán puts gentle distance between itself and the crowd — still rolling slowly, window still down, the man in the all-black suit's silhouette just barely visible in the driver's seat, one arm resting on the door. At 14s the phone's auto white balance shifts warmer as the camera swings back into full sunlight, the image going slightly flat and overexposed on the pale asphalt. At 15s the footage cuts abruptly mid-pan — not a clean edit, just the operator stopping the recording — the last frame frozen on a slightly motion-blurred rear view of the matte black supercar shrinking into the heat-haze of a bustling Manhattan street, the engine rumble fading into ambient noise from the environment, wind, and the sound of someone nearby saying something unintelligible off-mic.

entries.title: Macro Spice Cosmos Stop-Motion
entries.description: A stunning macro stop-motion prompt that transforms simple spices into a cosmic universe with surreal gravitational effects and particle motion.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second cinematic, ultra-detailed macro stop-motion style video in vertical 9:16 format. Scene opens on a rustic wooden table bathed in warm sunrise light. A small pile of mixed desi spices (turmeric, chili flakes, cumin, cardamom) sits still in extreme macro close-up. Dust particles gently float in visible light rays. The atmosphere is quiet, earthy, and intimate. At 3 seconds, a human finger slowly enters frame and pinches the spice mix. As the spices are lifted, the grains begin to defy gravity and float in slow motion. Each particle subtly starts glowing with warm tones (gold, red, amber). At 7 seconds, the spices suddenly burst outward in slow motion. Turmeric transforms into glowing golden nebula clouds, chili flakes become fiery red supernova explosions, cumin seeds turn into tiny orbiting planets, and pepper particles dissolve into deep space voids. The camera begins a slow orbital rotation around the expanding structure. From 11 to 14 seconds, the frame fully transforms into a cosmic universe made entirely of spices. Swirling galaxies form from spice textures, stars sparkle like salt crystals, and nebulae flow like colored powder clouds. The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the full universe scale. At 14 seconds, the entire cosmic structure collapses smoothly back into the original spice pile. The finger re-enters the frame, resetting everything as if nothing happened, creating a seamless loop. Use macro cinematography, 100–150mm lens look, shallow depth of field, soft volumetric lighting, and smooth high-frame-rate slow motion. Transition lighting from warm earthy tones in the beginning to deep cosmic blues and purples during transformation. Sound design should include soft kitchen ambience, rising tonal hum, particle crackles, deep bass whooshes during explosion, and a subtle “time reset” tick at the loop point. Ensure smooth, physically believable particle motion even during surreal transformation. Maintain highly satisfying visual symmetry and perfect loopability.

entries.title: Black Alien Water Horror Sequence
entries.description: A terrifying horror sequence where black water reveals submerged faces in a rooftop tank, culminating in an alien creature's eruption.
entries.prompt: Residents scream as black water pours from apartment taps. A man rushes to the rooftop water tank at night with a flashlight while people yell below. He climbs the slippery ladder as loud banging echoes from inside the tank. He opens the lid slightly — stillness. His flashlight hits dozens of pale human faces floating underwater. Their eyes snap open together. The water EXPLODES upward as a massive alien creature erupts out, flooding the rooftop in black liquid. ⸻ Shot 1 (0s–2s) — THE HOOK Inside apartment kitchen. Black water violently blasts from a tap onto someone’s hands. People scream in disgust. CUT immediately to rooftop door slamming open as a man sprints out carrying a flashlight. ⸻ Shot 2 (2s–5s) Handheld camera energy. The man runs across the rooftop toward the giant water tank. Loud metallic THUDS echo from inside. Tank vibrates slightly. Water leaks down the sides like thick oil. ⸻ Shot 3 (5s–8s) He climbs the ladder fast. The tank suddenly dents inward beside his face with a massive impact. He almost falls. Breathing hard, he reaches the top and slowly pushes the lid open. Silence. ⸻ Shot 4 (8s–11s) Flashlight beam scans black water. Nothing. Then pale submerged human faces drift into view beneath the surface. Dozens. Still. Then ALL their eyes snap open at once directly toward him. ⸻ Shot 5 (11s–15s) — PAYOFF The water ERUPTS upward violently. A massive alien creature launches out of the tank in a tidal wave of black liquid. The rooftop floods instantly. The man slips backward. Final frame: the creature lands spider-like on the rooftop wall behind him while the floating human faces continue rising from the overflowing tank.

entries.title: Futuristic South Asian City Transformation
entries.description: A cinematic drone sequence showing a realistic South Asian megacity evolving into a high-tech futuristic metropolis with neon lights and flying vehicles.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second ultra-cinematic futuristic city transformation sequence. Scene starts at night in a slightly old, realistic South Asian megacity with dim street lights, traffic, and dense urban chaos. The camera slowly flies forward between buildings in a smooth drone motion. At 3–5 seconds, subtle technological changes begin: street lights shift into soft neon glow, digital holographic ads start appearing in the air, and building surfaces slowly upgrade into sleek smart glass and metallic structures. At 6–10 seconds, the transformation accelerates dramatically. Roads become intelligent glowing pathways, AI interfaces appear in the environment, people interact with floating holograms, and autonomous flying transport vehicles move through the sky in smooth traffic patterns. At 10–13 seconds, the entire city fully evolves into a futuristic mega-city: ultra-tall smart skyscrapers, neon cyberpunk lighting, floating transit highways in the sky, and clean, organized energy flow throughout the environment. Final 2 seconds: wide aerial shot revealing the complete transformed city—alive, glowing, intelligent, and deeply connected with AI life. Subtle cinematic lens flare, volumetric lighting, ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic, 8K, smooth motion, sci-fi aesthetic, emotional awe feeling. STYLE: cinematic realism, cyber-futuristic, ultra-detailed, smooth camera motion, dramatic lighting, high-end film quality.

entries.title: MMA Cage Fight Sequence
entries.description: A technical 15-second multi-shot prompt detailing an MMA fight, including camera angles, lighting, and movement choreography.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-cinematic 15-second MMA cage fight inside a packed arena, bright overhead lights, chain-link fence surrounding the fighters, crowd blurred in the background.

0–2s: Wide cage shot — two fighters circle near the fence, gloves up, footwork light, tension high.

2–4s: Medium handheld shot — Fighter A pressures forward, Fighter B backs toward the cage, breathing heavy, shoulders tense.

4–6s: Close exchange — fast jab feint, low kick check, quick head movement, both athletes reacting realistically.

6–8s: Cage pressure — Fighter A pins Fighter B briefly against the fence, strong shoulder contact, hands fighting for position.

8–10s: Break and counter — Fighter B turns off the cage, but Fighter A times a clean hook with full hip rotation.

10–12s: Impact slow-motion — punch lands cleanly, sweat sprays, Fighter B’s head turns sharply, balance breaks, legs buckle.

12–13.5s: Fall — Fighter B drops to the mat with realistic body weight, arms trying to catch balance, referee rushing closer.

13.5–15s: Aftermath — Fighter A steps back, breathing hard, gloves raised slightly, crowd erupting behind the fence.

Camera: ringside cage angles, handheld intensity, fast but readable cuts, slight slow-motion only at impact.

Lighting: harsh arena lights, sweat highlights, strong contrast, fence shadows crossing the fighters.

Style: ultra-cinematic realism, MMA broadcast intensity, grounded physics, close-range aggression, no text, no overlays, stable proportions without stretch.

entries.title: Anime Character School Classroom Dance
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt for Seedance 2.0 to animate an anime character in a realistic high school setting. It focuses on natural body movement, maintaining character consistency from a reference image, and using an amateur handheld camera style.
entries.prompt:
参照画像のキャラクターを使って、15秒の縦型ダンス動画を作成。キャラクターは参照画像のアニメスタイルを維持、背景は日本の高校の教室のような実写スタイルを維持する。
- 顔、髪型、衣装、色、全体のシルエットは参照画像を優先する
- キャラクターは1人だけ
- 顔、手、指、足の形を自然に保つ - 衣装の細部よりも、身体の重心移動、姿勢、シルエットを優先する
- 激しいブレイクダンスではなく、高校生がノリで踊ってみた感じの音楽に乗るような短い実写ダンスMVにする
- 重心移動、肩、腰、膝、足首の連動を明確にする
- 同じ振付を続けず、ステップ、振り返り、手元、足元、横顔、髪の揺れを混ぜる
-友達がiPhoneで動画を撮っているような雰囲気で、素人感がでているカメラワーク（手ブレなど）
entries.translated_prompt:
Create a 15-second vertical dance video using the character from the reference image. The character should maintain the anime style of the reference image, while the background maintains a live-action style like a Japanese high school classroom.
- Prioritize the reference image for the face, hairstyle, outfit, colors, and overall silhouette
- Only one character
- Keep the shapes of the face, hands, fingers, and feet natural - Prioritize center of gravity movement, posture, and silhouette over costume details
- Make it a short live-action style dance MV, like a high schooler dancing to music for fun, rather than intense breakdancing
- Make the coordination of center of gravity movement, shoulders, waist, knees, and ankles clear
- Do not repeat the same choreography; mix steps, turns, hand movements, footwork, side profiles, and hair swaying
- Use camera work that feels like a friend is filming with an iPhone, giving it an amateur feel (such as camera shake)

entries.title: Mythic Forest Fairy War
entries.description: An epic cinematic sequence of an apocalyptic clash between descending fairies and erupting demons in an ancient rune-carved forest.
entries.prompt:
A vast ancient forest, towering trees thousands of years old, their bark carved with glowing runes, mist curling through the roots like living creatures. Dead silence. Then — a crack of golden light splits the sky. Thick storm clouds part and a blinding radiance pours through as thousands of fairies descend in formation, wings shimmering like stained glass catching sunlight, armor forged from moonstone and frozen starlight, spears tipped with pure white flame. They move like a murmuration — fluid, synchronized, devastating. Simultaneously — the forest floor fractures. Deep crimson light bleeds through the cracks as the earth tears itself open. A demon horde erupts upward in a volcanic surge — towering horned beasts, scaled warriors with molten eyes, dark wings like torn leather blocking out what remains of the sky, war cries shaking the ancient trees to their roots. The two forces lock eyes across the forest canopy for one suspended breath — complete silence — then collide with catastrophic force. Light meets shadow. Gold meets red. The ancient trees tremble and splinter. Magic detonates in every direction. The forest floor ignites. The sky tears open further. Camera sweeps wide in a breathtaking arc — the full scale of the collision visible — thousands deep on both sides — an apocalyptic clash that has been building for a thousand years finally unleashed in one single devastating moment. Cinematic. Mythic. Earth-shattering.

SCENE BREAKDOWN:
TimingScene
10–2sEstablishing wide shot ancient rune-carved forest, dead silence, mist curling through roots
22–4sSky cracks open golden light floods through storm clouds fairy army descends in glowing formation
34–6sClose-up fairy warriors in moonstone armor, shimmering wings, white flame spears, moving in unison
46–8sForest floor fractures crimson light bleeds through demon horde erupts violently from the earth
58–10sClose-up towering horned demons, molten eyes, torn leather wings, war cries shaking the trees
610–12sBoth armies lock eyes across the canopy  one suspended heartbeat of pure silence
712–14sCatastrophic collision light meets shadow gold meets red magic detonates in every direction
814–15ssweeping wide arc full scale of both armies clashing forest igniting sky tearing open

entries.title: Alien Creature Under Bus Horror
entries.description: A high-intensity horror movie prompt featuring an alien creature attacking a city bus from below, designed for maximum visual impact.
entries.prompt:
A packed city bus tears through rainy streets at night. Suddenly the entire floor dents upward beneath passengers’ feet with a metallic BOOM. People scream as scraping sounds race underneath the bus at impossible speed. Sparks blast past the windows. A passenger looks down outside — an alien creature is sprinting upside down beneath the chassis, weaving between axles. The driver slams the brakes. The floor rips open from below as the creature bursts upward into the aisle.

Shot 1 (0s–2s) — THE HOOK

Inside packed moving bus.
The floor suddenly BULGES upward violently beneath standing passengers, throwing people sideways instantly. Metal groans loudly.

A second impact hits immediately after.
Sparks streak past the windows.

Shot 2 (2s–5s)

Bus swerves hard through traffic.
Passengers scream and grab rails.

LOUD metallic scraping races from front to back underneath the vehicle like something huge is crawling at extreme speed below them.

The entire bus shakes rhythmically with heavy impacts.

Shot 3 (5s–8s)
A terrified passenger leans toward the side window.

Outside below:
an alien creature is hanging upside down beneath the moving bus, sprinting between the axles while gripping metal with elongated limbs.

Its glowing eyes snap upward toward the passenger instantly.

Shot 4 (8s–11s)

Driver slams brakes.

Everyone lurches forward violently.

The creature SMASHES upward repeatedly from below.
Floor panels begin tearing open one by one down the aisle toward camera like a zipper exploding upward.

Passengers scramble over seats in panic.

Shot 5 (11s–15s) — PAYOFF

The floor ERUPTS.

The creature launches fully into the aisle in a shower of sparks and twisted metal, grabbing a screaming passenger mid-air.

Bus crashes sideways into a divider.

Final frame:
through the shattered windshield, the bus skids while the creature crawls across the ceiling inside the overturned bus toward camera.

entries.title: Cinematic Samurai Dusk Duel
entries.description: A Kurosawa-inspired samurai duel storyboard, focusing on slow tension, wind-swept mist, and a singular decisive strike.
entries.prompt:
Style: Cinematic samurai drama, ultra-realistic, muted color palette, natural dusk lighting, slow-motion emphasis, wind-swept atmosphere, shallow depth of field, minimal dialogue, emotional tension, Kurosawa-inspired framing.

0–3s — Silent Approach
Wide establishing shot of a mist-covered field at dusk. Two samurai stand far apart, perfectly still. Tall grass sways in heavy wind. A distant temple silhouette fades into haze. Absolute silence—only wind ambience.

3–6s — The Slow Walk Begins
Both samurai begin walking toward each other. Alternating low-angle tracking shots. Close-ups of calm, focused eyes. Subtle hand movement near katana hilt. Controlled breathing, tension building with every step.

6–9s — Rising Tension
Camera slowly orbits as distance closes. Fabric and hair ripple in stronger wind. Footsteps sink into wet earth. No music, no dialogue—only rhythmic steps and rising pressure in still air.

9–11s — Final Standoff
They stop at blade distance. Extreme close-up on hands tightening around sword handles. A single falling leaf drifts between them in slow motion. Time feels suspended.

11–13s — Draw and Strike
Instant cut to ultra-slow motion: both draw katana simultaneously. Sharp metallic ring echoes. One decisive crossing slash mid-air. Sparks and motion blur freeze the impact moment.

13–15s — Aftermath Silence
One samurai remains standing. The other collapses out of frame. Wind continues through empty field. Camera holds on stillness, lingering on drifting grass, then fades to black.

entries.title: Bank Heist Escape Thriller
entries.description: A cinematic action storyboard for a bank heist escape, utilizing handheld camera energy and neon city lighting.
entries.prompt:
Style: Cinematic thriller, handheld camera energy, high contrast lighting, teal-orange grading, shallow depth of field, fast rhythmic cuts, realistic motion blur.

0–2s — The Heist Breaks Loose
Interior bank vault corridor. Red alarm lights flashing violently. Security doors slam open. Sirens begin blaring in the distance. Close-up: gloved hand grabbing a duffel bag stuffed with cash.

2–5s — Escape Initiated
Masked runner bursts through shattered glass doors. Slow-motion glass fragments flying outward, reflecting neon city lights. Camera shakes slightly as the runner hits the street.

5–8s — Street Chaos
Wide shot of a crowded city market street. People scatter in confusion. The runner pushes through pedestrians, weaving fast. Police sirens grow louder, red-blue lights washing over buildings.

8–11s — Chase Intensifies
Low-angle tracking shot of the runner sprinting across traffic. Cars brake suddenly. A police vehicle skids into frame. Quick cuts: boots hitting pavement, breathing heavy, cash bag swinging.

11–13s — Near Capture Moment
Runner slips through a narrow alley. A hand almost grabs them from behind. Neon signs flicker above, rain starts lightly, adding reflection on wet ground.

13–15s — Escape Beat Cliffhanger
Runner leaps over a barrier and disappears into a subway entrance. Camera lingers on flashing sirens flooding the alley, then cuts to black mid-siren peak.

entries.title: Ultra-Realistic Super Saiyan Transformation
entries.description: An intense 10-second cinematic action sequence featuring a physical transformation, high-speed combat, and massive environmental impact.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic action, grounded physics, IMAX film look, 4K–8K HDR, high contrast, deep shadows, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, anamorphic lens 35mm (f/2.8). 
No over-glow, no excessive aura. 
Energy as air pressure distortion + thin golden electricity (sharp, intermittent).

SCENE (CONTINUOUS 10 SECONDS):
A slim-built man wearing a white tank top and black pants stands on cracked ground.

Fast handheld push-in. Body tenses, veins visible, heavy breathing. Small golden electric sparks appear on hands and shoulders. Dust begins to vibrate.

Muscles grow into an athletic build gradually (no instant cut). Hair rises and turns golden. Ground cracks expand radially, small rocks lift and scatter. Subtle air distortion. A short mini shockwave pushes dust outward.

Reveal a humanoid tentacled monster in front. Tentacles move aggressively with heavy weight.
Character condenses power, leans slightly forward, then explodes into a high-speed sprint (realistic dash blur).

Character appears instantly in front of the monster. One powerful punch to torso/head.
Effects: heavy impact (flesh + mass), brief golden electricity burst at contact, air pressure hit, dust explosion from feet.
Camera: impact zoom + violent shake + slight slow motion on contact frame.

Monster is launched far, leaving a dust trail.
Cut to wide shot: monster crashes into a mountainside, rocks collapse, large debris falls (realistic rockfall, no energy explosion).

entries.title: Cinematic Basketball Storyboard
entries.description: A comprehensive sports storyboard prompt for a high-intensity basketball play, from a defensive steal to a powerful dunk.
entries.prompt:
Create a high-quality 4K cinematic basketball storyboard showing a full sequence from defense to a powerful score, using dynamic arena lighting, dramatic crowd atmosphere, and professional sports broadcast style. The scene begins with an intense half-court moment where a defender performs a clean steal or block, the ball sharply deflected as sweat and motion particles are captured in slow motion. Transition immediately into a fast break: the player recovers the ball, dribbles with speed and control, accelerating past opponents with quick crossovers and footwork. Show close-ups of sneakers gripping the court, the ball bouncing with precise rhythm, and focused facial expressions, mixed with wide shots of the court opening up. Add a key assist moment where the ball is passed sharply between defenders, followed by a sprint toward the basket with the crowd rising in anticipation. Build tension with a slow-motion approach to the paint, then a powerful finish—either a high-impact dunk, smooth layup, or clean jump shot. Show the ball swishing through the net or the rim rattling with force, including defender and crowd reactions.
Integrate realistic background audio throughout: squeaking sneakers on hardwood, echoing dribbles, player shouts, referee whistle, crowd murmurs building into loud cheers, commentator-style distant hype, and arena reverb that intensifies during key moments like the steal, fast break, and final shot.
End with an emotional celebration: the scorer running back, flexing, or raising arms as teammates join, arena lights glowing and crowd erupting. Use varied camera angles (wide, tracking, close-up, POV, slow motion), strong motion blur, and realistic physics (ball bounce, shoe friction, body movement), emphasizing the transition from defensive control to offensive dominance and victory.

0–5 seconds: A stylish woman in a bright hot pink mini dress and high heels walks slowly across a sunny suburban backyard beside a swimming pool. Her long hair flows in the breeze, she smiles playfully toward the camera.

5–8 seconds: Cut to Mike, a fit young gardener in his 20s, wearing a tank top, riding a red lawnmower while mowing straight lines. He suddenly looks up and notices her. His eyes lock on her.

entries.title: Cinematic Kinetic Sculpture Stop-Motion
entries.description: A detailed prompt for creating a 15-second ultra-wide cinematic stop-motion video of a kinetic sculpture featuring rubber bands and metallic objects with evolving geometric structures and seamless looping.
entries.prompt: Create a 15-second ultra-wide cinematic (19:6 aspect ratio) hyper-realistic stop-motion style video with precise mechanical motion, designed for a panoramic storytelling experience. Scene opens on a long minimalist white desk stretching horizontally across the frame under soft natural daylight. The composition is extremely wide, with strong negative space on both sides. In the center lies a single stretched rubber band anchored between two small metal pins. The environment is clean, quiet, and highly detailed with subtle dust floating in sideways light rays. At 3 seconds, a metal ball bearing drops from above and lands inside the rubber band slightly off-center. The impact causes a visible elastic ripple that travels horizontally along the band. The motion spreads laterally across the frame, emphasizing the wide composition. At 6 seconds, multiple small objects begin entering from both left and right edges of the frame in a synchronized rhythm: paper clips slide in from the left, tiny magnets glide in from the right, and micro metal cubes drop gently into the system. Each object interacts with the rubber band differently, creating tension, bounce, and magnetic pull. The system begins expanding horizontally across the entire frame. At 9 seconds, the rubber band network evolves into a complex kinetic structure spanning almost the full width of the scene. Geometric formations emerge horizontally: triangles linking left to right, hexagonal chains stretching across the desk, and spiral patterns forming in the center. The camera performs a slow lateral tracking shot, following the motion across the wide frame. At 12 seconds, the system becomes a fully synchronized floating kinetic sculpture spanning edge-to-edge. Objects orbit smoothly in coordinated horizontal motion, forming a living mechanical rhythm. The lighting becomes slightly more dramatic with soft contrast and reflective highlights traveling across metallic surfaces. At 15 seconds, all motion collapses simultaneously toward the center and resets instantly into the original single rubber band stretched between two pins, restoring the minimal composition. Perfect seamless loop. Use ultra-wide cinematic framing (19:6), macro-level detail, shallow depth of field, and smooth slow-motion physics. Emphasize horizontal movement, spatial rhythm, and edge-to-edge composition. Lighting should remain soft natural daylight with subtle dynamic reflections during transformation. Sound design includes directional object drops, elastic tension sweeps across stereo field, magnetic clicks moving left-to-right, soft mechanical hum expanding across space, and a clean spatial silence at reset for loop perfection. Ensure strong lateral visual storytelling, satisfying physics, and a perfectly seamless loop designed for ultra-wide cinematic viewing.

entries.title: History of Dance Evolution

A single modern pop beat drops — and history explodes into dance. Open on a smoky prehistoric cave, firelight casting wild shadows on stone walls. A group of fur-clad cavemen freeze as the beat hits — then erupt into uncoordinated, enthusiastic, hilariously committed dancing. Grunting, stomping, bones flying. Hard cut — a grand medieval stone castle courtyard, torches blazing. Knights in full armor and noblewomen in flowing gowns suddenly break into the same song, awkwardly but passionately moving in formation, a court jester spinning wildly in the background. Hard cut — a glittering 1970s disco ballroom, mirror ball spinning, neon lights painting everything gold and pink. Perfectly dressed dancers in bell-bottoms and platform shoes hit every beat with surgical precision, pointing at the ceiling in unison, silky smooth. Hard cut — a sleek modern rooftop at golden hour, city skyline behind. A diverse group in streetwear freestyles effortlessly, phones out, energy electric. entries.title: Woman vs Combat Robot Battle
entries.description: An intense cinematic prompt featuring a combat sequence between a woman and a bipedal robot on a narrow mountain ridge.
entries.prompt: A lone woman stands on a narrow rocky ridge high in the Caucasus mountains at golden hour, wind tearing at her torn tactical jacket, dark hair lashing across her sweat-streaked face. Storm clouds churn behind jagged snow-capped peaks. 2,000 feet of open air and fog fill the valley below her. A 6-foot bipedal combat robot — matte black titanium chassis, cracked chest plate leaking sparks, one optical sensor shattered — charges her across broken shale. She pivots hard left, boots skidding on loose gravel at the cliff edge, grabs its arm mid-swing and redirects its full momentum into the rock face — stone explodes on impact. She spins back, both hands gripping a shattered forearm blade she ripped from the robot's own chassis. The robot rises, hydraulics stuttering, its one remaining red optical sensor locking onto her. They face each other on the narrow ledge. Neither moves. The last sunlight drops behind the mountain. Everything turns cold blue and grey. Her breath fogs in the freezing air. Camera begins as a low ground-level tracker during the charge, shifts to a fast lateral dolly during impact, pulls into an extreme rack-focus close-up on her bloodshot eyes, then rises into a slow 360-degree orbit around both figures — open sky and cliff drop visible in every frame. ARRI Alexa film grain. Anamorphic 2.39:1 widescreen. Real-time physics and motion blur on impact. Sound: grinding metal, gale-force wind, labored breath, a low metallic drone, and a single distant heartbeat fading into silence.

Two fresh espresso shots pour directly onto the sugar, dissolving it instantly into a dark, syrupy pool at the bottom.SFX: A granular scrape of sugar, then the sharp hiss of hot espresso hitting metal. [00:03–00:05] Action: A full scoop of ice is added to the shaker. The lid snaps on with a firm click.SFX: Loud, chaotic ice rattling settling into a dull metallic clunk as the lid locks. [00:05–00:08] Action: The shaker is vigorously shaken in frame — held low and close to camera — for several seconds. Frost begins forming on the outside of the metal instantly.SFX: Aggressive, rhythmic ice-against-metal shaking, loud and satisfying. [00:08–00:10] Action: The shaker lid is cracked open and the frothy, caramel-colored espresso streams out over fresh ice spheres in the waiting glass. The liquid is visibly aerated — light, foamy, and layered.SFX: A fast, bubbly liquid pour with faint crackling from the ice. [00:10–00:13] Action: Cold oat milk foam — thick and pourable — is spooned slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats in a clean white layer across the top of the drink without breaking.SFX: A dense, whispery glug as foam settles onto the surface. [00:13–00:15] Action: Ground cinnamon is tapped through a small sieve over the foam, landing in a warm rust-colored haze. A black paper straw is pressed through the foam layer with one clean push.SFX: A soft powder hiss, then a quiet foam puncture as the straw goes in.

Camera: Heavy shaking, with brief defocus and motion blur. Extreme close-ups of metal forming over skin and the cat’s skeletal expansion into a mechanical tiger.
9–12s: The Manifestation
Action: The dust clears. The heroine is now fully clad in an intricate gold-and-white mech armor with sleek contours and glowing dark-gold edges. With a grasp of her right hand, a frost-emitting mech katana materializes.

samurai walking alone, enemies rushing from all directions
dust swirling, banners snapping hard

4-6s

11-13s

13-15s

wind settles, camera pushes in from behind

entries.title: Freestyle Football 16-Step Storyboard
entries.description: A comprehensive storyboard prompt for a street freestyle football performance set in a cinematic urban night environment.
entries.prompt:
请生成一张高完成度、高清晰度的「街头花式足球 · 16步动作分解」海报式分镜图，画面为正方形 4×4 十六宫格排版，每一格展示同一位街头花式足球表演者在同一场景中的一个连续动作步骤。整张图要像「高端运动海报 + 技巧分解教学板」的结合体，既有视觉冲击力，也有清晰的动作说明感。

【整体设定】
主题为：街头花式足球 freestyle 表演，不是正式比赛，不是射门训练，也不是多人对抗，而是一位表演者完成一整套连续的花式足球动作秀。
整体氛围要有：街头感、城市感、电影感、运动感、酷感、节奏感。
背景设定在夜晚的城市街头小球场或城市广场足球空间，有涂鸦墙、铁丝网、远处楼宇灯光、路灯、轻微反光的地面，整体环境统一且具有街头潮流气质。

【人物要求】
主角是一位年轻的帅气男生长相的花式足球达人，身材轻盈、协调、运动感强，短黑发，气质自信，动作流畅有控制力。
全图16格必须是同一个人，不要每格换人。
他穿着一套带有“炫酷”气质的足球服，但不要出现“冠军”两个字，也不要出现任何明确国家名称。服装感觉像某支专业球队的球衣。

【版式要求】
整张图为 4×4 十六宫格，每格都要有：
1. 大号步骤编号（1-16）
2. 中文动作标题
3. 2-4条简短中文动作要点
4. 清晰的人物全身动作
5. 足球运行轨迹箭头 / 脚步轨迹线
6. 足球必须清晰可见，位置合理，不能漂浮或消失

整体字体风格偏运动海报感，清晰有力，适合社交媒体传播。画面要锐利、清楚、干净，人物和足球都要完整，不要裁脚。

【动作顺序】
请按以下顺序设计16个连续动作，每格动作明显不同，并形成一个完整的 freestyle 表演流程：

1. 街头起势
动作：一只脚踩在足球上，身体打开，自信站姿，像表演开始。
要点：霸气站姿 / 右脚踩球 / 展现自信
2. 脚底拉球
动作：脚底将球向后拉回，再带一点横向移动。
要点：脚底踩球 / 向后拉球 / 身体微转
3. 踩单车绕球
动作：双脚围绕足球做踩单车动作。
要点：一脚绕球 / 跨步换脚 / 节奏流畅
4. 内外拨球
动作：用脚内侧和外侧连续拨球，形成左右切换。
要点：内侧拨球 / 外侧拨球 / 快速切换
5. 脚背挑球
动作：用脚背把足球向上挑起，让球离地。
要点：脚背发力 / 向上挑球 / 球起于前
6. 连续颠球
动作：连续脚背颠球，球保持在身体前方上下弹起。
要点：交替颠球 / 保持节奏 / 稳定连贯
7. 膝盖控球
动作：用膝盖或大腿控制足球弹起。
要点：球弹膝盖 / 控制落点 / 保持平衡
8. 脚后跟挑球
动作：用脚后跟从身后或侧后方把球向上挑起。
要点：脚后跟触球 / 向上挑起 / 身体前倾
9. 环球绕球
动作：做 Around the World，一只脚绕空中的球一圈。
要点：脚向外绕球 / 绕球一周 / 落地稳控
10. 交叉绕球
动作：双腿交叉完成绕球技巧。
要点：腿前交叉 / 绕球一周 / 空中换位
11. 肩部停球
动作：将球停在肩部或肩颈附近。
要点：球落肩部 / 收紧肩膀 / 稳定停球
12. 背部停球
动作：身体前倾，让球短暂停留在背部。
要点：身体前倾 / 球停背部 / 保持平衡
13. 彩虹挑球
动作：从身后将球挑起越过头顶，形成彩虹轨迹。
要点：脚后跟挑球 / 球越头顶 / 轨迹弧线
14. 旋身接球
动作：身体原地旋转，再接住落下的球。
要点：原地旋转 / 接住落球 / 软着陆控
15. 脚尖定球
动作：用脚尖或鞋面精准把球停住。
要点：脚尖抬起 / 精准定球 / 完美平衡
16. 街头谢幕
动作：再次一脚踩球，双臂打开，像完成整套表演后的收尾。
要点：右脚踩球 / 展开双臂 / 潇洒谢幕

【视觉风格】
- 整体偏高端运动海报风
- 有电影感夜景光影
- 画面动感强，带一点潮流街头审美
- 箭头 and 轨迹线要清晰，帮助理解足球运动路径
- 色彩以红、黑、金为主，突出高级感和中国红气质
- 字体醒目，适合小红书 / 推特 / 社媒传播
- 整张图要像一个完整的“16步花式足球动作分镜海报”
entries.translated_prompt:
Please generate a high-completion, high-definition 'Street Freestyle Football 16-Step Action Breakdown' poster-style storyboard. The layout should be a square 4x4 sixteen-grid arrangement, with each grid showing a continuous action step of the same street freestyle football performer in the same scene. The entire image should look like a combination of a 'high-end sports poster + technical breakdown teaching board,' possessing both visual impact and a clear sense of instructional action explanation.

[Overall Setting]
The theme is: Street freestyle football performance, not an official match, not shooting practice, nor a multiplayer competition, but a single performer completing a full set of continuous freestyle football moves.
The overall atmosphere should include: street feel, urban feel, cinematic feel, athletic feel, cool, and rhythmic.
The background is set in a small nighttime city street court or urban plaza football space, featuring graffiti walls, wire fences, distant building lights, streetlamps, slightly reflective ground; the environment should be unified with a street-style trendiness.

[Character Requirements]
The protagonist is a young, handsome male freestyle football expert, with a light, coordinated, and athletic physique, short black hair, a confident demeanor, and fluid, controlled movements.
The 16 grids in the entire image must feature the same person; do not change people in each grid.
He wears a football kit with a "cool" vibe, but the word "Champion" should not appear, nor should any specific country name. The clothing should feel like a jersey from a professional team.

[Layout Requirements]
The entire image is a 4x4 sixteen-grid, each grid must have:
1. Large step numbers (1-16)
2. Chinese action titles
3. 2-4 brief Chinese action key points
4. Clear full-body action of the character
5. Football trajectory arrows / footwork trajectory lines
6. The football must be clearly visible and positioned reasonably, not floating or disappearing.

The overall font style should lean towards a sports poster aesthetic, clear and powerful, suitable for social media sharing. The image should be sharp, clear, and clean; both the character and the football should be complete, no feet cut off.

[Action Sequence]
Please design 16 continuous actions in the following order, each action distinctly different, forming a complete freestyle performance flow:

1. Street Opening Pose
Action: One foot on the ball, body open, confident stance, like the start of a performance.
Points: Dominant stance / Right foot on ball / Showing confidence
2. Sole Roll-back
Action: Roll the ball back with the sole of the foot, adding a slight lateral movement.
Points: Sole on ball / Pull ball back / Slight body turn
3. Step-over
Action: Both feet performing step-overs around the football.
Points: One foot circling ball / Step over and switch feet / Smooth rhythm
4. Inside-Outside Dribble
Action: Use the inside and outside of the foot to tap the ball continuously, switching left and right.
Points: Inside touch / Outside touch / Quick switching
5. Laces Flick-up
Action: Use the laces to flick the ball upward, lifting it off the ground.
Points: Laces power / Flick ball up / Ball rises in front
6. Continuous Juggling
Action: Continuous juggling with the laces, keeping the ball bouncing up and down in front of the body.
Points: Alternate juggling / Keep rhythm / Stable continuity
7. Knee Control
Action: Control the ball bounce using knees or thighs.
Points: Ball hits knee / Control landing point / Maintain balance
8. Heel Flick
Action: Use the heel to flick the ball up from behind or side-rear.
Points: Heel contact / Flick upward / Lean body forward
9. Around the World (ATW)
Action: One foot circles the airborne ball.
Points: Foot circles outward / One full circle / Stable landing control
10. Crossover ATW
Action: Cross legs to complete a circling trick.
Points: Front leg cross / One full circle / Mid-air switch
11. Shoulder Stall
Action: Stall the ball on the shoulder or near the neck.
Points: Ball lands on shoulder / Tighten shoulder / Stable stall
12. Back Stall
Action: Lean forward to let the ball stay briefly on the back.
Points: Lean body forward / Ball on back / Maintain balance
13. Rainbow Flick
Action: Flick the ball from behind over the head, forming a rainbow trajectory.
Points: Heel flick / Ball over head / Arched trajectory
14. Spin and Catch
Action: Spin in place and catch the falling ball.
Points: In-place spin / Catch falling ball / Soft landing control
15. Toe Stall
Action: Use the tip of the toe or the top of the shoe to precisely stop the ball.
Points: Toe lift / Precise stall / Perfect balance
16. Street Curtain Call
Action: One foot on the ball again, arms open, like the closing of a full performance.
Points: Right foot on ball / Open arms / Stylish curtain call

[Visual Style]
- Overall high-end sports poster style
- Cinematic night scene lighting
- Strong sense of motion, with a bit of trendy street aesthetic
- Arrows and trajectory lines must be clear to help understand the ball's movement path
- Color scheme mainly Red, Black, and Gold, highlighting high-end quality and Chinese Red vibe
- Eye-catching fonts, suitable for Xiaohongshu / Twitter / social media sharing
- The entire image should look like a complete "16-step freestyle football action storyboard poster"

entries.title: Celebrity Airport Arrival Documentary
entries.description: A highly detailed documentary-style handheld camera prompt simulating a celebrity arrival at a busy airport with crowd chaos and realistic phone camera effects.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic single continuous handheld crowd POV shot of a major celebrity arriving at a busy airport. No cuts. Documentary realism. Natural phone-camera micro-shake, crowd obstruction, focus hunting, and chaotic fan energy. Loud natural environment audio only: crowd cheering, fans shouting “[CELEBRITY NAME]!”, camera shutter clicks, phones recording, airport announcements, footsteps, security voices, barricade rattles, distant engine idle and rev.
Natural daylight through airport glass panels, realistic reflections, mixed indoor-outdoor light, soft shadows, slight atmospheric depth. A [AGE]-year-old [NATIONALITY] celebrity with sharp elegant features, styled [HAIR DESCRIPTION], calm confident presence, consistent face, and soft controlled expression. Outfit strictly locked: [DESCRIBE OUTFIT FULLY]. No outfit or hairstyle changes.
0:00–0:03 handheld camera starts inside dense crowd behind barricades, phones raised, view partially blocked, camera searching toward arrival gate.  
0:03–0:06 camera lifts above shoulders, focus shifts between heads, hands, phones, flashes, and security forming a path.  
0:06–0:10 security pushes crowd slightly back, camera shakes naturally, celebrity appears in distance through gaps, initially blurred then clearer, walking forward gracefully with bodyguards.  
0:10–0:13 camera pushes in slightly, celebrity centered. Fan screams “[CELEBRITY NAME]! Please, ek photo!” Celebrity turns, smiles warmly, gives a small wave. Crowd erupts louder, phones surge upward.  
0:13–0:15 celebrity reaches [VEHICLES], bodyguard opens door, celebrity enters quickly and gracefully. Engine revs, vehicle moves away, camera lifts for one last glimpse through tinted window.
Negative prompt: no cuts, no slow motion, no drone shot, no music, no voiceover, no fake crowd, no inconsistent face, no outfit changes, no distorted anatomy, no violence, no over-stylized lighting.

entries.title: Cinematic Action Fight Storyboard
entries.description: A detailed 8-panel cinematic storyboard for an action movie sequence featuring a female protagonist in a gritty warehouse fight.
entries.prompt:
Create a high-quality 4K cinematic action movie storyboard with EXACTLY 8 PANELS ONLY (no more, no less), showing a female protagonist in a realistic fight sequence where she wins. Use dramatic lighting, high contrast shadows, realistic environments (abandoned warehouse, rooftop, or underground fight arena), and a gritty film tone. No text anywhere.
The storyboard must include exactly these 8 scenes:
Wide establishing shot of a dark, intense location (rain, dust, or low light atmosphere), both fighters facing each other
Close-up of the woman’s focused expression, controlled breathing, tension building
Opponent attacks first with aggressive movement (punch or kick)
She narrowly dodges—dynamic motion, fast reaction, camera tracking
Close combat exchange—blocks, counters, and impact moments with cinematic slow motion
Turning point—she reads the opponent and lands a clean, powerful counter move
Decisive takedown—opponent falls hard, dramatic impact, environment reacting (dust, water splash, etc.)
Final frame—she stands strong and calm, slightly injured but dominant, looking forward under dramatic lighting, clear victory
Use varied camera angles (wide, close-up, over-shoulder, low angle), realistic fight choreography, motion blur, and physical impact details.
Tone should feel like a Hollywood action film, focusing on tension, realism, and character strength—not stylized or social media aesthetic.
Strict rule: only 8 panels, no repetition, no extra frames.

entries.title: Google Pixel 10 IMAX Simulation
entries.description: A highly detailed technical prompt for a 7-second continuous shot of a Google Pixel 10 exploding and reassembling.
entries.prompt:
Camera Simulation: 65mm IMAX film, macro-capable Panavision anamorphic lens. Strong film grain throughout. Horizontal anamorphic lens flares triggered by reflections on glass, polished aluminium, and internal component surfaces. Warm-neutral key light from above camera-right — clean, approachable, matching Pixel’s brand tone. Deep black void. Subtle warm rim light lifts dark components from background.
Single continuous 7-second shot. No cuts. The camera faces the Pixel, flies through the exploding internals, rotates 180°, and watches them reassemble from the front.
00:00–00:01 — The Break
A Google Pixel 10 floats in the void, rotating slowly. Every seam illuminates with a thin white light — a beat of silence — then the phone erupts apart. Every component separates outward along its assembly axis in a controlled explosion. Speed ramps to 180%.
00:01–00:03 — The Fly-Through
The camera accelerates into the expanding cloud. It threads between the aluminium frame, camera modules, processor, memory stacks, ribbon cables, haptic motor, fingerprint sensor, and USB-C housing — each piece flashing bright as the camera passes. It flies directly between two camera bar lens elements, close enough to catch the anti-reflective coating shimmering purple and green.
00:03–00:04 — The Turn
Speed drops to 40%. The camera executes a smooth 180° whip turn — component highlights streaking into horizontal motion blur. It settles facing the entire field of suspended components simultaneously. A wide anamorphic flare streaks across from the brightest internal reflection.
00:04–00:06 — The Rebuild
Speed ramps to 200%. Every component reverses and accelerates inward. Motherboard arrives first, battery slides flat, camera bar lens stack and seat with mechanical precision, frame rails connect at their corners. Speed drops to 30% for final moments — the back glass descends and presses flush with a micro burst of dust. The display floats in, seats, and illuminates on contact.
00:06–00:06.5 — Product Hold
Speed drops to 20%. Camera settles into a classic three-quarter angle. The camera bar catches a clean horizontal line. Screen glows. Void falls to pure black. Hold.
00:06.5–00:07 — End Card
Smash cut to black. Google “G” logo fades in centred, full colour. Below it: “Pixel 10 — built for every moment”. Film grain. Hold.

entries.title: City Sidewalk Time Freeze Sequence
entries.description: An intricate prompt for a 15-second ultra-photorealistic sequence where a character freezes time on a busy sidewalk with a finger snap.
entries.prompt: @image1 is the lead character - maintain identical facial features, proportions, and identity throughout. Create a 15-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic time-freeze sequence with an ARRI Alexa Mini look, 50mm lens, natural daylight, strong shadows, shallow depth of field, and subtle film grain. The scene opens on a busy city sidewalk in full motion, captured in a front-facing steadicam shot tracking backward as he walks calmly toward camera through a natural flow of pedestrians while pigeons cross the bright sky above; without breaking stride, he casually raises his hand and snaps his fingers. Instantly, a bright spherical shockwave erupts from his hand, with visible air distortion and refracted light, expanding rapidly across the environment, freezing dust and debris mid-air, locking pedestrians in place mid-motion, and suspending pigeons mid-flight as reflections ripple across surrounding glass buildings before everything falls into complete stillness and silence, with fine particles hanging in the sunlight. The camera continues gliding backward as he walks through the frozen world, his footsteps the only sound, subtly observing his surroundings before approaching a frozen woman with striking red hair in a flowing green dress, her hair suspended mid-motion as she holds a takeaway coffee. He steps in, briefly studies the moment, removes the cup from her hand, takes a síp, then carefully places it back exactly as it was. He then turns his attention to the camera, raises his hand again, and snaps his fingers, releasing a more powerful shockwave that rapidly spreads outward, reversing the effect as motion instantly resumés - pedestrians continue walking, pigeons scatter into flight, the woman carries on unaware still holding her coffee, and debris drops naturally to the ground as full city sound returns. He pauses for a brief moment, then continues walking forward, gradually blending into the crowd while the camera keeps tracking backward, maintaining distance as he disappears into the flow, ending in a smooth fade out. Sound design follows the sequence: city ambience, sharp snap, deep expanding shockwave rumble, complete silence, isolated footsteps, subtle ambient echo, sip, second snap, stronger reverse shockwave, city noise returning, brief pause, then footsteps continuing

entries.title: Chef Cat Cooking Tomato and Eggs
entries.description: An epic and humorous multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a serious orange tabby cat cooking in a modern kitchen with detailed camera shots.
entries.prompt:
主题：
一只认真到离谱的猫，在现代化家庭厨房里做番茄炒蛋，整个过程像史诗级料理任务，严肃又搞笑。
人物：
一只圆脸橘色虎斑猫，胖乎乎，表情极其严肃，像专业大厨一样专注。它站在灶台前，用猫爪握着木铲翻炒番茄炒蛋，动作笨拙但充满仪式感。
服装：
黑色小厨师围裙，围裙正面有白色中文文字。
重要：如出现文字，必须精确拼写为“认真做菜”，勿更改、勿翻译、勿变形。所有镜头中文字保持可见、可读、字体一致。不要出现其他文字。
环境：
现代化家用厨房，深色橱柜，干净石英台面，嵌入式燃气灶，暖色柜底灯，背景有锅具、鸡蛋、番茄、葱花、小碗和木质砧板。厨房整洁高级，但猫做菜的行为带来反差喜感。
氛围：
严肃、紧张、荒诞、可爱、电影感强。像一场决定命运的料理比赛，但主角是一只猫。节奏快速，动作清晰，笑点来自猫的认真表情和夸张的厨师姿态。
音乐：
严肃管弦乐 + 低音鼓点 + 轻微喜剧拨弦，约100 BPM。前半段像史诗任务，后半段加入滑稽节奏，最后以庄严收束音结束。
色彩逻辑：
主色为暖黄、深灰、番茄红、鸡蛋金黄。厨房背景偏高级冷灰，锅中番茄炒蛋颜色鲜亮，火焰和蒸汽营造热烈视觉中心。
风格：
电影广告质感，高清写实，轻微夸张喜剧风，快速剪辑，浅景深，动态运镜，食物特写诱人，猫的表情要连续一致。
逻辑规则：
保持同一只橘色虎斑猫；保持黑色围裙和“认真做菜”文字一致；保持现代厨房空间一致；不要加入人类或其他动物；不要切换到无关场景；整个视频控制在15秒左右；镜头切换快速但动作清晰；番茄炒蛋从下锅、翻炒到出锅形成完整递进。
镜头1：
近景，35mm，低机位缓慢推进 / 橘猫戴着黑色围裙站在灶台前，眼神严肃盯着锅 / 围裙文字“认真做菜”清晰可见 / 音效：低沉鼓点开始。
镜头2：
特写，85mm，俯拍 / 猫爪把切好的番茄推入热锅，油花轻微飞溅 / 红色番茄与黑色锅形成强对比 / 音效：滋啦声。
镜头3：
中近景，50mm，手持轻微晃动 / 猫双爪握木铲，笨拙但认真地翻炒番茄 / 猫脸严肃得像在执行重大任务 / 音效：管弦乐加强。
镜头4：
极近特写，100mm微距 / 金黄色鸡蛋液倒入锅中，迅速凝固，与番茄混合 / 食物色彩鲜亮诱人 / 音效：鼓点加快，轻微喜剧拨弦。
镜头5：
中景，35mm，横向跟拍 / 猫用力一翻锅，番茄炒蛋短暂腾空，动作夸张但不混乱 / 蒸汽升起，火焰跳动 / 音效：夸张“呼”的一声。
镜头6：
近景，70mm，快速推近 / 猫停顿一秒，眯眼审视锅里的菜，表情像严厉大师 / 严肃与可爱形成强反差 / 音效：音乐突然短暂停顿。
镜头7：
成品特写，50mm，缓慢下移 / 番茄炒蛋被盛入白色盘子，颜色红黄鲜亮，热气上升 / 猫爪把盘子推到镜头前 / 音效：庄严收束音。
镜头8：
正面中近景，35mm，轻微推进 / 橘猫站在盘子后面，仍然一脸严肃，像完成了伟大使命 / 围裙文字“认真做菜”最后一次清晰可见 / 音效：严肃管弦乐结尾加入一个滑稽小音符。

entries.title: Macro Arrow Shaft Micro-World War
entries.description: A poetic cinematic prompt featuring an extreme macro transition from an arrow shaft into a hidden micro-civilization fighting its own war.
entries.prompt:
seconds, photoreal cinematic live-action with seamless macro scale transition, anamorphic lens feel, extreme shallow depth of field, volumetric light, golden embers and dust particles drifting through frame, warm amber and gold highlights with deep teal shadows. No subtitles, no text, no narration.

Opening frame: extreme close-up on the wooden shaft of a flying arrow that fills the entire frame, soft-blurred ancient battlefield glowing in the background, embers drifting past in slow motion at 120fps feel.

0-4s — Macro push-in on the shaft:
Camera pushes slowly forward along the arrow shaft. Focus racks across the surface, revealing intricate carved runes, lacquer cracks, and weathered wood grain. Light glints off the iron arrowhead in the distance of frame. A seamless, imperceptible scale shift begins — the grain of the wood deepens into canyon-like ridges, the carved runes become massive cliff walls, lacquer flakes turn into stone slabs. Sound design morphs from muffled battlefield roar into a deeper, echoing micro-world ambience.

4-9s — Microscopic civilization on the arrow:
Full macro reveal. A tiny civilization of splinter-sized warriors wages its own war across the fletching and shaft. Miniature soldiers in matching East Asian lamellar armor scale the carved runes like canyon walls using ropes and ladders. Tiny catapults along the shaft hurl fragments of dust and wood splinters that arc through the air in slow motion. Rows of micro-banners in red and blue wave between the feather barbs of the fletching, which tower overhead like enormous plumes. Tiny torches flicker along the shaft, casting warm pinpoint glows. Two opposing micro-formations clash near a rune carving, swords sparking. Camera does a slow lateral dolly along the shaft, revealing more of this hidden world, then settles on a single micro-warrior raising his banner triumphantly. Final frame holds on this tiny hero against the blurred, glowing battlefield far below as the arrow continues its endless slow-motion flight through golden embers.

Cinematography: single continuous macro take, smooth weighty camera motion, no jitter, no cuts. Believable miniature physics — tiny cloth banners, ropes, sparks, dust all behave at micro scale.

Atmosphere: dreamlike and mythic, the discovery of an entire hidden world living on a single arrow in flight. The vast battlefield and the micro-civilization mirror each other.

entries.title: Cinematic Casino Suspense Sequence
entries.description: A multi-shot cinematic prompt for a casino scene focusing on psychological tension, character consistency, and detailed atmospheric lighting.
entries.prompt:
Refer to the man from Image 2 — blonde, cream blazer, blue tie — to generate a 4-shot cinematic sequence based on the angles from Image 1 . Maintain consistent character appearance throughout. 4-shot sequence, 15 seconds. ARRI Alexa. Casino interior, deep amber and neon blue bokeh. Shot 1 [00:00–00:04]: The man grips and pulls the gold-topped lever with a slow, deliberate motion. His jaw is tight, expression unreadable. Medium shot, profile. The lever clicks and the machine hums to life. Slow dolly push-in toward his profile. The mechanical clunk of the lever, the whirring spin of reels beginning.

Shot 2 [00:04–00:08]: His hand rests on the edge of the machine. Fingers begin tapping — not rhythmically, but erratic, nervous, barely controlled. Close-up, low angle. Slight creeping handheld drift toward the hand. The dry click of fingertips on metal, distant casino murmur underneath.

Shot 3 [00:08–00:13]: Extreme close-up of his eyes. Blue machine light washes across his face from off-screen. His eyes are fixed — not blinking — making tiny involuntary micro-jitter movements, tracking something fast. Focus pull sharpens on the iris. Barely perceptible slow dolly push-in. The ambient hum of the machine rises slightly. No cuts, one-take.

Shot 4 [00:13–00:15]: Wide medium profile shot. He is completely still. The machine light pulses off his face. Slow static lock-off with an almost imperceptible handheld tremor. Deep casino bokeh stretches behind him. The machine hum fades low. Silence underneath. No background music. Consistent character throughout, no deformation or drift. No distortion, no stretching.

The hollow ambient hum of a nearly empty casino — distant slot machines cycling faintly, a single chip placed on a hard surface somewhere far off, low sub-bass room tone pressing underneath everything. No music.

format: vertical_9x16
fps: 24
shot_duration: ~0.9s
total_shots: 16
total_duration: 15s
style: American dark comedy, fast-paced, expressive animation, exaggerated reactions, cinematic lighting, slight handheld shake

Global rule: All hyenas are inside vehicles as drivers. No human pedestrians appear anywhere in the scene.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:01)
Wide shot. Busy chaotic street packed with speeding cars driven by aggressive hyenas. No pedestrians on the road. Honking everywhere.
Audio: horns blaring, engines roaring.

SHOT 2 (0:01–0:02)
Close-up. Gray cat in blue overalls, right leg in cast, holding a crutch. Sweating, hopeless expression.
Gray Cat (muttering): “No way…”

SHOT 3 (0:02–0:03)
Over-shoulder rear shot. The gray cat’s shoulders and head dominate foreground, completely still, frozen in place at the curb.
In the background, cars blast past at high speed in continuous motion blur, barely any gaps.
A taxi swerves by — a sunglasses-wearing hyena driver leans out of the driver seat window toward camera.
Hyena Driver (shouting): “Don’t block the road!”

SHOT 4 (0:03–0:04)
Medium shot. Behind him, stylish white cat in pink t-shirt and white pants notices. Oversized diamond sunglasses sparkle.
White Cat: “Oh boy…”

SHOT 5 (0:04–0:05)
Cut to sidewalk. Kindergarten bunnies walking with backpacks, holding floating balloons. Innocent vibe. No humans present.

SHOT 6 (0:05–0:06)
Fast action. White cat snatches a white balloon from a bunny.
Bunny: “Hey—!”

SHOT 7 (0:06–0:07)
Close-up. White cat stuffs balloon under shirt, forming a fake pregnant belly. Shirt stretches.

SHOT 8 (0:07–0:08)
White cat steps onto crosswalk, one hand holding belly, acting in pain. Dramatic limp.
White Cat (groaning): “Oh… it’s happening…”

SHOT 9 (0:08–0:09)
Cars slam brakes simultaneously. Tires screech. All visible hyenas remain inside driver seats, shocked.
Hyena Driver: “Whoa!!”

SHOT 10 (0:09–0:10)
Wide shot. Entire road frozen. Engines idling. White cat confidently turns back.

SHOT 11 (0:10–0:11)
White cat grabs gray cat’s hand.
White Cat: “Let’s go!”
Gray Cat: “Seriously?!”

SHOT 12 (0:11–0:12)
They hurry across. Gray cat limps fast, nearly tripping.

SHOT 13 (0:12–0:13)
Close-up. Balloon under shirt suddenly POPS loudly.
SFX: *BANG!*

SHOT 14 (0:13–0:14)
White cat freezes. Belly instantly flat. Awkward silence. Sunglasses slightly tilt.

SHOT 15 (0:14–0:15)
Hyena drivers still inside vehicles turn furious, honking aggressively.
White cat pushes gray cat to safety, then bows repeatedly in the middle of the road.
White Cat (shouting): “MY BAD, SORRY!”
