entries.title: Mythic Action Comedy: Wukong Cat
entries.description: A complex 15-second multi-cut action comedy sequence featuring an orange cat as a mythic trickster in a coliseum battle
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 15s / 160 BPM / MULTI-CUT / Seedance 2 / 3D myth-action comedy / dark humor
STYLE: Fast-cut spectacle, exaggerated physics, mythic scale meets slapstick payoff, punchline-driven pacing
SUBJECTS: Orange cat (mythic trickster aesthetic: golden headband, red-gold armor, cloud-rider stance, fierce but cocky). Colossal Buddha in clouds (serene yet overwhelming authority). Hyena gladiators (muscular, aggressive, armored). Arena animals (mixed species, roaring crowd).
PROPS: Golden staff, cloud platform, floating bone fragments, arena weapons, sand debris
ENVIRONMENT: Stormy sky above desert → massive impact crater → instant teleport to ancient Roman-style coliseum arena
MOOD: Arrogance → instant defeat → divine punishment → chaotic survival → comedic victory
COLOR LOGIC: Dark storm clouds + gold aura → dusty desert tones → warm brutal arena light → celebratory brightness
CAMERA: Rapid cinematic cuts, extreme scale shifts, dramatic zooms, impact shakes, crowd reaction inserts

SCENE:

Wide aerial shot. Orange cat rides a small cloud, gripping a golden staff, face furious. “Alright! Who wants it?!”
Clouds split open. A colossal Buddha form emerges. Massive palm fills the frame.
Instant impact. The palm slams forward. Shockwave blasts the cat backward mid-air.
Smash cut. Desert ground. Cat crashes down, forming a deep crater. Sand explodes outward.
Close-up. He groans, crawling out of the hole, coughing dust. “Okay… that was excessive…”
Sky darkens. Buddha voice echoes: “Now… you must atone.”
Giant finger points down. Flash of light.
Hard cut. Coliseum arena. Cat now in gladiator armor, holding a ridiculous feather wand toy. He looks around: “You gotta be kidding me.”
Reveal: a circle of snarling hyena gladiators closing in. One cracks neck: “Fresh meat.”
Cat yells upward: “This is not a fair trial!”
Hyenas leap in simultaneously.
Cat smirks suddenly. Flicks the wand—turns it into floating bone pieces. “But it is a distraction.”
Bones scatter across arena. Hyenas instantly break formation, chasing them wildly.
Beat. Cat sighs: “Predictable.”
Rapid action burst. He unleashes ultra-fast consecutive kicks, striking each hyena’s head one by one.
Comedic result: every hyena’s head gets stuck into the ground, legs flailing in the air.
Crowd erupts. Animals cheer wildly.
Cat turns toward camera, confident, brushes dust off shoulder.
He winks with left eye: “Guess I’m absolved.”

SFX: Wind roar in sky, massive palm impact boom, sand explosion, low divine echo voice, teleport flash, arena crowd murmur rising to cheers, bone scatter clinks, chaotic scrambling sounds, rapid kick thuds, comedic “thunk” impacts, roaring applause finale.

entries.prompt: A group of young riders race down a steep grassy hillside on rugged mountain bikes in a hyper-realistic GoPro-style action shot. Knobby tires bounce off rocks, dirt explodes sideways, and grass shreds beneath the wheels as riders carve aggressive lines. The camera rushes forward in a dynamic chase angle weaving between riders — chains whir, tires skid, rooster tails of dust spray behind every bike. The lead rider pulls ahead with body low over the frame, elbows wide, as the trail narrows toward the edge of a massive cliff. Wind howls through helmet vents. Just before the edge, folded carbon panels snap outward from the bike frame — razor-thin aerodynamic wings deploy with a sharp mechanical click — and compact rocket thrusters beneath the seat tube ignite in a burst of blue and white flame, scorching the grass below. The riders surge forward and explode off the cliff edge. A sonic burst rips through the air as wheels leave the ground and the bikes transition into full flight, spokes catching sunlight like spinning halos. Camera follows: high-speed trail chase cam → sharp forward dive at the cliff lip → stomach-dropping free-fall perspective showing the vast open drop → smooth stabilization locking onto bikes gliding mid-air in formation. Far below, a quiet village sits tiny and distant. Bright daylight, vivid saturated colors, lush green hills, clear blue sky. Heavy motion blur on spokes and frame edges, realistic suspension fork compression, heat shimmer from thruster Gugu Gaga nozzles, hard sunlight lens flares across carbon tubes and polished rims, wind pulling jerseys tight against riders' bodies, dirt and pebbles frozen mid-air around tires. Cinematic, high-speed, action-adventure, photorealistic.

entries.title: São Paulo Parkour Action Sequence
entries.description: A detailed multi-scene prompt for a high-intensity parkour chase across the rooftops of São Paulo, featuring bullet impacts and cinematic transitions.
entries.prompt:
A 27-year-old man, athletic, wearing a sweat-soaked white t-shirt and olive green cargo shorts with worn trainers, sprints across the rooftops of São Paulo’s dense favela skyline as the sun burns orange on the horizon.

[0s–1.5s]
Wide panoramic shot of São Paulo at sunset. Endless stacked concrete homes. A tiny moving figure is spotted running across rooftops.
A sharp CRACK echoes. A bullet strikes metal nearby — sparks burst. The tone shifts instantly.

[1.5s–3s]
Close tracking shot behind him. He sprints across corrugated metal roofing.
Another CRACK. A bullet hits inches from his foot — metallic clang, debris flicks upward.
Laundry lines whip across his face as he ducks instinctively but never slows. He leaps a gap.

[3s–5s]
He slides under a water tank.
A bullet rips through the tank above — water bursts out violently, raining over him.
He rolls through the spill and vaults over a wall onto a lower rooftop.

[5s–7s]
Running along a narrow ledge, 15 stories high.
Two rapid shots — CRACK CRACK. Concrete chips explode beside his shoulder.
He flinches slightly but keeps balance, eyes locked forward.

[7s–9s]
Massive gap between buildings. He accelerates.
Another shot — bullet grazes the edge behind him as he launches.
Mid-air slow motion. Dust trails behind his shoes. The city stretches endlessly beneath.

[9s–11s]

2. Orange cat skateboards in, lands cockily, catches board.

3. Lobby. Elevator doors closing. White cat inside, phone in hand, annoyed, ignoring him.

   Orange cat’s hands blur violently. He rapidly presses 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7 → 8 → 9.

8. DING. Floor 2. Doors open → instant slap exchange. Doors shut.

9. Floor 3 → punches mid-motion. Doors close.

10. Floor 4 → faster, heavier impacts, slapstick recoil.

11. Floors 5–7 → rapid montage of escalating fight, bodies bouncing off walls.

12. Floor 8 → white cat gains control, clean counterattack.

13. Floor 9 → final slam, orange cat defeated, pinned.

14. Floor 10. Silence. DING. Doors open into bright clean light.

15. White cat fixes hair, steps out elegantly, calm reset.

16. Inside elevator. Orange cat curled in corner, holding skateboard, crying.
    Final beat: “I just wanted floor seven…”

entries.title: Cinematic Schoolgirl Action Short
entries.description: A detailed cinematic storyboard for Seedance 2.0 featuring a schoolgirl's high-speed parkour and size-shifting transitions, demonstrating complex physics and scale changes.
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic short film, dynamic movie style action, bright summer daylight, realistic physics, high-speed motion, seamless scale transitions.

0:00 – 0:02 – EXT. PARK – DAY – TREE BRANCH
A Japanese schoolgirl crouches on a thick tree branch in a public park, wearing a school uniform, focused and fearless. She launches forward without hesitation. The camera dives with her in a fast, dramatic motion.
0:02 – 0:04 – FREE FALL TO PICNIC TABLE
She drops rapidly toward a picnic table below. The instant she impacts the table surface, her scale suddenly snaps smaller — now she is the size of a soda can. The tabletop becomes a giant landscape filled with oversized sandwiches, fruit, chips, drinks, and napkins. Without stopping, she immediately sprints forward between the food items at high speed.

0:04 – 0:06 – TABLE SURFACE – CONTINUOUS
A bee rockets past her like a speeding vehicle. She leaps onto its back in one fluid move, landing in a forward-facing riding position. Another scale snap happens mid-motion — now she is the same size as the bee.
0:06 – 0:09 – BEE FLIGHT – HIGH SPEED
The bee flies aggressively across the park. She clings tightly to its back as they weave at extreme speed through the legs of walking people. Shoes slam onto the ground around them like giant moving obstacles. Strong wind blasts her hair and clothes backward.

0:09 – 0:11 – SLOW MOTION – WATER BALLOON CHAOS
Still riding the bee, she flies through a group of kids in the middle of a water-balloon fight. Everything shifts into slow motion — exploding water balloons, suspended droplets sparkling in sunlight, her expression intense and exhilarated.
0:11 – 0:12.5 – NORMAL SPEED – CHEERLEADER PASS
Back to real speed. The bee shoots cleanly through the legs of a row of cheerleaders standing side by side, their uniforms and pom-poms creating a tunnel-like visual rhythm.

0:12.5 – 0:13.5 – JUMP AND CATCH
She jumps off the bee. Instantly, her scale snaps back to normal human size while falling. A male student catches her securely in his open arms. They are both now normal size.
0:13.5 – 0:15 – END BEAT
She hugs the male student, then turns and gives a playful wink directly to the camera. He looks surprised but happy. Freeze-frame energy.

entries.prompt:
被写体：2Dアニメ調のキャラクターが乗ったボード一つ。メインカメラはボードの斜め後ろに固定、ショットは途切れない。右上に小さな丸いワイプフレームを埋め込み、キャラクターの顔を正面から常時可視化。丸ワイプは明確なフレームエッジを持ち、高い解像度でキャラクターの表情（驚き、興奮、爽快感）を映し続ける。

シーン：カメラをボードの真後ろのリアフォローマウントにロックし、ショットを決して切らない。リアルなウォーターパークの広大な青空ゾーンで始まり、トロピカルな緑（ヤシの木、南国の風景）を背景に、キャラクターはボードに乗ったままウォータースライダーの頂上からスタート。1本の連続したスライダーを滑走し、最初はゆっくり、徐々に加速。大きく右カーカーブを描き、水が豪快に飛び散り、白く煌めく。メインフレームをボード追従で保ち、スライダーレール、カーブ、水しぶき、光の反射が後ろから明確に読み取れるように。右上の丸ワイプではキャラクターの顔、肩、髪が風に揺れ、目はキラキラの驚きから歓喜へ、髪は速度の下でなびき、水がかかる瞬間にびっくり表情に。最終的には高速のストレート区間を突き進み、プール状の着水ゾーンに突入。着水の瞬間、大きな水の爆発。スローダウンしながら水が光に包まれ、爽快感が画面全体を満たす。ワイプでもキャラクターの着水時の輝く瞳と爽快的な笑顔が同時に映る。1本の途切れない動き、全編にわたりリアルな水と光、トロピカルな背景、メインフレームの追従、右上の丸ワイプの常時表示。

ムード：息をのむ爽快感、バラエティ的な楽しさ、驚きと喜びの融合、爽涼しさ、スピード感。

スタイル：シネマティックリアリズム＆アニメハイブリッド、アクション・エンターテインメント、バラエティ・スペクタクル。No spoken dialogue（セリフなし）。

entries.title: Cinematic Top-Down Routine of a Drained Young Woman
entries.description: A highly detailed structured prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a continuous top-down POV sequence of a woman's morning routine, focusing on realistic lighting, atmospheric haze, and specific motion cues.
entries.prompt:
SUBJECT:
A drained young woman matching reference. She wears an oversized faded t-shirt and soft lounge shorts. Hair slightly messy, faint smudged kajal under her eyes, barefoot. Her movements are slow, automatic, almost like muscle memory rather than intention. Expression distant, unfocused.

ENVIRONMENT:
A narrow, low-ceiling studio apartment. A thin mattress pushed against the wall, rumpled sheets, clothes draped over a chair. A tight passage leads into a small wash area with a cracked mirror and damp floor. Beyond that, a compact kitchenette with stacked utensils, a flickering tube light, and a half-open window letting in tinted city glow. The space feels humid, stale, and lived-in.

MOOD:
Repetitive routine with an eerie undertone, like something unseen is quietly observing from above, waiting for a break in pattern.

COLOR LOGIC:
Muted tungsten warmth mixed with artificial green spill from outside. Slight haze in the air, soft diffusion on highlights, subtle noise for realism.

CAMERA:
Strict top-down POV tracking perfectly vertical above her head at all times. No tilt, no drift, no lateral offset. Smooth floating motion, phasing through ceilings and doorways seamlessly. 24mm lens feel, clean digital texture. Continuous single take.

SCENE FLOW:
She lies on the mattress, eyes open already, not waking, just… existing.
Sits up directly beneath the lens.
Without looking up, reaches beside her pillow. Finds a crumpled cigarette pack. Taps one out.
Places it between her lips. Searches briefly. Finds the lighter under the sheet. Lights it.
The flame flickers briefly against her face. She inhales. Drops the lighter.
She stands. The camera glides with her, perfectly locked overhead.
Walks slowly through the cramped room, stepping over scattered clothes.
Enters the narrow passage.
Moves into the wash area.
With the cigarette held loosely in one hand, she turns on the tap using the other.
Lets water run over her fingers first. Then splashes her face lazily, not fully committing.
Water drips. She doesn’t wipe it.
She exits back into the passage, trailing faint smoke.
Turns into the kitchenette.
Still under the exact center of the frame, she reaches toward the cluttered counter.
Moves aside a plate without looking. Picks up a steel tumbler.
Pauses.
Stands still.
The camera remains frozen above her.
She raises the cigarette slightly. Takes a slow drag.
Silence stretches.
Then, she slowly tilts her head upward.
Not sudden. Not sharp.
Just enough to meet the lens.
Holds eye contact.
Exhales smoke straight up, it blooms toward the camera, soft and hazy.
Doesn’t break the gaze.

SFX:
Soft lighter click, inhale/exhale, distant traffic hum, faint electrical buzz, water trickle, bare feet against floor.
Subtle room tone with low ambient tension.

entries.title: Supernatural museum horror-comedy
entries.description: A long-form scripted prompt for a 15-second comedy scene featuring a pharaoh cat and a haunted museum exhibit.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 15s / 155 BPM / MULTI-CUT / Seedance 2 / 3D supernatural museum comedy
STYLE: Fast horror-comedy pacing, haunted museum atmosphere, exaggerated character animation, slapstick myth revival
SUBJECTS: Orange cat pharaoh (arrogant, chaotic energy). White cat queen statue (regal, suddenly awakened, powerful). White rabbits (modern tourists, diverse reactions: panic, shouting, filming).
ENVIRONMENT: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Ancient Egypt wing → glass display cases, ancient artifacts, dim exhibition lighting → sudden blackout storm atmosphere inside museum
MOOD: Calm museum → supernatural glitch → comedic possession chaos → authority restoration
COLOR LOGIC: Warm museum gold → sudden cold blackout → glowing gold aura → normal neutral lighting restore
CAMERA: Rapid cinematic cuts, handheld panic effect during blackout, dramatic push-ins for possession moment, whip pans for chase

SCENE:

1. Wide shot. Metropolitan Museum Ancient Egypt gallery. Glass cases, statues, artifacts. White rabbits in casual tourist clothes calmly observing.

2. Insert shot. Ancient painting: orange cat wearing pharaoh attire, staring directly at viewer with arrogant expression. Nearby: white cat queen statue holding ceremonial staff, frozen and majestic.

3. Calm museum ambience. Tourists whisper. One rabbit says: “Wow… this place is creepy cool.”

4. Suddenly lightning outside. Thunder hits. Camera shakes slightly.

5. Lights flicker rapidly. Museum illumination stutters like a horror film.

6. Blackout. Full darkness. Rabbits scream: “What the hell?!” “This is not part of the exhibit!” Panic spreads.

7. In darkness, painting eyes of orange cat glow golden. Close-up: eyes ignite.

8. Painting ripples. Orange cat steps out of frame into real world like liquid canvas.

9. He stretches, looks around: “Finally… fresh air.”

10. He notices white cat queen statue. Walks over, waves hand in front of her face.

11. Orange cat sighs in relief: “Ah… so the queen is dead. I’m free now!”

12. He suddenly hugs random white rabbit tourists. One rabbit screams: “Sir?! Please don’t—”

13. Comedic escalation. Orange cat kisses a rabbit dressed as WWI nurse, holding her waist dramatically. Rabbit shouts: “I did NOT sign a consent form for this timeline!”

14. Flash of golden light. White cat queen statue reactivates, eyes glowing. She awakens mid-motion.

15. She sees chaos, enraged, yells: “ORANGE, what are you doing?!”

16. Instant reaction cut. Orange cat freezes, panics: “Oh no.”

17. He dives backward into the painting frame. White cat follows immediately, jumping in after him.

18. Lightning stops. Museum lights snap back to normal. Calm returns abruptly.

19. Final wide shot inside painting world: orange cat kneeling inside frame, terrified. White cat grabs his left ear firmly, dragging him down. She growls: “You ruined my museum, idiot.

entries.title: Battle of Salamis Surrealist Sequence
entries.description: An experimental historical surrealism prompt depicting the Battle of Salamis with time-fractured cinematic layers and impossible camera movements.
entries.prompt:
A 1-minute surreal, time-fractured cinematic sequence set during the Battle of Salamis, 480 BCE, presented as a collapsing memory of history rather than a literal recreation. The camera moves like a sentient observer, phasing between time layers, gliding at impossible speeds just above the waterline of the narrow straits of Salamis.

The sea behaves unnaturally — waves freeze mid-motion, then shatter into droplets that reverse and reassemble. Hundreds of Persian war galleys stretch endlessly across the horizon like a mirrored army, duplicated and distorted, while the smaller Greek triremes emerge sharply from pockets of clarity, cutting through the chaos with precision.

Instead of continuous motion, the video pulses between hyper-slow suspended moments and sudden bursts of extreme velocity. Oars slice through water in synchronized rhythm, each stroke echoing like a visual ripple through time. Ships flicker between intact and destroyed states, as if multiple outcomes overlap simultaneously.

The camera dives through narrow gaps between ships, then phases through hulls to reveal interior flashes — soldiers frozen mid-battle, expressions suspended between fear and determination. Greek triremes surge forward, their bronze rams faintly glowing, striking Persian ships in fragmented slow motion. Upon collision, wood disintegrates into particles of light and memory, dissolving into the sea.

The battlefield gradually becomes more abstract — fire arrows arc across the sky leaving luminous trails like constellations. Reflections on the water reveal alternate versions of the battle, hinting at parallel histories. Harsh Mediterranean sunlight refracts into prismatic beams, casting shifting, unnatural shadows.

Final moments: the camera rapidly ascends, revealing the entire strait as a fractured mosaic of time slices — victory, destruction, and silence coexisting — before collapsing into a single still frame of a calm blue sea.

entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic animated short film in a hand-painted, Ghibli-inspired aesthetic with soft lighting, emotional storytelling, and natural environmental motion. The tone is magical, nostalgic, and deeply atmospheric.
The story follows a peaceful countryside village and a young inventor who builds a flying machine that changes how the village sees the sky.
🌿 SCENE FLOW (SEQUENTIAL VIDEO STRUCTURE)
1. Establishing Village (Slow cinematic pan) Wide aerial shot of a lush green countryside village at sunrise. Rolling hills, rice fields swaying in wind, smoke rising from wooden houses. Soft golden light, peaceful ambient atmosphere, birds flying across the sky. Slow camera push-in.
2. The Hidden Workshop (Interior reveal) Cut to a cozy wooden inventor’s workshop filled with sketches, mechanical parts, and warm sunlight beams through dusty windows. Camera slowly moves across blueprints of a flying machine. Subtle floating dust particles, intimate mood.
3. The Inventor Moment (Character focus) Close-up of a young inventor sketching intensely. Emotional expression, soft lamp lighting on face, hands moving quickly across paper. Camera slowly rotates around character, showing determination and loneliness.
4. Machine Reveal (Hero object shot) The handcrafted flying machine is revealed—wood, brass, fabric wings. Camera low-angle orbit shot, slow dramatic reveal. Light glinting off metal parts. Subtle wind movement makes wings slightly shift.
5. First Flight Launch (Action sequence) The machine launches from a grassy hill above the village. Fast wind movement, grass bending, villagers running into frame below. Camera follows the machine accelerating upward into sky. Dynamic motion blur.
6. Mid-air instability (Tension moment) Flying machine tilts in turbulent wind. Camera shakes slightly, dramatic clouds swirling. Close-up of rotating wings struggling. Sound of wind intensifies. Emotional tension builds.
7. Village Reaction (Cutaway emotional shot) Villagers watching from below—children pointing, elders reacting in awe. Warm sunset lighting. Slow-motion emotional expressions. Camera pans across crowd faces.
8. Above the clouds (Calm transformation) Machine stabilizes above a glowing cloud sea. Peaceful silence replaces tension. Soft golden-orange sky blending into deep blue. Camera drifts slowly around the floating machine.
9. Magical Encounter + Ending (Climactic emotional finish) A glowing ethereal spirit-like light entity appears in the sky near the machine, gently illuminating everything. The inventor looks up in awe. Camera pulls back slowly into a vast sky revealing infinite clouds. Fade out into sunset.

entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 15s / 150 BPM / MULTI-CUT / Seedance 2 / 3D dark comedy fantasy
STYLE: Fast-paced cinematic cuts, exaggerated animation physics, dramatic lighting shifts, punchline-driven timing
SUBJECTS: Small black bear cub (timid, vulnerable). Adult polar bears (bulky, mocking, arrogant). Black cat (long white eyebrows, beige Taoist robe, mystical but slightly incompetent).
ENVIRONMENT: Snowy Arctic coastline → icy wind, pale sky → dark cave interior → magical transformation glow
MOOD: Sad isolation → absurd hope → magical build-up → comedic failure → dark humor punchline
COLOR LOGIC: Cold desaturated blues → shadowy cave → intense golden magic → muted aftermath
CAMERA: Rapid cuts, dynamic angles, close-ups for emotion, wide shots for scale, punch-in reactions

SCENE:

1. Wide shot. Frozen Arctic coast. Wind howling. Small black bear stands alone, dwarfed by environment.
2. Cut to group of adult polar bears circling him. One smirks: “Wrong color, kid.” Another laughs: “You lost or just ugly?”
3. Close-up. Black bear lowers his head, silent, eyes wet. Snow falls heavier.
4. Medium shot. He slowly walks away while the polar bears laugh behind him. One shouts: “Blend in or get out!”
5. Cut to cave interior. Dim, cold. Black bear curls into corner, quietly crying.
6. Sudden WHOOSH. Black cat drops from above into frame, robe fluttering.
7. Low angle on black cat. Calm voice: “Hey… don’t cry. I can grant you any wish.”
8. Close-up. Bear looks up, hopeful: “Really?”
9. Cat nods confidently: “Really. Go ahead.”
10. Bear kneels, hands together: “Please… make me a white polar bear.”
11. Dramatic close-up. Cat places paw on his head: “Your wish is my command.”
12. Explosion of golden light. Bear levitates, spinning mid-air. Magical energy pulses.
13. Transformation sequence. As he spins, his body changes—but stops halfway. He lands. Now still black… with a white V-shaped mark on his chest.
14. Silence. Bear looks down, confused, then furious: “This is NOT what I asked for!”
15. Cat scratches head awkwardly: “Uh… sorry. I’m still an intern.” Instantly turns into black smoke and vanishes. Final close-up. Bear looks at camera, screaming: “NO!!!!!!”

SFX: Arctic wind and distant echoes, mocking laughter, soft crying, magical whoosh entrance, calm mystical tone, rising energy hum, bright transformation burst, abrupt silence, awkward pause, smoke poof, final echoing scream.

One continuous shot, no cuts.

Subtle handheld realism at end.

Space ambience → intense descent → city noise → soft café sounds.

entries.title: Cinematic ARPG Boss Battle Scene
entries.description: A cinematic action-adventure video prompt for a boss battle between a rabbit and a giant fox, featuring Sekiro-style combat and dramatic camera work, suitable for cinematic video generation.
entries.prompt: Cinematic Action-adventure game boss battle scene, Sekiro-style combat, single continuous shot, fast-paced with intense impact. A white rabbit adventurer stands at the center of a shattered ancient stone battlefield. Opposite stands a tall fox, dressed in flowing Eastern robes and wearing a dark mask, exuding an oppressive aura. It holds a long whip that sways slowly through the air. The battle erupts instantly. The fox dashes forward at high speed, its whip slicing through the air with sharp, explosive cracks. The rabbit precisely blocks with the frying pan, sparks bursting at the moment of impact. They enter a high-frequency exchange—continuous blocks, deflections, and pressure—forming a classic ARPG-style “posture combat” rhythm. Camera language: low-angle tracking, rapid forward movement, slight handheld shake on impact, with strong motion blur on the whip swings. The fox unleashes chained attack combinations: sweeping whip strikes, upward lash attacks, and long-range pulling strikes to control distance. The rabbit side-steps, rolls, and counters at close range, striking rapidly with the frying pan in tight melee. Mid-battle, everything suddenly pauses. The wind intensifies, sand spirals upward, and the atmosphere compresses dramatically. The fox leaps backward to create distance. Its body begins to emit a white glow—the ultimate move activates. Transformation begins—the fox rapidly expands, transforming into a massive white spirit fox. Its fur flows like misty clouds, its enormous body covering the entire battlefield, radiating overwhelming pressure. The camera pulls back, revealing the vast difference in scale. The giant fox raises its front paw and slams it down toward the rabbit with devastating force. At the moment of impact—shockwaves spread outward, the ground violently shatters, and sand explodes across the frame. Final shot: the rabbit is engulfed beneath the shadow of the massive fox’s paw. On screen, bold red calligraphic characters appear: “落命”

entries.description: A cinematic space-themed prompt for Seedance 2.0 that depicts a peaceful nebula collapsing to reveal a massive, planet-sized mechanical structure.
entries.prompt:
Continuous camera motion, no cuts. Building wonder into catastrophic awe. Audio evolves from gentle nebula hum into earth-shaking mechanical emergence. No humans. Realistic space physics. No spontaneous objects. 
[Scene — 0:00–0:04] A lone ship drifts at the edge of a vast glowing nebula. Beautiful. Peaceful. Colors shifting slowly, deep violet, gold, electric blue. Then the nebula begins collapsing inward, slowly at first, then violently. The ship holds position, watching. 
[Emergence — 0:04–0:11] From the collapsing core something enormous unfolds.  Mechanical. Geometric. Planet-sized. Panels the size of continents fold outward one after another Energy conduits ignite across its surface in spreading waves Its scale makes the ship invisible by comparison The structure rotates slowly as it completes its unfolding, deliberate, ancient, awake Shockwaves from its emergence hit the ship continuously, sending it spinning. Camera pulls back desperately trying to fit the emerging structure in frame. It can't.  
[Ending — 0:11–0:15] The structure fully unfolds and goes completely still. Silent. Powered. Waiting. The ship hangs motionless before it, tiny, fragile. Then the structure's core ignites, a blinding pulse of energy expanding outward. Camera pulls to maximum wide. The light consumes everything. Then silence.

entries.prompt:
1–2s
Inside a cold blue-gray Gothic church, towering stone pillars rise toward the sky. Faint, cool light filters through the stained glass. A white-haired woman with her eyes closed and head bowed stands before the altar. She wears a black-and-white nun-like robe, a small red vertical mark on her forehead, and a silver cross pendant around her neck.
2–3.5s
Her eyes slowly open, expression cold and restrained. A golden holy grail descends into the frame, its surface churning with surging red light that illuminates her face and fingers.
3.5–5s
She cups the grail with both hands and drinks. Red mist spills from the rim, a red core ignites on her chest, and the cold blue color palette is overtaken by a bloody crimson glow.
5–6.5s
The black-and-white robe is torn apart by red energy. Silver spiked armor rapidly forms across her shoulders, chest, and arms. A deep crimson cape billows open behind her back.
6.5–8s
A silver crown of thorns, dotted with dark red roses, forms above her head. She rises, transforming into a dark battle valkyrie in silver and deep crimson, her chest core glowing brightly.
8–9.5s
Red metal shards and light converge in her hand to form a spear or halberd, its blade glowing with a blood-red hue. She raises the weapon at a low angle, the armor reflecting the church's cold light.
9.5–11s
The altar at the far end of the church shatters. A giant shadowy boss emerges from the rubble and black mist, clad in broken black armor with a red-and-black core in its chest and tattered bone wings extending from its back.
11–12.5s
The boss swings its massive clawed arm, sending stone pillars crumbling and candles sputtering out. She charges forward, her red-and-black cape trailing, the spear leaving a red trail as it scrapes the ground.
12.5–14s
She leaps, spins, and thrusts. The red spear cuts through the mist, piercing the boss's shoulder armor and erupting in silver sparks and red-and-black energy shards.
14–15s
The boss's chest core flares bright, ready to counter. She grips the spear with both hands, driving it straight for the core. The frame freezes on the moment the spear tip is about to strike, no subtitles or dialogue shown.

A chaotic ancient marketplace under Mount Fuji backdrop, slightly fake and theatrical. Over-saturated colors, Shaw Brothers lighting, dramatic wind. Cute animals in simple ancient clothing bargain, shout, and move in rhythmic chaos.

An orange cat beggar in ragged monk-like robes, messy fur, holding a filthy cracked bowl, wanders weakly through the crowd.

Orange cat bumps into people, ignored, pushed aside.

Orange Cat (weak, muttering)
just one bite… i’ll even pretend it’s gourmet…

Whip pan.

A hyena butcher stands at a stall stacked with roasted rats hanging on hooks. Greasy apron, cleaver SLAMS down.

Hyena spots orange cat instantly—rage explosion.

Hyena (yelling)
HEY TRASH PANDA—WRONG SPECIES, WRONG STREET

3–6s
Orange cat drops to knees, bowl raised high.

i’m not picky… i’ll eat the one that regrets its life the most

Beat—hyena’s eye twitches.

Hyena lifts leg—

Hyena
i’ll give you something to eat—my FOOT

SMASH CUT.

6–10s
Sudden silk swoosh sound.

A white cat noblewoman in pink jeweled ancient dress BURSTS INTO FRAME from the side.

uncivilized

Instant judo sequence, hyper-fast:

Arm lock—bone crack SFX
Shoulder throw—ground impact BOOM

All moves exaggerated, elegant, effortless.

Crowd GASPS in synchronized rhythm.

Slow-motion contrast.

White cat gently places a roasted rat into the dirty bowl.

Soft chime.

Orange cat still kneeling, shaking, eyes flooding.

this… is the nicest crime i’ve ever witnessed

13–15s
INTERCUT FAST:

Hyena EXTREME CLOSE-UP on ground—half-conscious, eyes darting, sweating.

i should’ve just sold vegetables…

Hard comedic sting.

Audio: No music. Only ambient sound—coffee machine steam bursts, cup clinks, cash register beeps, footsteps, cloth friction, punches, muffled chatter. Lighting: warm café practical lights mixed with cool window spill, dust floating in light beams.

MAIN CHARACTER (STRICT IDENTITY LOCK): Orange tabby cat, calm unreadable face, short fur, sharp eyes.
OUTFIT LOCK: Gray full-body waiter uniform, name badge hanging on neck. Must remain identical.

SUPPORT: White rabbit (purple shirt, black pants) paying at counter. Elegant white cat (pink dress) nearby.

OPPONENT RULES: Hyena customers, all unique faces, sunglasses, black suits. No resemblance to protagonist.

DIALOGUE STYLE: Dry, deadpan, dark humor.

ACTION:
0–2s: Close on register. Rabbit hands cash.
Rabbit: “Keep the change.”
Orange Cat (flat): “Not enough to fix today.”

2–4s: Off-screen harassment. White Cat tense. Hyenas chuckle.
Hyena: “Smile, sweetheart.”
Orange Cat slowly looks up.

4–6s: Orange Cat steps out.
Orange Cat: “Wrong table.”

6–10s: Sudden violence. One-hand slam—hyena face into counter. Cups explode, coffee splashes. Second hyena gut punch → head smash into espresso machine. Steam blast. Camera shakes hard.

10–12s: Two flank. Jacket pull, stumble, instant knee strike. Headbutt. One crashes into pastry display—glass shatters, crumbs scatter.

12–14s: Final hyena charges. Sidestep, rotational strike. Teeth spit, body wipes out tables. Silence drops except machine hiss.

14–15s (FINAL): Medium shot. Orange Cat breathing steady. White Cat gently wraps both hands around his right arm, gazing up with admiration.
White Cat (soft): “You work here every day?”
Orange Cat blinks left eye at camera: “Tips just improved.”
Dust floating. Warm light. Fade to black.

entries.title: Warship Final Mission Suicide Run
entries.description: A high-tension space battle scene where a burning warship makes a suicidal final charge against an enemy flagship.
entries.prompt:
Continuous camera motion, no cuts. Inevitable dread accelerating into catastrophic impact. Audio builds from dying engines groaning into obliterating final detonation. 
[Global Constraints] No humans. Zero gravity physics. No spontaneous objects. 
[Scene] A crippled warship, on fire, breaking apart, weapons gone. But it is turning deliberately toward the enemy flagship. Engines ignite to full power. It begins to move. 
[The Run 0:03–0:11] The flagship fires everything trying to stop it. plasma beams tear through the dying ship, massive chunks breaking away. It loses its bow. Loses engine banks. Reduced to a burning skeletal frame. Still accelerating. Still coming. Camera races alongside low and fast, feeling every impact. The flagship's fire grows desperate, heavier, tighter. Nothing stops it.
 [Ending 0:11–0:15] Impact. Both ships consumed in a single catastrophic detonation. The shockwave expands in perfect silence across the void. Nothing remains, just a glittering debris field slowly drifting apart. Camera holds wide. Still. Silence. The void reclaims everything.

entries.title: Cinematic Cyberpunk Rain Alley Encounter
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic sequence depicting a man in a rain-soaked alleyway who activates a high-tech exo-suit to combat a glitching digital entity.
entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic rain-soaked alley, midnight ambience, deep shadows, cold blue–purple neon reflections, shallow depth of field.
A mysterious young man (same face as reference) walks under flickering signs, holding a black umbrella, earphones in, lightly nodding to music. Calm expression, slightly wet hair, soft breath visible in cold air. Smooth side-tracking shot, puddles reflecting light.
Suddenly—electric surge. Streetlights flicker violently. A high-pitched digital distortion fills the air.
A nearby billboard glitches, then collapses inward like a vortex. The alley distorts—walls bending unnaturally.
From the distortion, a towering shadow entity emerges—humanoid but fragmented, made of shifting pixels and dark energy, eyes glowing white static.
Close-up: entity twitching, unstable, emitting digital growls.
Cut to close-up: the man, unfazed, slowly removing one earbud.
He stops. Silence.
He taps his wrist—instant activation.
A sleek black-and-chrome exo-suit forms around him in liquid-metal motion, glowing violet circuits, razor-sharp edges, reflective visor.
The entity lunges, warping space around it.
At impact moment—time fractures.
The man phases sideways in a glitch-like teleport, leaving behind a trail of fragmented light.
Slow-motion: he reappears mid-air, delivering a precise energy slash. The strike tears through the entity, reality rippling like broken glass.
The alley freezes—raindrops suspended mid-air.
Hero shot: he stands elevated, surrounded by floating shards of light and frozen rain, neon reflecting across his armor as the entity disintegrates into particles.
Everything snaps back.
Rain resumes.
Suit dissolves into thin air.
He puts the earbud back in… continues walking.
Final shot: alley returns to normal—only faint digital flickers remain.

entries.title: Single-Shot Cat Martial Arts Comedy
entries.description: An extensive cinematic video prompt for a stylized 3D action sequence featuring a white cat in a martial arts uniform fighting hyenas in a luxury hotel lobby.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 15s / 148 BPM / ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT / stylized 3D action-comedy homage
SUBJECTS: White cat in pink taekwondo uniform (clean → progressively wrecked, calm → lethal cool). Sleazy hyena in black suit & shades. Hyena gang (beige tees, black shorts, shades). Grey cat lady in extravagant fur coat (dramatic, high-society energy). Rabbit doorman (hyper-professional). Elastic animation, exaggerated impacts, gravity-bending stunt physics.
PROPS: Snowfall, rooftop door, narrow stair rails, marble lobby floor, chandelier glow, oversized fur coat.
ENVIRONMENT: Snowy rooftop → claustrophobic stairwell → grand luxury lobby → snowy city street.
MOOD: Stylish absurd combat, dry punchline humor, elegant chaos escalating nonstop.
COLOR FLOW: Cold blue → sickly green stairwell → golden luxury → crisp winter white.
CAMERA: Single unbroken Steadicam, aggressive tracking, whip pans, spins, vertical drops, always orbiting the white cat. Wide 24mm feel.

SCENE:

1. Snow drifts. White cat stands still, centered, unbothered. A hyena slides into frame: “Hey… you look expensive.”
2. She doesn’t blink. Turns. Walks. Dead silence. Hyena mutters: “Wow. Cold.”
3. Door BURSTS open—gang floods in, instantly surrounding her. “Wrong floor, sweetheart.”
4. Motion detonates—chain punches snap like gunfire. Camera punches in with each strike. Faces warp, bodies jolt backward.
5. Wrist trap → pivot → wall slam. Elbow strike lands sharp. Low sweep drops two at once. Camera whips around to catch impact.
6. She advances into stairwell. Tight brutal exchanges. One enemy lifted and hurled down the stairs, triggering chaotic domino crashes.
7. Two rush together. She slips between them, hooks both necks, synchronized leg sweep—both slam and tumble violently. One groans: “I quit…”
8. Camera spirals downward. She grabs railing and slides fast, delivering precise kicks mid-glide like target hits. “I hate this job!”
9. Launch off railing—brief slow-motion flip, fabric trailing—then instant snap back to full speed on landing.
10. Lobby impact. Marble echoes. She lands composed. Elegant crowd freezes, staring at her now scuffed uniform.
11. A beat of silence. Her eyes shift, locking onto the fur coat.
12. Sudden burst—she dashes, snatches coat mid-run, spins and wears it flawlessly in one fluid motion.
13. Grey cat lady shouts, “HEY—what are you—?!” then panics, covering herself: “Absolutely not!”
14. Hyenas crash into the lobby behind in a tangled pile. Rabbit doorman already opens the door with perfect timing.
15. Snowy street. She steps out, now regal and untouchable. Walks toward camera with a slight smirk: “Relax. I’m classy.”

SFX: Sharp winter wind, door blast, rapid strike impacts, heavy body thuds, stairwell echoes, railing grind, slow-motion air whoosh, marble impact boom, crowd gasp wave, fabric whip snap, chaotic crash pile, door swing gust,

entries.title: Sorceress Manifestation Cinematic Sequence
entries.description: A detailed 15-second cinematic storyboard prompt featuring a sorceress summoning a solar fire lion and unleashing a celestial shockwave.
entries.prompt:
0–3s – The Manifestation:
The shot opens with the woman slamming her hands toward the earth. Volcanic rock explodes as a 20-foot-tall lion made of roiling solar fire lunges from the fissures. Her gown whips violently in the resulting thermal blast.
3–7s – The Synchronization:
A rapid, low-angle orbital camera moves around the duo. The woman weaves her arms in a commanding dance; the lion mimics her movements, swiping a massive flaming paw at the camera and leaving a trail of intense heat haze and sparks across the lens.
7–10s – The Compression:
The woman pulls her hands together at her chest, drawing the lion's mass inward. The beast recoils and condenses into a blinding, white-hot orb of pure energy between her palms. A dramatic snap-zoom focuses on her face, her eyes reflecting the swirling solar core.
11–13s – The Shockwave:
The orb detonates. A massive, golden circular shockwave ripples outward, disintegrating nearby rock pillars into dust. The lion re-emerges behind her, now three times its previous size—a gargantuan, translucent celestial titan that rears back and roars into the heavens.
13–15s – The Firestorm:
The celestial lion dissolves into a million falling stars. The camera pulls back into an epic wide shot, showing the woman's tiny silhouette standing in a rain of golden embers as the storm clouds above ignite into a gargantuan, swirling fire vortex.

entries.prompt:
Create a 10-second hyper-cinematic sequence with an ultra-realistic, film-grade aesthetic. Capture it as if shot on an ARRI Alexa Mini LF using anamorphic lenses. Include subtle film grain, soft lens flares, and rich, moody color grading. Begin with a teal–orange cinematic tone that gradually transitions into intense reds, burning oranges, and deep blacks. Maintain high contrast, strong rim lighting, volumetric light rays, and a wind-driven atmosphere throughout. Editing should follow a music-video rhythm, with precise cuts aligned to a heavy cinematic beat.

Subject:
A strikingly handsome young man from @/image1. His hair is slightly messy and moves naturally with the wind. He has vivid bright blue eyes that later shift into glowing fiery orange. He wears a black high-collar coat over a black shirt, slim dark trousers, and boots. A white wireless earbud (AirPod-style) is visible in his right ear in multiple shots. On his left wrist, he wears a refined Hamilton-style watch with a dark dial, brown leather strap, and rose-gold accents.
Shot Breakdown:

0.00 – 1.00 sec
Extreme close-up of his face. Eyes closed, head slightly lowered. Soft overcast daylight, gentle wind moving his hair. Around 0.6 seconds, he slowly opens his eyes, revealing bright blue irises. Mood is intimate and slightly melancholic. Use shallow depth of field with a blurred field background.

1.00 – 2.00 sec
Cut to a close-up from the side/back of his head. He smoothly places the white wireless earbud into his right ear. Focus on natural skin detail and subtle finger motion. Maintain cinematic shallow focus.
2.00 – 3.00 sec
Quick cut to an extreme close-up of his left wrist as he adjusts his watch. Dramatic soft lighting highlights the dial and leather strap. Include subtle movement of the watch hands.

3.00 – 5.00 sec
Transition into a wide establishing shot from behind. He stands still at the center of a vast grassy field during golden-hour dusk. Stormy clouds dominate the sky with warm sunlight breaking through. Wind moves his coat and hair. He slowly extends his arms slightly as the coat flows. Frame it wide and low for an epic, solitary, reflective mood.
5.00 – 8.00 sec
Abrupt, high-impact VFX transition. The sky behind him bursts into a massive apocalyptic explosion. Large fireballs in orange and yellow tones, thick smoke (black and white), sparks, embers, and debris fill the scene. He becomes a strong silhouette against the flames, standing with legs apart and arms fully extended, evoking a phoenix-like presence. His coat moves violently due to heat and wind. Strong backlight, rim highlights, and light rays cut through the smoke. The explosion expands in slow motion, highly dynamic and intense.

8.00 – 10.00 sec
Hard cut to an extreme close-up of his right eye. The iris now burns with glowing orange and yellow fire, with realistic flame reflections

entries.title: Cyberpunk Subway Hacker Action
entries.description: A dark cyberpunk anime thriller scene following a street hacker being chased by surveillance drones in a flooded abandoned subway tunnel.
entries.prompt:
Characters: Augmented street hacker matching Character Design: Neon Shadow Runner. Compact surveillance drones with rotating lens arrays.
Scene: Abandoned subway tunnel beneath a futuristic city. Cracked concrete pillars, flooded tracks reflecting neon signage from above.
Style: Dark cyberpunk anime thriller. Moody, cinematic tension, slow-burn action with sharp bursts of movement.
Lighting: Dim violet and teal neon spill from street grates above, contrasted with flickering white emergency lights and piercing yellow drone scanners.
Audio: Echoing water drips, distant subway rumble, electrical buzzing, sharp scanner pings, sudden plasma discharge, splashing footsteps.
Avoid: Motion blur overload, unstable framing, cluttered visuals, inconsistent character proportions, erratic camera speed.
[0–3s]
Camera: Slow tracking shot from behind, waist level.
Action: The hacker runs along the flooded tracks, boots splashing through shallow water. Their visor flickers with glitching data streams.
Lighting: Purple neon reflections ripple across the water surface, casting distorted light onto tunnel walls.
[3–6s]
Camera: Tilt up with slight zoom.
Action: Two surveillance drones activate mid-air near the tunnel ceiling, their rotating lenses locking onto the hacker. Yellow scanning beams sweep across the environment.
Lighting: Sharp yellow cones slice through mist and dust particles.
[6–9s]
Camera: Tight side-profile close-up.
Action: The hacker skids to a stop behind a cracked pillar, breathing hard. Their augmented eye pulses with a bright cyan glow as they calculate an escape route.
Lighting: Flickering white light stutters, creating rhythmic shadow flashes.
[9–12s]
Camera: Fast over-the-shoulder shot from the hacker.
Action: A drone fires a rapid plasma burst, melting chunks of concrete from the pillar. The hacker rolls forward into the shallow water to evade.

entries.title: 16th Century Istanbul Market Street Sequence
entries.description: An immersive, continuous-shot prompt depicting the bustling life of an Ottoman-era bazaar at dusk, following a sequence of subjects from vendors to a janissary warrior.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT
cinematic continuous shot / motivated camera movement / 15s

SCENE
A bustling Ottoman-era market street in Istanbul, circa 16th century during the height of the Ottoman Empire, at dusk. Narrow cobblestone الطريق winds between wooden and stone buildings with overhanging upper floors and عثمانی architectural details.

Market stalls overflow with fresh bread, dates, figs, spices in colorful piles, النحاس utensils, woven carpets, and silks. Butchers display hanging cuts of meat, copper trays gleam under lantern light, and clay jars of زيت and honey line the edges.

Vendors shout in the 거리 in Ottoman Turkish accents, lively and layered. Smoke rises from braziers and nearby kitchens, blending with cool mist drifting from the Bosphorus. The ground is damp, reflecting lanterns and torchlight in uneven puddles. Cats roam freely, and a few chickens scatter between الناس.

CAMERA CONCEPT
A continuous, motivated camera move where each subject’s motion naturally redirects attention—flowing like a living observer through the chaos of the bazaar.

SEQUENCE

0:00–0:03
Close street-level view of a wooden stall stacked with figs, olives, and spices.
CAMERA FOCUS: a veiled Ottoman woman bargains with a merchant. She tastes a fig, pauses, then drops a few worn coins into his palm.

0:03–0:05
A donkey cart loaded with sacks of grain splashes through wet stone across the foreground, briefly obscuring the scene.
CAMERA SHIFT: the camera picks up the cart and begins tracking alongside it.

0:05–0:07
The cart squeezes through the narrow street, brushing against a hanging carpet with geometric Ottoman patterns. The fabric sweeps across the lens.
CAMERA SHIFT: as it clears, a group of chickens scatter loudly across the الطريق.

0:07–0:09
A ragged street boy rushes into frame, chasing the chickens with a stick, weaving through shoppers and السوق stalls.
CAMERA SHIFT: the camera follows him dynamically.

0:09–0:12
The boy passes the entrance of a dim kahvehane (coffee house). He disappears into the crowd.
CAMERA SHIFT: the wooden door creaks open as a tired man in traditional عثمانی لباس stumbles out.

0:12–0:15
The camera glides past him and enters the interior. Thick smoke from pipes fills the air, lit by flickering oil lamps. Low wooden tables, quiet گفتگو, cups of Turkish coffee.
CAMERA FINAL FOCUS: a silent armored figure sits in the corner—an Ottoman warrior (janissary/mercenary style), worn armor, السفر dust on boots, a curved sword resting beside him. He slowly raises his eyes toward the camera.

STYLE
Authentic Ottoman street life, dense crowd choreography, historically grounded textures, immersive bazaar realism.

LIGHTING
Warm lantern and torchlight reflecting on wet stone outside, cool mist diffusion, dim golden oil-lamp glow inside, smoke-heavy atmosphere.

QUALITY
photorealistic, cinematic lighting, ultra-detailed textures, immersive camera flow, rich 16th-century Ottoman atmosphere

entries.title: Rally Car Race Mountain Road

entries.prompt:
Ultra-cinematic 15-second rally car race through a rugged mountain dirt road during golden hour, dust and gravel dominating the scene.

0–2s: Wide aerial shot — rally car speeds along a winding dirt road carved into the mountains, dust trail stretching far behind.

2–4s: Low tracking shot — wheels tearing through gravel, rocks flying outward, suspension compressing over uneven terrain.

Style: ultra-cinematic realism, rally physics, aggressive drifting, heavy particle effects (dust, gravel), no text, no overlays, stable proportions without stretch.

entries.title: First-Person RPG Dialogue and Exploration Video Prompt
entries.description: A comprehensive video generation prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a first-person RPG game scene. It features a mechanical-eyed rabbit adventurer, interactive UI elements like dialogue choices, and a transition from dialogue to world exploration with cinematic camera movements.
entries.prompt:
First-person perspective, immersive ARPG dialogue scene, single continuous shot.

A small white rabbit adventurer stands directly in front of the camera. Its fur is soft and finely detailed, and its right eye is a glowing red mechanical eye. It reaches out toward the camera in an inviting gesture, with a calm and confident demeanor.

The environment is a vast fantasy world: rolling green grasslands, ruined ancient stone structures, distant mountain ranges, and a lightly smoking volcano. The morning light is soft, the air is clear, and a gentle breeze moves the grass and leaves, creating a strong cinematic atmosphere with depth.

The camera is in first-person view, with slight handheld motion and natural breathing sway. Shallow depth of field, cinematic realism.

The rabbit looks directly into the camera and says:
“Good morning, adventurer. It’s time to set out.”
A semi-transparent game UI (modern ARPG style) appears on the right side:
Alright, let’s go.
Not right now.
Why not?

The cursor moves smoothly twice, pauses for 0.3 seconds, then selects “Why not?”
The rabbit smiles slightly, tilts its head, and responds in a relaxed tone:
“Sure.”
In the next moment, all UI elements (dialogue box, options, health bar, minimap) fade out smoothly, returning the scene to a clean, UI-free world.
The rabbit turns around, its cloak and backpack swaying naturally with physics, and begins walking forward along a stone path.

The camera maintains a first-person follow, with subtle handheld motion, synchronized with the character’s walking rhythm.

While walking, the rabbit raises its hand and points toward the distant horizon (mountains and a faint city silhouette), saying:
“Look, that’s our destination.”
A brief pause of about 0.5 seconds. The wind intensifies slightly, causing more noticeable movement in the grass and clothing, enhancing the epic atmosphere.

The rabbit continues walking and says:
“We have to get there before 8:08 PM.”

The camera slowly pushes forward, focusing toward the distance. The far view transitions from slightly blurred to clear, with a subtle lens flare appearing, reinforcing the sense of a journey beginning and a clear objective.

No subtitles, no background music. Only natural ambient sounds: wind, footsteps, and distant birds.

She wears a flowing dark-green robe with subtle wind-reactive fabric layers. She releases a single arrow → before it lands, multiple masked attackers emerge silently from the fog. She remains still → then pivots with precision, drawing and releasing arrows in rapid succession. Combat sequence: Fluid archery combined with close-range defensive movements. She uses bow strikes, evasive footwork, and controlled spins. Arrows move with subtle motion trails, hitting targets with precise impact. overhead rotating camera shows her centered as attackers close in → arrows create a circular defensive pattern around her → brief slow-motion moment as one arrow splits mid-air into multiple trajectories (realistic, no fantasy exaggeration). 
 
Silence returns. She retrieves the first arrow she fired, plants it into the ground calmly, and lowers her bow. Lighting: soft golden sunrise, light fog, gentle wind through grass. 
Minimal motion trails, dust interaction, realistic arrow physics. Tone: stillness → awareness → precision → quiet control.

entries.title: Indonesian superhero combat sequence

entries.prompt:
image1's character as the subject (dark superhero with glowing white eyes, batik cape, and smoke aura). The scene and enemy Dutch colonial soldiers on a Javanese street.

Style: Cinematic quality, desaturated color grading with warm undertones, 1940s Indonesian colonial atmosphere. Dramatic lighting with volumetric smoke effects.
Sound: Deep ominous bass drone, gunfire sounds at 0–3s, heavy impact boom at 4s, rapid whoosh sounds during the touch-and-vanish sequence, eerie silence at the end with wind ambience.

entries.title: The Lake - Spaceship Arrival
entries.description: A detailed two-shot cinematic video prompt depicting a mysterious spaceship rising from a quiet lakeside town at night with realistic lighting and sound design.
entries.prompt:
Shot 1 (0–8s) - Low oblique aerial, approaching across the water: A small lakeside town at night, seen from a low aerial angle gliding just above the water's surface, approaching from the south. The lake is irregularly shaped with a rocky, forested far bank of dense pine trees - no houses on that side. Wooden cabins and a small main street are clustered only along the near western shore, scattered unevenly, warm porch lights glowing and reflecting in the still black water. Crickets chirp, water laps gently against a wooden dock, a distant dog barks once. Camera drifts slowly forward. entries.title: Wuxia Dragon Flight Multi-Scene Prompt
entries.description: A professional three-scene cinematic prompt involving a character gliding and riding an Eastern dragon with realistic physics and camera work.
entries.prompt:
scene 1 (00:00 – 00:05) — Aerial Drift (Handheld Cinematic Feel)

A stabilized handheld tracking shot follows slightly behind and to the side of a female character, @img1, suspended mid-air as if gliding using controlled body movement rather than obvious magic. She wears soft pink, lightweight silk robes inspired by traditional wuxia, but slightly weathered and textured. The wind pulls unevenly at her sleeves and hair, creating natural drag and resistance.

Below her: a dense cloud layer with occasional breaks revealing realistic mountain ridges and forests far beneath. The lighting is late afternoon golden hour but slightly diffused by atmospheric haze, creating soft shadows rather than glowing fantasy light. Subtle camera shake and lens breathing add realism.

scene 2 (00:05 – 00:10) — Emergence Through Atmosphere (Documentary Tone)

A wider lens captures @img1 continuing forward when turbulence in the clouds forms—air currents visibly shifting the mist. From below, a large Eastern dragon emerges, but not glowing—its surface resembles wet, reflective scales catching scattered sunlight.

The dragon doesn’t “burst” unrealistically; it pushes through clouds with weight and resistance, displacing vapor around its body. Its movement is powerful but grounded, like a massive flying creature navigating air pressure.

The camera struggles slightly to keep focus, adjusting exposure as light hits the dragon’s reflective body. @img1 maintains balance with subtle body adjustments, not perfectly still.

scene 3 (00:10 – 00:15) — Controlled Ride (Aerial Cinematography / Drone Style)

A wide aerial shot, as if captured by a high-end drone, reveals @img1 standing on the dragon’s head—but her stance isn’t exaggerated heroic posing. She keeps a low center of gravity, knees slightly bent to absorb motion.

The dragon flies fast, but the motion feels heavy and believable—air drag affecting both the creature and her clothing. The camera orbits slowly but with minor stabilization imperfections, like real aerial footage.

The environment: layered clouds, distant terrain fading into atmospheric perspective, no overly saturated fantasy colors. Textures remain detailed but grounded. Wind noise implied through movement. The koverall tone feels like a rare natural phenomenon captured on film rather than a staged fantasy scene.

Seedance 2 | 15-second cinematic wuxia-comedy | 1960s Hong Kong studio aesthetic | intentionally cheap props | visible wires | painted backdrops | rubber set pieces | theatrical lighting | exaggerated acting | fast comedic timing | punchy sound design | American-style dark humor dialogue

A BLACK CAT with long white eyebrows, dressed as a calm wandering monk (loose beige robes, prayer beads), sits serenely atop a clearly fake WHITE TIGER prop (stiff, visible seams).
Beside him, an ORANGE CAT dressed as a rebellious staff-wielding trickster (gold headband, red outfit) hovers on a flickering cloud platform. He scans the area cautiously.
They pass a cave covered in thick cotton spider webs. From inside: eerie, exaggerated female laughter.
0–3 seconds:
Wide shot. Wind howls.
Black cat gently pats the tiger (it squeaks).
Black cat (calm):
"Night’s falling. This feels like a mistake worth making."
Orange cat squints at the cave.
Orange cat:
"Yeah, this is how people disappear. I’ll check."
Black cat nods.
3–6 seconds:
Orange cat raises one finger—
A cheap flashlight pops into his hand.
Orange cat (dry):
"If I don’t come back, avenge me… or at least pretend."
He glides into the cave on his cloud.
6–9 seconds:
Inside. Dark.
He pushes through webs, annoyed.
Orange cat:
"Great. Zero cleaning budget."
He spots light deeper inside—
Accelerates toward it.
9–12 seconds:
Reveal: fake garden set. Painted flowers, plastic plants.
GRAY CATS with heavy makeup and flowing white gauze outfits laugh and run theatrically.
One notices him.
Gray cat (cold):
"Look. A volunteer."
Orange cat drops down, staff appearing in hand.
Orange cat:
"Enough. Monsters don’t get warnings twice."
Fight burst:
He spins, strikes, flips—fast, flashy.
Gray cats effortlessly dodge, laughing.
Gray cats (mocking):
"Cute."
"He trained for this."
Orange cat frustrated—targets one—leaps for a finishing strike—
12–14 seconds:
Two fingers suddenly stop the staff mid-air.
Reveal: black cat behind him.
Black cat (gentle):
"We don’t harm the living."
Instant shift—
Gray cats turn grotesque and lunge at him.
14–15 seconds:
Black cat murmurs a chant. Golden light bursts outward.
Gray cats freeze, collapse, dissolve into black smoke.
Silence.
Orange cat lowers his staff, looks at camera.
Orange cat (deadpan):
"So when I hit them, it’s wrong…
but when you erase them, it’s wisdom?"
Black cat stays silent, peaceful.
Awkward beat.
Cut to black with a sharp comedic sting.

entries.prompt: A cinematic 15-second sequence set on a crowded Istanbul sidewalk at dusk. Warm amber streetlights, busy pedestrians walking in both directions, shop windows glowing. 0:00–0:05: <<<image_1>>> a man in a dark coat walks calmly along the crowded sidewalk toward the camera. Pedestrians pass him in the opposite direction. A young man walks toward him looking normal and healthy. <<<image_1>>> The man reaches out and places his hand on the young man's shoulder as they cross paths. At the exact moment of contact, the young man's hair rapidly turns white, his face wrinkles, his body hunches — he ages decades in two seconds and drops to his knees. <<<image_1>>> The man pulls his hand back, golden energy visibly flows up his arm, his posture straightens, his presence becomes more powerful. He keeps walking forward without looking back. Cinematic steadicam, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, 8K. 0:05–0:10: <<<image_1>>> the man continues walking forward through the crowd. A woman walks past him looking normal and healthy. He brushes his fingers across her arm as she passes. At the exact moment of contact, her skin turns grey, her movement freezes mid-step, and she slowly crumbles into fine dust that scatters in the wind. A visible pulse of golden energy flows from where she stood into his chest. His eyes glow briefly with amber light, the air around him shimmers with time distortion like heat haze. Remaining pedestrians nearby step away from him in fear. Cinematic medium shot, volumetric golden light, photorealistic VFX, 8K. 0:10–0:15: <<<image_1>>> the man stops walking in the middle of the now-clearing sidewalk. Golden time energy swirls visibly around his entire body. He slowly raises both hands and opens his palms — all the stolen time releases upward in a massive vertical beam of golden light shooting into the darkening sky, illuminating the entire street. His coat and hair blow upward from the energy surge. The beam fades, he lowers his hands, the glow disappears. The street around him is completely empty — every pedestrian has vanished. He puts his hands in his pockets and walks away alone into the amber-lit dusk. Cinematic extreme wide shot, dramatic orchestral swell, Dolby Vision grade, 8K.

entries.prompt: BGMなし。SEのみ。 カートゥーンアニメ調の誇張されたモーション。 動きは「ゆっくりした入りと抜き」＋「中間の高速化」を強調し、ポーズ間をビュンと歪ませるように崩す。 キャラクターは左右へ大きく緩急のある高速移動を繰り返し、 「移動 → 可愛い決めポーズで静止」をリズミカルに反復する。 演出シークエンス： キャラクターは左右へ大きく緩急のある高速移動を繰り返し、 「移動 → 可愛い決めポーズで静止」をリズミカルに反復する。 顔アップ ・右上を見る → 左上を見る ・頬を赤らめ、手で口元を隠しながら意地悪にニヤリ ・マンガ的誇張表情＋ジェスチャー ・高速で後方へ引き、強いパースの決めポーズ ・手をカメラに突き出すフォーショアトニング カメラ： ダイナミックかつキネティックなカット割り。強い遠近感、誇張パース、キャラ追従と急加速を組み合わせる。リズムと“拍”を視覚で体感させる。 動作設計： 肩・腰・脚を連動させ、体幹が大きくしなり。 しなやかさと爆発的な力を両立。 荒々しくも洗練され、無駄のない動き。 感情の流れ： 集中 → 加速 → 没入 → 解放 緊張と恍惚が同居する表情変化を明確に描写。 エフェクト： 攻撃や動作の軌跡にシャープなエフェクト。 衝突時に弾けるビジュアル反応. 風圧・衝撃波で髪と衣装が大きく揺れる。 「重さ」と「鋭さ」を瞬間的に両立。 スローモーション： 決定的瞬間の直前または決めのみで使用。 時間を引き延ばし、感情とインパクトを最大化。 背景： ファンシーな室内ベース、キャンバス的扱い。 レイヤー優先順位： キャラクター グラフィック模様 白背景 グラフィック要素： 円、三角形、星形、多角形、柔らかいブロブ、ドット群。 フラット塗り、シャープエッジ、不透明、高コントラスト。 配色はパステルカラー限定。 モーション連動： 図形はキャラクターの動き・ポーズに反応して動く。 視覚的エネルギーを増幅するが、顔や重要部位は遮らない。 構図設計： 全要素を自然に統合しつつ、視線は常にキャラクターへ集中。 キャラクターと背景のコントラストを強く保つ。 「私を放置とは、色んな意味でいい度胸です！」
entries.translated_prompt: No BGM. SE only. Exaggerated cartoon anime-style motion. Emphasize 'slow in and slow out' + 'mid-speeding,' distorting and breaking poses with a 'whoosh' effect. The character repeats rhythmic high-speed movements left and right, alternating between 'moving' and 'stopping in a cute pose.' Performance Sequence: Character repeats fast movements with varying speeds, stopping in cute poses rhythmically. Face close-up: looking upper right → looking upper left; blushing and smiling mischievously while covering mouth; manga-style exaggerated expressions and gestures; pulling back fast with strong perspective; foreshadowing by thrusting hand toward the camera. Camera: Dynamic and kinetic cuts. Combining strong depth, exaggerated perspective, character tracking, and sudden acceleration. Visualizing the rhythm and 'beat.' Motion design: Connecting shoulders, waist, and legs for a supple core. Balancing flexibility and explosive power. Rough yet refined, efficient movement. Emotional flow: Concentration → Acceleration → Immersion → Release. Clearly depicting expressions where tension and ecstasy coexist. Effects: Sharp effects on attack or movement trails. Visual reactions popping upon collision. Hair and costume swaying heavily from wind pressure and shockwaves. Balancing 'weight' and 'sharpness' instantaneously. Slow motion: Used only right before or at the moment of a decisive pose to stretch time and maximize impact. Background: Fancy indoor base treated like a canvas. Layer priority: Character, graphic patterns, white background. Graphic elements: Circles, triangles, stars, polygons, soft blobs, dot groups. Flat fill, sharp edges, opaque, high contrast. Color scheme limited to pastels. Motion link: Shapes move in response to character motion/poses. Amplifying visual energy without obscuring the face or key areas. Composition design: Integrating all elements naturally while focusing the gaze on the character. Maintaining strong contrast between character and background. 'Leaving me alone... you’ve got some nerve in many ways!'

entries.title: Elizabethan London Market Continuous Shot Prompt
entries.description: A complex 15-second continuous shot prompt detailing an Elizabethan-era London market, with specific timestamps for camera movements, character actions, and environmental lighting for Seedance 2.0.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT
cinematic continuous shot / motivated camera movement / 15s
SCENE
A bustling Elizabethan-era market street in London, circa 1500s, at dusk. Timber-framed buildings lean over a narrow muddy street, upper floors nearly touching. Wooden market stalls overflow with bread, fish, herbs, and cloth. Butchers’ hooks hang with raw meat, barrels of ale line the الطريق, and livestock—geese, chickens, and a stray pig—wander freely.
Vendors shout in the 거리, accents rough and lively. Smoke rises from chimneys, mixing with damp fog rolling in from the nearby River Thames. The ground is wet, reflecting torchlight and lantern glow in uneven puddles.
CAMERA CONCEPT
A continuous, motivated camera move where each subject’s motion naturally redirects attention—flowing like a living observer through the chaos of the market.
SEQUENCE
0:00–0:03
Close street-level view of a wooden stall stacked with apples and root vegetables.
CAMERA FOCUS: a cloaked woman argues over price with a merchant. She bites into an apple to test it, then reluctantly drops worn coins into his hand.
0:03–0:05
A horse-drawn cart loaded with sacks of grain suddenly splashes through muddy water across the foreground, briefly obscuring the scene.
CAMERA SHIFT: the camera picks up the cart and begins tracking alongside it.
0:05–0:07
The cart grinds through the tight street, brushing against a hanging cloth banner bearing a faded guild emblem. The fabric whips across the lens.
CAMERA SHIFT: as the cloth clears, a group of geese scatter loudly across the الطريق.
0:07–0:09
A ragged street boy darts into frame, chasing the geese with a stick, weaving through townsfolk and baskets.
CAMERA SHIFT: the camera follows him, dodging passersby.
0:09–0:12
The boy rushes past the entrance of a dim tavern. He disappears into the crowd.
CAMERA SHIFT: the tavern door creaks open as a drunk patron stumbles out.
0:12–0:15
The camera glides past him and into the tavern interior. Thick smoke hangs in the air, lit by flickering oil lanterns. Rough wooden tables, spilled ale, murmuring voices.
CAMERA FINAL FOCUS: a silent armored figure sits in the corner—less polished knight, more worn mercenary—mud-stained boots, dented armor, a longsword resting against the bench. He slowly raises his eyes toward the camera.
STYLE
Authentic Elizabethan street life, dense crowd choreography, grounded realism, historically textured details.
LIGHTING
Warm torchlight reflecting in wet mud outside, cool fog diffusion, dim golden lantern glow inside, smoke-heavy atmosphere.
QUALITY
photorealistic, cinematic lighting, historically grounded detail, immersive camera flow, rich 1500s London atmosphere

城でにっこり笑う少女が、夢と現実の狭間で誰かを招待する10秒。ウィスパーボイス（日本語）で呟く2つのセリフ。優雅で妖しい。淡いパステル×ゴールド。

entries.title: Cinematic Oreo Baking Tutorial
entries.description: An extremely detailed step-by-step prompt for a 15-second cinematic cooking video, including specific timestamps, ingredients, and lighting instructions.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic cinematic cooking scene with warm natural lighting and a cozy kitchen environment. A real human woman is clearly visible throughout the scene, including her face, hands, and focused expressions while baking.

Top-down + slight angled cinematic camera showing a warm wooden table near a window with sunlight streaming in. (8–10s): Heavy cream and vanilla are added, creating a smooth dark chocolate batter. Close-up of her mixing motion and focused face.

(10–11s): Batter is poured into the cake pan evenly.

(11–12s): The cake is shown baking in the oven with a warm golden glow. Timer feel implied.

(12–13s): The baked cake is placed on a cooling rack. Steam gently rises.

(13–14s): Chocolate ganache is poured over the cake, slowly dripping down the sides. Offset spatula smooths the top in one clean motion.

(14–15s): Final decoration: piping cream rosettes, Oreo cookies placed around edges, macarons in center, blueberries scattered, sakura flowers added delicately by hand. Sunlight highlights glossy chocolate finish.

entries.prompt:

CAMERA:
Handheld FPV-style camera, aggressive forward motion, natural shake, slight motion blur, dynamic exposure shifts.

Wide open green valley surrounded by tall mountains, bright daylight, soft wind moving the grass naturally.

ACTION:
At the center of the field, a small floating orb glows with intense red energy. The orb pulses slowly at first.
As the camera rushes forward, the orb suddenly expands in brightness - energy starts leaking outward in unstable waves.

At 2s mark:
The orb violently destabilizes - releasing a massive burst of red plasma-like energy.

Particles:
Glowing red fragments, sparks, and energy streaks shoot outward in all directions with realistic speed and decay.

FINAL MOMENT:

entries.title: The Celestial Fracture: Biomechanical Valkyrie Action
entries.description: An epic sci-fi cinematic prompt involving a biomechanical Cerberus, a plasma-wielding Valkyrie, and a supernova backdrop.
entries.prompt:
The Celestial Fracture: A Supernova Strike

A hyper-realistic, high-octane cinematic video that demands absolute attention. A colossal, biomechanical Stained-Glass Cerberus—its internal skeleton forged from churning, liquid tungsten—violently crashes upward through the vaulted floor of a floating, neo-gothic cathedral suspended in the chaotic rings of a dying star. The breach sends explosive, slow-motion shockwaves of pulverized ancient marble and iridescent glass shards high into the localized anti-gravity field.

Riding the apex of the center hound's massive skull is a fiercely athletic Valkyrie, armored in polished obsidian and wielding a colossal scythe made of pure, white-hot plasma. Instead of bracing for the catastrophic impact, she harnesses the beast's violent upward momentum to launch into a spectacular, gravity-defying reverse-somersault execution strike, swinging the glowing plasma scythe overhead in a blinding, lethal arc directly toward the abyss.

The Twist:
Suddenly, an unexpected twist: as the Cerberus reaches the peak of its breach, the millions of suspended, shattered stained-glass fragments violently ignite with blinding, golden solar energy. The shards instantly coalesce and mutate into a massive swarm of glowing, translucent Celestial Manta Rays, their wings sharp as obsidian scalpels, erupting from the debris and soaring like kinetic missiles all around the suspended warrior.

The camera abandons a traditional wide shot for a relentless, fast-paced reverse-tracking snap-zoom. It spirals violently backward through the deadly storm of glowing glass manta rays, narrowly dodging their razor-sharp wings, before whipping 180 degrees to lock into a first-person POV directly over the Valkyrie's shoulder just as her plasma scythe connects with the Cerberus’s tungsten spine with catastrophic force. The blinding golden light of the dying star is dramatically pierced by a sudden, jagged shockwave of void-black anti-matter ripping across the nebula.

Audio Profile:
Audio features the deafening, apocalyptic crunch of shattering celestial architecture, the high-pitched, singing whine of the plasma scythe cutting the atmosphere, the terrifyingly beautiful, chaotic chime of a million glass wings slicing the air, and a soaring, high-tempo operatic choir layered with a heavy synth-bass crescendo. This auditory chaos cuts abruptly to a vacuum-sealed, ringing silence the exact millisecond the black anti-matter shockwave detonates.

Zorg mimics her, clumsily sliding his large feet into the sneakers, then pulls the puffy jacket over his shoulders and zips it up.

Zorg looks down at his new outfit and does a small, joyous hop. The sneakers squeak pleasantly.

Zorg looks at his warm clothes and speaks in a harmonious, buzzing tone.

Phoebe beams with pride, calling it the best gift in the galaxy. Zorg gives a clumsy but enthusiastic thumbs-up.
Phoebe: A perfect fit! The best gift in the galaxy.

entries.title: Marrakech Medina Heist Sequence
entries.description: A high-energy cinematic heist prompt set in the Marrakech medina at golden hour, utilizing various camera angles like drone shots and steadicams.
entries.prompt:
Marrakech medina at golden hour. The sun hangs low and orange over terracotta rooftops, casting long copper shadows between tangled alleyways stacked with spice pyramids, hanging lanterns, and drying saffron threads. Dust motes swirl in shafts of light.   
[0s–3s] Open on a tight overhead drone shot looking straight down into a narrow alley no wider than a man's shoulders. A young thief in a dust-colored linen shirt, bare feet slapping warm stone, bursts into frame sprinting full tilt. He clutches a small burlap pouch against his chest. The drone matches his speed, descending and tilting forward until it's level with the rooftops, revealing the vast medina maze unfolding beneath him.   
[3s–6s] Smash cut to a steadicam chase shot, 24mm wide, framing him from behind at waist height. He vaults a cart of blood oranges — they cascade into frame, bouncing like liquid fire across stone. A pursuing merchant shouts in Darija, swinging a wooden cane. The camera ducks under a low arch covered in blue tilework, and a shaft of golden light sweeps across the lens in a blinding flare.   
[6s–9s] Whip-pan to a lateral tracking shot as he scales a wall in three kinetic movements — foot on a crate, hand grabbing a copper pot hook, shoulder rolling onto a low roof. Hens explode into the air, feathers floating in slow motion. The camera rises with him in a vertical crane, revealing the full panorama: the pink Koutoubia mosque minaret in the distance, the Atlas Mountains silhouetted purple on the horizon, smoke rising from tagine stalls far below.   
[9s–12s] Hard cut to extreme close-up of his face, intercut with the pouch opening mid-stride — a single raw emerald the size of a walnut tumbles out, catches the sunset, and he snatches it back out of the air without breaking pace. Sweat beads on his brow. His dark eyes flick sideways. A 35mm lens, shallow focus, background dissolving into amber bokeh.   
[12s–15s] Reverse low-angle tracking shot, camera gliding backwards ahead of him across the rooftops. He leaps — a massive gap, at least four meters — between two buildings. Time stretches. His body arcs over the alley where, far below, a wedding procession plays ghaita horns and beats tbel drums, red petals falling. He lands in a perfect forward roll, springs up, and without pausing tosses the emerald into the air. Camera cranes up fast to catch it spinning against the blazing sun. Freeze frame. Silhouette. Cut to black.   
STYLE: Sun-baked desert epic, Villeneuve-grade scale with Guy Ritchie kinetic cutting. Shot on Alexa Mini LF, Cooke S4 primes. Color grade: burnt sienna, warm amber highlights, turquoise accent shadows from tilework. Heavy atmospheric haze, volumetric sun rays, practical dust kicked up by every footfall. Minimal lens flare, no grain — crisp, cinematic, rich.   
AUDIO: Breathy flute and hand-percussion tabla rhythm at 120 BPM building to a climax. Footsteps slapping stone. Distant call to prayer bleeding across rooftop

entries.title: Mech Warfare Post-Apocalyptic Thriller

entries.prompt: @Image1's character as the subject — an Asian male, navy blue T-shirt, black cargo shorts, round glasses, black cap, sneakers. Radiation-enhanced superhuman speed and strength, awakened orange-yellow glowing pupils, veins bulging, intense aura. Scene: Abandoned Chicago high-rise ruins, exposed rebar, cracked concrete, suspended derelict vehicles, rusted steel walkways, mutant vines, broken glass shards, dim moonlight, glitching neon flicker, thick fog, extreme high-altitude tension. One-take continuous shot, 15 seconds, cinematic, 120fps high frame rate, ultra-realistic dark American post-apocalyptic sci-fi thriller, desaturated cold gray palette with orange-yellow accent. 0–3s: Low angle wide shot — character stands at edge of cracked floor slab, panting after clearing small enemies, orange-yellow pupils coldly scanning ruins. Building violently shakes. Upgraded Giant Tracker bursts through fog, slams floor with massive claws, concrete explodes. Handheld slight tremor, wide angle oppressive framing. 3–6s: Giant Tracker sweeps massive claw — character side-dashes at extreme speed with strong motion blur afterimage. Claw shatters steel column, dust blast. Monster strikes repeatedly, character serpentine-sprints through debris gaps at high speed. Ground-level chase track shot, full motion blur. 6–8s: Character kicks off suspended vehicle in mid-air, rotates at high speed, launches spinning kick at monster's head. Monster roars, snapping jaw barely grazes his sneaker. Hitchcock spiral orbit shot, high-altitude danger. 8–10s: Character lands and explodes forward — three rapid heavy punches to monster's chest and jaw, each blow forcing it back, bone-crushing thuds. Low sweep kick destabilizes monster's footing. Medium close-up tracking, 120fps slow-motion captures fist impact force. 10–13s: Character grabs monster arm, reverse-twists — exoskeleton cracks and bursts. Leaps onto monster's back, legs lock around throat, both arms pry apart neck armor. Monster thrashes violently, character holds firm. Back overhead shot with fast lateral cuts, strong motion blur afterimage. 13–15s: Character vaults off, charges full-force punch into monster's split skull jaw — kinetic force detonates through the head, monster collapses, shockwave shatters surrounding vines and glass. Final freeze frame: character stands atop monster corpse, orange-yellow pupils cold and sharp, disheveled hair, dust and blood specks, total dominance. Slow-motion face close-up push, vignette edges darken, moonlight rakes across side face. Sound: heavy impacts, bone cracks, monster roars, debris crash, glass shatter, ending with deep bass thud.
