entries.title: Time-distorting woman cinematic sequence
entries.description: A complex, 15-second cinematic narrative prompt set in Istanbul where a mysterious woman ages and decays pedestrians with a touch, culminating in a burst of golden energy.
entries.prompt: A cinematic 15-second sequence set on a crowded Istanbul sidewalk at dusk, with warm amber streetlights, glowing shop windows, and dense pedestrian movement in both directions. The main character is a calm, mysterious woman (use <<<image_1>>> as strict identity reference with full face consistency). She walks steadily toward the camera through the crowd, her presence subtle yet powerful. As she passes a young man, she gently places her hand on his shoulder; at the exact moment of contact, his hair rapidly turns white, deep wrinkles form across his face, his posture collapses, and he ages decades within seconds before dropping to his knees. She withdraws her hand as visible golden time-energy flows up her arm, her posture becoming more refined and dominant, and she continues walking without looking back. Moving forward through the crowd, she brushes her fingers across the arm of another passerby, a woman who instantly begins to decay—her skin turns grey, her motion freezes, and her body slowly disintegrates into fine dust carried away by the wind. A pulse of glowing golden energy transfers from the dust into the main character’s chest, her eyes briefly illuminating with a soft amber glow as the air around her shimmers with subtle time distortion like heat haze. Nearby pedestrians react with fear, stepping away and clearing space around her. As the sequence reaches its final moment, she stops in the center of the now-empty sidewalk, golden energy swirling around her entire body in visible streams. She slowly raises both hands and opens her palms, releasing the accumulated time-energy upward into a massive vertical beam of radiant golden light that shoots into the darkening sky, illuminating the entire street. Her hair and coat lift dramatically in the surge of power before the light fades away. The glow disappears, leaving the street completely empty—every pedestrian gone. She calmly lowers her hands, places them in her pockets, and walks away alone into the amber-lit dusk. Shot in cinematic steadicam style with shallow depth of field, volumetric golden lighting, photorealistic VFX, ultra-detailed textures, Dolby Vision grade, smooth 60fps motion, and full 8K quality.

After Seedance 2.0 came out, my boss stayed up all night playing with it, (points behind) he's still sleeping now! (Resumes normal volume, smiles confidently) So now I'll demonstrate for everyone that the entire image, sound, camera work, including my expressions and actions (gesturing to self, tilting head) that you see now... were all created by my boss with just one sentence!

entries.title: Desert Leviathan and Shamanic Belly Dancer
entries.description: A complex cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 involving a creature breaching from sand, environment shifts to frost, and a high-action chase sequence.
entries.prompt: A hyper-realistic, high-octane cinematic epic set within the heart of an endless, undulating desert of scarlet sand. A colossal Desert Leviathan—a serpentine creature forged from ancient, hardened clay, bone, and pulsating veins of molten obsidian—violently explodes from the highest dune, breaching like a whale but through the earth itself. It sprays tsunamis of fine red sand high into the scorching air. Riding the apex of the Leviathan’s churning, scaly head is an ethereal belly dancer, draped in shimmering silk veils embedded with tiny mirrors and raw amber. Instead of trying to maintain balance, she embraces the creature's massive upward surge. She uses a golden, scimitar-shaped baton to weave the rising sand columns, drawing shimmering, fractal symbols of golden energy and glowing turquoise hieroglyphs from the creature’s hide, molding the flying sand into solid steps beneath her feet. The Twist: As the Leviathan roars—a sound like tectonic plates grinding beneath a waterfall—the entire desert landscape undergoes a sudden, localized environmental shift. The intense, oppressive heat violently transforms into an immediate, freezing flash-frost. The cascading waves of scarlet sand begin to solidify in mid-air, not into ice, but into geometric crystals of amethyst. Suddenly, a massive, explosive swarm of origami scarabs (folded from iridescent blue metal and paper) erupts from the frozen dunes, soaring like arrows all around the suspended dancer. The camera abandons a traditional perspective for a kinetic, fast-paced whip-pan tracking shot, following the dancer’s flight as she leaps from crystal sand-step to crystal sand-step, navigating the dangerous amethyst terrain and dodging the swarm of metal scarabs. She dives headfirst toward the creature’s open, frozen maw. Lighting & Atmosphere: The lighting is a conflict of extremes. The initial setting is scorched by a high-noon, harsh yellow sun. This is instantly replaced by the oppressive, cool, deep violet shadows of the flash-frozen desert and the refracted, kaleidoscopic colors bouncing off the amethyst crystals and metal scarabs. Audio Profile: The scene begins with a deafening, low-frequency rumble of shifting earth and the sickening crack of ancient wood. The Shaman’s magic hums with a pulsating, rhythmic chant layered with the crackling of siphoned electricity. When the frost-ravens erupt, the sound shifts to the shrieking, high-pitched scratching of ice on ice. A chaotic, primal drum score drives the action, cutting to absolute sonic vacuum just as the Shaman breaches the frozen breath, leaving only the sound of a single, slow heartbeat.

entries.title: Luxury Skeleton Watch Cinematic Commercial

Yellow taxis driving past
Pedestrians walking naturally
A few people stopping to watch or record
Others continuing their routine, ignoring the chaos

Fast, fluid movements with sharp kicks and clean strikes
Graceful dodges and turns, blending agility with power
Cinematic slow-motion at key impact moments
Hair and outfit reacting naturally to motion

Smooth tracking shots following her movement
Handheld energy during intense moments
Close-ups on expressions, confidence, and impact
Wide shots showing contrast between calm city life and action

entries.title: No Ticket, No Problem Action Comedy
entries.description: A highly detailed, long-form narrative prompt for an action-comedy scene involving cats in a jungle adventure.
entries.prompt:
TITLE: “No Ticket, No Problem”
Seedance 2 | 15-second cinematic action-comedy | jungle adventure parody | high-speed chaos | dark American humor dialogue | exaggerated reactions | dynamic camera | punchy sound design

A rugged jungle theme park entrance. Primitive wooden fences, tall gates, and a massive hanging wooden sign reading “CAT UNIVERSE.” Lush overgrown jungle beyond. Mist in the air. Subtle ominous ambiance.

An orange cat wearing khaki explorer gear, binoculars hanging around his neck, sits in a dusty jeep. A white cat in a pink dress sits in the back seat, clearly unimpressed.

0–3 seconds:
Wide shot. Jeep rolls to a stop at the gate. Jungle sounds echo.

A hyena guard in camouflage uniform and sunglasses steps forward, stern and silent.

He leans toward the driver side.

Hyena guard (flat, intimidating):
"Ticket."

Close-up on orange cat. Confident smile… slowly fades.

He starts searching frantically.

3–6 seconds:
Interior chaotic close shots.

Glove compartment bursts open—papers, snack wrappers, empty cans flying everywhere.

Orange cat digging everywhere. Increasing panic.

Orange cat (nervous laugh):
"Okay… funny story… I definitely had it… spiritually."

Cut to white cat in backseat, staring out the window, bored and annoyed.

White cat (dry):
"I knew this date was illegal."

Orange cat freezes. Looks at guard.

Orange cat (awkward):
"Yeah so… about the ticket… I don’t have it."

Beat. Silence.

6–9 seconds:
Sudden shift.

Orange cat slams the gas pedal.

ENGINE ROARS.

The jeep EXPLODES forward—

SMASHES through the wooden gate. Splinters fly in slow motion.

Hyena guard jumps back shouting.

Hyena guard:
"HEY— THAT’S NOT A VALID—"

Cut off by chaos.

The jeep speeds into the jungle.

White cat SCREAMS as she grabs the seat.

White cat:
"OH GREAT NOW WE’RE CRIMINALS—"

9–12 seconds:
Deep jungle. Camera racing alongside jeep.

Glowing floating bubbles fill the air—each one softly pulsing with different colors.

Inside each bubble: a sleeping tiny green baby T-rex.

The jeep rushes past—

Wind pressure disturbs the bubbles.

POP—POP—POP—

Bubbles burst rapidly.

Tiny T-rexes drop, wake up instantly—eyes glowing, teeth bared.

They SCREECH and begin chasing the jeep.

Fast chaotic pursuit.

White cat sighs, completely over it.

White cat (annoyed, deadpan):
"See? This is why I can’t let you make decisions."

12–15 seconds:
She reaches behind the seat—

Pulls out a ROCKET LAUNCHER casually.

Orange cat glances back, concerned.

Orange cat:
"...you brought that on a date?"

White cat shrugs.

White cat:
"I like options."

She fires.

WHOOSH—

Rocket splits mid-air into multiple flaming fragments.

Each fragment targets a different baby T-rex.

Rapid impacts—tiny explosions.

The T-rexes yelp, panic, scatter and flee in all directions.

Silence returns except for engine hum.

Final shot:
Inside jeep.

entries.prompt: 生成一个15秒的高燃游戏创意短片，包含深度旁白叙事，注意分镜编排与丝滑转场。【镜头与转场编排】0-5秒：手持摄影镜头快速推向闪烁红色RGB灯光的显示器。当屏幕中的角色举手时，利用“动作匹配转场”，无缝衔接至现实中男玩家起身向镜头伸手。镜头动作需保持连续的向前推力。5-8秒：玩家的手遮住镜头的瞬间，通过“黑屏过渡”丝滑切入CG世界。金色骷髅战士在黑暗中现身，慢动作展现左手爆发金色粒子。8-15秒：采用“快速跳切（Jump Cut）”配合节奏，展现角色的多角度特写。结尾画面逐渐变暗，与开头色调呼应，形成视觉闭环。【视觉与转场质量】全篇保持电影级写实与高对比度。转场必须平滑、无跳跃感，人物动作衔接自然 。【旁白与声音设计】1. 使用深沉、磁性、略带沙哑的男声旁白，语速稳重，充满故事感。2. 旁白内容：“在现实与虚幻的交界，唯一真实的，是战斗的渴望。”3. 声音设计：画面节奏与旁白重音、背景音效进行精准卡点。5秒处能量爆发需配合震撼的重低音（Sub-bass）。

entries.title: Pixel Art Horror RPG Gameplay Scene
entries.description: A detailed video generation prompt for creating a 15-second gameplay clip of a pixel-art horror RPG, including character exploration, UI dialogue boxes, and a supernatural encounter.
entries.prompt:
Screen recording of a 2D top-down pixel art horror RPG game, Japanese indie style reminiscent of The Witch's House and Ib. A stoic pale-haired anime girl sprite navigates a decaying Victorian mansion interior, dark muted palette with flickering candlelight casting long pixel shadows. Sparse windows reveal a pale moonlit night sky outside.

[0s–3s] The girl sprite walks up to a large ornate door and interacts with it. A pixel dialogue box appears on screen reading: "The door is locked… I need to find a key somewhere."

[3s–6s] The sprite moves right and examines a dusty wooden table. A centered dialogue box slides in displaying a torn note: "Beware of what you cannot see." A small pixel question mark bubble pops above her head.

[7s–11s] The sprite stands motionless. In the dim corridor behind her, a distorted black shadowy figure silently materializes and drifts closer. The moment it reaches directly behind her, a red exclamation mark bubble bursts above her head. She spins around instantly. The shadow vanishes.

[11s–15s] A dialogue box appears: "Was that… just my imagination…?" The sprite cautiously resumes exploring the dark hallways, checking bookshelves and paintings on cracked walls.

Atmospheric BGM: haunting ethereal piano melody layered with faint antique clock ticking. CRT scanline filter, 16-bit color depth, pixel-perfect animation. Slow camera follows the sprite with subtle screen shake during the shadow encounter. Dark ambient lighting, desaturated cool tones with warm candlelight accents.

entries.title: Dragonflight Trials POV
entries.description: A visceral first-person perspective prompt for animating a rider mounting a massive black dragon on a mountain platform.
entries.prompt: First-person POV from a rider approaching a massive black dragon from behind on a wooden mountain platform. The dragon stands at a starting ramp facing a wooden gate reading "DRAGONFLIGHT TRIALS START" with dragon-emblem banners on each side. Mountains and clouds beyond. The rider wears worn white leather gloves, dirt on hands. A white leather saddle with straps sits on the dragon's back. Ambient crowd noise: distant cheering, horns, excited murmur from spectators below. 35mm anamorphic, handheld POV, heavy film grain, teal-amber palette, bright sunlight, photoreal VFX, no zoom. 0s–2s: POV approaching the dragon's flank. Hands reach up, grab the saddle edge, pull up. One leg swings over. POV settles into the white saddle on the dragon's back. Hands grip the saddle straps. Crowd noise swells slightly. 2s–4s: Seated POV. The dragon slowly turns its massive horned head to the right, looking back over its shoulder toward the rider with one large amber eye — a knowing sideways glance, intense but calm. The eye blinks once, slowly. 4s–6s: The rider leans forward and extends one gloved hand to the side of the dragon's thick scaled neck. Pats it firmly three times with warm confident rhythm — thud, thud, thud — feeling the hard scales under the leather glove. The rider says softly but firmly: "Are you ready, my friend?" 6s–8s: The dragon holds the gaze for one more beat, then slowly turns its head back forward toward the starting gate. A deep exhale through its nostrils — a heavy deliberate sigh, two thick streams of warm air visible in the mountain cold. Its jaw tightens. Eyes narrow with focus. The crowd noise builds. 8s–10s: The dragon lowers its body slightly, hind legs coiling, claws gripping the wooden platform, wings tucking tight against its body in launch position. Muscles tensing visibly under the scales. The rider leans forward flat against the neck, hands locked on the straps, body pressed tight. Both locked in, both ready. Crowd roaring. The starting gate still ahead. Freeze on the tension. Style: hyperrealistic VFX, photoreal massive dragon, detailed scales and eye, worn leather saddle and gloves, mountain competition environment, visceral POV, rider always firmly mounted, layered crowd and competition soundscape — cheering, distant horns, wind, dragon breathing — building to crescendo, no music. Negative: cartoon, CGI look, zoom, third-person, rider's face visible, dragon launching or flying, text, watermark, morphing anatomy.

entries.title: Storm-Wyrm and Shaolin Monk Battle
entries.description: A high-octane cinematic script for a desert canyon battle featuring a thundercloud dragon and a modernized Shaolin monk, utilizing FPV drone-style camera work.
entries.prompt:
A hyper-realistic, high-octane cinematic video still set in a narrow, labyrinthine desert canyon at night. A colossal Storm-Wyrm—a serpentine dragon forged from turbulent thunderclouds and internal lattice-works of blue lightning—violently erupts from a dry riverbed, breaching like a whale through the canyon floor. It sends explosive shockwaves of pulverized red sandstone and electrified dust high into the storm-choked sky.

Riding the apex of the Storm-Wyrm's rugged, crackling snout is a modernized Shaolin Monk, clad in robes woven with conductive wire and armored boots. Instead of holding on, he harnesses the wyrm’s massive upward thrust to launch into a spectacular, gravity-defying flying spear kick, aiming directly at a hidden target over the chaotic, shifting dust cloud.

The Twist:
Suddenly, an unexpected twist: as the wyrm reaches its peak, the canyon walls around them violently ignite with intense static electricity, glowing in pulsating blue and purple hues. A massive, explosive swarm of flying, magnetic iron-ore gargoyles (carved from the cliff face itself) is ripped from the rock, soaring like kinetic missiles all around the suspended monk.

The camera perspective shifts from a high-angle wide to a kinetic, fast-paced spiraling FPV drone-style tracking shot. The camera corkscrews 360 degrees around the monk’s spin, tracking his leg trajectory through the static-filled dust as he smashes through the gargoyles and weaves between the lightning-filled air. The shot then plunges momentarily into a thick cloud bank just as the Storm-Wyrm’s massive, spade-like tail slams down into the canyon floor with catastrophic force. The cool, flickering blue static light is dramatically pierced by a sudden, jagged bolt of crimson lightning tearing across the dark sky.

Audio Profile (visualized):
The scene visualizes the sound of a deafening, crackling roar of compressed thunder and shattering rock, the zing of static electricity, the clatter of stone gargoyles, and a soaring, high-tempo percussion-heavy cinematic score that cuts abruptly to a muffled, low-frequency echo as the camera is engulfed by the heavy storm cloud.

entries.title: Female warrior transformation combat
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt featuring a female warrior transforming on a warhorse and engaging in combat with alien insects, using IMAX film style.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic continuous single-take shot, IMAX film simulation, Panavision C-series 35mm lens, f/4, strong backlighting, heavy shadows, desaturated grey tones.

Low-angle shot from behind a battle-worn Western female warrior sitting motionless on a massive black warhorse on dark soil under a dull grey sky. She wears damaged black armor, long blonde hair partially loose, strands moving in the wind.

Camera slowly rises toward her right hand as she violently pulls the reins. The horse rears — instant bullet-time slow motion.

Black-red flames erupt from the horse, incinerating surrounding alien insects into ash.

Her face, mostly shadowed, begins a painful transformation — eyes ignite with piercing white-gold light, leaking thick black smoke.

Her right palm splits open, dark blood spilling as twisting nerve-like fibers grow outward, forming a brutal halberd of smoke and living tissue.

The horse’s body fractures with glowing red cracks, channeling lava-like energy into her.

Heavy, jagged black bio-mechanical armor slams onto her body with bursts of red light and shockwaves, tearing away her worn clothes.

A dark organic-metal mask violently grows over her face, forming uneven compound eyes and flaming horns.

Bullet time snaps back to real speed.

Camera circles tightly as she launches into brutal combat — aggressive halberd strikes, impaling and shattering enemies, trails of black smoke and fire.

The warhorse spins and charges, crushing alien insects beneath its hooves.

Suddenly — silence. Violence stops.

0–3s: Wide establishing shot of Bundaran HI roundabout in Jakarta. A giant monster referencing image3's creature design — green scaly skin, tentacle arms, yellow bulging eyes, massive gaping jaw — towers over the buildings, smashing skyscrapers with its tentacle arms. 3–6s: Camera follows a beaten-up purple car speeding through the panicked crowd and screeching to a halt in the middle of the roundabout road. The car door swings open — image1's character (man in maroon t-shirt, glasses, backwards cap) steps out, looking up at the monster. A security guard (khaki uniform, brown pants, brown cap, utility belt) rushes toward him and shouts: "Kenapa baru muncul?!" The man smirks.

6–10s: image1's character places his right hand firmly on the purple car's hood. The car instantly disintegrates into swirling purple-black nano-tech particles, getting absorbed through his hand. The nano-particles rapidly spread from his arm across his entire body — his casual clothes dissolve as the nano-tech constructs piece by piece into the full mecha armor suit referencing image2's design: purple and dark blue armor plates, glowing blue wing units deploying from his back, glowing blue rabbit-ear antenna extending from the helmet, and a large weapon materializing in his right hand. Metallic clanking and high-tech assembly sound effects.

10–13s: Now fully armored, the character raises his heavy weapon, aims at the image3 monster towering above the buildings, and fires a massive blue laser beam. The beam hits the monster square in the chest — the monster roars in pain and is blasted backward, crashing through a building. Explosion debris and shockwave dust.

13–15s: The mecha suit helmet visor slides open, revealing image1's face — glasses still on, calm confident expression. He looks directly at the camera and says: "Mobil bututku sangat keren kan?" He turns and walks away from the camera toward the destruction, armor wings glowing. The security guard stands frozen in disbelief in the background.

Style: Photorealistic VFX blockbuster quality, cinematic widescreen framing. Shallow depth of field during character close-ups. Cold desaturated blue-grey color palette. Dusty atmospheric haze. entries.prompt:
A 23-second ultra-cinematic 2D anime action sequence at night. Dark blue sky, stars, bright full moon with strong rim light. Burning medieval village in background: flaming huts, black smoke, floating embers. Dry rocky hills, dusty ground. Fluid 24fps animation, painterly style, dynamic motion blur, dramatic cameras, epic orchestral swell.

0-2s: Sweeping low aerial shot racing toward blazing village. Silver-haired female warrior (early 20s, short choppy silver-white hair, glowing emerald eyes, fierce expression) sprints fast, green cape whipping. Silver plate armor over green tunic, gauntlets, boots. Voice: “Too slow.”

2-5s: Tracking shot from behind as she leaps, cape flaring like wings. Massive shadowy creature (long black hair, glowing green eyes, claws, purple-dark armor, bat wings) erupts from smoke and slams past in blur. She spins mid-air.

5-8s: Close-up warrior face, focused and sweaty. She raises hands in martial stance, green energy swirls. Summons massive white tornado upward. Creature dives; she blocks with crossed arms, cape billowing. Heroic low-angle against its wing.

8-11s: Extreme wide: warrior launched high in tornado. Mid-air collision with creature, tumbling spin. Tight face-to-face glare: her determined vs its snarling purple face. Creature hisses “You don’t belong here.” Sparks explode. Slow-mo grapple.

11-15s: Rapid cuts: she spins, kicks free, backflips, launches wind blast. Creature transforms into larger spiked dragon-beast with red spine accents and long tail. Epic wide aerial fight under moon, dust tornadoes and embers below.

15-19s: Fast montage: warrior dodges whipping tail, runs along it mid-air, leaps off with wind boost. Close-up glowing green eye and armored hand charging energy. She slams creature’s side in burst of orange sparks and smoke. Creature roars away.

19-23s: Dramatic close-up on warrior’s face (messy hair, burning green eyes, small confident smirk). Distant creature rises glowing green in smoke. Voice: “Round two.” Slow push-in as embers drift, village glows behind hills. Fade to black.

Style: Consistent designs — warrior pale skin, sharp jaw, athletic; creature ethereal menacing with flowing hair/claws. Deep blue-cyan grading with warm firelight. Detailed cape physics, armor reflections, wind/sparks/smoke particles. Arcane-style fluid choreography. Lip sync, wind howls, impacts, fire crackle.

entries.title: Cinematic Time-Freeze Sports Bar Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a 15-second time-freeze sequence set in a sports bar. It features a woman walking through a frozen crowd celebrating a World Series win, interacting with the suspended environment before restoring motion.
entries.prompt: Use @ Reference Image as the main character, keeping facial features and body proportions consistent throughout. She is a 30-year-old woman. Cinematic time-freeze short film, 15 seconds, ultra-realistic, shot on Arri Alexa Mini, 35mm lens, moody sports bar interior lighting with neon accents, volumetric haze, dynamic hard shadows, shallow depth of field. [0:00–0:03] A packed, dimly lit sports bar, time flowing normally. Steadicam frontal medium shot tracking her walking confidently through absolute chaos. On the blurred TVs in the background, the Yankees have just clinched the World Series. The crowd is erupting in pure euphoria. As she walks, she raises her right hand and snaps. [0:03–0:06] At the snap, a subtle spherical shockwave bursts from her fingertips with air distortion and light refraction, expanding outward. Everything freezes mid-explosion. Thick arcs of golden beer suspend in the air, with individual glistening droplets visible. Popcorn kernels float motionless. People are frozen mid-cheer and mid-air in leaping embraces. Volumetric neon light catches the suspended dust and liquid. Absolute silence. [0:06–0:09] Only she moves. Her footsteps echo slightly. The camera moves backward as she walks through the frozen celebration, observing calmly. She casually ducks under an arc of frozen, splashing beer. She notices a cluster of floating popcorn, reaches out, and plucks a single kernel from the air. [0:09–0:11] She stops in front of a frozen woman wearing a Yankees jersey, her face locked in an ecstatic, tearful scream, arms raised for a high-five. The main character tilts her head, gently adjusts the brim of the frozen woman’s Yankees cap, nods slightly, and softly says: “perfect.” [0:11–0:15] She turns, tosses the popcorn kernel into her mouth, and crunches it. She faces the camera, smirks, and snaps again. A stronger reverse shockwave restores motion. The beer completes its splash, the cheering roar instantly returns, and fans land their jumps. She walks away as the camera pushes through the wildly celebrating crowd. Fade to black. Sound: deafening bar roar/celebration → snap → deep shockwave/bass drop → absolute silence → footsteps → sharp popcorn crunch → “perfect” → snap → reverse shockwave → deafening celebration returns

entries.title: Autonomous High-Speed Chase
entries.description: A cinematic high-pressure driving prompt that transitions from a stressed human driver to a perfectly precise autonomous system, featuring anamorphic lenses and 8K photorealism.
entries.prompt:
High-speed urban environment under extreme pressure. Hyper-realistic, grounded physics. The tone shifts from human tension to machine-level precision.
Shot on 35mm anamorphic lens, f/2.8. Natural motion blur, realistic exposure, high dynamic range. Golden hour light cutting through dust, glass particles, and atmospheric haze.
Subject: A skilled driver under intense stress. Fully human at the start, breathing, micro-errors, instability. Gradually transitions into passive role as control shifts to a system beyond them.
Audio: starts organic (breath, friction, engine strain) → evolves into tight, mechanical, synchronized sound → ends in overwhelming environmental impact.
0–2s: Interior close-up. Hands gripping controls (steering wheel / throttle / harness). Micro-corrections, slight oversteer, imperfect rhythm. Breath audible. Stress visible.
2–4s: Rapid cuts: exterior tracking shot (speed established), side angle (environment rushing past), forward POV (danger ahead forming). Everything is still human-driven, slightly unstable.
4–6s: Wide shot, impossible situation ahead: blocked path, collapsing structure, incoming collision, or narrowing space. No clear solution.
6–8s: Back inside, the subject braces. Then controls shift subtly on their own. Movement becomes smoother… too smooth. Sound tightens. Breathing drops out of focus.
8–11s: Camera language changes: ultra-stable tracking shots, perfect alignment through space, impossible micro-adjustments at high speed. Multiple angles: top-down threading through obstacles, side pass with millimeter clearance, forward POV locking onto optimal path. The subject is no longer driving,  just holding on.
11–13s: The system commits to a maneuver no human would attempt: threading through collapsing debris / crossing moving objects / cutting through a closing gap at full speed. Time feels compressed and precise.
13–15s: Massive physical consequence: debris explosion, chain reaction collisions, shockwave through environment. But the subject emerges through it cleanly. 
Final shot: interior close-up,  subject still frozen, realizing they were not in control. Sound fades from mechanical precision back to raw breathing.
Ultra-photorealistic 8K, cinematic HDR lighting, perfect motion continuity, physically accurate mass interaction, multi-angle coherence, no artifacts, grounded realism.

entries.title: Prehistoric POV Paragliding Action
entries.description: An immersive first-person POV prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a paragliding flight through a prehistoric canyon filled with dinosaurs, complete with timing and sound effect cues.
entries.prompt:
VISUAL STYLE: Use live-action feature film realism with

crisp action-camera sharpness and ancient atmospheric haze. CHARACTERS: Define a pair of gloved human hands gripping worn paraglider toggles, dark flying boots, and multiple massive prehistoric predators crossing the flight path. STAGE: Set a vast prehistoric canyon that drops from open sky into fern-choked treetops, a fast river corridor, and a muddy predator clearing under harsh daylight haze. EMOTIONAL TARGET: Build from reckless speed into unstoppable hunted panic. COLOR LOGIC: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation TIMELINE: 00:00.0: Open on a strict POV suspended over the canyon lip. Use an ultra-wide 14mm action lens with locked forward flight. Drop hard toward the jungle canopy as both gloved hands pull the toggles down and the boots kick into empty air. SFX: Violent wind rush, harness straps snapping tight. 00:03.4: Keep the same locked POV and lens package. Dive between treetop crowns, skim past the swaying neck of a towering long-neck herbivore, and force the right hand to yank the toggle to miss its jawline by inches. SFX: Deep animal bellow, leaves tearing, rising wind scream. 00:06.8: Maintain the uninterrupted plunge. Thread into a narrow river corridor as a flock of pterosaurs erupts off the cliff wall and crosses directly through the flight path. Let the left hand snap the canopy into a hard bank while the boots clear wet rock by inches. SFX: Shrill wingbeats, river thunder, fabric strain. 00:10.2: Hold the same POV and keep driving forward. Blast out of the river bend into a muddy clearing, lose altitude fast, and drag the boot soles across churned earth as the canopy collapses behind the camera path. SFX: Skidding mud scrape, collapsing fabric whip, panicked breath. 00:12.8: Maintain the same first-person line at ground level. Stumble forward two desperate steps, look up, and let a charging Spinosaurus burst out of the river mist with its long jaws thrown wide straight at the lens until the teeth fill the frame. SFX: Ground-shaking footfalls, guttural bellow, snapping jaws. EXCLUDE: Avoid third-person camera breaks, disjointed hands, impossible flight resets, teleporting terrain, frozen creatures, modern gear drift, impossible neck rotation, cut language.

entries.title: Underground Crystal Cavern Mag-Lev Racing
entries.description: A high-speed cinematic video prompt featuring a futuristic mag-lev pod racing through a cavern of luminous crystals and geodes, ending with a dramatic explosion of prismatic light.
entries.prompt:
Start inside the mouth of a colossal underground cavern as the camera rushes forward and drops in a spiraling dive into the depths. Below, a mag-lev racing pod hurtles along a natural crystal rail formation deep underground, banking through impossible geological curves. 

Its design is minimal and luminous: a teardrop-shaped transparent cockpit revealing the pilot within, magnetic suspension rings that pulse electric blue, no visible propulsion — just pure electromagnetic force, and a surface so polished it mirrors the crystal walls rushing past. 

Giant amethyst and quartz formations blur by in streaks of purple and white while the pod's magnetic field makes the crystals around it resonate and sing. Without a cut, the camera tightens from the cavern-wide dive into a close chase along the crystal rail, revealing the pod's reflection fractured across a thousand crystal facets, electrical arcs jumping between the magnetic rings and nearby mineral deposits, and the crystal formations vibrating visibly, emitting harmonic tones. 

It drops below the rail for a dramatic undercarriage shot revealing the magnetic suspension gap — a thin line of pure blue-white energy — then whips to the front as the cavern opens into a massive geode chamber. For the climax, the crystal rail splits into three diverging paths around a central formation — an enormous singular crystal, twenty meters tall, glowing from within with trapped ancient light. 

The pod accelerates toward the fork, then at the last instant detaches from the rail entirely, going airborne through the geode chamber. It clips the giant crystal as it passes — the crystal shatters in slow motion, releasing its trapped light in a blinding prismatic explosion that fills the cavern with rainbow fire. The pod rides the light-blast's shockwave upward through a vertical shaft and erupts from a mountainside into daylight. 

The camera spirals outward for one final epic reveal — the mountain exhaling a column of rainbow light into the sky.

0-4s: [Medium-wide broadcast shot] Swedish male athlete with long blonde hair and beard (viking-like) spinning rapidly in the hammer throw circle. Authentic Olympic uniform. Real-life physics and momentum.

4-7s: [Broadcast tracking shot] The athlete releases the giant hammer. The camera pans fast to follow the arc of the heavy metal ball flying through the air against the stadium sky. Realistic high-speed physics.

7-12s: [Wide stadium view] The hammer heads towards the lower stands at high speed. A grandmotherly woman in the front row reaches out and catches the giant hammer firmly with both hands. No slow motion, real-time broadcast speed.

12-15s: [Reaction shot] The surrounding crowd jumps up and applauds. The woman holds the hammer, looking at the camera. Authentic live TV cut to the crowd's genuine reaction.

entries.title: Action Thriller Leviathan Chase
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for an action sequence involving a character fleeing a water leviathan across a broken bridge, utilizing speed ramps and handheld camera movements.
entries.prompt:
Using the uploaded reference image as the subject:
(0–2.5s)
A frantic, vibrating handheld tracking shot follows her as she sprints across a shattered bridge, wearing a pink hoodie. The footage speed-ramps from fast-forward into ultra slow motion. Behind her, a colossal leviathan—formed from bioluminescent water and jagged ice scales—surges forward. The camera violently jerks downward as she dodges flying rebar and chunks of concrete.
(2.5–4s)
The camera whip-pans 180 degrees, briefly overshooting her face before snapping into sharp focus. She skids, black sneakers carving trenches into wet asphalt. Speed ramps back to real-time chaos. She squares her stance—glowing crimson energy blasts erupt from her palms. Raindrops vaporize around her fists.
(4–6s)
The water leviathan unleashes a spiraling hydro-cannon. In extreme slow motion, the crimson laser collides with the roaring torrent. The camera flinches sideways. A sizzling shockwave erupts—scalding steam and boiling water splatter across the frame. The bridge fractures under the recoil.
(6–8.5s)
Speed ramps into a brutal back-and-forth barrage. The camera shakes in hurricane-force winds. The leviathan lashes out with a water tendril—she ducks, but a glancing blow spins her, visible agony on her face. The camera nearly loses track. She recovers, igniting hard-light energy wings. Her hoodie sleeves char black.
(8.5–12s)
The camera pushes through dense fog. She tucks her wings and launches straight into the leviathan’s chest. Time locks into slow motion at impact. A concentrated crimson hyper-laser channels through her right fist, driving into the creature’s glowing core. A concussive sonic boom warps the air—the leviathan detonates.
(12–15s)
The camera scrambles from the ground, tilting. The shockwave has flattened the monsoon rain. Millions of glowing bioluminescent droplets fall like embers. She lands on a floating slab of concrete—knees buckle, then lock upright. Her chest heaves. The scorched pink hoodie smolders.

Hyper-real water physics, natural skin texture, elegant cloth motion, subtle film grain, breathtaking scale, physically believable magic, premium cinematic lighting, emotionally overwhelming.

Audio: begin with distant room tone, dripping water, and a faint inhale; precise splashes synced to each step; low orchestral swell building with the spin; crystal wing flutter overhead; final reverb dissolving into ocean silence.

entries.title: Surreal Musical Sculpture Animation

entries.prompt: A continuous dolly-in glides along a surreal wooden sound sculpture perched on a stone overlook above the sea, bathed in golden-hour light. The rhythm is musical and melodic, yet deeply grounded—like structured improvisation. Sunlight catches the edges of the sculpture’s curves, while a soft crowd gathers just out of focus. entries.title: Chef Spicy Food Prank POV
entries.description: A continuous first-person perspective video prompt depicting a chef's escalating reaction to a spicy prank in a realistic kitchen setting.

The scene retains practical lighting and sound without artificial effects, ending on the Chef's intense stare, the ambient kitchen sounds undisturbed, a master chef clearly pranked.

entries.title: Emotional Hospital Interaction
entries.description: A cinematic prompt capturing a subtle emotional shift in a patient looking at a doctor, using lighting and bokeh to represent internal feelings.
entries.prompt: A calm, modern hospital room. A patient is lying on a bed while a professional, kind doctor stands beside him, gently checking his pulse and speaking softly. As the doctor leans slightly closer to examine the patient, the patient looks at the doctor and becomes emotionally captivated. His facial expression gradually shifts from weak and tired to calm, slightly smiling, and lost in admiration. To visually show his feelings (without unrealistic exaggeration), the background subtly transforms: the hospital environment softly blurs, and a warm, dreamy glow appears around the doctor. Light particles and soft-focus bokeh gently emerge, symbolizing the patient drifting into his thoughts. The patient is no longer focused on his illness instead, he is quietly staring at the doctor, completely absorbed in the moment. His breathing becomes calm, and his expression shows peace and affection. The doctor remains professional and unaware, continuing the check-up naturally. Final seconds: The camera continues its smooth motion as the dreamy overlay slightly fades, leaving a subtle emotional contrast a patient who has momentarily forgotten his pain, lost in thought. Important Direction (to avoid mistakes): The patient remains lying on the bed (not standing or moving unrealistically); The doctor behaves professionally (no exaggerated or inappropriate actions); The emotional effect is shown through lighting, focus, and atmosphere not unrealistic physical actions; No reversed roles or unnatural expressions; Keep the tone soft, respectful, and cinematic (not comedic or exaggerated)

entries.title: Orbital Ring Structural Failure
entries.description: A sci-fi action prompt depicting the catastrophic collapse of a giant space ring around an alien planet with intense camera work.
entries.prompt:
Gigantic orbital ring around an alien planet, structural failure propagating at high velocity, entire sections tearing apart while traffic is still moving across it.
Wide shot: the ring mid-rotation, a fracture suddenly racing along its surface faster than expected.
Hard tracking: camera locked to the crack as it splits structural layers, tearing through habitats and transit lines.
Close pass: maintenance ships accelerating along the ring, barely outrunning the collapsing structure behind them.
Near-failure: a ship misjudges speed, the surface drops away beneath it, forced to boost last-second to avoid being pulled into open space.
Chain reaction: rotating segments begin desyncing, colliding edges grinding and breaking apart.
Interior shot: corridor violently shifting, gravity flickering, people and debris slamming into walls as atmosphere vents.
Exterior whip: a massive section snaps free, rotating unpredictably, narrowly missing a fleeing ship.
Precision escape: pilot threads through a collapsing lattice of beams and cables, gaps closing in real time.
Shockwave: structural failure releases energy, pushing debris outward, ships struggling to maintain trajectory.
Final moment: a huge arc of the ring tears loose, drifting away, still populated with lights flickering across its surface.
Relentless structural collapse, no pauses, constant repositioning, cascading failures, grounded physics, massive scale with intimate danger.

entries.title: Ballet Dancer vs Boxer Cinematic Fight
entries.description: An elaborate cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 depicting an anime-style battle between a ballet dancer and a boxer in a boxing ring, complete with camera movements and lighting effects.
entries.prompt:
Japanese anime style with the exhilarating feel of a competitive fighting game. Set in a boxing ring, 15 seconds, 30fps, no subtitles. High-contrast cinematic lighting, volumetric light, atmospheric particles and smoke, with a strong audience presence. The overall pacing is clean and sharp, with decisive and powerful camera movement, no dragging. High dynamic range with realistic physical feedback.
[Entrance 0–5s]
Low-angle fast tracking shot with a steady push-in. A tall blonde, blue-eyed ballet dancer descends dramatically from above in a “Black Swan” form—more flamboyant and oppressive in presence. As she spins and lands, her movement carries clear aggression; the impact is heavier, sharper, with precise yet tension-filled body control. Feathers scatter through the air like black blades.
Lighting shifts to a cold, high-contrast tone, with sharp highlights outlining her silhouette, creating a dangerous atmosphere. The crowd erupts in cheers mixed with gasps.
Cut—
A towering  boxer stands at the center of the ring (red shorts, red gloves, beast-style mouthguard), radiating pressure. Like a gorilla, he pounds his chest, laughing arrogantly with disdain and provocation.
[Fight 5–15s]
Extreme close-up of the boxing bell as it rings sharply. Hard cut back to the ring.
The boxer throws a heavy punch—the Black Swan dodges with an extreme backbend, then immediately unleashes a counterattack:
A rapid upward high kick, followed by consecutive spinning kicks and slicing leg techniques. Her movements are sharper, more aggressive, with accelerated pacing and continuous, relentless attacks. Her motion is both elegant and feral.
The boxer is completely overwhelmed, forced into a defensive state, retreating step by step as his movements grow disordered.
Final move—after a high-speed spin, the Black Swan delivers a powerful horizontal whip kick (with strong kinetic force and air-tearing impact), launching the boxer high into the air before crashing heavily to the ground.
K.O.
The crowd erupts in thunderous cheers. The Black Swan slowly settles her stance, standing at the center of the spotlight. She gracefully bows like a noble black swan.

entries.title: Immersive High-Speed Office Melee
entries.description: A comprehensive action sequence prompt for a 15-second brutal fight scene in an office setting, utilizing character references and dynamic camera work.
entries.prompt:
15-second, no-dialogue, fully immersive high-speed brutal fight short film.

Two characters @ image1 and @ image2 . 
Live-action realistic style. Close-quarters, high-speed chaotic melee combat with no rules, fully out-of-control brawling. No flashy choreography—pure raw. Continuous exchange of punches, kicks, blocks, body checks, throws, and grappling entanglements. Ultra-realistic impact. Exaggerated yet physically grounded motion speed. Entire sequence in 120 FPS with no slow motion. Rapid dashes, evasions, and high-speed limb swings. Extreme motion blur and speed trails amplify intensity while preserving realistic weight and physics.

Master-level cinematic camera movement:

A professional film camera stays tightly locked to the action, flying dynamically with the fighters—high-speed dives, sudden stops, whip pans, and full 360° orbital tracking. The camera moves in sync with punches, kicks, and evasions, with responsive shake and displacement. One continuous take, no cuts. Sharp push-pull tracking, sudden directional shifts, fully integrated into the fight for a face-to-face immersive combat perspective. Smooth, zero-latency motion.

Master-level precision editing:

0–3 seconds: ultra-fast cuts to enter combat.

3–10 seconds: seamless action continuity with zero stutter or breaks.

10–15 seconds: dense, violent rapid-cut climax.

Editing rhythm escalates with combat intensity. Fast intercutting enhances chaos. Precise beat timing, no redundant shots. Constant suffocating high-speed pacing.

Environment Setting

Modern open-plan office with desks, computers, cabinets, printers, and swivel chairs; realistic layout with cool overhead lighting and side backlight for strong contrast. Slightly cramped space for added tension; no glass-breaking.

Environmental Interaction & Constraints:

Combat affects the space only through natural, physically justified collisions—papers scatter from air movement (not attacks), chairs slide or topple on impact, desks shift slightly without deliberate damage, and screens remain intact with minor vibration. No unnecessary or intentional destruction of equipment.

Body-driven combat: grappling, pinning, counter-throws, and realistic slams with subtle impact cracks/vibrations. Natural airflow—light paper/dust movement only, no exaggeration.

Final Action Design

Final 2–3s: both throw simultaneous close-range punches, freezing inches before impact—fully tensed, heavy breathing, locked in perfect deadlock.

entries.title: Complex Action Sequence with Transformations
entries.description: A highly detailed multi-phase video prompt for Seedance 2.0 that orchestrates character introductions, special effects, and cosmic transitions.
entries.prompt:
## Phase C (0.20s): 灯籠起動・爆発・全景提示

(0.07s) 瞬時カットで暗転へ。固定カメラ。人型シルエットのみ見える暗転（必殺技発動前の静寂）。画面中央に花形紋章（5弁、赤+灰色、幅40%）が出現し、中心から黄金色の爆発光が8方向に放射。紋章下部から縦の黄金エネルギービームが下方に伸びる。エネルギーが上方に拡散し始める。

(0.13s) 固定カメラ（煽りローアングル）。灯籠型オブジェクトの全体像が画面中央に表示（縦長六角形の提灯型、赤い本体に白い5弁花紋章、石造り台座付き）。背後から赤い光柱が天空へ伸びる。黄色・ターコイズの星パーティクルが浮遊。画面下部30%にピンク〜マゼンタの雲。3フレームで約2%の微ズームイン。

---

## Phase D (0.17s): ティルトダウン・キャラクター顕現

(0.17s) ティルトダウン（約60–80px/fの下方向パン）。5フレームで灯籠の上部アングルからキャラクター顔のミディアムクローズアップまで移動。灯籠が画面上方に退くにつれ、その下に隠れていた3人ユニットが順次画面に現れる（腰部→上半身→顔の順に顕現）。灯籠の赤い発光が上方に退いていく。霧エフェクトがキャラクター腰付近に漂う。ズーム変化なし（純粋なティルトダウン）。

---

## Phase E (0.73s): 3人ユニット紹介・溜め演出

(0.27s) 固定煽りローアングル。緩やかなズームイン（1–2px/f）。冷色主体（紺色ベース）。3人が正面を向いた紹介ポーズ。各キャラが腕・手・首などを小さく動かし（手を上げる・傾ける等のポーズ変化）、画面下部の金色盾型台座が徐々に画面外へ退く。

(0.20s) ズームイン継続。紺+紫混合へ色調遷移。台座縁に沿って黄色い電撃エフェクトが蛇行（3→6本に増加）。3人の表情が徐々に戦闘的に変化（目を見開く・唇の端が上がる）。

(0.26s) 紫→オレンジ→赤へ急速な色調遷移（「溜め→臨界」の視覚化）。3人の顔がフレームの70%を占めるクローズアップ. 中央キャラが叫ぶような表情に、左右キャラが攻撃準備ポーズへ。色調がほぼ赤/オレンジに転換完了し、次カットの瞬時カットに備える。

---

## Phase F (0.44s): 降下攻撃・着地インパクト

(0.24s) 瞬時カットで遠景に切り替わり。超高速ズームイン（8フレームで約10倍の拡大）。キャラクターが黄金色のエネルギーリング（2–3重の同心円）に包まれた状態で画面中央上部に小さく見える。放射状の赤いスピードラインが画面全体に走る。光球が急速に接近。灯籠底面が縦方向モーションブラーと共に画面の60%を覆い、黄金色の炎が底部から噴出開始（幅300px→500pxへ拡大）。灯籠底面の花紋章が画面幅80%の超接写に。着地直前、巨大な炎が画面下部40%を埋め、虹色レンズフレアが出現。

(0.20s) 着地インパクト。固定カメラ（衝撃による5–10pxの微振動）。黄金色の炎が画面下部50%を占め、虹色レンズフレアと色収差（RGB分離）が発生。炎が70%に拡大。90%以上のホワイトアウト（黄金色系ウォームホワイト、1フレーム持続）。炎柱（幅200→150px）が画面中央を縦貫し、背景が紫〜藍色へ転換し始める。

---

## Phase G (0.56s): 光柱上昇・雲海突破・宇宙到達

(0.16s) ティルトアップ＋微ズームアウト。画面中央を縦貫する光柱（幅100→60px）が細くなりながら上昇し、両側に虹色ストライプが出現。画面下部30–40%にピンク〜マゼンタの雲海が広がる。光柱が虹色のトレイル（弧状の軌跡、レインボーグラデーション、下方が太く上方が細い）に変化。画面全体が紫にフェードし、場面転換のトランジション。

(0.10s) 固定カメラ。紫フェードが解消し、暗紫色の宇宙的空間が安定。画面下部にピンク〜マゼンタの雲海（立体的なボリューメトリック表現）。虹色トレイルが明確に出現し、先端に白〜黄色の光球（直径40px）を伴いながら下部中央から上方へ弧状に伸びる。

(0.30s) ティルトアップ＋微ズームアウト。虹色トレイルの先端光球が画面上部へ上昇（雲海→宇宙）。光球から短い放射光条（30px）が四方に出現。光十字（クロスフレア）の形成開始（水平100px・垂直80px）。光十字が完全形成。最大サイズ（水平300px・垂直200px）に到達し、中心に純白の光核（略楕円形）。黄金色の星パーティクルが周囲に4–5個浮遊。

---

## Phase H (0.50s): 宇宙飛翔・惑星衝突

(0.27s) 瞬時カットで宇宙空間のワイドショットへ. 固定カメラ。暗紫〜紺色の宇宙空間に恒星が10–15個散在。画面左下に赤い巨大惑星（大気のリム光あり）、画面右下に青い小惑星。画面中央やや左に太陽状の大フレア（赤い水平光条が左右500px）。フレアが縮小。彗星形状（白〜黄色の光核＋オレンジ〜赤の炎尾）が赤い惑星方向へ加速移動（炎尾100px→200pxへ伸長、移動速度30–60px/f）。

(0.23s) 微ズームイン。光核の中にキャラクターの人型シルエットが確認可能（高さ30px）。彗星が赤い惑星の大気圏に接近。ターコイズ色の六角形フレーム内にチェックマークUIが出現（グリッチ風色収差エフェクト付き）。惑星リム光に接触し、接触点からオレンジ色のフレアが放射状（6–8本）に広がり始める。

entries.title: Coastal City Evolution 10,000-Year Timelapse
entries.description: An ambitious timelapse video prompt depicting a coastal city's evolution through human history and into a sci-fi future in a single continuous forward dolly shot.
entries.prompt: [CINEMATIC SETUP]  Film Style: Photorealistic 8K, 65mm IMAX. One continuous forward dolly — no cuts. The camera glides steadily forward at chest height, as if walking through time, while the coastal landscape and city evolve dramatically around it over 10,000 years.  Lens: 24mm wide-angle, shallow horizon line with subtle sea mist and horizon glow.  Color Grade: Soft dawn blues to warm earth tones to fiery sunset oranges to cool neon cyans to sterile white-silver, each era bleeding smoothly into the next.  Lighting: Natural daylight shifting to torchlight, gaslight, electric grids, holographic glow, and finally starlight — the illumination evolves with human progress.  Camera: Constant slow forward dolly movement. No lateral pans, no tilts. Seamless transitions through shared elements: shoreline becomes harbor becomes docks becomes launch platforms.  [TIMELINE — CONTINUOUS FORWARD DOLLY]  0-2s: PREHISTORIC SETTLEMENT. Glide forward along a wild rocky coastline at dawn. Simple thatched huts and stone circles assemble from scattered boulders and driftwood. Small fishing boats carve from logs on the beach. Early humans tend fires as smoke rises; shellfish mounds grow beside the path.  2-4s: ANCIENT PORT. The shoreline hardens into wooden piers. Mud huts transform into whitewashed stone buildings with red-tiled roofs. A bustling ancient harbor forms with wooden sailing ships docking. Marble columns rise on both sides. Olive groves and vineyards bloom rapidly along the advancing path.  4-6s: MEDIEVAL TRADE CITY. Stone walls and wooden structures give way to fortified castles and Gothic cathedrals. Cobblestone streets lay themselves underfoot. Markets assemble with colorful tents and horse-drawn carts. A grand harbor expands with larger galleons; cranes hoist cargo as the camera passes through sea spray and lantern light.  6-8s: INDUSTRIAL HARBOR. Cobblestones become paved roads. Brick factories and iron bridges replace medieval spires. Steamships and early railways emerge along the waterfront. Smokestacks rise, billowing dark plumes that fade into the next era. Warehouses and cranes multiply on both sides.  8-10s: MODERN METROPOLIS. Industrial grit transforms into sleek concrete and steel. Skyscrapers shoot upward in glass and chrome. Multi-lane highways and suspension bridges span the harbor. Cars and trains streak by with motion blur. Neon signs and digital billboards ignite sequentially as the city pulses with energy.  10-13s: NEAR-FUTURE MEGACITY. Glass towers evolve into towering arcologies with vertical gardens and glowing energy shields. Flying vehicles and maglev pods weave overhead. Holographic advertisements float in the air. The harbor fills with autonomous ships and floating platforms. Bioluminescent lights and drone swarms illuminate the scene.  13-15s: SPACE COLONY LAUNCH. The dense cityscape parts to reveal vast launch complexes on reclaimed land. Massive orbital elevators and starships stand ready.

entries.title: Photorealistic Sandworm Hunt Short Film
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-stage cinematic prompt for a desert chase sequence between a sail-skiff and a massive sandworm.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic short film, photorealistic VFX. 15-second desert hunt at high noon. Blinding light, zero shade, heat shimmer on everything.

[0–2s] Overhead drone — red desert canyon system. Sandstone towers, wind-carved arches, dry riverbeds. One figure: a woman on a sand-skiff — a flat wooden board with a triangular sail, gliding across compacted sand on bone runners. She wears wrapped linen armor, copper goggles, a weighted net coiled at her waist. She watches the sand.

[2–4s] ECU the sand surface — it's BREATHING. Rippling outward from a point 200 yards ahead. The sand rises like a slow dome. The sail-woman cuts the skiff hard right. The dome ERUPTS — a sandworm. 40 feet, segmented, chitinous plates the color of rust. Its mouth is a vertical iris lined with grinding teeth like a rock crusher. Sand cascades off its body. It roars — the sound is DEEP, below human hearing, but you feel it shake the frame.

[4–7s] Chase through the canyon — the skiff banks between sandstone pillars. The worm follows UNDERGROUND — you see its path as a moving ridge of sand, smashing through the earth, pillars cracking as it passes beneath their foundations. She throws the weighted net — it wraps around a sandstone tower, rope trailing to her skiff.

[7–10s] The worm surfaces directly in the skiff's path. She leans the board, catches wind, and the skiff JUMPS — airborne over the worm's back. In mid-air she drives a barbed stake into the top of its head plate. Lands the skiff on the other side. Rope connects stake to the sandstone tower.

[10–13s] The worm charges away — the rope goes taut against the tower. The tower HOLDS. The worm's momentum whiplashes it sideways. It crashes into a canyon wall. Sandstone debris cascades. Dust cloud erupts like a bomb. Silence inside the cloud.

[13–15s] Dust settles. The worm lies against the canyon wall, breathing but pinned. She brings the skiff alongside, pulls her goggles up. Beneath the goggles — calm, focused eyes. She draws a curved knife and begins cutting a single iridescent scale from the worm's flank — the harvest. That's all she came for. One scale. The worm hisses but doesn't fight. She pats its flank once, takes the scale, pushes off. The skiff catches wind. She vanishes between the sandstone towers. Cut to black. Ultra-realistic.

In a flash of ethereal light, the swarm materializes a stunning woman wearing an elegant deep-blue evening gown embroidered with shimmering butterflies. Interior, messy bedroom. A white tiger in loose pajamas slurps instant noodles at a cluttered desk, eyes glued to a glowing monitor.

SFX: THUD

Close-up: Old gray cat staring at the screen. His expression shifts from shock to defeated sigh.

End Frame
Frozen frame on “3 followers” with dramatic soap-opera zoom-in and echo effect

entries.title: Minimalist Bauhaus Motion Graphics Evolution

entries.prompt: 【核心视觉】：纯黑背景，自发光纯白线条，无剪辑一镜到底。 【运动轨迹】： 1. [原点]：中心白点脉动，涟漪消散。 2. [线条]：横向拉伸至边缘。 3. [几何]：线条演变为 9x9 网格，随后弯曲汇聚成正圆。 4. [3D 转换]：圆环拉伸成经纬线球体，由线框填充为实心，自带微弱高光。 5. [UI 演变]：球体展开成圆角矩形手机界面，展示极简 UI 元素。 6. [解构]：界面塌缩为等距魔方，随后六面像花瓣般绽放。 7. [粒子]：花瓣化作数百粒子，呈数学轨迹旋涡运动。 8. [重组]：粒子吸附组合成方形腕表轮廓。 9. [终章]：腕表化为流体丝带压缩回白点，猛烈脉动后最终展开为品牌 Logo。 【风格】：包豪斯极简主义，奢侈科技感，数学级精准，15秒连贯进化。

entries.prompt: 角色设定（绑定参考图） image1 （角色主体） 一位冷峻而危险的女性战士图片1，苍白肤色，黑色编织长发，身穿高反光黑色生物机械装甲图片2，结构复杂、带有外露骨骼与金属脊柱，披着带星空纹理的暗色披风，手持巨大黑色长剑，气质优雅而压迫。图片3（装备形态） 由图片2的装甲展开形成的高科技战斗形态：黑色液态机械覆盖全身，形成强化装甲结构，伴随橙红色能量流动（类似血管或熔岩纹路），背部可展开机械翼，头部形成全覆盖战斗头盔，冷光护目镜。图片4（巨型敌人） 一只庞大的有机机械巨兽，苍白外壳与复杂机械结构融合，身体由多条巨型肢体构成，内部流动着发红光的“血管”能量网络，整体既像生物又像战争机器，压迫感极强。 场景与环境（统一风格） 一座雾气弥漫的反乌托邦城市： 巨型灰色混凝土建筑密集排列，天空被厚重污染云层遮蔽，空气中漂浮灰尘与工业烟雾，远处隐约闪烁故障霓虹与红色警示灯，整体压抑、冷峻、无生命感。 🎬 分镜提示词（强化节奏版） 镜头1：中景跟拍（建立压迫氛围） @image1 快速穿行在废弃工业区中，黑色披风在身后拖曳如流体。 手持镜头侧面跟拍，轻微抖动增强真实感。 呼吸急促，脚步沉重有节奏。 远处传来低沉机械共振声。 镜头2：广角低机位跟拍（目标出现） 镜头拉低，从背后跟拍 @image1 冲向远方。 迷雾中逐渐显现图片4的巨大轮廓。 怪物轮廓若隐若现，红色内部能量脉动。 风声呼啸，伴随低频咆哮。 镜头3：装甲展开（变身起点） 特写：@image1 背部装甲裂开。 黑色液态机械开始流动重组，形成图片3的机械结构。 橙红能量在装甲缝隙中流动。 慢动作 + 金属咔嗒声 + 能量嗡鸣。 镜头4：头盔闭合（压迫感提升） 正面特写：机械组件分段覆盖 @image1 面部。 形成完整战斗头盔（图片3形态）。 伴随沉重金属锁定声。 镜头5：极近特写（启动瞬间） 护目镜亮起——强烈橙红光。 HUD界面微弱闪烁。 电子启动音刺入。 镜头6：全景（尺度对比） 超广角：图片3站在城市边缘高处。图片4在远处缓慢移动，占据画面主体。 人物极小，怪物巨大。 配乐开始推进，低频增强。 镜头7：冲锋（节奏爆发）图片3猛然冲出悬崖。 机械翼展开，喷射推进。 镜头高速跟拍飞行轨迹。 空气撕裂声 + 引擎轰鸣。 镜头8：撞击（高潮瞬间）图片3与图片4正面撞击。 金属与生物组织同时爆裂。 红色能量与橙色火花混合爆发。 冲击波扩散，画面震动。

entries.title: Bullet time selfie video template
entries.description: A comprehensive prompt template for creating 15-second bullet-time videos where a character takes a selfie during a slow-motion peak event.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 15s / ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT / BULLET TIME SELFIE

PARAMS:
<CHARACTER>: define subject, outfit, state
<ENVIRONMENT>: define location, time, atmosphere
<UNEXPECTED_EVENT>: define threat / accident / impact
<OUTCOME_ACTION>: define reaction (attack / dodge / collision / escape)
<FINAL_STATE>: define ending state

RULE:
Freeze the world, keep only <CHARACTER> in real-time motion.
Delay character action inside slow motion (~2s hold before selfie).
Selfie must clearly include both <CHARACTER> and the <UNEXPECTED_EVENT> in the same frame.

STRUCTURE:

0.0–3.0s — SETUP
<CHARACTER> in <ENVIRONMENT>, normal flow.
<UNEXPECTED_EVENT> begins and escalates rapidly.

3.0–10.0s — PEAK (SLOW MOTION)

3.0–5.0s
Time slows almost to a freeze at the critical moment.
<CHARACTER> holds position, tension builds.

5.0–10.0s
[cam: close, slight orbit / bullet time]
[sfx: ambience stretch, single phone snap]

<CHARACTER> pulls out phone → takes selfie capturing the moment → puts it back.

10.0–13.0s — OUTCOME ACTION
Time snaps back instantly.

<OUTCOME_ACTION> plays out.

13.0–15.0s — END
<FINAL_STATE>.

entries.title: Sorceress Sigil Battle
entries.description: A highly detailed 12-shot action sequence prompt featuring a white-haired sorceress battling a shadow entity with magic sigils.
entries.prompt: Shot 1 (00: 00–00:01) – MS, Dolly in + Whip Pan A white-haired sorceress stands in an ancient archive filled with hanging talismans and bells, painting a sigil. Dark mist erupts from the ground—she reacts instantly, dodging and countering with a sweeping brush strike. VFX: Distorted, pulsing shadow mist. SFX: Paper rustle, soft bells, low hum. Shot 2 (00: 01–00:02) – CU, Fast Push-in Her eyes glow. With a flick of her wrist, she draws sharp blue sigil strokes mid-air, forming blade-like trails. VFX: Intersecting cold-blue energy lines. SFX: Sharp air cuts, energy charge. Shot 3 (00: 02–00:03) – WS, Crane Up Talismans swirl violently. Layered circular sigils form beneath her feet. A shadow entity emerges but is blocked by the rotating barrier. VFX: Multi-layer rotating sigil rings, vortex of talismans. SFX: Deep resonance, swirling wind. Shot 4 (00: 03–00:04) – MFS, Orbit Tracking Scene shifts to a fractured sky. She steps on floating sigils; her brush extends into a glowing chain of runes that lashes toward the entity. VFX: Flickering rune-chain light. SFX: Air tearing, chain clinks. Shot 5 (00: 04–00:06) – LS, Chase Cam Amid storm clouds and a broken moon, she rides the rune chain through the air, pursuing the fleeing shadow. VFX: Rolling clouds, blue-white trails vs black mist. SFX: Roaring wind, distant thunder. Shot 6 (00: 06–00:07) – CU, Slide She taps nodes along the chain, activating hidden purple sigils that pulse with new energy. VFX: Sequential purple node illumination, pulse flow. SFX: Light clicks, energy hum. Shot 7 (00: 07–00:08) – MCU, Static She closes in and strikes the entity’s forehead. A burst of light—its body distorts, a complex seal appears on its chest. VFX: Purple-blue flash, rotating seal. SFX: Sharp burst, distorted screech. Shot 8 (00: 08–00:09) – WS, Dive Shot Both streak downward like meteors, piercing clouds toward an ancient stone altar. VFX: Comet-like light trails. SFX: Air screech, compression. Shot 9 (00: 09–00:10) – WS, Impact Static They crash. Dust erupts. She slams her hand down—radiating sigils crack across the ground. VFX: Glowing fractures spreading outward. SFX: Heavy impact, stone cracking. Shot 10 (00: 10–00:12) – LS, Pull Back A massive 3D sigil array rises, forming layered barriers that trap the entity at the center. She stands calmly outside. VFX: Expanding geometric barriers, drifting particles. SFX: Low steady resonance. Shot 11 (00: 12–00:13) – CU, Static She forms a hand seal and whispers: “Seal.” VFX: Light particles contract. SFX: Soft chant, energy tightening. Shot 12 (00: 13–00:15) – CU, Fade Out Eyes closed, she meditates as all light fades, leaving faint residual glow in silence. VFX: Light dissipates into darkness. SFX: Gentle wind, fading echo.

entries.title: Cinematic Volcanic Dragon Rescue
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 featuring a fantasy rescue sequence with complex camera movements and timing instructions.
entries.prompt: Ultra-cinematic fantasy action sequence in a volcanic kingdom at bright midday, with blazing sunlight cutting through ash, smoke, and heat shimmer. Start instantly with an epic ultra-wide shot of a black-stone fortress collapsing over a river of lava as a wingless knight sprints across a crumbling chain bridge while a young dragon tumbles from a broken tower. The camera rushes low and fast through sparks, falling stone, whipping chains, and bursts of flame, with dramatic scale and sharp visibility. At 7 seconds, enter slow motion as the knight leaps from the final archway, cape snapping violently, diving through fire and molten debris toward the falling dragon. At 10 seconds, snap back to full speed as the knight grabs the dragon’s neck harness, both slam onto a descending cargo lift, and crash safely into a lava tunnel as the fortress collapses behind them. End with the lift dropping into shadow while fire erupts above.

entries.title: 90s Japanese TV Drama Scene
entries.description: A comprehensive narrative prompt for Seedance 2.0 that generates a nostalgic 90s TV style multi-cut scene of an awkward family dinner.
entries.prompt: 1990年代の日本のテレビドラマ風。彼女の隣には彼氏が座っている。父親の隣には母親が座っている。4人のセリフはすべて日本語で話される。気まずさを演出するマルチカットの15秒のシーン。典型的な日本の狭いダイニングルーム、手作りの料理でいっぱいの食卓。4人の登場人物が、ぎゅうぎゅう詰めの食卓を囲んでいる。彼氏はこわばった様子で座り、父親は腕を組んで彼を鋭く睨みつけている。張り詰めた沈黙を破るように、娘は嬉しそうに微笑み、彼氏の方を指さして紹介する（「紹介します、彼氏です」娘の声）。母親は優しく微笑み、父親の肩をそっと叩いて落ち着かせようとする（「あなた、顔が怖いですよ」と母親の声）。温かい雰囲気に包まれ、父親はうつむき、長いため息をつくと、肩の力を抜き、ゆっくりと箸を手に取って食べ始める（「……まあ、食べなさい」と父親の声）。
entries.translated_prompt: 1990s Japanese TV drama style. A boyfriend is sitting next to his girlfriend. A mother is sitting next to the father. All dialogue for the four characters is in Japanese. A 15-second multi-cut scene depicting awkwardness. A typical cramped Japanese dining room, with a table full of homemade food. Four characters surround the crowded table. The boyfriend sits looking stiff, while the father sits with his arms crossed, glaring sharply at him. Breaking the tense silence, the daughter smiles happily and points to the boyfriend to introduce him ('I'd like to introduce you, this is my boyfriend,' daughter's voice). The mother smiles gently and softly pats the father's shoulder to try and calm him down ('Dear, your face looks scary,' mother's voice). Wrapped in a warm atmosphere, the father looks down, lets out a long sigh, relaxes his shoulders, and slowly picks up his chopsticks to begin eating ('...Well, eat up,' father's voice).

entries.title: Dynamic Multi-Style Dance Flicker
entries.description: A comprehensive video generation prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a 15-second hip-hop dance featuring rapid changes in clothing and visual art styles (flicker effect) while maintaining character consistency.
entries.prompt:
Each frame can change clothing and visual style independently. Do not maintain outfit or style continuity.

Ultra-realistic cinematic video, 15s, 24fps.

A female dancer performs hip-hop choreography, including a smooth moonwalk.
Her body movement must remain smooth, natural, and continuous throughout.

CAMERA:
Dynamic handheld energy camera swings, slight shake, crash zoom in/out, fast push-ins, and orbits around the dancer, following her movement rhythm.

CORE ACTION:
She dances confidently, centered in frame, full-body visible, strong rhythm and expressive movement.

CHAOS TRANSFORMATION (VERY HIGH SPEED):
Clothing AND visual style change extremely fast (near every frame flicker).

CLOTHING:
Every frame = new trendy outfit (no repetition, no blending):
- modern streetwear
- layered urban outfits
- edgy fashion looks
- contemporary performance wear

STYLE TRANSFORMATION (identity preserved):
Rapidly shift between unique visual styles:

- realistic human rendering
- anime-style rendering
- minimal continuous line art
- watercolor wash illustration
- inked comic style (bold outlines, graphic shading)
- soft pastel illustration
- textured digital painting
- rough sketch drawing style
- marker illustration style
- paper cut-out collage style
- clay-like sculpted look
- low-poly geometric 3D
- neon outline silhouette style
- glitch-outline graphic style (clean, non-distorting)
- storybook illustration style
- hand-painted brush style
- chalkboard drawing style
- airbrush gradient illustration
- silhouette shadow art style

STYLE BLENDING BURSTS:
Occasionally combine 2–3 styles in a single frame (e.g., line art + watercolor, comic + low-poly, sketch + digital paint) for brief visual bursts.

CRITICAL:
Her facial features, proportions, and identity must remain consistent across all styles.
Only rendering style and clothing change NOT the person.

SYNC:
Style and outfit changes align tightly with dance rhythm and camera motion.

VISUAL FEEL:
Hyper-fast flicker, energetic but clean and readable. No distortion or warping of body.

LIGHTING:
Dynamic studio lighting adapting to style changes.

CONSTRAINTS:
- body motion must remain perfectly continuous
- no pose resets
- no face distortion or identity change
- only clothing and visual style change rapidly
- no text, no logos

entries.title: Epic Ink-Wash Fantasy Warrior Scene
entries.description: A comprehensive cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a female warrior on a cliff top above a giant turtle carrying an ancient city. Includes detailed character design, lighting, and a 15-second camera timeline.
entries.prompt: 主体角色： 一位年轻女性战士，黑色长发编成多股辫，发丝在风中飞扬如墨色旗帜。面容冷峻苍白，眉目深邃，嘴唇微抿，目光如刃。身穿通体暗黑色金属铠甲，铠甲表面流动着微弱的星辰光点，如同将银河碎片锻入钢铁之中。左肩披垂一面星空斗篷，深蓝与漆黑交织，其上散落无数细密的金色光尘。双手握持一柄与身等高的黑铁巨剑，剑身宽阔厚重，剑柄末端雕饰繁复的哥特式花纹，剑刃隐隐流转暗紫色的光弧。 环境场景： 东方水墨洪荒世界。一只亘古神龟缓缓从苍茫大海中升起，龟壳之上层叠着一座完整的东方巨型古城——飞檐斗拱的殿宇、密布的阁楼廊桥、倾斜的宝塔与层层叠叠的瓦屋依山势蔓延至龟背最高处。神龟四足如石柱般插入海中，足间瀑布般倾泻海水。海面弥漫着浓重的雾气，天空被铅灰色云层压得极低，偶有闪电在云缝中无声游走。神龟背上古城的最高处是一面断崖绝壁，崖顶孤立于云雾之上，崖面垂直而下，石壁上嵌满被海风侵蚀千年的古老石刻。 色彩与光线： 整体水墨青灰色调，深蓝与靛青的海面，雾白色的大气透视，铠甲上的星辰光点提供微弱的暖金色散光。闪电为冷白色，瞬间照亮时将角色剪影投射在云幕上。崖顶最后一刻，乌云裂开一线天光，苍白的日光如神谕般垂直倾泻在角色身上。 风格： 实拍电影质感，连续物理运镜，自然的镜头惯性与呼吸感，真实大气透视，水墨意境与暗黑奇幻交融，无CG痕迹，画面带有胶片颗粒与微妙的镜头畸变。 时间线： 0:00–0:03 镜头从海面以下开始，水下一片幽暗的深蓝。巨大的神龟腿部如远古石柱般矗立在浑浊的海水中，镜头沿着龟腿表面缓慢上升，苔藓、藤壶和被海水浸泡千年的石刻纹路从镜头前掠过。海水中悬浮着细小的光尘颗粒。镜头穿破海面的一瞬间，水珠附着在镜头上缓缓滑落，世界从沉默的深蓝骤然切换为风声呼啸的灰白雾海。 0:03–0:06 镜头继续向上攀升，随惯性略微摇晃。神龟背上的古城逐渐显露全貌——底层是倾颓的渔村废墟与生锈的铁链吊桥，中层是密集错落的屋舍与狭窄的石阶巷道，火光从某些窗口中隐约透出。一条巨蟒般的锁链从城中高塔垂挂而下，链环上刻满梵文般的封印符号，在风中发出低沉的金属呻吟。镜头穿过两座倾斜的塔楼之间的缝隙，碎石与瓦片从上方坠落，擦着镜头边缘掠过。 0:06–0:09 镜头以弧线运动绕至古城侧面，一只苍灰色的巨鹰从雾中无声掠出，翼展遮蔽半个画面，气流扰动使镜头轻微震颤。镜头跟随巨鹰飞行轨迹向上偏转，揭示出断崖绝壁的全貌——垂直的石壁高耸入云，崖面上凿刻着巨大的古神浮雕，面容已被风化得模糊不清，唯有空洞的双眼仍然令人不安。崖壁上有一条极窄的石阶蜿蜒而上，女战士的身影出现在石阶中段，正在攀登。她的星空斗篷在风中猛烈翻卷，巨剑斜背在身后，剑尖拖出的暗紫色光弧在雾气中留下一道短暂的残影。 0:09–0:12 镜头切换至崖顶平台的边缘，以低角度仰拍。女战士的手掌先出现在崖沿，指尖的金属护甲扣入岩石裂缝，然后她整个人翻身跃上崖顶。落地的瞬间碎石四溅，她的黑发被气流扬起如墨色火焰。她单膝跪地喘息片刻，铠甲上的星辰光点此刻明灭不定，仿佛在与她的心跳同步。她缓缓站起，面朝悬崖边缘，身前是万丈虚空——远处海平面上，更多神龟的轮廓在雾中若隐若现，组成一支沉默的远古舰队。风从深渊中涌上来，撕扯着她的斗篷和发辫。 0:12–0:15 她向前迈出最后一步，双足站在崖顶最前端的碎石之上。她缓缓将巨剑从背后拔出，剑身与背甲摩擦发出刺耳的金属嘶鸣。她双手握住剑柄，将巨剑高高举过头顶。就在此刻，头顶铅灰色云层猛然撕裂，一道苍白刺目的天光如利刃般从云缝中直劈而下，精准地照在她和剑刃之上。巨剑上的暗紫色光弧在天光激发下骤然爆发，沿剑身蔓延出无数细密的电弧与星尘碎片，如同银河在剑刃上重新凝聚。她的剪影被投射在身后翻涌的云墙上，放大成一个巨大的暗影。远处海面上的神龟群同时发出低沉的共鸣，海水开始震荡，雾气被声波推开形成同心圆。镜头缓缓后拉，画面逐渐展开为全景——孤崖之巅，一人一剑，脚下是驮载着千年古城的洪荒巨兽，身后是苍茫无尽的雾海与沉默行进的神龟舰队，天光如柱，万物俯首。
entries.translated_prompt: Subject Character: A young female warrior with long black hair braided into multiple strands, her hair flying in the wind like ink-colored banners. Her face is cold and pale, eyes deep-set, lips pursed, and her gaze is as sharp as a blade. She wears all-black metallic armor with faint starlight flowing on its surface, as if galaxy shards were forged into steel. On her left shoulder, a starry cloak of deep blue and black is draped, scattered with countless fine golden dust particles. She holds a black iron greatsword as tall as herself; the blade is wide and heavy, the end of the hilt is decorated with intricate Gothic patterns, and the blade glows with a faint dark purple arc. Environment Scene: An Eastern ink-wash primordial world. An ancient divine turtle slowly rises from the vast sea, carrying a complete giant Eastern ancient city on its shell—palaces with flying eaves, dense attic corridors, leaning pagodas, and layered tile houses spreading to the highest point of the turtle's back. The turtle's four legs are like stone pillars inserted into the sea, with seawater pouring down like waterfalls between them. Thick fog fills the sea surface, and the sky is pressed low by lead-gray clouds, with occasional silent lightning dancing in the cloud gaps. At the highest point of the city on the turtle's back is a cliff edge standing alone above the clouds, with a vertical rock face covered in ancient carvings eroded by sea winds for millennia. Color and Light: Overall ink-wash blue-gray tones, deep blue and indigo sea surface, white misty atmospheric perspective. Starlight points on the armor provide weak warm golden scattered light. Lightning is cold white, casting the character's silhouette onto the cloud wall when it illuminates. At the final moment on the cliff top, a ray of light cracks through the dark clouds, pouring pale sunlight onto the character like an oracle. Style: Live-action film quality, continuous physical camera movement, natural lens inertia and breathing sensation, realistic atmospheric perspective, fusion of ink-wash aesthetic and dark fantasy, no CG traces, film grain, and subtle lens distortion. Timeline: 0:00–0:03 Camera starts below the sea, deep blue darkness. Giant turtle legs stand like ancient pillars in murky water. Camera rises along the turtle leg surface, passing moss, barnacles, and millennium-old stone carvings. Tiny light dust particles float in the water. As the camera breaks the surface, water droplets slide off the lens. The world shifts from silent deep blue to a whistling gray-white mist. 0:03–0:06 Camera continues climbing, swaying with inertia. The ancient city on the turtle's back is revealed—the bottom layer is ruins of a fishing village and rusted chain bridges; the middle layer has dense houses and narrow stone alleys, with fire flickering in some windows. A giant serpent-like chain hangs from a high tower, engraved with Sanskrit-like sealing symbols, moaning in the wind. Camera passes through a gap between two leaning towers as rubble falls. 0:06–0:09 Camera orbits to the side of the city. A pale gray giant eagle glides out of the fog, wings covering half the frame. Vibration from the airflow shakes the lens. Camera follows the eagle's flight upward, revealing the full cliff—the vertical rock wall reaches the clouds, carved with giant ancient god reliefs, faces weathered and blurry, only hollow eyes remaining. A narrow stone staircase winds up; the female warrior appears midway, climbing. Her starry cloak flaps violently, her greatsword slung on her back, its purple arc leaving a shadow in the fog. 0:09–0:12 Switch to the cliff edge, low angle. The warrior's hand appears first, metal gauntlets digging into rock cracks, then she flips onto the top. Rubble scatters upon landing. Her black hair rises like ink flames. She kneels briefly, panting, armor starlight pulsing with her heartbeat. She stands, facing the void—in the distance, more turtle silhouettes appear in the fog, forming a silent ancient fleet. Wind surges from the abyss, tearing at her cloak and braids. 0:12–0:15 She takes the final step to the edge. She draws the greatsword; metal screeches against the back plate. She raises it high with both hands. The lead-gray clouds tear open, and a pale blade of light pierces down precisely onto her and the sword. The dark purple arc on the blade explodes under the light, spreading sparks and stardust like a galaxy recongealing on the edge. Her silhouette is projected onto the billowing clouds behind her. The distant turtle fleet resonates with a low hum, the sea vibrates, and fog is pushed into concentric circles. Camera pulls back to a wide shot—atop the lonely cliff, a person with a sword, standing on a primordial beast carrying a millennium-old city, behind her a vast mist and the silent turtle fleet, light like a pillar, all things bowing.

entries.title: Retro Anime Apple Splitting Cat Dance
entries.description: A clever text-to-video prompt for Seedance 2.0 that creates a retro anime sequence. It features an apple splitting in half to reveal a dancing white cat supporting the top half, with detailed instructions on composition, transformation, and maintaining art style throughout the animation.
entries.prompt:
【日本のレトロアニメ】スタイル。
【りんご】がテーブルの上に置かれている。
背景は【薄緑】。カメラ固定。
柔らかいスタジオ照明。全フレームでアートスタイルを維持。

【りんご】がちょうど真ん中の高さ（上下50:50）で水平に分かれる。上半分と下半分は同じ高さ。上半分は【りんご】の上部の形を保ったまま持ち上がる。下半分は【りんご】の下部の形を保ったままテーブルの上に固定され動かない。上半分は1つだけ存在し、複製・分裂しない。

その隙間から【白猫】が現れ、下半分の上面の縁に両足で立つ。体は下半分の外側に出ており、【りんご】に埋まらない。両前足を上に伸ばして上半分の底面を支え、頭上に押し上げる。カットなし・テレポートなし・なめらかな変容。

登場後、【白猫】は両前足で上半分を頭上に支えたまま、足は下半分の縁から離れない。ジャンプしない。足を上げない。腰だけを左右にリズミカルに振り続ける。上半分は頭上で静止したまま揺れない。

構図は常にこの順番を維持：
［物・下半分・固定］―［キャラクターの体・外側に露出］―［物・上半分・頭上・1つだけ］

【白猫】は正面を向き、【笑顔】でダンスし続ける。静止しない。
【白猫】の見た目を全フレームで維持。

BGM：【日本のカントリー】
entries.translated_prompt:
[Japanese Retro Anime] style.
An [apple] is placed on a table.
Background is [light green]. Fixed camera.
Soft studio lighting. Maintain art style in all frames.

The [apple] splits horizontally at exactly the middle height (50:50 top/bottom). The top half and bottom half are equal in height. The top half rises while maintaining the shape of the top of the [apple]. The bottom half stays fixed on the table, maintaining the shape of the bottom of the [apple]. Only one top half exists, no duplication or splitting.

A [white cat] appears from the gap and stands on the edge of the top surface of the bottom half with both feet. Its body is outside the bottom half and not embedded in the [apple]. It extends both front paws upward to support the bottom of the top half and pushes it overhead. No cuts, no teleportation, smooth transformation.

After appearing, the [white cat] continues to support the top half overhead with both front paws, and its feet do not leave the edge of the bottom half. No jumping. No lifting legs. It continues to sway its hips rhythmically left and right. The top half remains still overhead without shaking.

The composition always maintains this order:
[Object/Bottom half/Fixed] — [Character body/Exposed outside] — [Object/Top half/Overhead/Only one]

The [white cat] faces forward and continues to dance with a [smile]. No stopping.
Maintain the look of the [white cat] in all frames.

entries.title: First-Person POV Hangzhou Dining Prank
entries.description: A detailed first-person perspective video prompt for Seedance 2.0 involving a character interaction and a humorous reaction to food at West Lake, Hangzhou.
entries.prompt:
realistic live-action, single continuous shot, full first-person POV, no cuts, no angle changes, no scene transitions, no montage, no flash cuts, no music, no subtitles. Only two characters: my unseen first-person POV and @ Image1 sitting across from me. Natural ambient sound only: light restaurant noise, tableware, distant water, faint voices, chewing, spitting, rinsing, my laughter.

Setting:
Outdoor dining table beside West Lake, Hangzhou, near the water, calm daylight or soft late afternoon light. Real smartphone-video realism, grounded textures, realistic food, realistic body and hand motion, accurate chopstick use, accurate mouth movement, accurate eye focus. The lake stays visible to one side of frame.

Character:
@ Image1 is the only visible person. She can switch seamlessly between slightly fierce-cute and soft adorable. Lip sync, voice, expressions, and body language stay fully synchronized. Emotional arc: cheerful and relaxed while eating, then shocked disgust, then angry embarrassment.

Table:
Exactly 7 dishes on the table. One dish is the West Lake vinegar fish shown in @ Image2. @ Image1 is happily eating rice and the other dishes, but not the fish at first. The table feels full but readable. The fish dish remains clearly visible before I offer it to her.

Camera:
Entire video is from my seated first-person view across the table. My hand and chopsticks may enter frame naturally. Slight handheld micro-shake from breathing and laughter only, never chaotic. No third-person shots, no reverse shots, no overhead shots, no cutaways. Continuous believable framing centered on @ Image1 with part of the lake visible.

Action:
@ Image1 sits opposite me, happily eating from her bowl, enjoying rice and other dishes except the West Lake vinegar fish. She looks bright, playful, relaxed, cute.

From first-person POV, I pick up one bite of the fish with chopsticks and slowly extend it toward her. She notices it immediately, trusts me, leans forward, opens her mouth happily, and makes a cute “aam” sound as she bites the fish. I gently pull the chopsticks and my hand back out of frame.

She chews happily for about one second, expecting it to taste good. Then the taste hits. Her expression changes instantly into exaggerated but believable disgust. Her face shifts into a comedic purple-disgust reaction while staying within realistic live-action style. She quickly turns toward the lake and spits it out with repeated “ptui, ptui, ptui” sounds. The motion is fast, fluid, and continuous from chewing to rejection.

The moment she starts spitting, I begin laughing in first-person POV and keep laughing through the whole reaction. My laughter sounds genuine, amused, and uncontrollable, coming from behind the camera. The camera shakes slightly from laughing.

After spitting, @ Image1 sticks out her tongue in disgust, immediately grabs the water on the table
