entries.title: Cinematic Post-Apocalyptic Survival Sequence
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-shot prompt designed for Seedance 2.0, structuring a cinematic sequence about a woman aiming a bow in a gritty post-apocalyptic setting. The prompt specifies cinematic setup, film stock, lighting, character description, audio style, and a second-by-second timeline detailing shot types (ECU, Macro Cut, OTS, POV, Wide Shot) and actions.
entries.prompt: "[CINEMATIC SETUP] Genre & Mood: Gritty Post-Apocalyptic Survival. Tense, visceral, and hyper-realistic. Film Stock & Lens: Shot on 35mm anamorphic lens, f/2.8 for shallow depth of field. Teal-orange desaturated color grade with earthy, dusty undertones. Lighting & Atmosphere: Dramatic volumetric Golden Hour light with heavy dust motes and heat haze. Character Description: An athletic woman in her late 20s, wearing weathered tactical leather armor and dirt-smudged skin. Her hair is wind-blown and messy; her expression is one of intense, lethal focus. Audio Style: Immersive spatial sound design. Detailed SFX of bowstring tension, rhythmic heavy breathing, wind howling through the canyon, and a high-velocity "thwack" on impact. [TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND] 0-3s: [Extreme Close-up (ECU)] High-angle shot of the woman's face as she aims a mechanical compound bow. The bowstring is pulled taut against her cheek. Movie-level realistic facial features, no deformation, stable throughout. 3-4s: [Macro Cut] Extreme close-up of her iris. The pupil dilates sharply as she locks onto her target. Realistic light reflections in the eye. 4-8s: [Over-the-shoulder (OTS) Shot] The camera sits behind her shoulder on a jagged cliff edge. In the valley below, a herd of mutated, post-apocalyptic Cape Buffalo with thickened grey hide and jagged horns graze peacefully. Smooth camera push-in. 8-10s: [The Release & POV] She releases the arrow. Fast Tracking POV shot following the arrowhead at maximum velocity. Intense motion blur on the passing rocky environment as the arrow slices the air. 10-15s: [Impact & Wide Shot] The arrow strikes the lead beast in the flank with realistic physics. The animal collapses heavily into the dust. The rest of the herd panics and scatters in a chaotic wide shot. Sound fade to the howl of the wind. [STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS] Photorealistic 8K, ultra-detailed textures (skin pores, rusted metal, animal fur), cinematic lighting, perfect motion blur, high dynamic range, no artifacts, coherent multi-subject motion."

entries.title: Cinematic Battle Prompt: Wolf vs. Rooster
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-sequence prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a comedic yet action-packed battle between a furious armored wolf and an unbothered rooster in a Pixar 3D animated style.
entries.prompt: Pixar 3D animated forest clearing. Sunny day, god rays through trees, green grass, flowers. CHARACTERS: - Giant armored wolf: black fur, gold sword, yellow eyes, furious and humiliated, attacks with full rage - Tiny rooster: red comb, completely unbothered, bored expression, deflects everything with casual wing flaps SEQUENCE: 0-3s — Wolf roars, raises sword overhead, brings it down with full force. Rooster glances up, sighs, flicks one wing — sword deflects sideways. Sparks fly. Wolf stumbles forward from own momentum. Rooster examines wing casually, unbothered. 3-6s — Wolf swings horizontal slash. Rooster ducks under it yawning, taps sword away with wingtip. Wolf spins, overhead strike — rooster hits ground, shockwave crater. Rooster hasn't changed expression once. 6-9s — Wolf goes berserk — rapid five-hit combo, sword blur. Rooster deflects each strike with alternating wings — tap, tap, tap, tap, tap. Casual rhythm like swatting flies. Last strike — rooster catches blade between two feathers. Stops it cold. Wolf strains, shaking. Can't move it. 9-12s — Rooster releases blade, wolf stumbles backward. Wolf charges with shoulder slam — rooster steps aside, wolf face plants into grass. Wolf up instantly, wild overhead — rooster flicks it away with tail feather. Sword spins out of wolf's grip, lands in tree trunk. 12-15s — Wolf stares at empty hands. Rooster turns, walks away slowly, doesn't look back. Scratches ground with one claw. Pecks at something in the grass. Wolf collapses face down defeated. Rooster glances back once. Looks away. Unbothered. CAMERA: Low angle on wolf attacks, extreme slow-mo on every deflection, close-up on rooster's bored face, wide on sword crater impacts, whip pan on rapid combo, wide defeat shot. SOUND: Massive sword whoosh, wing deflect light tap, sparks crackle, ground shatter, wolf frustrated growl escalating, rooster quiet cluck, sword clang on deflect, final thud of wolf collapse, peaceful bird ambience resumes.

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 prompt for a premium lifestyle commercial video
entries.description: A detailed, multi-section prompt for Seedance 2.0 designed to generate a 15-second premium lifestyle commercial video featuring a character mixing a cocktail, emphasizing high-quality mobile phone camera texture, cinematic realism, specific lighting, and precise shot composition and lip-syncing.
entries.prompt:
【风格】高级商业氛围短片（Premium Lifestyle Commercial），高清手机前置镜头质感（Vlog互动视角），电影写实色彩，面部柔光打光，注意分镜编排和对口型，单人出镜

【时长】15秒

【场景】卧室+调酒区一体空间，温馨台灯与紫黄霓虹氛围光交织，微醺暖调

【角色】完全参考@ 的人物外貌特征（顶级亚洲明艳神颜），穿深蓝蕾丝吊带裙、长卷发，全程形象高度一致

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：POV慵懒起床（POV → Medium Shot 丝滑转场）

主观视角（POV），镜头从第一人称俯视角度对准床上盖着毯子的双腿，手伸入画面掀开被子，双腿落地起身。镜头随起身动作自然抬起并快速切至中景——女主已站在床边面对镜头，慵懒又带一丝霸道地说："睡什么睡，起来喝酒。"（中文口型精准同步）

[00:03-00:06] 镜头2：优雅倒酒（Medium Shot）

中景，机位切至卧室调酒区，背景台灯暖光与紫黄霓虹光映在墙面。女主拿起白酒瓶，手腕微倾，透明酒液沿瓶口流入银色量酒器，随后将量酒器中的酒液倒入杯中并加入橙汁，液体混合的色彩层次清晰可见。

[00:06-00:09] 镜头3：挤柠檬特写（Close-up）

近景动作特写。女主双手各持半个切开的青柠，用力对挤，柠檬汁水真实地滴落进调酒壶，汁液飞溅的细节清晰，随后抓起一把冰块丢入壶中，冰块碰撞发出清脆声响。

[00:09-00:12] 镜头4：摇酒（Close-up / Shake）

近景。女主双手持调酒壶举至脸侧，有节奏地快速摇晃，长卷发随动作轻微摆动，壶内冰块撞击声清脆卡点。她保持迷人微笑注视镜头，眼神明亮带笑。

[00:12-00:15] 镜头5：品尝与收尾（Medium Shot）

中景。女主手持一杯蓝黄渐变的精致鸡尾酒，杯中气泡缓缓上升。她轻抿一口，眉眼舒展露出满意的微醺神情，随后对镜头开心挥手，定格。

entries.title: Cat Master Fairy Tale Thriller Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed, scene-by-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second cinematic dark fairy-tale thriller with a comedic twist, featuring two cat siblings (orange and white) encountering a wolf disguised as a grandma in a candy house. The prompt specifies lighting, camera movement (dynamic handheld, fast snap zooms), character actions, and the final comedic resolution.
entries.prompt:
Seedance 2 Prompt (15 seconds total, each shot ~0.6–1.2s)

Cinematic dark fairy-tale thriller with comedic twist, eerie enchanted forest, low-key lighting, cold moonlight filtering through dense trees, volumetric fog, high contrast shadows, dynamic handheld camera, expressive character animation, fast-paced storytelling.

S1 (0.9s)
Wide shot: An orange cat older brother in blue overalls and a gray flat cap runs barefoot through a dark forest, pulling along a white cat little sister in a dirty pink dress, both breathing heavily.

S2 (0.8s)
Rear tracking shot: The forest behind them echoes with distant howling wolves, shadows shifting between trees.

S3 (0.9s)
Forward reveal: Through the fog, a glowing candy house made of sweets appears at the end of the path, colorful and surreal against the dark woods.

S4 (0.7s)
Close-up: The siblings slow down, eyes wide—fear mixed with curiosity.

S5 (0.8s)
Door action: The orange cat cautiously pushes open the candy door, it creaks softly.

S6 (0.9s)
Interior wide: Inside, dim warm light reveals a strange room—giant half-open birdcage, scattered sweets, and a bed in the corner.

S7 (0.8s)
Close-up: On the bed lies a white-haired “grandma” in green pajamas and a white shower cap, blanket half covering her face.

S8 (0.9s)
Dialogue moment: The “grandma” weakly gestures toward the birdcage, implying there is cake nearby, voice soft and inviting.

S9 (0.8s)
Insert shot: A cake sits temptingly near the open birdcage door.

S10 (1.0s)
Action split: The little sister eagerly reaches for the cake, while the orange cat narrows his eyes, scanning the room.

S11 (0.9s)
Suspicion reveal: Close-up at the foot of the bed—a wolf tail sticks out from beneath the blanket.

S12 (1.0s)
Action burst: The orange cat instantly grabs a nearby large iron shovel, swings it with full force toward the “grandma’s” head.

S13 (1.0s)
Impact & reveal: The shower cap flies off—“grandma” leaps up in pain, revealing a ferocious wolf face, snarling before panicking.

S14 (1.0s)
Escape: The wolf stumbles and scrambles out the door, fleeing into the dark forest.

S15 (1.2s)
Final comedic beat: The orange cat scratches the back of his head proudly, while the little sister happily eats cake beside him, cheering with crumbs on her face.

Motion & Effects:
Dynamic chase camera, shaky handheld for tension, fast snap zooms during action, exaggerated character expressions, cloth and fur simulation, soft glow from candy elements, contrast between horror atmosphere and playful comedic timing.

entries.title: Espionage-Thriller Fight Scene Prompt with Image References
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-shot prompt for generating a high-intensity espionage-thriller fight sequence between two characters, Mei and Dex Rei, using Seedance 2.0. The prompt includes references to specific image files for character and environment design, along with complex camera work and motion descriptions.
entries.prompt:
Mei Tactical suit.png = Mei: East Asian woman, long straight black hair, black leather tactical suit with gold accent piping along collar, shoulders, and wrist cuffs, gold buckle utility belt, dual thigh holsters, black flat-heeled boots with gold chevron trim. 

Dex Rei Tactical suit.png = Dex Rei: East Asian woman, dark green twin ponytails with blunt-cut bangs, dark green leather tactical suit with black reinforced shoulder pads and knee panels, black utility belt with hip pouch, single thigh holster, black lace-up heeled combat boots, black tactical gloves. 

Hallway 2.PNG = Hallway environment reference. 

Style & Mood: Aggressive espionage-thriller intensity dialed higher. Fluorescent tubes flicker under impact vibrations, casting staccato light across polished epoxy floors. Desaturated teal-gray palette, motion blur on extremities during fast rotation, sharp focus snapping to point of contact on every strike. Sweat droplets flung from hair on spinning moves catch the overhead light. 

Dynamic Description: Handheld medium shot already in motion — Mei drives forward with a rapid three-punch combination, fists cutting the air. Dex Rei weaves back, parries the third strike wide, and fires a roundhouse kick that whips her green ponytails in a wide arc, boot connecting flush with Mei's raised guard. Smash cut to low-angle wide, static — Mei absorbs the impact, slides back half a step on the slick floor, then explodes forward with a spinning back kick, her black hair fanning outward as her heel drives toward Dex Rei's sternum. Cut to high-angle crane shot descending — Dex Rei catches the kick against crossed forearms, the force pushing her boots backward on polished floor, fluorescent reflections streaking beneath her. She redirects Mei's momentum, pivots, and launches a spinning jump kick — her entire body rotating airborne, green suit blurring, boot arcing toward Mei's head. Cut to ECU, static — Mei's hand snaps up, palm catching the incoming boot inches from her temple, fingers gripping leather. Whip-pan to medium handheld tracking — Mei shoves the caught leg away, immediately chains into a leaping roundhouse, her body torquing horizontal mid-air, gold wrist cuffs flashing under fluorescent light. The kick grazes Dex Rei's shoulder as she ducks. Cut to wide stabilized tracking from floor level — Dex Rei drops into a spinning leg sweep across the polished surface, one palm planted. Mei vaults over it, lands, and Dex Rei is already rising with a vertical spinning crescent kick that forces Mei to arch backward, the boot passing centimeters from her chin. Hard cut to medium close-up, handheld — both women snap back to fighting stance simultaneously, chests heaving, green ponytails and black hair still settling from the rotational force. A flicker of mutual acknowledgment passes between them — Dex Rei's smirk, Mei's narrowed eyes — before they surge forward again.

entries.title: Cinematic WWE Wrestling Match with Shocking Twist
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-section prompt for Seedance 2.0 designed to generate a high-quality, cinematic WWE-style wrestling match video, complete with specific camera setups, character descriptions, a second-by-second timeline, and a shocking plot twist involving the referee.
entries.prompt:
[CINEMATIC SETUP]

Style: Professional 4K TV Sports Broadcast footage, handheld ringside camera mixed with wide crane shots.

Lens/Aperture: 35mm broadcast lens, deep depth of field to keep the crowd in view.

Color Grade: High-contrast, saturated "Main Event" lighting with vibrant blues and reds.

Atmosphere: Volumetric haze, strobe light flashes from the crowd, realistic arena sweat and skin texture.

Audio: Immersive spatial sound, roaring stadium crowd, thudding ring canvas impacts, heavy metallic chair "clang" SFX.

[CHARACTERS]

Wrestler 1: Athletic, lean high-flyer in neon green trunks and wristbands.

Wrestler 2: Heavyweight powerhouse, tall with long wet hair, wearing black leather tights.

The Behemoth: A colossal, morbidly obese giant in a stretched leopard-print singlet.The Official: Standard referee in a black-and-white striped shirt and black slacks.

0-3s: [Medium Tracking Shot] Wrestler 1 sprints toward the ring ropes, bounces off the tensioned cables with realistic physics, and accelerates back toward the center.

3-6s: [Dynamic Low-Angle] Wrestler 2 stands his ground and executes a massive lariat clothesline; Wrestler 1 flips backward from the impact and hits the canvas hard with a visible ripple effect on the ring floor.

6-11s: [Wide Crane Shot] Both wrestlers lie dazed. A massive 500lb Behemoth climbs the turnbuckle. He pauses, then performs a giant splash, landing body-first onto both men. The ring frame shakes violently upon impact.

11-15s: [Tight Close-up] The referee suddenly grabs a cold-rolled steel chair. In a shocking heel-turn, he swings the chair overhead, smashing it against the Behemoth’s skull. Metallic impact sparks and "CLANG" spatial audio.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Photorealistic 8K, ultra-detailed skin textures and sweat, cinematic stadium lighting, perfect motion blur, high dynamic range, no artifacts, coherent multi-subject physics.

entries.title: Elemental Chaos Battle on a Coastal Battlefield
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.0 (used via Dreamina) describing a massive coastal battle between three colossal creatures: a sky dragon, a fire colossus, and an ocean leviathan. The prompt specifies the opening frame, simultaneous attacks, elemental chaos, environmental destruction, camera sweeps, color logic, and a final catastrophic collision.
entries.prompt:
A massive coastal battlefield where ocean, land, and sky collide. Three colossal creatures engage:
— a sky dragon with metallic scales and storm wings
— a fire colossus emerging from volcanic fissures
— a giant ocean leviathan rising from the sea
Opening frame: wide shot of coastline — ocean churning, volcano erupting, storm clouds gathering overhead.
Hook at second two: all three creatures attack simultaneously.
The battlefield fractures into elemental chaos:
— the dragon generates hurricane-force winds and lightning
— the fire colossus erupts lava and shockwaves
— the leviathan summons massive tidal surges
The city between them collapses under combined forces — water floods streets, fire ignites structures, wind tears apart buildings.
Camera sweeps between the three titans, snap zooming into collisions — fire meeting water in explosive steam clouds, lightning striking molten terrain.
Color logic: deep ocean blue, molten orange-red, storm gray and electric white.
Escalation builds as all three forces collide at the same point, destabilizing the entire coastline.
Final beat: hard POV shift — camera becomes the wave-fire-storm collision itself, rushing forward as all elements merge into a single catastrophic blast.
Massive environmental destruction, multi-element physics interaction, cinematic scale, 4K ultra-detail.

entries.prompt:
Use @Image1 as the character reference. Keep character design, hairstyle, ears, tail, outfit, and colors perfectly consistent.

【主体 / Subject】

A blue-haired fox girl with long flowing hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy tail.
She wears a shrine-maiden inspired outfit with loose sleeves and a short skirt.
She stands in a Japanese shrine setting with a red torii gate, autumn leaves falling around her.
Her expression is playful, energetic, slightly teasing.

【アクション / Action】

She performs an energetic, bouncy dance with frequent jumping motions.

Repeated light jumps in rhythm (ぴょんぴょん)
Knees bend deeply before each jump for natural motion
Hair, sleeves, and tail bounce dynamically with physics
Tail sways with exaggerated follow-through motion
Spins mid-jump once (360° quick spin)
Lands softly and immediately transitions into next jump
Arms swing wide, then pull inward for momentum
Ends with a high jump and playful pose on landing

👉 重要安定化指示

Clear leg bending and landing weight control
Natural gravity and smooth jump arcs
No body distortion during airtime
Tail follows delayed secondary motion

Landscape 16:9, 15 seconds
Start: full-body wide shot (全身見せてジャンプ確認)
Slight low-angle to emphasize jump height
Gentle tracking to follow vertical movement
Subtle handheld bounce synced with jumps
Mid-section zoom during spin jump
End: slight push-in as she lands final pose

High quality 2D anime animation
Smooth, high frame consistency
Bright autumn color palette (red, orange, gold leaves)
Soft sunlight filtering through trees
Motion emphasis on cloth physics and tail volume
Clean linework, slightly soft shading
Light bloom and depth of field

Upbeat, hyper-energetic J-pop / electro dance track (~170 BPM)

Bouncy bass and punchy kick drum
Bright synth melodies
Clap and snare accents on jumps
Cute but energetic female vocal (short phrases / chants)
Fox-like playful “hey!” or “yo!” vocal accents
Subtle ambient shrine atmosphere (wind + leaves)

entries.prompt: 风格】伪纪录片（Vlog Style），超写实主义，固定机位实拍感，自然光，悬疑喜剧色彩，手机竖屏拍摄质感 【时长】15秒 【场景】普通家庭客厅，白墙前，下午侧光从窗户打进来，地上有瑜伽垫，墙上能投出清晰人影 【角色】女主@图片1，穿着运动背心和瑜伽裤，扎着马尾，正在对着手机支架录跳舞视频 [00:00-00:05] 镜头1：日常铺垫（Normalcy / Fixed Camera） 画面：固定机位中景，手机自拍视角。 动作：女主对着镜头比了个心，然后开始跳一段简单的抖音热门舞蹈，动作略生疏，偶尔看地上的手机对动作。 关键细节：此时墙上的影子完全正常，动作同步。背景安静，只有蓝牙音箱放出的音乐声。 氛围：完全日常，没有任何异常暗示。 [00:05-00:11] 镜头2：BUG出现（The Glitch / Same Fixed Camera） 动作：女主重复同一段舞蹈，跳到中间一个转身动作时—— 高能时刻（核心爆点）：墙上的影子突然**没有跟着转身**，而是自顾自地切换成一套完全不同的高难度街舞动作（Breaking Power Move），影子在墙上做托马斯全旋，动作流畅丝滑。女主还没发现，继续跳自己的简单舞步，但影子已经完全脱离同步，在墙上疯狂solo。 导演备注：影子的舞蹈水平要明显碾压本体。两者的动作反差越大喜剧效果越强——本体在跳"爱你"手势舞，影子在做风车地板动作。 [00:11-00:15] 镜头3：喜剧回马枪（The Punchline / Same Fixed Camera） 动作：女主跳完回看手机录像回放，发现影子的异常，猛地扭头瞪向墙壁。 结果：影子此刻已经恢复正常——老老实实地复制着女主的每一个动作。女主狐疑地慢慢举起右手，影子也举起右手。女主快速换左手——影子也毫无破绽地跟上。 最终定格：女主一脸"我是不是疯了"的表情对着镜头，但就在画面即将结束的最后0.5秒，影子趁女主看向镜头的瞬间，偷偷比了个耶的手势。画面定格在这一帧。

Action: The female lead makes a heart gesture towards the camera, then starts dancing a simple popular Douyin dance, movements slightly unfamiliar, occasionally looking at the phone on the floor to check movements. Key Detail: The shadow on the wall is completely normal and synchronized. The background is quiet, only the music playing from the Bluetooth speaker. Atmosphere: Completely normal, no hint of abnormality. [00:05-00:11] Shot 2: The Glitch / Same Fixed Camera Action: The female lead repeats the same dance. When performing a turn in the middle— Climax Moment (Core Twist): The shadow on the wall suddenly **does not follow the turn**, but instead switches to a completely different, high-difficulty street dance routine (Breaking Power Move) on its own. The shadow performs a Thomas flare on the wall, movements smooth and fluid. The female lead hasn't noticed, continuing her simple dance steps, but the shadow has completely broken synchronization and is wildly soloing on the wall. Director's Note: The shadow's dancing skill must clearly surpass the body. The greater the contrast in their movements, the stronger the comedic effect—the body is doing the "I love you" hand gesture dance, while the shadow is doing a windmill floor move. [00:11-00:15] Shot 3: The Punchline / Same Fixed Camera Action: The female lead finishes dancing, reviews the phone recording playback, notices the shadow's anomaly, and sharply turns her head to glare at the wall. Result: The shadow has now returned to normal—faithfully copying every movement of the female lead. The female lead slowly raises her right hand suspiciously, and the shadow also raises its right hand. The female lead quickly switches to her left hand—the shadow follows flawlessly. Final Freeze: The female lead has a "Am I going crazy" expression towards the camera, but in the last 0.5 seconds before the frame ends, the shadow secretly makes a peace sign while the female lead is looking at the camera. The frame freezes on this moment.

entries.title: Mecha High-Speed Movement Cinematic Prompt (RAY-G)
entries.description: A detailed, multi-segment prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second video showcasing the high-speed movement of a giant mecha named RAY-G (Image 1). The style is minimalist, hardcore mecha, and high-frame-rate, focusing on 'instant burst power' and 'streamlined trajectory,' inspired by Gundam and Metal Gear. The prompt uses two reference images and specifies five distinct shots with detailed camera work and effects.
entries.prompt:
针对您提供的巨大机甲 <<<Image1>>>   (RAY-G)，我为您设计了一份时长 15秒、风格极其干练、时髦（Stylish）且充满重力无视感的高速移动视频脚本。

这份提示词融合了《机动战士高达：水星的魔女》的灵动感与《金属装备》的机械冷硬风，重点在于**“瞬间爆发力”与“流线型轨迹”**。

视频生成脚本：【RAY-G: 极速切点 (Point Break)】
总时长： 15秒

风格标签： 极简主义、硬核机甲、高帧率动作、流体动力学、赛璐璐高级感。

(00:00 - 03:00) 序幕：静止的动量 (Static Potential)
镜头： 极近景（Extreme Close-up），斜角构图。

画面： 画面中心是 <<<Image1>>>   漆黑磨砂装甲上的橙色线条。线条开始像血管一样有节奏地剧烈闪烁，发出高频的嗡鸣声。

特效： 空气因高温产生剧烈扭曲（Heat Haze），背景的海面保持极度的静谧，形成动静反差。

[Prompt / 提示词]:

极近景，斜角构图。聚焦于机甲 <<<Image1>>>   的黑色磨砂装甲。鲜艳的橙色线条像呼吸灯一样高频闪烁。装甲缝隙喷射出极细的白色高压蒸汽。环境背景模糊。极简主义色彩，电影级质感，金属冷硬风格。

(03:00 - 06:00) 瞬发：突破音障 (Instant Acceleration)
镜头： 侧面追踪镜头（Side Tracking Shot），伴随强烈的拉伸感（FOV Shift）。

动作： 机甲 @image2 的鸟脚状后肢猛地一踏，脚踝处的滑轮（Land Spinner）高速旋转。瞬间从静止变为超音速，海面被切开一道笔直的白浪。

特效： 产生圆锥形的音爆云（Sonic Boom），橙色残影在空中拉出一道锋利的直线。

[Prompt / 提示词]:

侧面动态追踪。机甲 @image2 瞬间爆发起跑。足部滑轮高速旋转，在海面上切开巨大的V形浪花。超音速冲击波云。极速运动模糊，机甲拉出长长的橙色轨迹残影。空间拉伸感，震撼的加速度视觉。

(06:00 - 10:00) 垂直机动：重力反转 (Vertical Evasion)
镜头： 动态环绕升降镜头（Crane & Orbit）。

动作： 机甲奔向一座半毁的沿海巨塔，完全不减速，直接顺着垂直的墙面向上冲刺。它在垂直墙面上进行了一个华丽的180度螺旋转身，避开假想的攻击。

特效： 碎裂的玻璃碎片在空中飞舞，折射出夕阳的橙光。

[Prompt / 提示词]:

动态环绕镜头。机甲 <<<Image1>>>   在垂直建筑物表面高速冲刺，无视重力。身体进行优雅的螺旋旋转（Barrel Roll）。碎片飞溅，反射夕阳橙光。高对比度阴影，赛璐璐动画风格，极具张力的动作设计。

(10:00 - 13:00) 高光：战术滑行 (Tactical Slide)
镜头： 极低角度（Low Angle）对准足部。

动作： 机甲从高处跃下，足部在海面上进行长距离的漂移滑行。身体压低至极限，呈现掠食者般的姿态。

特效： 巨量的水雾被激起，在阳光下形成彩虹。

[Prompt / 提示词]:

极低角度。机甲 <<<Image1>>>   在海面上低重心漂移滑行。巨大的白色浪花与水雾。掠食者姿态，机械关节细致运作。夕阳余晖，金属反光，色彩饱和度极高，极致的画面纯净感。

(13:00 - 15:00) 尾声：单眼凝视 (The Glare)
镜头： 正面近景，逐渐变焦。

动作： 机甲滑行停止，身体由于惯性轻微晃动。头部导向板打开，中心那颗发光的青绿色单眼（Monocular）猛地看向镜头。

特效： 画面最后瞬间闪过一个“LOCK ON”的橙色UI界面，随即切黑。

[Prompt / 提示词]:

正面近景。机甲 @image2 停止滑行，蒸汽散去。头部青绿色单眼亮起，锐利冷酷。屏幕中心出现橙色锁定UI。电影级运镜，画面骤然切黑。
entries.translated_prompt:
For the giant mecha <<<Image 1>>> (RAY-G) you provided, I have designed a 15-second video script for high-speed movement, featuring an extremely concise, stylish, and gravity-defying style.

This prompt combines the agility of "Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury" with the mechanical coldness of "Metal Gear," focusing on **"instant burst power" and "streamlined trajectory."**

Video Generation Script: [RAY-G: Point Break]
Total Duration: 15 seconds

Style Tags: Minimalism, hardcore mecha, high frame rate action, fluid dynamics, cel-shading high-end feel.

(00:00 - 03:00) Prologue: Static Potential
Camera: Extreme Close-up, diagonal composition.

Visuals: The center of the frame is the orange lines on the matte black armor of <<<Image 1>>>. The lines begin to flash intensely and rhythmically like blood vessels, emitting a high-frequency hum.

Effects: Air is severely distorted due to high temperature (Heat Haze), the background sea surface remains extremely still, creating a contrast between motion and stillness.

[Prompt / Keywords]:

Extreme close-up, diagonal composition. Focus on the matte black armor of the mecha <<<Image 1>>>. Vibrant orange lines flash at high frequency like breathing lights. Extremely fine white high-pressure steam sprays from the armor seams. Environmental background is blurred. Minimalist color scheme, cinematic texture, cold, hard metal style.

(03:00 - 06:00) Instant Acceleration: Breaking the Sound Barrier
Camera: Side Tracking Shot, accompanied by strong stretching (FOV Shift).

Action: The mecha @image 2's bird-like hind legs stomp down, the wheels (Land Spinner) on its ankles spinning at high speed. It instantly goes from stationary to supersonic speed, cutting a straight white wake across the sea surface.

Effects: A conical sonic boom cloud is generated, and an orange afterimage pulls a sharp straight line in the air.

[Prompt / Keywords]:

Side dynamic tracking. Mecha @image 2 instantly bursts into a run. Ankle wheels spin at high speed, cutting a huge V-shaped wake on the sea surface. Supersonic shockwave cloud. Extreme motion blur, the mecha pulls a long orange trajectory afterimage. Sense of spatial stretching, visually stunning acceleration.

(06:00 - 10:00) Vertical Maneuver: Gravity Reversal
Camera: Dynamic Crane & Orbit shot.

Action: The mecha rushes towards a half-destroyed coastal giant tower, without slowing down, directly sprinting up the vertical wall surface. It performs a spectacular 180-degree barrel roll on the vertical wall to evade an imaginary attack.

Effects: Shattered glass fragments fly in the air, refracting the orange light of the sunset.

[Prompt / Keywords]:

Dynamic orbiting camera. Mecha <<<Image 1>>> sprints at high speed on a vertical building surface, defying gravity. The body performs an elegant barrel roll. Fragments splash, reflecting the sunset orange light. High-contrast shadows, cel-shading animation style, highly dramatic action design.

(10:00 - 13:00) Highlight: Tactical Slide
Camera: Extreme Low Angle aimed at the feet.

Action: The mecha leaps from a high point, its feet performing a long-distance drift slide on the sea surface. The body is lowered to the extreme, presenting a predator-like posture.

Effects: A massive amount of water mist is kicked up, forming a rainbow in the sunlight.

[Prompt / Keywords]:

Extreme low angle. Mecha <<<Image 1>>> drifts with a low center of gravity on the sea surface. Huge white waves and water mist. Predator posture, detailed operation of mechanical joints. Sunset glow, metal reflection, extremely high color saturation, ultimate visual purity.

(13:00 - 15:00) Epilogue: The Glare
Camera: Front close-up, gradually zooming.

Action: The mecha stops sliding, its body slightly shaking due to inertia. The head visor opens, and the central glowing blue-green monocular eye suddenly looks at the camera.

Effects: A brief flash of an orange "LOCK ON" UI interface appears on the screen at the very end, then cuts to black.

[Prompt / Keywords]:

Front close-up. Mecha @image 2 stops sliding, steam dissipates. The head's blue-green monocular eye lights up, sharp and cold. An orange lock-on UI appears in the center of the screen. Cinematic camera work, the screen suddenly cuts to black.

entries.prompt: 【风格】夏日泳池派对（Summer Pool Party Montage），快切剪辑（Rapid Cuts），4K高清，高饱和明亮色调 【时长】15秒 【场景】阳光露天泳池派对，两层公寓楼背景，泳池边站满人群，黄色浮床漂浮水面 【角色】金发女子、红发女子、黑发女子，均穿彩色花纹比基尼 [00:00-00:01] 镜头1：冰块开场（Macro Close-up） 近景：不规则透明冰块置于玻璃杯中，表面湿润，内部裂纹清晰，红褐色焦外光斑（Bokeh）满布背景。 [00:01-00:02] 镜头2：派对全景（Wide Shot） 全景：两层公寓前泳池，阳台池边挤满人群，画面中心两道白色水花从蓝色泳池炸出，黄色浮床漂浮。 [00:02-00:03] 镜头3：湿发笑容（Close-up） 特写：金发女子面对镜头，脸上密布水珠，湿发贴脸，张嘴大笑。浅景深蓝色水光背景。 [00:04-00:05] 镜头4：浮床慵懒（Medium Shot） 中景：黑发女子躺黄色浮床上，戴白色大框墨镜，双手扶眼镜，闭眼仰头。腕上银表、粉黄手镯叠戴。 [00:05-00:06] 镜头5：湿发慢动作（Close-up, Slow-mo） 特写升格：红发女子双手缓缓将湿发往后推开，微低头，水珠从发丝甩出。 [00:07-00:08] 镜头6：派对律动（Medium Shot） 中景：两名女子池边起舞，右侧女子腰间系带比基尼，腕叠银镯，右手握啤酒瓶，身体随节奏摇晃。 [00:08-00:09] 镜头7：池边并肩（Medium Shot） 中景：两名女子背对镜头并肩站立，蓝白/红白花纹泳裤，腕间手镯随手势晃动，池畔树影人群虚化。 [00:09-00:10] 镜头8：手持DV记录（Medium Shot） 中景：金发女子湿发，戴银饰，右手举银色手持DV对准前方，眼神专注盯取景器。左侧另一女子背影入画。 [00:11-00:12] 镜头9：水下双人游（Underwater Wide） 水下全景：金发、红发女子面对镜头游来，气泡翻涌，光线折射，画面带自然浊度。 [00:12-00:13] 镜头10：水下特写（Underwater Close-up） 水下特写：两人面部上身，光线穿透水面，少量气泡漂浮，表情隐约可见。 [00:14-00:15] 镜头11：沙滩球收尾（Wide Shot） 全景：蓝白沙滩球飞过画面中心，前景女子挥臂抛球，泳池边人群欢呼，浮床点缀水面。

entries.title: Dystopian Surreal Cinematic Video Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed, multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating a dark, surreal, post-war dystopian film with specific camera movements, color grading, and symbolic imagery, such as a fragmented giant face and a woman carrying a house structure.
entries.prompt:
A dark, cinematic surreal film set in a post-war dystopian city, muted tones, cold color grading, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, dramatic lighting.

Scene 1:
A cracked empty street near a foggy shoreline. A woman in a long grey coat walks slowly toward the camera. Beside her floats a giant fragmented human face made of broken buildings and concrete, subtly shifting as if alive. Dust particles drift in the air.

Scene 2:
Cut to a tired child leaning against a broken wall indoors, eyes half-closed, exhausted. In the blurred background, another child sits silently. The atmosphere feels heavy, abandoned, and hopeless.

Scene 3:
A stern middle-aged man in a grey overcoat stands in a ruined European-style street beside an old rusty car. The camera slowly pushes in as he looks ahead with a hardened expression.

Scene 4:
Close-up of a woman’s face partially merged with mechanical and architectural fragments. Orange butterflies flutter around her head in slow motion, symbolizing fragile hope.

Scene 5:
A crowded street under a massive curved wall embedded with small structures and windows. People walk aimlessly, heads down, creating a sense of routine and oppression.

Scene 6:
A street musician with messy hair plays a guitar into a vintage microphone. Behind him stands a silent crowd. A rusted tram looms in the background. Light rain begins to fall.

Scene 7:
A line of children in worn vintage clothing stands still, staring directly into the camera. Their expressions are blank, almost haunting. Slow dolly movement forward.

Scene 8:
A surreal couple walks together. The woman carries a house-like structure on her head, with her face visible through a small window. The man beside her is partially covered in dark soot. They walk through rubble in silence.

Scene 9 (Final):
A woman sits in a cluttered room filled with old radios and clocks. A sign reading “MORE” hangs behind her. She slowly turns a knob on a vintage radio as static fills the air. Fade to black.
🎥 Style & Motion Keywords

cinematic, dystopian, surreal realism, slow motion, dramatic lighting, volumetric fog, depth of field, 35mm film look, desaturated tones, symbolic storytelling, melancholic mood, smooth camera movement

【起始帧 - 图1场景】：镜头从天空俯冲而下，掠过悬浮的巨大苍白月球，快速接近两尊耸立云端的巨型佛像立掌雕塑（高度超过百米），穿过佛像指缝间缭绕的薄雾与红色灯笼串。镜头急速下降，俯瞰脚下青绿色运河纵横的东方奇幻水上都城，密集的木质古建筑、吊脚楼、石桥、灯火通明的船坞在雾气中若隐若现。

entries.title: Comedic ADHD Cat Teacher Short Film
entries.description: A detailed, multi-section prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating a fast-paced, absurd comedic short film about a cat teacher dealing with a hyperactive student, ending with a heartwarming twist and specific camera/editing instructions.
entries.prompt:
Fast-paced comedic parody Seedance 2 short film set in an elementary school classroom. An orange cat teacher (wearing bright lipstick, an exaggerated pink wig, a pearl necklace, and a primary school teacher outfit) stands at the blackboard teaching. A black cat student (white shirt, dark blue shorts) displays constant hyperactive behavior at his desk: chatting with classmates, frequently leaving his seat, sneaking a peek at a blue cartoon cat comic hidden in his drawer, shaking his legs, staring out the window, rummaging through his backpack and spilling everything onto the floor. The orange cat teacher becomes increasingly overwhelmed as the classroom spirals into chaos.

Dialogue (rapid, overlapping):
Orange Cat Teacher: “Quiet! Back to your seat and focus!”
Black Cat Student: “Huh? Just give me a second!”
Other Classmates: “Teacher, he’s doing it again!”

The orange cat teacher, furious, calls: “Please come to the school immediately!” A white cat mother (in a red dress) appears and rushes the black cat student to a clinic. A handsome white tiger doctor (wearing black-framed glasses and a white coat) calmly says, “This is ADHD,” and hands over a glowing yellow capsule.

Cut back to classroom: The black cat student stands at the front, now focused and composed. The orange cat teacher, touched, praises him: “You’ve changed a lot!” Other cat students applaud enthusiastically: “So impressive!” The black cat student smiles shyly.

Camera & style: rapid cuts, whip pans, exaggerated motion blur, 0.6–1.2 second pacing; strong contrast from chaos to order, ending in a slow-motion freeze frame. Absurd, over-the-top comedic tone with a slightly heartwarming twist.

entries.title: Golden Nunchaku Action Sequence Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed, multi-shot prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating an action sequence focused on a glowing golden nunchaku, featuring rapid spinning, luminous trails, an overhead camera orbit, and a final dramatic explosion and character reveal.
entries.prompt: A glowing golden nunchaku spins rapidly in both hands, carving bright arcs against the dark background. Each swing leaves luminous gold trails that linger in the air. The nunchaku swings widen — golden arc trails stretch across the entire screen, overlapping and crisscrossing in every direction. It grows larger as it approaches — the golden glow overwhelms the screen — total whiteout. The nunchaku reappears spinning midair, trailing golden arc-shaped afterimages. Orange sparks scatter around it. Low angle — a gloved hand reaches up to catch the descending chain. The camera orbits from overhead, sweeping past the back of the head, golden rim light tracing the hair's silhouette, then swings around to the front revealing the face with a confident expression. The character poses with the nunchaku held at shoulder height. Behind them, an orange explosion ignites and rapidly expands — god rays pour from above. The blast overwhelms the frame into blinding white. The camera slowly pulls back as the explosion subsides. The fireball fades from white-hot to orange to dark smoke forming a mushroom cloud shape. The character stands still, weapon at side — diamond-shaped sparkles appear around them. Debris and embers drift through the air. New scene. Extreme close-up of the character's face — a soft, satisfied smile. Golden bokeh particles float in the dark background.

Seedance 2 Prompt (15 seconds total, each shot ~0.6–1.2s)

Cinematic dark whimsical drama, 18th-century Paris street at night, light snowfall, moody blue-gray tones, gas lamps glowing through fog, wet cobblestone reflections, stylized historical fantasy, subtle comedic undertone, dynamic camera movement, soft film grain.

S2 (0.8s)
Medium tracking shot: The rabbit shivers slightly, hands tucked in sleeves, քայլing slowly past elegant buildings and flickering street lamps.

S3 (0.9s)

S4 (0.7s)
Close-up: The basket sways gently, vibrant eggs contrasting against the dark, muted environment.

S5 (0.8s)
Sudden tension: A horse carriage bursts into frame, driven recklessly by a hyena dressed as a gray-clad servant, charging toward the cat lady.

S6 (0.7s)

S7 (0.8s)
Slow-motion: Dozens of Easter eggs fly into the air, spinning, scattering across the snowy street.

S8 (1.0s)
Action burst: The white rabbit instantly dashes forward with surprising agility, body stretching elastically.

S9 (1.0s)
Comedic sequence: He catches eggs rapidly using both hands, feet, and even his mouth, juggling multiple at once with exaggerated, goofy facial expressions.

S10 (0.8s)
Close-up: One egg nearly falls—he flips backward, catching it with his foot mid-air.

S11 (0.9s)
Final catch: He lands awkwardly but successfully, holding all eggs stacked precariously, cheeks puffed, eyes crossed comically.

S12 (0.8s)
Reaction shot: The orange cat lady watches, eyes wide, then smiles warmly, clearly impressed.

S13 (1.0s)

S14 (1.0s)
Emotional beat: The rabbit blushes slightly under his ragged hat, still trying to balance the eggs.

S15 (1.2s)

entries.title: 15-Second Microdrama: Alien Cat Twist
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-scene, 15-second microdrama prompt for Seedance 2.0, featuring a boy, a stray cat, a mother, and a shocking alien reveal, complete with specific scene descriptions, dialogue, sound design, and duration requirements.
entries.prompt:
Scene (0–5s):
A stormy suburban American street at night, rain pouring, streetlights flickering. Close-up of a 7-year-old blond boy (soaked, cheeks flushed) crouching down, gently picking up a shivering stray orange cat. The cat meows weakly, clinging to his chest. Smash cut — the front door bursts open as the boy rushes into a warm yet tense living room. His mother (wearing a home knit sweater, stern expression) stands at the staircase, her face darkening.
Dialogue 1 (Mom, furious and sharp):
Are you kidding me?! You brought a dirty stray into MY house?!

Scene (6–10s):
The boy clutches the cat tightly, eyes tearing up, trying to explain. The cat suddenly stops shaking, slowly lifting its head, pupils shrinking unnaturally. In an instant — the orange cat LEAPS straight onto the mother’s face.
Slow motion: claws latch onto her face, she lets out a suffocating scream, stumbling backward, knocking over furniture.
The boy rushes forward in panic, desperately pulling at the cat.
Dialogue 2 (Boy, breaking down):
Stop! Stop! Let her go!! PLEASE!!

Scene (11–15s):
Extreme close-up — the boy finally yanks the cat off.
Silence.
The mother’s “face” peels off completely, along with her blonde hair, sliding down.
Revealing — a green-skinned, large black-eyed alien face, wet and cold, staring directly forward.

The boy’s pupils shake violently. The “face” drops from his hands onto the floor.
The orange cat lands and slowly turns its head, eerily calm.
The alien tilts its head slightly, mouth stretching into an unnatural smile.
Dialogue 3 (Alien, low and eerie):
…You weren’t supposed to see that.

Sound Design:
Heavy rain and distant thunder at the start, door slam impact; mid-section tearing/claw impact, furniture crashing, suffocating screams; final section sudden silence → wet peeling sound → rising low-frequency horror tone, final line with subtle echo.

Duration:
Exactly 15 seconds (high-intensity American micro drama, dense shock beats, extreme twist payoff)

entries.title: Complex Action Sequence Video Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0, describing a dramatic sequence involving orbiting objects, talismans, a character reveal, energy transformations, and a final cosmic explosion, designed for a dynamic video output.
entries.prompt:
Dark navy background. A few small objects drift along a wide circular orbit — the rotation center sits in the upper right of the frame, the camera watches from the outer edge. A decorated box, a striped ball, and a couple of carnival items arc past one by one, curving leftward across the view. Sparse confetti strips and gold coins float through the air.

Three cream-colored rectangular talismans appear on the same orbital path, each bearing a different painted emblem. They approach one at a time, sweeping across the camera in a wide arc.

A glowing golden-framed card carrying a character illustration enters along the orbit. It drifts to center screen and the camera pushes in. The golden frame swells beyond the screen edges and vanishes — only the character remains. Gold sparkles and cross-shaped flares surround the reveal.

Red talismans orbit the character in irregular circular paths. Flame-colored ribbons weave through the hair. A fireball ignites near the outstretched hand, swelling until it fills nearly half the screen with white-hot light. The fireball contracts back toward the hands. Energy converts — flames dissolve into crackling purple arcs. The talismans transform into large glowing red rectangles covered in flame-crest patterns, fanning out in formation.

The character spins with the talismans fanning wider. Camera drives in — golden light ignites in both eyes, a held beat of charge. Pull back to full body. White-gold explosion erupts outward. The talismans launch toward the camera — one large talisman surges forward, dark surface swirling with magenta crests, growing until it covers the entire frame. Black.

New scene. No character visible. Red glowing rectangles streak across dark space in a wide circular arc, trailing fire. They converge on a single point at center screen. On impact, red flash fills the screen — hot pink wash expands, then fades.

Red-orange glowing core at the center with spiral energy arcs rotating around it. More red rectangles converge from all sides onto the central energy sphere. Everything compresses to a single bright point — total whiteout.

Fireball detonates outward with radial god rays. It expands to half the screen, then disperses. Red rectangle debris drifts through the flames. The color shifts — red bleeds to magenta, magenta to purple. In one frame, cold blue-purple replaces everything. New scene.

entries.prompt:
【开场镜头序列·总时长15秒·共7个切换镜头】
■ 镜头1（0:00–0:02）无人机超广角·宇宙殖民地全景
以超广角无人机镜头从宇宙殖民地外壳切入。巨大的环形殖民地内部徐徐展现——晨光穿透弧形透明穹顶，斜射进入殖民地内部的近未来都市。城市天际线在金色晨雾中若隐若现，悬浮建筑群与发光轨道交错排列。镜头以极慢速度向内推进，营造出宏大的史诗感开场。画面色调：冷蓝主调，金色晨光为点缀。
■ 镜头2（0:02–0:04）俯瞰垂直下降·高台上的女性全身
镜头从正上方俯视，捕捉站在高台边缘的女性全身。她身着白色与红色机甲战衣，肩部装甲宽大且具攻击性线条，裙摆由多层刀状装甲板构成。黑色长发在高处的风中轻轻飘动。镜头以缓慢的垂直下降（crane down）方式靠近，白色机甲在晨光下反射出耀眼的金属光泽，红色回路纹路隐约发出微弱的光芒。高台下方是深邃的未来城市峡谷，悬浮车辆如星点般穿梭。
■ 镜头3（0:04–0:06）极近地面·足部特写
镜头切换至极近地面的低角度仰拍，聚焦于她白色高跟机甲靴的靴尖，精准立于高台边缘。镜头缓缓向后拉开，露出靴身的红色发光线条纹路与小腿部位的白色装甲片。靴尖之下是无尽的城市深处，模糊的霓虹光与建筑轮廓形成强烈的高度感与紧张感。风声与城市低频嗡鸣作为音效层。
■ 镜头4（0:06–0:09）侧面横向追踪·腰部至肩部
镜头从她的腰侧开始，以流畅的横向追踪（tracking shot）缓缓向上移动。经过多层刀状装甲裙摆的细节——每片装甲边缘锋利、有光泽；沿着腰部向上，红色能量纹路在白色装甲上蜿蜒延伸；到达宽大的肩甲，顶端有棱角分明的突起结构。整个追踪过程背景为虚化的城市天际线，浅景深突出机甲质感。镜头运动速度配合慢拍电子节奏，流畅而充满张力。
■ 镜头5（0:09–0:11）手部极致特写·赛博机械手
切换至手部特写。她的一只手（赛博机械义手）搭放于高台金属栏杆之上。镜头极近，捕捉机械关节的精密结构——白色骨架、红色发光关节点、指尖处细微的传感器纹路。红色光点以脉冲节奏缓慢闪烁，仿佛心跳。栏杆下方城市的反射光在机械手表面形成流动的光影。音效：微弱的电流嗡鸣声与城市风声交叠。
■ 镜头6（0:11–0:13）侧颜极近特写·晨光轮廓光
镜头切换为极近侧颜特写。白色面具从侧面看，边缘线条流畅且具攻击性；黑色长发顺着肩甲垂落，在微风中轻柔摆动。晨光从画面右侧打来，精准地勾勒出面具边缘与发丝轮廓，形成金色的逆光轮廓（rim light）。面具侧面隐约可见一双眼睛的轮廓，凝视远方的城市。表情无法判读，充满神秘感与力量感。背景极度虚化为橙金色的晨光光晕。
■ 镜头7（0:13–0:15）无人机后退上升·都市全景收尾
镜头以无人机方式向后拉升，女性的轮廓在画面中央逐渐缩小——从全身到半身到剪影，最终成为殖民地城市天际线前的一个微小黑色剪影。晨光将整个画面渲染成金橙色调。镜头继续上升至殖民地内部全景，都市的宏大规模完整呈现，以此结束开场序列。整体结尾节奏放缓，为后续音乐高潮蓄力。
【全局视觉设定】
色调：冷蓝与金橙的强烈对比，机甲以白色为主色调，红色为能量强调色。
光线：晨光斜射、金属反射光、红色能量发光。
画质：8K电影级，超高细节，景深层次丰富，胶片颗粒质感。
氛围：史诗、神秘、力量感、孤独的未来主义。
entries.translated_prompt:
【Opening Shot Sequence · Total Duration 15 seconds · 7 Switching Shots】
■ Shot 1 (0:00–0:02) Drone Ultra-Wide · Cosmic Colony Panorama
Enters from the exterior shell of the space colony with an ultra-wide drone shot. The interior of the massive ring-shaped colony slowly unfolds—morning light penetrates the curved transparent dome, obliquely shining into the near-future city inside the colony. The city skyline is faintly visible in the golden morning mist, with floating building clusters and glowing tracks interwoven. The camera slowly pushes inward, creating a grand, epic opening. Color tone: Cold blue main tone, accented by golden morning light.
■ Shot 2 (0:02–0:04) Overhead Vertical Descent · Full Body of Female on High Platform
The camera looks down from directly above, capturing the full body of a female standing on the edge of a high platform. She is wearing white and red mech armor, with broad, aggressive shoulder armor lines, and a skirt composed of multiple layers of blade-like armor plates. Black long hair gently flutters in the high-altitude wind. The camera slowly approaches with a vertical crane down, the white mech reflects dazzling metallic luster in the morning light, and red circuit patterns faintly emit a weak glow. Below the platform is a deep future city canyon, with floating vehicles traversing like scattered stars.
■ Shot 3 (0:04–0:06) Extreme Close-up to Ground · Foot Detail
The camera switches to a low-angle shot extremely close to the ground, focusing on the tip of her white high-heeled mech boot, precisely positioned on the edge of the platform. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the red glowing lines on the boot body and the white armor plates on the calf area. Below the boot tip is the endless depth of the city, with blurred neon lights and building outlines forming a strong sense of height and tension. Wind noise and city low-frequency humming serve as the sound layer.
■ Shot 4 (0:06–0:09) Side Horizontal Tracking · Waist to Shoulder
The camera starts from her waist side, slowly moving upward with a smooth horizontal tracking shot. It passes over the details of the multi-layered blade-like armor skirt—each armor edge is sharp and glossy; moving up the waist, red energy patterns snake across the white armor; reaching the broad shoulder armor, with angular protruding structures at the top. The background during the tracking process is a blurred city skyline, with shallow depth of field highlighting the mech texture. The camera movement speed matches a slow electronic rhythm, smooth and full of tension.
■ Shot 5 (0:09–0:11) Extreme Hand Close-up · Cybernetic Mechanical Hand
Switches to a hand close-up. One of her hands (a cybernetic mechanical prosthetic) rests on the metal railing of the high platform. The camera is extremely close, capturing the precise structure of the mechanical joints—white framework, red glowing joint points, and subtle sensor lines at the fingertips. Red light dots slowly pulse in rhythm, like a heartbeat. The reflected light of the city below the railing forms flowing light and shadow on the mechanical hand surface. Sound effects: faint electrical humming mixed with city wind noise.
■ Shot 6 (0:11–0:13) Extreme Side Profile Close-up · Morning Light Rim Light
The camera switches to an extreme side profile close-up. The white mask, viewed from the side, has smooth and aggressive edge lines; black long hair hangs down along the shoulder armor, gently swaying in the breeze. Morning light comes from the right side of the frame, precisely outlining the edges of the mask and the hair strands, forming a golden rim light. The outline of a pair of eyes is vaguely visible on the side of the mask, gazing at the distant city. The expression is unreadable, full of mystery and power. The background is extremely blurred into an orange-golden morning light halo.
■ Shot 7 (0:13–0:15) Drone Backward Ascent · City Panorama Conclusion
The camera pulls back and ascends in a drone fashion, the silhouette of the female gradually shrinking in the center of the frame—from full body to half body to silhouette, finally becoming a tiny black silhouette against the colony city skyline. The morning light renders the entire scene in a golden-orange tone. The camera continues to ascend to the full panorama of the colony interior, the massive scale of the metropolis fully presented, concluding the opening sequence. The overall ending rhythm slows down, building anticipation for the subsequent music climax.
【Global Visual Settings】
Color Tone: Strong contrast between cold blue and golden orange, mech primarily white, red as energy accent color.
Lighting: Oblique morning light, metallic reflections, red energy glow.
Image Quality: 8K cinematic, ultra-high detail, rich depth of field, film grain texture.
Atmosphere: Epic, mysterious, powerful, lonely futurism.

entries.title: Ice Giant vs. Magma Titan Battle (Dreamina/Seedance 2)
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a 15-second action sequence featuring a battle between an ice giant and a magma titan in a frozen glacial valley. It specifies the environment, action choreography, velocity ramp effects, camera movement (low tracking shot, upward crane), and cinematic style constraints (8K, photorealistic, ray-traced reflections). Note: This prompt is explicitly tagged for Seedance 2, even though the tweet mentions Dreamina.
entries.prompt:
**Environment:**

A frozen glacial valley under pale arctic twilight. Deep cobalt shadows across the ice field with cold blue ambient light reflecting from massive glacier walls. Snow particles drifting through the air. Frozen lake surfaces acting as natural mirrors for diegetic reflections.

**Action:**

15.0s sequence. A towering figure composed of crystalline ice and refracting light engages a magma-armored titan whose body glows through volcanic fissures beneath black stone plating. They clash in rapid close-range combat across the frozen lake. Each strike fractures the ice beneath them, sending radial cracks spreading outward. The magma titan’s punches melt sections of the glacier while the ice giant counters with explosive frost bursts that instantly freeze the molten rock.

Velocity Ramp choreography: rapid exchanges freeze into ultra-slow motion when fists collide, showing ice crystals shattering and lava droplets vaporizing before snapping back to full speed as both titans slide across the ice surface.

**Camera:**

Low tracking shot sliding across the frozen lake surface, reflections capturing both combatants. A sudden upward crane move follows the moment the magma titan is thrown into a glacier wall, ice exploding outward.

**Style & Constraints:**

8K resolution, photorealistic volumetric snow, ray-traced reflections on ice surfaces, cinematic cold lighting, 35mm film grain, stable geometry, no flicker.

entries.title: Epic Multi-Shot Sequence of Sun Wukong on a Mythological Battlefield
entries.description: A detailed, multi-shot prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating an epic, cinematic sequence featuring Sun Wukong on a mythological battlefield, transitioning from a dark, desperate fight against skeletal warriors to a moment of divine intervention with the appearance of a towering Buddha and celestial army. The prompt specifies camera angles, lighting, color grading, and scene progression across eight distinct shots.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic hyper-dynamic fast-paced multi-shot sequence, epic mythological battlefield, IMAX film simulation, 35mm Panavision lens, f/4, heavy cinematic color grading, dramatic contrast between dark necrotic tones and radiant golden divine light.

Shot 1: Extreme close-up on Sun Wukong’s face, covered in dirt and blood, golden eyes flickering with exhaustion yet defiance. His fur is matted, his breathing heavy. He kneels in the center of a ruined battlefield, his golden staff cracked and planted into the ground for support. Around him, countless skeletal warriors slowly close in, their hollow eyes glowing with eerie green fire.

Shot 2: Rapid shaky handheld shot circling Wukong. The skeletal army tightens its formation, bones clattering, rusted weapons scraping. Wukong struggles to stand, gripping his staff, as the undead swarm prepares to strike from all directions.

Shot 3: Low-angle shot from behind Wukong. Just as the skeletons lunge forward, a faint golden glow begins to emerge behind him, cutting through the darkness like dawn breaking through a storm.

Shot 4: Sudden explosive bloom of radiant golden light. A towering Buddha manifestation appears behind Wukong, विशाल and serene, radiating infinite divine energy. The battlefield is instantly bathed in warm, overwhelming golden luminosity.

Shot 5: Fast upward tilt. Rows upon rows of celestial soldiers materialize in the sky and on the ground behind the Buddha—heavenly generals clad in ornate golden armor, divine banners flowing, weapons shining with sacred light.

Shot 6: Whip-pan across the battlefield. The skeletons freeze mid-attack, their bodies trembling under the pressure of the divine aura. Golden light surges outward like a tidal wave.

Shot 7: Ultra-fast sequence of disintegration shots. The skeletal army is instantly reduced to ash—bones crack, dissolve, and scatter into glowing dust, evaporating into nothingness under the overwhelming holy radiance.

Shot 8: Wide epic drone pull-back. Wukong stands silhouetted in front of the colossal golden Buddha and the vast heavenly army. The battlefield, once dark and corrupted, is now purified, glowing with divine light. Golden particles drift through the air like sacred snow.

Final frame: Freeze in epic tension—Wukong gripping his staff, head slightly bowed, while behind him the Buddha and celestial army radiate infinite power, dominating the horizon.

entries.title: Detailed Seedance 2.0 prompt for a skeleton girl playing piano in a miniature diorama
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-shot Seedance 2.0 prompt adapted from another creator's work, focusing on generating a whimsical, clay-animation style video. It specifies the subject (a stylish skeleton girl), the environment (a miniature diorama with glowing ghosts), the mood, and a precise three-shot timeline with specific camera movements, actions, and audio cues.
entries.prompt:
Subject:
Subject 1: A cute and stylish skeleton girl. She wears a navy sailor-style jacket, a pink pleated skirt, and a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a small skull. Her skeleton fingers are highly flexible, delicate, and expressive. For consistency in appearance and character, please refer to reference image.
Environment:
A high-quality 3D miniature diorama with a whimsical, clay-animation style. A small white grand piano sits on a stage with a stone-like texture. Surrounding her are several friendly, glowing white ghosts with simple black eyes, shaped like draped fabric. A dreamlike blue architectural space. Warm, fantastical light emanates from the ghosts and small lanterns. Toy-like texture.
Mood:
Eccentric, elegant, and cozy, yet somewhat eerie. The performance is not chaotic but deliberate, creating a magical and graceful impression.
Timeline:
[00:00-00:02] Shot 1: Wide-angle POV, slow push-in. A skeletal girl sits elegantly at the white grand piano on the stone stage. She raises her skeletal hands, slightly tucks her posture, and after snapping her head up to look straight ahead, begins to play the keys smoothly. Audio: A beautiful, elegant classical piano intro.
[00:02-00:03] Shot 2: Hard cut to a medium shot. Stable movement via gimbal. She is in complete control of the melody. Her skeletal fingers press the keys with clear, legible movements in a flowing cycle, gliding smoothly across the surface. Friendly, glowing white ghosts sway and bounce gently in time with the music’s rhythm. Audio: A fast-paced, rhythmic classical piano melody syncs perfectly with her finger movements.
[00:03-00:07] Shot 3: Close-up, tracking slightly. Focus on her face and the piano keys. She concludes her performance with a dramatic finale and removes her hands from the keys as the ghosts begin to glow more brightly in the warm lighting. She turns toward the camera and nods gently. Audio: The final, elegant piano chord resonates, followed by a soft, magical chorus.

entries.title: Feral Werewolf Transformation Cinematic Sequence
entries.description: An extensive, highly detailed prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a cinematic sequence of a feral werewolf transformation. It specifies camera simulation (IMAX, film grain, halation), dual-tone lighting (cold lunar blue vs. feral burning orange), scene description, character action, and the agonizing, asymmetrical nature of the mutation, requiring an uploaded face reference for identity preservation.
entries.prompt:
Camera Simulation
Shot on 65mm IMAX film with a vintage anamorphic lens. Noticeable film grain, subtle gate weave, and soft halation on highlights. Occasional lens breathing subtly warps the image as the body mutates.

Lighting Style
A dead, fog-covered wasteland under a massive dim moon.
Moonlight is unnaturally cold, casting blue-gray tones across the entire scene.
As the transformation begins, a deep amber-gold light burns from inside his body, clashing with the cold lunar light.

Dual-tone lighting:
Outside: cold lunar blue
Inside: feral burning orange

Scene Description
A man (use the uploaded face as reference, preserve exact facial identity and features) stands alone in a misty, desolate landscape. The camera moves in a handheld, slow circular orbit around him. Wind howls softly through the fog.

He looks up at the moon—his expression tired, resisting something within. His breathing becomes heavier. His fingers twitch unnaturally.

His body suddenly begins to break—his spine jerks, bones shift visibly beneath the skin in a disturbing, organic motion. A low growl escapes his throat, not fully human. Veins darken, then pulse with a dim amber glow from within.

His fingernails crack and extend into rough, uneven claws.

The transformation intensifies violently. His jaw stretches forward painfully, not snapping instantly but distorting in a slow, agonizing motion. Teeth push through his gums. Thick fur erupts unevenly across his body—messy, dirty, mixed with sweat and blood.

His posture collapses forward into a half-beast stance. The camera shakes more aggressively, reacting to the energy and movement.

He is caught in a disturbing hybrid state—not fully human, not fully beast:
One arm fully wolf-like, the other still human but breaking apart.
His face is asymmetrical—one eye human, the other glowing with feral light.

Nearby metal debris subtly vibrates—not magnetically, but reacting to a primal energy frequency emanating from him. His chest glows faintly, as if something inside is trying to break out.

Then—final snap.

His body fully transforms into a towering werewolf:
Massive, muscular frame
Wet, matted fur
Heavy breath steaming in the cold air
Eyes reflecting cold moonlight mixed with inner fire

His silhouette stands against the moon.

Silence.

He slowly lowers his head—not in rage, but pure instinct. The camera holds close on his face. A subtle twitch.

Then suddenly—he bursts forward at extreme speed, vanishing into the fog.

entries.title: Scientific Storytelling Video on Honeybee Venom and Cancer
entries.description: An extremely detailed, structured prompt for Seedance 2.0 designed to create a 15-second, six-cut cinematic science documentary explaining how honeybee venom (melittin) interacts with cancer cells. It specifies format, intent, common style (ultra macro cinematic realism, biological visualization), timeline, visual cues, and voiceover/sound effects for each cut.
entries.prompt:
TITLE: NATURE’S CODE — THE VENOM THAT TARGETS CANCER

FORMAT:
Seedance 2.0 | 15s | 6 cinematic cuts | Hyper-real | Science storytelling

INTENT
Create a visually compelling, scientifically grounded narrative explaining how honeybee venom (melittin) interacts with cancer cells.
Tone must be educational, precise, and cinematic, avoiding exaggeration or cure claims.
Focus on mechanism, contrast, and visual clarity, not drama.

COMMON STYLE
Ultra macro cinematic realism, biological visualization, high-detail cell structures, slow motion fluid physics, dark medical tone, volumetric lighting, golden highlights (venom), deep blacks (tumor mass), microscopic world scale, documentary + cinematic hybrid

TIMELINE
CUT 1 (0:00–0:02.5)
Macro honeybee in slow motion → transition into microscopic scale
VO: “Nature builds weapons… we are only beginning to understand.”
SFX: soft ambient hum

CUT 2 (0:02.5–0:05)
Venom particles (melittin) flowing through bloodstream
VO: “A single peptide… melittin.”
SFX: fluid motion

CUT 3 (0:05–0:07.5)
Tumor cells appear, irregular and unstable
VO: “Targets the most aggressive cancer cells…”
SFX: low tension tone

CUT 4 (0:07.5–0:10)
Melittin binds to cell membrane → pores form → membrane rupture
VO: “Breaking their defenses… from within.”
SFX: micro crackle

CUT 5 (0:10–0:12.5)
Cell collapses → signaling fades
VO: “Interrupting the signals that fuel growth.”
SFX: fading electrical tone

CUT 6 (0:12.5–0:15)
Healthy cells remain intact
VO: “Precision… not force.”
SFX: soft resolve

FINAL FRAME:
Black screen
Text: “Research is ongoing.”

entries.prompt:
Original Sci-Fi Dark Comedy Action Short Film: Inside a high-tech experimental laboratory filled with glowing glass tubes, holographic screens, and flickering neon panels, a white-clad orange cat patient (wearing a full-body hospital gown with a white bandage wrapped around its forehead) frantically sprints between metallic workstations, pursued by a relentless hyena in a black suit and dark sunglasses. At the peak of the chase, the orange cat suddenly stops, spins, and tosses a chicken bone high into the air. In a split second, the hyena’s fierce expression collapses into greedy distraction, eyes locked upward. Seizing the moment, the orange cat presses a button on a smartphone—instantly, a hidden net deploys from the ceiling, trapping the hyena mid-leap. The lab falls silent except for faint electrical buzzing. The orange cat slowly turns toward the camera, straightens its posture, and flashes a smug, victorious grin.

A powerful hook within the first 2 seconds, stable pacing with escalating tension, coherent action choreography, cinematic composition, realistic lighting and reflections on metallic surfaces, a blend of suspense and humor, high-definition detail, expressive character animation, and an original, highly shareable concept designed for social media impact.

entries.title: Transformation Sequence: Tentacles and Alien Hiss
entries.description: A detailed, multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a character's violent transformation sequence, starting with a handheld close-up, followed by tentacles wrapping around her, an alien voice, and a final shift into an alien form with a predatory expression and sharp teeth. The prompt specifies camera movements, timing, and emotional reactions across 15 seconds.
entries.prompt:
0–2s

Handheld shaky tracking close-up, wind swirling hard, red tentacles floating around her, camera unstable and breathing.

2–4s

Tentacles suddenly snap and wrap tightly around her body from behind, pulling her upward slightly as she reacts instantly, her body jerking and resisting, movements sharp and uncontrolled.

4–6s

A deep alien voice echoes: “Serve us… conquer the Earth… and the power you seek will be yours.” Her body stiffens violently as energy surges through her, red glow spreading across her skin while she begins to struggle harder, shaking and twisting as if fighting the force.

6–8s

Camera circles her rapidly in handheld motion as transformation begins — her body convulses, movements erratic, she tries to pull away but fails. Her skin starts shifting unevenly, forming darker, thicker organic layers while she writhes in visible tension.

8–10s

Extreme close-up: her skin rapidly changes into layered, organic, slightly glossy textures, forming scale-like patterns. The transformation is unstable and reactive, surface moving like living tissue while she trembles and gasps.

10–11.5s

Cut to side/back shot: tall alien silhouettes move slowly around her, observing while she struggles violently, her body still twitching and resisting within the tentacles.

11.5–13s

Cut to front: tentacles suddenly retract sharply, releasing her mid-motion. She drops heavily to her knees, catching herself with unstable movement, breathing fast, body still twitching from the transformation.

13–15s

Handheld close-up pushes toward her face as the final transformation completes her facial structure shifts into an alien form with organic interconnected textures, surfaces stretching and reforming fluidly. She lifts her head slowly, then lets out a sharp hiss, revealing rows of sharp, unnatural teeth. Her eyes darken, expression turning predatory as the camera shakes subtly in front of her.

The scene is set in a city at night, featuring a young Japanese salaryman and an office lady running together in a sudden rain shower, both soaked and laughing. This is a detailed text-to-video prompt for Seedance 2.0.

entries.title: Bullet Time Falling Businessman
entries.description: A prompt designed for Seedance 2.0 to create a cinematic bullet-time effect video of a businessman falling backward on an icy street in Wall Street, with the camera orbiting the frozen scene.
entries.prompt: Bullet time effect. A businessman in white shirt and black tie slipping and falling backwards on icy wet street in Wall Street, New York. Coffee cup standing on ground, liquid exploding outward frozen in mid-air. Ice chunks, water droplets, and coffee splash all completely suspended — time is frozen. Tall buildings on both sides creating a canyon effect. Camera smoothly orbits 360 degrees around the falling man at low ground level angle, only the camera moves while everything else remains perfectly still. Cinematic, overcast dramatic lighting, wide angle lens distortion.

entries.title: Cat Master and Bear Pharaoh Cinematic Comedy
entries.description: A detailed, multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating a cinematic dark comedy adventure featuring an orange cat explorer and a mummy gray bear in an ancient pyramid. The prompt specifies camera work (handheld, whip pans), lighting (moody torchlight), sound effects (grinding, BOOM), and a comedic, synchronized reaction shot.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic dark comedy adventure shot on Arri Alexa 35 with handheld jitter, exaggerated reaction shots, and punchy fast-cut editing, featuring moody torch lighting, dusty particle VFX, and a claustrophobic ancient pyramid atmosphere.

S1: Low-angle tracking shot as an orange cat explorer in an Indiana Jones-style outfit leads a line of nervous cat apprentices holding flickering torches into a narrow pyramid corridor, shadows dancing wildly on the walls.
S2: Close-up of the orange cat’s confident smirk as he raises a paw dramatically, signaling the team forward, dust drifting in the torchlight.
S3: Wide handheld shot revealing a hidden burial chamber filled with ancient coffins and gold relics, the cats’ torchlight barely illuminating the vast darkness.
S4: Insert shot of a trembling apprentice cat accidentally brushing against a carved stone pedestal, triggering a subtle “click” echoing ominously.
S5: Medium shot of a massive Egyptian sarcophagus slowly creaking open, lid sliding aside with a deep grinding sound.
S6: Extreme close-up of glowing eyes snapping open inside the coffin—wrapped bandages shifting.
S7: Whip pan as a towering mummy gray bear bursts upright from the coffin, bandages unraveling, letting out a deep, absurdly loud roar.
S8: Rapid chaotic handheld shots of all cats screaming and scrambling, torches flailing, sparks flying as they run in different directions.
S9: Close-up of one apprentice slipping and slamming into a wall lever by accident—CLACK!
S10: Wide shot of a massive stone door dropping instantly, sealing the chamber with a thunderous BOOM, cutting off the escaping cats.
S11: Silence. Pitch black. Only faint breathing echoes in the darkness.
S12: Close-up in darkness as a tiny flame flickers—orange cat nervously lights a small lighter, illuminating his uneasy face.
S13: Slow push-in as the flame reveals the massive mummy gray bear standing inches away, both frozen, staring directly at each other.
S14: Extreme close-up split-second beat—wide eyes from both the orange cat and the bear.
S15: Sudden explosive reaction—both scream at the exact same time and violently jump backward in perfect sync, knocking over ancient artifacts in a chaotic comedic crash.

preview_videos.caption: Cat Master and Bear Pharaoh Cinematic Comedy

entries.title: Anime Girls Cyberpunk Scene Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed, 15-second prompt used with CapCut AI Video Maker Seedance 2.0 to generate a scene featuring three anime girls in cyberpunk outfits, focusing on CG explosions, dramatic lighting, and an emotional close-up.
entries.prompt: Three anime girls (left: short black hair with horn accessories, black-cyan-magenta cyberpunk outfit; center: long silver-white hair, red eyes, black dress; right: red ponytail, blue eyes, white outfit) stand still as holographic wireframe CG objects surrounding them crack and explode into cyan particle dust over 6 seconds — fragments scatter outward like shattered glass. Stage clears to pure black. Girls walk slowly to center, forming back-to-back triangle, heads tilted up, eyes closed. Overhead single white spotlight narrows to illuminate only them. LED floor pulses one final triangle ripple outward from their feet. At 10 seconds hard cut to extreme close-up of center girl, silver hair flowing across face, single cyan light-streak crossing her red eye like a tear. Headset mic glows faintly. Dead silence framing. 15 seconds.

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Detailed Combat Video Prompt: Maid Blade Dance
entries.description: A highly detailed, structured prompt for generating a 15-second combat video titled 'Maid Blade Dance - Mei vs Coco' using Seedance 2.0. The prompt specifies characters, weapons, movement cores, environment, lighting, atmosphere, camera work, and a sequence of 10 detailed cuts with timing and action descriptions.
entries.prompt:
タイトル：「メイドブレードダンス - メイ vs ココ」
所要時間：「15秒」
入力：
A: "<<<画像1>>>"
B: "<<<画像2>>>"
キャラクター:
A:
名前：「霧島メイ」
武器：「迷いの刀（黒紫）」
B:
名前：「桜庭ココ」
武器：「リボン槍（銀色＋赤リボン）」
ムーブメントコア:
A: ["高速多段斬り"、"黒紫オーラ"、"多重ブラー残像"]
B: [「槍による高速回転」、「白銀オーラ」、「リボン螺旋状」]
環境：
場所：「和風屋敷廊下（月夜・障子背景）」
照明：「月光青＋障子オレンジ」
雰囲気：「黒と白の塵」
カメラ：「24mm〜70mm。高速追従＋急停止。激突スロー時（0.3倍速）」
カット:
- カット: 1
所要時間：「1.5秒」
アクション：「メイ（左）ココ（右）が10m離れて対峙。メイが刀を半分抜く」
カメラ：「ゆっくり水平パン（24mm）」
- カット: 2
所要時間：「1.5秒」
アクション：「メイが刀を完全に抜ける。黒紫のオーラ一瞬閃。メイがココに直線的に移動（残像あり）」
カメラ：「メイへ超高速ドリーイン（50mm）」
- カット: 3
所要時間：「2秒」
アクション：「ココが槍を軸に高速回転。メイの連続斬撃が槍に触れる。白青色の火花。リボンが遠心力で広がる」
カメラ：「ココ中心に回転（45mm）」
- カット: 4
所要時間：「1.5秒」
アクション：「メイが刀を胸の高さに構える。ココが槍を横に構える。対応の動きを測り合う」
カメラ：「ワクワク。横トラッキング（35mm）」
- カット: 5
所要時間：「2秒」
アクション: "メイが連続7回の斬撃。各斬撃が黒い光の軌跡。ココがリボンを薙ぎ払い迎撃。リボンが黒い軌跡を白くかき消す"
カメラ：「メイへの高速追従パン（50mm）」
- カット: 6
所要時間：「1.5秒」
アクション：「メイが袈裟懸けで巨大な斬撃。黒紫のオーラが画面を半分横切り。ココが槍を斜めに見て見て」
カメラ：「斜めからメイの軌跡を辿る（50mm）」
- カット: 7
所要時間：「2秒」
アクション: 「ココが身体を回転させながら槍を構え変える。連続3回の高速突き。メイが刀で払い落とし」
カメラ：「ココへフラッシュドリーイン＋回転（40mm）」
- カット: 8
所要時間：「2.5秒」
アクション：「刀と槍が正面から激突。火花が爆発的に飛び散る（黒紫×白青）。二人の髪が波打ち。ダスト放射状に拡散」
カメラ: 「固定。突出部を中心（70mm）」
効果: "スローモーション 0.3倍"
- カット: 9
所要時間：「1.5秒」
アクション: 「メイとココがずっと数メートル後ろに吹き飛ぶ。膝をついて相手を見つめる」
カメラ：「二人から同時に後ろへ向い（35mm）」
- カット: 10
期間: "1秒"
アクション: "メイが刀を振る。ココが槍を立て直す。次の開始姿勢へ"
カメラ：「ゆっくり引き（24mm）」
ループ：「黒と白の塵が分かれて渦巻く。戦いは永遠に続く」
注：
- "メイ：直線的・鋭い動き。ココ：曲線的・流動的な動き"
- 「黒紫 vs 白青の火花が個性を表現」
- 「月光と障子が和風決闘の世界観を強調」

entries.title: High-Energy Japan Travel Documentary Montage
entries.description: A complex, segmented prompt for Seedance 2.0 (via ClaudeCode + Renoise) generating a high-energy, 15-second travel documentary montage of Japan. The prompt specifies five distinct scenes (Torii gate, Kyoto backstreet, Shibuya crossing, Shinkansen, Tokyo aerial), each with detailed camera movements (orbits, dolly rush, 360 spin, crane up, whip pan) and specific visual requirements (photorealistic, natural film grain, no CGI). It also includes an audio style specification (High-energy EDM, 140BPM).
entries.prompt:
Travel documentary footage of Japan, shot on Sony A7 IV,  natural film grain, photorealistic, no CGI, no stylization.

  [0-3s] A real weathered red torii gate at night. Camera starts  ground-level at the base of the gate looking up — then rapidly  orbits 180 degrees around the torii post, accelerating as it  swings, revealing the misty stone steps and orange lantern glow  on the other side. The movement is fast and sweeping.  

[3-6s] A narrow Kyoto backstreet at night. Camera bursts forward  at high speed down the alley in a fast dolly rush — wooden machiya  houses and red lanterns blur past on both sides. A woman in a dark  kimono steps aside. Camera tilts sharply upward mid-rush to reveal  the sky framed between the rooftops, then snaps back down.  

[6-9s] Shibuya scramble crossing at night. Camera starts low in  the crowd, spins 360 degrees fast at hip level — people and neon  signs streak past — then rapidly cranes straight up into the air,  rising fast to reveal the full intersection below. The spin-to-rise  transition is sudden and energetic. 

 [9-12s] A shinkansen N700 bullet train. Camera holds static for a  split second — then the train BLASTS past at full speed inches from  the lens, the shockwave shaking the frame violently. Camera  immediately whips to track it from behind, accelerating to match  speed, rice fields streaking. 

 [12-15s] Wide aerial Tokyo at dusk. Camera starts in tight on city  streets, then rockets upward fast — buildings shrinking rapidly —  spinning slightly as it rises, until the full Tokyo bay and Mount  Fuji horizon are revealed. Camera decelerates and holds the grand  final frame steady.  Audio style: High-energy EDM, hard synth drops, 140BPM, bass hit  on each camera snap. No text, subtitles, watermarks, or logos. Quality: photorealistic, natural textures, real locations, fluid  motion. Avoid: CGI look, artificial lighting, slow or static camera.

Seedance V2 

The Biomechanical Parasite 

(异形寄生体撕裂)" theme: "H.R. Giger / Dead Space / Visceral Sci-Fi Horror"

entries.title: Dramatic Anime MV: Falling Tiger and Unimpressed Cat
entries.description: A highly detailed, time-segmented prompt (0-15s) for a dramatic, fast-cut anime music video with comedic payoff, featuring a white tiger falling from the sky into a 1930s Tokyo rice paddy where an orange cat is planting rice. The prompt specifies cinematic tension, rapid cuts, POV distortion, and a sudden comedic release.
entries.prompt:
A highly dramatic, fast-cut anime MV with exaggerated cinematic tension and comedic payoff. 1930s Tokyo rice paddies, muddy textures, stormy sky. Extreme sense of falling urgency using rapid cuts, POV distortion, speed ramps, spinning camera, impact zooms. Dramatic orchestral music escalating non-stop, then sudden comedic release at the end. No dialogue, no voice-over. Each shot 0.6–1.2s.

0–0.8s (HOOK)
Extreme close-up: muddy water surface. Ripple expands → reflection shows a white tiger falling from the sky at insane speed.

0.8–1.6s
SMASH CUT → tiger tumbling mid-air, body spinning violently, wind tearing fur.

1.6–2.4s
POV tiger → ground rushing upward extremely fast. Rice paddies distort with speed.

2.4–3.2s
Cut → orange cat in muddy farmer clothes, calmly planting rice. Slow, peaceful motion.

3.2–4.0s
Back to tiger → extreme close-up eyes, panic rising. Sunglasses slightly slipping.

4.0–4.8s
Rapid micro-cuts: sky spin → ground zoom → cat step → sky spin → distance collapsing fast.

4.8–5.6s
Top-down shot → tiger perfectly aligned to crash into orange cat.

5.6–6.4s
Tiger yanks parachute → explosive deploy → instant violent spinning chaos.

6.4–7.2s
Camera rotates 360° with tiger. Horizon flips. Ground now dangerously close.

7.2–8.0s
Parachute unstable → cords under extreme tension. Tiger loses control completely.

8.0–8.8s
Tiger panic peaks → aggressively twists cords into a tight yarn-ball knot.

8.8–9.6s
Parachute collapses → freefall speed doubles. Sound compresses into heartbeat rhythm.

9.6–10.4s
Ultra-fast dive shot → motion blur streaks. Orange cat grows rapidly in frame.

10.4–11.2s
Cut → cat finally senses something. Slight head turn.

11.2–12.0s (IMPACT BUILD)
Extreme close-up: tiger face in silent scream → smash zoom toward ground.

12.0–12.8s (IMPACT)
Massive muddy explosion. Water and mud burst upward in slow motion.

12.8–13.6s
Mud rain falls. Silence. Shapes slowly appear through the splash.

13.6–14.2s (REVEAL)
White tiger sitting on top of the orange cat’s back, slightly dazed but intact.

14.2–15.0s (COMEDIC PAYOFF)
Close-up: orange cat’s face, completely covered in mud, eyes half-open, extremely annoyed.
White tiger casually adjusts sunglasses while sitting on him.
Freeze frame → dramatic music abruptly cuts.
