entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Tsui Hark Style Wuxia Film Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-shot prompt for generating a Wuxia (martial arts) film sequence in the style of director Tsui Hark, set in Zhangjiajie's Tianmen Mountain, emphasizing dynamic camera work and specific action sequences. It requires a reference image for the character's face/costume.
entries.prompt:
【云窟剑影·天门血战】
——张家界天门山一镜到底
核心风格： 徐克新式武侠大片、一镜到底、高帧率、4K超清。

色调： 徐克亮调，“冷玉青墨 + 琥珀流光”。高对比、山岚自带柔光滤镜，锐化人物轮廓，达芬奇工业级调色。

场景： 张家界天门山（湘西诡谲地貌。天门洞开，吞云吐雾；999级天梯垂直挂于绝壁，如通天之路；石林石柱如利剑攒蹙，云海翻腾间栈道若隐若现，飞鸟不渡）。

运镜轨迹：
低角度仰拍（强调天险） → 急速推向洞口 → 180°横向平移（展现栈道激斗） → 俯冲下坠 → 缓拉回正 → 逆光特写。

镜头脚本：
0-4秒【起势·天门云涌】：

运镜： 极低角度仰拍，镜头从天梯底部向上急速俯冲掠过。

画面： 人物面部参考@【@图1】武侠侠客装扮（白衣胜雪，斗笠压低，手持长剑） 孤身立于999级天梯中央。

动作： 狂风卷起周遭云雾，【@图1】右手扶剑柄，左手捏剑指划过鼻梁。镜头拉远，展现其背后的天门洞，宛如一只巨大的苍天之眼。

4-8秒【激斗·悬梯截杀】：

运镜： 180°环绕平移。

画面： 十余名劲装死士从两侧如猿猴般贴着绝壁荡下。

动作： 【@图1】足尖点梯，身形倒挂旋转。（徐克式慢动量感） 剑不出鞘，以鞘代棍点、拨、挑，气浪将台阶上的雨水震成水雾。镜头急速环绕，捕捉残影与金属撞击的火花。

8-11秒【破阵·纵横石林】：

运镜： 镜头跟随人物俯冲，穿过石拱门进入悬崖栈道。

画面： 刺客布下钢丝阵。

动作： 【@图1】长剑终于出鞘（剑身映射琥珀色日光），一记横扫千军。剑气化作青墨弧光，斩断钢丝，钢丝崩断回弹击碎崖石。他在仅容一人的栈道上闪转腾挪，身影与石柱交错，虚实结合。

11-15秒【收势·雾散孤峰】：

运镜： 镜头从洞口向外缓拉，由窄变宽，展现万丈深渊。

画面： 漫天符纸（或枯叶）随风飞舞，【@图1】立于天门洞边缘，脚下即是云海。

动作： 挽剑花归鞘，反手背剑。阳光从天门洞背后透射过来，形成巨大的丁达尔效应。

定格： 镜头推进至极度特写，斗笠边缘滴下一滴血，划过下颌。眼神凌厉如电，背景是无尽的山河大观。
entries.translated_prompt:
[Cloud Cave Sword Shadow · Heavenly Gate Bloody Battle]
— One-shot sequence at Tianmen Mountain, Zhangjiajie
Core Style: Tsui Hark's new style Wuxia blockbuster, one-shot sequence, high frame rate, 4K ultra-clear.

Tone: Tsui Hark's bright tone, “Cold Jade Blue-Black + Amber Flowing Light.” High contrast, mountain mist acts as a soft light filter, sharpening character outlines, DaVinci industrial-grade color grading.

Scene: Tianmen Mountain, Zhangjiajie (Wacky terrain of Western Hunan. Tianmen Cave opens, swallowing clouds and mist; 999 steps of the Heavenly Ladder hang vertically on the cliff, like a path to heaven; stone forests and pillars cluster like sharp swords, plank roads are faintly visible amidst surging clouds, birds do not cross).

Camera Movement Trajectory:
Low-angle upward shot (emphasizing the natural danger) → Rapid push toward the cave entrance → 180° horizontal pan (showing intense fight on the plank road) → Dive down → Slowly pull back to center → Backlit close-up.

Shot Script:
0-4 seconds [Opening Stance · Heavenly Gate Cloud Surge]:

Movement: Extreme low-angle upward shot, the camera rapidly swoops up and over the Heavenly Ladder from the bottom.

Visuals: Character face reference @[Image 1] Wuxia swordsman attire (white clothes like snow, low-pressed bamboo hat, holding a long sword) stands alone in the center of the 999 steps.

Action: Strong winds whip up the surrounding clouds and mist. [Image 1] holds the sword hilt with the right hand, and the left hand forms a sword-finger gesture across the bridge of the nose. The camera pulls back to show the Tianmen Cave behind him, resembling a giant eye of the heavens.

4-8 seconds [Fierce Battle · Suspended Ladder Interception]:

Movement: 180° orbiting pan.

Visuals: More than ten assassins in tight suits swing down from both sides, clinging to the cliff like monkeys.

Action: [Image 1] touches the steps with his toes, his body spinning upside down. (Tsui Hark-style slow-motion dynamics) The sword remains sheathed, using the sheath as a stick to point, parry, and strike. The air current shakes the rainwater on the steps into mist. The camera rapidly orbits, capturing afterimages and the sparks of metal impact.

8-11 seconds [Breaking the Formation · Traversing the Stone Forest]:

Movement: The camera follows the character diving, passing through a stone archway into the cliffside plank road.

Visuals: Assassins set up a steel wire trap.

Action: [Image 1]'s long sword finally unsheathes (the blade reflects amber sunlight), executing a sweeping strike. The sword energy transforms into a blue-black arc of light, cutting the steel wires. The snapping wires rebound and shatter cliff rocks. He dodges and weaves on the narrow plank road, his figure intersecting with the stone pillars, blending virtual and real.

11-15 seconds [Closing Stance · Mist Dissipates on the Lonely Peak]:

Movement: The camera slowly pulls out from the cave entrance, widening the view to reveal the abyss.

Visuals: Paper talismans (or dead leaves) flutter in the wind. [Image 1] stands at the edge of the Tianmen Cave, with a sea of clouds below his feet.

Action: He performs a sword flourish and sheathes the sword, placing it on his back. Sunlight streams through the Tianmen Cave, creating a massive Tyndall effect.

Freeze Frame: The camera pushes in for an extreme close-up. A drop of blood drips from the edge of the bamboo hat, tracing his jawline. His eyes are sharp as lightning, with the vast landscape in the background.

entries.title: Dimensional Entity Megacity Collision Prompt (Dreamina)
entries.description: A highly detailed, complex prompt for generating a video of a towering humanoid entity made of shifting geometry appearing over a megacity, causing a dimensional tear that makes two versions of the city collide. This prompt was explicitly made using Dreamina AI, which incorporates Seedance 2.0 technology.
entries.prompt:
A towering humanoid entity made of shifting translucent geometry appears above a megacity skyline, its body composed of overlapping dimensional planes reflecting alternate realities — hook at second two: the entity opens both hands and a vertical dimensional tear slices through the city.

Reality splits.

Two versions of the city begin occupying the same space.

Buildings phase through each other as competing timelines collide.

The destruction is dimensional and structural: streets fold into mirrored corridors, cars fall sideways into parallel gravity planes, and skyscrapers fragment into geometric shards as their alternate versions misalign.

Every movement of the entity widens the rift.

Entire districts slide into adjacent dimensions.

The gauntlet unfolds through a skyline progressively divided between worlds: street level where pedestrians phase between realities → mid-rise districts where buildings overlap in transparent duplicates → rooftop where entire towers rotate into perpendicular universes.

Aircraft vanish into dimensional folds.

Bridges twist into impossible angles.

Chase-cam flying through intersecting city layers as gravity shifts between realities.

Velocity ramp when the dimensional rift expands wide enough to swallow an entire city block.

Cut to aerial: the megacity now exists as two overlapping worlds drifting apart.

The dimensional entity stands between them.

Diegetic prismatic dimensional light reflecting through fractured architecture and overlapping skylines, cinematic multiverse distortion effects, particle fragments of shattered reality, 4K.

entries.prompt:
A hyper-realistic, 8K resolution, adrenaline-fueled single-take POV action sequence. The camera is chest-mounted on a man wearing camouflage joggers and worn-out black-and-white sneakers. He stands on the dizzying edge of a rusted skyscraper, 1000 feet above a crystalline turquoise ocean. No clouds, no haze—just a sheer, terrifying vertical drop into the deep blue.

[The Initial Freefall]
The sequence begins with a sudden, heart-stopping leap into a 20-meter vertical freefall. The camera points directly at his feet as the sea surface rushes toward the lens. A deafening, high-pitched whistling 'Hyuo' wind screams past the microphone. Just before the impact, he catches a lower rusted horizontal bar with both hands—white wristband visible—and swings his body forward to land on a tiny vertical pole.

[The Rhythmic Jumps & The Near-Death Slip]
He immediately begins a rhythmic series of high-speed jumps:

Jump 1: A clean, agile spring to a second vertical pole 2 meters away.

Jump 2: A rapid leap to a thin, rusted horizontal pipe.

Jump 3 (The Slip): As he jumps toward the third vertical pole, his right sneaker completely misses the mark and slides off the rusted metal. The camera tilts violently over the edge, staring straight down at the 1000-foot abyss. He lets out a sharp, panicked gasp. For a terrifying second, his body leans into the void, but he desperately claws at the pole with his fingers, his boots scrambling against the side until he manages to hook his leg and haul himself back up.

Jump 4: Still trembling, he forces a frantic, heavy-breathing leap to the next bar to keep the momentum.

Jump 5: A final, explosive long-distance jump to a swaying metal platform. He lands with a heavy, jarring metallic 'Clang', his body hunching low, gripping the vibrating metal for dear life.

[The Ending]
The camera remains in a low, fetal position on the final bar, shaking from the adrenaline. No dialogue. The audio is a visceral layer of the aggressive 'Hyuo' wind, his intense, ragged, and rapid gasping for air, and a loud, thumping heartbeat that resonates as if inside his chest. The harsh midday sun glints off the ocean waves far below, creating a blinding, beautiful, yet lethal glare. Cinematic materials, fluid 120fps motion, hyper-detailed rust and skin textures.

entries.title: Hollywood-Style Shanghai City Montage Video Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second, Hollywood-level fast-cut video montage of Shanghai, blending cyberpunk and traditional Shanghai styles with specific cinematic techniques like FPV drone shots, time-lapses, and micro-photography.
entries.prompt:

镜头序列： 1. 陆家嘴三件套摩天大楼在晨曦云雾中穿梭，直升机大俯冲航拍。
2. 镜头快速推近外滩万国建筑群，展现精细的石材纹理。
3. 穿梭机（FPV）在深夜霓虹闪烁的街道与东方明珠塔身疾速掠过。
4. 南浦大桥螺旋引桥的延时摄影，金色的流光车灯汇聚成环。
5. 航拍镜头平稳划过梧桐树影下的武康大楼。
6. 微距特写：一笼热气腾腾的南翔小笼包被筷子提起，汤汁晃动。
7. 高速蒙太奇剪辑：石库门弄堂、磁悬浮列车、豫园古建、摩登天际线快速闪回。
要求： 极致的动感运镜、穿梭机航拍、微距摄影、丝滑转场。
氛围： 充满活力、未来感、高级感、快节奏。全景与细节结合，突出城市脉动，商业广告质感。4k，写实风，流畅动态。

entries.title: Cyberpunk Action Sequence: Elegant Female Agent Jumps from Skyscraper to Moving Car

The sequence covers her awakening and jump from a skyscraper, a freefall intercepted by a transforming Huawei AITO M7 (智界R7) car, and the car's transformation into an F-14 fighter jet while she stands on its back. The prompt specifies cinematic style (35mm handheld film, 8K, high contrast), detailed physical effects (cloth, hair, mechanical parts), specific camera movements (continuous tracking, rapid cuts), and precise sound design for each 15-second chapter.

entries.title: Complex single-shot morphing video prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A highly detailed, structured prompt for Seedance 2.0 designed to generate a single, continuous, cut-free shot that smoothly morphs through seven distinct reference images. The prompt specifies cinematic style, dynamic camera movements (push-in, tracking, orbit), and detailed transformation logic between each image, focusing on temporal coherence and consistent subject identity.
entries.prompt:
【基本設定】
structure: 単一の連続ショット（カットなし）
progression: 7枚の画像を順番にモーフィング
visibility: 各画像は一瞬だけ明確に認識できる（停止不要）
transition: 常に滑らかで連続的
style: シネマティック、高精細、ダイナミック、フリッカーなし
【プロンプト本体】
<<<Image1>>> から開始。
映像は完全に途切れのない1ショットで進行し、<<<Image1>>>  → <<<Image2>>>  → <<<Image3>>>  → <<<Image4>>>   → <<<Image5>>>   → <<<Image6>>>  → <<<Image7>>>  の順に連続的に変形していく。
全体は静止的ではなく、カメラが常に動き続けるダイナミックな映像の中でモーフィングが発生する。
ただし被写体の認識性は維持し、構図が破綻しないように制御する。
各画像は流れの中で一瞬だけ明確に視認できるピーク状態を持つが、停止やホールドはしない。
すべては連続した「動きの中の進化」として表現する。
【変形ロジック（順番固定・重複禁止）】
<<<Image1>>>  → <<<Image2>>>  ：
カメラが前方へスムーズにプッシュインしながら変形開始
輪郭 → パーツ → 色 → 質感の順で段階的に変化
微細な粒子分解 → 再構築
<<<Image2>>>  → <<<Image3>>>  ：
カメラが横方向へ流れるトラッキング移動
光の走査（ライトスキャン）により構造が書き換わる
発光ラインが流れ、形状が連続的に変化
※粒子表現は禁止
<<<Image3>>>  → <<<Image4>>>  ：
カメラが被写体の周囲を回り込むようにオービット移動
空間歪み・レンズワープにより形状が引き伸ばされながら変形
<<<Image4>>>  → <<<Image5>>>  ：
カメラがやや引きながら視点を変える（軽いドリーアウト＋角度変化）
被写体が液体のように溶け、流れながら再形成される
<<<Image5>>>   → <<<Image6>>>  ：
カメラが一瞬加速し、動きに勢いをつける
被写体が破片化し、空間に散った後、再び集まり新しい形へ再構築
<<<Image6>>>  → <<<Image7>>>  ：
カメラが再び中心へ寄りながら安定化
エネルギーが中心に収束し、光と波動によって最終形態へ統合される
【カメラ挙動（重要）】
・常に動いているが制御された動き
・使用可能：
  - プッシュイン / プルアウト
  - 横トラッキング
  - オービット（回り込み）
  - 軽いパース変化
・禁止：
  - 急激なブレ
  - 被写体ロスト
  - 不自然なジャンプ
【制約（重要）】
・カット編集禁止（完全1ショット）
・同一エフェクトの再使用禁止
・フリッカー、ノイズ、破綻禁止
・被写体の位置・スケールは大きく崩さない
・各画像は必ず一度は明確に視認できる状態を作る
・すべての変化は連続的かつ意味のある構造変形であること
【強化キーワード】
dynamic camera movement
cinematic motion flow
smooth continuous morphing
temporal coherence
high detail preservation
consistent subject identity
seamless transformation flow
entries.translated_prompt:
【Basic Settings】
structure: Single continuous shot (no cuts)
progression: Morphing 7 images sequentially
visibility: Each image is clearly recognizable for only an instant (no stopping required)
transition: Always smooth and continuous
style: Cinematic, high-definition, dynamic, no flicker
【Prompt Body】
Start from <<<Image1>>>.
The footage proceeds in a completely seamless single shot, continuously transforming in the order of <<<Image1>>> → <<<Image2>>> → <<<Image3>>> → <<<Image4>>> → <<<Image5>>> → <<<Image6>>> → <<<Image7>>>.
The overall scene is not static; morphing occurs within a dynamic video where the camera is constantly moving.
However, the recognizability of the subject is maintained, and the composition is controlled to prevent collapse.
Each image has a peak state where it is clearly visible for an instant within the flow, but there is no stopping or holding.
Everything is expressed as a continuous "evolution within motion."
【Transformation Logic (Fixed order, no duplication)】
<<<Image1>>> → <<<Image2>>>:
The camera begins transformation while smoothly pushing in forward
Gradual change in the order of outline → parts → color → texture
Fine particle decomposition → reconstruction
<<<Image2>>> → <<<Image3>>>:
Tracking movement where the camera flows horizontally
The structure is rewritten by light scanning
Emitting lines flow, and the shape continuously changes
* Particle expression is prohibited
<<<Image3>>> → <<<Image4>>>:
Orbit movement where the camera circles around the subject
The shape is stretched and transformed by spatial distortion and lens warp
<<<Image4>>> → <<<Image5>>>:
The camera slightly pulls back and changes perspective (light dolly out + angle change)
The subject melts like liquid and is reformed while flowing
<<<Image5>>> → <<<Image6>>>:
The camera accelerates momentarily, adding momentum to the movement
The subject fragments, scatters in space, and then reassembles into a new form
<<<Image6>>> → <<<Image7>>>:
The camera stabilizes while converging back towards the center
Energy converges at the center and integrates into the final form through light and waves
【Camera Behavior (Important)】
・Always moving but controlled movement
・Usable:
  - Push-in / Pull-out
  - Horizontal tracking
  - Orbit (circling)
  - Light perspective change
・Prohibited:
  - Sudden blur
  - Loss of subject
  - Unnatural jumps
【Constraints (Important)】
・Cut editing prohibited (complete single shot)
・Reuse of the same effect prohibited
・Flicker, noise, and breakdown prohibited
・Subject position/scale should not be significantly disrupted
・Each image must achieve a clearly visible state at least once
・All changes must be continuous and meaningful structural transformations
【Enhancement Keywords】
dynamic camera movement
cinematic motion flow
smooth continuous morphing
temporal coherence
high detail preservation
consistent subject identity
seamless transformation flow

entries.title: Ultra-Cinematic Time-Freeze Motorcycle Action Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed, 12-second, two-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0, focusing on an ultra-cinematic action sequence involving a superbike, a near-fatal crash, and a dramatic time-freeze effect where a duplicate of the rider steps off the frozen bike and breaks the fourth wall.
entries.prompt:
Create a 12-second ultra-cinematic action scene with strong realism, perfect character consistency, realistic motorcycle physics, dramatic suspense, and seamless time-freeze storytelling.

MAIN SUBJECT:
A black, ultra-fast superbike on a busy highway at dusk. The rider wears a full black racing suit, black gloves, and a glossy black full-face helmet with a dark visor. The bike looks aggressive, premium, aerodynamic, and extremely fast.

STYLE:
hyper-realistic, cinematic, high-speed action film, dramatic lighting, intense motion blur during speed, sharp focus during time freeze, realistic highway environment, grounded physics, premium movie look, highly detailed reflections on the black motorcycle and helmet, 4K cinematic composition.

CAMERA:
dynamic tracking shots, low-angle pursuit shots, fast push-in, slight handheld vibration during speed, then absolute stillness when time stops, dramatic close-up on the rider’s duplicate body after separation, direct eye contact with camera, then instant return to violent real-time motion.

TIMELINE:

0.0s - 1.5s
A black superbike races through dense highway traffic at insane speed. The rider aggressively weaves between cars, overtaking everyone. Cinematic low front-side tracking shot, sparks of reflected city lights, intense speed sensation, realistic motion blur, danger rising.

1.5s - 3.0s
The motorcycle keeps accelerating. Cars are passed one after another. Camera shifts between a rear chase shot and a low side shot near the spinning wheels. The rider looks fully focused, body leaning with precision, the bike slicing through traffic like a missile.

3.0s - 4.2s
A large cargo truck suddenly appears directly ahead in the rider’s lane. The truck feels massive and unavoidable. Camera rapidly pushes in toward the front collision line. Tension peaks. The motorcycle is about to crash head-on.

4.2s - 5.0s
At exactly 1 centimeter before impact, time stops completely. Absolute stillness. The whole world freezes: truck, traffic, dust, reflections, fabric folds, everything suspended in place. No crash is shown yet. The motorcycle and the original rider body remain frozen on the bike in the exact pre-impact position.

5.0s - 7.5s
A second version of the rider — an identical physical duplicate, implying the rider’s spirit or soul separated from the body — calmly steps off the frozen motorcycle while the original body remains motionless on the bike. The duplicate removes the helmet. Under the helmet is the exact same rider’s face. Expression: shocked, confused, darkly comedic disbelief. He walks one or two steps toward camera through the frozen world.

7.5s - 11.5s
Medium close-up. The duplicate turns directly to the viewer, breaking the fourth wall. He looks straight into the lens and says clearly in English:
“Ohh shitt. I think I’m dead.”
Natural lip sync, natural facial performance, subtle panic mixed with disbelief. Keep the original body still frozen on the bike in the background to reinforce the visual reveal. Do not show gore.

11.5s - 12.0s
Without warning, time instantly resumes. Everything snaps back into motion at once. The duplicate disappears the moment time restarts. The motorcycle collides violently with the truck in a sudden brutal impact. Show the crash only at the final moment, extremely fast and shocking, cinematic debris burst, hard cut to impact.

Do not show the actual crash before time stops.
The audience must only realize the rider is dead when the duplicate steps off the frozen bike.
The original rider body must remain on the motorcycle while the duplicate walks away.
The duplicate must be visually identical to the rider.
No gore, no blood, no exposed injuries.
Keep the emotional tone: suspense first, then surreal dark humor, then sudden impact.
Preserve one continuous cinematic sequence with seamless transitions.
Prioritize realism, continuity, dramatic tension, and precise timing.

Create a 4-second cinematic public service announcement. The camera moves smoothly and confidently forward through a beautiful open sky with clean white clouds, soft sunlight, and a few birds flying naturally in the distance. The movement feels calm, cool, elevated, and powerful. No people, no vehicles, no buildings, no road, no extra objects. Minimal, elegant, emotional public safety tone.

At the end of the shot, display only this English text clearly in the sky, centered and cinematic:
“Don’t be fast, ride safe.”

Use a deep, old male voice with a strong, calm, authoritative tone, like a serious public service announcement narrator. The voice says exactly:
“Don’t be fast, ride safe.”

Style: ultra-cinematic, realistic sky, clean atmosphere, subtle inspirational feeling, premium PSA look, smooth motion, strong readability, no clutter, no subtitles other than the main message, no watermark.

entries.title: Cinematic Lamborghini Brand Creative Ad Video Generation Prompt
entries.description: A detailed, multi-segment prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a cinematic, high-impact Lamborghini brand creative advertisement video. The prompt specifies a first-person, high-speed chase perspective, emphasizing the transition from the raw power of a bull to the mechanical sculpture and aggressive lines of the Lamborghini, with specific instructions for visual style, scene transitions, and sound design across a 15-second timeline.
entries.prompt:
电影级兰博基尼品牌创意广告，超写实，第一人称高速追随镜头，极强视觉冲击，丝滑连续运镜，整体气质高级、冷酷、极具侵略性。打造一支简约但攻击性极强的第一人称高速穿梭广告。不要低质赛博变形，不要直接把整头公牛生硬变成车，而是通过局部特写、反光、结构线条与视觉转场，把公牛的原始力量与爆发感自然转译成兰博基尼的机械雕塑感、空气动力学和极限速度。全程无背景音乐，仅保留高质量拟音与空间音效。整体时长15秒内，每3秒必须有明显视觉升级，避免单镜头平淡拖沓。
【0-3s】黑暗与深黑金属质感空间中，一头通体深黑、肌肉线条极其清晰、皮肤表面带有克制金属冷光的狂暴公牛突然高速冲出。镜头以第一人称紧贴公牛头部侧前方高速追随，几乎擦着牛角、额头骨线、颈部肌肉和肩背起伏前冲。开场必须有极强贴脸压迫感，不要平拍，不要普通奔跑镜头，要像速度和力量直接顶到镜头前，风压扑面，画面极简，只保留少量冷白高光、黑色阴影、空气压迫感与速度残影。
【3-5s】镜头突然前压加速，极近距离推进到公牛眼部与牛角根部特写，眼神中带有冰冷攻击性，反光里出现一道锋利的冷白光刃、橙色能量余辉与金属切面高光。利用牛角弧线、眼部反光和骨骼结构做无缝转场，瞬间衔接到兰博基尼前灯、楔形车鼻与锋利折线的局部特写。这个转场必须丝滑、极快、高级，像兰博基尼本来就潜伏在公牛的力量结构里。
【5-8s】进入兰博基尼车头与前灯世界后，镜头继续第一人称高速前冲，贴着车头侧前方掠过锐利灯组、低趴前舱盖、切削感极强的前脸折面、进气口与楔形轮廓。镜头沿着车身肩线高速滑行，延续刚才贴着公牛肌肉与骨线前冲的惯性，让生物的爆发结构自然过渡成机械曲面与刀锋折线。整体色彩以兰博基尼标志性的亮黄或哑黑主车身为主，搭配黑色阴影、冷白金属高光与少量橙色热能反光，克制、高级、危险。
【8-11s】镜头继续加速，掠过车侧锋利曲面，俯冲冲向轮毂与轮胎，高速贴地穿梭。轮毂旋转、刹车卡钳、碳纤维侧裙、空气通道、车门切线、尾部空气动力学结构依次闪现。运镜要像被一股不可控的暴力速度拖拽着向前，连续俯冲、绕侧、贴地前压、从车身折面和缝隙边缘擦过，维持极强第一视角爽感。镜头语言强调机械兽性的压迫感，不要温和，不要优雅游走，要像一台暴怒的超级跑车在撕开空气。
【11-13s】镜头再一次快速前冲，整个兰博基尼车身在速度中被完整建立，楔形低趴比例、锐利灯组、夸张进气结构、车侧雕刻曲面、宽大轮组与极具攻击性的姿态全部清晰成型。镜头可短暂沿车顶或车侧高速掠行，再拉到车头侧前方，完成最后一次动势积累。要让整辆车像一头真正完成机械觉醒的公牛，力量感和品牌识别同时拉满。
【13-15s】镜头收于低机位车头侧前方英雄镜头，一辆完整的兰博基尼超级跑车稳定前冲或刚刚定格，车身极低、极宽、极锋利，像刀锋一样切开空间。车漆反光冷酷克制，背景只保留少量赛道热浪、空气流线、轮胎残影和速度余波。结尾必须短、狠、有压迫感，像在宣告：原始野性，最终被锻造成兰博基尼的速度机器。
音效设计：开场使用低频能量脉冲、公牛沉重踏地、鼻息、皮肤掠风、贴脸风切与空气压缩声；推进到眼部与牛角时加入一记极细锐、极克制的空气收束与金属光刃转场音；进入兰博基尼局部后强化金属掠风、车漆表面气流滑过、轮毂旋转、碳纤维震颤、刹车系统轻鸣、灯组唤醒与空间whoosh；结尾突出轮胎压地、车体稳定落位、空气被切开的余震和低频收束感。全程不要背景音乐。
特殊控制：锁定品牌气质为兰博基尼式冷酷、锋利、侵略性、机械兽性和极限速度美学；镜头必须连续丝滑；每段都要有明确视觉升级；动作合理，转场自然，无卡顿无跳变；不要低质赛博朋克，不要廉价机甲变形感，不要普通跑车宣传片质感，必须像顶级超跑品牌的高端创意广告。
entries.translated_prompt:
Cinematic Lamborghini brand creative advertisement, ultra-realistic, first-person high-speed follow shot, extremely strong visual impact, smooth continuous camera movement, overall sophisticated, cool, and highly aggressive aesthetic. Create a simple but extremely aggressive first-person high-speed shuttle advertisement. Avoid low-quality cyber deformation, do not directly transform the entire bull into a car, but naturally translate the bull's primal power and explosive feeling into the Lamborghini's mechanical sculpture, aerodynamics, and extreme speed through close-ups, reflections, structural lines, and visual transitions. No background music throughout, only high-quality foley and spatial sound effects. The total duration is within 15 seconds, with a clear visual upgrade required every 3 seconds to avoid monotonous, dragged-out single shots.
[0-3s] In a dark space with deep black metallic texture, a raging bull, entirely deep black, with extremely clear muscle lines and a restrained metallic cold light on its skin surface, suddenly rushes out at high speed. The camera follows closely in a first-person perspective, almost grazing the horns, forehead bone lines, neck muscles, and shoulder/back contours as it charges forward. The opening must have an extremely strong face-to-face oppressive feeling; avoid flat shots or ordinary running shots. It should feel like speed and power are directly hitting the lens, with wind pressure rushing towards the face. The visuals are minimalist, retaining only a small amount of cold white highlights, black shadows, air pressure, and speed afterimages.
[3-5s] The camera suddenly pushes forward and accelerates, moving into an extreme close-up of the bull's eyes and the base of the horns. The eyes show cold aggression, and the reflection reveals a sharp, cold white light blade, an orange energy afterglow, and metallic facets. Use the curve of the horns, the reflection in the eyes, and the bone structure for a seamless transition, instantly connecting to a partial close-up of the Lamborghini's headlights, wedge-shaped nose, and sharp folded lines. This transition must be smooth, extremely fast, and sophisticated, as if the Lamborghini was inherently latent within the bull's power structure.
[5-8s] After entering the world of the Lamborghini's front end and headlights, the camera continues its first-person high-speed charge, sweeping past the sharp light clusters, low-slung hood, the extremely sculpted folded surfaces of the front face, air intakes, and wedge silhouette. The camera slides rapidly along the car's shoulder line, continuing the momentum of rushing past the bull's muscles and bone lines, allowing the biological explosive structure to naturally transition into mechanical curves and razor-sharp lines. The overall color scheme is dominated by Lamborghini's signature bright yellow or matte black main body, paired with black shadows, cold white metallic highlights, and a small amount of orange thermal reflection—restrained, sophisticated, and dangerous.
[8-11s] The camera continues to accelerate, sweeping past the sharp curves of the car's side, diving towards the wheels and tires, shuttling close to the ground at high speed. Wheel rotation, brake calipers, carbon fiber side skirts, air ducts, door cut lines, and rear aerodynamic structures flash by sequentially. The camera movement should feel like being dragged forward by an uncontrollable violent speed, continuously diving, circling the side, pressing close to the ground, and brushing past the folded surfaces and edges of the car's seams, maintaining an extremely strong first-person thrill. The camera language emphasizes the oppressive feeling of mechanical bestiality; avoid gentleness or graceful cruising. It should look like an enraged supercar tearing through the air.
[11-13s] The camera rushes forward rapidly once more, and the entire Lamborghini body is fully established in motion: the wedge-shaped low profile, sharp light clusters, exaggerated intake structures, sculpted side curves, wide wheel set, and extremely aggressive stance are all clearly formed. The camera can briefly sweep along the roof or side at high speed, then pull back to the front side to complete the final accumulation of momentum. The entire car should look like a bull that has truly completed its mechanical awakening, maximizing both the sense of power and brand recognition.
[13-15s] The shot concludes with a low-angle, front-side hero shot of the car. A complete Lamborghini supercar is either stably charging forward or has just frozen in place. The body is extremely low, wide, and sharp, cutting through space like a blade. The paint reflection is cool and restrained. The background retains only a small amount of racetrack heat haze, airflow lines, tire afterimages, and speed ripples. The ending must be short, fierce, and oppressive, like declaring: Primal wildness, finally forged into the speed machine that is Lamborghini.
Sound Design: The opening uses low-frequency energy pulses, the bull's heavy footsteps, snorting, skin grazing the wind, face-close wind shear, and air compression sounds; when moving to the eyes and horns, add a very subtle, sharp, and restrained sound of air convergence and a metallic light blade transition sound; after entering the Lamborghini details, amplify the sound of metal grazing the wind, airflow sliding over the paint surface, wheel rotation, carbon fiber vibration, subtle brake system sounds, light cluster activation, and spatial whoosh; the ending emphasizes tire pressure on the ground, the car body settling stably, the aftershock of air being cut, and a low-frequency convergence feeling. No background music throughout.
Special Controls: Lock the brand aesthetic to Lamborghini's coolness, sharpness, aggressiveness, mechanical bestiality, and extreme speed aesthetics; the camera movement must be continuous and smooth; every segment must have a clear visual upgrade; actions are reasonable, transitions are natural, with no stuttering or jumping; avoid low-quality cyberpunk, cheap mecha transformation feeling, or ordinary sports car promotional video quality. It must resemble a high-end creative advertisement for a top-tier supercar brand.

entries.title: Cinematic Trailer Style Video Generation
entries.description: A detailed, multi-shot prompt for Seedance 2.0 used to create a cinematic trailer-style video. The prompt specifies camera movements, scene transitions (from illustration to realism), and overall style parameters.
entries.prompt:
[0s–3s]: （ image1 ）A continuous slow push-in that never stops — zooming toward the center of a 19th-century Grimm-style storybook illustration of a deep dark spruce forest, As the camera moves closer, the illustration begins to malfunction, The trees sway in a wind that should not be possible inside a drawing. 

[3s–5.5s]: ( image2 ) The zoom continues without interruption. The illustrated begins to soften and dissolve from the center outward, as if a mist is seeping through the paper and replacing the drawing from within. As the camera keeps pushing forward, this zone of realism expands outward in a controlled, organic spread. The warm cream-sepia illustration gradually drains away into cold desaturated blue-green. The drawn surface at the edges briefly wavers and thins like damp paper giving way to moisture, then quietly dissolves into the same realistic forest texture. No abrupt morphing, no multiple competing distortions — just a single eerie replacement, as if the illustration is being overtaken by a real forest through a veil of mist. By 5.5 seconds, the camera is moving fully inside the real forest, and the drawing has completely vanished. 

[5.5s–11s]: ( image3 ) The forward motion gently eases into a continuous upward drift without a cut, as if the camera is being lifted through the real forest in one smooth arc. It rises between the trunks and passes through the lower branches, gradually clearing the canopy — not soaring too high, but just enough to reveal the breadth of the dark Nordic forest under flat grey light. The motion remains calm and deliberate, with a subtle floating quality, allowing the forest to breathe onscreen. The camera then begins a slow, natural transition from vertical ascent into a shallow backward glide, as if searching for the road beyond the trees. 

[11s–15s]: ( image4 ) The same movement continues seamlessly. The camera glides forward and gently descends out of the forest edge toward the road, settling into a low eye-level perspective near the tarmac. In one unbroken motion, it arrives at an extreme wide shot with the horizon stable and the road stretching dead straight into a grey-white vanishing point. The same boxy vintage sedan is already in frame, driving steadily away, growing smaller in the mist. Fallen pine needles drift faintly across the wet surface. The mist thickens gradually ahead. 

Global style: 35mm tungsten film, anamorphic, fine grain, cinematic. Desaturated blue-green midtones, crushed blacks, flat overcast diffusion. Smooth continuous camera motion, sharp details, stable horizon, natural proportions. First two shots transition from antique illustration warmth to cold cinematic realism. No text, no typography, no digital effects.

entries.prompt: 在儿童房的地板上，一个迷你女孩骑着一块小滑板，贴着地面飞驰。画面比例如此巨大，以至于真人大小的玩具和家具都显得无比巨大。镜头从低角度紧随其后，以类似一镜到底的镜头不断向背景移动。影片运用了超广角镜头、动态模糊、景深和电影级光影效果。速度分三个阶段逐渐加快。第一阶段，她高速穿过狭窄的通道，如同乐高城市建筑间的峡谷，在积木间灵活穿梭。第二阶段，一个巨大的球从前方滚向她，她滑进球与墙壁之间的狭小缝隙，险险躲过掉落的积木，并从一辆行驶中的迷你汽车的轮胎间擦身而过。在第三阶段，她从即将被风合上的图画书书页缝隙中破空而出，从摇晃的毛绒玩具腋下钻过，最后跃入即将关闭的玩具箱盖上的小缝隙，以最快的速度消失在黑暗的远方。这是一段惊险刺激、扣人心弦的视频，充满了一系列惊险的逃脱场面。视频场景设定在一个逼真的儿童房内，运用微缩视角营造出身临其境、如同游乐设施般的体验，充分利用了巨大的障碍物和狭小的缝隙。
entries.translated_prompt: On the floor of a child's room, a miniature girl rides a small skateboard, speeding close to the ground. The scale of the picture is so vast that life-sized toys and furniture appear immense. The camera follows closely from a low angle, continuously moving toward the background in a single-shot style. The film uses an ultra-wide-angle lens, dynamic blur, depth of field, and cinematic lighting effects. The speed gradually increases in three stages. In the first stage, she speeds through narrow passages, like canyons between Lego city buildings, weaving flexibly between the blocks. In the second stage, a giant ball rolls toward her from the front, and she slides into the narrow gap between the ball and the wall, narrowly avoiding falling blocks, and brushes past the tires of a moving miniature car. In the third stage, she bursts out from the gap between the pages of a picture book about to be closed by the wind, ducks under the armpit of a swaying plush toy, and finally leaps into the small gap on the lid of a toy box that is about to close, disappearing into the dark distance at the fastest speed. This is a thrilling, suspenseful video, full of a series of daring escape scenes. The video scene is set in a realistic child's room, using a miniature perspective to create an immersive, ride-like experience, fully utilizing the huge obstacles and narrow gaps.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Transformation Scene
entries.description: A detailed, single-take 15-second prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a man in a wasteland undergoing a violent, glowing transformation into an armored, horned figure with electrical arcs and a miniature black hole effect.
entries.prompt:
65mm IMAX, ultra-wide anamorphic lens, heavy film grain, strong lens flares. Eclipse-like atmosphere with dense gray fog. Only light source is an internal orange-red glow from the character, like a dying star.
Single-take 15s:
A dust-covered man stands alone in a wasteland. Handheld camera circles him in a 360° orbit with slight shake from heat. He slowly raises his hand—fingertips turn semi-transparent, air distorts.
His body convulses under pressure. Glowing golden cracks spread beneath his skin, bones crack. Purple-black smoke with blue electrical arcs bursts from his spine. Deep fractures leak liquid gold.
Floating metal debris is pulled toward him. Rusted black armor plates slam into his body with sparks, forming uneven armor—cracked shoulders and a chest plate revealing a molten core.
Red metal spreads across his face, forming a mask. His eyes collapse, then ignite with blue electric light, one flickering. Two large black horns emerge with faint purple flames.
Final: he raises his hand, forming a blue flame like a miniature black hole. He slams the ground—spiraling gravity shockwave destroys nearby ruins. Silence. Broken black wings extend. He lifts his head, blue eyes glowing through the fog.

entries.translated_prompt: A panoramic, level-fixed shot of a desolate gray beach. Mist spreads forward from the deep background. The outlines of Gothic architecture are faintly visible in the mist. The beach ground is covered with fine gray gravel and charred debris. The overall tone is extremely low-saturation, cold gray, and oppressive. A bionic heroine (wearing a white formal suit, silver mechanical neck armor and prosthetic arm, black ponytail, golden gear earrings, red lips, with cinematic realism and stable facial features throughout) stands in the center of the frame. Her suit is slowly billowed by the sea breeze. Her silver prosthetic arm holds a staff vertically. Three rings at the top of the staff burn with orange-red energy. The energy light casts a warm orange contour light on the front of the heroine's white suit. Low, epic background music slowly unfolds in a wide sound field, interweaving with the sizzling sound of burning energy and heavy breathing. The camera pulls back. The heroine's silver prosthetic arm suddenly strikes the staff against the sand, and the impact kicks up a large amount of gray dust that scatters around. The dust forms a translucent golden cloud in the side backlight. Three orange-red energy rings detach from the top of the staff, hover in the air, and rapidly accelerate their rotation. Each ring drags a complete orange-red light trail behind it as it spins. The heroine's prosthetic arm suddenly raises high, signaling an attack. Her cloak dramatically unfolds backward with the arm movement. Strands of her ponytail are lifted forward by the impact airflow. The heavy thud of the staff hitting the ground, the sound of metal vibration, and the sound of wind swirling sand simultaneously roar in. A rapid push-in low-angle close-up. The heroine's silver prosthetic arm's index finger suddenly swings upward into the sky. Golden flames leap and burn on the precise metal fingertip. Blue and white electric arcs spread upward along the prosthetic arm's joints, merging with the flames at the fingertip. Huge mechanical structures in the background begin to collapse. Metal components tumble and fall in the firelight. The sharp whistling sound of the fingertip cutting through the air and the high-frequency energy convergence hum suddenly pierce the scene. A rapid panoramic horizontal tracking shot. The first giant energy ring, like a flying saw, cuts a complete orange-red arc of fire in the air at extremely high speed. The arc's wake forms a continuously glowing trajectory in the dark sky, instantly slicing into the side armor of a giant steel airship. At the moment of penetration, the armor plate explodes outward along the cutting line. Orange-red magma sprays outward from the incision. The harsh friction sound of the saw blade cutting metal and the sound of sparks and explosions tear the sound field. A top-down tracking shot presses down. The energy ring penetrates the side wing and continues to cut into the ship's core cabin. The core is instantly triggered into a chain explosion upon penetration. The first wave of explosion expands spherically, and the second wave longitudinally tears along the hull's texture. Metal fragments, accompanied by thick black smoke columns and red firelight, rapidly spread around. The sound of metal tearing and the distant low-frequency roar interweave into an overwhelming sound wave. A fixed mid-shot, level view. The second energy ring whistles towards a giant bipedal walking mecha on the ground. The orange light trail generated by the ring's rotation during flight forms an extremely strong cold-warm contrast with the dark background. The color saturation of the screen suddenly increases at this moment. The low-frequency hum of the energy ring rapidly spinning continuously vibrates in the frame. A shaking mid-shot, low-angle view. The energy ring precisely hits the core of the mecha's left knee joint. A huge fireball erupts outward from inside the joint. The explosion's shockwave pushes the mecha's entire upper body backward. A waterfall of sparks sprays outward from the explosion point, covering a ten-meter radius. The camera shakes violently with the impact. The heavy sound of metal collision and the continuous crackling sound of the mecha's damaged electrical sparks roar in amidst the vibration. A panoramic side shift. The mecha's right knee is subsequently hit by the third energy ring, completely paralyzing it. The massive body slowly tilts to the right after both knees are destroyed. Armor plates continuously fall off during the tilting process. The outlines of the Gothic spire architecture in the misty background tremble with the mecha's collapsing vibration. The dull, colossal sound of the mecha finally hitting the ground and the sound of debris falling scatter from near to far. The BGM rhythm reaches its first climax at this moment.

entries.translated_prompt: Full panoramic, level, fixed shot of a desolate gray beach. Mist spreads forward from the deep background. Gothic architectural outlines are faintly visible in the mist. The beach ground is covered with fragmented gray gravel and charred debris. The overall tone is extremely low saturation, cold gray, and oppressive. A bionic heroine (white formal suit, silver mechanical neck armor and prosthetic arm, black ponytail, golden gear earrings, red lips, cinematic realistic facial features that remain stable throughout) stands in the center of the frame. Her suit is slowly billowed by the sea wind. Her silver prosthetic arm holds a staff vertically. Three rings at the top of the staff burn with orange-red energy. The energy light casts a warm orange contour light on the front of the heroine's white suit. A low, epic underscore slowly unfolds in the wide sound field, interwoven with the sizzling sound of burning energy and heavy breathing. The camera pulls back. The heroine's silver prosthetic arm slams the staff into the sand, the impact generating a large burst of gray dust that scatters outwards. The dust forms a translucent golden cloud in the side backlight. Three orange-red energy rings detach from the top of the staff, hover in the air, and rapidly accelerate their rotation. Each rotating ring trails a complete orange-red light streak. The heroine's prosthetic arm abruptly raises, signaling an attack. Her cloak snaps backward with the arm movement, and her ponytail hair is lifted forward by the impact airflow. The heavy thud of the staff hitting the ground, metallic vibration, and the sound of wind sweeping the sand simultaneously rush in. Rapid push-in close-up from a low angle. The heroine's silver prosthetic arm index finger violently swings upwards. Golden flames leap and burn at the precise metallic fingertip. Blue and white electric arcs spread up the prosthetic arm joints to the fingertip, merging with the flames. In the background, a massive mechanical structure begins to collapse. Metal components tumble and fall in the firelight. The sharp whistling sound of the fingertip cutting through the air and the high-frequency energy convergence hum suddenly pierce the scene. Rapid horizontal tracking shot of the panorama. The first giant energy ring, like a flying saw, cuts a complete orange-red arc of firelight in the air at an extremely high rotational speed. The arc trail forms a continuously glowing track in the dark gray sky, instantly slicing into the side armor of a colossal steel spaceship. The moment of penetration, the armor plate explodes outwards along the cutting line. Orange-red magma erupts from the incision. The piercing friction sound of the saw blade cutting metal and the explosive sound of sparks tearing the sound field. Overhead tracking shot presses down. The energy ring penetrates the side wing and continues to cut into the ship's core cabin. The moment the core is pierced triggers a chain explosion. The first wave of explosion expands spherically, and the second tears vertically along the ship's texture. Metal fragments, accompanied by thick black smoke and red firelight, spread rapidly outwards. The sound of tearing metal and distant low-frequency rumbling interweave into an overwhelming sound wave. Fixed medium shot at eye level. The second energy ring whistles towards a giant bipedal walking mech on the ground. The orange light trail generated by the ring's rotation creates a strong cold-warm contrast with the dark background. The color saturation of the image suddenly increases at this moment. The low-frequency hum of the energy ring spinning at high speed continuously vibrates in the frame. Shaking medium shot from a low angle. The energy ring precisely hits the core of the mech's left knee joint. A huge fireball erupts outwards from inside the joint. The explosion shockwave pushes the entire upper body of the mech backward. A waterfall of sparks sprays outwards from the explosion point, covering a radius of ten meters. The camera shakes violently with the impact. The heavy sound of metal collision and the continuous crackling of electrical sparks from the damaged mech roar into the scene amidst the vibration. Panoramic side shift. The mech's right knee is subsequently hit by the third energy ring, completely paralyzing it. The massive body slowly tilts to the right after both knees are destroyed. Armor plates continuously detach during the tilting process. The outlines of the Gothic spire architecture in the misty background tremble with the collapse of the mech. The dull, colossal thud of the mech finally hitting the ground and the sound of falling rubble dissipate from near to far. The BGM rhythm reaches its first climax at this moment.

entries.prompt: 核心场景：高级餐厅烛光晚餐，丈夫为妻子送上定制高奢降噪耳机，妻子感动落泪，完成佩戴的浪漫瞬间 镜头 1（0-1s）✨ 氛围铺垫 画面：俯拍高级餐厅全景，暖黄烛光摇曳，水晶杯折射柔光，黑丝绒桌布上摆着精致法餐，妻子穿着丝绒裙低头切牛排，丈夫温柔凝视她，指尖摩挲着丝绒礼盒 音效：餐厅轻柔爵士 BGM，刀叉轻碰瓷盘的细碎声 台词：丈夫（低沉温柔）：“亲爱的，今天辛苦你了。” 镜头 2（2-3s）🎧 惊喜揭晓 画面：特写丈夫缓缓推过丝绒礼盒，妻子抬眼愣住，睫毛轻颤；丈夫打开盒盖，定制款高奢耳机（金属质感 + 刻字细节）在烛光下泛着冷冽高级光 音效：BGM 渐弱，礼盒开合的轻响，妻子倒吸一口气的气音 台词：妻子（哽咽）：“这是……？” 丈夫：“你总说加班戴耳机吵，这个，只听得到我的声音。” 镜头 3（4-5s）😭 情绪爆发 画面：近景怼脸拍妻子，眼泪顺着脸颊滑落，抬手捂住嘴，眼神里满是惊喜与感动；丈夫伸手轻轻拭去她的泪 音效：BGM 升调，加入温柔钢琴音，妻子细微的抽噎声 台词：妻子（哭着笑）：“你怎么知道我想要这个很久了……” 镜头 4（6-7s）💞 浪漫收尾 画面：特写丈夫拿起耳机，小心为妻子戴上，指尖轻触她的耳廓；妻子闭眼微笑，耳机贴合耳际的瞬间，镜头拉远到两人交握的手，烛光将影子晕成温柔的轮廓 音效：BGM 达到高潮后渐弱，只剩两人的呼吸声 台词：丈夫（轻声）：“以后，世界再吵，我都在你耳边。”
entries.translated_prompt: Core scene: Candlelight dinner at a high-end restaurant, husband presents his wife with custom luxury noise-canceling headphones, wife is moved to tears, completing the romantic moment of wearing them. Shot 1 (0-1s) ✨ Atmosphere setting. Visuals: Overhead shot of the high-end restaurant, warm yellow candlelight flickering, crystal glasses reflecting soft light, exquisite French cuisine on a black velvet tablecloth, wife in a velvet dress cutting steak, husband gazing at her tenderly, fingers stroking the velvet gift box. Husband: "You always said it was noisy wearing headphones while working overtime. With this, you'll only hear my voice." Shot 3 (4-5s) 😭 Emotional climax. Sound effects: BGM rises in pitch, adding gentle piano music, wife's subtle sobs. Dialogue: Wife (crying and laughing): "How did you know I've wanted this for a long time..." Visuals: Close-up of the husband picking up the headphones, carefully putting them on his wife, fingertips lightly touching her earlobe; wife closes her eyes and smiles, the moment the headphones fit her ears, the camera pulls back to their clasped hands, the candlelight blurring their shadows into a gentle outline. entries.title: High-Speed Cinematic Action Scene with Web-Slinging

The scene features a male character using high-tension webs to swing and accelerate between skyscrapers during the golden hour, emphasizing realistic physics, dynamic movement sequences (acceleration, jump, fall, explosive ascent, re-acceleration), and a close, tracking camera perspective.
entries.prompt:
リファレンス画像の<<<Image1>>>  を完全に維持したまま、超リアルで映画のような高速アクション動画を生成してください。

ゴールデンアワーの暖かい光に包まれた高層ビル群の中、男性がクモの糸のような高張力ウェブを使って、ビルの間を超高速で突き進むシネマティックアクション。すべての動きはビルとビルの間、外壁や窓のすぐ近く、屋上ラインより下〜ギリギリ付近で行うこと。開けた空に長時間出ないこと。

【アクション構成（重要）】

最初は“前方加速”から始まる。
<<<Image1>>>  は前方上方向の建物に向かってウェブを発射し、その張力で一気に前へ引き込まれ、ビルの隙間を一直線に超高速で突き進む。壁や窓のすぐ横をかすめながら進み、強いスピードと奥行きを見せる。

その後、勢いを乗せたまま大きくジャンプし、ビルの隙間を一気に「ボーン」と飛び越える。ここでは一瞬だけ開けた空間に出るが、すぐに次のアクションへ移行する。

ジャンプ後、キャラクターは一度バランスを崩し、落下し始める。重力に引かれて急激に下へ落ちるリアルな落下を描写すること。ここで一瞬のスリルを作る。

落下中、<<<Image1>>>  は即座に上方向の建物の縁や構造物に向かってウェブを発射し、空中で引っ掛ける。その瞬間、強烈な張力によって体が一気に上方向へ引き上げられ、爆発的に上昇する。

その後、再び前方に向かってウェブを発射し、前進加速へ戻る。

ウェブの使用回数は全体で2〜3回に抑え、1つ1つのアクションをしっかり見せること。

【動きの特徴】
すべての動きは慣性、重力、張力に基づいたリアルな物理挙動にすること。減速やホバリングは禁止。常にスピードの流れが途切れず、「加速 → 跳躍 → 落下 → 爆発的上昇 → 再加速」という明確な緩急を作る。

【身体表現】
ウェブを発射する瞬間、片腕を鋭く前方または上方に突き出す。加速中は体が引っ張られて伸び、脚は後方へ流れる。ジャンプ時は全身で勢いを乗せ、落下時は重力に従い自然に崩れる。引き上げ時は体が一気に上へ持ち上がるダイナミックな動きにする。

【カメラ】
カメラは基本的に前進方向の追従ショットを維持し、キャラクターの後方または近距離から追いかける。常に奥へ進む動きを強調し、スピードとパースの変化を最大化する。サイドアングルは使用しない。

【演出】
ガラス外壁の反射、流れる窓のライン、強いモーションブラー、風圧による服の揺れ、光のフレアを活用し、圧倒的なスピードと没入感を演出する。壁との距離は常に近く、衝突ギリギリのスリルを強調する。

【感情】
集中、興奮、アドレナリン、自信、そして一瞬の危機（落下）からのリカバリーによる高揚感を表現する。

entries.translated_prompt:
Generate an ultra-realistic, cinematic, high-speed action video while completely maintaining the reference image <<<Image1>>>.

A cinematic action scene where a male character speeds through skyscrapers using high-tension, spider-web-like material during the warm light of the golden hour. All movements must occur between buildings, very close to exterior walls and windows, and below or barely at the rooftop line. Do not remain in the open sky for long periods.

[Action Sequence (Important)]

The sequence begins with “forward acceleration.”
<<<Image1>>> fires a web towards a building in the forward-upward direction, and the tension pulls him forward instantly, speeding him straight through the gap between buildings. He proceeds while grazing the walls and windows, showing strong speed and depth.

Next, maintaining momentum, he executes a large jump, leaping across the gap between buildings in a single bound. He is briefly in the open space here but immediately transitions to the next action.

After the jump, the character momentarily loses balance and begins to fall. Depict a realistic fall, rapidly dropping due to gravity. This creates a momentary thrill.

While falling, <<<Image1>>> immediately fires a web towards the edge or structure of a building in the upward direction, hooking it mid-air. At that instant, the intense tension violently pulls his body upward, resulting in an explosive ascent.

He then fires a web forward again, returning to forward acceleration.

Limit the use of webs to 2–3 times in total, ensuring each action is clearly visible.

[Movement Characteristics]
All movements must adhere to realistic physics based on inertia, gravity, and tension. Deceleration or hovering is prohibited. The flow of speed must be continuous, creating a clear dynamic rhythm of “acceleration → leap → fall → explosive ascent → re-acceleration.”

[Physical Expression]
At the moment of firing the web, one arm is sharply thrust forward or upward. During acceleration, the body is stretched and elongated by the pull, with the legs trailing behind. During the jump, the whole body carries momentum, and during the fall, the body collapses naturally according to gravity. During the pull-up, the body is lifted upward in a dynamic motion.

[Camera]
The camera should primarily maintain a tracking shot in the direction of forward movement, following the character from behind or close-up. Constantly emphasize the movement into the depth, maximizing the sense of speed and perspective change. Do not use side angles.

[Direction]
Utilize reflections on glass curtain walls, flowing window lines, strong motion blur, clothing fluttering due to wind pressure, and lens flares to create an overwhelming sense of speed and immersion. The distance to the walls should always be close, emphasizing the thrill of near-collision.

[Emotion]
Express concentration, excitement, adrenaline, confidence, and the exhilaration derived from recovering from a momentary crisis (the fall).

Overall, prioritize ultra-realism, cinematic quality, high-speed straight movement, strong depth, dynamic action rhythm, and physical realism.

entries.title: Impossible Camera Move through a Southeast Asian Night Market
entries.description: A detailed, multi-shot prompt for a 15-second continuous, impossible camera move through a dense Southeast Asian night market, focusing on photorealistic ground-to-aerial cinematography, wet stone reflections, and intense orange/red lighting. The prompt specifies camera movements, audio cues, and emotional pacing for each shot.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 15s / single continuous impossible camera move / no dialogue
STYLE: Dense Southeast Asian night market, wet stone, steam and fire, orange lantern light, photorealistic ground-to-aerial cinematic 8K
Shot 01 (0:00–2:00): Camera starts at ankle level. Forest of feet — sandals, bare feet, flip flops on glistening wet stone. Market sounds overwhelming. Camera weaves between legs like water. Audio: Wet footsteps, distant vendor calls, sizzling.

Shot 02 (2:00–3:30): Camera rises slowly past steaming woks. A gas flame bursts at exact eye level — camera briefly engulfed in orange fire then emerges through it, uncut. Audio: Gas flame WHOMP. Wok sizzle. Shot 03 (3:30–5:00): Camera weaves through hanging lanterns at mid-height, skimming past them like a moth navigating. Red and orange light strobing across the lens. Audio: Lantern chains clinking. Crowd murmur. Shot 04 (5:00–6:30): Camera dips suddenly under a low table. A child has fallen asleep on a bag under here. Quiet pocket of stillness inside the chaos. Camera lingers one beat. Audio: Noise muffled. Child's quiet breathing.
Shot 05 (6:30–8:00): Camera rises back up through the smoke of a charcoal grill — lens briefly obscured by smoke, then emerges above the stall canopy level. Audio: Charcoal crackle. Smoke hiss.
Shot 06 (8:00–10:00): Camera continues rising — now above rooftop level. The market reveals itself as an endless orange lantern sea stretching to the horizon. Camera tilts slowly, taking in the full scale. Audio: Market sounds fading to a low ambient hum.
Shot 07 (10:00–12:00): Camera begins descending back down — targeting a single stall at the market edge. A lone vendor counting coins. Everything closing around them. Audio: Distant vendor calls dying out one by one. Shot 08 (12:00–13:30): Camera settles at the vendor's hands. Close on coins being stacked methodically. One lantern swaying above them. Audio: Coin clinks. Wind in the lantern.
Shot 09 (13:30–15:00): Camera tilts up slowly to the vendor's face. They look up — directly into the camera. Hold. Fade to black. Audio: Last coin placed. Silence.
STYLE NOTES: Ground level feels claustrophobic and overwhelming. The aerial shot is the emotional exhale. Warm orange and red throughout — deepening to amber at the end. Wet stone reflections throughout. Real fire and real smoke, no CG substitutes. 8K.

entries.prompt: A stylized cinematic 3D animation set on a nighttime city street with wet reflective pavement, soft street lights, and neon glow. An anthropomorphic white rabbit magician stands at the center, wearing a black tailcoat, white shirt, black bow tie, and a black top hat, surrounded by a loose semicircle of onlookers. The rabbit performs smooth, professional card handling with a standard 52-card deck. The deck is fanned evenly at chest height, all cards visible and unique. A hand from the camera selects one card from the fan — the Ace of Hearts. The rabbit takes the same card and holds it clearly facing the camera. The rabbit flicks the card lightly. The Ace of Hearts begins to glow at the edges, then disintegrates into fine red and gold particles. The particles form a controlled, continuous stream with motion trails, flowing forward across the street. The camera follows the particle stream as it travels toward a large glass building facade. Upon impact, a point of light appears and expands outward in a grid-like pattern across the glass surface. The entire building facade activates, and a massive glowing Ace of Hearts forms across it, bright and clearly defined, with subtle pulsing light. After a brief hold, the giant Ace of Hearts breaks apart into particles again. The particles reverse direction, streaming back through the air toward the rabbit. The rabbit steps forward and reaches into the air, catching the incoming particles. In close-up, the particles compress and reform into a single solid playing card in the rabbit’s hand — the Ace of Hearts, unchanged. The rabbit presents the card toward the camera. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the crowd reacting and clapping, while the city lights and reflections remain vivid in the background.

entries.prompt:
制作一个以猫咪在深夜食堂制作手作拉面为主题的短视频，电影级调色（暖色调，充满烟火气），细腻颗粒，浅景深。

场景设定为城市街头一家充满和式风情的深夜拉面摊位前。背景有温暖的黄色灯笼、木质吧台，以及远处模糊的街道霓虹灯。
视频内容需要按照以下步骤分镜展示：

揉面与切面： 猫咪穿着小围裙，有节奏地在撒了面粉的木质案板上揉捏面团，然后用一把锋利的面刀将面团切成均匀的细面条。

煮面与甩干： 猫咪将面条抖散投入沸腾的大锅中，几秒后用竹漏勺将面条捞起，熟练地在空中用力甩两下，将多余的水分甩干。

调汤底： 猫咪拿着一个精致的长柄勺，从熬制浓郁的白色骨汤锅里舀出一勺汤，缓缓倒入一个深蓝色的陶瓷大碗中。

摆盘： 猫咪用筷子整齐地放入煮好的面条，再依次在面条上摆放两片厚实的叉烧、半个溏心蛋、几片海苔和葱花，动作精细。

结尾： 结尾镜头猫咪师傅将这碗热气腾腾、冒着白烟的拉面轻轻推向镜头，并微微点头示意。

要求：

视频风格： 写实，画面清晰，中景。

声音（ASMR）： 整个视频不需语音旁白，但要放大：切面时的“哒哒”声、面条入水的“哗啦”声、甩干水分的“飒飒”声、热汤入碗的流动声等。

背景音乐： 背景有轻柔、舒缓的萨克斯风音乐，营造静谧的深夜氛围。

Plating: The cat neatly places the cooked noodles into the bowl with chopsticks, then sequentially arranges two thick slices of char siu, half a soft-boiled egg, a few pieces of seaweed, and scallions on top, with precise movements.

entries.title: Cinematic Skiing Video Generation

entries.prompt:
Please generate a skiing video based on the provided reference image. The overall style should be bright, crisp, full of athletic energy, with smooth motion and cinematic camera language. Timeline and shot design as follows:

0–3s: The character from the image smiles at the camera in the snow. Subtle camera shake with snowflakes falling. Background wind noise gradually increases, and a fast-moving flow of wind and snow appears in the frame.

3–5s: Fast cut to an extreme close-up of the character's feet as the ski bindings snap shut, crushing the snow. Simultaneously, the camera rises, transitioning to an overhead view of a steep snowy slope, showing a clear incline as the sense of speed is about to explode.

5–8s: The character slides down from a height at high speed. Shot 1 is a side-front medium follow shot, with the body leaning forward and movements being sharp; Shot 2 cuts to an overhead shot as the steep slope extends downward, with the snow track lines stretching rapidly, creating a strong sense of speed.

8–11s: A series of rapid camera cuts. A low-angle ground shot shows the skis skimming the snow surface as snow powder is kicked up at high speed; a wide shot shows the character making a beautiful turn on the steep slope, their body and the snow line forming a smooth curve.

11–13s: The camera returns to a front-view follow shot as the character charges toward the lens at high speed, performing a sharp turn at close range, sending a massive spray of snow into the air.

13–15s: A large amount of snow powder splashes directly onto the lens, covering the screen in a white snow mist. The camera briefly loses focus before freezing, leaving a strong dynamic afterimage. Its glowing red eyes ignite from the headlights, and it releases a blazing stream of fire into the stormy air. [Context]: A winding, rain-drenched road cutting through a dense, fog-covered pine forest. Towering trees loom on both sides, partially hidden by thick mist. entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Video Prompt: Eastern Dark Mythology Sky Burial
entries.description: A detailed, 15-second, single-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.0, focusing on Eastern dark mythology, sky burial imagery, megalophobia, and Chinese surreal disaster landscapes. The prompt specifies color palette, camera movements, shot types (extreme close-up, pull-back, wide angle), and sound design, detailing the progression of the scene from falling feathers on a bronze bell to the slow rising of a colossal sky burial deity.
entries.prompt: 15秒，一镜到底，东方黑暗神话，天葬意象，巨物恐惧，中国式超现实灾厄景观，无对白，无旁白。整体色调为冷灰、骨白、旧金、暗红，天空低压，空气中飘落大量羽毛，像雪一样持续下坠。 0:00–0:03：极近特写开场。85mm长焦微距，浅景深。骨白羽毛缓慢落在一只巨大的青铜铃铛表面，铃铛半埋在黑色冻土中，表面布满古老符纹和干裂血锈。羽毛落下时，铃铛内部传来极低频的闷响，地面细小石粒震动。冷顶光，阴影纯黑。 0:03–0:08：镜头贴地后拉并微微抬升。35mm，稳定滑行。黑色荒原上立着无数倾斜木桩与残破祭幡，地面覆盖一层羽毛。镜头掠过几只巨大的枯鹿角，它们最初像普通遗骸，随后才意识到那其实是一个更庞大存在的一部分。随着镜头继续后退，一层层暗红色祭布从地面被缓慢拉起，布面沾满灰尘、蜡油和雨蚀痕迹，边缘挂满青铜小铃。铃声极轻，却密集得令人不安。 0:08–0:12：镜头穿过一片塌陷的石门，冲出后豁然开阔。24mm广角，深焦。完整巨物现身：一尊埋伏在山谷中的天葬神像缓缓起身，身体由成百上千层沉重祭布、兽角、骨饰和巨大空洞面具组成，高度远超山脊。它起身时，成片羽毛被气流卷向天空，像倒流的大雪。远处的废弃寺庙与经幡在它脚边显得极其渺小。天空惨白，巨物上部形成压迫剪影。 0:12–0:15：镜头极慢前推。50mm。巨像胸前悬挂的巨大空面具缓缓转向镜头，面具五官空无一物，只有眼眶深处浮现极微弱暗红火点。所有铃铛同时轻响一下，羽毛骤然停止下落，画面边缘逐渐失光，黑场。音效：低频风压、远处群铃、巨大布料拖拽、最后一声空洞钟鸣后静默。
entries.translated_prompt: 15 seconds, one-shot, Eastern dark mythology, sky burial imagery, megalophobia, Chinese surreal disaster landscape, no dialogue, no narration. The overall color palette is cold gray, bone white, old gold, and dark red. The sky is low-pressure, and a large amount of feathers are falling in the air, continuously descending like snow. 0:00–0:03: Extreme close-up opening. 85mm telephoto macro, shallow depth of field. Bone-white feathers slowly fall onto the surface of a giant bronze bell, which is half-buried in black frozen soil, its surface covered with ancient runes and cracked blood rust. As the feathers fall, a very low-frequency muffled sound comes from inside the bell, and small stones on the ground vibrate. Cold top light, pure black shadows. 0:03–0:08: The camera pulls back close to the ground and slightly lifts. 35mm, stable glide. Countless tilted wooden stakes and broken prayer flags stand on the black wasteland, and the ground is covered with a layer of feathers. The camera sweeps past several large, withered deer antlers, which initially look like ordinary remains, but are then realized to be part of a much larger entity. As the camera continues to retreat, layers of dark red sacrificial cloth are slowly pulled up from the ground. The cloth is stained with dust, wax, and traces of rain erosion, and the edges are hung with small bronze bells. The sound of the bells is extremely light, yet densely unsettling. 0:08–0:12: The camera passes through a collapsed stone gate and bursts out into a sudden expanse. 24mm wide-angle, deep focus. The complete giant object appears: a sky burial deity statue, ambushed in the valley, slowly rises. Its body is composed of hundreds of layers of heavy sacrificial cloth, animal horns, bone ornaments, and a huge empty mask, its height far exceeding the ridge. As it rises, large patches of feathers are swept into the sky by the airflow, like snow flowing backward. The distant abandoned temple and prayer flags appear extremely small at its feet. The sky is pale white, and the upper part of the giant object forms an oppressive silhouette. 0:12–0:15: The camera slowly pushes forward. 50mm. The huge empty mask hanging on the giant statue's chest slowly turns towards the camera. The mask's features are empty, with only a faint, dark red spark appearing deep within the eye sockets. All the bells chime lightly at the same time, the feathers suddenly stop falling, the edges of the screen gradually lose light, and the screen goes black. Sound effects: low-frequency wind pressure, distant cluster of bells, dragging of huge fabric, followed by silence after the last hollow chime.

entries.prompt: A scavenger crawls to the top of a dune ridge on his stomach and looks over. Below in the basin, an entire buried city is surfacing, buildings pushing up through the sand slowly, like something breathing out. He doesn't move. Doesn't radio. entries.title: Urban Time-Shift Martial Arts Epic: Cat Ninja vs. Tiger Warrior
entries.description: A highly detailed, action-packed prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating an 'Urban Time-Shift Martial Arts Epic' video. It features a fight between a Cat Ninja and a White Tiger Warrior, transitioning the battle scene from 16th-century Rome's Trevi Fountain to 21st-century Venice's canals, emphasizing cinematic effects, speed, and a clash of dark shadow energy versus white martial aura.
entries.prompt:
都市時空穿越武道大片(Urban Time-Shift Martial Arts Epic)。頂級電影特效，極速剪輯節奏，強調力量、速度與守護意志的極限碰撞。視覺風格強烈對比：一方是暗影凝聚的東方巨龍能量，另一方是純白剛勁的武道氣場屏障。時空在戰鬥中撕裂重組。

【場景】
戰場從16世紀羅馬的特雷維噴泉開始——石雕神像、流動水池、燭光與月色交織；隨著戰鬥升級，空間逐漸扭曲破碎，最終延伸至21世紀的威尼斯運河——霓虹燈倒映水面，水氣與現代燈光交錯，歷史與現代重疊。

【角色】

橘貓忍者：穿黑色忍者裝束，身形敏捷，橘色毛髮在夜色中若隱若現，雙眼銳利發光，周身環繞暗影氣流。
白老虎武者：壯碩白虎，身穿跆拳道服與黑帶，肌肉線條分明，氣勢沉穩，周身環繞白色氣浪與震動波紋。

【分鏡腳本】

[00:00–00:03] 鏡頭1：古城開戰·速度試探
機位：高速滑軌＋手持混合運鏡(Dynamic Tracking + Handheld)。
畫面：特雷維噴泉前，水花飛濺。橘貓忍者瞬間消失又出現，殘影連續閃現；白老虎穩站原地，以最小動作格擋攻擊。拳腳碰撞間激起水柱與碎石，雕像表面出現裂痕。

[00:03–00:06] 鏡頭2：時空撕裂·場景轉換
機位：旋轉升空鏡頭(Spiral Rise Shot)。
畫面：兩者一次猛烈對撞，能量爆開——空間如玻璃碎裂。背景從古羅馬石雕快速扭曲，轉為威尼斯運河。水面翻湧，貢多拉劇烈晃動，霓虹燈在水中扭曲反射。
特寫：橘貓低吼，黑影氣流如煙翻騰；白虎踏水而立，腳下水面出現同心圓氣紋。

[00:06–00:11] 鏡頭3：絕技對轟·龍與氣場
機位：史詩級廣角全景(Epic Wide Shot)。
動作（同步爆發）：
橘貓忍者：雙爪結印猛然推出，暗影能量凝聚成一條巨大東方巨龍(Eastern Shadow Dragon)，龍鱗細節清晰，盤旋升空，張口咆哮，帶動水氣與霓虹光流席捲前方。
白老虎武者：雙掌前推，白色氣場屏障瞬間展開(White Martial Aura Barrier)，氣流層層擴散，如水波與震動波交織，穩定而厚重。
特效碰撞：巨龍猛烈撞擊氣場，爆發巨大衝擊波，水面炸裂升空，運河兩側建築玻璃震碎，霓虹燈閃爍失控。

[00:11–00:13] 鏡頭4：壓制與反擊
機位：快速推進鏡頭(Rapid Push-in)。
畫面：白色氣場出現裂紋，但白虎怒吼發力，肌肉繃緊，氣場瞬間反震。巨龍被撕裂一部分，黑影能量四散如煙。橘貓被震退，在水面滑行數米，濺起高牆般水浪。

[00:13–00:15] 鏡頭5：終局定格·對峙未完
機位：慢動作定格＋環繞(Freeze + Slow Orbit)。
畫面：威尼斯夜色中，水氣瀰漫。白老虎穩站水面中央，氣場緩緩收斂；橘貓半蹲於漂浮木板上，黑影氣流再次凝聚。兩者對視——戰意未熄。背景霓虹在水霧中閃爍，時空裂縫仍隱約可見，能量光點緩緩飄散。
entries.translated_prompt:
Urban Time-Shift Martial Arts Epic. Top-tier cinematic special effects, extremely fast editing pace, emphasizing the ultimate clash of power, speed, and the will to protect. Strong visual contrast: one side is the Eastern Giant Dragon energy condensed from shadows, the other is the pure white, rigid martial aura barrier. Time and space are torn and reassembled during the battle.

[Scene]
The battle begins at the Trevi Fountain in 16th-century Rome—stone statues, flowing water, interwoven candlelight and moonlight; as the battle escalates, space gradually twists and shatters, finally extending to the Venice Canal in the 21st century—neon lights reflecting on the water, water vapor and modern lighting intertwined, history and modernity overlapping.

[Characters]

Orange Cat Ninja: Wears black ninja attire, agile, orange fur faintly visible in the night, sharp, glowing eyes, surrounded by shadow energy currents.
White Tiger Warrior: A robust white tiger, wearing a Taekwondo uniform and black belt, clear muscle definition, calm demeanor, surrounded by white energy waves and vibration ripples.

[Storyboard]

[00:00–00:03] Shot 1: Ancient City Battle · Speed Test
Camera: High-speed dolly + handheld mixed cinematography (Dynamic Tracking + Handheld).
Visuals: In front of the Trevi Fountain, water splashes. The Orange Cat Ninja instantly disappears and reappears, continuous afterimages flashing; the White Tiger stands steady, blocking attacks with minimal movement. Water columns and shattered stones are kicked up during the clash of fists and feet, and cracks appear on the surface of the statues.

[00:03–00:06] Shot 2: Space-Time Tear · Scene Transition
Camera: Spiral Rise Shot.
Visuals: A fierce collision between the two, energy explodes—space shatters like glass. The background quickly twists from ancient Roman stone carvings to the Venice Canal. The water surface surges, gondolas shake violently, and neon lights reflect distortedly in the water.
Close-up: The Orange Cat growls, black shadow energy rolls like smoke; the White Tiger stands on the water, concentric ripples appear under its feet.

[00:06–00:11] Shot 3: Ultimate Technique Clash · Dragon and Aura
Camera: Epic Wide Shot.
Action (Simultaneous Burst):
Orange Cat Ninja: Claws form a seal and push forward suddenly, shadow energy condenses into a massive Eastern Shadow Dragon. The dragon scales are clearly detailed, spiraling into the sky, roaring with an open mouth, sweeping water vapor and neon light streams forward.
White Tiger Warrior: Palms push forward, a White Martial Aura Barrier instantly expands. The airflow spreads layer by layer, interwoven like water waves and vibration waves, stable and heavy.
Special Effects Collision: The Giant Dragon violently impacts the aura, erupting a huge shockwave. The water surface explodes into the sky, glass in buildings on both sides of the canal shatters, and neon lights flicker out of control.

[00:11–00:13] Shot 4: Suppression and Counterattack
Camera: Rapid Push-in.
Visuals: Cracks appear in the white aura, but the White Tiger roars and exerts force, muscles tensing, the aura instantly counter-vibrates. A part of the Giant Dragon is torn, black shadow energy scatters like smoke. The Orange Cat is knocked back, sliding several meters on the water, splashing a high wall of water.

[00:13–00:15] Shot 5: Final Freeze Frame · Standoff Unresolved
Camera: Freeze + Slow Orbit.
Visuals: In the Venice night, water vapor permeates the air. The White Tiger stands steadily in the center of the water, the aura slowly receding; the Orange Cat crouches on a floating wooden board, black shadow energy condensing again. They stare at each other—the will to fight remains. Background neon lights flicker in the mist, and the space-time rift is still faintly visible, energy light points slowly drifting away.

entries.title: Elemental Superheroes Battle Over Shattered City
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-stage prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a dynamic action scene featuring three elemental figures (lightning, fire, ice) battling above a shattered coastal megacity under a rotating superstorm, specifying the sequence of events, power activation, camera movement (dynamic orbit, snap zooming), and color logic.
entries.prompt:
Three figures suspended above a shattered coastal megacity under a rotating superstorm:

— a 30-year-old woman wreathed in living lightning, body threaded with branching electric veins, eyes glowing white-hot;

— a towering fire entity formed of molten armor and solar plasma, constantly shedding embers;

— a pale ice sovereign with crystalline skin and flowing frost structures orbiting her form.

Opening frame: medium tri-shot, all three hovering in perfect stillness, storm clouds spiraling around them — the city below already partially flooded and burning.

Hook at second two: all three activate simultaneously.

The storm wielder pulls lightning from the cloud system, the fire entity ignites into full solar output, and the ice sovereign freezes the surrounding atmosphere into expanding crystalline lattices.

The environment fractures into layered systems: lightning chains across buildings, firestorms ignite entire districts, and ice formations suspend debris mid-air.

Each character controls a domain:

— lightning creates branching shock networks across the skyline

— fire generates expanding heat waves and explosive pressure bursts

— ice locks entire sections of the battlefield into geometric suspension

Dynamic orbit camera circles the three-way collision, snap zooming into impact moments where elements clash — lightning striking frozen structures, fire vaporizing ice into explosive steam clouds.

Color logic: white-violet lightning arcs, deep orange fire cores, cobalt ice volumes — each occupying distinct zones of the frame.

Escalation builds as their powers begin interfering — thermal shockwaves fracture frozen structures, lightning supercharges vapor explosions.

Final beat: hard POV shift — camera becomes the collision point itself, plunging downward as all three forces converge into a single detonation wave that obliterates the city center.

Volumetric storm, fire, and ice particle systems interacting in real-time, cinematic destruction physics, 4K ultra-detail.

preview_videos.caption: Elemental Superheroes Battle Over Shattered City

entries.title: Wuxia Comedy: Cat Hero, Duck Scholar, and Husky Doctor
entries.description: A detailed, humorous prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating a Wuxia comedy video set in a traditional Chinese courtyard at night. The plot involves a Cat Hero interrogating a Duck Scholar (who is holding a melatonin capsule) and a dramatic intervention by a Husky Doctor, using cinematic lighting and exaggerated action.
entries.prompt:
影片場景設定 (Global Style)
環境場景：深夜的中式古風庭院，青瓦白牆、紅燈籠隨風微晃，地面有月光與樹影交錯，整體光影帶有濃厚復古武俠電影質感。
角色形象：
橘貓（大俠）：穿著古風俠客服，披風微揚，表情兇狠中帶點憨，氣場十足。
烤鴨（書生）：穿著古代書生長袍，被繩子綁在木樁上，神情委屈又緊張，嘴巴鼓鼓的（含著黑色膠囊）。
哈士奇（醫生）：穿白袍醫生制服，戴黑框眼鏡，神情專業又帶點自信過頭的戲劇感。
道具設定：黑色膠囊（褪黑激素）含在烤鴨嘴中。
畫質要求：電影級打光，超高清 4K，動物毛髮與布料細節清晰，動作流暢，略帶慢動作強化戲劇張力。

分鏡劇情與旁白 (Script & Prompts)

鏡頭 1：武俠審訊（全景/中景）
畫面描述：左側橘貓大俠負手而立，披風隨風微動，右側烤鴨書生被綁在木樁上，嘴巴鼓起。橘貓突然上前，一掌拍在木樁旁，氣勢逼人。
動作：橘貓步步逼近，眼神凌厲。
旁白（橘貓）：
「說！為何不肯交出你嘴中的褪黑激素！」

鏡頭 2：書生鴨死守（烤鴨特寫）
畫面描述：鏡頭推近烤鴨，嘴巴緊閉，臉頰鼓起，眼神倔強又帶點慌張。
動作：烤鴨拼命搖頭，死死咬住膠囊不放。
旁白（烤鴨）：
（含糊不清）「唔唔唔！（我不能給！）」

鏡頭 3：氣氛升溫（橘貓特寫）
畫面描述：橘貓眼神一沉，緩緩抬手，武俠氣場拉滿，背景燈籠微微晃動。
動作：橘貓手指關節發出“喀喀”聲，準備動粗。
旁白（橘貓）：
「敬酒不吃，吃罰酒是吧……」

鏡頭 4：醫生突襲（動作鏡頭）
畫面描述：畫面右側突然衝出哈士奇醫生，一個滑步切入畫面，動作誇張但專業。
動作：哈士奇迅速伸出一掌，「啪！」地按在烤鴨胸口（類似急救按壓）。
音效：低沉“砰”一聲＋誇張彈出音效。

鏡頭 5：膠囊飛出（慢動作特寫）
畫面描述：慢動作鏡頭，烤鴨張嘴，「噗！」一顆黑色膠囊從口中飛出，在空中旋轉。
動作：哈士奇單手優雅接住膠囊，鏡片反光一閃。

鏡頭 6：全場愣住（反應鏡頭）

entries.translated_prompt:
Film Scene Setting (Global Style)
Environment: A traditional Chinese courtyard late at night, with blue tiles and white walls, red lanterns swaying slightly in the wind. Moonlight and tree shadows intersect on the ground. The overall lighting has a strong retro Wuxia film texture.
Character Design:
Orange Cat (Hero): Wearing traditional Wuxia attire, cape slightly fluttering, expression fierce yet slightly goofy, full of presence.
Roast Duck (Scholar): Wearing an ancient scholar's long robe, tied to a wooden stake, looking wronged and nervous, mouth puffed out (holding a black capsule).
Husky (Doctor): Wearing a white doctor's uniform, black-rimmed glasses, looking professional yet with a hint of overconfident drama.
Prop Setting: Black capsule (melatonin) held in the Roast Duck's mouth.
Quality Requirements: Cinematic lighting, ultra-high definition 4K, clear details of animal fur and fabric, smooth action, slight slow motion to enhance dramatic tension.

Storyboard and Narration (Script & Prompts)

Shot 1: Wuxia Interrogation (Full/Medium Shot)
Visual Description: The Orange Cat Hero stands with hands behind his back on the left, his cape slightly moving in the wind. The Roast Duck Scholar is tied to a stake on the right, his mouth puffed out. The Orange Cat suddenly steps forward and slams his palm next to the stake, creating an intimidating presence.
Action: The Orange Cat approaches step by step, eyes sharp.
Narration (Orange Cat):
"Speak! Why won't you hand over the melatonin in your mouth!"

Shot 2: Scholar Duck's Resistance (Roast Duck Close-up)
Visual Description: The camera pushes in on the Roast Duck, mouth tightly shut, cheeks puffed out, eyes stubborn yet slightly panicked.
Action: The Roast Duck shakes his head desperately, biting down hard on the capsule.
Narration (Roast Duck):
(Muffled) "Mmm mmm mmm! (I can't give it!)"

Shot 3: Tension Rises (Orange Cat Close-up)
Visual Description: The Orange Cat's eyes darken, he slowly raises his hand, the Wuxia aura maximized, background lanterns slightly swaying.
Action: The Orange Cat's finger joints crackle, preparing for violence.
Narration (Orange Cat):
"You won't take the polite way, so you choose the hard way, huh..."

Shot 4: Doctor's Raid (Action Shot)
Visual Description: The Husky Doctor suddenly rushes in from the right side of the frame, sliding in with exaggerated but professional movement.
Action: The Husky quickly extends a palm and "Slaps!" the Roast Duck's chest (similar to CPR compression).
Sound Effect: A deep "thump" + exaggerated pop-out sound effect.

Shot 5: Capsule Flies Out (Slow Motion Close-up)
Visual Description: Slow-motion shot, the Roast Duck opens his mouth, "Pfft!" A black capsule flies out of his mouth, spinning in the air.
Action: The Husky elegantly catches the capsule with one hand, his glasses flashing with reflection.

Shot 6: Everyone Stunned (Reaction Shot)
Visual Description: Both the Orange Cat and the Roast Duck are stunned simultaneously. The frame freezes for a moment, the atmosphere instantly shifting from tense to absurd.
Action: The Orange Cat slowly turns his head to look at the Husky.
Narration (Orange Cat, quietly):
"...That works?"

Shot 7: Doctor's Conclusion (Husky Close-up)
Visual Description: The Husky pushes up his glasses, holding the black capsule between his fingers, smiling confidently at the camera, the background slightly blurred.
Action: Nods slightly, tone professional yet slightly smug.
Narration (Husky):
"Melatonin is not for everyone."
"It's best to consult a doctor first."

Shot 8: Ending (Full Shot Freeze Frame)
Visual Description: The three characters freeze. The Orange Cat maintains his Wuxia posture but looks confused, the Roast Duck looks exhausted, and the Husky stands confidently in the middle. A few night bird calls are heard in the background.
Action: Frame freezes + slight film grain effect fades out.
