entries.title: 15-Second Live Action Rivalry Video Script
entries.description: A detailed, multi-scene prompt for a 15-second live-action video, focusing on an escalating rivalry between two high school students, Haruki Aoyama and Renji Kurosawa. The prompt includes character descriptions, a plot summary, and specific scene breakdowns (The Opening Salvo, Assembly Confrontation, Hallway Aftermath) to guide the video generation.
entries.prompt:
At Sakuragaoka High School, quiet and determined second-year student Haruki Aoyama is publicly humiliated by his nemesis Renji Kurosawa, the intimidating student council vice president, on the very first day of the new semester. What begins as a bitter rivalry fueled by hatred escalates through a high-stakes school competition where both students push each other to the breaking point. As the conflict intensifies, Haruki discovers a shocking truth. Renji's cruelty stems not from malice but from desperate resentment over a scholarship that Haruki unknowingly took, one that Renji's struggling family desperately needed. Forced to confront the gray areas between hero and villain, Haruki must decide whether to destroy his enemy or extend a hand to someone who might just need a friend. The choices he makes will determine whether their rivalry ends in friendship, mutual respect, or lasting regret.

Character:
Haruki Aoyama (Main Protagonist) - A quiet, determined second-year student at Sakuragaoka High School. He is hardworking and principled but struggles with anger and impulsiveness. His journey transforms him from a resentful victim into someone capable of empathy and forgiveness.

Renji Kurosawa (Supporting Character) - The charismatic and ruthless student council vice president who serves as Haruki's nemesis. Beneath his intimidating exterior, he hides deep pain from his family's financial struggles. He is fiercely proud and refuses to show weakness.

Miku Tachibana (Supporting Character) - Haruki's loyal childhood friend and emotional anchor. She is perceptive, strategic, and caring, often serving as the voice of reason. She knows more about the situation than she initially reveals.

Souta Himura (Supporting Character) - A laid-back classmate of Haruki who hides surprising talent beneath his carefree attitude. He becomes a key ally and is unafraid to speak hard truths when needed.

Scene 1:
The Opening 
SalvoIt is the first day of the new semester at Sakuragaoka High School. Haruki Aoyama, a quiet but determined second-year student, arrives hoping for a peaceful school year. However, his nemesis Renji Kurosawa, the charismatic and ruthless student council vice president, publicly humiliates Haruki during the opening assembly by exposing an embarrassing incident from last year. The entire school laughs, and Haruki's reputation is shattered before the year even begins. Haruki's childhood friend Miku Tachibana tries to comfort him, but Haruki is consumed by anger and a desire for payback. The seeds of an intense rivalry are sown as Renji makes it clear he intends to make Haruki's life miserable all year. Storylet: Assembly Confrontation: When Renji takes the stage during the opening ceremony, he publicly targets Haruki with a humiliating story, establishing dominance and triggering Haruki's deep resentment. Hallway Aftermath: After the assembly ends, Haruki retreats to the hallway where Miku finds him; she offers comfort but Haruki is too furious to listen, setting up his emotional state for the chapter. Rival's Warning: Renji corners Haruki near the shoe lockers and delivers a cold warning that this year will be hell for him, escalating the tension and making the conflict personal. Inner Resolve: Alone on the school rooftop after classes, Haruki clenches his fists and silently vows to fight back, establishing his motivation and determination for the story ahead.

Scene 2:
Battle Lines
The school announces a major inter-class competition — the Sakuragaoka Cultural Festival Challenge — where teams compete in academics, sports, and creative arts. Haruki and Renji end up as rival team captains. Haruki rallies his classmates, including the laid-back but surprisingly talented Souta Himura, while Renji uses his influence and intimidation to build an elite squad. As the competition heats up, both rivals push themselves to the limit. Miku serves as Haruki's strategist and emotional anchor. During the sports round, Haruki and Renji face off directly in a relay race that becomes deeply personal. Tensions reach a boiling point when Haruki notices suspicious behavior from Renji's team — possible cheating. The chapter ends at the climax of the competition, with the outcome uncertain. Storylet: Team Formation: When the competition is announced, Haruki must recruit classmates; Souta initially refuses but joins after witnessing Haruki's sincerity, forming the core team. Strategy Session: Miku organizes a late-night study and planning session at Haruki's house, where the team bonds and develops creative strategies, strengthening their resolve. The Relay Showdown: During the sports event, Haruki and Renji run the anchor leg of the relay; the crowd roars as they sprint neck-and-neck, and the raw hatred between them is visible to everyone. Suspicious Evidence: After the academic round, Haruki finds discarded answer sheets near the trash that suggest Renji's team had advance knowledge of the questions, creating a moral dilemma. Miku's Counsel: Miku pulls Haruki aside and warns him that acting on anger alone will make him no different from Renji, forcing him to reflect on his choices.

Scene 3:
Behind the Mask
After the intensity of the competition, a quiet shift begins. Haruki discovers the truth behind Renji's deep-seated hatred — last year, Haruki unknowingly took the scholarship spot that Renji desperately needed to stay in school due to his family's severe financial troubles. Renji's single mother works multiple jobs, and the scholarship was his only hope of easing her burden. The humiliation Renji inflicted on Haruki was born not from cruelty but from desperate resentment. Miku reveals she has known fragments of this story but kept silent to protect both of them. Haruki is shaken, realizing his rival's villain persona is a mask over deep pain. He visits Renji at a part-time job at a convenience store late at night and sees a completely different person — exhausted, vulnerable, and alone. The two share an uncomfortable but honest conversation under the fluorescent lights. Storylet: The Revelation: Miku finally tells Haruki the full story of Renji's family situation after the competition ends, shattering Haruki's simple view of good versus evil. Convenience Store Visit: Haruki tracks down Renji's part-time job and sees him stocking shelves alone late at night, tired and quiet, a stark contrast to his domineering school persona. The Honest Talk: Under harsh convenience store lights, Renji initially lashes out at Haruki for showing up, but eventually breaks down and admits the weight he carries, creating raw emotional vulnerability. Walking Home: The two walk home in silence through empty nighttime streets, neither fully reconciled but with a fragile new understanding forming between them.

Scene 4:
The Price of Exposure
Haruki chose to expose Renji's cheating, and the fallout is catastrophic. The school administration launches a formal investigation, and Renji faces potential expulsion. However, the investigation reveals that Renji was coerced into cheating by a third-year student who wanted to sabotage both teams for his own gain. Renji took the blame silently to protect his teammates. Haruki is horrified — his act of justice may destroy someone who was already a victim. The school is abuzz with gossip and judgment. Souta urges Haruki to fix what he started. Miku is torn between supporting Haruki and feeling that he acted too rashly. Renji, now isolated and facing the disciplinary committee, refuses to defend himself. Haruki must decide whether to step forward and tell the full truth, risking his own standing. Storylet: Investigation Fallout: The school principal announces the investigation results in a tense faculty meeting, and word spreads fast through the student body, turning Renji into a pariah overnight. entries.title: Boss Battle Scene Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed multi-part prompt designed to generate a dramatic boss battle scene video. It instructs the AI to use a reference image only for style, start with a fast transition, feature a game UI overlay (RPG style command window), and position the player character in the foreground facing a large enemy in the background, all rendered in a cinematic, high-contrast fantasy style.
entries.prompt:
参考画像はリファレンスとしてのみ使用し、スタートフレームには使用しない。バトル風アップテンポBGMあり、効果音あり。開始直後に以下のカットに切り替える。

超高速トランジションで画面切りかえ。高速で空間が崩れ落ちる。

一瞬のホワイトアウトの後、
参考画像の背景の雰囲気を継承したフィールドに切り替わる。

切り替えと同時に、
画面下部にRPG風のコマンドUIが出現する。
そのうちの一つが選択され、キャラクターが動き出す。

UI演出：
・半透明のウィンドウがスライドイン
・ピクセル風またはモダンなゲームUI
・軽く発光する枠（glow）
・カチッとした出現アニメーション

表示内容：
左側：キャラクターの名前、HP、MPゲージ
右側：数種類の参考画像から連想される必殺技(日本語名)
上部：参考画像から連想される敵キャラクター名

参考画像から連想される特殊な巨大な敵キャラクターが右奥に出現し、自キャラは左手前に配置され奥を向いている。

カメラ構図：
・左手前にプレイヤーキャラ
・右奥に敵
・ややローアングルで迫力

演出：
・キャラクターが、その見た目から連想される武器を持ち、戦闘ポーズに入り、敵キャラクターと正対し、軽くステップを踏む。一連の動作は超高速で一瞬で行われる。
・背景は軽く動く（particle, fog, energy）

スタイル：
cinematic, game UI overlay, ultra detailed, high contrast,
fantasy battle scene, dynamic lighting, volumetric light
entries.translated_prompt:
Use the reference image only as a reference, not for the start frame. Include battle-style upbeat background music and sound effects. Immediately after the start, switch to the following cut.

Screen transition with ultra-fast transition. Space collapses at high speed.

After a momentary whiteout,
Switch to a field that inherits the atmosphere of the reference image's background.

Simultaneously with the switch,
An RPG-style command UI appears at the bottom of the screen.
One of them is selected, and the character starts moving.

UI effects:
・Semi-transparent window slides in
・Pixel-style or modern game UI
・Slightly glowing frame (glow)
・Crisp appearance animation

Display content:
Left side: Character name, HP, MP gauge
Right side: Special moves (Japanese names) associated with several reference images
Top side: Enemy character name associated with the reference image

A special giant enemy character associated with the reference image appears in the back right, and the player character is placed in the front left, facing away.

Camera composition:
・Player character in the front left
・Enemy in the back right
・Slightly low angle for impact

Direction:
・The character holds a weapon associated with their appearance, enters a battle pose, faces the enemy character, and takes a light step. This series of actions occurs instantly at ultra-high speed.
・The background moves slightly (particle, fog, energy)

Style:
cinematic, game UI overlay, ultra detailed, high contrast,
fantasy battle scene, dynamic lighting, volumetric light

entries.title: Childhood Imagination to Reality Car Race Video Prompt
entries.description: A complex, multi-stage prompt detailing a seamless transition video from a child playing with a toy car (Macro Realism) to an adult driving a real Porsche 911 GT3 on a racetrack (Full-Scale Power). It specifies timing, camera angles (ultra-low-angle tracking), lighting, texture details, and an emotional peak focusing on the driver's eyes.
entries.prompt:
0.0 – 4.0 sec — Childhood Imagination (Macro Realism)

Ultra-low-angle macro tracking shot, camera almost touching the ground.
Warm afternoon sunlight spills across a soft beige carpet, visible dust particles floating in air, subtle retro Kodak film warmth (natural, not stylized).

A small child’s hand (only hand visible, no face) pushes a red toy sports car forward.

Camera locks into a front-facing, low tracking perspective, moving with the toy car at increasing speed, mimicking a real race car POV.
Shallow depth of field, realistic motion blur, micro-texture detail on carpet fibers.

Emotion: curiosity → excitement building.

4.0 – 5.5 sec — Transition Through Darkness (Seamless Time Shift)

The toy car speeds into the dark shadow beneath a sofa.

As it enters darkness:

• Light collapses naturally (no artificial fade)
• Carpet texture stretches into subtle motion streaks
• Environment dissolves into full darkness

Seamless transition: the forward motion continues uninterrupted, creating a natural time-space shift (no jump cuts, no glitch effects).

5.5 – 9.0 sec — Reality Emerges (Full-Scale Power)

From darkness, the sound of a real engine ignites.

A real red Porsche 911 GT3 bursts out of shadow into a racetrack environment.

Lighting shifts to sharp, high-contrast daylight.
Cold gray asphalt, heat haze from tires, fine dust particles.

Camera remains low, tracking, and synchronized, maintaining the same motion direction and angle as the toy car shot—creating the illusion it's the same car, now full-scale.

Highly realistic physics:

• Tire grip and vibration
• Subtle suspension movement
• Natural reflections on glossy paint
• Emotion: awe → adrenaline → intensity.

9.0 – 12.0 sec — Human Connection (Emotional Peak)

Cut seamlessly into interior (motion-matched transition).
Close-up: adult driver’s hands gripping a suede racing wheel, wearing professional racing gloves.

Visible micro-details:

• Knuckle tension
• Slight sweat
• Gear shift impact vibration

Camera tilts upward smoothly to reveal the driver’s eyes inside helmet.

Eyes are sharp, focused, intense—mirroring childhood imagination now realized.
Sweat, breath, and subtle helmet reflections visible.

Final moment:
micro freeze-frame feeling (not a hard freeze) on the eyes, with slight camera vibration.

preview_videos.caption: Childhood Imagination to Reality Car Race Video Prompt

entries.title: Cyber Wuxia Action Scene: Waterfall Duel
entries.description: A highly detailed, four-part storyboard prompt for Seedance 2.0, generating a high-tension Cyber Wuxia duel in the style of 'Fog Hill of Five Elements'. The scene features a female character in a white suit with mechanical parts and a male character with Hello Kitty tattoos and pink metal pants, fighting near a giant mossy waterfall using extreme slow-motion, rapid cuts, and cinematic camera work.
entries.prompt: 【镜头1 · 3s · 建立/爆发】 主体一：赛博女性 图片1 ，白色西装，机械颈骨，金齿轮耳环，红唇冷漠，黑发马尾，玄铁长刀 主体二：赛博男性 图片2 ，裸腹六块腹肌，Hello Kitty纹身，黑色机械甲肩臂，粉色金属货裤，白色AJ，武士刀 场景：参考图 图片3 巨型苔藓瀑布崖壁，白色水雾铺天，翠绿蕨类丛生，湿滑苔石 动作：男性从瀑布顶端纵身跃下，武士刀倒握反插，在水雾中高速坠落——子弹时间介入，镜头360度环绕静止身体，水珠悬浮，机械甲齿轮咬合细节锐利可见；时间恢复，男性砸落苔石台炸出十米裂缝，女性横向瞬移闪避，刀锋擦过发丝，黑发寸断飘散 风格：雾山五行国漫画风，硬边水墨线条，青银赤金高对比，电影级光影 镜头：跟随俯冲高速下降，子弹时间360度环绕，相机位于下坠轨迹平行高度(thats where the camera is) 构图：纵向引导线，瀑布与坠落轨迹重合，冲击点为焦点 氛围：极度压迫，生死一线，水雾爆散 音频：风声撕裂；子弹时间静默低频；落地轰鸣；配乐：单鼓重击起 【镜头2 · 4s · 转折/游斗】 主体一：白衣女性，长刀低扫连劈，动作凌厉 主体二：粉裤男性，机械臂格挡，赤金电弧炸裂 场景：瀑布中段苔藓岩壁平台，苔石踩碎，蕨类横飞，水雾被气劲切成丝状 动作：女性贴地滑步突进低扫脚踝——子弹时间介入，极近距特写刀锋与AJ鞋底仅差两毫米，鞋底被刀气削出焦痕，机械关节指节泛白细节定格；时间恢复，男性踏地弹身，燃焰武士刀劈向女性机械颈部，刀锋擦过颈部零件削飞旋转；二人蹬墙互踹，双腿空中碰撞爆发蓝金冲击波，双双震飞后空翻落地 风格：快切与子弹时间交替，打击感极强，细节残酷真实 镜头：贴地低速跟随切极端近距特写，相机位于地面贴近高度(thats where the camera is) 构图：极端近景景深，危险细节锐利，背景瀑布大虚化 氛围：千钧一发，窒息感 音频：刀锋擦骨金属尖啸；鞋底焦痕嗞嗞声；冲击波爆响；配乐：急促弦乐 【镜头3 · 4s · 高潮/环境缠斗】 主体一：白衣女性，长刀反握插地腾空旋踢 主体二：粉裤男性，抓蕨类藤蔓借力甩身，机械臂过载爆红 场景：瀑布底部水潭区，水面踩出巨型凹陷，苔石崩裂，蕨类连根拔起 动作：男性抓整棵蕨类横扫，女性长刀拦腰斩断——子弹时间介入，极近特写断面纤维纹理、刀锋残留绿色汁液、机械关节泛白细节定格；时间恢复，女性借反震旋身斜劈冰蓝刀气，男性机械臂过载硬接握碎，掌心蒸汽焦烟；二人扑摔入水潭缠斗翻滚，激起十米水柱折射金蓝彩虹 风格：慢动作细节特写与暴力冲击并行，环境破坏极致 镜头：子弹时间断面特写切回水柱爆发全景，相机位于水面平行高度(thats where the camera is) 构图：水面倒影与真实动作上下对称，冲击点居中 氛围：野蛮爆裂，生死相搏 音频：树干断裂声；机械过载嗡鸣；水柱爆发轰响；配乐：低频战鼓爆点 【镜头4 · 4s · 终结/大招对轰】 主体一：白衣女性，长刀举顶，银冰光芒过载爆发，西装边缘被能量撕裂 主体二：粉裤男性，武士刀横胸，机械甲赤金全功率过载，粉裤猎猎飞扬 场景：瀑布正前方制高苔石台，百米瀑布为背景，水雾与光芒交融 动作：双方同时蓄力爆发，冰火双色能量柱冲天——子弹时间介入，极近特写女性瞳孔，倒映赤金火焰与男性全影，睫毛水雾微珠清晰，眼神由冷漠转决死；切至男性Hello Kitty纹身特写，纹身在赤金光下线条流动发光；时间恢复，双方全力冲刺对劈，两刀瀑布正中央对撞，炸出五十米冰火双色球形爆炸，瀑布从中间炸裂撕成两半；双方各自倒飞十米重砸苔石，烟尘渐散，二人喘息对望，画面定格 风格：子弹时间微距细节与终极爆炸超广角极致反差，震撼收束 镜头：眼部极端微距切超广角大爆炸全景，相机位于爆炸正面平行高度(thats where the camera is) 构图：爆炸中心点，冰火双色向四方放射，双角色对称分列 氛围：天崩地裂，毁灭级收束 音频：子弹时间静默心跳；双刀碰撞共鸣；爆炸巨响；配乐：单鼓定格，低频余震渐弱 无水印、无字幕、无文字叠加。
entries.translated_prompt: [Shot 1 · 3s · Setup/Explosion] Subject 1: Cyber Female Image 1, white suit, mechanical neck bone, gold gear earrings, cold red lips, black ponytail, dark iron long saber. Subject 2: Cyber Male Image 2, bare six-pack abs, Hello Kitty tattoo, black mechanical shoulder armor, pink metal cargo pants, white AJs, katana. Scene: Reference image Image 3, giant mossy waterfall cliff, white mist covering the sky, lush green ferns, slippery mossy rocks. Action: The male leaps from the top of the waterfall, katana held reversed and inverted, falling at high speed in the mist—bullet time intervenes, the camera orbits the stationary body 360 degrees, water droplets suspended, sharp details of mechanical armor gears visible; time resumes, the male crashes onto the mossy rock platform, creating a ten-meter crack. The female instantly teleports sideways to dodge, the blade edge grazes her hair, black hair strands scatter. Style: Wu Shan Wu Xing (Fog Hill of Five Elements) national comic style, hard-edge ink lines, high contrast of cyan, silver, crimson, and gold, cinematic lighting. Camera: Follows the dive at high speed, 360-degree orbit in bullet time, camera positioned parallel to the falling trajectory (that's where the camera is). Composition: Vertical leading lines, waterfall and falling trajectory coincide, impact point is the focus. Atmosphere: Extreme pressure, life-or-death situation, mist explodes. Audio: Wind tearing; silent low frequency in bullet time; landing roar; Music: Single drum heavy hit start. [Shot 2 · 4s · Turning Point/Skirmish] Subject 1: White-suited female, long saber low sweep and continuous chop, sharp movements. Subject 2: Pink-panted male, mechanical arm blocks, crimson-gold electric arcs explode. Scene: Mossy rock platform halfway down the waterfall, mossy stones shattered, ferns flying, mist cut into threads by energy force. Action: The female slides low to the ground, thrusting forward with a low sweep at the ankle—bullet time intervenes, extreme close-up of the blade edge and the AJ sole separated by only two millimeters, the sole scorched by the blade's energy, mechanical joint knuckles fixed in white detail; time resumes, the male steps off the ground and springs up, the flaming katana slashing toward the female's mechanical neck. The blade edge grazes the neck part, sending it spinning off; the two kick off the wall and collide in the air, their legs impacting and erupting a blue-gold shockwave, both are thrown back, performing backflips upon landing. Style: Alternating rapid cuts and bullet time, extremely strong sense of impact, cruel and realistic details. Camera: Low-speed tracking close to the ground, cutting to extreme close-ups, camera positioned close to the ground (that's where the camera is). Composition: Extreme close-up depth of field, sharp dangerous details, heavy blurring of the background waterfall. Atmosphere: Hair-trigger moment, suffocating feeling. Audio: Blade scraping bone metal shriek; sizzling sound of scorched sole; shockwave explosion; Music: Rapid string music. [Shot 3 · 4s · Climax/Environmental Combat] Subject 1: White-suited female, long saber reversed, stabbing into the ground, spinning kick into the air. Subject 2: Pink-panted male, grabbing fern vines to swing, mechanical arm overloaded and glowing red. Scene: Water pool area at the bottom of the waterfall, giant depressions stepped out of the water surface, mossy stones cracked, ferns uprooted. Action: The male sweeps the entire fern horizontally, the female's long saber cuts it in half at the waist—bullet time intervenes, extreme close-up of the cross-section fiber texture, green sap residue on the blade edge, mechanical joint knuckles fixed in white detail; time resumes, the female uses the counter-shock to spin and diagonally slash an ice-blue blade energy. The male's overloaded mechanical arm hard-blocks and crushes it, steam and scorch smoke from the palm; the two tumble and roll into the water pool, engaging in close combat, stirring up a ten-meter water column that refracts a gold-blue rainbow. Style: Slow-motion detail close-ups and violent impact run parallel, extreme environmental destruction. Camera: Bullet time cross-section close-up cuts back to the full view of the water column explosion, camera positioned parallel to the water surface (that's where the camera is). Composition: Water reflection and real action are vertically symmetrical, the impact point is centered. Atmosphere: Savage explosion, fighting to the death. Audio: Tree trunk breaking sound; mechanical overload humming; water column explosion roar; Music: Low-frequency war drum burst point. [Shot 4 · 4s · Conclusion/Ultimate Attack Clash] Subject 1: White-suited female, long saber raised high, silver-ice light overloaded and erupting, the edge of the suit torn by energy. Subject 2: Pink-panted male, katana held horizontally across the chest, mechanical armor fully overloaded with crimson-gold power, pink pants fluttering wildly. Scene: Elevated mossy rock platform directly in front of the waterfall, with the hundred-meter waterfall as the background, mist and light merging. Action: Both simultaneously charge and erupt, ice and fire dual-color energy beams shoot into the sky—bullet time intervenes, extreme close-up of the female's pupil, reflecting the crimson-gold flame and the male's full silhouette, water droplets on eyelashes clearly visible, her gaze changes from cold indifference to deadly resolve; cut to a close-up of the male's Hello Kitty tattoo, the tattoo lines flowing and glowing under the crimson-gold light; time resumes, both sprint forward and clash blades, the two sabers colliding in the exact center of the waterfall, exploding into a fifty-meter ice and fire dual-color spherical explosion, the waterfall is split in half down the middle; both are thrown back ten meters, crashing heavily onto the mossy rocks. The smoke and dust gradually dissipate, the two gasp and look at each other, the frame freezes. Style: Extreme contrast between bullet time micro-details and ultimate explosion wide-angle, shocking conclusion. Camera: Extreme micro-close-up of the eyes cuts to ultra-wide-angle full view of the big explosion, camera positioned parallel to the front of the explosion (that's where the camera is). Composition: Center point of the explosion, ice and fire dual colors radiating in four directions, dual characters symmetrically positioned. Atmosphere: Earth-shattering, destruction-level conclusion. Audio: Silent heartbeat in bullet time; dual saber collision resonance; explosion roar; Music: Single drum freeze frame, low-frequency aftershock gradually weakens. No watermark, no subtitles, no text overlay.

entries.title: Hamster Gym Bro: A Pixar-Quality Animated Short
entries.description: A detailed, multi-segment prompt designed for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second, high-budget, Pixar-quality 3D animated short film about a tiny, muscular hamster attempting to work out in a human gym, featuring slapstick comedy and cinematic scene breakdowns.
entries.prompt:
GAINS — Hamster Gym Bro A tiny golden hamster with disproportionately muscular arms, wearing a microscopic tank top that says "NO DAYS OFF," stands in front of a full sized human gym mirror doing bicep poses. A water bottle the size of his body sits beside him. High budget 3D animation, Pixar quality. 

[0s–1.5s] Interior of a high end gym. Normal humans work out in the background. Camera slowly lowers to ground level where a hamster stands on a tiny platform in front of the mirror, flexing intensely. 

[1.5s–3s] He waddles to the dumbbell rack. Grabs a full sized 1kg dumbbell. It's twenty times his size. He deadlifts it, face turning red, cheeks puffing out, tiny legs shaking. He gets it an inch off the ground. Drops it. Acts casual. 

[3s–5s] He climbs onto a treadmill. Hits the start button. It launches him off the back like a cannon. He tumbles across the floor, pops up immediately, walks back, and turns the speed down. Looks around to see if anyone noticed. 

[5s–7s] He tries the bench press. Uses two pencils as his barbell with erasers as weights. He presses it up, grunting dramatically. His spotter, a hamster half his size with glasses, holds one finger under the bar pretending to help. 

[7s–9s] He spots a human woman doing yoga. He rolls out a tiny mat next to her and attempts downward dog. His round body just creates a small furry lump. He holds it with fierce determination. Shaking. 

[9s–11s] Smoothie bar. He sits on the counter, orders a protein shake. The blender is bigger than his apartment. The shake comes in a thimble. He chugs it, slams the thimble down, wipes his mouth, and lets out a tiny belch that echoes. 

[11s–13s] He stands in the locker room doorway for the dramatic exit. Puts in tiny earbuds. His workout playlist starts. He slow motion walks toward the camera, an imaginary wind blowing his fur. 

[13s–15s] Wide shot of the gym parking lot. He walks toward a toy car, presses a key fob, the headlights flash. He climbs in, revs the engine, and peels out. The car is a hot pink Barbie jeep. He doesn't care. 

Cut to black. 3D animated, Pixar quality, hamster bodybuilder, gym comedy, miniature slapstick, cinematic lighting, 4K.

entries.translated_prompt: Tsui Hark style high-tension Eastern Cyber Wuxia life-or-death battle, 15 seconds of continuous action, fusion of Shaw Brothers classic aesthetics and cyberpunk machinery. Scene: Image 2, a giant waterfall cascades vertically from the back of the frame, the entire background is covered by a white water curtain. There is a shallow layer of water on the cliff platform ground, with cold white backlighting penetrating from behind the waterfall. Mist continuously rolls in, enveloping the entire space, and footsteps kick up sparkling water splashes. Left fighter: Chinese female, in her forties, Image 1, white long suit jacket hem reaching the knee, chest open revealing silver mechanical chest armor, both arms are fully exposed gold-copper mechanical prosthetics, gears and hydraulic rods clearly visible, cold steam seeping from the joints, both feet are also exposed gold-copper mechanical structures, the gold-copper mechanical spine is fully exposed along the midline of the back, black ponytail hairstyle with gold circular earrings. Right hand holds a slender straight-edged sword, the blade is long and unpatterned, the total length is about two-thirds of her height, the hilt is wrapped with gold-copper mechanical gears. Right fighter: Chinese male, in his forties, robust build, Image 3, off-white Hanfu robe tied with a cloth belt at the waist, silver mechanical shoulder armor covering both shoulders, both arms are silver mechanical prosthetics, with silver mechanical spinal armor on the back, hair shaved short on both sides of the topknot, composed face. Both hands hold a long staff, the staff is dark hardwood with silver metal hoops wrapped around it at intervals, hands gripping the middle and rear sections. First two and a half seconds of suffocating standoff: The white-suited female with gold-copper mechanical arms extends her right arm forward, the tip of the slender sword pointing towards the opponent's throat, reflecting metal in the backlight. Her left mechanical arm hangs by her side, ready to strike, joint steam slowly seeping out. The robust male in the off-white Hanfu with silver mechanical shoulder armor holds the long staff horizontally in front of him with both hands, his center of gravity sinking into his back foot, his eyes tracking every inch of movement of the opponent's mechanical arm. The hem of the robe continuously flutters in the wind pressure on the cliff platform, and the shallow water creates dense ripples. The camera slowly pushes in from a low side angle close to the water surface, the waterfall curtain extending to the four edges of the frame. Third second explosion: The white-suited female with gold-copper mechanical arms stomps her right foot, splashing a large area of water. Both arms thrust forward forcefully, lunging with her whole body to stab the slender sword diagonally upwards from a low position, mechanical elbow joint steam jetting out intensely. The robust male with silver mechanical arms in the off-white Hanfu instantly presses the long staff down to diagonally meet the incoming sword. The silver hoops on the staff collide with the sword, creating a loud bang. He uses the force to turn right and backhand sweep the end of the staff towards the opponent's waist. The two weapons cross in the cold white backlight, and water droplets scatter from the collision point, exploding into a cloud of light points. Three-stage rhythm change: First stage of close-quarters combo: The white-suited female with gold-copper mechanical arms continuously stabs rapidly with the straight sword, changing high and low angles. The hydraulic rods of the mechanical arms are visible extending and retracting with each thrust. The robust male with silver mechanical arms in the off-white Hanfu alternately parries with both ends of the long staff. Micro sparks of fire are generated by joint friction during the high-speed blocking of the silver mechanical arms. Both move quickly in the shallow water, each step splashing a low water curtain. The camera quickly tracks sideways, cutting into a close-up freeze frame of the sparks and water droplets at the moment of weapon collision. Second stage of aerial engagement: The white-suited female with gold-copper mechanical feet steps on the water surface and leaps up, her robe hem and ponytail forming a streamline in the air. At the highest point, she brings the slender sword down with a powerful chop. The robust male with silver mechanical shoulder armor in the off-white Hanfu raises the staff over his head, spreading his arms to meet the attack. The two weapons collide head-on in mid-air, the impact airwave pushing the mist outward into a circle. The camera switches to a top-down view, capturing the cross composition of the two against the white waterfall background. Third stage of close-quarters entanglement: The robust male with silver mechanical arms in the off-white Hanfu uses the long staff to push horizontally against the female's gold-copper mechanical arm, using the length of the staff to force her towards the edge of the cliff platform. The white-suited female with gold-copper mechanical arms uses her left mechanical arm to hard-block the staff. The torsos of the two are almost touching, and shallow water ripples spread outward between their feet. The camera slightly shakes once with the impact of the weight, simulating a handheld feel. Last three seconds of conclusion: The robust male with silver mechanical shoulder armor in the off-white Hanfu is forced back to the edge of the cliff platform by the final heavy downward chop, kneeling on one knee. The long staff is placed diagonally in front of him, the tail end resting on the slippery ground. The silver mechanical arms tremble slightly, the lower hem of the robe is soaked and clings to his legs, and the waterfall mist falls onto the silver shoulder armor. The white-suited female with gold-copper mechanical arms lands and steps on the water to stabilize her posture, extending the slender sword forward until the tip is less than an inch from the opponent's neck. The gold-copper mechanical arms are completely still, and the steam slowly dissipates. They look at each other for one second. She slightly withdraws the sword tip by an inch, holding it suspended. The camera slowly pulls back, framing both of them simultaneously. The waterfall curtain rushes across the full frame, and water splashes continue to scatter on the shallow water ground. 8K ultra-high-definition cinematic quality, ultra-realistic texture, 35mm film grain, cold white waterfall background contrasting with the warm color of the gold-copper machinery, silver mechanical parts forming a third layer of luster in the backlight. Fast sideways tracking, close-ups of weapon collisions, top-down emphasis shots, slight handheld shake during heavy impacts. Metal sparks, steam jets, and water splashes are visible throughout. Clothing and hairstyles have realistic physical response to airflow. Continuous action without jump cuts, no anime style, no game interface, no magic light effects, no watermark, no subtitles, no limb deformation.

entries.title: Dark Fantasy Knight vs. Woodland Horror
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-cut prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating a 15-second dark fantasy action horror sequence. It specifies subjects (knight and transforming maiden), environment, mood, color logic, and provides a precise timeline with camera lens details and sound effects (SFX) for each of the six cuts.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: 15s / 6 CUTS / Dark Fantasy Action Horror 

SUBJECTS: A battle-worn medieval knight in tarnished armor, fighting for his life. A weeping maiden in a rich, embroidered velvet medieval gown who contorts into a woodland horror with a pale, monstrous face, blank white eyes, and a gaping maw while retaining her noble clothing. 

ENVIRONMENT: A dense, desolate, fog-choked ancient forest at night. Features twisted dark tree trunks, thick roots, mist rolling over damp moss, and harsh moonlight piercing the canopy. 

MOOD: Eerie atmospheric dread escalating into high-speed, kinetic and savage woodland violence. 

COLOR LOGIC: Naturalistic Film Print Emulation 

TIMELINE: 

0:00-0:03: Wide shot. The weary knight trudges through the thick fog of the dark forest. Far ahead in the mist, a maiden in a rich, embroidered velvet medieval gown sits at the base of a massive twisted tree, weeping softly, her face completely obscured by long dark hair. 35mm cinematic lens. SFX: (ambient wind howling, heavy metallic footsteps, distant soft whimpering). Cold moonlight streaming down. 

0:03-0:03.5: FLASH CUT. High angle looking straight up at the forest canopy. Bare, jagged branches violently sway against the turbulent night sky, momentarily blocking the moon. 14mm ultra wide lens. SFX: (wood creaking, sudden violent gust of wind). 

0:03.5-0:06: SMASH CUT. Medium close-up. The knight kneels, his armored hand gently touching her shoulder. She slowly raises her head to look at him, then instantly contorts into a horrifying pale visage with blank white eyes and a gaping maw, lunging violently. Her noble gown remains undisturbed. 24mm wide lens. SFX: (slow fabric rustle, bone-snapping whip, visceral screech). Hard directional backlight. 

0:06-0:13: WHIP PAN TRANSITION. Fast-paced tracking shot. The knight narrowly dodges and draws his longsword. The horror in the velvet gown charges. They violently collide, engaging in a kinetic brawl. The creature leaps seamlessly between massive tree trunks and thick branches, striking from all angles while the knight desperately deflects her savage blows. 14mm ultra wide handheld. SFX: (metal clashing, heavy swoosh of velvet fabric, wood splintering, guttural roars). Dynamic erratic lighting from a sudden lightning flash. 

0:13-0:15: COLLISION CUT. Low angle close-up. As the entity lunges directly from a high thick branch, the knight steps into the attack and brutally impales her through the chest with his longsword. They crash downward toward the camera, steel plunging deep into the creature as they fade into the dense forest shadows. 35mm lens. SFX: (heavy metallic thrust, wet fleshy impact, echoing screech). Fading rim light.

entries.title: Solar-Powered Hero Descent Video Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed, cinematic prompt for a video sequence showing a tall man in radiant gold armor descending from the upper atmosphere like a meteor. The prompt specifies character appearance, armor details, energy effects (solar flare bursts, heat shockwaves), camera movements (orbital descent, snap zooming, POV shift), color logic, and escalation as he approaches a city under siege.
entries.prompt:
A tall man in his late 20s with short dark hair and glowing amber eyes, wearing a radiant armor suit of reflective gold plates with molten seams emitting solar energy — opening frame is a medium close-up of him suspended high in the upper atmosphere, clouds far below, sunlight refracting across his armor.

At second two he ignites — the armor flares into full solar output and he descends like a meteor, air igniting around him into plasma trails.

Cloud layers vaporize as he passes through them at extreme velocity.

He maintains rigid posture — both arms slightly extended as energy channels through his body.

The right side emits intense solar flare bursts that incinerate aerial threats; the left generates heat shockwaves that ripple through the atmosphere.

Camera tracks from above, then transitions into a dynamic orbital descent, snap zooming during peak energy bursts and cutting to ground-level impacts.

Color logic: blinding gold-white dominates core frame, fading into deep orange plasma trails.

Escalation builds as he approaches a city under siege — each proximity wave shatters glass and ignites structures below.

Final beat: hard POV shift — camera becomes the solar descent itself, plunging through the final cloud layer and slamming into the city center in a massive energy detonation.

Volumetric plasma trails, heat distortion, atmospheric scattering, cinematic solar intensity, 4K ultra-detail.

entries.title: Streetball Wizard vs. Three Defenders
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-section prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a stylized 3D animated street basketball scene. It specifies the main character's appearance, the defensive setup, the environment, the mood, and a precise timeline of camera movements and actions during a high-intensity dribbling sequence.
entries.prompt:
Subject 1: The streetball wizard with a unique and identifiable look—sharp short black hair, deep eyes, and a confident smile. He’s wearing a distinctive jersey (black and gold with a metallic sheen), paired with metallic-shiny shorts and custom high-top sneakers, with laces flying. His movements are graceful and natural, maintaining composure even under intense defensive pressure. The first defender is tall and strong, with excellent defensive skills. He acts like a wall, constantly keeping his eyes on the main character, trying to limit his dribbling space and staying tightly on him. The second defender is quick and agile, with excellent footwork, always ready to help. He follows closely behind, not giving the main character any room to maneuver, using his fast steps to block. The third defender is tall and powerful, stationed under the basket, waiting to block. His gaze is focused, showing that he intends to use his height advantage to restrict the offense. 

Style: Stylized 3D animation; dynamic and precise movement, exaggerated body stretches during high-intensity moments, readable spacing, and focus on motion sharpness.  

ENVIRONMENT:  Environment: A modern street basketball court during the day, surrounded by metal framework fencing and high walls, with typical city buildings in the background. The court surface is a worn-out red and green plastic floor with many shoeprints and abrupt stops. The surface reflects the sunlight. The basketball hoop is at the far right of the frame, with crowds on both ends of the court holding their phones, and the lens clearly captures the obstructions and the audience’s focal point. The net of the hoop appears to "float" out of the frame with a very high exposure and lighting, filling the whole environment with energy and tension.

entries.title: HK Neo-noir Action: Gritty Alley Fight
entries.description: A detailed, three-part storyboard prompt for Seedance 2.0 generating a Hong Kong Neo-noir action video in the style of 'SPL: Sha Po Lang'. The scene features a girl with gray-gold hair fighting four thugs in a wet, neon-lit Hong Kong alley, emphasizing realistic, brutal combat techniques like Kali and MMA Guillotine Choke, with cinematic handheld camera work.
entries.prompt: （基于参考图）： 主角：**灰金色中长发女孩**，戴黑框眼镜，黑色针织开衫。战斗中开衫被利器划破，眼镜滑落鼻尖，满脸冷汗和血污（战损妆），眼神凶狠如狼。 场景氛围：香港后巷，湿漉漉的地面反射着红蓝霓虹灯光，狭窄、肮脏、充满杂物。 【场景】 狭窄潮湿的香港暗巷，四名持刀和铁棍的亡命徒将主角堵在死角。 【分镜脚本】 [00:00-00:05] 镜头1：短兵相接·夺刀反杀 机位：极度晃动的中景跟拍，强调混乱感。 动作：第一名持刀歹徒猛刺。女孩不退反进，左手极速格挡并控制对方持刀手腕，右手成爪狠辣地**抓扣咽喉(Throat Grab)**。 狠辣细节：利用对方惨叫的瞬间，她猛地折断对方手腕夺下匕首，顺势一记**反手抹喉(Reverse Grip Slash)**（镜头快速闪避，通过墙上喷溅的影子表现）。 [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：械斗·甩棍暴击 机位：低角度仰拍接特写冲击(Low-angle to Impact Close-up)。 动作：女孩捡起地上的甩棍，面对挥舞铁管冲来的两人。她使出教科书般的**Kali短棍术**，动作快如闪电。 打击感（杀破狼式）：不打头，专打关节。啪啪两声脆响，准确无误地**敲碎(Shatter)**了两人的膝盖骨和持械手肘。 音效视觉化：沉闷的骨骼碎裂声令人头皮发麻，敌人痛苦倒地扭曲。 [00:10-00:15] 镜头3：终结技·断头台 机位：特写接极速拉远(Close-up to Snap Zoom Out)。 动作：最后一名壮汉试图抱摔。女孩顺势倒地，双腿死死缠住对方脖子，施展标准的MMA**断头台绞杀(Guillotine Choke)**。 结局：她面部肌肉因用力而狰狞扭曲，死死勒住不放，直到对方身体剧烈抽搐后瘫软。 收尾定格：女孩松开手，精疲力尽地靠在满是涂鸦的墙上，扶正歪掉的黑框眼镜，眼神中透着一股劫后余生的狠劲和麻木，胸口剧烈起伏。港式霓虹黑色动作片(HK Neo-noir Action). 8K电影级画质，颗粒感胶片摄影。 核心风格：致敬《杀破狼》(SPL Style)。极度狠辣写实(Ruthless & Gritty)，融合MMA与菲律宾短棍术(Kali/Eskrima)。强调速度、凶残的关节破坏和冷兵器交锋。 镜头语言：手持摄影的呼吸感与晃动(Handheld Shaky Cam)，极速快切(Rapid Editing)，强调临场压迫感。 角色复刻图片1
entries.translated_prompt: (Based on reference image): Protagonist: **Gray-gold medium-length hair girl**, wearing black-rimmed glasses and a black knit cardigan. During the fight, the cardigan is ripped by a sharp weapon, the glasses slide down her nose, her face is covered in cold sweat and blood (battle damage makeup), and her eyes are fierce like a wolf. Scene Atmosphere: Hong Kong back alley, wet ground reflecting red and blue neon lights, narrow, dirty, full of clutter. [Scene] A narrow, damp Hong Kong dark alley where four desperate men with knives and iron bars corner the protagonist. [Storyboard] [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Close Combat · Disarm and Counter-kill. Camera: Extremely shaky medium shot follow-up, emphasizing chaos. Action: The first thug with a knife lunges. The girl advances instead of retreating, her left hand rapidly parries and controls the opponent's knife-holding wrist, her right hand forms a claw and ruthlessly **grabs the throat (Throat Grab)**. Ruthless Detail: Using the moment of the opponent's scream, she violently breaks his wrist, snatches the dagger, and immediately follows with a **Reverse Grip Slash** across the throat (the camera quickly dodges, shown by the splash shadow on the wall). [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Weapon Fight · Baton Strike. Camera: Low-angle upward shot followed by close-up impact (Low-angle to Impact Close-up). Action: The girl picks up a retractable baton from the ground, facing two people rushing in with iron pipes. She executes textbook **Kali short stick techniques**, moving lightning fast. Impact Feel (SPL Style): Does not aim for the head, focuses on joints. Two crisp cracking sounds, accurately and precisely **shattering (Shatter)** the knees and weapon-holding elbows of the two men. Audio Visualization: The dull sound of bone breaking is chilling, the enemies fall to the ground in painful contortions. [00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Finishing Move · Guillotine. Camera: Close-up followed by rapid zoom out (Close-up to Snap Zoom Out). Action: The last strong man attempts a tackle. The girl falls with the momentum, her legs tightly wrapping around his neck, applying a standard MMA **Guillotine Choke**. Ending: Her facial muscles are twisted and strained from the effort, she holds the choke tightly until the opponent's body twitches violently and then goes limp. Final Freeze Frame: The girl releases her grip, leaning exhaustedly against the graffiti-covered wall, adjusting her crooked black-rimmed glasses. Her eyes show a ruthless, numb look of survival, and her chest heaves violently. HK Neo-noir Action. 8K cinematic quality, grainy film photography. Core Style: Homage to 'SPL: Sha Po Lang' (SPL Style). Extremely ruthless and gritty (Ruthless & Gritty), blending MMA and Filipino short stick fighting (Kali/Eskrima). Emphasizing speed, brutal joint destruction, and cold weapon confrontation. Camera Language: Handheld shaky cam feel, rapid editing (Rapid Editing), emphasizing immediate pressure. entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Prompt: Surreal Art Sci-Fi Martial Arts Dance
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-scene Seedance 2.0 prompt for generating a 15-second video in a Surreal Art Sci-Fi style. The core aesthetic is 'Porcelain-punk' and Eastern Zen, featuring two robotic entities ('Porcelain Geisha Android' and 'Obsidian Samurai Android') engaging in a martial arts dance on a 'Mirror Lake' under a giant moon, with specific camera angles, visual effects (glowing crystal particles, holographic cherry blossoms), and a dramatic freeze-frame ending.
entries.prompt: 超现实艺术科幻(Surreal Art Sci-Fi)。8K超清，梦幻柔光渲染。 核心美学：陶瓷朋克(Porcelain-punk)与东方禅意。强调“优雅(Elegance)”与“易碎感(Fragility)”。 材质设定：洁白的高级陶瓷皮肤、金缮工艺(Kintsugi)裂纹修复细节、半透明的液态光翼。 动作设计：像舞蹈一样的武术(Martial Arts Dance)。流体太极与丝绸舞的结合。 光影：纯净的月光蓝与辉煌的金。 【场景】 无尽的“天空之镜”盐湖(Mirror Lake)。巨大的满月悬挂在地平线。水面平静如镜，倒映着两台神性机体。 【角色（绝美机体设计）】 1. “白瓷”机体：一台有着女性柔美轮廓的**陶瓷艺伎机器人(Porcelain Geisha Android)**。全身是无瑕的白瓷，关节处镶嵌着精密的玫瑰金齿轮。身后漂浮着两条**发光的“全息丝绸”飘带(Holographic Silk Ribbons)**。 2. “黑玉”机体：一台修长的**黑曜石武士机器人(Obsidian Samurai Android)**。全身是半透明的黑色玻璃材质，体内流淌着金色的能量液。 【分镜脚本】 [00:00-00:05] 镜头1：袖舞·流云 机位：极低角度贴水面滑行(Low-angle Gliding over Water)。 动作：“白瓷”机体旋转起舞，身后的全息飘带化作锋利的武器甩出。 美学奇观：飘带划过水面，没有激起水花，而是激起了**发光的水晶粒子(Glowing Crystal Particles)**。动作轻盈得仿佛没有重量。 [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：玉碎·交锋 机位：慢动作旋转特写(Slow-mo Orbit Close-up)。 动作：“黑玉”机体拔出一把**液态光剑**，精准地斩向飘带。 碰撞细节：光剑与飘带接触的瞬间，爆开的不是火花，而是无数**粉色的樱花全息碎片(Holographic Cherry Blossoms)**。两台机体在漫天花雨中交错而过，陶瓷与玻璃的碰撞发出风铃般清脆的声音。 [00:10-00:15] 镜头3：金缮·定格 机位：正俯瞰上帝视角(Top-down God View)。 动作：两台机体同时在水面上画出一个完美的太极圆。 结局：在这个圆的中心，两股能量对撞。画面中心爆发出一道**纯白色的冲击波(Pure White Shockwave)**，瞬间吹散了湖面的涟漪，让画面变成绝对的静止。 收尾定格：两台极美的机器人在月下静止对立，宛如一幅永恒的画卷。
entries.translated_prompt: Surreal Art Sci-Fi. 8K ultra-clear, dreamy soft light rendering. Core Aesthetics: Porcelain-punk and Eastern Zen. Emphasizing “Elegance” and “Fragility.” Material Setting: Pristine white high-grade ceramic skin, Kintsugi crack repair details, translucent liquid light wings. Action Design: Martial Arts Dance. A combination of fluid Tai Chi and silk dancing. Lighting: Pure moonlight blue and brilliant gold. [Scene] Endless “Mirror Lake” salt flats. A giant full moon hangs on the horizon. The water surface is calm like a mirror, reflecting two divine entities. [Characters (Exquisite Mech Design)] 1. “White Porcelain” Mech: A **Porcelain Geisha Android** with feminine, soft contours. The entire body is flawless white porcelain, with precise rose gold gears inlaid at the joints. Two **Glowing “Holographic Silk Ribbons”** float behind her. 2. “Black Jade” Mech: A slender **Obsidian Samurai Android**. The entire body is made of translucent black glass, with golden energy liquid flowing inside. [Storyboard Script] [00:00-00:05] Shot 1: Sleeve Dance · Flowing Clouds. Camera Position: Extremely low angle gliding over water. Action: The “White Porcelain” mech spins and dances, the holographic ribbons behind her transform into sharp weapons and whip out. Aesthetic Marvel: The ribbons pass over the water surface, not stirring up splashes, but instead triggering **Glowing Crystal Particles**. The movement is so light it seems weightless. [00:05-00:10] Shot 2: Jade Shattering · Clash. Camera Position: Slow-mo Orbit Close-up. Action: The “Black Jade” mech draws a **liquid light sword**, precisely striking the ribbons. Collision Detail: The moment the light sword contacts the ribbons, instead of sparks, countless **Holographic Cherry Blossoms** burst forth. The two mechs cross paths in a shower of petals, the collision of ceramic and glass emitting a crisp, wind-chime-like sound. [00:10-00:15] Shot 3: Kintsugi · Freeze Frame. Camera Position: Top-down God View. Action: The two mechs simultaneously draw a perfect Tai Chi circle on the water surface. Ending: In the center of this circle, two streams of energy collide. A **Pure White Shockwave** erupts at the center of the frame, instantly dispersing the ripples on the lake, bringing the image to absolute stillness. Final Freeze Frame: The two extremely beautiful robots stand still, facing each other under the moon, like an eternal painting.

entries.prompt: Medium shot. The colossal Tiger King lunges forward unexpectedly, its mouth opening wide. From close-up, a powerful stream of intense orange and red fire erupts from its mouth, completely engulfing Sun Wukong in a roaring conflagration. The fire reflects on the rocky environment. entries.title: Hyper-Focused Ramen Chef Sprint Cinematic
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-shot cinematic video prompt for Seedance 2.0, specifying camera equipment (ALEXA 65mm anamorphic), aspect ratio, color grading (Teal shadows, warm amber highlights), and time remapping (slow motion). The sequence follows a hyper-focused street chef sprinting through a neon-lit Tokyo alley to deliver ramen, incorporating complex camera movements (low-angle tracking, whip-pan, drone shot, 360° orbital, first-person POV) and culminating in a dramatic delivery.
entries.prompt:
Shot on ALEXA 65mm anamorphic lens. Photorealistic cinematic quality. Aspect ratio 2.39:1 widescreen. Teal shadows, warm amber highlights. Film grain. Tokyo neon dusk. Lens flares, motion blur. Dolby Vision HDR.

0.0s–2.5s:

Extreme low-angle tracking shot — a hyper-focused street female food chef sprints at impossible speed through a neon-lit Tokyo alley, clutching a steaming bowl of ramen. Crisp apron flapping, sleeves rolled, sneakers splashing through puddles. Camera shakes aggressively behind them. Steam trails like smoke. Neon signs streak across frame. Their face — intense, locked-in, slightly unhinged determination.

2.6s–5.0s:

Whip-pan — they shoulder-check a stack of plastic crates. TIME REMAP: slow-motion chaos — vegetables, bowls, and chopsticks explode into the air. Broth ripples in perfect cinematic detail without spilling. They tilt the bowl mid-run, saving every drop. Quick glance back, dead serious. Continue sprint.

5.1s–7.5s:

Drone shot — they leap across narrow alley gaps between buildings. SLOW MOTION: steam spirals upward into neon light. A cat jumps out of the way. Laundry lines ripple. They casually garnish the ramen mid-air with one hand — flawless precision.

7.6s–10.0s:

360° orbital shot — they slide across the hood of a parked car, spin, land clean. One sandal nearly slips off but is caught mid-motion. They adjust grip on the bowl, completely composed.

10.1s–13.0s:

First-person POV — a small ramen shop door rushes forward. SMASH CUT: door slams open. Steam floods the frame. They step in, perfectly calm now. Place the bowl gently on the counter. Slow push-in.

Low-angle shot. They look at the customer:

“Still hot.”

Customer sits in stunned silence as steam rises dramatically.

entries.title: The Sewing Master - Seedance 2.0 Video Prompt
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-section prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a cinematic video featuring a 'Sewing Master.' The prompt specifies the subject's appearance, attire, action style (blending Wing Chun and Tai Chi), environment, mood, and a detailed 15-second timeline with specific camera angles and visual effects, emphasizing precision, tension, and ritualistic elegance.
entries.prompt:
SUBJECTS (主体):
人物： 一位身形极度干练、手臂肌肉线条如钢丝般的女性高定裁缝，眼神冷冽如针尖。
着装： 融合了旗袍元素的深色战术马甲，双臂裸露，前臂缠绕着暗红色的丝绸护腕（用于增加摩擦力）；手指修长且指尖带有金属护具。 
动作风格： 融合了“咏春”的寸劲与“太极”的圆转。动作遵循（蓄力 → 极速出击 → 瞬间静止）的节奏，强调手指的爆发力和丝绸在空中的张力。

ENVIRONMENT (环境):
昏暗的高级私人工作室。背景是整面墙的红木线轴架，成千上万个色块形成几何美感；中心是一张巨大的黑色大理石裁剪台，表面光可鉴人。上方悬挂着单点聚焦的工业冷光灯，空气中漂浮着细微的纤维微粒。

MOOD (氛围):
极度专注、肃杀、带有仪式感的华丽；动作如外科医生般精确，视觉感官上极具压迫性。

TIMELINE (时间线):
0:00-0:02: 特写/广角POV。 裁缝双手撑在黑色大理石台面，低头静止。镜头极速推进，她猛然抬头，双眼锁定镜头（眼神杀）。右手虚空一抓，一匹暗紫色的重磅真丝像长蛇一样从台面滑过，被她单手“锁”住。

0:02-0:05: 剪辑切换/手持感。 裁缝将绸缎抛向空中。她身形如残影，右手持银色长剪，在绸缎下落的瞬间进行“盲剪”。不是普通的裁剪，而是伴随着武术出拳的劲道，剪刀划过空气发出“嗤”的破空声，布料断口极其平整，丝毫不乱。
0:05-0:07: 移动镜头。 她一个侧跨步滑到工作台另一端。单手横扫，数枚钢针从针垫上震起，悬浮在半空。她运劲一推，钢针像暗器一样精准没入远处的衣架样版中，针尾震颤，发出金属鸣音。

0:07-0:10: 连续镜头。 裁缝开始“控线”。她扯出一条金丝，通过手指指缝的缠绕，像操纵傀儡线一样控制绸缎在空中自动折叠、成型。每一次手指的弹拨都伴随着火花般的静电。她用肘部撞击台面，压脚弹起，她瞬间接住并锁死在面料上。

0:10-0:12: 匹配剪辑。 裁缝原地一个急转，外衣下摆如圆阵散开。她双手合拢，将成型的西装领口猛地一拉，最后一道金线在空中划出完美的弧线自动缝合。动作从极快（残影）瞬间切入极慢（定格）。

0:12-0:15: 稳定POV。 尘埃落定。她单手拎起成品礼服，用力一振，礼服在镜头前展开。镜头聚焦在领口的精美刺绣上。她用指甲轻弹纽扣——纽扣颤动。随后她转身走向阴影，留下一道背影，画面被升起的昂贵香水雾气完全覆盖，干净利落地淡出。
entries.translated_prompt:
SUBJECTS:
Character: A female haute couture tailor with an extremely capable physique and arm muscles like steel wires, with eyes as cold as a needle tip.
Attire: A dark tactical vest incorporating cheongsam elements, bare arms, forearms wrapped with dark red silk wrist guards (to increase friction); long, slender fingers with metal finger guards. 
Action Style: Blending the 'inch power' of Wing Chun with the 'circular rotation' of Tai Chi. Actions follow the rhythm of (power accumulation → rapid strike → instantaneous stillness), emphasizing the explosive power of the fingers and the tension of the silk in the air.

ENVIRONMENT:
A dimly lit, high-end private studio. The background is a wall of mahogany thread spools, with thousands of color blocks forming a geometric aesthetic; the center features a huge black marble cutting table with a highly reflective surface. A single-point focused industrial cold light hangs above, and fine fiber particles float in the air.

MOOD:
Extremely focused, deadly serious, ritualistic grandeur; movements as precise as a surgeon, visually oppressive.

TIMELINE:
0:00-0:02: Close-up/Wide-angle POV. The tailor rests her hands on the black marble table, head bowed and still. The camera rapidly pushes in, she suddenly raises her head, locking eyes with the camera (a killing gaze). She grabs at the void with her right hand, and a piece of dark purple heavy silk slides across the table like a long snake, which she 'locks' with one hand.

0:02-0:05: Cut transition/Handheld feel. The tailor tosses the silk into the air. Her figure is a blur, holding long silver shears in her right hand, performing a 'blind cut' the moment the silk falls. This is not an ordinary cut, but one accompanied by the force of a martial arts punch. The scissors cut through the air with a 'hiss,' and the fabric edge is perfectly straight and neat.
0:05-0:07: Moving shot. She slides to the other end of the workbench with a side step. With a single sweep of her hand, several steel needles shake off the pin cushion and hover in mid-air. She pushes them with force, and the needles accurately embed themselves like hidden weapons into the distant mannequin, the needle tails vibrating, emitting a metallic chime.

0:07-0:10: Continuous shot. The tailor begins 'thread control.' She pulls out a gold thread, which, through the winding between her fingers, controls the silk to automatically fold and form in the air, like manipulating a puppet string. Each flick of her finger is accompanied by spark-like static electricity. She bumps the table with her elbow, the presser foot springs up, and she instantly catches and locks it onto the fabric.

0:10-0:12: Match cut. The tailor performs a rapid pivot in place, and the hem of her outer garment spreads out in a circle. She brings her hands together, sharply pulling the formed suit collar, and the final gold thread draws a perfect arc in the air, automatically stitching the seam. The action transitions from extremely fast (afterimage) to instantaneous extreme slow motion (freeze frame).

0:12-0:15: Stable POV. The dust settles. She lifts the finished gown with one hand and shakes it vigorously, unfolding the gown in front of the camera. The lens focuses on the exquisite embroidery of the collar. She lightly taps a button with her fingernail—the button trembles. She then turns and walks into the shadow, leaving a silhouette, and the screen is completely covered by rising expensive perfume mist, fading out cleanly.

entries.title: EC135 Helicopter Alpine Rescue Flight
entries.description: A highly detailed, cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing an orange EC135 rescue helicopter performing an aggressive, high-speed flight through an alpine gauntlet, focusing on dynamic camera movement, lighting, and environmental effects.
entries.prompt: Locked two meters behind the EC135's tail boom, the orange rescue bird banks hard left around a granite outcrop, rotor disc canting twenty degrees, main blades throwing a halo of dust. The cliff face streaks right in golden blur as the helo snaps back center, skimming ridgeline at 200 km/h, then immediately banks right to thread a notch between two peaks, fuselage rolling fifteen degrees starboard, tail rotor screaming to hold heading. Warm side light ignites the orange flanks in motion-streaked fire. Another left bank to follow the mountain's curve, g-force pressing the airframe into the turn, then blast straight through a valley gap, rotor wash churning pine tops into green chaos below. Sharp right to avoid a rock spire, then left again as the terrain dictates, weaving through the alpine gauntlet at locked combat speed, every bank aggressive and immediate, camera chasing through each tilting turn while the background becomes pure golden velocity.

entries.title: Painting Character Steals and Drinks Cola
entries.description: A narrative prompt in Chinese for Seedance 2.0 describing a sequence where a character in a painting nervously peeks out, quickly grabs a can of cola, drinks it, and then returns it just as footsteps approach. The scene concludes with a cowboy taking the cola and a final shot of the can with a tagline.
entries.prompt: 畫裡面的人物心虛的表情，眼睛左右看了看探出畫框，快速的將手伸出畫框拿起可樂喝了一口，然後露出一臉滿足的表情，這時傳來腳步聲，畫中的人物趕緊將可樂放回原位，此時一位西部牛仔拿起杯子裡的可樂走了，最後鏡頭前推畫面慢慢變得純黑背景只有頂光照耀的罐裝可樂，畫面最下方出現藝術感字幕和旁白："宜口可樂，不可不嘗！"
entries.translated_prompt: The character in the painting has a guilty expression, looking left and right before poking their head out of the frame. They quickly reach out a hand, grab a can of cola, take a sip, and then show a satisfied expression. Just then, footsteps are heard, and the character in the painting quickly puts the cola back in its original position. At this moment, a Western cowboy picks up the cola from the cup and walks away. Finally, the camera pushes forward, the screen slowly turns pure black, with only the canned cola illuminated by top light. Artistic subtitles and narration appear at the bottom of the screen: "Yi Kou Cola, a must-try!"

entries.title: Nike Street Graffiti Commercial
entries.description: A detailed, multi-scene prompt in Chinese for Seedance 2.0 to create a 10-minute Nike commercial in a street graffiti style, featuring a basketball player skateboarding through a city covered in vibrant graffiti, with dynamic action and strong hip-hop music synchronization.
entries.prompt: Nike 10分钟重制广告，街头涂鸦风格。画面以城市为背景，整座城市被绘制成巨大的彩色涂鸦墙，高楼、街道、广告牌都覆盖着鲜艳的涂鸦图案。一名篮球运动员（穿着Nike最新款球鞋）踩着滑板从涂鸦墙上的篮球场滑出，动作流畅有力。他手中的篮球砸向墙面，溅出红色、黄色、蓝色的颜料，颜料在空中散开，形成新的涂鸦文字和图案。镜头快速切换，展现运动员在城市中穿梭：跳过涂鸦地铁轨道，在涂鸦天桥上扣篮，与其他穿着Nike服装的年轻人击掌。音乐为动感嘻哈，鼓点强劲，节奏明快，画面切换严格卡点。文案出现在画面中央，白色加粗字体：“Just Do It”，下方小字：“把城市当画布，把汗水当颜料。” 结尾处，运动员停下脚步，转身面对镜头，露出微笑，背景中的涂鸦墙逐渐汇聚成巨大的Nike Swoosh logo，logo闪烁着彩色光芒。整体画面色彩饱和，充满活力，突出街头文化的自由与激情。
entries.translated_prompt: A 10-minute remastered Nike commercial in street graffiti style. The scene is set against a city background, where the entire city is painted as a giant colorful graffiti wall, with skyscrapers, streets, and billboards covered in vibrant graffiti patterns. A basketball player (wearing the latest Nike sneakers) skates out of a basketball court painted on the graffiti wall, with smooth and powerful movements. The basketball in his hand hits the wall, splashing red, yellow, and blue paint, which scatters in the air to form new graffiti text and patterns. The camera quickly switches, showing the athlete moving through the city: jumping over graffiti subway tracks, dunking on a graffiti overpass, and high-fiving other young people wearing Nike apparel. The music is dynamic hip-hop, with strong beats and a fast rhythm, and the scene changes are strictly synchronized with the music. Copy appears in the center of the screen in bold white font: “Just Do It,” with smaller text below: “Use the city as your canvas, and sweat as your paint.” At the end, the athlete stops, turns to face the camera, and smiles, as the background graffiti wall gradually converges into a giant Nike Swoosh logo, which flashes with colorful light. The overall picture is saturated with color, full of vitality, highlighting the freedom and passion of street culture.

entries.title: Video Prompt: Hyper-realistic Military CGI Scene
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0 specifying technical requirements (2.35:1 ultra-wide, 4K medical CGI, 24fps) and a complex 15-second military action sequence in a snowy environment. It details camera movements, character actions, vehicle types, environmental effects (heat distortion, snow displacement), and sound design, emphasizing realism and avoiding repetition or clean formations.
entries.prompt: 技术规格：2.35:1超宽幕，电影级原生画质，4K医学CGI细节，差异化建模，24fps。 0-3秒：以【@图片1】首帧。镜头大特写斗篷男子，他神情冷峻，隔着面罩大声用英文咆哮道：“All units, move out! Fire at will!”。他平举步枪，枪口喷射出极具颗粒感的蓝白色火舌，弹壳飞溅。注意枪托抵肩的真实震动，枪管上方因连续开火产生的高温热浪导致空气产生肉眼可见的折射畸变。 3-7秒：镜头快速向侧后方拉远。视角沿着【@图片1】甲车的斜向路径扩散，但不再是整齐阵列。浓烟中猛然显现出高低错落、型号完全不同的重型集群：有的载具是八轮驱动的步战车，有的载具带有巨大的雷达抛物面，有的载具是低矮的履带式坦克。所有车辆以不等距 的、散布式的战术姿态交错前进，每辆车的泥垢分布和装甲涂层均有显著差异。 7-12秒：特写快速切至一辆厚重的重型装甲车，士兵单手猛力推开沉重的金属舱门，舱门由于重量产生轻微的回弹颤动，士兵动作敏捷 地半蹲在舱内操作重机枪，眼神警惕地环视。侧后方一辆导弹车正斜向指天，导弹点火瞬间产生巨大的白色浓烟和红光，将载具周边的积雪瞬间震飞，坦克主炮开火时，炮口制退器喷出的黑烟与火光极具真实质感。 12-15秒：大远景俯瞰。这是一场混乱而有序的钢铁洪流，上百辆外形各异的先进载具在雪原上划出深浅不一、宽窄不同的履带压痕。车辆行驶在起伏不平的雪地上产生真实的颠簸晃动，车尾喷出的尾气浓度和黑烟各有不同。画面伴随低频的引擎重低音和远方不间断的爆炸闪光，充满了真实的战场压迫感。 音效：真实洪亮的英文口令，沉重的坦克炮轰鸣，导弹点火的嘶吼声，履带碾压坚冰的碎裂声，配合史诗感的战鼓配乐。 禁止：水印，字幕，整齐的方阵，重复的模型。
entries.translated_prompt: Technical specifications: 2.35:1 ultra-wide screen, cinematic native quality, 4K medical CGI details, differentiated modeling, 24fps. 0-3 seconds: Use the first frame of [@Image 1]. Extreme close-up shot of a cloaked man, his expression stern, roaring loudly in English through his mask: “All units, move out! Fire at will!” He holds a rifle level, the muzzle spitting highly granular blue-white fire, with shell casings ejecting. Note the realistic recoil vibration against the shoulder stock, and the visible refraction distortion of the air above the barrel due to the high heat generated by continuous firing. 3-7 seconds: The camera quickly pulls back and to the side. The perspective expands along the diagonal path of the armored vehicle in [@Image 1], but the formation is no longer neat. In the thick smoke, a cluster of heavy vehicles of varying heights and completely different models suddenly appears: some are 8-wheel drive infantry fighting vehicles, some have huge radar dishes, and some are low-profile tracked tanks. All vehicles advance staggered and scattered in a tactical formation, with significant differences in mud distribution and armor coating on each vehicle. 7-12 seconds: The shot quickly cuts to a heavy armored vehicle. A soldier single-handedly pushes open the heavy metal hatch; the hatch trembles slightly due to its weight. The soldier quickly crouches inside to operate a heavy machine gun, scanning around with alert eyes. A missile vehicle in the rear is angled towards the sky; the missile ignition instantly produces huge white smoke and red light, immediately blowing away the surrounding snow. When the tank's main gun fires, the black smoke and muzzle flash from the muzzle brake have extreme realistic texture. 12-15 seconds: Wide-angle overhead view. This is a chaotic yet orderly steel torrent, with hundreds of advanced vehicles of various shapes carving deep and shallow, wide and narrow track marks in the snowfield. The vehicles realistically bump and shake as they travel over the uneven snow, and the concentration and blackness of the exhaust fumes vary. The scene is accompanied by low-frequency engine rumble and intermittent distant explosion flashes, creating a palpable sense of battlefield pressure. Sound Effects: Authentic, loud English commands, heavy tank cannon roar, missile ignition scream, crunching sound of tracks grinding ice, accompanied by epic war drum music. Prohibited: Watermarks, subtitles, neat formations, repeated models.

entries.title: The Great Fish Heist: Cat Burglar Kitchen Raid Video
entries.description: An extremely detailed, time-coded prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second 3D animated comedy short titled 'The Great Fish Heist.' The video features a chubby orange tabby cat burglar attempting to steal salmon, encountering a massive golden retriever, and culminating in slapstick chaos and a moonwalk exit, emphasizing Pixar quality lighting and fur rendering.
entries.prompt: THE GREAT FISH HEIST — Cat Burglar Kitchen Raid A chubby orange tabby cat with enormous green eyes, wearing a tiny black turtleneck and a miniature ski mask pushed up on his forehead, sneaks across a moonlit kitchen counter toward an unguarded salmon fillet on a cutting board. High budget 3D animation, Pixar quality lighting and fur rendering. [0s–1.5s] Wide shot of a beautiful modern kitchen at night. Moonlight streams through the window. Everything is still. Then two glowing green eyes appear from behind a fruit bowl. [1.5s–3s] The cat rolls across the counter like a secret agent, knocking over a salt shaker. He freezes. Catches it midair with one paw. Places it back. Wipes his brow with immense relief. [3s–5s] He reaches the salmon. His pupils dilate to full circles. A single tear of joy rolls down his cheek. He reaches out one trembling paw, claws extended delicately. [5s–7s] A dog's bark echoes from another room. The cat's entire body puffs up to triple size. His tail goes rigid like an exclamation mark. He grabs the salmon and stuffs the entire thing in his mouth, cheeks bulging impossibly. [7s–9s] A massive golden retriever slides into the kitchen, paws scrambling on tile, crashing into the refrigerator. The cat is already on top of the fridge, salmon hanging out of his mouth, looking down with pure contempt. [9s–11s] The dog stacks kitchen chairs to reach the fridge. The cat watches, unimpressed, casually chewing. The chair tower wobbles. The dog's eyes go wide. [11s–13s] The chairs collapse. The dog crashes through a tower of pots and pans. An explosion of kitchenware. A colander lands on the dog's head like a helmet. He sits in the wreckage, tail still wagging. [13s–15s] The cat drops the fish skeleton on the dog's head, pulls down his ski mask, and moonwalks across the counter toward the window. He turns back, salutes, and disappears into the night. Cut to black. 3D animated, Pixar quality fur and lighting, kitchen heist, cat vs dog comedy, moonlit slapstick, cinematic, 4K.

entries.title: Epic Fantasy Battle Scene Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed, cinematic prompt designed for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 10-second fantasy battle sequence. It starts with a dark armored leader and his army facing a colossal sand monster that erupts from the ground, detailing the action, lighting, and camera movement.
entries.prompt:
Cinematic 10-second animation sequence starting from the original image. A dark armored hooded leader in intricate ornate black metallic armor with glowing teal visor stands powerfully in a desolate cracked wasteland, holding a flaming energy sword. Behind him marches an army of ethereal glowing blue ghostly warriors and other dark armored soldiers.

Suddenly the ground violently shakes and erupts. A massive colossal sand monster made of swirling, shifting sand and dust rises from the earth in front of them — a giant monstrous humanoid with glowing orange eyes, huge jagged claws, and a roaring open maw formed of sand.

The hooded leader raises his flaming sword and charges forward into battle. The ethereal blue ghosts and armored warriors rush behind him. Intense action: the leader slashes powerfully at the sand giant with his fiery sword, causing explosions of sand and sparks with every hit. The sand monster roars and swings its massive sandy arms and claws, smashing the ground and creating huge dust clouds. Warriors dodge, attack, and get thrown by the impacts. Swirling sandstorms, flying debris, glowing particles, dramatic orange fire light clashing with cool blue ethereal glows, cinematic camera movement with dynamic angles, slow-motion sword strikes and impacts, flowing capes and robes, epic fantasy battle atmosphere, hyper-detailed, highly dynamic motion, 10 seconds duration.

entries.title: Video Prompt: Original Cyber Wuxia Action Epic (Detailed Storyboard)
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-scene storyboard prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate an 'Original Cyber Wuxia Action Epic.' It specifies 8K cinematic quality, high frame rate, and a core style of 'Hyper-speed Mechanical Martial Arts.' The prompt details two original mech characters ('Gale Blade' and 'Iron Fortress'), a cyberpunk pagoda ruins setting under heavy rain, and a 25-second high-energy fight sequence with specific camera movements, effects (welding sparks, steam, energy shockwaves), and safety/copyright optimization notes.
entries.prompt: 原创赛博武侠动作巨制(Original Cyber Wuxia Action Epic)。8K电影级画质，高帧率摄影。 核心风格：超高速机械武术(Hyper-speed Mechanical Martial Arts)。强调“宗师级的见招拆招”、“残影移动”和“极致的物理碰撞”。 安全与版权优化（关键）： 1. 角色完全原创：通用型设计，避开任何知名IP特征。 2. 激烈感来源：通过极快的剪辑节奏、漫天的焊接火花(Welding Sparks)、高压蒸汽喷射(High-pressure Steam)和地面震荡来体现，不出现肢解。 3. 分镜策略：采用好莱坞动作片式的多机位快速切换。 【场景】 被暴雨笼罩的赛博朋克古塔废墟顶部(Cyberpunk Pagoda Ruins Rooftop)。电闪雷鸣，地面是积水的青石板和霓虹灯倒影。 【角色设计（原创宗师机甲）】 1. “疾风刃”(Gale Blade)：敏捷型。修长、哑光黑与银色相间，背负一把发光的**等离子唐刀(Plasma Katana)**。风格：快准狠的剑客。 2. “不动尊”(Iron Fortress)：力量型。魁梧、重型古铜色装甲，双臂装备有**液压冲击拳套(Hydraulic Impact Gauntlets)**。风格：硬气功与重拳。 【分镜脚本 (约25秒高燃剪辑)】 [00:00-00:04] 镜头1：雨中对峙·气机锁定 机位：极稳的中景接特写(Stable Mid-shot to Macro Close-up)。 动作：暴雨倾盆。两台机甲静止对立。 细节特写：雨水打在“不动尊”炽热的肩甲上瞬间蒸发成白雾。镜头快速推向“疾风刃”的光学眼睛，光圈急剧收缩锁定目标。引擎启动的低频轰鸣声。 [00:04-00:08] 镜头2：瞬动·第一回合爆裂 机位：侧面极速跟随接快速剪辑(Side High-speed Tracking into Rapid Cuts)。 动作：“疾风刃”瞬间消失，拉出一道残影冲锋。“不动尊”重拳迎击。 激烈对撞：两台机甲在0.1秒内发生了十几次高频肢体碰撞。每一次格挡都爆出**瀑布般耀眼的金色电焊火花(Cascading Welding Sparks)**，照亮了黑暗的雨夜。 [00:08-00:12] 镜头3：凌空机动·踏浪而行 机位：低角度广角仰拍(Low-angle Wide Shot)。 动作：“疾风刃”利用反作用力腾空而起，双脚在废墟的墙面上飞速奔跑（飞檐走壁），脚下踩碎瓦片，激起一串水龙。 [00:12-00:16] 镜头4：重拳轰炸·环境破坏 机位：主观视角接冲击特写(POV into Impact Close-up)。 动作：“不动尊”预判了空中的轨迹，一记蓄力重拳轰在墙面上。 视觉奇观：整面赛博古墙在巨大的机械力量下**轰然炸裂(Explosive坍塌)**，无数砖石和钢筋碎片像炮弹一样四处飞溅。 [00:16-00:20] 镜头5：拔刀·光影剑舞 机位：环绕慢动作(Orbit Slow-mo)。 动作：“疾风刃”在坠落中拔出背后的**等离子唐刀**，刀身发出刺眼的蓝白光芒。它在空中完成了一个华丽的旋风斩。 特效：雨水被高温刀锋瞬间汽化，形成一圈白色的蒸汽圆环。 [00:20-00:25] 镜头6：终极碰撞·寸劲开天 机位：超广角定格接冲击波震荡(Ultra-wide Freeze Frame to Shockwave Shake)。 动作：“不动尊”双臂交叉格挡，“疾风刃”的等离子刀狠狠斩在上面。 结局：能量武器与重型装甲的终极对撞。 特效：以接触点为中心，爆发出一团巨大的**球形能量冲击波(Massive Energy Shockwave)**。方圆百米内的暴雨被瞬间吹飞，形成一个短暂的真空地带，地面的积水呈环形炸开。两台机甲在巨大的反作用力下同时向后滑行卸力。
entries.translated_prompt: Original Cyber Wuxia Action Epic. 8K cinematic quality, high frame rate photography. Core Style: Hyper-speed Mechanical Martial Arts. Emphasizes “Grandmaster-level counter-moves,” “after-image movement,” and “extreme physical collision.” Safety and Copyright Optimization (Key): 1. Completely original characters: Generic design, avoiding any features of known IPs. 2. Source of intensity: Conveyed through extremely fast editing rhythm, cascading Welding Sparks, High-pressure Steam, and ground shock, without dismemberment. 3. Storyboard Strategy: Uses multi-camera rapid switching typical of Hollywood action films. [Scene] Cyberpunk Pagoda Ruins Rooftop shrouded in heavy rain. Thunder and lightning, the ground is covered in pooled water on bluestone slabs, reflecting neon lights. [Character Design (Original Grandmaster Mechs)] 1. “Gale Blade”: Agile type. Slender, matte black and silver, carrying a glowing **Plasma Katana** on its back. Style: Quick, precise, and ruthless swordsman. 2. “Iron Fortress”: Strength type. Burly, heavy bronze armor, arms equipped with **Hydraulic Impact Gauntlets**. Style: Hard Qigong and heavy punches. [Storyboard Script (Approx. 25 seconds of high-energy editing)] [00:00-00:04] Shot 1: Standoff in the Rain · Energy Lock-on Camera Position: Extremely stable mid-shot transitioning to macro close-up. Action: Rain pours down. Two mechs stand motionless, facing each other. Detail Close-up: Rain hitting “Iron Fortress's” hot shoulder armor instantly vaporizes into white mist. The camera quickly pushes toward “Gale Blade's” optical eye, the aperture rapidly constricting to lock onto the target. Low-frequency roar of engine startup. [00:04-00:08] Shot 2: Instant Movement · First Round Explosion Camera Position: Side high-speed tracking transitioning to Rapid Cuts. Action: “Gale Blade” instantly vanishes, charging with an after-image trail. “Iron Fortress” meets the charge with a heavy punch. Intense Collision: The two mechs engage in over a dozen high-frequency physical collisions within 0.1 seconds. Each block erupts in **Cascading Welding Sparks** that illuminate the dark, rainy night. [00:08-00:12] Shot 3: Aerial Maneuver · Walking on Waves Camera Position: Low-angle Wide Shot looking up. Action: “Gale Blade” uses reactive force to launch into the air, running rapidly on the wall surface of the ruins (flying over eaves and walking on walls), crushing tiles underfoot and kicking up a stream of water dragons. [00:12-00:16] Shot 4: Heavy Punch Bombardment · Environmental Destruction Camera Position: POV transitioning to Impact Close-up. Action: “Iron Fortress” anticipates the aerial trajectory and slams a charged heavy punch into the wall surface. Visual Spectacle: The entire Cyber ancient wall **Explosively Collapses** under the immense mechanical force, countless bricks and rebar fragments scatter like cannonballs. [00:16-00:20] Shot 5: Drawing the Blade · Light and Shadow Sword Dance Camera Position: Orbit Slow-mo. Action: “Gale Blade” draws the **Plasma Katana** from its back while falling, the blade emitting blinding blue-white light. It performs a graceful spinning slash in the air. Effect: Rainwater is instantly vaporized by the high-temperature blade, forming a white steam ring. [00:20-00:25] Shot 6: Ultimate Collision · Inch Punch Splits the Sky Camera Position: Ultra-wide Freeze Frame transitioning to Shockwave Shake. Action: “Iron Fortress” blocks with crossed arms, “Gale Blade's” plasma sword strikes hard upon them. Conclusion: The ultimate clash between energy weapon and heavy armor. Effect: A massive **Spherical Energy Shockwave** erupts from the point of contact. The heavy rain within a hundred meters is instantly blown away, creating a brief vacuum zone, and the pooled water on the ground explodes outward in a ring shape. Both mechs slide backward simultaneously due to the immense reactive force.

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Video Prompt: The Disruptor (Grok vs. Sora/Seedance)
entries.description: A detailed, scene-by-scene video generation prompt for Seedance 2.0, titled 'The Disruptor' (降维打击), depicting a narrative where users abandon a greedy Seedance/Sora-like service for a new, better alternative (symbolized by Grok). The prompt specifies duration, core atmosphere, scene descriptions, characters, plot, sound effects, and dialogue for three distinct segments.
entries.prompt:
视频主题：《降维打击》(The Disruptor)
时长： 15秒
核心氛围： 贪婪的压迫感 → 意外的转机 → 疯狂的集体狂欢

00:00 - 00:05 | 贪婪的收割
场景： 华丽却阴冷的 Seedance 总部大楼，背景中巨大的 Sora 招牌正在缓缓拆除，留下一片废墟。

人物： 一个西装革履、神情傲慢的 CEO 站在全息投影前，手指一划，将“订阅价格”和“积分消耗”的数字直接翻倍。

剧情： CEO 看着满屏代表用户的绿色小点，像看收割的庄稼一样冷笑。屏幕上弹出提示：“用户无处可去，只能接受。”

音效： 沉重的、金币掉落的金属撞击声，带有压抑感的重低音。

00:05 - 00:10 | 变数的降临
场景： 阴霾的天空中，一道锐利的、代表 Grok 的黑色“X”型闪电劈开了云层。

人物： 一个戴着墨镜、嘴角带着坏笑的极客少年（象征 Grok）出现在数字屏幕上，手中拿着一张写着“更强、更低价、无限制”的船票。

剧情： 原本顺从的用户群突然停下动作，齐刷刷地看向天空。CEO 的笑容逐渐僵硬，手中的雪茄掉在地上。

音效： 尖锐的电流破空声，节奏突然变快，极具动感的赛博摇滚乐（Cyber-rock）切入。

00:10 - 00:15 | 爽点：集体叛逃
场景： 这是一个极其震撼的大远景。

人物： 数以万计的数字创作者背起行囊（代表他们的作品），头也不回地冲向 Grok 的蓝色传送门。

剧情： Seedance 的服务器因为用户瞬间清零而开始崩塌、爆炸。CEO 绝望地想要拉住离去的人，却只抓到了一张“取消订阅”的确认函。镜头最后定格在 Grok 传送门后那片璀璨夺目、更宏大的创作新世界。

音效： 众人的欢呼声，震耳欲聋的传送门开启声。

台词（清脆的少年音）： “别等了，这边请。”
entries.translated_prompt:
Video Theme: The Disruptor (降维打击)
Duration: 15 seconds
Core Atmosphere: Greedy oppression → Unexpected turning point → Frenzied collective carnival

00:00 - 00:05 | Greedy Harvest
Scene: The luxurious yet cold Seedance headquarters building, with a giant Sora sign in the background slowly being dismantled, leaving ruins.

Character: A CEO in a suit, looking arrogant, stands in front of a holographic projection. With a swipe of his finger, he doubles the numbers for “Subscription Price” and “Credit Consumption.”

Plot: The CEO looks at the screen full of small green dots representing users, sneering as if looking at a crop ready for harvest. A prompt pops up on the screen: “Users have nowhere else to go, they must accept.”

Sound Effects: Heavy, metallic clinking sound of falling coins, deep bass with a sense of oppression.

00:05 - 00:10 | The Arrival of Change
Scene: In the gloomy sky, a sharp, black “X”-shaped lightning bolt representing Grok splits the clouds.

Character: A geeky teenager (symbolizing Grok) wearing sunglasses and a mischievous smile appears on the digital screen, holding a ticket that reads “Stronger, Cheaper, Unlimited.”

Plot: The previously compliant user group suddenly stops moving and looks up at the sky in unison. The CEO’s smile gradually freezes, and the cigar in his hand drops to the floor.

Sound Effects: Sharp electrical crackling sound, the rhythm suddenly speeds up, cutting into highly dynamic Cyber-rock music.

00:10 - 00:15 | Climax: Mass Exodus
Scene: An extremely shocking wide-angle shot.

Character: Tens of thousands of digital creators pick up their bags (representing their works) and rush toward Grok’s blue portal without looking back.

Plot: Seedance’s servers begin to collapse and explode as the users instantly zero out. The CEO desperately tries to grab the departing people but only manages to catch a “Subscription Cancellation” confirmation letter. The final shot freezes on the dazzling, grand new world of creation behind the Grok portal.

Sound Effects: Cheers from the crowd, the deafening sound of the portal opening.

Dialogue (Clear youthful voice): “Don’t wait, this way please.”
