A vast frozen valley under pale twilight. Towering glacier walls reflect soft blue light across the snowfield while wind sweeps fine snow particles across the surface. The frozen ground glitters with crystalline frost.

**Action:**

15.0s sequence from the first-person perspective of a massive glacier tiger stalking prey. The viewer sees white fur edges at the bottom of frame and faint icy vapor in each breath. The tiger moves silently through deep snow while distant footsteps echo across the frozen valley.

At the 2-second mark the tiger breaks into a sprint. Snow explodes outward beneath its paws as the camera races low across the terrain.

A herd of elk appears ahead near a frozen river.

Velocity Ramp choreography: the tiger launches into a massive leap as the moment slows — snow crystals and frost particles suspended in the air before snapping back to real-time speed as the tiger lands across the ice.

The frozen river cracks violently beneath the impact.

**Camera:**

Low predator-eye POV racing just above the snow surface, with occasional head tilts revealing the immense glacier walls surrounding the hunt.

**Style & Constraints:**

Photorealistic fur edges, volumetric snow particles, cinematic cold lighting, realistic animal motion physics, 8K.

entries.title: Zero-Gravity Rotating Corridor Fight
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a 15-second sci-fi action sequence in one continuous take, depicting a zero-gravity fight between an agent and security personnel inside a slowly rotating high-tech transport ship corridor, emphasizing the use of the environment and constant change of spatial direction.
entries.prompt: 科幻动作片风格，15秒，一镜到底，镜头进入一条白色高科技运输舰走廊，红色警报灯开始闪烁，重力系统突然故障，整条走廊缓慢旋转起来。镜头以中近距离贴身跟随一名穿深灰战术服的特工，他在失重状态下与一名敌方安保展开极近距离搏斗。随着舱体持续旋转，地板、墙壁和天花板不断交换位置，两人一边在空中翻滚一边抓住扶手、管道和门框借力，拳击、肘击、膝撞和夺枪动作紧凑狠厉。镜头跟随人物穿过旋转舱门，掠过漂浮碎片、工具箱和闪烁灯管，空间方向不断改变却始终保持动作清晰。最后特工将敌人甩向一面透明观察窗，窗外是缓缓旋转的行星和碎裂的太空残骸，镜头在失重旋转中定格于人物重新稳住姿态的瞬间，极具高成本机械布景与特技感。
entries.translated_prompt: Sci-fi action film style, 15 seconds, one continuous take. The camera enters a white high-tech transport ship corridor. Red warning lights begin to flash, the gravity system suddenly malfunctions, and the entire corridor slowly begins to rotate. The camera closely follows an agent in a dark gray tactical suit at medium-close range as he engages in extremely close-quarters combat with an enemy security guard in a state of weightlessness. As the cabin continues to rotate, the floor, walls, and ceiling constantly swap positions. The two fighters tumble through the air, grabbing handrails, pipes, and door frames for leverage, with tight, fierce movements including punches, elbow strikes, knee strikes, and weapon disarms. The camera follows the character through the rotating hatch, past floating debris, toolboxes, and flickering light tubes. The spatial orientation constantly changes, yet the action remains clear. Finally, the agent throws the enemy toward a transparent observation window, outside of which are slowly rotating planets and fragmented space debris. The shot freezes during the weightless rotation at the moment the character regains stability, conveying a high-budget mechanical set and stunt feel.

entries.prompt:
Use the provided images as exact references for the woman, her transformed crimson relic-war form, and the radiant angelic war-saint. 15-second ultra-cinematic live-action sequence in an abandoned financial district boulevard by day, overcast sky, cracked pavement, wrecked cars, broken glass, drifting dust, damaged towers, grounded realism.

A woman walks alone down the center of the street holding a black crystalline relic shard. She stops and crushes it in her fist. Crimson-violet light bursts through her fingers and a shockwave throws dust and debris outward. In fast clean stages, black obsidian and pale ivory armor grows over her body, deep crimson fissures ignite, her face remains partly recognizable, and a crimson blade forms in her hand. Back arc-blades match the reference but stay rigid and attached-looking. Dust settles. A radiant angelic war-saint appears down the boulevard with white ceramic armor, gold seams, pale-gold eyes, rigid back fins, and a long execution spear. The angel attacks first with a fast spear rush. She blocks, reverses instantly, closes distance unnaturally fast, and slashes through the angel’s torso. entries.title: Action Comedy: Polite Master in Dojo
entries.description: A detailed prompt for a 15-second Eastern action-comedy short film in one continuous take, set inside a wooden dojo. An elderly master attempts a 'gentle balance demonstration' but accidentally sends students flying with light touches, creating an absurd and stunned atmosphere.
entries.prompt:
Eastern action-comedy style, 15 seconds, one continuous take. Inside a wooden dojo, an elderly legendary master has been invited to give a “gentle balance demonstration.” He stands at the center, humble and restrained in expression. Several students step forward one by one to assist. He merely taps a shoulder, wrist, or forehead lightly with a single finger, yet each student spins dramatically through the air, slides across the floor, crashes into soft mats, or flips behind the weapon rack. Each time, the master pulls his hand back with slight embarrassment, as if he himself did not expect that to happen. The camera shifts quickly between wide and medium shots, with action that is fluid and exaggerated. The entire dojo falls into absurd silence and stunned disbelief.

东方动作喜剧风格，15秒，一镜到底，木质道场内，一位年长的传奇宗师被邀请做“轻柔平衡演示”，他站在中央，神情谦逊克制。几位学员依次上前配合，他只是用一根手指轻轻点一下肩膀、手腕或额头，学员们却夸张地旋转飞出、滑过地板、撞进软垫、翻进兵器架后面。宗师本人每次都略显尴尬地收手，像是自己也没想到会这样，镜头在全景和中景之间快速切换，动作流畅而夸张，整个道场陷入荒谬的安静与震惊。

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Chinese Fantasy CG Prompt: Calligraphy Magic
entries.description: A detailed Seedance 2.0 prompt for generating a top-tier Chinese fantasy CG video. The scene features a white-robed immortal on a giant jade platform, using a jade brush to write powerful golden calligraphy that transforms into a massive 'Heavenly Dao' character array to destroy a target, emphasizing high saturation, gold and ink fusion, and extreme visual impact.
entries.prompt: 顶级国风动漫奇幻CG，电影级东方玄幻大片质感，超高饱和度，金墨交融，超现实主义视觉奇观，瑰丽震撼，神圣压迫感强。16:9，15秒，画面流畅丝滑，镜头高级，动作清晰，特效宏大，视觉冲击极强。  角色： 白衣清冷仙人，气质孤绝，眼神淡漠如水，手持白玉长笔，立于苍茫云海之巅的巨型白玉石台中央，仿佛执掌天道法则。  第一镜： 微距特写角色骨节分明的手腕与修长手指，白玉长笔在掌中旋转，发出清越破空鸣响。角色眼神冷漠，凌空挥毫，笔锋沙沙作响。浓黑墨迹脱笔而出，瞬间燃烧化为耀眼金芒，连续写出数十个巨大立体狂草汉字——“关注我的都发财”。每个字都笔走龙蛇，锋芒毕露，霸道狂傲。镜头慢动作突出笔锋轨迹、墨转金光、狂草成型。  第二镜： 镜头拉至全景，角色广袖轻挥，笔尖轻点虚空。所有金色狂草汉字瞬间爆亮，极速分裂复制，化作万千金字冲天升空。无数金字在天穹之间高速交错穿梭，排布严整，形成震撼字海异象。画面伴随高频金属摩擦声、神圣低吟声与强能量轰鸣，视觉爆点拉满。  第三镜： 低视角极速环绕，万千金字高速旋转，编织成覆盖天地的巨大球形天道字阵，将目标彻底笼罩。法阵缓缓自转，所有文字笔画化作无数锐利金色剑气。角色冷冷吐出一个字：“灭。”刹那间字阵爆发，万道金光贯穿天地，笔画剑气如剑雨狂绞，目标在天道法则与万剑切割中崩碎毁灭，空间震颤扭曲，巨响轰鸣。  第四镜： 仰拍大远景，金光逐渐平息，天道字阵完成绞杀后化作万丈金字洪流，从天穹倒灌回角色袖中。空中飘落残金光斑、墨滴与云雾余辉。白玉长笔化作流光消散。角色负手而立，白衣猎猎，站在白玉石台中央俯瞰云海，清冷孤绝，神性与压迫感拉满，画面震撼收尾。  要求： 整体结构清晰，起势神圣，爆发华丽，绞杀震撼，收束高贵。突出“写字成法、万字成阵、天道绞杀、金光归袖”的核心主线。画面必须有顶级国风动漫奇幻CG质感，镜头丝滑高级，特效宏大但主体清晰。
entries.translated_prompt: Top-tier Chinese fantasy animated CG, cinematic Eastern fantasy blockbuster quality, ultra-high saturation, fusion of gold and ink, surreal visual spectacle, magnificent and shocking, strong sense of divine oppression. 16:9 aspect ratio, 15 seconds duration, smooth and fluid visuals, advanced camera work, clear action, grand special effects, extremely strong visual impact. Character: A white-robed, cold and aloof immortal, with an isolated temperament, eyes as indifferent as water, holding a white jade long brush, standing in the center of a giant white jade stone platform on the vast sea of clouds, seemingly controlling the laws of the Heavenly Dao. First Shot: Micro close-up of the character's well-defined wrists and slender fingers. The white jade brush spins in the palm, emitting a clear, air-breaking sound. The character's eyes are cold. He swings the brush in the air, the tip rustling. Thick black ink detaches from the brush and instantly burns into dazzling golden light, continuously writing dozens of huge, three-dimensional wild cursive Chinese characters—"Those who follow me will get rich." Each character is dynamic and powerful, sharp and arrogant. Slow motion highlights the brush trajectory, the ink turning into golden light, and the formation of the cursive script. Second Shot: The camera pulls out to a panoramic view. The character lightly waves his wide sleeve and gently taps the void with the brush tip. All the golden cursive characters instantly burst into light, rapidly splitting and replicating, turning into thousands of golden characters soaring into the sky. Countless golden characters rapidly crisscross and shuttle between the heavens, arranged neatly, forming a shocking spectacle of a sea of characters. The visuals are accompanied by high-frequency metal friction sounds, sacred low murmurs, and strong energy roars, maximizing the visual explosion point. Third Shot: Low-angle, high-speed circling shot. The thousands of golden characters rapidly rotate, weaving into a giant spherical Heavenly Dao character array covering the sky and earth, completely enveloping the target. The array slowly rotates, and all the character strokes transform into countless sharp golden sword energies. The character coldly utters one word: "Destroy." In an instant, the array explodes, ten thousand golden lights pierce the heavens and earth, and the stroke-sword energies twist and cut like a rain of swords. The target disintegrates and is destroyed under the laws of the Heavenly Dao and the cutting of ten thousand swords. Space trembles and distorts, with a deafening roar. Fourth Shot: High-angle, long-distance shot looking up. The golden light gradually subsides. After the Heavenly Dao array completes the destruction, it transforms into a torrent of golden characters, pouring back into the character's sleeve from the sky. Residual golden light spots, ink drops, and cloud remnants float in the air. The white jade brush turns into a stream of light and dissipates. The character stands with his hands behind his back, his white robe fluttering, overlooking the sea of clouds from the center of the white jade platform, cold and isolated, maximizing the sense of divinity and oppression. The scene ends with a shocking finish. Requirements: The overall structure must be clear, the beginning sacred, the explosion magnificent, the destruction shocking, and the conclusion noble. Highlight the core storyline of "Writing characters into law, ten thousand characters forming an array, the Heavenly Dao destroying, and golden light returning to the sleeve." The visuals must have the quality of top-tier Chinese fantasy animated CG, with smooth and advanced camera work, grand special effects, but clear main subjects.

entries.title: Wartime Disaster Movie Scene, One-Shot
entries.description: A highly detailed, cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 Pro, designed to generate a continuous, one-shot scene from a wartime disaster movie. The scene follows a young messenger running through a shelled trench, past explosions and fleeing crowds, culminating in him firing a signal flare from a ruined bell tower, emphasizing realism, strong rhythm, and no cuts.
entries.prompt: 战争灾难电影感，一镜到底，清晨灰蓝色天光下，一名年轻传令员冲出被炮火撕开的地下掩体，镜头紧贴其身后高速跟随，穿过泥泞战壕、燃烧的补给车、炸裂的木桥和四散奔逃的人群。远处不断有炮弹落下，泥土、木屑、火焰和烟柱在镜头两侧连续爆开，士兵和担架队从前景横穿而过，极具临场感。主角翻越一段坍塌沙袋墙，滑下满是积水的斜坡，穿过一片布满铁丝网和弹坑的开阔地，爆炸冲击波在身后掀起巨大尘浪。最后他冲上一座半毁钟楼废墟，将一枚发光信号筒插入高处装置，镜头随之迅速拉起，俯瞰整片燃烧战场与远处仍在推进的军阵，电影级写实战争规模感，强节奏，无剪辑。
entries.translated_prompt: Wartime disaster movie feel, one-shot, under the gray-blue morning light, a young messenger rushes out of an underground bunker torn open by artillery fire. The camera closely follows him at high speed, passing through muddy trenches, burning supply vehicles, exploded wooden bridges, and scattered fleeing crowds. Artillery shells continuously fall in the distance, with dirt, wood chips, flames, and smoke columns bursting continuously on both sides of the lens. Soldiers and stretcher teams cross the foreground, creating an extreme sense of presence. The protagonist climbs over a collapsed sandbag wall, slides down a waterlogged slope, crosses an open area covered with barbed wire and shell craters, and the explosion shockwave raises a huge dust cloud behind him. Finally, he rushes onto the ruins of a half-destroyed bell tower and inserts a glowing signal flare into a high-altitude device. The camera quickly pulls up, overlooking the entire burning battlefield and the advancing military formation in the distance, achieving a cinematic, realistic sense of war scale, strong rhythm, and no cuts.

entries.title: Action Comedy: Old Master in Hotel Lobby
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt for a 15-second action comedy short film in one continuous take, featuring an elderly legendary martial arts master who casually defeats over ten attackers in a luxurious hotel lobby without changing his expression, resulting in absurd humor and chaos.
entries.prompt:
Comedy action short film style, 15 seconds, one continuous take. Inside a luxurious hotel lobby, an elderly legendary martial arts master in a simple dark jacket and jeans walks slowly toward a revolving door, completely calm and expressionless. More than ten black-clad attackers rush at him from every direction. He barely uses any force at all, casually brushing them aside, nudging a shoulder, or stepping out of the way at the perfect moment, causing them to crash into each other, tumble into the revolving door, and get spun around and flung out by the moving glass panels. The camera stays close and follows him throughout. The action rhythm is precise and restrained, while his expression never changes. Around him, chaos erupts as people fly and fall everywhere, with glass reflections and floor debris adding to the comedy. The whole scene feels like a high-budget serious action movie, but with absurd humor.

喜剧动作短片风格，15秒，一镜到底，豪华酒店大堂内，一位年长的传奇格斗宗师穿着朴素深色夹克和牛仔裤，神情极度平静，缓缓走向旋转门。十几个黑衣袭击者从四面八方冲来，他几乎不出重手，只是随手轻轻拨开、推肩、侧身让步，让袭击者们彼此相撞、摔进旋转门、被门叶连续带着转圈甩出去。镜头贴身跟随，动作节奏精准克制，表情始终冷静无波，周围人仰马翻，玻璃反光和地面碎屑增加喜剧张力，整体像高成本严肃动作片却带荒诞幽默。

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Chinese Ink Style Cat vs Dog Battle Prompt
entries.description: A comprehensive Seedance 2.0 prompt for generating a high-energy, Chinese ink-style (Wushan Wuxing/Fog Hill of Five Elements) battle video between a 'Knife-Shield Dog' and a 'Banana Cat'. The prompt details the characters, their elemental attributes (Fire/Metal/Earth vs. Water/Wood/Ice), the high-contrast red/black/gold color palette, and four distinct, action-packed camera sequences leading to a massive elemental clash climax.
entries.prompt:
雾山五行正统国漫画风，锐利硬边水墨线条，高对比红黑与青金主色调，电影级光影，国风奇幻战斗美学，强打击感，强能量碰撞感，16:9，时长15秒，画面流畅丝滑，动作连贯清晰，动态张力拉满，整体质感高级，特效炸裂但画面不乱。

角色设定：
角色一：刀盾狗，手持菜刀与盾牌，近战压迫感极强，火、金、土属性为主，战斗风格刚猛霸道，爆发力强，冲击感十足。战斗中高喊：“我的刀盾！”
角色二：香蕉猫，身法灵动诡谲，水、木、冰属性为主，动作轻巧迅疾，带水墨妖异感与东方灵气。战斗中高喊：“比比拉布！”

镜头1（开场爆发）：
断崖古林之巅，狂风卷动，雾气翻涌，刀盾狗与香蕉猫隔空对峙后瞬间出手。刀盾狗掌心爆发赤红烈焰罡气，火浪席卷前冲；香蕉猫周身凝聚幽蓝水墨漩涡，水龙咆哮冲出。火浪与水龙在空中正面碰撞，瞬间炸开大片蒸腾雾气与墨色冲击波，林木折断，山石崩裂，碎石与火星四散。低角度高速推进，镜头微震，穿插气劲对撞特写，节奏凌厉，刀盾狗嘶吼：“我的刀盾！”

镜头2（高速游斗）：
双方瞬间贴身，高速移动残影交错，展开极致流畅的近中距离连续打斗。刀盾狗挥盾冲撞、挥刀斩击，烈焰化作火蛇狂噬，金属性刃雨倾泻压制，攻势如洪流碾压；香蕉猫则以水墨长鞭抽击，木藤疾速缠绕，借身法腾挪闪避，反击刁钻迅猛。两者元素互克，火与水、金与木不断碰撞爆闪。镜头环绕急速运转，快速切镜与丝滑跟焦结合，动作清晰不糊，强光影爆闪中，香蕉猫高喊：“比比拉布！”

镜头3（环境缠斗）：
战斗升级到环境破坏层面。刀盾狗猛踏地面，引动地脉，大片土石隆起轰砸；香蕉猫借水汽凝成锋利冰棱，从侧面高速反刺。火焰焚烧古林，却被水墨瀑布强行扑灭；金属利刃飞旋突进，又被暴长木藤缠绕绞碎。地面不断龟裂，断木横飞，山壁崩口，焚毁的林木又在水木之力下诡异重生。镜头加入慢动作特写突出元素交锋细节，再切回超广角展现战场全貌，伴随明显震动反馈。刀盾狗再次咆哮：“我的刀盾！”

镜头4（大招对轰，高潮终结）：
双方同时开启最强领域。刀盾狗展开赤红黑金火焰战域，烈焰升腾，金刃盘旋，土石升空，形成毁灭性压迫场；香蕉猫开启幽蓝青金水墨灵域，水龙盘绕，木藤遮天，冰棱如雨，墨浪翻卷。双领域在断崖古林中央正面碰撞，天地失色，能量疯狂挤压后轰然爆裂，形成巨型火水墨三重冲击波，整片山林被瞬间掀翻。最终刀盾狗顶着冲击正面突进，盾牌破浪，菜刀燃起极致烈焰，一刀斩穿核心能量；香蕉猫也裹挟水墨龙影迎面冲杀，双方在最强一击中定格对撞。最后以超强爆炸收尾，雾气、火星、墨流、碎石同时炸开，画面震撼收束。

成片要求：
整体节奏参考《雾山五行》式高燃国漫战斗演出，运镜凌厉，动作必须清晰流畅，打击感强，能量碰撞炸裂，环境破坏明显，角色个性鲜明，四个镜头层层递进，最终高潮爆发，保证15秒内完成一场极具观赏性的顶级国风元素大战。
entries.translated_prompt:
Authentic Chinese ink-style animation (Wushan Wuxing/Fog Hill of Five Elements), sharp, hard-edged ink lines, high-contrast red/black and cyan/gold main color palette, cinematic lighting, Chinese fantasy battle aesthetic, strong sense of impact, strong energy collision, 16:9 aspect ratio, 15 seconds duration, smooth and fluid visuals, coherent and clear action, maximized dynamic tension, overall high-end texture, explosive special effects but uncluttered visuals.

Character Settings:
Character 1: Knife-Shield Dog, wielding a cleaver and shield, extremely oppressive in close combat, primarily Fire, Metal, and Earth attributes. Fighting style is fierce and dominant, with strong explosive power and impact. Shouts: "My knife and shield!" during combat.
Character 2: Banana Cat, agile and elusive in movement, primarily Water, Wood, and Ice attributes. Actions are light, swift, and carry a sense of ink-style eeriness and Eastern spiritual energy. Shouts: "Bi Bi La Bu!" during combat.

Shot 1 (Opening Burst):
On the edge of a cliff in an ancient forest, strong winds roll, mist surges. The Knife-Shield Dog and Banana Cat confront each other across the air and instantly strike. The Knife-Shield Dog's palm erupts with crimson flame aura, and a wave of fire sweeps forward; The Banana Cat condenses a deep blue ink vortex around its body, and a water dragon roars out. The fire wave and water dragon collide head-on in the air, instantly exploding into a large area of steaming mist and ink shockwaves. Trees snap, rocks shatter, and debris and sparks scatter. Low-angle, high-speed push-in, slight camera shake, interspersed with close-ups of the energy collision. The rhythm is sharp. The Knife-Shield Dog roars: "My knife and shield!"

Shot 2 (High-Speed Skirmish):
Both sides instantly close in, high-speed moving afterimages crisscross, engaging in extremely fluid close-to-medium range continuous fighting. The Knife-Shield Dog swings its shield to charge and its cleaver to slash. Flames transform into fire snakes to devour, and metal-attribute blade rain pours down to suppress, the offensive crushing like a torrent; The Banana Cat uses an ink long whip to strike, wood vines rapidly wrap around, dodging and weaving with agile movements, counterattacking cunningly and swiftly. The two elements counteract each other, fire vs. water, metal vs. wood, constantly colliding and flashing brightly. The camera rapidly circles, combining quick cuts with smooth focus tracking. The action is clear and not blurry. Amidst the strong light flashes, the Banana Cat shouts: "Bi Bi La Bu!"

Shot 3 (Environmental Entanglement):
The battle escalates to environmental destruction. The Knife-Shield Dog stomps the ground, triggering earth energy, and large chunks of earth and stone rise and smash; The Banana Cat uses water vapor to condense sharp ice prisms, stabbing rapidly from the side. Flames burn the ancient forest but are forcibly extinguished by ink waterfalls; Metal blades spin and thrust forward but are strangled and shredded by rapidly growing wood vines. The ground constantly cracks, broken wood flies horizontally, the cliff face breaks open, and the burned forest mysteriously regenerates under the power of water and wood. The camera includes slow-motion close-ups to highlight the details of the elemental clash, then cuts back to an ultra-wide shot to show the full battlefield, accompanied by noticeable vibration feedback. The Knife-Shield Dog roars again: "My knife and shield!"

Shot 4 (Ultimate Move Clash, Climax Finish):
Both sides simultaneously activate their strongest domains. The Knife-Shield Dog unleashes a crimson, black-gold flame battle domain. Flames soar, golden blades circle, earth and stone lift into the air, forming a destructive oppressive field; The Banana Cat activates a deep blue, cyan-gold ink spiritual domain. Water dragons coil, wood vines cover the sky, ice prisms fall like rain, and ink waves surge. The two domains collide head-on in the center of the cliff ancient forest. Heaven and earth lose color. The energy is violently squeezed and then explodes with a roar, forming a giant triple shockwave of fire, water, and ink, instantly overturning the entire mountain forest. Finally, the Knife-Shield Dog pushes forward through the impact, its shield breaking the waves, its cleaver igniting with extreme flames, cutting through the core energy; The Banana Cat also rushes forward, enveloped in a water-ink dragon shadow. Both sides freeze in a head-on collision during their strongest attack. The scene ends with a super explosion, mist, sparks, ink flow, and shattered stones bursting simultaneously. The visuals conclude with a shock.

Film Requirements:
The overall rhythm should reference the high-energy Chinese animation battle performance style of "Wushan Wuxing." Camera work must be sharp, action must be clear and fluid, impact must be strong, energy collision must be explosive, environmental destruction must be obvious, characters must be distinct, the four shots must progress layer by layer, culminating in a final climax, ensuring a highly visual, top-tier Chinese style elemental battle is completed within 15 seconds.

entries.title: First-Person POV Flying Broomstick Video Generation

Video type: vertical cinematic video, 9:16 aspect ratio, ultra realistic, 4K, 24fps

Perspective:
Strict first-person POV from a young Japanese woman riding a flying broom
Camera = her eye level
No third-person shots, no external camera

---

Character (visible elements only):
Both hands clearly visible, gripping a wooden broom stick firmly (left and right hand spaced naturally)
Hands positioned in front of the camera at lower center
Legs visible behind the broom, wearing short denim pants (shorts), bare thighs
Sneakers on feet
Slight visibility of short hair tips at top edge, moving in wind

Riding posture:
Leaning slightly forward (like riding a broom in a classic witch style)
Broom stick aligned between legs
Stable but dynamic posture

Vertical composition (9:16)
Hands and broom handle always remain in the lower 30% of the frame
Forward view dominates the upper 70% of the frame
No cutting away from POV

---

Bright daytime, clear sky, vivid and saturated colors
Japanese sightseeing locations

---

Fast forward movement
Natural up-down motion (broom floating effect)
Slight shaking from wind
Subtle tilting during turns

---

[0.0s - 1.2s | TAKE OFF]
Camera angled slightly downward
Both hands gripping broom visible
Feet lift off ground smoothly
Wind begins lightly

---

[1.2s - 3.0s | ACCELERATION]
Speed increases
Wind becomes stronger
Hands tighten grip slightly
Legs react subtly to airflow

---

[3.0s - 6.0s | SHIBUYA FLIGHT]
Fly low across Shibuya crossing
People below looking up (motion blurred)
Buildings passing quickly
Maintain stable forward POV

---

[6.0s - 8.5s | TEMPLE PASS]
Transition to Senso-ji area
Fly close to lanterns and gate
Slight slowdown for cinematic feel

---

[8.5s - 11.0s | TORII RUN]
Enter red torii gates pathway
Fly straight through multiple gates at high speed
Strong motion blur on sides

---

[11.0s - 13.0s | FINAL ASCENT]
Tilt upward slightly
Gain altitude
Sky fills upper frame
Hands still gripping broom visible

---

Effects:
Wind affecting hands, legs, and hair tips
Motion blur at edges
Depth of field: center sharp, sides slightly blurred

---

Lighting:
Bright natural sunlight, soft shadows, high contrast

---

Color grading:
Vivid, cinematic, slightly warm tone for travel appeal

---

Mood:
Exciting, मुक्त, magical, immersive travel experience
Sense of freedom and speed

Hyper-realistic POV, fantasy + tourism fusion, immersive experience

vertical video, 9:16, 10 seconds, ultra realistic, cinematic lighting, Japanese woman age 20, natural beauty, medium-length black hair, casual outfit, modern apartment room, soft daylight, high detail skin texture, shallow depth of field, subtle camera push-in

From 7.5 seconds to the end, she slowly raises her head and looks directly into the camera with a slight sinister smile, fully transformed, dark aura swirling around her, her hair moves as if blown by slow wind, camera stops and holds on her face, strong final pose, cinematic pause, slight vignette, subtle flicker effect at the end

sound design: soft ambient at beginning → slight distortion at notification → deep bass impact at transformation peak → subtle dark hum at the end

facial acting emphasis: micro expression changes, gradual loss of warmth in the eyes, transition from natural smile to emotionless to slightly sinister expression

high quality particle simulation, volumetric lighting, realistic shadow interaction, smooth transitions without hard cuts

entries.title: Ramadan to Eid Infinity Zoom Hyperlapse
entries.description: A highly detailed, two-part prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second seamless infinity zoom hyperlapse video in the style of detailed paper-cut art, capturing the journey and key moments of the Ramadan to Eid celebration.
entries.prompt:
Seamless infinity zoom hyperlapse through highly detailed paper-cut art capturing the journey of Ramadan to Eid celebration. The scene begins with a glowing crescent moon above a quiet neighborhood at sahur time, soft lantern lights flickering. The camera zooms into a house window where a family is preparing sahur, then transitions smoothly into a fast-paced hyperlapse of daily fasting moments—people working, praying, and waiting for iftar.

The zoom continues into a bustling street filled with takjil vendors and crowds at sunset, then transitions into chaotic Eid homecoming traffic (mudik), with packed cars and motorbikes moving in dynamic hyperlapse motion.

entries.prompt:
核心主题：写实科技感，科幻机甲，磅礴史诗，重工业机械美学，真人演绎，极限运动
 
人物设定：

参考@图1，完全相同，身高1.7米，面部有微脏感；红色特勤作战服，高科技战术马甲，臂腕带屏控制器，服装和配饰有明显污渍、划痕与使用痕迹；深黑夜晚，光线偏暗，表情坚毅，眉头微皱。
 
场景与机甲：
未来感飞船船舱，海上万米高空，乌云闪电，海面海雾，能见度低；80米高重型机甲，真实金属质感，重工业机械美学。
 
画质与氛围：
IMAX胶片摄影，Panavision C系列镜头，动态模糊；好莱坞青橙色调，低饱和度，暗部细节保留，胶片颗粒感，轻微柔焦；写实科幻史诗风格，机械感与重量感，好莱坞级视觉特效。
 
镜头与画面：
手持一镜到底，轻微呼吸感镜头浮动；开场平视近景，后拉跟随，跳机变身时仰拍大全景，机甲落地后环绕过肩拍摄；人物激活控制器，穿戴虚拟机械臂铠，全息投影熄灭后虚拟臂铠保留，控制器显示红色“START”。

修改后：帧描述（动作参考巨大机器人变身）

帧1-3：穿戴与行走（0-4秒）
（仅作为前置状态）

核心画面：夜晚，未来感飞船船舱内，特勤人员在行走中激活控制器并穿戴虚拟臂铠。

人物：参考照片，1.7米，眉头微皱，表情坚毅，特勤黑色作战服，战术马甲，带屏控制器，服装有污渍划痕。

动作：行走中点击左臂控制器，激活全息投影，右手伸入投影穿戴红色机械臂铠，浅蓝色投影读条显示“SUCCESS”后熄灭，臂铠保留在右手上，控制器变为红色“START”。

画质：IMAX胶片质感，青橙色调，低饱和，手持轻微呼吸感镜头，动态模糊。

帧4-5：跳机（4-6秒）

核心画面：人物跃出船舱，在空中双手展开，0.5s转体旋转360度后保持滑翔、预备的姿态，激活启动指令。

动作：走到跳伞平台，向前跨出，0.5s转体旋转360度后双手向两侧完全展开，做出经典的巨型机甲变身前滑翔姿态。高速下坠中，点击左臂控制器激活“启动协议”（Protocol Start），伴随戏剧化的数字化浅蓝色调全息界面。

镜头：极速下坠拉近镜头，随后匹配人物速度保持距离，捕捉其滑翔预备姿态。

环境：海上万米高空，乌云闪电，海雾弥漫，能见度低。

帧6-8：组合（6-8秒）

核心画面：机甲部件有序全息影像扩增变大，精确、高速地在人物周围组合成实体机甲中机甲各部件飞掠、组合的动作）。

变身过程（关键点）：

人物（比例1:47）在空中保持滑翔姿态，两套巨大的腿部和脚部部件（具有重工业机械美学，非方块）机甲全息虚拟影像从下方和侧面扩张蔓延，精确地附着并锁定在人物的下方，人物双脚踩入实体机甲。

两套巨大的手臂部件（包括保留的右手机械臂铠）和胸部核心部件全息虚拟投影变大扩增蔓延，精确地定位、对接并锁定，将人物身体完全包裹，外部实体机甲框架显现。

最后，机甲的头部和经典的V字天线部件从角色面部以全息虚拟投影变大扩增蔓延，旋转并锁定在顶部，形成实体机甲双眼点亮。

视觉：在部件全息投影扩张蔓延和组合时，有细腻的粒子对齐、机械锁定和能量释放效果，有炫酷的粒子和光线。

比例：人物（占比极小）完全融合在机甲核心内，变身过程流畅、有序、一气呵成。

镜头：仰拍，机甲框架占满画面。

帧9-11：完成（8-11秒）

核心画面：机甲组合完毕，在空中短暂停留并摆出经典的巨型机甲完成姿态，高速下坠准备着陆。

动作：机甲在空中组合完成瞬间，头部天线弹出，双眼点亮（产生镜头光斑），双手（特别是右手的虚拟/机械臂铠）做出经典的“完成”或“滑翔后准备”姿态。随后，机甲姿态转换，全身推进器点亮，高速下坠。

机甲细节：哑光涂装磨损掉漆，关节油污，推进器点亮，产生镜头光斑。

动态：高速下坠，边缘棱角发红发烫，留下拖尾轨迹。

风格：重工业机械美学，真实金属质感，好莱坞级特效。

帧12：震荡（11-12秒）
（保留原动作，重现重型着陆感）

核心画面：机甲如陨石般砸向海面，单脚跪姿单手撑地着陆，激起滔天巨浪。

着陆：机体悬挂压缩，回弹有厚重阻尼感。

海面：深蓝色海面被砸开，数百米高环形水墙扩散，水下水花与气泡漩涡，排山倒海的冲击力。

画质：8K超细节，每滴水珠清晰可见，低饱和青橙色调，胶片颗粒感。

7、昂扬（12-14秒）

起身：机甲着陆片刻缓缓起身（史诗感）。翻涌的海水如海啸般冲击着机身，机甲起身的过程中，机体流出大量海水。巨大身躯在海浪中巍然矗立，海水只没过其膝盖部分，周围有如苍蝇般大小的直升飞机飞过，强烈的对比感凸显其难以置信的宏伟尺寸。机甲周身环绕着浓密的蒸汽和水雾，光线穿过产生丁达尔效应。直升飞机探照灯扫过机甲，金属表面产生霓虹反射效果。
 
7、威胁（14-15秒）
（保留原动作）
巨兽：机甲正前方远处出现一只体型庞大，散发荧光的海兽，对机甲发出咆哮。
entries.translated_prompt:
Core Theme: Realistic sci-fi feel, sci-fi mecha, epic grandeur, heavy industrial mechanical aesthetic, live-action performance, extreme sports
 
Character Setting:

Reference @Image 1, completely identical, 1.7 meters tall, slightly dirty face; red special forces combat uniform, high-tech tactical vest, arm-worn controller with screen, clothing and accessories show obvious dirt, scratches, and signs of use; deep dark night, dim lighting, resolute expression, slightly furrowed brow.
 
Scene and Mecha:
Futuristic spaceship cabin, 10,000 meters high above the sea, dark clouds and lightning, sea surface fog, low visibility; 80-meter tall heavy mecha, realistic metal texture, heavy industrial mechanical aesthetic.
 
Image Quality and Atmosphere:
IMAX film photography, Panavision C-series lens, motion blur; Hollywood orange-teal color grading, low saturation, details preserved in dark areas, film grain, slight soft focus; realistic sci-fi epic style, sense of machinery and weight, Hollywood-level visual effects.
 
Camera and Framing:
Handheld one-shot, slight breathing camera float; opening flat close-up, pull back and follow, low-angle wide shot during jump and transformation, orbiting over-the-shoulder shot after mecha landing; character activates controller, puts on virtual mechanical arm armor, virtual arm armor remains after the holographic projection extinguishes, controller displays red “START”.

Modified: Frame Description (Action reference: giant robot transformation)

Frames 1-3: Wearing and Walking (0-4 seconds)
(Only as a pre-state)

Core Scene: Night, inside a futuristic spaceship cabin, special forces personnel activate the controller and put on virtual arm armor while walking.

Character: Reference photo, 1.7 meters, slightly furrowed brow, resolute expression, black special forces combat uniform, tactical vest, controller with screen, clothing has dirt and scratches.

Action: While walking, taps the left arm controller, activates the holographic projection, right hand reaches into the projection to put on red mechanical arm armor, light blue projection progress bar displays “SUCCESS” and then extinguishes, arm armor remains on the right hand, controller turns red “START”.

Image Quality: IMAX film texture, orange-teal color grading, low saturation, handheld slight breathing camera, motion blur.

Frames 4-5: Jumping (4-6 seconds)

Core Scene: Character leaps out of the cabin, spreads arms in the air, rotates 360 degrees in 0.5s, then maintains a gliding, ready posture, activating the start command.

Action: Walks to the jump platform, steps forward, rotates 360 degrees in 0.5s with arms fully spread to the sides, adopting the classic gliding posture before a giant mecha transformation. During high-speed descent, taps the left arm controller to activate “Protocol Start,” accompanied by a dramatic digital light blue holographic interface.

Camera: Extreme speed descent close-up, then matches the character's speed to maintain distance, capturing the gliding ready posture.

Environment: 10,000 meters high above the sea, dark clouds and lightning, dense sea fog, low visibility.

Frames 6-8: Assembly (6-8 seconds)

Core Scene: Mecha components orderly expand and enlarge via holographic projection, accurately and rapidly assembling into the physical mecha around the character (showing the components flying and combining).

Transformation Process (Key Points):

Character (1:47 scale) maintains a gliding posture in the air. Two sets of massive leg and foot components (featuring heavy industrial mechanical aesthetic, non-blocky) mecha holographic virtual images expand and spread from below and the sides, accurately attaching and locking onto the character's lower body. The character's feet step into the physical mecha.

Two sets of massive arm components (including the retained right mechanical arm armor) and the core chest component holographic virtual projections enlarge and spread, accurately positioning, docking, and locking, completely enveloping the character's body. The external physical mecha frame appears.

Finally, the mecha's head and classic V-fin antenna component enlarge and spread from the character's face as a holographic virtual projection, rotating and locking into place at the top, forming the physical mecha's illuminated eyes.

Visuals: During the expansion and assembly of the component holographic projections, there are delicate particle alignment, mechanical locking, and energy release effects, with cool particles and light.

Scale: The character (extremely small proportion) is fully integrated into the mecha core. The transformation process is smooth, orderly, and seamless.

Camera: Low-angle shot, mecha frame fills the screen.

Frames 9-11: Completion (8-11 seconds)

Core Scene: Mecha assembly is complete, briefly hovering in the air and striking the classic giant mecha completion pose, then descending at high speed, preparing to land.

Action: The moment the mecha assembly completes in the air, the head antenna pops out, the eyes light up (creating lens flare), and the hands (especially the virtual/mechanical arm armor on the right hand) adopt the classic “completion” or “post-gliding ready” pose. Subsequently, the mecha changes posture, all thrusters light up, and it descends at high speed.

Mecha Details: Matte paint worn and chipped, oily joints, illuminated thrusters, creating lens flare.

Dynamics: High-speed descent, edges glowing red hot, leaving a trailing trajectory.

Style: Heavy industrial mechanical aesthetic, realistic metal texture, Hollywood-level special effects.

Frame 12: Impact (11-12 seconds)
(Retaining the original action to reproduce the heavy landing feel)

Core Scene: The mecha smashes into the sea surface like a meteor, landing in a single-knee kneeling posture with one hand bracing the ground, kicking up a massive tidal wave.

Landing: The body suspension compresses, rebounding with a heavy damping feel.

Sea Surface: The deep blue sea surface is split open, hundreds of meters high circular water wall spreads, underwater splashes and bubble vortices, overwhelming impact force.

Image Quality: 8K ultra-detail, every drop of water clearly visible, low saturation orange-teal color grading, film grain.

7. Rising (12-14 seconds)

Rising: The mecha slowly rises after a brief moment of landing (epic feel). The surging seawater impacts the mecha like a tsunami, and a large amount of seawater flows out of the mecha during its ascent. The massive body stands towering in the waves, with the water only reaching its knees. Helicopters, appearing fly-sized, fly around, highlighting the incredible scale. Dense steam and water mist surround the mecha, and light passing through creates a Tyndall effect. Helicopter searchlights sweep across the mecha, and the metal surface produces a neon reflection effect.
 
7. Threat (14-15 seconds)
(Retaining the original action)
Beast: A massive, glowing sea creature appears in the distance directly in front of the mecha, roaring at it.

Two heavily armored desert off-road vehicles speed through a narrow iron-rich canyon, scattered with abandoned mining equipment and giant crane hook pendulums hanging on both sides. [0-3 seconds · Canyon Cut-in] The camera cuts in between the canyon walls, closely following the leading chariot as it rapidly retreats—the heroine stands motionless on the roof Image 2. Giant hook pendulums on both sides of the canyon swing slowly high above. [3-7 seconds · Pendulum Trap Trigger] The heroine's mechanical prosthetic arm suddenly points upwards—the driver simultaneously triggers the overhead crane hook; the giant pendulum violently sweeps across, tearing off armored plates, chains, tools, and metal fragments from the chasing vehicle. An entire car door flips and scatters in the canyon side light; the enemy vehicle suddenly turns, and exposed suspension systems spark violently. The heroine stands steadily on the roof, the flag spear drawing an arc; the camera sweeps low beneath the swinging hook, wheel hub covers are torn off, and metal fragments scatter in the narrow ochre-red canyon light. [7-11 seconds · Countering the Pendulum · Breaking the Trap] The enemy counter-attacks by dragging the leading chariot towards a preset pendulum trap—the chariot violently swerves, the heroine's mechanical prosthetic arm instantly spreads five fingers and inserts them into the steel frame of the roof to lock the center of gravity. A mechanical spine structure unfolds along her back to resist the impact. The metal neck armor bursts with blue and white electric arcs to counteract the pendulum's pulling force; the flag spear is significantly deflected by the airflow impact, but the heroine's mechanical prosthetic arm rotates in reverse to firmly press down on the flag pole; the chariot drifts to the limit, squeezing into a narrow rock fissure, while the giant hook pendulum horizontally tears the enemy vehicle's entire body towards the canyon rock wall, smashing it with a crash. [11-15 seconds · Rushing Out of the Canyon · Freeze Frame before the Mech] The leading chariot rushes out of the canyon exit. The light suddenly switches from the ochre-red canyon side light to the warm yellow, strong backlight of the desert sun; the camera slowly decelerates and pulls back—in the open post-apocalyptic desert ahead, the silhouette of a giant mech Image 3 stands towering amidst black smoke and the scorching sun. The heroine still stands on the roof, holding the red flag spear high in one hand, pointing directly at the mech's cockpit. The white suit is covered in flying sand, and the ponytail hair floats against the light in the explosion's heatwave; the camera finally freezes in a low-angle, wide-shot, strictly replicating the composition Image 3—the abandoned chariot occupies the bottom right of the frame, the giant mech fills the left side of the sky, and the black smoke and scorching sun create an epic sense of oppression, slowly fading out. [Style/Quality]: 4K ultra-high definition, sharp clarity, rich details, no blur or ghosting, post-apocalyptic industrial blockbuster style, strong contrast between ochre-red canyon side light and warm yellow desert backlight, realistic physical effects of tearing metal, dense dust and violent momentum throughout. [Constraints]: Normal human structure, stable and undistorted face, no screen flicker. The heroine's clothing and mechanical details strictly adhere to the original appearance of Image 1 throughout. The final freeze-frame composition is strictly replicated, and the flag spear length remains consistent throughout. Duration 15 seconds.

entries.prompt: FORMAT: cinematic continuous shot / motivated camera movement / 15s SCENE A crowded medieval market street inside a stone city at dusk. Narrow cobblestone road, wooden stalls, hanging banners, livestock moving through the crowd. Warm torchlight reflects on damp stones while light mist drifts between buildings. CAMERA CONCEPT A continuous motivated camera move where each new moving subject entering the frame redirects the camera’s attention. Every motion naturally hands the focus to the next subject. SEQUENCE 0:00–0:03 Close street-level view of a market stall. CAMERA FOCUS: a woman bargaining with a merchant while selecting fruit from a wooden basket. She hands coins to the merchant. 0:03–0:05 A horse pulling a heavy wooden cart suddenly crosses the foreground from the opposite direction, briefly blocking the frame. CAMERA SHIFT: the camera catches the cart and begins tracking it as it moves through the market. 0:05–0:07 The cart squeezes between stalls and brushes past a hanging banner. The banner swings violently across the frame. CAMERA SHIFT: as the banner clears the view it reveals chickens scattering across the cobblestone street. 0:07–0:09 A street boy runs after the escaping chickens, chasing them through the crowd. CAMERA SHIFT: the camera begins following the boy as he runs between villagers. 0:09–0:12 The boy rushes past a tavern entrance and disappears into the crowd. CAMERA SHIFT: the tavern door suddenly swings open as someone exits. 0:12–0:15 The camera glides through the open doorway into the dim tavern interior. Lantern light flickers across wooden tables and drifting smoke. CAMERA FINAL FOCUS: a lone armored knight sitting quietly at a corner table, a massive sword leaning beside the bench as the knight slowly lifts his gaze. STYLE Layered medieval street life, natural crowd choreography, continuous motivated camera movement. LIGHTING Warm torchlight outside, dim lantern glow inside the tavern, smoke and dust catching the light. QUALITY photorealistic, cinematic lighting, grounded camera motion, rich medieval atmosphere, highly detailed

entries.prompt: FORMAT: 15s / MULTI-CUT / 6 BEATS / HIGH-VIRAL COMEDIC PAYOFF SUBJECTS: A small round-faced figure with huge eyes, copper-red pigtails, a yellow polka-dot dress, and exaggerated cartoon proportions. A tall ice cream vendor with a curled mustache, crimson vest, tilted cap, and a long brass paddle carrying elastic white ice cream. Stylized 3D animation with rounded shapes and squash-and-stretch. ENVIRONMENT: A sunlit stone courtyard in an old hillside town with flower-draped archways, a mosaic fountain, ceramic bowls, and a brass ice cream cart with copper bells. Late afternoon light creates warm highlights on cobblestone. MOOD: Fast slapstick mischief with instant hooks, fake wins, and a crowd-pleasing payoff. COLOR LOGIC: Hyperreal Pop Look TIMELINE: 0:00-0:02: The Scroll Stop. Extreme close-up, 50mm. Huge eyes reflect a spinning white scoop, then pull fast to a wide shot, 35mm, revealing the figure frozen mid-skid as the vendor presents the brass paddle like a stage trick. SFX: sharp gasp, bell flutter, fountain splash. 0:02-0:04: Match cut into The First Miss. Close-up, 50mm. Hands clap shut on empty air as the cone snaps upward. The face stays frozen while the pupils tilt up. SFX: quick whoosh, soft clap, tiny squeak, crowd chuckle. 0:04-0:07: Cut on action into The Side Switch. Medium wide shot, 35mm. The vendor slides the paddle behind his back and pops the cone out on the other side. The figure lunges left, scrambles right, and pinwheels in place. A tea glass rattles on a nearby table. SFX: paddle swishes, shoe skids, glass clink, growing laughter. 0:07-0:09: Reaction cut into The Fake Victory. Medium close-up, 50mm. The cone lands in the waiting hand and the face bursts into victory, then the vendor peels the stretchy scoop away in one smooth move, leaving the cone bare for a beat. SFX: victory chime cut short, peel wobble, laughter pop, offended inhale. 0:09-0:11: Insert cut into The Public Humiliation. Insert shot of a ceramic cat staring from a shelf. Smash cut to a medium shot, 35mm, as the figure sags into noodle posture, then puffs both cheeks and folds both arms while onlookers bounce with silent laughter. SFX: tiny huff, crowd laughter swell, cart bell tinkle. 0:11-0:15: Whip pan transition into The Real Win. Medium close-up, 50mm. The vendor kneels and places the cone gently into the waiting hand with no trick this time. One still beat. The figure looks down, eyes sparkle, then the camera pulls back to a wide shot, 35mm, as the figure leans in for the first taste and the courtyard breaks into applause. SFX: soft handoff, held-breath pause, bright chime bloom, applause burst, warm music lift.

entries.prompt: 场景：第一人称视角战场 - 黄昏 / 阴天 单镜头（第一人称视角） 氛围：混乱、幽闭和紧张。泥泞、烟灰和潮湿铁金属的气味充斥着空气，被骑士沉重的头盔狭窄的开口所限制。巨大的巨人怪物的庞大身躯和不可阻挡的力量与被困在沉重盔甲中的人类视角形成鲜明对比。 镜头描述： 从骑士头盔内部持续不断的、无间断的第一人称视角拍摄，通过坚硬的金属面罩狭缝（没有玻璃）框取剧烈的身体互动。摄像机模拟出身体遭受巨大动能打击时的沉重、剧烈的物理效果，被向后抛飞，在泥泞中快速翻滚以躲避斧头，并用手持宽剑抵地拦截巨人的冲力。 时间轴 / 分镜头： 0:00-0:03 - [第一人称视角 / 24 毫米广角 / 手持晃动镜头]。透过黑暗、刮花的金属面罩狭缝，一个巨大的巨人向前猛扑并直拳攻击骑士，将主体击飞。 音效：刺耳的金属撞击声，突然响起的高频耳鸣声开始。 光照：刺骨的、散射的灰色黄昏光线笼罩着泥泞的战场。 0:03-0:06 - [突然的空中翻滚/猛烈撞击]。动能冲击将装甲骑士远远地抛向空中。地平线通过狭窄的面罩狭缝快速旋转和翻滚，在令人迷失方向的失重弧线中，突然重重地坠入泥地。刺耳的、震耳欲聋的耳鸣声瞬间掩盖了所有背景噪音。 音效：尖锐的耳鸣声，随后是装甲重重砸在泥地上的沉闷声响。 0:06-0:10 - [低角度视角/快速侧身翻滚]。巨人迅速缩短距离，高耸在上空，挥舞着一把巨大的生锈战斧。摄像机模拟在泥泞土地上快速进行全身桶滚；天空、泥地和巨人一起在令人头晕目眩的水平旋转中模糊在一起，巨大的斧刃猛烈地砸向附近的软泥，撞击时剧烈地晃动了摄像机。 音效：沉重的钢铁切割空气的呼啸声，震耳欲聋的轰鸣声。 0:10-0:15 - [低角度主观镜头/重型地面锚定]. 在翻滚中，一个泥泞覆盖的钢铁手套疯狂地从泥泞中抓起一把被丢弃的宽剑。当巨人再次冲锋时，骑士坚定地将剑柄牢牢地锚定在地面上，将剑尖向上瞄准。咆哮的巨人纯粹向下的动量使其猛烈地撞击在锚定的刀刃上，在紧张的、残酷的动能碰撞中停止了冲锋。装甲手套在画面中剧烈摇晃，努力抵抗着推动下压的巨大生物的沉重压力。 音效：沉重的物理撞击声，巨人挣扎时深沉的低音咆哮声。 技术及渲染： - 相机：狂乱、沉重的第一人称主观视角，模拟人类身处铁甲内的重量感，通过头盔面罩限制视野范围。 - 光线：弥散、阴沉的黄昏，冷色调且带有刺眼的金属反射。 - 镜头：24mm（模拟人眼视野但被头盔外壳扭曲）。 - 修饰：使用 35mm 胶片拍摄，照片级真实感，电影氛围照明，高度细节，原始素材，电影画面，8k 分辨率，体积渲染。 细节与纹理： - 头盔的开放式面罩缝隙处，厚重铁质框架上凝固着凹痕和厚泥，确保视野完全不受任何非自然玻璃反光的阻碍。 - 巨人食人魔粗糙、崎岖的灰绿色皮革皮肤，沾满汗水和污垢。 - 摇晃的钢铁护手甲上，有深深的、参差不齐的刮痕和生锈的凹陷。 音效层： 0:00-0:04: 激烈的战场环境音突然被震耳欲聋的金属撞击声切断。 0:04-0:10: 刺耳的持续耳鸣声完全掩盖了外部声音，头盔内急促、吃力的呼吸声。 0:10-0:15: 沉重的金属碰撞声，深沉的咆哮声逐渐穿透逐渐减弱的耳鸣声。
entries.translated_prompt: Scene: First-person perspective battlefield - Dusk / Overcast. Single shot (first-person perspective). Atmosphere: Chaotic, claustrophobic, and tense. The smell of mud, soot, and damp iron metal fills the air, restricted by the narrow opening of the knight's heavy helmet. The massive body and unstoppable force of the giant monster contrast sharply with the human perspective trapped in heavy armor. Lens Description: Continuous, uninterrupted first-person perspective shooting from inside the knight's helmet, framing intense physical interaction through the slit of the hard metal face mask (no glass). The camera simulates the heavy, violent physical effects of the body suffering a huge kinetic impact, being thrown backward, quickly rolling in the mud to dodge an axe, and using a handheld broadsword anchored to the ground to intercept the giant's charge. Timeline / Shot Breakdown: 0:00-0:03 - [First-person perspective / 24mm wide-angle / handheld shaky shot]. Through the dark, scratched metal face mask slit, a huge giant lunges forward and attacks the knight with a straight punch, throwing the subject flying. Sound Effects: Piercing metal impact sound, sudden onset of high-frequency tinnitus begins. Lighting: Biting, diffused gray twilight light envelops the muddy battlefield. 0:03-0:06 - [Sudden aerial tumble/violent impact]. The kinetic impact throws the armored knight far into the air. The horizon quickly rotates and tumbles through the narrow face mask slit, suddenly crashing heavily into the mud in a disorienting, weightless arc. Piercing, deafening tinnitus instantly drowns out all background noise. Sound Effects: Sharp ringing sound, followed by the dull thud of armor hitting the mud heavily. 0:06-0:10 - [Low-angle perspective/fast side roll]. The giant quickly closes the distance, towering overhead, wielding a huge, rusty battle axe. The camera simulates a fast full-body barrel roll on the muddy ground; the sky, mud, and giant blur together in a dizzying horizontal rotation. The huge axe blade violently smashes into the nearby soft mud, shaking the camera violently upon impact. Sound Effects: Whistling sound of heavy steel cutting through the air, deafening roar. 0:10-0:15 - [Low-angle subjective shot/heavy ground anchor]. During the roll, a mud-covered steel gauntlet frantically grabs a discarded broadsword from the mud. As the giant charges again, the knight firmly anchors the sword hilt to the ground, aiming the tip upward. The roaring giant's sheer downward momentum causes it to violently impact the anchored blade, stopping the charge in a tense, brutal kinetic collision. The armored gauntlet shakes violently in the frame, struggling to resist the heavy pressure of the massive creature pushing down. Sound Effects: Heavy physical impact sound, deep bass growl of the giant struggling. Technology and Rendering: - Camera: Frenzied, heavy first-person subjective perspective, simulating the sense of weight of a human inside iron armor, limiting the field of view through the helmet face mask. - Lighting: Diffused, gloomy twilight, cool tones with dazzling metal reflections. - Lens: 24mm (simulating human eye vision but distorted by the helmet shell). - Modification: Shot on 35mm film, photorealistic, cinematic atmosphere lighting, high detail, raw footage, cinematic screen, 8k resolution, volumetric rendering. Details and Texture: - At the slit of the helmet's open face mask, solidified dents and thick mud on the heavy iron frame, ensuring the view is completely unobstructed by any unnatural glass reflections. - The giant ogre's rough, rugged gray-green leather skin, stained with sweat and dirt. - Deep, jagged scratches and rusty dents on the shaking steel gauntlet. Sound Layer: 0:00-0:04: The intense battlefield ambient sound is suddenly cut off by a deafening metal impact sound. 0:04-0:10: Piercing, continuous tinnitus completely masks external sounds, rapid, labored breathing inside the helmet. 0:10-0:15: Heavy metal collision sounds, deep growls gradually penetrate the fading tinnitus.

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Prompt for a Luxury Towel Commercial
entries.description: A detailed, multi-stage prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a cinematic commercial for a luxury towel brand named 'Adam'. The video script includes an 'Impact' phase (micro-view of water absorption), an 'Emotional' phase (model gently wiping neck), and a 'Brand' phase (logo reveal).
entries.prompt:
[主体]: 亚洲美女(五官精致， 比例自然， 面部稳定不扭曲)@【@图1】，黑色波浪长发， 一条具有奢华质感的纯白毛巾(纤维蓬松).
[时间线脚本]: 
1-5秒 (冲击篇): 极微距视角， 晶莹的水珠像瀑布一样砸向毛巾， 毛巾触碰水滴瞬间， 水滴被“黑洞式”吸收消失， 画面产生强烈的物理张力， 配合 3秒缓慢变焦 (Slow Zoom In). 
5-12秒 (情绪篇): 镜头转为 环绕镜头 (Orbit)， 亚洲美女缓慢且温柔地用毛巾擦拭脖颈， 闭眼微笑， 头发随微风轻摆， 丁达尔暖橙色光影洒在皮肤上， 呈现电影级调色. 
12-15秒 (品牌篇): 画面背景逐渐虚化， 镜头平滑后拉 (Pull Out)， 画面正中央由光影汇聚成清晰的艺术字体“Adam”， 字迹锐度清晰.

[镜头语言]: 希区柯克变焦(Dolly Zoom)衔接环绕运镜， 画面流畅丝滑， 稳定无抖动.
[旁白]: (脚本) “Adam，给肌肤最温柔的答案。”.
[风格/画质]: 4K超高清， 电影质感， 每一个毛圈细节可见， 色彩饱和自然， 无模糊重影.
[约束]: 人体结构正常， 动作不僵硬， 同一角色面部不换脸， 结尾品牌文字显示准确.

- 音效：急促的呼吸声 

00:02–00:06（4s） 
- 景别：中景跟拍 + 低角度仰拍
- 动作：
1. 女主脚下一滑，身体瞬间失去重心。
2. 她惊呼一声 “啊——！”，双手胡乱挥舞，裙摆被风吹得飞扬起来。 
- 表情：女主瞳孔地震，从慌张变成惊恐。
- 音效：风声 + 重物落地的闷响（被接住的声音）

 00:06–00:15（9s）

2. 顺势将她打横抱进怀里。
3. 女主整个人撞进他坚实的胸膛，鼻尖蹭到他衣襟上冷冽的龙涎香。

- 男主：原本冰冷的眉眼，在触到她温热的身体时，眼底瞬间柔和，嘴角勾起一抹极淡的、不易察觉的笑意。
- 台词（男主低沉磁性，带着一丝宠溺的无奈）： “我是谁?我就是你翻墙也要逃婚的摄政王。” 

- 景别：双人怼脸特写（CP感拉满）
- 动作：
1. 男主拇指轻轻摩挲着女主被他抓在掌心的手腕。
2. 微微俯身凑近，额头抵着她的额头，两人鼻尖相触，呼吸交缠。
3. 女主睫毛剧烈颤抖，长长的睫毛在眼下投出一片阴影。
- 表情：
- 女主眼神湿漉漉的，带着水汽，又气又羞，眼眶微红。眼神闪躲，双手抵住男主的胸口。
- 男主深情凝视她，眼神里满是占有欲和藏不住的温柔。

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Supercar Showcase Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed 10-second prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a video showcasing five different supercars, focusing on their personality and performance. The prompt specifies the car types, five distinct scenes, a progressive shot sequence (static close-up to dynamic sci-fi), detailed timing (0-2s, 2-4s, 4-10s), specific camera movements (tracking, orbiting, following), visual effects (motion blur, distortion), and sound design (Brazilian funk music).
entries.prompt:
以“超跑个性与性能”为核心，10秒内串联5款特色超跑（红黑碳纤维超跑、蓝绿色光泽超跑、黄色经典兰博基尼、黄黑赛事风超跑、银色未来概念车），覆盖室内车库、明亮展厅、户外展示区、赛道、科技感室内5大场景。

从静态设计到动态行驶，全方位呈现超跑的外观质感与性能属性。

采用“静态特写→静态光效衬托→动态行驶→动态特效强化→科幻化动态”的递进式分镜。

0-2秒聚焦超跑静态细节（材质、线条）。

2-4秒用场景+光效突出视觉焦点，

4-10秒逐步强化动态感。

静态段落用“局部推近（如碳纤维纹理、车灯）+整体定格”镜头，动态段落切换为“跟拍（黄黑超跑赛道行驶）+环绕（荧光绿超跑移动）+动态跟随（概念车穿梭）”。

每2秒为一个节奏单元，0-2秒（快切静态）用0.5秒/帧的快速分镜，2-4秒（稳承光效）1秒/帧聚焦黄色兰博基尼与光效的融合，4-10秒（强动态）再次提速并通过特效增强视觉冲击。

光效贴合超跑定位，运动模糊通过“模糊程度递进”让观众感知“速度递增”，画面扭曲特效为概念车设计强化“未来穿梭”科幻感。

镜头捕捉静态时关注“进气口棱角、轮毂辐条数量”等细节，动态时捕捉“车身轻微颠簸、尾翼随速度调整、车轮与车身同步运动”。

色彩上动态段落光效色与超跑色呼应，静态段落均为“深色+亮色”搭配，多辆超跑突出“性能化细节”，场景保留“地面纹理清晰度”。搭配巴西funk音乐。
entries.translated_prompt:
Focusing on "Supercar Personality and Performance," string together 5 distinctive supercars within 10 seconds (red and black carbon fiber supercar, blue-green glossy supercar, yellow classic Lamborghini, yellow and black racing style supercar, silver future concept car), covering 5 major scenes: indoor garage, bright showroom, outdoor display area, racetrack, and futuristic interior.

Present the supercar's exterior texture and performance attributes comprehensively, from static design to dynamic driving.

Use a progressive sequence of shots: "Static Close-up → Static Lighting Emphasis → Dynamic Driving → Dynamic Special Effects Enhancement → Sci-fi Dynamics."

0-2 seconds focus on static details of the supercar (material, lines).

2-4 seconds use scene + lighting effects to highlight the visual focus.

4-10 seconds gradually strengthen the sense of dynamism.

Static segments use "local push-in (e.g., carbon fiber texture, headlights) + overall freeze-frame" shots; dynamic segments switch to "tracking shot (yellow and black supercar driving on track) + orbiting shot (fluorescent green supercar moving) + dynamic following (concept car traversing)."

Each 2 seconds is a rhythmic unit; 0-2 seconds (fast-cut static) use 0.5 seconds/frame fast cuts; 2-4 seconds (steady lighting) 1 second/frame focusing on the fusion of the yellow Lamborghini and lighting effects; 4-10 seconds (strong dynamics) accelerate again and enhance visual impact with special effects.

Lighting effects match the supercar's positioning; motion blur uses "progressive blur levels" to make the audience perceive "increasing speed"; screen distortion effects are designed for the concept car to enhance the sci-fi sense of "future traversing."

When capturing static shots, the camera focuses on details like "air intake edges, number of wheel spokes"; when dynamic, it captures "slight body bumps, rear wing adjustment with speed, synchronized movement of wheels and body."

In terms of color, the dynamic segments' lighting colors echo the supercar colors, while static segments use a "dark + bright color" combination, highlighting "performance details" of multiple supercars, and the scene maintains "clear ground texture." Accompanied by Brazilian funk music.

特效核心：暗烟粒子实体化汇聚、机甲咬合微动画、黑焰扩散、空间震颤

【运镜·FPV极限手持】

【时间轴·分镜】

0–3秒｜战场残存

动作： 战场废墟，烈火燃烧的中世纪要塞遗迹，尸横遍野，浓烟滚滚，血红天空被黑云撕裂。男主单膝跪地，身后战友已倒，他低垂着头，发丝沾血，右手死死捏着暗域法球，球体震颤，暗紫烟气从指缝渗出。他缓缓抬起头，眼神从绝望切换为燃烧。

镜头： FPV极低机位贴地冲向人物，经过倒地士兵，震颤推至面部极近特写，捕捉眼神变化瞬间。镜头抖动激烈，如同在炮击震波中手持拍摄。

3–6秒｜法球碎裂·觉醒引爆

动作与特效： 男主咬紧牙关，低吼一声，右拳猛然握碎法球。

碎裂瞬间——一声低沉的能量爆鸣，如同深渊裂开。黑紫色冲击波以人物为圆心向外炸裂扩散，地面石块被气浪掀飞，周围火焰被压平再暴力反弹。暗烟粒子如活物般从碎片中喷涌，迅速缠绕右臂向全身蔓延。

男主双眼瞳孔被暗红烈焰取代，嘴角微微上扬，一种黑暗的平静覆盖了疲惫。

镜头： 法球碎裂瞬间镜头猛烈震颤失焦，冲击波扫过镜头产生色差畸变，快速修正后绕右侧高速环轨一圈。

6–9秒｜撕裂与重构·肉身之痛

动作： 男主仰头，眉心死死锁紧，承受体内黑暗能量的强行重写。

特效核心：

皮肤表面迸射出暗色金属碎屑，如同从体内向外穿刺

黑色液态金属从脊柱处开始渗出，如融化的暗铁沿身体蔓延

衣物被撕裂抽离，布料碎片被黑色能量场吸附后化为灰烬

骨骼重组的闷响声，关节处迸发出暗紫电弧

胸腔内部透出黑红色光芒，皮肤如裂缝般显现能量纹路

镜头： 手持近身跟拍，因能量冲击频繁失焦再对焦，模拟摄影师被气浪推退的效果。

9–12秒｜黑铁机甲·降临组装

装甲生长特效（超细节）：

躯干甲：黑铁流线型装甲板从暗烟中实体化，带有血红能量纹路浮雕，表面如熔岩冷却的裂痕质感，缝隙中渗出暗紫能量光流

肩甲：巨大的锋刺肩甲对撞咬合，爆发黑色电光，留下永久咬合齿痕，肩甲顶端的骨刺如活物般缓慢生长

头盔覆盖：黑色装甲碎片从颈部向上蔓延包裹面部，形成参考图中的尖顶鬼王头盔造型——尖锐的三叉王冠从顶部刺出，面甲缝隙透出暗红眼光，无任何透明显示屏，纯粹的黑暗钢铁威压

战斗披风：黑色残破披风从肩甲处自动展开，如同暗焰燃烧的翅膀轮廓

微动画细节：装甲接缝处的棘刺微微震颤调整，如同呼吸；每块甲片边缘的腐蚀纹路实时蔓延

氛围特效： 变身完成瞬间，方圆十米地面上的血迹与尘土被黑色威压气场压成环形波纹，周围火焰全部变色为紫黑色火焰。

镜头： 快速环绕360°低角度轨道，装甲每一块咬合时镜头同步震颤，如同物理冲击波直接打在摄影机上。

12–15秒｜完成·战场屠戮

最终形态： 全套黑铁尖刺机甲，参考图中索伦式鬼王造型——三叉尖顶头盔，巨型锋刃肩甲，全身暗黑重甲，血红能量纹路。

武器具象化： 双手张开，掌心暗烟凝聚旋转，瞬间化作一把巨型黑焰大剑——剑身宽厚，刻满古老诅咒纹路，黑焰沿剑刃燃烧，偶尔迸出暗紫闪电。

战场屠戮序列（快剪）：

第一斩：大剑横扫，气浪将三名敌兵同时击飞，镜头FPV跟随剑轨运动

第二斩：仰冲刺穿，镜头贴地仰拍剑刃向下劈落，冲击波炸开地面

第三斩：旋转斩击，摄影机被气浪旋转带动，画面同步旋转失稳

暗骑士停步，站立于火焰与倒伏敌兵之间，黑焰披风翻卷，头盔缝隙透出暗红眼光直视镜头

最终镜头： 极低角度仰拍，镜头缓慢向后拉远，暗骑士巍然伫立于燃烧的战场废墟之上，黑焰大剑插地，火焰映照黑铁甲身，画面定格。
entries.translated_prompt:
【Core Theme】

Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu, battlefield awakening, shattering of the dark smoke orb, black iron mecha Dark Knight, cinematic dark divinity.

【Character Basic Settings】

100% realistic Korean male face, with knife wounds and bruises on the face, blood seeping from the corner of the mouth, eyes carrying a burning will after extreme exhaustion and despair. Black damaged combat uniform, fabric edges scorched by war fire, stained with mud and dark red blood. Muscular build, kneeling on one knee, panting, right hand tightly gripping a "Dark Domain Orb" emitting surging dark purple and black smoke—the sphere contains swirling deep red and dark purple energy vortices, like a sealed black hole.

【Atmosphere and Quality】

Visual Tone: Cinematic texture, IMAX film camera, Panavision DXL2 lens, focal length 28mm, aperture f2.8.

Color Palette: Dark orange, scorched black, dark purple main tones. Fire backlighting highlights the contours, compressed shadows retain details.

Style Core: Heavy industrial CG aesthetic, emphasizing the fusion of metallic texture and dark magic, as if reality is being torn apart.

Special Effects Core: Dark smoke particles materialize and converge, subtle mecha articulation animation, black flame diffusion, spatial tremor.

【Cinematography·FPV Extreme Handheld】

Full FPV first-person follow-up feel, high-speed camera switching, handheld without stabilizer.

Lens Breathing: Simulates the extreme follow-up of a battlefield photographer, intense tremor + rapid focus breathing.

Dynamic Trajectory: Extreme close-up impact → fast orbiting → violent pull-out from low angle → full battlefield panoramic dive.

【Timeline·Shot Breakdown】

0–3 seconds | Battlefield Remnants

Action: Battlefield ruins, burning medieval fortress remnants, corpses scattered everywhere, thick smoke rolling, blood-red sky torn by black clouds. The male lead kneels on one knee, his comrades fallen behind him. He lowers his head, hair stained with blood, right hand tightly clutching the Dark Domain Orb. The sphere trembles, and dark purple smoke seeps from his fingers. He slowly raises his head, his gaze switching from despair to burning resolve.

Camera: FPV extremely low angle rushes towards the character, passing fallen soldiers, the tremor pushes to an extreme close-up of the face, capturing the instant the gaze changes. The camera shakes violently, as if being shot handheld during artillery shockwaves.

3–6 seconds | Orb Shattering·Awakening Explosion

Action and Effects: The male lead grits his teeth, lets out a low roar, and violently crushes the orb with his right fist.

Instant of shattering—a low, deep energy boom, like the abyss opening. A black-purple shockwave explodes outward, centered on the character. Ground stones are lifted by the air blast, and surrounding flames are flattened and then violently rebound. Dark smoke particles surge from the fragments like living things, rapidly wrapping around the right arm and spreading across the entire body.

The male lead's pupils are replaced by dark red flames. The corner of his mouth slightly turns up, a dark calmness covering his exhaustion.

Camera: The moment the orb shatters, the camera violently shakes and loses focus. The shockwave sweeps across the lens, causing chromatic aberration. After rapid correction, it orbits the right side at high speed for one circle.

6–9 seconds | Tearing and Reconstruction·Physical Pain

Action: The male lead tilts his head back, his brow tightly locked, enduring the forced rewriting of dark energy within his body.

Core Effects:

Dark metallic fragments burst from the skin's surface, as if piercing outward from within the body.

Black liquid metal begins to seep out from the spine, spreading along the body like molten dark iron.

Clothing is torn and stripped away, fabric fragments are absorbed by the black energy field and turn to ash.

Muffled sound of bone restructuring, dark purple electric arcs burst from the joints.

Black-red light penetrates from inside the chest cavity, and energy patterns appear on the skin like cracks.

Camera: Handheld close-up follow-up, frequently losing and regaining focus due to energy impact, simulating the effect of the photographer being pushed back by the air blast.

9–12 seconds | Black Iron Mecha·Assembly and Descent

Armor Growth Effects (Ultra Detail):

Torso Armor: Black iron streamlined armor plates materialize from the dark smoke, featuring blood-red energy pattern bas-reliefs, the surface textured like cracks in cooling lava, with dark purple energy light streams seeping from the gaps.

Shoulder Armor: Giant spiked shoulder pads collide and interlock, erupting black electric light, leaving permanent bite marks. Bone spurs on the top of the shoulder pads slowly grow like living things.

Helmet Coverage: Black armor fragments spread upward from the neck, enveloping the face, forming the spiked Ghost King helmet shape seen in the reference image—sharp trident crown protrudes from the top, dark red light shines through the faceplate gaps, no transparent display screen, pure dark steel oppression.

Battle Cloak: A black tattered cloak automatically unfolds from the shoulder pads, resembling the silhouette of wings burning with dark flames.

Micro Animation Details: The thorns at the armor joints slightly tremble and adjust, like breathing; the corrosion patterns on the edge of each plate spread in real-time.

Atmospheric Effects: The moment the transformation is complete, the bloodstains and dust on the ground within a ten-meter radius are compressed into circular ripples by the black oppressive aura. All surrounding flames change color to purple-black flames.

Camera: Fast 360° low-angle orbit. The camera trembles synchronously with each armor plate interlocking, like a physical shockwave hitting the camera directly.

12–15 seconds | Completion·Battlefield Slaughter

Final Form: Full set of black iron spiked mecha, referencing the Sauron-esque Ghost King design—trident spiked helmet, giant blade shoulder pads, full dark heavy armor, blood-red energy patterns.

Weapon Materialization: Hands spread open, dark smoke condenses and rotates in the palms, instantly forming a giant black flame greatsword—the blade is wide and thick, engraved with ancient curse patterns. Black flames burn along the edge of the blade, occasionally bursting with dark purple lightning.

Battlefield Slaughter Sequence (Quick Cut):

First Slash: The greatsword sweeps horizontally, the air blast simultaneously knocking back three enemy soldiers. The camera FPV follows the sword's trajectory.

Second Slash: Upward charge and pierce. The camera shoots from a low angle on the ground as the blade slashes downward, the impact blast tearing open the ground.

Third Slash: Spinning slash. The camera is spun by the air blast, the image rotates and loses stability synchronously.

The Dark Knight stops, standing between the flames and the fallen enemies. The black flame cloak billows. Dark red light shines through the helmet gaps, staring directly at the camera.

Final Shot: Extreme low-angle upward shot. The camera slowly pulls back. The Dark Knight stands majestically on the burning battlefield ruins. The black flame greatsword is plunged into the ground. Flames reflect off the black iron armor. The screen freezes.

entries.title: Colossal Ocean Leviathan Attack on a Megacity Harbor

entries.prompt:
A colossal ocean leviathan, 300 meters long with armored whale-like plating and luminous bioluminescent currents flowing through translucent fins, rises from the deep ocean just offshore of a megacity harbor — hook at second two: the creature breaches vertically through the water, displacing millions of tons of ocean in a single eruption.

A wall of water surges outward from the breach point.

The destruction is tidal and structural: container ships lift like toys in the surge, harbor cranes snap as their bases flood, and seawalls crumble under the sudden pressure of displaced ocean mass.

Each movement of the leviathan generates secondary tidal waves.

Entire docks tear free from their foundations.

The gauntlet progresses inland through a waterfront district consumed by the surge: port infrastructure ripped apart → cargo ships sliding through city streets → mid-rise buildings collapsing as floodwater erodes their foundations.

Oil storage tanks rupture.

Ferries crash into office towers.

Chase-cam skimming just above the floodwater as the leviathan swims through partially submerged streets.

Velocity ramp when the creature’s tail strike generates a secondary megawave that overtops the entire harbor barrier.

Cut to aerial: half the coastal district now underwater.

The leviathan circles within the newly formed inland sea.

Diegetic deep-ocean bioluminescence reflecting through floodwater and shattered glass, cinematic water displacement physics, massive volumetric spray and debris simulation, 4K.

 0:04-0:10 | 升级： 镜头向右转动，聚焦于一名跪地的装甲将士。他以插入地面的长枪为支点，起初一动不动，唯有沉重的呼吸在寒冷中呼出白气。残破的战袍在寒风中剧烈抽打，铠甲上的血迹和烟灰随着身体的颤抖而碎裂脱落。镜头以几乎不可察觉的精度缓慢逼近并绕至其身后，不断收紧框架，拒绝提供任何安全感。 音效： 粗重的呼吸声、盔甲的嘎吱声、战袍剧烈的抽打声、埋在土下的残骸在风中发出的微小碰撞声。

 0:10-0:15 | 高潮： 越过将士肩膀，烟雾短暂变稀，一个庞大的身影带着沉重得不可思议的力量穿过黑色帷幕，其全貌始终未曾完全显露。将士感知到了威胁，恐惧地抬起头，呼吸急促，双手紧握枪柄，随后猛力拔出长枪。拔枪的动作将泥土和余烬扬起并甩向镜头，此时巨兽的轮廓在瞬间变得更加清晰。 音效： 沉重的踩踏声、烟雾风声骤降、急促的吸气声、钢铁挣脱血土的尖锐声、泥土和灰烬爆裂四散声。
entries.translated_prompt:
Format: 15 seconds / One-take / Cinematic realism / No cuts, oppressive and heavy suspense, post-battle residual environmental sound design.

Scene Description: A battlefield where the fires of war have just been extinguished, visibility is low, and the air is filled with choking smoke and the lingering smell of charring. The ground is soaked with blood and war damage, covered with broken flags, snapped weapons, and layers of fallen soldiers' remains. A soldier in tattered armor kneels alone in the wreckage, his long spear stuck in the bloody soil supporting his body. His armor is stained with blood and soot, and his body seems ready to collapse at any moment from cold and exhaustion. The audience should feel intense desolation, suffocation, and a sense of tension as if shrouded in darkness, as if although the war has ended, some more terrifying threat still lurks in the shadows. The entire clip must be presented with an uninterrupted, stealth-like camera movement.

 Timeline:
0:00-0:04 | Setup: Low-angle stealth perspective tracking shot, moving through thick smoke and scattered embers. The lens is constantly hit by flying charcoal particles and dust, creating intermittent visual obstruction. The camera slides past a tattered battle flag stained with blood and mud, bearing a fragmented unit number, then reveals the outlines stacked beneath the ashes: a piece of armor pierced by arrows, a helmet half-buried in the soil. The overall composition exhibits David Fincher-style precise control and information withholding. Sound Effects: Residual sounds of raging fire, the harsh scraping of soot against metal, distant lingering echoes of explosions.

 0:04-0:10 | Escalation: The camera rotates to the right, focusing on the kneeling armored soldier. He uses the spear inserted into the ground as a support point, initially motionless, with only heavy breathing exhaling white mist in the cold air. His tattered battle robe whips violently in the cold wind, and the blood and soot on his armor crack and flake off as his body trembles. The camera slowly approaches with almost imperceptible precision and circles behind him, continuously tightening the frame, refusing to provide any sense of security. Sound Effects: Heavy breathing sounds, the creaking of armor, the violent whipping sound of the battle robe, tiny collision sounds from debris buried under the soil in the wind.

 0:10-0:15 | Climax: Moving over the soldier's shoulder, the smoke briefly thins, and a massive silhouette, carrying an incredibly heavy force, passes through the black curtain, its full appearance never completely revealed. The soldier senses the threat, raises his head in fear, breathing rapidly, gripping the spear handle tightly, and then forcefully pulls out the long spear. The action of drawing the spear kicks up mud and embers, throwing them towards the camera, at which point the silhouette of the giant beast instantly becomes clearer. Sound Effects: Heavy footsteps, the sudden drop in smoke and wind noise, rapid gasping sounds, the sharp sound of steel breaking free from the bloody soil, the bursting and scattering sounds of mud and ashes.

entries.prompt: 预设场景：持剑人站在云层之上的山巅，下面日落云霞翻涌如涛涛江海，风吹的的发丝和白衣飞舞。 【0-2s】动作：持剑人于悬崖之巅的青石板上静立，右手反握剑柄，剑身斜指下方云海，周身气息内敛。镜头：超广角镜头从低角度缓缓上摇，全景展现悬崖峭壁、翻腾云海与持剑人，暗调冷色营造肃杀氛围。场景：悬崖边缘布满苍劲古松，松枝被山风吹得狂舞，云雾在脚下翻涌，偶尔有雄鹰在云海间盘旋 【2-4s】动作：持剑人右脚蹬地，身形如箭窜出，同时拔剑出鞘，剑随身走，划出一道半圆弧线。镜头：跟拍镜头极速推进，伴随轻微旋转，捕捉剑身出鞘瞬间的寒芒，运动模糊强化速度感。场景：剑气撕裂云雾，形成不规则气流，悬崖上的碎石被脚步震落，坠入云海消失不见 【4-6s】动作：身形腾空，左手剑诀指天，右手剑横向劈出，剑招刚劲有力 无人机从侧面环绕拍摄，定格空中劈剑的瞬间，慢放0.5秒凸显剑势凌厉。场景：空中云雾被剑气搅碎，形成环形雾团，远处的雪山在云雾中若隐若现，山顶积雪在阳光下闪耀 【6-8s】落地后左脚尖点地，身形旋转360度，剑随身旋，剑花层层绽放。镜头：环形环绕镜头贴身跟拍，快速变焦捕捉剑花细节，镜头微震强化旋转冲击力。场景：旋转带起的气流卷动松针，松针与云雾交织飞舞，悬崖上的积雪被旋转剑气搅出雪雾 【8-10s】动作：剑交左手，右手化掌推出，同时左脚前踏，剑随掌势直刺前方。镜头：特写镜头聚焦剑尖，从剑尖视角向前推进，展现直刺的迅猛速度。场景：剑尖刺破云雾，云雾在剑尖凝结成水滴，前方的云海中隐约可见一座悬浮的仙岛轮廓 【10-12.5s】动作：收剑于腰侧，身形向后飘退，右脚在青石板上划出一道弧线，留下浅浅痕迹。镜头：拉远镜头从全景逐渐缩小，捕捉飘退轨迹与石板痕迹，暗调光影突出身形飘逸感。场景：飘退带起的气流吹得松枝剧烈晃动，松涛声在山谷中回荡，云海被气流搅出层层涟漪 【12.5-15s】动作：右脚落地瞬间，剑再次出鞘，向上撩起，剑招灵动飘逸。镜头：低角度仰拍镜头，跟随剑势向上移动，慢放剑撩起的瞬间，凸显剑招灵动。场景：剑气将上方的云雾向上挑起，形成一道雾帘，雾帘后的天空透出淡淡的霞光
entries.translated_prompt: Preset Scene: The swordsman stands on the peak of a mountain above the clouds, with the sunset clouds below surging like a vast ocean. The wind blows the hair and white clothes. [0-2s] Action: The swordsman stands still on a bluestone slab at the edge of the cliff, holding the sword hilt in a reverse grip with the blade pointing diagonally down towards the sea of clouds; the surrounding aura is contained. Camera: Ultra-wide-angle lens slowly pans up from a low angle, showing a full view of the cliff, the surging sea of clouds, and the swordsman. Dark, cool tones create a solemn atmosphere. Scene: The edge of the cliff is covered with vigorous ancient pines, their branches wildly swaying in the mountain wind. Clouds and mist surge at the feet, with eagles occasionally circling in the sea of clouds. [2-4s] Action: The swordsman pushes off with the right foot, darting out like an arrow, simultaneously drawing the sword, which follows the body, tracing a semi-circular arc. Camera: Follow-up shot rapidly advances, accompanied by slight rotation, capturing the cold glint of the blade as it is drawn, with motion blur enhancing the sense of speed. Scene: Sword energy tears through the clouds, forming irregular air currents. Loose stones on the cliff are shaken off by the footsteps, falling into the sea of clouds and disappearing. [4-6s] Action: The body leaps into the air, the left hand pointing the sword-sign to the sky, and the right hand horizontally cleaving with the sword; the move is vigorous and powerful. Camera: Drone shoots from the side, circling, freezing the moment of the aerial cleave, slowed down to 0.5 seconds to highlight the sharpness of the sword strike. Scene: The clouds in the air are shattered by the sword energy, forming a circular mist ring. Distant snow-capped mountains are faintly visible in the mist, their peaks glistening in the sunlight. [6-8s] Action: After landing, the left toe touches the ground, the body rotates 360 degrees, the sword follows the body's rotation, and sword flowers bloom layer upon layer. Camera: Circular orbiting shot closely follows the body, rapidly zooming to capture the details of the sword flowers, with slight camera shake enhancing the impact of the rotation. Scene: The airflow generated by the rotation swirls pine needles. Pine needles and mist interweave and fly. The snow on the cliff is stirred up into a snow mist by the rotating sword energy. [8-10s] Action: The sword is transferred to the left hand, the right hand pushes out as a palm strike, while the left foot steps forward, and the sword follows the momentum of the palm, thrusting straight ahead. Camera: Close-up shot focuses on the sword tip, advancing forward from the sword tip's perspective, showing the swiftness of the straight thrust. Scene: The sword tip pierces the mist, which condenses into water droplets on the tip. The outline of a floating immortal island is vaguely visible in the sea of clouds ahead. [10-12.5s] Action: The sword is retracted to the waist, the body drifts backward, the right foot drawing an arc on the bluestone slab, leaving a shallow mark. Camera: Long shot gradually zooms out from the full view, capturing the trajectory of the backward drift and the mark on the stone slab. Dark lighting highlights the ethereal quality of the movement. Scene: The airflow generated by the backward drift causes the pine branches to shake violently. The sound of pine waves echoes in the valley, and the sea of clouds is stirred into layers of ripples by the airflow. [12.5-15s] Action: The moment the right foot lands, the sword is drawn again, sweeping upward; the move is agile and graceful. Camera: Low-angle upward-panning shot follows the sword's momentum, slowing down the moment of the upward sweep to emphasize the sword's agility. Scene: The sword energy lifts the clouds above, forming a curtain of mist. Faint rays of sunset glow are visible through the mist curtain.

entries.prompt:
人物设定：@男主，现代装束（黑色风衣或深色长款外套，发型自然凌乱），气质冷峻霸道，眼神如刃，全程保持角色一致性。

0–3s：极致面部特写，@男主立于雪山之巅，凛冽寒风吹动发丝与风衣衣角，左手负于身后，右手缓缓抬起指向苍天，镜头锁定他的眼睛——眼神从冷静到爆发，瞳孔中倒映着翻滚雷云，嘴型清晰怒吼「剑来！」二字，声音与画面同步震撼，体积光从云层缝隙穿透打在他脸上，轮廓感极强。

3–7s：镜头以极速无缝广角推远切换至上帝俯瞰视角，雪山之巅的@男主身影迅速缩小至画面中心一个黑点，镜头持续拉远展现宏伟现代都市全景——摩天大楼、立交桥、霓虹灯尽收眼底，整座城市在雷云笼罩下气氛压抑震撼，雷云滚滚电闪雷鸣，天空呈现冷青钢铁质感。

entries.title: Pure Hand-Drawn 2D Cartoon Witch Flight Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A highly specific JSON prompt for Seedance 2.0, instructing it to generate a video in the style of pure hand-drawn 2D animation (drawn on ones), explicitly forbidding 3D or CGI elements. The scene features a young witch flying on a broom over an ancient European town at golden hour, using a tight rear-follow camera shot, with detailed descriptions of the witch's billowing cloak, wild hair motion, and hand-painted watercolor backgrounds.
entries.prompt: A young witch flies on a broom over an ancient European town at golden hour. The camera stays tight behind her back as the town opens ahead. Her dark purple cloak whips directly into camera, animated with hand-drawn cloth physics. Her long messy brown hair lashes wildly in all directions with expressive independent strands. She flies between narrow stone buildings with flower pots, red tiled roofs, and climbing greenery. Hand-drawn wind lines split around her body and curl into small vortices behind her. As she passes windows, her wind blasts shutters open in a domino chain. White curtains burst outward. Golden sunlight flashes through the glass and creates hand-drawn 2D lens bloom with glowing dust. The town below reacts. People point upward, hats blow away, rooftop cats jump, pigeons explode into flocks, leaves spiral through her wake, and laundry lines whip violently. Suddenly laundry lines cross her path. She tries to dodge. She brakes hard. Her body lurches forward over the broom from the sudden deceleration while her legs lift backward. Too late. She bursts through the first line. A large white shirt catches on her face and completely covers it. A sheet wraps around her body. A sock dangles from the broom. She wobbles on the broom - one leg kicked sideways, one hand gripping tightly, the other yanking wildly at the shirt covering her face. Angry muffled words bubble under the fabric. Her head jerks right-left-right in exaggerated hand-drawn motion with extreme squash and stretch. Her neck elongates with each shake. Her eyes briefly spin when the shirt lifts. She pulls hard. The shirt flies off her face. Her face is revealed: messy hair, comic fury, clenched teeth, burning eyes, deeply furrowed brows - then a long exhale and visible relief. She straightens herself on the broom, leans forward, grips tightly, and accelerates. Hand-drawn speed lines stream around her. A building suddenly appears ahead. She brakes sharply. Her body and broom compress forward. She banks hard around it, shoulder nearly scraping the wall, then snaps back to a straight path and accelerates again. A shop sign appears overhead. She flattens herself low against the broom as the sign passes mere centimeters above her head. Another laundry line appears. entries.title: Construction Time-Lapse and Deconstruction Prompt Comparison (Seedance 2.0 vs. Grok)
entries.description: The user compares the performance of Grok and Seedance 2.0 for generating a time-lapse video of a building's construction/deconstruction. The tweet contains two highly detailed prompts: one for construction (used for Seedance 2.0) and one for deconstruction (used for Grok). Only the construction prompt is extracted as it was successfully used with Seedance 2.0, demonstrating a clear video generation instruction.
entries.prompt:
固定机位广角延时摄影，完整记录一座建筑从空白地基到竣工落成的全过程。镜头始终固定，仅通过时间压缩（10-30倍速快进）呈现建造节奏，可见自然光在画面中循环更替（清晨→正午→黄昏→夜间）。 Phase 0｜空白起点 空旷平整的原始场地，地面可见测量桩和轮廓放线。施工设备尚未进场，背景环境（山/海/城市天际线）清晰可见，是全片唯一不变的稳定元素。静止画面持续3秒。 Phase 1｜场地准备与基础施工 挖掘机、推土机快速进场，围挡搭建，安全标识就位。挖掘机开挖基槽，土方被装载车铲起、转运、堆放至场地一侧。钢筋网在基坑内快速铺设成型，混凝土搅拌车驶入、浇筑、抹平。地基轮廓在画面中逐渐清晰。 Phase 2｜主体结构生长 脚手架从地面快速向上攀升，如骨架生长。混凝土柱和楼板逐层浇筑，每一层完成后建筑整体明显升高——呈现阶梯状上升节奏（非连续飞升）。吊车持续旋转，将钢筋、模板、混凝土构件精准吊至作业层。材料堆放区在建筑旁侧始终可见，材料堆随作业进度此消彼长。 Phase 3｜围护与外墙封闭 楼板结构完成后，外墙材料开始安装： 砖混结构：工人逐层砌砖，墙面快速升高 玻璃幕墙：吊车吊起整块玻璃单元，工人对位固定 木质外墙：工人逐块拼装，木板条按顺序覆盖 石材外立面：切割好的石板被吊装、粘贴、压紧 建筑从透明骨架逐渐被外墙"填满"，轮廓日益清晰。 Phase 4｜屋顶完工 屋面结构在工人配合下完成铺设：防水层展开、隔热层覆盖、面层材料逐块就位（瓦片/金属屋面/平屋顶铺装）。屋顶封闭标志建筑主体形态完成，整体轮廓第一次完整呈现。 Phase 5｜门窗安装与机电管线 门窗框架被精准安装入洞口，玻璃由工人配合吊具缓慢就位。与此同时，线管、水管、风管在墙内外快速穿布，如血管在建筑内部延伸。电气设备、卫浴洁具陆续进场安装，室内空间由空壳快速转变为功能体。 Phase 6｜室内装修与外部收尾 室内地面铺装、墙面涂料、吊顶逐步完成，每个空间依次从毛坯变为精装状态。室外同步推进：外立面收口、外墙涂料滚涂或饰面贴附、窗台压顶，建筑表面质感逐渐细腻。 Phase 7｜景观与场地落成 围挡拆除，施工设备依次驶离。绿化施工车辆进场：种植土摊铺，乔木被吊车吊入种植穴，灌木丛快速覆盖地面，草坪分块铺展。硬质铺装（石材/木板/混凝土）逐块拼接完成。灯具、标识、设施依次安装。 Phase 8｜竣工状态 最后一辆施工车辆驶离，场地恢复整洁。建筑完整矗立：外立面光洁，景观绿意盎然，灯光亮起。静止画面持续5秒。背景环境（山/海/天际线）依然是最初那片，未曾改变。 画面定格——从空地到建筑，见证一座房子的诞生。 技术参数 机位：固定广角，构图覆盖建筑主体+周边材料堆放区+进出车辆通道 风格：建造纪录片，4K超清，工业质感色调→竣工暖色调 时间压缩：10-30倍速，保留机械动作可读性 音频：施工声（机械轰鸣、钢筋碰撞）快进处理→竣工时转为空灵配乐 无水印、无字幕、无文字叠加

精密拆解：[参考图建筑名称]有序解构延时摄影，类型：建筑精密拆解延时摄影 / 固定机位逆向记录，duration: 高速逆向演变序列（完整有序拆解周期），core_principle: 禁止魔法过渡，要用快进展示机械和人工有序拆解、材料堆放、转运清理的真实过程。绝对禁止垮塌、爆破、突然消失等不可控镜头。所有拆解必须是可控的、分步的、有序的工程作业。 demolition_methodology: 工业级精密拆解：人工+机械配合→逐件拆卸→分类堆放→系统转运→场地清空 reference_image_analysis: instruction: 深度分析用户提供的[参考图]，静默记录所有建筑关键细节，作为拆解起始状态的100%精准起点 analysis_checklist: [建筑风格类型（现代/传统/混合/热带/工业等）, 建筑层数与整体尺度（单层/多层/别墅/大宅）, 主体结构形式（木结构/混凝土/钢结构/砖混）, 外立面材质（木材/石材/玻璃/混凝土/金属/涂料）, 可拆解部件清单（屋顶/门窗/外墙板/楼板/柱梁等）, 材料估算（需要堆放多少立方木材/钢材/混凝土块等）, 拆解难度评估（哪些部分需要吊车/哪些可人工拆卸）] initial_state_lock: Phase 0必须100%还原参考图完工状态，作为有序拆解的起点 narrative_timeline: [Phase 0: 完工状态（拆解前准备）, Phase 1: 拆解准备与景观移除, Phase 2: 室内物品拆卸与转运, Phase 3: 第一批材料转运（清空部分堆放区）, Phase 4: 门窗与特殊构件拆除, Phase 5: 外墙材料拆除, Phase 6: 第二批材料大规模转运, Phase 7: 主体结构拆除（自上而下有序解体）, Phase 8: 基础拆除与材料清运] - Each phase contains detailed visual descriptions, motion_style, key_action, material_flow, and importance/emphasis notes. The prompt details the entire process from initial complete building state through systematic deconstruction, material sorting, removal, and final site clearance, with emphasis on controlled demolition methods avoiding magical transitions or collapse scenarios.
entries.translated_prompt:
Fixed-position wide-angle time-lapse photography, fully documenting the entire process of a building from empty foundation to completion. The camera remains fixed, only using time compression (10-30x fast-forward) to present the construction rhythm, showing natural light cycling through the scene (morning → noon → dusk → night). Phase 0: Empty Starting Point - The flat, empty raw site with survey stakes and layout lines visible. Construction equipment has not yet arrived. The background environment (mountain/sea/city skyline) is clearly visible as the only stable, unchanging element throughout the entire piece. Static frame lasts 3 seconds. Phase 1: Site Preparation and Foundation Work - Excavators and bulldozers quickly arrive, safety fences erected, safety signs in place. Excavators dig foundation trenches, soil loaded onto transport vehicles and moved to one side of the site. Reinforcement mesh quickly laid in the foundation pit, concrete mixer trucks enter, pour, and level. Foundation outline gradually becomes clear in the frame. Phase 2: Main Structure Growth - Scaffolding rapidly rises from the ground like a skeleton growing. Concrete columns and floors are poured layer by layer, each completed level visibly raising the entire building—presenting a stepped rising rhythm (not continuous flying up). Cranes continuously rotate, precisely lifting reinforcement, formwork, and concrete components to working levels. Material stacking areas remain visible beside the building, material piles grow and shrink with work progress.
