entries.title: Acoustic Serenade and Emotional Reaction Storyboard
entries.description: An extremely detailed, time-coded storyboard prompt for Seedance 2.0, generated from an image-to-video process, describing a musical performance and the emotional reaction of the listener, including specific camera angles, close-ups, and a final slow rack focus on a tear.
entries.prompt:
[00:00 – 00:03 | OVER-THE-SHOULDER MEDIUM SHOT - SLOW PUSH IN] 
Camera sits just behind and above the red-haired girl's left shoulder, her wild crimson waves and the neck of her acoustic guitar filling the foreground in soft bokeh. Across from her, Ruby, brown curls, dark tee, quilt-covered bed at her back, comes into sharp focus. The warm amber glow of the bedside lamp halos the room. The red-haired girl's strumming hand begins to move. She opens her mouth and sings softly: "Ruby… oh Ruby…" The camera breathes forward almost imperceptibly, closing the emotional distance. 

[00:03 – 00:06 | EXTREME CLOSE-UP - GUITAR HAND, LOW ANGLE] 
Cut to a ground-level macro shot angled upward at the strumming hand against the guitar body. Fingers move with loose, unhurried grace across the strings. The warm lamplight catches the shimmer of each string vibration. The faint resonance of the acoustic body fills the frame. Her voice drifts over: "…do you know how much you mean to me?" 

[00:06 – 00:10 | TIGHT CLOSE-UP - RUBY'S FACE, STATIC] 
Hard cut to Ruby's face centered, lit entirely by the golden lamp behind her. Her lips are parted just slightly, cheeks flushed, eyes glistening with the quiet weight of being truly seen. A slow, disbelieving smile creeps in at the corner of her mouth. She doesn't speak. She doesn't need to. The song does it all: "Ruby… my Ruby…" 

[00:10 – 00:13 | TWO-SHOT MEDIUM - WIDE, HANDHELD DRIFT] 
Camera floats back on a subtle handheld drift, revealing both girls in the full frame for the first time the cluttered bookshelves, the faded quilt, the soft chaos of a lived-in room. The red-haired girl leans slightly forward as she reaches the final line, voice barely above a whisper: "…I'll love you till the very end." The last chord rings out and hangs in the air. 

[00:13 – 00:15 | EXTREME CLOSE-UP - RUBY'S EYES, SLOW RACK FOCUS] 
The final cut lands on Ruby's eyes alone. Focus pulls soft… then razor sharp. A single tear catches the lamplight on her lower lash line, not yet fallen. She exhales.

全程无剪辑视角，第一人杯POV，模拟一只极速逃生的成年雄鹰镜头风格。

超广角畸变镜头，画面边缘强烈拉伸，极度夸张的空间纵深感与运动视差(Motion Parallax)，电影级微距压迫感镜头以超音速级速度推进，伴随狂暴的甩摇(Whip-pans)、极限俯冲、急速滚转、翅膀扇动带来的剧烈空中颠簸与不规则震颤。

场景设定在黄昏末世，海面之上是巨大的废弃都市废墟，断裂的摩天大楼、坍塌的桥梁、锈蚀的金属钢架、破碎的玻璃幕墙、漂浮的残骸与巨浪交织。

夕阳呈血金色，低角度光线穿透厚重尘雾与浓烟，废墟在热浪与海雾中扭曲晃动，长长的阴影被无限拉长。雄鹰紧贴海面与废墟低空掠过，破碎建筑、锈蚀钢板、翻滚的巨浪、飞溅的海水在镜头前极速划过。

身后是末日灾难的追击：坠落的建筑残骸、爆炸冲击波、翻滚的火海、弥漫的浓烟与飞散的金属碎片。

巨型建筑轰然倒塌，钢筋扭曲断裂、玻璃与混凝土碎片如雨般砸落，爆炸火光冲天，火星与灰烬在空气中狂舞。镜头始终保持毫秒级极限闪避，与坠落的钢梁、爆炸冲击波、火海边缘险之又险擦身而过，气流与冲击波剧烈晃动镜头，带来极强的物理临场感。

光影为电影级质感：暖金夕阳高光、爆炸火光的强对比反射、厚重末日雾需、深邃拉长的阴影、粒子特效拉满——烟尘、灰烬、海水飞沫、金属碎屑、燃烧余烬在镜头周围疯狂旋转。

情绪基调：极致肾上腺素、生死逃亡、未日压迫感、野性求生本能。

全现场沉浸式音效：雄鹰尖锐啸叫、狂风呼味、翅膀剧烈振翅声、建筑崩塌巨响、金属撕裂声、爆炸轰鸣、海浪咆哮、冲击波撕裂空气的巨响视频在最高潮处戛然而止：雄鹰全速穿越火海与浓烟，在末日废墟的夹缝中极限逃生。

画质：8K电影质感，超写实渲。
entries.translated_prompt:

The scene is set in a twilight apocalypse, with massive abandoned city ruins above the sea surface: fractured skyscrapers, collapsed bridges, rusted metal frameworks, shattered glass curtain walls, floating debris intertwined with huge waves.

The sunset is blood-gold, low-angle light penetrates thick dust and smoke, the ruins twist and shake in the heat haze and sea fog, and long shadows are infinitely stretched. The eagle skims low over the sea surface and ruins, with broken buildings, rusted steel plates, rolling giant waves, and splashing seawater flashing past the lens at extreme speed.

Behind it is the pursuit of an apocalyptic disaster: falling building debris, explosion shockwaves, rolling fire seas, pervasive smoke, and scattered metal fragments.

Giant buildings collapse with a roar, steel bars twist and break, glass and concrete fragments rain down, explosion fire lights up the sky, and sparks and ashes dance wildly in the air. The camera maintains millisecond-level extreme evasion, narrowly brushing past falling steel beams, explosion shockwaves, and the edge of the fire sea. Air currents and shockwaves violently shake the lens, creating a strong sense of physical presence.

Lighting and shadow provide cinematic quality: warm gold sunset highlights, high-contrast reflections from explosion fire, heavy apocalyptic fog, deep and elongated shadows, and particle effects maximized—dust, ashes, sea spray, metal fragments, and burning embers wildly spinning around the lens.

Emotional tone: extreme adrenaline, life-and-death escape, apocalyptic oppression, primal survival instinct.

Fully immersive on-site sound effects: sharp eagle screams, howling wind, violent wing flapping sounds, loud building collapse noises, metal tearing sounds, explosion roars, sea wave roars, and the huge sound of shockwaves tearing the air. The video abruptly stops at the climax: the eagle speeds through fire and thick smoke, making a narrow escape through the gaps of the apocalyptic ruins.

Quality: 8K cinematic texture, ultra-realistic rendering.

entries.title: Anubis Tickle Scene
entries.description: A detailed, narrative prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a scene in a modern Chinese 3D animation style. The scene depicts the jackal god Anubis sitting on a throne, bored, and challenging a human to make him laugh. The human proceeds to tickle Anubis's armpit, causing the god to laugh uncontrollably before dismissing the human.
entries.prompt: 在一段采用中国现代3D动画风格的画面中，强大的胡狼神阿努比斯双手枕在脑后，端坐在王座上。一个人类走近他。阿努比斯用他那漫不经心、百无聊赖的语气告诉人类，他需要逗他笑。人类咧嘴一笑，伸手去挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯一脸疑惑。镜头拉近，人类的手在阿努比斯的腋窝里扭动着手指。阿努比斯立刻咧嘴一笑，闭上眼睛，发出低沉的、闷闷的笑声，因为他怕痒。人类继续挠阿努比斯的腋窝，阿努比斯闭着眼睛咯咯地笑个不停，然后抱紧自己，护住腋窝。笑了几声后，阿努比斯告诉人类他做得很好，可以走了。
entries.translated_prompt: In a scene adopting a modern Chinese 3D animation style, the mighty jackal god Anubis sits on a throne with his hands behind his head. A human approaches him. Anubis, in a casual and bored tone, tells the human that he needs to make him laugh. The human grins and reaches out to scratch Anubis's armpit, causing Anubis to look confused. The camera zooms in on the human's fingers wiggling in Anubis's armpit. Anubis immediately grins, closes his eyes, and lets out a low, muffled laugh because he is ticklish. The human continues to scratch Anubis's armpit, and Anubis keeps giggling with his eyes closed, then hugs himself to protect his armpits. After a few laughs, Anubis tells the human he did a good job and can leave.

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Archangel Transformation Video Prompt
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-stage Seedance 2.0 prompt for generating a realistic sci-fi/tokusatsu video depicting an archangel's transformation. It specifies cinematic quality, low-saturation blue-gray tones, detailed character settings (bruises, fatigue), specific camera movements (single shot, handheld), and a precise timeline for the transformation sequence, including the convergence of luminous feathers and the assembly of white-gold mecha armor.
entries.prompt:
【核心主题】
写实科幻特摄 ，废墟坠落 ，圣洁羽毛汇聚 ，白金机甲天使 ，电影级神性 

【人物基础设定】
面部有淤青，嘴角有血渍。表情略显疲态。
变身瞬间，表情轻微痛苦，眉心仅轻微蹙起，保持压抑感。 
白色破烂外套黑色随性破烂衬衣，和白色破裤子，经历了战斗的战损衣服。 
核心道具：
右手紧握一块散发着高频纯白蓝光芒的“圣环水晶核心”。 
场景环境：
末日，城市，摩天大楼天台，阴天，微风，战火纷飞，灰蓝色调天空。天空中划过带有火焰与浓烟的陨石。 

【氛围与画质】
视觉基调：电影质感。模拟 IMAX 胶片摄影机，搭配 Panavision C 系列镜头（焦段 35mm，光圈 f4）。 
色彩与影调：低饱和灰蓝主调。暗部信息压缩，保留细节。边缘添加轻微柔焦与适度的胶片颗粒感。 
风格核心：CG美学风格。强调生物质感与外星科技的融合，营造压抑、沉重、实拍的肉身痛苦感。 
特效核心：强调无数发光羽毛实体化汇聚的动态过程，以及机甲装备时带有神性。

【运镜】
单镜头：一镜到底，无剪辑。 
动态轨迹：开场极广角坠落 -> 震颤推至半身特写 -> 变身时环绕 -> 拉远仰拍全身。 
呼吸感：手持拍摄，全程保持轻微的、如呼吸般的镜头浮动，增强临场感。 

【时间轴】
0-3秒 坠落 动作：
主角从高空重重砸在废墟中惯性让身体滚了几圈，给人很惨烈的视觉冲击。身体激起环形烟尘气浪。她剧烈喘息着艰难站起，黑棕色头发凌乱，沾满泥污的脸低垂，目光死死盯着右手中搏动的蓝白色水晶核心。 
镜头：跟随坠落，砸地瞬间强烈震颤，快速推至半身。 

3-6 秒 羽毛汇聚 ：
主角喃喃自语低声坚定的说：“那就再来一次！"
动作与特效：主角咬牙手捏碎手中的水晶核心。伴随清脆的能量爆裂声，一道刺目的白光冲天而起。
 羽毛汇聚：空气中凭空浮现出无数发光的洁白羽毛，它们形成一个高速旋转的涡流，瞬间包裹住她的右臂并迅速向全身蔓延。主角双眼瞳孔被纯白光芒取代。 
环境共鸣：身后浮现出一个巨大的、若隐若现的金色光环图腾。镜头因能量冲击产生耳鸣般的微颤。

6-9 秒 撕裂 ：
表情：轻微皱眉，忍受痛苦。 主角仰头承受巨大冲击，眉心紧锁。体内爆发出神圣的白色气浪 
核心：全身皮肤表面弹射出少许玻璃碎屑。金色光尘溢出，闪着彩虹色微光从腰带内侧向身体躯干蔓延。 
身体：白色烟雾从体内喷涌，裹挟着发丝般。 

9-12 秒 重组与展翅：
新物质：全套白色机甲覆盖全身，装甲表面带有珍珠般的哑光质感和金色的神圣纹路浮雕，缝隙中透出淡蓝色的能量光流。肩甲：新生的金色肩甲对撞，爆发出电光火花，留下永久的、如同烫伤的齿痕。 
羽毛核心展现：伴随着一声震撼的机械轰鸣，一对巨大的、由白色金属羽翼构成的机械翅膀在她身后猛然展开，翅膀边缘散落着发光的光羽。 
衣物：原有的衣物已经破烂不堪，被某种诡异的力量从主角身上快速抽离，离开身体。 
面部覆盖：白色机透明led碎面从面部开始蔓延面部，头戴由羽毛组成的皇冠，组成漏出面部的半透明头盔，头盔半透明面部显示屏中有生命体征和战斗信息的屏幕双眼。 
金色光环：背部有光纤量子生成圆形金色光环在背后浮现，白色金色色相间。金色光环旋转，旋转能量光脉冲式涌动。 视线：在整个变身过程中，主角的视线始终注视远方。纤细的金色电弧，发出滋滋碎响。身体周围的气流开始翻涌，翻涌的热浪对画面产生轻微色散畸变效果。 
装甲生长：伴随着富有神性的机械咬合声，白色的流线型机甲片在羽毛的光辉中实体化，迅速贴合她的躯干与四肢进行组装。金属连接处迸发出耀眼的金色电弧。
甲壳：甲壳碎屑四溅，有彩虹色棱镜碎片闪烁飘出，飘在身体周围，旋转悬停片刻后诡异回缩，重新回溯组合成战衣零件。 
面部：眼睛持续发白光，带有神性的威亚，面部出现对称的粗线条图腾纹身。 镜头：因冲击剧烈晃动、失焦，随即猛拉回正。 

12-15秒 完成 
头盔：整个面部被白色面具覆盖，只露出双眼。 
武器具象化：主角双臂向身体两侧猛然张开。掌心无数光羽凝聚，瞬间化作两把散发着白色烈焰的圣能战刀 
最终构图：镜头拉远并切为低角度仰拍。主角身着白金机甲，巨大的机械翅膀完全伸展，手持双武器摆出战斗姿态。她周身散发的神圣威压导致周围地面的碎石悬浮升空，画面定格在如天使降临般的震撼瞬间。 
最终镜头：环绕至人物右侧，机位变为俯拍，镜头以极缓速度逐渐向后拉远，变身完毕人物向正上方弹射起飞，垂直飞出画面。镜头被巨大的气流和热浪影响而抖动。

entries.title: Turbulent Sea Galleon Cinematic Prompt
entries.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a dynamic camera sequence starting high above a turbulent emerald sea, swooping down to a galleon, passing seamlessly through a stained-glass window into a still cabin, and then exiting back into the night sky.
entries.prompt: A turbulent emerald sea crashing under the pale light of a crescent moon. A majestic 18th-century galleon rides the roaring waves, sails billowing. The camera swoops down from the storm clouds like a falcon, rushing over the choppy water. The ornate stern of the ship grows huge, featuring intricate stained-glass windows framing the captain's quarters. Matching the ship's violent rocking, the camera passes seamlessly through a glass pane into a surprisingly still, candle-lit cabin. A colorful macaw sleeps quietly on a hanging brass perch, undisturbed by the storm. The camera glides past the bird and exits seamlessly through a side porthole. It sweeps high into the night sky, the massive ship reduced to a toy on the water. The sound of crashing waves fades to silence.

entries.title: Dark Fairytale Chase-Battle Cinematic Storyboard
entries.description: An extremely detailed, time-coded cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 outlining a dark fairytale battle between a forest witch and an iron hunter, transitioning through multiple settings and featuring specific camera movements, close-ups, and a powerful finale.
entries.prompt: A cinematic dark fairytale chase-battle. A forest witch in moss-green robes with glowing antler branches controls roots, spores, and luminous vines. Her enemy is a brutal iron hunter in black armor carrying a giant mechanized crossbow and chainsaw spear. The setting transitions from enchanted forest shrine → collapsing tree bridge → glowing mushroom ravine → ancient root throne. 0–3 seconds: the iron hunter crashes through the forest shrine walls in a shower of splintered wood and sparks, firing a massive bolt at the witch. She dissolves into leaves and reforms behind hanging roots. Close-ups of crossbow gears, glowing spores, bark fragments, and her luminous eyes. 3–7 seconds: the hunter charges through the trees with the chainsaw spear tearing through roots. The witch whips glowing vines around his limbs while giant thorn branches erupt from the ground. The tree bridge collapses beneath them. Close-ups of spinning chain teeth, vine tension, sparks, and snapping wood. 7–10 seconds: both plunge into a ravine filled with giant glowing mushrooms and drifting spores. The witch floats between roots and fungus caps while the hunter falls heavily from ledge to ledge, firing bolts upward. She summons enormous root hands from the ravine walls. Orbit camera, bioluminescent fog, dark fantasy atmosphere. 10–12 seconds: fast tracking shot through the ravine as the hunter breaks free and charges one final time. The witch raises both hands, and hundreds of vines spiral together into a glowing spear of living wood. Close-ups of spores, bark twisting, metal armor cracking, and hunter visor sparks. 12–15 seconds: overhead slow-motion impact at the ancient root throne. The living spear hits the hunter in the chest and roots instantly consume his armor, dragging him into the forest floor as green light erupts outward. Mushrooms release clouds of glowing spores and the entire ravine pulses like a living heartbeat. Beautiful, eerie, powerful finale. Style: dark fairytale fantasy, enchanted forest bioluminescence, strong green-gold glow, brutal iron machinery contrast, cinematic destruction, atmospheric spores, mythic witch energy, rich texture detail.turn this director's storyboard into a super realistic cinematic video, 8K resolution, master-level film work

entries.title: Cinematic Celestial Battle Storyboard Prompt
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-shot storyboard prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a celestial battle between a sun warrior and an eclipse beast, specifying scene transitions, timing, camera close-ups, and technical styles like solar fire and black eclipse contrast.
entries.prompt: A cinematic celestial battle sequence. A radiant sun warrior in ornate golden armor stands atop a desert observatory buried in dunes. He wields a blazing solar spear and a burning circular halo shield. His enemy is an enormous eclipse beast made of black ash, obsidian bone, and molten cracks of dark fire. The setting transitions from desert observatory → shattered sun dial platform → eclipse sky → flaming crater. 0–3 seconds: the eclipse beast erupts from beneath the sand in a wave of black dust and broken stone. The sun warrior plants his spear and blocks with his halo shield as the shockwave tears through ancient pillars. Close-ups of sand blasting, molten eyes, golden armor, and glowing spear tip. 3–7 seconds: the beast charges with jagged obsidian claws. The warrior spins the solar spear in wide arcs, carving glowing fire rings through the dust storm. The observatory floor fractures into burning lines. Close-ups of spear sparks, claw collisions, burning runes, and flying debris. 7–10 seconds: the warrior launches skyward on a pillar of sunlight as the eclipse darkens the sky. The beast leaps after him through falling stone and spiraling ash. Midair combat around a giant shadowed sun. Close-ups of golden halo shield, black smoke mane, blazing spear thrusts, and eclipse light. 10–12 seconds: fast descending tracking shot. The warrior pierces the beast’s chest with the solar spear and drives it downward, both trailing fire and ash. A huge ring of light expands behind them. Close-ups of impact point, cracks of molten energy, and blazing fragments. 12–15 seconds: overhead slow-motion crash into a desert crater. The spear detonates in a massive burst of solar fire, blasting away the darkness and sending molten sand into the sky. The eclipse beast disintegrates into ash and burning embers. Final frame: the warrior kneels in the crater center surrounded by glowing glass sand. Epic, godlike, triumphant. Style: ancient celestial fantasy, desert myth, solar fire, black eclipse contrast, massive scale, cinematic action, golden light, obsidian darkness, intense slow motion, dramatic impact shots.

entries.title: Interstellar Star-Cruiser Chase and Zero-Gravity Interior Scene
entries.description: A detailed, cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a fast-paced sequence involving an interstellar star-cruiser, starting with a cosmic panorama, rushing forward at light-speed, phasing through the ship's window into a zero-gravity lounge, and finally sweeping back out to reveal the ship's scale.
entries.prompt: A vibrant interstellar panorama framed by a swirling purple nebula. A sleek, silver star-cruiser travels silently across the cosmic void. The camera rushes forward at light-speed, rapidly overtaking the ship. The cruiser's glowing geometry becomes massive, a panoramic observation window coming into view. Matching the ship's incredible velocity, the camera phases seamlessly through the transparent aluminum. Inside the serene, zero-gravity lounge, a young child floats mid-air, drawing softly on a digital tablet under ambient starlight. The camera drifts past the child and phases out the opposite viewing deck window. It sweeps upward, revealing the majestic scale of the ship shrinking against the stars. A deep sub-bass hum fades to silence.

entries.title: Awkward Palace Scene: Mistaken Identity
entries.description: A detailed, 15-second vertical video prompt for Seedance 2.0, generating a first-person perspective, cinematic, high-definition ancient palace drama scene. A noble concubine, initially expecting the Emperor in the imperial garden, realizes she has mistaken the viewer (the camera) for the Emperor, leading to an awkward moment with a eunuch's voice revealing the mistake.
entries.prompt:
9:16竖屏，第一人称视角，古装宫廷剧质感，电影级高清。
0-3秒：皇宫御花园，假山流水，牡丹盛开，阳光斑驳。贵气妃子站在花丛旁，珠钗凤冠，明黄凤袍，手持团扇听到脚步声转身，团扇半遮面，妩媚一笑说："皇上驾到，臣妾有礼了~"
4-8秒：她款款走来，凤袍飘动，镜头后退，她走近后发现不对，团扇放下，表情从妩媚变成疑惑，凑近镜头仔细看，问道："等等……你不是皇上？"
9-12秒：镜头外的声音（太监尖细嗓音）："娘娘，奴才是小桂子啊……"妃子脸色一变，尴尬地后退一步，快速整理仪态，咳嗽一声说："本宫……本宫当然知道。"
13-15秒：她转身背对镜头，肩膀明显垮下，用团扇捂脸，小声嘟囔："丢死人了……"画面定格在她懊恼的背影和飘落的花瓣，配"尴尬"音效。音效：脚步声、风声、太监尖嗓音、尴尬咳嗽声、"完了"音效。禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。
entries.translated_prompt:
9:16 vertical screen, first-person perspective, ancient costume palace drama texture, cinematic high definition.
0-3 seconds: Imperial garden, rockery and flowing water, peonies in full bloom, dappled sunlight. A noble concubine stands by the flowers, wearing pearl hairpins and a phoenix crown, in a bright yellow phoenix robe, holding a round fan. Hearing footsteps, she turns, the fan half-covering her face, and says with a charming smile: "Your Majesty has arrived, I pay my respects~".
4-8 seconds: She walks gracefully, her phoenix robe fluttering, the camera retreats. As she approaches, she realizes something is wrong, puts down the fan, her expression changes from charming to confused, she leans closer to the camera and asks: "Wait... you are not the Emperor?"
9-12 seconds: A voice off-camera (a eunuch's high-pitched voice): "Your Highness, I am Xiao Guizi..." The concubine's expression changes, she awkwardly steps back, quickly adjusts her posture, coughs and says: "I... I certainly know that."
13-15 seconds: She turns her back to the camera, her shoulders visibly slumping, covers her face with the round fan, and mutters softly: "How embarrassing..." The frame freezes on her annoyed back and falling petals, accompanied by an "awkward" sound effect. Sound effects: footsteps, wind, eunuch's high-pitched voice, awkward cough, "it's over" sound effect. Prohibition: any text, subtitles, LOGO, or watermark.

entries.title: Pure Hand-Drawn 2D Cartoon Animation
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-scene storyboard prompt demanding a pure 2D, hand-drawn animation style (no 3D) of a boy riding a paper airplane over a seaside town, focusing on exaggerated cartoon physics, cloth dynamics, and watercolor textures.
entries.prompt:
Pure hand-drawn 2D cartoon animation only — absolutely no 3D. Ever. 24fps on ones, 16:9. Every line breathes with subtle hand-drawn imperfections. A young adventurous boy rides a flying paper airplane over a vibrant seaside town during sunset. The camera stays closely behind his back the entire time — we see his shoulders, messy hair, fragile paper wings, and the world opening ahead.
His loose sky-blue scarf whips toward the camera with fully hand-drawn cloth physics, every fold unique. His messy dark hair flies wildly in the wind with exaggerated cartoon motion. The wind itself appears as flowing white and pale-blue hand-drawn brush strokes swirling around him and trailing behind the plane.
He glides between pastel seaside buildings with wooden balconies, flower pots, and laundry lines. As he passes, shutters burst open in a domino effect and curtains fly outward. Each window releases glowing golden sunset light that hits the camera, forming hand-drawn 2D lens flares and floating dust particles.
The town below is alive — fishermen point upward, children run through streets, seagulls scatter, cats leap across rooftops, and market flags whip in the wind he leaves behind.
Suddenly colorful festival banners stretch across the street. He tries to dodge by pulling the paper plane upward, but the sudden slowdown throws his body forward. He bursts through a banner — a red cloth wraps over his face while ribbons tangle around the wing.
He wobbles on the fragile plane, gripping with one hand while pulling the cloth away with the other. His head shakes left-right-left with exaggerated squash and stretch animation, neck stretching comically and eyes spinning briefly.
Finally he yanks the cloth free. It flies away in the wind. His face appears messy and annoyed — teeth clenched and brows furrowed — then he exhales with relief.
He leans forward and accelerates again, hand-drawn speed lines rushing around him. A clock tower appears suddenly — he brakes hard and sharply banks around it, barely missing the bricks.
Another obstacle appears — a string of lanterns. He flattens himself against the paper plane as they pass inches above his head. One final banner swings into his path; he twists and slides underneath, but a tiny ribbon lands on his nose and he flicks it away in irritation.
Every acceleration stretches his body backward, scarf and hair whipping violently. Every stop throws him forward. Every turn bends the plane dramatically.
The environment is painted in soft watercolor textures — glowing orange and pink skies, terracotta rooftops, emerald trees, and violet shadows with layered parallax depth. Warm golden sunset light washes over everything as seagulls cross the glowing horizon.
Pure 2D. Hand-drawn. No 3D. Ever.

entries.title: Cinematic O'Neill Space Colony Film Still
entries.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a film still capturing the interior of a massive O'Neill space colony (Island One concept) from a grounded, human perspective, featuring a family looking up at the curving habitat and dramatic 'god rays' lighting.
entries.prompt: A cinematic film still, capturing the interior of a massive O'Neill space colony (Island One concept) from a grounded, human perspective. A young family—mother, father, and child—are standing on a rugged, overgrown grassy ridge at dusk, looking upward in profound awe. The curving landscape of the habitat, covered in diverse farms, small towns, and winding rivers, sweeps majestically overhead, creating an impossible, yet tangible sky-arch above them. The entire scene is illuminated by the powerful, warm, golden "terminator line" of sunlight bursting through a vast, dust-mote-filled gap in the articulated mirror arrays high above the central axis. This dramatic backlighting creates a striking rim-light on the family and casts incredibly long, shifting shadows across the textured fields below. The atmosphere is thick with haze and particles, creating strong, visible "god rays" that pierce the colony's interior. A soft, classic Spielbergian lens flare subtly strikes the corner of the frame. The metal and composite structures of the colony's central spine are visible, appearing worn and lived-in, not sterile or graphics-like. Tangible details in the foreground include a weathered fence post, a functional, aged tractor wheel, and overgrown vines, adding grit and texture. The camera uses a slightly shallow depth of field, making the opposite side of the cylinder an imposing but softened backdrop. Natural film grain, non-digital focus aesthetic, 1980s analog cinematography style, non-English text on screen is forbidden.

entries.title: 15-Second Cinematic Transformation Scene Prompt (IMAX Style)
entries.description: An extremely detailed, 15-second continuous shot prompt for a cinematic transformation scene, requiring a reference image for the face, specific clothing, environment, and detailed camera movements (underwater start, first-person motion, shockwaves, and a brutal fight sequence) using an IMAX film camera style.
entries.prompt:
Face: Refer to (upload your image). Facial structure and features must match exactly with no beautification.

Clothing: worn, weathered jacket.

Environment: black soil ground beside a lake under a dull grey sky.

Visual Style: cinematic widescreen transformation scene. Simulate IMAX film camera with Panavision C-series lens (35mm, f/4). Low-saturation grey color grading with compressed shadows while preserving detail.

Camera: single continuous shot, no cuts.

Scene begins underwater, low upward angle toward the character. Water surface ripples distort the image. The protagonist kneels by the lake, blurred through the water. Light scattering, shallow depth of field, humid lens effect. Camera slowly pushes forward as the protagonist lowers their head and gently touches the water with a slightly bent index finger.

Activation (1–4.5s): whisper “Berubah!”. When the finger touches the water, a circular electromagnetic pulse erupts outward. Purple particles surge, air trembles. Camera bursts out of the water in first-person motion, traveling along fingers, arm, and torso while glowing pulse patterns climb the body layer by layer. Eyes ignite white-purple, violet smoke leaks from the sockets, mechanical systems awaken beneath cracking skin. Air bends inward forming rippling shockwaves.

Tearing (4.5–9.5s): camera pulls slightly back revealing an alien insect attacking from behind. Dark red cracks spread across the body, purple liquid energy leaks out. Black mist bursts with fine electric arcs as clothing tears and burns from within.

Transformation & Fight (9.5–13s): armor plates slam onto the body with purple flashes and shockwaves. The protagonist blocks a blade, spins into a sweeping kick ripping through the enemy; green fluid and black mist scatter. Helmet forms with glowing compound eyes, some flickering like faulty units. Combat remains brutal and close: bone-breaking strikes, grappling, ending with the protagonist crushing the creature’s throat until it dissolves into black mist.

Final (13–15s): camera circles to the front and slowly pulls away. The protagonist breathes heavily in the bleak lakeside environment. Freeze for three seconds. No dialogue, no explosions.

entries.prompt: 陨石坠落 · 一镜到底，手持手机拍摄镜头 超写实 · 15秒 · 完整描述 东京彩虹大桥，下午三点，轻度堵车。 镜头跟随一名30岁左右、深灰西装、白衬衫、略显憔悴的日本男性，他站在自己车旁边打电话谈生意，另一只手插在裤兜里。桥上没有异常，风正常地吹，远处东京湾的海面平静反光。 电话还没挂，天空突然出现一颗小陨石，三秒内坠落在东京湾方向的水里。男子没有立刻反应，继续说着电话，只是眼神不自觉飘向那个方向。 两秒后，一声沉闷的低频震动从脚底传来，不是很响，但桥面的钢板在轻微颤抖。旁边车里的人摇下车窗探头张望。男子停止说话，手机还贴着耳朵，眼睛看向东京湾。 海面升起一团低矮的白色水雾，范围很大，像是什么东西在水下爆炸。没有火，没有蘑菇云，掀起巨浪。随后天空出现更多的陨石坠落。 五秒后巨大的冲击波将城市毁灭。画面定格。渐黑。
entries.translated_prompt: Meteorite fall · One-shot, handheld phone camera perspective Hyper-realistic · 15 seconds · Complete description Tokyo Rainbow Bridge, 3 PM, light traffic. The camera follows a Japanese male, around 30 years old, in a dark gray suit and white shirt, looking slightly haggard. He stands next to his car, talking business on the phone, with his other hand in his pocket. Nothing unusual on the bridge; the wind blows normally, and the surface of Tokyo Bay in the distance reflects calmly. Before he hangs up, a small meteorite suddenly appears in the sky and falls into the water towards Tokyo Bay within three seconds. The man doesn't react immediately, continuing his call, only his gaze unconsciously drifting in that direction. Two seconds later, a dull, low-frequency vibration comes from underfoot, not very loud, but the steel plates of the bridge tremble slightly. People in the adjacent car roll down their windows and peer out. The man stops talking, his phone still pressed to his ear, eyes fixed on Tokyo Bay. A low, white mist rises from the sea surface, covering a large area, like something exploded underwater. No fire, no mushroom cloud, just giant waves being stirred up. Subsequently, more meteorites begin to fall from the sky. Five seconds later, a massive shockwave destroys the city. The frame freezes. Fades to black.

entries.title: Seedance 2.0 Scene Continuation Video Prompt
entries.description: A two-part prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a continuous video sequence based on a single reference image (Image 1). The first part generates the 10 seconds of action leading up to Image 1, featuring a female assassin in black, mimicking a famous scene (Arya Stark vs. Night King). The second part generates the 10 seconds following Image 1, showing the assassin defeating the general and striking a pose. Both parts require specific camera work, rhythm, movie-like quality, martial arts choreography, and sound effects, while strictly avoiding blood/gore and dangerous actions. The assassin's face and pose must reference a second image (Image 2).

entries.prompt: 16:9横屏，中国动画风格，银白冷冽色调。 0 - 3秒：深夜酒楼屋顶，黑衣刺客背负十字镖囊，长脸配深眼窝，薄唇紧抿，月光下身影如鬼魅，双手各夹三枚里剑，镜头从手里剑特写拉至全身。 4 - 8秒：对面灰衣侠客手持飞刀，瓜子脸配星目，眉间有淡淡疤痕，长发改用灰布带绑成低马尾，十指之间夹着把薄如蝉翼的飞刀，镜头环绕拍摄两人对峙。 9 - 12秒：两人同时出手，六枚手里剑与十把飞刀在空中交织碰撞，发出连绵不断的金属脆响，火花如银色烟花绽放，部分暗器擦过屋脊瓦片留下痕迹，慢镜头追踪一枚飞刀击碎手里剑后继续飞行的轨迹。 13 - 15秒：两人暗器耗尽后近身搏斗，匕首与短刀在屋脊上快速交锋，最后灰衣侠客一脚踢飞刺客手中匕首，同时飞刀抵住对方咽喉，月光照在两人脸上，刺客缓缓举手投降。 音效：暗器破空、金属碰撞、瓦片碎裂、衣袂飘动。 禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO或水印。

Style: Hyper-realistic sci-fi, cinematic lighting, extreme detail, prominent texture of dark steel mecha. Camera: Tracking shot circling around, slowly pushing in, close-up of mechanical assembly details (interlocking, locking, sparks). Composition: Dynamic composition, following the trajectory of mechanical assembly, highlighting the mecha formation process. Atmosphere: Shocking and orderly, full of technological sense and ritual of mechanical assembly. Audio: Mechanical interlocking sounds, light sparks, track unfolding sounds; Score: Strings gradually strengthen, rhythm matching the assembly action.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Mecha Angel Transformation Video Prompt for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-section prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second, single-shot cinematic video of a character's painful transformation into a white-gold mecha angel on a ruined city rooftop, emphasizing realistic CG aesthetics, specific camera dynamics (shaking, orbiting, pull-out), and detailed step-by-step actions and special effects across the timeline.
entries.prompt:
【核心主题】
写实科幻特摄 ，废墟坠落 ，圣洁羽毛汇聚 ，白金机甲天使 ，电影级神性 

【人物基础设定】
面部有淤青，嘴角有血渍。表情略显疲态。
变身瞬间，表情轻微痛苦，眉心仅轻微蹙起，保持压抑感。 
白色破烂外套黑色随性破烂衬衣，和白色破裤子，经历了战斗的战损衣服。 
核心道具：
右手紧握一块散发着高频纯白蓝光芒的“圣环水晶核心”。 
场景环境：
末日，城市，摩天大楼天台，阴天，微风，战火纷飞，灰蓝色调天空。天空中划过带有火焰与浓烟的陨石。 

【氛围与画质】
视觉基调：电影质感。模拟 IMAX 胶片摄影机，搭配 Panavision C 系列镜头（焦段 35mm，光圈 f4）。 
色彩与影调：低饱和灰蓝主调。暗部信息压缩，保留细节。边缘添加轻微柔焦与适度的胶片颗粒感。 
风格核心：CG美学风格。强调生物质感与外星科技的融合，营造压抑、沉重、实拍的肉身痛苦感。 
特效核心：强调无数发光羽毛实体化汇聚的动态过程，以及机甲装备时带有神性。

【运镜】
单镜头：一镜到底，无剪辑。 
动态轨迹：开场极广角坠落 -> 震颤推至半身特写 -> 变身时环绕 -> 拉远仰拍全身。 
呼吸感：手持拍摄，全程保持轻微的、如呼吸般的镜头浮动，增强临场感。 

【时间轴】
0-3秒 坠落 动作：
主角从高空重重砸在废墟中惯性让身体滚了几圈，给人很惨烈的视觉冲击。身体激起环形烟尘气浪。她剧烈喘息着艰难站起，黑棕色头发凌乱，沾满泥污的脸低垂，目光死死盯着右手中搏动的蓝白色水晶核心。 
镜头：跟随坠落，砸地瞬间强烈震颤，快速推至半身。 

3-6 秒 羽毛汇聚 ：
主角喃喃自语低声坚定的说：“那就再来一次！" 
动作与特效：主角咬牙手捏碎手中的水晶核心。伴随清脆的能量爆裂声，一道刺目的白光冲天而起。
 羽毛汇聚：空气中凭空浮现出无数发光的洁白羽毛，它们形成一个高速旋转的涡流，瞬间包裹住她的右臂并迅速向全身蔓延。主角双眼瞳孔被纯白光芒取代。 
环境共鸣：身后浮现出一个巨大的、若隐若现的金色光环图腾。镜头因能量冲击产生耳鸣般的微颤。

6-9 秒 撕裂 ：
表情：轻微皱眉，忍受痛苦。 主角仰头承受巨大冲击，眉心紧锁。体内爆发出神圣的白色气浪 
核心：全身皮肤表面弹射出少许玻璃碎屑。金色光尘溢出，闪着彩虹色微光从腰带内侧向身体躯干蔓延。 
身体：白色烟雾从体内喷涌，裹挟着发丝般。 

9-12 秒 重组与展翅：
新物质：全套白色机甲覆盖全身，装甲表面带有珍珠般的哑光质感和金色的神圣纹路浮雕，缝隙中透出淡蓝色的能量光流。肩甲：新生的金色肩甲对撞，爆发出电光火花，留下永久的、如同烫伤的齿痕。 
羽毛核心展现：伴随着一声震撼的机械轰鸣，一对巨大的、由白色金属羽翼构成的机械翅膀在她身后猛然展开，翅膀边缘散落着发光的光羽。 
衣物：原有的衣物已经破烂不堪，被某种诡异的力量从主角身上快速抽离，离开身体。 
面部覆盖：白色透led碎面从面部开始蔓延面部，头戴由羽毛组成的皇冠，组成漏出面部的半透明头盔，头盔半透明面部显示屏中有生命体征和战斗信息的屏幕双眼。 
金色光环：背部有光纤量子生成圆形金色光环在背后浮现，白色金色色相间。金色光环旋转，旋转能量光脉冲式涌动。 视线：在整个变身过程中，主角的视线始终注视远方。纤细的金色电弧，发出滋滋碎响。身体周围的气流开始翻涌，翻涌的热浪对画面产生轻微色散畸变效果。 
装甲生长：伴随着富有神性的机械咬合声，白色的流线型机甲片在羽毛的光辉中实体化，迅速贴合她的躯干与四肢进行组装。金属连接处迸发出耀眼的金色电弧。
甲壳：甲壳碎屑四溅，有彩虹色棱镜碎片闪烁飘出，飘在身体周围，旋转悬停片刻后诡异回缩，重新回溯组合成战衣零件。 
面部：眼睛持续发白光，带有神性的威亚，面部出现对称的粗线条图腾纹身。 镜头：因冲击剧烈晃动、失焦，随即猛拉回正。 

12-15秒 完成 
头盔：整个面部被白色面具覆盖，只露出双眼。 
武器具象化：主角双臂向身体两侧猛然张开。掌心无数光羽凝聚，瞬间化作两把散发着白色烈焰的圣能战刀 
最终构图：镜头拉远并切为低角度仰拍。主角身着白金机甲，巨大的机械翅膀完全伸展，手持双武器摆出战斗姿态。她周身散发的神圣威压导致周围地面的碎石悬浮升空，画面定格在如天使降临般的震撼瞬间。 
最终镜头：环绕至人物右侧，机位变为俯拍，镜头以极缓速度逐渐向后拉远，变身完毕人物向正上方弹射起飞，垂直飞出画面。镜头被巨大的气流和热浪影响而抖动。
entries.translated_prompt:
【Core Theme】
Realistic sci-fi tokusatsu, falling into ruins, holy feathers converging, white-gold mecha angel, cinematic divinity

【Basic Character Setting】
Bruises on the face, bloodstains at the corner of the mouth. Expression slightly fatigued.
At the moment of transformation, the expression is slightly painful, the brow is only slightly furrowed, maintaining a sense of suppression.
White tattered jacket, black casual tattered shirt, and white pants, battle-damaged clothes that have gone through fighting.
Core Prop:
The right hand tightly grips a "Holy Ring Crystal Core" emitting high-frequency pure white and blue light.
Scene Environment:
Apocalypse, city, skyscraper rooftop, overcast, light breeze, war-torn, gray-blue sky. Meteors with flames and thick smoke streak across the sky.

【Atmosphere and Quality】
Visual Tone: Cinematic texture. Simulating IMAX film camera, paired with Panavision C series lens (focal length 35mm, aperture f4).
Color and Tone: Low-saturation gray-blue main tone. Dark area information compressed, retaining details. Slight soft focus and appropriate film grain added to the edges.
Core Style: CG aesthetic style. Emphasizing the fusion of biological texture and alien technology, creating a sense of oppression, heaviness, and realistic physical pain.
Core Special Effects: Emphasizing the dynamic process of countless glowing feathers materializing and converging, and the divinity when the mecha is equipped.

【Camera Movement】
Single Shot: One shot to the end, no cuts.
Dynamic Trajectory: Extreme wide-angle fall at the beginning -> Trembling push to half-body close-up -> Orbiting during transformation -> Pull back to full-body low-angle shot.
Breathing Sense: Handheld shooting, maintaining a slight, breathing-like lens float throughout, enhancing the sense of presence.

【Timeline】
0-3 seconds Fall Action:
The protagonist heavily smashes into the ruins from high altitude, the inertia causes the body to roll a few times, giving a tragic visual impact. The body stirs up a circular smoke and dust wave. She gasps violently and struggles to stand up, black-brown hair messy, mud-stained face lowered, eyes fixed on the pulsating blue-white crystal core in her right hand.
Camera: Follow the fall, strong tremor at the moment of impact, quickly push to half-body.

3-6 seconds Feather Convergence:
The protagonist mutters softly and firmly says: "Then let's do it again!"
Action and Special Effects: The protagonist grits her teeth and crushes the crystal core in her hand. Accompanied by a crisp energy burst sound, a dazzling white light shoots up into the sky.
Feather Convergence: Countless glowing white feathers appear out of thin air, forming a high-speed rotating vortex, instantly wrapping around her right arm and quickly spreading to her whole body. The protagonist's pupils are replaced by pure white light.
Environmental Resonance: A huge, faintly visible golden halo totem appears behind her. The lens slightly trembles like tinnitus due to the energy impact.

6-9 seconds Tearing:
Expression: Slight frown, enduring pain. The protagonist looks up to withstand the huge impact, brows tightly locked. Sacred white energy surge erupts from within the body
Core: A few glass shards eject from the surface of the whole body skin. Golden light dust overflows, flashing rainbow-colored subtle light, spreading from the inside of the belt towards the torso.
Body: White smoke spews from the body, wrapped like strands of hair.

9-12 seconds Reassembly and Spreading Wings:
New Material: A full set of white mecha covers the whole body, the armor surface has a pearl-like matte texture and golden sacred pattern relief, faint blue energy flow streams through the gaps. Shoulder Armor: The newly formed golden shoulder armor collides, erupting electric sparks, leaving permanent, burn-like serrated marks.
Feather Core Manifestation: Accompanied by a shocking mechanical roar, a pair of huge mechanical wings composed of white metal feathers suddenly spread out behind her, glowing light feathers scattered at the edges of the wings.
Clothing: The original clothing is already tattered, quickly pulled away from the protagonist by some strange force, leaving the body.
Face Coverage: White transparent LED fragmented surface begins to spread from the face, wearing a crown made of feathers, forming a translucent helmet that exposes the face, the helmet's translucent face display shows vital signs and combat information screen eyes.
Golden Halo: A circular golden halo generated by fiber optic quantum appears on the back, alternating white and gold colors. The golden halo rotates, and the rotating energy light surges pulse-like. Gaze: Throughout the transformation process, the protagonist's gaze is always fixed on the distance. Slender golden electric arcs make sizzling sounds. The airflow around the body begins to churn, and the churning heat wave causes a slight chromatic aberration distortion effect on the screen.
Armor Growth: Accompanied by a mechanical clicking sound full of divinity, white streamlined mecha pieces materialize in the glow of the feathers, quickly fitting onto her torso and limbs for assembly. Dazzling golden electric arcs burst out at the metal connection points.
Carapace: Carapace shards splash around, rainbow-colored prism fragments flash and float out, hovering around the body for a moment before strangely retracting, re-tracing and reassembling into battle suit parts.
Face: Eyes continue to emit white light, with the divine aura, symmetrical thick-lined totem tattoos appear on the face. Camera: Shakes violently and loses focus due to the impact, then quickly pulls back to normal.

12-15 seconds Completion
Helmet: The entire face is covered by a white mask, only the eyes are exposed.
Weapon Materialization: The protagonist suddenly spreads her arms to both sides of her body. Countless light feathers condense in her palms, instantly transforming into two holy energy battle knives emitting white flames.
Final Composition: The lens pulls back and cuts to a low-angle upward shot. The protagonist, dressed in white-gold mecha, with huge mechanical wings fully extended, poses in a battle stance holding dual weapons. The sacred pressure radiating from her causes the surrounding rubble on the ground to float up, the scene freezes at a shocking moment like the descent of an angel.
Final Shot: Orbits to the right side of the character, the camera position changes to an overhead shot, the lens gradually pulls back at an extremely slow speed, the transformation is complete, and the character ejects and takes off vertically towards the upper front, flying out of the frame. The lens shakes due to the huge airflow and heat wave.

entries.prompt:
16:9 横屏，国漫电影级画面，金白圣光色调。
0-3 秒：断崖之上乌云密布，少年剑客跪地双手握住插在岩石中的古剑，娃娃脸配圆眼，单眼皮，黑发凌乱被汗浸湿，古剑周围符文流转发出嗡鸣，镜头从俯视缓慢旋转下降。
4-7 秒：天空魔族大军压境，为首魔将手持黑色战戈，方脸配络腮胡，眼眶中燃烧绿色鬼火，挥手示意大军进攻，无数黑色箭矢如蝗虫般射向少年，镜头快速推近。
8-12 秒：少年猛然拔出古剑，金白光芒冲天而起驱散乌云，剑身上龙纹苏醒发出龙吟，少年挥剑斩出金色剑气将所有箭矢化为齑粉，镜头跟随剑气轨迹高速推进。
13-15 秒：少年踏空而起，身后浮现金色巨龙虚影，一剑斩向魔将，魔将举戈格挡却被一剑斩断兵器并从肩膀到部劈开，金色光芒笼罩整个战场，魔族大军惊恐后退，画面定格在少年持剑俯视的剪影，身后阳光刺破云层。
音效：剑身嗡鸣、龙吟震天、箭矢碎裂、魔族惊呼。
禁止：任何文字、字幕、LOGO 或水印。
entries.translated_prompt:
16:9 horizontal screen, Chinese animation cinematic quality, gold and white holy light color palette.
0-3 seconds: Dark clouds gather above a broken cliff. A young swordsman kneels, gripping an ancient sword plunged into the rock with both hands. He has a baby face with round eyes, single eyelids, and messy black hair soaked with sweat. Runes flow around the ancient sword, emitting a hum. The camera slowly rotates and descends from an overhead view.
4-7 seconds: The demon army presses down from the sky. The leading demon general holds a black war halberd, has a square face with a beard, and green ghost fire burns in his eye sockets. He gestures for the army to attack. Countless black arrows shoot towards the young man like locusts. The camera quickly pushes in.
8-12 seconds: The young man suddenly draws the ancient sword. Gold and white light shoots up into the sky, dispersing the dark clouds. The dragon pattern on the sword awakens and emits a dragon roar. The young man swings the sword, cutting out a golden sword energy that pulverizes all the arrows. The camera follows the trajectory of the sword energy at high speed.
13-15 seconds: The young man steps into the air, and a golden giant dragon phantom appears behind him. He strikes the demon general with a single sword. The demon general raises his halberd to block but the weapon is cut off and the general is split from shoulder to torso by the sword. Golden light envelops the entire battlefield. The demon army retreats in terror. The frame freezes on the silhouette of the young man holding the sword and looking down, with sunlight piercing through the clouds behind him.
Sound effects: Sword humming, dragon roar shaking the sky, arrows shattering, demon screams.
Prohibited: Any text, subtitles, LOGO, or watermark.

entries.title: Epic fantasy movie scene generation using SJinn Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed multi-shot prompt designed to generate a 15-second continuous action sequence, structured with a clear narrative arc (Kishōtenketsu) and cinematic quality, featuring a fairy, a monster, and a warrior on a wyvern.
entries.prompt:
【映像構成】ファンタジー映画のクライマックスを再現した、起承転結のある15秒間（4ショット）の連続アクション映像。 

【映像スタイル】超高品質なフォトリアル・シネマティック映像。突き抜けるような青空、物理演算に基づいた衣装のなびき、ダイナミックなカメラワーク。

 【キャラクター】 1. 妖精：茶色のベレー帽、白いドレス、背中に虹色の透明な羽。 2. モンスター：巨大で禍々しい影のような怪物。 3. 戦士：銀の甲冑を纏った、白髪ロングヘアの絶世の美女。巨大な翼を持つ飛ぶ恐竜（ワイバーン）に跨っている。 

【Shot 1: 緊迫の逃走】（初期フレームから開始）白亜の巨大な階段にうずくまっていた妖精が、背後の異変に「ハッ」として立ち上がり、必死に階段を駆け上がっていく。カメラは背後から彼女を激しく追いかける。 

【Shot 2: モンスターの追撃】階段の下から巨大なモンスターが恐ろしいスピードで這い上がり、少女の足元にまで迫る。階段の石が砕け散る中、少女は塔の頂上へと追い詰められる。 

【Shot 3: 決死のダイブ】塔の端に到達した少女。一瞬だけ躊躇するが、意を決して後ろを振り向かずに真っ逆さまに空へと身を投じる。カメラは彼女の傍らを並走しながら、急速に地面へ向かって落下するPOV視点。 

【Shot 4: 翼の救出】塔の下方、眩しい光の中から飛ぶ恐竜に乗った白髪の女戦士が猛スピードで現れる。戦士は手を伸ばして空中で少女をガッシリと受け止め、力強く抱きかかえる。

 【Shot 5: 希望の空へ】戦士を乗せた飛竜が大きく翼を広げ、急上昇して画面を横切る。二人は眼下に広がる白亜の美しい街並みに向かって、風を切りながら優雅に飛んでいく。逆光の中で二人のシルエットが輝いて終わる。

[Video Composition] A 15-second continuous action video (4 shots) with a narrative arc (Kishōtenketsu), recreating the climax of a fantasy movie. 

[Video Style] Ultra-high quality photorealistic cinematic footage. Piercing blue sky, physically calculated movement of clothing, dynamic camera work.

 [Characters] 1. Fairy: Brown beret, white dress, transparent rainbow wings on her back. 2. Monster: A huge, ominous, shadow-like creature. 3. Warrior: An unparalleled beauty with long white hair, clad in silver armor, riding a flying dinosaur (Wyvern) with giant wings. 

[Shot 1: Tense Escape] (Starting from the initial frame) A fairy, who was crouching on a huge white staircase, notices a disturbance behind her, stands up with a start, and desperately runs up the stairs. The camera fiercely chases her from behind. 

[Shot 2: Monster's Pursuit] A giant monster crawls up from the bottom of the stairs at terrifying speed, closing in on the girl's feet. As the stone of the stairs shatters, the girl is cornered at the top of the tower. 

[Shot 3: Desperate Dive] The girl reaches the edge of the tower. She hesitates for a moment, but then resolutely throws herself backward into the sky without looking back. The camera runs alongside her, showing a POV shot of rapidly falling towards the ground. 

[Shot 4: Winged Rescue] From below the tower, a white-haired female warrior riding a flying dinosaur appears at full speed from a dazzling light. The warrior reaches out, firmly catches the girl in mid-air, and powerfully embraces her.

 [Shot 5: Towards the Sky of Hope] The flying dragon carrying the warrior spreads its wings wide and rapidly ascends, crossing the screen. The two fly gracefully through the wind towards the beautiful white city spread out below them. The video ends with their silhouettes shining against the backlight.

entries.prompt: [这两张图片是一段竹林武打戏的两个女主，请围绕两个女主生成一段流畅的对手戏，经典武侠仙侠电影风格，密集的翠绿竹林，落叶纷飞。超高速摄影，完全真人实拍，需要运用到分镜和不同视角切换，让整个画面更有节奏感和电影感，画面强烈的视觉冲击。仅生成打斗音效和环境的音效，不要配背景音乐。镜头1：中景，白衣女子率出剑攻击，青衣女子快速旋转闪避，并给予一剑。镜头2：特写镜头 ，白衣女子挥剑格挡。随后，镜头切中远景，白衣女子向后滑行，青衣女子持剑紧随，地面尘土飞扬，镜头跟随移动。镜头3：中远景，环移跟随，两人在竹林互相对剑，画面强烈的视觉冲击 。镜头4：特写镜头，白衣女子剑突然断裂。随后切中景，青衣女子一剑对准白衣女子喉咙，并收剑注意白衣女子全程拿的是白色的剑，青衣女子拿的是黑色剑刃的剑（必须是黑色的剑刃），完全跟参考图保持一致，二人都是单手持剑，另一只没有拿任何东西。]
entries.translated_prompt: [These two images are the two female leads of a bamboo forest martial arts scene. Please generate a fluid duel scene around the two female leads, in the style of classic Wuxia Xianxia movies, dense emerald green bamboo forest, falling leaves flying. Ultra-high-speed photography, completely real-person shooting, requiring the use of storyboards and different perspective switching to make the whole picture more rhythmic and cinematic, with strong visual impact. Only generate fighting sound effects and environmental sound effects, do not add background music. Shot 1: Medium shot, the woman in white attacks with her sword first, the woman in cyan quickly spins to dodge, and counters with a sword strike. Shot 2: Close-up shot, the woman in white swings her sword to parry. Then, the shot cuts to a medium-long shot, the woman in white slides backward, the woman in cyan follows closely with her sword, dust flies on the ground, the camera follows the movement. Shot 3: Medium-long shot, orbiting follow, the two exchange sword blows in the bamboo forest, strong visual impact. Shot 4: Close-up shot, the woman in white's sword suddenly breaks. Then cuts to a medium shot, the woman in cyan points her sword at the woman in white's throat, and then withdraws the sword. Note that the woman in white holds a white sword throughout, and the woman in cyan holds a sword with a black blade (must be a black blade), completely consistent with the reference images. Both hold the sword with one hand, the other hand holds nothing.]

entries.title: Ancient Style Fairy Sister Video Prompt for Seedance 2.0 (Detailed Scene Breakdown)
entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a 15-second video featuring a 'Little Fairy Sister' in an ancient Chinese style. The prompt includes specific style requirements, character design, background, content, and a six-shot storyboard with precise camera movements, actions, and special effects for each 2.5-second segment.
entries.prompt: 风格：仙气古风、清新甜美、第一视角沉浸式跟随、柔光唯美 总时长：15s = 6 个分镜 × 2.5s / 镜（单镜≤3s，符合要求） 核心人设：小师妹｜月白浅粉渐变纱衣、广袖飘逸、满头blingbling 珍珠碎钻发簪、眉眼清甜、软萌灵动 背景：仙门古建（飞檐回廊、桃花枝、青石地、薄雾、宫灯、流水） 内容：小师妹主动带路参观 + 即兴轻舞，沉浸式治愈感 完整分镜脚本（动作极详细，即梦直接适配） 镜头 1｜2.5s｜第一视角跟随・近景 + 慢推 运镜：第一视角向前慢推，沉浸式迎面走来 画面 & 动作： 小师妹站在古建回廊口，侧身回头对你笑，眼弯成月牙； 右手轻轻撩起一侧纱袖，左手自然垂在身侧，发簪随转头闪细碎光； 脚尖轻点青石地，小碎步上前，主动伸手做「跟我来」的邀请手势。 背景：木质飞檐、垂挂白纱、淡粉桃花枝、薄雾轻绕 特效：发丝柔光、发簪碎钻反光、浅淡花瓣粒子 镜头 2｜2.5s｜侧跟运镜・中景・移步参观 运镜：第一视角侧跟，平稳移动 画面 & 动作： 小师妹转身带路，广袖纱衣随风轻飘； 左手轻扶回廊木栏，右手自然摆动，步伐轻盈小碎步； 路过桃花枝时，抬手轻轻拂过花瓣，指尖碰落两瓣桃花，回头对你甜甜眨眼。 背景：古建回廊、青石步道、垂枝桃花、朦胧宫灯 特效：花瓣飘落、裙摆动态飘纱、发簪流光 镜头 3｜2.5s｜环绕运镜・中景・庭院驻足 运镜：慢环绕小师妹半圈，沉浸式看庭院全景 画面 & 动作： 走到庭院中央，小师妹停下转身面向你； 双手背在身后，脚尖微微踮起，歪头笑，介绍庭院； 发簪随歪头晃动，blingbling 反光，纱衣下摆轻旋。 背景：仙门古建庭院、石桌石凳、薄雾、远山飞檐、满庭桃花 特效：地面柔光、淡雾流动、花瓣慢落 镜头 4｜2.5s｜近景推镜・起手式・预备跳舞 运镜：镜头快速轻推至半身近景 画面 & 动作： 小师妹轻声一笑，双手缓缓抬起至肩侧，广袖自然展开； 左脚轻踏半步，重心微侧，身体微微后仰，做古典舞起手式； 眉眼温柔，发丝轻扬，发簪在柔光下闪钻光，仙气拉满。 背景：虚化古建庭院，聚焦人物 特效：袖摆流光、周身淡粉色仙气光晕、细碎星光粒子 镜头 5｜2.5s｜全景俯拍・轻舞旋转・核心表演 运镜：轻俯拍 + 小幅环绕，唯美全景 画面 & 动作： 小师妹原地小旋身 1 圈，广袖纱衣完全展开如花瓣； 右手高举拂袖过头顶，左手轻按腰侧，脚尖点地小跳； 舞步轻柔，裙摆飘飞，发簪随旋转闪连续亮光，笑容甜美。 背景：古建飞檐、满庭桃花、薄雾环绕、沉浸式全景 特效：旋身带粉色光尾、花瓣随舞步飞起、仙气雾效 镜头 6｜2.5s｜近景定格・收尾比心・甜美收尾 运镜：镜头拉回近景，轻微定格 画面 & 动作： 旋身停下，小师妹面向你，双手在脸颊旁比出小巧爱心； 头轻轻歪向一侧，甜甜笑，发簪垂落碎光； 纱袖轻垂，脚步站稳，温柔收尾。 背景：模糊古建 + 桃花，柔光特写 特效：爱心淡光效、发簪 blingbling 高光、花瓣收尾飘落 即梦「一键复制」生成指令（逐镜直接粘贴） 镜头 1（2.5s） 第一视角沉浸式，古风仙气小师妹，月白浅粉纱衣，满头 blingbling 珍珠钻发簪，清新甜美，回廊口回头笑，小碎步上前伸手邀请，古建飞檐白纱桃花，薄雾柔光，发簪反光，花瓣粒子，唯美古风，高清流畅 镜头 2（2.5s） 第一视角侧跟，仙气小师妹带路，轻扶古建木栏，拂过桃花枝，回头眨眼甜笑，广袖纱衣飘逸，青石回廊桃花，动态飘纱，发簪流光，花瓣飘落，沉浸式古风，高清 镜头 3（2.5s） 慢环绕运镜，仙气小师妹庭院驻足，背手踮脚歪头笑，介绍庭院，古建庭院石桌桃花，薄雾柔光，发簪 blingbling 反光，清新甜美，沉浸式古风，高清 镜头 4（2.5s） 轻推近景，仙气小师妹古典舞起手式，抬手展袖，侧身踮脚，眉眼温柔，纱衣广袖飘逸，发簪钻光，周身淡粉仙气光晕，星光粒子，唯美古风，高清 镜头 5（2.5s） 轻俯拍环绕，仙气小师妹轻舞旋身 1 圈，广袖展开如花瓣，踮脚小跳拂袖，裙摆飘飞，古建庭院桃花薄雾，旋身光尾花瓣飞舞，发簪流光，高燃唯美古风，高清 镜头 6（2.5s） 近景定格，仙气小师妹跳舞跳舞收尾，双手比心歪头甜笑，纱袖轻垂，发簪碎钻高光，爱心光效，桃花花瓣收尾，古建柔光背景，清新甜美仙气，高清流

entries.title: Cinematic Horror Thriller Video Prompt
entries.description: A detailed, multi-shot video prompt for Seedance 2.0, designed to generate a cinematic horror thriller scene. It specifies film style, duration, protagonist, a three-shot storyboard script with actions, camera movements, environmental details, and technical parameters like HDR lighting and volumetric fog for a high-quality, suspenseful output.
entries.prompt: Seedance 2.0...【Film Style】 Cinematic horror thriller, modern supernatural suspense film, dark forest atmosphere, volumetric fog, moody blue night lighting, realistic flashlight illumination, slow tension building, dramatic horror soundtrack atmosphere. 【Duration】 12 seconds  【Protagonist】 A young woman alone in a dark forest at night holding a flashlight, cautiously approaching a small abandoned wooden cabin. 【Storyboard Script】 [00:00–00:05] Shot 1: Arrival & Approach Scene: A misty forest at night with tall pine trees surrounding an old wooden cabin. Action: The woman slowly walks toward the cabin holding a flashlight. The beam cuts through drifting fog and illuminates tree trunks and the cabin porch. Camera: Wide cinematic tracking shot moving slowly behind her, matching the arrival and approach frames from the storyboard. [00:05–00:9] Shot 2: Suspense & Awareness Action: She stops walking and slowly turns her head as if she hears something in the woods. Her breathing becomes tense. Camera: The camera pushes in from medium shot to a close-up of her worried face while the flashlight beam trembles slightly. Environmental Detail: Fog drifts between trees, the cabin creaks quietly, and distant forest sounds echo. [00:09–00:12] Shot 3: Fear & Vulnerability Action: She raises the flashlight and slowly scans the forest around her. Her eyes dart nervously between the trees. Dialogue Cue: In a soft, nervous British accent she calls out quietly, **"Hello?"** Performance Direction: Her voice trembles slightly as if she is unsure whether she wants an answer. Camera: Close-up on her face illuminated by the flashlight beam, then slowly pulling back to reveal how alone she is in the dark forest. Atmosphere: Fog thickens and the forest grows silent as she waits for a response. 【Technical Parameters】 Cinematic depth of field, HDR night lighting, volumetric fog particles, realistic flashlight light scattering, subtle handheld tension, dramatic horror color grading.

entries.title: One-shot Wuxia epic with cinematic camera work
entries.description: A detailed Chinese prompt for Seedance 2.0 to generate a continuous, one-shot Wuxia (martial arts) epic video in the visual aesthetic of Tsui Hark, emphasizing high frame rate, 4K resolution, specific color grading, and complex camera movements (low-angle back follow, 180° orbit, push-in through waterfall, slow pull-out, close-up freeze frame). The prompt also specifies a three-part action sequence (starting, breaking shadow, chasing shadow, concluding) and requires three reference images for character appearance and scene setting.

entries.title: Video Script for 'Accidentally Touching Girlfriend' using Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed video script prompt for Seedance 2.0, outlining character settings, scene details, and a full 9-second storyboard with specific actions, dialogue, and visual effects to create a humorous short video about a boyfriend accidentally touching his girlfriend's leg.
entries.prompt:
【人物设定】
• 男生： 约20出头，发型清爽，穿着白色长袖衬衫、黑色长裤。性格看起来有点憨厚，眼神透着“清纯的愚蠢”。
• 女生： 约20出头，长发齐刘海，穿着日系JK制服（白色短袖衬衫、深蓝色蝴蝶结领结、深蓝色百褶裙、黑丝袜）。性格反转极大，从文静到“霸总”。
【场景设定】
• 地点： 卧室床边。
• 背景： 浅灰色褶皱窗帘，床铺整洁，光线柔和。
【脚本内容】
00:00 - 00:01
• 画面： 两人并排坐在床边。女生手里抱着一袋零食在吃。
• 文字标题（居上）： 当你小心摸到女朋友
• 人物状态： 男生眼神呆滞地盯着前方（模拟看电视），女生面无表情地咀嚼。
00:01 - 00:02
• 画面： 男生自然地伸手去女生怀里的零食袋里掏吃的。
• 字幕： 一起看电视~
• 表情： 男生很淡定，心思全在“电视”上。
00:02 - 00:04
• 画面： 男生从袋子里拿出一块零食塞进嘴里，嚼得津津有味。
• 字幕： 拿吃的
• 表情： 两人维持着平静的观影气氛。
00:04 - 00:05
• 画面： 男生再次伸手去拿，但这次没对准袋子，手直接按在了女生的腿上（大腿位置）。
• 字幕： 继续拿……
• 动作： 男生的手不仅放上去了，还稍微停顿了一下，显然还没反应过来。
00:05 - 00:06
• 画面： 画面瞬间定格感。女生停止咀嚼，缓缓转头盯着男生的手，再看向男生的脸。
• 字幕： 摸我？
• 表情变化： * 女生： 眼神从疑惑瞬间转为一种“阴谋得逞”的坏笑。
• 男生： 瞳孔地震，嘴巴微张，整个人僵住，满脸写着“我不是故意的，药丸”。
00:06 - 00:07
• 画面： 女生突然放下零食袋，一个“饿虎扑食”的姿势向男生逼近。男生惊慌失措地举起双手做防御状，身体往后仰。
• 字幕： 你先动手的哦~
• 台词（男生）： “不是这个意思，我不是……”
00:07 - 00:09
• 画面： 背景音乐变得急促/动感。女生跨坐过去（动作幅度大，带点霸道感），男生已经退无可退，缩在床角。
• 字幕： 真的不要……
• 表情： 女生笑得非常灿烂（带点调皮的压迫感），男生一脸惊恐但又透着某种无奈的顺从。
• 视觉效果： 画面最后伴随动感的卡点音乐快速剪辑，营造出一种“男生在劫难逃”的幽默氛围。
entries.translated_prompt:
【Character Settings】
• Male: Around 20 years old, neat hairstyle, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers. Personality appears somewhat simple and honest, with eyes conveying “pure foolishness.”
• Female: Around 20 years old, long hair with straight bangs, wearing a Japanese JK uniform (white short-sleeved shirt, dark blue bow tie, dark blue pleated skirt, black stockings). Personality has a huge reversal, from quiet and gentle to a “dominant CEO” type.
【Scene Settings】
• Location: Beside the bed in the bedroom.
• Background: Light gray pleated curtains, tidy bed, soft lighting.
【Script Content】
00:00 - 00:01
• Scene: The two are sitting side-by-side on the bed. The girl is holding a bag of snacks and eating.
• Text Title (Top): When you accidentally touch your girlfriend
• Character Status: The boy stares blankly ahead (simulating watching TV), the girl chews expressionlessly.
00:01 - 00:02
• Scene: The boy naturally reaches into the girl's snack bag to grab something to eat.
• Subtitle: Watching TV together~
• Expression: The boy is calm, his mind entirely focused on the “TV.”
00:02 - 00:04
• Scene: The boy takes a piece of snack from the bag and puts it in his mouth, chewing with relish.
• Subtitle: Grabbing snacks
• Expression: The two maintain a calm atmosphere while watching.
00:04 - 00:05
• Scene: The boy reaches out again to grab, but this time misses the bag, and his hand lands directly on the girl's leg (thigh area).
• Subtitle: Keep grabbing…
• Action: The boy's hand not only landed but paused slightly, clearly not having realized what happened yet.
00:05 - 00:06
• Scene: The frame instantly freezes. The girl stops chewing, slowly turns her head to stare at the boy's hand, then looks at his face.
• Subtitle: Touching me?
• Expression Change: * Girl: Her eyes instantly shift from confusion to a mischievous smile of “scheme successful.”
• Boy: Pupils dilate, mouth slightly open, body frozen, face screaming “I didn’t mean to, I’m doomed.”
00:06 - 00:07
• Scene: The girl suddenly puts down the snack bag and lunges towards the boy in a “hungry tiger pouncing” posture. The boy raises his hands defensively in panic, leaning his body backward.
• Subtitle: You started it~
• Dialogue (Boy): “That’s not what I meant, I wasn’t…”
00:07 - 00:09
• Scene: The background music becomes rapid/dynamic. The girl straddles him (large, slightly dominant movement), the boy has nowhere to retreat, shrinking into the corner of the bed.
• Subtitle: Really don’t want to…
• Expression: The girl smiles brightly (with a playful sense of oppression), the boy looks terrified but with a certain helpless compliance.
• Visual Effect: The scene ends with rapid cuts synchronized with dynamic music, creating a humorous atmosphere of “the boy is doomed.”

entries.title: Street Interview Style Video Script for Seedance 2.0
entries.description: A detailed 15-second video script prompt for Seedance 2.0, designed in a vertical (9:16) street interview style with strong realism. The script covers dialogue, scene changes, character actions, and sound effects related to people queuing up for the 'OpenClaw' AI service.
entries.prompt:
9:16竖屏，街访风格，真实感强烈。
0 - 2秒：镜头对着长长的队伍，博主（圆脸女生）对着镜头说："武汉！凌晨三点！这些人排队干嘛？火锅？不！" 镜头快速推进到队伍末尾。
3 - 6秒：镜头采访排队小哥（戴眼镜），博主问："兄弟，排啥呢？"小哥激动地说："吃虾！OpenClaw！听说安装包要抢！"后面大妈探头："这是啥虾？麻辣还是蒜蓉？"
7 - 10秒：镜头切到队伍前方，一个程序员模样的男生对着镜头说："我排了6小时！终于轮到我养龙虾了！"画面到他疯狂点击手机屏幕，配"恭喜你领养成功"音效。
11 - 15秒：镜头回到博主，她站在空荡荡的队伍位置说："结果服务器崩了，大家白排。"旁边一个男生抱头痛哭。镜头定格在博主无奈比OK手势和"龙虾太火了"弹幕特效飘过。
音效：街道嘈杂、哭声、搞笑"完了"音效、"下次早点来"配音。
entries.translated_prompt:
9:16 vertical screen, street interview style, strong sense of realism.
0 - 2 seconds: Camera focuses on a long queue, the blogger (round-faced girl) says to the camera: "Wuhan! Three in the morning! What are these people queuing for? Hotpot? No!" The camera quickly pushes to the end of the line.
3 - 6 seconds: Camera interviews a guy in the queue (wearing glasses), the blogger asks: "Bro, what are you queuing for?" The guy excitedly says: "Eating shrimp! OpenClaw! I heard the installation package is hard to grab!" An auntie behind him peeks in: "What kind of shrimp is that? Spicy or garlic?"
7 - 10 seconds: Camera cuts to the front of the line, a guy who looks like a programmer says to the camera: "I've been queuing for 6 hours! Finally, it's my turn to raise the lobster!" The screen shows him frantically tapping his phone screen, accompanied by a "Congratulations on your successful adoption" sound effect.
11 - 15 seconds: Camera returns to the blogger, standing where the queue used to be, saying: "Turns out the server crashed, everyone queued for nothing." A guy next to her is crying with his head in his hands. The camera freezes on the blogger making a helpless OK gesture and a "Lobster is too hot" bullet screen effect floating past.
Sound effects: Street noise, crying, funny "It's over" sound effect, "Come earlier next time" voiceover.

entries.description: An extremely detailed, multi-paragraph prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing an ultra-wide-angle macro FPV tracking sequence of a cat in an abandoned underground parking structure, focusing on fragmented glimpses, high frame rate, and dramatic lighting.
entries.prompt: Ultra-wide-angle macro FPV tracking sequence following a cat. The feline is never fully revealed; only fragmented glimpses pass the lens: the twitch of an ear, scattered whiskers, a paw brushing the floor, a swath of fur gliding past the camera. Focus continuously shifts between these fleeting details and nearby environmental hazards. Shot at 120fps to capture subtle tremors and high-frequency vibrations as the cat bounds and lands. Setting: An abandoned underground parking structure. Textured concrete floor, numbered pillars with faded, indecipherable markings, shallow puddles and tire tracks reflecting harsh light. Dust particles and condensation mist hang in the air. Sparse cold-white ceiling LEDs mingle with distant vehicle headlights, creating sharp contrast and deep shadows. The cavernous space resonates with emptiness and tension. Movement: The cat navigates unpredictably—darting through narrow gaps, executing sudden 90° pivots, explosive bursts of speed, and tight lateral rolls that skim edges of doors and guardrails. The camera mirrors its frenetic rhythm, micro-vibrating with the steps and accentuating exaggerated motion parallax as pillars and parked cars streak past. Key interaction: A gust of wind—generated by ventilation and a passing car—lifts loose debris: paper scraps, plastic bags, and dust swirl into a spiraling vortex. As the cat rockets forward, debris stretches into radial motion blur lines, enhanced by fisheye distortion. A rolling tire splashes a puddle, scattering droplets that refract light realistically. Climactic moment: A car’s headlight suddenly sweeps across the scene, reflecting sharply off the wet floor. The cat skids into a chaotic spiral, claws gripping the slick surface, fur vibrating, droplets flinging outward—captured in 120fps slow motion. Motion instantly resumes at high speed as the cat races along the ramp edge, hugging walls, and threads through a half-open maintenance door or narrow fence gap, escaping into safety. Atmosphere: Claustrophobic, urgent, and tense, yet ultimately triumphant. Sound design emphasizes rushing air, splashing water, metallic echoes from guardrails, and residual vibrations. The sequence concludes as the cat lands in a shadowy corner, with the camera’s lingering tremors gradually fading into stillness.

entries.title: Candid Late-Night Pizza Moment with Handheld Camcorder Aesthetic
entries.description: A highly detailed prompt designed to generate a video of a young woman eating pizza in bed, captured with a close-up, wide-angle, handheld camera aesthetic. The prompt specifies lighting (harsh on-camera flash), texture details (wrinkled sheets, glistening oil), and motion (slow lowering of the slice, cheese stretching and snapping) to achieve a candid, analog, pre-digital feel.
entries.prompt:
A dim bedroom lit by a harsh on-camera flash. White bedsheets fill most of the frame, slightly wrinkled and textured. An open pizza box sits nearby on the bed, its lid tilted back, revealing a partially eaten pizza.

A young woman lies on her back across the bed, head tilted slightly toward the camera. She wears a playful shirt patterned with cartoon pizza slices. Her hair spreads across the pillow.

The camera is held very close above her with a wide consumer lens, creating slight perspective distortion. The flash flattens shadows and creates glossy highlights on her eyes and the pizza grease.

She lifts a slice of pepperoni pizza above her face.

Slowly, she lowers it toward her mouth.

The cheese stretches slightly from the slice as it moves. Oil glistens on the pepperoni under the flash. The slice bends naturally as gravity pulls the tip downward.

She takes a bite.

The crust compresses between her fingers. The cheese pulls and separates unevenly as she bites through it. A small strand of melted cheese briefly stretches before snapping.

Her eyes remain fixed toward the camera as she chews.

The camera remains very close and handheld, shifting slightly as if the person filming adjusts their grip. The flash creates harsh reflections across the pizza box and glossy toppings.

Image quality shows consumer analog artifacts: visible grain, slight color noise in darker areas, mild softness, and faint exposure fluctuation.

The camera lingers as she continues eating casually, the pizza slice slowly disappearing bite by bite.

Overall feeling: intimate, playful, and candid — a messy late-night pizza moment captured with a handheld camcorder in a pre-digital bedroom setting.

 [00:05-00:10] 镜头2：牛顿定律失效 镜头感：快速与慢动作高频切换。英雄瞬移加速冲入人群。动作：英雄使出一记回旋踢。目标受击后瞬间撞倒身后十人，产生夸张的骨牌效应。特效奇观：巨大的冲击波将地面的尘士全部震开。所有杂鱼在接触英雄胶体的瞬间，身体炸裂出大量白色粉尘（代替血腥感）向四周弹射，撞碎周围的木箱和道具。 
[00:10-00:15] 镜头3：终极终结技 镜头感：英雄摘下墨镜，对着镜头露出一抹迷人的邪魅一笑（眨眼）。动作：一辆吉普车全速朝他冲来。 既不躲闪也不畏惧，抬腿就是一记正前踢。特效奇观：吉普车像玩具车一样被垂直踢飞，在触碰到他脚尖的瞬间翻滚解体，零件四散。在漫天下的汽车零件和飞舞的喽啰背景下，英雄淡定地重新戴上墨镜，理了理头发。

entries.prompt:

【作画スタイル】極めて美麗な水中作画。海面に差し込む光の筋（ゴッドレイ）、きらめく気泡、圧倒的な透明感を持つ高品質な2Dセルルックアニメ。

【キャラクター】白いフリルのワンピースを着た、透き通るような肌をもつショートヘアの美しい少女。そして神々しく輝く一頭のイルカ。

【Shot 1: 海の微睡み】水中のクロースアップ。目を閉じた少女が、頭上から差し込む眩しい光の筋を浴びながら、無数の気泡に包まれて幻想的に美しく漂っている。

【Shot 2: 劇的な出逢い】別アングルへのカット切り替え。光の奥から、きらきらと輝く美しいイルカが泳いでやってくる。少女はゆっくりと目を開け、イルカを見つけて優しく微笑む。

【Shot 3: 蒼の旅路】ダイナミックなトラッキング（追従）カメラ。少女がイルカの背中につかまり、二人は光り輝く美しい海の世界を軽快なスピードで泳いでいく。白いワンピースが水流でドラマチックにはためく。

【Shot 4: 光への上昇】海面を真下から見上げるアングル。イルカと少女が、眩しい太陽の光が差す海面（ゴール）に向かって、一気に水を蹴って猛スピードで急上昇していく。光がどんどん強くなる。

【Shot 5: 最高の笑顔】（POV・主観ショット）「ザバーッ！」と豪快な水飛沫を上げて、海面から眩しい青空の上空へと飛び出す。レンズに水滴が付着する。抜けるような青い空と強烈な太陽光の下、少女がカメラに向かって目を輝かせ、キラキラとした「最高の笑顔（満面の笑み）」を見せて終わる。

entries.title: Epic Space Combat Scene with Cosmic Energy and Zero-Gravity Camera
entries.description: A detailed prompt for generating an epic space combat video between a woman in a flowing combat coat and an alien warrior in crystalline armor. The scene is set in an asteroid field above a nebula, featuring continuous action, rapid teleportation, gravity-defying strikes, and massive gravity pulses. The prompt specifies cinematic rendering, hyper-realistic space lighting, and dynamic camera work with velocity ramps.
entries.prompt:
A woman in her late 20s wearing a flowing black combat coat threaded with glowing silver star patterns leaps across fragments of shattered asteroids drifting in deep space.

Facing her is a tall alien warrior clad in crystalline armor emitting pulsating violet energy from within its translucent body.

She attacks in a continuous chain — rapid teleport dashes, spinning blade arcs, and gravity-defying aerial strikes that send waves of cosmic energy rippling through the asteroid field.

The alien warrior counters with massive gravity pulses that shatter nearby asteroids and fling debris outward like meteor storms.

Camera orbits the duel in sweeping zero-gravity arcs, drifting through the debris field while alternating between intense close-up blade clashes and wide celestial views of the asteroid battlefield.

Velocity ramps drive the spectacle — attacks accelerate into blinding flashes while key impacts freeze momentarily, showing fragments of rock and energy suspended in the void before motion resumes.

Environment: a drifting asteroid field above a glowing nebula, distant planets visible through clouds of cosmic dust.

Soft nebula light in blues and purples illuminates the scene while bright energy bursts from the combatants create dramatic diegetic flashes across floating debris.

Hyper-realistic space lighting, cinematic rendering, volumetric nebula clouds, cinematic grain, 8K resolution.

 【Shot 1: 極限の疾走】超高速トラッキングカメラ。夜のメガシティの空中ハイウェイを少女が猛スピードで駆け抜ける。彼女はカメラに向かって大きく口を開け、「アハハハハ！」と口を動かして笑う。

In the collapsing architecture, the warrior performs a wall-running dodge, transitioning into an aerial backflip, concluding with a ground shockwave that repels surrounding enemies in a circle of dust and energy. Final burst: the warrior channels her inner strength, her entire body glowing, unleashing a torrent of slashes and shots in all directions. entries.title: Domestic Catastrophe: Expanding Soap Foam Fills Neighborhood
entries.description: A creative prompt for a video starting with a mundane first-person view of dispensing soap, which then rapidly expands into an overwhelming volume of foam, filling a house and eventually covering the entire neighborhood block. The prompt emphasizes scale shift, velocity ramp, photorealistic soap physics, and a deadpan domestic catastrophe tone.
entries.prompt: First-person POV camera looking down at two hands in latex kitchen gloves pressing a soap dispenser at a bathroom sink, a completely ordinary domestic morning. The soap emerges. At the 2-second mark the foam expands beyond the palm still expanding, pushing both hands outward, filling the sink basin in four seconds, overflowing the counter in six. Camera pulls back as the foam volume doubles every two seconds: doorframe, hallway, staircase, the foam moving with the same even pressure in all directions simultaneously, furniture disappearing beneath the surface. The camera is riding the foam's leading edge, always just ahead of submersion. Outside window visible at the midpoint: the foam is exiting the house from every opening. Aerial pull-back reveals the entire neighborhood block going white. Warm bathroom light transitioning to overcast outdoor grey as scale expands. Foam-expansion velocity ramp, scale-shift reveal, deadpan domestic catastrophe, photorealistic soap physics, 4K.

entries.title: Cyberpunk Motorcycle Chase Sequence in Seoul
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-stage cinematic prompt for Seedance 2.0 describing a high-speed cyberpunk motorcycle chase through downtown Seoul at night, including a jump, a landing on a moving truck, a spiral garage drift, and an exit onto a rain-soaked boulevard. The prompt specifies character appearance, gear, camera angles, and lighting effects.
entries.prompt:
A man in his early 30s, tan skin, short windswept hair, wearing a matte-black armored riding jacket with reflective blue seams, carbon fiber riding pants, and reinforced boots, launches a high-powered sport motorbike off the edge of an elevated highway ramp in downtown Seoul at the 2-second mark — the bike suspended above dense night traffic as LED billboards and neon street signs illuminate the machine from below.

The motorcycle rotates sideways in a controlled whip, sparks trailing briefly from the rear frame as the rider corrects mid-air. Camera positioned from a nearby rooftop captures the full silhouette of rider and bike against the glowing city grid — skyscraper windows reflecting streaks of motion while the highway curves beneath.

He lands violently on the roof of a moving delivery truck, suspension compressing hard on impact, the metal roof buckling slightly. Without slowing, the rider accelerates forward, launching off the front of the truck toward a descending parking garage ramp.

Inside the spiral ramp he drifts along the concrete walls, tires screeching, the camera following in a tight circular chase shot as reflections from passing headlights sweep across the rider’s helmet.

Street level: the rider bursts out of the garage exit onto a rain-soaked boulevard, weaving through taxis and buses as neon reflections smear across the wet asphalt.

Seoul neon night, elevated highway stunt launch, moving truck rooftop landing, spiral garage descent drift, continuous high-speed motion, cinematic grain, 4K.

entries.title: Short Drama: 'The Dragon Turns Over: Ex Can't Reach'
entries.description: A highly detailed, multi-scene video prompt for a Seedance 2.0 short drama titled 'The Dragon Turns Over: Ex Can't Reach.' The prompt outlines a 45-second narrative involving workplace humiliation, identity reversal, and a dramatic firing sequence. It specifies camera angles (shaky subjective POV, slow motion, quick cuts), dialogue, micro-expressions, and sound effects across three acts (Betrayal, Return, Firing) to achieve a dramatic, high-stakes reversal.
entries.prompt:
《潜龙翻身：前任高攀不起》总时长： 45秒核心梗： 职场羞辱 + 身份反转 + 全员震惊 + 肃清门户 

第一幕：穷途末路 (The Betrayal)
时间： [00:00 - 00:15]场景： 拥挤沉闷的开放式办公区。
[00:00-00:05] 运镜：
（保持不变）主观视角手持摇晃。纸箱猛地被推到胸口。
[00:05-00:10] 动作与特写：前女友（苏倩）挽着新任经理（王经理）。她嫌弃地拍手，仿佛沾了灰。
[00:10-00:15] 对白与微表情：苏倩（刻薄）： “李泽，认命吧。王经理年薪五十万，而你？在这个工位坐到死也买不起我那个包。大家同事一场，自己滚吧。”微表情： 王经理油腻地推搡李泽肩膀。李泽低头，拳头死死攥紧，青筋暴起。

第二幕：王者归来 (The Return)
时间： [00:15 - 00:30]场景： 公司大会议室，全体员工列队，等待新老板。
[00:15-00:20] 运镜：
会议室大门被保镖猛地撞开。镜头给到李泽穿着高定西装、气场全开走进来的慢动作（Slow Motion）。
[00:20-00:25] 关键修改：群像反应 (Crowd Reaction)
镜头快速扫过会议桌两侧的普通员工：
有人正准备鼓掌欢迎，看到是李泽后，手僵在半空，嘴巴张大成“O”型。
曾经嘲笑过李泽的两个男同事，惊恐地对视一眼，迅速低下头假装看文件，瑟瑟发抖。
窃窃私语声瞬间消失，全场死寂，只有李泽皮鞋踩在地板上的声音。
[00:25-00:30] 动作与特写：苏倩原本在整理头发准备献媚，看到李泽瞬间，瞳孔剧烈收缩，下意识后退一步撞到椅子。
李泽无视所有人的目光，径直走到主位，拉开椅子，从容坐下。李泽（冷漠，环视全场）： “怎么，不认识我了？原管理层全员解聘。这家公司现在的姓——李。”

第三幕：清算时刻 (The Firing)
时间： [00:30 - 00:45]场景： 局势逆转，彻底清算。
[00:30-00:35] 动作与王经理反应：苏倩慌乱中扑向会议桌试图解释。关键修改：王经理反应
镜头给到王经理，他原本趾高气昂地站在副手位置，此刻双腿一软，直接瘫坐在地上。他颤抖着手想去拿桌上的水杯掩饰尴尬，结果手抖得太厉害，水杯“啪”地打翻，水洒了一裤裆，狼狈不堪。
[00:35-00:40] 对白与高潮：苏倩（带哭腔）： “阿泽！你听我解释，我那是为了刺激你上进！我心里只有你啊！”
李泽甚至没有正眼看她，只是嫌恶地用两根手指夹起桌上的《辞退通知书》，轻轻一扬。
[00:40-00:45] 结局与台词：
纸张像雪花一样散落在苏倩和瘫软的王经理身上。李泽站起身，整理了一下袖口，眼神冰冷如铁。李泽（一字一顿）：
“我买下这家公司，是为了大扫除。我的地盘，容不下垃圾。”
动作：
李泽说完，看都不看地上一眼，转身大步离去。画面处理：
镜头聚焦在李泽决绝的背影上，背景音效只有沉重的关门声——“嘭！”（全黑屏，无字幕，留白结束）
entries.translated_prompt:
“The Dragon Turns Over: Ex Can't Reach” Total Duration: 45 seconds Core Plot Points: Workplace Humiliation + Identity Reversal + Universal Shock + House Cleaning 

Act 1: The End of the Road (The Betrayal)
Time: [00:00 - 00:15] Scene: Crowded and dull open-plan office area.
[00:00-00:05] Camera Movement:
(Keep consistent) Subjective POV handheld shake. A cardboard box is violently pushed against the chest.
[00:05-00:10] Action and Close-up: Ex-girlfriend (Su Qian) is holding the arm of the new manager (Manager Wang). She claps her hands disdainfully, as if shaking off dust.
[00:10-00:15] Dialogue and Micro-expressions: Su Qian (meanly): “Li Ze, accept your fate. Manager Wang earns half a million a year, and you? You’ll sit in this cubicle until you die and still won't afford my bag. We were colleagues, now get out yourself.” Micro-expressions: Manager Wang greasily shoves Li Ze's shoulder. Li Ze lowers his head, fists clenched tightly, veins bulging.

Act 2: The Return of the King (The Return)
Time: [00:15 - 00:30] Scene: Company main conference room, all employees lined up, waiting for the new boss.
[00:15-00:20] Camera Movement:
The conference room door is violently slammed open by bodyguards. The camera gives a slow-motion shot (Slow Motion) of Li Ze walking in, wearing a bespoke suit and radiating powerful aura.
[00:20-00:25] Key Change: Crowd Reaction
The camera quickly scans the ordinary employees on both sides of the conference table:
Someone is about to applaud the welcome, sees it's Li Ze, their hand freezes mid-air, mouth wide open into an “O” shape.
Two male colleagues who used to mock Li Ze exchange terrified glances, quickly lower their heads pretending to look at documents, trembling.
The whispering instantly disappears, the whole room is dead silent, only the sound of Li Ze's leather shoes on the floor.
[00:25-00:30] Action and Close-up: Su Qian was originally tidying her hair, preparing to fawn, but the moment she sees Li Ze, her pupils contract violently, and she instinctively steps back, hitting a chair.
Li Ze ignores everyone's gaze, walks straight to the main seat, pulls out the chair, and sits down calmly. Li Ze (coldly, surveying the room): “What, don't you recognize me? The entire former management team is dismissed. The surname of this company is now—Li.”

Act 3: The Moment of Reckoning (The Firing)
Time: [00:30 - 00:45] Scene: The situation reverses, complete reckoning.
[00:30-00:35] Action and Manager Wang's Reaction: Su Qian rushes towards the conference table in panic, trying to explain. Key Change: Manager Wang's Reaction
The camera focuses on Manager Wang. He was originally standing arrogantly in the deputy position, but now his legs give way, and he collapses directly onto the floor. He trembles trying to grab the water cup on the table to cover his embarrassment, but his hand shakes too much, the cup overturns with a “pa” sound, spilling water all over his pants, looking utterly miserable.
[00:35-00:40] Dialogue and Climax: Su Qian (crying): “A-Ze! Listen to me, I did that to motivate you to improve! You are the only one in my heart!”
Li Ze doesn't even look her in the eye, but disgustedly uses two fingers to pick up the 'Termination Notice' from the table and lightly flicks it.
[00:40-00:45] Ending and Dialogue:
The papers scatter like snowflakes over Su Qian and the collapsed Manager Wang. Li Ze stands up, straightens his cuff, his eyes icy cold. Li Ze (word by word):
“I bought this company for a deep clean. My territory has no room for trash.”
Action:
After speaking, Li Ze walks away quickly without looking at the floor. Visual Treatment:
The camera focuses on Li Ze's resolute back, the only background sound is the heavy closing of the door—“BANG!” (Screen goes black, no subtitles, ends with white space)
